lmp: Ŋwà' ca yi ce suŋ àmbò ràrâ Jisos Krâis ce e m ba muu Dɛvìd, Dɛvìd à ba muu Abràhâm.
eng: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

lmp: Abràham à m bi Aisìk, Aisìk à bi Jakòp, Jakòp à bi Judà ba bfʉr vi.
eng: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

lmp: Judà à m bi Pɛrɛ̀s ba Sarɛ̀ ce yàp ma à m ba Tamàr. Pɛrɛ̀s à bi Ɛsiròm, Ɛsiròm à bi Râm.
eng: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

lmp: Ram à m bi Àminadàp, Àminadàp à bi Nashòn, Nashòn à bi Sarmòn.
eng: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

lmp: Sarmòn à m bi Buwàs ce yì ma à m ba Rahàp, Buwàs à bi Obɛ̀d ce yì ma à m ba Rûr, Obɛ̀d à bi Jɛɛsì.
eng: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

lmp: Jɛɛsì à m bi ŋkʉʉ Dɛvìd. Dɛvìd à bi Solomʉ̀n ce yì ma à m ba ŋgwa Yurìyà nà,
eng: Jesse became the father of King David. David became the father of Solomon by her who had been the wife of Uriah.

lmp: Solomʉ̀n à bi Rɛbùwàm, Rɛbùwàm à bi Àbijà, Àbijà à bi Asà.
eng: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

lmp: Asà à m bi Jɛsafàr, Jɛsafàr à bi Joràm, Joràm à bi Òsayà,
eng: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

lmp: Òsayà à bi Jotàm, Jotàm à bi Ɛhàr, Ɛhàr à bi Hɛ̀sìkayà.
eng: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

lmp: Hɛ̀sìkayà à m bi Mànasìs, Mànasìs à bi Amòn, Amòn à bi Jòsayà.
eng: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

lmp: Jòsayà à m bi Jɛ̀konàr ba bfʉr vi à nfè' ce a m ce koo bèe Judà à rkòŋ ce du àgho à to' Babilòn nà.
eng: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers, at the time of the exile to Babylon.

lmp: A ka' koo wowèe dù àgho à to' Babilòn, Jɛ̀konàr à bi Shɛlatɛ̀r, Shɛlatɛ̀r à bi Sɛ̀robabɛ̀r,
eng: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

lmp: Sɛ̀robabɛ̀r à bi Àbiyùr, Àbiyùr à bi Ɛlayikìm, Ɛlayikìm à bi Asòr.
eng: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

lmp: Asòr à m bi Sadòk, Sadòk à bi Akìm, Akìm à bi Ɛ̀liyùr.
eng: Azor became the father of Sadoc. Sadoc became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

lmp: Ɛ̀liyùr à m bi Ɛ̀lisà, Ɛ̀lisà à bi Matàm, Matàm à bi Jakòp,
eng: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

lmp: Jakòp à bi Josɛ̀f ce e m ba nduu yì Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m bi Jisòs ce a ce too enɛ Krâis.
eng: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

lmp: Banɛ ŋgʉ̀ bèe à m ba ncòp-kyèe-à-rrʉ̀ʉ kɛ' embe nfè' yì Abràhâm, du ba' mbe nfè' yì Dɛvìd, a ker ba ncòp-kyèe-à-rrʉ̀ʉ kɛ' embe nfè' yì Dɛvìd du ba' mbe nfè' a m ce koo bèe ce dù àgho à to' Babilòn nà, a ba ncòp-kyèe-à-rrʉ̀ʉ kɛ' embe nfè' ce a m dù nè bèe à to' Babilòn du ba' mbe nfè' yì Krâis anà.
eng: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

lmp: A mbò rbi Jisos Krâis li m ba à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ̂. Yì ma ce à m ba Mɛ̀ɛri à m koo kwàŋ ese Josɛ̀f enɛ e bo dù bgùu a ye. Tɛ a ye a ka' kèe rìŋni mnyor àmbò nduu a nje, e ba nè rbʉ̀ à ŋger Yʉ' Rara. Josɛ̀f à lo a riŋ enɛ e yu nè rbʉ̀.
eng: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this; for after his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Josɛ̀f ce e m ba nduu yì à m ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, a ke' ce kòŋ enɛ e coosi ye à mʉ̀ bèe ka', a ce kwà'shi enɛ e be kwesi gùu tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' riŋ ka'.
eng: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

lmp: E ka' ce kwà'shi à rgèe wa'a, a yɛ rlo àmbò ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à vʉ̀ a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Josɛ̀f muu Dɛvìd, fa wɛp à rlòr ŋgwa wô Mɛ̀ɛri ka', njobè' muu ce e yu njep yê rbʉ̀ nà à lò ba ese Yʉ' Rara.
eng: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, Joseph, son of David, don't be afraid to take to yourself Mary, your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

lmp: E be bi muu mbaŋrù tɛ à fa li rlii enɛ Jisòs, njobè' e be gèe tɛ yì bèe a luŋ efa yàp buu bbebep."
eng: She shall bring forth a son. You shall call his name Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.

lmp: Buu ca wɛɛwɛ vi m ba wa'a tɛ yuu ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa njì enjep yì ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu yi bo ghɛɛte njo. E m làa enɛ̂,
eng: Now all this has happened, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

lmp: "Muu ŋgòŋgò be ba nè rbʉ̀, bi muu mbaŋrù tɛ a fa li rlii enɛ Ɛ̀manùwɛ̀l."
eng: Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall bring forth a son. They shall call his name Immanuel; which is, being interpreted, God with us.

lmp: Josɛ̀f à ka' lɛ' efa mmirlò, a gee yuu ce ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ ye à rlo nà, a lor ŋgwa yì a du a ye fa yê là'.
eng: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

lmp: A ye a m rìŋni mnyor àmbò nduu ba nje ka' caar e bi muu mbaŋrù anà. E ka' bi, Josɛ̀f à fa rlii muu enɛ Jisòs.
eng: and didn't know her sexually until she had brought forth her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce a m bi Jisòs à rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛ̂m, à ŋgòŋ Jùdiyà à nfè' ce Hɛròd à m ba ŋkʉʉ, ŋgâa bfee mo' a lo ekù mbùuntii a du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m,
eng: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

lmp: a bipshi enɛ̂, "Muu ce a bi ye à ŋkʉʉ Jus nà yû? Wèr à yɛ li rkàŋsì kù mbùuntii, a vʉ à rgʉ'shi nè ye."
eng: Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.

lmp: Ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd à ka' yu' ca, yi fa ye ŋgɛ' sê, a fa ŋgɛ' foŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

lmp: E kɛ' bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, a bipshi nè wowèe enɛ yi m ba enɛ a be bi Krâis anà ba fɛ lɛ?
eng: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "À rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛ̂m, à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà. Ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m saŋ enɛ̂,
eng: They said to him, In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

lmp: "Wɛ̀ ce Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛ̂m, ce à yu à ŋgôŋ Judà, à yu ŋwɛ̂ mʉcàr à mʉ̀ ŋgâa rsa' à ŋgòŋ Judà ka' koo-mʉcàr, njobè' ŋwɛ̀ rsa' be fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ yò bèe, cìŋ yà bèe Isrɛ̀l àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ncìŋ njèe." "
eng: You Bethlehem, land of Judah, are in no way least among the princes of Judah: for out of you shall come forth a governor, who shall shepherd my people, Israel.'

lmp: Hɛròd à kɛ' ŋgâa bfee anà mbe dì' ce e m ku ba mimŋgi', a bipshi nè wowèe, a yu' nfè' ce rkàŋsì li m yɛɛti seesê.
eng: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

lmp: A ka' yu', a tuu wowèe à rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛ̂m, a laa enɛ̂, "Dù nè du roo muu anà bòŋboŋ, wêe ròo yɛ ye, wèe gee tɛ m rîŋ, tɛ m bo dù cà'ni ye foŋ."
eng: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' yuu ce ŋkʉʉ à làa, a nati a ce dù, a ku yɛ àm bò rkàŋsì ce wowèe a m yɛ kù mbùuntii nà li ce dù kùntombì nè wowèe caar a ba' a tɛɛ mbe dì' ce muu anà à m ba.
eng: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them, until it came and stood over where the young child was.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ àmbò li tɛɛ, a lu'shi magòr sê.
eng: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

lmp: Wowèe a niŋ mbe ndàp, a yɛ muu a yì ma ce Mɛ̀ɛri, a gʉ'shi nè ye. A ka' gʉ'shi nè ye wɛɛ, a mʉ' wâp bbàa, a fʉr bco' mo' ce a too enɛ gûl, ba nrɛ̀ɛ, ker ba njɛ̀ɛ mgʉr mo' ce mi m ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ sê, a fa nè ye.
eng: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à bɛɛ wowèe à rlo enɛ a fa kʉti càa yɛ Hɛròd ka'. Wowèe a kʉtì a wô to' à njî jɛɛ.
eng: Being warned in a dream that they shouldn't return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù, Tata Nyʉ̀ à tuu yì ncìndap nè Josɛ̀f à rlo a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì lor muu ca ba yì mâ, caŋ du àgho à to' Ijìp, cu àfo caar tɛ m ke làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à kʉti, njobè' Hɛròd tɛɛ à rròo muu ca tɛ e bo yʉ."
eng: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.

lmp: Josɛ̀f à lɛ' efa mmirlò, a lor muu ba ma muu nètʉ', a du à to' Ijìp,
eng: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night, and departed into Egypt,

lmp: a cu àfo caar Hɛròd à ke kwe. Ca yi m ba wa'a tɛ yuu ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa njì enjep yì ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m kɛ' muu wà e fʉʉ e à to' Ijìp" nà yi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: and was there until the death of Herod; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, Out of Egypt I called my son.

lmp: Hɛròd à ka' yɛ enɛ ŋgâa bfee ekù mbùuntii a bo' ye, ntee yi yaŋ ye sê, e fa rsa' enɛ a yʉshi boo mmbaŋrù wɛɛwɛ ce a kɛ̀' embe bfê' bbaa kʉti njìnjì ce a yu à rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛ̂m, ker ba à mʉ mla' ce mi yu àgee rla' ca. E m fa rsa' wa'a, njobè' bfè' vi m ba àmbò bbaa, kɛ' embe nfè' ce ŋgâa bfee ekù mbùuntii a m yɛ rkàŋsì ce a m suŋ ye enɛ a yɛ nà.
eng: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out, and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, yuu ce Jɛ̀rìmiyà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa nà, yi ghɛɛtè njo. E m làa enɛ̂,
eng: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

lmp: "A m yu' njèndoŋ ŋwɛ̀ à rla' Ramà, ŋgàŋ à ce war a ce koosimnse magòr sê, Racɛ̀l à ce war njo' boo vi, a kani enɛ e be cip ka' njobè' boo vi a m kweŋger wɛɛwɛ."
eng: A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn't be comforted, because they are no more.

lmp: Hɛròd à ka' kwe, Josɛ̀f à yɛ ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à rlo à to' Ijìp.
eng: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

lmp: E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàti, lor muu ba yì mâ, tɛ wèe wowèe kʉti à ŋgôŋ Isrɛ̀l, njobè' bèe ce a m ce ròo à ryʉ muu ca, a kweŋger."
eng: Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child's life are dead.

lmp: E natì a lor muu ba ma a du àgho à ŋgôŋ Isrɛ̀l.
eng: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

lmp: E ka' bà' yu' enɛ Àkɛlò à ye kʉʉ yì ta Hɛròd a ce sa' à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, e wɛp à rdù cu àfo. Nyʉ̀ à ka' bɛɛ ye à rlo, e natì a du à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

lmp: A ka' bà', a cu à rla' mo' ce a m too enɛ Nasarɛ̀t. Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ̂, "A be too ye enɛ ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Nasarɛ̀t" nà yi ghɛɛtè njo.
eng: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets: He will be called a Nazarene.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe à kɛ' a ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à ntee rìŋ à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà.
eng: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Kupse-nè yè ndèe, ma' yè buu bbebep njobè' nfè' ce kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi be kɛ̀', ce ghɛɛ."
eng: Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa yuu a kuu ye. E m làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce fuŋ à ntee rìŋ a ce làa enɛ̂, "Kupshi nè nduunjì nè Tatâ, nashi tɛ yi ba kùyɛɛ." "
eng: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

lmp: Jôn à m yar bcɛ̀' ce a m ba' nè mnyôr Kàmɛ̂l, a cʉʉ ŋgùp nyàa njep mbùu. Vi byee à m ba mŋguu ba blù.
eng: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel's hair, with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

lmp: Bèe a m ce lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, ba à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, ker ba à mla' ce mi m ba àgee rdip Jodàn, a ce dù ce yɛ ye.
eng: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

lmp: Wowèe a m suŋ yàp buu bbebep ce a m gèe, e baptìr wowèe njep rdip Jodàn.
eng: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

lmp: E ka' yɛ àmbò bèe magòr efa mʉ̀ bèe Farìsi, ba bèe Sadùsî, a vʉ̀ enɛ e bo bàptir wowèe, e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Boo bfî, ŋwɛ̀ ce e bɛɛ wèe tɛ wèe bo caŋ sòrti efa rshentee ce Nyʉ̀ be ko'si nè bèe nà à bɛɛ nda?
eng: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

lmp: Gèe là nè buu ce vi be ce dùŋshi enɛ wèe à kupse, a ma' yè buu bbebep.
eng: Therefore bring forth fruit worthy of repentance!

lmp: Wèe fa lòr weenɛ wèe à ka' ce làa enɛ̂, "Abràham yu yèr tâ," wèe fʉr wee btu efa ŋgɛ' ka'. M ce suŋ wèe enɛ àde' Nyʉ̀ ku lor blùr ca beesi à boo Abràhâm.
eng: Don't think to yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father,' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

lmp: A lɛ̀ njàa njep mbùu ce wɛɛ. Ce ce yi ka' tɛ yʉ bòŋboŋ ka', banɛ a be gwàr, mà' njep mor.
eng: Even now the axe lies at the root of the trees. Therefore, every tree that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, Jisòs à lô à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a du mbà rdip Jodàn tɛ Jôn bo bàptir ye.
eng: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

lmp: Jôn à ce ròo njì à rkanì, a laa enɛ̂, "Yu ba wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ ba bàptir mɛ̀, wɛ̀ vʉ wɛnɛ m baptir wɛ̀ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: But John would have hindered him, saying, I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Mà'shi tɛ yi ba wa'a sè'ni na. Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ sèe gee ca tɛ sèe bo gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu yɛɛnì." Jôn à byemì.
eng: But Jesus, answering, said to him, Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness. Then he allowed him.

lmp: E ka' bàptir Jisòs wɛɛ, e ku fʉʉ enjep rò. Awɛ rbuu li mʉ'tì, e yɛ àmbò Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi sùu mbe yê ndùu àmbò bèŋ wa'a.
eng: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

lmp: Njèndoŋ à laa embe bùu enɛ̂, "Cena yu muu wà ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, a ce yu' rbòŋ nè ye."
eng: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.

lmp: Awɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi lor Jisòs a du àgho à ntee rìŋ tɛ Satàn bo mòoshi ye.
eng: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

lmp: E ji mdip à mnòŋ mŋkyèe, njè à kɛ' a ce yaŋ ye.
eng: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

lmp: Satàn à vʉ̂, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ba Muu Nyʉ̀, à laa tɛ blùr ca vi beeŋger à brɛ̂d."
eng: The tempter came and said to him, If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ e ke cu ntèe ba njo' brɛ̂d cà'cà' ka'. E ke cu ba njo' blàa ce vi ke fʉʉ ekù cûu Nyʉ̀." "
eng: But he answered, It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of the mouth of God.'

lmp: Satàn à lor ye a du àgho à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ce yu rla' rrara, a ko' nè ye a tɛr mbe tu Nyʉ̀ ce yi m sàp mbekì sê, a laa nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

lmp: "Wɛ̀ ka' ba Muu Nyʉ̀, à nyɛɛ ka embe na cɛɛ à nshè, njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ be làa tɛ vi bcìndap a ke'ni wɛ̀, yà wɛ̀ mbe mmbò fà dì' à lɛɛ yo kùu à lùr ka'." "
eng: and said to him, If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you.' and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don't dash your foot against a stone.'

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "A ker saŋ enɛ̂, "Fa mòoshi Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀ ka'." "
eng: Jesus said to him, Again, it is written, 'You shall not test the Lord, your God.'

lmp: Satàn à ker lor ye a du àgho mbe rtùu ce li m sàp sê, a duŋshi ye bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na, ker ba ku' buu bbòŋboŋ enjo,
eng: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world, and their glory.

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' gʉ'shi nè mɛ̀ banɛ m be fa buu ca wɛɛwɛ nè wɛ̀."
eng: He said to him, I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Lò efa mɛ̂ geŋ, Satàn, njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Gʉ'shi nè Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀, fa' ba nè ye cà'cà'." "
eng: Then Jesus said to him, Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'

lmp: Awɛ Satàn à ma'shì ye a dû, bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a vʉ̂, a ke' à ye.
eng: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu' enɛ a fa Jôn à shaŋ, a kʉti à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

lmp: E m lô à rla' Nasarɛ̀t, a du a cu à rla' Kàpanùm ce li m ba àwâa rò à ŋgôŋ Sɛbulòn ba Naptalè,
eng: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

lmp: tɛ yuu ce Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa yi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Ntɛ̀' Sɛbulòn, ba ntɛ̀' Naptalè ce vi yu à mbèp rdip rgòr, nèŋguu rdip Jodàn, ce vi yu à ŋgôŋ Galèle yì bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles

lmp: Bèe ce a m cu à tʉ̀'nji a yɛ ma rraa. Rraa li raa mbendù bèe ce a ce cu à ŋgôŋ tʉ̀'nji ce e càa ŋger."
eng: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light, to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.

lmp: Kɛ' embe nfè' anà, Jisòs à kɛ' a ce fè'shi, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Kupse-nè, ma' yè buu bbebep njobè' nfè' ce kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi be kɛ̀', ce ghɛɛ."
eng: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce jɛ̀r àwâa tʉ̀ ce à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a yɛ bèe mo' a baa, Saimʉ̀n ce li rlii mo' li m ba enɛ Pità, ba Andrù ce e m ba nfʉr yì. Wowèe a m ba ŋgâa ŋkoo nca, a ce mà' rraa njep rò, tɛ a bo koo nca njo.
eng: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè fa mɛ̂ mbùu tɛ m gee tɛ wèe ba ŋgâa ŋkoo nca ce be ba bèe."
eng: He said to them, Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.

lmp: Wowèe a ku lɛ map mraa, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

lmp: E ka' lò embo ce dù, a ker yɛ bèe mo' a baa ce à m ba Jɛ̂ms, ce e m ba muu yì Sɛbɛ̀dî, ba nfʉr yì ce Jôn. Wowèe a m ba mbe keŋ a yàp ta wèe a ce cʉʉshi map mraa. Jisòs à kɛ' wowèe.
eng: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

lmp: Wowèe a ku ma'shi yàp keŋ ba yàp tâ, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

lmp: Jisòs à m jɛ̀r à mʉ bbu' mla' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a ce yɛ'ni bèe à mndap mloo, a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, a ce gèe bèe ce a m ce yaŋ byaŋ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ a ce kè'se.
eng: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

lmp: Yì nsuŋ à du à bbu' mla' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Sirìyà, bèe a vʉ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce yaŋ byaŋ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, ba bèe ce mnyor vi m ce yaŋ wowèe, ba bèe ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m ba njep wowèe, ba bèe ce a m ce gwè kà', ker ba bèe ce mŋgʉ̀' nyor mo' vi m kweŋger. Jisòs à gee wowèe a ke'sè.
eng: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

lmp: Bkʉr bèe a m lô à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, ba à Mla' Rʉ̂ʉ, ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, ba à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, ba nèŋguu Jodàn, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ ku' bèe, a ko' mbe rtùu, a ka' bà' mbo, a cu à nshè. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a vʉsè,
eng: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

lmp: e kɛ' a ce yɛ'ni wowèe a laa enɛ̂,
eng: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

lmp: "Mbôŋtu mi yu nè bèe ce a yu ŋgâa fùp à yʉ', njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yu yap.
eng: Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

lmp: Yu'-nè rbòŋ ce lu'shi njobè' wee blà' embe bùu vi yu gòr sê. Wowèe a m ku fa ŋgɛ' nè ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m ba entombì nè wèe nà wa'a.
eng: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

lmp: "Wèe yu mgwaŋ enjep ŋgòŋ na. Ka' yi yu wa'a, mgwaŋ mi ka' cir, àde' a gee ekɛ mi ka' ker lêe? Mi be kèr ba yuu ŋgèe yuu ka', tɛ a cu' tɛ bèe a ce càa ce nyɛ̀ŋshi nè mkùu.
eng: You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

lmp: M ce làa nè wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ, tɛ rbuu li ka' kèe mì, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi mi foŋ, àde' mʉ yuu mo' embe ŋwâ' mncir yi ke du fà yuu ka', caar tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ghɛɛte njo.
eng: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' lor mʉ ncir efa mncir ca àtɛ̀r, yɛ'ni bèe mo' foŋ enɛ a gee wa'a, banɛ ŋgàŋ be kèe ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' lɛ mncir ca, ce yɛ'ni bèe vi, banɛ ŋgàŋ be ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀.
eng: Whoever, therefore, shall break one of these least commandments, and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ye ŋgêe yɛɛnì yi ka' tɛ càa yî ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba yî bèe Farìsi ka', banɛ àde' wèe niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

lmp: "Wèe à yu' enɛ a m làa nè bèe elûuŋgòŋ enɛ̂, "Fa yʉ ka', ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yʉ ŋwɛ̀ banɛ a be lòr ye à mnsa'."
eng: You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, 'You shall not murder;' and 'Whoever shall murder shall be in danger of the judgment.'

lmp: à lɛ lo rfa anà mbe gee dî' ntòo rfa, be du yɛ ye tɛ wèe ye nashi bcùu, tɛ à ka' kʉti fa lo rfa anà.
eng: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' somir wɛ̀, wèe ye ce dù mbe kôr, à yɛ enɛ wèe ye à sèesi a ba cûu mo'sir, fà dì' e du nè wɛ̀, fa wɛ̀ nè ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa' tɛ ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa' fa wɛ̀ nè ŋwɛ̀ ncir tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ncir fa wɛ̀ mbe shaŋ ka'.
eng: Agree with your adversary quickly, while you are with him in the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

lmp: M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ à be kù cu mbe shaŋ anà caar, là' yi mbàa ce yi yu nè wɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ, ka' fʉʉ embo.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there, until you have paid the last penny.

lmp: "Wèe à yu' weenɛ a m làa enɛ̂, "Fa koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'."
eng: You have heard that it was said, 'You shall not commit adultery;'

lmp: M ce làa ya nè wèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' juu ŋgwa yì, ke' ba njobè' ŋgwa yì anà à nòŋ a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', banɛ e gèe ŋgwa yì anà à noŋ a nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' lor njeŋwɛ̀ ce e fʉʉ bgùu, banɛ e koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò'.
eng: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

lmp: "Wèe à ker yu' foŋ enɛ a m làa nè bèe elûuŋgòŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ye lè' à rgèe yuu mo' nè Tata Nyʉ̀, ŋgàŋ fa buu efa rgèe yuu anà ka'."
eng: Again you have heard that it was said to them of old time, 'You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,'

lmp: M ce làa ya nè wèe enɛ, ŋwɛ̀ fa kʉʉsi yuu bebep nè yuu bebep ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lip wɛ̀ nè bo à gè', à beesì gè' mo' nè ye foŋ tɛ e lîp.
eng: But I tell you, don't resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce kòŋ enɛ wèe ye sa' mnsa', koo cɛ̀' ese wɛ̀, à ma'shì tɛ e koo yò kur foŋ.
eng: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ku koo wɛ̀ à ŋger enɛ wèe ye jɛr mar mò'sir, à jɛr wèe ye mar baa.
eng: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' laa enɛ à fa ye yuu, à fa ŋgàŋ yuu anà. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce kòŋ à rfòo yuu ese wɛ̀, à fa shè ka'.
eng: Give to him who asks you, and don't turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

lmp: "Wèe à yu' enɛ a m làa enɛ̂, "Kòŋ nfʉrò, baa ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa wɛ̀".
eng: You have heard that it was said, 'You shall love your neighbor, and hate your enemy.'

lmp: Banɛ wèe à ka' ce fa yuu nè bèe ce a buu yuu, wèe fa fyɛp msòŋ tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ yuu ce wèe à gèe ka'. Ŋgâa mbo'ni a ke gèe wa'a à mndap mloo ker ba à btase tɛ bèe a bo ce yòŋshi wowèe. M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wowèe a koni wap blà' wɛɛ.
eng: Therefore when you do merciful deeds, don't sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

lmp: Wèe ka' ce fa yuu nè bèe ce a buu, wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ye bo ŋkòp yi riŋ yuu ce ye bo mà' yi ce gèe ka',
eng: But when you do merciful deeds, don't let your left hand know what your right hand does,

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo rìŋ yuu ce wèe à fa ka'. Wèe à ka' gee wa'a, banɛ yè Ta ce e ke yɛ buu ce bèe a gèe à bsʉ̀ti, be là' wèe.
eng: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

lmp: "Wèe à ka' ce gèe rloo, wèe fa gèe àmbò ŋgâa mbo'ni a ke gèe nà ka'. Wowèe a ke kòŋ à rtɛɛ mbekì à mndap mloo ker ba à btase, gee rloo tɛ bèe a bo yɛ wowèe. M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, wowèe a koo wap blà' wɛɛ.
eng: When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

lmp: Wèe à ka' tɛ fòosi bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep nè wèe ka', yè Ta embe bùu foosì wèe yè buu bbebep ce wèe à gèe foŋ ka'.
eng: But if you don't forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

lmp: "Wèe à ka' ce jì mdip, wèe fa ce koosimnse àmbò ŋgâa mbo'ni a ke gèe nà ka', njobè' wowèe a ke jì mdip wa'a, su'si mmir ka', tɛ bèe a bo yɛ enɛ wowèe a ce jì mdip. M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wowèe a koo wap blà' wɛɛ.
eng: Moreover when you fast, don't be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces, that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

lmp: Lɛ̀ nè wee bkù' ba mbe bùu mbe dì' ce àde' mfyɛp vi ye ka', nlo ye ka', byɛ̀ɛ vi kep mbo yɛɛ buu ka'.
eng: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don't break through and steal;

lmp: Fàdì' ce yò buu yu, a fàdì' ce yo ntee yi yu foŋ.
eng: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

lmp: "Rlir li yu àmbò lam nè nyor. Me mmir mi ka' ba yɛɛnì, banɛ rraa li yu à yè nyòr wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

lmp: "Banɛ m ce suŋ wèe enɛ mlù mi fa ce koo wèe nè yè nyor enɛ wèe be ye kɛ, kɛ̀ no kɛ ka'. Mlù mi fa ce koo wèe nè yè nyor foŋ enɛ wèe be yar ba kɛ ka'. Mbò ryôŋ ŋwɛ̀ li càa byee, nyor ŋwɛ̀ à caa bcɛ̀' a?
eng: Therefore, I tell you, don't be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn't life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

lmp: Fyɛ' ka nè bsiŋ. Vi ke byè buu kɛ̀ kep buu kɛ̀ lɛ à bcàŋ ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, yè Ta embe bùu ku ce nyaŋ wowèe. Mbò yè ntaa lùu sê, a caa yì bsiŋ a?
eng: See the birds of the sky, that they don't sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren't you of much more value than they?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ efa wêe mʉ ce mlù mi ka' ce koo ye, e kyesè nòŋ mo' mbendù vi mnòŋ enjep ŋgòŋ na a nda?
eng: Which of you, by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

lmp: Bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' a ke dù yap ba àmbùu buu ca, yè Ta embe bùu à rìŋ enɛ wèe à ba tʉr buu ca.
eng: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

lmp: Banɛ wèe ròo entombì ba kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, gee ŋgêe yɛɛnì àmbò e ce kòŋ, tɛ e fa wèe buu ca wɛɛwɛ foŋ.
eng: But seek first God's Kingdom, and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

lmp: Banɛ mlù mi fa ce koo wèe à buu cê àyàŋsè ka'. Be ba àyàŋsè tɛ buu ku ba ce mlù mi koo wèe àgho. Ŋgɛ' ŋwɛ̀ ce à nôŋ mo'sir à ghɛɛte nè ŋgàŋ à nòŋ anà.
eng: Therefore don't be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day's own evil is sufficient.

lmp: "Wèe fa sa' bèe mo' ka', tɛ a bo sa' wèe ka',
eng: Don't judge, so that you won't be judged.

lmp: "Bipshi nè tɛ a bo fa nè wèe. Ròo nè tɛ wèe bo yɛ. Kùushi nè tɛ a bo mʉ̀' kèŋ nè wèe.
eng: Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

lmp: Cûu ŋka' yî yi'sè ba nduunjì yî yi'sè yi ce dù ba à dì' rcu ce nfesè, bèe ce a ce yɛ yi, a ba mʉcàr.
eng: How narrow is the gate, and restricted is the way that leads to life! Few are those who find it.

lmp: "Lòr nè nfè' nè bèe ce a ce nya' mnde' enɛ a wowèe ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀. Wowèe a ce vʉ̀ à ryɛ wèe, ma' ŋgùp njèe, wɛ̂ fyɛ' njep mʉ, wowèe a ba àmbò bkuura ce vi ce ròo yuu ye.
eng: Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep's clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

lmp: mbèŋ à gwê, mdip mi ruu, fu' yi caa a ci' ndap anà sê, e ke' gwe ka' njobè' a m boo kùu efa gho mbendù ryɛɛ.
eng: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it didn't fall, for it was founded on the rock.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yu' buu ce mɛ̀ làa na, ke' gee vi ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu àmbò lʉr ce e m bà'ri yì ndap mbendù nsaruŋ,
eng: Everyone who hears these words of mine, and doesn't do them will be like a foolish man, who built his house on the sand.

lmp: mbèŋ à gwê, mdip mi ruu, fu' yi caa a ci' ndap anà, e gwê, a koo yuu efa gho ka'."
eng: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew, and beat on that house; and it fell--and great was its fall.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca mìsi, ku' bèe anà a bɛɛŋgèr à ryɛ'nì ce e m yɛ'ni anà sê,
eng: It happened, when Jesus had finished saying these things, that the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

lmp: njobè' e m yɛ'ni àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tʉr ŋger, a ke' yɛ'ni àmbò yàp bèe ce a m ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir nà ka'.
eng: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' sùu embe rtùu, ku' bèe a du a yê mbùu.
eng: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

lmp: Ka' cu, ŋwɛ̀ msàasì à vʉ a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wɛ̀ ka' ce kòŋ, à gee m ke'sè, ba nrara."
eng: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.

lmp: Jisòs à naa bo a joo ye àgho, a laa enɛ̂, "M ce kòŋ wa'a, kè'se, ba nrara." Ŋwɛ̀ anà à ku ke'se à nfè' anà, a ba nrara.
eng: Jesus stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, I want to. Be made clean. Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

lmp: Jisòs à ciisì nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka'. Dù duŋshi yò nyor nè ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, gee taŋshì ce Musìs à m làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ msàasì gee tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à kè'se nà."
eng: Jesus said to him, See that you tell nobody, but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' niŋ à rla' Kàpanùm, ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ rjèe à vʉ̂, a yɛ ye a bu' mmbo nè ye,
eng: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nòŋ à là', yì ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' à kwe, e ce yu' ryaŋ sê."
eng: and saying, Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M be vʉ̀ gèe tɛ e ke'se."
eng: Jesus said to him, I will come and heal him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ca à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' à niŋ mbe mɛ̂ ndàp ka'. Kù laa ba mbʉ̀ nlàa mò'sir tɛ yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ke'se.
eng: The centurion answered, Lord, I'm not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.

lmp: Mɛ mɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce m ce fà' njeptii bèe ce yap nta' yi càa ya. M tʉr bsoogɛ̀ ce a yu njep mɛ̂ tìi foŋ. M ka' laa nè mò' enɛ̂, "Dù", banɛ e be dù. M ka' laa nè mò' enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀", banɛ e be vʉ̀. M ka' laa nè yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' enɛ̂, "Gèe ca", banɛ e be gèe yi."
eng: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go,' and he goes; and tell another, 'Come,' and he comes; and tell my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu' blàa ca, a bɛɛŋger sê, a laa nè bèe ce a m ce dù a yê mbùu nà enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ mɛ̀ be yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rbyemì ca ka', ka' à to' Isrɛ̀l.
eng: When Jesus heard it, he marveled, and said to those who followed, Most certainly I tell you, I haven't found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ bèe magòr a be kèe vʉ̀ ekù mbùuntii ba embà mbùuntii cute a Abràhâm, ba Aisìk, ba Jakòp wèe à ŋkà', mbe nto' Nyʉ̀.
eng: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò boo ŋkʉʉ, a be kèe fʉr wowèe embo, mà' à dì' ce ku ba ba tʉ̀'nji, ce bèe a ce warse ce kʉr msòŋ àfo."
eng: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ŋgòr anà enɛ̂, "Dù, yi be kù ba àmbò wɛ̀ byemi enɛ yi be ba nà." Yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à m ku ke'se à nfè' anà.
eng: Jesus said to the centurion, Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed. His servant was healed in that hour.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' dù mbe ndàp mbe Pità, a yɛ àmbò malu yì Pità nòŋ, tu yi ce luu ye.
eng: When Jesus came into Peter's house, he saw his wife's mother lying sick with a fever.

lmp: Jisòs à joo bo ese ye, tu anà yi tetì, e natì mbekì, a fɛr buu nè ye.
eng: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. She got up and served him.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, bèe a vʉ nè bèe magòr ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m ba njep wowèe. Jisòs à lâa, byʉ' bbebep anà vi fʉʉ enjep wowèe, a ker gee bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce yaŋ a ke'sè.
eng: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick;

lmp: Ca yi m ba wa'a, tɛ yuu ce Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa yi bo ghɛɛte njo. E m làa enɛ̂, "E m koo visèe bsɛ̀, a ker byɛ' visèe byaŋ."
eng: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying: He took our infirmities, and bore our diseases.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ enɛ ku' bèe a sìr ye, e laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ a wowèe a tuu nèŋguu rò.
eng: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'ni mncir mò' à vʉ̂, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wɛ̀ ka' ce dù ba fɛ, banɛ m be kù ba fa wɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: A scribe came, and said to him, Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Bsìi vi tʉr bto, bsiŋ vi tʉr mndap, Muu Ŋwɛ̀ à ke' tʉr dì' ce àde' e lɛ yi tu ka'."
eng: Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu foŋ, à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mà'shi tɛ m du tuŋ yà ta wɛɛ."
eng: Another of his disciples said to him, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu, ma'shi tɛ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe a tuŋ wâp bgʉ̂ʉ bèe."
eng: But Jesus said to him, Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.

lmp: E ka' làa wa' wɛɛ, a niŋ mbe keŋ, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yê mbùu mbo.
eng: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

lmp: Ka' cu, ma fu' mo' yi kɛ' a ce càa à rdip anà, mdip mi ce ko' mbekì, a ce niŋ mbe mʉ̀ keŋ, Jisòs à ce buumi yi yu.
eng: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves, but he was asleep.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a dû, a yɛɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, jà' wèr, sèe à kwe."
eng: They came to him, and woke him up, saying, Save us, Lord! We are dying!

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce wɛp ba kɛ wa'a? Le rbyemì li yu mʉcàr sê." E ka' làa wa'a, a nati mbekì, a waa fu' ba rdip, ŋgòŋ yi tɛɛ nyaŋ.
eng: He said to them, Why are you fearful, O you of little faith? Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

lmp: Wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̂ kɛ, ce enɛ fu' yi yu'ni nè ye, rdip li yu'nì nè ye foŋ?"
eng: The men marveled, saying, What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

lmp: Jisòs à ka' tuu nèŋguu rò, ba sè'ni ba à ŋgòŋ bèe Gɛ̀rasà, a yɛ bèe a mmbaa ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m ba njep wowèe, àmbò a ce vʉ̀ efa dì' ce a m ce tuŋ bèe. Wowèe a m ce fa ŋgɛ' se àmbò mŋgàa-baa wa', ŋwɛ̀ à ker ce bàp njep nduunjì ce yi m càa à dì' anà ka'.
eng: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

lmp: Wowèe a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Muu Nyʉ̀, yuu ce sèe tʉr a kɛ? Wɛ̀ vʉ̀ àfa à rfa wèr ŋgɛ' tɛ nfè' ka' kèe ghɛɛ a?"
eng: Behold, they cried out, saying, What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?

lmp: Kʉr ŋkûnyàm mo' gòr sê, yi m ba àfo a ce yeŋger, a ba à njìsàp ka'.
eng: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

lmp: Byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' anà vi bu' mmbo nè Jisòs, a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ce fʉr wèr, à laa tɛ wèr du niŋ njep kʉr ŋkûnyàm ca."
eng: The demons begged him, saying, If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.

lmp: E laa nè vi enɛ̂, "Dù nè." Byʉ' anà vi fʉʉ a du a niŋ njep ŋkûnyàm anà, kʉr ŋkûnyàm anà wɛɛwɛ yi kɛɛtì a caŋ a du mbà baa, a gweŋger njep rò, a no mdip a kweŋger.
eng: He said to them, Go! They came out, and went into the herd of pigs: and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea, and died in the water.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce cìŋ ŋkûnyàm ca a caŋsè, a du à là', a suŋ buu ca wɛɛwɛ, a ker suŋ yuu ce yi m koni nè bèe ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m ba njep wowèe nà.
eng: Those who fed them fled, and went away into the city, and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

lmp: A ka' suŋ, bèe wɛɛwɛ à rla' anà a fʉʉ, a du à ryɛ Jisòs, a ka' yɛ ye, a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ e lo efa yap ŋgòŋ.
eng: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

lmp: Jisòs à niŋ mbe keŋ, a ker tuu nèŋguu rò, a du a ba' fa yê là'.
eng: He entered into a boat, and crossed over, and came into his own city.

lmp: Bèe mo' a vʉ nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce yì ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' à m kwe, e noŋ mbe kèŋ. Jisòs à ka' yɛ lap rbyemì, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce yì ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' à m kwe nà enɛ̂, "Kur ntee muu wà, mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep."
eng: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a laa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀."
eng: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, This man blasphemes.

lmp: Jisòs à riŋ yuu ce wowèe a m ce kwà'shi, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kwà'shi njɛ̀ɛ buu bbebep ca wa' njokɛ?
eng: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, Why do you think evil in your hearts?

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu àtɛ̀r yu ba yî fɛ? Yu ba à rlàa enɛ, "Mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep", kɛ̀ à rlàa enɛ, "Lò mbekì, jɛ̂r"?
eng: For which is easier, to say, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Get up, and walk?'

lmp: Banɛ à rgèe tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ tʉr ŋger njep ŋgòŋ à rfòosi bèe efa yàp buu bbebep." E laa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ ca enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì, lor yo kèŋ, du à là'."
eng: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins... then he said to the paralytic, Get up, and take up your mat, and go up to your house.

lmp: E natì mbekì, a du à là'.
eng: He arose and departed to his house.

lmp: Bèe a ka' yɛ ca, a wɛp sê, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ce e fa nè bèe nà.
eng: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' lò embo ce dù, a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Matìyò àmbò e cu mbe dì' rfà' ce e m ce koo mbàa bàrà'. E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu." Matìyò à ku nati a du a yê mbùu.
eng: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, Follow me. He got up and followed him.

lmp: Jisòs à m dù a cu mbe ndàp mbe Matìyò, a ce yeŋger. Ku' ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà', ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a vʉ̂, a cute, a ce yeŋger a Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe.
eng: It happened as he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yɛ, a laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Yè ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ce ye buu a ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà', ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep njokɛ?"
eng: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu', a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe ce a ke ròo ŋwɛ̀ mcɛ̀p e ke ba ŋgâa byaŋ, ke' ba bêe btatap ka'.
eng: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

lmp: Dù nè du fyɛ', yɛ ka enɛ yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce làa enɛ̂, "Yuu ce m ce kòŋ yu ŋkoosimnse, ke' ba ba taŋshì ka'" nà, yi yu ba enɛ kɛ lɛ? Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ à rkɛ' bêe byɛɛnì ka'. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ à rkɛ' ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep."
eng: But you go and learn what this means: 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu vî Jôn, a vʉ̂, a yɛ ye a bipshi enɛ̂, "Wèr bèe Farìsi wèe e ke jì mdip, geewa'a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a ce jì yap ka' njokɛ?"
eng: Then John's disciples came to him, saying, Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don't fast?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Àde' bèe ce a dù à ŋkâ' bgùu, a ba à nduu-gùu wèe ker ce koosimnse à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Geewa'a, nfè' mò' be ba ce a be koo nduu- gùu ese wowèe, tɛ wowèe a ka' koosimnse à nfè' anà.
eng: Jesus said to them, Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ saa cɛ̂' fi, tar mbendù yî rʉ̀ʉ ka'. E ka' gee wa'a, banɛ cɛ̂' fi ca yi be sàa yî rʉ̀ʉ tɛ toto raa càa yì entòmbì nà.
eng: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ lor mrû' mfi foŋ lɛ njep mŋgùp mrù' vî brʉ̀ʉ ka'. E ka' gee wa'a banɛ mrû' mfi anà mi be lò koo, to'shi mŋgùp mrù' anà, tɛ mrù' mi kʉte à nshè, tɛ mŋgùp mrù' anà vi bʉ à cicì. Yi ke ba enɛ a lɛ mrû' mfi ba njep mŋgùp mrù' vî bfi tɛ mi bo kʉ̀te ka', tɛ mŋgùp mrù' vi to'ŋger ka'."
eng: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce làa buu ca nè wowèe, ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mò' embe ndàp rloo à vʉ̂, a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a laa enɛ̂, "Muu wà à ku kwe sè'ni sè'ni na. Ka' yi yu wa'a, vʉ̀ la' mo mmbo mbe yê ndùu tɛ e bo kʉti ntèe."
eng: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.

lmp: Jisòs à natì a du a yê mbùu a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe.
eng: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m cu mbe kùu à bfè' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, à vʉ njì embe yê njì, a joo mcʉ̀ŋcʉŋ cɛ̀' ese ye.
eng: Behold, a woman who had an issue of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

lmp: E m làa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "M ka' ku joo ba yi cùu cɛ̀', m ku ke'se."
eng: for she said within herself, If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.

lmp: Jisòs à karsì nyor, a yɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Muu wà, kur ntee, lo rbyemì li gèe wɛ̀ ke'sè." Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à ku ke'se à nfè' anà.
eng: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well. And the woman was made well from that hour.

lmp: Jisòs à dû, a ba' mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ca a yɛ àmbò ŋgâa mndoŋ a ce fyɛp mndoŋ, bèe a ce warse sê.
eng: When Jesus came into the ruler's house, and saw the flute players, and the crowd in noisy disorder,

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Dù nè, muunje ca à kwe kwe ka', e ce buumi buumi." E ka' làa wa'a, wowèe a vʉshì ye.
eng: he said to them, Make room, because the girl isn't dead, but sleeping. They were ridiculing him.

lmp: A ka' fʉr bèe anà embe ndàp, e niŋ mbo, a koo muunje anà à bò, e natì mbekì.
eng: But when the crowd was put out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

lmp: Nsuŋ kuu yuu ce Jisòs à m gèe na à du à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgòŋ anà.
eng: The report of this went out into all that land.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' lò embo ce dù, mmbaŋrù mo' bèe a mbaa ce a m ba mnfèp, a natì, a du a yê mbùu a ce waa enɛ̂, "Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè wèr."
eng: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, Have mercy on us, son of David!

lmp: E ka' niŋ mbe ndàp, mmbaŋrù ca a vʉ a yɛ ye. E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à byemi enɛ àde' m gee wèe yɛ buu a?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no, Tatâ."
eng: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, Do you believe that I am able to do this? They told him, Yes, Lord.

lmp: A ka' bèesi wa'a, e joo map mmir nè mmbo, a laa enɛ̂, "Tɛ yi ku ba nè wèe àmbò wèe à byemi enɛ yi be ba nà."
eng: Then he touched their eyes, saying, According to your faith be it done to you.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce yɛ buu. E laa nè wowèe tatap se enɛ̂, "Wèe fa gèe tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' riŋ ka'."
eng: Their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, See that no one knows about this.

lmp: Wowèe a nati a du a du a suŋ yap yu yuu ce Jisòs à m gèe nè wowèe nà à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgòŋ anà.
eng: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

lmp: Jisòs wèe a ka' nàti ce dù, bèe a vʉ nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ba lʉr, yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi ba njep ye.
eng: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' fʉr yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' anà, ŋwɛ̀ anà à kɛ' a ce làa. Bèe ce a m ba àfo a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca yi m be koni à ŋgòŋ Isrɛ̀l ka'."
eng: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a laa yap enɛ̂, "E ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe ba à ŋger ŋkʉʉ mnyʉ̂mkà'."
eng: But the Pharisees said, By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.

lmp: Jisòs à m jɛ̀r à mla' mŋgòrŋgòr ba à mla' mŋkɛ'ŋkɛ' a ce yɛ'ni bèe à wap mndap mloo, a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, a ce gèe bèe ce a m ce yaŋ byaŋ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a ce kè'se.
eng: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues, and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

lmp: E ka' ce yɛ ku' bèe, nse yi koo ye nè wowèe, njobè' wowèe a m jep, a riŋ yuu ce a ce gèe ka', àmbò njèe ce yi buu ŋwɛ̀ ncìŋ njèe wa'a.
eng: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them, because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

lmp: E laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Buu à bi à mŋkʉ̀ gòr, ŋgâa rkep a ba mʉcàr.
eng: Then he said to his disciples, The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

lmp: Banɛ wèe loo nè Tàr ce e tʉr ŋkʉ̀ enɛ e tuusi ŋgâa mfà' tɛ a du kep yì buu efa mŋkʉ̀."
eng: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.

lmp: Jisòs à m kɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a fa wowèe ŋger enɛ wowèe a ce fʉr byʉ' bbebep enjep bèe, ker gee tɛ bèe ce a ce yaŋ byaŋ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ a ke'se.
eng: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

lmp: A mlii ŋgâa ntuu ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ anà na: Ŋwɛ̀ entombì à m ba Saimʉ̀n ce a ce too enɛ Pità, ba nfʉr yì ce Andrù, ba Jɛ̂ms, muu Sɛbɛ̀dî, ba nfʉr yì ce Jôn,
eng: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

lmp: ba Felêp, ba Bàtòlomì, ba Tomâs, ba Matìyò ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ ŋkùu mbâa bàrà', ba Jɛ̂ms, ce e m ba muu Alfìyòs ba Tàdiyòs,
eng: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, whose surname was Thaddaeus;

lmp: ba Saimʉ̀n ce e m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe Silòt ba Judas Ìskarìyòt ce e m lò a fyeni Jisòs nà.
eng: Simon the Canaanite; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

lmp: Jisòs à m tuu bèe ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ca, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa dù à ŋgôŋ bèe enje jɛɛ, kɛ̀ à mla' bêe à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà ka'.
eng: Jesus sent these twelve out, and commanded them, saying, Don't go among the Gentiles, and don't enter into any city of the Samaritans.

lmp: Dù nè yɛ ba njèe embe ndʉ̀' Isrɛ̀l ce yi m bʉ nà.
eng: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

lmp: Wêe ce dù, wèe ce fe'shi weenɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ embe bùu yi yu àtʉtʉ.
eng: As you go, preach, saying, 'The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!'

lmp: Gèe nè tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se, gee tɛ bèe ce a kweŋger a kʉti btèe, gee tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ msàasì a ke'se, raa, fʉr nè byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe. Wèe à m là' a ka' koni ka', wêe gèe nè bèe wa'a, wèe fa koo blà' ka'.
eng: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

lmp: Wee ce dù, ŋwɛ̀ fa lòr mbàa, ka' mʉcàr ɛ̀, lɛ̀ njep posà tɛ e bo dù àgho ka'.
eng: Don't take any gold, nor silver, nor brass in your money belts.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fa lòr bàa kɛ̀ bcɛ̂' bbaa, kɛ̀ blaba' kɛ̀ mbàŋ ka', njobè' yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ a la' ŋwɛ̀ rfà'.
eng: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor shoes, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

lmp: "Wèe à ka' niŋ à rla' rgòr, kɛ̀ à rla' rkɛ' ɛ̀, wèe fyɛ' ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ nyɛɛnì àfo, cu wèe ŋwɛ̀ anà wèe caar tɛ yè nfè' ce wèe be lô à rla' anà du ghɛɛ."
eng: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy; and stay there until you go on.

lmp: Wèe à ka' niŋ mbe ndàp, wèe ca'nì bèe embo.
eng: As you enter into the household, greet it.

lmp: Ndap anà à ka' ba ndap nyɛɛnì, wèe ma'shì tɛ yè cumʉnyaŋ ba mbe ndàp anà. Ndap anà à ka' tɛ ba ndap nyɛɛnì ka', banɛ e bɛ bghònì anà.
eng: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn't worthy, let your peace return to you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ koni wèe kɛ̀ yu' yuu ce wèe be làa ka', wèe ka' ce fʉʉ embe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ anà, kɛ̂ à rla' anà ɛ̀, wèe kashì nfʉ̀nfʉ efa wêe mkùu.
eng: Whoever doesn't receive you, nor hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake off the dust from your feet.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ be kèe ba à nôŋ mnsa' tɛ ŋgɛ' à rla' Sodòm ba Gòmorà ba àndèe nè ŋgɛ' à rla' anà.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

lmp: "Yɛ̂, m ce tuu wèe tɛ wèe du ba àmbò njèe à mʉ̀ bkuura. Banɛ wèe feese àmbò mnyo, ba nè rbornì-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò bbèŋ.
eng: Behold, I send you out as sheep in the midst of wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents, and harmless as doves.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a be kèe bàa wèe njo' mɛ̀. Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛɛ tatap du ba' à lʉ̀simbùu, ŋgàŋ be lùŋ.
eng: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

lmp: A ka' fa wèe ŋgɛ' à rla' mo', wèe caŋ du à rla' mo' jɛɛ. M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe be jɛ̀r à mla' Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ ka', tɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ vʉ̂.
eng: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel, until the Son of Man has come.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce a ce yɛ'ni ye caa yì ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ka'. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ rfà' caa yì masà ka'.
eng: A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

lmp: Ka' nyʉ̀'tu ce yi yu mbe wêe tù, a bè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: but the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa wɛp ka'. Wèe lùu ntaa à bsii Nyʉ̀ a caa bbe' àŋgoo.
eng: Therefore don't be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' suŋ à bsii bèe enɛ e yu yà ŋwɛ̀ banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ be suŋ à bsii yà Ta embe bùu enɛ e yu yà ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, him I will also confess before my Father who is in heaven.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' mɛŋni mɛ̀ à bsii bèe banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ be mɛŋni ye à bsii yà Ta embe bùu foŋ.
eng: But whoever denies me before men, him I will also deny before my Father who is in heaven.

lmp: "Wèe fa ce kwà'shi enɛ mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ ba nè cumʉnyaŋ njep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ ba nè cumʉnyaŋ ka'. Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ ba nè kàafà'.
eng: Don't think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn't come to send peace, but a sword.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' fa ncep nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce ncòp-ba-à-rʉ̀ʉ mìsi, a lo embo, a du a ce yɛ'ni a ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à mlâ' à ŋgòŋ anà.
eng: It happened that when Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

lmp: Jôn à m ba mbe shaŋ. A ka' yu' mfà' ce Krâis à m ce gèe, a tuu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ,
eng: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

lmp: a du bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce yi m ba enɛ e be vʉ̀ nà kɛ̀ wèr cu ce ke' ba ŋwɛ̂ jɛɛ?"
eng: and said to him, Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kʉti nè du suŋ Jôn buu ce wèe à yu' a ker yɛ.
eng: Jesus answered them, Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

lmp: Bèe ce a fèp a ce yɛ buu, mntɛ̀ŋ a ce jɛ̀shi yɛɛnì, ŋgâa msàasì a ce kè'se, ce ba brara, mnfuŋtù' a ce yu' buu, bèe ce a kweŋger a ce kʉti btèe, ŋgâa fùp a ce suŋ Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

lmp: Rbôŋtu li yu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce tarni mɛ̀ tarni ka'."
eng: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jôn a ka' nàti ce dù, Jisòs à kɛ' a ce suŋ ku' kʉr bèe ca buu kuu Jôn. E m làa enɛ̂, "Wèe à m fʉʉ a du à ntee rìŋ ba à ryɛ kɛ? Wèe à m dù à ryɛ àmbò fu' yi ce cì' ŋke' a?
eng: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

lmp: Yi ka' tɛ ba wa' ka' banɛ wèe à m dù à ryɛ kɛ? Wèe à m dù à ryɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e sùsi nyor nè bcɛ̀' yòo, a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Bèe ce a ke sùsi nyor nè bcɛ̂' yòo, a ke cu ba à mnto'.
eng: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in king's houses.

lmp: Banɛ wèe à m fʉʉ a du ba à ryɛ kɛ sê? Wèe à m dù ba à ryɛ ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a? Ɛ̀no, m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe à m yɛ anà càa ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce a saŋ àmbò ye mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, m be tuu yà ŋwɛ̀ ntuu tɛ e du entombì nè wɛ̀, dù kupshi nduunjì nè wɛ̀."
eng: For this is he, of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

lmp: "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ efa mʉ̀ bèe wɛɛwɛ ce bbyèŋge a bi, mò' a be caa Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe ka'. Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu yi mʉcàr se mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ à càa ye.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

lmp: Kɛ' embe nfè' Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe vʉ ba' sè'ni na, bèe a ce fa ŋgɛ' nè kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, ŋgâa ŋger a ce fàp kʉʉ anà.
eng: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

lmp: Mŋwà' ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ ba ŋwà' mncir vi m suŋ àmbò buu ce vi be ka' ba caar a ba' à nfè' yì Jôn.
eng: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce kòŋ à rbyemì, wèe riŋ weenɛ e yu Àlajà ce a m làa enɛ e be kèe vʉ̀ nà.
eng: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'.
eng: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

lmp: "Banɛ àde' m be'nì bèe elùuni na ba à kɛ? Wowèe a yu àmbò bghàrbèe ce a cute à ntaa a ce kɛ' bghàrbèe mo', a ce làa enɛ̂,
eng: But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a kɛ' a ce lapni mla' fàdì' ce e m gèe ku' buu bghagha' nà, njobè' bêe àfo a m kupse a ma' yàp buu bbebep ka'.
eng: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn't repent.

lmp: "Ndòo à co' wèe ce wèe yu bêe à rla' Kòrasìn! Ndòo à co' wèe ce wèe yu bêe à rla' Bɛ̀tsaidà, njobè' a m ba gee buu bghagha' ce a m gèe fa wêe mʉ nà ba à rla' Tayà ba à rla' Sidòn, bêe àfo a m ba nè kupse e sese', a ma' bcɛ̂' njì rkwe, a yo' bʉ à nyòr a cute àgho.
eng: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Tàr, Tata ce à tʉr rbuu ba nshe, m ce yòŋshi wɛ̀ njobè' wɛ̀ sʉ̀ti buu ca ese ŋgâa bfee ba bèe ce a rìŋ buu, a duŋshi ba nè boo bkɛ'.
eng: At that time, Jesus answered, I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

lmp: Ɛ̀no, Tàr, ca yu ba yuu ce wɛ̀ m ce yu' rbòŋ à rgèe.
eng: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

lmp: "Yà Ta à fa buu wɛɛwɛ mba mɛ̂ mmbò. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' rìŋ muu caa efa Tàr ka', ŋwɛ̀ mò' à rìŋ Tàr caa efa muu ker ba bèe ce muu à kòŋ à rdùŋshi ye nè wowèe ka'.
eng: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son, and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

lmp: Vʉ̀ nè yɛ mɛ̀, wèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce fà' a byɛ' mntɛ̀r vi ce rìr wèe, tɛ m gee tɛ wèe lʉshî.
eng: Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

lmp: À m ba nfè' anà Jisòs à ce jɛ̀r nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, a caa à ŋkʉ̀ msaŋ mò'. Njè à m ce yaŋ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu. Wowèe a tee btu msaŋ a ce ye.
eng: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yɛ wa'a, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a ce gèe yuu ce ncir yi byemi enɛ a gee nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à be be' yuu ce Dɛvìd à m gèe à nfè' ce njè à m ce yaŋ ye ker ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ba nà ka' a?
eng: But he said to them, Haven't you read what David did, when he was hungry, and those who were with him;

lmp: E m dù mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a lor brɛ̂d ce a m fa nè Nyʉ̀ a ye, a fa bɛr nè bèe ce a wowèe a m ba. Ncir yi m byemi enɛ e ye ka', kɛ̀ enɛ bèe ce e m ba a wowèe a ye foŋ ka'. Bèe ce yi m ba enɛ a ye à m ku ba ba ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: how he entered into the house of God, and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, neither for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

lmp: Mbò wèe à be be' foŋ mbe ŋwà' mncir enɛ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a ke bʉ' ncir mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ke' ba fàa nè wowèe ka' a?
eng: Or have you not read in the law, that on the Sabbath day, the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath, and are guiltless?

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ yuu mo' ce yi càa Nyʉ̀ yi yu mbena.
eng: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

lmp: Wèe à m ba riŋ mbùu efa blàa ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Yuu ce m ce kòŋ yu ŋkoosimnse, ke' ba taŋshì ka'" nà, wèe à m ba làa weenɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu bebep ka' yu ŋwɛ̀ mbembep ka'.
eng: But if you had known what this means, 'I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,' you would not have condemned the guiltless.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ yu Tàr ce e tʉr mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀."
eng: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.

lmp: E m lò embo, a du a niŋ mbe yàp ndap rloo.
eng: He departed there, and went into their synagogue.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba mbo ce li rkoo mo' li m kwe. Bèe mo' ce a m ba mbo a bipshì nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Wà' ncir yi byemi enɛ a gee tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ke'se nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ a?" Wowèe a m bipshi wa'a enɛ e ka' faa nlàa tɛ wowèe a bo sa' ye enɛ e bʉ' ncir.
eng: And behold there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day? that they might accuse him.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yu nda efa wêe mʉ ce e ka' tʉr njèe, e gwe njep bè'tè nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, e ke' koo enjo, fʉr mbe ŋkʉ̀ ka'?
eng: He said to them, What man is there among you, who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won't he grab on to it, and lift it out?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à lùu ntaa a caa njèe. Banɛ ncir yi byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ gee yuu bòŋboŋ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀."
eng: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce li rkoo li m kwe nà enɛ̂, "Mà' lo rkoo kùyɛɛ." E ma', li kʉtì rbòŋboŋ, a ba àmbò lì ce li m kwe yi ka' nà.
eng: Then he told the man, Stretch out your hand. He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a fʉʉ njepmbè a cu mcʉ̀, a seesi àmbò a be koo Jisòs yʉ.
eng: But the Pharisees went out, and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' rìŋ enɛ a ce cu mcʉ̀ tɛ a bo yʉ ye, a lô àfo. Bèe magòr a m dù a yê mbùu, e gee bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce yaŋ a ke'sè.
eng: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ a fa dù suŋ bèe enɛ e yu Muu Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: and commanded them that they should not make him known:

lmp: Ca yi m ba wa' tɛ yuu ce Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa, yi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce mɛ̀ ce, ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, a ce yu' rbòŋ nè ye. M be sùusi ya yʉ' mbe yê ndù tɛ e suŋ àmbò la rsa' nè bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: Behold, my servant whom I have chosen; my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased: I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

lmp: Bèe a m vʉ̀ nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m fèp, a ba lʉr, yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi ba njep ye. Jisòs à gee e ke'sè, a kɛ' a ce làa, a ce yɛ buu foŋ.
eng: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Wà' ŋwɛ̀ ca yu Muu Dɛvìd a?"
eng: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, Can this be the son of David?

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yu' wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe ba à ŋger Bɛsɛbùl ce e yu ŋkʉʉ mnyʉ̂mkà'."
eng: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, This man does not cast out demons, except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

lmp: Jisòs à m ku riŋ yuu ce wowèe a ce kwà'shi, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "To' yi ka' gapni, ke' ba cûu mo'sir ka' banɛ to' anà yi be sà'ŋger, gwè. Rla' li ka' gapni, ke' ba cûu mo'sir ka', ndap gapnì, ke' ba cûu mo'sir ka' banɛ àde' rla' anà li tɛɛ ka', ndap anà tɛɛ ka' foŋ.
eng: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

lmp: Satàn ka' ce fʉr Satàn enjep bèe banɛ ŋgàpni yi yu nje nyòr Satàn. Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ àde' yi to' yi ka' tɛɛ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

lmp: M ka' ba ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' anà ba à ŋger Bɛsɛbùl, banɛ bèe wee a ce fʉr yap byʉ' anà enjep bèe ba à ŋger nda? Banɛ be kù sa' ba yè bèe sa' wèe.
eng: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

lmp: M ka' ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe ba à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ banɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi vʉ̀ nè wèe.
eng: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come upon you.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ niŋ mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ ŋger kwɛ' yì buu du àgho ka', ce ka' tɛ ba enɛ e ba kɛ' a kur ŋwɛ̀ anà wɛɛ, ka' niŋ mbo kwɛ̀' yì buu, dù àgho ka'?
eng: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man, and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ ba wèr ye ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu yà ŋwɛ̀ bbàa. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ ce baashi wèr ye ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ ce da'si da'si.
eng: He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn't gather with me, scatters.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu boo bfî, àde' wèe ce wèe yu bêe bbebep, laa yuu bòŋboŋ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Yi yu wa' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ e ke làa ba efa ku' buu ce vi ruu njep yê ntee.
eng: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ e ke fʉr buu bbòŋboŋ efa buu bbòŋboŋ ce vi yu njep yê ntee, ŋwɛ̂ mbembep fʉr buu bbebep efa buu bbebep ce vi yu njep yê ntee.
eng: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ be kèe ba à nôŋ mnsa' tɛ bèe a laa yuu kùu blàa bcicì wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a m làa,
eng: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

lmp: njobè' wo blàa vi be kèe fʉr wɛ̀ efa mnsa' tɛ wo blàa vi gee tɛ à gwe mnsa'."
eng: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsi a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wèr ce kòŋ wernɛ à duŋshi ncòo mò' tɛ wèr yɛ."
eng: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.

lmp: E beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋgʉ̀ bèe ce a yu ŋgâa bsàrbuu, a ba mini nè Nyʉ̀ ka' na a ce làa enɛ m duŋshi wowèe ncòo. M be dùŋshi wowèe ncòo mò' caa efa ncòo yì Jonà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: But he answered them, An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

lmp: Àmbò Jonà à m cu njep rbʉ̂ nca ce e m kù' sê, à mnôŋ btaar nà, Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ye ye be cu njep mʉ̀ nshe à mnôŋ btaar.
eng: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the whale, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

lmp: Bêe à rla' Nenɛvì a be kèe tɛɛ à nòŋ mnsa' a ŋgʉ̀ bèe yî sè'ni na, làa enɛ wowèe a gèe yuu bebep njobè' Jonà à m fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wowèe, wowèe a kupsè a ma' yàp buu bbebep. Yɛ nè, yuu mo' yi yu mbena sè'ni na ce yi càa Jonà.
eng: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce sa' to' embà mbùu-ŋgòŋ be kèe nàti tɛɛ mbekì à nòŋ mnsa', làa enɛ ŋgʉ̀ bèe e sè'ni na a gèe yuu bebep, njobè' e m vʉ̀ yi ba à njìsàp sê, à ryu' blâa bfee ce Solomʉ̀n à m ce làa. Yɛ nè, yuu mo' yi yu mbena sè'ni na ce yi càa Solomʉ̀n.
eng: The queen of the south will rise up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

lmp: "Yʉ' bebep yi ke fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀ kashi à ŋgôŋ yuur à rròo dî' rlʉ̀shì. Yi ka' roo yɛ ka',
eng: But the unclean spirit, when he is gone out of the man, passes through waterless places, seeking rest, and doesn't find it.

lmp: yi laa enɛ̂, "M be kʉti mbe ndàp ce mɛ̀ m fʉʉ embo nà." Yi ce kʉti, yɛ ndap anà ba mbòmmbo, a yɛ̂r, kupshi, e ce raa.
eng: Then he says, 'I will return into my house from which I came out,' and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

lmp: Yi yɛ wa'a, ker du vʉ nè byʉ' mmo' vi sàambâ, ce vi bep a caa yi, a wowèe a niŋ cu mbo, ŋgàŋ misi bep caa àmbò e m ba entombì. A mbò yi be kèe ba nè ŋgʉ̀ bêe bbebep e sè'ni wa'a."
eng: Then he goes, and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kù bii ce làa nè bèe, yì ma ba bfʉr vi a vʉ̂, a tɛɛ njepmbè a ce kòŋ à rlàa yuu nè ye.
eng: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, yò ma ba bfʉr wo a tɛɛ njepmbè a ce ròo à ryɛ wɛ̀."
eng: One said to him, Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.

lmp: E beesì a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ anà enɛ̂, "Yà ma yu nda, bfʉr wa à ba wèe kɛ?"
eng: But he answered him who spoke to him, Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?

lmp: E naa yi bo a duŋshi ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu àgho, a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, a yà ma ba bfʉr wa na.
eng: He stretched out his hand towards his disciples, and said, Behold, my mother and my brothers!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gee yuu ce yà Ta ce e yu mbe bùu ce kòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu nfʉrà, a ba njar yà, a ba yà mâ."
eng: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.

lmp: Jisòs à m fʉʉ embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ anà a du a cu àwâa rò.
eng: On that day Jesus went out of the house, and sat by the seaside.

lmp: Ku' bèe a vʉ̂, a sir ye a tarte, e niŋ mbe keŋ a cu mbo, bèe anà a tɛɛ nje wâa tʉ̀.
eng: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.

lmp: E suŋ wowèe buu magòr à mŋgàa. E m làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m dù à rbyè buu,
eng: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

lmp: a ka' ce byè, ŋgʉ̀ buu mò' à gweŋgèr àwâa nduunjì, bsiŋ vi vʉ̂, a ye.
eng: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu mò' à gweŋgèr yi ba mbendù nshe ce e m ba mbendù ryɛɛ. Ŋgʉ̀ buu anà à yaŋsè a fʉʉ njobè' nshe e mbendù ryɛɛ anà à m ba gòr ka'.
eng: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn't have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' saŋ, a too ŋgʉ̀ buu anà, e yoprì njobè' mŋgàŋ vi m niŋ njep nshe bòŋboŋ ka'.
eng: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu mò' à m gwèŋger à mʉ̀ msini, msini mi ku', a kur.
eng: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu mò' à gweŋgèr mbe nshe mbòŋmboŋ, a fʉʉ, a gee mbʉ̀, mò' à gee mbʉ̀ rjèe, mò' mntuunfu, mò' mntaar.
eng: Others fell on good soil, and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'."
eng: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ko'shì a yê geŋ a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce suŋ buu nè bèe ba à mŋgàa njokɛ?"
eng: The disciples came, and said to him, Why do you speak to them in parables?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Buu ce àde' bèe a riŋ kuu kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka' na, Nyʉ̀ à gèe wèe à rîŋ. À ka' ba yi àmbò wowèe, Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe a riŋ ka'.
eng: He answered them, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr yuu, banɛ a be kèr fa ye buu mò', tɛ e misi tʉr buu gòr. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ tʉr yuu ka', banɛ a be koo, ka' mʉ yì ce e tʉr nà ese ye.
eng: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance, but whoever doesn't have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce suŋ buu nè wowèe ba à mŋgàa. M ce gèe wa'a tɛ wowèe a ce kè' ce yɛ ka', a ce yu'shi, ce yu' ka', a riŋ buu foŋ ka'.
eng: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don't see, and hearing, they don't hear, neither do they understand.

lmp: Wowèe a gèe yuu ce Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa nà yi ghɛɛtè njo. E m làa enɛ̂, "Bèe ca a be ce yu', ce rìŋ yuu ce wowèe a ce yu' anà ka'. Wowèe a be ce yɛ, ce rìŋ yuu ce a ce yɛ anà ka',
eng: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, 'By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive:

lmp: njobè' ntee yi yini wowèe, wowèe a riŋ buu ka'. Wowèe a kani à ryu' buu, a cete map mmir fà dì' wowèe a bo yɛ buu nè map mmir, yu' buu nè wap btù', rìŋ buu, bèeŋger vʉ̀ yɛ mɛ̀ tɛ m gee tɛ wowèe a luŋ ka'."
eng: for this people's heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and should turn again; and I would heal them.'

lmp: Mbôŋtu mi yu yi nè wèe njobè' me mmir mi ce yɛ buu, wee btù' vi ce yu' buu.
eng: But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gweŋger àwâa nduunjì tɛɛ àtu ŋwɛ̀ ce e m yu' yuu ce a ce làa àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, a ke' yu' ka', Satàn à vʉ a fʉr yuu anà enjep yê ntee.
eng: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom, and doesn't understand it, the evil one comes, and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger yi ba mbe nshe e mbendù ryɛɛ nà tɛɛ àtu ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ ku yu' rbòŋ àgho sê,
eng: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word, and immediately with joy receives it;

lmp: blàa anà vi ke' taa mŋgàŋ njep ye ka', ku cu ba à nfè' mʉcàr. E ba à nfè' ce bèe a ce fa ye ŋgɛ', kɛ̀ buu vi ba btatap nè ye njo' blàa anà, e ku kʉti njìnjì.
eng: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger à mʉ̀ msini nà, tɛɛ àtu bèe ce a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, ku byemi, mlù ce à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na, ba broŋ buu, vi kur blàa anà, yi gee ŋgʉ̀ ka'.
eng: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger yi ba mbe nshe mbòŋmboŋ nà tɛɛ àtu ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, yu' bòŋboŋ sê, gee ŋgʉ̀, mò' ba rjèe, mò' ba mntuunfu, mò' ba mntaar."
eng: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word, and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit, and brings forth, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

lmp: Jisòs à ker ma' ŋgàa mò' nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ embe bùu yi yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m byè ŋgʉ̀ buu bbòŋboŋ à mŋkʉ̀.
eng: He set another parable before them, saying, The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

lmp: Bèe a ka' ce buumi, yì ŋwɛ̀ bbàa à vʉ a bye ŋke' à mʉ̀ msaŋ ce ŋgàŋ à m byè, a du yi yu.
eng: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

lmp: Msaŋ mi ka' kù', bùr, ŋke' cà yi yɛɛtì sè'ni à ŋke'.
eng: But when the blade sprang up and brought forth fruit, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

lmp: Ŋgâa mfà' à vʉ̂, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ŋkʉ̀ ca enɛ̂, "Masà, mbò wɛ̀ m byè ŋgʉ̀ buu bbòŋboŋ a wɛ̂ ŋkʉ̀ a? Ŋke' yi ka' lo yi ba efɛ?"
eng: The servants of the householder came and said to him, 'Sir, didn't you sow good seed in your field? Where did this darnel come from?'

lmp: E beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yuu ca à gèe yà ŋwɛ̀ bbàa mò'." Ŋgâa mfà' a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce kòŋ wɛnɛ wèr du co'ni ŋke' anà a?"
eng: He said to them, 'An enemy has done this.' The servants asked him, 'Do you want us to go and gather them up?'

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ kani. Wèe à ka' ce co'ni ŋke' anà, seemò' wèe co'nì msaŋ à mʉ̀ mo.
eng: But he said, 'No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

lmp: Jisòs à ker ma' ŋgàa mò' nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò ŋgʉ̀ mostà ce ŋwɛ̀ à m lòr a bye fa yê ŋkʉ̀.
eng: He set another parable before them, saying, The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field;

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ mostà ca ŋwɛɛsi a caa ŋgʉ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ. Ka' yi yu wa'a, a ke byè, e ku' caa buu wɛɛwɛ ce a byè à mŋkʉ̀, ba sè'ni ba à ce, bsiŋ vi vʉ ba'ri mndap à mnta' efa gho."
eng: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs, and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.

lmp: E m ker ma' ŋgàa mò' nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò yis ce njeŋwɛ̀ à m lòr, a fe' mkʉ̂ŋ brɛ̂d mŋkâa btaar, a top àgho caar mkʉ̀ŋ anà mi ko'."
eng: He spoke another parable to them. The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.

lmp: Jisòs à m suŋ buu ca wɛɛwɛ nè bèe ce a m ba a wowèe, a ma' ba à mŋgàa. Yuu mo' yi yu ce e m làa nè wowèe a buu efa rmà' ba à ŋgàa ka'.
