eng: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn't speak to them,

lmp: E m gèe wa'a tɛ yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa, yi bo ghɛɛte njo. E m làa enɛ̂, "M be mʉ̀' ya cùu, mà' mŋgàa. M be suŋ buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m sʉ̀ti ese bèe kɛ̂' à nfè' ce e m gèe ŋgòŋ."
eng: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.

lmp: E ka' làa wa' mìsi, a ma'shi bèe cà, a niŋ mbe ndàp. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yɛ ye mbo, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Suŋ ka wèr mbùu efa ŋgàa ŋke' ce yi m kù' à mʉ̀ msaŋ nà."
eng: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m byè ŋgʉ̀ buu bbòŋboŋ nà a Muu Ŋwɛ̀,
eng: He answered them, He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

lmp: ŋkʉ̀ à ba ŋgòŋ ca, ŋgʉ̀ buu bbòŋboŋ à ba bèe ce Nyʉ̀ yu yàp ŋkʉʉ, ŋke' à ba bèe ce a yu bèe Satàn.
eng: the field is the world; and the good seed, these are the children of the Kingdom; and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ bbàa ce e m byè yi ba ŋke' nà à ba Satàn. Nfè' ntee msaŋ yu nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi ce mì, ŋgâa rtee a ba bcìndap Nyʉ̀.
eng: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

lmp: Àmbò a ke baashi ŋke' too nè mor nà, yi be kèe ba wa'a à nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi ce mì.
eng: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

lmp: Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kèe tuu vi bcìndap tɛ wowèe a baashi buu ce vi ke gèe bèe a ce gèe buu bbebep, ker ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep wɛɛwɛ embe dì' yi kʉʉ,
eng: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling, and those who do iniquity,

lmp: mà' njep mor ce bèe a be kèe ce warse ce kʉr msòŋ njo.
eng: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and the gnashing of teeth.

lmp: A ce mà' wowèe njo wa'a tɛ bèe ce a yu byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ a saŋ àmbò nyʉ̀ wa' mbe dì' kʉʉ yàp tâ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'.
eng: Then the righteous will shine forth like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

lmp: "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò yuu bòŋboŋ ce a sʉ̀ti à mŋkʉ̀, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' vʉ̀ yɛ, a lor a sʉti foŋ, a lu'shi sê, a dû, a fyeni yì buu wɛɛwɛ a yuu ŋkʉ̀ anà.
eng: Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a treasure hidden in the field, which a man found, and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has, and buys that field.

lmp: a ka' yɛ mo' ce e lùu ntaa sê, a du a fyeni yì buu wɛɛwɛ a yuu àgho.
eng: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had, and bought it.

lmp: "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu foŋ àmbò rraa ce a m mà' njep rò, a koo nca njo njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet, that was cast into the sea, and gathered some fish of every kind,

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wà' wèe à yu' buu ca wɛɛwɛ a?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no."
eng: Jesus said to them, Have you understood all these things? They answered him, Yes, Lord.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir wɛɛwɛ ce a yɛ'ni buu kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, a yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ndap ce e fʉr buu bfi ba buu brʉ̀ʉ embe dì' ce e ke lɛ̀ yì buu."
eng: He said to them, Therefore, every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' mà' mŋgàa ca nè wowèe mìsi, a lô àfo,
eng: It happened that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

lmp: a dù fa yê là', a yɛ'ni bêe àfo mbe yàp ndap rloo, wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe bfee ca ba efɛ, a koni ŋger à rgèe buu bghagha' ca ba efɛ?
eng: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished, and said, Where did this man get this wisdom, and these mighty works?

lmp: Mbò ŋwɛ̀ ca yu muu kapintà cà a? Mbò a too yì ma enɛ Mɛ̀ɛri a? Mbò bfʉr vi à ba Jɛms ba Josɛ̀f, ba Saimʉ̀n ba Judàs a?
eng: Isn't this the carpenter's son? Isn't his mother called Mary, and his brothers, James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

lmp: Mbò bjar vi wɛɛwɛ a ce cu àfa sèe wowèe a? Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe bfee ca ba ŋger ca efɛ?"
eng: Aren't all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, a kanì ye. Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A ke yu'ni nè ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à bdì' bsìp, geewa'a bèe efa yê là' ba bèe embe yê ndàp a ke yu'ni nè ye ka'."
eng: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and in his own house.

lmp: E m gèe buu bghagha' àfo gòr ka' njobè' wowèe a m byemi nè ye ka'.
eng: He didn't do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, Hɛròd ce e m ce sa' à ŋgôŋ Galèle à yu' nsuŋ Jisòs,
eng: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

lmp: a laa nè bèe ce a m ce fà' nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe. E fʉʉ efa rkwe. A mbùu ce e tʉr ŋger à rgèe njɛ̀ɛ buu bghagha' ca."
eng: and said to his servants, This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.

lmp: Hɛròd à m koo Jôn, a kur, a fa mbe shaŋ. Hɛròd à m fa ye mbe shaŋ àtu Hɛ̀rodìyà ce e m ba ŋgwa nfʉr yì ce Felêp.
eng: For Herod had laid hold of John, and bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife.

lmp: Jôn à m ba nè laa nè Hɛròd enɛ̂, "Ncir yi byemi enɛ à fap ŋgwa nfʉrò, beesi à yò ka'."
eng: For John said to him, It is not lawful for you to have her.

lmp: Ka' e m ce kòŋ à ryʉ Jôn wa'a, geewa'a njì yi bûu, njobè' bèe anà a m byemi enɛ Jôn yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

lmp: E m gèe ŋkà' à rkuushi nòŋ ce a m bi ye, muu Hɛ̀rodìyà à bii bii à bsii bèe ce a m vʉ̀ ŋkà', nyor à boŋ ye sê,
eng: But when Herod's birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

lmp: e ye lè', a ka' enɛ e be fa ye yuu ce e ka' laa enɛ e fa ye.
eng: Whereupon he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

lmp: E du a yɛ yì mâ, yì ma à suŋ ye yuu ce e gêe. E vʉ̂, a laa enɛ̂, "Fa tu Jôn njep kaŋ sè'ni na."
eng: She, being prompted by her mother, said, Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.

lmp: Mlù mi koo ŋkʉʉ sê, à ka' ba njobè' e m ye lè' à bsii bèe ce a m vʉ̀ ŋkà' ca, e laa enɛ a fa yuu ce e làa enɛ a fa nè ye nà.
eng: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths, and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

lmp: E m tuu bsoogɛ̀ mbe shaŋ, wowèe a du a tee tu ese Jôn,
eng: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

lmp: a vʉ àgho njep kaŋ a fa nè muu anà, e du àgho, a fa nè yì mâ.
eng: His head was brought on a platter, and given to the young lady: and she brought it to her mother.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jôn a ka' yu' wa'a, a dû, a lor gʉ̀ʉ a tuŋ, a du a suŋ Jisòs.
eng: His disciples came, and took the body, and buried it; and they went and told Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kù yu' yuu ce yi koni, a lô fàdì' ce e m ba, a niŋ mbe keŋ, a du fà dì' mo' ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ker ba àfo caa efa ye ka'. Bèe a ka' yu', a fʉʉse efa mla' wɛɛwɛ, a jɛr nè mkùu, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat, to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' dù fʉʉ nje wâa rò, a yɛ ku' bèe, a koosimnse nè wowèe, a gee bèe efa wâp mʉ ce a m ce yaŋ, a ke'sè.
eng: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them, and healed their sick.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' coo, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sèe yu ànjìsàp efa mla', nyʉ̀ à ce coo. Làa tɛ bèe ca a duse à mlà' tɛ a bo dù yuu byee, ye."
eng: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Mbùu mò' yu àgho nè wowèe à rdù ka'. Fa nè wowèe yuu tɛ a ye."
eng: But Jesus said to them, They don't need to go away. You give them something to eat.

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Yuu ce wèr tʉr ku ba brɛ̂d tâ, ba nca baa."
eng: They told him, We only have here five loaves and two fish.

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè àgho fa nè mɛ̀."
eng: He said, Bring them here to me.

lmp: E laa nè bèe enɛ a cute à mjɛɛ, a lor brɛ̂d ta ba nca baa cà, a ke' mbe bùu, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi, a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a gapshì nè bèe anà.
eng: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples, and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ye a yu'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a baashì bbɛbɛ' ce vi m bɛti, vi ruu à mŋkàa ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: They all ate, and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù wɛɛwɛ ce a m ye, a m ba àmbò bèe ncʉ̀kì tâ, ka' lor bbyèŋge ba bghàrbèe.
eng: Those who ate were about five thousand men, besides women and children.

lmp: E m làa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ wowèe a niŋ mbe keŋ, tuu nèŋguu rò entombì, tɛ e laasi bèe anà.
eng: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

lmp: E ka' làasi wowèe, a ko' mbe rtùu mimŋgi' à rgèe rloo. À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr e ku bii mbo mimŋgi'.
eng: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà keŋ à dù nè yi yu ànjìsàp sê, mdip mi ce ko' mbekì ce sùu, a ce tʉʉ nyor nje keŋ njobè' fu' yi m ce càa magòr.
eng: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', e du a wâp mbùu, a ce jɛ̀r mbendù rdip.
eng: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yɛ àmbò e ce jɛ̀r mbendù rdip, wowèe a wɛp sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Yu nyir", a ka' làa wa'a, a waa njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp.
eng: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, It's a ghost! and they cried out for fear.

lmp: Jisòs à ku làa nè wowèe à nfè' anà enɛ̂, "Kur nè ntee, a mɛ̀. Wèe fa wɛp ka'."
eng: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying Cheer up! It is I! Don't be afraid.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, ka' ba wɛ̀, à laa tɛ m jɛr mbendù rdip vʉ̀ yɛ wɛ̀."
eng: Peter answered him and said, Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.

lmp: E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀." Pità à fʉʉ embe keŋ a jɛr mbendù rdip a ce dù à ryɛ Jisòs.
eng: He said, Come! Peter stepped down from the boat, and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

lmp: E ka' yɛ àmbò fu' yi ce càa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, a wɛp, a kɛ' a ce sùu njep mʉ̀ rò, a waa a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, jà' mɛ̀."
eng: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, Lord, save me!

lmp: Jisòs à ku fa bo a koo ye àgho, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À yu ŋwɛ̀ ce lo rbyemi li yu mʉcàr. Wɛ̀ ba ce tarni njokɛ?"
eng: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, You of little faith, why did you doubt?

lmp: Wowèe a ka' niŋ mbe keŋ, fu' yi tetì.
eng: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba yap mbe keŋ nà, a gʉ'shì nè ye, a laa enɛ̂. "À yu Muu Nyʉ̀ ghup."
eng: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, You are truly the Son of God!

lmp: Wowèe a ka' tuu nèŋguu rò wɛɛ, a cʉʉ keŋ àwâa rò, a ba sè'ni ba à ŋgôŋ Gɛ̀nɛsarɛ̀t.
eng: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

lmp: Bêe àfo a ka' yɛ ye a rîŋ, a cep ntuu nè bèe ce a m ba à mla' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgòŋ anà. Wowèe a vʉ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce yaŋ,
eng: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region, and brought to him all who were sick,

lmp: a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ e ma'shi tɛ wowèe a ku jòo ba yi cûu cɛ̀'. Ŋgâa byaŋ wɛɛwɛ ce a m jòo ye, a m kè'se.
eng: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

lmp: Mʉ nfè' mò' à ka' tuuse, bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a vʉ a yɛ Jisòs, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

lmp: "Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a fʉʉ enjep ndèe ce visèe bta a m yɛ'ni sèe njokɛ? Wowèe a ke sù'si mmbo à njî yɛɛnì ka' ye byee ka'."
eng: Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don't wash their hands when they eat bread.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Wee wèe e ke fʉʉ enjep mncir Nyʉ̀ njo' ndèe wêe bta njokɛ?
eng: He answered them, Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ a m làa enɛ̂, "Yu'ni nè yò ta ba yò mâ." A ker laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' cɛp yì tâ, kɛ̀ yì ma ɛ̀, banɛ a be yʉ ŋgàŋ."
eng: For God commanded, 'Honor your father and your mother,' and, 'He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'

lmp: Wèe ce làa ye weenɛ, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor yuu ce yi ba jà' yì ma kɛ̀ yì ta àgho, laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ fa nè Nyʉ̀",
eng: But you say, 'Whoever may tell his father or his mother, Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,

lmp: banɛ ŋgàŋ be kèr jà' yì ta ba yì ma àgho ka'. Banɛ wèe à lòr ndèe wêe bta a siŋsi mncir Nyʉ̀ àgho.
eng: he shall not honor his father or mother.' You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni. Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa yuu mini se a kuu wèe à nfè' ce e m ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀,
eng: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe ca a ku ce yu'ni nè mɛ̀ ba nè cùu, yap ntee yi ba ànjìsàp ese mɛ̀.
eng: These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

lmp: Wowèe a ce gèe rloo nè mɛ̀ ba à cicì, njobè' a ce yɛ'ni bèe mncir ce à lɛ̀ bèe, àmbò a lɛ mncir Nyʉ̀ wa'a." "
eng: And in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.'

lmp: E kɛ' bèe ce a m ba àfo, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yu'shi nè bòŋboŋ.
eng: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, Hear, and understand.

lmp: Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke ye, a yuu yi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e bep à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yuu ce yi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e ba jàpri e ke ba yuu ce yi ke fʉʉ ekù cûu ŋwɛ̀."
eng: That which enters into the mouth doesn't defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a vʉ a yɛ ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Wà' à rìŋ wɛnɛ bèe Farìsi a ba yu' yuu ce wɛ̀ ba laa nà, ntee yi bep wowèe se a?"
eng: Then the disciples came, and said to him, Do you know that the Pharisees were offended, when they heard this saying?

lmp: E beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Yuu wɛɛwɛ ce à byè ba yà Ta embe bùu ka', a be kèe co'.
eng: But he answered, Every plant which my heavenly Father didn't plant will be uprooted.

lmp: Mà'shi nè wowèe. Wowèe a yu mnfèp. Nfèp ka' ce dùŋshi nfèp mò' nduunjì, banɛ wowèe a be gwèŋger njep bè'tè bsìp."
eng: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sàr mbùu efa ŋgàa ca nè wèr."
eng: Peter answered him, Explain the parable to us.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Wee wèe à be riŋ buu foŋ ka' a?
eng: So Jesus said, Do you also still not understand?

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ weenɛ yuu wɛɛwɛ ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke ye yi ke dù njep rbʉ̀, lo fʉʉ a?
eng: Don't you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly, and then out of the body?

lmp: Yuu ce yi ke fʉʉ ekù cùu, yi ke lò ba enjep ntee. A njɛ̀ɛ yuu ce yi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e ba jàpri à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

lmp: Buu bbebep àmbò à ryʉ ŋwɛ̀, koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò', bsàkì, byɛ̀ɛ, tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ, laa yuu bebep kuu ŋwɛ̀ mò', yu buu ce bèe a ke kwà'shi à rgèe ba enjep ntee.
eng: For out of the heart come forth evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

lmp: Buu ca a buu ce vi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀, e ba jàpri. À rye yuu ke' su'si mmbo ka', a yuu ce àde' yi gee ŋwɛ̀ e ba jàpri ka'."
eng: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn't defile the man.

lmp: Jisòs à m lô àfo a du à ŋgôŋ Tayà ba Sidòn.
eng: Jesus went out from there, and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

lmp: Ka' cu, njeŋwɛ̀ mô' à ŋgòŋ anà ce à m ku ba njeŋwɛ̀ efa mʉ̀ bèe Kɛnàn à vʉ̂, a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè mɛ̀! Yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi m niŋ njep muu wà, e ce yu' ryaŋ sê."
eng: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders, and cried, saying, Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely demonized!

lmp: Jisòs à laa yuu ka'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ko'shì a yê geŋ, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Làa tɛ e dû, njobè' e ce war a sêe mbùu."
eng: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, Send her away; for she cries after us.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "A m tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m vʉ yɛ ba njèe embe ndʉ̀' Isrɛ̀l ce yi m bʉ."
eng: But he answered, I wasn't sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à vʉ a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a laa enɛ̂. "Tatâ, jà' mɛ̀."
eng: But she came and worshiped him, saying, Lord, help me.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Yi bòŋ enɛ a lor byee boo ma' nè ŋgwe ka'."
eng: But he answered, It is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu mini wa'a, Tatâ, to ŋgwe yi ke kù ce ye mkʉ̀' baa ce mi gwèŋger embe tɛbùr yàp ta foŋ."
eng: But she said, Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters' table.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, Jisòs à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Haba! Njeŋwɛ̀ câ, lo rbyemì li tap sê. Tɛ yi ba nè wɛ̀ àmbò à ce kòŋ na." Muu yì à ku ke'se à nfè' anà.
eng: Then Jesus answered her, Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire. And her daughter was healed from that hour.

lmp: Jisòs à lô àfo, a caa àwâa rô à ŋgòŋ Galèlê, a ko' mbe rtùu, a cu à nshè.
eng: Jesus departed there, and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up into the mountain, and sat there.

lmp: Ku' bèe a vʉ̂, a yɛ ye mbo. Wowèe a m vʉ̀ nè bèe ce a m ba mntɛ̀ŋ, ba bèe ce a m kepŋger, ba mnfèp, ba blʉr, ker ba bèe magòr ce a m ce yaŋ, a lɛ njep yê tìi, e gee wowèe a ke'sè.
eng: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

lmp: Bèe a ka' yɛ àmbò blʉr a ce làa, bèe ce a m kepŋger a ce jɛ̀r, mntɛ̀ŋ a ce jɛ̀r bòŋboŋ, mnfèp a ce yɛ buu, a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a ku'si Nyʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l.
eng: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, injured whole, lame walking, and blind seeing--and they glorified the God of Israel.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce koosimnse nè bèe ca sê. Wèr wowèe à cu à mnôŋ btaar, wowèe a ke' koni yuu ye ka'. M ce kòŋ à rlàa tɛ wowèe a du nè njè ka' fà dì' wowèe a du gwè njè à nduunjì ka'."
eng: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, I have compassion on the multitude, because they continue with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don't want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Àde' wèr konì brɛ̂d ba efɛ ka' nyaŋ ku' bèe ca àgho, ce àfa ku ba rìŋ na?"
eng: The disciples said to him, Where should we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe tʉr brɛ̂d sɛ'?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr tʉr brɛ̂d sàambâ, ba mʉ nca mo'."
eng: Jesus said to them, How many loaves do you have? They said, Seven, and a few small fish.

lmp: E laa nè bèe cà enɛ wowèe a cute à nshè.
eng: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;

lmp: A ka' cute, e lor brɛ̂d sàambâ ba nca cà, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, wowèe a gapshì nè bèe anà.
eng: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a ye, a yu'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a baashì bbɛbɛ' ce vi m bɛti, vi ruu à mŋkàa sàambâ.
eng: They all ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù wɛɛwɛ ce a m ye, a m ba ncʉ̀kì kyèe, ka' lor bbyèŋge ba bghàrbèe.
eng: Those who ate were four thousand men, besides women and children.

lmp: Jisòs à laasì bèe, a niŋ mbe keŋ a du à ŋgôŋ Magadàn.
eng: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi ba bèe Sadùsî, a m dù à rmòoshi Jisòs, a laa nè ye enɛ e duŋshi wowèe ncòo embe bùu.
eng: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

lmp: E beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wee ke yɛ àmbò rbuu li bàŋ à mbùuŋkùr, wèe laa weenɛ ŋgòŋ yi be fʉʉ bòŋ,
eng: But he answered them, When it is evening, you say, 'It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.'

lmp: e ba à ŋgàptʉ', wèe yɛ àmbò rbuu li ce bàŋ nè mmbà'-ŋwɛ̀, wèe laa weenɛ, ŋgòŋ yi be bep nè fu' ntìni sê. Wèe rìŋ à rfyɛ' rbuu, rìŋ àmbò ŋgòŋ yi be ba. Ka' yi yu wa'a, àde' wèe riŋ yuu ce ncòo yî sè'ni na tɛɛ àtu mo ka'.
eng: In the morning, 'It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.' Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can't discern the signs of the times!

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ bèe ce a yu ŋgâa bsàrbuu, a ba mini nè Nyʉ̀ ka' ce a ker ce ròo enɛ a duŋshi wowèe ncòo. M be dùŋshi wowèe ncòo mò' caa efa ncòo yì Jonà ka'." Jisòs à ka' laa wa'a, a ma'shì wowèe mbo a dû.
eng: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah. He left them, and departed.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m tuu nèŋguu rò a lese à rlòr brɛ̂d.
eng: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nfè' nè yis bèe Farìsi ba bèe Sadùsî."
eng: Jesus said to them, Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce làa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "E làa wa'a njobè' sèe à vʉ̀ nè brɛ̂d ka'."
eng: They reasoned among themselves, saying, We brought no bread.

lmp: Jisòs à riŋ yuu ce wowèe a ce làa, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce le rbyemì li yu mʉcàr, wèe ce làa fa wêe mʉ enɛ wèe tʉr brɛ̂d ka' njokɛ?
eng: Jesus, perceiving it, said, Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, 'because you have brought no bread?'

lmp: Wèe à be riŋ buu ka' a? Mbò wèe ce kuushi brɛ̂d ta ce a m nyaŋ bèe ncʉ̀kì ta àgho ker ba mŋkàa ce wèe à m baashi bbɛbɛ' àgho nà ka' a?
eng: Don't you yet perceive, neither remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

lmp: Mbò wèe ce kuushi brɛ̂d sàamba ce a m nyaŋ bèe ncʉ̀kì kyèe àgho nà, ker ba mŋkàa ce wèe à m baashi bbɛbɛ' àgho nà ka' a?
eng: Nor the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

lmp: Wèe à ba riŋ weenɛ m ce làa nè wèe ba àmbò brɛ̂d ka' ka' njokɛ? Lòr nè nfè' nè yis bèe Farìsi ba bèe Sadùsî."
eng: How is it that you don't perceive that I didn't speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a riŋ sè'ni enɛ e ba ce làa nè wowèe ba enɛ wowèe a lor nfè' nè yis brɛ̂d ka', e ba ce làa ba enɛ wowèe a lor nfè' nè ryɛ'nì bèe Farìsi ba bèe Sadùsî.
eng: Then they understood that he didn't tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

lmp: Jisòs à m dù, a ka' bà' à mʉ̀ mla' ce mi m ba àgee rla' Sisàriyà Filèpâi, a bipshi nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Bèe a ce làa enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ yu ba nda?"
eng: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ yu Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe, bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ yu Àlajà, bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ, ka' tɛ ba Jɛ̀rìmiyà ka' banɛ yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ mò'."
eng: They said, Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah, or one of the prophets.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yi yu yi ekɛ àmbò wèe? Wèe ce làa ye weenɛ m yu nda?"
eng: He said to them, But who do you say that I am?

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ Krâis anà ce e yu Muu Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe."
eng: Simon Peter answered, You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À yu ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu, Saimʉ̀n, muu Jonà, njobè' à gèe ŋwɛ̀ wɛ̀ ka' riŋ yuu ce wɛ̀ làa na ka', à gèe ba yà Ta ce e yu mbe bùu.
eng: Jesus answered him, Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

lmp: M ce suŋ wɛ̂ Pità enɛ à yu ryɛɛ. M be bà'ri yà cor mbendù ryɛɛ anà ce àde' ka' rkwe ɛ̀, li gee yuu mo' àgho ka'.
eng: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

lmp: M be fa wɛ̀ bki embe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ embe bùu. Yuu ce wɛ̀ ka' kur njep ŋgòŋ na, banɛ a be kur yi mbe bùu. Yuu ce wɛ̀ ka' fyɛɛshi njep ŋgòŋ na banɛ a be fyɛ̀ɛshi yi mbe bùu."
eng: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

lmp: E m cìisi nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ wowèe a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' enɛ e yu Krâis anà ka'.
eng: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

lmp: Kɛ' ese à nfè' anà, Jisòs à kɛ' a ce raasi nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ e be kù dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, yɛ ŋgɛ' mbà mmbo bleebèe ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir gòr sê, tɛ a yʉ ye, mnòŋ vi ba btaar e fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

lmp: Pità à koo ye, a ye a lɛ'sì nyor, a kɛ' a ce lapni ye a ce làa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, Nyʉ̀ fɛɛsi! Àde' njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca yi ke' koni nè wɛ̀ ka'."
eng: Peter took him aside, and began to rebuke him, saying, Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.

lmp: E karsì nyor, a laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Lò efa mɛ̂ geŋ, Satàn! À ce jepsi mɛ̀. Mo mkwà'shì mi yu ba mi ŋwɛ̀, yu mi Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: But he turned, and said to Peter, Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.

lmp: E ka' làa nè ye wa' wɛɛ, a laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce kòŋ à rvʉ̀ a mɛ̂ mbùu banɛ ŋgàŋ kani yì nyor, byɛ' yi kìntaa vʉ a mɛ̂ mbùu,
eng: Then Jesus said to his disciples, If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

lmp: njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rboŋshi li ryòŋ banɛ ŋgàŋ be bɛ li. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ boŋshi li ryòŋ ka', njo' mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni li.
eng: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ konì ba njɛ̀ɛ sɛ' kɛ, ce e ka' tʉr buu enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ, lo bɛ li ryòŋ? Yuu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ fa àtu li ryòŋ a kɛ?
eng: For what will it profit a man, if he gains the whole world, and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe buu ca njobè' Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be vʉ̀ nè fòo yì Tâ, a vi bcìndap wèe, là' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à buu ce e m ce gèe.
eng: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will render to everyone according to his deeds.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ bèe mo' a yu à mʉ̀ bèe ce a tɛɛte mbena ce rkwe li be jòo wowèe ka', tɛ wowèe a ku cu caar, yɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ àmbò e ce vʉ̀ nè yi kʉʉ-ŋwɛ̀."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi ka' càa ntuunfu, Jisòs à lor Pità ba Jɛ̂ms, ba Jôn ce e m ba nfʉr Jɛ̂ms, a wowèe a ko' mbe rtûu rsàsap, à ku ba wowèe mbo cà'cà'.
eng: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

lmp: A m bà' mbo, Jisòs à kupsè a ba à njɛ̂ɛ jɛɛ, vi bsii vi raa àmbò nyʉ̀, vi bcɛ̀' vi ce là'ŋger.
eng: He was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

lmp: Ka' cu, Àlajà ba Musìs a nyɛɛ, a ce de' a Jisòs.
eng: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

lmp: Pità à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yi bòŋ àmbò sèe yu àfa na. Mà'shi tɛ m ba'ri btàp vi btaar, tɛ mo' ba yo, tɛ mo' ba yî Musìs, tɛ mo' ba yî Àlajà."
eng: Peter answered, and said to Jesus, Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let's make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

lmp: E ka' kù bii ce làa, mmbà' ce rraa li m ce fʉʉ enjo vi vʉ a cete wowèe, njèndoŋ à laa embe mʉ̀ mmbà' anà enɛ̂, "Cena yu muu wà, ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, a ce yu' rbòŋ nè ye. Ce yu' nè yuu ce e ce làa."
eng: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yu', a wɛp sê, a gweŋger nè bsii njep nshè.
eng: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

lmp: Jisòs à vʉ̂, a joo wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Nàti nè mbekì, wèe fa wɛp ka'."
eng: Jesus came and touched them and said, Get up, and don't be afraid.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' nàa map mmir, a ker yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' caa efa Jisòs ka'.
eng: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce sùu embe rtùu, Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' yuu ce wèe à yɛ ka' caar tɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ke fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, Don't tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Banɛ ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a ce làa enɛ Àlajà be vʉ̀ entòmbì njokɛ?"
eng: His disciples asked him, saying, Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?

lmp: E beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Rtarnì li yu njo ka', Àlajà be vʉ̀. E be vʉ̀ gèe tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ kʉti àmbò vi m ba.
eng: Jesus answered them, Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe enɛ Àlajà à vʉ̀ wɛɛ, bèe a rìŋ ye ka', a ku ce gèe buu ce a m ce kòŋ à rgèe nè ye. Yi yu enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ye ye be yɛ ŋgɛ' mbe wâp mmbò."
eng: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn't recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a riŋ sè'ni enɛ e ba ce làa nè wowèe enɛ Àlajà à vʉ̀ wɛɛ wa'a, a ce làa ba àmbò Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe.
eng: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' kʉti, yɛ bèe cà, ŋwɛ̀ mò' a vʉ̂, a gʉ'shi njeptii Jisòs,
eng: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him, saying,

lmp: a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, koosimnse nè muu wà, njobè' e ce gwè kà', a ce yɛ ŋgɛ' sê. E ke lò ku gwe njep mor, ba njep mdip.
eng: Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic, and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Haba! Wêe bèe elùuni ce wèe buu rbyemì, a beesi mini tʉtʉ̀ŋ na. M be cu wèe sèe dù bà' fɛ? M be kur ntee nè wèe dù bà' fɛ? Vʉ̀ nè muu anà fa nè mɛ̀ mbena."
eng: Jesus answered, Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.

lmp: Jisòs à lapnì yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' anà, yi fʉʉ enjep muu anà, e ku ke'sè à nfè' anà.
eng: Jesus rebuked him, the demon went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a vʉ̂, à ku ba Jisòs a wowèe, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à ba moo à rfʉr yʉ' anà làr njokɛ?"
eng: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, Why weren't we able to cast it out?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Wèe à ba moo làr njobè' le rbyemì li yu mʉcàr àmbò ŋgʉ̀ mostà. M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ le rbyemì li ka' ba mʉcàr se àmbò ŋgʉ̀ mostà, àde' wèe ku laa nè rtùu ca enɛ̂, co'ti embe na, du mbena, tɛ li ku co'ti, tɛ yuu mo' yi ker ba tatap nè wèe ka'.
eng: He said to them, Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, 'Move from here to there,' and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò njɛ̀ɛ yʉ' ca, àde' a fʉr yi enjep ŋwɛ̀ ka', ce a ka' tɛ gèe rloo, jì mdip ka'."
eng: But this kind doesn't go out except by prayer and fasting.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a ka' vʉ̀ àbee à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A be lòr Muu Ŋwɛ̀ fa mbà mmbo bèe,
eng: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

lmp: tɛ a yʉ ye, mnòŋ vi ba btaar, tɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe." E ka' làa wa'a, yi bep wowèe sê.
eng: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up. They were exceedingly sorry.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù bà' à rla' Kàpanùm, ŋgâa ŋkùu mbàa embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a vʉ̂, a yɛ Pità, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Yò ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì e ke là' mbàa embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a?"
eng: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, Doesn't your teacher pay the didrachma?

lmp: Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no". A ka' niŋ mbe ndàp, Jisòs à kɛ' a laa yuu nè ye entombì. E m làa enɛ̂, "À ce kwà'shi yo wɛnɛ kɛ Saimʉ̀n? Bèe ce a ke là' mbàa nè bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na e ke ba wêe kɛ? E ke là' ŋgâa to' kɛ̀ bkìlò?"
eng: He said, Yes. When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?

lmp: Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "E ke là' bkìlò." Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Banɛ àde' ŋgâa to' a la' ka'.
eng: Peter said to him, From strangers. Jesus said to him, Therefore the children are exempt.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, sèe ce kòŋ enɛ nyor bep bèe ca nè sèe ka'. Dù mbà rò, ma' yò huk njep rò, nca ce wɛ̀ ka' koo entombì, à mʉ' cùu efa gho. Wɛ̂ mʉ̀', tɛ à yɛ mbàa kôo. Wɛ̂ yɛ, à fʉr, la' mbàa ya ba yo àgho."
eng: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a vʉ̂, a yɛ ye, a bipshi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr sê mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yu nda?"
eng: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?

lmp: E kɛ' mʉ ghàrŋwɛ̀, a tɛr mbe wâp mʉ,
eng: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the midst of them,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe à ka' tɛ kupse, ba àmbò boo bkɛ' ka', àde' wèe niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: and said, Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn, and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' lor yì nyor njep nshè àmbò muu ŋkɛ' ca, ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr se mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀.
eng: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child, the same is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni muu ghàrŋwɛ̀ àmbò ca a mɛ̂ rlii, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni mɛ̀.
eng: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ a ka' gee mò' efa boo bkɛ' ce a byemi nè mɛ̀ na a gee yuu bebep, banɛ yi be ba àndèe nè ŋgàŋ, ce a ka' lor ma lûr ŋgò' baa, cʉʉ ye kù ndoŋ, ma' ye njep rdip rgòr, tɛ e no mdip kwe.
eng: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him that a huge millstone should be hung around his neck, and that he should be sunk in the depths of the sea.

lmp: Ndòo à co' ŋgòŋ njobè' buu yu njep ŋgòŋ ce vi ke gèe bèe a ce gèe buu bbebep. Buu ca vi be kù ce ba. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ndòo be co' ŋwɛ̀ ce buu ca vi be vʉ̀ njo' ye.
eng: Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ e ka' roo yɛ, banɛ e be lu'shi à njèe yî mò'sir ce e yɛ na, càa yî ncòp-bʉ̀'ʉ-à-mmbʉ̀'ʉ ce yi dà' yi ka' nà.
eng: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

lmp: Yi ku ba wa'a nè yè Ta ce e yu mbe bùu. E ce kòŋ enɛ mò' efa boo bkɛ' ca bʉ ka'.
eng: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

lmp: "Nfʉrò à ka' gee yuu bebep nè wɛ̀, à du yɛ ye, suŋ ye. Suŋ ye à nfè' ce ku ba wèe ye bèe a mmbaa. E ka' byemì enɛ e gèe yuu bebep, banɛ wɛ̀ gèe wèe ye à ker kʉti bfʉr.
eng: If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, Pità à bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, nfʉrà à ka' ce gèe buu bbebep nè mɛ̀, m foosì bkâŋ sɛ'? Àde' m foosì ye caar ba' ŋkàrà' sàamba a?"
eng: Then Peter came and said to him, Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à ku foosi ye ba ŋkàrà' sàamba cà'cà' ka'. Fòosi ye ŋkàrà' msàambâ, bdì' sàambâ.
eng: Jesus said to him, I don't tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò ŋkʉʉ ce e m ce kòŋ à rfyɛ' ŋwâ' mŋkaa ŋgâa mfà'.
eng: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who wanted to reconcile accounts with his servants.

lmp: E ka' kɛ̀' ce fyɛ', a vʉ nè ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò' ce e m tʉr rkaa a ye à mmalàr àŋgoo.
eng: When he had begun to reconcile, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

lmp: E ka' tʉr yuu ce e la' rkaa anà àgho ka', yì masà à laa enɛ a koo ye ba ŋgwa yì ba boo vi, ker lor yì buu wɛɛwɛ, fyeni la' li rkaa àgho.
eng: But because he couldn't pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà à gwe njep yê tìi, a bu' mmbo nè ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Fa mɛ̀ mʉ nfè' mò' tɛ m roo mbàa, là' rkaa anà wɛɛwɛ."
eng: The servant therefore fell down and kneeled before him, saying, 'Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!'

lmp: Yì masà à koosìmnse nè ye, a laa enɛ e dû, e mà'shi mbàa anà nè ye.
eng: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him, and forgave him the debt.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà à ka' fʉʉ embe ndàp, a tarte a ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò' ce a ye a m ba nè rkaa foŋ à bàa mbàa, a koo ye, a kaa à ndoŋ, a laa enɛ̂, "Là' ya mbàa."
eng: But that servant went out, and found one of his fellow servants, who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him, and took him by the throat, saying, 'Pay me what you owe!'

lmp: E kanì, a fa ye ba à shaŋ enɛ e kèe là' yi mbàa wɛɛ ka' fʉʉ embo.
eng: He would not, but went and cast him into prison, until he should pay back that which was due.

lmp: Ŋgâa mfà' mo' a ka' yɛ yuu ce yi m koni na, yi bep wowèe sê, wowèe a dû, a suŋ yàp masà buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi m koni anà.
eng: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told to their lord all that was done.

lmp: Yàp masà à kɛ' ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ bsàrbuu câ, wɛ̀ ba bu' mmbo nè mɛ̀, mɛ̀ laa mɛnɛ mɛ̀ mà'shi ku' mbàa anà nè wɛ̀.
eng: Then his lord called him in, and said to him, 'You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt, because you begged me.

lmp: Àde' wɛ̀ ke' ba koosimnse foŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò' ca àmbò mɛ̀ ba koosi nè wɛ̀ nà ka' a?"
eng: Shouldn't you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?'

lmp: Ntee yi yaŋ yì masà, e fa ye mbe mmbo ŋgâa ŋkè'ni ŋgâa shaŋ enɛ a fa ye ŋgɛ' caar tɛ e la' yi mbàa wɛɛwɛ.
eng: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors, until he should pay all that was due to him.

lmp: A mbò yà Ta embe bùu be gèe nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ efa wêe mʉ wa'a, ce wèe a ka' tɛ ce fòosi bfʉr wee enje ntee ka'."
eng: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don't each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca mìsi, a lô à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a du à mbèp ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà ce e yu nèŋguu rdip Jodàn.
eng: It happened when Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee, and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

lmp: Ku' bèe a du a yê mbùu, a ka' bà' àfo, e gee ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'sè.
eng: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi mo' a vʉ a mooshi ye, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ncir yi byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ juu ŋgwa yì ka' àtu kɛ a?"
eng: Pharisees came to him, testing him, and saying, Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?

lmp: E beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Mbò wèe à bè' Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ a yɛ weenɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m boo bèe efa rkɛ̀', e m boo mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ba njeŋwɛ̀ a?
eng: He answered, Haven't you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "À ka' ba njobè' mɛ̀ m boo mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ba njeŋwɛ̀, mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ be mà'shi yì ta ba yì mâ, cu a ŋgwa yì, tɛ a ye a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir."
eng: and said, 'For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall join to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh?'

lmp: Banɛ wowèe a ker ba a baa ka'. A yu ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir. Banɛ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à tarshi, ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa gàpse ka'."
eng: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don't let man tear apart.

lmp: Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Musìs à m ka' ba laa enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ fa ŋwà' nè njeŋwɛ̀ à rdùŋshi enɛ e sà'si gùu, ka' juu ye njokɛ?"
eng: They asked him, Why then did Moses command us to give her a bill of divorce, and divorce her?

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Musìs à m mà'shi enɛ wèe juu wee bbyèŋge njobè' wèe tèe btu sê. Yi m ba wa'a efa rkɛ̀' ka'.
eng: He said to them, Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' juu ŋgwa yì, ke' ba njobè' enɛ ŋgwa yì à nòŋ a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', ker lor ŋgwa mò', banɛ ŋgàŋ à koo njeŋwɛ̀ ce yu ŋgwa yì ka'."
eng: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ba wa'a nè mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ba ŋgwa yì, banɛ yi bòŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ lor ŋgwa ka'."
eng: His disciples said to him, If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ byemì yuu ca ka'. Bèe ce àde' a byemì ku ba bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe enɛ wowèe a byemi.
eng: But he said to them, Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

lmp: Bèe mo' a yu bkar njobè' a m bi wowèe a ku ba bkar, bèe mo' a ba bkar njobè' bèe a gèe wowèe a ba bkar. Bèe mo' a yu bkar njobè' à gèe wowèe a gee wap mnyor à bkar njo' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e byemì yuu mɛ̀ làa na, ŋgàŋ byemi yi."
eng: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother's womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven's sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m vʉ̀ nè bghàrbèe enɛ Jisòs bo la' mmbo mbe wâp ndù, loo nè wowèe. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a lapnì bèe anà.
eng: Then little children were brought to him, that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Mà'shi nè tɛ bghàrbèe anà a vʉ yɛ mɛ̀. Wèe fa jepsi wowèe ka', njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu nè bèe ce a yu àmbò bghàrbèe ca."
eng: But Jesus said, Allow the little children, and don't forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.

lmp: E la' mi mmbo mbe wâp ndù, a loo, a nati a dû.
eng: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m vʉ̀ a yɛ Jisòs, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂. "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, yuu bòŋboŋ ce àde' m gee ka' koni ryòŋ ce nfesè yu ba kɛ?"
eng: Behold, one came to him and said, Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?

lmp: E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ bipshi nè mɛ̀ àmbò yuu bòŋboŋ njokɛ? Ku ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ. Wɛ̀ ka' ce kòŋ à rkoni ryòŋ ce nfesè, à lɛ mncir."
eng: He said to him, Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Mncir vî fɛ?" Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Fa yʉ ka', fa koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', fa yɛ̀ɛ ka', fa tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ ka',
eng: He said to him, Which ones? Jesus said, 'You shall not murder.' 'You shall not commit adultery.' 'You shall not steal.' 'You shall not offer false testimony.'

lmp: yu'ni nè yò ta ba yò mâ, ker ce koŋ nfʉrò àmbò à kòŋ yò nyor."
eng: Honor your father and mother.' And, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'

lmp: Muu nsùnsù ca à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ lɛ̀ mncir ca wɛɛwɛ, banɛ yuu ce àde' m ker gee yu ba kɛ?"
eng: The young man said to him, All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ce kòŋ à rba yɛɛnì se à bsii Nyʉ̀, à du fyeni yò buu wɛɛwɛ, lor mbàa efa gho, gapshi nè ŋgâa fùp, tɛ à bo tʉr bkù' mbe bùu. Wɛ̂ gèe wa' wɛɛ, vʉ a mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Jesus said to him, If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.

lmp: Muu nsùnsù ca à ka' yu' wa'a, a sɛ sê, a nati a du njobè' e m tʉr ku' buu sê.
eng: But when the young man heard the saying, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ yi yu tatap nè ŋwɛ̀ mbàa à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀.
eng: Jesus said to his disciples, Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

lmp: M ker ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ yi yu àtɛ̀r nè kàmɛl à rtose njep rlir nsàrà' nè ŋwɛ̀ mbàa à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yu' wa'a, a bɛɛŋger sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e lûŋ, yu ba nda?"
eng: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, Who then can be saved?

lmp: Jisòs à fyɛ' wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Ca yi yu tatap se nè bèe, à ka' ba yi nè Nyʉ̀, buu wɛɛwɛ yu àtɛ̀r."
eng: Looking at them, Jesus said, With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.

lmp: Pità à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, wèr à mà'shi yèr buu wɛɛwɛ a vʉ a wɛ̂ mbùu. Banɛ yuu ce wèr be koni yu ba kɛ?"
eng: Then Peter answered, Behold, we have left everything, and followed you. What then will we have?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ be kèe ba à nfè' ce a gèe buu wɛɛwɛ vi kʉtì bfi, a nfè' ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kèe cu mbe kàbàrà' nè yi fòo embe bùu-ŋwɛ̀ nà, tɛ wèe ce wèe à vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ mbùu na, cu mbe bkàbàrà' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, ce sa' mntɛ̀' Isrɛ̀l ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: Jesus said to them, Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' ma'shi vi mndap, kɛ̀ bfʉr vi, kɛ̀ bjar vi, kɛ̀ yì tâ, kɛ̀ yì mâ, kɛ̀ boo vi, kɛ̀ yi ŋgòŋ ce e tʉr ɛ̀, njo' mɛ̀, e be koni ku' buu sê, càa àmbò e m tʉr nà kàŋ rjèe, kèr koni ryòŋ ce nfesè foŋ.
eng: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name's sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

lmp: Bèe magòr ce a yu entombì sè'ni na, a be kèe ba elʉ̀simbùu, tɛ bèe magòr ce a yu elʉ̀simbùu sè'ni na, a ba entombì.
eng: But many will be last who are first; and first who are last.

lmp: "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m fʉʉ à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' mò' a du a ròo bèe tɛ a bo fà' yi nsuu.
eng: For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, ŋwɛ̀ nsuu à laa nè yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa mfà' enɛ̂, "Kɛ' ŋgâa mfà', la' wowèe. Kɛ̀' la' bèe ce mɛ̀ ba lor elʉ̀simbùu nà, ka' la' bɛr bèe, misi nè bèe ce mɛ̀ ba lor entombì nà."
eng: When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, 'Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.'

lmp: Bèe ce a m lòr wowèe à rfà' àmbò à nyʉ̀ ta nà, a vʉ̂, a la' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ mbʉ̀ mbàa.
eng: When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

lmp: Koo yo mbàa dû. À kwà'shi ba mɛ̀ à rlà' wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e ba vʉ rfà' elʉ̀simbùu yɛɛnì.
eng: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

lmp: Mbò m tʉr ŋger à rgèe yuu ce m ce kòŋ nè ya mbàa a? Kɛ̀ à ce ko'ndoŋ njobè' m yu mmbo-mtoo lɛ̂?"
eng: Isn't it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?'

lmp: Yi yu enɛ bèe ce a yu entòmbì a be kèe ba elʉ̀simbùu, tɛ bèe ce a yu elʉ̀simbùu a ba entombì."
eng: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.

lmp: Jisòs à m ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a ka' ce dù, a lor ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a wowèe a lɛ'sì nyor, e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

lmp: "Yɛ nè, Sèe ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, tɛ a du fa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ mbà mmbo bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir. Wowèe a be sa' ye, teni enɛ a yʉ ye,
eng: Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

lmp: Ma boo vi Sɛbɛ̀di à m vʉ̀ a boo vi wèe, a yɛ Jisòs. E m gwè njep yê tìi, a laa enɛ e gee yuu nè ye.
eng: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ kòŋ enɛ m gee ba kɛ nè wɛ̀?" E beesì enɛ̂, "M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ à laa tɛ mò' efa boo wa ke cu à yo bo mà', tɛ mò' cu à yo bo ŋkòp, à nfè' ce à ce sa' yo kʉʉ."
eng: He said to her, What do you want? She said to him, Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand, and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Wèe yi yuu ce wèe ce bipshi ka'. Àde' wèe no enjep ndoŋ ce m be no enjo a?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Àde' wèr no enjo."
eng: But Jesus answered, You don't know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with? They said to him, We are able.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe be no enjep ndoŋ ce m be no enjo ghup. Ka' yi yu wa'a, mɛ̀ tʉr ŋger à rlàa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ cu a mɛ̂ bo mà' kɛ̀ a mɛ̂ bo ŋkòp ka'. Bdì' anà vi yu ba nè bèe ce yà Ta à m kupshi a lɛ nè wowèe."
eng: He said to them, You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with, but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give; but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.

lmp: Bɛr ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce bèe nrʉʉ a ka' yu' yuu ce a bipshi na, yi bep wowèe sê.
eng: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ'shì wowèe àbee, a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe rìŋ weenɛ ŋgâa rsa' bèe enje jɛɛ a ke sa' yap bèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ sê, bêe bgòrgòr mo' a lor yap ŋger, nyʉ' bèe àgho foŋ.
eng: But Jesus summoned them, and said, You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca yi fa kèe ba fa wêe mʉ ka'. Yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ efa wêe mʉ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr, banɛ ŋgàŋ ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè wèe,
eng: It shall not be so among you, but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce kòŋ à rba entombì ba ye ŋkwàa.
eng: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

lmp: Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ye ye à m vʉ̀ enɛ bèe a bo fà' nè ye ka'. E m vʉ̀ yi tɛ e bo fà', kèr fa li ryòŋ, tee bèe magòr efa rkwe."
eng: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

lmp: Wowèe a m lô à rla' Jɛ̀rikù a ce dù, bèe magòr a ce dù a yê mbùu.
eng: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

lmp: Ka' cu, mmbaŋrù mo' bèe a mmbaa ce a m ba mnfèp a cu àwâa nduunjì. A ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs ce càa, wowèe a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè wèr."
eng: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!

lmp: Bèe cà a lapnì wowèe, a laa enɛ wowèe a cu nyaŋ. Wowèe a ker misi a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè wèr."
eng: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!

lmp: Jisòs à tɛɛ, a kɛ' wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kòŋ weenɛ m gee mɛ kɛ nè wèe?"
eng: Jesus stood still, and called them, and asked, What do you want me to do for you?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wèr ce kòŋ enɛ à gee tɛ wèr yɛ buu."
eng: They told him, Lord, that our eyes may be opened.

lmp: Jisòs à koosimnse nè wowèe, a joo map mmir, wowèe a ku kɛ' a ce yɛ buu, a nati a du a yê mbùu.
eng: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀ bà' àtʉtʉ rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, ba sè'ni ba à rla' Bɛtɛfɛ̀ ce li m ba àgee rtùu Olèf. Jisòs à tuu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu bèe a mmbaa,
eng: When they drew near to Jerusalem, and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Dù nè nje rla' enje wêe cùu na. Wèe be bà' njo tɛ wèe ku yɛ àmbò a cʉʉ jàaki', muu à tɛɛ àgee mo. Fyɛ̀ɛ nè vʉ àgho fa nè mɛ̀.
eng: saying to them, Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them, and bring them to me.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' laa yuu mo' nè wèe, wèe suŋ ye enɛ̂, "Tata ce tà' gèe yuu àgho," tɛ e ku mà'shi tɛ wèe vʉ àgho."
eng: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, 'The Lord needs them,' and immediately he will send them.

lmp: Ca yi m koni wa'a, tɛ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa njì enjep yì ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu yi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: All this was done, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Suŋ nè bêe à rla' Sayòn enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, yè ŋkʉʉ ce vʉ̀ à ryɛ wèe, a ba nè rbornì-ŋwɛ̀, a cu mbendù muu jàaki'." "
eng: Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs, a dû, a gee yuu ce Jisòs à m làa nè wowèe.
eng: The disciples went, and did just as Jesus commanded them,

lmp: Wowèe a m vʉ̀ nè jàaki', ba muu, a co'ni bcɛ̀' a laashi mbendù mo, Jisòs à ko' a cu mbo.
eng: and brought the donkey and the colt, and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

lmp: Ku' bèe magòr se a laashì bcɛ̀' njep nduunjì, bèe mo' a gwar mnta' ce, a laashi njo.
eng: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees, and spread them on the road.

lmp: Ku' bèe ce a m ce dù entombì, ker ba ku' bèe ce a m ce vʉ̀ embe yê njì, a kɛ' a ce yòp enɛ̂, "Sèe ku'si Muu Dɛvìd! Nyʉ̀ ghoni ŋwɛ̀ ce e vʉ̀ à rlii Tatâ! Sèe ku'si Nyʉ̀ embe bùu!"
eng: The multitudes who went before him, and who followed kept shouting, Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

lmp: Jisòs à ka' niŋ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, rla' wɛɛwɛ li ci'tì, bèe a ce bipshi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu nda?"
eng: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, Who is this?

lmp: Bèe ce a wowèe a m ba nà a beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu Jisòs, ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce à rla' Nasarɛ̂t à ŋgôŋ Galèlê."
eng: The multitudes said, This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.

lmp: Jisòs à m niŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a juu bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce fyèni buu, ba bèe ce a m ce yuu buu mbo, a bute btɛbùr ese bèe ce a m ce kupse mbàa, a bute mnta' ese bèe ce a m ce fyèni bbèŋ.
eng: Jesus entered into the temple of God, and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "A be too yà ndap enɛ ndap rloo." Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe à gèe yà ndap à kʉtì ba à mbʉ̀' byɛ̀ɛ."
eng: He said to them, It is written, 'My house shall be called a house of prayer,' but you have made it a den of robbers!

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba mnfèp, ba bèe ce a m ba mntɛ̀ŋ a m vʉ̀ a yɛ ye mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ anà, e gee wowèe a lûŋ.
eng: The blind and the lame came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, a ka' yɛ buu bbɛ̀ɛ ce e m gèe na, kèr yu' àmbò bghàrbèe a ce yòp mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Sèe ku'si Muu Dɛvìd", ntee yi yaŋ wowèe sê.
eng: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, Hosanna to the son of David! they were indignant,

lmp: Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce yu' yuu ce boo ca a ce yòp a?" Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no, àmbò wèe à be be' dì' mo' embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ ce yi ce làa enɛ̂, "Wèe à yɛ'ni bghàrbèe, ba boo ce a bii nyoŋ mmbee, wowèe a ce kù'si Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ se" nà a?"
eng: and said to him, Do you hear what these are saying? Jesus said to them, Yes. Did you never read, 'Out of the mouth of babes and nursing babies you have perfected praise?'

lmp: E ma'shì wowèe a fʉʉ efa rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a du à rla' Bɛtanì, a noŋ àfo.
eng: He left them, and went out of the city to Bethany, and lodged there.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', e ka' nàti ce kʉti à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, njè à ce yaŋ ye.
eng: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

lmp: E m yɛ ce fik àwâa nduunjì, a du a fyɛ' mbo, a yɛ yuu mo' mbo caa efa bfù cà'cà' ka'. E laa nè yi enɛ̂, "Àde' à ke yʉ mbàŋ à nfè' mò' ka'." Ce fik anà yi ku yopri.
eng: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it, and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, Let there be no fruit from you forever! Immediately the fig tree withered away.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yɛ wa'a, a bɛɛŋger sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Ce fik ca yi ba yopri cɛrcɛr wa'a ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, How did the fig tree immediately wither away?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ, wèe à ka' byemi ke' ce tarni ka', àde' wèe ku gee ba yuu ce mɛ̀ gèe nè ce fik na cà'cà' ka', àde' wèe ku laa nè rtùu ca foŋ enɛ, "Co'ti embo nà du gwe njep rdip rgòr", yi ku ba wa'a.
eng: Jesus answered them, Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith, and don't doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' it would be done.

lmp: Wèe à ka' byemi, banɛ wèe be koni buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe à ka' bipshi nè Nyʉ̀ à rloo."
eng: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.

lmp: E ka' bà' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a niŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a ce yɛ'ni bèe mbo. Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba bleebèe, a vʉ a yɛ ye, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋger ce à ce gèe buu ca àgho yi lò efɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa wɛ̀ ŋger ca à fa nda?"
eng: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M be bipshi yuu mo' nè wèe foŋ. Wèe à ka' beesî, banɛ m be suŋ wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa mɛ̀ ŋger à rgèe buu ca.
eng: Jesus answered them, I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

lmp: Ŋger ce Jôn à m tʉr à rbàptir bèe nà yi m lò ba efɛ? Yi m lò ba ese Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ ese bèe?" Wowèe a du mcʉ̀, a seesi a laa enɛ̂, "Sèe à ka' laa seenɛ̂, yi ŋger anà yi m lò ese Nyʉ̀, banɛ e be bipshi nè sèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à m ka' ba byemi yuu ce e m làa ka' njokɛ?"
eng: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men? They reasoned with themselves, saying, If we say, 'From heaven,' he will ask us, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

lmp: Sèe ka' laa ba seenɛ̂, "Yi m lò ese ŋwɛ̀", banɛ bèe a be bàa sèe njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a byemi enɛ Jôn à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀."
eng: But if we say, 'From men,' we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.

lmp: Wowèe a kʉtì a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Wèr rìŋ ka'." E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ be suŋ wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa mɛ̀ ŋger à rgèe buu ca ka'.
eng: They answered Jesus, and said, We don't know. He also said to them, Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

lmp: "Wèe ce kwà'shi wee kɛ àmbò ca? Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m tʉr boo a baa. E m dù, a yɛ ŋwɛ̂ nlee a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Muu wà, dù fa' nsuu ntìni."
eng: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, 'Son, go work today in my vineyard.'

lmp: E beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, m be dù ka'," a ka' làa wa'a, a ker lo a kwa'shi a kupse yi ntee, a dû.
eng: He answered, 'I will not,' but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

lmp: E du a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ embenjì ŋwɛ̂ nlee, a laa yuu ce e ba laa nè ŋwɛ̂ nlee nà nè ye. E beesì a laa enɛ̂, "M be dù." A ka' làa wa'a, a du ka'.
eng: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, 'I go, sir,' but he didn't go.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ efa boo a baa ca ce e m gèe yuu ce yì ta à m kòŋ à m ba nda?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Muu nlee." Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' ba bkwàrà a ce dù mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ entombì nè wèe.
eng: Which of the two did the will of his father? They said to him, The first. Jesus said to them, Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into the Kingdom of God before you.

lmp: Jôn à m vʉ̀ a yɛ wèe a ce dùŋshi wèe nduunjî yɛɛnì, wèe à byemì yuu ce e m ce làa ka', ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' ba bkwàrà, a byemì yap yu. Wèe à ka' yɛ wa'a, a ke' kupse, byemi ka'.
eng: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn't believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn't even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

lmp: "Yu' nè ŋgàa mò'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m fà' yi nsuu, a bye njɛ̀ɛ msini ce a ke gèe mrù' àgho mbo, a bee ŋka' a sir nsuu anà àgho, a tuŋ dì' ce a bo gèe mrù' mbo a boo tà'tà' mbo foŋ. E ka' gèe wa' wɛɛ, a lɛ nsuu anà nè bèe mo', a du à mbè.
eng: Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a winepress in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "E be yʉshi bêe bbebep ca à njî mbembep sê, lɛ̀ yi nsuu anà nè bêe jɛɛ ce nfè' ce a ke tee msini à ka' ghɛɛ tɛ wowèe a bo tee mi fa nè ye."
eng: They told him, He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers, who will give him the fruit in its season.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mbò wèe à be be' mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Lùr ce ŋgâa mboo mndap a m mà', à m kʉti ba lùr rbuu ndap" a? "Ca à m gèe Tata Nyʉ̀, à ba yuu bɛ̀ɛ nè sèe."
eng: Jesus said to them, Did you never read in the Scriptures, 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes?'

lmp: Banɛ m ce suŋ wèe enɛ a be koo kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ese wèe, fa nè to' ce yi be gèe ndèe kʉʉ anà.
eng: Therefore I tell you, the Kingdom of God will be taken away from you, and will be given to a nation bringing forth its fruit.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe Farìsi a ka' yu' mŋgàa ce e mà', a riŋ enɛ e mà' mŋgàa anà ba àmbò wowèe.
eng: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce ròo à rkoo ye, a ce wɛp bèe njobè' bèe a m byemi enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker laa buu nè wowèe à mŋgàa. E m làa enɛ̂,
eng: Jesus answered and spoke again in parables to them, saying,

lmp: "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò ŋkʉʉ ce e m gèe ŋkâ' bgùu nè muu yì.
eng: The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a marriage feast for his son,

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù cep, bèe anà a lor yap yu ntuu anà àtɛ̀r, a du ba à rgèe yàp ntà'tè, bèe mo' à du à mŋkʉ̀, bèe mo' a du à rkap yàp ntaa.
eng: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise,

lmp: Bɛr bèe ce a m be nà, a koo ŋgâa mfà' anà, a fa ŋgɛ' nè wowèe, a yʉshi wowèe.
eng: and the rest grabbed his servants, and treated them shamefully, and killed them.

lmp: Ntee yi yaŋ ŋkʉʉ sê, e tuu vi bsoogɛ̀, wowèe a du a yʉshi bèe ce a m yʉshi yi ŋgâa mfà' nà, a too lap rla'.
eng: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

lmp: A ka' gèe wa' wɛɛ, e laa nè yi ŋgâa mfà' enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ fɛ̀r buu ŋkà' a misî, bèe ce mɛ̀ be a ghɛɛtè à bèe ce a ba vʉ̀ ŋkà' anà ka'.
eng: Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren't worthy.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a m nàti a du a cu mcʉ̀ àmbò a be gèe tɛ Jisòs ka' fàa nlàa.
eng: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

lmp: Wowèe a tuu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yàp buu, ker ba bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ bèe vi Hɛròd enɛ wowèe a du laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wèr rìŋ wernɛ à yu ŋwɛ̀ mini, a ce yɛ'ni bèe mnduunjì Nyʉ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. Wɛ ke lòr ŋwɛ̀ mò' jɛɛ ka'.
eng: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter who you teach, for you aren't partial to anyone.

lmp: Suŋ ka wèr yuu ce à ce kwà'shi. Ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe ma' mbâa bàrà' nè ŋkwe Rum kɛ̀ sèe ma' ka'?"
eng: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

lmp: Jisòs à m rìŋ yuu ce wowèe a m tʉr à mbʉ̀, a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni, wèe ce mòoshi mɛ̀ njokɛ?
eng: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

lmp: Nàa nè mbʉ̀ mbàa ce a ke mà' mbâa bàrà' àgho." Wowèe a vʉ nè mbʉ̀ mbàa, a fa nè ye.
eng: Show me the tax money. They brought to him a denarius.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Tu ŋwɛ̀ embo a yî nda, rlii ce a saŋ mbo à ba li nda?"
eng: He asked them, Whose is this image and inscription?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Tu embo a yî ŋkwe Rûm, rlii embo à ba li foŋ." E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ wèe fa buu ŋkʉʉ nè ŋkʉʉ, fa vî Nyʉ̀ nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: They said to him, Caesar's. Then he said to them, Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a bɛɛŋger sê, a ma'shi ye, a duse.
eng: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him, and went away.

lmp: Bèe Sadùsi ce a ce kani enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ kwe ker fʉʉ efa rkwe ka' nà, a vʉ a yɛ ye nyʉ̀ anà, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: On that day Sadducees those who say that there is no resurrection came to him. They asked him,

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, Musìs à m làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor ŋgwa, a ye a bi boo ka', ŋgàŋ kwe, banɛ nfʉr yì be laasi ye, tɛ a ye a bi boo nè nfʉr yì ce e kwe anà.
eng: saying, Teacher, Moses said, 'If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife, and raise up seed for his brother.'

lmp: Bfʉr mo' ce wèr wowèe à m ce cu, a m ba bèe nsàambâ. Ŋwɛ̂ nlee à lòr ŋgwa, a kwe, a bi boo a ye ka', a ma'shi ŋgwa nè nfʉr yì.
eng: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no seed left his wife to his brother.

lmp: Yuu ce yi m koni ŋwɛ̂ nlee nà, yi m koni nè ŋwɛ̀ embe yê njì, a koni nè ŋwɛ̀ embe njì ŋwɛ̀ embe yê njì, a caasi mò' efa bfʉr bèe nsàamba anà ka'.
eng: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

lmp: À ka' ba à lʉ̀simbùu, njeŋwɛ̀ ca ye ye à kwe.
eng: After them all, the woman died.

lmp: Banɛ be kèe ba à nfè' ce bèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe, tɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ca ba ŋgwa nda, àmbò yi yu enɛ bfʉr bèe nsàamba ca wɛɛwɛ a m ba bduu vi nà?"
eng: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce làa wa'a, a ce fàa fàa njobè' wèe rìŋ yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce làa ka', a riŋ ŋger Nyʉ̀ foŋ ka'.
eng: But Jesus answered them, You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

lmp: Be kèe ba à nfè' ce bèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe tɛ bèe a ker lòr bbyèŋge, kɛ̀ gùusi boo ka'. Bèe a be kèe ba àmbò bcìndap Nyʉ̀ embe bùu.
eng: For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like God's angels in heaven.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò rfʉʉ ce bèe ce a kweŋger a be kèe fʉʉ efa rkwe, mbò wèe à be be' yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè wèe a? E m làa enɛ̂,
eng: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven't you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

lmp: "A mɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ Abràhâm, a ba Nyʉ̀ Aisìk, a ker ba Nyʉ̀ Jakòp." E yu Nyʉ̀ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ka', e yu ba Nyʉ̀ bèe ce a cu btèe."
eng: I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob?' God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.

lmp: Bèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a bɛɛŋger à ryɛ'nì ce e m yɛ'ni anà sê.
eng: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs à cipsi cùu ese bèe Sadùsî, wowèe a kuu nyor a vʉ a yɛ ye.
eng: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

lmp: Mò' efa wowèe ce e m rìŋ mncir sê, à mooshì ye, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, ncir ce yi càa mncir wɛɛwɛ embe ŋwà' mncir yu yî fɛ?"
eng: Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Kòŋ Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀ nè yo ntee- ŋwɛ̀, ba nè lo ryòŋ-ŋwɛ̀, ker ba nè wo bfee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Jesus said to him, 'You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.'

lmp: Ncir ca yu ncir ce gòr, à ba ncir ce entombì.
eng: This is the first and great commandment.

lmp: Ncir yì embenjì mo yi yu àmbò yi foŋ. Yi yu enɛ̂, "Kòŋ nfʉrò àmbò à kòŋ yò nyor."
eng: A second likewise is this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' mncir ba mbe mŋwà' ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, vi tɛɛ ba mbendù mncir bbaa ca."
eng: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' ce vʉ̀ àbee, Jisòs à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

lmp: "Wèe ce kwà'shi wee kɛ àmbò Krâis anà? E yu muu nda?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "E yu muu Dɛvìd."
eng: saying, What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he? They said to him, Of David.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ba yi kɛ ce enɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi m gèe Dɛvìd à too ye enɛ Tatâ? E m làa enɛ̂,
eng: He said to them, How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

lmp: "Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Tata yà enɛ̂, "Cu à la rkoo mà' caar tɛ m gee tɛ à tɛr mo mkùu mbendù bèe ce a bàa wɛ̀.""
eng: The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet?'

lmp: Dɛvìd à ka' too ye enɛ Tatâ, banɛ àde' e ker ba muu yì à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à tʉr yuu mo' à rbèesi nè ye ka'. Kɛ' e nyʉ̀ anà, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ker tʉr cùu à rbipshi yuu mo' nè ye ka'.
eng: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forth.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè bèe ker ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂,
eng: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

lmp: "Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsi a cu mbe nta' Musìs.
eng: saying, The scribes and the Pharisees sat on Moses' seat.

lmp: Banɛ wèe yu'ni nè wowèe, gee yuu ce wowèe a ce suŋ wèe. Wèe fa gèe yuu ce wowèe a ce gèe ka' njobè' wowèe a ke gèe yuu ce wowèe a ke fè'shi ka'.
eng: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don't do their works; for they say, and don't do.

lmp: Wowèe a ke kur mntɛ̀r ce vi ce rìr sê, lɛ mbe mkɛ̂ɛmbɛ̀' bèe, ke' koŋ à rnàa ntubo jà' wowèe àgho ka'.
eng: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men's shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a ce gèe, a ce gèe ba enɛ bèe a bo yɛ wowèe. Wowèe a lò tar bbàa guru wap ce a ke lɛ̀ Blâa Nyʉ̀ njo, cʉʉ nje tù, vi bɛrŋgèr sê, gee mcʉ̀ŋcʉŋ efa wap bcɛ̀' vi sapŋgèr sê.
eng: But all their works they do to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad, enlarge the fringes of their garments,

lmp: Wowèe a kòŋ à rcu à mnta' bêe bgòrgòr à mŋkà', a koŋ à rcu à mnta' bbòŋboŋ à mndap mloo.
eng: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

lmp: Wowèe a kòŋ enɛ bèe a ca'ni wowèe à mntaa, a ker koŋ foŋ enɛ bèe a too wowèe enɛ Rabài.
eng: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called 'Rabbi, Rabbi' by men.

lmp: Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ bèe a too wèe enɛ Rabài ka', njobè' wèe tʉr ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì mò'sir cà'cà'. Wèe yu ba bfʉr.
eng: But don't you be called 'Rabbi,' for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

lmp: Wèe fa too ŋwɛ̀ mò' enjep ŋgòŋ na enɛ Tàr ka', njobè' wèe ku tʉr Tàr mò'sir cà'cà', e ba mbe bùu.
eng: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

lmp: Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' too wèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ka', njobè' wèe ku tʉr ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì mò'sir cà'cà', ce yu Krâis anà.
eng: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr se efa wêe mʉ be ba ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè wèe.
eng: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' naa yì nyor mbekì banɛ a be sùusi ŋgàŋ njep nshè. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' suusi yì nyor njep nshè banɛ a be nàa ye mbekì.
eng: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

lmp: "Ndòo à co' wèe ce ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsî. Wèe yu ŋgâa bo' wee btu njobè' wèe à cete ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' ce yi ce dù mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ à bsii bèe. Wèe ce dù mbo ka', a ma'shi enɛ bèe ce a ce ghèter à rdù mbo nà a du ka'.
eng: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows' houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe ce ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsî. Wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni njobè' wèe ce jɛ̀r à mŋgòŋ a ce jɛ̀r à bkeŋ tɛ wèe bo gèe ka' ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir ɛ̀, kupse byemi nè Nyʉ̀. E ce kupse, wèe gee ye e misì bep caa wèe ŋkàrà' baa.
eng: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much of a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe ce mnfèp ce wèe ce dùŋshi bèe nduunjì. Wèe ce làa weenɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ye lè', kaa à rlii Ndap Nyʉ̀, yì anà ba yuu ka'; ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ye lè', kaa ba à rlii buu embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ ce a gèe nè njɛ̀ɛ bco' mo' ce a too enɛ gûl, banɛ lè' anà yi kur ŋgàŋ.
eng: Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, 'Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.'

lmp: Wêe mnfèp ce a ce dùŋshi bèe nduunjì! Wee ke kàr buu wɛɛwɛ ce wee ke no, fà dì' wèe no mʉ yuu tèe njo ka', ce mì jù'.
eng: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe ce ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, ba bèe Farìsî. Wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni njobè' wêe ke sù'si ndoŋ ba kaŋ embe ndù, geewa'a, a fyɛ' njep mʉ vi ruu nè buu ce wèe à koo ese bèe à ŋger, ker ba buu ce wèe ku ce gèe ba àmbò wèe à gwɛɛ.
eng: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

lmp: A mbò wèe ku ba wa' foŋ. Bèe a yɛ wèe efa mmìr, wèe yɛɛtì à bêe byɛɛnì, a fyɛ' enjep mʉ, wèe ba ŋgâa mbo'ni, a ba ŋgâa bsàrbuu.
eng: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe ce ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, ba bèe Farìsî. Wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni njobè' wèe à boo mshê mmbòŋmboŋ nè ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, ba bèe ce a m ce cu rcu yɛɛnì, a kupshi mi, mi ba yɛɛnì.
eng: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

lmp: Yɛ̂, a mà' yè Ndap Nyʉ̀ e tɛɛ mbòmmbo.
eng: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ wèe be kèr yɛ mɛ̀ ka', caar tɛ nfè' ghɛɛ ce wèe be làa enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ ghoni ŋwɛ̀ ce e vʉ̀ à rlii Tata Nyʉ̀." "
eng: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, 'Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!'

lmp: Jisòs à m fʉʉ embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a ka' ce dù, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yɛ ye, a duŋshi ye Ndap Nyʉ̀.
eng: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mbò wèe ce yɛ ndap ca a? M ce suŋ wèe nè mini- ŋwɛ̀ enɛ lùr mò' be cu nje Ndap Nyʉ̀ ca ka'. A be kɛ̀ɛshi vi wɛɛwɛ."
eng: But he answered them, You see all of these things, don't you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.

lmp: E du a cu mbe rtùu Olèf, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yɛ ye, a ku ba a wowèe mbo cà'cà'. Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Suŋ wèr nfè' ce buu ca vi be koni. Yuu ce yi be dùŋshi enɛ à ce vʉ̀, ŋgòŋ yi ce mì foŋ yu kɛ?"
eng: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe lor nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka'.
eng: Jesus answered them, Be careful that no one leads you astray.

lmp: Bèe magòr a be vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ rlii ce làa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Krâis anà", bo' bèe magòr tɛ a da'.
eng: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am the Christ,' and will lead many astray.

lmp: Wèe be yu' enɛ a ce mà' bìr, kèr yu' à mŋoo enɛ a ce mà' bìr à bdì' mo' foŋ. Wèe ka' yu' wa'a, mlù mi fa koo wèe ka'. Buu ca vi be kù koni, vi koni wa'a, yi ke' ba ba enɛ nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi be mì à ghɛɛ ka'.
eng: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren't troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

lmp: To' yi be mà' bìr a to' mo', ŋkʉʉ ma' bìr a ŋkʉʉ mò'. Njè be koo, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ci'ti à bdì' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

lmp: Buu ca be ba nè bèe àmbò à nfè' ce njeŋwɛ̀ e ke kɛ̀' ce luuti muu nà.
eng: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

lmp: A be koo wèe fa mbe mmbo bèe mo' tɛ a fa wèe ŋgɛ', yʉshi wèe. Bèe wɛɛwɛ a be bàa wèe njo' mɛ̀.
eng: Then they will deliver you up to oppression, and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name's sake.

lmp: Bèe magòr a be kʉti njìnjì, bàa wap btu, fyèni wap btu,
