eng: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

lmp: tɛ bèe ce a ce nya' mnde' enɛ wowèe a yu ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a nyɛɛ, bo' bèe magòr tɛ a da'.
eng: Many false prophets will arise, and will lead many astray.

lmp: Buu bbebep vi be kù' gòr, tɛ rkòŋnì bèe magòr li wɛnî.
eng: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ku tɛɛ tatap du ba' à lʉ̀simbùu banɛ ŋgàŋ be lùŋ.
eng: But he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

lmp: A be fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ca à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ tɛ bto' wɛɛwɛ a yu', tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' mì.
eng: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

lmp: "Banɛ wèe ka' ke yɛ yuu bsàrbuu ce yi bepsi Ndap Nyʉ̀ e tɛɛ mbòmmbo ce Danìyɛ̀l ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa àmbò yi nà, àmbò yi tɛɛ mbe dî' rara embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce bè' ŋwà' ca rîŋ,
eng: When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place let the reader understand,

lmp: Bèe ce a be bo'shi enɛ a wowèe Krâis, kɛ̀ enɛ a wowèe ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, a be nyɛɛ, dùŋshi mncòo, gèe buu bghagha' ce bèe a bɛ̂ɛ, enɛ njì yi ka' ba tɛ wowèe a bo bo' ka' nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce nà-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For there will arise false christs, and false prophets, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

lmp: Yɛ̂, mɛ̀ suŋ wèe buu ca tɛ nfè' ka' ghɛɛ.
eng: Behold, I have told you beforehand.

lmp: Banɛ wee wèe ka' ke yɛ buu ca ce koni, wèe riŋ weenɛ nfè' anà yu àtʉtʉ sê.
eng: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that it is near, even at the doors.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋgʉ̀ bèe e sè'ni be kweŋger wɛɛ tɛ buu ca ka' ba ka'.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away, until all these things are accomplished.

lmp: Rbuu ba nshe a be kèe mì, geewa'a wa blàa vi be kèe mì à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

lmp: "À ka' ba àmbò nòŋ ba nfè' ce buu ca vi be koni, ŋwɛ̀ mò' rìŋ ka', ka' bcìndap Nyʉ̀, kɛ̀ Muu Nyʉ̀ ɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ, ku ba ba Tàr cà'cà'.
eng: But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

lmp: Nfè' ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be vʉ̀, be ba àmbò nfè' yì Nowa à m ba nà.
eng: As the days of Noah were, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.

lmp: Rbôŋtu li be ba nè ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce yì masà à ka' kʉti, yɛ àmbò e ce gèe li rfà' à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a.
eng: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ masà anà be fa yì buu wɛɛwɛ mbe yê mmbò.
eng: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà yu ŋwɛ̂ mbembep, laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "Yi be lòr nfè' sê, tɛ yà masà ka' vʉ̀",
eng: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, 'My lord is delaying his coming,'

lmp: kɛ' ce lìp ŋgâa mfà' mo', ce yeŋger, ce noŋger a no ŋkoo wèe,
eng: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

lmp: banɛ yì masà be vʉ̀ à nôŋ mo', à nfè' ce e ba riŋ ka',
eng: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn't expect it, and in an hour when he doesn't know it,

lmp: gwàte ye à btete à btete, fa ye dì' ba à mʉ̀ bèe ce a yu ŋgâa bo' wap btu. Bèe a be ce warse ce kʉr msòŋ àfo.
eng: and will cut him in pieces, and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. There is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

lmp: "Be ba à nfè' anà tɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi ba àmbò nfè' ce boo mŋgòŋgò mo' bèe nrʉʉ a m lòr wap blâm, a du à rkoni nduu-gùu.
eng: Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins, who took their lamps, and went out to meet the bridegroom.

lmp: E m fa buu nè ŋwɛ̀ àmbò ŋger ŋgàŋ yi m ba. E m fa mò' ncʉ̀kì tâ, a fa mò' ncʉ̀kì baa, a fa mò' ncʉ̀kì mò'sir. E ka' fa, a du à mbè.
eng: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one; to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m koo ncʉ̀kì ta nà à lòr mbàa anà a ku kɛ' a ce gèe ntaa àgho, a ye sɛ' à ncʉ̀kì tâ.
eng: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m koo ncʉ̀kì baa nà à gee ntaa foŋ, a ye sɛ' à ncʉ̀kì baa.
eng: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m koo yi ncʉ̀kì mò'sir nà à du a tuŋ bè'tè a sʉti mbàa anà njo.
eng: But he who received the one went away and dug in the earth, and hid his lord's money.

lmp: Yàp masà à m cu à mbè sê, a ka' kʉti, a fyɛ' enɛ wowèe a m di' gee ekɛ nè mbàa ce e m fa nè wowèe nà lɛ.
eng: Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and reconciled accounts with them.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m koo ncʉ̀kì baa nà, à vʉ foŋ, a laa enɛ̂, "Masà, wɛ̀ m fa mɛ̀ ncʉ̀kì baa. Yɛ̂, mɛ̀ gèe ntaa àgho a ye sɛ' à ncʉ̀kì baa."
eng: He also who got the two talents came and said, 'Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents besides them.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m koo ncʉ̀kì mò'sir nà à vʉ foŋ, a laa enɛ̂, "Masà, mɛ̀ m rìŋ mɛnɛ à yu ŋwɛ̂ ntatap sê. Wɛ̂ ke kep yuu ce wɛ̀ m byè ka', kap yuu ce wɛ̀ m ŋwaŋ ka'.
eng: He also who had received the one talent came and said, 'Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you did not sow, and gathering where you did not scatter.

lmp: Banɛ wɛ̀ m ba lɛ̀ ya mbàa mbe bâŋ, mɛ̂ kʉti, tɛ m bo koo ya mbàa nè sɛ'- ŋwɛ̀.
eng: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

lmp: Banɛ wèe koo ncʉ̀kì anà ese ye, fa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr ncʉ̀kì rʉʉ nà.
eng: Take away therefore the talent from him, and give it to him who has the ten talents.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr yuu, banɛ a be kèr fa ye buu mò', tɛ e misi tʉr buu gòr. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ tʉr yuu ka', banɛ a be koo ka' mʉ yì ce e tʉr nà ese ye.
eng: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away.

lmp: Koo nè ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ cicì nà, ma' à dì' ce ku ba ba tʉ̀'nji ce bèe a be ce warse ce kʉr msòŋ àfo."
eng: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

lmp: "Be kèe be à nfè' ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ à vʉ̀ nè yi fòo-ŋwɛ̀ a bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ nà, tɛ e cu mbe yi kàbàrà' fòo,
eng: But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

lmp: Wèr à m yɛ wɛ̀ ba à se'kɛ, wɛ̀ ba kìlò, wèr à konì wɛ̀, kɛ̀ wɛ̀ ba mbùuriŋ, wèr à fa wɛ̀ bcɛ̀'?
eng: When did we see you as a stranger, and take you in; or naked, and clothe you?

lmp: Wèr à m yɛ wɛ̀ ba à se'kɛ, wɛ̀ ce yaŋ, kɛ̀ a ba mbe shaŋ ɛ̀, wèr à ca'ni wɛ̀?"
eng: When did we see you sick, or in prison, and come to you?'

lmp: Wowèe a ce làa wa'a, ŋkʉʉ beesi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini- ŋwɛ̀ enɛ àmbò wèe à m gèe buu ca nè ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' efa mʉ̀ bfʉr wa ca na, wèe à m gèe ba nè mɛ̀."
eng: The King will answer them, 'Most certainly I tell you, inasmuch as you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.'

lmp: Wowèe a bipshi wa'a, tɛ e beesi enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ àmbò wèe à m jà' ka' mʉ ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' efa mʉ̀ bfʉr wa ca ka' na, banɛ wèe à m jà' mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: Then he will answer them, saying, 'Most certainly I tell you, inasmuch as you didn't do it to one of the least of these, you didn't do it to me.' Matthew Matïìyoè 25 46 E laèa wa'a, tá woweèe a du niñ njep ñgá' ce nfeseè, tá beâe byáánïì a du cu rcu ce nfeseè." These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca mìsi, a laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂,
eng: It happened, when Jesus had finished all these words, that he said to his disciples,

lmp: "Wèe rìŋ weenɛ ku bɛti mnôŋ bbaa tɛ a ye ŋkâ' càasi-mndap. A be koo Muu Ŋwɛ̀ fa nè bèe tɛ a taa mbe kìntaa."
eng: You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bleebèe, a tartè mbe ndàp mbe Kaifàs ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì,
eng: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

lmp: a seesi àmbò a be gèe ka' koo Jisòs à bfee, yʉ.
eng: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit, and kill him.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa enɛ̂, "Sèe fa koo ye ba à mʉ̀ ŋkà' ka', fà dì' bèe a lo lapni, rè bkòr ka'."
eng: But they said, Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.

lmp: Jisòs à m ba à rla' Bɛtanì, mbe ndàp Saimʉ̀n ŋwɛ̀ msàasì.
eng: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à vʉ̂, a yɛ ye, a tʉr mʉ ntʉŋ blùr, njɛ̀ɛ mgʉr mo' ce mi lùu ntaa sê, mi ba njo, e cu'nì ye mbe tù à nfè' ce e m ce ye byee.
eng: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yɛ, nyor à bep wowèe, wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "A jarsi mgʉr ca à cicì wa'a njokɛ?
eng: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, Why this waste?

lmp: A ba fyèni à mbàa gòr sê, lòr mbàa efa gho fa nè ŋgâa fùp."
eng: For this ointment might have been sold for much, and given to the poor.

lmp: Jisòs à m rìŋ yuu ce wowèe a m ce làa, a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe ce fa njeŋwɛ̀ ca ŋgɛ' wa' njokɛ? E gèe ba yuu bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀.
eng: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, Why do you trouble the woman? Because she has done a good work for me.

lmp: Ŋgâa fùp a ku ba wèe wowèe à nfè' sìp, à ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, sèe be ba à nfè' sìp ka'.
eng: For you always have the poor with you; but you don't always have me.

lmp: E cù'ni mɛ̀ mgʉr ca à nyòr wa'a, a ce kupshi yà nyor, tɛ a ka' tuŋ mɛ̀.
eng: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ fàdì' wɛɛwɛ ce a ka' fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca njep ŋgòŋ na, a be suŋ yuu ce e gèe na, ce kuushi ye."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.

lmp: Ca yi ka' mì, ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, ce a m ce too enɛ Judas Ìskarìyòt, à du a yɛ bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì,
eng: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ka' fa Jisòs mba wêe mmbò, wèe fa mɛ̀ kɛ?" Wowèe a be' mbàa mntaar a fa nè ye.
eng: and said, What are you willing to give me, that I should deliver him to you? They weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

lmp: E kɛ' ese à nfè' anà a ce ròo nduunjì à rfyèni Jisòs.
eng: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ entombì efa ŋkà' ce a m ce ye brɛ̂d ce a lɛ̀ yis njo ka', ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a vʉ a yɛ ye, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce kòŋ enɛ wèr fɛr byee ba fɛ tɛ à bo ye ŋkâ' càasi-mndap àgho?"
eng: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Dù nè du yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à mʉ̀ rla', laa nè ye enɛ̂, "ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì à làa enɛ̂, "Yà nfè' à ghɛɛ. M be ye ŋkâ' càasi mndap wèr ŋgâa yɛ'ni yà buu mbe wɛ̂ ndàp." " "
eng: He said, Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, 'The Teacher says, My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.'

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ku gee àmbò e m làa, a fɛr byee ŋkà' anà.
eng: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, e cu a yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, tɛ a bo ye byee.
eng: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce ye byee, e laa enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ mò' efa wèe be fyèni mɛ̀."
eng: As they were eating, he said, Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.

lmp: Wowèe a koosimnse sê, a kɛ' a ce bipshi à mò'sir à mò'sir enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wà' a mɛ̀ a?"
eng: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, It isn't me, is it, Lord?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce yi bo yi be tarte a ya njep kaŋ, yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni mɛ̀.
eng: He answered, He who dipped his hand with me in the dish, the same will betray me.

lmp: Muu ŋwɛ̀ be kù dù àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ nà. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ndòo be co' ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni ye. Yi yu àndèe nè ŋwɛ̀ anà enɛ a m ba bi ye ka'."
eng: The Son of Man goes, even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.

lmp: Judàs ce e m ba à rfyèni ye nà, à laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wà' a mɛ̀ a?" Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À làa yo cùu."
eng: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, It isn't me, is it, Rabbi? He said to him, You said it.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce ye byee, Jisòs à lor brɛ̂d, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi, a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa enɛ̂, "Kò nè ye, ca yu yà nyor."
eng: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples, and said, Take, eat; this is my body.

lmp: E lor ndoŋ, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a fa nè wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ no mrù' enjep ndoŋ na.
eng: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, All of you drink it,

lmp: Ca yu wa blɛɛ ce vi kur lê' Nyʉ̀, ce vi be fʉʉ, sùu àtu bèe magòr, tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo fòosi wowèe efa buu bbebep ce wowèe a gèe.
eng: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ m be kèr no mrù' ce a gèe nè mbàŋ ce na ka' caar bà' à nòŋ ce m be no mî mfi wèe sèe wèe mbe dî' kʉʉ yà Tâ."
eng: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father's Kingdom.

lmp: Wowèe a yop yɛɛ, a nati a ce dù mbe rtùu Olèf.
eng: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

lmp: A ka' ce dù mbo Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Be ba nètʉ' e ntìni na, tɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ caŋse ma' mɛ̀. Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "M be lìp ŋwɛ̀ ncìŋ njèe tɛ njèe yi da'se."
eng: Then Jesus said to them, All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.'

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m be fʉʉ efa rkwe dù à ŋgôŋ Galèle tɛ wèe vʉ koni mɛ̀ àfo."
eng: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.

lmp: Pità à laa enɛ̂, "Bèe ca wɛɛwɛ a ka' ma' wɛ̀, m ma' wɛ̀ ka'."
eng: But Peter answered him, Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ nètʉ' e ntìni na, à be kani ŋkàrà' taar enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: Jesus said to him, Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.

lmp: Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ku ba ba enɛ sò kwe àbee, m kanì ka'." Bɛr ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wɛɛwɛ a ku laa wa' foŋ.
eng: Peter said to him, Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you. All of the disciples also said likewise.

lmp: Jisòs a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a du mbe dì' mo' embe rtùu anà ce a m ce too enɛ Gɛ̀tsɛmanì, e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Cu nè mbena tɛ m du nje na dù gèe rloo."
eng: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, Sit here, while I go there and pray.

lmp: E lor Pità ba boo Sɛbɛ̀di a baa, a du a wowèe. E m kɛ̀' a ce seŋ buu, mlù mi ce koo ye sê,
eng: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

lmp: e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋkoosimnse ce e yu njep mɛ̂ ntee yu ba yì ce àde' e ku yʉ mɛ̀. Cu nè mbena tɛ sèe ce kè'ni."
eng: Then he said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch with me.

lmp: E lo embo a du à njìsàp ka', a gwe kʉkʉ̀p a loo a laa enɛ̂, "Yà Tâ, yi ka' ba àtɛ̀r, à gee tɛ ndoŋ ŋgɛ' ca caa embe mɛ̂ tù. Geewa'a, ke' ba enɛ à gee ba àmbò m ce kòŋ ka', gèe ba àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ."
eng: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.

lmp: E ka' nàti embe dì' ce e ba ce gèe rloo nà kʉti, a yɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ce buumi. E laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Banɛ àde' wèe à ke' ba cu mbekì tɛ sèe ce kè'ni àmbò awà mò'sir ka' a?
eng: He came to the disciples, and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, What, couldn't you watch with me for one hour?

lmp: Ke'ni nè ce loo, fà dì' wèe gwe rmòoshì ka'. Ntee njep rbʉ̀, bsɛ̀ nje nyòr."
eng: Watch and pray, that you don't enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

lmp: Jisòs à ker dû, a loo a laa enɛ̂, "Yà Tâ, yi ka' ba enɛ àde' ndoŋ ca caa embe mɛ̂ tù ka', banɛ à gee tɛ yuu ce à ce kòŋ yi geetî."
eng: Again, a second time he went away, and prayed, saying, My Father, if this cup can't pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.

lmp: E ka' kʉti, a ker yɛ wowèe a ce buumi, mmirlò mi ku ce dù nè wowèe dù.
eng: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

lmp: E ker ma'shi wowèe mbo, a ker du a ker loo, a ku laa àmbò e ba laa nà.
eng: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

lmp: E ka' mìsi, a kʉti a yɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ku bii ce buumi, a ce lʉ̀shi a? Yɛ̂, nfè' à ghɛɛ. A be fa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ mbe mmbo ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep.
eng: Then he came to his disciples, and said to them, Sleep on now, and take your rest. Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

lmp: Lò nè tɛ sèe ce dù. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e fyeni mɛ̀ nà yu àtʉtʉ."
eng: Arise, let's be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.

lmp: E ka' kù bii mìsi efa cùu, Judàs ce e m ba mò' efa bèe ce ncòp-baa-à- rrʉ̀ʉ, à tosè. E m ba a ku' bèe ce bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bleebèe a m tuu. Wowèe a m tʉr bsà' ba mmbàŋ.
eng: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priest and elders of the people.

lmp: Judàs ce e m fyèni ye nà à m suŋ wowèe wɛɛ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce m ka' baa nje nyòr, banɛ a ye; wèe koo."
eng: Now he who betrayed him gave them a sign, saying, Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.

lmp: E ka' tose, a ko'shi àgee Jisòs, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ cà'ni wɛ̀, Rabài." E ka' làa wa'a, a baa ye nje nyòr.
eng: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, Hail, Rabbi! and kissed him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋkarà, gèe yuu ce wɛ̀ ba vʉ àfa à rgèe." Bèe anà a vʉ̂, a koo ye a ba'ni.
eng: Jesus said to him, Friend, why are you here? Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

lmp: Yi ka' koni wa'a, mò' efa bèe ce a m ba a Jisòs wèe, à co' yì sà' a tee tù' ese ŋkwàa ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand, and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and struck off his ear.

lmp: Jisòs à laa yi yu nè ye enɛ̂, "Kʉsi sà' mbà rùu njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e co' sà', be kèe kù kwe à sà'.
eng: Then Jesus said to him, Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

lmp: À ce kwà'shi wɛnɛ àde' m ke' laa nè yà Ta tɛ e ku tuusi mɛ̀ vi bcìndap bkʉr àŋgoo ka' a?
eng: Or do you think that I couldn't ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

lmp: Yà Ta ka' gee wa'a, banɛ yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce làa àmbò buu ca yi ghɛɛtè njo à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè bèe à nfè' anà enɛ̂, "Wèe à vʉ̀ à rkoo mɛ̀, a tʉr bsà' ba mmbàŋ àmbò m yu lɛ nyɛ̀ɛ wa'a njokɛ? Mɛ̀ m ce vʉ̀ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ ce cu à nshè ce yɛ'ni bèe, wèe à ke' koo mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn't arrest me.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, buu ca wɛɛwɛ vi koni tɛ yuu ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m saŋ yi bo ghɛɛte njo." Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wɛɛwɛ a ma' ye, a caŋse.
eng: But all this has happened, that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled. Then all the disciples left him, and fled.

lmp: Bèe ce a m koo Jisòs nà a m lòr ye a du àgho mbe ndàp Kaifàs ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bleebèe a m kaari mbo.
eng: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

lmp: Pità à du a yê mbùu, a ba yi encàŋ. E du a ba' mbe cùu mambe ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a niŋ mbo, a cu à nshè a bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀, tɛ e bo yɛ yuu ce yi be ba.
eng: But Peter followed him from a distance, to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa kansùr, a roo bèe tɛ a bo vʉ̀ tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ, tɛ a koo ye yʉ. Geewa'a, a yɛ fàa ka'.
eng: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death;

lmp: Ku' bèe a vʉ̂, a ke' laa yuu mo'sir ka'. À ka' ba à lʉ̀simbùu, bèe mo' bèe a mmbaa a vʉ̂,
eng: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Byɛ ca à m làa enɛ àde' e ku sa'sì Ndap Nyʉ̀ ca, ker ba'ri à mnôŋ btaar."
eng: and said, This man said, 'I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à natì mbekì, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ tʉr yuu à rbèesi kuu buu ce bèe ca a làa a kuu wɛ̀ na ka' a?"
eng: The high priest stood up, and said to him, Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?

lmp: Jisòs à laa yuu ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à kaa à rlii Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe, suŋ ka wèr enɛ à yu Krâis anà, ce e yu Muu Nyʉ̀ nà lɛ̂."
eng: But Jesus held his peace. The high priest answered him, I adjure you by the living God, that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À làa yo cùu. M ce suŋ wèe wɛɛwɛ mɛnɛ kɛ' e sè'ni na, wèe be yɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ àmbò e cu à rkoo mà' Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ, kèr yɛ foŋ àmbò e ce sùu mbendù mmbà' embe bùu."
eng: Jesus said to him, You have said it. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à sasì bcɛ̀' efa nyòr, a laa enɛ̂, "E bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀. Mbùu mò' ker ba nè sèe à rlàa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker laa yuu kuu ŋwɛ̀ ca ka'. To wèe à yu' àmbò e bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀.
eng: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

lmp: Wèe à làa wee kɛ?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Yi yu enɛ a yʉ ye."
eng: What do you think? They answered, He is worthy of death!

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, a ce ye nè mce nje mmìr, a tʉʉshi ye nè bdʉ̀'. Bèe mo' a lip ye nè mmbo,
eng: Then they spit in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ce à yu Krâis anà, to' ka enɛ à lìp nda wɛ̀ lɛ."
eng: saying, Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?

lmp: Pità à m cu njep mambe, muunje mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à vʉ̂, a yɛ ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ wɛ̀ à m ba wèe Jisòs ce à ŋgôŋ Galèlê."
eng: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!

lmp: E kanì à bsii bèe wɛɛwɛ, a laa enɛ̂, "M rìŋ yuu ce à ce làa ka'."
eng: But he denied it before them all, saying, I don't know what you are talking about.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a du a tɛɛ njep cùu ŋka' embe mambe anà, muunje mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à ker yɛ ye, a laa nè bèe ce a m ba àfo enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ba a Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t."
eng: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him, and said to those who were there, This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.

lmp: Pità à ker kani, a kâa, a laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'."
eng: Again he denied it with an oath, I don't know the man.

lmp: Mʉ nfè' mò' à ka' tuuse, bèe ce a m ba àfo a ko'shì àgee Pità, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À yu mò' efa wowèe ghup njobè' njɛ̀ɛ njì ce à ce làa yi ce dùŋshi wa'a."
eng: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.

lmp: Pità à ye lè', a laa enɛ̂, "Ndòo co' mɛ̀ ce ka' tɛ ba enɛ m ce làa ba yuu mini ka'. M rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'." Nduŋgʉp à ku toŋ à nfè' anà.
eng: Then he began to curse and to swear, I don't know the man! Immediately the rooster crowed.

lmp: Pità à kuushì yuu ce Jisòs à m làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ, à be kani ŋkàrà' taar enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka'." E ka' kuushi wa'a, a fʉʉ njep mbè, a bʉ' rwar.
eng: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times. He went out and wept bitterly.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba bleebèe a cutè, a seesi àmbò a be gèe ka' yʉ Jisòs.
eng: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death:

lmp: Wowèe a kur ye, a lor ye a du àgho, a fa nè Pailɛ̀t ce e m ba govanò.
eng: and they bound him, and led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

lmp: Judàs ce e m fyèni ye nà, à ka' yɛ enɛ a teni mnsa' enɛ a yʉ Jisòs, a kupse yi ntee, a lor mbàa mntaar cà, a du àgho, a kʉsi nè bêe bgòrgòr ba bleebèe cà,
eng: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ gèe yuu bebep, a fyeni ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu mo' bebep ka'." Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Yì anà yi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè wèr ka'. A yò nsa'."
eng: saying, I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood. But they said, What is that to us? You see to it.

lmp: Judàs à ma' mbàa anà mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a fʉʉ, a du a kɛrnî.
eng: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr ca, a kwɛ' mbàa anà, a laa enɛ̂, "Ncir yi byemi enɛ a lɛ mbàa ca à mʉ̀ mbàa embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ ka' njobè' yu mbàa blɛɛ."
eng: The chief priests took the pieces of silver, and said, It's not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.

lmp: Wowèe a seesì, a lor mbàa anà, a du a yuu ŋkʉ̀ ŋwɛ̀ mboo mkìŋ àgho tɛ a bo ce tuŋ bkìlò àfo.
eng: They took counsel, and bought the potter's field with them, to bury strangers in.

lmp: A mbùu ce a ce too ŋkʉ̀ anà enɛ ŋkʉ̀ blɛɛ, caar ba' ntìni na.
eng: Therefore that field was called The Field of Blood to this day.

lmp: Ca yi ka' ba wa'a, yuu ce Jɛ̀rìmiyà, ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu à m làa nà yi ghɛɛtè njo. E m làa enɛ̂, "Wowèe a m lòr mbàa mntaar ce à m ba mbàa ce bèe Isrɛ̀l a m byemi enɛ a be là' yi tu àgho,
eng: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

lmp: a yuu ŋkʉ̀ ŋwɛ̀ mboo mkìŋ, àmbò Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè mɛ̀."
eng: and they gave them for the potter's field, as the Lord commanded me.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' tɛɛ njeptii govanò, govanò à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋkʉʉ Jus a?" Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "À làa wɛ̀ wa'a."
eng: Now Jesus stood before the governor: and the governor asked him, saying, Are you the King of the Jews? Jesus said to him, So you say.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba bleebèe a ka' toshi ye à buu mò', e beesì yuu ka'.
eng: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mbò à ce yu' ku' buu ce a làa enɛ wɛ̀ gèe na a?"
eng: Then Pilate said to him, Don't you hear how many things they testify against you?

lmp: Jisòs à laa yuu ka' koo mʉcàr, govanò à bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

lmp: A m ce ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap à bfè' wɛɛwɛ banɛ govanò be fʉr ŋwɛ̀ shaŋ mò' embe shaŋ. E m ce fʉr ba ŋwɛ̀ ce à làa bèe enɛ e fʉr.
eng: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner, whom they desired.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce bèe wɛɛwɛ a m rìŋ ye, à ba mbe shaŋ. A m too ye enɛ Bàrabàs.
eng: They had then a notable prisoner, called Barabbas.

lmp: Bèe a ka' kaari àbee, Pailɛ̀t à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe ce kòŋ enɛ m fʉr embe shaŋ fa nè wèe yu nda? M fʉr ba Bàrabàs kɛ̀ Jisòs ce a too enɛ Krâis nà?"
eng: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus, who is called Christ?

lmp: E m rìŋ enɛ wowèe a m ce ko'ndoŋ nè Jisòs, a ka' koo ye a vʉ àgho a fa nè ye.
eng: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

lmp: Yi m ba foŋ enɛ à m ba à nfè' Pailɛ̀t à m ce sa' mnsa' ca, ŋgwa yì à cep ntuu nè ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Fa gèe yuu mo' nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu bebep ka' nà ka', njobè' mɛ̀ yɛ rlo ntìni àmbò ye, li fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' sê."
eng: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things this day in a dream because of him.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr ba bleebèe ca, a barsì bèe enɛ wowèe a laa nè Pailɛ̀t enɛ e laa tɛ a fʉr Bàrabàs, yʉ Jisòs.
eng: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas, and destroy Jesus.

lmp: Govanò à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ efa bèe a mmbaa ca ce wèe ce kòŋ weenɛ m fʉr embe shaŋ fa nè wèe yu nda?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Bàrabàs."
eng: But the governor answered them, Which of the two do you want me to release to you? They said, Barabbas!

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ m be gèe mɛ kɛ nè Jisòs ce a too enɛ Krâis na?" Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a beesì enɛ̂, "Taa yi mbe kìntaa."
eng: Pilate said to them, What then shall I do to Jesus, who is called Christ? They all said to him, Let him be crucified!

lmp: E ker bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M taa ye mbe kìntaa njokɛ? Yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe seesê, yu ba kɛ?" Wowèe a ku ce waani, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Taa lɛ ye mbe kìntaa."
eng: But the governor said, Why? What evil has he done? But they cried out exceedingly, saying, Let him be crucified!

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ka' yɛ enɛ yuu gèe yi ker ba ka', bghaa vi ce ròo ko' à mʉ̀ bèe, e lor mdip a su'si mi mmbo àgho à bsii bèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Ya bo yi yu njep rkwe ŋwɛ̀ ca ka', kwà' wèe."
eng: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water, and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Mà'shi tɛ vi blɛɛ vi ba mbe wêr tù kèr ba mbe tu boo wer."
eng: All the people answered, May his blood be on us, and on our children!

lmp: E fʉr Bàrabàs embe shaŋ, a fa nè wowèe, a lâa, a lip Jisòs nè yɛɛnsò. A ka' lìp wɛɛ, a fa enɛ a taa ye mbe kìntaa.
eng: Then he released to them Barabbas, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

lmp: Bsoogɛ̀ vî govanò, a lor Jisòs a du àgho mbe dì' mnsa' embe nto' ce govanò à m ce cu mbo, bɛr bsoogɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ a niŋ mbo, a sir ye a tarte,
eng: Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

lmp: a co'ni ye bcɛ̀' efa nyòr, a lor cɛ̂' beer a yarsi ye à nyòr,
eng: They stripped him, and put a scarlet robe on him.

lmp: a gee rtaa kʉʉ nè bsòpsì a sop ye mbe tù, a lor mbàŋ a fa nè ye mbà bo mà'. A ka' gèe wa'a, a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a vʉshi ye, a kɛ' a ce bùu ye àmbò ŋkʉʉ wa'a, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Nyàr, ŋkwe Jûs."
eng: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him, and mocked him, saying, Hail, King of the Jews!

lmp: Wowèe a ce ye nè mce, a koo mbàŋ cà ese ye, a lip ye àgho mbe tù.
eng: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀shi ye wɛɛ, a co' cɛ̂' beer cà efa yê nyòr, a lor vi bcɛ̀', a kʉsi ye à nyòr, a lor ye a du àgho à rtaa mbe kìntaa.
eng: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off of him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce dù, a tarte a ŋwɛ̀ mô' à rla' Sàirên, ce a m ce too enɛ Saimʉ̀n. A koo ye à ŋger enɛ e byɛ' kìntaa.
eng: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' mbe dì' ce a m ce too enɛ Golgotà, ce mbùu efa rlii ca yu enɛ̂, "Dî' kèkèp tu.",
eng: They came to a place called Golgotha, that is to say, The place of a skull.

lmp: a fa ye mrù' ce a m fìŋshi nè ŋgʉ̀-cece' enɛ e no. E ka' yu'shi, a kani efa rno.
eng: They gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' taa ye mbe kìntaa, a lor vi bcɛ̀' a ma' kàŋ àgho tɛ a bo yɛ àmbò a be gàp. A ka' gàp wɛɛ,
eng: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

lmp: a cu à nshè a ce kè'ni ye.
eng: and they sat and watched him there.

lmp: A saŋ mbùu ce a taa ye mbe kìntaa, a la' mbe tu kìntaa. A m saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu Jisòs ce ŋkʉʉ Jûs."
eng: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

lmp: A m taa byɛ̀ɛ a baa a Jisòs wèe mbe bkìntaa, mò' à ba à bo mà', mò' à ba a yê bo ŋkòp.
eng: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce càa yap càa, a kor btu, a su' ye nè mcɛp,
eng: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ce àde' à sa'sì Ndap Nyʉ̀, bà'ri à mnôŋ btaar, jà' là yo tu. Yi ka' ba enɛ à yu Muu Nyʉ̀, sùu là embe kìntaa."
eng: and saying, You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, ba bleebèe, a ku vʉshi ye à njɛ̂ɛ wa' foŋ.
eng: Likewise the chief priests also mocking, with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

lmp: Byɛ̀ɛ ce a m taa a Jisòs wèe mbe bkìntaa nà, a su' ye nè mcɛp à njɛ̂ɛ wa' foŋ.
eng: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' kùu ŋgòŋ, tʉ̀' à sii.
eng: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò à nyʉ̀ taar wa'a, Jisòs à waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀lôi, Ɛ̀lôi, Lama Sàbàtanì?" ce mbùu efa gho yu enɛ̂, "Yà Nyʉ̀, Yà Nyʉ̀, wɛ̀ lèse mɛ̀ njokɛ?"
eng: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani? That is, My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?

lmp: Bèe mo' ce a m tɛɛte àfo, a ka' yu', a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce kɛ' Àlajà."
eng: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, This man is calling Elijah.

lmp: Mò' efa wowèe à ka' yu' wa'a, a caŋ a lor kʉ̀sha, a fʉʉ njep mrù' ce mi ce baŋshi, a fapte à ŋke', a fa nè ye enɛ e bo nyoŋ.
eng: Immediately one of them ran, and took a sponge, and filled it with vinegar, and put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

lmp: Bɛr bèe a laa yap enɛ̂, "Bè tɛɛ ka wa' lɛ̂; sèe yɛ ka enɛ wà' Àlajà be vʉ̀ jà' ye lɛ."
eng: The rest said, Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to save him.

lmp: Jisòs à ker waa, a ma'shi li ryòŋ nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

lmp: Cɛ̀' ce a m teni dî' mo' embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ àgho yi ku sati à nfè' anà tìtìyɛɛ, kɛ' embe tù, ba' njep mbùu, ŋgòŋ yi ci'tì, myɛɛ mi waŋgèr,
eng: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

lmp: mshè mi mʉ'ŋgèr, bèe Nyʉ̀ magòr ce a m kweŋger a fʉʉ, a ba btèe.
eng: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

lmp: Jisòs à ka' lò fʉʉ efa rkwe, wowèe a fʉʉsè enjep mshè, a niŋ à Rla' Rrara, a duŋshi yàp nyor nè bèe magòr.
eng: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ rjèe, ba bsoogɛ̀ ce a wowèe a m ce kè'ni Jisòs à ka' yɛ àmbò ŋgòŋ yi cì'ti, kèr yɛ buu ce vi koni, a wɛp sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ba Muu Nyʉ̀ ghup."
eng: Now the centurion, and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake, and the things that were done, feared exceedingly, saying, Truly this was the Son of God.

lmp: Bbyèŋge a m ba àfo àŋgoo, a tɛɛ à njìsàp a ce fyɛ'. À m ba bbyèŋge ce a m lô à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a du a Jisòs wèe, tɛ a bo jà' ye à buu.
eng: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wowèe à m ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà, ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m ba ma yì Jɛ̂ms ba Josɛ̀f, ker ba ma boo vî Sɛbɛ̀dî.
eng: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, ŋwɛ̀ mbàa mò' ce à rla' Àrimàtiyà à vʉ̂. A m too ye enɛ Josɛ̀f, ye ye à ba mò' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs.
eng: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea, named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus' disciple came.

lmp: E m dù a yɛ Pailɛ̀t, a laa nè ye enɛ e fa gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ nè ye tɛ e tuŋ. Pailɛ̀t à byemì.
eng: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

lmp: Josɛ̀f à koo gʉ̀ʉ ŋwɛ̀, a kur njep ma cɛ̂' bòŋboŋ,
eng: Joseph took the body, and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,

lmp: a lɛ njep li rshê rfi ce e m sò' nje ryɛɛ, a biŋsi ma lùr, a cete ncûu rshè àgho, a nati a dû.
eng: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock, and he rolled a great stone to the door of the tomb, and departed.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà, ba Mɛ̀ɛri mò' cà, a m cu à ncûu rshè.
eng: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, ce nòŋ ce a m ce fɛ̀r buu mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ yi m càa yi wɛɛ, bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe Farìsi a du a yɛ Pailɛ̀t,
eng: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Masà, wèr ce kuushi enɛ à m ba à nfè' ce ŋwɛ̀ mbo' bèe ca à m bii ntèe, e m làa enɛ̂, "Mnòŋ vi be câa btaar, tɛ m fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: saying, Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: 'After three days I will rise again.'

lmp: Banɛ wɛ̀ ba làa tɛ a ke'ni rshè anà bòŋboŋ caar tɛ mnòŋ vi câa btaar, fà dì' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a vʉ yɛ̀ɛ gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀, suŋ bèe enɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe, tɛ mnde' ce a nya' elʉ̀simbùu na mi caa mì entòmbì ka'."
eng: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, 'He is risen from the dead;' and the last deception will be worse than the first.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè ŋgâa rkè'nì ca tɛ wèe wowèe dû, du yɛ enɛ wowèe a kè'ni rshè anà bòŋboŋ."
eng: Pilate said to them, You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.

lmp: Wowèe a dû, a fa ncòo à lùr embe ndù ncûu rshè, fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo jòo ka', a lɛ ŋgâa rkè'nì cà àfo.
eng: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

lmp: Mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ mi ka' càa wɛɛ, ce tʉ̀' be raa tɛ ba nòŋ entombì embe mʉ̀ ŋgàa nà, à ku bii à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' sê, Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà, ba Mɛ̀ɛri mò' cà, a du à rfyɛ' rshè.
eng: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

lmp: Ka' cu, ŋgòŋ yi ci'tì tatap sê, ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à suu embe bùu, a biŋsi lùr embe ncùu rshè, a cu mbendù mo.
eng: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky, and came and rolled away the stone from the door, and sat on it.

lmp: E m ce bàpŋger àmbò sa'mbèŋ wa'a, vi bcɛ̀' vi ce fʉp àmbò mmbà' wa'a.
eng: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce kè'ni rshè a wɛp, a kaŋ sê, a ba àmbò bgʉ̂ʉ bèe wa'a.
eng: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à laa nè bbyèŋge anà enɛ̂, "Wèe fa wɛp ka'. M rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe ce ròo ba Jisòs ce a mʉ taa mbe kìntaa nà.
eng: The angel answered the women, Don't be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

lmp: E yu mbena ka'. E fʉʉ efa rkwe àmbò e m làa nà. Vʉ̀ nè yɛ mbe dì' ce yi gʉ̀ʉ yi mʉ nôŋ.
eng: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

lmp: Wèe du cɛrcɛr du suŋ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe. E ce dù lɛ à ŋgôŋ Galèle entombì nè wowèe. Wowèe a be bà' àfo tɛ a yɛ lɛ ye. A yuu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wèe."
eng: Go quickly and tell his disciples, 'He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.' Behold, I have told you.

lmp: Wowèe a nàtî à ncûu nshè cɛrcɛr sê, nè bwɛp-ŋwɛ̀ ker ba nè rlu'shì- ŋwɛ̀, a caŋ a du à rsuŋ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu.
eng: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

lmp: Ka' cu, Jisòs à tartè a wowèe, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ cà'ni wèe." Wowèe a du a gwe njep yê tìi, a gʉ'shi nè ye.
eng: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, Rejoice! They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa wɛp ka'. Dù nè suŋ bfʉr wa enɛ wowèe a du à ŋgôŋ Galèlê. Wowèe a be bà' àfo, yɛ mɛ̀."
eng: Then Jesus said to them, Don't be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce dù, bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m ce kè'ni rshè a du à mʉ̀ rla', a suŋ bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì yuu ce yi koni.
eng: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city, and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu', a yɛ bleebèe a wowèe a cutè a fa ntaŋ, a lor ku' mbàa a fa nè bsoogɛ̀ cà,
eng: When they were assembled with the elders, and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wêe dù, wèe laa weenɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a vʉ̀ nètʉ' a yɛɛ gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀, wèe à ce lɛ buumi.
eng: saying, Say that his disciples came by night, and stole him away while we slept.

lmp: Govanò à ka' yu' nsuŋ ca, wèr yɛ ye nashi nè ye, fà dì' wèe niŋ à ŋgɛ' ka'."
eng: If this comes to the governor's ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.

lmp: Wowèe a koo mbàa, a gee àmbò a m làa nè wowèe. Jus a ku bii ce suŋ nsuŋ ca à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a caar ba' ntìni na.
eng: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until this day.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce ncòp-mò'sir-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a du à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a du a ko' mbe rtùu ce Jisòs à m làa enɛ wowèe a ko' mbo nà.
eng: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ ye, a gʉ'shi nè ye, bèe mo' a tarnì yap tarni.
eng: When they saw him, they bowed down to him, but some doubted.

lmp: Jisòs à vʉ̂, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A fa ŋger embe bùu ba enjep nshè wɛɛwɛ nè mɛ̀.
eng: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

lmp: Dù nè du gee tɛ bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ a ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yà buu. Bàptir nè wowèe à rlii Tàr, ba Muu, ba Yʉ' Rara,
eng: Go, and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

lmp: yɛ'ni wowèe tɛ a gee buu wɛɛwɛ ce mɛ̀ làa nè wèe. Rìŋ nè enɛ m be ba wèe sèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ caar dù bà' à nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi be mì."
eng: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age. Amen.

lmp: Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ kuu Jisòs Krâis ce e yu Muu Nyʉ̀ à kɛ̀' embe na.
eng: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

lmp: A saŋ mbe ŋwà' Àsayà ce ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "M be tuu ya ŋwɛ̀ ntuu tɛ e du entombì nè wɛ̀, dù kupshi nduunjì nè wɛ̀.
eng: As it is written in the prophets, Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce fuŋ à ntee rìŋ a ce làa enɛ̂, "Kupshi nè nduunjì nè Tatâ, nashi tɛ yi ba kùyɛɛ." "
eng: The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!'

lmp: Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe à m nyɛɛ à ntee rìŋ, a ce fè'shi enɛ bèe a kupse, ma' yàp buu bbebep tɛ a baptir wowèe, tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo fòosi wowèe.
eng: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

lmp: Bêe à to' Jùdiyà ba bêe à rlà' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m bsìp a m dù à ryu' yuu ce e m ce fè'shi. Wowèe a m ce suŋ yàp buu bbebep, e ce bàptir wowèe njep rdip Jodàn.
eng: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

lmp: Jôn à m yar bcɛ̀' ce a m ba' nè mnyôr kàmɛ̂l, a cʉʉ ŋgùp nyàa njep mbùu. Vi byee à ba mŋguu ba blù.
eng: John was clothed with camel's hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

lmp: E m ce fè'shi a ce làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' be vʉ̀ embe mɛ̂ njì ce e tʉr ŋger a caa mɛ̀. Àde' m ghɛɛtè à rbà'shi vi bkʉ̀ blaba' ka'.
eng: He preached, saying, After me comes he who is mightier than I, the thong of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

lmp: M ce bàptir wèe nè mdip, geewa'a e be bàptir yi wèe ba nè Yʉ' Rara."
eng: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà Jisòs à natî à rla' Nasarɛ̀t ce à ŋgòŋ Galèlê, à du a yɛ Jôn, e baptìr ye njep rdip Jodàn.
eng: It happened in those days, that Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kù fʉʉ enjep rò, a yɛ àmbò rbuu li mʉ'tì, a ker yɛ àmbò Yʉ' Rara yi ce sùu mbe yê ndù àmbò bèŋ wa'a.
eng: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting, and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

lmp: Njèndoŋ à laa embe bùu enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ muu wà ce m kòŋ sê. M ce yu' rbòŋ nè wɛ̀ sê."
eng: A voice came out of the sky, You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

lmp: E ka' kù fʉʉ enjep rò, Yʉ' yi ku lor ye a du àgho à ntee rìŋ.
eng: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

lmp: E m cu àfo à mnòŋ mŋkyèe, Satàn à ce mòoshi ye. Mnyâa à rìŋ vi m ba à dì' anà, bcìndap Nyʉ̀ vi ce kè'ni ye.
eng: He was there in the wilderness forty days tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce a m koo Jôn a fa à shaŋ, Jisòs à du à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ yì Nyʉ̀ nè bèe.
eng: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom of God,

lmp: E m ce làa nè bèe enɛ̂, "Nfè' à ghɛɛ, kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àtʉtʉ sè'ni, kupse nè, ma' yè buu bbebep, byemi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ."
eng: and saying, The time is fulfilled, and the Kingdom of God is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce jɛ̀r àwâa rdip rgòr ce à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a yɛ Saimʉ̀n ba nfʉr yì ce Andrù, ce a m ba ŋgàa ŋkoo nca, àmbò a ce mà' rraa njep rò.
eng: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew the brother of Simon casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè fa mɛ̂ mbùu, tɛ m gee wèe tɛ wèe ba ŋgâa ŋkoo nca ce be ba ba bèe."
eng: Jesus said to them, Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, wowèe a ku lɛ map mraa cà, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

lmp: E ka' dù mʉcàr, a ker yɛ Jɛ̂ms, ba Jôn ce a m ba boo Sɛbɛ̀di mbe keŋ, a ce tʉʉshi map mraa. E kɛ' wowèe.
eng: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John, his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

lmp: Wowèe a ma'shì yàp ta ce Sɛbɛ̀di a yi ŋgâa mfà' wèe mbe keŋ, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

lmp: Wowèe a m dù ba' à rla' Kàpanùm. À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, Jisòs à ku niŋ mbe ndàp rloo, a kɛ' a ce yɛ'ni bèe.
eng: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

lmp: Bèe anà a m bɛ̀ɛ li ryɛ'nì njobè' li m ba àmbò li ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ka', li m tʉr ŋger.
eng: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba mbe ndap rloo anà ce yʉ' bebep yi m ba njep ye. Yʉ' ana yi m waa, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

lmp: "Habai, Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t, yuu ce à ce ròo ese wèr yu ba kɛ? Wɛ̀ vʉ̀ à ryʉshi wèr a? M rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce à yu. À yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀."
eng: saying, Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!

lmp: Jisòs à lapnì yʉ' anà enɛ̂, "Cu nyaŋ! Fʉʉ enjep ye!"
eng: Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be quiet, and come out of him!

lmp: Yʉ' bebep ca yi m nyɛr ŋwɛ̀ anà a ma' à nshè, a waa, a fʉʉ enjep ye.
eng: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

lmp: Bèe anà a bɛɛŋgèr, a ce bipshi a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Yu ba njɛ̀ɛ kɛ ce yi koni na?" Wowèe a m làa enɛ̂, "Cena yu ryɛ'nì ce rfi ce li tʉr ŋger mo'. E ce làa nè byʉ' bbebep vi ce yu'ni nè ye."
eng: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, What is this? A new teaching? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bèe a yu' yì nsuŋ à bdì' bsìp à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: The report of him went out immediately everywhere into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

lmp: Jisòs wèe a m fʉʉ embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a ka' kù fʉʉ wa'a, e lor Jɛms ba Jôn a wowèe a du mbe ndàp mbe Saimʉ̀n ba Andrù.
eng: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

lmp: Malu yì Saimʉ̀n à noŋ mbe bkuu, tu yi ce luu ye. A ka' kù niŋ wa'a, wowèe a suŋ Jisòs.
eng: Now Simon's wife's mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

lmp: E du a koo ye à bò, a naa mbekì, mbɛp cà à bornì, e kɛ' a ce fɛ̀r byee nè wowèe.
eng: He came and took her by the hand, and raised her up. The fever left her, and she served them.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr anà, bèe mo' a vʉ nè ŋgàa byaŋ ba bèe ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m niŋ njep wowèe, a vʉ àgho à ryɛ Jisòs.
eng: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick, and those who were possessed by demons.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ efa là' anà a vʉ a tɛɛ njep ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀'.
eng: All the city was gathered together at the door.

lmp: E gee bèe magòr ce a m ce yaŋ byaŋ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a ke'sè, a ker fʉshi byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe magòr. E m shè enɛ byʉ' anà vi fa làa yuu ka' njobè' vi m rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu.
eng: He healed many who were sick with various diseases, and cast out many demons. He didn't allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' sê, Jisòs à nyɛɛ a du à dì' mo' ce bèe a m ba ka', a gee rloo àfo.
eng: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ba, a fʉʉ a ce ròo ye.
eng: Simon and those who were with him followed after him;

lmp: A ka' yɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce ròo wɛ̀."
eng: and they found him, and told him, Everyone is looking for you.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Sèe du à mla' mo' tɛ m du fè'shi àfo foŋ. A yuu ce mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ àtu mo."
eng: He said to them, Let's go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs à ce jɛ̀shi à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a ce fè'shi à mndap rloo, a ce fʉshi byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe.
eng: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ msàasì mò' à m vʉ̀ a yɛ Jisòs, a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a loo ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' kôŋ, à gee m ke'sè, ba nrara."
eng: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, If you want to, you can make me clean.

lmp: Jisòs à koosìmnse nè ye, a naa bo a joo ye àgho, a laa enɛ̂, "M kòŋ wa'a. Kè'se, ba nrara."
eng: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, I want to. Be made clean.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, msàasì mi ku lo ye efa nyòr, e ba nrara.
eng: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him, and he was made clean.

lmp: E ka' ce dù, Jisòs a ciisì nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: He strictly warned him, and immediately sent him out,

lmp: "Yɛ̂, fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka'. Dù duŋshi yò nyor nè ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, gee taŋshì ce Musìs à m làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ msàasì gee tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à kè'se nà."
eng: and said to him, See you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

lmp: Geewa'a ŋwɛ̀ ca à dû, a kɛ' a ce suŋ yuu anà nè bèe à bdì' wɛɛwɛ. Nsuŋ ca à m gèe Jisòs à ker ce fʉʉ à mʉ̀ bèe ka'. E m ce cu à rìŋ, bèe a ce vʉ̂ à bdì' wɛɛwɛ, a ce yɛ ye àfo.
eng: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places: and they came to him from everywhere.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' lò kʉti à rla' Kàpanùm, bèe a yu' enɛ e kʉti.
eng: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was in the house.

lmp: Ku' bèe a vʉsè a ruu mbe ndàp, fɛŋ yi ke' ba ka'. E fe'shì blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wowèe.
eng: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

lmp: Bèe mo' bèe ŋkyèe, a byɛ' ŋwɛ̀ ce yì ŋgʉ̀' nyor mo' à m kwe, a vʉ àgho.
eng: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

lmp: Bèe a m ba magòr, wowèe a ke' yi à rcàa nè ŋgàŋ dù yɛ Jisòs ka'. Wowèe a ko' a to' toto mbe tu ndap à ŋkè'nì embe dì' ce Jisòs cu. A ka' to', a suusi ye mbe ndàp njî à toto anà mbe kèŋ.
eng: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ lap rbyemì, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce mbèp nyor à m kwe nà enɛ̂, "Muu wà, mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep."
eng: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, Son, your sins are forgiven you.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'nì mncir mo' a m cute àfo, a ce kwà'shi enɛ̂,
eng: But there were some of the scribes sitting there, and reasoning in their hearts,

lmp: "E làa wa'a njokɛ? E bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e foosì bèe efa buu bbebep caa efa Nyʉ̀, a nda?"
eng: Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?

lmp: Jisòs à m ku yi enjep yê ntee enɛ a buu ce wowèe a ce kwà'shi, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kwà'shi buu ca njokɛ?
eng: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu àtɛ̀r a yì efɛ? Yu ba à rlàa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ ca enɛ, "Mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep", kɛ à rlàa enɛ, "Lo mbekì, lor yo kèŋ, jɛ̂r."?
eng: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, 'Your sins are forgiven;' or to say, 'Arise, and take up your bed, and walk?'

lmp: M be dùŋshi wèe mɛnɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ tʉr ŋger njep ŋgòŋ na à rfòosi bèe efa yàp buu bbebep."
eng: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins--he said to the paralytic--

lmp: E m làa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ ca enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè wɛ̀ mɛnɛ à nati mbekì, lor yo kèŋ du à là'."
eng: I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.

lmp: E natì mbekì, a lor yi kèŋ a ce fʉʉ àgho. Bèe wɛɛwɛ à ce fyɛ', a bɛɛŋger, a ku'si Nyʉ̀, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Wèr a m be yɛ njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca ka'!"
eng: He arose, and immediately took up the mat, and went out in front of them all; so that they were all amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw anything like this!

lmp: Jisòs à m ker du àwâa rdip rgòr, ku' bèe a vʉ̂, e yɛ'nì wowèe.
eng: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

lmp: E ka' ce dù, a yɛ Lɛvì ce à m ba muu Alfìyòs àmbò e cu mbe dì' rfà' ce e m ce koo mbàa bàrà'. Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu." E natì a du a yê mbùu.
eng: As he passed by, he saw Levi, the son of Alphaeus, sitting at the tax office, and he said to him, Follow me. And he arose and followed him.

lmp: Jisòs à m dù a cu mbe ndàp mbe Lɛvì a ce yeŋger. Ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà', ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a ce ye byee a ye ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu. Ku' njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca a m ce dù a yê mbùu.
eng: It happened, that he was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

lmp: Ŋgàa ryɛ'ni mncir ce a m ba bèe Farìsi a ka' yɛ àmbò e ce ye byee a ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, ba ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà', a bipshi nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "E ce ye byee a ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep njokɛ?"
eng: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?

lmp: E ka' yu' wa'a, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bèe ce a ke ròo ŋwɛ̀ ncɛ̀p e ke ba ŋgâa byaŋ, ke' ba bêe btatap ka'. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ à rkɛ' bêe byɛɛnì ka'. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ à rkɛ' ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep."
eng: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu vi Jôn ba bèe Farìsi a ce jì mdip, awɛ bèe a du a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa yɛ'nì buu vi Jôn ba vî bèe Farìsi a ke jì mdip, wo a ke' jì yap ka' njokɛ?"
eng: John's disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, Why do John's disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don't fast?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Àde' bèe ce a dù Ŋkâ' bgùu a ba à nduu-gùu wèe ker ce jì mdip a? Nduu-gùu à ka' ku ba a wowèe àde' wowèe a ji mdip ka'.
eng: Jesus said to them, Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can't fast.

lmp: Geewa'a, nfè' mò' be ba ce a be koo nduu-gùu tɛ wowèe a ji mdip à nfè' anà.
eng: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then will they fast in that day.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ saa cɛ̂' fi tar mbendù cɛ̂' rʉ̀ʉ ka'. E ka' gee wa'a banɛ cɛ̂' fi cà yi be sàa yî rʉ̀ʉ tɛ toto raa càa yì entombì nà.
eng: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ lor mrû' mfi foŋ lɛ njep mŋgùp mrù' vî brʉ̀ʉ ka'. E ka' gee wa'a banɛ mrû' mfi anà mi be lò koo, to'shi mŋgùp mrù' anà, tɛ mrù' mi kʉte à nshè tɛ ŋgùp mrù' anà bʉ à cicì." Yi ke ba enɛ a lɛ mrû' mfi ba njep mŋgùp mrù' vî bfi tɛ mi bo kʉ̀te ka', tɛ mŋgùp mrù' vi to'ŋger ka'.
eng: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.

lmp: Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m ce càa à ŋkʉ̀ msaŋ mò' nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, wowèe a ce tee tu msaŋ a ce ye.
eng: It happened that he was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields, and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a gèe yuu ce ncir yi kani enɛ ŋwɛ̀ fa gèe nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa nyʉ̀ ka' njokɛ?"
eng: The Pharisees said to him, Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?

lmp: E beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à be be' yuu ce Dɛvìd à m gèe à nfè' ce njè à m ce yaŋ ye ker ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ba nà ka' a?
eng: He said to them, Did you never read what David did, when he had need, and was hungry--he, and those who were with him?

lmp: E m dù mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à nfè' ce Àbìyatà à m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a lor brɛ̂d ce a m fa nè Nyʉ̀, a ye, a fa bɛr nè bèe ce a wowèe a m ba. Ncir yi m byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' jɛɛ ye caa efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ka'."
eng: How he entered into the house of God when Abiathar was high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à m lɛ̀ mi mmbomntaa tɛ mi bo jà' ŋwɛ̀, ke' ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ba ŋkwàa nè mmbomntaa ka'.
eng: He said to them, The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

lmp: Banɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ yu Tàr ce e tʉr mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀."
eng: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker niŋ mbe ndap rloo. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba mbo ce li rkoo li m kwe.
eng: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there who had his hand withered.

lmp: Wowèe a roo à ryɛ enɛ Jisòs be gèe tɛ e ke'se nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ lɛ, tɛ wowèe a bo sa' ye enɛ e bʉ' ncir.
eng: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce rkoo li m kwe ye anà enɛ̂, "Nàti vʉ mbena!"
eng: He said to the man who had his hand withered, Stand up.

lmp: E bipshì nè bèe anà enɛ̂, "Yisèe ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe gee ba yuu bòŋboŋ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ yuu bebep? Yi byemi enɛ sèe ja' ŋwɛ̀ jà' kɛ̀ sèe yʉ ŋwɛ̀ yʉ?" Wowèe a beesì yuu nè ye ka'.
eng: He said to them, Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill? But they were silent.

lmp: Nyor à bep Jisòs à ryɛ njɛ̀ɛ ntèe-tu ca. E fyɛ' wowèe à rshentee, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ cà enɛ̂, "Mà' lo rkoo kùyɛɛ." E ma', li kʉtì bòŋboŋ.
eng: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, Stretch out your hand. He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yɛ, a ku fʉʉ, a du a yɛ bèe ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd mò', a wowèe a kɛ' a ce sèesi àmbò a be koo Jisòs yʉ.
eng: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

lmp: Jisòs a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a m lò a du àwâa rdip rgòr. Bèe magòr a du fa wâp mbùu. À m ba bêe à ŋgôŋ Galèle ba Jùdiyà,
eng: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples, and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

lmp: ba bêe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, ba bêe à ŋgôŋ Ìdumìyà ba mla' mo' ce mi m ba àŋguu rdip Jodàn, ker ba Tayà ba Sidòn. Wowèe a m vʉ̀ magòr se à ryɛ ye njo' njɛ̀ɛ mfà' ce wowèe a m yu' enɛ e m ce gèe.
eng: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ a fyɛ' keŋ tɛ e bo niŋ mbo fà dì' ku' bèe anà a bo fate ye ka'.
eng: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn't press on him.

lmp: E m làa wa'a njobè' e m gèe ŋgâa byaŋ magòr a ke'se, ŋgâa byaŋ mo' a ce ghèter à rjòo ye enɛ a bo kè'se foŋ.
eng: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

lmp: Byʉ' bbebep vi m ce yɛ Jisòs à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ku gweŋger à nshè kùntombì nè ye, ce waani ce laa enɛ, "A wɛ̀ Muu Nyʉ̀."
eng: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him, and cried, You are the Son of God!

lmp: Jisòs à ciisì nè vi enɛ vi fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ enɛ e yu Muu Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

lmp: Jisòs à m ko' mbe rtùu a kɛ' bèe ce e m kòŋ, wowèe a vʉ a yɛ ye.
eng: He went up into the mountain, and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀, e co' bèe ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ à yi ŋgâa ntuu tɛ a wowèe a bo ce ba, tɛ e bo ce tuu wowèe, tɛ a du ce fè'shi,
eng: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach,

lmp: kèr tʉr ŋger à rjùu byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe.
eng: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

lmp: Bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ca à m ba Saimʉ̀n ce e m too enɛ Pità,
eng: Simon, to whom he gave the name Peter;

lmp: ba Jɛms ce e m ba muu yì Sɛbɛ̀dî, ba nfʉr yì Jôn ce Jisòs à m too wowèe enɛ Boanɛrgɛ̀s, ce mbùu efa gho yu enɛ "Boo sa'mbèŋ",
eng: James the son of Zebedee; John, the brother of James, and he surnamed them Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder;

lmp: Andrù, Felêp, Bàtòlomì, Matìyò, Tomâs, Jɛms ce e m ba muu Alfìyòs, ba Tàdiyòs. Saimʉ̀n ce e m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe Silòt,
eng: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

lmp: ba Judas Ìskarìyòt ce e m lò a fyeni Jisòs nà.
eng: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. He came into a house.

lmp: Jisòs à m kʉti mbe ndàp. A ka' kʉti, ku' bèe a ker kaarì, a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a ke' tʉr njì à rye yuu ka'.
eng: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

lmp: Yì bèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a du à rkoo ye njobè' wowèe a m ce kwà'shi enɛ tu yi ce kar ye.
eng: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him: for they said, He is insane.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ce a m vʉ̂ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a m làa enɛ Bɛsɛbùl yu njep ye, a ker ce làa enɛ e ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' à ŋger ŋkʉʉ mnyʉ̂mkà'.
eng: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, He has Beelzebul, and, By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ' wowèe a laa buu nè wowèe à mŋgàa enɛ̂, "Àde' Satàn fʉr Satàn enjep ŋwɛ̀ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: He summoned them, and said to them in parables, How can Satan cast out Satan?

lmp: Ŋgàpni yi ka' ba à to', àde' to' anà yi tɛɛ ka'.
eng: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

lmp: Ŋgàpni yi ka' ba mbe ndàp, àde' ndap anà tɛɛ ka'.
eng: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

lmp: Banɛ Satàn ka' ce rè bkòr a yì nyor, ŋgàpni yi ba, banɛ e be tɛɛ ka', tɛ ba yi wa' wɛɛ.
eng: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can't stand, but has an end.

lmp: "Yi ku ba foŋ enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ niŋ mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ ŋger, kwɛ' yì buu du àgho ka', ce yi ka' tɛ ba enɛ e kur ŋwɛ̀ ŋger anà ka'. E ka' kur ye wɛɛ, e ka' kwɛ' buu embe yê ndàp.
eng: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder, unless he first binds the strong man; and then he will plunder his house.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ be kèe fòosi buu bbebep ce bèe a m gèe, ka' buu bbebep ce wowèe a làa.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' bepsi rlii Yʉ' Rara, àde' Nyʉ̀ ke foosi ye ka'. Ŋgàŋ be niŋ à mnsa' njo' yi yuu bebep, nfesè."
eng: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is guilty of an eternal sin

lmp: Jisòs à m làa cena njobè' wee mo' a m ce làa enɛ yʉ' bebep yi yu lɛ njep ye.
eng: --because they said, He has an unclean spirit.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ca ma Jisòs ba bfʉr vi a vʉ a tɛɛte njep ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀', a ce kɛ' ye.
eng: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

lmp: Ku' bèe ce a m cute a Jisòs wèe nà, a m làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, yò ma ba bfʉr gho ba bjar gho a yu njepmbè a ce ròo wɛ̀."
eng: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.

lmp: E beesì nè wowèe enɛ, "Yà ma a nda? Bfʉr wa à ba wèe kɛ?"
eng: He answered them, Who are my mother and my brothers?

lmp: E m fyɛ' bèe ce a m cute a sir ye mbe mʉ nà, a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, a yà ma ba bfʉr wa na.
eng: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, Behold, my mother and my brothers!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce gèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu nfʉrà, ba njar yà, ba yà mâ."
eng: For whoever does the will of God, the same is my brother, and my sister, and mother.

lmp: À ka' kèr ba à nfè' mò', Jisòs à kɛ' a ce yɛ'ni bèe àwâa rò. Ku' bèe àŋgoo se a vʉ a sir ye a tarte, e niŋ mbe keŋ a cu mbo. Bèe anà a tɛɛtè nje wâa rò.
eng: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea, and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

lmp: E yɛ'nì wowèe buu magòr à mŋgàa. E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

lmp: "Yu' nè, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ce dù à rbyè buu,
eng: Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow,

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'."
eng: He said, Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.

lmp: E ka' ba mimŋgi' bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ba bèe mo' a vʉ̂, a laa nè ye enɛ e suŋ wowèe mbùu efa ŋgàa ca.
eng: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Buu ce àde' bèe a riŋ kuu kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka' nà, Nyʉ̀ à gèe wèe à rîŋ. À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a yu yìsèe bèe ka' nà, a ce suŋ wowèe buu wɛɛwɛ ba à mŋgàa.
eng: He said to them, To you is given the mystery of the Kingdom of God, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

lmp: Yi yu wa'a, tɛ wowèe a ce kè' kèr kè', yɛ ka', a ce yu'shi ce yu' ka', fà dì' a bo kupse, mà' yàp buu bbebep tɛ Nyʉ̀ foosi wowèe ka'."
eng: that 'seeing they may see, and not perceive; and hearing they may hear, and not understand; lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.'

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe yi mbùu efa ŋgàa ca ka' a? Wèe à ka' tɛ yi ka', banɛ àde' wèe gee wee kɛ ka' yi mbùu efa mŋgàa wɛɛwɛ?
eng: He said to them, Don't you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

lmp: Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ mbyè buu ca ce byè, yu nlàa Nyʉ̀.
eng: The farmer sows the word.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger àwâa nduunjì nà, yu bèe ce a yu' nlàa Nyʉ̀, Satàn ku vʉ fʉr enjep wâp ntee.
eng: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes, and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger mbendù nshe ce e m ba mbendù ryɛɛ nà yu bèe ce a ke yu' nlàa Nyʉ̀, ku yu' rbòŋ àgho sê,
eng: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

lmp: geewa'a vi ke' taa mŋgàŋ njep wowèe ka', ku cu ba nfè' mʉcàr. E ba à nfè' bèe a ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ', kɛ̀ buu vi ba btatap nè wowèe njo' nlàa anà, wowèe a ku kʉti njìnjì.
eng: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger à mʉ̀ msini nà, yu bèe ce a yu' nlàa Nyʉ̀,
eng: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

lmp: mlù ce à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na, ba broŋ buu, ba ntee ce bèe a ke tʉr à buu mò', vi kur blàa anà, yi ke' gee ŋgʉ̀ ka'.
eng: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

lmp: Yì ce e m gwèŋger mbe nshe mbòŋmboŋ tɛɛ àtu bèe ce a yu' nlàa Nyʉ̀, byemi, yi gee ŋgʉ̀, mò' ba mntaar, mò' ba mntuunfu, mò' ba rjèe."
eng: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, and accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.

lmp: E m ker laa nè wowèe foŋ enɛ̂, "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ cʉ' lâm, lor ghee kʉpshi àgho, kɛ̀ tɛr mbà kàasi a? Àmbò e be tɛr ba mbe dì' ce lam e ke tɛɛ a?
eng: He said to them, Is the lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn't it put on a stand?

lmp: Rìŋ nè enɛ yuu ce a sʉ̀ti, yi be kè yɛɛti àwaŋ, tɛ yuu ce a tɛ'shi yi yɛɛti àwaŋ foŋ.
eng: For there is nothing hidden, except that it should be made known; neither was anything made secret, but that it should come to light.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'."
eng: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.

lmp: E m ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yu' nè buu ce a suŋ wèe bòŋboŋ. Nfè' ce wɛ̀ fè' yuu njo, ku ba yì ce Nyʉ̀ be kè fè' njo fa nè wɛ̀, fè' càase embo.
eng: He said to them, Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you, and more will be given to you who hear.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr yuu, banɛ a be fa ye buu mò'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ tʉr yuu ka' banɛ a be koo ka' mʉ yì ce e ce kwà'shi enɛ e tʉr nà ese ye."
eng: For whoever has, to him will more be given, and he who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

lmp: E m ker laa enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ̂, yi yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m byè kwaa à mʉ̀ nsuu.
eng: He said, The Kingdom of God is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

lmp: E m ku ce nòŋ, tʉ̀' ce raa, nyʉ̀ ce coo. Kwaa ce e m byè nà à fʉʉ a ce kù', e ke' yi àmbò e gèe a ka' ce kù' ka'.
eng: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, he doesn't know how.

lmp: Yu ba nshe ce e ke gèe kwaa ku', bate. Yuu entòmbì e ke ba ncèe, e lò embenjìmo sop mʉ sà' ka' bate.
eng: For the earth bears fruit: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

lmp: E ka' bi, banɛ e be kep njobè' nfè' rkep à ghɛɛ."
eng: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts forth the sickle, because the harvest has come.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Àde' sèe laa seenɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò kɛ? Yu njɛ̀ɛ ŋgàa ce efɛ ce àde' sèe ma' ka' riŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu?
eng: He said, How will we liken the Kingdom of God? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

lmp: Àde' sèe laa seenɛ yi yu àmbò ŋgʉ̀ mostà ce e ŋwɛɛsi sê.
eng: It's like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

lmp: Geewa'a, a byè e fʉʉ, ku', ntii efa gho ba magòr, ba sè'ni ba à ce ce àde' bsiŋ vi ba'rì mndap mbo."
eng: yet when it is sown, grows up, and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.

lmp: Jisòs à m mà' ku' mŋgàa mo' àmbò bca, a fe'shi nlàa Nyʉ̀ nè wowèe à ndèe ce àde' wowèe a m ba yu'.
eng: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

lmp: E m làa yuu mo' nè wowèe, buu efa rmà' ba ŋgàa ka', e ba a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe, sar buu wɛɛwɛ nè wowèe.
eng: Without a parable he didn't speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

lmp: À m ba à nyʉ̀ anà à mbùuŋkùr, Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Sèe tuu nèŋguu rò."
eng: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, Let's go over to the other side.

lmp: Wowèe a ma'shì ku' bèe ce a wowèe à m ba nà, a niŋ mbe keŋ ce Jisòs à m ba mbo, a wowèe a ce tuu. Bkeŋ mo' vi m ce tuu foŋ.
eng: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

lmp: Fu' tatap yi kɛ' a ce càa, a doo mdip, mi niŋ mbe keŋ a sɛni ruu mbo.
eng: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

lmp: Jisòs à m ba mbà njì keŋ, a lɛ yi tu mbe mbuu, a ce buumi. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a yɛɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, à ce yɛ wɛnɛ wèr ce kweŋger njep rò na ka' a?"
eng: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion, and they woke him up, and told him, Teacher, don't you care that we are dying?

lmp: E lɛ' efa mmirlò, a waa fu', a laa nè rdip enɛ̂, "Tɛɛ nyaŋ, fa cì'ti ka'." Fu' yi teetì, ŋgòŋ yi ba nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: He awoke, and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, Peace! Be still! The wind ceased, and there was a great calm.

lmp: E laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Wèe ce wɛp ba kɛ wa'a? Wèe à be tʉr rbyemì ka' a?"
eng: He said to them, Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?

lmp: Wowèe a wɛp sê, a laa fa wâp mʉ enɛ, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca a nda sê, ce fu' yi ce yu'ni nè ye, rdip li ce yu'ni nè ye foŋ na?"
eng: They were greatly afraid, and said to one another, Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?

lmp: Jisòs a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a m dù ba' à ŋgòŋ bèe Gɛ̀rasà ce yi m ba nèŋguu rdip rgòr.
eng: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

lmp: E ka' kù fʉʉ embe keŋ, ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce yʉ' bebep yi m niŋ njep ye à vʉ efa dì' ce a m ce tuŋ bèe, à ryɛ ye.
eng: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à m ce cu ba à dì' anà. Yi ke' ba àtɛ̀r à rkur ye, ka' nè bkwàŋ ka'.
eng: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

lmp: A m ce lò kur ye mkoo ba mkùu nè bkwàŋ, e ku ceeshi. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ker tʉr ŋger à rkoo ye kur ka'.
eng: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

lmp: E m ce kar à mndù shè ba à mtùu nètʉ' ba nèmootì a ce war, ker ce shɛshi yì nyor nè blùr.
eng: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

lmp: E ka' yɛ Jisòs àmbò e nyɛɛ, e caŋ a du a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi,
eng: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

lmp: a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Jisòs, Muu Nyʉ̀ embe bùu, yuu ce sò tʉr a kɛ? M ce loo wɛ̀ à rlii Nyʉ̀ enɛ à fa fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ka'."
eng: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don't torment me.

lmp: E m làa wa'a njobè' Jisòs à m làa enɛ̂, "Fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀ ca, wɛ̂ yʉ' bebep."
eng: For he said to him, Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Lo rlii a nda?" E beesì enɛ̂, "La rlii a Ncʉ̀kì, njobè' wèr yu àŋgoo."
eng: He asked him, What is your name? He said to him, My name is Legion, for we are many.

lmp: E m bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ e fa jùu wowêe à dì' anà ka'.
eng: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

lmp: Kʉr ŋkûnyàm mo' gòr se yi m ba àfo, a ce yeŋger àwâa rtùu.
eng: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

lmp: Byʉ' bbebep ca vi bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Mà'shi tɛ wèr du niŋ à mʉ̀ ŋkûnyàm ca, niŋ njep mʉ̀ mo."
eng: All the demons begged him, saying, Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.

lmp: Jisòs à byemì, byʉ' ca vi fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀ ca, a niŋ njep mʉ̀ ŋkûnyàm. Ŋkûnyàm ce yi m ba àmbò ncʉ̀kì baa yi kɛɛtì a suu mbà baa, a gweŋger njep rdip rgòr, a no mdip a kweŋger.
eng: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

lmp: Ŋgâa cìŋ ŋkûnyàm ca a m caŋ, a du a suŋ bèe à là', a ker suŋ nè bèe ce a m ba à mŋkʉ̀, awɛ bèe a dusè à ryɛ yuu ce yi m koni.
eng: Those who fed them fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

lmp: Wowèe a m dù ba', a yɛ Jisòs ba ŋwɛ̀ ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m niŋ njep ye àŋgoo nà àmbò e cu, a yar bcɛ̀' à nyòr. Vi bfee vi banì kʉti mbo. Wowèe a m wɛp sê.
eng: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba, a yɛ yuu ce yi m koni nè ŋwɛ̀ ca ba ŋkûnyàm ca a m suŋ nè bèe anà.
