eng: Those who saw it declared to them how it happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ e lo efa yap ŋgòŋ dû.
eng: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce niŋ mbe keŋ, ŋwɛ̀ ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m fʉʉ enjep ye nà à loo enɛ e be dù a ye.
eng: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

lmp: E kanì, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù fa wɛ̂ là' du suŋ yò bèe buu ce Tata à koosimnse a gee nè wɛ̀."
eng: He didn't allow him, but said to him, Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you, and how he had mercy on you.

lmp: Ŋgàŋ à du a ce kar à Mla' ce Rʉ̂ʉ, a ce suŋ buu ce Jisòs à m gèe nè ye. Bèe wɛɛwɛ a bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker niŋ mbe keŋ, a tuu nèŋguu rò. A ka' bà' njo, ku' bèe a vʉ a kaari àwâa ròo.
eng: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Jairòs, ce à m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mò' embe ndàp rloo, à vʉ̂, a ka' yɛ Jisòs, a gwe njep yê tìi,
eng: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet,

lmp: a bu' mmbo, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Muu wà ce muunje ku ba yî ŋkwe, vʉ̀ la' mo mmbo mbe yê ndù tɛ e bo kè'se, cu ntèe."
eng: and begged him much, saying, My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.

lmp: Jisòs à du a ye, ku' bèe mò' foŋ a du a yê mbùu, a ce nyòrni, a fate ye.
eng: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba àfo ce e m cu mbe kùu à bfè' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: A certain woman, who had an issue of blood for twelve years,

lmp: E m yɛ ŋgɛ' mbe mmbo ŋgâa mcɛ̀p magòr, a too mbaa sê, a ke' ke'se ka'. Yaŋ yi ku ce dù ba kùntombì.
eng: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

lmp: E m yu' nsuŋ Jisòs, a vʉ a niŋ mbe mʉ̀ bèe, a vʉ mbe yê njì, a joo ye cɛ̀',
eng: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd, and touched his clothes.

lmp: njobè' e m làa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ ka' ku joo ba yi cɛ̀', m ku ke'se."
eng: For she said, If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.

lmp: E ka' jòo cɛ̀' Jisòs, yaŋ ca yi ku borni, e ku yu' nje yê nyòr enɛ e kè'se.
eng: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

lmp: Jisòs à m ku riŋ enɛ ŋger mo' yi fʉʉ ye enje nyòr, a karsi nyor a laa enɛ̂, "À jòo nda wa bcɛ̀'?"
eng: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd, and asked, Who touched my clothes?

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ yɛ àmbò ku' bèe a ce nyòrni enɛ̂, à bipshì wɛnɛ à jòo nda wɛ̀ lɛ a?"
eng: His disciples said to him, You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'

lmp: Geewa'a e m ku ce fyɛ' à ryɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e jòo ye anà.
eng: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à m rìŋ yuu ce yi m koni ye, a kɛ' a wɛp, a ce kàŋ, a vʉ a gwe njeptii Jisòs, a suŋ yì mini.
eng: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

lmp: E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Muu wà, lo rbyemì li gèe wɛ̀ ke'sè. Dù nè rfʉtè- ŋwɛ̀, yò ŋgɛ' à mì."
eng: He said to her, Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.

lmp: E ka' bii ce làa, bèe mo' embe ndàp Jairòs a vʉ nè ntuu enɛ muu yì à lɛ kwe, e fa kèr fa lɛ Jisòs ŋgɛ' tɛ e vʉ à cicì ka'.
eng: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler's house saying, Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu' yuu ce wowèe a ce làa, a laa nè Jairòs enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka', kù byemi nè mɛ̀."
eng: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, Don't be afraid, only believe.

lmp: E m byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' du fa yî mbùu caa efa Pità ba Jɛ̂ms, ba Jôn ce e m ba nfʉr Jɛms ka'.
eng: He allowed no one to follow him, except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

lmp: A ka' bà' à rla' ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr anà, a yɛ bjep vi ba àfo, bèe a ce warse sê, a ce koosimnse.
eng: He came to the synagogue ruler's house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

lmp: E niŋ mbe ndàp, a laa nè bèe anà enɛ̂, "Wèe ce warse ba kɛ, a ce koosimnse? Muu ca à kwe kwe ka'. E ce buumi buumi."
eng: When he had entered in, he said to them, Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.

lmp: Bèe a vʉshì ye. E fʉshì wowèe wɛɛwɛ njepmbè, a lor tar muu ba ma muu, ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce a wowèe a m ba, a wowèe a du mbe dì' ce muu anà à m nòŋ.
eng: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

lmp: E m koo ye à bò, a laa nè ye enɛ, "Tàlità, kumì," ce mbùu efa gho yu enɛ̂, "Muunje, m ce laa nè wɛ̀, lò mbekì."
eng: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, Talitha cumi! which means, being interpreted, Girl, I tell you, get up!

lmp: Muunje anà à ku lo mbekì a ce jɛ̀shi. E m ba bfè' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ. Bèe a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê.
eng: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. A ker laa nè wowèe enɛ a fa muu anà byee tɛ e ye.
eng: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

lmp: Jisòs à m lô à to' anà, a du fa yê là'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du fa yê mbuu.
eng: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

lmp: À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, e kɛ' a ce yɛ'ni bèe mbe ndàp rloo. Bèe ce a m yu', a m bɛ̀ɛŋger, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe njɛ̀ɛ ryɛ'nì ca efɛ? A njɛ̀ɛ bfee kɛ ce a m fa nè ye wa'a? E gèe njɛ̀ɛ mfà' mghagha' ca à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, Where did this man get these things? and, What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

lmp: Mbò a ye kapintà ce muu Mɛ̀ɛri a? Mbò e yu nfʉr Jɛ̂ms, ba Josès, ba Jud ker ba Saimʉ̀n a? Mbò bjar vi a yu sèe wowèe àfa a?" A ka' làa wa'a, a kani ye.
eng: Isn't this the carpenter, the son of Mary, and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren't his sisters here with us? They were offended at him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A ke yu'ni nè ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à bdì' wɛɛwɛ, geewa'a bèe efa yê là', ba yì ndap, a ke yu'ni nè ye ka'."
eng: Jesus said to them, A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.

lmp: Àtà e m ba gee mfà' mghagha' fa yê là' ka'. E m ku naa mi mmbo mbendù ŋgâa byaŋ mʉcàr, wowèe a ke'sè.
eng: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people, and healed them.

lmp: E m ba nè rgha'nì-ŋwɛ̀ à ryɛ enɛ bèe a byemi ka'. E m nàti, a ce kar à mla' mo', a ce yɛ'ni bèe blâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

lmp: E m kɛ' bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ce e m ce nà, a tuu wowèe a baa a baa, a fa wowèe ŋger enɛ wowèe a ce fʉr byʉ' bbebep enjep bèe.
eng: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ a ku lor ba mbàŋ, a fa lòr byee, ba bàa ba mbàa ka'.
eng: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ àtà a yar blaba', geewa'a, a fa yar bcɛ̀' à nyôr bbaa ka'.
eng: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à ka' du niŋ ka' mbe ndàp yî fɛ ɛ̀, wèe ku cu ba mbo caar, ba' à nfè' ce wèe be fʉʉ efa rla' anà.
eng: He said to them, Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

lmp: Wèe à ka' niŋ à rla', a ke' koni wèe, kɛ̀ yu'shi yuu ce wèe ce làa ka', wèe kashì nfʉ̀nfʉ efa me mkùu à to' anà, duse, à rdùŋshi enɛ wowèe a gèe yuu bebep."
eng: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!

lmp: Wowèe a dû, a ce fè'shi nè bèe enɛ a kupse, ma' yàp buu bbebep.
eng: They went out and preached that people should repent.

lmp: Wowèe a m fʉshi ku' byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe, a ker yo' ŋgâa byaŋ magòr nè mgʉr, wowèe a ke'sè.
eng: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick, and healed them.

lmp: Bèe a m ce suŋ àmbò Jisòs gòr, ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd à yu'. Bèe mò' a m ce làa enɛ a Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe ce e fʉʉ efa rkwe, a mbùu ce e tʉr ŋger à rgèe njɛ̀ɛ buu bghagha' ca wa'a.
eng: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m ce laa yap enɛ a Àlajà; bèe mo' enɛ a ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce e yu àmbò ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce entòmbì nà.
eng: But others said, He is Elijah. Others said, He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.

lmp: Hɛròd à ka' yu' wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Jôn ce mɛ̀ m tee ye tu nà, à fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: But Herod, when he heard this, said, This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.

lmp: Hɛròd ca à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu bèe, a du a koo Jôn, a kur, a fa ye mbe shaŋ àtu Hɛ̀rodìyà ce e m ba ŋgwa nfʉr yì ce Felêp.
eng: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John, and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip's wife, for he had married her.

lmp: Jôn à m banì laa nè Hɛròd enɛ̂, "Ncir yi byemi enɛ à fap ŋgwa nfʉrò beesì à yò ka'."
eng: For John said to Herod, It is not lawful for you to have your brother's wife.

lmp: Hɛ̀rodìyà à ka' yu', a baa Jôn sê. E m ròo à ryʉ Jôn, geewa'a njì yi buu,
eng: Herodias set herself against him, and desired to kill him, but she couldn't,

lmp: njobè' Hɛròd à m ce wɛp Jôn. E m yi enɛ Jôn yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, a ker ba ŋwɛ̂ nrara, a ce tɛ'shi ye. Jôn à m ce làa yuu, yi ce fa Hɛròd ŋgɛ' sê, geewa'a, e ku ce kòŋ à ryu' yuu ce e m ce làa.
eng: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

lmp: Fɛŋ yi m lò a yɛɛti mbe nfè' ce Hɛròd à m kɛ' ŋkà' yi nòŋ ce a m bi ye. E m be bêe bgòrgòr embe yê nto', ba bsoogɛ̀ ce bgòrgòr, ba bòo mlii mo' ce à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: Then a convenient day came, that Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

lmp: Muu Hɛ̀rodìyà ce njeŋwɛ̀ à m vʉ̀ a bii bii, nyòr à boŋ Hɛròd ba bèe ce a m vʉ̀ ŋkà'. Awɛ Hɛròd à làa nè muu ana enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' bipshi ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ ce wɛ̀ kòŋ, m ku fa nè wɛ̀."
eng: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.

lmp: E m ye lè', a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' bipshi ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ, m ku fa nè wɛ̀, ka' nto'nì efa ya ŋgòŋ."
eng: He swore to her, Whatever you shall ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.

lmp: Muu ca à dû, a bipshi nè yì ma enɛ̂, "M be bipshi ba kɛ?" Yì ma à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Tu Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe."
eng: She went out, and said to her mother, What shall I ask? She said, The head of John the Baptizer.

lmp: Muu anà à ku caŋ a kʉti, a du a laa nè ŋkʉʉ enɛ̂, "M ce kòŋ enɛ à fa mɛ̀ tu Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe njep kaŋ sè'ni."
eng: She came in immediately with haste to the king, and asked, I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.

lmp: Mlù mi koo ŋkʉʉ sê, à ka' ba njobè' e m ye lè' à bsii bèe ce a m vʉ̀ ŋkà' nà, e moo à rshè làr.
eng: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths, and of his dinner guests, he didn't wish to refuse her.

lmp: E m ku tuu ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̀ enɛ e du vʉ nè tu Jôn. E du mbe shaŋ, a tee tu ese Jôn,
eng: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard, and commanded to bring John's head, and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

lmp: a vʉ àgho njep kaŋ, a fa nè muu anà, e fa nè yì mâ.
eng: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jôn à ka' yu' wa'a, a du a lor gʉ̀ʉ a tuŋ.
eng: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse, and laid it in a tomb.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a m kʉti a yɛ ye, a suŋ ye buu ce wowèe a m gèe, ker ba buu ce wowèe a m dù a yɛ'ni bèe.
eng: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

lmp: Bèe a ce vʉ̀ magòr, ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a ke' tʉr njì à rye yuu ka'. Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Sèe du à dì' mo' ce bèe a yu ka' tɛ wèe lʉshi mʉcàr."
eng: He said to them, You come apart into a deserted place, and rest awhile. For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

lmp: Wowèe a niŋ mbe keŋ, a du à dì' ce bèe a m ba ka'.
eng: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

lmp: Bèe a yɛ àmbò wowèe a ce dù, a riŋ wowèe, a fʉʉse efa mla' wɛɛwɛ, a caŋse a du a ba' à dì' anà entombì.
eng: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kù fʉʉ embe keŋ, a yɛ ku' bèe àwâa rò, a koosimnse nè bèe anà magòr njobè' wowèe a m ba àmbò njèe ce yi buu ŋwɛ̀ rcìŋ wa'a. E kɛ' a ce yɛ'ni wowèe ku' buu.
eng: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd, and he began to teach them many things.

lmp: Nfè' à m kɛ̀' a ce càa, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a vʉ̂, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sèe yu à njìsàp efa mla', nyʉ̀ à ce coo.
eng: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him, and said, This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

lmp: Làa tɛ wowèe a duse à mla' ce mi yu àtʉtʉ, ba mì ce mi yu à mŋkʉ̀, dù yuu byee, ye."
eng: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages, and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Fa nè wowèe yuu tɛ a ye." Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Banɛ wèr lor bàa mbâa bbaa, du yuu brɛ̂d àgho nè wowèe a?"
eng: But he answered them, You give them something to eat. They asked him, Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread, and give them something to eat?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe tʉr brɛ̂d yi sɛ'? Dù fyɛ' ka nè." Wowèe a ka' dù fyɛ', a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr tʉr brɛ̂d tâ, ba nca baa."
eng: He said to them, How many loaves do you have? Go see. When they knew, they said, Five, and two fish.

lmp: E laa enɛ wowèe a laa tɛ bèe anà a cute à mjɛɛ à bkʉr à bkʉr.
eng: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

lmp: Wowèe a lâa, bèe anà a cutè à bkʉr à bkʉr. Bkʉr mo' bèe rjèe rjèe; bkʉr mo' bèe mta mtâ.
eng: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

lmp: E lor brɛ̂d tâ, ba nca baa cà, a ke' mbe bùu, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi brɛ̂d, a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ a gapshi nè bèe anà, a ceeshi nca anà foŋ a gapshi nè wowèe.
eng: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ye, a yu'.
eng: They all ate, and were filled.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a baashì bbɛbɛ' brɛ̂d ba btete nca, vi ruu à mŋkàa ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù ce a m ye byee anà a m ba bèe ncʉ̀kì tâ.
eng: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

lmp: Jisòs à m ku laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ a niŋ mbe keŋ, tuu nèŋguu rò entombì, tɛ e laasi bèe anà.
eng: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat, and to go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

lmp: E ka' làasi wowèe wɛɛ a ko' mbe rtùu à rgèe rloo.
eng: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, keŋ à ba mbe ntee rdip, Jisòs à ba nje waa ŋkʉ̀ mimŋgi'.
eng: When evening had come, the boat was in the midst of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

lmp: E yɛ àmbò ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ce ni'ni nè keŋ, njobè' fu' yi m ce càa magòr. À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', e du a wâp mbùu, a ce jɛ̀r mbendù rdip, a ce ròo càa wowèe.
eng: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea, and he would have passed by them,

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ àmbò e ce jɛ̀r mbendù rdip, a ce kwa'shi enɛ a nyir, a warse,
eng: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

lmp: njobè' wowèe wɛɛwɛ a m yɛ ye, a ce wɛp. E ku laa nè wowèe à nfè' anà enɛ̂, "Kur nè ntee, a mɛ̀, fa wɛp nè ka'."
eng: for they all saw him, and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them, and said to them, Cheer up! It is I! Don't be afraid.

lmp: E niŋ a cu a wowèe mbe keŋ, awɛ fu' cà yi teetì. Wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê,
eng: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

lmp: njobè' wowèe a m be riŋ àmbò Jisòs à m gèe, a ka' nyaŋ ku' bèe ca nè brɛ̂d tâ, ba nca baa ka'.
eng: for they hadn't understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' tuu nèŋguu rò, a cʉʉ keŋ àwâa rò, a ba sè'ni ba à ŋgôŋ Gɛ̀nɛsarɛ̀t.
eng: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret, and moored to the shore.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ku fʉʉ embe keŋ, bèe a yɛ ye, a rîŋ.
eng: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

lmp: E m ce jɛ̀r à dì' anà, bèe a ce yu' fà dì' e yu, byɛ'se ŋgâa byaŋ, vʉ àgho, yɛ ye.
eng: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick, on their mats, to where they heard he was.

lmp: Bdì' wɛɛwɛ ce e m dù, kɛ̀ à mlà' mkɛ'ŋkɛ' ba à mla' mŋgòrŋgòr ɛ̀, bèe a vʉ̀ nè ŋgâa byaŋ à ntaa, ce bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ e ku ma'shi tɛ a joo ka' yi cùu cɛ̀'. Ŋgâa byaŋ wɛɛwɛ ce a m jòo ye a m ke'sè.
eng: Wherever he entered, into villages, or into cities, or into the country, they laid the sick in the marketplaces, and begged him that they might touch just the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir mo' ce a m vʉ̂ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a m vʉ à ryɛ Jisòs.
eng: Then the Pharisees, and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

lmp: Wowèe a m yɛ àmbò ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu mo' a ce ye byee nè mmbo msii.
eng: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is, unwashed, hands, they found fault.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi ba Jus wɛɛwɛ a ka' tɛ sù'si mmbo àmbò ndèe wâp bta à m ba ka', a ye yuu ka'.
eng: For the Pharisees, and all the Jews, don't eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

lmp: A ka' vʉ efa ntaa, a ku su'si mmbo wɛɛ ka' ye yuu. Wowèe a ker tʉr ndèe mò' foŋ ce wâp bta a m kwe, a lɛ nè wowèe, àmbò àde' wowèe a su'sì mndoŋ ba mkìŋ, ker ba bkaŋ à njî yɛɛnì.
eng: They don't eat when they come from the marketplace, unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things, which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a bipshì nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a lɛ̀ ndèe visèe bta ka', a ce ye buu nè mmbo msii njokɛ?"
eng: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, Why don't your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Àsayà ce ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa yuu mini kuu wèe ce ŋgâa mbo'ni àmbò a m saŋ enɛ̂, "Bèe ca a ku ce yu'ni nè mɛ̀ ba nè cùu. Yap mntee yi yu ànjìsàp ese mɛ̀.
eng: He answered them, Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, 'This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

lmp: Wowèe a ce gèe rloo nè mɛ̀ à cicì, njobè' a ce yɛ'ni bèe mncir ce à lɛ̀ ba bèe."
eng: But in vain do they worship me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.'

lmp: Wèe à mà' ncir Nyʉ̀ a lor ba ndèe to'."
eng: For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men--the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe tʉr njì bfee à rkani mncir Nyʉ̀ tɛ wèe bo lòr yè ndèe to'.
eng: He said to them, Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

lmp: Musìs à m làa enɛ̂, "Yu'ni nè yò ta ba yò mâ." A ker laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' cɛp yì ta kɛ̀ yì ma ɛ̀, banɛ a be yʉ ŋgàŋ."
eng: For Moses said, 'Honor your father and your mother;' and, 'He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.'

lmp: Wèe ce làa weenɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor yuu ce e ba jà' yì ma ba yì ta àgho, laa enɛ, "Yuu ce mɛ̀ tʉr ce mɛ̀ ba jà' wɛ̀ àgho nà, yu Kobàn", ce yi yu enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ fa nè Nyʉ̀,"
eng: But you say, 'If a man tells his father or his mother, Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban, that is to say, given to God;'

lmp: wèe ker byemi enɛ e ja' yì ma ba yì ta àgho ka'.
eng: then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

lmp: Wêe gee wa'a, banɛ wèe à lòr yè ndèe a siŋsi mncir Nyʉ̀ àgho. Ku' buu mò' yu foŋ àmbò bca, ce wêe ke gèe."
eng: making void the word of God by your tradition, which you have handed down. You do many things like this.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker kɛ' ku' bèe ce a m ba àfo a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yu'shi nè bòŋboŋ.
eng: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, Hear me, all of you, and understand.

lmp: Yuu ce yi ke niŋ njep ŋwɛ̀, yi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e ba jàpri à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yuu ce yi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e ba jàpri à bsii Nyʉ̀ yu ba yuu ce yi fʉʉ enjep ye.
eng: There is nothing from outside of the man, that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'."
eng: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!

lmp: E ka' mà'shi bèe, niŋ mbe ndàp, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a bipshì nè ye enɛ ŋgàa anà yu enɛ kɛ lɛ.
eng: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

lmp: E beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wee wèe à be riŋ buu foŋ ka' a? Mbò wèe yi weenɛ àde' yuu ce yi ke niŋ njep ŋwɛ̀ yi gee ŋwɛ̀ e bep à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka' ka' a?
eng: He said to them, Are you thus without understanding also? Don't you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can't defile him,

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' yi ke niŋ ba njep ntee ka', yi ke niŋ ba njep rbʉ̀, fʉʉ enjo." E ka' làa wa'a a raasi enɛ byee wɛɛwɛ vi yu bbòŋboŋ à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: because it doesn't go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, thus purifying all foods?

lmp: E m ker laa enɛ̂, "Yuu ce yi ke fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀, à yì ce e ke gèe ye e ba jàpri à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: He said, That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ buu bbebep ca vi ke lò ba enjep ntee: bsàkì, byɛ̀ɛ, nyʉshi bèe, à rkoo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò',
eng: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

lmp: à rbàŋ mmir à buu, bsàrbuu, mbo'ni, ndêe mbembep, ŋko'ndoŋ, mnsa'ni, nàanyor ba blʉr.
eng: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

lmp: Buu bbebep ca bsìp vi ke fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀, gee ye e ba jàpri à bsii Nyʉ̀."
eng: All these evil things come from within, and defile the man.

lmp: Jisòs à m nàtî à àfo, a du à dì' ce rla' Tayà li m ba. E m dù a ba' àfo, a niŋ mbe ndàp, a koŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' riŋ enɛ e yu mbo ka'. Geewa'a bèe a ku rîŋ.
eng: From there he arose, and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house, and didn't want anyone to know it, but he couldn't escape notice.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' ce nyʉ̀rkà' à m niŋ njep muu yì, à m yu' enɛ Jisòs yu àfo, a vʉ̂, a gwe njep yê tìi.
eng: For a woman, whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à m ba ŋwɛ̀ enje jɛɛ. A m bi ye à ŋgôŋ Sìròfònisìyà. E m bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ e fʉr yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' ca enjep muu yì.
eng: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mà'shi tɛ a nyaŋ boo entòmbì njobè' yi bòŋ enɛ a lor byee boo ma' nè ŋgwe ka'."
eng: But Jesus said to her, Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children's bread and throw it to the dogs.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ca à beesì enɛ̂, "Yi yu mini wa'a, Tatâ, to ŋgwe yi ke ye mkʉ̀' baa boo ce mi gwèŋger foŋ."
eng: But she answered him, Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children's crumbs.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À ka' ba njo' yuu ce wɛ̀ làa na, yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' ca yi fʉʉ enjep muu ghò. Dù yo yu."
eng: He said to her, For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.

lmp: E m kʉti à là', a yɛ àmbò muu yì nòŋ mbe bkuu, yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' anà yi banì fʉʉ enjep ye.
eng: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

lmp: Jisòs à m nàtî à dì' ce rla' Tayà li m ba nà, a to'ni rla' Sidòn, a caa Mla' ce Rʉ̂ʉ, a du a ba' à rdip rgòr ce à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee, through the midst of the region of Decapolis.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m vʉ̀ nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m fuŋre a ke' yi à rlàa yuu bòŋboŋ foŋ ka', a bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ e naa mi mmbo mbendù ŋwɛ̀ anà, ja' ye.
eng: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

lmp: Jisòs à fʉr ye embe mʉ̀ bèe, a fa ye mntummbo mbà btù', a ce mce, a joo ye rlee àgho,
eng: He took him aside from the multitude, privately, and put his fingers into his ears, and he spat, and touched his tongue.

lmp: a ke' mbe bùu a shoo, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Efatà." Efatà ca yu enɛ, "Mʉ̀'ti."
eng: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, Ephphatha! that is, Be opened!

lmp: Vi btù' vi mʉ'ŋgèr, rlee li ba'ŋgèr ye, e kɛ' a ce làa yɛɛnì.
eng: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

lmp: Jisòs à ciisì nè wowèe enɛ a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka'. E ka' cìisi wa'a wowèe a misì a suŋ bèe gòr.
eng: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

lmp: Bèe a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê, a ce làa enɛ̂, "E gèe buu wɛɛwɛ yɛɛnì; e gèe mnfuŋtù' a ce yu' buu, blʉr a ce làa."
eng: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear, and the mute speak!

lmp: À m ba à mnòŋ anà, ma kʉr bèe yi ker vʉ a kaari, a ke' koni yuu ye ka'. Jisòs à kɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself, and said to them,

lmp: "M ce koosimnse nè bèe ca sê, wèr wowèe à cu à mnôŋ btaar, wowèe a ke' koni yuu ye ka'.
eng: I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days, and have nothing to eat.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Brɛ̂d yi be ka' lò efɛ à ntee rìŋ ca, ce àde' yi ghɛɛtè à ryaŋ wowèe?"
eng: His disciples answered him, From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe tʉr brɛ̂d bsɛ'?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr tʉr brɛ̂d sàambâ."
eng: He asked them, How many loaves do you have? They said, Seven.

lmp: Awɛ e laa bèe anà a cutè à nshè. E lor brɛ̂d sàamba cà, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a gapshì nè bèe anà.
eng: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them, and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

lmp: Wowèe a m tʉr mʉ nca foŋ. E yoŋshì Nyʉ̀, a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ a gapshi nè bèe anà foŋ.
eng: They had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

lmp: Wowèe a ye a yu', a baashi bbɛbɛ' ce vi m bɛti, vi ruu à mŋkàa sàambâ.
eng: They ate, and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ye, a m ba àmbò ncʉ̀kì kyèe. E laa wowèe a dusè,
eng: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

lmp: e niŋ mbe keŋ a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe, a tuu à mbèp Dàlmànutà.
eng: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples, and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a m vʉ̀, a ce taase Jisòs. Wowèe a m ce ròo à rmòoshi ye, awɛ a laa nè ye enɛ e duŋshi wowèe ncòo embe bùu.
eng: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven, and testing him.

lmp: E shoo, a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe e lùuni a ce ròo mncôo bghagha' wa'a njokɛ? Ài', m suŋ wèe mɛnɛ àde' m duŋshì ncòo nè bèe ca ka'."
eng: He sighed deeply in his spirit, and said, Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.

lmp: E ma'shì wowèe, a niŋ mbe keŋ, a tuu nèŋguu rò.
eng: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a m lèse à rlòr brɛ̂d, a ku tʉr ba ntu' brɛ̂d mo'sir mbe keŋ.
eng: They forgot to take bread; and they didn't have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

lmp: Jisòs à ciisì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nfè' nè yis bèe Farìsi ba yì Hɛròd."
eng: He warned them, saying, Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce làa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "E làa wa'a njobè' sèe à ba vʉ nè brɛ̂d ka'."
eng: They reasoned with one another, saying, It's because we have no bread.

lmp: Jisòs à m yi yuu ce wowèe a ce làa. A laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce làa fa wêe mʉ enɛ wèe tʉr brɛ̂d ka' njokɛ? Wèe à be riŋ buu ka' a? Wà' wèe à be riŋ mbùu efa gho ka' a? Wà' ku ba ntèe-tu a?
eng: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, Why do you reason that it's because you have no bread? Don't you perceive yet, neither understand? Is your heart still hardened?

lmp: Wèe à tʉr mmir, a ke' ce yɛ buu ka' a? A tʉr btù', a ke' ce yu' buu ka' a? Kɛ̀ yu ba enɛ wèe ce kuushi buu ka' a?
eng: Having eyes, don't you see? Having ears, don't you hear? Don't you remember?

lmp: À nfè' mɛ̀ m bɛ'shi mtu' brɛ̂d tâ, a fa nè bèe ncʉ̀kì ta nà, wowèe a m ye, wèe a kwɛ' bbɛbɛ' à mŋkâa bsɛ'?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr à m kwɛ̀' à mŋkàa ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ."
eng: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They told him, Twelve.

lmp: E ker bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "À nfè' mɛ̀ m fa mntu' brɛ̂d sàamba nè bèe ncʉ̀kì kyèe nà, wowèe a m ye, wèe à kwɛ' bbɛbɛ' à mŋkâa bsɛ'?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr à m kwɛ̀' bbɛbɛ' à mŋkàa sàambâ."
eng: When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up? They told him, Seven.

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ wèe à be riŋ mbùu efa yuu ce m ce làa ka' a?"
eng: He asked them, Don't you understand, yet?

lmp: Wowèe a m vʉ̀ a ba' à rlà' Bɛ̀tsaidà, bèe mo' a vʉ nè nfèp enɛ Jisòs joo ye nè bo tɛ e ke'se.
eng: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him, and begged him to touch him.

lmp: E ghashì ye à rkoo a ye a fʉʉ efa là' anà. A ka' dù bà', a ce ye nè mce nje mmìr, a la' mmbo mbe yê ndù, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce yɛ buu sè'ni a?"
eng: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spit on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

lmp: E fyɛ' mbekì, a beesi enɛ̂, "M ce yɛ àmbò bèe a ce jɛ̀shi, a ba àmbò bce wa'a."
eng: He looked up, and said, I see men; for I see them like trees walking.

lmp: Jisòs à ker la' ye mmbo nje mmìr, e tuŋsì mmir, a misi a yɛ buu sè'ni bòŋboŋ.
eng: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

lmp: Jisòs à ma'shì ye enɛ e du mbe yê ndàp, a laa nè ye enɛ e fa kèr dù à mʉ̀ la' ka'.
eng: He sent him away to his house, saying, Don't enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.

lmp: Jisòs a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a m ce dù à bu' mla' ce mi m ba à to' Sisàriyà Fìlepài. A ka' dù bà' à nduunjì e bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bèe a ce làa enɛ m yu nda?"
eng: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, Who do men say that I am?

lmp: Wowèe a bèesi nè ye enɛ̂, "Bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ à yu Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe, bèe mo' enɛ à yu Àlajà, bèe mo' enɛ à yu mò' efa ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀."
eng: They told him, John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others: one of the prophets.

lmp: E ker bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yi yu yi kɛ àmbò wèe, wèe ce làa ye weenɛ m yu nda?" Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ Krâis anà."
eng: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Peter answered, You are the Christ.

lmp: E ciisì nè wowèe enɛ a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' enɛ a ye Krâis anà ka'.
eng: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

lmp: Jisòs à m kɛ̀' a ce yɛ'ni ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kù yɛ ŋgɛ' gòr sê, tɛ bleebèe ba bêe bgòrgòr efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ker ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a kani ye. A be kè yʉ ye, mnòŋ vi ba btaar, e fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

lmp: E m làa buu ca nè wowèe rara sê. Pità à koo ye, a ye a lɛ'sì nyor, a kɛ' a ce lapni ye kuu yuu ce e làa anà.
eng: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him, and began to rebuke him.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nyor a fyɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Lò efa mɛ̂ geŋ, Satàn! Mo mkwà'shì yu ba mî ŋwɛ̀, yu mî Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: But he, turning around, and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ' ku' bèe ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce kòŋ à rvʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu, banɛ ŋgàŋ kani yì nyor, byɛ' yi kìntaa, ce vʉ fa mɛ̂ mbùu.
eng: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples, and said to them, Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rboŋshi li ryòŋ banɛ ŋgàŋ be bɛ li, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ boŋshi li ryòŋ ka' njo' mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni li.
eng: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ konì ba njɛ̀ɛ sɛ' kɛ ce e ka' tʉr buu enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ, bɛ li ryòŋ?
eng: For what does it profit a man, to gain the whole world, and forfeit his life?

lmp: Yuu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ fa àtu li ryòŋ yu kɛ?
eng: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce rìtu yi ce koo ye nè mɛ̀, ker ba nè wa blàa embe njɛ̀ɛ nfè' e sè'ni ce bèe a ce kani Nyʉ̀, a ker ce gèe buu bebep na, banɛ rìtu yi be kè koo Muu Ŋwɛ̀ nè ye foŋ mbe nfè' ce e be kè vʉ̀ a bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce brara wèe nè fòo yì Tâ."
eng: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him, when he comes in the glory of his Father with the holy angels.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ bèe mo' a yu à mʉ̀ bèe ce a tɛɛte na ce rkwe li be jòo wowèe ka'. Wowèe a be kù cu caar yɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ àmbò yi vʉ̀ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀."
eng: He said to them, Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see the Kingdom of God come with power.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi ka' càa ntuunfu, Jisòs à lor Pità ba Jɛ̂ms, ker ba Jôn, a ko' a wowèe mbe rtûu rsàsap, à ku ba wowèe mbo cà'cà'. A m bà' mbo, Jisòs à kupsè a ba à njɛ̂ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

lmp: Vi bcɛ̀' vi beetì bbʉʉ, a ce là'ŋger sê, a fʉp ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ à m ba su'si vi fʉp wa' ka'.
eng: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

lmp: Ka' cu, Àlajà ba Musìs a nyɛɛ, a ce de' a Jisòs.
eng: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

lmp: Awɛ Pità à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Rabài yi bòŋ àmbò sèe yu àfa na. Mà'shi tɛ wèr ba'ri btâp btaar, tɛ mo' ba yo, tɛ mo' ba yi Musìs, tɛ mo' ba yi Àlajà."
eng: Peter answered Jesus, Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.

lmp: E m yi yuu ce e laa ka' njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp sê.
eng: For he didn't know what to say, for they were very afraid.

lmp: Mmbà' vi vʉ̂, a cete wowèe, njèndoŋ à laa enjep mʉ̀ mo enɛ̂, "Cena yu muu wà ce m kòŋ sê. Ce yu' nè yuu ce e ce làa."
eng: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.

lmp: Wowèe a ke'sè ŋgòŋ, a ker yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' caa efa Jisòs ka'.
eng: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce sùu embe rtùu, Jisòs à ciisì nè wowèe enɛ a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ yuu ce wowèe a yɛ nà ka', caar tɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ke fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

lmp: Wowèe a m suŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka', geewa'a, a ce tarni enɛ nfʉʉ efa rkwe ca yu ba kɛ lɛ.
eng: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the rising from the dead meant.

lmp: Wowèe a m bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a ce làa enɛ Àlajà be vʉ̀ entombì njokɛ?"
eng: They asked him, saying, Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?

lmp: E beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Rtarnì li yu njo ka', Àlajà be vʉ̀ wɛɛ, gèe tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ kʉti àmbò vi m ba. Banɛ a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kù yɛ ŋgɛ' sê, tɛ bèe a jaasi ye njokɛ?
eng: He said to them, Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

lmp: M ce suŋ wee mɛnɛ Àlajà à vʉ̀ war, bèe a gee buu ce a m ce kòŋ à rgèe nè ye, àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀."
eng: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.

lmp: Wowèe a m vʉ̀ a yɛ bɛr ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, ku' bèe a sir wowèe, ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a ce sɛr nsɛr a wowèe.
eng: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

lmp: Ku' bèe ca a ka' kù yɛ ye, a bɛɛŋger sê, a caŋse a du à rcà'ni ye.
eng: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him greeted him.

lmp: E bipshì nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Wèe ce sɛr ba kɛ wèe wowèe?"
eng: He asked the scribes, What are you asking them?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe anà à beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, mɛ̀ ba vʉ nè muu wà à ryɛ wɛ̀. Yʉ' bebep yi yu njep ye, a gêe, e ke' ce làa ka'.
eng: One of the multitude answered, Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

lmp: Yi lò gee ye, e gwe à nshè, bdʉdʉ' vi fʉʉ ye à cùu, e ce kʉr msòŋ, tee mbà yɛɛ. Mɛ̀ laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu mɛnɛ a fʉr yʉ' anà, wowèe a moo làr."
eng: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down, and he foams at the mouth, and grinds his teeth, and wastes away. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren't able.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Haba! Wêe bèe e lùuni ce wèe buu rbyemì! M be cu wèe sèe dù bà' fɛ? M be kur ntee nè wèe dù bà' fɛ? Vʉ̀ nè muu anà fa nè mɛ̀."
eng: He answered him, Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.

lmp: A m vʉ̀ nè muu anà a fa nè ye. Yʉ' cà yi ka' yɛ Jisòs, a gêe, muu anà à gwe kà', a ce biŋri a ce fʉr bdʉdʉ' à cùu.
eng: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him, and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshi nè tar muu enɛ̂, "Muu ca à m kɛ̀' yaŋ ca à se'kɛ?" E beesì enɛ̂, "Yi m ku kɛ' à nfè' e m bii ŋkɛ'.
eng: He asked his father, How long has it been since this has come to him? He said, From childhood.

lmp: Yi m lò ku ce mà' ye njep mor ba njep rò à ryʉ ye. Ka' ba enɛ àde' à gee yuu mo', à koosìmnse nè wèr, ja' wèr."
eng: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water, to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us, and help us.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce làa wɛnɛ, "ka' ba enɛ àde' à gee yuu mo'" wa'a, a ce làa ba enɛ kɛ? Buu wɛɛwɛ yu àtɛ̀r nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e byemi."
eng: Jesus said to him, If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.

lmp: Tar muu anà à ku waa à cùu anà, a laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ byemi. Gèe tɛ la rbyemì li tap."
eng: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, I believe. Help my unbelief!

lmp: Jisòs à m yɛ enɛ ku' bèe a ce vʉ̀se, e waa yʉ' bebep anà a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ yʉ' ce yi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e fuŋrè ker ba lʉr, mɛ̀ laa nè wɛ̀: fʉʉ enjep ye. Fa kèr niŋ njep ye nyʉ̀ mò' ka'."
eng: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!

lmp: Yʉ' anà yi waa, e ker gwe kà', yi fʉʉ enjep ye, e noŋ àmbò gʉ̀ʉ ŋwɛ̀ wa'a. Wèe mo' a ce làa enɛ e kwe.
eng: Having cried out, and convulsed greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead; so much that most of them said, He is dead.

lmp: Jisòs à ghashì ye à rkoo, a naa mbekì, e natì a tɛɛ.
eng: But Jesus took him by the hand, and raised him up; and he arose.

lmp: E ka' niŋ mbe ndàp, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu à ku ba Jisòs a wowèe, wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à ba moo a rfʉr yʉ' anà enjep ye làr njokɛ?"
eng: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, Why couldn't we cast it out?

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yuu ce àde' yi fʉr njɛ̀ɛ yʉ' ca enjep ŋwɛ̀ ku ba rloo rtatap cà'cà'."
eng: He said to them, This kind can come out by nothing, except by prayer and fasting.

lmp: Wowèe a m nàti a caa njî à ŋgôŋ Galèlê. Jisòs à koŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' yi ka',
eng: They went out from there, and passed through Galilee. He didn't want anyone to know it.

lmp: njobè' e m ce yɛ'ni ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a ce laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A be lòr Muu Ŋwɛ̀ fa mbà mmbo bèe, tɛ a yʉ ye, tɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe mbenjì mnôŋ btaar."
eng: For he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.

lmp: Geewa'a wowèe a m rìŋ yuu ce e m làa ka', a ce wɛp à rbipshi nè ye.
eng: But they didn't understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

lmp: Wowèe a m dù a ba' à rla' Kàpanùm, a ka' niŋ mbe ndàp, e bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à ba ce sɛr ba kɛ à nduunjì?"
eng: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì ka', njobè' wowèe a m ce sɛr enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr efa wowèe a nda lɛ?
eng: But they were silent, for they had disputed one with another on the way about who was the greatest.

lmp: E cu à nshè, a kɛ' yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rba ŋwɛ̀ e kùntombì, banɛ e be lòr yi tu à ŋwɛ̀ embà lʉ̀simbùu, ba à ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè bèe wɛɛwɛ."
eng: He sat down, and called the twelve; and he said to them, If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.

lmp: E m lòr mʉ ghàrŋwɛ̀ a tɛr mbe wâp mʉ, a koo ye nje nyòr, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: He took a little child, and set him in the midst of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni mʉ ghàrŋwɛ̀ àmbò ca fa mɛ̂ rlii, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni mɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni mɛ̀, banɛ e koni ba mɛ̀ ka', e koni ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀."
eng: Whoever receives one such little child in my name, receives me, and whoever receives me, doesn't receive me, but him who sent me.

lmp: Jôn à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, wèr à mʉ yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' e ce fʉshi byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe fa wɛ̂ rlii. Wèr à laa nè ye enɛ e fa kèr gèe wa' ka' njobè' e yu mo' efa sêe mʉ ka'."
eng: John said to him, Teacher, we saw someone who doesn't follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow us.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa làa enɛ ŋgàŋ borni ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gee rfâ' rghagha' fa mɛ̂ rlii banɛ àde' e laa yuu bebep kuu mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But Jesus said, Don't forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name, and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ba yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ bbàa ka', banɛ e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' fa wèe ndoŋ mdip njobè' wèe yu bèe Krâis, àde' e bɛ vi blà' ka'."
eng: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name, because you are Christ's, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gee mò' efa boo bkɛ' ce a byemi nè mɛ̀ na, e gee yuu bebep, banɛ yi be ba àndèe nè ye ce a ka' lor ma lûr ŋgò' baa cʉʉ ye kù ndoŋ, ma' njep rdip rgòr.
eng: Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he was thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

lmp: Yo bo yi ka' gee wɛ̀ à gee yuu bebep, à tee yi ma'; yi yu àndèe enɛ à niŋ mbe dî' rcu ce nfesè, buu bo, nè ce enɛ à tʉr mmbo mmbaa dù njep mor ce àtà a liisì ka'.
eng: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

lmp: Yo kùu yi ka' gee wɛ̀ à gee yuu bebep, à tee yi ma'; yi yu àndèe enɛ à niŋ mbe dî' rcu ce nfesè, buu kùu, nè ce enɛ à tʉr mkùu mmbaa, tɛ a ma' wɛ̀ njep mor.
eng: where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.' If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched--

lmp: Mor anà yi be kè liiti nyʉ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

lmp: Lo rlir li ka' gee wɛ̀ à gee yuu bebep, à so'ni li enje tù, ma'; yi yu àndèe enɛ à ba ntò' rlir, niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ nè ce à tʉr mmir mmbaa tɛ a ke koo wɛ̀, mà' njep mor.
eng: If your eye causes you to stumble, cast it out. It is better for you to enter into the Kingdom of God with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

lmp: Mŋgʉ̂r ce mi ce ye wowèe njo mi be kweŋger ka', tɛ mor anà yi liiti ka'.
eng: where their worm doesn't die, and the fire is not quenched.'

lmp: A be kè yo' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ nè mgwaŋ ce yu ba mor.
eng: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

lmp: Mgwaŋ mi bòŋ. Geewa'a mi ka' cir, àde' wèe gee weekɛ mi ka' ker lêe? Banɛ wèe ba àmbò mgwaŋ mlèelee. Cu nè nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀."
eng: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.

lmp: Jisòs à natì a du à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, a ker du à ŋgôŋ nèŋguu rdip Jodàn. Ku' bèe a ker vʉse à ryɛ ye, e yɛ'ni wowèe àmbò e m ku ce yɛ'ni bèe nà.
eng: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi mo' a vʉ̂, a mooshi ye, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Wà' ncir yi byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ juu ŋgwa yì a?"
eng: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Musìs à m làa nè wèe enɛ kɛ?"
eng: He answered, What did Moses command you?

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Musìs à m fa njì enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' kòŋ à rjùu ŋgwa yì, e saŋ ŋwà' fa nè ye à rdùŋshi enɛ e sà'si gùu, ka' jùu ye."
eng: They said, Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.

lmp: Jisòs à kʉsì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Musìs à m saŋ ncir ca nè wèe njobè' wèe tèe btu.
eng: But Jesus said to them, For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

lmp: Geewa'a à m ba efa rkɛ̀' Nyʉ̀ à boo mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ba njeŋwɛ̀.
eng: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

lmp: A mbùu ce yi yu enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ be mà'shi yì ta ba yì mâ, cu a ŋgwa yì,
eng: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

lmp: tɛ a ye a ba à ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir. Banɛ wowèe a ker ba a baa ka', a yu ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

lmp: Banɛ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à ka' tarshi, ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa gàpse ka'."
eng: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' kʉti mbe ndàp, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ker bipshi yuu kuu yuu ce e m làa anà.
eng: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

lmp: E beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' juu ŋgwa yì, lor mò', banɛ e koo njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋgwa yì ka',
eng: He said to them, Whoever divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery against her.

lmp: njeŋwɛ̀ ye ye ka' ma'shi nduu yì du bgùu a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò', banɛ e nòŋ a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce yu nduu yì ka'."
eng: If a woman herself divorces her husband, and marries another, she commits adultery.

lmp: Bèe a m vʉ̀ nè bghàrbèe enɛ Jisòs bo jòo wowèe, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a lapnì bèe anà.
eng: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ wa'a, nyòr à bep ye sê. E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mà'shi tɛ boo anà a vʉ yɛ mɛ̀, wèe fa jepsi wowèe ka', njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu ba nè bèe ce a yu àmbò boo ca.
eng: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation, and said to them, Allow the little children to come to me! Don't forbid them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

lmp: Mɛ̂ suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ koo kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ àmbò muu ŋkɛ' ka', àde' e ke niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ anà ka'."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a koo wowèe nje nyòr, a la' mmbo mbe wâp ndù, a ghoni wowèe.
eng: He took them in his arms, and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce dù rjɛ̀r, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à caŋ a vʉ a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nî mbòŋmboŋ, yuu ce àde' m gee ka' koni ryòŋ ce nfesè a kɛ?"
eng: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ too mɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ njokɛ? Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ ka', ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ ku ba Nyʉ̀ cà'cà'.
eng: Jesus said to him, Why do you call me good? No one is good except one--God.

lmp: To à ku riŋ mncir ce vi làa enɛ̂, "Fa yʉ ka', fa koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ kɛ̀ nòŋ wèe nduu ŋwɛ̀ ka', fa yɛ̀ɛ ka', fa tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ ka', fa fìp ŋwɛ̀ ka', yu'ni nè yò ta ba yò mâ." "
eng: You know the commandments: 'Do not murder,' 'Do not commit adultery,' 'Do not steal,' 'Do not give false testimony,' 'Do not defraud,' 'Honor your father and mother.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, mɛ̀ lɛ̀ mncir ca wɛɛwɛ kɛ̂' à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ba muu ŋkɛ'."
eng: He said to him, Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.

lmp: Jisòs à fyɛ' ye, a koŋ ye. A laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yuu mo' yi bɛti ce à tʉr à rgèe. Dù fyeni yò buu wɛɛwɛ, lor mbàa efa gho gapshi nè ŋgâa fùp, tɛ à bo tʉr bkù' mbe bùu. Wɛ gèe wa' wɛɛ, à vʉ fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ka' yu' yuu ce Jisòs à làa, a sɛ sê, a kar bsii a dû, njobè' e m tʉr ku' buu sê.
eng: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

lmp: Jisòs à fyɛ' ŋgòŋ, a laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Yi yu tatap se nè ŋgâa mbàa à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: Jesus looked around, and said to his disciples, How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a bɛɛŋgèr. E ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Boo wâ, yi yu tatap se à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀.
eng: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, Children, how hard is it for those who trust in riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

lmp: Yi yu àtɛ̀r nè kàmɛ̂l à rtose nje rlir nsàrà' caa nè ŋwɛ̀ mbàa à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle's eye than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a laa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e luŋ yu ba nda?"
eng: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, Then who can be saved?

lmp: Jisòs à fyɛ' wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Buu ca vi yu btatap se nè ŋwɛ̀, ke' ba nè Nyʉ̀ ka', njobè' buu wɛɛwɛ vi yu àtɛ̀r nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: Jesus, looking at them, said, With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.

lmp: Pità à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, wèr à mà'shi yèr buu wɛɛwɛ, a vʉ fa wɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Peter began to tell him, Behold, we have left all, and have followed you.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "M suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ma'shi yì ndap, kɛ̀ bfʉr vi, kɛ̀ bjar vi, kɛ̀ yì tâ, kɛ̀ yì mâ, kɛ̀ boo vi, kɛ̀ vi mŋkʉ̀, àtu mɛ̀, ker ba njobè' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ,
eng: Jesus said, Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

lmp: e be koni buu à nfè' e sè'ni càa àmbò e m tʉr nà kàŋ rjèe. E be koni mndap, bfʉr, bjàr, mma, boo, ba mŋkʉ̀. Geewa'a bèe a be kù ce fa ye ŋgɛ'. E ba mbe nfè' ce e be kè vʉ̀, e koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time, houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

lmp: Bèe magòr ce a yu entombì sè'ni na, a be kè ba elʉ̀simbùu, tɛ bèe magòr ce a yu lʉ̀simbùu sè'ni na, a ba entombì."
eng: But many who are first will be last; and the last first.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. Jisòs à ce dù kùntombì nè wowèe. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ce bɛ̀ɛŋger. Bèe ce a m ce jɛ̀r mbe wâp njì a ce wɛp. Jisòs à ker fʉr yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ embe mʉ̀ bèe, a kɛ' a ce suŋ wowèe buu ce vi be koni ye.
eng: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Sèe ce dù wa'a tɛ a du fa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ mbà mmbo bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir. Wowèe a be sa' ye, teni enɛ a yʉ ye, kèr lòr ye fa mbe mmbo bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

lmp: Jɛms ba Jôn ce boo Sɛbɛ̀di a vʉ a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, wèr ce kòŋ wernɛ à gee yuu mo' nè wèr."
eng: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.

lmp: E beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wêe kòŋ enɛ m gee mɛkɛ nè wèe?"
eng: He said to them, What do you want me to do for you?

lmp: Wowèe a làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wer ce kòŋ wernɛ e ba à nfè' ce à cu mbe wɛ̂ kàbàrà' nà, tɛ wèr cute àgee wɛ̀, mò' cu a yo bo mà', tɛ mò' cu à yo bo ŋkòp."
eng: They said to him, Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand, and one at your left hand, in your glory.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe yi yuu ce wèe ce bipshi ka'. Àde' wèe no enjep ndoŋ ce m be no enjo a? Kɛ̀ àde' wèe koo njɛ̀ɛ bàptir ce m be koo a?"
eng: But Jesus said to them, You don't know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Àde' wèr no." E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe be no enjep ndoŋ ce m be no enjo, koo njɛ̀ɛ bàptir ce m be koo.
eng: They said to him, We are able. Jesus said to them, You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, mɛ̀ tʉr ŋger à rlàa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ cu a mɛ̂ bo mà' kɛ̀ a mɛ̂ bo ŋkòp ka'. Bdì' anà vi yu ba nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à kupshi a lɛ nè wowèe."
eng: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.

lmp: Bɛr yì bèe ce rʉʉ a ka' yu' yuu ce Jɛms ba Jôn a m làa na, nyor à bep wowèe sê.
eng: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant towards James and John.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ'shì wowèe àbee, a laa nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ̂, "Wèe yi weenɛ ŋgâa rsa' bèe enje jɛɛ a ke sa' yap bèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ sê. Bêe bgòrgòr mo' a lòr yap ŋger nyʉ' bèe agho foŋ.
eng: Jesus summoned them, and said to them, You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca yi fa kè ba fa wêe mʉ ka'. Yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ efa wêe mʉ ce e ka' kòŋ à rba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr, banɛ ŋgàŋ ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè wèe,
eng: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ à rba entombì ba ŋkwàa nè bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Whoever of you wants to become first among you, shall be bondservant of all.

lmp: Njobè' Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ye ye à m vʉ̀ enɛ bèe a bo ce fà' nè ye ka', e m vʉ̀ tɛ e bo fà', kèr fa li ryòŋ, tee bèe magòr efa rkwe."
eng: For the Son of Man also came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.

lmp: Wowèe a m vʉ̀ ba' à rla' Jɛ̀rikù. E ka' ce lô àfo a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ker ba ku' bèe mo', nfèp mò' à cu àwâa nduunjì, a ce loo buu. A m too nfèp ca enɛ Bàtimòs ce muu Timòs.
eng: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho, with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

lmp: E ka' yu' enɛ a Jisôs à rla' Nasarɛ̀t, e kɛ' a ce làa mbekì enɛ̂, "Jisòs, Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè mɛ̀."
eng: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out, and say, Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!

lmp: Bèe magòr a m lapni ye enɛ e cu nyaŋ. E ker misi a waa sè'ni magòr sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè mɛ̀."
eng: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, You son of David, have mercy on me!

lmp: Jisòs à tɛɛ, a laa enɛ̂, "Kɛ' nè ye." Wowèe a laa nè nfèp anà enɛ̂, "Kur ntee, nati mbekì, e ce kɛ' wɛ̀."
eng: Jesus stood still, and said, Call him. They called the blind man, saying to him, Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!

lmp: E ma' yi cɛ̀' njep nshè, a nyɛɛ mbekì, a du a yɛ Jisòs.
eng: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce kòŋ enɛ m gee ba kɛ nè wɛ̀?" Nfèp anà à bèesi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, gèe tɛ m ker yɛ buu."
eng: Jesus asked him, What do you want me to do for you? The blind man said to him, Rabboni, that I may see again.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù, lo rbyemì li gee wɛ̀ ke'sè." E ku kɛ' a ce yɛ buu, a nati a du a yê mbùu.
eng: Jesus said to him, Go your way. Your faith has made you well. Immediately he received his sight, and followed Jesus in the way.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' àtʉtʉ rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a ba à rla' Bɛtɛfɛ̀ ker ba à rla' Bɛtanì, ce mi m ba àgee rtùu Olèf. Jisòs à tuu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a baa,
eng: When they drew near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Dù nè nje rla' enje wêe cùu na. Wèe be dù niŋ tɛ wèe ku yɛ muu jàaki' ce ŋwɛ̀ à m be cu mbo ka' àmbò a cʉʉ. Wee yɛ, wèe fyɛɛ vʉ àgho.
eng: and said to them, Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him, and bring him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' bipshi enɛ wèe ce fyɛ̀ɛ njokɛ lɛ, wèe suŋ ye enɛ, Tata ce tà' gèe yuu àgho, ka' kʉsi."
eng: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you doing this?' say, 'The Lord needs him;' and immediately he will send him back here.

lmp: Wowèe a du a yɛ muu jàaki' àmbò a cʉʉ njep ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀', àwâa nduunjì. A ka' ce fyɛ̀ɛ muu jàaki' ca,
eng: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

lmp: bèe ce a m tɛɛte àfo a bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce fyɛ̀ɛ muu jàaki' anà njokɛ?"
eng: Some of those who stood there asked them, What are you doing, untying the young donkey?

lmp: Wowèe a suŋ bèe anà yuu ce Jisòs à m làa, bèe anà a ma'shì, wowèe a du àgho.
eng: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

lmp: A ka' bà' àgho, a co'ni bcɛ̀' a laashi mbendù mo, Jisòs à ko' a cu mbo.
eng: They brought the young donkey to Jesus, and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

lmp: Bèe magòr a laashì bcɛ̀' njep nduunjì, wèe mo' a saŋsì yap ba mmba' ce mkɛ'ŋkɛ' ce a m fàashi.
eng: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees, and spreading them on the road.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce dù kùntombì ker ba bèe ce a m ce vʉ̀ embe yê njì a ce yòp mbekì enɛ̂, "Rlùŋ li vʉ̀! Nyʉ̀ ghoni ŋwɛ̀ ce e vʉ̀ à rlii Tatâ.
eng: Those who went in front, and those who followed, cried out, Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ghoni kʉʉ yìsèe ta Dɛvìd ce yi ce vʉ̀ na! Sèe ku'si Nyʉ̀ embe bùu!"
eng: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!

lmp: Jisòs à niŋ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a fyɛ' buu wɛɛwɛ, a ka' yɛ enɛ nyʉ̀ ce coo, a nati a yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ wèe, a du à rla' Bɛtanì.
eng: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, wowèe a natî à rla' Bɛtanì, a ka' ce dù, njè à ce yaŋ Jisòs.
eng: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

lmp: E ka' yɛ ce fik àmbò yi tɛɛ à njìsàp, a tʉr ku' bfù sê, e du a fyɛ' enɛ yi yʉ lɛ. A ka' bà', a yɛ yuu mbo caa efa bfù cà'cà' ka', njobè' nfè' fik e ke yʉ à m ghɛɛ ka'.
eng: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ce fik anà enɛ̂, "À be kèr yʉ mbàŋ tɛ ŋwɛ̀ bo ye ka'." Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a yu' àmbò e làa wa'a.
eng: Jesus told it, May no one ever eat fruit from you again! and his disciples heard it.

lmp: Wowèe a du a ba' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, Jisòs à ka' niŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a yɛ bèe mo' àmbò a ce fyèni buu, wèe mo' a ce yuu. E m jùu wowèe e mbo. E m bùte btɛbùr ese bèe ce a m ce kupse mbàa, ker ba mnta' ese bèe ce a m ce fyèni bbèŋ.
eng: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple, and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the tables of the money changers, and the seats of those who sold the doves.

lmp: E m byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ker byɛ' yuu to'ni àgho à mambe Ndap Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

lmp: E m yɛ'ni bèe a laa enɛ̂, "Mbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ, "A be too yà ndap enɛ ndap rloo nè bto' wɛɛwɛ" a? Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe à gee yà ndap à kʉtì ba mbʉ̀' byɛ̀ɛ."
eng: He taught, saying to them, Isn't it written, 'My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations?' But you have made it a den of robbers!

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a ka' yu' yuu ce Jisòs à m gèe na, a ce ròo nduunjì à ryʉ ye, a ker wɛp njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a m tʉr rgha'nì àmbò li ryɛ'nì.
eng: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' coo, Jisòs wèe a fʉʉ à mʉ̀ rla' anà.
eng: When evening came, he went out of the city.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce càa à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' a yɛ ce fik cà àmbò yi ku yopri nè mŋgàŋ-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

lmp: Pità à kuushì yuu ce yi mʉ ba, a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Rabài, yɛ ce ce wɛ̀ mʉ cɛp nà àmbò yi yuushi."
eng: Peter, remembering, said to him, Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Byemi nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Jesus answered them, Have faith in God.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè Nyʉ̀, ke' ce tarni ka', e ka' laa nè rtùu ca enɛ̂, "Rtùu câ, co'ti embo nà, du gwe njep rdip rgòr", banɛ yi be kù ba wa'a.
eng: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, 'Be taken up and cast into the sea,' and doesn't doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening; he shall have whatever he says.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, mɛ̂ suŋ wèe mɛnɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ka' bipshi nè Nyʉ̀ à rloo, byemi weenɛ wèe à koni, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be fa nè wèe.
eng: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce gèe rloo, tʉr ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ntee bebep, wèe foosì ye tɛ yè Ta embe bùu bo fòosi wèe yè buu bbebep foŋ.
eng: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

lmp: Wèe ka' tɛ fòosi bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep nè wèe ka', banɛ yè Ta embe bùu be fòosi wèe yè buu bbebep foŋ ka'."
eng: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.

lmp: Jisòs a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a m ker kʉti à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. E ka' ce jɛ̀shi mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgàa ryɛ'ni mncir ker ba bleebèe a vʉ a yɛ ye,
eng: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, and the scribes, and the elders came to him,

lmp: a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋger ce à ce gèe buu ca àgho li lò efɛ? Ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa wɛ̀ ŋger ca à fa nda?"
eng: and they began saying to him, By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M be bipshi yuu mo'sir nè wèe. Wèe à ka' beesî, banɛ m suŋ wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa mɛ̀ ŋger à rgèe buu ca.
eng: Jesus said to them, I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

lmp: Ŋger ce Jôn à m tʉr à rbàptir bèe nà yi m lò ba ese Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ ese bèe? Bèesi à nè mɛ̀."
eng: The baptism of John--was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.

lmp: Wowèe a du mcʉ̀, a seesi enɛ̂, "Sèe à ka' laa seenɛ yi ŋger anà yi m lò ese Nyʉ̀, banɛ e be bipshi nè sèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à m ka' ba byemi yuu ce e m làa ka' njokɛ?"
eng: They reasoned with themselves, saying, If we should say, 'From heaven;' he will say, 'Why then did you not believe him?'

lmp: Wà' sèe be làa seenɛ yi m lò ba ese bèe a?" Wowèe a m wɛp bèe njobè' ŋwɛ̀ nsìp à m byemi enɛ Jôn à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ghup.
eng: If we should say, 'From men'--they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

lmp: Wowèe a kʉtì a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Wèr yi ka'." Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ be suŋ wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fa mɛ̀ ŋger à rgèe buu ca ka'."
eng: They answered Jesus, We don't know. Jesus said to them, Neither do I tell you by what authority I do these things.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ' a ce suŋ buu nè bèe ca à mŋgàa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m fà' yi nsuu, a bye njɛ̀ɛ msini ce a ke gèe mrù' àgho, a bee ŋka' a sir nsuu anà àgho, a tuŋ dì' ce a be gèe mrù' mbo, a boo tà'tà' mbo foŋ. A ka' gèe wa'a wɛɛ, a lɛ nsuu anà nè bèe mo', a du à mbè.
eng: He began to speak to them in parables. A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the winepress, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

lmp: Nfè' ntee msini anà à ka' ghɛɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ca à tuu yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò' enɛ e du yɛ bèe ce e m lɛ̀ nsuu nè wowèe nà, koo msini mi.
eng: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

lmp: E dû, a ka' bà', bèe anà a koo ye a lîp, e kʉtì mbòmmbo.
eng: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nsuu à ker tuu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò', wowèe a ker koo a lîp, a to' tu, a koosi ye rìtu.
eng: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

lmp: E ker tuu mò', wowèe a koo a yʉ, awɛ e ker tuu wèe mo', wowèe a lip wèe mo', a yʉshi wèe mo'.
eng: Again he sent another; and they killed him; and many others, beating some, and killing some.

lmp: E m ku tʉr sè'ni ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à rtuu, ce à m ba muu yì ce e m kòŋ magòr. E m lò a tuu ye àlʉ̀simbùu, a ce kwà'shi enɛ a be yu'ni nè muu yì ca.
eng: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, 'They will respect my son.'

lmp: Bèe ce a m lɛ̀ nsuu nè wowèe na, a ka' yɛ ye, a laa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "A ŋwɛ̀ ce e be ye bti' na. Sèe koo yʉ, tɛ vi bti' vi bo ba visèe."
eng: But those farmers said among themselves, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.'

lmp: A koo ye a yʉ, a fʉr embe mʉ̀ nsuu, a ma' njepmbè.
eng: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

lmp: Banɛ yuu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ nsuu gee nè wowèe yu kɛ? E be vʉ̀ yʉshi wowèe, lɛ̀ nsuu nè bêe jɛɛ.
eng: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

lmp: Wèe à m be be' nlàa Nyʉ̀ ca ka' a? Enɛ̂, "Lùr ce ŋgâa boo mndap a m mà', à m kʉtì ba lûr rbuundap.
eng: Haven't you even read this Scripture: 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the head of the corner.

lmp: Ca à m gèe Tata Nyʉ̀, à ba yuu bɛ̀ɛ nè sèe."m"
eng: This was from the Lord, it is marvelous in our eyes'?

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr anà a m ròo à rkoo Jisòs, njobè' wowèe a m yi enɛ e m mà' ŋgàa ca ba nè wowèe. Geewa'a wowèe a m wɛp bèe, a ma'shi Jisòs a duse.
eng: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him, and went away.

lmp: Wowèe a lo a tuu bèe Farìsi mo' ba bèe vi ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd enɛ a vʉ bipshi buu nè Jisòs tɛ a bo ròo njì ce a be gèe tɛ e ka' fàa nlàa.
eng: They sent some of the Pharisees and of the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

lmp: Wowèe a vʉ a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wèr yi wernɛ a wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ mini ce wɛ ke lòr ŋwɛ̀ mò' jɛɛ ka'. Wɛ ke yɛ'ni nduunjî Nyʉ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò yi yu. Suŋ ka nè wèr lɛ̂, ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe ma' mbâa bàrà' nè ŋkwe Rum kɛ̀ sèe ma' ka'?"
eng: When they had come, they asked him, Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don't defer to anyone; for you aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

lmp: Jisòs à yɛ taa ce wowèe a ce lè', a bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce mòoshi mɛ̀ njokɛ? Nàa nè mbʉ̀ mbàa ce a ke mà' mbàa àgho."
eng: Shall we give, or shall we not give? But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.

lmp: Wowèe a vʉ nè mbʉ̀ mbàa a fa nè ye, e bipshì enɛ̂, "Tu ŋwɛ̀ embo na a yi nda, rlii ce a saŋ mbo na à ba rlii nda?" Wowèe a bèesi nè ye enɛ̂, "Tu embo a yî ŋkwe Rûm, rlii embo à ba li foŋ."
eng: They brought it. He said to them, Whose is this image and inscription? They said to him, Caesar's.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Fa nè buu ŋkʉʉ nè ŋkʉʉ, fa vî Nyʉ̀ nè Nyʉ̀." Wowèe a ba nè rgha'nì-ŋwɛ̀ à ryu' njɛ̀ɛ làa ca.
eng: Jesus answered them, Render to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's. They marveled greatly at him.

lmp: Bèe Sadùsi ce a kani enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ kwe ker fʉʉ efa rkwe ka' a vʉ a bipshi nè Jisòs enɛ̂,
eng: There came to him Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection. They asked him, saying,

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, Musìs à m saŋ ncir nè sèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor ŋgwa, a ye a bi boo ka', ŋgàŋ kwe, banɛ nfʉr yì be laasi ye tɛ a ye a bi boo nè nfʉr yì ce e kwe nà.
eng: Teacher, Moses wrote to us, 'If a man's brother dies, and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife, and raise up offspring for his brother.'

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce làa wa'a, a ce fàa fàa njobè' wèe yi yuu ŊWâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa ka', a riŋ ŋger Nyʉ̀ foŋ ka'.
eng: Jesus answered them, Isn't this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God?

lmp: Be kè ba à nfè' ce bèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe tɛ bèe a ker lòr bbyèŋge kɛ̀ gùusi boo ka'; bèe a be kè ba àmbò bcìndap Nyʉ̀ embe bùu.
eng: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a kweŋger a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe, wèe à m be be' embe ŋwà' Musìs embe dì' ce yi ce suŋ àmbò ce ce mor yi m ce kɛti mbo nà ka' a? Nyʉ̀ à m làa mbo nè Musìs enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ Abràhâm, a ba Nyʉ̀ Aisìk, a ker ba Nyʉ̀ Jakòp" a?
eng: But about the dead, that they are raised; haven't you read in the book of Moses, about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'?

lmp: E yu Nyʉ̀ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ka', e yu ba Nyʉ̀ bèe ce a cu btèe. Wèe ce fàa sê."
eng: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'ni mncir mò' ce e m ce yu'shi àmbò Jisòs ce de' a wèe mo' ca wèe, à yɛ enɛ Jisòs à bèesi buu nè wowèe yɛɛnì sê. E bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ncir ce yi yu kùntombì nè mncir wɛɛwɛ a yì efɛ?"
eng: One of the scribes came, and heard them questioning together. Knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, Which commandment is the greatest of all?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ncir entombì yu ca: "Bèe Isrɛ̀l, yu' nè! Yìsèe Tata Nyʉ̀ ku ba mò'sir.
eng: Jesus answered, The greatest is, 'Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one:

lmp: Banɛ à koŋ Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀ nè yo ntee-ŋwɛ̀, ba nè lo ryòŋ-ŋwɛ̀, ker ba nè wo bfee-ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ, ker ba nè yo ŋger wɛɛwɛ."
eng: you shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, and with all your soul, and with all your mind, and with all your strength.' This is the first commandment.

lmp: Ncir ce embenjì yi yu enɛ̂: "Kòŋ nfʉrò àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ yò nyor." Ncir mo' yi yu ce yi càa bca ka'."
eng: The second is like this, 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.' There is no other commandment greater than these.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'ni mncir anà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ làa yɛɛnì sê, ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì. Wɛ̀ làa mini wɛnɛ, Nyʉ̀ ku ba mò'sir, mò' ker ba ka', ku ba ye.
eng: The scribe said to him, Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he,

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ koŋ Nyʉ̀ nè yi ntee wɛɛwɛ, ba nè vi bfee-ŋwɛ̀, ker ba nè yi ŋger wɛɛwɛ, koŋ nfʉr yì foŋ àmbò e kòŋ yì nyor. Yi bòŋ magòr à rlɛ̀ mncir a caa à rgèe btaŋshì ce btòo, ker ba btaŋshì wɛɛwɛ."
eng: and to love him with all the heart, and with all the understanding, with all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à bèesi nè bfee-ŋwɛ, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ yu njìsàp efa kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'." Kɛ' embo nà ŋwɛ̀ à ker tʉr cùu à rbipshi yuu nè ye ka'.
eng: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, You are not far from the Kingdom of God. No one dared ask him any question after that.

lmp: Àmbò Jisòs à m ce yɛ'ni bèe mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, e lo a bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a làa enɛ Krâis anà yu muu Dɛvìd à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi m gèe Dɛvìd à làa enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Tata yà enɛ̂, "Cu à la rkoo mà' caar tɛ m gee tɛ à tɛr mo mkùu mbendù bèe ce a bàa wɛ̀." "
eng: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.'

lmp: Dɛvìd ce too ye enɛ Tatâ, banɛ àde' e ker ba muu yì à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?" Bèe magòr a m lu'shi à ryu' cena.
eng: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son? The common people heard him gladly.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce yɛ'ni bèe, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lor nè nfè' nè ŋgèe ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir. Wowèe a kòŋ à ryar mŋgàbʉlà ce kar àgho, ker koŋ enɛ bèe a ce ca'ni wowèe à mntaa.
eng: In his teaching he said to them, Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

lmp: Wowèe a niŋ à mndap mloo, koŋ à rcu à mnta' bêe bgòrgòr, a bà' à mŋkà', ce ba mnta' bbòŋboŋ.
eng: and the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts:

lmp: Wowèe a ke bo' bbyepbkʉʉ, ye yàp buu wɛɛwɛ, ce gèe mloo msàsap à rdùŋshi bèe enɛ wowèe a rìŋ à rloo sê. Yap ŋgɛ' be kè ba gòr sê."
eng: those who devour widows' houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.

lmp: Jisòs à m cu à mbèp dì' ce a m ce fa mbàa mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a ce fyɛ' àmbò bèe a ce lɛ̀ mbàa njep ŋkùp rfa. Ŋgâa mbàa a m fa mbàa sê.
eng: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury, and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

lmp: Ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ fùp à vʉ a fa mbàa njo baa. Mbàa baa ca yi yu àmbò bfrâŋ ta wa'a.
eng: A poor widow came, and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs a kɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wee nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ, ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ce yu ŋwɛ̀ fùp na à fa mbàa a caa bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a fa mbàa njo.
eng: He called his disciples to himself, and said to them, Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

lmp: Bèe ca wɛɛwɛ a gàpni buu mò' efa ku' yàp buu ce a tʉr, a fa rfa àgho, ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ca ce e tʉr yuu ka' à lòr mʉ yuu wɛɛwɛ ce e tʉr à ba yì ce yi ba jà' ye, a fa."
eng: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce fʉʉ embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, mò' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, yɛ àmbò blùr ca ba mndàp ca vi kù'ŋger nà."
eng: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ yɛ ku' mndap bgòrgòr ca a? Lùr mò' be cu nje ndap ka'. A be kɛ̀ɛshi vi wɛɛwɛ."
eng: Jesus said to him, Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.

lmp: E du a cu mbe rtùu Olèf, a ce kè' Ndap Nyʉ̀. Awɛ Pità ba Jɛ̂ms, ker ba Jôn ba Andrù a ku ba a wowèe mbo cà'cà', a bipshi yuu mo' nè ye.
eng: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,
