lmp: A m bipshi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, suŋ wèr nfè' ce buu ca be koni. Yuu ce yi be dùŋshi enɛ nfè' ce buu ca be koni à ghɛɛ, yu kɛ?"
eng: Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ' a ce suŋ wowèe enɛ̂, "Lor nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka'.
eng: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, Be careful that no one leads you astray.

lmp: Bèe magòr a be vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ rlii ce làa enɛ̂, a mɛ̀ ye, bo' bèe magòr tɛ a da'.
eng: For many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he!' and will lead many astray.

lmp: Wèe à ka' yu' enɛ a ce mà' bìr, ker yu' à mŋoo enɛ a ce mà' bìr à bdì' mò', mlù mi fa koo wèe ka'. Buu ca vi be kù koni; geewa'a nfè' ŋgòŋ yi be mì à be ghɛɛ ka'.
eng: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don't be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a be kè bàa wèe njo' mɛ̀. Geewa'a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛɛ tatap du ba' àlʉ̀simbùu banɛ ŋgàŋ be lùŋ."
eng: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake, but he who endures to the end, the same will be saved.

lmp: "Wèe à ka' yɛ yuu bsàrbuu ce yi ce bepsi Ndap Nyʉ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce bè' ŋwà' ca rìŋ, banɛ bèe ce a yu à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a caŋ duse à mtùu.
eng: But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not let the reader understand, then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba mbe tu ndap, e fa sùu embo à rlòr yuu ka' caŋ ka'.
eng: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu à mŋkʉ̀, e fa kèr kʉti à rlòr yi cɛ̀' ka' caŋ ka'.
eng: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

lmp: Mlù mi be ba nè bbyèŋge ce a yu nè mmbʉ̀, ba byèŋge ce a ce nyoŋsi boo.
eng: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

lmp: Wèe loo weenɛ buu ca vi fa koni à cûu saa ka'.
eng: Pray that your flight won't be in the winter.

lmp: Be ba à nfè' anà tɛ ŋgɛ' ba gòr sê, ba ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ce e m be ba ka', kɛ' embe nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ŋgòŋ, ba' sè'ni na, ŋgɛ' mò' be kèr ba wa' ka'.
eng: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nfè' ŋgɛ' e ba nlʉ̀'shi. E m tɛ bà gèe wa'a ka', mbʉ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à m ba lùŋ ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nfè' anà à lʉ'shì wa'a njobè' yì bèe ce e m ce.
eng: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ke laa nè wèe à nfè' anà enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, a Krâis na", kɛ̀ enɛ̂, "A ye nà" ɛ̀, wèe fa byemi ka',
eng: Then if anyone tells you, 'Look, here is the Christ!' or, 'Look, there!' don't believe it.

lmp: njobè' bèe ce a be bo'shi enɛ a wowèe Krâis, kɛ̀ enɛ a wowèe ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ɛ̀, a be kè nyɛɛ, dùŋshi mncòo kèr gèe buu bghagha' enɛ a bo bo' ka' nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce nà-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For there will arise false christs and false prophets, and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

lmp: Banɛ wèe lor nfè', njobè' mɛ̀ suŋ wèe buu ca tɛ nfè' ka' ghɛɛ.
eng: But you watch. Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

lmp: "Be ba à mnòŋ ce ŋgɛ' ca à caa tɛ nyʉ̀ liiti, tɛ ŋwɛɛ yi ker saŋ ka'.
eng: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

lmp: Mkàŋsì mi be gwèŋger embe bùu, tɛ buu ŋger embe bùu bsìp vi ci'tî.
eng: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

lmp: Be ba à nfè' anà tɛ bèe a yɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ àmbò e ce vʉ̀ mbe mʉ̀ mmbà' embe bùu nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, ker ba nè fòo-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

lmp: E be tuu bcìndap à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à mmbuu ŋgòŋ kyèe tɛ a baashi yì bèe ce e m ce nà ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir.
eng: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

lmp: "Yɛ'ni nè yuu ese ce fik ca: Bfù efa gho vi ke kàrŋger, e ba à nfè' ce yi ka' karŋger, top, wèe riŋ weenɛ nfè' mbèŋ yu àtʉtʉ.
eng: Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender, and puts forth its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa buumi ka' njobè' wèe rìŋ nfè' ce ŋwɛ̀ ndap be vʉ̀ ka'. Seemò' e be vʉ̀ à mbùuŋkùr, kɛ̀ nè ntee-tʉ', kɛ̀ à nfè' ntooŋgʉp yi toŋ, kɛ̀ à nfè' tʉ̀' à raa ɛ̀.
eng: Watch therefore, for you don't know when the lord of the house is coming, whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

lmp: E ka' lɛ'si vʉ̂, e fa yɛ wèe à mmirlò ka'.
eng: lest coming suddenly he might find you sleeping.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa nè wèe, m ce làa nè bèe wɛɛwɛ. Fa buumi nè ka'."
eng: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi m bɛti bbaa tɛ a ka' ye Ŋkâ' càasi mndap, ba ŋkà' ce a ke ye brɛ̂d ce a lɛ̀ yis njo ka'. Bêe bgòrgòr efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a ce ròo njì tɛ a bo koo Jisòs à bfee, yʉ.
eng: It was now two days before the feast of the Passover and the unleavened bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception, and kill him.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Sèe fa koo ye à mʉ̀ ŋkà' ka' njobè' sèe ka' koo ye à mʉ̀ ŋkà', bèe a lo kɛ' ŋgɛ'."
eng: For they said, Not during the feast, because there might be a riot of the people.

lmp: Jisòs à m ba à rla' Bɛtanì mbe ndàp mbe Saimʉ̀n ŋwɛ̀ msàasì. A ka' ce ye byee, njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à niŋ nè mʉ njɛ̀ɛ ntʉŋ blùr mò'. Njɛ̀ɛ mgʉr mo' ce mi m ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ, a luu ntaa sê, mi ba njo jiŋ. E bʉ' ndoo mʉ ntʉŋ anà a cu'ni mgʉr enjo mbe tu Jisòs.
eng: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard--very costly. She broke the jar, and poured it over his head.

lmp: Ntee yi yaŋ bèe mo' ce a m ba mbo, wowèe a kɛ' a ce làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "A jarsi mgʉr ca à cicì njokɛ?
eng: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, Why has this ointment been wasted?

lmp: A ba fyèni mgʉr ca tɛ yi caa btosìn mjèe mtaar tɛ a lor mbàa anà fa nè ŋgâa fùp." Wowèe a ka' làa wa'a, a lapni njeŋwɛ̀ ca sê.
eng: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii, and given to the poor. They grumbled against her.

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂ "Lɛ̀ nè ye nyaŋ. Wèe ce fa ye ŋgɛ' njokɛ? E gèe ba yuu bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀.
eng: But Jesus said, Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

lmp: Ŋgâa fùp a be kù ba wèe wowèe à nfè' sìp. Àde' wèe ja' wowèe à nfè' wèe à gwɛɛ. Geewa'a, sèe be ba à nfè' sìp ka'.
eng: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe yuu ce yi ghɛɛte à ndèe yi ŋger. E cù'ni mgʉr ca fa mɛ̂ nyòr à rkupshi yà nyor tɛ a ka' tuŋ.
eng: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ fàdì' wɛɛwɛ ce a ka' ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ njep ŋgòŋ na, a be suŋ yuu ce njeŋwɛ̀ ca à m gèe nà, kèr ce kuushi ye."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.

lmp: Judas Ìskarìyòt ce à m ba mò' efa bèe ncòp-baa-à rrʉ̀ʉ à m dù a yɛ bêe bgòrgòr efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì tɛ e bo fyèni Jisòs nè wowèe.
eng: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

lmp: Wowèe a yu' rbòŋ nè yuu ce e suŋ wowèe, a ka'ni enɛ a be fa ye mbàa. Judàs à kɛ' a ce ròo nduunjì à rfyèni Jisòs.
eng: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

lmp: Nòŋ entombì efa Ŋkâ' ye brɛ̂d ce a lɛ̀ yis njo ka' yi m ghɛɛ. À m ba nòŋ ce a m ce shɛshi bya' ce a be ye ŋkà' àgho. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce kòŋ enɛ wèr fɛr byee ba fɛ, tɛ à bo ye?"
eng: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?

lmp: E tuu bèe a mmbaa efa wâp mʉ a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Dù nè à mʉ̀ rla', wèe be bà' tɛ wèe tarte wèe mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e byɛ̀' ntʉŋ mdip. Dù nè fa yê mbùu,
eng: He sent two of his disciples, and said to them, Go into the city, and there you will meet a man carrying a pitcher of water. Follow him,

lmp: e niŋ mbe ndàp, wèe niŋ mbo foŋ, laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ndap enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì à làa enɛ̂, "Dì' ce m be ye Ŋkâ' càasi mndap wèr ŋgâa yɛ'ni yà buu wèe yi yû?"
eng: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says, Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'

lmp: Wèe be làa wa'a, tɛ e duŋshi wèe rum ndap mò' ŋgòr mbendù ndap anà, ce a kupshi, a fa buu mbo wɛɛwɛ. Wèe fɛr byee ŋkà' ca mbo."
eng: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù, a yɛ buu wɛɛwɛ à ku ba àmbò Jisòs à m suŋ wowèe nà. Wowèe a fɛr byee ŋkà' anà mbo.
eng: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, Jisòs à vʉ a yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' cu mbe tɛbùr ce ye byee, Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ mò' efa wèe be fyèni mɛ̀, mò' ce e ce ye byee wèr ye."
eng: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me--he who eats with me.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce koosimnse, a ce bipshi nè ye mò'sir mò'sir enɛ̂, "Wà' yu mɛ̀ a?"
eng: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, Surely not I? And another said, Surely not I?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mò' efa wèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ce e ce cʉ̀' brɛ̂d wèr ye njep kaŋ na, be fyèni mɛ̀.
eng: He answered them, It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

lmp: Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kù kwe àmbò Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ndòo be co' ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni ye. Yi yu àndèe enɛ a m ba bi ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'."
eng: For the Son of Man goes, even as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.

lmp: Àmbò wowèe a m ce yeŋger anà, e lor brɛ̂d a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi, a fa nè wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Kò nè. Ca yu yà nyor."
eng: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed, he broke it, and gave to them, and said, Take, eat. This is my body.

lmp: E lor ndoŋ, a ka' yòŋshi Nyʉ̀, a fa nè wowèe, wowèe wɛɛwɛ a nô.
eng: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Cena yu wa blɛɛ ce vi kur lê' fi ce vi be fʉʉ, sùu àtu bèe magòr.
eng: He said to them, This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ m be kèr no mrù' ce a gèe nè mbàŋ ce na ka', caar dù bà' à nfè' ce m be no mî mfi mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine, until that day when I drink it anew in the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Wowèe a yop yɛɛ, a natî, a du mbe rtùu Olèf.
eng: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

lmp: A ka' bà', Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe wɛɛwɛ be lò caŋse mà' mɛ̀ àmbò Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa. Yi làa enɛ̂, "M be lìp ŋwɛ̀ ncìŋ njèe tɛ njèe yi da'se."
eng: Jesus said to them, All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, 'I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.'

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m be fʉʉ efa rkwe, du à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, tɛ wèe vʉ koni mɛ̀ àfo."
eng: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Bèe ca wɛɛwɛ a ka' ma' wɛ̀, m ma' wɛ̀ ka'."
eng: But Peter said to him, Although all will be offended, yet I will not.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ nètʉ' e ntìni nfè' baa, à be kani ŋkàrà' taar enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: Jesus said to him, Most certainly I tell you, that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.

lmp: Pità à ku luŋ enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ku ba ba enɛ sò kwe àbee, m kanì ka'." Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ku laa wa' foŋ.
eng: But he spoke all the more, If I must die with you, I will not deny you. They all said the same thing.

lmp: Wowèe a du mbe dì' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ Gɛ̀tsɛmanì. A ka' bà' mbo, Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Cu nè mbena tɛ m gee rloo."
eng: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, Sit here, while I pray.

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, a lor Pità ba Jɛ̂ms, ker ba Jôn, a wowèe a dû. E kɛ' a ce seŋ buu, mlù mi ce koo ye sê.
eng: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

lmp: E làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋkoosimnse ce e yu njep mɛ̂ ntee yu yì ce àde' e ku yʉ mɛ̀. Cu nè mbena ce ke'nî."
eng: He said to them, My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here, and watch.

lmp: E lo embo a du à njìsàp ka', a gwe kʉkʉ̀p, a loo nè Nyʉ̀ enɛ yi ka' ba àtɛ̀r e gee tɛ nfè' ŋgɛ' ce e ce vʉ̀ nà caa embe yê tù.
eng: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that, if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

lmp: E loo enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, àde' à gee buu wɛɛwɛ. Gèe tɛ ndoŋ ŋgɛ' ca caa embe mɛ̂ tù. Geewa'a, ke' ba enɛ à gee ba àmbò m ce kòŋ ka', gèe ba àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ."
eng: He said, Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.

lmp: E ka' kʉti, a yɛ àmbò ŋgâa yɛ'nì yì buu a ce buumi. E laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Saimʉ̀n, à ce buumi a? Àde' à ke' ke'sè mʉ tètè ka' a?
eng: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn't you watch one hour?

lmp: Kè'se nè ce loo fà dì' wèe gwe rmòoshì ka'. Ntee njep rbʉ̀, bsɛ̀ nje nyòr."
eng: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.

lmp: Jisòs à ker du a ker loo àmbò e ba loo nà.
eng: Again he went away, and prayed, saying the same words.

lmp: E ka' kʉti, a ker yɛ àmbò wowèe a ce buumi, mmirlo mi ku ce dù nè wowèe dù. Wowèe a tʉr yuu ce a laa nè ye ka'.
eng: Again he returned, and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy, and they didn't know what to answer him.

lmp: E ka' kèr dù kʉti, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ku bii buumi a ce lʉ̀shi a? Yi ghɛɛ sè'ni, nfè' à ghɛɛ. A be fa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ mbe mmbo ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep.
eng: He came the third time, and said to them, Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

lmp: Lò nè mbekì tɛ sèe dû. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e fyèni mɛ̀ nà yu àtʉtʉ."
eng: Arise, let us be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kù bii mìsi efa cùu, Judàs ce e m ba mò' efa yì bèe ce ncòp- baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ nà à tosè. E m ba a ku' bèe ce a m tʉr bsà' ba mmbàŋ. Bèe ce a m tuu wowèe à m ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, ker ba bleebèe.
eng: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came--and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

lmp: Judàs ce e m fyèni ye nà à m suŋ wowèe wɛɛ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce m ka' baa nje nyòr banɛ a ye. Koo nè ye du àgho, ke'ni bòŋboŋ fà dì' e caŋ ka'."
eng: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, Whoever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.

lmp: A ka' vʉ̀, a ko'shi àgee Jisòs, a laa enɛ̂, "Rabài", a baa ye nje nyòr.
eng: When he had come, immediately he came to him, and said, Rabbi! Rabbi! and kissed him.

lmp: Bèe anà a koo Jisòs a ba'ni.
eng: They laid their hands on him, and seized him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m ba a Jisòs à co' sà', a tee tù' ese ŋkwàa ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à vʉ̀ à rkoo mɛ̀ a tʉr bsà' ba mmbàŋ àmbò m yu lɛ nyɛ̀ɛ wa'a njokɛ?
eng: Jesus answered them, Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

lmp: To mɛ̀ m ku ce yɛ'ni wèe mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ. Wèe à ke' koo mɛ̀ mbo ka'. Geewa'a, tɛ yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa yi ghɛɛte njo."
eng: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn't arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.

lmp: Bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ cà wɛɛwɛ a ma' ye, a caŋse.
eng: They all left him, and fled.

lmp: A ka' koo Jisòs ce dù àgho, muu nsùnsù mò' ce e m ku wap ba cɛ̀' à nyòr à ce dù a yê mbùu. Bèe ca a koo ye à cɛ̀',
eng: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself, over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

lmp: e ma'shì nè wowèe a caŋ a du mbùuriŋ.
eng: but he left the linen cloth, and fled from them naked.

lmp: A m dù nè Jisòs njeptii ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba bleebèe, ker ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, a vʉ àbee.
eng: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

lmp: Pità à du a yê mbùu a ba yi encàŋ, a du a ba' mbe mambe ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. E ka' bà' a cu njepmbè a ce yɛr mor a bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ wèe.
eng: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe wɛɛwɛ embe kansùr a m ròo bèe tɛ a bo vʉ̀ tɛɛ njìnsa' tɛ a koo Jisòs, yʉ. Geewa'a, a yɛ fàa ka'.
eng: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

lmp: Ku' bèe a m tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ. Nlàa ŋwɛ̀ yi tartè a yi mò' ka'.
eng: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn't agree with each other.

lmp: Bèe mo' a natì mbekì a nya' mnde' enɛ̂,
eng: Some stood up, and gave false testimony against him, saying,

lmp: "Wèr à m yu' àmbò e ce làa enɛ̂, "M be sà'si Ndap Nyʉ̀ ce bèe a bà'ri nè mmbo na, lòr mnôŋ btaar bà'ri njɛ̀ɛ mò' ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ ba'rì ka'." "
eng: We heard him say, 'I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.'

lmp: Ka' yuu ce wowèe a m làa foŋ na yi m tarte a yi mò' ka'.
eng: Even so, their testimony did not agree.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à natì mbekì a bipshi nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "À tʉr yuu à rbèesi kuu yuu ce bèe ca a ce làa kuu wɛ̀ na ka' a?"
eng: The high priest stood up in the midst, and asked Jesus, Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?

lmp: Jisòs à ku cip, a laa yuu ka'. E ker bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ Krâis, Muu Nyʉ̀ ce wèr ce gʉ'shi nè ye nà a?"
eng: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ye. Wèe be yɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ àmbò e cu à bo mà' Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ, kèr yɛ foŋ àmbò e ce sùu à mʉ̀ mmbà'."
eng: Jesus said, I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à shashì bcɛ̀' efa nyòr, a laa enɛ̂, "Mbùu mò' ker ba nè sèe à rlàa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker laa yuu kuu ŋwɛ̀ ca ka'.
eng: The high priest tore his clothes, and said, What further need have we of witnesses?

lmp: Wèe à yu' àmbò e bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀. Wèe à làa wee kɛ?" Bèe wɛɛwɛ a laa enɛ a yʉ ye.
eng: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think? They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

lmp: Bèe mo' a kɛ' a ce ce ye nè mce, a cete ye mmir, a tʉshi ye nè bdʉ̀' a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "To' ka' ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉshi wɛ̀ nè bdʉ̀'." Bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ a koo ye, a lîp.
eng: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, Prophesy! The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

lmp: Pità à ku bii njep mambe anà, muunje mò' ce e m ce fà' nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì,
eng: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

lmp: à vʉ a yɛ Pità àmbò e ce yɛr mor. A fyɛ' ye enɛ ntuŋ, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ m ba wèe Jisòs à rla' Nasarɛ̀t foŋ."
eng: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him, and said, You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!

lmp: Pità à kanì, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M rìŋ ye ka'. M rìŋ yuu ce à ce làa anà ka'." A ka' làa wa'a, a lɛ'si nyor embe mambe a tɛɛ njep mntosì. E ka' tɛɛ njo, nduŋgʉp à tôŋ.
eng: But he denied it, saying, I neither know, nor understand what you are saying. He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

lmp: Muunje ca à ker yɛ Pità, a ker laa nè bèe ce a m ba àfo enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu mò' efa wowèe."
eng: The maid saw him, and began again to tell those who stood by, This is one of them.

lmp: Pità à ker kani. Mʉ nfè' à ka' tuuse, bèe ce a m ba àfo nà a laa nè Pità foŋ enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ mò' efa wowèe ghup njobè' à yu ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Galèlê."
eng: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.

lmp: Pità à ye lè', a laa enɛ̂, "M rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce wêe làa na ka'."
eng: But he began to curse, and to swear, I don't know this man of whom you speak!

lmp: Nduŋgʉp à ker toŋ à nfè' anà. Pità à kuushì yuu ce Jisòs à m suŋ ye enɛ̂, "Tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ nfè' baa, à be kani enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka', ŋkàrà' taar nà." E ka' kuushi wa'a, a bʉ' rwar.
eng: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the word, how that Jesus said to him, Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times. When he thought about that, he wept.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba bleebêe à to', ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, ba bɛr ŋgâa kansùr wɛɛwɛ a seesì àmbò a be gèe nè Jisòs. A ka' sèesi wɛɛ, a kur ye, a du àgho a fa nè Pailɛ̀t.
eng: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders and scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, and bound Jesus, and carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋkʉʉ Jus a?" Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "À làa yo cùu."
eng: Pilate asked him, Are you the King of the Jews? He answered, So you say.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a toshì ye à ku' buu gòr.
eng: The chief priests accused him of many things.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ker bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "À tʉr yuu làa ka' a? Â yu' ku' buu ce a ce làa àmbò wɛ̀ na laŋ?"
eng: Pilate again asked him, Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!

lmp: Jisòs à ker laa yi yu yuu ka'. Pailɛ̀t à bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

lmp: À m ce ba à ŋkà' ca, Pailɛ̀t fʉr ŋwɛ̀ shaŋ mò'sir efa shaŋ. E m ce fʉr ba ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe a kòŋ.
eng: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whom they asked of him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ba mbe shaŋ. A m too ye enɛ Bàrabàs. E m ba mbe shaŋ a bèe mo' ce a wowèe a m yʉshi bèe à nfè' wowèe a m tà' bùr gopmɛ̀n.
eng: There was one called Barabbas, bound with those who had made insurrection, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

lmp: Ku' bèe a vʉ̂, a yɛ Pailɛ̀t a laa nè ye enɛ e fʉr ŋwɛ̀ shaŋ mò' embe shaŋ àmbò e ke gèe à nfè' ŋkà' ca nà.
eng: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

lmp: E bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wêe kòŋ enɛ m fʉr ŋkʉʉ Jus fa nè wèe a?"
eng: Pilate answered them, saying, Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?

lmp: E m bipshi wa'a njobè' e m rìŋ enɛ bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a m ce ko'-ndoŋ nè Jisòs a ka' koo ye a vʉ àgho a fa nè ye.
eng: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr ca a cepshì bèe enɛ a laa tɛ Pailɛ̀t fʉr ba Bàrabàs fa nè wowèe.
eng: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ker bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ m gee mɛ kɛ nè ŋwɛ̀ ce wêe too enɛ ŋkʉʉ Jus na?"
eng: Pilate again asked them, What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?

lmp: Wowèe a waa enɛ̂, "Taa ye mbe kìntaa."
eng: They cried out again, Crucify him!

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M taa ye mbe kìntaa njokɛ? Yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe seesê, yu ba kɛ?" Wowèe a ku ce waani, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Taa lɛ ye mbe kìntaa."
eng: Pilate said to them, Why, what evil has he done? But they cried out exceedingly, Crucify him!

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à m kòŋ à rgèe tɛ nyor boŋ kʉr bèe anà. E fʉr Bàrabàs embe shaŋ a fa nè wowèe, a laa enɛ a lip Jisòs. A ka' lìp ye nè byɛɛnsò wɛɛ, a fa ye tɛ a bo dù taa mbe kìntaa.
eng: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

lmp: Bsoogɛ̀ mo' a m lòr Jisòs a niŋ àgho mbe dì' mnsa' embe nto' ce govanò à m ce cu mbo, a kɛ' bsoogɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ mbo.
eng: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

lmp: Bèe a ka' vʉ̀, a lor cɛ̂' beer a fa ye à nyòr, a gee rtaa kʉʉ nè bsòpsì a sop ye mbe tù,
eng: They clothed him with purple, and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

lmp: a kɛ' a ce cà'ni ye, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Nyàr, ŋkwe Jûs."
eng: They began to salute him, Hail, King of the Jews!

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, a lip ye nè ŋke' mbe tù, a ce ye nè mce, a gʉ'shi a ce bo'shi enɛ a ce cà'ni ye.
eng: They struck his head with a reed, and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀shi ye mìsi, a co' yap cɛ̂' beer cà, a lor bcɛ̀' vi, a kʉsi ye à nyòr, a lor ye a du àgho à rtaa mbe kìntaa.
eng: When they had mocked him, they took the purple off of him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' à nduunjì a yɛ Saimʉ̀n ce à rla' Sàirên, àmbò e ce kʉti efa mŋkʉ̀. À m ba tàr yì Àlɛ̀ksandà ba Rufòs. Wowèe a koo ye à ŋger enɛ e koo kìntaa ese Jisòs byɛ'.
eng: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them, that he might bear his cross.

lmp: A wowèe a du nè Jisòs fàdì' ce a m ce too enɛ Golgotà. Mbùu efa rlii ca yu enɛ̂, "Dî' kèkèp tu."
eng: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, The place of a skull.

lmp: A ka' bà', a lor mrù' a fiŋshi nè mɛ̂r, a fa nè Jisòs enɛ e no, e kanì.
eng: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn't take it.

lmp: Wowèe a taa ye mbe kìntaa, a lor vi bcɛ̀' a ma' kaŋ àgho, tɛ a bo yɛ àmbò a be gàp.
eng: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

lmp: A m taa Jisòs mbe kìntaa à nyʉ̀ bʉ̀'ʉ à ŋgàptʉ'.
eng: It was the third hour, and they crucified him.

lmp: A m saŋ mbùu ce a m taa ye mbe kìntaa. A m saŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋkʉʉ Jûs."
eng: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

lmp: A m taa byɛ̀ɛ a baa mbe bkìntaa foŋ. Mò' à ba à yi bo mà', mò' à bo ŋkòp.
eng: With him they crucified two robbers; one on his right hand, and one on his left.

lmp: A ka' gèe wa'a, blâa Nyʉ̀ ce a saŋ enɛ̂, "A m bè' ye à mʉ ŋgâa bʉ'shi mncir" nà vi ghɛɛtè njo.
eng: The Scripture was fulfilled, which says, He was numbered with transgressors.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce càa yap càa a m ce kòr btu, a ce sù' ye nè mcɛp, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Àhâ! Wɛ̀ ce àde' à sa'sì Ndap Nyʉ̀ bà'ri à mnôŋ btaar,
eng: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads, and saying, Ha! You who destroy the temple, and build it in three days,

lmp: jà' là yo tu suu embe kìntaa."
eng: save yourself, and come down from the cross!

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a ce vʉ̀shi ye foŋ, a ce làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "E m jà' bèe mo' a moo à rjà' yi tu làr.
eng: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, He saved others. He can't save himself.

lmp: Sèe yɛ ka àmbò Krâis, ŋkʉʉ à to' Isrɛ̀l be sùu embe kìntaa sè'ni na tɛ sèe bo byemi nè ye." Bèe a mmbaa ce a m taa a Jisòs wèe mbe bkìntaa nà, a cɛp ye foŋ.
eng: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him. Those who were crucified with him insulted him.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' kùu ŋgòŋ, tʉ̀' à sii, kɛ' à nyʉ̀ ncòp-baa du ba' à nyʉ̀ taar.
eng: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

lmp: À ka' ba à nyʉ̀ taar anà, Jisòs à waa enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀lôi, Ɛ̀lôi, Lama Sàbàtanì", ce e yu enɛ̂, "Yà Nyʉ̀, yà Nyʉ̀, wɛ̀ lèse mɛ̀ njokɛ?"
eng: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani? which is, being interpreted, My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?

lmp: Bèe mo' ce a m tɛɛte àfo a ka' yu', a laa enɛ̂, "Yu' nè, e ce kɛ' Àlajà."
eng: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he is calling Elijah.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à caŋ a du a fʉʉ kʉ̀sha njep mʉ̀ njɛ̀ɛ mrù' mo' ce mi m ce baŋshi, a fapte à ŋke', a fa nè Jisòs enɛ e bo nyoŋ. E ka' fa, a laa enɛ̂, "Sèe yɛ ka enɛ wà' Àlajà be vʉ̀ sùusi ye embe kìntaa na lɛ."
eng: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave it to him to drink, saying, Let him be. Let's see whether Elijah comes to take him down.

lmp: Jisòs à waa tatap à nfè' anà, a kwe.
eng: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

lmp: Cɛ̀' ce a m teni dì' mo' embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ àgho yi m sàti, kɛ' embe tù du a ba' njep mbùu.
eng: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ rjèe ce e m tɛɛ a ce kè'ni Jisòs, à ka' yɛ àmbò e kwe, e laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ba Muu Nyʉ̀ ghup."
eng: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, Truly this man was the Son of God!

lmp: Bbyèŋge mo' a m ba àfo foŋ, a tɛɛ à njìsàp a ce fyɛ'. Mɛ̀ɛri à rla' Makdalà, ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce à m ba ma yì Jɛms ce ŋkɛ' ba Josès, a m ba à mʉ̀ bbyèŋge ca a Sàlomè wèe.
eng: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

lmp: Wowèe a m ce kar àmbùu Jisòs a ce jà' ye à nfè' e m ba à ŋgôŋ Galèlê. Ku' bbyèŋge mo' foŋ ce a m vʉ̀ a Jisòs wêe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a m ba àfo.
eng: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him, and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' bèe a m ce tami nyor enɛ tʉ̀' be raa tɛ a cu mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, Josɛ̀f ce à rla' Àrimàtiyà à du à mbùuŋkùr anà, a du a yɛ Pailɛ̀t. Josɛ̀f ca à m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa kansùr ce bèe a m ce yu'ni nè ye sê. E m ce kè' nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be vʉ̀ sa' àmbò ŋkʉʉ. E kur ntee a du a yɛ Pailɛ̀t, a laa enɛ e fa gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ nè ye tɛ e tuŋ.
eng: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath, Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for the Kingdom of God, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs à ba kwe wɛɛ, a tarni sê. A kɛ' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ rjèe cà. E ka' vʉ̀, e bipshì nè ye enɛ Jisòs à ba kwe wɛɛ lɛ.
eng: Pilate marveled if he were already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

lmp: E ka' suŋ ye enɛ Jisòs à ba kwe wɛɛ, e laa nè Josɛ̀f enɛ e du lor gʉ̂ʉ Jisòs.
eng: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

lmp: Josɛ̀f à du a yuu cɛ̂' bòŋboŋ, a suusi gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ embe kìntaa, a kur nè cɛ̀' anà a lɛ njep rshè ce a m sò' nje ryɛɛ. A ka' lɛ̀ a biŋsi ma lùr a cete ncùu rshè àgho.
eng: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri e à rla' Makdalà ba Mɛ̀ɛri ma yì Josès a m ba àfo, a yɛ mbe dì' ce a tuŋ Jisòs.
eng: Mary Magdalene and Mary, the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

lmp: Nòŋ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ yi ka' càa, Mɛ̀ɛri e à rla' Makdalà, ba Mɛ̀ɛri ma yì Jɛ̂ms, ba Sàlomè a yuu njɛ̀ɛ mgʉr mo' tɛ a bo yo' gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ àgho.
eng: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome, bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ entombì embe mʉ̀ ŋgàa, à nfè' nyʉ̀ à bàp e kùmbùuntii, wowèe a ce du fàdì' rshè li m ba nà.
eng: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

lmp: A ka' ce dù a ce bipshi a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be dù biŋsi lùr embe ncùu rshè nè sèe a nda?"
eng: They were saying among themselves, Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?

lmp: Lùr anà à m kù' sê. Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀ bà' àfo, a yɛ enɛ a ba biŋsi lùr anà embe ndù ncùu rshè wɛɛ.
eng: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' niŋ njep rshè, a yɛ muu nsùnsù mò' àmbò e cu à ŋgʉ̀' bo mà', a yar ŋgàbʉlâ mbʉʉ. Nyor à baŋ wowèe sê.
eng: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe, and they were amazed.

lmp: Muu nsùnsù ca à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa wɛp ka', m rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe ce ròo Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t ce a mʉ taa ye mbe kìntaa nà. E yu mbena ka'. E fʉʉ efa rkwe. Yɛ nè, a mbe dì' a mʉ lɛ ye na.
eng: He said to them, Don't be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen. He is not here. Behold, the place where they laid him!

lmp: Banɛ wèe du suŋ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ba Pità enɛ e dù à ŋgôŋ Galèle entombì nè wèe. Wèe be yɛ ye àfo àmbò e m suŋ wèe nà."
eng: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, 'He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.'

lmp: Wowèe a saa enjep rshè a caŋ, njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp, a ker jep foŋ. Wowèe a laa yuu nè ŋwɛ̀ ka' njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp.
eng: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' fʉʉ efa rkwe à nòŋ entombì embe mʉ̀ ŋgàa, a duŋshi yì nyor entombì nè Mɛ̀ɛri e à rla' Makdalà ce e m fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' sàamba enjep ye nà.
eng: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à ka' yɛ ye, a du a suŋ bèe ce a m ce ba a Jisòs wèe. Wowèe a m ce cu rkwe, a ce warse.
eng: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' enɛ Mɛ̀ɛri à yɛ ye e cu ntèe nà, wowèe a byemì ka'.
eng: When they heard that he was alive, and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' embenjì, e duŋshì yì nyor nè bèe a mmbaa ce a m ce dù à rla' mo', a yɛɛti à mmìr à njɛ̂ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them, as they walked, on their way into the country.

lmp: Wowèe a kʉtì a suŋ bɛr bèe, wowèe a ker byemi ka'.
eng: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn't believe them, either.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' elʉ̀simbùu, e duŋshì yì nyor nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce a m bɛti ncòp-mò'sir-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, à nfè' ce wowèe a m ce ye byee. E m lapni wowèe njobè' wowèe a m tèe-btu, a byemi ka'. E m lapni wowèe wa'a njobè' bèe ce a m yɛ ye a m suŋ wowèe enɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe, wowèe a kanì.
eng: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table, and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn't believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Dù nè à bto' wɛɛwɛ fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He said to them, Go into all the world, and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi a baptìr ye, ŋgàŋ be lùŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ byemi ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ be gwè mnsa'.
eng: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

lmp: Bèe ce a byemi a be gèe buu ghagha' ca. Wowèe a be fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe fa mɛ̂ rlii, làa bli bfi,
eng: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

lmp: koo mnyo nè mmbo, a ka' no nli' e gee yuu nè wowèe ka'. Wowèe a be jòo ŋgâa byaŋ nè mmbo tɛ a ke'se."
eng: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.

lmp: Tata Jisòs à ka' làa nè wowèe wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à lor ye a du àgho mbe bùu. E ka' bà' mbo a cu à bo mà' Nyʉ̀.
eng: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven, and sat down at the right hand of God.

lmp: Wowèe a dû, a ce fe'shi à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ. Tata à m jà' wowèe a fa wowèe ŋger à rgèe buu bghagha' tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ enɛ blàa ce wowèe a ce fè'shi vi yu mini.
eng: They went out, and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them, and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

lmp: Bèe magòr a lòr nfè' a saŋ buu ce vi m koni a sêe mʉ.
eng: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

lmp: Buu ce wowèe a saŋ, ku ba buu ce bèe ce a m ce yɛ nè map mmir efa rkɛ̀', ce a m ba ŋgâa fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ a m suŋ wèr.
eng: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

lmp: Màsà Tìyofilòs, mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ à ka' fyɛ' buu ca wɛɛwɛ bòŋboŋ àmbò vi m ba efa rkɛ̀', a yɛ mɛnɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ foŋ nè mɛ̀ à rsaŋ buu anà yɛɛnì àmbò vi m ba, fa nè wɛ̀,
eng: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

lmp: tɛ à bo rìŋ enɛ buu ce a yɛ'ni wɛ̀ vi yu mini ghup.
eng: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce Hɛròd à m ba ŋkʉʉ à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì mò' à ba, a ce too enɛ Sàkàriyà. À m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ŋgoo ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì embe ndàp Àbijà. A m ce too ŋgwa yì enɛ Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t. Ye ye à m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Ɛròn ce à m ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce cu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, a ce gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa, a bɛr mo' ka'.
eng: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

lmp: Wowèe a m tʉr boo ka' njobè' Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t à m ba kar, wowèe a ker rʉʉ sê.
eng: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' ce bèe embe ŋgoo Sàkàriyà a ce fà' mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, Sàkàriyà à ce gèe li rfà' àmbò ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Now it happened, while he executed the priest's office before God in the order of his division,

lmp: Ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀ a m saŋ mlii bèe, a lɛ njep lɛ', a cu' àmbò yàp ndèe à m ba. A ka' cù', rlii Sàkàriyà li fʉʉ enjo enɛ e niŋ mbe Ndàp Tata Nyʉ̀, too nrɛ̀ɛ nè ye.
eng: according to the custom of the priest's office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

lmp: À ka' ba nfè' ce a ce too nrɛ̀ɛ, bèe wɛɛwɛ a tɛɛ njepmbè a ce gèe rloo.
eng: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

lmp: Sàkàriyà à ka' ba mbo wa'a, ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à nyɛɛ, a tɛɛ à ŋgʉ̀' bo mà' dî' ntòo nrɛ̀ɛ.
eng: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

lmp: Sàkàriyà à ka' yɛ ye, mlù mi koo ye, e wɛp sê.
eng: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka', Sàkàriyà, Nyʉ̀ à yu' lo rloo. Ŋgwa wô Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t be bi wɛ̀ muu mbaŋrù. À be fa rlii muu anà enɛ Jôn.
eng: But the angel said to him, Don't be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard, and your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

lmp: À be kè lu'shi, yu' rbòŋ, tɛ bèe magòr a lu'shi foŋ, à nfè' ce a bi muu anà,
eng: You will have joy and gladness; and many will rejoice at his birth.

lmp: njobè' e be kè ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr à bsii Tata Nyʉ̀. E be kè no mrù' ka', no yuu tatap ka'. E be kè ruu nè Yʉ' Rara, kɛ' enjep rbʉ̀ yì mâ.
eng: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother's womb.

lmp: E be kè gèe tɛ bèe magòr efa mʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l a kʉti njeptii Tata ce e yu yàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord, their God.

lmp: E be kè dù entombî nè ye nè njɛ̀ɛ yʉ' ker ba ŋger ce Àlajà à m tʉr, tɛ e bo gèe tɛ btar boo a boo wap wèe a kʉti àbee, gèe tɛ bèe ce a tèe btu a tʉr bfee àmbò bèe ce a yu yɛɛnì a tʉr, tɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ a bo tami nyor à rkoni Tatâ."
eng: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, 'to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,' and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.

lmp: Sàkàriyà à laa nè ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ rʉ̀ʉ sê, ŋgwa wà foŋ à rʉ̂ʉ. Àtà m riŋ nè kɛ enɛ yuu ce à ce làa na yi be ba mini?"
eng: Zacharias said to the angel, How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à beesì enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Gaberyà ce mɛ ke tɛɛ à bsii Nyʉ̀. Nyʉ̀ à tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m vʉ cep ntuu bòŋboŋ ca nè wɛ̀.
eng: The angel answered him, I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you, and to bring you this good news.

lmp: Yuu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wɛ̀ na yi be kè gèeti à nfè' ce yi ba gèeti, geewa'a, àmbò wɛ̀ byemi ka' banɛ à be kèr làa ka' kɛ̂', ntìni du ba' mbe nfè' ce yuu ca yi be gèeti."
eng: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak, until the day that these things will happen, because you didn't believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.

lmp: Sàkàriyà à m cu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ anà tètè sê. Bèe ce a m cu ce kè' ye nà a ce tarni enɛ à koni ba kɛ lɛ.
eng: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

lmp: Sàkàriyà à ka' fʉʉ embo, a moo à rlàa nè wowèe làr, a kɛ' a ce suŋ buu nè wowèe ba nè mmbo. Wowèe a ka' yɛ wa' a ku riŋ enɛ e yɛ njɛ̀ɛ rlo mo'.
eng: When he came out, he could not speak to them, and they perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

lmp: Yì nfè' rfà' à ka' mì, e kʉtì mbe yê ndàp.
eng: It happened, when the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

lmp: Mnòŋ mo' vi ka' càa, Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t à koo rbʉ̀, a cu mbe ndàp mŋwɛɛ tâ, a ker ce fʉʉ à mʉ̀ bèe ka'.
eng: After these days Elizabeth, his wife, conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe ca nè mɛ̀ à gèe Tatâ. E fyɛ' mɛ̀ a bur mɛ̀ rìtu ce yi m ce koo mɛ̀ à mʉ̀ bèe nà embe tù."
eng: Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.

lmp: Rbʉ̂ Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t li ka' ba mŋwɛɛ ntuunfu, Nyʉ̀ à tuu yì ncìndap ce a too enɛ Gaberyà, à rla' Nasarɛ̀t à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee, named Nazareth,

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ca à m tʉr ntuu à rcep nè muunje mò', ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Josɛ̀f à m ce niŋ gùu àgho. Josɛ̀f à m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' ŋkʉʉ Dɛvìd. A m too rlii muunje anà enɛ Mɛ̀ɛri.
eng: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of the house of David. The virgin's name was Mary.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à vʉ̂, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ cà'ni wɛ̀! Tata yu wèe ye, à tʉr rbôŋtu wèe Nyʉ̀!"
eng: Having come in, the angel said to her, Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à ka' yu' ntuu ce ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à m cep na, bfee vi jep ye, e ce seŋ enɛ yuu ce ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à làa anà yi yu ba enɛ kɛ lɛ.
eng: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka' Mɛ̀ɛri, njobè' à tʉr rbôŋtu wèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: The angel said to her, Don't be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

lmp: À be koo rbʉ̀, bi muu mbaŋrù, fa rlii enɛ Jisòs.
eng: Behold, you will conceive in your womb, and bring forth a son, and will call his name 'Jesus.'

lmp: Muu anà be kè ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr, tɛ a too ye enɛ Muu Nyʉ̀ embe bùu. Tata Nyʉ̀ be fa kʉʉ yì ta Dɛvìd nè ye.
eng: He will be great, and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father, David,

lmp: E be kè sa' mbe ndʉ̀' Jakòp à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, tɛ yi kʉʉ yi mi ka'."
eng: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à laa nè ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ be riŋ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ka'. Banɛ àtà ca yi ba wa' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: Mary said to the angel, How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à beesì enɛ̂, "Yʉ' Rara yi be vʉ̀ mbe wɛ̂ ndù, tɛ ŋger Nyʉ̀ embe bùu yi tɛ'shi wɛ̀. Banɛ a be kè too muu nrara anà enɛ Muu Nyʉ̀.
eng: The angel answered her, The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

lmp: Yɛ̂, nfʉrô Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t à koo rbʉ̀ à nfè' ce e yu nleeŋwɛ̀ sê. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a m ce too enɛ kar yu nè rbʉ̀ sè'ni à mŋwɛɛ ntuunfu.
eng: Behold, Elizabeth, your relative, also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

lmp: Ca yi yu wa' njobè' yuu mo' yi yu ce àtà yi gha' Nyʉ̀ à rgèe ka'."
eng: For everything spoken by God is possible.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à laa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ rfà' Tatâ. Tɛ yuu ce wɛ̀ làa anà yi ku ba àmbò wɛ̀ làa." E ka' làa wa'a, ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à ma'shì ye a dû.
eng: Mary said, Behold, the handmaid of the Lord; be it to me according to your word. The angel departed from her.

lmp: Mʉ mnòŋ mo' vi ka' càa, Mɛ̀ɛri à natì a du cɛrcɛr mbe rla' mo' ce li m ba mbe mtûu à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà.
eng: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

lmp: E ka' bà', a niŋ mbe ndàp mbe Sàkàriyà, a ca'ni Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t.
eng: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

lmp: Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t à ka' yu' àmbò e cà'ni ye, muu enjep yê rbʉ̀ à karsì nyor. Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t à ruusì nè Yʉ' Rara,
eng: It happened, when Elizabeth heard Mary's greeting, that the baby leaped in her womb, and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

lmp: a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ tʉr rbôŋtu a caa bbyèŋge wɛɛwɛ. Nyʉ̀ à ghòni muu ce à be bi anà.
eng: She called out with a loud voice, and said, Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

lmp: Yi lò efa kɛ, ma yì Tata yà à ka' vʉ à rcà'ni mɛ̀?
eng: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

lmp: À ba à nfè' ce mɛ̀ ba yu' àmbò wɛ̀ cà'ni mɛ̀ nà, muu enjep mɛ̂ rbʉ̀ à karsì nyor nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

lmp: À yu ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu njobè' wɛ̀ byemi enɛ yuu ce Tata à làa nè wɛ̀ yi be kù ba àmbò e làa."
eng: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à laa enɛ̂, "Ya ntee yi ce nɛ̀si Tata Nyʉ̀.
eng: Mary said, My soul magnifies the Lord.

lmp: Ya yʉ' yi ce lu'shi nè Nyʉ̀ ce e gèe mɛ̀ lûŋ,
eng: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

lmp: njobè' e kuushi mɛ̀ ce m yu yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà', ka' m yu ŋwɛ̀ à mʉ̀ bèe ka' wa'a. Kɛ̂' ntìni na, ŋgʉ̀ bèe wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ a be ce too mɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu,
eng: for he has looked at the humble state of his handmaid. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

lmp: njobè' Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ à gèe ku' buu bbòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀. Li rlii li yu rrara.
eng: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

lmp: E ke koosimnse nè bèe ce a ce wɛp ye kɛ' embe ŋgʉ̀ bèe mò' du ba' mbe mò'.
eng: His mercy is for generations of generations on those who fear him.

lmp: E dùŋshi yi ŋger, a da'si ŋgâa nàatu.
eng: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

lmp: E sùusi bêe bgòrgòr embe mnta', a ku'si bêe bkɛ'kɛ'.
eng: He has put down princes from their thrones. And has exalted the lowly.

lmp: E fa buu bbòŋboŋ nè bèe ce njè ce yaŋ wowèe, a juu ŋgâa mbàa, wowèe a dusè mbòmmbo.
eng: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

lmp: E m lɛ̀ mi mkà'ni ce e m gèe, a ja' Isrɛ̀l ce e m ba yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà'.
eng: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

lmp: E m gèe wa'a, a ce kuushi mkà'ni ce e m gèe nè Abràham ker ba nè yì ŋgʉ̀ bèe à nfè' sìp."
eng: As he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his seed forever.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à m cu a Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t àmbò mŋwɛɛ btaar wa'a, a ka' kʉti fa yê là'.
eng: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

lmp: Nfè' rbi à ka' ghɛɛ, Ɛ̀lisabɛ̀t à bi muu mbaŋrù.
eng: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she brought forth a son.

lmp: Bèe ce a wowèe a m ce cu, ker ba yì bèe, a ka' yu' ku' yuu bòŋboŋ ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nè ye na, a lu'shi a wowèe.
eng: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy towards her, and they rejoiced with her.

lmp: Muu à ka' bà' mnòŋ waami, a vʉ à rgèe bʉ̀ muu. Bèe a m ce kwà'shi enɛ a be cu' ba yì tâ.
eng: It happened on the eighth day, that they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of the father.

lmp: Yì ma à shê, a laa enɛ̂, "A be too ye enɛ Jôn."
eng: His mother answered, Not so; but he will be called John.

lmp: Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rìŋ wɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe wɛ̂ ndʉ̀' tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rlii ca ka'."
eng: They said to her, There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' làa wa'a, a de' a Sàkàriyà wèe nè mmbo, a bipshi nè ye enɛ e kòŋ à rcu' ba nda lɛ.
eng: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

lmp: Sàkàriyà à laa nè mmbo enɛ a fa ye ŋwà'. A ka' fa ye ŋwà', e saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Li rlii li yu enɛ Jôn." Bèe wɛɛwɛ a bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, His name is John. They all marveled.

lmp: Nfè' à ke' tuuse ka', e ker kɛ' a ce làa, a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀.
eng: His mouth was opened immediately, and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

lmp: Bèe ce a wowèe a m ce cu a m wɛp sê. Bèe ce a m ba à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à rla' embe mtûu à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a m suŋ buu ca.
eng: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m yu' vi a m ce kuushi vi, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Njɛ̀ɛ muu ca be kè ba njɛ̀ɛ muu ce kɛ?" Bo Tata Nyʉ̀ yi m ba mbe yê ndù nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, What then will this child be? The hand of the Lord was with him.

lmp: Sàkàriyà ce e m ba tar muu ca, à m ruu nè Yʉ' Rara, a cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ nè bèe enɛ̂,
eng: His father, Zacharias, was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

lmp: "Sèe ku'si Tata ce e yu Nyʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l. E m vʉ̀ a yɛ yì bèe, a tee wowèe efa ŋgɛ'.
eng: Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and worked redemption for his people;

lmp: Muu ca à m kù' à nyòr, a ker ku' à yʉ'. E ka' kù', a ku ce cu ba à rìŋ caar a ba' à nòŋ ce yi m ba enɛ e be fʉʉ à mʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l.
eng: The child was growing, and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà ŋkʉʉ Kayisaro Ògostò à fa rsa' enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a yê ŋgòŋ a saŋ mlii tɛ e bo bè' bèe.
eng: Now it happened in those days, that a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

lmp: À m ba nfè' entombì ce a m ce bè' bèe. Kùrɛnò à m ba govanô à ŋgôŋ Sirìyà à nfè' anà.
eng: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à m dù fa yê là' à rsaŋ li rlii àfo.
eng: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

lmp: Josɛ̀f ye ye à m nàtî à rla' Nasarɛ̀t à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a du a ba' à rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛm à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà. Rla' ca à m ba rla' Dɛvìd. E m dù àfo njobè' e m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Dɛvìd.
eng: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to the city of David, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David;

lmp: E m dù a Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m ce niŋ gùu àgho tɛ a ye a bo dù saŋ mlii. Mɛ̀ɛri à m ba nè rbʉ̀.
eng: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

lmp: Wowèe a ba' a cu à rla' anà, nfè' rbi à ghɛɛ.
eng: It happened, while they were there, that the day had come that she should give birth.

lmp: E m bi muu rŋgòo, à ba muu mbaŋrù. E m kur muu anà njep bcɛ̀', a noŋsi njep rghii njèe njobè' ndap à m ruu nè wowèe.
eng: She brought forth her firstborn son, and she wrapped him in bands of cloth, and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

lmp: Bèe mo' ce a m ce cìŋ yap njèe a m ba à rla' anà a ba à mŋkʉ̀, a ce cìŋ yap njèe nètʉ'.
eng: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

lmp: Ncìndap à nyɛɛ mbe wâp ndù, rraa Tata li suu mbe wâp ndù, wowèe a wɛp sê.
eng: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp nè ka', mɛ̀ vʉ̀ wèe nè nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ, à ba nsuŋ ce bèe wɛɛwɛ a be yu', lu'shi sê.
eng: The angel said to them, Don't be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

lmp: A bi yè ŋwɛ̀ rjà' à rla' Dɛvìd ntìni na. A ye Krâis anà ce e yu Tatâ.
eng: For there is born to you, this day, in the city of David, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

lmp: Yuu ce yi be gèe tɛ wèe riŋ enɛ nsuŋ ca yu mini yi yu enɛ, wèe be dù yɛ muu àmbò a kur njep bcɛ̀', a noŋsi njep rghii njèe."
eng: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' kè' a yɛ àmbò ku' bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a vʉ̀, a kyese nyor àgee ncìndap Nyʉ̀ cà, a ce kù'si Nyʉ̀, a ce làa enɛ̂,
eng: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God, and saying,

lmp: "Fòo yi ba nè Nyʉ̀ embe bùu, tɛ cumʉnyaŋ ba njep ŋgòŋ nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ ce yu' rbòŋ nè wowèe."
eng: Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.

lmp: Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ca a ka' mà'shi wowèe kʉti mbe bùu, ŋgâa ncìŋ njèe ca a kɛ' a ce làa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Sèe du à rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛm du yɛ ka yuu ce Tata à suŋ sèe enɛ yi koni na."
eng: It happened, when the angels went away from them into the sky, that the shepherds said one to another, Let's go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.

lmp: Wowèe a natì, a du cɛrcɛr sê, a du a yɛ Mɛ̀ɛri ba Josɛ̀f, a yɛ muu àmbò e nòŋ njep rghii.
eng: They came with haste, and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

lmp: A ka' yɛ muu ca, a suŋ Josɛ̀f ba Mɛ̀ɛri yuu ce ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à suŋ wowèe àmbò muu anà.
eng: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m yu' nsuŋ ce ŋgâa ncìŋ njèe a m suŋ na, a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê.
eng: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri ye ye à m ce kuushi buu ca a ce kwà'shi àmbò vi.
eng: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

lmp: Ŋgâa ncìŋ njèe a m kʉti, a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀, a ker ce kù'si ye à buu wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a m yu' a ker yɛ, njobè' buu anà à m ku ba àmbò ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ wowèe.
eng: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

lmp: Ŋgàa à ka' kùu, nfè' ce a be gèe muu bʉ̀ à ghɛɛ. E ka' ghɛɛ, a fa rlii muu enɛ Jisòs. Rlii ca à m ku ba rlii ce ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à m fa muu wɛɛ tɛ yì ma ka' kè koo rbʉ̀.
eng: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

lmp: Nfè' ce a be mìsi gèe yuu ce ncir yi làa enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ce e bi muu gee tɛ e bo ba nrara à bsii Nyʉ̀ à ka' ghɛɛ, Mɛ̀ɛri ba Josɛ̀f a lor muu a du àgho à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à rfa nè Tata Nyʉ̀,
eng: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem, to present him to the Lord

lmp: àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Mncir Tata enɛ̂, "A be fa boo rŋgòo ce yu boo mmbaŋrù wɛɛwɛ nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: as it is written in the law of the Lord, Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord,

lmp: Wowèe a m dù foŋ à rgèe taŋshì àmbò ncir Tata Nyʉ̀ yi ce làa. Yi yu mbo enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ gèe taŋshì ca nè bbêŋ bbaa ka', e gee nè byoo bûu bbaa.
eng: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à nfè' anà a ce too enɛ Simìyòn. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ nyɛɛnì, a ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ foŋ, a cu a ce kè' nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l a tʉr rfʉtè. Yʉ' Rara yi m ba a ye.
eng: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

lmp: Yʉ' anà yi m gèe e riŋ enɛ e be yɛ Krâis yì Tata Nyʉ̀ wɛɛ, ka' kwe.
eng: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord's Christ.

lmp: Yʉ' ca yi lor ye a du àgho mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀. Ma muu ba tar muu a ka' vʉ̀ nè muu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à rgèe yuu ce ncir yi m ce làa enɛ a gee àtu muu,
eng: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

lmp: Simìyòn à koo muu mbe mbò, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ a laa enɛ̂,
eng: then he received him into his arms, and blessed God, and said,

lmp: "Yà masà, wɛ̀ lɛ̀ mo mkà'ni, mà'shi là sè'ni tɛ yò ŋwɛ̀ rfà' du yi yu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

lmp: Tar muu ba ma muu a m yu' buu ce Simìyòn à m làa a kuu muu anà, a bɛɛŋger sê.
eng: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him,

lmp: Simìyòn à ghonì wowèe a laa nè yì ma ce Mɛ̀ɛri enɛ̂, "Muu ca à lɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ tɛ e bo gèe tɛ bèe magôr à to' Isrɛ̀l a kweŋger, kèr gèe tɛ bèe magôr à ŋgòŋ anà a natî. E be ba ncòo ce bèe magòr a be kòŋ ka', làa bebep se àmbò ye.
eng: and Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, Behold, this child is set for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

lmp: Yi ba wa'a, tɛ mkwà'shì bèe magòr mi bo yɛɛti àwaŋ. Ŋkoosimnse ce e be kè ba àmbò kàafâ' ncɛncɛp wa'a, be kè sòp yo ntee foŋ."
eng: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a ce too enɛ Anà. E m ba muu Fɛnùwɛ̀r embe ndʉ̀' Ashà. E m ba nleeŋwɛ̀ sê. E m dù bgùu, a nduu a ku cu ba à bfè' sàamba cà'cà', nduu à kwe.
eng: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

lmp: E m cu à ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ a ba' bfè' ncòp kyèe-à-mwaami. E m ce buu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à nfè' mò' ka', ka' nètʉ' ɛ̀, ka' nèmootì ɛ̀, e m ku ba mbo a ce jì mdip, a ce gèe rloo nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years, who didn't depart from the temple, worshipping with fastings and petitions night and day.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' a m vʉ̀ nè muu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ anà, ye ye à ku tose foŋ, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a laa àmbò muu ca nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce kè' enɛ Nyʉ̀ fʉr rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m efa ŋgɛ'.
eng: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce ncir Tata Nyʉ̀ yi m ce làa enɛ a gêe, a kʉti à lap rla' Nasarɛ̀t à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

lmp: Muu ca à m kù' a tʉr ŋger, a ker tʉr bfee foŋ sê. Nyʉ̀ à tʉr ye à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

lmp: Yì ta ba yì ma a m ce dù ŋkâ' càasi-mndap à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m njep fè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ba bfè' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a wowèe a du ŋkà' ce a m ce dù njep fè' njep fè' nà.
eng: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast,

lmp: Ŋkà' yi ka' mì, wowèe a natì a ce kʉti à là', Jisòs à cu yi mbenjì à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. Yì ta ba yì ma a riŋ ka'.
eng: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn't know it,

lmp: Wowèe a m ce kwà'shi enɛ e yu mbe ŋgoo bèe ce a wowèe a m ce dù. A ka' jɛ̀r à nòŋ bìi, a yɛ ye ka', a kɛ' a ce ròo ye à mʉ̀ bfʉr wap ba bkar wap.
eng: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day's journey, and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ ye ka', a kʉti à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à rròo ye.
eng: When they didn't find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi ka' câa btaar wowèe a yɛ ye mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ àmbò e cu mbe mʉ̀ ŋgâa ryɛ'nì, a ce yu'shi buu ce wowèe a m ce yɛ'ni, a ce bipshi buu nè wowèe.
eng: It happened after three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the midst of the teachers, both listening to them, and asking them questions.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m yu' buu ce e m ce làa, a m bɛ̀ɛŋger à ryu' àmbò e m ce bipshi buu, a ker ce bèesi buu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

lmp: Yì ta ba yì ma a ka' yɛ ye a bɛɛŋger sê. Yì ma à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Muu wà, wɛ̀ gèe nè wèr wa' njokɛ? Wèr yò ta à ròo wɛ̀, tu yi korŋgèr wèr."
eng: When they saw him, they were astonished, and his mother said to him, Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Wèe à ba ce ròo mɛ̀ njokɛ? Wèe à ba rìŋ weenɛ yu ya dì' à rba mbe Ndàp yà ta ka' a?"
eng: He said to them, Why were you looking for me? Didn't you know that I must be in my Father's house?

lmp: Wowèe a m rìŋ mbùu ce e m làa wa' ka'.
eng: They didn't understand the saying which he spoke to them.

lmp: E natì a du a wowèe à rla' Nasarɛ̀t, a cu a wowèe, a ce yu'ni nè wowèe. Yì ma à m lɛ̀ buu ca wɛɛwɛ njep yê ntee.
eng: And he went down with them, and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

lmp: Jisòs à m ce kù' à nyòr ba à bfee, a tʉr bsii waŋ a Nyʉ̀ ker ba bèe.
eng: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Tìbɛrìyàs à m cu mbe kʉʉ, a sa' à bfè' ncòp-ta-à- rrʉ̀ʉ, Nyʉ̀ à laa nè Jôn muu Sàkàriyà à ntee rìŋ. À m ba à nfè' anà, Pontos Pailɛ̀t à ba govanô à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà. Hɛròd à ce sa' ŋgôŋ Galèlê, Felep ce e m ba nfʉr yì, à ce sa' ŋgôŋ Iturà ba ŋgôŋ Tàkonitìs, Lesanàs à ce sa' ŋgôŋ Abilɛ̀n.
eng: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

lmp: Anàs ba Kaifàs a m ba btu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

lmp: Jôn à m jɛ̀r à bdì' wɛɛwɛ ce vi m ba à ŋgôŋ fàdì' ce rdip Jodàn li m ba, a ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè bèe, a ce làa enɛ wowèe a kupse, ma' yàp buu bbebep tɛ a baptir wowèe, tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo fòosi wowèe.
eng: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe ŋwâ' Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce fuŋ à ntee rìŋ a ce làa enɛ̂, "Kupshi nè nduunjì nè Tatâ, nashi tɛ yi ba kùyɛɛ.
eng: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, The voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

lmp: A be ruusi mntòŋ wɛɛwɛ, kɛ̀ɛshi mtùu wɛɛwɛ tɛ mi kʉti mmbo'. A be nàshi mnduunjì ce vi gooŋger tɛ vi ba kùyɛɛ, kupshi vì ce vi yu kotè-kotè tɛ vi ba nfɛ̂ŋ.
eng: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

lmp: Tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a bo yɛ rlùŋ Nyʉ̀." "
eng: All flesh will see God's salvation.'

lmp: Bèe a m vʉ̀ à bkʉr à bkʉr a yɛ Jôn enɛ e baptir wowèe. Jôn à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Boo bfî, ŋwɛ̀ ce e bɛɛ wèe enɛ wèe caŋ sòrti efa rshentee ce Nyʉ̀ be ko'si nè bèe nà, à bɛɛ nda?
eng: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

lmp: Gèe là nè buu ce vi be ce dùŋshi enɛ wèe à kupse, a ma' yè buu bbebep. Wèe fa ce làa fa wêe mʉ enɛ̂, "Abràham yu yèr tâ" ka'. M ce suŋ wèe enɛ àde' Nyʉ̀ ku lor blùr ca beesi à boo Abràhâm.
eng: Bring forth therefore fruits worthy of repentance, and don't begin to say among yourselves, 'We have Abraham for our father;' for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

lmp: A lɛ̀ njàa njep mbùu ce wɛɛ. Ce ce yi ka' tɛ yʉ bòŋboŋ ka', banɛ a be gwàr, mà' njep mor."
eng: Even now the axe also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn't bring forth good fruit is cut down, and thrown into the fire.

lmp: Ku' bèe anà a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ wèr be gèe wer kɛ?"
eng: The multitudes asked him, What then must we do?

lmp: Jôn à beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr bcɛ̂' bbaa, e fa mo' nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr byee, e ku gee wa' foŋ."
eng: He answered them, He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.

lmp: Ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' a m vʉ̀ foŋ enɛ e baptir wowèe, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wèr be gèe wer kɛ?"
eng: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, Teacher, what must we do?

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ka' ce kùu mbâa bàrà', wèe fa koo càa embe dì' ce ncir yi làa ka'."
eng: He said to them, Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.

lmp: Bsoogɛ̀ foŋ a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Yuu ce àde' wèr gee foŋ yu kɛ?" E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa koo mbàa ese ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ŋger ka', kɛ̀ nya' mnde' mbe tu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Wèe fa cɛ̀ŋ mbàa ce a ce là' wèe àgho ka'."
eng: Soldiers also asked him, saying, What about us? What must we do? He said to them, Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.

lmp: Bèe a m cu a ce kè', a ce tarni enɛ Jôn yu Krâis anà lɛ.
eng: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

lmp: Jôn à laa nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ̂, "M ce bàptir wèe nè mdip, geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce yi ŋger yi càa ya ce vʉ̀. Mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' m ba'shì vi bkʉ̀ laba' ka'. E be bàptir yi wèe nè Yʉ' Rara ba mor.
eng: John answered them all, I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the latchet of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire,

lmp: Yì gʉ̀ yu mba yê bò, ce e be fyɛpshi msaŋ àgho, baashi msaŋ lɛ̀ njep koo. À ka' ba yi àmbò bbʉ̀shì efa gho, e be baashi tòo njep mor ce àde' yi liitì ka'."
eng: whose fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.

lmp: Jôn à fa ncep nè bèe à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ wa'a, a ce fè'shi ba Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wowèe.
eng: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

lmp: E m lapni ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd njobè' e m fʉr Hɛ̀rodìyà ce e m ba ŋgwa nfʉr yî muu ma nà, ker ba njobè' ku' buu bbebep mo' ce e m gèe.
eng: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother's wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

lmp: E m ker gee yuu mo' ce yi m bep a caa ŋger. E m koo Jôn a fa à shaŋ.
eng: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

lmp: Jôn à ka' bàptir bèe wɛɛwɛ, a baptir Jisòs foŋ. Jisòs à ka' ce gèe rloo, rbuu li mʉ'tì.
eng: Now it happened, when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized, and was praying. The sky was opened,

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi suu mbe yê ndù, a ba àmbò bèŋ. Njèndoŋ à laa embe bùu enɛ̂, "À yu muu wà ce m kòŋ sê. M ce yu' rbòŋ nè wɛ̀ sê."
eng: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form as a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.

lmp: Jisòs à m ce kɛ̀' li rfà', a ba àmbò bfè' mntaar. Bèe a m ce kwà'shi enɛ a ye muu Josɛ̀f ce e m ba muu Hɛlì.
eng: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son as was supposed of Joseph, the son of Heli,

lmp: Hɛlì à m ba muu Matàr, Matàr à ba muu Lɛvì, Lɛvì à ba muu Mɛlɛkì, Mɛlɛkì à ba muu Jɛ̀nayì, Jɛ̀nayì à ba muu Josɛ̀f,
eng: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

lmp: Josɛ̀f à ba muu Màtàtiyàr, Màtàtiyàr à ba muu Ɛmòs, Ɛmòs à ba muu Nahùm, Nahùm à ba muu Ɛsilè, Ɛsilè à ba muu Nàgayì,
eng: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

lmp: Nàgayì à ba muu Mâr, Mar à ba muu Màtàtiyàr, Màtàtiyàr à ba muu Sɛmɛ̀n, Sɛmɛ̀n à ba muu Josɛ̀f, Josɛ̀f à ba muu Jodà,
eng: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

lmp: Jodà à ba muu Joanàm, Joanàm à ba muu Rɛsà, Rɛsà à ba muu Sɛ̀robabɛ̀r, Sɛ̀robabɛ̀r à ba muu Shɛlatɛ̀r, Shɛlatɛ̀r à ba muu Nɛrì,
eng: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

lmp: Nɛrì à ba muu Mɛlɛkì, Mɛlɛkì à ba muu Adì, Adì à ba muu Kosàm, Kosàm à ba muu Ɛ̀limadàm, Ɛ̀limadàm à ba muu Ɛ̂r,
eng: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

lmp: Ɛr à ba muu Joshùwà, Joshùwà à ba muu Ɛ̀lisà, Ɛ̀lisà à ba muu Joràm, Joràm à ba muu Matàr, Matàr à ba muu Lɛvì,
eng: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

lmp: Lɛvì à ba muu Simìyòn, Simìyòn à ba muu Judà, Judà à ba muu Josɛ̀f, Josɛ̀f à ba muu Jonàm, Jonàm à ba muu Ɛ̀liyakìm,
eng: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

lmp: Ɛ̀liyakìm à ba muu Mɛlìyà, Mɛlìyà à ba muu Mɛnà, Mɛnà à ba muu Màtatà, Màtatà à ba muu Natàn, Natàn à ba muu Dɛvìd,
eng: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

lmp: Dɛvìd à ba muu Jɛɛsì, Jɛɛsì à ba muu Obɛ̀d, Obɛ̀d à ba muu Buwàs, Buwàs à ba muu Salmòn, Salmòn à ba muu Nashòn,
eng: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

lmp: Nashòn à ba muu Àminadàp, Àminadàp à ba muu Àdimìn, Àdimìn à ba muu Arnì, Arnì à ba muu Hɛsròn, Hɛsròn à ba muu Pɛrɛ̀s, Pɛrɛ̀s à ba muu Judà,
eng: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

lmp: Judà à ba muu Jakòp, Jakòp à ba muu Aisìk, Aisìk à ba muu Abràhâm, Abràham à ba muu Tɛrà, Tɛrà à ba muu Nahòr,
eng: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

lmp: Nahòr à ba muu Sɛrùk, Sɛrùk à ba muu Rugà, Rugà à ba muu Pɛlɛ̀k, Pɛlɛ̀k à ba muu Ɛbɛ̀r, Ɛbɛ̀r à ba muu Shɛlà,
eng: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

lmp: Shɛlà à ba muu Kàyinàn, Kàyinàn à ba muu Àfasàr, Àfasàr à ba muu Shɛ̂m, Shɛm à ba muu Nowà, Nowà à ba muu Lamɛ̀k,
eng: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

lmp: Lamɛ̀k à ba muu Mɛ̀tusɛlà, Mɛ̀tusɛlà à ba muu Ɛnòk, Ɛnòk à ba muu Jɛrɛ̀r, Jɛrɛ̀r à ba muu Màhàlɛlɛ̀r, Màhàlɛlɛ̀r à ba muu Kàyinàn,
eng: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

lmp: Kàyinàn à ba muu Ɛnòs, Ɛnòs à ba muu Sɛ̂r, Sɛr à ba muu Adàm ce e m ba muu Nyʉ̀.
eng: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

lmp: Jisòs à m ruu nè Yʉ' Rara. E m kʉti efa rdip Jodàn, Yʉ' Rara anà yi lor ye a du àgho à ntee rìŋ,
eng: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan, and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

lmp: e cu àfo à mnòŋ mkyèe, Satàn à ce mòoshi ye. E m ye yuu ka' à mnòŋ anà. Mnòŋ anà vi ka' mì, njè à yaŋ ye sê.
eng: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

lmp: Satàn à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ba muu Nyʉ̀, à laa ka tɛ blùr ca vi beeŋger à brɛ̂d."
eng: The devil said to him, If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ e ke cu ntèe ba njo' brɛ̂d cà'cà' ka'." "
eng: Jesus answered him, saying, It is written, 'Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.'

lmp: Satàn à lor ye a du àgho mbe tu rtùu, a duŋshi ye bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na njà' mò'sir,
eng: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

lmp: a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M be fa wɛ̀ ŋger ba bkù' ce à bto' enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ. A m fa buu ca wɛɛwɛ nè mɛ̀, àde' m fa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ kòŋ.
eng: The devil said to him, I will give you all this authority, and their glory, for it has been delivered to me; and I give it to whomever I want.

lmp: Banɛ wɛ̀ ka' gʉ'shi nè mɛ̀, buu ca wɛɛwɛ ba wo."
eng: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Gʉ'shi nè Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀, fa' ba nè ye cà'cà'." "
eng: Jesus answered him, Get behind me Satan! For it is written, 'You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.'

lmp: Satàn à ker lor ye a du àgho à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a du nè ye mbe tu Ndap Nyʉ̀ ce yi sàp mbekì sê, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ba Muu Nyʉ̀, à nyɛɛ ka embe na cɛɛ njep nshè,
eng: He led him to Jerusalem, and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

lmp: njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ be làa tɛ vi bcìndap a ke'ni wɛ̀."
eng: for it is written, 'He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;'

lmp: A ker saŋ foŋ enɛ̂, "Wowèe a be yà wɛ̀ mbe mmbò fà dì' à tʉʉ yo kùu à lùr ka'." "
eng: and, 'On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.'

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Fa mòoshi Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀ ka'." "
eng: Jesus answering, said to him, It has been said, 'You shall not tempt the Lord your God.'

lmp: Satàn à ka' mòoshi ye à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ mìsi, a ma'shi ye a dû, enɛ nfè' mò' e ghɛɛ, tɛ e ka' kèr kʉti.
eng: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

lmp: Jisòs à kʉtì à ŋgôŋ Galèle nè ŋger Yʉ' Rara. Nsuŋ àmbò ye à dù à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgòŋ anà.
eng: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

lmp: E m yɛ'ni bèe a wâp mndap mloo. Bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu' rbòŋ sê, a ku'si ye.
eng: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

lmp: E m dù foŋ à rla' Nasarɛ̀t fàdì' ce e m kù'. À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, e du mbe ndàp rloo àmbò e m ce dù à nfè' wɛɛwɛ nà. A ka' bà' mbo, a nati mbekì à rbè' embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

lmp: A m fa ye ŋwà' ce Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m saŋ. E mʉ̀' ŋwà' anà a fyɛ' mbe dì' ce a m saŋ enɛ̂,
eng: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ mbe dì' ana, bè', a cetè ŋwà', a kʉsi nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ba koo ese ye, a cu à nshè. Bèe embe ndàp rloo wɛɛwɛ a m ku ce fyɛ' ba ye.
eng: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

lmp: E kɛ' a ce làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Àmbò mɛ̀ bè' nlâa Nyʉ̀ ca nè wèe ntìni, wèe à yu' na, yi ku ghɛɛte njo."
eng: He began to tell them, Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a yu' rbòŋ nè ye, a bɛɛŋger se à nlâa bòŋboŋ ce e m làa anà. Wowèe a m làa enɛ̂, "Àmbò a ye muu Josɛ̀f a?"
eng: All testified about him, and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth, and they said, Isn't this Joseph's son?

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe be mà' ŋgàa ca nè mɛ̀, "Ŋwɛ̀ mcɛ̀p bɛ̀ɛ mo mcɛ̀p lûŋ. Gèe là njɛ̀ɛ buu ce wèr à m yu' enɛ wɛ̀ m gèe à rla' Kàpanùm nà fa wɛ̂ là' na foŋ." "
eng: He said to them, Doubtless you will tell me this parable, 'Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.'

lmp: E m ker laa enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ àde' a yu'nì nè ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ fa yê là' ka'.
eng: He said, Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ weenɛ byepkʉʉ a m ba à to' Isrɛ̀l à nfè' yì Àlajà sê, mbe nfè' ce mbèŋ à m gwè ka' à bfê' btaar ba nto', njè à koo à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Isrɛ̀l à nfè' anà nà.
eng: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

lmp: Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m tuusi ye nè mò' efa wowèe ka'. E m tuusi ye ba nè ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ba à rla' Sɛrɛfàr à ŋgôŋ Sidòn.
eng: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ ku' ŋgâa msàasì a m ba à to' Isrɛ̀l à nfè' yì Ɛ̀leshà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀. Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m gèe mò' efa wowèe à ke'sè ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe e ke'sè à m ku ba Namàn ce à m ba ŋwɛ̂ à to' Sirìyà."
eng: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ embe ndàp rloo a ka' yu' wa'a, nyor à bep wowèe sê.
eng: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue, as they heard these things.

lmp: Wowèe a natì mbekì, a fʉr yê à rla' a ko' àgho mbe tu rtùu ce a m bà'ri lap rla' mbo nà, tɛ a bo mà' ye njep rbar.
eng: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

lmp: E tosè yi yu à btar bèe a dû.
eng: But he, passing through the midst of them, went his way.

lmp: E m ker du à rla' Kàpanùm à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a yɛ'ni bèe nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀.
eng: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

lmp: Wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr se à ryu' buu ce e m ce yɛ'ni, njobè' vi blàa vi m ba nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ sê.
eng: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba mbe ndàp rloo anà ce yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi m ba njep ye. Ŋwɛ̀ anà à m waa tatap sê, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon, and he cried out with a loud voice,
