lmp: "Habai, Jisôs à rla' Nasarɛ̀t, yuu ce à ce ròo ese wèr yu ba kɛ? Wɛ̀ vʉ̀ à ryʉshi wèr a? M rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce à yu, à yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀."
eng: saying, Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know you who you are: the Holy One of God!

lmp: Jisòs à waa yʉ' anà enɛ̂, "Cu nyaŋ, fʉʉ enjep ye." Yi nyɛr ŋgàŋ a ma' à nshè a wâp bsii, a fʉʉ enjep ye, a ke' bɛɛsi ye ka'.
eng: Jesus rebuked him, saying, Be silent, and come out of him! When the demon had thrown him down in their midst, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

lmp: Wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a laa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Blàa ŋwɛ̀ ca vi yu ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? E ce làa nè byʉ' bebep nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, vi ce fʉʉse enjep bèe."
eng: Amazement came on all, and they spoke together, one with another, saying, What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!

lmp: Nsuŋ àmbò Jisòs à m dù à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgòŋ anà.
eng: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

lmp: Jisòs à m fʉʉ embe ndàp rloo a du mbe ndàp mbe Saimʉ̀n. Tu yi ce luu malu yì Saimʉ̀n sê, wowèe a laa nè Jisòs enɛ e ja' ye.
eng: He rose up from the synagogue, and entered into Simon's house. Simon's mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him for her.

lmp: E dû, a tɛɛ mbendù njeŋwɛ̀ anà a lâa, mbɛp anà à bornì. Nfè' à ke' tuuse ka', njeŋwɛ̀ anà natì mbekì a fɛr byee a fa nè wowèe.
eng: He stood over her, and rebuked the fever; and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' ce coo, bèe wɛɛwɛ ce yàp bèe à m ce yaŋ byaŋ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ a vʉsè nè ŋgâa byaŋ anà, e lɛ mi mmbo mbe wâp ndù, a gee wowèe a ke'sè.
eng: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

lmp: Byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m fʉse enjep bèe magòr, a ce waani sê, a ce làa enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ Muu Nyʉ̀." Jisòs à waa byʉ' ca, a ke' fa vi njì enɛ vi laa yuu ka' njobè' vi m rìŋ enɛ e yu Krâis anà.
eng: Demons also came out from many, crying out, and saying, You are the Christ, the Son of God! Rebuking them, he didn't allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, Jisòs à fʉʉ efa rla' anà a du à dì' ce e be kù ba mimŋgi'. Bèe a kɛ' a ce ròo ye, a ka' yɛ ye, a koŋ enɛ e ku cu a wowèe.
eng: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place, and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn't go away from them.

lmp: Geewa'a, e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M be kù fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ à mla' mo' foŋ njobè' a yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m vʉ gêe."
eng: But he said to them, I must preach the good news of the Kingdom of God to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.

lmp: E m dù a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca à mndap mloo wɛɛwɛ ce vi m ba à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà.
eng: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mò' Jisòs à tɛɛ àwâa ma tʉ̂ Gɛ̀nɛsarɛ̀t, kʉr bèe a sir ye a kaari a tarte tɛ a bo yu' blâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: Now it happened, while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, that he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

lmp: E m yɛ bkeŋ bbaa àwâa tʉ̀ anà. Ŋgâa ŋkoo nca a m tɛr bkeŋ anà a du à rsù'si map mraa.
eng: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them, and were washing their nets.

lmp: E niŋ mbe mò' ce à m ba yì Saimʉ̀n, a laa nè ye enɛ e doo du àgho nje mʉ̀ rò mʉcàr. E cu mbo a ce yɛ'ni ku' bèe ce a m tɛɛ nje wâa tʉ̀ nà.
eng: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon's, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

lmp: E ka' yɛ'ni mìsi, a laa nè Saimʉ̀n enɛ̂, "Dòo nè keŋ du àgho mbe dì' ce yi coomi, ma' me mraa njep rò, koo nca."
eng: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, Put out into the deep, and let down your nets for a catch.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n à beesì enɛ̂, "Masà, wèr à fà' nètʉ' tatap sê, caar tʉ̀' à raa, a ke' koo yuu ka'. Geewa'a, àmbò wɛ̀ làa na, banɛ m be mà' mraa njep rò."
eng: Simon answered him, Master, we worked all night, and took nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' mà', nca yi niŋ njo ku' gòr sê, mraa mi kɛ' a ce ceeŋger.
eng: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

lmp: Wowèe a lap ŋgâa ŋkoo nca mo' ce a m ba mbe keŋ mò' nà enɛ wowèe a vʉ ja' wowèe. Wowèe a vʉ a ja' wowèe, a wowèe a koo nca yi ruu à bkeŋ bbaa anà jiŋ, keŋ à ce sɛni niŋ njep mʉ̀ rò.
eng: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came, and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à ka' yɛ yuu ce yi m ba na, a gwe njeptii Jisòs, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, nàti efa mɛ̂ geŋ. M yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgèe buu bbebep."
eng: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus' knees, saying, Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n ker ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ce koo nca nà, a bɛɛŋgèr sê, à ryɛ ku' njɛ̀ɛ nca ce wowèe a m koo.
eng: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

lmp: Jɛms ba Jôn ce a m ba boo Sɛbɛ̀dî, ce a Saimʉ̀n wèe a m ce koo nca, a m bɛ̀ɛŋger foŋ sê. Jisòs à laa nè Saimʉ̀n enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka', kɛ̂' sè'ni na, à be ce koo ba bèe."
eng: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, Don't be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, wowèe a doo bkeŋ a du àgho à wâa rò, a ma'shi buu wɛɛwɛ a du a yê mbùu.
eng: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' Jisòs à ba à rla' mo', mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' à ba àfo ce msàasì mi m koo ye à nyor wɛɛwɛ. E ka' yɛ Jisòs a gwe njep nshè nè bsii, a bu' mmbo nè ye a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wɛ̀ ka' kôŋ, à gee m ke'sè, ba nrara."
eng: It happened, while he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face, and begged him, saying, Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.

lmp: Jisòs à naa bo a joo ye àgho, a laa enɛ̂, "M ce kòŋ wa'a, kè'se, ba nrara." E ka' làa wa'a, msàasì mi ku lo yê à nyòr.
eng: He stretched out his hand, and touched him, saying, I want to. Be made clean. Immediately the leprosy left him.

lmp: Jisòs à ciisì nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Dù duŋshi yò nyor nè ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ tɛ à bo gèe taŋshì ce Musìs à m làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ gee tɛ e bo ba nrara, tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à kè'se nà."
eng: He commanded him to tell no one, But go your way, and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.

lmp: Ka' e m làa enɛ e fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka' wa'a, nsuŋ à ker misi a du à bdì' wɛɛwɛ, bèe a ce vʉ̀ à bkʉr à bkʉr tɛ a bo yu' buu ce e m ce yɛ'ni, tɛ e bo gee wowèe a luŋ efa wap byaŋ.
eng: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear, and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

lmp: E m ce fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ bèe, ce dù à ntee rìŋ, ce gèe rloo.
eng: But he withdrew himself into the desert, and prayed.

lmp: À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mò', Jisòs à ka' ce yɛ'ni bèe, bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ce a m vʉ̂ à bu' mla' à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, ba à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà wɛɛwɛ ker ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a cutè àfo. Tata Nyʉ̀ à m fa Jisòs ŋger à rgèe tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se.
eng: It happened on one of those days, that he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by, who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

lmp: Bèe mo' a byɛ' ŋwɛ̀ mò' mbe kèŋ ce yì ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' à m kwe, a gheter à rniŋ nè ye mbe ndàp, lɛ̀ njeptii Jisòs.
eng: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

lmp: Bèe a m ruu magòr, nduunjì yi ke' ba nè wowèe à rniŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ ca mbo ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a ko' nè ye mbe tu ndap, a co'ni dì' mo' embo, a suusi ye mbe kèŋ cà mbe mʉ̀ bèe embe ndàp, a lɛ njeptii Jisòs.
eng: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop, and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the midst before Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ lap rbyemì, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ anà enɛ̂, "Ŋkarà, mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep."
eng: Seeing their faith, he said to him, Man, your sins are forgiven you.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsi a kɛ' a ce làa enjep ntee enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀ na a nda? Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e foosì ŋwɛ̀ efa buu bbebep caa efa Nyʉ̀ yu nda?"
eng: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, Who is this that speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?

lmp: Jisòs à ku riŋ yuu ce wowèe a m ce kwà'shi, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kwà'shi njɛ̀ɛ buu ca wa'a njokɛ?
eng: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu àtɛ̀r yu ba yî fɛ? Yu ba à rlàa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep" kɛ̀ à rlàa enɛ̂, "Lò mbekì, jɛ̂r"?
eng: Which is easier to say, 'Your sins are forgiven you;' or to say, 'Arise and walk?'

lmp: Banɛ à rgèe tɛ wèe bo rìŋ weenɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ tʉr ŋger njep ŋgòŋ na à rfòosi bèe efa yàp buu bbebep." E laa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ ca enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à nati mbekì, lor yo kèŋ du à là'."
eng: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins he said to the paralyzed man, I tell you, arise, and take up your cot, and go to your house.

lmp: Nfè' à m tuuse ka', e natì mbekì à bsii bèe wɛɛwɛ, a lor yi kèŋ a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ a ce dù fa yê là'.
eng: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

lmp: Wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a ce wɛp sê, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Wèr à yɛ buu bghagha' ntìni."
eng: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, We have seen strange things today.

lmp: Ca yi ka' mì wɛɛ, Jisòs à fʉʉ, a ka' ce dù a yɛ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' mò' ce a m ce too ye enɛ Lɛvì cu mbe yi dî' rfà'. Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: After these things he went out, and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, Follow me!

lmp: Lɛvì à natì, a ma'shi yì buu wɛɛwɛ, a du a yê mbùu.
eng: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

lmp: Lɛvì à m gèe ma ŋkà' nè ye mbe yê ndàp. Ku' ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' ker ba bèe mo' a m ba mbo foŋ a cute a sir tɛbùr a wowèe a ce yeŋger.
eng: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi ba bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ ce a m ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a rʉ'ŋgèr, a laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs enɛ̂, "Wèe ce yeŋger a ce noŋger wèe ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' wèe ker ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep njokɛ?"
eng: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bèe ce a ke ròo ŋwɛ̀ mcɛ̀p e ke ba ŋgâa byaŋ, ke' ba bêe btatap ka'.
eng: Jesus answered them, Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

lmp: Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ à rkɛ' bêe byɛɛnì ka'. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ à rkɛ' ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep tɛ wowèe a bo kupse, mà' yàp buu bbebep anà."
eng: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.

lmp: Bèe a m làa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jôn ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu bèe Farìsi, a ke jì mdip, ce gèe rloo à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, geewa'a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a ce yeŋger yap ker ce no buu."
eng: They said to him, Why do John's disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kwà'shi weenɛ àde' wèe ma'shì bèe ce a vʉ̀ ŋkâ' bgùu nè njè ce nduu-gùu ku ba àfo a?
eng: He said to them, Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast, while the bridegroom is with them?

lmp: Geewa'a, nfè' mò' be ba ce a be koo nduu ese wowèe tɛ wowèe a ji mdip à nfè' anà."
eng: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.

lmp: Jisòs à m mà' ŋgàa ca nè wowèe foŋ enɛ̂, "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ saa cɛ̂' fi la' mbendù cɛ̂' rʉ̀ʉ tarshi ka'. E ka' gee wa'a, banɛ a sàa cɛ̀' fi anà à cicì. Wɛ̀ ka' tar yi mbendù yî rʉ̀ʉ, yi ghɛɛte ka'.
eng: He also told a parable to them. No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ lor mrû' mfi lɛ njep mŋgùp mrù' vî brʉ̀ʉ ka'. E ka' gee wa'a banɛ mrû' mfi anà mi be lò koo, to'shi mŋgùp mrù' anà, tɛ mrù' mi kʉte à nshè, tɛ mŋgùp mrù' anà vi bʉ à cicì.
eng: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled, and the skins will be destroyed.

lmp: Yi ke ba enɛ a lɛ mrû' mfi ba njep mŋgùp mrù' vî bfi tɛ mi bo kʉ̀te ka', tɛ mŋgùp mrù' vi to'ŋger ka'.
eng: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' no mrù' ce mi koo, e ker koŋ à rno msɛ̂ŋ mrù' ka' njobè' e ka' no banɛ e be làa enɛ̂, "Mrù' ce mi koo mi yu àndèe nè msɛ̂ŋ mrù'." "
eng: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, 'The old is better.'

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ mò', Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a caa à ŋkʉ̀ msaŋ mò'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a tee msaŋ anà a ce si'si mbà mmbò a ce ye.
eng: Now it happened on the second Sabbath after the first, that he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain, and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi mo' a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe ce gèe yuu ce ncir yi kani enɛ a fa gèe nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ka' njokɛ?"
eng: But some of the Pharisees said to them, Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Wèe à be be' yuu ce Dɛvìd à m gèe à nfè' ce njè à m ce yaŋ ye ker ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ba nà ka' a?
eng: Jesus, answering them, said, Haven't you read what David did when he was hungry, he, and those who were with him;

lmp: E m dù mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a lor brɛ̂d ce a m fa nè Nyʉ̀, a ye, a fa bɛr nè bèe ce a wowèe a m ba. Ncir yi byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mô' jɛɛ ye caa efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ka'."
eng: how he entered into the house of God, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?

lmp: Jisòs à m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Muu Ŋwɛ̀ yu Tàr ce e tʉr mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀."
eng: He said to them, The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.

lmp: À ka' kèr ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ mò', Jisòs à du mbe ndàp rloo, a ce yɛ'ni bèe mbo. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba mbo, li rkoo mà' li m kwe.
eng: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsi a ce fyɛ' enɛ e be gèe tɛ ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ mò' ke'se nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ lɛ, tɛ wowèe a bo sa' ye enɛ e bʉ' ncir.
eng: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

lmp: Jisòs à ku riŋ yuu ce wowèe a m ce kwà'shi, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce li rkoo li m kwe nà enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì vʉ tɛɛ mbena." E natì a tɛɛ mbo.
eng: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, Rise up, and stand in the middle. He arose and stood.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce bip ca nè wèe. Yisèe ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe gee ba yuu bòŋboŋ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ yuu bebep? Yi byemi enɛ sèe ja' ŋwɛ̀ jà' kɛ̀ enɛ sèe yʉ ŋwɛ̀ yʉ?"
eng: Then Jesus said to them, I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?

lmp: E ka' bipshi wa'a, a fyɛ' wowèe wɛɛwɛ a kaari a tarte, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ anà enɛ̂ "Mà' lo rkoo kùyɛɛ." E gee wa'a, li rkoo li bôŋ, a kʉti àmbò li m ba.
eng: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, Stretch out your hand. He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

lmp: Rshentee li ko' wowèe sê, wowèe a kɛ' a ce sèesi njɛ̀ɛ yuu ce àde' a gee nè Jisòs.
eng: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

lmp: À m ba à mnòŋ anà, Jisòs à ko' mbe rtùu à rgèe rloo, a cu mbo, a loo nè Nyʉ̀ caar tʉ̀' à raa.
eng: It happened in these days, that he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, e kɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a ce bèe ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ efa wâp mʉ, a too wowèe enɛ ŋgâa ntuu.
eng: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

lmp: Bèe anà à m ba Saimʉ̀n ce e m too enɛ Pità, ba Andrù ce e m ba nfʉr Saimʉ̀n, ba Jɛ̂ms, ba Jôn, ba Felêp, ba Bàtòlomì,
eng: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

lmp: ba Matìyò, ba Tomâs, ba Jɛms muu Alfìyòs, ba Saimʉ̀n ce a m ce too enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ntee lùu-luu,
eng: Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Simon, who was called the Zealot;

lmp: ba Judàs muu Jɛ̂ms, ba Judas Ìskarìyòt ce e m lò a fyeni Jisòs nà.
eng: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

lmp: Jisòs à m sùu a wowèe embe rtùu a tɛɛ à mbo'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m ba àfo à ku' ŋgoo sê, bèe a vʉ̂ à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, ker ba à bu' mla', à mla' Tayà ba Sidòn ce mi m ba àwâa rò.
eng: He came down with them, and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples, and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem, and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases;

lmp: Wowèe a m vʉ̀ à ryu' yuu ce e m ce yɛ'ni, a ker vʉ foŋ tɛ e bo gèe wowèe a ke'se efa wap byaŋ. Bèe ce byʉ' bbebep vi m ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ' a m vʉ̀se foŋ, e gee wowèe a ke'sè.
eng: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits, and they were being healed.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ce ghèter à rjòo ye njobè' wowèe a m rìŋ enɛ ŋger yi m ce fʉʉ ye enje nyòr, a ce gèe bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m jòo ye a ce kè'se.
eng: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out from him and healed them all.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' nàa mmir fyɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a laa enɛ̂, "Mbôŋtu mi yu nè wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa fùp, njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yu ye.
eng: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said, Blessed are you who are poor, for yours is the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Mbôŋtu mi yu nè wèe ce njè ce yaŋ wèe sè'ni na, njobè' wèe be kè ye yu'. Mbôŋtu mi yu nè wèe ce wèe ce warse sè'ni na, njobè' wèe be kè vʉ̀shi.
eng: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

lmp: Mbôŋtu mi yu nè wèe ce bèe a ka' baa wèe, beesi njì nè wèe, cɛp wèe, bepsi me mlii njobè' Muu Ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Blessed are you when men shall hate you, and when they shall exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man's sake.

lmp: Lu'shi nè à njɛ̀ɛ nòŋ anà, nyɛshi mbekì nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀ njobè' wee blà' embe bùu vi yu magòr sê. Wap btarkʉ a m ku gee buu ca nè ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ foŋ.
eng: Rejoice in that day, and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

lmp: Geewa'a, ndòo à co' wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa mbàa njobè' wèe à yu' le rbòŋ wɛɛ.
eng: But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

lmp: Làa nè nè bèe ce a ce làa enɛ ndòo co' wèe nà enɛ Nyʉ̀ ghoni wowèe, ker loo foŋ nè bèe ce a ce fa ŋgɛ' nè wèe.
eng: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lip wɛ̀ nè bo à gè', à beesì gè' mo' nè ye foŋ tɛ e lîp. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koo yò kûr, à ma'shì e koo cɛ̀' yì enjep mʉ foŋ.
eng: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don't withhold your coat also.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' loo yuu ese wɛ̀, à fa ye yuu anà. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koo yo yuu, à fa kèr làa enɛ ŋgàŋ kʉsi nè wɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Give to everyone who asks you, and don't ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

lmp: Banɛ wèe gee nè bèe mò' àmbò wèe ce kòŋ enɛ a gee nè wèe.
eng: As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

lmp: E m mà' ŋgàa nè wowèe foŋ enɛ̂, "Àde' nfèp duŋshì nfèp mò' nduunjì a? E ka' gee wa'a, wowèe bsìp a ke' gweŋger njep bè'tè a?
eng: He spoke a parable to them. Can the blind guide the blind? Won't they both fall into a pit?

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce a ce yɛ'ni ye, caa ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ka'. Geewa'a, a ka' yɛ'ni ŋwɛ̀ bòŋboŋ banɛ ŋgàŋ be ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e yɛ'ni ye.
eng: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

lmp: Wɛ̀ mà'shi ntaaŋguu nje rlìr nje wɛ̀, a ce fyɛ' ba ŋkʉ̀' ce ce yi yu nfʉrò nje rlìr njokɛ?
eng: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye, but don't consider the beam that is in your own eye?

lmp: Àde' à laa nè nfʉrò enɛ̂, "Nfʉrà, nàa rlir tɛ m koo wɛ̀ mʉ ŋkʉ̀' ce enjo," ke' yɛ ntaaŋguu ce e yu wɛ̀ nje rlìr nà ka' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Wɛ̀ ce à yu ŋwɛ̀ mbo'ni, fʉr ntaaŋguu ce e yu nje rlìr njep wɛ̀ wɛɛ tɛ à bo yɛ mʉ ŋkʉ̀' ce ce yi yu nje rlìr nje nfʉrò bòŋboŋ, ka' fʉr.
eng: Or how can you tell your brother, 'Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,' when you yourself don't see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother's eye.

lmp: "Yi yu enɛ àde' mbàŋ ce bebep yi yʉ mbe ce ce bòŋboŋ ka', a ker ba foŋ enɛ àde' mbàŋ ce bòŋboŋ yi yʉ mbe ce ce bebep ka'.
eng: For there is no good tree that brings forth rotten fruit; nor again a rotten tree that brings forth good fruit.

lmp: A ke rìŋ ce nè mbàŋ ce anà. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ kʉ rbì embe rɛp ka', kɛ̀ lèemʉ embe rgʉ̀ ka'.
eng: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don't gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ e ke fʉr buu bbòŋboŋ efa buu bbòŋboŋ ce vi yu njep yê ntee, ŋwɛ̂ mbembep fʉr buu bbebep efa buu bbebep ce vi yu njep yê ntee. Yi yu wa'a njobè' ŋwɛ̀ e ke làa ba efa ku' buu ce vi ruu njep yê ntee.
eng: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

lmp: "Wèe ce kɛ' mɛ̀ enɛ̂ "Tatâ, Tatâ", a ce gèe buu ce m ce suŋ wèe ka' njokɛ?
eng: Why do you call me, 'Lord, Lord,' and don't do the things which I say?

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca nè bèe anà mìsi, a du à rla' Kàpanùm.
eng: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ rjèe à m ba àfo, a tʉr yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e m kòŋ sê, e ce yaŋ a tɛɛ yî ŋkwe.
eng: A certain centurion's servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

lmp: E ka' yu' nsuŋ àmbò Jisòs, a tuu bleebèe mo' efa mʉ̀ Jûs, enɛ a du laa nè Jisòs enɛ e vʉ gee tɛ yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ke'se.
eng: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù yɛ Jisòs, a bu' mmbo nè ye nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ ba gèe yuu ce e làa na nè ye,
eng: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, He is worthy for you to do this for him,

lmp: njobè' e kòŋ yisèe to' sê, a ba'ri ndap rloo nè wèr."
eng: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.

lmp: Jisòs à du a wowèe, a ka' bà' àtʉtʉ ndap ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̀ anà, a tarte a bèe ce e ba tuu. E m tuu wowèe enɛ a du laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, fa fa ŋgɛ' nè yò nyor ka' njobè' mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' à niŋ mbe mɛ̂ ndàp ka'.
eng: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, Lord, don't trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ ba kwa'shi mɛnɛ mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à rvʉ̀ yɛ wɛ̀ ka'. Kù làa ba mbʉ̀ nlàa mò'sir tɛ yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ke'se.
eng: Therefore I didn't even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

lmp: Mɛ mɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce m ce fà' njeptii bèe ce yap nta' yi càa ya, a tʉr bsoogɛ̀ ce a yu njep mɛ̂ tìi. M ka' laa nè mò' enɛ "Dû", banɛ e be dù. M ka' laa nè mò' enɛ "Vʉ̀", banɛ e be vʉ̀. M ka' laa nè yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' enɛ, "Gèe ca", banɛ e be gèe yuu anà."
eng: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, 'Go!' and he goes; and to another, 'Come!' and he comes; and to my servant, 'Do this,' and he does it.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu' blàa ca, a bɛɛŋger sê, a karsi nyor a laa nè kʉr bèe ce a m ce dù a yê mbùu nà enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe enɛ mɛ̀ be yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rbyemì ca ka', ka' à to' Isrɛ̀l."
eng: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.

lmp: Bèe ce a m tuu anà a ka' kʉti bà' mbe ndàp, a yɛ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà à kè'se wɛɛ.
eng: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

lmp: Mʉ nfè' à ka' tuuse, e natì a du à rla' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ Nɛ̂n. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ba ma kʉr bèe a du a wowèe.
eng: It happened soon afterwards, that he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

lmp: E ka' bà' àtʉtʉ cûu ŋka' à rla' anà, a yɛ àmbò a byɛ̀' gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ a ce fʉʉ àgho. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwe anà à m ku ba muu mbaŋrù ce yì ma à m tʉr cà'cà'. Yì ma ca à m ba ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀. Kʉr bèe efa rla' anà ce yi m bà'ti yi m ba a ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ anà wèe.
eng: Now when he drew near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

lmp: Tata à ka' yɛ ye, nse yi koo ye nè ye sê, e laa enɛ̂, "Fa war ka'."
eng: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her, and said to her, Don't cry.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a du a joo ŋkùp gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ anà, bèe ce a m byɛ̀' ŋkùp anà a tɛɛ, e laa enɛ̂, "Muu nsùnsù, m ce làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à nati mbekì."
eng: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, Young man, I tell you, arise!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwe na à natì mbekì, a kɛ' a ce làa. Jisòs à koo ye a fa nè yì mâ.
eng: He who was dead sat up, and began to speak. And he gave him to his mother.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a wɛp, a ku'si Nyʉ̀, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̂ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̂ ŋgòr à fʉʉ efa sêe mʉ," a ker ce làa enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à vʉ̀ à rjà' yì bèe."
eng: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, A great prophet has arisen among us! and, God has visited his people!

lmp: Nsuŋ kuu yuu ce Jisòs à m gèe na à m dù à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà wɛɛwɛ ker ba à mla' ce mi m sìr ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a kaari a tarte.
eng: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea, and in all the surrounding region.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jôn a m yɛ buu ca a suŋ Jôn. E kɛ' bèe a mmbaa efa wâp mʉ,
eng: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

lmp: a tuu wowèe enɛ wowèe a du yɛ Tatâ, bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce yi m ba enɛ e be vʉ̀ nà kɛ̀ wèr cu ce ke' ba ŋwɛ̂ jɛɛ?"
eng: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀ yɛ Jisòs, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe à tuu wèr enɛ wèr vʉ yɛ wɛ̀, bipshi nè wɛ̀ enɛ a wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce yi m ba enɛ e be vʉ̀ nà kɛ̀ wèr cu ce ke' ba ŋwɛ̂ jɛɛ lɛ?"
eng: When the men had come to him, they said, John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, 'Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?'

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, Jisòs à gee bèe a ke'sè efa byaŋ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a gee bèe ce a m tʉr byʉ' bbebep a ke'sè, a gee bèe ce a m fèp, a ker ce yɛ buu.
eng: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

lmp: E beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kʉti nè du suŋ Jôn buu ce wèe à yɛ a ker yu'. Bèe ce a fèp a ce yɛ buu, mntɛ̀ŋ a ce jɛ̀shi yɛɛnì, ŋgâa msàasì a ce ke'sè, ce ba brara, mnfuŋ-tù' a ce yu' buu, bèe ce a m kweŋger a ce kʉti btèe, ŋgâa fùp a ce suŋ Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: Jesus answered them, Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

lmp: Rbôŋtu li yu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce tarni mɛ̀ tarni ka'."
eng: Blessed is he who is not offended by me.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu ce Jôn à m tuu nà a ka' dù, Jisòs à kɛ' a ce suŋ ku' kʉr bèe ca buu kuu Jôn. E m làa enɛ̂, "Wèe à m fʉʉ a du à rìŋ ba à ryɛ kɛ? Wèe à m dù à ryɛ àmbò fu' yi ce cì' ŋke' a?
eng: When John's messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

lmp: Yi ka' tɛ ba wa' ka', banɛ wèe à m dù ba à ryɛ kɛ? Wèe à m dù à ryɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e sùsi nyor nè bcɛ̀' yòo a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Bèe ce a ke sùsi nyor nè bcɛ̂' bbòŋboŋ, ce ye rbòŋ, a ke cu ba à nto'.
eng: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed, and live delicately, are in kings' courts.

lmp: Banɛ wèe à m fʉʉ a du ba à ryɛ kɛ sê? Wèe à m dù ba à ryɛ ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a? Ɛ̀no, m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe à m yɛ anà càa ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce a saŋ àmbò ye mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, m be tuu yà ŋwɛ̀ ntuu tɛ e du entombì nè wɛ̀, dù kupshi nduunjì nè wɛ̀."
eng: This is he of whom it is written, 'Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.'

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ efa bèe wɛɛwɛ ce bbyèŋge a bi, mò' càa Jôn ka'. Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu yi mʉcàr se mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ à càa ye."
eng: For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer, yet he who is least in the Kingdom of God is greater than he.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ, ka' nè ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà'-ŋwɛ̀, a m yu' yuu ce Jisòs à m làa, a byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ ce gèe yì buu à njî yɛɛnì, a byemi enɛ Jôn baptir wowèe.
eng: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John's baptism.

lmp: Geewa'a, bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a m kani yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kòŋ à rgèe nè wowèe, a kani foŋ enɛ Jôn fa bàptir wowèe ka'.
eng: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

lmp: "Banɛ àde' m be'nì bèe elùuni na ba à kɛ? Wowèe a yu àmbò kɛ?
eng: To what then will I liken the people of this generation? What are they like?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi mò' à làa nè Jisòs enɛ a ye a du yeŋger. Jisòs à du a niŋ mbe ndàp mbe ŋwɛ̀ anà, a cu, tɛ a ye a bo yeŋger.
eng: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee's house, and sat at the table.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba à rla' anà ce e m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgèe buu bbebep. E ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs ce yeŋger mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi ca, a lor mʉ ntʉŋ blùr ce njɛ̀ɛ mgʉr mo' ce mi m ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ sê, mi m ba njo,
eng: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee's house, she brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

lmp: a vʉ a tɛɛ mbe yê njì àgee mi mkùu a ce war, mŋgoommir mi ce cɛɛcɛ mbe mkùu Jisòs, e ce siŋsi nè yi nyʉ̀'tu. E m nyò'shi mkùu Jisòs, a cu'ni mgʉr ce e m tʉr nà àgho.
eng: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi ce e m be Jisòs nà, à ka' yɛ ca, a laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ba ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, e ba rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce njeŋwɛ̀ ce e ce jòo ye na yu, njobè' e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgèe buu bbebep."
eng: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Saimʉ̀n, m tʉr yuu à rsuŋ wɛ̀." E laa enɛ̂, "Suŋ là mɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì."
eng: Jesus answered him, Simon, I have something to tell you. He said, Teacher, say on.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Bèe mo' bèe a mmbaa a m tʉr rkaa a ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m fòosi wowèe mbàa. Mò' à m tʉr rkaa a ye à bbàa mbàa tâ, mò' à tʉr li a ye à nto'nì bàa mbàa.
eng: A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n à beesì enɛ̂, "M kwà'shi mɛnɛ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce rkaa li li m ba gòr nà." Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ bèesi yɛɛnì."
eng: Simon answered, He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most. He said to him, You have judged correctly.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a karsi nyor a ke' njeŋwɛ̀ ca, a laa nè Saimʉ̀n enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ yɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ca a? Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ mbe wɛ̂ ndàp, wɛ̀ fa mɛ̀ mdip enɛ m su'si mkùu àgho ka', geewa'a, njeŋwɛ̀ ca à sù'si ma mkùu nè mŋgoommir, a siŋsi nè yi nyʉ̀'tu.
eng: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ba koni mɛ̀ a baa mɛ̀ nje nyòr ka', kɛ' embe nfè' mɛ̀ ba niŋ mbe ndàp na njeŋwɛ̀ ca à be borni efa rnyò'shi mɛ̀ mkùu ka'.
eng: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ba cu'ni mɛ̀ mgʉr mbe tù ka', e cu'nì mgʉr ce mi ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ se à ma mkùu.
eng: You didn't anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

lmp: Banɛ m ce suŋ wɛ̀ mɛnɛ ku' njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ce e dùŋshi nè mɛ̀ na li ce dùŋshi enɛ a fòosi ye efa ku' buu bbebep ce e m gèe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a fòosi yì buu bbebep mʉcàr ce dùŋshi rkòŋnì mʉcàr."
eng: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But to whom little is forgiven, the same loves little.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a laa nè njeŋwɛ̀ ca enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ fòosi wɛ̀ efa yò buu bbebep."
eng: He said to her, Your sins are forgiven.

lmp: Bèe mo' ce a wowèe a m cute a ce ye byee nà, a kɛ' a ce làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fòosi bèe efa yàp buu bbebep na a nda?"
eng: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, Who is this who even forgives sins?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè njeŋwɛ̀ anà enɛ̂, "Lo rbyemì li gèe wɛ̀ ke'sè, dù yo yu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀."
eng: He said to the woman, Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.

lmp: Mʉ nfè' à ka' tuuse, Jisòs à jɛr à mla' mŋgòrŋgòr ba à mla' mŋkɛ'ŋkɛ', a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀. Yì bèe ce ncòp baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ a m dù a ye.
eng: It happened soon afterwards, that he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of the Kingdom of God. With him were the twelve,

lmp: Bbyèŋge mo' ce e m gèe wowèe a luŋ efa byʉ' bbebep, ba byaŋ, a m dù foŋ a wowèe. Mò' efa wowèe à m ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce a m ce too enɛ Màkdàlên, ce byʉ' bbebep vi m fʉʉ enjep ye vi sàamba nà,
eng: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

lmp: mò' à ba Jòanà ce e m ba ŋgwa Kusà ce e m ba tu rfà' embe ndàp Hɛròd. Sùsanà à ba mò' foŋ, ker ba bbyèŋge mo' àŋgoo. Bbyèŋge ca a m jà' Jisòs wèe nè yap mbàa ba yàp buu ce a m tʉr.
eng: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod's steward; Susanna; and many others; who served them from their possessions.

lmp: Bèe a m ce vʉ̂ à bbu' mla' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ à ryɛ Jisòs. A ka' vʉ̀ kaari à ma kʉr, Jisòs à ma' ŋgàa enɛ̂,
eng: When a great multitude came together, and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ce dù à rbyè yì buu, a ka' ce byè, ŋgʉ̀ buu mò' à gweŋgèr àwâa nduunjì, bèe a ka' càa a nyɛŋshi nè mkùu, bsiŋ vi vʉ a ye.
eng: The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a bipshì nè ye enɛ ŋgàa ca yu ba enɛ kɛ lɛ?
eng: Then his disciples asked him, What does this parable mean?

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Buu ce àde' bèe a riŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka' nà, Nyʉ̀ à gèe wèe à rîŋ. À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe mo', a ce suŋ wowèe buu ca ba à mŋgàa tɛ wowèe a ce kè' ce yɛ ka', a ce yu'shi, ce yu' ka'."
eng: He said, To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of God, but to the rest in parables; that 'seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.'

lmp: "Ŋgàa ca yu enɛ, ŋgʉ̀ buu yu nlâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger àwâa nduunjì nà tɛɛ yi ba àtu bèe ce a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, Satàn ku fʉr blàa anà enjep wâp mntee, fà dì' wowèe a bo byemi, lùŋ ka'.
eng: Those along the road are those who hear, then the devil comes, and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger mbendù ryɛɛ nà tɛɛ àtu bèe ce a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, yu' rbòŋ àgho sê, geewa'a, blàa anà vi ke' taa mŋgàŋ njep wowèe ka'. Wowèe à lò ku byemi ba à mʉ nfè' mò', e ba à nfè' ce rmòoshì li vʉ̀ nè wowèe, wowèe a ku kʉti njìnjì.
eng: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root, who believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger à mʉ̀ msini nà tɛɛ àtu bèe ce a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ ku byemi, a ce cu, mlù ce à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na, ba broŋ buu, ba buu ce bèe a ke yu' rbòŋ àgho, vi kur blàa anà, vi ke' yʉ mbàŋ ce yi tèe ka'.
eng: That which fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life, and bring no fruit to maturity.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀ buu ce e m gwèŋger yi ba mbe nshe yî mbòŋmboŋ nà tɛɛ àtu bèe ce a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, lɛ njep ntee bòŋboŋ sê, nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, ku', tɛɛ tatap, gee ŋgʉ̀.
eng: That in the good ground, these are such as in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and bring forth fruit with patience.

lmp: "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ cʉ' lâm, ker lor ghee kʉpshi àgho kɛ̀ tɛr mbà kàasi ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' cʉ' lâm, banɛ ŋgàŋ be tɛr ba mbe tɛbùr, tɛ bèe ce a ce niŋ mbe ndàp a bo yɛ rraa.
eng: No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container, or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

lmp: Ma yì Jisòs ker ba bfʉr vi a m vʉ̀ à ryɛ ye, nduunjì yi ke' ba nè wowèe à ryɛ ye ka' njobè' bèe a m ba gòr sê.
eng: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Yò ma ba bfʉr wo a tɛɛ njepmbè a ce kòŋ à ryɛ wɛ̀."
eng: It was told him by some saying, Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Yà ma ba bfʉr wa yu bèe ce a ce yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, a ce gèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ ce làa."
eng: But he answered them, My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God, and do it.

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mò' Jisòs à niŋ mbe keŋ a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Sèe tuu tʉ̀ ca du nèŋguŋ." E ka' làa wa'a, a wowèe a kɛ' a ce tuu.
eng: Now it happened on one of those days, that he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, Let's go over to the other side of the lake. So they launched out.

lmp: A ka' ce tuu, e buumì. Ka' cu, fu' mo' yi vʉ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ sê, mdip mi kɛ' a ce niŋ mbe keŋ, yi ba bebep nè wowèe.
eng: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yɛɛ ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Masà, Masà, sèe à kwe." E lɛ' efa mmirlò, a waa fu' ba rdip, fu' anà yi tetì, rdip li tɛɛ nyaŋ, ŋgòŋ yi ba sè'ni nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: They came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we are dying! He awoke, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water, and they ceased, and it was calm.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Le rbyemì li yu ba fɛ?" Wowèe a wɛp a ker bɛɛŋger foŋ sê, a ce làa fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu nda sê? E waa fu', yi yu'nì nè ye, rdip li yu'nì nè ye foŋ."
eng: He said to them, Where is your faith? Being afraid they marveled, saying one to another, Who is this, then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?

lmp: Wowèe a m tuu, a ba' à ŋgôŋ bèe Gɛ̀rasà. Wɛ̀ ka' tɛɛ à ŋgòŋ anà, ŋgôŋ Galèle yi kʉtì nèŋguu rò.
eng: They arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce fʉʉ embe keŋ, a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mô' à rla' anà ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m ba njep ye. E m kar mbùuriŋ kɛ̂' à nfè' njìsàp sê, a ce cu mbe ndàp ka'. E m ce cu yi ba fàdì' ce a m ce tuŋ bèe.
eng: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn't live in a house, but in the tombs.

lmp: E ka' yɛ Jisòs, a waa, a gwe njep yê tìi, a ce war enɛ̂, "Jisòs, Muu Nyʉ̀ embe bùu, yuu ce sò tʉr a kɛ? M ce loo nè wɛ̀ enɛ à fa fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ka'."
eng: When he saw Jesus, he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don't torment me!

lmp: E m làa wa'a njobè' Jisòs à m làa nè yʉ' bebep cà enɛ yi fʉʉ enjep ye. Yʉ' anà yi m ce lô koo ye àmbò mrù' wa'a nfè' àŋgoo sê. A m ce lô kur ye nè bshaŋ à mkoo ker ba à mkùu ce kè'ni ye. Yi gèe wa'a, e ceeshì bshaŋ anà, nyʉ̀rkà' lor ye du àgho à ntee rìŋ.
eng: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard, and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bands apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Lo rlii a nda?" E beesì enɛ̂, "La rlii a Mncʉ̀kì." E m làa wa'a njobè' byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m niŋ njep ye àŋgoo.
eng: Jesus asked him, What is your name? He said, Legion, for many demons had entered into him.

lmp: Byʉ' anà vi m bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ e fa làa enɛ wowèe a fʉʉ du njep bè'tè ŋgɛ' ka'.
eng: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

lmp: Kʉr ŋkûnyàm mo' gòr se yi m ba àfo a ce yeŋger mbe rtùu. Byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' ca vi bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ e ma'shi tɛ a niŋ ba njep ŋkûnyàm anà. Jisòs à ma'shì.
eng: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. He allowed them.

lmp: Byʉ' anà vi ka' fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀ anà, a niŋ njep kʉr ŋkûnyàm cà, yi kɛɛtì a caŋ a du mbà baa, a gweŋger njep tʉ̀, a no mdip, a kweŋger.
eng: The demons came out from the man, and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake, and were drowned.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce cìŋ ŋkûnyàm ca a ka' yɛ yuu ce yi m koni, a caŋ a dû, a suŋ yuu ce yi m koni na à là', a ker suŋ nè bèe ce a m ba à mŋkʉ̀.
eng: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled, and told it in the city and in the country.

lmp: Bèe a fʉʉ a du à ryɛ yuu ce yi m koni. Wowèe a du a yɛ Jisòs, a ker yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m fʉʉ enjep ye nà àmbò e cu njeptii Jisòs nè bcɛ̀' à nyòr, vi bfee vi banì kʉti mbo. Wowèe a wɛp sê.
eng: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus, and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus' feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba àfo a yɛ yuu ce yi m koni, a suŋ bèe ce a m vʉ̀ nà àmbò a m gèe ŋwɛ̀ anà à lûŋ.
eng: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Gɛ̀rasà a m làa enɛ Jisòs dû, njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp magòr sê. Yi ka' ba wa'a, e niŋ mbe keŋ tɛ e bo kʉti.
eng: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. He entered into the boat, and returned.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi m fʉʉ enjep ye nà à bu' mmbo nè Jisòs enɛ a ye a dû. Jisòs à kanì, a laa nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

lmp: "Kʉti fa wɛ̂ là' du suŋ bèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe nè wɛ̀." Ŋwɛ̀ anà à du a jɛr à rla' anà wɛɛwɛ a ce suŋ bèe yuu ce Jisòs à gèe nè ye.
eng: Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you. He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kʉti, kʉr bèe a konì ye, njobè' wowèe wɛɛwɛ a m cu a ce kè' ye.
eng: It happened, when Jesus returned, that the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

lmp: Ka' cu, ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Jairòs à vʉ̂. E m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr embe ndàp rloo. E m vʉ̀ a gwe njeptii Jisòs a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ e vʉ mbe yê ndàp,
eng: Behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus' feet, and begged him to come into his house,

lmp: njobè' e m tʉr muunje mò'sir cà'cà', e ce yaŋ, a ba yî ŋkwe. Muu anà à m ba àmbò bfè' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ wa'a. Jisòs à ka' nàti ce dù, bèe a fatè ye mbetar.
eng: for he had an only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba àfo ce e m cu mbe kùu à bfè' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, ŋwɛ̀ mcɛ̀p mò' à ke' ba ce àde' e m ba kupshi ye e ke'se ka'.
eng: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians, and could not be healed by any,

lmp: E m vʉ̀ njì embe njì Jisòs, a joo cûu cɛ̀' ese ye, a ku ke'se mbe dì'.
eng: came behind him, and touched the fringe of his cloak, and immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshi enɛ̂, "À jòo nda mɛ̀?" Bèe wɛɛwɛ a kanì enɛ a jòo ye ka'. Pità à laa enɛ̂, "Masà, yu ba bèe ce a yu gòr a ce nyòrni a ka' ce cìrshi wɛ̀ mbetar."
eng: Jesus said, Who touched me? When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, 'Who touched me?'

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à jòo mɛ̀, njobè' mɛ̀ yu' àmbò ŋger yi fʉʉ mɛ̀ enje nyòr."
eng: But Jesus said, Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à ka' yɛ enɛ e yɛɛti àwaŋ, e kɛ' a ce kàŋ, a vʉ a gwe njeptii Jisòs. E m suŋ mbùu ce e m jòo ye a ker suŋ àmbò e m ku ke'se à nfè' ce e m jòo ye anà à bsii bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling, and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Muu wà, lo rbyemì li gèe wɛ̀ ke'sè. Dù yo yu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀."
eng: He said to her, Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kù bii làa, ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe ndàp ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr embe ndàp rloo à vʉ̂, a laa enɛ̂, "Muu wò à kwe. Fa kèr fa ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ŋgɛ' ka'."
eng: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue's house came, saying to him, Your daughter is dead. Don't trouble the Teacher.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu', a laa nè Jairòs enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka', kù byemi byemi, muu wò be lùŋ."
eng: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, Don't be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.

lmp: Jisòs à dû, a ka' bà', a ma'shi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' niŋ mbe ndàp a ye caa efa Pità ba Jôn ba Jɛ̂ms, ker ba tar muu ba ma muu ka'.
eng: When he came to the house, he didn't allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ce warse a ce koosimnse. E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Fa war nè ka'. Muu ca à kwe kwe ka', e ce buumi buumi."
eng: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, Don't weep. She isn't dead, but sleeping.

lmp: Wowèe a vʉshì ye, njobè' wowèe a m rìŋ enɛ muu anà à kwe.
eng: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

lmp: Geewa'a, e koo ye à bò, a laa enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì, muu."
eng: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, Child, arise!

lmp: E kʉti ntèe, a nati mbekì njà' mò'sir. Jisòs à laa enɛ a fa muu anà yuu tɛ e ye.
eng: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

lmp: Yì ma ba yì ta a bɛɛŋgèr sê. Jisòs à laa enɛ wowèe a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' yuu ce yi koni anà ka'.
eng: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

lmp: Jisòs à m kɛ' yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ a fa wowèe ŋger à rfʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe, ker ba à rgèe tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se.
eng: He called the twelve together, and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

lmp: E m tuu wowèe enɛ wowèe a du fe'shi àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, ker gee tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se.
eng: He sent them forth to preach the Kingdom of God, and to heal the sick.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wêe ce dù, ŋwɛ̀ fa lòr yuu mo' ka', ka' mbàŋ, ka' bàa, ka' brɛ̂d, ka' mbàa, ka' cɛ̀' ɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ fa lòr ka'.
eng: He said to them, Take nothing for your journey--neither staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money; neither have two coats apiece.

lmp: Wèe à ka' du niŋ ka' mbe ndàp ce efɛ, wèe ku cu ba mbo, nati ba embo ka' du à rla' mo'.
eng: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

lmp: Fàdì' ce bèe a ka' tɛ koni wèe ka', wèe kashì nfʉ̀nfʉ efa wêe mkùu à nfè' ce wèe ce lò, à rdùŋshi enɛ wowèe a gèe yuu bebep."
eng: As many as don't receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.

lmp: Wowèe a natì a du à bbu' mla' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ, a ce gèe ŋgâa byaŋ a ce kè'se à bdì' wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a m ce dù.
eng: They departed, and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News, and healing everywhere.

lmp: Hɛròd ce e m ce sa' ŋgôŋ Galèlê, à m yu' buu ce vi m ce koni na bfee vi jep ye sê, njobè' bèe mo' a m ce làa enɛ Jôn à fʉʉ efa rkwe,
eng: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

lmp: bèe mo' a ce làa yap enɛ Àlajà à ker nyɛɛ, bèe mo' a ker ce làa yap enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ mò' elûuŋgòŋ à fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

lmp: Hɛròd à laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m tee tu ese Jôn. Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ ka' ce yu' ku' buu àmbò ye nà yu ba nda?" E ka' làa wa'a, a ce ghèter à ryɛ ye sê.
eng: Herod said, John I beheaded, but who is this, about whom I hear such things? He sought to see him.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a ka' kʉti a suŋ ye buu wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a gèe. E lor wowèe a wowèe a lɛ'sì nyor a du à rla' mo' ce a ce too enɛ Bɛ̀rsaidà.
eng: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them, and withdrew apart to a deserted place of a city called Bethsaida.

lmp: Bèe magòr a ka' yu' enɛ e dù àfo, a du a yê mbùu, e konì wowèe, a suŋ wowèe àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, a gee bèe ce a m ce yaŋ a ke'sè.
eng: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, and spoke to them of the Kingdom of God, and he cured those who needed healing.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' kɛ̀' ce coo, bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ a vʉ a yɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Làa tɛ bèe ca a duse à mla' ce mi yu àtʉtʉ, ker ba à mla' ce mi yu à mŋkʉ̀, yɛ enɛ àde' à konì dì' rnòŋ, ker koni yuu ye foŋ lɛ, njobè' sèe yu ànjìsàp efa mla'."
eng: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came, and said to him, Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms, and lodge, and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa wowèe yuu tɛ a ye." Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr ku tʉr ba mntu' brɛ̂d vi tâ, ba nca yi baa. Banɛ wèr du yuu byee nè ku' bèe ca wɛɛwɛ a?"
eng: But he said to them, You give them something to eat. They said, We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù ce a m ba àfo a m ba àmbò ncʉ̀kì tâ. Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Làa nè tɛ wowèe a cute à nshè à bkʉr à bkʉr tɛ bèe a ba mbe kʉr e mo'sir àmbò bèe mta wa'a."
eng: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.

lmp: Wowèe a gee wa'a, bèe wɛɛwɛ a cutè à nshè.
eng: They did so, and made them all sit down.

lmp: Jisòs à lor brɛ̂d ta ba nca baa ca, a ke' mbe bùu, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi, a fa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ a gapshi nè bèe anà.
eng: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, and broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ye a yu', ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a baashì bbɛbɛ' ce vi m bɛti, vi ruu à mŋkàa ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: They ate, and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mò', Jisòs à ce gèe rloo mimŋgi', ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ba a ye. E bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ku' bèe ce a ke vʉ̀ na, a ke làa enɛ m yu nda?"
eng: It happened, as he was praying alone, that the disciples were with him, and he asked them, Who do the multitudes say that I am?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ à yu Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe, bèe mo' enɛ à yu Àlajà, bèe mo' enɛ à yu mò' efa ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ elûuŋgòŋ ce e fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: They answered, 'John the Baptizer,' but others say, 'Elijah,' and others, that one of the old prophets is risen again.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yi yu yi kɛ àmbò wèe? Wèe ce làa ye weenɛ m yu nda?" Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ Krâis yì Nyʉ̀."
eng: He said to them, But who do you say that I am? Peter answered, The Christ of God.

lmp: E ciisì nè wowèe tatap sê, enɛ wowèe a fa suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka',
eng: But he warned them, and commanded them to tell this to no one,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kù yɛ ŋgɛ' gòr sê, tɛ bleebèe ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a kani ye, a be yʉ ye, mnòŋ vi ba btaar, tɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: saying, The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce kòŋ à rvʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu, banɛ ŋgàŋ kani yì nyor, byɛ' yi kìntaa à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, ce vʉ fa mɛ̂ mbùu,
eng: He said to all, If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

lmp: njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rboŋshi li ryòŋ banɛ ŋgàŋ be bɛ li, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ boŋshi li ryòŋ ka', njo' mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni li.
eng: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake, the same will save it.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ konì ba njɛ̀ɛ sɛ' kɛ, ce e ka' tʉr buu enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ, lo bɛ li ryòŋ?
eng: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce rìtu yi ce koo ye nè mɛ̀, ker ba nè wa blàa, banɛ rìtu yi be koo Muu Ŋwɛ̀ nè ye foŋ, à nfè' ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kè vʉ̀ nè yi fòo-ŋwɛ̀, ba fòo yì Tâ, ker ba fòo bcìndap Nyʉ̂ brara.
eng: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed, when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe yuu mini enɛ bèe mo' a tɛɛ mbena ce rkwe li be jòo wowèe ka', tɛ wowèe a cu, caar yɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here, who will in no way taste of death, until they see the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi caa àmbò waami wa'a, kɛ' e nyʉ̀ ce Jisòs à m làa buu ca, e lor Pità ba Jôn ba Jɛ̂ms, a du a wowèe mbe rtùu à rgèe rloo.
eng: It happened about eight days after these sayings, that he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

lmp: E ka' ce loo, vi bsii vi kupsè a ba à njɛ̂ɛ jɛɛ, vi bcɛ̀' vi fʉp a ce là'ŋger.
eng: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

lmp: Ka' cu mmbaŋrù mo' a baa a ce de' a Jisòs. Mmbaŋrù ca à m ba Musìs ba Àlajà.
eng: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

lmp: Wowèe a m nyɛɛ nè fòo-ŋwɛ̀ a ce de' a Jisòs àmbò li rkwe ce yi m ba enɛ e be kwe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, mìsi li rfà'.
eng: who appeared in glory, and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

lmp: Mmirlò mi m ce koo Pità ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ba nà, a ka' waŋ wowèe efa mmìr bòŋboŋ, a yɛ fôo Jisòs, a yɛ mmbaŋrù a baa cà àmbò a tɛɛ a Jisòs.
eng: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù ca a ka' mà'shi Jisòs ce dù, Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Masà, yi bòŋ àmbò sèe yu àfa na. Mà'shi tɛ wèr ba'ri btàp vî btaar, tɛ mò' ba yo, mo' ba yì Musìs, tɛ mo' ba yì Àlajà." E m làa wa'a, a riŋ yuu ce e m ce làa ka'.
eng: It happened, as they were parting from him, that Peter said to Jesus, Master, it is good for us to be here. Let's make three tents: one for you, and one for Moses, and one for Elijah, not knowing what he said.

lmp: E ka' kù bii ce làa, mmbà' vi nyɛɛ, a ce cete wowèe, vi ka' ce cete wowèe wa'a, wowèe a wɛp sê.
eng: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

lmp: Njèndoŋ à laa embe mʉ̀ mmbà' ca enɛ̂, "Cena yu muu wà. A ye ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m ce. Ce yu' nè yuu ce e ce làa."
eng: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!

lmp: Njèndoŋ ca à ka' làa mìsi wɛɛ, wowèe a ka' kè' a ku yɛ Jisòs mimŋgi'. Wowèe a m suŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' yuu ce wowèe a m yɛ nà ka'.
eng: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa wowèe a suu embe rtùu, ku' bèe a du à ryɛ ye.
eng: It happened on the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, that a great multitude met him.

lmp: Ka' cu, ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe anà à fuŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, m ce bu' mmbo nè wɛ̀ enɛ à fyɛ' muu wà ca. Ku ba muu ce m tʉr cà'cà'.
eng: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only child.

lmp: Yʉ' mo' yi ke lò niŋ njep ye, koo ye, e war, yʉ' anà yi ma' ye à nshè, e bʉʉŋgèr, bdʉdʉ' vi ce fʉʉ ye ekù cùu. Yʉ' anà yi ke gèe wa'a, e sɛ sê, yi ce kòŋ à rmà'shi ye ka'.
eng: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams, and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

lmp: Mɛ̀ mʉ bu' mmbo nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu enɛ wowèe a fʉr yʉ' anà enjep ye, wowèe a mòo à rfʉr yi làr."
eng: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn't.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Haba! Bèe elùuni ce wèe buu rbyemì, a beesi mini tʉtʉ̀ŋ na. M be cu wèe sèe, kur ntee nè wèe dù bà' fɛ? Vʉ̀ nè muu wò mbena."
eng: Jesus answered, Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.

lmp: Muu anà à ka' ce vʉ̀, nyʉ̀rkà' anà à ma' ye à nshè, e bʉʉŋgèr. Jisòs à lapnì yʉ' bebep anà a gee muu anà à lûŋ, e kʉsì ye nè yì tâ.
eng: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, and healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê, à ryɛ ku' ŋger Nyʉ̀ ca. Wowèe a ka' ce bɛ̀ɛŋger wa'a, Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂,
eng: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

lmp: "Mʉ̀' nè wee btù', yu' yuu ce m ce suŋ wèe na bòŋboŋ. A be lòr Muu Ŋwɛ̀ fa mbà mmbo bèe."
eng: Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.

lmp: Geewa'a, wowèe a m rìŋ yuu ce e m làa anà ka'. A m sʉ̀ti mbùu efa yuu ce e m làa anà ese wowèe fà dì' wowèe a bo rìŋ yi ka'. Wowèe a wɛp à rbipshi yuu kuu yuu ce e m làa anà.
eng: But they didn't understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a m kɛ̀' a ce sɛr mnsɛr enɛ ŋwɛ̀ efa wâp mʉ ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr a nda lɛ.
eng: There arose an argument among them about which of them was the greatest.

lmp: Jisòs à riŋ yuu ce wowèe a m ce kwà'shi, a koo mʉ ghàrŋwɛ̀ a tɛr a yê geŋ,
eng: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni muu ghàrŋwɛ̀ àmbò ca a mɛ̂ rlii, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni mɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀. Yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' sê a wêe mʉ wɛɛwɛ yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr."
eng: and said to them, Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.

lmp: Jôn à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Masà, wèr à yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' e ce fʉr yʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe a wɛ̂ rlii, wèr à laa nè ye enɛ e fa kèr gèe wa' ka' njobè' e yu mò' efa sêe mʉ ka'."
eng: John answered, Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn't follow with us.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèe fa làa enɛ ŋgàŋ borni ka' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ba yè ŋwɛ̀ bbàa ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu yè ŋwɛ̀."
eng: Jesus said to him, Don't forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.

lmp: Nfè' ce a be lòr Jisòs dù àgho mbe bùu à ka' ghɛɛ, e kur ntee a nati a ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem,

lmp: E m tuu bèe mo' entombì. Wowèe a du a niŋ à rla' mô' à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà tɛ a bo fyɛ' dì', kupshi buu nè ye.
eng: and sent messengers before his face. They went, and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

lmp: Geewa'a, bêe à ŋgòŋ anà a m kani à rkoni ye njobè' e m ce vʉ̀ à rcàa dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: They didn't receive him, because he was traveling with his face set towards Jerusalem.

lmp: Jɛms ba Jôn ce ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a ka' yɛ ca, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, â kòŋ enɛ wèr laa tɛ mor yi suu embe bùu, tòo wowèe tɛ a kweŋger a?"
eng: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky, and destroy them, just as Elijah did?

lmp: Jisòs à karsì nyor a lapni wowèe,
eng: But he turned and rebuked them, You don't know of what kind of spirit you are.

lmp: a wowèe a natì a du à rla' jɛɛ.
eng: For the Son of Man didn't come to destroy men's lives, but to save them. They went to another village.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce dù, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à yɛ Jisòs a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ce dù ba fɛ, banɛ m be kù ba fa wɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Bsìi vi tʉr bto, bsiŋ vi tʉr mndap, Muu Ŋwɛ̀ à ke' tʉr dì' ce àde' e lɛ yi tu ka'."
eng: Jesus said to him, The foxes have holes, and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.

lmp: E m làa nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ mbùu." Ŋwɛ̀ anà à beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, bè ma'shi tɛ m du tuŋ yà ta wɛɛ."
eng: He said to another, Follow me! But he said, Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ, "Mà'shi tɛ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe a tuŋ wap bgʉ̂ʉ bèe. Dù yo du fe'shi kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ nè bèe."
eng: But Jesus said to him, Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ye ye à ker laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, m be dù a wɛ̂ mbùu. Kù ma'shi tɛ m du dàasi bèe embe mɛ̂ ndàp wɛɛ."
eng: Another also said, I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor soo kɛ' rfà', ker ce kè' mbenjì, banɛ ŋgàŋ à ghɛɛte à rgèe rfà' ce li kùu kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: But Jesus said to him, No one, having put his hand to the plow, and looking back, is fit for the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Ca yi ka' mì wɛɛ, Tata à ce ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu mò', bèe ncòp-baa-à- msàambâ, a tuu wowèe a baa a baa enɛ a du entombì nè ye, du du à mla' wɛɛwɛ ker ba à bdì' wɛɛwɛ ce e m ba à rdù àfo.
eng: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place, where he was about to come.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Buu à bi à mŋkʉ̀ gòr, ŋgâa rkep a ba mʉcàr. Banɛ wèe loo nè Tàr ce e tʉr ŋkʉ̀ enɛ e tuusi ŋgâa mfà' tɛ a du kep yì buu efa mŋkʉ̀.
eng: Then he said to them, The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

lmp: Dù nè! M ce tuu wèe tɛ wèe du ba àmbò njèe à mʉ̀ bkuura.
eng: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fa lòr posà, kɛ̀ bàa, kɛ̀ blaba' ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ fa cà'ni ŋwɛ̀ à nduunjì ka'.
eng: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

lmp: Wèe à ka' du ba', ndap ce wèe à ka' niŋ mbo, wèe kɛ' laa weenɛ̂, "Cumʉnyaŋ ba mbe ndàp na."
eng: Into whatever house you enter, first say, 'Peace be to this house.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ cumʉnyaŋ à ka' ba mbe ndàp anà banɛ yè cumʉnyaŋ be dù nè ŋgàŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ cumʉnyaŋ à ka' tɛ ba mbo ka', yè cumʉnyaŋ kʉtì nè wèe.
eng: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

lmp: Kù cu nè ba mbe ndàp anà, ce ye ker ce no njɛ̀ɛ kɛ ce a ka' fa wèe, njobè' yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ a la' ŋwɛ̀ rfà'. Wèe fa lò embe ndàp mò' dù mbe mò' ka'.
eng: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don't go from house to house.

lmp: Wèe à ka' du niŋ à rla' mo', kɛ̀ yu mbe lî fɛ ɛ̀, bêe àfo a ka' koni wèe, wèe ye yuu ce a ka' fa wèe.
eng: Into whatever city you enter, and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

lmp: Gèe nè tɛ ŋgâa byâŋ àfo a ke'se, laa nè nè bèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi vʉ̀, a ba àtʉtʉ nè wèe."
eng: Heal the sick who are therein, and tell them, 'The Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

lmp: Wèe à ka' niŋ à rla', kɛ̀ yu ba lî fɛ, a ka' tɛ koni wèe ka', wèe du à btase à mʉ̀ mla' anà laa enɛ̂,
eng: But into whatever city you enter, and they don't receive you, go out into its streets and say,

lmp: "Wèr ce kashi nfʉ̀nfʉ ce wèr à koo à mkùu fa wêe là' na, à rdùŋshi enɛ wèe à gèe yuu bebep. Ka' yi yu wa'a, rìŋ nè enɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi vʉ̀ àtʉtʉ."
eng: Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that the Kingdom of God has come near to you.'

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ be kè ba à nòŋ anà tɛ ŋgɛ' yì bêe à rla' Sodòm ba àndèe nè ŋgɛ' yì bêe à rla' anà.
eng: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

lmp: "Ndòo à co' wèe ce wèe yu bêe à rla' Kòrasìn, ndòo à co' wèe ce wèe yu bêe à rla' Bɛ̀rsaidà njobè' a m ba gee buu bghagha' ce a m gèe fa wêe mʉ nà ba à rla' Tayà, ker ba à rla' Sidòn bêe àfo a m ba nè kupse e sese', a ma' bcɛ̀' njì rkwe, a yo' bʉ à nyòr, a cute àgho.
eng: Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

lmp: Bèe ncòp-baa-à-msàamba cà a du a kʉti nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀ a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mnyʉ̂mkà' foŋ a yu'ni nè wèr njo' lo rlii."
eng: The seventy returned with joy, saying, Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ mʉ yɛ àmbò Satàn à gwè embe bùu àmbò mbèŋ à bàp wa'a.
eng: He said to them, I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

lmp: Yɛ̂, mɛ̀ fa wèe ŋger à rnyɛ̀ŋshi mnyo ba mnyobsaa, a fa wèe ŋger mbendù ŋwɛ̀ bbàa. Àde' yuu mo' yi joo wèe ka'.
eng: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe fa ce lu'shi enɛ mnyʉ̂mkà' vi yu'ni nè wèe ka', wèe lu'shi ba njobè' a saŋ me mlii mbe bùu."
eng: Nevertheless, don't rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà Yʉ' Rara yi gee Jisòs à ce lu'shi sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Tàr, Tata ce e tʉr rbuu ba nshe, m ce yòŋshi wɛ̀ njobè' wɛ̀ sʉ̀ti buu ca ese ŋgâa bfee, ba bèe ce a rìŋ buu, a duŋshi vi ba nè boo bkɛ'. Ɛ̀no Tàr, ca yu ba yuu ce wɛ̀ m ce yu' rbòŋ à rgèe."
eng: In that same hour Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

lmp: "Yà ta à fa buu wɛɛwɛ mba mɛ̂ mmbò. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce muu yu caa efa Tàr ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce Tàr yu caa efa muu ker ba bèe ce muu à kòŋ à rdùŋshi ye nè wowèe ka'."
eng: Turning to the disciples, he said, All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a karsi nyor a laa ca ba nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu cà'cà'. E m làa nè wowèe à bsʉ̀ti enɛ̂, "Mbôŋtu mi yu nè bèe ce a ce yɛ buu ce wèe ce yɛ na.
eng: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ magòr ba bkʉʉ magòr a m ce kòŋ à ryɛ buu ce wèe ce yɛ na, a yɛ ka', a koŋ à ryu' buu ce wèe ce yu' na, a yu' ka'."
eng: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn't see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn't hear them.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'ni mncir mò' à nàti mbekì à rmòoshi Jisòs, a bipshi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, yuu ce àde' m gee ka' koni ryòŋ ce nfesè a kɛ?"
eng: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe ŋwâ' mncir enɛ kɛ? Wɛ ke bè' mbo enɛ kɛ?"
eng: He said to him, What is written in the law? How do you read it?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Kòŋ Tata ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀ nè yo ntee-ŋwɛ̀, ba nè lo ryòŋ-ŋwɛ̀, ba nè yo ŋger wɛɛwɛ, ba nè wo bfee wɛɛwɛ, ker koŋ nfʉrò àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ yò nyor."
eng: He answered, You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ bèesi yɛɛnì. Gèe wa'a tɛ à bo cu nfesè."
eng: He said to him, You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà a m ce kòŋ enɛ tɛ bèe a riŋ enɛ yuu ce e bipshi anà yi yu yɛɛnì, a bipshi nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Nfʉrà yu ba nda sê?"
eng: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, Who is my neighbor?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rikù, a ka' bà' à nduunjì, a gwe mbe mmbo ŋgâa byɛ̀ɛ. Ŋgâa byɛ̀ɛ anà a fapshì buu ese ye wɛɛwɛ, a lip ye, a caŋse a duse, e noŋ mbo a ba yî ŋkwe.
eng: Jesus answered, A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì mò' à lo a ce sùu njep nduunjì anà à nfè' anà foŋ, a ka' yɛ ye, a lɛ' yi yu a caa a dû.
eng: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe ntɛ̀' Lɛvì ye ye à ka' vʉ̀ bà' mbo yɛ ye, a lɛ' a caa a dû.
eng: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place, and saw him, passed by on the other side.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà ce e m ce dù à mbèp anà foŋ à vʉ a bʉʉ a yê ndù, a ka' yɛ àmbò e nòŋ, nse yi koo ye.
eng: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

lmp: E du a su'si vi mnfur nè mrù', a fa mcɛ̀p mbo, a kur. A ka' kur, a ko'si ye mbe yì jàaki', a lor a du àgho mbe hòtɛ̂l, a ke'ni ye.
eng: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, and brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, e fʉr mbàa baa, a fa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce fà' mbo, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Kè'ni ye bòŋboŋ, ka' ba enɛ mbàa ca yi sɛ̀, wɛ̀ kyesè mbàa mo', banɛ m be kʉti tɛ m kʉʉsi yi nè wɛ̀."
eng: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, and gave them to the host, and said to him, 'Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.'

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ efa bèe a mntaar ca ce à ce kwà'shi enɛ e m ba nfʉr nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gwè mbe mmbo byɛ̀ɛ nà à m ba nda?"
eng: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'ni mncir ca à beesì enɛ̂, "Yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e m koosimnse nè ye nà." Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù gee wa' foŋ."
eng: He said, He who showed mercy on him. Then Jesus said to him, Go and do likewise.

lmp: Jisòs ba yi ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' nàti ce dù, e du a ba' à rla' mo', njeŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Maatà à konì ye, a niŋ a ye mbe ndàp.
eng: It happened as they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

lmp: E m tʉr nfʉr yì mò' a ce too enɛ Mɛ̀ɛri. Mɛ̀ɛri ca à cu njeptii Tata Jisòs a ce yu'shi buu ce e m ce làa.
eng: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus' feet, and heard his word.

lmp: Maatà à m lɛ̀ ntee ba à rfɛ̀r byee. E vʉ a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Tatâ, nfʉrà à mà'shi mfà' wɛɛwɛ ba mbe mɛ̂ mmbò, wɛ̀ ke' ce lòr à yuu ka' a? Làa nè ye enɛ e vʉ ja' mɛ̀."
eng: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, Lord, don't you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.

lmp: Tata à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Maatà, Maatà, mlù mi ce koo wɛ̀ à buu magòr,
eng: Jesus answered her, Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

lmp: geewa'a, yuu mo' yi yu ce ŋwɛ̀ à ba tʉr. Mɛ̀ɛri à ce yuu bòŋboŋ ce a be kèr koo ese ye ka'."
eng: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mò' Jisòs à ce loo mbe dî' mo', a ka' loo mìsi, ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yɛ'ni wèr à rgèe rloo àmbò Jôn à m yɛ'ni ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu foŋ nà."
eng: It happened, that when he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à ka' ce gèe rloo, wèe laa weenɛ̂, "Tàr, tɛ lo rlii li ba rrara, tɛ yo kʉʉ yi kɛ'.
eng: He said to them, When you pray, say, 'Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on Earth, as it is in heaven.

lmp: Fa wèr byee à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Give us day by day our daily bread.

lmp: Fòosi wèr yèr buu bbebep, njobè' wer wèr e ke fòosi ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e gèe yuu bebep nè wèr. Fa mà'shi tɛ rmòoshì li vʉ nè wèr ka'." "
eng: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.'

lmp: E m ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yu nda efa wèe ce e ka' tʉr ŋkar yì, ŋkar yì anà vʉ yɛ ye nè ntee tʉ', laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋkarà, fòosi mɛ̀ mntu' baa btaar,
eng: He said to them, Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight, and tell him, 'Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

lmp: njobè' ŋkarà mò' ce e ce càa càa a niŋ mɛ̀, mɛ̀ tʉr yuu ce m tar ye àgho ka',"
eng: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,'

lmp: ŋgàŋ beesi embe ndàp enɛ̂, "Fa fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ka', mɛ̀ li' ya kèŋ wɛɛ, wèr boo wa wèe à nòŋte, àde' m ker nati mbekì tɛ m bo fa yuu mo' nè wɛ̀ ka'."
eng: and he from within will answer and say, 'Don't bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can't get up and give it to you'?

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋgàŋ à ka' tɛ nàti mbekì fa nè ye njobè' e yu ŋkar yì ka', banɛ e be nàti mbekì fa ye yuu wɛɛwɛ ce e ce ròo njobè' e làa a tambʉ.
eng: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

lmp: Banɛ m ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe bipshi tɛ a bo fa nè wèe. Ròo nè tɛ wèe bo yɛ. Kùushi nè tɛ a bo mʉ̀' kèŋ nè wèe.
eng: I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

lmp: Wà' muu ka' loo rbùuŋgʉp, e fa ye ba ŋgaa a?
eng: Or if he asks for an egg, he won't give him a scorpion, will he?

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, à ka' riŋ à rfa buu bbòŋboŋ nè boo wee, yi ba yi kɛ àmbò yè Ta embe bùu. Mbò e be fa Yʉ' Rara nè bèe ce a loo enɛ e fa wowèe a?"
eng: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?

lmp: Jisòs à m ce fʉr yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' ce yi m gèe ŋwɛ̀ mò' e ce làa ka'. Yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' anà yi ka' fʉʉ, ŋwɛ̀ anà à kɛ' a ce làa, ku' bèe ce a m ba àfo a bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. It happened, when the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

lmp: Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe ba à ŋger Bɛsɛbùl ce e yu ŋkʉʉ byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà'."
eng: But some of them said, He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.

lmp: Bèe mo' a mooshì ye, a laa nè ye enɛ e duŋshi wowèe ncòo embe bùu.
eng: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

lmp: Jisòs à ku riŋ yuu ce wowèe a m ce kwà'shi, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "To' yi ka' gapni, ke' ba cûu mo'sir ka', banɛ to' anà yi be sà'ŋger. Ndap ka' gapni, ke' ba cûu mo'sir ka', banɛ ndap anà be gwè.
eng: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

lmp: Banɛ Satàn ka' ce fʉr Satàn enjep bèe banɛ ŋgàpni yi yu nje yê nyòr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, àde' yi to' yi tɛɛ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? M ce làa wa'a njobè' wèe à làa enɛ m ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe ba à ŋger Bɛsɛbùl.
eng: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

lmp: M ka' ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enjep bèe ba à ŋger Bɛsɛbùl banɛ bèe wee a ke fʉr yap byʉ' anà ba à ŋger nda? Banɛ be kù sa' ba yè bèe sa' wèe.
eng: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore will they be your judges.

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ m ce fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' ca wa'a, ntubo Nyʉ̀ ba njo, banɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi vʉ̀ nè wèe.
eng: But if I by the finger of God cast out demons, then the Kingdom of God has come to you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ŋger ce e tʉr buu bìr yɛɛnì à ka' ce kè'ni yì ndap, banɛ yuu mo' embe yê ndàp yi be dù à yuu ka'.
eng: When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

lmp: Yʉ' bebep yi ke fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀, kashi à ŋgôŋ yuur à rròo dî' rlʉ̀shì. Yi ka' roo yɛ ka', yi laa enɛ̂, "M be kʉti mbe ndàp ce mɛ̀ m fʉʉ embo nà."
eng: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest, and finding none, he says, 'I will turn back to my house from which I came out.'

lmp: Yi ce kʉti yɛ àmbò a yɛr ndap, a kupshi e ce raa.
eng: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

lmp: Yi yɛ wa'a, ker du vʉ nè byʉ' mmo' vi sàambâ, ce vi bep a caa yi, a wowèe a niŋ cu mbo, ŋgàŋ misì bep caa àmbò e m ba entombì nà."
eng: Then he goes, and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca wa'a, njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à laa efa mʉ̀ ku' bèe ca enɛ̂, "Rbôŋtu li yu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m bi wɛ̀, a nyoŋsi wɛ̀."
eng: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice, and said to him, Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Mbôŋtu mi yu ba nè bèe ce a ce yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, ce gèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce làa."
