eng: But he said, On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.

lmp: Ku' bèe a ka' vʉ̀ gòr, e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋgʉ̀ bèe ca yu ŋgʉ̀ bsàrbuu. Wowèe a ce ròo enɛ a duŋshi wowèe ncòo, geewa'a, a be dùŋshi wowèe ncòo mò' càa efa yì Jonà ka'.
eng: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah, the prophet.

lmp: Àmbò Jonà à m ba ncòo nè bêe à to' Nenɛvì nà, Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ye ye be ba ncòo nè ŋgʉ̀ bêe sè'ni na.
eng: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so will also the Son of Man be to this generation.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋkʉʉ embà mbùu ŋgòŋ, be kè nàti tɛɛ à nòŋ mnsa', làa enɛ ŋgʉ̀ bèe yî sè'ni na à gèe yuu bebep njobè' e m vʉ̀ yi ba à njìsàp sê, à ryu' blàa bfee ce Solomʉ̀n à m ce làa. Yɛ nè! Yuu mo' yi yu mbena sè'ni ce yi càa Solomʉ̀n.
eng: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation, and will condemn them: for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

lmp: Bêe à rla' Nenɛvì a be kè nàti tɛɛ à nôŋ mnsa', làa enɛ a ŋgʉ̀ bèe yî sè'ni à gèe yuu bebep njobè' Jonà à m fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wowèe, wowèe a kupse a ma' yàp buu bbebep. Yɛ nè! Yuu mo' yi yu mbena sè'ni na ce yi càa Jonà.
eng: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it: for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

lmp: "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ cʉ' lâm, tɛr ba mbe dì' ce bèe a be buu efa ryɛ kɛ̀ lor ghee kʉpshi àgho ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' cʉ' lâm, banɛ e be tɛr ba mbe tɛbùr tɛ bèe ce a ce niŋ mbe ndàp a bo yɛ àmbò ndap ce raa.
eng: No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

lmp: E ka' làa mìsi, ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi mò' à be ye enɛ a ye a du yeŋger. E du a niŋ mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ anà a cu à nshè a ye a bo yeŋger.
eng: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in, and sat at the table.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi anà à ka' yɛ enɛ Jisòs à ba su'si mmbo a ka' kɛ' a ce yeŋger ka', e bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

lmp: Tata à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Bèe Farìsi câ, wêe ke sù'si mndoŋ ba bkaŋ embe ndù, a fyɛ' wèe enjep mʉ, wee mntee vi ruu nè mkwà'shì ce enɛ wèe à ba ce koo buu ese bèe à ŋger, ker ba bsàrbuu.
eng: The Lord said to him, Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

lmp: Blʉr câ, mbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu embe ndù, ku ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu anà enjep mʉ foŋ a?
eng: You foolish ones, didn't he who made the outside make the inside also?

lmp: Wèe lor buu enjep mʉ, gàpshi nè ŋgâa fùp, tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ bo ba brara nè wèe.
eng: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

lmp: "Ndòo à co' wèe, bèe Farìsî, njobè' wee ke fa ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa rʉ̂ʉ, efa mʉ buu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce a ke lɛ̀ njep njàp, a ma' ŋgêe mini, a koŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Wèe à ba gèe buu ca kèr gèe mmo' ca foŋ.
eng: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and the love of God. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe, bèe Farìsî, njobè' wee ke dù à mndap mloo, koŋ à rcu à mnta' bêe bgòrgòr, wee bà' à ntaa, koŋ enɛ bèe a ce vʉ ce ca'ni wèe.
eng: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues, and the greetings in the marketplaces.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe njobè' wèe yu àmbò mshè ce mi ce yɛɛti ka', bèe a jɛ̀r ce càa mbo, riŋ ka'."
eng: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don't know it.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'ni mncir mò' à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wɛ̀ làa buu ca wa'a a ce cɛp wèr foŋ."
eng: One of the lawyers answered him, Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ndòo à co' wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir foŋ njobè' wee ke lɛ̀ mntɛ̀r ce vi ce rìr sê, mbendù bèe mò'. Wêe ke nàa ntubo la' wowèe à mntɛ̀r anà ka'.
eng: He said, Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won't even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe njobè' wèe ce boo mshè nè ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce à m yʉshi ba wêe btâ, a yʉshi wowèe.
eng: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

lmp: Banɛ wèe à rìŋ, a byemi yuu ce wêe bta a m gèe. Wowèe a m yʉshi ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, wèe à ce boo ye ba mshè.
eng: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

lmp: A mbùu ce bfee Nyʉ̀ vi m làa enɛ̂, "M be tuusi ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ker ba ŋgâa ntuu nè wowèe tɛ wowèe a koo bèe mò' efa wowèe yʉshi, fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe mo' efa wowèe,"
eng: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, 'I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

lmp: tɛ ŋgʉ̀ bêe sè'ni a bo làa yuu kùu ŋgâa ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m yʉshi, kɛ' embe nfè' ce a m gèe ŋgòŋ ca.
eng: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation;

lmp: A be kɛ̀' embe nfè' ce a m yʉ Ɛbɛ̀l dù ba' mbe nfè' ce a m yʉ Sàkàriyà mbetar dî' ntòo rfa ba dî' rara. Ɛ̀no, m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋgʉ̀ bêe sè'ni a be làa yuu kuu buu ca.
eng: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.' Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

lmp: Ndòo à co' wèe ce ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir njobè' wèe à lòr ki ce a ke mʉ̀' ndap bfee, a du àgho. Wèe à niŋ mbo ka', a kani bèe ce a ce ghèter à rniŋ mbo nà efa rdù mbo."
eng: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn't enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' lò embe ndàp anà, bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a kɛ' a ce làa bebep se àmbò ye, a bipshi ku' buu nè ye,
eng: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him;

lmp: a ce kè' enɛ e laa mʉ yuu mo' bebep tɛ a bo koo ye.
eng: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

lmp: Buu ca à ka' koni wa'a, ku' bèe à mncʉ̀kì à mncʉ̀kì, a kaarì a ce nyòrni, a ce nyɛ̀ŋshi bèe mo' nè mkùu. Jisòs à kɛ' entombì a laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nfè' nè yes bèe Farìsi ce yu ŋgâa mbo'ni nà.
eng: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

lmp: Yuu mo' yi yu ce a tɛ'shi, ce yi be kè buu efa ryɛɛti àwaŋ ka'. Yuu mo' yi yu ce a sʉ̀ti, ce bèe a be kè buu efa rrìŋ ka'.
eng: But there is nothing covered up, that will not be revealed, nor hidden, that will not be known.

lmp: Banɛ a be yu' yuu ce wèe à làa nètʉ' ba à mmir waŋ, suŋ yì ce wèe à cete kèŋ a cʉʉni ŋwɛ̀ mbà tù' ba à btu mndap.
eng: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

lmp: Bkar wâ, m ce làa nè wèe mɛnɛ wèe fa wɛp bèe ce a ke yʉ ŋwɛ̀ e kwe wɛɛ, a ker tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe ka' nà ka'.
eng: I tell you, my friends, don't be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

lmp: Ka' nyʉ̀'tu ce yi yu mbe wêe tù ɛ̀, e bè' yi wɛɛwɛ. Banɛ wèe fa wɛp ka' njobè' wèe lùu ntaa à bsii Nyʉ̀, a caa bbe' àŋgoo.
eng: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered. Therefore don't be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

lmp: M ce laa nè wèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' suŋ à bsii bèe enɛ e yu yà ŋwɛ̀, banɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be suŋ àmbò ye foŋ à bsii bcìndap Nyʉ̀.
eng: I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, him will the Son of Man also confess before the angels of God;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ kʉr bèe cà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, làa tɛ nfʉrà gap bti' wèr ye."
eng: One of the multitude said to him, Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ câ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa mɛ̀ ŋger enɛ m sa', kɛ̀ enɛ m gap buu nè wèe à fa nda?"
eng: But he said to him, Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?

lmp: E ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nfè' efa rgani buu. Ryòŋ ŋwɛ̀ li ke ba ku' buu ce ŋwɛ̀ tʉr ka'."
eng: He said to them, Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man's life doesn't consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.

lmp: E ma' ŋgàa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mbàa mò' à m tʉr yi nsuu, byee vi ku' à nsuu anà bòŋboŋ sê.
eng: He spoke a parable to them, saying, The ground of a certain rich man brought forth abundantly.

lmp: E kwa'shì a laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "M be gèe mɛ kɛ? M tʉr dì' ce m be lɛ̀ byee ca wɛɛwɛ ka'."
eng: He reasoned within himself, saying, 'What will I do, because I don't have room to store my crops?'

lmp: E ka' kwà'shi wa' wɛɛ a ker laa enɛ̂, "A yuu ce m be gèe na. M be sà'si wa bcàŋ, sɛɛ vî bgòrgòr, lɛ̀ yà kwaa ba yà buu njo.
eng: He said, 'This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, and build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

lmp: Mɛ̂ gèe wa' wɛɛ, laa nè yà nyor enɛ̂, Wɛ̀ tʉr ku' buu bbòŋboŋ ce à be ye à bfè' àŋgoo sê. Lòr ŋgòŋ àtɛ̀r, yeŋger, noŋger, yu' rbòŋ nè yò nyor."
eng: I will tell my soul, Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, be merry.'

lmp: E ka' ce kwà'shi wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Lʉr câ, m be koo lo ryòŋ nètʉ' e ntìni na, tɛ ku' yò buu ce wɛ̀ kupshi a lɛ na ba vî nda?"
eng: But God said to him, 'You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared--whose will they be?'

lmp: E m ker laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Banɛ m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ mlù mi fa ce koo wèe nè yè nyor enɛ wèe be ye ba kɛ ka', kɛ̀ nè yè nyor enɛ wèe be yar ba kɛ lɛ ka'.
eng: He said to his disciples, Therefore I tell you, don't be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

lmp: Ryôŋ ŋwɛ̀ li càa byee, nyor ŋwɛ̀ à caa bcɛ̀'.
eng: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

lmp: Kwà'shi ka nè àmbò bkâaŋkò' ce vi ke byè buu ka', kep buu efa mŋkʉ̀ ka', tʉr btàp kɛ̀ bcàŋ ka', geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ ku ce nyaŋ wowèe. Yè ntaa à lùu sê, a caa yì bsiŋ.
eng: Consider the ravens: they don't sow, they don't reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ efa wêe mʉ ce mlù mi ka' ce koo ye, e kyesè nôŋ mo' mbendù vi mnòŋ enjep ŋgòŋ na a nda?
eng: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ àde' wèe gee yuu ce yi ku ba mʉcàr àmbò yì anà ka', mlù mi ka' ce koo wèe à bɛr buu mo' cà njokɛ?
eng: If then you aren't able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

lmp: Kwà'shi ka nè àmbò bfʉ̀lawà vi ke kù'. Vi ke fà' kɛ̀ ba' bcɛ̀' ka', ka' yi yu wa'a, m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ka' bcɛ̀' kʉʉ ce Solomʉ̀n à m ce yar ce vi m bòŋ se nà, mo' yi m bòŋ àmbò fʉ̀lawà ka'.
eng: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don't toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ka' ce susi mjɛɛ efa rìŋ, ce mi yɛɛti ntìni, e fʉʉ àyàŋsè, a too njep mor, banɛ e be sùsi yi wèe gòr àmbò kɛ? Le rbyemì li yu mʉcàr.
eng: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists, and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

lmp: Wèe fa ròo ba yuu ce wèe be ye, ba yì ce wèe be no ka'. Fa gèe tɛ mlù mi ce koo wèe ka'.
eng: Don't seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

lmp: Bèe enje jɛɛ ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' a ke dù yap ba àmbùu buu ca, yè Ta à rìŋ enɛ wèe à ba tʉr buu ca.
eng: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

lmp: Banɛ wèe roo ba kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ tɛ e fa buu ca nè wèe foŋ.
eng: But seek God's Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

lmp: "Fa wɛp nè ka', mʉ ya njèe, njobè' yè Ta ce yu' rbòŋ se à rfa wèe kʉʉ anà.
eng: Don't be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father's good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

lmp: Fyèni nè yè buu, lor mbàa efa gho gap nè ŋgâa fùp. Tar nè bposà ce àde' vi bep ka', lɛ̀ nè yè buu ba mbe bùu mbe dì' ce àde' vi du à yuu ka'. Àde' nyɛ̀ɛ ba' mbo ka'. Àde' mfyɛp vi ye ka'.
eng: Sell that which you have, and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don't grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn't fail, where no thief approaches, neither moth destroys.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ fàdì' ce yè buu yu, a fàdì' ce ye ntee yi yu foŋ.
eng: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

lmp: "Cʉʉ nè mŋkànda mbendù bcɛ̀', cʉ' wee blâm, tɛ vi ce raa.
eng: Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

lmp: Pità à laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, à ce mà' ŋgàa ca ba nè wèr kɛ̀ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ?"
eng: Peter said to him, Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?

lmp: Tata à beesì enɛ̂, "Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ mini a ker riŋ buu foŋ sê, yu nda? Yu ŋwɛ̀ ce yì masà à lɛ̀ yì ndap enɛ e ce fyɛ', ce fa byee nè yi ŋgâa mfà' njep nfè'.
eng: The Lord said, Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

lmp: Rbôŋtu li be ba nè ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce yì masà à ka' kʉti, yɛ àmbò e ce gèe li rfà' à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a.
eng: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ masà anà be fa yì buu wɛɛwɛ mbe yê mmbò.
eng: Truly I tell you, that he will set him over all that he has.

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà à ka' laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "Yi be lòr nfè' sê, tɛ yà masà ka' vʉ̀," kɛ' sè'ni ce lìp mmbaŋrù ba bbyèŋge ce a yu ŋgâa mfà', ce ye yì buu, ce no buu, vi ce koo ye,
eng: But if that servant says in his heart, 'My lord delays his coming,' and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink, and to be drunken,

lmp: yì masà be vʉ̀ à nôŋ mo' ce e ce kè' ka', ker ba à njɛ̀ɛ nfè' ce e ba riŋ ka', gwàte ye à btete à btete, fa ye dì' ba à mʉ̀ bèe ce a byemi ka'.
eng: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn't expecting him, and in an hour that he doesn't know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e ka' riŋ yuu ce yì masà ce kòŋ, ke' tami nyor, gee yuu ce yì masà ce kòŋ ka', banɛ a be lìp ye nè mŋgwàa àŋgoo.
eng: That servant, who knew his lord's will, and didn't prepare, nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e ka' tɛ rìŋ yuu ce yì masà ce kòŋ ka', ka' gee yuu mo' ce a ba lìp ye àtu mo, banɛ a be lìp ye nè mŋgwàa mʉcàr. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a ka' fa ye buu gòr, a be kè' enɛ ye ye fa gòr. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a ka' lɛ buu mbe yê mmbò gòr, banɛ a be kè kè' enɛ e fa buu gòr foŋ.
eng: but he who didn't know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whoever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

lmp: "Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ à rmà' mor njep ŋgòŋ, a ce kòŋ mɛnɛ yi ba kɛ̀' war ce she.
eng: I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

lmp: E laa foŋ nè bèe ce a m ba àfo nà enɛ̂, "Wêe ke yɛ àmbò mmbà' vi ko' embà mbùuntii wèe ku laa weenɛ mbèŋ be gwè, mbèŋ ku gwe ghup.
eng: He said to the multitudes also, When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, 'A shower is coming,' and so it happens.

lmp: Fu' yi lò ce ko' embà mbùuŋgòŋ, wèe laa weenɛ ŋgòŋ yi be lùu sê, yi ku luu ghup.
eng: When a south wind blows, you say, 'There will be a scorching heat,' and it happens.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni, wêe rìŋ à rfyɛ' buu, riŋ àmbò ŋgòŋ yi be ba, ker yɛ àmbò rbuu li yu, wèe ku riŋ yuu ce yi be ba. Wèe à ka' ke' riŋ à rfyɛ' buu ce vi ce koni à nfè' yî sè'ni, rìŋ yuu ce yi be ba ka' njokɛ?
eng: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don't interpret this time?

lmp: "Àde' wèe ke' sa' nè wee btu, rìŋ yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì ka' njokɛ?
eng: Why don't you judge for yourselves what is right?

lmp: Yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor wɛ̀ à mnsa', wèe ye ka' ce dù mbe kôr, à ghetèr wèe ye seesi mìsi à nduunjì fà dì' e bo lòr wɛ̀ dù àgho fa nè ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa', tɛ ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa' lor wɛ̀ fa nè ŋwɛ̀ ncir, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ncir fa wɛ̀ mbe shaŋ ka'.
eng: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

lmp: M ce suŋ wɛ̀ enɛ à be kù cu mbe shaŋ anà caar, là' yi mbàa ce yi yu nè wɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ka' fʉʉ embo."
eng: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there, until you have paid the very last penny.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m ba àfo à nfè' ce Jisòs à m ce làa nè kʉr bèe anà, a suŋ Jisòs àmbò bèe mô' à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, ce Pailɛ̀t à m yʉshi, wap blɛɛ vi fiŋshì nyor à mʉ̀ blɛɛ mnyàa ce wowèe a m vʉ̀ àgho, a taŋshì taŋshì àgho nè wowèe.
eng: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans, whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wà' wèe ce kwà'shi weenɛ bèe à ŋgôŋ Galèle ca a m yɛ ŋgɛ' ca wa'a yi ba enɛ wowèe a m ba yap ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a caa bèe wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Galèle a?
eng: Jesus answered them, Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

lmp: Yi yu wa' ka', m ce suŋ wèe enɛ wèe à ka' tɛ kupse, mà' yè buu bbebep ka', banɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ be kweŋger wa' foŋ.
eng: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

lmp: Yi yu yi kɛ àmbò bèe ncòp-waami-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ce ma ŋgʉ̀' ndap mò' ce e Silòm à m kɛ̀ɛti a yʉshi nà? Wà' wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ wowèe a m ba yap ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a caa bèe wɛɛwɛ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a?
eng: Or those eighteen, on whom the tower in Siloam fell, and killed them; do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

lmp: Yi yu wa' ka'. M ce suŋ wèe enɛ wèe à ka' tɛ kupse, mà' yè buu bbebep ka', banɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ be kweŋger wa' foŋ."
eng: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

lmp: E ma' ŋgàa ca nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m tʉr ce fik mbe yê ŋka'. E m nàti a du a ce fyɛ' enɛ yi yʉ lɛ, a ka' fyɛ', yi yʉ ka'.
eng: He spoke this parable. A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it, and found none.

lmp: E laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce fyɛ' yi ŋka' enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, yu sè'ni bfê' btaar àmbò mɛ̀ vʉ̀ a fyɛ' mbe ce ca a yɛ yi yʉ ka'. Gwàr yi, yi ce bepsi nshe ca à cicì njokɛ."
eng: He said to the vine dresser, 'Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down. Why does it waste the soil?'

lmp: E beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Masà, mà'shi tɛ yi ku bè tɛɛ à fè' ca, tɛ m tuŋ bgeŋ efa gho, fa bbàr mbʉ àgho.
eng: He answered, 'Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it, and fertilize it.

lmp: Yi ka' yʉ mbàŋ à fè' e kôo, yi ba yɛɛnì. Yi ka' nè yʉ ka', à gwâr." "
eng: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.'

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, Jisòs à ce yɛ'ni mbe ndàp rloo mò'.
eng: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba mbo ce yʉ' mo' yi m ba njep ye a gee ye e yaŋ à bfè' ncòp-waami-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a gʉ'mi sê, a moo à rnàa nyor mbekì làr.
eng: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years, and she was bent over, and could in no way straighten herself up.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ ye, a kɛ' ye a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀, wɛ̀ lùŋ efa yo yaŋ."
eng: When Jesus saw her, he called her, and said to her, Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a lɛ mi mmbo mbe yê ndù, e ku naa nyor mbekì, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀.
eng: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight, and glorified God.

lmp: Nyor à m bep ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr embe ndàp rloo njobè' Jisòs à m gèe njeŋwɛ̀ anà à ke'sè nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, e laa nè bèe enɛ̂, "Mnòŋ nfà' buu vi yu ntuunfu. Banɛ wèe à ba vʉ̀ à mnòŋ anà tɛ a gee tɛ wèe ke'se, ke' ba enɛ wèe vʉ ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!

lmp: Tata à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa mbo'ni, wà' ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu fa wêe mʉ ce e ke buu efa rfyɛ̀ɛ yi nà' kɛ̀ yi jàaki' embe ŋka' nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ du àgho à rò à rnosì a?
eng: Therefore the Lord answered him, You hypocrites! Doesn't each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath, and lead him away to water?

lmp: Àmbò yi ba ba yɛɛnì enɛ a fyɛ̀ɛshi muu Abràham ca ce Satàn à kur nè yaŋ à bfè' ncòp-waami-à-rrʉ̀ʉ na efa yi yaŋ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ a?"
eng: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham, whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?

lmp: E ka' làa ca, rìtu yi koo bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m bàa ye, bɛr bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu' rbòŋ à buu bbòŋboŋ wɛɛwɛ ce e m gèe.
eng: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed, and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

lmp: Jisòs à làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu àmbò kɛ? Àde' m be'nì yi à kɛ̂ nà?
eng: He said, What is the Kingdom of God like? To what shall I compare it?

lmp: Yi yu àmbò ŋgʉ̀ mostà ce ŋwɛ̀ à m byè mbe yê ŋka', yi lo a ku' a ba à ce, bsiŋ vi ba'rì mndap à mnta' efa gho."
eng: It is like a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and put in his own garden. It grew, and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky lodged in its branches.

lmp: E ker laa enɛ̂, "Àde' m be'nì kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ba à kɛ̂ nà?
eng: Again he said, To what shall I compare the Kingdom of God?

lmp: Yi yu àmbò yes ce njeŋwɛ̀ à m lòr a fe' mkʉ̀ŋ brɛ̂d mŋkâa btaar, a top àgho caar mkʉ̀ŋ anà mi ko'."
eng: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker nati a ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. A ka' ce dù, a ce jɛr à mla' mŋgòrŋgòr ba à mla' mkɛ'kɛ', a ce yɛ'ni bèe.
eng: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wà' ku ba ba bèe mʉcàr ce a be kè lùŋ a? E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: One said to him, Lord, are they few who are saved? He said to them,

lmp: Ghèter nè niŋ à ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' ce yi yu yi'sè, njobè' m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ bèe magòr se a be ghèter à rniŋ, mòo làr.
eng: Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in, and will not be able.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi mo' a ku vʉ à nfè' anà a yɛ Jisòs a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Lô àfa du à dî' jɛɛ njobè' ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd ce tà' à ryʉ wɛ̀."
eng: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, Get out of here, and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Dù nè du suŋ kwɛ̀ɛ anà enɛ m be fʉr byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' enje bèe, gèe tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se ntìni na ker ba àyàŋsè, tʉ̀' mò' e kèr raa, tɛ m misi la rfà'.
eng: He said to them, Go and tell that fox, 'Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

lmp: M be kù ce jɛ̀r ce dù ya yu ntìni na, ba àyàŋsè, ker ba àyàŋsè cà njobè' àde' ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ kwe à dì' mo' jɛɛ caa efa à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ka'.
eng: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can't be that a prophet perish outside of Jerusalem.'

lmp: Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m! Wèe ce wêe ke yʉshi ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, ce tʉʉshi bèe ce a tuu enɛ a vʉ yɛ wèe nè blùr. Yu nfè' sɛ' ce mɛ̀ kòŋ à rbaashi boo wee àmbò ma ŋgʉp e ke ku'ri boo nà, wèe à koŋ ka'.
eng: Jerusalem, Jerusalem, that kills the prophets, and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ mò', Jisòs à du à ryeŋgèr mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ rlii, bèe a ce ker ye bòŋboŋ sê.
eng: It happened, when he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, that they were watching him.

lmp: Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ce bko' vi m koo ye à tɛɛ njeptii Jisòs.
eng: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi anà ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir enɛ̂, "Ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe gee tɛ ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ ke'se nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ yi byemi ka'?"
eng: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?

lmp: Wowèe a laa yuu ka'. Jisòs à koo ŋwɛ̀ anà a gee e ke'sè, a laa nè ye enɛ e dû.
eng: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

lmp: E ka' gèe wa' wɛɛ, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mò' efa wèe à ka' tʉr muu mbaŋrù kɛ̀ nà' ɛ̀, e gwe njep rwee nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, àde' e caasì nfè' efa rfʉr enjo a?"
eng: He answered them, Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn't immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?

lmp: Wowèe a m tʉr yuu làa ka'.
eng: They couldn't answer him regarding these things.

lmp: E ka' yɛ àmbò bèe ce a m be nà a ce taŋni à rcu ba mbe mnta' bbòŋboŋ, e ma' ŋgàa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' be wɛ̀ à Ŋkâ' bgùu, à fa cu ba mbe nta' yî bòŋboŋ ka', njobè' àde' yi ku ba enɛ ŋgàŋ à ba be ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr nè wɛ̀.
eng: When you are invited by anyone to a marriage feast, don't sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

lmp: E m ker laa foŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ba be ye nà enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' fɛr byee vî nèmootì, kɛ̀ vî à mbùuŋkùr ɛ̀, à fa be ba bkar wo kɛ̀ bfʉr wo, kɛ̀ bèe ce wèe wowèe à ràte, kɛ̀ ŋgâa mbàa ce wèe wowèe ce cu à dî' mo'sir ka'. Wɛ̀ ka' be ba wowèe banɛ àde' wowèe foŋ a ku be wɛ̀, tɛ yi ba sè'ni enɛ wowèe a là' yò ntar ce wɛ̀ m tar wowèe àgho nà.
eng: He also said to the one who had invited him, When you make a dinner or a supper, don't call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' ce gèe ŋkà', à be ba ŋgâa fùp, ba bèe ce a kepŋger, ba mntɛ̀ŋ, ba bèe ce a fèp.
eng: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' gee wa' banɛ à be ba ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu njobè' wowèe a tʉr yuu mo' ce àde' a la' wɛ̀ àgho ka'. Nyʉ̀ be kè là' wɛ̀ à nfè' ce bèe ce a yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: and you will be blessed, because they don't have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m cute a sir tɛbùr nà à ka' yu' wa'a, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rbôŋtu li yu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kè ye ŋkà' embe nto' Nyʉ̀ embe bùu."
eng: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, Blessed is he who will feast in the Kingdom of God!

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ce gèe ma njɛ̀ɛ ŋkà' mo' gòr, a be ku' bèe sê.
eng: But he said to him, A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

lmp: Nfè' ŋkà' à ka' ghɛɛ, e tuu yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' enɛ e du laa nè bèe ce e m be nà enɛ wowèe a vʉse, njobè' e fɛr buu ŋkà' a misî.
eng: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, 'Come, for everything is ready now.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à kɛ' a ce suŋ yuu ce e be jepsi ye efa rdù ŋkà' anà. Ŋwɛ̀ entombì à laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ yuu ŋkʉ̀, à ba yì ce m be kù dù ba sè'ni na dù yɛ àmbò ŋkʉ̀ anà yu. Dù laa nè ye enɛ ntee yi fa yaŋ lɛ ye ka'."
eng: They all as one began to make excuses. The first said to him, 'I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.'

lmp: E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Kèr du à mnduunjì à mʉ̀ rla' ker ba à mʉ mnduunjî à mŋkʉ̀, koo bèe à ŋger, tɛ a vʉ̂, tɛ yà ndap bo ruu.
eng: The lord said to the servant, 'Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.'

lmp: Ma kʉr bèe yi m ce jɛ̀r a Jisòs wèe, e karsì nyor a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' vʉ a mɛ̂ mbùu, ke' baa yì ta ba yì mâ, ba ŋgwa yì, ba boo vi, ba bfʉr vi ba bjar vi, ker ba nè yì nyor-ŋwɛ̀ foŋ ka', banɛ àde' ŋgàŋ ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yà buu ka'.
eng: If anyone comes to me, and doesn't disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can't be my disciple.

lmp: Ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà' ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a m ce vʉ̀ àtʉtʉ nè Jisòs à ryu' buu ce e m ce yɛ'ni.
eng: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a kɛ' a ce de'ŋger a ce làa enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a vʉ̀, ŋwɛ̀ ca à konì wowèe, a ce yeŋger a wowèe."
eng: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, Jisòs à ma' ŋgàa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: He told them this parable.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ efa wêe mʉ ce e ka' tʉr njèe rjèe, mò' efa gho bʉ, e ke' ma'shì njèe yî ncòp-bʉ̀'ʉ-à-mmbʉ̀'ʉ à rtùu dù ròo yì ce e bʉ nà, caar yɛ ka', a nda?
eng: Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep, and lost one of them, wouldn't leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness, and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

lmp: E m ker ma' ŋgàa mò' enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m tʉr boo mmbaŋrù a baa.
eng: He said, A certain man had two sons.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' à laa nè yì ta enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, gàp bti' fa wa." E ka' làa wa'a, e lor yì buu a gap nè wowèe.
eng: The younger of them said to his father, 'Father, give me my share of your property.' He divided his livelihood between them.

lmp: Mʉ mnòŋ vi ka' tuuse, ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' à lor buu wɛɛwɛ ce e m tʉr, a du à to' mo' ce yi m ba ànjìsàp sê, a jarsi buu anà àfo à buu bcicì.
eng: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

lmp: E ka' jarsi buu anà wɛɛ, njè à koo à to' anà sê, e ke' tʉr yuu ye ka'.
eng: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

lmp: E du a ce cu a ŋwɛ̀ mô' à to' anà, ŋwɛ̀ anà à tuu ye enɛ e du à mŋkʉ̀ du ce nyaŋ yi ŋkûnyàm.
eng: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

lmp: E m ce kòŋ à rye ka' byee ŋkûnyàm, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ke' fa ye ka'.
eng: He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

lmp: Bfee vi ka' vʉ̀ ye mbo, e laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa mfà' ce yà ta e ke là', ce a ke ye byee vi ce gha' wowèe, a yu bèe a m sɛ', mɛ̀ cu ya mbena ce kwe njè!
eng: But when he came to himself he said, 'How many hired servants of my father's have bread enough to spare, and I'm dying with hunger!

lmp: M be nàti dù yɛ yà tâ, làa nè ye enɛ̂, Yà tâ, mɛ̀ gèe yuu bebep nè Nyʉ̀, ba nè wɛ̀ foŋ,
eng: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in your sight.

lmp: m ker ghɛɛte ce àde' à too mɛ̀ enɛ muu wò ka', lòr mɛ̀ tɛ m ba ba àmbò yò ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò'."
eng: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.'

lmp: E ka' làa nè yì nyor wa' wɛɛ, a nati a du a yɛ yì tâ. A ka' nyɛɛ ànjìsàp, yì ta à yɛ ye, a koosimnse nè ye, a caŋ a baa ye nje nyòr, a nyo'shi ye.
eng: He arose, and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him, and was moved with compassion, and ran, and fell on his neck, and kissed him.

lmp: Wêe mìsi wɛɛ, vʉ nè nà' ce e ruusi, sɛɛ, tɛ sèe ye ce lu'shi,
eng: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let us eat, and celebrate;

lmp: njobè' muu wà ca à m kwe a ker kʉti ntèe, e m bʉ, a ker yɛɛti." Wowèe a ka' gèe wa' wɛɛ, a kɛ' a ce ye ŋkà'.
eng: for this, my son, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.' They began to celebrate.

lmp: "Muu nlee à m ba yi à mŋkʉ̀ à nfè' anà, a ka' vʉ̀ bà' àtʉtʉ, a yu' àmbò bèe a ce bu' mncùu a ce bii bii.
eng: Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

lmp: Yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ sèe gee ŋkà', lu'shi njobè' nfʉrò ca à m kwe a ker kʉti ntèe, e m bʉ a ker yɛɛti.""
eng: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.'

lmp: E m ker ma' ŋgàa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mbàa mò' à m ba a tʉr yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò', bèe a vʉ a suŋ ye enɛ yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà ce jarsi yì buu.
eng: He also said to his disciples, There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

lmp: E kɛ' ye a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yuu ce mɛ̀ yu' a kuu wɛ̀ nà yu ba kɛ? Bè' yà buu wɛɛwɛ, saŋ tɛ m bo rìŋ àmbò vi yu, njobè' à be kèr ba yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ka'."
eng: He called him, and said to him, 'What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ca à laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "Yà masà be fʉr mɛ̀ efa rfà'. M be gèe mɛ kɛ? M tʉr ŋger à rfà' nsuu ka', rìtu yi ce koo mɛ̀ à rloo buu. M be gèe mɛ kɛ?
eng: The manager said within himself, 'What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don't have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

lmp: Banɛ m ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ wèe lor wee bkù' ce vi bep na, koo bkar àgho, e ba à nfè' ce bkù' anà vi ker ba ka', tɛ a bo koni wèe mbe rla' ce a ke cu mbo nfesè.
eng: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' riŋ à rfyɛ' à yuu ce yi yu mʉcàr nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, banɛ àde' e fyɛ' à yî gòr nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ foŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' riŋ à rfyɛ' à yuu ce yi yu mʉcàr ka', banɛ àde' e riŋ à rfyɛ' à yî gòr foŋ ka'.
eng: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

lmp: Banɛ wɛ̀ ka' tɛ rìŋ à rfyɛ' à bkù' ce vi bep na nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ ka', àde' fa nda bkù' mini nè wɛ̀.
eng: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' tɛ fyɛ' à yuu ce yu yî ŋwɛ̀ mò' bòŋboŋ ka', àde' fa nda wɛ̀ yuu ce yu yò nè ŋwɛ̀?
eng: If you have not been faithful in that which is another's, who will give you that which is your own?

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ rfà' fa' nè mmasà bbaa ka'. E ka' gee wa'a, banɛ e be bàa mò', kòŋ mò', yu'ni nè mò', lòr mò' à yuu ka'. Àde' à fa' nè Nyʉ̀ ker fa' nè mbàa ka'."
eng: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one, and love the other; or else he will hold to one, and despise the other. You aren't able to serve God and mammon.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yu' wa'a, a vʉshi ye njobè' wowèe a m kòŋ mbàa sê.
eng: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A wèe bèe ce wèe ce dùŋshi enɛ wèe yu bêe mini, geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ rìŋ yuu ce yi yu njep wêe mntee wɛɛwɛ. Yuu ce bèe a lòr à yuu gòr yu yuu ce Nyʉ̀ bàa.
eng: He said to them, You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

lmp: Buu ce a saŋ mbe ŋwâ' mncir ba mbe mŋwâ' ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ vi m tʉr ŋger a ba' mbe nfè' yì Jôn ŋwɛ̀ bàptir bèe. Kɛ' ese à nfè' anà a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ce ghèter à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ anà à ŋger.
eng: The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of the Kingdom of God is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

lmp: Geewa'a, yi yu àtɛ̀r nè rbuu ba nshe à rmì, nè yì ce enɛ a co' mbʉ̀ nlàa mò' embe Ŋwà' Mncir.
eng: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away, than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' juu ŋgwa yì, lor ŋgwa mò' banɛ e koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' lor njeŋwɛ̀ ce nduu à jùu, banɛ e koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' foŋ.
eng: Everyone who divorces his wife, and marries another, commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ mbàa mò' à m ba ce e m ce sùsi nyor nè bcɛ̂' mbàa, a ce yu' rbòŋ nè yì nyor à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ ma bè'tè yi yu mbe sêe tar, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ à rtuu yɛ wèe njo nà bo tʉr njì ka', tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ à rtuu yɛ wèr mbena bo tʉr njì foŋ ka'."
eng: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that none may cross over from there to us.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mbàa ca à laa enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, banɛ m ce bu' mmbo nè wɛ̀ enɛ à tuu Lasòròs mbe ndàp yà tâ,
eng: He said, 'I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father's house;

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa' ka', ta Abràhâm, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lo ba embà yir, du suŋ wowèe, wowèe a ku kupse ma' yàp buu bbebep."
eng: He said, 'No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.'

lmp: Jisòs à m làa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Buu ce àde' vi gee ŋwɛ̀ gee yuu bebep vi be kù ce vʉ̀, geewa'a, ndòo be co' ŋwɛ̀ ce buu anà vi ka' vʉ njo' ye.
eng: He said to the disciples, It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

lmp: Yi yu àndèe enɛ a lòr ŋgò' lùr cʉʉ ye kù ndoŋ, lor ye ma' njep rdip rgòr, nè yì ce enɛ e gee mò' efa boo bkɛ'kɛ' ca tɛ e gee yuu bebep.
eng: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

lmp: Banɛ wèe ke'ni wee btu. Nfʉrò à ka' gee yuu bebep, à lapnì ye. E ka' kupse, ma' yi yuu bebep anà, à foosì ye.
eng: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

lmp: E ka' gee yuu bebep nè wɛ̀ à nôŋ mo'sir ŋkàrà' sàambâ, ce vʉ̀ ce làa nè wɛ̀ à ŋkàrà' sàamba anà enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ kupse a ma' ya yuu bebep," à foosì ye."
eng: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, 'I repent,' you shall forgive him.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu a laa nè Tata enɛ̂, "Kù'si ler rbyemì."
eng: The apostles said to the Lord, Increase our faith.

lmp: Tata à beesì enɛ̂, "Le rbyemì li ba ba mʉcàr se àmbò ŋgʉ̀ mostà, wèe à ba làa nè ma ce ca enɛ̂, "Co'ti embe na tɛɛ njep rdip rgòr," tɛ yi ku yu'ni nè wèe.
eng: The Lord said, If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, 'Be uprooted, and be planted in the sea,' and it would obey you.

lmp: "Yi ka' ba enɛ mò' efa wèe tʉr ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e ce fà' nsuu, kɛ̀ e ce cìŋ ba njèe nè ye ɛ̀, e ka' kʉti efa mŋkʉ̀, wà' à be làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ cɛrcɛr vʉ cu à nshè yeŋger" a?
eng: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say, when he comes in from the field, 'Come immediately and sit down at the table,'

lmp: Àmbò à be làa nè ye ba enɛ̂, "Fɛ̀r mɛ̀ byee, yar cɛ̂' rfà' caasi byee nè mɛ̀ tɛ m ye no yuu, mɛ̂ mìsi wɛɛ, wɛ wɛ̀ ka' ye yuu, ker no yuu" a?
eng: and will not rather tell him, 'Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me, while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink'?

lmp: Wà' à be yòŋshi ŋwɛ̀ rfà' anà njobè' e ba gee yuu ce wɛ̀ ba laa enɛ e gee a?
eng: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

lmp: Banɛ wee wèe foŋ à ka' gee buu wɛɛwɛ ce a làa enɛ wèe gêe, wèe laa weenɛ̂, "Wèr ku ba ba ŋgâa mfà', wèr à ku gee ba yuu ce wèr à ba gèe." "
eng: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, 'We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.'

lmp: Jisòs à ka' nàti ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a caa njep ndèe ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà ba Galèlê.
eng: It happened as he was on his way to Jerusalem, that he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

lmp: E ka' ce niŋ à mʉ rla' mo', ŋgâa yaŋ msàasì bèe nrʉ̂ʉ a vʉ à ryɛ ye. A ka' vʉ̀, a tɛɛ encàŋ sê,
eng: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

lmp: a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Masà Jisòs, koosimnse nè wèr."
eng: They lifted up their voices, saying, Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!

lmp: E ka' yɛ wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Dù nè du duŋshi wee mnyor nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì." Wowèe a ka' ce dù, a ke'se à nduunjì.
eng: When he saw them, he said to them, Go and show yourselves to the priests. It happened that as they went, they were cleansed.

lmp: Mò' efa wowèe à ka' yɛ enɛ e kè'se, a kʉti a ce yòp mbekì sê, a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀.
eng: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

lmp: E m gwè njeptii Jisòs a yoŋshi ye. Ŋwɛ̀ anà à m ba ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà.
eng: He fell on his face at Jesus' feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

lmp: Jisòs à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Àmbò bèe ce a ba ke'se a ba ba bèe nrʉʉ a? Bèe mbʉ̀'ʉ a yu ba fɛ?
eng: Jesus answered, Weren't the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

lmp: Wà' ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ba ker ba ce àde' e ba vʉ yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ caa efa ŋwɛ̀ nfuu ca ka' a?"
eng: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this stranger?

lmp: E m làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì du yo yu, lo rbyemì li gèe wɛ̀, wɛ̀ ke'sè."
eng: Then he said to him, Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a m bipshi nè Jisòs enɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi be kè vʉ̀ ba à se'kɛ lɛ. Jisòs à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi be vʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce bèe a ce yɛ nè mmir ka'.
eng: Being asked by the Pharisees when the Kingdom of God would come, he answered them, The Kingdom of God doesn't come with observation;

lmp: Àde' bèe a laa enɛ̂, "A yi mbena" na, kɛ̀ enɛ̂, "A yi njena" na ka', njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu fa wêe mʉ."
eng: neither will they say, 'Look, here!' or, 'Look, there!' for behold, the Kingdom of God is within you.

lmp: E m làa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Be kè ba à nfè' mò' tɛ wèe ja'ni mnyor weenɛ wèe à ba yɛ nòŋ mo' efa mnòŋ ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kè vʉ̀ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, kè' yɛ ka'.
eng: He said to the disciples, The days will come, when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

lmp: Bèe a be làa nè wèe enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, a ye njena" na, kɛ̀ enɛ "Yɛ̂, a ye mbena" na. Wèe fa nàti dù a wâp mbùu ka',
eng: They will tell you, 'Look, here!' or 'Look, there!' Don't go away, nor follow after them,

lmp: njobè' nòŋ yî Muu Ŋwɛ̀ yi be ba àmbò mbèŋ ce e ke bàp rbuu li raa, kɛ̂' a mbùu rbuu mo' du ba' à rmo' nà.
eng: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of the one part under the sky, shines to the other part under the sky; so will the Son of Man be in his day.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, e be kɛ̀' entombì yɛ ŋgɛ' gòr sê, tɛ ŋgʉ̀ bêe sè'ni na a kani ye.
eng: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

lmp: Nfè' yì Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be ba àmbò nfè' yì Nowa à m ba nà.
eng: As it happened in the days of Noah, even so will it be also in the days of the Son of Man.

lmp: Bèe a m ce ye buu, a ce no buu, mmbaŋrù a ce lòr bbyèŋge, bbyèŋge a ce dùse bgùu, ku ce gèe wa' caar a ba' nyʉ̀ ce Nowa à m niŋ mbe keŋ, mdip mi ruu à ŋgòŋ a yʉshi wowèe wɛɛwɛ nà.
eng: They ate, they drank, they married, they were given in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came, and destroyed them all.

lmp: Yi m ku ba à nfè' yì Lot wa' foŋ. Bèe a m ce ye buu, a ce no buu, a ce yuu buu, a ce fyèni buu, a ce byè buu, a ce bà'ri mndap.
eng: Likewise, even as it happened in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ ce Lot à m fʉʉ à rla' Sodòm, mor ba blûr mor vi she a suu embe bùu àmbò mbèŋ e ke gwè nà, a yʉshi wowèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky, and destroyed them all.

lmp: Yi be kù ba wa'a, à nòŋ ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be yɛɛti nà.
eng: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

lmp: Ka' ba à nòŋ anà, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba mbe tu ndap, yì buu ba mbe ndàp, e fa kèr sùu embo à rlòr buu anà ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ke ba à mŋkʉ̀ foŋ, e fa kèr kʉti à rlòr yuu mo' embo ka'.
eng: In that day, he who will be on the housetop, and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

lmp: Kuushi nè ŋgwa Lôt.
eng: Remember Lot's wife!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce boŋshi li ryòŋ, banɛ e be bɛ li. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ boŋshi li ryòŋ ka', banɛ e be koni li.
eng: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe enɛ be kè ba nètʉ' anà, tɛ bèe a mmbaa a noŋ mbe bkuu, tɛ a lor mò', ma'shi mò'.
eng: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. The one will be taken, and the other will be left.

lmp: Bbyèŋge a baa a be kè ce gò' baa àbee, tɛ a lor mò', ma'shi mo'.
eng: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken, and the other will be left.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, ca yi be kè koni ba fɛ?" E beesì enɛ̂, "E ke ba fàdì' ce gʉ̂ʉ yuu yi yu, banɛ bjìkaawà vi be kaari àfo."
eng: They, answering, asked him, Where, Lord? He said to them, Where the body is, there will the vultures also be gathered together.

lmp: E m mà' ŋgàa nè wowèe à ryɛ'ni wowèe enɛ wowèe a ba ce loo à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, kè' ce koosi bsɛ̀ à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray, and not give up,

lmp: E m mà' ŋgàa anà enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa' mò' à m ba à rla' mo' a ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ ka', a ker ce lòr bèe à yuu ka'.
eng: saying, There was a judge in a certain city who didn't fear God, and didn't respect man.

lmp: Ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba à rla' anà foŋ. E m ku ce vʉ̀ ce bu' mbo nè ye, ce làa enɛ̂, "Jà' mɛ̀ sa' mnsa' ce wèr yà ŋwɛ̀ bbàa tʉr na, teni mi yɛɛnì."
eng: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, 'Defend me from my adversary!'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa' ca à ku ce kani. A ka' lò a laa nè yì nyor enɛ̂, "Ka' m ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ ka', a ce lòr bèe à yuu ka' wa'a,
eng: He wouldn't for a while, but afterward he said to himself, 'Though I neither fear God, nor respect man,

lmp: àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ca à fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' gòr na, m be sa' mi mnsa', teni mi yɛɛnì, buwa'làr e ku ce vʉ̀, tɛ m misi sɛ̀." "
eng: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.'

lmp: Tata à laa enɛ̂, "Yu' yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ nsa' mnsa' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ mnàŋ na à m làa.
eng: The Lord said, Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

lmp: Mbò Nyʉ̀ be sa' mnsa' tɛ vi ba yɛɛnì à mbèp yì bèe ce a ce war nè ye nèmootì ba nètʉ' foŋ a? Wà' àde' e caasì nfè' efa rteni wap mnsa' a?
eng: Won't God avenge his chosen ones, who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ, e be sa' wap mnsa' tɛ vi ba yɛɛnì à mbèp yàp, sa' vi cɛrcɛr sê. Ka' yi yu wa'a, wà' Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kè vʉ̀, tɛ e yɛ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ ce a byemi, àmbò a tɛɛ tatap a?"
eng: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?

lmp: Jisòs à m ker ma' ŋgàa nè bèe mo' ce a m rìŋ yap enɛ wowèe a yu bêe byɛɛnì, a ce fyɛ' bèe mo' à yuu ka' enɛ̂,
eng: He spoke also this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others.

lmp: "bèe a mmbaa a m dù mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à rgèe rloo, mò' à ba ŋwɛ̀ Farìsî, mò' à ba ŋwɛ̀ ŋkùu mbâa bàrà'.
eng: Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

lmp: Bèe a m vʉ̀ nè bghàrbèe foŋ enɛ Jisòs joo wowèe, ghoni wowèe. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yɛ wa'a, a lapni bèe anà.
eng: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

lmp: Jisòs à kɛ' wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Mà'shi nè tɛ boo ca a vʉ yɛ mɛ̀. Wèe fa jepsi wowèe ka' njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yu ba nè bèe ce a yu àmbò boo ca.
eng: Jesus summoned them, saying, Allow the little children to come to me, and don't hinder them, for the Kingdom of God belongs to such as these.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ koo kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ àmbò muu ŋkɛ' ka' banɛ àde' ŋgàŋ niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ anà ka'."
eng: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn't receive the Kingdom of God like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rsa' mò' à m bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ce mbòŋmboŋ, yuu ce àde' m gee ka' koni ryòŋ ce nfesè yu kɛ?"
eng: A certain ruler asked him, saying, Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Â too mɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ njokɛ? Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ ka', ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ ku ba Nyʉ̀ cà'cà'.
eng: Jesus asked him, Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one--God.

lmp: To à ku riŋ mncir wɛɛwɛ. Fa koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ kɛ̀ nòŋ wèe nduu ŋwɛ̀ ka', fa yʉ ŋwɛ̀ ka', fa yɛ̀ɛ ka', fa tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ ka', yu'ni nè yò ma ba yò tâ."
eng: You know the commandments: 'Don't commit adultery,' 'Don't murder,' 'Don't steal,' 'Don't give false testimony,' 'Honor your father and your mother.'

lmp: E laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ lɛ̀ mncir ca wɛɛwɛ kɛ' à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ba muu ŋkɛ'."
eng: He said, I have observed all these things from my youth up.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu' wa'a, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yuu yi bɛti yi mo'sir ce wɛ̀ ba gèe. Fyèni buu wɛɛwɛ ce a tʉr, lor mbàa efa gho, gapshi nè ŋgâa fùp, tɛ à bo tʉr bkù' mbe bùu. Wɛ̂ gèe wa' wɛɛ, vʉ fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have, and distribute it to the poor. You will have treasure in heaven. Come, follow me.

lmp: E ka' yu' wa'a, nyor à bep ye sê, njobè' e m tʉr ku' buu sê.
eng: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu tatap sê, nè ŋgâa mbàa à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀.
eng: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into the Kingdom of God!

lmp: Yi yu àtɛ̀r nè kàmɛl à rtose nje rlir nsàrà' nè ŋwɛ̀ mbàa à rniŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle's eye, than for a rich man to enter into the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Bèe ce a m yu' yuu ce e m làa na, a bipshì enɛ̂, "Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e luŋ yu ba nda?"
eng: Those who heard it said, Then who can be saved?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Yuu ce yi yu btatap se nè ŋwɛ̀, yi yu àtɛ̀r nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: But he said, The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, wèr à mà'shi yèr buu wɛɛwɛ a vʉ fa wɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Peter said, Look, we have left everything, and followed you.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ma'shi li rla' kɛ̀ ŋgwa yì ɛ̀, kɛ̀ bfʉr vi ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yì ma ba yì ta ɛ̀, kɛ̀ boo vi ɛ̀, njobè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀,
eng: He said to them, Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for the Kingdom of God's sake,

lmp: banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ku' buu se à nfè' e sè'ni na, kèr koni ryòŋ ce nfesè à nfè' ce e bii ka' vʉ̀."
eng: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.

lmp: E lòr bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a lɛ'si nyor a wowèe, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, sèe ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m saŋ àmbò Muu Ŋwɛ̀ nà, vi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: He took the twelve aside, and said to them, Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

lmp: A be fa ye mbe mmbo bèe enje jɛɛ. Wowèe a be jàasi ye, cɛp ye, ce ye nè mce.
eng: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

lmp: A be lìp ye nè byɛɛnsò, yʉ ye, mnòŋ vi ba btaar tɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m rìŋ yuu mo' efa buu ce e m làa anà ka'. A m sʉ̀ti mbùu efa yuu ce e m làa anà ese wowèe, wowèe a ke' riŋ yuu ce e m ce làa anà ka'.
eng: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn't understand the things that were said.

lmp: Jisòs à m lò a ce dù, a ka' bà' àtʉtʉ rla' Jɛ̀rikù, nfèp mò' a cu àwâa nduunjì a ce loo buu.
eng: It happened, as he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

lmp: E ka' yu' àmbò kʉr bèe a ce càa, e bipshì enɛ yu ba kɛ lɛ?
eng: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

lmp: A suŋ ye enɛ̂, "Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t ce càa."
eng: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

lmp: E waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Jisòs, Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè mɛ̀."
eng: He cried out, Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba yap entombì nà, a lapnì ye a laa enɛ e cu nyaŋ. E ker misi yi yu a waa gòr a laa enɛ̂, "Muu Dɛvìd, koosimnse nè mɛ̀."
eng: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, You son of David, have mercy on me!

lmp: Jisòs à tɛɛ, a laa enɛ a vʉ nè ŋwɛ̀ anà fa nè ye. E ka' vʉ̀ bà' àtʉtʉ, e bipshì nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

lmp: "Wɛ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ m gee mɛkɛ nè wɛ̀?" E beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ à gee tɛ m ker yɛ buu."
eng: What do you want me to do? He said, Lord, that I may see again.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ buu, lo rbyemì li gèe wɛ̀, wɛ̀ ke'sè."
eng: Jesus said to him, Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.

lmp: E ku kɛ' a ce yɛ buu, a nati a du a yê mbùu, a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀. Bèe wɛɛwɛ a ka' yɛ, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ foŋ.
eng: Immediately he received his sight, and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

lmp: Jisòs à m niŋ à rla' Jɛ̀rikù a to'ni rla' anà a ce càa.
eng: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba à rla' anà a ce too enɛ Sàkiyòs. E m ba tu nè ŋgâa ŋkùu mbâa bàrà', a tʉr mbàa foŋ sê.
eng: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

lmp: E m ce ghèter à ryɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Jisòs yu, a yɛ ye ka' njobè' e m ba ŋwɛ̂ nlʉ̀'shi, kʉr bèe a tɛ'shì ye.
eng: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn't because of the crowd, because he was short.

lmp: E caŋ a du entombì, a ko' mbe ce Sìkamò enɛ Jisòs e ce càa nà, e bo yɛ.
eng: He ran on ahead, and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was to pass that way.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' vʉ̀ bà' mbe dì' ce ce anà yi m ba, a ke' mbekì, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sàkiyòs, sùu embe ce anà cɛrcɛr, njobè' m be kù nòŋ mbe wɛ̂ ndàp ntìni na."
eng: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.

lmp: Sàkiyòs à suu embe ce anà cɛrcɛr, a koni ye nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a ka' yɛ yuu ce yi m koni na, a kɛ' a ce de'ŋger enɛ, e dù à rnòŋ mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ ŋgèe buu bbebep.
eng: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.

lmp: Sàkiyòs à natì mbekì a laa nè Tata enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yɛ̂, m be to'ni yà buu tìtìyɛɛnì, fa mbèp mò' nè ŋgâa fùp. Ka' ba enɛ mɛ̀ m koo yuu ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ŋger, banɛ m be là' yi yuu ce mɛ̀ m koo anà bkàŋ kyèe."
eng: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ndap ca à lùŋ ntìni njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ca ye ye yu muu Abràham foŋ.
eng: Jesus said to him, Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ à m vʉ̀ à rròo bèe ce a m bʉ, tɛ e bo gèe tɛ wowèe a lûŋ."
eng: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce yu'shi yuu ce Jisòs à m làa na, Jisòs à ker ma' ŋgàa nè wowèe njobè' e m bà' àtʉtʉ rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, wowèe a ce kwà'shi enɛ nfè' be tuuse ka' tɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi kɛ'.
eng: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that the Kingdom of God would be revealed immediately.

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Muu ŋkʉʉ à m dù à to' mo' ànjìsàp sê, enɛ a bo dù ghar ye à ŋkʉʉ tɛ e ka' kʉti.
eng: He said therefore, A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom, and to return.

lmp: E m kɛ' yi ŋgâa mfà' bèe nrʉ̂ʉ, a fa wowèe ncʉ̀kì mò'sir, mò'sir, a laa enɛ̂, "Gèe nè ntaa nè mbàa ca caar tɛ m ke kʉti."
eng: He called ten servants of his, and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, 'Conduct business until I come.'

lmp: Yì bèe à m bàa ye sê, a tuu bèe a yê mbùu enɛ a du laa nè ŋgâa ghar kʉʉ enɛ̂, "Wèr ce kòŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca ba yèr ŋkʉʉ ka'."
eng: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, 'We don't want this man to reign over us.'

lmp: A m ku ghar ye à ŋkʉʉ. E ka' kʉti a kɛ' ŋgâa mfà' ce e m fa mbàa nè wowèe nà, tɛ e bo yɛ enɛ wowèe a m di' gee ntaa nè mbàa anà a ye sɛ' à mbàa sɛ' lɛ.
eng: It happened when he had come back again, having received the kingdom, that he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ embenjì mo à vʉ̂, a laa enɛ̂, "Masà, mɛ̀ gèe ntaa nè ncʉ̀kì ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀ nà, a ye sɛ' à ncʉ̀kì tâ."
eng: The second came, saying, 'Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.' Luke Luêk 19 19 E laa neè ye foñ enáê, "Máè fa wáè ñger aè rsa' mla' taê." So he said to him, 'And you are to be over five cities.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò' à ka' vʉ̀, a laa yi enɛ̂, "Masà, a yo mbàa cà na. Mɛ̀ m ku kur njep kâa cɛ̀', a kupshi a noŋsî.
eng: Another came, saying, 'Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ce wɛp wɛ̀ sê, njobè' à yu ŋwɛ̂ ntatap. Wɛ̂ ke kep yuu ce wɛ̀ m byè ka', kap yuu ce wɛ̀ m ŋwaŋ ka'."
eng: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn't lay down, and reap that which you didn't sow.'

lmp: Yì masà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce mbembep. M be lòr nlàa ce yi fʉʉ ekù wɛ̂ cùu na, sa' wɛ̀ àgho. Wɛ̀ m yi wɛnɛ a mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̂ ntatap ce mɛ ke yɛ yuu ce ŋwɛ̂ jɛɛ à lɛ̀ ku lôr, mɛ̂ yɛ yuu ce ŋwɛ̂ jɛɛ à byè ku kep.
eng: He said to him, 'Out of your own mouth will I judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn't lay down, and reaping that which I didn't sow.

lmp: "M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr yuu, banɛ a be kèr fa ye buu mò'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ tʉr yuu ka', banɛ a be koo ka' mʉ yì ce e tʉr nà ese ye.
eng: For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn't have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a bàa mɛ̀ nà, ce a m ce kòŋ enɛ m ba yàp ŋkʉʉ ka' nà, vʉ̀ nè nè wowèe mbena, shɛshi a mɛ̂ bsii." "
eng: But bring those enemies of mine who didn't want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.'

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa ca mìsi, a nati a ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m entombì nè wowèe.
eng: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

lmp: E ka' dù bà' àtʉtʉ rla' Bɛtɛfɛ̀ ba rla' Bɛtanì àgee rtùu Olèf, a tuu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu bèe à baa, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: It happened, when he drew near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

lmp: "Dù nè nje rla' rkɛ' enje wêe cùu na. Wèe be bà' tɛ wèe yɛ àmbò a cʉʉ muu jàaki' ce ŋwɛ̀ à m be cu mbo ka'. Wee yɛ, wèe fyɛɛ vʉ àgho mbena.
eng: saying, Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, whereon no man ever yet sat. Untie it, and bring it.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' bipshi nè wèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce fyɛ̀ɛ jàaki' anà njokɛ?" wèe suŋ ye enɛ̂, "Tata ce tà' gèe yuu àgho ka' kʉsi." "
eng: If anyone asks you, 'Why are you untying it?' say to him: 'The Lord needs it.'

lmp: Bèe ce e m tuu nà a du a yɛ buu à ku ba àmbò e m suŋ wowèe nà.
eng: Those who were sent went away, and found things just as he had told them.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce fyɛ̀ɛ muu jàaki', ŋgâa jàaki' a bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce fyɛ̀ɛ muu jàaki' anà njokɛ?"
eng: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, Why are you untying the colt?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Tata ce kòŋ à rgèe yuu àgho."
eng: They said, The Lord needs it.

lmp: Wowèe a du àgho a fa nè Jisòs, a co'ni bcɛ̀' a laashi mbendù mo, a ko'si Jisòs mbo.
eng: They brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt, and set Jesus on them.

lmp: E ka' cu mbo ce dù, bèe à co'nì bcɛ̀' a laashi njep nduunjì.
eng: As he went, they spread their cloaks in the way.

lmp: E ka' bà' àtʉtʉ rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m fàdì' ce nduunjì yi sùu embe rtùu Olèf nà, ku' bèe ce a m ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a kɛ' a ce yu' rbòŋ, a ce yɛɛ mbekì sê, a ce nɛ̀si Nyʉ̀ njobè' ku' buu bghagha' ce wowèe a m yɛ.
eng: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

lmp: Wowèe a m ce yòp enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ ghoni ŋkʉʉ ce e ce vʉ̀ à rlii Tatâ, tɛ cumʉnyaŋ ba mbe bùu. Sèe ku'si Nyʉ̀ embe bùu."
eng: saying, Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!

lmp: Bèe Farìsi mo' ce a m ba à mʉ̀ ku' bèe ca, a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, lapni ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu ca."
eng: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, Teacher, rebuke your disciples!

lmp: Jisòs a beesì enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ bèe ca a ka' cumʉnyaŋ, blùr ca vi ku yôp."
eng: He answered them, I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.

lmp: E ka' vʉ̀ bà' àtʉtʉ, yɛ rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a war,
eng: When he drew near, he saw the city and wept over it,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Wee wèe foŋ à ba riŋ yuu ce àde' yi ba gee cumʉnyaŋ ba àgho ntìni na, geewa'a, a sʉ̀ti yi ese wèe.
eng: saying, If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

lmp: Mnòŋ mo' vi be kè ba ce bèe ce a bàa wèe a be kè boo ŋka' sìr wèe àgho kaari tarte, gàŋ wèe fa mbetar,
eng: For the days will come on you, when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

lmp: koo wèe, ba boo wee ce wèe wowèe yu mbe ŋka', lìpshi à nshè. Wowèe a be mà'shi tɛ lùr mò' cu mbendù mò' ka', njobè' wèe à m rìŋ nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m vʉ̀ à rfʉr wèe efa ŋgɛ' nà ka'."
eng: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn't know the time of your visitation.

lmp: E m niŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a kɛ' a ce jùu bèe ce a m ce fyèni buu mbo,
eng: He entered into the temple, and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Yà ndap be ba ndap rloo. Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe à gee yà ndap à kʉtì ba mbʉ̀' byɛ̀ɛ." "
eng: saying to them, It is written, 'My house is a house of prayer,' but you have made it a 'den of robbers'!

lmp: E m ce yɛ'ni mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ. Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ker ba bèe ce a m ba boo mlii, a m ce ghèter à ryʉ ye.
eng: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests and the scribes and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

lmp: Geewa'a, wowèe a m koni nduunjì ka' njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ku ce yu' ba yuu ce e m ce làa.
eng: They couldn't find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ mò' Jisòs à ka' ce yɛ'ni bèe mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ, bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a bleebèe wèe a vʉ̂,
eng: It happened on one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, that the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

lmp: a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋger ce à ce gèe buu ca àgho yi lò efɛ? Ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa wɛ̀ ŋger ca à fa nda?"
eng: They asked him, Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "M be bipshi yuu mo' nè wèe foŋ.
eng: He answered them, I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

lmp: Ŋger ce Jôn à m tʉr à rbàptir bèe nà yi m lò ba ese Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ ese bèe? Suŋ à nè mɛ̀."
eng: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?

lmp: Wowèe a du mcʉ̀, a seesi enɛ̂, "Sèe ka' laa seenɛ yi ŋger anà yi m lò ese Nyʉ̀, banɛ e be bipshi nè sèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à m ka' ba byemi yuu ce e m làa ka' njokɛ?"
eng: They reasoned with themselves, saying, If we say, 'From heaven,' he will say, 'Why didn't you believe him?'

lmp: Sèe à ka' laa seenɛ ŋger anà yi m lò ese ŋwɛ̀, banɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a be tʉʉshi sèe nè blùr, njobè' wowèe a byemi enɛ Jôn à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ."
eng: But if we say, 'From men,' all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.

lmp: Wowèe a kʉtì a beesi enɛ̂, "Wèr rìŋ ka'."
eng: They answered that they didn't know where it was from.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ be suŋ wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa mɛ̀ ŋger à rgèe buu ca ka'."
eng: Jesus said to them, Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

lmp: E m mà' ŋgàa nè bèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m fà' yi nsuu, a bye njɛ̀ɛ msini ce a ke gèe mrù' àgho mbo, a lɛ nè bèe mo' enɛ a di' ce fa' nsuu anà ce fa ye mʉ yuu. E ka' lɛ̀ nè wowèe, a du à mbè, a du a cu tàtà sê.
eng: He began to tell the people this parable. A man planted a vineyard, and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

lmp: Nfè' tee msini à ka' ghɛɛ, e tuu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' enɛ e du yɛ bèe anà, koo msini mi. Bèe anà a koo ŋwɛ̀ anà, a lîp, a kʉsi ye njìnjì, e du mbòmmbo.
eng: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him, and sent him away empty.

lmp: E ker tuu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' mò', wowèe a ker lip ye foŋ, a coosi ye, a koosi ye rìtu, e du mbòmmbo.
eng: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him, and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

lmp: E ka' kèr tuu mò', wowèe a bɛɛsì ye, a fʉr embe mʉ̀ nsuu a ma'.
eng: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him, and threw him out.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nsuu à laa sè'ni enɛ̂, "M be gèe mɛkɛ? M be tuu muu wà ce mɛ̀ kòŋ se na. Seemò' wowèe a be yu'ni nè ye."
eng: The lord of the vineyard said, 'What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.'

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ ye, a laa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "A ŋwɛ̀ ce e be ye bti' na. Sèe koo yʉ, tɛ vi bti' bo ba visèe."
eng: But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, 'This is the heir. Come, let's kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.'

lmp: Jisòs à fyɛ' wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Banɛ yuu ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Lùr ce ŋgâa mboo mndap a m mà', à kʉti ba lùr rbuu-ndap" nà yi yu ba enɛ kɛ?
eng: But he looked at them, and said, Then what is this that is written, 'The stone which the builders rejected, the same was made the chief cornerstone?'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gwe mbendù lùr anà banɛ ŋgàŋ be ceeŋger à btete à btete. Ŋwɛ̀ ce lùr anà à ka' gwe mbe yê ndù, banɛ e be bʉ'shi ye."
eng: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a ce ròo nduunjì à rkoo Jisòs à nfè' anà njobè' wowèe a m rìŋ enɛ e mà' ŋgàa anà ba nè wowèe. Geewa'a, wowèe a m wɛp bèe.
eng: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people--for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce ker ye, a tuu ŋgâa ŋker enɛ a du bo'shi enɛ a yu ŋgâa làayɛ. Wowèe a ka' dù a ce kè' enɛ Jisòs laa mʉ yuu mo' bebep, tɛ a bo koo ye fa mbe mmbo govanò.
eng: They watched him, and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wèr rìŋ wernɛ à ce làa, ker ce yɛ'ni ba yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì. Wèr rìŋ wernɛ wɛ̂ ke lòr ŋwɛ̀ mò' jɛɛ ka', a ce yɛ'ni bèe mnduunjì Nyʉ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: They asked him, Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren't partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

lmp: Suŋ ka wèr. Ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe ma' mbâa bàrà' nè ŋkwe Rum kɛ̀ sèe ma' ka' à?"
eng: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

lmp: Jisòs à yɛ taa ce a m lè' nè ye, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, Why do you test me?

lmp: "Nàa nè mbʉ̀ mbàa ce a ke mà' mbâa bàrà' àgho." Wowèe a vʉ nè mbʉ̀ mbàa a fa nè ye, e laa enɛ̂, "Tu ŋwɛ̀ embo a yî nda, rlii ce a saŋ mbo à ba lî nda?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Tu embo a yi ŋkwe Rûm, rlii embo à ba li foŋ."
eng: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it? They answered, Caesar's.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ wèe fa buu ŋkʉʉ nè ŋkʉʉ, fa vi Nyʉ̀ nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: He said to them, Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's.

lmp: E m làa yuu mo' à mʉ̀ bèe ce àde' wowèe a m ba koo ye àtu mo ka'. Wowèe a m bɛ̀ɛŋger à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e m bèesi yuu ce wowèe a m bipshi, a baate yap cùu.
eng: They weren't able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer, and were silent.

lmp: Bèe Sadùsi mo' ce a m kani enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ kwe ker fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', a vʉ a yɛ Jisòs tɛ a bo bipshi yuu nè ye. Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, Musìs à m saŋ ncir nè sèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor ŋgwa, a ye a bi boo ka', ŋgàŋ kwe, banɛ nfʉr yì be laasi ye, tɛ a ye a bi boo nè nfʉr yì ce e kwe anà.
eng: They asked him, Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man's brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife, and raise up children for his brother.

lmp: Bfʉr mo' a m ba bèe nsàambâ. Ŋwɛ̂ nlee à lòr ŋgwa a bi boo a ye ka', a kwe.
eng: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ embe yê njì à laasì ye, a kwe foŋ.
eng: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ embenjì ŋwɛ̀ embe yê njì à ker laasi ye, a kwe. Yi m ku koni nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ wa'a, mò' efa wowèe à bi boo a njeŋwɛ̀ anà ka'.
eng: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

lmp: À ka' ba àlʉ̀simbùu, njeŋwɛ̀ ca à kwe foŋ.
eng: Afterward the woman also died.

lmp: Banɛ be kè ba à nfè' ce bèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe, tɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ca ba ŋgwa nda, àmbò yi yu enɛ bfʉr bèe nsàamba ca wɛɛwɛ a m ba bduu vi nà?"
eng: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Mmbaŋrù enjep ŋgòŋ na a ce lòr bbyèŋge, bbyèŋge a ce dùse bgùu.
eng: Jesus said to them, The children of this age marry, and are given in marriage.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a ghɛɛte à bèe ce a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe, cu à ŋgòŋ ce yi bii ka' ba nà, a be kèr lòr bbyèŋge kɛ̀ guusi boo ka',
eng: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead, neither marry, nor are given in marriage.

lmp: njobè' àde' wowèe a ker kweŋger ka'. Wowèe a be kè ba àmbò bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wa'a. Wowèe a be kè ba boo Nyʉ̀ njobè' wowèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: For they can't die any more, for they are like the angels, and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò rfʉʉ ce bèe ce a kweŋger a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe, Musìs ye ye à m dùŋshi enɛ ca yi yu wa'a. Mbe dì' ce e m saŋ àmbò ce ce mor yi m ce kɛti mbo nà, e ce too Tata Nyʉ̀ mbo nà enɛ Nyʉ̀ Abràhâm, ba Nyʉ̀ Aisìk ker ba Nyʉ̀ Jakòp.
eng: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord 'The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.'

lmp: E yu Nyʉ̀ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ka', e yu ba Nyʉ̀ bèe ce a cu btèe. E rìŋ yi enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a cu btèe."
eng: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, wɛ̀ làa bòŋboŋ."
eng: Some of the scribes answered, Teacher, you speak well.

lmp: Wowèe a m ker tʉr cùu à rbipshi yuu mo' nè ye ka'.
eng: They didn't dare to ask him any more questions.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Àde' bèe a laa enɛ Krâis anà yu muu Dɛvìd à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ,
eng: He said to them, Why do they say that the Christ is David's son?

lmp: ce Dɛvìd ce làa yi mbe Ŋwà' Byɛɛ enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Tata yà enɛ̂, "Cu à la rkoo mà',
eng: David himself says in the book of Psalms, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit at my right hand,

lmp: caar tɛ m gee tɛ à tɛr mo mkùu mbendù bèe ce a bàa wɛ̀.""
eng: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.'

lmp: Dɛvìd ce too ye enɛ Tatâ, banɛ àde' e ker ba muu yì à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?

lmp: Jisòs à m làa ca nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce yu'.
eng: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nfè' nè ŋgèe ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir. Wowèe a ke kòŋ à ryar mŋgàbʉlà ce kar àgho, koŋ enɛ bèe a ca'ni wowèe à mntaa. Wowèe a niŋ à mndap mloo, ce ba mnta' bêe bgòrgòr, a bà' à mŋkà', ce ba mnta' bbòŋboŋ.
eng: Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

lmp: Jisòs à naa mmir a yɛ àmbò ŋgâa mbàa a ce fa rfa njep ŋkùp rfa embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: He looked up, and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

lmp: E m yɛ ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ fùp àmbò e fa mbàa baa njep ŋkùp anà.
eng: Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fùp na, à fa a caa bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He said, Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

lmp: Bèe ca wɛɛwɛ a gàpni buu mò' efa ku' yàp buu ce a tʉr, a fa rfa àgho, ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ca ce e tʉr yuu ka' à lor mʉ yuu wɛɛwɛ ce e tʉr, à ba yì ce yi ba jà' ye, a fa."
eng: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m ce suŋ buu àmbò Ndap Nyʉ̀, a ce làa enɛ a bà'ri ndap anà nè blûr bbòŋboŋ, buu ce bèe a m fa nè Nyʉ̀ a susi ndap anà àgho vi boŋ foŋ sê. Jisòs à laa enɛ̂,
eng: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

lmp: "Buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce yɛ na, nfè' mò' be kè ba tɛ lùr mo' cu nje Ndap Nyʉ̀ ca ka'. A be kè kɛ̀ɛshi vi wɛɛwɛ."
eng: As for these things which you see, the days will come, in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, buu ca vi be ba ba à se'kɛ? Yuu ce yi be dùŋshi enɛ nfè' ce buu ca be koni à ghɛɛ, be ba kɛ?"
eng: They asked him, Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka', njobè' bèe magòr a be vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ rlii ce làa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Krâis anà," kèr làa foŋ enɛ̂, "Nfè' ce ghɛɛ." Wèe fa dù àmbùu wowèe ka'.
eng: He said, Watch out that you don't get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, 'I am he,' and, 'The time is at hand.' Therefore don't follow them.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ke yu' enɛ a ce mà' bìr, ker yu' àmbò ŋgâa ŋgɛ' a ce kɛ̀' ŋgɛ', wèe fa wɛp ka'. Buu ca be kù ke kɛ' koni, vi koni wa'a, ke' ba enɛ nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi be mì à ghɛɛ ka'."
eng: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don't be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won't come immediately.

lmp: E m ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "To' yi be mà' bìr a to' mo', tɛ ŋkʉʉ mò' ma' bìr a mò'.
eng: Then he said to them, Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

lmp: Ŋgòŋ yi be cì'ti sê, tɛ njè koo, tɛ byaŋ vi gwe à ndù bèe à bdì' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Buu bwɛp, ker ba mncôo btatap sê, vi be yɛɛti mbe bùu.
eng: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.

lmp: "Tɛ buu ca ka' koni, a be koo wèe fa wèe ŋgɛ', dù nè wèe à mndap mloo, fa wèe à bshaŋ, dù nè wèe njeptii bkʉʉ ba bgovanò njo' mɛ̀.
eng: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name's sake.

lmp: Ca yi be gèe tɛ wèe koni fɛŋ à rsuŋ wowèe buu kuu mɛ̀.
eng: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

lmp: Tɛ nfè' ka' ghɛɛ, wèe fa mà'shi tɛ mntee vi ce bu' wèe tɛ wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ wèe be dù làa wee kɛ lɛ ka',
eng: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

lmp: njobè' m be fa wèe blàa kù cùu, ba bfee à njɛ̀ɛ ce àde' mò' efa bèe ce a bàa wèe riŋ yuu ce e beesi ka'.
eng: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

lmp: Wêe bta ba wêe mmâ, ba bfʉr wee ba bèe ce wèe wowèe à ràte, ba bkar wee, a be fyèni wèe, tɛ a yʉshi bèe mo' efa wèe.
eng: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a be bàa wèe njo' mɛ̀.
eng: You will be hated by all men for my name's sake.

lmp: Geewa'a, mbʉ̀ nyʉ̀'tu embe tu mò' efa wèe be bʉ ka'.
eng: And not a hair of your head will perish.

lmp: Wèe à ka' tɛɛ tatap banɛ wèe be so me myòŋ.
eng: By your endurance you will win your lives.

lmp: Nfè' anà à ka' ghɛɛ banɛ bèe ce a yu à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a caŋ duse à mtùu, tɛ bèe ce a yu à mʉ̀ la' a fʉʉ, tɛ bèe ce a yu à mŋkʉ̀ a ker kʉti à là' ka',
eng: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the midst of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

lmp: njobè' nfè' ca be ba nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be kʉsi mcucu' àtu buu bbebep ce bèe a m gèe, tɛ yuu ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

lmp: Mlù mi be koo bbyèŋge ce a yu nè mmbʉ̀ ba bbyèŋge ce a ce nyoŋsi boo. Mlù mi be ba nè bêe à ŋgòŋ ca, tɛ Nyʉ̀ bepsi ntee nè wowèe.
eng: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land, and wrath to this people.

lmp: A be yʉshi bèe mo' nè bkàafà', tɛ a koo bèe mo' à rkòŋ, dù àgho à bto' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, tɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a nyɛŋshi Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m nè mkùu caar tɛ yàp nfè' mi tɛ a ka' borni.
eng: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles, until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

lmp: "Mncòo vi be yɛɛti mbe rlir nyʉ̀, ba mbe ŋwɛɛ, ba mbe mkàŋsì, tɛ mlù mi ba njep ŋgòŋ na, tɛ bjep vi ba njo' rcòo ce rdip rgòr li be ce còo, kèr ce baŋti ce ko' mbekì ce gwè.
eng: There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

lmp: Bèe a be kwe bwɛp, àmbò wowèe a be cu ce fyɛ' yuu ce yi be koni ŋgòŋ à nfè' anà, njobè' buu ŋger embe bùu na vi be cì'ti.
