eng: men fainting for fear, and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world: for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

lmp: Buu ca vi ce koni wa'a, tɛ a lo yɛ àmbò Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ce vʉ̀ mbe mʉ̀ mmbà' nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ ba nè fòo-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

lmp: Buu ca à ka' kɛ' ce koni, wèe tɛɛ mbekì, naa btu, njobè' nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be tee wèe efa ŋgɛ' ce ghɛɛ."
eng: But when these things begin to happen, look up, and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.

lmp: E m mà' ŋgàa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Fyɛ' nè ce fîk, ker ba bce wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He told them a parable. See the fig tree, and all the trees.

lmp: Wêe ke yɛ à nfè' ce bce anà vi kɛ̀' a ce top, wèe ku riŋ weenɛ nfè' mbèŋ yu àtʉtʉ.
eng: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

lmp: Banɛ wèe à ka' ke yɛ àmbò buu ca vi ce koni, wèe riŋ weenɛ nfè' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ à ghɛɛ.
eng: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that the Kingdom of God is near.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋgʉ̀ bèe ca be kweŋger wɛɛ tɛ buu ca ka' koni ka'.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

lmp: Rbuu ba nshe a be kè mì, geewa'a, wa blàa vi be kè mì à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

lmp: Lòr nè nfè', buwa'làr wèe lo fa nyor à buu bcicì, ba buu mno ba buu ce mlù mi ke koo bèe àgho njep ŋgòŋ na, tɛ nòŋ anà yi lo bʉ̀ʉ wèe bʉ̀ʉ àmbò taa yi bʉ̀ʉ nyàa wa'a.
eng: So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

lmp: Jisòs à m ce yɛ'ni mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, e ba à mbùuŋkùr e du mbe rtùu Olèf cu mbo tʉ̀' raa.
eng: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

lmp: Tʉ̀' e raa, bèe wɛɛwɛ a du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' tɛ a bo yu' buu ce e ce yɛ'ni.
eng: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

lmp: Nfè' à kɛ̀' a ce ghɛɛ ce a be ye ŋkà' nè brɛ̂d ce a lɛ̀ yes njo ka', ce a m ce too enɛ Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap.
eng: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, drew near.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir a m ce ròo mʉ njɛ̀ɛ nduunjì mo' à ryʉ Jisòs njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp bèe.
eng: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

lmp: Satàn à niŋ njep Judàs ce a m ce too enɛ Ìskarìyòt, ce e m ba mò' efa bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: Satan entered into Judas, who was surnamed Iscariot, who was numbered with the twelve.

lmp: Judàs à natì a dû, a yɛ bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe ce a m ba btu nè bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀, a seesi a wowèe àmbò àde' e gee ka' fyeni Jisòs nè wowèe.
eng: He went away, and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

lmp: Wowèe a yu' rbòŋ, a ka'ni enɛ a be fa ye mbàa.
eng: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

lmp: E byemì, a kɛ' a ce ròo nduunjì à rfyèni Jisòs nè wowèe à nfè' ce bèe a yu àfo ka'.
eng: He consented, and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

lmp: Nòŋ entòmbì efa mnòŋ ce a m ce ye brɛ̂d ce a lɛ̀ yes njo ka' yi m ghɛɛ. Nòŋ anà à m ba nòŋ ce a m ce shɛshi njèe ce a be ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap àgho.
eng: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

lmp: Jisòs à tuu Pità ba Jôn, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Dù nè fɛr byee tɛ sèe bo ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap àgho."
eng: He sent Peter and John, saying, Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "À ce kòŋ enɛ wèr fɛr byee ŋkà' anà ba fɛ tɛ à bo ye?"
eng: They said to him, Where do you want us to prepare?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, wèe be dù niŋ à mʉ̀ rla', tɛ wèe tarte wèe mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e byɛ̀' ntʉŋ mdip. Dù nè fa yê mbùu, niŋ mbe ndàp ce e be niŋ,
eng: He said to them, Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

lmp: laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ndap enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì à làa enɛ wèr bipshi nè wɛ̀ enɛ dì' ce e be ye byee Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap mbo a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe yu ba fɛ lɛ?"
eng: Tell the master of the house, 'The Teacher says to you, Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?'

lmp: E be dùŋshi wèe ma rum ndap embe ndap ce a bà'ri mbendù ndap anà, a kupshi bòŋboŋ sê. Fɛ̀r nè byee ŋkà' mbo."
eng: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù, a yɛ, yi ku ba àmbò Jisòs à m suŋ wowèe nà. Wowèe a fɛr byee ŋkà' anà.
eng: They went, found things as he had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

lmp: Nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ, Jisòs ba yi ŋgâa ntuu a cutè a sir tɛbùr.
eng: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ mʉ ce kòŋ se enɛ sèe ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap ca, tɛ m ka' yɛ ŋgɛ'.
eng: He said to them, I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ m be kèr ye ŋkà' ca ka', caar tɛ yuu ce ŋkà' ca yi tɛɛ àtu mo yi ke ghɛɛte mbe rla' Nyʉ̀ embe bùu."
eng: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in the Kingdom of God.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a lor ndoŋ, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a laa enɛ̂, "Kò nè no.
eng: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, Take this, and share it among yourselves,

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe enɛ m be kèr no mrù' ce a gèe nè mbàŋ ce ca ka', caar bà' à nfè' ce kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi be kè vʉ̀."
eng: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until the Kingdom of God comes.

lmp: E m lòr brɛ̂d, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi, a fa nè wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Ca yu yà nyor ce mɛ̀ fa a wêe btù. Ce gee nè àmbò sèe ce gèe na tɛ wèe bo ce kuushi mɛ̀."
eng: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it, and gave to them, saying, This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.

lmp: A ka' ye byee mìsi, e lor ndoŋ àmbò e m lòr brɛ̂d nà, a laa enɛ̂, "Ndoŋ ca yu lê' fi ce Nyʉ̀ à kur a bèe nè wa blɛɛ.
eng: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni mɛ̀ ce yeŋger wèr ye mbe tɛbùr na.
eng: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

lmp: Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be kù kwe àmbò yi m ba à rba, geewa'a, ndòo be co' ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni ye."
eng: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce bipshi fa wâp mʉ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e be gèe njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca yu ba nda lɛ?
eng: They began to question among themselves, which of them it was who would do this thing.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ̀' a ce sɛr mnsɛr foŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr efa wâp mʉ yu nda lɛ?
eng: There arose also a contention among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bkʉʉ bèe enje jɛɛ a ke sa' yap bèe nè ŋger- ŋwɛ̀, bèe a ce too ŋgâa rsa' anà enɛ ŋgâa rjà'.
eng: He said to them, The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called 'benefactors.'

lmp: Wèe fa ba à njɛ̂ɛ wa' ka'. Yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr se efa wêe mʉ ba àmbò muu ŋkɛ'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu tu nè bèe ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ rfà'.
eng: But not so with you. But one who is the greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr yu ba nda? Yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ye byee kɛ̀ yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce càasi byee nè ye à? Mbò yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce ye byee a? M yu ya fa wêe mʉ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ rfà'.
eng: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn't it he who sits at the table? But I am in the midst of you as one who serves.

lmp: A wèe ce wèe à ku tɛɛ tatap, a ma' mɛ̀ à nfè' rmòoshi ka'.
eng: But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

lmp: Mɛ̀ fa kʉʉ nè wèe àmbò yà Ta à m fa nè mɛ̀ nà,
eng: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

lmp: tɛ wèe bo yeŋger kèr noŋger mbe yà tɛbùr embe mɛ̂ nto', cu mbe bkàbàrà' ce sa' mntɛ̀' Isrɛ̀l ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

lmp: "Saimʉ̀n, Saimʉ̀n, yɛ̂, Satàn à loo njì à rfyɛpshi wèe àmbò à ke fyɛpshi msaŋ nà.
eng: The Lord said, Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have you, that he might sift you as wheat,

lmp: Geewa'a, mɛ̀ gèe rloo nè wɛ̀ enɛ lo rbyemì li fa mì ka'. E ba à nfè' ce lo rbyemì li kʉti a ba rtatap, à tapsi bfʉr wo."
eng: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn't fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mɛ̀ tami nyor à rdù shaŋ wèe sò, kèr kwe wèe sò."
eng: He said to him, Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Pità, m ce suŋ wɛ̀ mɛnɛ tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ nètʉ' e ntìni na, à be kani ŋkàrà' taar enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: He said, I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.

lmp: E m ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "À m ba mbe nfè' ce mɛ̀ m tuu wèe, a laa mɛnɛ wèe fa lòr posà kɛ̀ bàa, kɛ̀ blaba' ka' nà, wà' wèe à m buu yuu mo' a?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr à m buu yuu mo' ka'."
eng: He said to them, When I sent you out without purse, and wallet, and shoes, did you lack anything? They said, Nothing.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè wèe sè'ni na enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr posà kɛ̀ bàa ɛ̀, e lôr. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ tʉr kàafà' ka', ŋgàŋ fyenì yi cɛ̀', yuu yì.
eng: Then he said to them, But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a wallet. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe enɛ yuu ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "A m bè' ye à mʉ̀ ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep" nà, yi be koni nè mɛ̀, ghɛɛte njo. Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, yuu ce a saŋ àmbò mɛ̀ yi ce ghɛɛte njo."
eng: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: 'He was counted with transgressors.' For that which concerns me has an end.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yɛ̂, a bkàafâ' bbaa na." E beesì enɛ̂, "Vi ghɛɛ wa'a."
eng: They said, Lord, behold, here are two swords. He said to them, That is enough.

lmp: E fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ rla' a du mbe rtùu Olèf àmbò e m ce dù à nfè' wɛɛwɛ nà. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du a yê mbùu.
eng: He came out, and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

lmp: E ka' dù bà' mbe dì' anà, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Loo nè, fà dì' wèe gwe rmòoshì ka'."
eng: When he was at the place, he said to them, Pray that you don't enter into temptation.

lmp: E m fʉʉ efa wâp mʉ a du mbe dì' ce ŋwɛ̀ à m ka' ba ma' lùr e ku ba', a gʉ'shi nè mŋkʉʉshi, a gee rloo, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: He was withdrawn from them about a stone's throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

lmp: "Yà Tâ, wɛ̀ ka' kôŋ, gèe tɛ ndoŋ ŋgɛ' ca caa embe mɛ̂ tù. Geewa'a, ke' ba enɛ m ce làa mɛnɛ à gee ba àmbò mɛ̀ kòŋ ka', gèe ba àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ enɛ yi ba."
eng: saying, Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.

lmp: Awɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ embe bùu à yɛɛtì, a fa ye ŋger.
eng: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

lmp: Mlù mi ka' ce koo ye sê, e gee rloo nè yi ntee-ŋwɛ̀, mlì' mi suu ye efa nyòr àmbò blɛɛ wa'a, a cɛɛcɛ à nshè.
eng: Being in agony he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

lmp: E ka' natì embe dì' ce e ba ce gèe rloo nà, kʉti, a yɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu àmbò a ce buumi njobè' wowèe a m koosimnse gòr a sɛ̂.
eng: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples, and found them sleeping because of grief,

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce buumi ba kɛ? Nàti nè mbekì, gee rloo, fà dì' wèe bo gwè rmòoshì ka'."
eng: and said to them, Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.

lmp: E ka' kù bii ce làa, kʉr bèe a vʉ̂. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a m ce too enɛ Judàs, ce e m ba mò' efa bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ nà, à tɛɛ kùntombì nè wowèe. E m vʉ̀ a ba' àgee Jisòs tɛ e bo baa ye nje nyòr.
eng: While he was still speaking, behold, a multitude, and he who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Judàs, à be fyèni Muu Ŋwɛ̀ nè rbaa ce à ce baa ye nje nyòr a?"
eng: But Jesus said to him, Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?

lmp: Yì bèe ce a wowèe a m ba a m yɛ yuu ce yi be koni, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wèr gwate wowèe nè sà' a?"
eng: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, Lord, shall we strike with the sword?

lmp: Mò' efa wowèe à co' sà', a tee tù' mà' ese ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋkwàa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Yi ghɛɛ wa'a."
eng: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a joo tù' ŋwɛ̀ anà, yi kʉtì àmbò yi m ba.
eng: But Jesus answered, Let me at least do this--and he touched his ear, and healed him.

lmp: E laa nè bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba bèe ce a m ba btu nè bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀, ba bleebèe ce a wowèe a m vʉ̀ à rkoo ye nà enɛ̂, "Wèe à vʉ̀ à rkoo mɛ̀ nè bsà' ba mmbàŋ àmbò m yu lɛ nyɛ̀ɛ wa'a njokɛ?
eng: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

lmp: To mɛ̀ m ku ba wèe sèe mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, wèe à m be naa bo joo mɛ̀ àgho ka'. Geewa'a, nfè' ca yu yè nfè', nfè' ce tʉ̀'nji be tʉr ŋger."
eng: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn't stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.

lmp: Wowèe a m koo Jisòs, a du àgho mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. Pità à m ce dù a wâp mbùu, a ba yi encàŋ.
eng: They seized him, and led him away, and brought him into the high priest's house. But Peter followed from a distance.

lmp: A m tòo mor mbe mambe kôr, bèe a cu a ce yɛr, Pità à cu fa wâp mʉ foŋ.
eng: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard, and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

lmp: Muunje mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à yɛ àmbò e cu a ce yɛr mor, e fyɛ' ye mbe mmìr, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ba a Jisòs foŋ."
eng: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, This man also was with him.

lmp: Pità à kanì, a laa enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀ câ, m rìŋ ye ka'."
eng: He denied Jesus, saying, Woman, I don't know him.

lmp: Mʉ nfè' à ka' tuuse, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ker yɛ ye a laa enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ mò' efa wowèe foŋ." Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ câ, a mɛ̀ mò' ka'."
eng: After a little while someone else saw him, and said, You also are one of them! But Peter answered, Man, I am not!

lmp: Nfè' à ka' tuuse àmbò awà mò'sir wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ker laa tatap enɛ̂, "Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ba a ye. E yu ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Galèlê."
eng: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!

lmp: Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ câ, mɛ̀ rìŋ yuu ce à ce làa na ka'." E ka' kù bii ce làa wa'a, nduŋgʉp à toŋ.
eng: But Peter said, Man, I don't know what you are talking about! Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

lmp: Tata à karsì nyor a ke' ye mbe mmìr. E ka' kuushi yuu ce e m làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ nètʉ' e ntìni na, à be kani ŋkàrà' taar enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka'." nà.
eng: The Lord turned, and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord's word, how he said to him, Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.

lmp: Pità à fʉʉ njep mbè a bʉ' rwar.
eng: He went out, and wept bitterly.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Jisòs, a m vʉ̀shi ye, a lip ye.
eng: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

lmp: A m kur ye mmir, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Suŋ ka enɛ à lìp nda wɛ̀ lɛ?"
eng: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?

lmp: Wowèe a m sù' ye nè mcɛp sê.
eng: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, bleebèe efa mʉ̀ Jûs, ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, a cutè mbe kansùr, a lor Jisòs a vʉ àgho mbo, a laa nè ye enɛ̂,
eng: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people was gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

lmp: "Wɛ̀ ka' ba Krâis anà, à suŋ wèr." Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "M ka' suŋ wèe, wèe byemì ka'.
eng: If you are the Christ, tell us. But he said to them, If I tell you, you won't believe,

lmp: M ka' bipshi yuu nè wèe, wèe beesì ka'.
eng: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

lmp: Kɛ' e sè'ni na, Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be cu à rkoo mà' Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ."
eng: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a bipshì enɛ̂, "Banɛ a wɛ̀ Muu Nyʉ̀ a?" E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "À làa wèe nè wee bcùu enɛ a mɛ̀ ye."
eng: They all said, Are you then the Son of God? He said to them, You say it, because I am.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Àde' sèe ker ce ròo bèe mo' enɛ a vʉ tɛɛ njìnsa' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? To sèe à yu' yuu ce e làa nè yi cùu."
eng: They said, Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a natì mbekì, a lor Jisòs a du àgho a fa nè Pailɛ̀t.
eng: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

lmp: Wowèe a m kɛ̀' a ce toshi ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca à ce karsi btu ese yèr bèe. E ce làa nè bèe enɛ wowèe a fa mà' mbâa bàrà' nè ŋkwe Rum ka', a ce làa foŋ enɛ a lɛ ye Krâis ce e yu ŋkʉʉ."
eng: They began to accuse him, saying, We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋkʉʉ Jus a?" Jisòs à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "À làa wɛ̀ wa'a."
eng: Pilate asked him, Are you the King of the Jews? He answered him, So you say.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à laa nè bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ku' bèe ce a m ba àfo nà enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ yɛ yuu mo' ce m taa ŋwɛ̀ ca àtu mo ka'."
eng: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, I find no basis for a charge against this man.

lmp: Wowèe a ker laa tatap enɛ̂, "E karsi btu bêe à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà wɛɛwɛ nè li ryɛ'nì kɛ̀' efa ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a daa àgho a ba' àfa."
eng: But they insisted, saying, He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ka' yu' wa'a, a bipshi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Galèle a?"
eng: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

lmp: E ka' yu' enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgòŋ ce Hɛròd ce sa', e tuusì ye nè Hɛròd ce e m ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à nfè' anà foŋ.
eng: When he found out that he was in Herod's jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

lmp: Hɛròd à ka' yɛ Jisòs, a yu' rbòŋ sê, njobè' e m ce kòŋ à ryɛ ye kɛ' ese à nfè' njìsàp. E m yu' buu ce Jisòs à m ce gèe, a ce kòŋ à ryɛ yuu ghagha' mo' ce e be gèe.
eng: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

lmp: E ka' yɛ Jisòs wa'a, a bipshi ku' buu nè ye, e laa yuu ka'.
eng: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, a m toshi ye nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ sê.
eng: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

lmp: Hɛròd ba vi bsoogɛ̀ a m vʉ̀shi ye, a lor ye à yuu cicì, a lor cɛ̂' bòŋboŋ a ma' ye à nyòr, a kʉsi ye nè Pailɛ̀t.
eng: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

lmp: Hɛròd ba Pailɛ̀t a m koo ŋkar nyʉ̀ anà. Tɛ a ye a ka' koo ŋkar nyʉ̀ anà, a ye a m bàni sê.
eng: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à kɛ' bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba ŋgâa rsa', ker ba bèe ce a m ba àfo,
eng: Pilate called together the chief priests and the rulers and the people,

lmp: a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à vʉ̀ nè ŋwɛ̀ ca enɛ e ce karsi btu ese bèe. Mɛ̀ fyɛ' njep mʉ̀ mo a wêe bsii, a yɛ mɛnɛ e gèe yuu mo' efa buu ce wèe à làa enɛ e gèe na ka'.
eng: and said to them, You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and see, I have examined him before you, and found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ Hɛròd ye ye à yɛ enɛ e gèe yuu bebep ka'. A mbùu ce e kʉsi ye nè sèe. Yi yu rara enɛ e gèe yuu mo' ce àde' a yʉ ye àtu mo ka'.
eng: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

lmp: Banɛ a be lip ye, tɛ m ma'shi tɛ e dû."
eng: I will therefore chastise him and release him.

lmp: A m ce ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap, yi ba enɛ Pailɛ̀t be fʉr yàp ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe shaŋ, fa nè wowèe.
eng: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

lmp: Ku' bèe ca wɛɛwɛ a waa a laa enɛ̂, "Yʉ ŋwɛ̀ ca, fʉr Bàrabàs embe shaŋ, fa nè wèr."
eng: But they all cried out together, saying, Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!--

lmp: A m fa Bàrabàs à shaŋ njobè' e m barsi bêe à rla' anà enɛ a tee tu nè ŋkwe Rûm, a ker yʉ ŋwɛ̀ foŋ.
eng: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à m ce kòŋ à rmà'shi Jisòs, a ker laa yuu nè wowèe.
eng: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

lmp: Wowèe a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Taa ye mbe kìntaa! Taa ye mbe kìntaa!"
eng: but they shouted, saying, Crucify! Crucify him!

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe seesê, yu ba kɛ? Mɛ̀ yɛ yuu mo' ce e gèe ce àde' a yʉ ye àtu mo ka'. Banɛ a be lìp ye tɛ m ma'shi ye."
eng: He said to them the third time, Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.

lmp: Wowèe a ku ce waani, a ce làa enɛ a taa lɛ ye mbe kìntaa. A ka' waani wa'a, a so.
eng: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à boŋlàr a teni mnsa' enɛ a taa ye mbe kìntaa àmbò wowèe a làa nà.
eng: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

lmp: E m fʉr ŋwɛ̀ ce wowèe a m ce kòŋ enɛ e fʉr embe shaŋ, à ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m dù shaŋ njobè' e m barsi bèe enɛ a tee tu nè ŋkwe Rûm, a ker yʉ ŋwɛ̀ foŋ nà. E ka' fʉr, a fa Jisòs enɛ a gee yuu ce wowèe a m kòŋ nà nè ye.
eng: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

lmp: Wowèe a lor ye a ce dù àgho, a ka' bà' à nduunjì, a tarte a ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Saimʉ̀n ce à rla' Sàirên, ce e m ce vʉ̀ efa mŋkʉ̀. A m koo ye a fa kìntaa nè ye enɛ e byɛ', ce jɛr mbenjì Jisòs.
eng: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid on him the cross, to carry it after Jesus.

lmp: Ku' bèe magòr a m ce dù a yê mbùu. Bbyèŋge a m ba a wâp mʉ, a ce koosimnse a ce warse njo' ŋgɛ' ce Jisòs à m ce yɛ.
eng: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

lmp: Jisòs à karsì nyor, a laa enɛ̂, "Bbyèŋgê à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, wèe fa war nè mɛ̀ ka', war nè ba nè wee btu, ker ba nè boo wee,
eng: But Jesus, turning to them, said, Daughters of Jerusalem, don't weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

lmp: njobè' nfè' mò' be ba tɛ bèe a laa enɛ̂, "Rbôŋtu li yu nè bbyèŋge ce a yu bkar, ce a m be bi boo ka', a ker nyoŋsi boo ka'."
eng: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, 'Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.'

lmp: Wowèe a be kè làa nè mtûu mŋgòrŋgòr enɛ̂, "Gwèŋger nè mbe wêr ndù," làa nè mtûu mŋkɛ'ŋkɛ' enɛ̂, "Gʉ̀ʉshi nè wèr."
eng: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, 'Fall on us!' and tell the hills, 'Cover us.'

lmp: Bèe a ka' ce gèe buu ca nè mɛ̀ à nfè' ce ce yi bii còŋ, banɛ yi ka' yuushi, yi ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?

lmp: A m lòr mmbaŋrù mo' bèe a mbaa ce a m bʉ' ncir, a ce dù àgho a Jisòs wèe tɛ a bo dù taa mbe kìntaa.
eng: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' mbe dì' ce a m ce too enɛ Kèkèp-Tu, a taa Jisòs mbe kìntaa mbo, a taa bèe mò' ce a m bʉ' ncir nà mbo foŋ. Mò' à m ba mbe kìntaa a yê bo mà', mò' à ba mbe kìntaa a yê bo ŋkòp.
eng: When they came to the place that is called The Skull, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Ya Tâ, fòosi wowèe, njobè' wowèe a rìŋ yuu ce a ce gèe ka'." Wowèe a m lòr vi bcɛ̀', a ma' kàŋ àgho, bèe ce a m so a du nè bcɛ̀' anà.
eng: Jesus said, Father, forgive them, for they don't know what they are doing. Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

lmp: Bèe a m tɛɛ a ce fyɛ', ŋgâa rsa' a ce vʉ̀shi ye, a ce làa enɛ̂, "E m jà' bèe mò' efa ŋgɛ', e ja' là yi tu foŋ, ce e ka' ba Krâis anà ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce."
eng: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!

lmp: Bsoogɛ̀ foŋ a m coosi ye. Wowèe a m vʉ̀ a fa ye mrù' ce mi ce baŋshi,
eng: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ba ŋkʉʉ Jûs, à ja' ka yo tu efa ŋgɛ'."
eng: and saying, If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!

lmp: A m saŋ mbe yê tù enɛ̂, "A ŋkʉʉ Jus nà."
eng: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.

lmp: Mò' efa bèe ce a m bʉ' ncir a taa wowèe a Jisòs wèe nà, à m sù' ye nè mcɛp. E m làa enɛ̂, "Mbò a wɛ̀ Krâis anà a? Jà' là yo tu efa ŋgɛ' tɛ à bo jà' wèr foŋ."
eng: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ba mbe kìntaa foŋ nà à lapnì ye, a laa enɛ̂, "À ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ ka' a? To wɛ wɛ̀ ku ba ŋwɛ̀ rkwe foŋ àmbò ye.
eng: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, Don't you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

lmp: Yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ sò yɛ ŋgɛ'. Sò ce yɛ ŋgɛ' njo' buu bbebep ce sò à gèe, ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe yi yu yuu mo' ka'."
eng: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Jisòs, kuushi mɛ̀ à nfè' ce wɛ̀ ka' vʉ ce sa' yo kʉʉ."
eng: He said to Jesus, Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ, à be ba wèe sò à ŋgôŋ Paràdâis ntìni."
eng: Jesus said to him, Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' kùu ŋgòŋ, tʉ̀' à sii caar a ba' à nyʉ̀ taar.
eng: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

lmp: Cɛ̀' ce a m teni dì' mo' embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ àgho yi m sà'ti tìtìyɛɛ.
eng: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

lmp: Jisòs à waa tatap sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Yà Tâ, mɛ̀ fa la ryòŋ mbe wɛ̂ mmbò." E ka' làa wa'a, a ko'si ryòŋ, a kwe.
eng: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, Father, into your hands I commit my spirit! Having said this, he breathed his last.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ à ka' yɛ yuu ce yi m koni na, a ku'si Nyʉ̀, a laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu ghup enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì."
eng: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, Certainly this was a righteous man.

lmp: Bèe ce a m kaari àfo à ryɛ, a ka' yɛ yuu ce yi m koni, a la' mmbo mbe wâp mntee a duse.
eng: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their breasts.

lmp: Bkar vi wɛɛwɛ ba bbyèŋge ce a m lô à ŋgôŋ Galèle a du a yê mbùu, a m tɛɛ ànjìsàp, a ce yɛ buu ca.
eng: All his acquaintances, and the women who followed with him from Galilee, stood at a distance, watching these things.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba ce a m ce too enɛ Josɛ̀f. E m ba ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Jus ce a m too enɛ Àrimàtiyà. E m ba mò' efa bèe ce a m ce sa' Kansùr, a ba ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ, a ker ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì.
eng: Behold, a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

lmp: E m cu a ce kè' nfè' ce kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi be kɛ̀'. E m byemi yuu ce a m gèe nè Jisòs na ka'.
eng: he had not consented to their counsel and deed, from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for the Kingdom of God:

lmp: E m dù a yɛ Pailɛ̀t, a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ e fa gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ nè ye tɛ e tuŋ.
eng: this man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus' body.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à byemì, e suusì gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ embe kìntaa, a kur njep bcɛ̂' bbòŋboŋ, a lɛ njep rshè ce a m sò' nje ryɛɛ, à ba rshè ce a m be tuŋ ŋwɛ̀ njo ka'.
eng: He took it down, and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

lmp: À m ba à nòŋ ce bèe a m ce tami nyor à nôŋ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀.
eng: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

lmp: Bbyèŋge ce a m lô à ŋgôŋ Galèle a du àmbùu Jisòs nà, a m dù a Josɛ̀f wèe, a yɛ rshè, a yɛ àmbò a m lɛ̀ gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ njo.
eng: The women, who had come with him out of Galilee, followed after, and saw the tomb, and how his body was laid.

lmp: Wowèe a m kʉti à là', a kupshi mgʉr mo' tɛ a bo yo' gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ àgho. À m ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, wowèe a lʉshì àmbò ncir yi m làa.
eng: They returned, and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ entòmbì embe mʉ̀ ŋgàa, à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' sê, bbyèŋge anà a lor mgʉr ce a m kupshi, a du fàdì' ce rshè li m ba.
eng: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' a yɛ àmbò a biŋsi lùr embe ndù ncûu rshè.
eng: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

lmp: Wowèe a niŋ njo, a yɛ gʉ̂ʉ Tata Jisòs ka'.
eng: They entered in, and didn't find the Lord Jesus' body.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce bɛ̀ɛŋger àmbò ca, bèe a m baa a nyɛɛ, a tɛɛ fa wâp geŋ. Bcɛ̀' ce bèe anà a m mà' vi m ce là'ŋger sê.
eng: It happened, while they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

lmp: Bbyèŋge anà a wɛp sê, a bʉʉ btu njep nshè. Bèe a mmbaa anà a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce ròo ŋwɛ̂ ntèe à mʉ̀ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe njokɛ?
eng: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. They said to them, Why do you seek the living among the dead?

lmp: E yu mbena ka'. E fʉʉ efa rkwe. Kuushi nè yuu ce e m làa nè wèe à nfè' ce e m ba à ŋgôŋ Galèle enɛ̂,
eng: He isn't here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

lmp: "A be kù fa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ nè ŋgâa gèe buu bbebep, tɛ wowèe a taa ye mbe kìntaa, mnòŋ vi ba btaar tɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe" nà."
eng: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men, and be crucified, and the third day rise again?

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, wowèe a kuushì yuu ce e m làa anà.
eng: They remembered his words,

lmp: Wowèe a kʉtì, a suŋ buu ca nè bèe ce ncòp-mò'sir-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, ker ba bɛr bèe.
eng: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven, and to all the rest.

lmp: Bèe ce a m kʉti anà à m ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà, ba Jòanà, ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m ba ma yì Jɛ̂ms. Wowèe ba bbyèŋge mo' ce a wowèe a m ba nà a m suŋ buu ca nè ŋgâa ntuu anà.
eng: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

lmp: Geewa'a, wowèe a byemì yuu ce bbyèŋge ca a m suŋ wowèe ka' njobè' yi m ce yɛɛti nè wowèe enɛ yuu ce a m suŋ anà à m ba yuu cicì.
eng: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn't believe them.

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Pità à natì a caŋ a du fàdì' ce rshè li m ba, a ka' fyɛ' njo, a ku yɛ bcɛ̀' ce a m kur ye njo nà àmbò vi nòŋte. E natì a kʉti, a ba nè rgha'nì-ŋwɛ̀ à yuu ce yi m koni na.
eng: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

lmp: À m ba nyʉ̀ anà bèe a mmbaa efa wâp mʉ a ce dù à mʉ rla' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ Ɛmayòs. À rnàtî à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m dù à rla' ca yi yu àmbò mar sàambâ.
eng: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce dù, a ce de' àmbò buu ca wɛɛwɛ ce vi m koni.
eng: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce dù ce de' àmbò buu ca, Jisòs à vʉ̂, a koni wowèe, a ce dù a wowèe.
eng: It happened, while they talked and questioned together, that Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à gêe, wowèe a ke' riŋ ye ka'.
eng: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce jɛ̀r ce de' ba àmbò kɛ?" Wowèe a tɛɛ nè ŋkoosimnse-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: He said to them, What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wâp mʉ ce a m ce too enɛ Kìlopàs, à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wà' ku ba ba wɛ̀ efa mʉ̀ bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a vʉ̀ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ce e rìŋ buu ce vi koni àfo à mnòŋ ca ka' a?"
eng: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn't know the things which have happened there in these days?

lmp: E bipshì enɛ̂, "À koni kɛ?" Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Buu ce vi koni yu buu ce vi kùu Jisôs à rla' Nasarɛ̀t ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce e m ce làa, ce gèe buu bghagha', a ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr à bsii Nyʉ̀ ba bèe.
eng: He said to them, What things? They said to him, The things concerning Jesus, the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

lmp: Yìsèe bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ker ba ŋgâa rsa', a m koo ye a fa ye mbe mmbo govanò tɛ a bo sa' ye, yʉ. A ka' sa', a taa ye mbe kìntaa.
eng: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

lmp: Wèr à m ce kè' yer enɛ a ye ŋwɛ̀ ce e be tee bèe Isrɛ̀l efa ŋgɛ'. Ku ba ca cà'cà' ka', mnòŋ vi yu sè'ni vi btaar kɛ̂' nyʉ̀ ce buu ca à m koni.
eng: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

lmp: Bbyèŋge mo' efa wêr mʉ a suŋ wèr yuu mo' wèr à bɛɛŋgèr sê. Wowèe a ba du fàdì' ce rshè li yu à ŋgàptʉ' e ntìni na,
eng: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

lmp: a ka' bà', a yɛ gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ njep rshè ka'. A ka' yɛ ka', a kʉti a laa enɛ wowèe a yɛ njɛ̀ɛ rlo mo' àmbò bcìndap Nyʉ̀, bcìndap Nyʉ̀ anà a suŋ wowèe enɛ e ku cu ntèe.
eng: and when they didn't find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wêr mʉ a ba du fàdì' rshè li yu, a ka' bà', a yɛ buu à ku ba àmbò bbyèŋge ca a suŋ wowèe nà, a ke' yɛ ye ka'."
eng: Some of us went to the tomb, and found it just like the women had said, but they didn't see him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' làa wa'a, e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe yu blʉr, a ce sìrni à rbyemi yuu ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m làa.
eng: He said to them, Foolish men, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

lmp: Mbò yi m ba yɛɛnì enɛ Krâis anà yɛ ŋgɛ' ca, tɛ a ka' kù'si ye a?"
eng: Didn't the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?

lmp: E m kɛ̀' embe mŋwà' ce Musìs à m saŋ, a du mbe mŋwà' ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ a m saŋ, a nashi buu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa àmbò ye nè wowèe.
eng: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù bà' àtʉtʉ rla' ce wowèe a m ce dù àfo nà, Jisòs à gee àmbò e ce càa rla' anà càa wa'a.
eng: They drew near to the village, where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

lmp: Wowèe a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ e fa dù ka', a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sèe noŋ àfa njobè' nyʉ̀ à coo, mràŋraŋ mi kɛ̀' a ce koshi." Awɛ e du mbe ndàp tɛ a wowèe a bo nòŋ mbo.
eng: They urged him, saying, Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over. He went in to stay with them.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' cu tɛ a bo ye byee, e lor brɛ̂d, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi a fa nè wowèe.
eng: It happened, that when he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave to them.

lmp: Map mmir mi mʉ'ŋgèr, wowèe a riŋ ye. A ka' rìŋ ye wa'a, e bʉ, wowèe a ker yɛ ye ka'.
eng: Their eyes were opened, and they recognized him, and he vanished out of their sight.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Mbò ntee yi ba ce lùu sò se à nfè' ce e ba ce làa nè sò à nduunjì, a ce nàshi yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa nà a?"
eng: They said one to another, Weren't our hearts burning within us, while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?

lmp: Wowèe a natì mbekì njà' mò'sir, a kʉti à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a ka' bà', a yɛ bèe ce ncòp-mò'sir-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ba, àmbò a cute àbee,
eng: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

lmp: a ce làa enɛ̂, "Tata à fʉʉ efa rkwe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, a duŋshi yì nyor nè Saimʉ̀n."
eng: saying, The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!

lmp: bèe a mmbaa ca a suŋ yuu ce yi m koni wowèe à nduunjì, a ker suŋ àmbò wowèe a m rìŋ ye à nfè' ce e m bɛ'shi brɛ̂d a fa nè wowèe nà.
eng: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' kù bii ce suŋ buu ca, Jisòs à ku nyɛɛ mbe wâp tar, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Cumʉnyaŋ ba nè wèe."
eng: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, Peace be to you.

lmp: Wowèe a m lɛ', a wɛp sê, a ce kwà'shi enɛ wowèe a yɛ ba nyir.
eng: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mlù mi ce koo wèe njokɛ? Wèe ce tarni njokɛ?
eng: He said to them, Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

lmp: Fyɛ' nè ma mmbo ba ma mkùu tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ ku ba mɛ̀ seesê. Jòo nè mɛ̀, fyɛ' mɛ̀, njobè' nyir e ke tʉr nyàa nyor ba bvʉp àmbò wèe à yɛ mɛ̀ tʉr na ka'."
eng: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn't have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a duŋshi wowèe mi mmbo ba mi mkùu.
eng: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

lmp: Wowèe a ku bii tarni a ke' be byemi ka', a ce yu' rbòŋ, a ce bɛ̀ɛŋger sê. E bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe tʉr yuu ye tâa a?"
eng: While they still didn't believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, Do you have anything here to eat?

lmp: Wowèe a fa ye tete nca ce a m laa.
eng: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

lmp: E koo a ye a wâp bsii.
eng: He took them, and ate in front of them.

lmp: E ka' ye, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Buu ca yu buu ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ku bii wèe sèe nà. Mɛ̀ m làa mɛnɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce a saŋ àmbò mɛ̀ mbe ŋwâ' mncir Musìs, ba mbe mŋwâ' ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, ker ba mbe mŋwâ' byɛɛ vi be kù ghɛɛte njo."
eng: He said to them, This is what I told you, while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms, concerning me must be fulfilled.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a mʉ' wâp bfee, tɛ wowèe a bo rìŋ buu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce làa.
eng: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ Krâis anà be yɛ ŋgɛ', mnòŋ vi ba btaar, tɛ e fʉʉ efa rkwe,
eng: He said to them, Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

lmp: tɛ a kɛ̂' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m fè'shi nè bto' wɛɛwɛ à li rlii enɛ bèe a kupse, ma' yàp buu bbebep tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo fòosi wowèe.
eng: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

lmp: Wèe à yɛ àmbò buu ca à ghɛɛte njo, banɛ wèe be suŋ bèe.
eng: You are witnesses of these things.

lmp: Yɛ̂, m be dù tɛ m tuusi yuu ce yà Ta à m kà'ni nà nè wèe. Banɛ wèe cu à rla' ca, caar tɛ ŋger embe bùu yi suu mbe wêe ndù."
eng: Behold, I send forth the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.

lmp: E lor wowèe a fʉʉ àgho efa mʉ̀ rla', a du a ba' àwâa rla' Bɛtanì. E ka' bà', a naa mi mmbo mbekì, a ghoni wowèe.
eng: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.

lmp: E ka' ghòni wowèe, a ma'shi wowèe, Nyʉ̀ à lor ye a du àgho mbe bùu.
eng: It happened, while he blessed them, that he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.

lmp: Wowèe a gʉ'shì nè ye, a nati a kʉti à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀ sê.
eng: They worshiped him, and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

lmp: Wowèe a m ku cu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀.
eng: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

lmp: À m ba efa rkɛ̀', Nlàa yi ku ba. Yi m ba àbee a Nyʉ̀. Nlàa anà yi m ba Nyʉ̀.
eng: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

lmp: Yi m ku ba efa rkɛ̀' a Nyʉ̀.
eng: The same was in the beginning with God.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ à m gèe yi à ŋger Nyʉ̀. Yuu mo' yi yu ce yi m buu efa rgèe ka'.
eng: All things were made through him. Without him was not anything made that has been made.

lmp: Ryòŋ li m vʉ̀ ba ese yi. Ryòŋ anà li m ba rraa nè bèe.
eng: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

lmp: Rraa anà li ke raa à tʉ̀'nji. Tʉ̀'nji à m be liisi rraa anà ka'.
eng: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn't overcome it.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba ce Nyʉ̀ à m tuu. Li rlii li m ba enɛ Jôn.
eng: There came a man, sent from God, whose name was John.

lmp: E m vʉ̀ tɛ e bo suŋ bèe àmbò rraa anà tɛ bèe a bo byemi njobè' e suŋ wowèe.
eng: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

lmp: E m ba rraa anà ka'. E m ku vʉ yi ba à rsuŋ bèe àmbò rraa anà.
eng: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

lmp: Rraa mini ce li ke raa mbendù bèe wɛɛwɛ nà li m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ.
eng: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

lmp: E m ba njep ŋgòŋ. Ŋgòŋ ca à m gèe ye à ŋger Nyʉ̀. Ŋgòŋ yi m rìŋ ye ka'.
eng: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn't recognize him.

lmp: E m vʉ̀ fa yê là', yì bèe a konì ye ka'.
eng: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn't receive him.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a m koni ye a ker byemi nè ye foŋ nà, e fa ŋger enɛ wowèe a beeŋger ba boo Nyʉ̀.
eng: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God's children, to those who believe in his name:

lmp: Boo ce a bi ba àmbò a ke bi boo nà ka'. Yu ba boo ce a bi ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ kòŋ.
eng: who were born not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

lmp: Nlàa anà yi m bèeŋger à ŋwɛ̀ ghup, a cu a wêr mʉ. Wèr à m yɛ yi fòo ce yi m lò ba ese yì Tâ. Nyʉ̀ à m fa njɛ̀ɛ fòo ca ba nè muu yì ce e ku ba mò'sir. Wèr à m yɛ rbôŋ Nyʉ̀ ba mini Nyʉ̀ ba njep ye.
eng: The Word became flesh, and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the one and only Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

lmp: Jôn a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m suŋ bèe àmbò ye. E m làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe enɛ e bii ka' vʉ̀ nà. Mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe enɛ nta' ŋwɛ̀ anà yi càa ya, njobè' tɛ a ka' kè bi mɛ̀, e m ku ba."
eng: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, This was he of whom I said, 'He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.'

lmp: À ka' ba njo' ku' li rbòŋ, sèe wɛɛwɛ à konì bghònì ese ye ŋkàrà' àŋgoo.
eng: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m fa sèe mncir ba njì enjep Musìs, à ka' ba njì enjep Jisos Krâis, sèe à rìŋ rbôŋ Nyʉ̀ ba mini Nyʉ̀.
eng: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m be yɛ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Muu Nyʉ̀ ce e ku ba mò'sir, a ker ba mntee Nyʉ̀, a ye ce e dùŋshi sèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce yì Ta yu.
eng: No one has seen God at any time. The one and only Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has declared him.

lmp: Jus ce à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a m tuu bèe mò' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe Lɛvì enɛ a du yɛ Jôn, bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ nda?"
eng: This is John's testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, Who are you?

lmp: Jôn à m kani efa rbèesi yuu ce wowèe a m bipshi na ka'. Cena a yuu ce e m làa nè wowèe à bsii bèe wɛɛwɛ. E m làa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Krâis anà ka'"
eng: He declared, and didn't deny, but he declared, I am not the Christ.

lmp: Wowèe a ker bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Banɛ a wɛ̀ nda? A wɛ̀ Àlajà a?" E beesì enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Àlajà ka'." Wowèe a ker bipshi enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ anà a?" Jôn à kanì.
eng: They asked him, What then? Are you Elijah? He said, I am not. Are you the prophet? He answered, No.

lmp: Wowèe a ker bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Banɛ a wɛ̀ nda sê? Suŋ wèr njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce à yu tɛ wèr bo kʉti suŋ bèe ce a ba tuu wèr."
eng: They said therefore to him, Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?

lmp: Jôn à beesì enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce Àsayà à m làa àmbò ye elûuŋgòŋ enɛ̂, "Njèndoŋ mò' ce fuŋ à ntee rìŋ enɛ̂, Kupshi nè nduunjì nè Tata.""
eng: He said, I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, 'Make straight the way of the Lord,' as Isaiah the prophet said.

lmp: Bèe mò' ce bèe Farìsi a m tuu
eng: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

lmp: a m bipshi nè Jôn enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' tɛ ba Krâis anà ka', ba Àlajà ka', ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ e be tuu nà ka', wɛ̀ ka' ce bàptir bèe njokɛ?"
eng: They asked him, Why then do you baptize, if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?

lmp: Jôn à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce bàptir bèe ba nè mdip. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu a wêe mʉ, ce wèe à be riŋ ye ka'.
eng: John answered them, I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don't know.

lmp: A ye ce e ce vʉ̀ embe mɛ̂ njì. Yi nta' yi càa ya. Mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' m co'ni vi blaba' ka'."
eng: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I'm not worthy to loosen.

lmp: Buu ca vi m koni ba à rla' Bɛtanì ce li yu nèŋguu rdip Jodàn. A fàdì' Jôn à m ce bàptir bèe.
eng: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, Jôn à yɛ àmbò Jisòs ce vʉ̀ à ryɛ ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ nè Muu Njèe Nyʉ̀ ce e be siŋsi buu bbebep enjep ŋgòŋ.
eng: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

lmp: A ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m ce làa mɛnɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce vʉ̀ embe mɛ̂ njì ce yi nta' yi càa ya njobè' a m bii ka' bi mɛ̀, e ku ba nà."
eng: This is he of whom I said, 'After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ m rìŋ mɛnɛ a ye Krâis anà ka'. Geewa'a, mbùu ce mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ ya ce bàptir bèe à to' Isrɛ̀l à m ba enɛ wowèe a bo rìŋ ye."
eng: I didn't know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water: that he would be revealed to Israel.

lmp: Jôn à m suŋ bèe ba yuu ce e m yɛ, a laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m yɛ àmbò Yʉ' Rara yi ce sùu embe bùu àmbò bèŋ wa'a, a cu mbe yê ndù.
eng: John testified, saying, I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà mɛ̀ be riŋ ye ka'. Geewa'a Nyʉ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m vʉ baptir bèe à m làa nè mɛ̀ wɛɛ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce à be yɛ àmbò Yʉ' yi be sùu embe bùu, cu mbe yê ndù, a ŋwɛ̀ ce e be bàptir bèe nè Yʉ' Rara."
eng: I didn't recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water, he said to me, 'On whomever you will see the Spirit descending, and remaining on him, the same is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, a ce suŋ wèe rara enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà yu Muu Nyʉ̀."
eng: I have seen, and have testified that this is the Son of God.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' kèr raa, Jôn à tɛɛ a bèe a mmbaa ce e m ce yɛ'ni wowèe.
eng: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

lmp: E ka' yɛ àmbò Jisòs ce càa, a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ nè muu njèe Nyʉ̀."
eng: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, Behold, the Lamb of God!

lmp: bèe a mmbaa anà a ka' yu' àmbò Jôn à làa wa'a, a nati a du àmbùu Jisòs.
eng: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' karsi nyor yɛ àmbò wowèe a ce vʉ̀ a yê mbùu, e bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce ròo ba kɛ?" Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài ce yi yu enɛ Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, à ce cu ba fɛ?"
eng: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, What are you looking for? They said to him, Rabbi which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher, where are you staying?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè yɛ." Wowèe a du a yɛ fàdì' e m ce cu, a cu a Jisòs wèe, kɛ' embe nfè' nyʉ̀ à m kɛ̀' a ce coo.
eng: He said to them, Come, and see. They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

lmp: Mò' efa bèe a mmbaa ca ce e m yu' yuu Jôn à m làa a du àmbùu Jisòs foŋ nà à m ba Andrù nfʉr Saimʉn Pità.
eng: One of the two who heard John, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter's brother.

lmp: E m nàti a du cɛrcɛr sê, a du a yɛ nfʉr yî Saimʉn Pità a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à yɛ Mɛ̀sayà." Rlii ca li yu enɛ Krâis ŋwɛ̀ ce a ghar.
eng: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, We have found the Messiah! which is, being interpreted, Christ.

lmp: E m lòr ye a ye a du a yɛ Jisòs. Jisòs à ke' Saimʉ̀n a laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ Saimʉ̀n ce à yu muu Jôn, a be too wɛ̀ enɛ Kɛfàs." Rlii ce enɛ Kɛfàs na li ku ba foŋ àmbò rlii ce li yu enɛ Pità nà.
eng: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas which is by interpretation, Peter.

lmp: Tʉ̀' mò' à ka' kèr raa, Jisòs à natì enɛ e ce dù à ŋgôŋ Galèlê. E m ròo Felêp, a yɛ ye, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, Follow me.

lmp: Felep ca à m ba ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Bɛ̀tsaidà àmbò Andrù ba Saimʉn Pità a m ba.
eng: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, of the city of Andrew and Peter.

lmp: Felep ye ye à m yɛ Nàtanìyɛ̀l a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Musìs à m saŋ àmbò ye mbe ŋwà' mncir, ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a ker saŋ àmbò ye foŋ nà. A ye Jisòs muu Josɛ̀f ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t."
eng: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, We have found him, of whom Moses in the law, and the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.

lmp: Nàtanìyɛ̀l à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wà' àde' yuu bòŋboŋ yi fʉʉ à rla' Nasarɛ̀t a?" Felep à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ yɛ."
eng: Nathanael said to him, Can any good thing come out of Nazareth? Philip said to him, Come and see.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ àmbò Nàtanìyɛ̀l ce vʉ̀ à ryɛ ye, e laa yuu a kuu ye. E m làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ Isrɛ̀l ghup, a ba ŋwɛ̀ nlàayɛ."
eng: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!

lmp: Nàtanìyɛ̀l à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ rìŋ mɛ̀ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?" Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Tɛ Felep ka' kɛ' wɛ̀, mɛ̀ ba yɛ wɛ̀ à nfè' ce wɛ̀ ba cu njep mbùu ce ce a too enɛ fik nà."
eng: Nathanael said to him, How do you know me? Jesus answered him, Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.

lmp: Nàtanìyɛ̀l à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài, a wɛ̀ Muu Nyʉ̀. A wɛ̀ ŋkʉʉ à to' Isrɛ̀l."
eng: Nathanael answered him, Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, Jisòs ye ye à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ku byemi ba njobè' mɛ̀ ba laa mɛnɛ mɛ̀ ba yɛ wɛ̀ à nfè' wɛ̀ ba cu njep mbùu ce ce a too enɛ fik nà a? À be yɛ buu mo' ce vi be càa cena."
eng: Jesus answered him, Because I told you, 'I saw you underneath the fig tree,' do you believe? You will see greater things than these!

lmp: E m ker laa enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe be yɛ àmbò rbuu li be mʉ̀'ti tɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a ce ko' ce sùu mbendù Muu Ŋwɛ̀."
eng: He said to him, Most certainly, I tell you, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi ka' ba btaar, bèe mo' a ce gèe Ŋkâ' bgùu à rla' Kɛnà à ŋgôŋ Galèlê. Ma yì Jisòs à m ba àfo.
eng: The third day, there was a marriage in Cana of Galilee. Jesus' mother was there.

lmp: A m be Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu à ŋkà' ca foŋ.
eng: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the marriage.

lmp: Mrù' ŋkà' ca mi ka' mì, ma yì Jisòs à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "A no mrù' mi sɛ̂."
eng: When the wine ran out, Jesus' mother said to him, They have no wine.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀, à ce làa ba nè mɛ̀ njokɛ? Nfè' yà à be ghɛɛ ka'."
eng: Jesus said to her, Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.

lmp: Yì ma à laa nè ŋgâa mfà' enɛ̂, "Gèe nè yuu ce e ka' suŋ wèe enɛ wèe gêe."
eng: His mother said to the servants, Whatever he says to you, do it.

lmp: Mntʉŋ blùr vi m ba àfo vi ntuunfu. À m ba mntʉŋ ce Jus a m ce tɛr mdip njo tɛ a bo ce sù'si nyor àgho, ce ba brara à bsii Nyʉ̀. Àde' bgalòn mdip vi m ba ku du njep ntʉŋ mò'sir àmbò mmbaa du ba' mntaar wa'a.
eng: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews' way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa mfà' enɛ̂, "Tu' nè mdip cu'ni njep mntʉŋ ca." Wowèe a m tu' mdip a cu'ni njep mntʉŋ anà mi ruu àgho wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Jesus said to them, Fill the water pots with water. They filled them up to the brim.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Sɛpsi nè mdip anà du fa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gàpshi buu ŋkà'." Wowèe a m ku gee àmbò e m làa.
eng: He said to them, Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast. So they took it.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rgàpshì à yu'shì mdip ce mi m bèeŋger à mrù' na, a riŋ fàdì' mi lò ka'. Geewa'a ŋgâa mfà' a m rìŋ fàdì' mi m lò. E kɛ' ndùu gùu,
eng: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn't know where it came from but the servants who had drawn the water knew, the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe a ke tar bèe, vʉ nè mrû' mbòŋmboŋ entombì, bèe a no yu' wɛɛ, e ka' vʉ nè mì ce mi bòŋ gòr ka'. Wɛ̀ gèe yo jɛɛ. Wɛ̀ lòr mrû' mmbòŋmboŋ a tar bèe àgho ba àlʉ̀simbùu."
eng: and said to him, Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!

lmp: Yuu ghagha' ce Jisòs à m gèe à rla' Kɛnà à ŋgôŋ Galèle na, à m ba ncòo entombì ce e m dùŋshi njɛ̀ɛ fòo ce e tʉr. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yɛ, a byemi nè ye.
eng: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

lmp: A ka' ye ŋkà' mìsi, Jisòs ba yì ma ba bfʉr vi ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a natì a du à rla' Kàpanùm a cu àfo à mʉ mnòŋ mo'.
eng: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

lmp: Nfè' à m kɛ̀' a ce ghɛɛ ce bèe Jus a ke ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap. Jisòs à du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m tɛ e bo ye ŋkà' anà foŋ.
eng: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

lmp: E ka' dù bà', a niŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a yɛ àmbò bèe a ce fyèni nà', ba njèe, ba bbèŋ a ker yɛ àmbò bèe a ce kupse mbàa mbo.
eng: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

lmp: E lor kʉ̀ a gee ŋgwàa àgho, a juu bèe anà àgho, a ker juu yap njèe ba yap nà' embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀. E m bùte btɛbùr ese bèe ce a m ce kupse mbàa nà, a da'si yap mbàa anà à nshè.
eng: He made a whip of cords, and threw all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers' money, and overthrew their tables.

lmp: E m làa nè bèe ce a m ce fyèni bbèŋ nà enɛ̂, "Lòr nè buu anà duse àgho. Wèe à gèe ndap yà Ta à kʉtì ndap ntaa njokɛ?"
eng: To those who sold the doves, he said, Take these things out of here! Don't make my Father's house a marketplace!

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu anà a ka' yɛ àmbò e gèe wa'a, wowèe a kuushì yuu ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ce mɛ̀ tʉr nè yò ndap li be yʉ mɛ̀" nà.
eng: His disciples remembered that it was written, Zeal for your house will eat me up.

lmp: Jus a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yuu ce àde' à gee àmbò ncòo à rdùŋshi wèr enɛ à tʉr ŋger à rgèe buu ca, yu kɛ?"
eng: The Jews therefore answered him, What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ka' sa' Ndap Nyʉ̀ ca, m lor mnôŋ btaar ba'rî."
eng: Jesus answered them, Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Habai! A m bà'ri Ndap Nyʉ̀ ca à bfè' ncòp-ntuunfu- à-mŋkyèe. Àde' à gee wɛ kɛ ka' ba'ri à mnôŋ btaar?"
eng: The Jews therefore said, It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?

lmp: Geewa'a Jisòs à m ce làa àmbò Ndap Nyʉ̀ ca, a ce làa ba àmbò yì nyor.
eng: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

lmp: E ka' lô fʉʉ efa rkwe, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a kuushì yuu ce e m làa anà. A ka' kuushi, a byemi yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa, a ker byemi yuu ce Jisòs à m làa anà.
eng: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture, and the word which Jesus had said.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a duŋshi mncòo, vi gee bèe magòr a byemì nè ye sê.
eng: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

lmp: Geewa'a, e m fa yì nyor nè wowèe ka' njobè' e m rìŋ mntee bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But Jesus didn't trust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

lmp: Mbùu mò' à m ker ba àgho enɛ a suŋ ye àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ka', njobè' e m rìŋ buu ce bèe a ce kwà'shi wɛɛ.
eng: and because he didn't need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mò' à m ba à mʉ̀ Jûs, a too ye enɛ Nìkòdɛmòs. E m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe Farìsî.
eng: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

lmp: À ka' ba nètʉ' mò', e du a yɛ Jisòs, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài, wèr rìŋ wernɛ a wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì ce Nyʉ̀ à tuu, njobè' Nyʉ̀ à ka' tɛ fa ŋwɛ̀ ŋger ka', àde' ŋgàŋ duŋshì mncòo ce à ce dùŋshi na ka'."
eng: The same came to him by night, and said to him, Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ a ka' tɛ bi ŋwɛ̀ nfè' baa ka', àde' ŋgàŋ yɛ kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: Jesus answered him, Most certainly, I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can't see the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Nìkòdɛmòs à bipshì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba nleeŋwɛ̀ wɛɛ, àde' a gee ekɛ ka' ker bi ye? Wà' àde' e ker kʉti njep rbʉ̀ yì mâ, a bi ye ŋkàrà' baa a?"
eng: Nicodemus said to him, How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother's womb, and be born?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ a ka' tɛ bi ŋwɛ̀ nè mdip ker ba nè yʉ' ka', àde' ŋgàŋ niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Jesus answered, Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and spirit, he can't enter into the Kingdom of God!

lmp: Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à bi, yu yî ŋwɛ̀. Yuu ce yʉ' yi bi, à ba yî yʉ'.
eng: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

lmp: Fa bɛ̀ɛŋger njobè' mɛ̀ làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ a be kù kèr bi ŋwɛ̀ nfè' baa ka'.
eng: Don't marvel that I said to you, 'You must be born anew.'

lmp: Fu' yi ke càa, kashi àmbò yi gwɛɛ, à yu' àmbò yi còo. Wɛ̂ yu' wa', riŋ fàdì' yi lò kɛ̀ fàdì' ce yi ce dù ka'. Yi ku ba wa'a nè ŋwɛ̀ ce Yʉ' yi bi ye."
eng: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don't know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.

lmp: Nìkòdɛmòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Àde' buu ca vi ba wa'a à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: Nicodemus answered him, How can these things be?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ce à yu ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nî à to' Isrɛ̀l, wɛ̀ rìŋ buu ca ka' a?"
eng: Jesus answered him, Are you the teacher of Israel, and don't understand these things?

lmp: "M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèr ce làa ba buu ce wèr rìŋ, a ce suŋ wèe ba buu ce wèr à yɛ nè mer mmir. Wèr à ka' ce suŋ wèe buu ca, wèe à ke' byemì ka'.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know, and testify of that which we have seen, and you don't receive our witness.

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe àmbò buu enjep ŋgòŋ na, wèe à byemì ka', m ka' suŋ wèe àmbò buu embe bùu, wèe gee wee kɛ ka' byemi?
eng: If I told you earthly things and you don't believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu àgho ce e m be du mbe bùu caa efa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m lò embo a suu njep ŋgòŋ na ka'.
eng: No one has ascended into heaven, but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

lmp: Àmbò Musìs à m nàa nyo ce a m tòo nè bco' mbekì à nfè' wowèe a m ce jɛ̀r à rìŋ nà, a mbò a be kù kè nàa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ wa'a,
eng: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè ye, e bo koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kòŋ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ magòr sê, a tuu Muu yì ce e ku ba mò'sir enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè ye, e bo kwe ka', koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m tuu Muu yì njep ŋgòŋ enɛ e vʉ sa' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ ka', e m tuu Muu yi enɛ wowèe a bo lùŋ njo' ye.
eng: For God didn't send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè ye, e lùŋ efa mnsa'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ byemi nè ye ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ à gwè mnsa' njobè' e kani efa rbyemi nè Muu yì ce e ku ba mò'sir.
eng: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn't believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the one and only Son of God.

lmp: A mbò mnsa' anà vi yu à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ̂: Rraa li vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ, bèe a koŋ ba tʉ̀'nji a caa rraa njobè' wowèe a ce gèe buu bbebep.
eng: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for their works were evil.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe buu bbebep banɛ ŋgàŋ kòŋ rraa ka', a koŋ à rbà' fàdì' rraa li yu ka', tɛ yì buu bbebep bo yɛɛti àwaŋ ka'.
eng: For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn't come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe yuu mini, e ke vʉ̀ fàdì' rraa li yu tɛ bèe a bo yɛ rara enɛ e ce gèe ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ."
eng: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.

lmp: Buu ca à ka' mì wɛɛ, Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'nì yì buu a natì a du à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, e cu a wowèe àfo, a baptir bèe.
eng: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them, and baptized.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, Jôn à m ce bàptir bèe à rla' Ɛnòn àgee rla' Salìm. Mdip mi m ba àfo sê. Bèe a m ce vʉ̀, e ce bàptir wowèe.
eng: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came, and were baptized.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà a be nè fa Jôn à shaŋ ka'.
eng: For John was not yet thrown into prison.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'nì buu Jôn mo' a m kɛ̀' a ce sɛr mnsɛr a ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ Jus àmbò àde' ŋwɛ̀ su'sì nyor ba nrara à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: There arose therefore a questioning on the part of John's disciples with some Jews about purification.

lmp: Wowèe a du a yɛ Jôn a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài, ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe ye à m ba nèŋguu rdip Jodàn, wɛ̀ suŋ bèe àmbò ye nà, ŋwɛ̀ anà ce bàptir bèe, bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce dù yê mbùu."
eng: They came to John, and said to him, Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, the same baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.

lmp: Jôn à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Àtà ŋwɛ̀ tʉr yuu mo' caa efa yì ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè ye ka'.
eng: John answered, A man can receive nothing, unless it has been given him from heaven.

lmp: Wee wèe foŋ à m yu' àmbò mɛ̀ m làa enɛ a mɛ̀ Krâis nà ka'. M yu ya ba ŋwɛ̀ ce a tuu enɛ e du entombì nè ye.
eng: You yourselves testify that I said, 'I am not the Christ,' but, 'I have been sent before him.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke tʉr ŋgwagùu yu ba nduu. Ŋkar nduu ka' tɛɛ ce yu' àmbò nduu anà ce làa, banɛ e be lu'shi magòr sê. A mbò yi ku ba nè mɛ̀ wa'a. M ce lu'shi se njobè' m yu ŋkar nduu anà.
eng: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom's voice. This, my joy, therefore is made full.

lmp: Yi nta' yi be kù ce dù entombì, tɛ ya yi ce kʉti njìnjì.
eng: He must increase, but I must decrease.

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e sùu embe bùu a ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ. Ŋwɛ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ ku ba ŋwɛ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ, a ce làa yi ba àmbò buu enjep ŋgòŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e sùu yi ba embe bùu nà yu mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe.
eng: He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the Earth belongs to the Earth, and speaks of the Earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

lmp: E ce làa ba buu ce e m yɛ nè mi mmir, a yu' nè vi btù'. Geewa'a bèe a byemi yuu ce e ce làa ka'.
eng: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi yuu ce e làa, banɛ ŋgàŋ ce dùŋshi enɛ yuu Nyʉ̀ à làa yi yu mini.
eng: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à tuu ce suŋ bèe blâa Nyʉ̀, njobè' Nyʉ̀ à lòr yi Yʉ' a fa nè ye a bɛr yuu mo' ka'.
eng: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

lmp: Tàr kòŋ Muu yì, a fa buu wɛɛwɛ mba yê mmbò.
eng: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè Muu banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ryòŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' kani efa rbyemi nè Muu yì banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ryòŋ ka'. Nyʉ̀ be cɛpshi ntèe nè ŋwɛ̀ anà nfesè."
eng: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won't see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a m yu' enɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ker ba bèe ce Jisòs à m bàptir nà a m ba gòr a caa ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jôn.
eng: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

lmp: Gee ne wa'a, Jisòs a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce bàptir bèe ka'. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ca a bèe ce a m ce bàptir bèe nè ye.
eng: although Jesus himself didn't baptize, but his disciples,

lmp: Tata Jisòs à ka' rìŋ enɛ bèe Farìsi a yu' buu ca, e natî à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a ce kʉti à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: he left Judea, and departed into Galilee.

lmp: Àmbò e m ce kʉti anà, yi m ba enɛ e be kù dù ba njî à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà.
eng: He needed to pass through Samaria.

lmp: E ka' ce jɛ̀r ce càa à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà anà, a ba' à rla' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ Sikà. Rla' ca li m ba àgee ŋkʉ̀ ce Jakòp à m fa nè muu yî Josɛ̀f.
eng: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son, Joseph.

lmp: Jakòp à m tʉr rdip rtuŋ àfo. Jisòs à ka' bà' fa rdip anà, a lʉshi àgee mo njobè' e m jɛ̀r a sɛ̂. À m ba à nfè' anà nyʉ̀ à kɛ' a ce kùu ŋgòŋ.
eng: Jacob's well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mô' à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà à m vʉ̀ à rtu' mdip. Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa mɛ̀ mdip tɛ m no."
eng: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, Give me a drink.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a m ba nè du à ryuu byee à mʉ̀ rla'.
eng: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Haba! Mbò a wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ Jus a? Yi lò efà kɛ, wɛ̀ ka' ce loo mdip ese mɛ̀ ce m yu njeŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà?" Jus ba bèe à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà a ke gèe buu àbee ka'. è
eng: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman? For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ba riŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ e ke fa nè bèe, ker riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce loo mdip ese wɛ̀ tɛ e bo no, à ba loo ba wɛ̀ enɛ e fa wɛ̀ mdip ce mi ke mì ka', tɛ e fa wɛ̀ mdip anà."
eng: Jesus answered her, If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, 'Give me a drink,' you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, rdip rtuŋ ca li coomi sê. À tʉr yuu ce à be tu' mdip àgho ka', banɛ à be tu' mdip ce mi ke mì ka' efɛ?
eng: The woman said to him, Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. From where then have you that living water?

lmp: Wà' à càa yèr ta Jakòp ce e m tuŋ rdip ca nè wèr a? E m no mdip enjep rdip rtuŋ ca a boo vi wèe ker ba yi nyàa."
eng: Are you greater than our father, Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank of it himself, as did his children, and his livestock?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' no mdip enjep rdip rtuŋ ca, ntee mdip yi ku lo luu ye.
eng: Jesus answered her, Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' no mdip ce à fa mɛ̀ a fa ye, àde' ntee mdip yi ker luu ye à nfè' mò' ka'. Mdip ce m be fa ŋgàŋ mi be ba nè ye àmbò rdip ce li be ce fʉʉ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, gèe tɛ e koni ryòŋ ce nfesè."
eng: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, fa mɛ̀ njɛ̀ɛ mdip anà tɛ m no, fà dì' ntee mdip yi bo kèr lùu mɛ̀ tɛ m ker ce vʉ̀ à rtu' mdip àfa ka'."
eng: The woman said to him, Sir, give me this water, so that I don't get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù vʉ nè nduu wò."
eng: Jesus said to her, Go, call your husband, and come here.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa enɛ̂, "M tʉr nduu ka'." Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Â làa mini ghup enɛ à tʉr nduu ka'.
eng: The woman answered, I have no husband. Jesus said to her, You said well, 'I have no husband,'

lmp: Wɛ̀ m dù bgùu mndap tâ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe ye ce cu sè'ni na, a nduu wò ka'. Wɛ̀ làa yuu mini ghup."
eng: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Masà, mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ à yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: The woman said to him, Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

lmp: Wer btarkʉ a m ce dù rloo mbe rtûu àfa na, wèe a ce làa ye enɛ dì' ce àde' bèe a du rloo ku ba ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m."
eng: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀, m ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ nfè' ce ghɛɛ ce bèe a be kèr dù rloo mbe rtùu ca ka', ka' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: Jesus said to her, Woman, believe me, the hour comes, when neither in this mountain, nor in Jerusalem, will you worship the Father.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce wêe ke loo nè ye ka'. Wèr rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce wer ke loo nè ye njobè' rlùŋ li ke lò ba ese Jûs.
eng: You worship that which you don't know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

lmp: Nfè' ce vʉ̀, nfè' anà à ghɛɛte sè'ni na, ce ŋgâa rloo ce mini a be loo nè Tàr à yʉ' ker ba à mini. A njɛ̀ɛ ŋgâa rloo ce Tàr e kòŋ.
eng: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshippers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshippers.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ yu yʉ'. Banɛ bèe ce a ce loo nè ye a be kù loo à yʉ' ker ba à mini."
eng: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ Mɛ̀sayà ce a too enɛ Krâis nà be vʉ̀. E be vʉ̀ tɛ e suŋ sèe buu wɛɛwɛ."
eng: The woman said to him, I know that Messiah comes, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ ce m ce làa nè wɛ̀ na, a mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ anà."
eng: Jesus said to her, I am he, the one who speaks to you.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' anà, ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a kʉtì. A ka' kʉti yɛ àmbò Jisòs ce de' a njeŋwɛ̀, wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr sê. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m bipshi yuu ce njeŋwɛ̀ anà à m ce ròo kɛ̀ mbùu ce Jisòs à m ce de' a ye ka'.
eng: At this, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, What are you looking for? or, Why do you speak with her?

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à m tɛr ntʉŋ mdip a kʉti à là' a laa nè bèe enɛ̂,
eng: So the woman left her water pot, and went away into the city, and said to the people,

lmp: "Vʉ̀ nè vʉ yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e suŋ mɛ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ ce mɛ̀ m ce gèe. Seemò' ŋwɛ̀ anà a Krâis."
eng: Come, see a man who told me everything that I did. Can this be the Christ?

lmp: Wowèe a fʉʉ à rla' anà a dù à ryɛ ye.
eng: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

lmp: Àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ca à m kʉti à là' nà, ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ca a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Rabài, ye yuu sè'ni."
eng: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, Rabbi, eat.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M tʉr njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' ce wèe rìŋ ka'."
eng: But he said to them, I have food to eat that you don't know about.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu', a laa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à vʉ̀ nè byee a fa nè ye a?"
eng: The disciples therefore said one to another, Has anyone brought him something to eat?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wa byee yu enɛ m gee yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ kòŋ, ker misi rfà' ce e m fa nè mɛ̀.
eng: Jesus said to them, My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.

lmp: Wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ mŋwɛɛ vi bɛti kyèe tɛ a ka' kep kwaa efa mŋkʉ̀. M ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe naa me mmir fyɛ' à mŋkʉ̀. Kwaa à bàŋ, nfè' rkep à ce ghɛɛ.
eng: Don't you say, 'There are yet four months until the harvest?' Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes, and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kep buu efa mŋkʉ̀ ce yɛ sɛ' efa li rfà' wɛɛ. E ce baashi byee ce vi bo koni ryòŋ ce nfesè, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ rbyè ker ba ŋwɛ̀ rkep a bo lu'shi bsìp.
eng: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit to eternal life; that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

lmp: Yi ku ba foŋ àmbò a ke mà' ŋgàa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ jɛɛ byê, ŋwɛ̀ jɛɛ kep nà.
eng: For in this the saying is true, 'One sows, and another reaps.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ tuu wèe enɛ wèe du kep buu ce wèe à m byè ka'. Bèe mo' a m byè, wèe à ye sɛ' efa rfà' bèe anà."
eng: I sent you to reap that for which you haven't labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.

lmp: Bèe magôr à ŋgòŋ Sàmarìyà ce a m vʉ̂ à rla' Sikà a m byemi nè Jisòs njobè' njeŋwɛ̀ anà à m làa enɛ̂, "E suŋ mɛ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ ce mɛ̀ m gèe."
eng: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, He told me everything that I did.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀ yɛ Jisòs, a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ a wowèe a cu. Jisòs à byemì, a cu a wowèe à mnôŋ bbaa.
eng: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

lmp: Bèe mo' gòr se a ker byemi nè ye njobè' buu ce e m suŋ wowèe.
eng: Many more believed because of his word.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa nè njeŋwɛ̀ anà enɛ̂, "Wèr à ku byemi ba njo' yuu ce wɛ̀ suŋ wèr ka', wèr à yu' sè'ni nè wer btù', a riŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ wernɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e be gèe tɛ ŋgòŋ yi lûŋ."
eng: They said to the woman, Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.

lmp: Mnôŋ bbaa ca vi ka' càa, Jisòs à natì a ce dù à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

lmp: Jisòs nè yi tu nyor à m be laa enɛ a ke yu'ni nè ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ fa yê ŋgòŋ ka'.
eng: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

lmp: Geewa'a, e ka' bà' à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, bêe à ŋgôŋ Galèle a konì ye bòŋboŋ sê, njobè' wowèe foŋ a m dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap, a yɛ buu ce Jisòs à m gèe à nfè' ce a m ce ye ŋkà' anà.
eng: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ba à ŋgôŋ Galèle wa'a, a ker du à rla' Kɛnà fàdì' ce e m bèesi mdip mi kʉtì mrù' nà. Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mò' à m ba àfo ce muu yì à m ce yaŋ à rla' ce a m ce too enɛ Kàpanùm.
eng: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ca à ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs à nàtî à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a vʉ à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, e du a yɛ ye, a bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ a ye a du à rla' Kàpanùm tɛ e bo gee muu yì ce e m ce yaŋ a ku ba yî ŋkwe, ke'se.
eng: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him, and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèe ku ce kòŋ à ryɛ mncòo ba buu bbɛ̀ɛ ka' byemi nè mɛ̀."
eng: Jesus therefore said to him, Unless you see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr anà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yà tâ, sò ce du fà dì' muu wà kwe ka'."
eng: The nobleman said to him, Sir, come down before my child dies.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù, muu wò be kwe ka'." Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr anà à byemì yuu ce Jisòs à m làa, a nati a ce kʉti.
eng: Jesus said to him, Go your way. Your son lives. The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

lmp: E ka' kʉti bà' àwâa rla', ŋgâa mfà' a vʉ a koni ye a laa nè ye enɛ muu yì à lùŋ.
eng: As he was now going down, his servants met him and reported, saying Your child lives!

lmp: E bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Muu ca à mʉ kɛ' a ce lùŋ ba à nfè' efɛ?" Wowèe a beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "E mʉ luŋ nèŋkùr à nfè' nyʉ̀ à mʉ kɛ' a ce lɛ'si nyor."
eng: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.

lmp: Tar muu à kuushì enɛ nfè' muu yì à mʉ naa rlir anà ku ba nfè' ce Jisòs à mʉ laa nè ye enɛ muu yì be kwe ka' nà. Ye yi tu nyor ker ba bèe embe yê ndàp wɛɛwɛ a byemì nè Jisòs.
eng: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, Your son lives. He believed, as did his whole house.

lmp: Yuu ghagha' ca a ncòo embenjì ce Jisòs à m gèe à nfè' ce e m lô à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a kʉti à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

lmp: Buu ca vi ka' mì wɛɛ, Jus a ce ye yap ŋkà' mo'. Jisòs à du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

lmp: Tʉ̀ mo' yi m ba à rla' anà àgee cûu ŋka' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ cùu ŋka' njèe. A too rlii tʉ̀ anà à li Hibrù enɛ Bɛ̀tsatà. A m bà'ri btàp mbùu too àwâa tʉ̀ anà vi tâ.
eng: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, Bethesda, having five porches.

lmp: Ku' ŋgâa byaŋ a m nòŋte à btàp anà. Bèe mo' efa wowèe a m fèp, bèe mo' a ba mntɛ̀ŋ, mŋgʉ̀' nyor mmo' vi kweŋgèr bèe mo'. Wowèe a m cu a ce kè' nfè' ce tʉ̀ be kɛ̀' ce baŋti.
eng: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à m ce lô vʉ̀ ce gèe tʉ̀ anà yi ce baŋti. Tʉ̀ anà yi m ce baŋti wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gwe njo entombì, e m ka' ce yaŋ ba njɛ̀ɛ yaŋ kɛ, banɛ e be lùŋ.
