eng: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool, and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was made whole of whatever disease he had.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba àfo ce e m yaŋ à bfè' ncòp-waami-à-mntaar.
eng: A certain man was there, who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' vʉ̀ bà' a yɛ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ anà nòŋ. E m rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à m yaŋ nfè' njìsàp sê. E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ kòŋ à rlùŋ efa yo yaŋ ca a?"
eng: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, Do you want to be made well?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Masà, e ke ba à nfè' ce tʉ̀ à baŋti m tʉr ŋwɛ̀ ce e lor mɛ̀ dù àgho njo ka'. Mɛ lô ghèter à nfè' anà enɛ m du njo, ŋwɛ̀ mò' ku du entombì nè mɛ̀."
eng: The sick man answered him, Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I'm coming, another steps down before me.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì, lor lo rwàa ce dû."
eng: Jesus said to him, Arise, take up your mat, and walk.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à ku luŋ à nfè' anà a lor li rwàa a ce dù. Nòŋ ce Jisòs à m gèe ŋwɛ̀ anà e luŋ efa yi yaŋ anà, à m ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀.
eng: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now it was the Sabbath on that day.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jus laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce Jisòs à ba gee e luŋ nà enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ rìŋ enɛ ntìni a mmbomntaa. Wɛ̀ byɛ̀' rwàa anà wa'a, a bʉ' ncir."
eng: So the Jews said to him who was cured, It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ba gee mɛ̀ luŋ efa ya yaŋ à ba laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ m lor la rwàa ce dû."
eng: He answered them, He who made me well, the same said to me, 'Take up your mat, and walk.'

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ba laa enɛ à lor lo rwàa du à ba laa nda anà?"
eng: Then they asked him, Who is the man who said to you, 'Take up your mat, and walk'?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à m rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe ye e luŋ efa yi yaŋ ka', njobè' Jisòs à m lò a bʉ à mʉ̀ kʉr bèe ce a m ba àfo.
eng: But he who was healed didn't know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

lmp: Mʉ nfè' mò' à ka' tuuse, Jisòs à yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe ye e luŋ nà mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, wɛ̀ lùŋ efa yo yaŋ. Fa kèr gèe buu bbebep ka', fà dì' ŋgɛ' mò' gòr lo koni wɛ̀ càa cena ka'."
eng: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà à du a suŋ Jus enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe ye e luŋ à gèe Jisòs.
eng: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

lmp: Wowèe a kɛ' a ce fa Jisòs ŋgɛ' njobè' buu ce e m gèe nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa.
eng: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus, and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yà ta ce fà' à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Mɛ mɛ̀ ce fà' à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a."
eng: But Jesus answered them, My Father is still working, so I am working, too.

lmp: Jus a ka' yu' yuu ce Jisòs à làa, a ku ker gheter ba à se enɛ a ba yʉ ye njobè' e m ku bʉ' ba ncir mmbomntaa cà'cà' ka', e m ker laa foŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu yì tâ. Banɛ e m ce làa enɛ a Nyʉ̀ a ku ba yɛɛnì.
eng: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè bèe anà enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ àde' Muu gee yuu nè yi tu ka'. Àde' e gee ba yuu ce e yɛ Tàr à ce gèe. Yuu ce yì Ta e ke gèe, a yuu ce ye ye e ke gèe.
eng: Jesus therefore answered them, Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

lmp: Tàr kòŋ Muu, a ce dùŋshi ye buu wɛɛwɛ ce e ke gèe. E be dùŋshi ye buu bghagha' ce e be gèe ce vi be càa vì ce wèe à yɛ na, tɛ wèe yɛ, bɛ̀ɛŋger sê.
eng: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

lmp: Àmbò Tàr e ke gèe bèe ce a kweŋger a fʉʉ efa rkwe, cu btèe, a mbò Muu ye ye e ke gèe bèe ce e ce, a cu btèe à njɛ̂ɛ wa' foŋ.
eng: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

lmp: Tàr e ke sa' ŋwɛ̀ ka', e fa ŋger nè muu yì enɛ e sa' bèe,
eng: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

lmp: tɛ bèe a bo yu'ni nè Muu yì àmbò a ke yu'ni nè ye foŋ nà. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ yu'ni nè muu ka', banɛ àde' ŋgàŋ yu'nì nè Tàr ce e m tuu Muu anà ka'.
eng: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn't honor the Son doesn't honor the Father who sent him.

lmp: "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yu' ya nlàa, byemi nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ryòŋ ce nfesè. A be sa' ŋwɛ̀ anà ka' njobè' rkwe li kèr tʉr ŋger mbe yê ndù ka'. Ŋgàŋ be cu ntèe.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word, and believes him who sent me, has eternal life, and doesn't come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ku ba ce e ce suŋ àmbò mɛ̀. M rìŋ mɛnɛ yuu ce e ce suŋ àmbò mɛ̀ yi yu mini.
eng: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

lmp: Wèe à m tuu yè bèe enɛ a du yɛ Jôn. E m suŋ wèe yuu mini.
eng: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

lmp: Mbùu mò' yu àgho nè mɛ̀ à rròo ŋwɛ̀ tɛ e bo suŋ bèe àmbò mɛ̀ ka'. Geewa'a m ce suŋ wèe enɛ Jôn à m làa àmbò mɛ̀, tɛ wèe bo byemi, lùŋ.
eng: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

lmp: E m ba lam ce a cʉ̀' e ce raa sê. Wèe à m koni li rraa anà, a lu'shi nè li à mʉ nfè' mò'.
eng: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

lmp: M tʉr buu mò' ce vi ce suŋ àmbò mɛ̀ caa vî Jôn. Mfà' ce m ce gèe ce yà Ta à fa mɛ̀ ŋger enɛ m gee misi mi ce suŋ àmbò mɛ̀, a ce dùŋshi enɛ yà Ta à tuu mɛ̀.
eng: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John, for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

lmp: Yà Ta ce e m tuu mɛ̀ à làa yuu a kuu mɛ̀ foŋ. Wèe à m be yu' yì njèndoŋ ka', a be yɛ ye ka'.
eng: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

lmp: Wèe à lɛ̀ yi nlàa njep wêe mntee ka' njobè' wèe à byemi nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu nà ka'.
eng: You don't have his word living in you; because you don't believe him whom he sent.

lmp: Wèe ce yɛ'ni Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ njobè' wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ yi be gèe tɛ wèe koni ryòŋ ce nfesè. Ku ba ŋwà' anà ce yi ce suŋ àmbò mɛ̀.
eng: You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

lmp: Wèe à m ba byemi nè Musìs, wèe à ba byemi nè mɛ̀ njobè' Musìs à m saŋ àmbò mɛ̀.
eng: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

lmp: Wèe à ka' tɛ byemi yuu ce e m saŋ ka', wèe ka' byemi yuu ce m ce làa à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: But if you don't believe his writings, how will you believe my words?

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, Jisòs à tuu nèŋguu tʉ̂ Galèle ce a too foŋ enɛ Tìbɛrìyàs.
eng: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

lmp: Bèe magòr a ce dù a yê mbùu njobè' mncòo ce e m gèe. E m gèe ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'sè.
eng: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

lmp: Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m ko' mbe rtùu, a ka' bà' mbo a cu à nshè.
eng: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, nfè' ce Jus a m ce ye yap ŋkâ' càasi-mndap à kɛ' a ce ghɛɛ.
eng: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' nàa mmir yɛ àmbò kʉr bèe a ce vʉ̀ à ryɛ ye, e laa nè Felep enɛ̂, "Sèe be yuu byee ba efɛ tɛ bèe ca a ka' ye?"
eng: Jesus therefore lifting up his eyes, and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?

lmp: Jisòs à m làa wa'a a ce taase Felep taase njobè' e m ku riŋ yuu ce e be gèe.
eng: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

lmp: Felep à beesì enɛ̂, "Sèe à ka' yuu byee à bbàa mbâa bbaa vi ghɛɛtè ka'."
eng: Philip answered him, Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that everyone of them may receive a little.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu mò' ce à m ba Andrù ce e m ba nfʉr Saimʉn Pità à laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂,
eng: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, said to him,

lmp: "Muu mbaŋrù mò' yu mbena, a tʉr brɛ̂d yi tâ, ba nca baa. Àde' mʉ byee ca vi ba' à yuu ka'."
eng: There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Làa nè tɛ bèe ca a cu à nshè." Mjɛɛ mi m ba mbe dì' anà. Mmbaŋrù ce a m cute à nshè a m ba àmbò ncʉ̀kì tâ.
eng: Jesus said, Have the people sit down. Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

lmp: Jisòs à lor mntu' brɛ̂d anà, a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a gapshi nè bèe ce a m cute à nshè nà. A lor nca a gapshi nè wowèe foŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ye a yu'.
eng: Jesus took the loaves; and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down; likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

lmp: A ka' ye yu', Jisòs à laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Baashi nè bbɛbɛ' brɛ̂d ce vi bɛti nà àbee fà dì' vi bʉ à cicì ka'."
eng: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.

lmp: Wowèe a baashì bbɛbɛ' brɛ̂d anà àbee. Bbɛbɛ' ce vi m bɛti vi m ruu à mŋkàa ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

lmp: Bèe anà a ka' yɛ ncòo ce Jisòs à m dùŋshi na, a laa enɛ̂, "Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m làa enɛ e be kè vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ nà."
eng: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.

lmp: Jisòs à m rìŋ enɛ bèe anà a ce ròo à rkoo ye à ŋger, ghar à ŋkʉʉ. E ka' rìŋ wa'a, a nati a beeŋger à ŋgʉ̀' rtùu mò' a cu àfo mimŋgi'.
eng: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force, to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

lmp: À ka' ba à mbùuŋkùr, ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a du àwâa tʉ̀,
eng: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,

lmp: a niŋ mbe keŋ, a ce dù à rla' Kàpanùm ce li m ba nèŋguu tʉ̀ anà. A ka' ce dù, tʉ̀' à sii wowèe. À m ba à nfè' anà, Jisòs à be vʉ a koni wowèe ka'.
eng: and they entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

lmp: Fu' yi kɛ' a ce càa gòr sê, rdip li ce bèeŋger ce ko' mbekì, ce sùu.
eng: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù àmbò bkìlomɛtà ta dù bà' ntuunfu wa'a, a yɛ àmbò Jisòs ce jɛ̀r mbendù rdip a ce vʉ̀ àgee keŋ. Wowèe a ka' yɛ wa'a, a wɛp sê.
eng: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea, and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp nè ka', a mɛ̀."
eng: But he said to them, It is I. Don't be afraid.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce kòŋ à rkoo ye mbe keŋ. A ka' kè', a ku yɛ enɛ wowèe a bà' nèŋguu tʉ̀ fàdì' wowèe a m ce dù.
eng: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, bèe ce a m ku bii yap nje wâa tʉ̀ a yɛ enɛ keŋ à m ku ba njo mò'sir. A m rìŋ enɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m niŋ mbe keŋ anà a du mapŋgi', Jisòs à ba mbo ka'.
eng: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn't entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

lmp: Bkeŋ mo' vi m vʉ̂ à rla' Tìbɛrìyàs, a vʉ a ba' fàdì' ce bèe a m ye brɛ̂d ce Tata Jisòs à m yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ àtu mo nà.
eng: However boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

lmp: Bèe anà a ka' yɛ enɛ ka' Jisòs kɛ̀ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a yu àfo ka', wowèe a niŋ à bkeŋ anà a du à rla' Kàpanùm a ce ròo Jisòs.
eng: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn't there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats, and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ ye nèŋguu tʉ̀, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài, wɛ̀ vʉ̀ àfa à se'kɛ?"
eng: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, Rabbi, when did you come here?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe ce ròo mɛ̀ ba njo' ncòo ce wèe à mʉ yɛ mɛ̀ duŋshì nà ka'. Wèe ce ròo mɛ̀ ba njo' brɛ̂d ce wèe à mʉ ye a yu'.
eng: Jesus answered them, Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves, and were filled.

lmp: Wèe fa fà' ba à rkoni byee ce vi be mì ka'. Fà' nè ba à rkoni byee ce vi be cu, fa ryòŋ ce nfesè. A njɛ̀ɛ byee ce Muu Ŋwɛ̀ be fa wèe. Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yà Ta à fa ye yì ncòo à rdùŋshi enɛ e yu muu yì."
eng: Don't work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Yuu ce àde' wèr gêe, tɛ yi ka' ba enɛ wèr ce gèe mfà' Nyʉ̀ yu kɛ?"
eng: They said therefore to him, What must we do, that we may work the works of God?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Yuu ce àde' wèe gee yi yu enɛ wèe byemi nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e tuu mɛ̀."
eng: Jesus answered them, This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.

lmp: Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ncòo ce àde' à duŋshì tɛ wèr bo yɛ, byemi nè wɛ̀ yu kɛ?
eng: They said therefore to him, What then do you do for a sign, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you do?

lmp: Visèe bta a m ye manà à rìŋ àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à m fa wowèe byee ce vi m sùu embe bùu enɛ wowèe a ye." "
eng: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, 'He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.'

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ byee ce a m fa nè wee bta nà, à m fa Musìs ka'. Yà Ta a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fa wèe byee ce mini ce vi sùu embe bùu.
eng: Jesus therefore said to them, Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn't Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

lmp: Byee ce Nyʉ̀ ce fa anà yu byee ce vi sùu embe bùu a ce fa ryòŋ ce mini nè bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na."
eng: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven, and gives life to the world.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, fa wèr njɛ̀ɛ byee ca à nfè' sìp."
eng: They said therefore to him, Lord, always give us this bread.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M yu byee ce e à ryòŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' vʉ yɛ mɛ̀, àde' njè ker yaŋ ye ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè mɛ̀ àde' ntee yi ker yuushi ye ka'.
eng: Jesus said to them, I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.

lmp: Geewa'a, yi ku ba àmbò mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe nà, wèe à yɛ mɛ̀ nè me mmir a ke' byemi nè mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don't believe.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce yà Ta à fa nè mɛ̀, a be vʉ̀ yɛ mɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' vʉ yɛ mɛ̀, àde' m ke juu ŋgàŋ ka',
eng: All those who the Father gives me will come to me. Him who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

lmp: njobè' mɛ̀ sùu embe bùu a rgèe ba yuu ce m kòŋ ka'. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ a rgèe ba yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ kòŋ.
eng: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

lmp: Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ kòŋ, yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce e fa mba mɛ̂ mmbò bʉ ka', tɛ m bo gèe tɛ wowèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe à nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu.
eng: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

lmp: Yuu ce yà Ta kòŋ yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yɛ muu yì, byemi nè ye, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ryòŋ ce nfesè. Be ba à nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu, m gee tɛ ŋgàŋ fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.

lmp: Jus a kɛ' a ce de'ŋger njobè' Jisòs à m làa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ byee ce vi sùu embe bùu."
eng: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, I am the bread which came down out of heaven.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa enɛ̂, "Mbò ŋwɛ̀ ca a Jisòs muu Josɛ̀f a? To sèe rìŋ yì ta ba yì mâ. E ka' ce làa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ sùu embe bùu" njokɛ?"
eng: They said, Isn't this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, 'I have come down out of heaven?'

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa kèr de'ŋger ka'.
eng: Therefore Jesus answered them, Don't murmur among yourselves.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' vʉ yɛ mɛ̀ caa efa enɛ Tàr ce e m tuu mɛ̀ à gèe e vʉ a yɛ mɛ̀ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' vʉ yɛ mɛ̀ banɛ m be gèe tɛ ŋgàŋ fʉʉ efa rkwe à nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu.
eng: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him, and I will raise him up in the last day.

lmp: Ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m saŋ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ be kè yɛ'ni wowèe wɛɛwɛ." Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yu' nlâa yà Tâ, yɛ'ni buu ese ye, banɛ ŋgàŋ be vʉ̀ yɛ mɛ̀.
eng: It is written in the prophets, 'They will all be taught by God.' Therefore everyone who hears from the Father, and has learned, comes to me.

lmp: M ce làa ba mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m be yɛ Tàr ka', ku ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m lò ese Nyʉ̀ ce e yɛ Tàr.
eng: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

lmp: A mɛ̀ byee ce à ryòŋ.
eng: I am the bread of life.

lmp: Wee bta a m ye manà à rìŋ a ku lo a kweŋger.
eng: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.

lmp: Cena a byee ce vi sùu embe bùu, ce ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ye, e ke kwe ka'.
eng: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

lmp: A mɛ̀ byee vî btèe ce vi sùu embe bùu, ce vi ke fa bèe ryòŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ye byee ca banɛ ŋgàŋ be cu nfesè. Byee ce m be fa nè bèe enjep ŋgòŋ tɛ a bo koni ryòŋ na, yu yà nyor."
eng: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.

lmp: Awɛ Jus a kɛ' a ce sɛr mnsɛr a wâp mʉ tatap sê, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ fa yì nyor nè sèe enɛ sèe ye à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, How can this man give us his flesh to eat?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, wèe à ka' tɛ ye nyor Muu Ŋwɛ̀, kèr no vi blɛɛ ka', wèe konì ryòŋ ka'.
eng: Jesus therefore said to them, Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don't have life in yourselves.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ye yà nyor ker no wa blɛɛ banɛ e be koni ryòŋ ce nfesè. M be kè fʉr ye efa rkwe à nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu.
eng: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

lmp: Yà nyor yu byee ce mini, wa blɛɛ à ba yuu no ce mini.
eng: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ye yà nyor, ker no wa blɛɛ banɛ ŋgàŋ be cu njep mɛ̀ tɛ mɛ mɛ̀ cu njep ye.
eng: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

lmp: Àmbò Tàr ce e yu ntèe à tuu mɛ̀, mɛ̀ cu ntèe njobè' ye, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ye yà nyor, e be cu ntèe njo' mɛ̀.
eng: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father; so he who feeds on me, he will also live because of me.

lmp: Ca yu byee ce vi sùu embe bùu, à ke' ba njɛ̀ɛ byee ce wee bta a m ye a ku lo a kweŋger nà ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ye byee ca banɛ ŋgàŋ be cu nfesè."
eng: This is the bread which came down out of heaven--not as our fathers ate the manna, and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa buu ca à nfè' ce e m ce yɛ'ni bèe mbe ndàp rloo à rla' Kàpanùm.
eng: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

lmp: Bèe magòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yu' yuu ce e m làa na, a laa enɛ̂, "Nlàa ca yi tap sê. Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e byemì njɛ̀ɛ nlàa ca a nda?"
eng: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?

lmp: Jisòs à ka' rìŋ enɛ wowèe a m ce de'ŋger njobè' yuu ce e m làa na, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Cena yi bep wèe a?
eng: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, Does this cause you to stumble?

lmp: Banɛ wèe à ka' ba yɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ àmbò e ce ko' mbe dì' ce e m ba, a ka' vʉ nà, wèe à ba làa wee kɛ?
eng: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

lmp: Yʉ' a yuu ce yi ke fa ŋwɛ̀ ryòŋ. Àde' nyor gee yuu mo' ka'. Blàa ce mɛ̀ làa nè wèe na, yu yʉ', à ker ba ryòŋ.
eng: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

lmp: Geewa'a bèe efa wêe mʉ a byemi ka'." Jisòs à m ku riŋ bèe ce a be byemi ka' efa rkɛ̀', a ker riŋ foŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni ye.
eng: But there are some of you who don't believe. For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn't believe, and who it was who would betray him.

lmp: E ker laa enɛ̂, "A mbùu ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ vʉ yɛ mɛ̀ caa efa enɛ Tàr à fa ye njì enɛ e vʉ yɛ mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: He said, For this cause have I said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.

lmp: Kɛ' embe nfè' anà, bèe magòr efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ma'shì ye, a ker ce kar a ye ka'.
eng: At this, many of his disciples went back, and walked no more with him.

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs à laa nè bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ enɛ̂, "Yi yu yi kɛ àmbò wèe, wèe be mà'shi mɛ̀ dùse foŋ a?"
eng: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, You don't also want to go away, do you?

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, àde' wèr ka' ker du yɛ ba nda? A wɛ̀ ce à tʉr blàa ce vi ke gèe bèe a koni ryòŋ ce li be kè mì ka'.
eng: Simon Peter answered him, Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

lmp: Wèr à byemi nè wɛ̀, a riŋ sè'ni wernɛ à yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀."
eng: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "To a mɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ ce wèe bèe ncòp-baa-à- rrʉ̀ʉ? Ka' yi yu wa'a, mò' efa wêe mʉ yu nyʉ̀rkà'."
eng: Jesus answered them, Didn't I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?

lmp: E m ce làa ba àmbò Judàs muu Saimʉn Ìskarìyòt. Judàs ca ce e m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be lò fyèni ye.
eng: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

lmp: Buu ca à ka' mì wɛɛ, Jisòs à kɛ' a ce karkar à ŋgôŋ Galèlê. E m kòŋ à rdù à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà ka' njobè' Jus a m ce kòŋ à ryʉ ye.
eng: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn't walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, nfè' ce Jus a m ce ye ŋkâ' btàp à kɛ' a ce ghɛɛ.
eng: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bfʉr vi a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàtî àfa, du à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà tɛ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yò buu a bo yɛ mfà' ce à ce gèe na.
eng: His brothers therefore said to him, Depart from here, and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' kòŋ enɛ bèe a riŋ ye, àde' ŋgàŋ ce gèe buu à bsʉ̀ti ka'. Wɛ̀ ka' ce gèe mfà' ca, à gee ba àwaŋ tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a bo yɛ."
eng: For no one does anything in secret, and himself seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.

lmp: Bfʉr vi a m ce làa wa'a, a byemi nè ye ka' foŋ.
eng: For even his brothers didn't believe in him.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yà nfè' à be ghɛɛ ka'. À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, nfè' ku ba.
eng: Jesus therefore said to them, My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

lmp: Àde' ŋgòŋ a baa wèe ka'. Wowèe a bàa yi mɛ̀ njobè' m ce suŋ wowèe enɛ wowèe a ce gèe buu bbebep.
eng: The world can't hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

lmp: Dù nè ŋkà' anà. M be dù ya yu ŋkà' anà ka', njobè' yà nfè' à be ghɛɛ ka'."
eng: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.

lmp: E ka' làa nè wowèe wa'a, a cu yi yu à ŋgôŋ Galèlê.
eng: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

lmp: Bfʉr vi a ka' dùse ŋkà' anà wɛɛ, e lo a du a wâp mbùu. E m dù àwaŋ ka', e m dù ba à bsʉ̀ti.
eng: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

lmp: Jus a m ce ròo ye à ŋkà' anà, a ce bipshi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu fɛ?"
eng: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, Where is he?

lmp: Bèe magòr a ce cʉ̀ʉni àmbò ye. Bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ̂, "E yu ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ." Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Ài', e ce bo' bèe bo'."
eng: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, He is a good man. Others said, Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m làa yuu mo' àwaŋ a kuu ye ka' njobè' a m ce wɛp Jûs.
eng: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

lmp: A ka' ye ŋkà' bà' tìtìyɛɛ, Jisòs à du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a ce yɛ'ni bèe mbo.
eng: But when it was now the midst of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

lmp: Jus a m bɛ̀ɛŋger, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca rìŋ buu wa' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ, ce e m be du ŋwà' mncir ka'?"
eng: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, How does this man know letters, having never been educated?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Buu ce m ce yɛ'ni yu wa ka', yu ba vi ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: Jesus therefore answered them, My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rgèe ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ be rìŋ enɛ yuu ce m ce yɛ'ni yi lò ba ese Nyʉ̀, kɛ̀ m ce làa ba à ya ŋger lɛ.
eng: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God, or if I am speaking from myself.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' laa yuu ba à yi ŋger, banɛ ŋgàŋ ce ròo enɛ bèe a ku'si ba ye. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce ròo enɛ bèe a ku'si ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e tuu ye, sèe riŋ seenɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ mini, a tʉr fàa ka'.
eng: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

lmp: "Mbò Musìs a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fa wèe mncir a? Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ ce lɛ̀ mncir anà ka'. Wèe à ka' ce ròo à ryʉ mɛ̀ njokɛ?"
eng: Didn't Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?

lmp: Kʉr bèe anà a beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Hɛbɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce ròo à ryʉ wɛ̀ a nda? Yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi yu njep wɛ̀."
eng: The multitude answered, You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m gèe rfâ' rmo'sir, wèe à tʉr rgha'nì.
eng: Jesus answered them, I did one work, and you all marvel because of it.

lmp: Musìs à m fa ncir enɛ wèe ce gee bʉ̀. Ke' ba enɛ a ye ce e m kɛ̀' ka', à m kɛ̀' ba wee btâ. Musìs à ka' lɛ̀ ncir wa'a wèe à lo a ce gèe bʉ̀ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀.
eng: Moses has given you circumcision not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers, and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ wêe ke gèe bʉ̀ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa fà dì' wèe bo bʉ' ncir Musìs ka', wèe à ka' ce bepsi ntee nè mɛ̀ njobè' mɛ̀ gèe ŋwɛ̀ à luŋ bòŋboŋ efa yi yaŋ nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa njokɛ?
eng: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me, because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce sa' mnsa', wèe fa fyɛ' mmir bèe ka', wèe sa' teni yɛɛnì."
eng: Don't judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.

lmp: Bèe mô' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a m làa enɛ̂, "Mbò ŋwɛ̀ ca a ŋwɛ̀ ce a ròo à ryʉ nà a?
eng: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, Isn't this he whom they seek to kill?

lmp: Yɛ nè, e ce làa buu àwaŋ, ŋwɛ̀ à ke' ce làa yuu nè ye ka'. Seemò' bêe bgòrgòr a yɛ enɛ e yu Krâis anà.
eng: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

lmp: Geewa'a, wèr rìŋ fàdì' ce ŋwɛ̀ ca ce vʉ̀, a riŋ enɛ be ba à nfè' ce Krâis anà à nyɛɛ, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ riŋ fàdì' e lò ka'."
eng: However we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.

lmp: Awɛ Jisòs à ka' ce yɛ'ni mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a laa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Wèe rìŋ mɛ̀, a riŋ fàdì' ce m ce vʉ̀. Ka' yi yu wa' mɛ̀ vʉ̀ àfa ba à ya ŋger ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e tuu mɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ mini. Wèe rìŋ ye ka'.
eng: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don't know.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ ya ye, njobè' mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ ese ye, à ba ye ce e m tuu mɛ̀."
eng: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.

lmp: Awɛ wowèe a ghetèr enɛ a ba koo ye. A ka' ghèter wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à joo ye ka' njobè' yì nfè' à m be ghɛɛ ka'.
eng: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

lmp: Bèe magòr a m byemi nè ye, a laa enɛ̂, "Krâis anà à ka' nyɛɛ, àde' e duŋshì mncòo caa vì ce ŋwɛ̀ ca à dùŋshi na a?"
eng: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, When the Christ comes, he won't do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a m yu' àmbò kʉr bèe ca a ce cʉ̀ʉni àmbò Jisòs. Yi ka' ba wa'a, bèe Farìsi ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a tuu bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ enɛ a du koo ye.
eng: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Sèe be kù cu sè'ni ba nfè' mʉcàr tɛ m kʉti dù yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: Then Jesus said, I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

lmp: Wèe be ròo mɛ̀, yɛ mɛ̀ ka', njobè' àde' wèe vʉ fàdì' m be ba ka'."
eng: You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come.

lmp: Jus a kɛ' a ce làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce ròo à rdù ba fɛ, a ka' ce làa enɛ sèe be yɛ ye ka'? E ce ròo à rdù yɛ yìsèe bèe ce a yu à bto' mo' tɛ e bo cu a wowèe, yɛ'ni bêe à to' anà a?
eng: The Jews therefore said among themselves, Where will this man go that we won't find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?

lmp: E ce làa enɛ̂, "Wèe be ròo mɛ̀ yɛ mɛ̀ ka', bà' fàdì' m be ba ka", banɛ e làa ba enɛ kɛ?"
eng: What is this word that he said, 'You will seek me, and won't find me; and where I am, you can't come'?

lmp: Nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu efa ŋkà' anà à m ba nôŋ gòr. À ka' ba à nòŋ anà, Jisòs à natì mbekì a laa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Ntee yi ka' ce yuushi ŋwɛ̀, ŋgàŋ vʉ yɛ mɛ̀, no yuu.
eng: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè mɛ̀ àmbò Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa, banɛ mdip ce mi ke fa bèe ryòŋ mi be fʉʉ enje yê nyòr gòr sê."
eng: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa cena wa'a, a ce làa ba àmbò Yʉ' ce bèe ce a byemi nè ye a be koni. À m ba à nfè' anà, bèe a be koni Yʉ' anà ka', njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m bii ka' kù'si Jisòs.
eng: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn't yet glorified.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' blàa ca, bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ anà ghup."
eng: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, This is truly the prophet.

lmp: Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu Krâis anà." Bèe mo' a ker laa yap enɛ̂, "Àde' Krâis anà vʉ̂ à ŋgòŋ Galèle ka'.
eng: Others said, This is the Christ. But some said, What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

lmp: Mbò Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ Krâis anà be ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Dɛvìd, ba ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Bɛtɛ̀lɛ̀hɛm ce yu rla' Dɛvìd a?"
eng: Hasn't the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the seed of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?

lmp: Bèe a lo a ba bcùu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ njo' ye.
eng: So there arose a division in the multitude because of him.

lmp: Bèe mo' a lo a koŋ à rkoo ye. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m jòo ye nè bo ka'.
eng: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

lmp: Ŋgâa kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ a m kʉti a du a yɛ bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe Farìsî. Wowèe a bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à dù a koo ye a vʉ àgho ka' njokɛ?"
eng: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees, and they said to them, Why didn't you bring him?

lmp: Ŋgâa kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ a beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m be laa yuu nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca à làa na ka'."
eng: The officers answered, No man ever spoke like this man!

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A'a, a bo' wèe foŋ a?
eng: The Pharisees therefore answered them, You aren't also led astray, are you?

lmp: Wèe à be riŋ ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa rsa', kɛ̀ bèe Farìsi ɛ̀, ce e byemi nè ye a?
eng: Have any of the rulers believed in him, or of the Pharisees?

lmp: Bèe ce a ku ba yap àwàa a ke' riŋ mncir ka' nà, banɛ Nyʉ̀ à rò' wowèe."
eng: But this multitude that doesn't know the law is accursed.

lmp: Nìkòdɛmòs à m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe Farìsî, a ye ce e m be du yɛ Jisòs nà. E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: Nicodemus he who came to him by night, being one of them said to them,

lmp: "Wà' visèe mncir vi byemi enɛ a sa' mnsa' ŋwɛ̀, fa ŋgàŋ à shaŋ, ce a be kɛ' a yu' yuu ce ŋgàŋ à làa ka' a?"
eng: Does our law judge a man, unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Haba! Wɛ wɛ̀ foŋ yu ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Galèle a? Wɛ̀ ka' fyɛ' mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ à yɛ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ be vʉ̂ à ŋgôŋ Galèle ka'."
eng: They answered him, Are you also from Galilee? Search, and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a da'sè a duse à mlà'.
eng: Everyone went to his own house,

lmp: Jisòs à du yi ba mbe rtùu Olèf.
eng: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', e ker du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀. Bèe wɛɛwɛ a du a yɛ ye mbo. E cu à nshè a ce yɛ'ni wowèe.
eng: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down, and taught them.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir ba bèe Farìsi a vʉ mbo nè ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m koo a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀, a tɛr kùntombì nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂,
eng: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the midst,

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì, a koo njeŋwɛ̀ ca a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀.
eng: they told him, Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

lmp: Musìs à m saŋ mbe ŋwà' mncir enɛ a ka' koo njeŋwɛ̀ a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀, a tʉʉshì nè blùr e kwê. Wɛ̀ làa yo wɛ kɛ?"
eng: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such. What then do you say about her?

lmp: Wowèe a m làa wa'a, a ce mòoshi ye enɛ e ka' faa nlàa, tɛ a bo rìŋ yuu ce a be gèe nè ye. Jisòs à be'tì nyor à nshè a kɛ' a ce saŋ yuu à nshè nè ntubo.
eng: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down, and wrote on the ground with his finger.

lmp: Wowèe a ku ce bipshi nè ye enɛ e làa yi enɛ kɛ lɛ? E naa nyor mbekì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' ba a wêe mʉ ce e m be gee yuu bebep ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ tʉʉ njeŋwɛ̀ ca nè lùr entombì."
eng: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a ker be'ti nyor a ce saŋ yuu à nshè nè ntubo.
eng: Again he stooped down, and with his finger wrote on the ground.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' nlàa ca a nati a duse mò'sir mò'sir. Bleebèe a m dù entombì nè bghàrbèe, a ma'shi Jisòs a njeŋwɛ̀ anà mbo.
eng: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

lmp: Jisòs à naa nyor mbekì a laa enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀, wowèe a yû? Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à gèe yuu nè wɛ̀ ka' a?"
eng: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Masà, ŋwɛ̀ à gèe yuu nè mɛ̀ ka'." Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M be gèe yuu mo' nè wɛ̀ foŋ ka'. Dù yo yu, wɛ̂ dù à fa kèr gèe yuu bebep ka'."
eng: She said, No one, Lord. Jesus said, Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker laa nè bèe enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ rraa enjep ŋgòŋ na. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' vʉ fa mɛ̂ mbùu banɛ àde' e ker jɛr à tʉ̀'nji ka', e be koni ba rraa ce li fa ryòŋ."
eng: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ce suŋ wɛ̀ àmbò yo tu; yi ba yɛɛnì ka'."
eng: The Pharisees therefore said to him, You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ka' ce suŋ mɛ̀ ce suŋ àmbò ya tu wa'a, yuu ce m ce suŋ yi yu yɛɛnì njobè' mɛ̀ rìŋ fàdì' ce mɛ̀ vʉ̀, a riŋ fàdì' ce m ce dù. Wèe rìŋ fàdì' ce mɛ̀ vʉ̀ ka', a riŋ fàdì' ce m ce dù ka'.
eng: Jesus answered them, Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don't know where I came from, or where I am going.

lmp: Wèe ce sa' ye ba àmbò bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ke sa'. M ce sa' ya yu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

lmp: M ka' ce sa' bèe, m sa' yɛɛnì njobè' àde' m sa' nè ya tu ka'. M ce sa' àbee wèr ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

lmp: A saŋ mbe ye ŋwà' mncir enɛ̂, "bèe a mmbaa a ka' tɛɛ njìnsa' à yuu banɛ yuu anà yi yu mini."
eng: It's also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

lmp: M ce suŋ àmbò ya tu, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce suŋ àmbò mɛ̀ foŋ yu yà Ta ce e m tuu mɛ̀."
eng: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Yò Ta yû?" Jisòs à beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe rìŋ mɛ̀ ka', a riŋ yà Ta foŋ ka'. Wèe à ba riŋ mɛ̀, wèe à ba rìŋ yà Ta foŋ."
eng: They said therefore to him, Where is your Father? Jesus answered, You know neither me, nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa buu ca nè wowèe à nfè' ce e m ce yɛ'ni mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a ba ba mbe dì' ce a m ce fa rfa. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m koo ye ka' njobè' yì nfè' à m be ghɛɛ ka'.
eng: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M be dù ya yu, tɛ wèe roo mɛ̀, yɛ ka', kwe nè yè buu bbebep. Àde' wèe vʉ fàdì' ce m ce dù ka'."
eng: Jesus said therefore again to them, I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can't come.

lmp: Jus a laa enɛ̂, "E làa enɛ e ce dù fàdì' ce àde' sèe vʉ ka' wa'a, banɛ e be yʉ yì nyor a?"
eng: The Jews therefore said, Will he kill himself, that he says, 'Where I am going, you can't come?'

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe yu ye bèe enjep nshè na, mɛ̀ lo ya e mbekì. Wèe yu ye bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na, mɛ̀ ba ya ŋwɛ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'.
eng: He said to them, You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe enɛ wèe be kwe nè yè buu bbebep, njobè' wèe à ka' tɛ byemi enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̀ ce m yu ka', banɛ wèe be kwe nè yè buu bbebep."
eng: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ nda sê?" Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "M yu ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ ke suŋ wèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ enɛ m yu nà.
eng: They said therefore to him, Who are you? Jesus said to them, Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

lmp: M tʉr buu magòr ce mɛ̀ ba làa kuu wèe, kèr sa' wèe njo' buu anà. Geewa'a, m ce suŋ wèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ mini. M ce suŋ ŋgòŋ ca ba yuu ce mɛ̀ yu' ese ye."
eng: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce làa wa'a wowèe a riŋ enɛ e ce làa ba àmbò yì Ta ka'.
eng: They didn't understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Be ba à nfè' ce wèe à nàa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ mbekì tɛ wèe ka' rìŋ enɛ a mɛ̀ ye, kèr rìŋ foŋ enɛ m ce gèe yuu mo' a mɛ̂ ŋger ka'. M ku ce làa ba buu ce yà Ta à yɛ'ni mɛ̀.
eng: Jesus therefore said to them, When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e tuu mɛ̀ yu wèr ye, e mà'shi mɛ̀ mamŋgi' ka' njobè' mɛ̂ ke kû gèe ba buu ce nyor ce bòŋ ye."
eng: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn't left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.

lmp: E ka' làa buu ca wa'a, bèe magòr a byemì nè ye.
eng: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè Jus ce a m byemi nè ye nà enɛ̂, "Wèe ka' ku ce gèe buu ce mɛ̀ yɛ'ni wèe, banɛ wèe yu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yà buu ghup.
eng: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

lmp: Wèe be rìŋ yuu mini, tɛ mini anà gee tɛ wèe lûŋ."
eng: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Wèr yu ŋgʉ̀ Abràhâm. Wèr à m be ba bkwàa nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Wɛ̀ ka' ce làa wɛnɛ à be gèe tɛ wèr luŋ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: They answered him, We are Abraham's seed, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, 'You will be made free?'

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe buu bbebep banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋkwàa nè buu bbebep.
eng: Jesus answered them, Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

lmp: Àde' ŋkwàa yi cu mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̀ nfesè ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke cu mbo nfesè a muu ŋwɛ̀ ndàp anà.
eng: A bondservant doesn't live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

lmp: Banɛ Muu Nyʉ̀ à ka' gee wèe lûŋ, banɛ wèe à lùŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ ghup.
eng: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe yu ŋgʉ̀ Abràhâm. Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe ce ròo à ryʉ mɛ̀, njobè' yuu mɛ̀ suŋ wèe yi niŋ wèe mbà tù' ka'.
eng: I know that you are Abraham's seed, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe ba buu ce mɛ̀ yɛ ese yà Tâ, wèe à ce gèe ye ba buu ce wèe à yɛ'ni ese yè tâ."
eng: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.

lmp: Wowèe a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Abràham yu yèr tâ." Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à ba ba boo Abràhâm, wèe à ba gèe ba buu ce Abràham à m ce gèe.
eng: They answered him, Our father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were Abraham's children, you would do the works of Abraham.

lmp: Wèe ce ròo ye sè'ni à ryʉ mɛ̀ ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ suŋ wèe yuu mini ce mɛ̀ yu' ese Nyʉ̀. Abràham à m be gee yuu mo' wa' ka'.
eng: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth, which I heard from God. Abraham didn't do this.

lmp: Wèe ce gèe ba yuu ce yè ta ce gèe." Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr yu boo ce a bi à bsàkì ka'. Yèr ta ku ba Nyʉ̀ cà'cà'."
eng: You do the works of your father. They said to him, We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à ka' ba ba yè Tâ, wèe à ba kòŋ mɛ̀ njobè' mɛ̀ lò ese Nyʉ̀ a ka' vʉ àfa. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ ba à ya ŋger ka'; mɛ̀ vʉ̀ ba à ŋger ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: Therefore Jesus said to them, If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven't come of myself, but he sent me.

lmp: Wèe ce yu' yuu ce m ce làa ka' njokɛ? Wèe ce yu' ka' njobè' yi yu àtɛ̀r nè wèe à ryu' ka'.
eng: Why don't you understand my speech? Because you can't hear my word.

lmp: Satàn yu yè tâ. Wèe ce kòŋ à rgèe ba buu ce e kòŋ. E m ku ba ŋwɛ̀ nyʉshi bèe efa rkɛ̀'. Àde' e tɛɛ à yuu mini ka', njobè' e yu ŋwɛ̀ mini ka'. E ke nya' mnde', ku nya' àmbò yi ŋgèe yi yu nà njobè' e yu ŋwɛ̀ mnde', a ba tàr mnde'.
eng: You are of your father, the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn't stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and its father.

lmp: A yuu ce m ce suŋ wèe yuu mini, wèe à ce byemi nè mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But because I tell the truth, you don't believe me.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ duŋshi yuu bebep ce mɛ̀ gèe a? Mɛ̀ ka' ce suŋ wèe ba yuu mini, wèe à byemì nè mɛ̀ ka' njokɛ?
eng: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ banɛ ŋgàŋ be yu'shi blâa Nyʉ̀. Mbùu ce wèe ce yu'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ ka' yu njobè' wèe yu bèe Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don't hear, because you are not of God.

lmp: Jus a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "To yi yu yɛɛnì àmbò wèr ce làa enɛ à yu ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà, yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi ba njep wɛ̀."
eng: Then the Jews answered him, Don't we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi yu njep mɛ̀ ka'; m ce yu'ni ba nè yà Tâ, wèe à ke' ce yu'ni ye yu nè mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Jesus answered, I don't have a demon, but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.

lmp: M ce ròo ba enɛ bèe a ku'si mɛ̀ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e ce ròo enɛ bèe a ku'si ye, a ba ŋwɛ̀ sa' mnsa'.
eng: But I don't seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce yu' yuu ce m ce làa, ce gèe yi, banɛ rkwe li be jòo ye ka'."
eng: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.

lmp: Jus a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr rìŋ sè'ni wernɛ yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi yu njep wɛ̀. To Abràham à m kwe, ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a kweŋgèr foŋ. Wɛ̀ ka' ce làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yu' yuu ce à ce làa ce gèe yi, rkwe li ke' joo ye ka' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: Then the Jews said to him, Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, and the prophets; and you say, 'If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.'

lmp: Wɛ̀ càa yèr ta Abràham a? E m kwe. Ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ anà a kweŋgèr foŋ. Wɛ̀ ka' ce làa yo enɛ a wɛ̀ nda?"
eng: Are you greater than our father, Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "M ka' ce kù'si ya tu, bkù' anà ba yuu cicì. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce kù'si mɛ̀ yu yà Ta ce wèe ce làa enɛ a yè Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: Jesus answered, If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

lmp: Ka' wèe ce làa wa'a, wèe rìŋ ye ka'. Mɛ̀ rìŋ ye. M ka' ba laa mɛnɛ mɛ̀ rìŋ ye ka', mɛ̀ ba ba ŋwɛ̀ mnde' àmbò wèe. Mɛ̀ rìŋ ye, a ce gèe yuu ce e ce làa.
eng: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, 'I don't know him,' I would be like you, a liar. But I know him, and keep his word.

lmp: Abràham ce yu yè ta à m lu'shi enɛ e be yɛ nfè' yà. E m yɛ, a lu'shi."
eng: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it, and was glad.

lmp: Jus a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ be ba' bfè' mnta ka', a ce làa wɛnɛ wɛ̀ m yɛ Abràham ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: The Jews therefore said to him, You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ, tɛ Abràham ka' kè ba, m ku ba."
eng: Jesus said to them, Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a kwɛ' blùr tɛ a bo tʉʉshi ye àgho. Yi ka' ba wa'a, e bʉ a fʉʉ yi yu embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus was hidden, and went out of the temple, having gone through the midst of them, and so passed by.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ce càa, a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m bi ye e ku ba nfèp.
eng: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài, a m bi ŋwɛ̀ ca e ku ba nfèp njo' yì buu bbebep kɛ̀ njo' buu bbebep yì ma ba yì tâ?"
eng: His disciples asked him, Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca kɛ̀ yì ta ba yì ma a m gèe buu bbebep ka'. A m bi ye e ku ba nfèp tɛ bèe a bo yɛ rfà' Nyʉ̀ njep yuu ce a be gèe nè ye.
eng: Jesus answered, Neither did this man sin, nor his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.

lmp: Sè'ni ce sèe bii à rraa, sèe ku tʉr à rgèe ba mfà' ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ à fa nè sèe enɛ sèe fa'. Tʉ̀' be lò sii, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ker fà' ka'.
eng: I must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

lmp: À nfè' ce m yu njep ŋgòŋ na, m yu rraa nè ŋgòŋ."
eng: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.

lmp: E ka' làa buu ca wa'a, a ce mce à nshè, a top nshe àgho a yo' nfèp anà àgho nje mmìr,
eng: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man's eyes with the mud,

lmp: a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù su'si mmir njep tʉ̂ Sailòm ce yi yu enɛ, "A tuu"." Nfèp anà à du a su'si mi mmir njep tʉ̀ anà. A ka' ce kʉti a ce yɛ buu.
eng: and said to him, Go, wash in the pool of Siloam which means Sent. So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

lmp: Bèe efa yê là' ker ba bèe ce a m yɛ à nfè' ce e m ce loo buu nà, a laa enɛ̂, "A'a! Àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce cu ce loo buu nà a?"
eng: The neighbors therefore, and those who saw that he was blind before, said, Isn't this he who sat and begged?

lmp: Bèe mo' a laa enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no, a ye." Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Ài', e ku feese ye feese." E laa yi enɛ "A mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ anà."
eng: Others were saying, It is he. Still others were saying, He looks like him. He said, I am he.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ gèe wɛ kɛ a ka' ce yɛ buu?"
eng: They therefore were asking him, How were your eyes opened?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce a too enɛ Jisòs nà, à topshi nshe a yo' mɛ̀ nje mmìr, a laa enɛ m du su'si mmir njep tʉ̂ Silòm. Mɛ̀ du a ka' sù'si mmir njo, a kɛ' a ce yɛ buu."
eng: He answered, A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, 'Go to the pool of Siloam, and wash.' So I went away and washed, and I received sight.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè yi enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ anà yû?" E beesì enɛ̂, "M rìŋ fàdì' e yu ka'."
eng: Then they asked him, Where is he? He said, I don't know.

lmp: Wowèe a lor ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba nfèp nà, a wowèe a du a yɛ bèe Farìsî.
eng: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

lmp: Nòŋ ce Jisòs à m topshi nshe a gee nfèp anà à ce yɛ buu nà, à m ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀.
eng: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi foŋ a ker bipshi nè ye enɛ e ba gee ekɛ a ka' ce yɛ buu lɛ. E suŋ wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ anà à ba yo' mɛ̀ nshe nje mmìr, mɛ̀ du a su'si mmir, a kɛ' a ce yɛ buu."
eng: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ bèe Farìsi a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀ ka' njobè' e cu mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ka'." Bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ a laa yap enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ba ba ŋwɛ̂ mbebep, e ba gèe yuu bɛ̀ɛ ca à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?" Wowèe a kɛ' a ce kwà'shi jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, because he doesn't keep the Sabbath. Others said, How can a man who is a sinner do such signs? There was division among them.

lmp: Wowèe a ker bipshi nè ŋwɛ̀ anà enɛ̂, "Àmbò ŋwɛ̀ anà à gèe wɛ̀, wɛ̀ ce yɛ buu sè'ni na, wɛ̀ làa yo wɛ kɛ àmbò ye?" E beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀."
eng: Therefore they asked the blind man again, What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes? He said, He is a prophet.

lmp: Jus a m byemi yap yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à m be fep a ka' lo a ce yɛ buu ka', caar wowèe a kɛ' yì ta ba yì mâ,
eng: The Jews therefore did not believe concerning him, that he had been blind, and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

lmp: a bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu muu wèe a? Yi yu mini enɛ e m fèp kɛ' embe nfè' a m bi ye a? E gèe ekɛ a ka' ce yɛ buu?"
eng: and asked them, Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?

lmp: Yì ta ba yì ma a beesì a laa enɛ̂, "Wèr rìŋ enɛ e yu muu wèr. Wèr à m bi ye e ku ba nfèp.
eng: His parents answered them, We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

lmp: Wèr à rìŋ yer yu àmbò e gèe a ka' ce yɛ buu ka', a riŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe e ka' ce yɛ buu ka'. Bipshi nè nè ye. E yu nleeŋwɛ̀. E be suŋ wèe nè yi cùu."
eng: but how he now sees, we don't know; or who opened his eyes, we don't know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.

lmp: Yì ta ba yì ma a m làa wa'a njobè' a m ce wɛp Jûs. A m ce wɛp wowèe njobè' wowèe a m byemi war àbee enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' laa enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis anà, banɛ a be jùu ŋgàŋ embe ndàp rloo.
eng: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

lmp: A mbùu ce yì ta ba yì ma a m làa enɛ̂, "E yu nleeŋwɛ̀, bipshi nè nè ye."
eng: Therefore his parents said, He is of age. Ask him.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ker kɛ' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba nfèp nà, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Làa yuu ce Nyʉ̀ rìŋ enjo. Wèr rìŋ wernɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe wɛ̀, wɛ̀ ce yɛ buu na yu ŋwɛ̀ ŋgèe buu bbebep."
eng: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Kɛ̀ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ŋgèe buu bbebep ɛ̀, kɛ̀ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ŋgèe buu bbebep ka' ɛ̀, mɛ̀ rìŋ ya yu ka'. Yuu ce m rìŋ yi ku ba ba enɛ mɛ̀ m fèp, a ce yɛ buu sè'ni."
eng: He therefore answered, I don't know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "E ba gee ekɛ nè wɛ̀? E ba gee à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ wɛ̀ ka' ce yɛ buu?"
eng: They said to him again, What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?

lmp: E beesì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe wɛɛ, wèe à ce yu' ka'. Wèe ce kòŋ enɛ m ker suŋ wèe njokɛ? Wêe kòŋ à rba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu foŋ a?"
eng: He answered them, I told you already, and you didn't listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don't also want to become his disciples, do you?

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, wowèe a cɛp ye a laa enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce à yu ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu, wèr yu yer ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Musìs.
eng: They insulted him and said, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

lmp: Wèr rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ buu nè Musìs. À ka' ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca, wèr rìŋ fàdì' ce e ce vʉ̀ ka'."
eng: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don't know where he comes from.

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Cena yu ba yuu bɛ̀ɛ! Ka' wèe rìŋ fàdì' ce ŋwɛ̀ ca ce vʉ̀ ka' wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe mɛ̀ ka' ce yɛ buu à gèe ye.
eng: The man answered them, How amazing! You don't know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke yu' mloo ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep ka'. E ke yu' ba rloo ŋwɛ̀ nsìp ce e ke wɛp ye, ce gèe yuu ce e kòŋ.
eng: We know that God doesn't listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshipper of God, and does his will, he listens to him.

lmp: Kɛ' ese à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ŋgòŋ, ŋwɛ̀ à m be yu' enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à gèe ŋwɛ̀ ce a m bi ye e ku ba nfèp e ce yɛ buu ka'.
eng: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ka' tɛ bà lò ba ese Nyʉ̀ ka', e ba gèe yuu mo' ka'."
eng: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.

lmp: Wowèe a beesì a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "A m bi wɛ̀ njep mʉ̀ buu bbebep, wɛ̀ ce ròo à ryɛ'ni wèr a?" A ka' làa wa'a, a juu ye embe ndàp rloo.
eng: They answered him, You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us? They threw him out.

lmp: Jisòs à m yu' enɛ a jùu ŋwɛ̀ anà embe ndàp rloo. E ka' ròo ye yɛ, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ byemi nè Muu Ŋwɛ̀ a?"
eng: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, Do you believe in the Son of God?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Masà, Muu Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu nda tɛ m bo byemi nè ye?"
eng: He answered, Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ yɛ ye wɛɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa nè wɛ̀ sè'ni na yu ye."
eng: Jesus said to him, You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.

lmp: E laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mɛ̀ byemi nè wɛ̀." E ka' làa wa'a, a gʉ'shi nè ye.
eng: He said, Lord, I believe! and he worshiped him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na tɛ m bo teni mnsa' tɛ bèe ce a ce yɛ buu ka' a bo yɛ buu, tɛ bèe ce a ce yɛ buu nà a bo kʉti mnfèp."
eng: Jesus said, I came into this world for judgment, that those who don't see may see; and that those who see may become blind.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi mo' ce a m ba àfo a yu' blàa ca, a m bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Banɛ wèr à fèp foŋ a?"
eng: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, Are we also blind?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à ba ba mnfèp, wèe à ba ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep ka'. Àmbò wèe ce làa enɛ wèe ce yɛ buu, banɛ wèe ku cu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep."
eng: Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, 'We see.' Therefore your sin remains.

lmp: "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce niŋ mbe ŋka' njèe, ko' à ŋka', ke' du njì embe cûu ŋka' ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu nyɛ̀ɛ a ker ba ŋkep.
eng: Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn't enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, the same is a thief and a robber.

lmp: Jisòs à m mà' ŋgàa ca nè wowèe, wowèe a ke' riŋ ŋgàa anà ka'.
eng: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn't understand what he was telling them.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe yuu tatap, m yu cûu ŋka' njèe.
eng: Jesus therefore said to them again, Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep's door.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a dù entombì nè mɛ̀, a yu byɛ̀ɛ, njèe yi mɛŋnì yàp njèndoŋ.
eng: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn't listen to them.

lmp: A mɛ̀ cûu ŋka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' caa njì enjep mɛ̀ banɛ ŋgàŋ be lùŋ efa ŋgɛ'. E be niŋ mbo à nfè' ce e gwɛɛ, koni yuu ye.
eng: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.

lmp: Nyɛ̀ɛ e ke vʉ̀ tɛ e bo yɛ̀ɛ, yʉ, kèr bepsi buu. Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ ya tɛ bèe a bo koni ryòŋ, tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

lmp: "M yu gây mbòŋmboŋ. Gây mbòŋmboŋ e ke tami nyor à rkwe njo' yi njèe.
eng: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce a lòr ye, e ce jà' yi jà', yu gày ce e tʉr njèe anà ka'. E ka' yɛ àmbò kuura ce vʉ̀, e be caŋ mà' njèe, tɛ kuura koshi mo', bɛr yi da' à rìŋ.
eng: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn't own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep, and scatters them.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce a lòr e ce jà' yi jà' nà e lo caŋ njobè' njèe yu yi ka'; e tʉr yi yu nfè' àgho ka'.
eng: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand, and doesn't care for the sheep.

lmp: M yu gây mbòŋmboŋ. M rìŋ ya njèe, ya njèe yi riŋ mɛ̀.
eng: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I'm known by my own;

lmp: Àmbò yà ta kòŋ mɛ̀, mɛ mɛ̀ à koŋ ye nà. Mɛ̀ tami nyor à rkwe njo' yi.
eng: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

lmp: M ker tʉr ya njèe mo', yi ba mbe ŋka' anà ka'. M be kù vʉ̀ nè njèe anà foŋ mbe ŋka' ca tɛ yi yu' yà njèndoŋ, ba kʉr e mo'sir, tʉr ŋwɛ̀ rcìŋ mò'sir.
eng: I have other sheep, which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

lmp: Yà ta kòŋ mɛ̀ njobè' mɛ̀ fa la ryòŋ tɛ m bo kèr lò koni li.
eng: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' be koo la ryòŋ ese mɛ̀ ka'. Ce fa ba mɛ̀ à la rkòŋ. M tʉr ŋger à rfa la ryòŋ, a ker tʉr ŋger à rkoo li. Cena yu ba yuu ce yà Ta à làa enɛ m gêe."
eng: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa blàa ca, bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ Jus a kɛ' a ce kwà'shi jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ njo' blàa anà.
eng: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

lmp: Bèe magòr a kɛ' a ce làa enɛ̂, "Yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi karsi ye tu, e kɛ' a ce baa. Sèe ce yu' yuu ce e ce làa njokɛ sê?"
eng: Many of them said, He has a demon, and is insane! Why do you listen to him?

lmp: Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi ka' karsi ŋwɛ̀ tu, e laa njɛ̀ɛ buu ca ka'. Àde' yʉ' nyʉ̀rkà' yi gee nfèp ce yɛ buu à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: Others said, These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn't possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?

lmp: Nfè' ce a m ce ye Ŋkâ' Hànukà à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à m ghɛɛ. À m ba à nfè' ce saa à m ya'ni.
eng: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. A ka' bà' a du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a ce jɛ̀r mbe dì' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ njì-baaki ŋkʉʉ Solomʉ̀n.
eng: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon's porch.

lmp: Jus a vʉ a sir ye a kaari a tarte, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr be kè' dù bà' ba fɛ, tɛ à ka' suŋ wèr njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce à yu? Wɛ̀ ka' ba Krâis, ce yu ŋwɛ̀ rjà' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà'ni enɛ e be tuu nà, à suŋ wèr rara."
eng: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe wɛɛ, wèe à byemì ka'. Buu ce m ce gèe à rlii yà Tâ, vi ce dùŋshi njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce m yu.
eng: Jesus answered them, I told you, and you don't believe. The works that I do in my Father's name, these testify about me.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe à byemi enɛ m yu Krâis ka' njobè' wèe yu ya njèe ka'.
eng: But you don't believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

lmp: Ya njèe yi ke yu' yà njèndoŋ, rîŋ. Mɛ̀ rìŋ yi foŋ, yi ce vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ mbùu.
eng: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

lmp: M ce fa yi ryòŋ ce nfesè, tɛ yi ker kwe à nfè' mò' ka'. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' fʉr yi emba mɛ̂ mmbò ka'.
eng: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

lmp: Yà Ta ce e fa yi nè mɛ̀, tʉr ŋger a caa buu wɛɛwɛ. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' fʉr njèe ca embà mmbo yà Ta ka'.
eng: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father's hand.

lmp: Wèr yà Ta yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir."
eng: I and the Father are one.

lmp: Jus a ka' yu' blàa ca, a kwɛ' blùr tɛ a bo tʉʉshi ye àgho tɛ e kwe.
eng: Therefore Jews took up stones again to stone him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à yɛ ku' buu bbòŋboŋ ce mɛ̀ gèe à rlii yà Tâ. Efa mʉ̀ buu ca, wèe ce kòŋ à rtʉʉshi mɛ̀ nè blùr ba àtu yì efɛ?"
eng: Jesus answered them, I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?

lmp: Bèe anà a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr be tʉʉshi wɛ̀ nè blùr njobè' buu bbòŋboŋ ce wɛ̀ gèe ka'. Wèr be tʉʉshi wɛ̀ nè blùr njobè' wɛ̀ bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀. À ku ba ba ŋwɛ̀, a ce làa wɛnɛ à yu Nyʉ̀."
eng: The Jews answered him, We don't stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy: because you, being a man, make yourself God.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "A saŋ mbe ye ŋwà' mncir enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ̂, "Wèe yu mnyʉ̀."
eng: Jesus answered them, Isn't it written in your law, 'I said, you are gods?'

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ blâa Nyʉ̀ vi ke kupse ka'. Banɛ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ bèe ce e làa blàa ca nè wowèe a yu àmbò ye nà,
eng: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came and the Scripture can't be broken,

lmp: wèe à ka' ce làa weenɛ m ce làa mɛnɛ m yu Nyʉ̀ wa'a a ce bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀ bepsi njokɛ? Yu mɛ̀ ce yà Ta à m ce a tuu njep ŋgòŋ.
eng: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, 'You blaspheme,' because I said, 'I am the Son of God?'

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ m ce gèe ba mfà' yà Ta ka', wèe fa byemi nè mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: If I don't do the works of my Father, don't believe me.

lmp: M ka' ce gèe ba mfà' yà Tâ, wèe à ka' tɛ bà byemi nè mɛ̀ njo' buu ce m ce làa ka', wèe à ba byemi nè mɛ̀ njo' buu ce m ce gèe tɛ wèe bo rìŋ rara enɛ m yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa yà Tâ, yà Ta à ba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa mɛ̀."
eng: But if I do them, though you don't believe me, believe the works; that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.

lmp: Wowèe a m ker ce ròo à rkoo ye, e fʉʉ efa wâp mʉ a dû.
eng: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

lmp: E m ker kʉti a tuu rdip Jodàn a du fàdì' ce Jôn à m ce bàptir bèe nà, a cu àfo.
eng: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and there he stayed.

lmp: Bèe magòr a m vʉ̀ a yɛ ye àfo, a kɛ' a ce làa enɛ̂, "Jôn à m gèe yuu mo' à rdùŋshi enɛ à m tuu ba Nyʉ̀ a tuu ye ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, buu ce Jôn à m làa àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca vi yu mini."
eng: Many came to him. They said, John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.

lmp: Bèe magòr ce a m ba à dì' anà a m byemi nè Jisòs.
eng: Many believed in him there.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba a ce yaŋ, ce a too ye enɛ Lasòròs. E m ce cu à rla' Bɛtanì a Mɛ̀ɛri ba Maatà ce à m ba bjar vi.
eng: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri ce ndur yî Lasòròs à m ce yaŋ na, à m ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m cu'ni mgʉr à mkùu Tata Jisòs, a siŋsi nè yi nyʉ̀'tu nà.
eng: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment, and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother, Lazarus, was sick.

lmp: Bjar vi a m cep ntuu nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, ŋwɛ̀ ce à kòŋ nà ce yaŋ."
eng: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yu' ntuu ca a laa enɛ̂, "Yaŋ ca yi be lʉ̀si ba nè rkwe ka'. Cena yi yu wa'a tɛ bèe magòr a bo yɛ bkù' Nyʉ̀ tɛ a bo kù'si Muu Nyʉ̀ njobè' yi."
eng: But when Jesus heard it, he said, This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God's Son may be glorified by it.

lmp: Jisòs à m kòŋ Maatà ba nfʉr yì ker ba Lasòròs.
eng: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

lmp: E ka' yu' enɛ Lasòròs ce yaŋ, a ker cu fàdì' ce e m ba nà à mnôŋ bbaa.
eng: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

lmp: Mnòŋ anà vi ka' càa, e laa nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Sèe kʉti à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà."
eng: Then after this he said to the disciples, Let's go into Judea again.

lmp: Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Rabài, to mnòŋ vi ku caa mʉcàr sê, ce Jus a mʉ ce ròo à rtʉʉshi wɛ̀ nè blùr. Wɛ̀ ka' laa wɛnɛ à be kʉti à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà njokɛ?"
eng: The disciples told him, Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you, and are you going there again?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ e ke saŋ, kɛ̂' à mʉ ŋgàptʉ' du ba' à mbùuŋkùr. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce jɛ̀r à nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi ce raa, àde' ŋgàŋ kotè à yuu ka' njobè' ŋgòŋ yi ce raa, e ce yɛ buu.
eng: Jesus answered, Aren't there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn't stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

lmp: Geewa'a ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce jɛ̀r nètʉ' banɛ ŋgàŋ be kote njobè' rraa li yu njep ye ka'."
eng: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn't in him.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a ker suŋ wowèe enɛ̂, "Lasòròs ce yu ŋkar yìsèe ce buumi buumi. M be dù tɛ m bo yɛ̀ɛ ye efa mmirlò."
eng: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, Our friend, Lazarus, has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, e ka' ce buumi banɛ e be lùŋ."
eng: The disciples therefore said, Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce làa wa'a, a ce kwà'shi enɛ Lasòròs ce buumi àmbò bèe a ke buumi nà. Geewa'a Jisòs à m ce làa ba enɛ Lasòròs à kwe kwe.
eng: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

lmp: Jisòs à m suŋ wowèe rara enɛ̂, "Lasòròs à kwe.
eng: So Jesus said to them plainly then, Lazarus is dead.

lmp: M ce lu'shi njobè' wèe, mɛnɛ mɛ̀ mʉ ba àfo ka', tɛ wèe bo byemi nè mɛ̀. Banɛ sèe du yɛ ye."
eng: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let's go to him.

lmp: Tomas ce a m ce too ye enɛ rfar nà, à laa nè bèe ce a wowèe a m ce yɛ'ni buu Jisòs nà enɛ̂, "Sèe du àmbùu Jisòs foŋ tɛ sèe bo dù kwe sèe wowèe."
eng: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, Let's go also, that we may die with him.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' bà' à rla' Bɛtanì, a yu' enɛ yu mnòŋ kyèe àmbò a mʉ tuŋ Lasòròs.
eng: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà Jus magòr se a lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a vʉ à rcà'ni Maatà ba Mɛ̀ɛri njo' ndur yàp ce e m kwe. Lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m du ba' à rla' Bɛtanì yi yu sàsap ka'. Yi ku ba àmbò bkìlomɛtà vî btaar wa'a.
eng: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away. Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

lmp: Maatà à ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs ce vʉ̀, e natì a du a koni ye à nduunjì. Mɛ̀ɛri à cu yi mbe ndàp.
eng: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

lmp: Maatà à ka' koni Jisòs, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wɛ̀ mʉ ba àfa ndur yà à mʉ kwe ka'.
eng: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.

lmp: Ka' sè'ni na, mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ be fa yuu ce wɛ̀ ka' bipshi nè ye."
eng: Even now I know that, whatever you ask of God, God will give you.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ndur yò be fʉʉ efa rkwe."
eng: Jesus said to her, Your brother will rise again.

lmp: Maatà à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M rìŋ mɛnɛ e be fʉʉ efa rkwe à nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu ce bèe wɛɛwɛ a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe nà."
eng: Martha said to him, I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ce mɛ̂ ke gèe bèe a ce fʉʉ efa rkwe, a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke fa ryòŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè mɛ̀, ka' ŋgàŋ à ka' kwe, e be cu nfesè.
eng: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' cu ntèe, byemi nè mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ be cu nfesè. Wà' wɛ̀ byemi a?"
eng: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?

lmp: E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no, Tatâ, mɛ̀ byemi mɛnɛ à yu Krâis, Muu Nyʉ̀ ce e m ba enɛ e be vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ nà."
eng: She said to him, Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God's Son, he who comes into the world.

lmp: Maatà à ka' làa wa'a, a du a kɛ' nfʉr yî Mɛ̀ɛri a cʉʉni nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì à vʉ̀ a ce kɛ' wɛ̀."
eng: When she had said this, she went away, and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, The Teacher is here, and is calling you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à ka' yu', a sa'ti mbekì a du a koni ye.
eng: When she heard this, she arose quickly, and went to him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, Jisòs à be niŋ à mʉ̀ rla' ka'. E m ku bii ba mbe dì' ce Maatà à m dù a yɛ ye nà.
eng: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

lmp: Jus ce a wowèe a m ce cu rkwe mbe ndàp nà a ka' yɛ àmbò Mɛ̀ɛri à sà'ti a fʉʉ njepmbè, wowèe a du a yê mbùu njobè' a m ce kwà' enɛ e ce dù à rwar rkwe fàdì' rshè li m ba.
eng: Then the Jews who were with her in the house, and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, She is going to the tomb to weep there.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à du a yɛ Jisòs, a gʉ'shi njep yê tìi, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wɛ̀ mʉ ba àfa, ndur yà à mʉ kwe ka'."
eng: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was, and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn't have died.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ àmbò Mɛ̀ɛri ce war, kèr yɛ àmbò Jus ce a Mɛ̀ɛri wèe a m ce vʉ̀ nà a ce warse, yi joo ye sê, mlù mi koo ye.
eng: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit, and was troubled,

lmp: E bipshì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à mʉ tuŋ ye ba fɛ?" Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, vʉ̀ yɛ."
eng: and said, Where have you laid him? They told him, Lord, come and see.

lmp: Jisòs à suusì mŋgoommir.
eng: Jesus wept.

lmp: Jus anà a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ nè àmbò e m kòŋ ye nà."
eng: The Jews therefore said, See how much affection he had for him!

lmp: Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe nfèp à ce yɛ buu nà à ke' ba gèe tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca luŋ efa rkwe ka' a?"
eng: Some of them said, Couldn't this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?

lmp: Yi ker joo Jisòs, e du mbe dì' ce rshè li m ba. Rshè anà à m ba mbʉ̀' ce a m sò' nje ryɛɛ, a biŋsi lùr a cete àgho.
eng: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Cà'si nè lùr anà." Maatà ce e m ba njar ŋkʉshè ŋwɛ̀ nà, à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, e be rʉ̀ʉ sê, njobè' yu mnòŋ kyèe sè'ni àmbò a mʉ tuŋ ye."
eng: Jesus said, Take away the stone. Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mbò mɛ̀ ba suŋ wɛ̀ enɛ à be yɛ ŋger Nyʉ̀ ce wɛ̀ ka' byemi a?"
eng: Jesus said to her, Didn't I tell you that if you believed, you would see God's glory?

lmp: A m cà'si lùr embe ncûu rshè. Jisòs à ke' mbe bùu a laa enɛ̂, "Tàr, m ce yòŋshi wɛ̀ njobè' wɛ̀ yu' la rloo.
eng: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes, and said, Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wɛ̂ ke yu' la rloo à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Geewa'a, m ce làa cena njo' bèe ce a tɛɛ na, tɛ wowèe a bo byemi enɛ a wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ m tuu mɛ̀."
eng: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude that stands around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a waa mbekì enɛ̂, "Lasòròs, fʉʉ enjo!"
eng: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, Lazarus, come out!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwe na à fʉʉ àmbò a m kur mi mkoo ba mi mkùu nè bcɛ̀', a boo vi bsii nè bcɛ̀' nà. Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bà'shi nè bcɛ̀' tɛ e dû."
eng: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, Free him, and let him go.

lmp: Bèe ce a m vʉ̀ a Mɛ̀ɛri wèe nà, a m yɛ yuu ce Jisòs à m gèe, bèe magòr efa wâp mʉ a byemì nè ye.
eng: Therefore many of the Jews, who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did, believed in him.

lmp: Bèe mo' a natì yap a du a yɛ bèe Farìsi a suŋ wowèe yuu ce Jisòs à m gèe anà.
eng: But some of them went away to the Pharisees, and told them the things which Jesus had done.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bèe Farìsi ca ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a kɛ' kansùr, a laa enɛ̂, "Sèe be gèe seekɛ? Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce dùŋshi ku' mncòo sê.
eng: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

lmp: Sèe à ka' ma'shi enɛ e ce gee njɛ̀ɛ buu ca, bèe wɛɛwɛ a lo byemi nè ye, tɛ bêe à to' Rum a lo vʉ̀ bepsi yisèe dî' rara ba yisèe to'."
eng: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.

lmp: Mò' efa wowèe ce a m ce too enɛ Kaifàs ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì mbe fè' anà à m nàti mbekì a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe rìŋ yuu ka' mʉcàr ka'.
eng: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, You know nothing at all,

lmp: Wèe à ba rìŋ weenɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir kwe àtu bèe nè ce enɛ to' sìp yi bʉ."
eng: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.

lmp: Kaifàs à m ce làa wa'a, a ce làa ba à mkwà'shì mi ka'. Àmbò Kaifàs ca à m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à fè' anà, e m suŋ bèe yuu ce yi be lò ba. E m làa enɛ Jisòs tɛɛ à rkwe àtu to' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Now he didn't say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

lmp: Yi m ba enɛ e be kwe ba àtu to' ca cà'cà' ka'. Yi m ba enɛ e be kwe àtu bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a yu à bto' wɛɛwɛ tɛ e bo vʉ̀ nè wowèe àbee tɛ wowèe a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a kɛ' ese nòŋ anà, a ce sèesi àmbò a be gèe ka' yʉ ye.
eng: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisòs à ker kar àwaŋ à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà ka'. E m lò a du à rla' mo' ce a too enɛ Ɛfrɛ̀m. Rla' anà li yu àwâa rìŋ. E m dù a cu àfo a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe.
eng: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

lmp: Nfè' à m kɛ̀' a ce ghɛɛ ce a be ye ŋkâ' càasi-mndap. Bèe a m lô à bbu' mla' wɛɛwɛ a du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. Wowèe à m kòŋ à rgèe wap mnyor tɛ vi ba brara à bsii Nyʉ̀, tɛ nfè' ŋkà' ka' ghɛɛ.
eng: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce ròo Jisòs, a kɛ' a ce bipshi fa wâp mʉ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ kɛ? E be vʉ̀ ŋkà' ca kɛ̀ e be vʉ̀ ka'?"
eng: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke one with another, as they stood in the temple, What do you think--that he isn't coming to the feast at all?

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bèe Farìsi a m fa rsa' à nfè' anà enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' riŋ fàdì' Jisòs yu, ŋgàŋ vʉ suŋ wowèe tɛ wowèe a bo dù koo ye.
eng: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

lmp: Mnòŋ ce a be ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap vi ka' bɛti ntuunfu, Jisòs à natì a du à rla' Bɛtanì. Rla' Bɛtanì ca yu fàdì' ce Lasòròs ce Jisòs à m fʉr efa rkwe nà à m ce cu.
eng: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

lmp: A m laa byee a tar ye àgho. Maatà à m ce càasi byee. Lasòròs ye ye à m ba mò' ce a Jisòs wèe a m ce ye byee mbe tɛbùr.
eng: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce ye byee, Mɛ̀ɛri à vʉ nè mgʉr ce mi m bòŋ sê, ce a m gèe nè njɛ̀ɛ mjɛɛ ce a m ce too enɛ Nâd. Mgʉr anà mi m lùu ntaa sê. Mi m ba àmbò nto'nì lità wa'a. E m lòr mgʉr anà a cu'ni à mkùu Jisòs, a siŋsi nè yi nyʉ̀'tu. Ndap à m ku rʉʉ nsìp nsìp nè mgʉr anà.
eng: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

lmp: Judas Ìskarìyòt ce e m ba mo' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be lò fyèni Jisòs nà, à m làa enɛ̂,
eng: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

lmp: "Haba! Àde' a ke' ba fyèni mgʉr ca à bbâa mbâa btaar, lòr mbàa efa gho fa nè ŋgâa fùp ka' njokɛ?"
eng: Why wasn't this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?
