lmp: E m làa wa'a, ke' ba njobè' e m ce koosimnse nè ŋgâa fùp ka'. E m làa wa'a njobè' e m ba nyɛ̀ɛ. A ye ce e m ce lɛ̀ yap mbàa, a ce yɛ̀ɛ mo' enjo.
eng: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

lmp: Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "Lɛ̀ ye nyaŋ. Mà'shi tɛ e gee wa'a à nòŋ ce a be kè tuŋ mɛ̀.
eng: But Jesus said, Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

lmp: Ŋgâa fùp a ku ba wèe wowèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, à ka' ba àmbò mɛ̀ yi, sèe be ba à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ka'."
eng: For you always have the poor with you, but you don't always have me.

lmp: Ma kʉr Jus a ka' yu' enɛ Jisòs yu à rla' anà, a natì a vʉ̂. Wowèe a m vʉ̀ tɛ a bo kù yɛ ba Jisòs cà'cà' ka', a m kòŋ foŋ à ryɛ Lasòròs ce Jisòs à m fʉr efa rkwe nà.
eng: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus' sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a seesì àmbò a be yʉ Lasòròs,
eng: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

lmp: njobè' Jus magòr a m mà'shi wowèe a byemì nè Jisòs njo' ye.
eng: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, ku' bèe ce a m vʉ̀ à rye ŋkà' nà, a yu' enɛ Jisòs ce vʉ̀ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a gwar bbàp mtɛɛ a du a koni ye àgho à nduunjì, a ce yòp enɛ̂, "Hòsanà! Bghònì vi yu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce vʉ̀ à rlii Tatâ, a ba ŋkʉʉ à to' Isrɛ̀l."
eng: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!

lmp: Jisòs à m koni muu jàaki', a ko' a cu mbo, àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ nà. A m saŋ mbo enɛ̂,
eng: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

lmp: "Rla' Sayòn, fa wɛp ka'. Yɛ yò ŋkʉʉ àmbò e ce vʉ̀, a cu mbendù muu jàaki'."
eng: Don't be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey's colt.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a m rìŋ mbùu efa buu ce vi m koni na efa rkɛ̀' ka'. Wowèe a m lò a riŋ ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kù'si Jisòs nà. Wowèe a m kuushi buu ce a m saŋ a kuu ye à nfè' anà, a kuushi foŋ àmbò a m gèe buu ca nè ye.
eng: His disciples didn't understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba a Jisòs wèe à nfè' ce e m fʉr Lasòròs efa rkwe nà a m ce suŋ bèe àmbò yuu ce yi m koni.
eng: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.

lmp: A mbùu ce bèe magòr ce a m yu' yuu bɛ̀ɛ ce Jisòs à m gèe anà, a m vʉ̀ a yɛ ye.
eng: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

lmp: Bèe Farìsi a ka' yɛ wa'a, a kɛ' a ce làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Àde' sèe gee yuu mo' ka'. Yɛ àmbò bèe wɛɛwɛ a kuŋ nyor a du a yê mbùu."
eng: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, bèe mo' à to' Grês a ba à mʉ̀ bèe ce a m ce du à rgèe rloo à ŋkà' anà.
eng: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.

lmp: Bèe Grês ca a m dù a yɛ Felep ce à rla' Bɛ̀tsaidà à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Masà, wèr ce kòŋ à ryɛ Jisòs."
eng: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, Sir, we want to see Jesus.

lmp: Felep à du a suŋ Andrù, a ye a du a suŋ Jisòs.
eng: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce a be kù'si Muu Ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Jesus answered them, The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ, mbʉ̀ kwaa à ka' tɛ gwè à nshè kwe ka', banɛ e be kù cu mò'sir àmbò e m ba. E ka' gwe à nshè, rlir li fʉʉ, kwaa kwe, banɛ e be kù', gèe mbʉ̀ kwaa àŋgoo.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' boŋshi li ryòŋ banɛ e be bɛ li. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ boŋshi li ryòŋ njep ŋgòŋ na ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ be tʉr li ryòŋ, cu nfesè.
eng: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koŋ à rfà' nè mɛ̀, ŋgàŋ vʉ fa mɛ̂ mbùu. Fàdì' ce m ka' ba, banɛ yà ŋwɛ̀ rfà' be ba àfo foŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' fa' nè mɛ̀ banɛ yà ta be nàa ye mbekì.
eng: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

lmp: "Ya ntee yi ce fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' sè'ni sê. M be ka' laa mɛ kɛ? M laa mɛnɛ "Yà Tâ, fʉr mɛ̀ efa ŋgɛ' ce e yu sè'ni nà" a? Ài', m be làa wa' ka'. Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ tɛ m bo yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ca
eng: Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? 'Father, save me from this time?' But for this cause I came to this time.

lmp: Yà Tâ, gèe tɛ a ku'si lo rlii." E ka' làa wa'a, a yu' njèndoŋ à laa embe bùu enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ gèe wa'a, m be kèr gèe."
eng: Father, glorify your name! Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.

lmp: Kʉr bèe mo' ce a m ba àfo a m yu' njèndoŋ anà a laa enɛ mbèŋ à waŋger. Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à làa yuu nè ye.
eng: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, An angel has spoken to him.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Njèndoŋ ca à làa njo' mɛ̀ ka', e làa njo' wèe.
eng: Jesus answered, This voice hasn't come for my sake, but for your sakes.

lmp: Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce Nyʉ̀ be sa' ŋgòŋ ca. Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce a be so ŋkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ ca.
eng: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, a be nàa mɛ̀ mbekì tɛ m sʉŋ bèe wɛɛwɛ à yà."
eng: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa wa'a tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ rkwe ce e be kwe.
eng: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

lmp: Kʉr bèe anà a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à m yu' embe Ŋwà' Mncir enɛ Krâis anà be cu nfesè. Wɛ̀ ka' ce làa wɛnɛ a be nàa Muu Ŋwɛ̀ mbekì njokɛ? Muu Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu nda sê?"
eng: The multitude answered him, We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, 'The Son of Man must be lifted up?' Who is this Son of Man?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Rraa li be kù ba wèe wowèe ba à nfè' mʉcàcàr. Ce jɛr nè sè'ni àmbò rraa li bii àgho, fà dì' tʉ̀'nji koni wèe ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke jɛ̀r à tʉ̀'nji e ke rìŋ fàdì' ce e ce dù ka'.
eng: Jesus therefore said to them, Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn't overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn't know where he is going.

lmp: Byemi nè nè rraa ca àmbò li ku bii fa wêe mʉ na, tɛ wèe bo ba boo ce à rraa." Jisòs à ka' làa blàa ca mìsi, a lɛ'si nyor efa mʉ̀ bèe a du a cu mimŋgi'.
eng: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light. Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

lmp: Ka' Jisòs à m dùŋshi ku' mncòo a wâp bsii wa'a, wowèe a m byemi yap yu nè ye ka'.
eng: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn't believe in him,

lmp: Buu ca vi m ku koni àmbò Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m saŋ nà. E m saŋ enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wà' ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e byemi blâa Nyʉ̀ ce wèr à fè'shi na a? Wà' ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e rìŋ yo ŋger a?"
eng: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

lmp: Bèe anà à m byemi ka'. Yi ku ba àmbò Àsayà à m ker saŋ nà. E m saŋ enɛ̂,
eng: For this cause they couldn't believe, for Isaiah said again,

lmp: "Nyʉ̀ à cete mâp mmir, a teesi wap btu fà dì' wowèe a bo yɛ rraa ca nè mâp mmir, rìŋ buu ca, bèesi yap ntee vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ mbùu tɛ m bo gèe wowèe a luŋ ka'."
eng: He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.

lmp: Àsayà à m ce làa buu ca wa'a njobè' e m yɛ fòo Jisòs, a ce làa ba àmbò ye.
eng: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

lmp: Geewa'a, bèe magòr a m byemi nè ye, ka' bèe mo' ce a m ba bêe bgòrgòr. Wowèe a m suŋ bèe ka', njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp bèe Farìsî. Wowèe a m gèe wa'a, fà dì' a bo jùu wowèe embe ndàp rloo ka'.
eng: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn't confess it, so that they wouldn't be put out of the synagogue,

lmp: Wowèe a m ce kòŋ à rgèe ba yuu ce vʉse Nyʉ̀ vʉse wowèe ka'. Wowèe a m ce kòŋ à rgèe ba yuu ce ku'si ba bèe kù'si wowèe.
eng: for they loved men's praise more than God's praise.

lmp: Jisòs à m làa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' byemi nè mɛ̀ banɛ ŋgàŋ à ku byemi ba nè mɛ̀ ka', e byemi foŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: Jesus cried out and said, Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yɛ mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ à yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na àmbò rraa tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè mɛ̀, e bo kèr cu à tʉ̀'nji ka'.
eng: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yu' wa blàa, ke' gee yuu ce mɛ̀ làa ka', be sa' mɛ̀ nsa' ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'. Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ tɛ m bo sa' bèe ka'. Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ tɛ m bo gèe bèe a lûŋ.
eng: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn't believe, I don't judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' kani mɛ̀ ker kani wa blàa foŋ, ŋgàŋ tʉr yuu ce yi be sa' ye. Wa blàa a yuu ce vi be sa' ŋwɛ̀ anà à nòŋ elʉ̀simbùu.
eng: He who rejects me, and doesn't receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' m ce làa buu ca ba à ŋger ya ka'. Yu ba yà Ta ce e m tuu mɛ̀ ce e m suŋ mɛ̀ yuu ce m lâa.
eng: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ vi blàa vi yu ryòŋ ce nfesè. Banɛ blàa ce m ce làa nè wèe yu ba blàa ce mɛ̀ yu' ese yà Ta cà'cà'."
eng: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.

lmp: Tɛ a ka' ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap, Jisòs à m rìŋ enɛ nfè' à ghɛɛ ce e be mà'shi ŋgòŋ ca dù yɛ yì Tâ. E m kòŋ yì bèe ce a yu njep ŋgòŋ na, a koŋ wowèe a du a misî.
eng: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce ye byee à mbùuŋkùr, Satàn à banì gee Judàs ce muu Saimʉn Ìskarìyòt à kɛ' a ce kwà'shi enɛ e be fyèni Jisòs.
eng: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon's son, to betray him,

lmp: Jisòs à m rìŋ enɛ yì Ta à m fa buu wɛɛwɛ mbe yê mmbò. E m rìŋ foŋ enɛ e m lô ese Nyʉ̀, a ce kʉti à ryɛ Nyʉ̀,
eng: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came forth from God, and was going to God,

lmp: a nati mbekì à nfè' byee anà, a co'ni bcɛ̂' mo' efa nyòr, a lor bàtàare a cʉʉ njep mbùu.
eng: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel, and wrapped a towel around his waist.

lmp: E ka' cʉʉ wɛɛ, a lor mdip a cu'ni njep kaŋ a kɛ' a ce sù'si mkûu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a ce sòr nè bàtàare ce e ba cʉʉ njep mbùu nà.
eng: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples' feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

lmp: E ka' bà' mbe Saimʉn Pità, e laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, a wɛ̀ ce à be sù'si ma mkùu a?"
eng: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, Lord, do you wash my feet?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ be riŋ yuu ce m ce gèe sè'ni ka'. À be lò rìŋ ba embenjì."
eng: Jesus answered him, You don't know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Àde' à ke' su'si ma mkùu ka'." Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "M ka' tɛ sù'si mo mkùu ka', banɛ sò à mì."
eng: Peter said to him, You will never wash my feet! Jesus answered him, If I don't wash you, you have no part with me.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, banɛ à fa kù sù'si ba ma mkùu cà'cà' ka', sù'si ma mmbo ba ya tu foŋ."
eng: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' su'si nyor wɛɛ, banɛ ŋgàŋ be kù sù'si ba mi mkùu njobè' yì nyor ce raa. À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, wèe ce raa, geewa'a ku ba wèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce raa ka'."
eng: Jesus said to him, Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.

lmp: E m làa wa'a, a ku riŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e be lò fyèni ye. A mbùu ce e m làa enɛ̂, "Ku ba wèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce raa ka'."
eng: For he knew him who would betray him, therefore he said, You are not all clean.

lmp: E ka' sù'si wowèe mkùu wɛɛ, a lor vi bcɛ̀' ce e ba co'ni nà a yar, a du a cu à nshè. E ka' cu, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wà' wèe rìŋ yuu ce mɛ̀ gèe nè wèe na a?
eng: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?

lmp: Wèe ce too mɛ̀ enɛ Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, a ker ce too mɛ̀ enɛ Tatâ. Wèe ce too yɛɛnì njobè' m yu wa'a.
eng: You call me, 'Teacher' and 'Lord.' You say so correctly, for so I am.

lmp: Àmbò mɛ̀ ce m yu Tatâ, a ker ba Ŋwɛ̀ Ryɛ'nì, mɛ̀ ka' su'si me mkùu, banɛ wèe ce su'si mkûu bfʉr wee foŋ.
eng: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another's feet.

lmp: Mɛ̀ gèe ca à rdùŋshi wèe tɛ wee wèe foŋ bo gèe àmbò mɛ̀ gèe na.
eng: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ rfà' caa yì masà ka'. Àbà ŋwɛ̀ ntuu caa ŋwɛ̀ ce e tuu ye ka'.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

lmp: Wèe à ka' riŋ buu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wèe na, ce gèe vi, banɛ wèe be koni bghònì.
eng: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

lmp: M ce làa ca ba àmbò wèe wɛɛwɛ ka'. M rìŋ bèe ce mɛ̀ ce. Geewa'a, yuu ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi m làa yi be kù ghɛɛte àmbò a m saŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce wèr ye à m ce ye byee àbee, à m kʉti yà ŋwɛ̀ bbàa."
eng: I don't speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen. But that the Scripture may be fulfilled, 'He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe buu ca sè'ni tɛ vi ka' koni, vi ka' lo koni tɛ wèe bo byemi enɛ m yu njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce m yu.
eng: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni yà ŋwɛ̀ ntuu, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni mɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koni mɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa blàa ca wɛɛ, mlù mi kɛ' a ce koo ye. E laa rara enɛ̂, "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ be fyèni mɛ̀."
eng: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a kɛ' a ce kè'ni nè mmir, a ce tarni ŋwɛ̀ ce Jisòs à m ce làa.
eng: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wowèe ce Jisòs à m kòŋ se nà à m cu a kɛr nyor a yê geŋ.
eng: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus' breast.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à lap ye enɛ e bipshi nè Jisòs enɛ e ce làa ba àmbò nda lɛ.
eng: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.

lmp: E yɛ'tì yi tu nje ŋgùŋ Jisòs, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, ŋwɛ̀ anà yu nda?"
eng: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus' breast, asked him, Lord, who is it?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Yu ŋwɛ̀ ce m be bɛ' brɛ̂d cʉ̀' njep njàp fa nè ye." E ka' làa wa'a, a bɛ' brɛ̂d a cʉ' njep njàp, a fa nè Judàs, muu Saimʉn Ìskarìyòt.
eng: Jesus therefore answered, It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it. So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

lmp: E ka' ye, Satàn à niŋ njep yê ntee. Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa càasi nfè' ka', gèe yuu ce à ce kòŋ à rgèe nà cɛrcɛr."
eng: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, What you do, do quickly.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ba mbo a m rìŋ mbùu ce Jisòs à m làa nè ye wa' ka'.
eng: Now no man at the table knew why he said this to him.

lmp: Àmbò Judàs à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce lɛ̀ yap mbàa nà, bèe mo' a ce kwà'shi yap enɛ Jisòs ce làa ba enɛ e du yuu buu ŋkà', kɛ̀ enɛ e du fa yuu nè ŋgâa fùp.
eng: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, Buy what things we need for the feast, or that he should give something to the poor.

lmp: E ka' koo brɛ̂d ca a ku fʉʉ njepmbè. À m ba nètʉ'.
eng: Therefore, having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

lmp: E ka' fʉʉ, Jisòs à laa enɛ̂, "A kù'si Muu Ŋwɛ̀ sè'ni. A ku'si Nyʉ̀ njì enjep ye.
eng: When he had gone out, Jesus said, Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

lmp: A ka' ku'si Nyʉ̀ njì enjep ye, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be kù'si Muu njì enjep yê nyòr. E be gèe wa'a cɛrcɛr sê.
eng: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

lmp: Boo wâ, sèe be kù cu ba à nfè' mʉcàcàr. Wèe be ròo mɛ̀. Yi ku ba àmbò mɛ̀ m suŋ Jus enɛ̂, "Àde' wèe vʉ fàdì' ce m ce dù ka'" nà.
eng: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, 'Where I am going, you can't come,' so now I tell you.

lmp: M ce fa wèe ncir ce fi enɛ wèe kòŋni. Wèe koŋni foŋ àmbò mɛ̀ m kòŋ wèe nà.
eng: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another, just like I have loved you; that you also love one another.

lmp: Wèe à ka' koŋni wa'a, banɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a be rìŋ enɛ wèe yu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yà buu."
eng: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, à ce dù ba fɛ?" Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Àde' à du fàdì' ce m ce dù na sè'ni ka'. À be lò ka' vʉ̀ a mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Simon Peter said to him, Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, Where I am going, you can't follow now, but you will follow afterwards.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, àde' m du fa wɛ̂ mbùu sè'ni ka' njokɛ? M be kwe njo' wɛ̀."
eng: Peter said to him, Lord, why can't I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Wɛnɛ à be kwe njo' mɛ̀ lɛ! M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini- ŋwɛ̀ enɛ tɛ nduŋgʉp ka' toŋ, à be kani enɛ à rìŋ mɛ̀ ka' ŋkàrà' taar.
eng: Jesus answered him, Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won't crow until you have denied me three times.

lmp: "Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ wee mntee vi ce fa wèe ŋgɛ' ka', wèe byemi nè Nyʉ̀, ker byemi nè mɛ̀ foŋ.
eng: Don't let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

lmp: Tomas à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wèr rìŋ fàdì' ce à ce dù ka', banɛ àde' wèr riŋ nduunjì anà à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: Thomas said to him, Lord, we don't know where you are going. How can we know the way?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ nduunjì, a mɛ̀ mini, a mɛ̀ ryòŋ. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' du yɛ yà Tâ, ce e buu efa rcàa njì enjep mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Jesus said to him, I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

lmp: Wèe à ba riŋ mɛ̀, wèe à ba rìŋ yà Ta foŋ. Kɛ' e sè'ni na, wèe à rìŋ ye, a ker yɛ ye foŋ."
eng: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him, and have seen him.

lmp: Felep à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, dùŋshi wèr yò Ta tɛ yi bo ghɛɛte wèr."
eng: Philip said to him, Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Felêp, sèe à cu tètè wa'a, wɛ̀ ke' riŋ mɛ̀ ka' lɛ? Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yɛ mɛ̀, banɛ e yɛ yà Tâ. Wɛ̀ ka' ker ce làa enɛ m duŋshi wɛ̀ yà Ta njokɛ?
eng: Jesus said to him, Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, 'Show us the Father?'

lmp: Wɛ̀ byemi enɛ m yu njep yà Tâ, yà Ta à ba njep mɛ̀ a? Blàa ce m ce làa nè wèe na, m ce làa ba à ŋger ya ka'. Yà Ta ce e yu njep mɛ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe li rfà'.
eng: Don't you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

lmp: Byemi nè yuu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wèe enɛ m yu njep yà Tâ, yà Ta à ba njep mɛ̀ nà. Wèe à ka' tɛ byemi njo' blàa ca ka', wèe à ba byemi njobè' mfà' ce mɛ̀ gèe na.
eng: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works' sake.

lmp: "M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè mɛ̀, banɛ e be gèe buu ce m ce gèe, kèr gèe buu ce vi càa vi ce m ce gèe njobè' m ce dù à rcu wèr Tàr.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

lmp: Wèe à ka' loo ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ à mɛ̂ rlii, m be gèe yuu anà, tɛ bèe a bo kù'si Tàr njo' Muu yì.
eng: Whatever you will ask in my name, that will I do, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

lmp: Wèe à ka' loo ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ à mɛ̂ rlii, m be gèe yi.
eng: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

lmp: "Wèe à ka' koŋ mɛ̀, wèe yu' wa blàa.
eng: If you love me, keep my commandments.

lmp: M be loo nè Tàr tɛ e tuusi wèe Ŋwɛ̀ Rjà' mò' tɛ e bo cu wèe wowèe nfesè.
eng: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever,--

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Rjà' ca yu Yʉ' ce yi ke suŋ bèe yuu mini. Àde' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ a konì Ŋwɛ̀ Rjà' anà ka', njobè' àde' wowèe a yɛ ye kɛ̀ riŋ ye ka'. Bèe ce a rìŋ ye yu wèe njobè' e be cu wèe wowèe, ba njep wêe mntee.
eng: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can't receive; for it doesn't see him, neither knows him. You know him, for he lives with you, and will be in you.

lmp: M be mà'shi wèe nè ye tu ka'. M be dù kʉti vʉ̀ yɛ wèe.
eng: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

lmp: Ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ker yɛ mɛ̀ ka'. Geewa'a, wèe be yɛ mɛ̀. À ka' ba njobè' m cu ntèe, banɛ wèe be cu btèe foŋ.
eng: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

lmp: Nòŋ anà yi be ghɛɛ tɛ wèe riŋ enɛ m yu njep yà Tâ, wèe à ba njep mɛ̀, mɛ mɛ̀ à ba njep wèe.
eng: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yu' wa blàa, lɛ̂, banɛ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ mɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ mɛ̀ banɛ yà Ta be kòŋ ŋgàŋ foŋ. M be kòŋ ŋwɛ̀ anà foŋ, dùŋshi yà nyor nè ye."
eng: One who has my commandments, and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.

lmp: Judàs ce à m ba Judas Ìskarìyòt ka', à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, à be dùŋshi yò nyor nè wèr tɛ wèr yɛ wɛ̀ tɛ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ a yɛ wɛ̀ ka' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: Judas not Iscariot said to him, Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ mɛ̀ banɛ ŋgàŋ be yu' wa blàa. Yà Ta be kòŋ ye. Wèr yà Ta be vʉ̀ cu wèr ŋwɛ̀ anà wèe.
eng: Jesus answered him, If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him, and make our home with him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ mɛ̀ ka', a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce yu' wa blàa ka'. Blàa ce wèe ce yu' na, yu wa ka', yu blàa yà Ta ce e m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: He who doesn't love me doesn't keep my words. The word which you hear isn't mine, but the Father's who sent me.

lmp: "M ce suŋ wèe buu ca a ku bii fa wêe mʉ.
eng: I have said these things to you, while still living with you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Rjà' ce yu Yʉ' Rara ce Tàr be tuu a mɛ̂ rlii, yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e be vʉ̀ yɛ'ni wèe buu wɛɛwɛ, gèe tɛ wèe kuushi buu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

lmp: "Mɛ̀ lɛ̀ cumʉnyaŋ nè wèe, m ce fa yà cumʉnyaŋ nè wèe. M ce fa ba àmbò bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ke fa ka'. Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ wee mntee vi ce fa wèe ŋgɛ' ka'. Wèe fa wɛp buu ka'.
eng: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, give I to you. Don't let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

lmp: Wèe à m yu' àmbò mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe mɛnɛ m ce dù kʉti yɛ wèe. Wèe à ba koŋ mɛ̀, wèe à ba lu'shi enɛ m ce dù à ryɛ Tàr, njobè' e kù' a caa mɛ̀.
eng: You heard how I told you, 'I go away, and I come to you.' If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said 'I am going to my Father;' for the Father is greater than I.

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe buu ca sè'ni tɛ vi ka' koni, vi lò koni nà, tɛ wèe bo byemi nè mɛ̀.
eng: Now I have told you before it happens so that, when it happens, you may believe.

lmp: M be kèr suŋ buu wèe sèe wèe gòr ka' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce sa' ŋgòŋ ca ce vʉ̀. E tʉr ŋger mbe mɛ̂ ndù ka'.
eng: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

lmp: M ku ce gèe ba àmbò Tàr à suŋ mɛ̀ enɛ m gêe, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi bo rìŋ enɛ mɛ̀ kòŋ ye. Nàti nè tɛ sèe du à dî' jɛɛ."
eng: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let us go from here.

lmp: Jisòs à m ker laa enɛ̂, "M yu msini grɛ̂p ce mini. Yà Ta a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke ke' à msini ca.
eng: I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

lmp: M ku koŋ wèe foŋ àmbò yà Ta kòŋ mɛ̀. Cu nè njep la rkòŋnì.
eng: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

lmp: Wèe à ka' gee buu ce mɛ̀ làa nè wèe, wèe be cu njep la rkòŋnì àmbò mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ à gèe buu ce yà Ta à làa enɛ m gêe, a cu njep li rkòŋnì nà.
eng: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love; even as I have kept my Father's commandments, and remain in his love.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa buu ca nè wèe tɛ wèe bo lu'shi foŋ àmbò mɛ̀, tɛ le rlu'shì anà li bo mìsi.
eng: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa enɛ wèe gee yi yu enɛ wèe koŋni àmbò m kòŋ wèe.
eng: This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

lmp: "Ŋgòŋ ca yi ka' baa wèe, rìŋ nè enɛ yi m baa mɛ̀ entombî nè wèe.
eng: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

lmp: Wèe à ba ba bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na, wowèe a ba kòŋ wèe njobè' wèe yu yàp bèe. Geewa'a wèe yu ye bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Mɛ̀ ce wèe efa mʉ̀ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na. A mbùu ce wowèe a bàa wèe.
eng: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

lmp: Kuushi nè yuu ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ rfà' caa yì masà ka' nà. Wowèe a m ka' ba fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ', banɛ a be fa wèe ŋgɛ' foŋ. Wowèe a m ka' ba yu'ni nè wa blàa banɛ a be yu'ni nè wee blàa foŋ.
eng: Remember the word that I said to you: 'A servant is not greater than his lord.' If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will keep yours also.

lmp: Wowèe a be gèe nè wèe wa'a njobè' mɛ̀, ker ba foŋ njobè' wowèe a rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But all these things will they do to you for my name's sake, because they don't know him who sent me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m tɛ bà vʉ̀ làa yuu nè wowèe ka', a m ba tàa wowèe à yuu bebep ka'. Àmbò mɛ̀ vʉ̀ sè'ni na, yuu mo' yi yu ce àde' yi ker tɛ'shi yàp buu bbebep ka'.
eng: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' baa mɛ̀, banɛ e bàa yà Ta foŋ.
eng: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ka' tɛ bà gèe mfà' ce ŋwɛ̀ à m be gee ka' fa wâp mʉ na ka', a m ba tàa wowèe à yuu bebep ka'. Wowèe a yɛ mfà' ca sè'ni, a ku bii ce bàa mɛ̀, ba yà Ta foŋ.
eng: If I hadn't done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn't have had sin. But now have they seen and also hated both me and my Father.

lmp: Buu ca vi koni wa'a, tɛ yi bo kù ghɛɛte àmbò a m saŋ mbe yap ŋwà' mncir enɛ̂, "A m bàa mɛ̀ à cicì."
eng: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, 'They hated me without a cause.'

lmp: Be kè ba à nfè' mò' tɛ m tuu ŋwɛ̀ rjà' mò' nè wèe ese Tàr. Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu Yʉ' ce yi lò ese Tàr, yi ke suŋ bèe yuu mini. Yi be vʉ̀ tɛ yi suŋ bèe àmbò mɛ̀.
eng: When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

lmp: Bèe a be jùu wèe embe ndàp rloo. Nfè' ce ghɛɛ ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e be yʉ wèe, be kwà'shi enɛ e gèe ba rfà' Nyʉ̀.
eng: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time comes that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

lmp: Wowèe a be gèe buu ca njobè' wowèe a rìŋ Tàr ka', a riŋ mɛ̀ foŋ ka'.
eng: They will do these things because they have not known the Father, nor me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe buu ca tɛ nfè' ka' ghɛɛ, vi koni, tɛ wèe bo kuushi enɛ mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe. "Mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe buu ca efa rkɛ̀' ka' njobè' sèe à m ku ba.
eng: But I have told you these things, so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn't tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

lmp: M ce kʉti sè'ni dù yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tuu mɛ̀. Ka' yi yu wa'a, mò' efa wèe à be bipshi nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "À ce dù ba fɛ lɛ?" ka'.
eng: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, 'Where are you going?'

lmp: Wèe ce koosimnse njo' buu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wèe na.
eng: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

lmp: Geewa'a, m ce suŋ wèe yuu mini. Yi yu bòŋboŋ nè wèe enɛ m dû, njobè' m ka' tɛ dù ka', Ŋwɛ̀ Rjà' vʉ cu wèe wowèe ka'. M ka' dû, m tuu ye tɛ e vʉ cu wèe wowèe.
eng: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away, for if I don't go away, the Counselor won't come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

lmp: E be vʉ̀ tɛ e gee tɛ ŋgòŋ yi yɛ yàp fàa kùu buu bbebep, ba buu byɛɛnì ker ba mnsa'.
eng: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

lmp: A be yɛ yàp fàa kùu buu bbebep njobè' wowèe a byemi nè mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: about sin, because they don't believe in me;

lmp: Kùu buu byɛɛnì njobè' m ce dù à ryɛ yà Tâ, tɛ wèe ker yɛ mɛ̀ ka',
eng: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won't see me any more;

lmp: ker ba mnsa' njobè' ŋkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na à gwè mnsa'.
eng: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

lmp: "Buu yu magòr ce mɛ̀ ba suŋ wèe, à ba njobè' m ka' suŋ wèe sè'ni na, vi caa ye ŋger.
eng: I have yet many things to tell you, but you can't bear them now.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a kɛ' a ce làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Yuu ce e làa nè sèe na yi yu ba enɛ kɛ? E làa enɛ̂, "Nfè' mʉcàr tɛ wèe yɛ mɛ̀ ka', e ba nfè' mʉcàr tɛ wèe yɛ mɛ̀", a ker laa foŋ enɛ̂, "Njobè' m ce dù à ryɛ Tàr" njokɛ?"
eng: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, What is this that he says to us, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;' and, 'Because I go to the Father?'

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Nfè' mʉcàr ce e ce làa na, yu ba enɛ kɛ? Sèe rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ yuu ce e làa na ka'."
eng: They said therefore, What is this that he says, 'A little while?' We don't know what he is saying.

lmp: Jisòs à m rìŋ enɛ wowèe a kòŋ à rbipshi yuu nè ye, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ làa enɛ̂, "Nfè' mʉcàr tɛ wèe yɛ mɛ̀ ka', e kèr ba nfè' mʉcàr tɛ wèe yɛ mɛ̀." Wà' a yuu ce wèe ce bipshi a wêe mʉ a?
eng: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, 'A little while, and you won't see me, and again a little while, and you will see me?'

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe be war ce koosimnse, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ce lu'shi yi yu. Wèe be seŋ buu tɛ yè nseŋ buu anà lo kʉti ba à rlu'shì.
eng: Most certainly I tell you, that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

lmp: E ke ba à nfè' ce njeŋwɛ̀ ce luuti, e ce koosimnse njobè' nfè' rbi à ghɛɛ. E ba à nfè' ce e bi muu wɛɛ, e ker kuushi ryaŋ cà ka' njobè' e ce lu'shi enɛ e bi muu.
eng: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow, because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn't remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

lmp: A mbò wèe ce koosimnse sè'ni wa'a, geewa'a m be kèr yɛ wèe, tɛ wèe lu'shi à nfè' anà, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker jepsi wèe efa rlu'shì ka'.
eng: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

lmp: "Be ba nyʉ̀ anà tɛ wèe ker loo yuu mo' ese mɛ̀ ka'. M ce suŋ wèe nè mini- ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe à ka' loo ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ ese Tàr fa mɛ̂ rlii, e be fa yuu anà nè wèe.
eng: In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a laa enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀hɛ̂! À ce làa sè'ni rara, à ker ce mà' ba ŋgàa ka'.
eng: His disciples said to him, Behold, now you speak plainly, and speak no figures of speech.

lmp: Wèr à rìŋ sè'ni na enɛ à rìŋ buu wɛɛwɛ. Mbùu mò' ker ba àgho nè ŋwɛ̀ à rbipshi yuu mo' nè wɛ̀ ka'. À ka' ba njobè' cena, wèr a byemi enɛ wɛ̀ lò ese Nyʉ̀."
eng: Now we know that you know all things, and don't need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came forth from God.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à byemi sè'ni a?
eng: Jesus answered them, Do you now believe?

lmp: Yɛ̂, nfè' ce ghɛɛ, e ghɛɛ wɛɛ, ce wèe be da'se, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ kʉti fa yê là', mà'shi mɛ̀ mamŋgi'. M be ba mamŋgi' ka', njobè' Tàr ku ba wèr ye.
eng: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa cena nè wèe tɛ wèe bo koni cumʉnyaŋ njep mɛ̀. Wèe be yɛ ŋgɛ' njep ŋgòŋ na. Ka' yi yu wa'a, kur nè ntee. Mɛ̀ so ŋgòŋ ca."
eng: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have oppression; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca, a naa mmir a ke' mbe bùu a laa enɛ̂, "Tàr, nfè' à ghɛɛ. Kù'si muu wò, tɛ muu wò ye ye bo kù'si wɛ̀.
eng: Jesus said these things, and lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

lmp: Wɛ̀ fa ye ŋger mbendù bèe wɛɛwɛ tɛ e bo fa ryòŋ ce nfesè nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̀ fa mba yê mmbò.
eng: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

lmp: Ryòŋ ce nfesè ca li yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ riŋ wɛ̀, ce ku ba ba wɛ̀ cà'cà' ce à yu Nyʉ̀ mini, ker riŋ Jisos Krâis ce wɛ̀ tuu njep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

lmp: Mɛ̀ mìsi rfà' ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀ enɛ m gêe, a ku'si wɛ̀ àgho njep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

lmp: Wɛ̂ Tàr, kù'si là mɛ̀ sè'ni a wɛ̂ bsii nè bkù' ce mɛ̀ m tʉr wèe sò tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' ba.
eng: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

lmp: "Mɛ̀ gèe yò bèe ce wɛ̀ m fa mba mɛ̂ mmbò efa mʉ̀ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a riŋ wɛ̀. Bèe anà à m ba yò bèe, wɛ̀ fa wowèe nè mɛ̀. Wowèe a yu'ni nè wo blàa.
eng: I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

lmp: Wowèe a rìŋ sè'ni enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce m tʉr, vi lò ba ese wɛ̀.
eng: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wowèe blàa ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀. Wowèe a byemi blàa ca, a riŋ foŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ mɛ̀ lò ba ese wɛ̀. Wowèe a byemi enɛ wɛ̀ tuu mɛ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: for the words which you have given me I have given to them, and they received them, and knew for sure that I came forth from you, and they have believed that you sent me.

lmp: "M ce loo nè wowèe. M ce loo ba nè ŋgòŋ ca ka', m ce loo ba nè bèe ce wɛ̀ fa nè mɛ̀ na njobè' wowèe a yu yò bèe.
eng: I pray for them. I don't pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

lmp: Ya yu yo, yo à ba ya. A kù'si mɛ̀ njo' wowèe.
eng: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

lmp: M be kèr cu njep ŋgòŋ ka', wowèe a be kù cu yap njo, tɛ m vʉ ya vʉ̀ yɛ wɛ̀. Tàr ce nrara, kè'ni wowèe nè yo ŋger ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀ foŋ nà, tɛ wowèe a bo ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir àmbò sò yu nà.
eng: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ba wèr wowèe, a ke'ni wowèe, wowèe a cu njep lo rlii ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀. Mɛ̀ cìŋ wowèe, yuu mo' yi ke' joo wowèe ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, mò' efa wowèe à m bʉ caa efa ŋwɛ̀ ce yi yu enɛ e be bʉ nà ka'. E m bʉ tɛ yuu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi bo ghɛɛte njo.
eng: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. Those whom you have given me I have kept. None of them is lost, except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

lmp: M ce vʉ à ryɛ wɛ̀ sè'ni, a ce làa buu ca njep ŋgòŋ na, tɛ la rlu'shì li bo mìsi njep wowèe.
eng: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wowèe wo blàa; ŋgòŋ yi bàa wowèe njobè' wowèe a yu bèe enjep ŋgòŋ ka', àmbò mɛ mɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ ka' nà.
eng: I have given them your word. The world hated them, because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ à fʉr wowèe enjep ŋgòŋ ka'. M ce loo mɛnɛ à ke'ni wowèe fà dì' Satàn ce e yu ŋwɛ̂ mbebep gee yuu mo' nè wowèe ka'.
eng: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

lmp: Wowèe a yu bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na ka', àmbò mɛ mɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ka' nà.
eng: They are not of the world even as I am not of the world.

lmp: Ce wowèe, lɛ wowèe rara nè yò mini. Wo blàa yu mini.
eng: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

lmp: Àmbò wɛ̀ m tuu mɛ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na mɛ mɛ̀ à tuu wowèe njep ŋgòŋ foŋ.
eng: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ce ya tu, a lɛ rara njo' wowèe, tɛ à bo ce wowèe foŋ, lɛ̀ rara nè yò mini.
eng: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

lmp: "M ce loo ba nè wowèe cà'cà' ka', m ce loo foŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a be byemi nè mɛ̀ njobè' wap blàa.
eng: Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who believe in me through their word,

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, àmbò wɛ̂ Tàr, à yu njep mɛ̀, mɛ̀ ba njep wɛ̀ nà, tɛ wowèe a bo ba njep sò foŋ, tɛ ŋgòŋ ca yi bo byemi enɛ wɛ̀ m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ kù'si wowèe àmbò wɛ̀ m kù'si mɛ̀ nà, tɛ wowèe a bo ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir àmbò sò ku ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir foŋ nà.
eng: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them; that they may be one, even as we are one;

lmp: M yu njep wowèe àmbò à yu njep mɛ̀ foŋ nà, tɛ wowèe a bo ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi bo rìŋ enɛ wɛ̀ m tuu mɛ̀, kèr rìŋ foŋ enɛ wɛ̀ m kòŋ wowèe àmbò wɛ̀ m kòŋ mɛ̀ foŋ nà.
eng: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one; that the world may know that you sent me, and loved them, even as you loved me.

lmp: Tàr, mɛ̀ kòŋ mɛnɛ bèe ce wɛ̀ fa mɛ̀ na, a ba wèr wowèe fàdì' ce m be ba foŋ, tɛ a bo yɛ wa bkù' ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀ njobè' wɛ̀ m kòŋ mɛ̀ tɛ a ka' kè gèe ŋgòŋ, a ka' fa mɛ̀ bkù' anà.
eng: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory, which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

lmp: Tàr, wɛ̀ ce à yu yɛɛnì, ŋgòŋ yi rìŋ wɛ̀ ka' mɛ̀ rìŋ ya yu wɛ̀. Bèe ca a rìŋ enɛ wɛ̀ m tuu mɛ̀.
eng: Righteous Father, the world hasn't known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ gèe wowèe a riŋ lo rlii. M be kù ce gèe wa'a tɛ lo rkòŋnì ce wɛ̀ tʉr nè mɛ̀ li ba njep wowèe, tɛ m ba njep wowèe foŋ."
eng: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa buu ca wɛɛ, a lor ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a wowèe a du a tuu ntòŋ Kɛdròn fàdì' ce ŋka' bce yi m ba. E m niŋ mbo a ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu anà.
eng: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

lmp: Judàs ce e m fyèni ye nà, ye ye à m rìŋ dì' anà njobè' Jisòs ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu wèe a m ce dù mbe dì' anà cɛ'cɛ'.
eng: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, e koo kʉr bsoogɛ̀ ba ŋgâa rkè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ ese ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba Farìsî, a wowèe a ka' ce dù, a lor blam a cʉ', a bɛrsi msùsùŋ, a lor buu bìr.
eng: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

lmp: Jisòs à m rìŋ buu ce vi be koni ye wɛɛwɛ. A ka' rìŋ wa'a, a fʉʉ a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wêe ròo ba nda?"
eng: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went forth, and said to them, Who are you looking for?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr ce ròo ba Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t." Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ye." Judàs ce e m fyèni ye nà à m tɛɛ a wowèe.
eng: They answered him, Jesus of Nazareth. Jesus said to them, I am he. Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ye", wowèe a kʉtì njìnjì a gweŋger à nshè.
eng: When therefore he said to them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.

lmp: E ker bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce ròo ba nda?" Wowèe a ker laa enɛ̂, "Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t."
eng: Again therefore he asked them, Who are you looking for? They said, Jesus of Nazareth.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe wɛɛ enɛ a mɛ̀ ye. Yi ka' ba enɛ wèe ce ròo ba mɛ̀, wèe ma'shì tɛ bèe ca a duse."
eng: Jesus answered, I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,

lmp: E m làa wa'a tɛ yi bo kù ghɛɛte àmbò e m làa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ bʉsi ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce wɛ̀ m fa nè mɛ̀ nà ka'."
eng: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.

lmp: Awɛ Saimʉn Pità ce e m tʉr sà', à co' embà rùu, a tee tù' mà' ese ŋkwàa ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. A m ce too ŋkwàa anà enɛ Markùs.
eng: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, and struck the high priest's servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant's name was Malchus.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Kʉsi kàafà' mbà rùu. M fa no njep ndoŋ ce Tàr à fa nè mɛ̀ na ka' a?"
eng: Jesus therefore said to Peter, Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bsoogɛ̀ ba ŋgâa ke'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ a m koo Jisòs a kur,
eng: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews, seized Jesus and bound him,

lmp: a du àgho a yɛ Anàs entombì. Anàs à m ba talu yì Kaifàs ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à fè' anà.
eng: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

lmp: Kaifàs ca a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cep Jus enɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir kwe àtu bèe nà.
eng: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu mò' a m dù àmbùu Jisòs à nfè' anà. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à m rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs anà. E niŋ a Jisòs mbe mambe ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì anà.
eng: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

lmp: Pità à m tɛɛ yi ba njep ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' njepmbè. Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs mò' à m ba àfo ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à m rìŋ. E m fʉʉ njepmbè a laa nè muunje ce e m tɛɛ à ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' enɛ e ma'shi, e lor Pità a ye a niŋ mbe mambe cà.
eng: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

lmp: Muunje ce e m ke'ni ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' nà à laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Mbò à yu mò' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu ŋwɛ̀ ca lɛ?" E laa enɛ̂, "M yu mò' ka'."
eng: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, Are you also one of this man's disciples? He said, I am not.

lmp: Ŋgâa mfà' ba ŋgâa rkè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ a m fyɛɛshi mor a tɛɛ a ce yɛr njobè' mbɛp à m ce fute sê. Pità ye ye à m dù a tɛɛ a ce yɛr mor a wowèe.
eng: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì na à m bipshi buu nè Jisòs a kuu ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, ker ba li ryɛ'nì.
eng: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples, and about his teaching.

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ làa buu àwaŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ. Mɛ̀ m ce yɛ'ni bèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ à mndap mloo, ba mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, ce yu bdì' ce Jus a ke vʉ̀ ce tarte. Mɛ̀ làa yuu mo' à bsʉ̀ti ka'.
eng: Jesus answered him, I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues, and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

lmp: À ce bipshi nè mɛ̀ njokɛ? Bipshi ba nè bèe ce a m yu' buu ce mɛ̀ m ce làa nè wowèe. Wowèe a rìŋ buu ce mɛ̀ m làa."
eng: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, these know the things which I said.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ rkè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ mò' ce e m tɛɛ a yê geŋ à lip ye nè bo a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Haba! Wà' a njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' à beesì yuu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a?"
eng: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, Do you answer the high priest like that?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "M ka' laa wa'a, fàa ba njo, à suŋ fàa anà. Ka' ba enɛ mɛ̀ làa yɛɛnì, wɛ̀ ka' lip mɛ̀ njokɛ?"
eng: Jesus answered him, If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?

lmp: Anàs à lâa, a lor ye àmbò a m kur nà, a dù àgho, a yɛ Kaifàs ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à m ku tɛɛ a ce yɛr mor. Bèe mo' a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mbò à yu mò' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu ŋwɛ̀ anà foŋ a?" Pità à kanì a laa enɛ̂, "M yu mò' ka'."
eng: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, You aren't also one of his disciples, are you? He denied it, and said, I am not.

lmp: Mò' efa ŋgâa mfâ' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nà, ce e m ba ràrâ ŋwɛ̀ ce Pità à m tee yi tù' nà, à m làa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Mbò mɛ̀ m yɛ wèe ye mbe ŋka' bce a?"
eng: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, Didn't I see you in the garden with him?

lmp: Pità à ker kani. E ka' kani wa'a, nduŋgʉp à ku toŋ.
eng: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

lmp: À ka' ba à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', wowèe a lor Jisòs embe mambe Kaifàs a du àgho mbe nto' yàp govanò. Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀, a niŋ mbe nto' ka' njobè' wowèe a m ce kòŋ à rba brara à bsii Nyʉ̀ tɛ wowèe a bo ye yap Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap.
eng: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn't enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pailɛ̀t à fʉʉ njepmbè a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à koo ŋwɛ̀ ca a vʉ àgho enɛ e fàa kɛ?"
eng: Pilate therefore went out to them, and said, What accusation do you bring against this man?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ka' tɛ bà ba ŋwɛ̀ ŋgèe buu bbebep ka', wèr à ba koo ye vʉ̀ àgho fa nè wɛ̀ ka'."
eng: They answered him, If this man weren't an evildoer, we wouldn't have delivered him up to you.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè ye du sa' ye àmbò ye ncir yi yu." Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Wèr tʉr ŋger à rsa' ŋwɛ̀ yʉ ka'."
eng: Pilate therefore said to them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law. Therefore the Jews said to him, It is not lawful for us to put anyone to death,

lmp: Cena yi m ba wa'a, tɛ nlàa ce Jisòs à m làa kuu njɛ̀ɛ rkwe ce e be kwe nà yi bo kù ghɛɛte njo.
eng: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à kʉtì mbe nto' a kɛ' Jisòs a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋkʉʉ Jus a?"
eng: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, Are you the King of the Jews?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Yuu ce wɛ̀ bipshi na, à ku kwa'shi ba wɛ̀ kɛ̀ à suŋ bèe mo' a suŋ wɛ̀ a kuu mɛ̀?"
eng: Jesus answered him, Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à beesì enɛ̂, "M yu ŋwɛ̀ Jus ka'. Bèe ce a vʉ̀ nè wɛ̀ a fa nè mɛ̀ yu yò bèe ker ba bèe efa wâp mʉ ce a ke taŋshi taŋshì nà. Wɛ̀ gèe ba kɛ a ka' koo wɛ̀ a vʉ àgho?"
eng: Pilate answered, I'm not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Ya kʉʉ yu yì enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Ya kʉʉ à ba ba yì enjep ŋgòŋ na, yà bèe a ba bèe yà njì, rè bkòr fà dì' a fa mɛ̀ mbà mmbo Jus ka'. Yi yu enɛ ya kʉʉ yi lò ba enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'."
eng: Jesus answered, My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn't be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Banɛ à yu ŋkʉʉ a?" Jisòs a beesì enɛ̂, "To wɛ̀ làa wɛnɛ m yu ŋkʉʉ. A m bi mɛ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na, mɛ̀ vʉ̀ mɛnɛ m bo suŋ bèe àmbò yuu mini. A mbùu ce a m bi mɛ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛɛ njep mini, a ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu' wa blàa."
eng: Pilate therefore said to him, Are you a king then? Jesus answered, You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mini anà yu kɛ sê?" E ka' làa wa'a, a ker fʉʉ embe nto' a yɛ Jûs, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ yɛ yuu bebep mò' ce ŋwɛ̀ ca à gèe ka'.
eng: Pilate said to him, What is truth? When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, I find no basis for a charge against him.

lmp: Yè ndèe mò' yu enɛ a ka' ce ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap, m fʉr ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe shaŋ, fa nè wèe. Wèe ce kòŋ weenɛ m fʉr ŋkʉʉ Jus fa nè wèe a?"
eng: But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?

lmp: Wowèe a waa enɛ̂, "Ài', fa fʉr ba ye ka'. Fʉr ba Bàrabàs fa nè wèr." Bàrabàs ca à m ba ŋkep.
eng: Then they all shouted again, saying, Not this man, but Barabbas! Now Barabbas was a robber.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pailɛ̀t à lâa, bsoogɛ̀ a lip Jisòs.
eng: So Pilate then took Jesus, and flogged him.

lmp: Wowèe a gee rtaa kʉʉ nè bsòpsì a sop ye mbe tù, a lor cɛ̂' beer a fa ye à nyòr.
eng: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown, and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

lmp: a kɛ' a ce bùu ye àmbò ŋkʉʉ wa'a, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Nyàr, ŋkwe Jûs." Wowèe a m lìp ye nè mmbo.
eng: They kept saying, Hail, King of the Jews! and they kept slapping him.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ker fʉʉ embe nto' a laa nè Jus enɛ̂, "Yɛ nè, m be fʉr ŋwɛ̀ ca njepmbè tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ mɛ̀ yɛ fàa mò' ce e gèe ka'."
eng: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.

lmp: Jisòs à fʉʉ njepmbè nè rtaa bsòpsì ca mbe tù ba cɛ̂' beer cà à nyòr. Pailɛ̀t à laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ là nè ŋwɛ̀ anà."
eng: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, Behold, the man!

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋgâa kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ a ka' yɛ ye, a waani enɛ̂, "Taa ye mbe kìntaa! Taa ye mbe kìntaa!" Pailɛ̀t à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Koo là nè ye du taa mbe kìntaa. À ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, mɛ̀ yɛ fàa ce e gèe ka'."
eng: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, Crucify! Crucify! Pilate said to them, Take him yourselves, and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.

lmp: Jus a ku le' yap enɛ̂, "Wèr tʉr ncir, àmbò ncir anà yi ce làa, e be kù kwe njobè' e ce lòr yì nyor enɛ e yu Muu Nyʉ̀."
eng: The Jews answered him, We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ka' yu' blàa ca, a wɛp magòr sê.
eng: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

lmp: A ker niŋ mbe nto' a Jisòs, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "A wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ efɛ?" Jisòs à laa yuu ka'.
eng: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, Where are you from? But Jesus gave him no answer.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pailɛ̀t à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ làa yuu nè mɛ̀ ka' a? Mbò wɛ̀ rìŋ wɛnɛ m tʉr ŋger à rmà'shi wɛ̀ tɛ à du yo yu, a ker tʉr ŋger à rtaa wɛ̀ mbe kìntaa a?"
eng: Pilate therefore said to him, Aren't you speaking to me? Don't you know that I have power to release you, and have power to crucify you?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì enɛ̂, "Àde' à tʉr ŋger mbe mɛ̂ ndù ka', ce a m ka' tɛ bà fa ŋger anà nè wɛ̀ embe bùu ka'. Banɛ yuu bebep yi ŋwɛ̀ ce e koo mɛ̀ a fa mba wɛ̂ mmbò, yi yu yi gòr a caa yo."
eng: Jesus answered, You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ka' yu' blàa ca, a koŋ enɛ e ba mà'shi Jisòs tɛ e dû. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jus a ce waani enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' ma'shi ŋwɛ̀ ca e dû, banɛ à yu ŋkar Sisà ka'. è ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor yì nyor à ŋkʉʉ banɛ ŋgàŋ à tɛr Sisà mkùu mbe tù."
eng: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, If you release this man, you aren't Caesar's friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à ka' yu' blàa ca, a fʉr Jisòs njepmbè, a cu mbe dì' mnsa' tɛ e bo teni mnsa'. A m ce too dì' ca enɛ dì' ce a fèe nè blùr. A m ce too dì' anà à li Hibrù enɛ̂, "Gàbatà."
eng: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out, and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Pavement, but in Hebrew, Gabbatha.

lmp: Nòŋ anà à m ba nòŋ ce a m ce tami nyor à rye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap. Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ̀' a ce kùu ŋgòŋ à nfè' anà. Pailɛ̀t à laa nè bèe enɛ̂, "A yè ŋkʉʉ na."
eng: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, Behold, your King!

lmp: Wowèe a waanì enɛ̂, "Mìsi ye! Mìsi ye! Taa ye mbe kìntaa!" Pailɛ̀t à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kòŋ enɛ m taa yè ŋkʉʉ mbe kìntaa a?" Bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgàa taŋshi taŋshì a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr tʉr ŋkʉʉ mò' caa efa Sisà ka'."
eng: They cried out, Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him! Pilate said to them, Shall I crucify your King? The chief priests answered, We have no king but Caesar!

lmp: À ka' ba àlʉ̀simbùu, Pailɛ̀t à boŋlàr a fa ye nè wowèe tɛ a bo taa ye mbe kìntaa. Wowèe a m koo Jisòs a du àgho.
eng: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

lmp: E m byɛ̀' yi kìntaa, a wowèe a du à dì' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ Dì' kèkèp tu. A too dì' anà à li Hibrù enɛ Golgotà.
eng: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called The Place of a Skull, which is called in Hebrew, Golgotha,

lmp: A fàdì' ce a m taa Jisòs mbe kìntaa. A m taa bèe mo' a baa mbe bkìntaa foŋ. Mò' à m ba à bo ŋkòp Jisòs mò' à ba yi à bo mà', Jisòs à ba yi mbetar.
eng: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à m saŋ ŋwà' foŋ a taa mbe tu kìntaa. E m saŋ enɛ̂, "Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t, ŋkʉʉ Jûs."
eng: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.

lmp: Jus magòr a m bè' ŋwà' anà njobè' fàdì' ce a m taa Jisòs nà à m ba à wâa la'. A m saŋ ŋwà' anà à li Hibrù, ba à li Latìn ker ba à li Grêk.
eng: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr efa ŋgàa taŋshi taŋshì efa mʉ̀ Jus a ka' bè', a du a yɛ Pailɛ̀t a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa saŋ ba enɛ "ŋkʉʉ Jus" ka', saŋ ba enɛ "ŋwɛ̀ ca à m làa enɛ a ye ŋkʉʉ Jûs." "
eng: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, Don't write, 'The King of the Jews,' but, 'he said, I am King of the Jews.'

lmp: Pailɛ̀t à beesì enɛ̂, "Yuu ce mɛ̀ saŋ, a yuu ce mɛ̀ saŋ."
eng: Pilate answered, What I have written, I have written.

lmp: Bsoogɛ̀ a ka' taa Jisòs mbe kìntaa wɛɛ, a lor vi bcɛ̀' a gap bdì' kyèe, ŋwɛ̀ à lor vi, ŋwɛ̀ à lor vi. Yì sàaro à bɛtì. Sàaro anà à m tʉr ntar ka'.
eng: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the coat. Now the coat was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa a wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Sèe fa sàa cɛ̀' ca ka', sèe ma' kàŋ tɛ sèe bo yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce sàaro ca be dù nè ye." Cena yi m koni tɛ yi bo ghɛɛte àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "A m gàp wa bcɛ̀' a wâp mʉ, a ker ma' kàŋ tɛ a bo yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce yà sàaro be dù nè ye." Bsoogɛ̀ a m ku gee àmbò a m saŋ.
eng: Then they said to one another, Let's not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, They parted my garments among them. For my cloak they cast lots. Therefore the soldiers did these things.

lmp: Ma yì Jisòs, ba nfʉr yì mâ, ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m ba ŋgwa Kìlopàs ba Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà, a m tɛɛ àgee kìntaa Jisòs.
eng: But there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother, and his mother's sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' yɛ yì mâ, ker ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu ce e m kòŋ nà àmbò wowèe a tɛɛ àtʉtʉ, e laa nè yì ma enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀ yɛ̂, a muu ghò na."
eng: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, Woman, behold your son!

lmp: E m ker laa nè ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, a yò ma na." Kɛ̂' à nfè' anà, ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu à lor yì mâ, a ye a du a ce cu a yê là'.
eng: Then he said to the disciple, Behold, your mother! From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì wɛɛ, Jisòs à riŋ sè'ni enɛ li rfà' li mì. E m làa enɛ̂, "Ntee yi ce yuushi mɛ̀." E m làa wa'a tɛ yi bo ghɛɛte àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, I am thirsty.

lmp: Ghee mo' yi m tɛɛ àfo, mrû' mcece' mi ba njo jiŋ. A m lor kʉ̀sha a fʉʉ njep mʉ̀ mrù' anà a kur à mbàŋ a naa mbekì, a tʉr ye àgee cùu.
eng: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

lmp: Jisòs à m nyoŋ mrù' anà efa kʉ̀sha. E ka' nyoŋ wɛɛ, a laa enɛ̂ "Yi mì." A kɛr tu, a ma'shi li ryòŋ nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, It is finished. He bowed his head, and gave up his spirit.

lmp: Àmbò nòŋ anà à m ba nòŋ ce a m ce tami nyor tɛ a bo fʉʉ cu mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, Jus a m ce kòŋ enɛ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe vi cu mbe kìntaa ka'. Mmbomntaa anà à m ba mî gòr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a du a laa nè Pailɛ̀t enɛ e ma'shi tɛ wowèe a kepshi mkùu ese bèe anà, tɛ a bo yàŋse kweŋger tɛ a ca'si efa bsii.
eng: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn't remain on the cross on the Sabbath for that Sabbath was a special one, asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.

lmp: Bsoogɛ̀ a vʉ a kepshi mkùu ese ŋwɛ̀ entombì a ker kepshi mkùu ese ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m taa mbe kìntaa foŋ nà.
eng: Therefore the soldiers came, and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him;

lmp: Wowèe a ka' vʉ̀ bà' mbe Jisòs a yɛ enɛ e ba kwe wɛɛ, a ke' kepshi mkùu mi ka'.
eng: but when they came to Jesus, and saw that he was already dead, they didn't break his legs.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̀ mò' à sop mbèp nyor ese Jisòs nè rkòŋ, mdip ba blɛɛ mi ku fʉʉ à cùu anà.
eng: However one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m yɛ buu ca a ŋwɛ̀ ce e suŋ vi. Yuu ce e làa yi yu mini. Ye ye rìŋ foŋ enɛ yuu ce e ce làa yi yu mini. E ce suŋ wèe buu ca tɛ wèe bo byemi foŋ.
eng: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

lmp: Buu ca vi m koni tɛ yi bo ghɛɛte àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "A be kè kep yi vʉp mo' ka'."
eng: For these things happened, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, A bone of him will not be broken.

lmp: Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi ker laa mbe dì' mo' enɛ̂, "Wowèe a be kè yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce a m sòp."
eng: Again another Scripture says, They will look on him whom they pierced.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì wɛɛ, Josɛ̀f ce à rla' Àrimàtiyà à vʉ a yɛ Pailɛ̀t. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a ke' ce kòŋ enɛ bèe a riŋ ka' njobè' e m ce wɛp Jûs. E m làa nè Pailɛ̀t enɛ e fa ye njì tɛ e suusi gʉ̂ʉ Jisòs embe kìntaa, tuŋ. Pailɛ̀t à ka' byemi, e du a suusî, a du àgho.
eng: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus' body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

lmp: Nìkòdɛmòs foŋ ce e m be vʉ a yɛ Jisòs nètʉ' nà, à m dù a ye, a tʉr njɛ̀ɛ mcɛ̀p mo' ce a m ce too enɛ mɛ̂r, ba alùs ce a m fìŋshi. Mcɛ̀p anà mi m ba àmbò bkilù mŋkyèe wa'a.
eng: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

lmp: A m lòr gʉ̂ʉ Jisòs a kur nè bcɛ̂' bbòŋboŋ nè mcɛ̀p anà-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò Jus a m ce gèe.
eng: So they took Jesus' body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

lmp: Ŋka' mbyè buu yi m ba fàdì' ce a m taa Jisòs mbe kìntaa anà. Rshê rfi li m ba mbo ce a m be tuŋ ŋwɛ̀ njo ka'.
eng: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' Jus a m ce tami nyor nyʉ̀ anà tɛ a bo fʉʉ cu mmbomntaa, a lɛ ye njep rshè anà, njobè' li m ba àtʉtʉ.
eng: Then because of the Jews' Preparation Day for the tomb was near at hand they laid Jesus there.

lmp: À ka' ba nòŋ entombì embe mʉ̀ ŋgàa, à mʉ ŋgàptʉ', ŋgòŋ yi ku bii sii, Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà à du fàdì' rshè li m ba nà. E ka' bà' a yɛ enɛ a m cà'si lùr ce a m cete ncûu rshè àgho nà.
eng: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw the stone taken away from the tomb.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, e natì a caŋ a du a yɛ Saimʉn Pità ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs mò' ce Jisòs à m kòŋ ye se nà, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "A fʉr Tata enjep rshè, a du àgho, wèr à rìŋ fàdì' ce a lɛ̀ ye ka'."
eng: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter, and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don't know where they have laid him!

lmp: Pità ba ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ca a natì a caŋ a du fàdì' ce rshè li m ba nà.
eng: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs mò' anà à caŋ a caa Pità, a du a ba' fàdì' ce rshè li m ba nà entombì.
eng: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter, and came to the tomb first.

lmp: E ka' be'ti nyor fyɛ' njep rshè a ku yɛ bcɛ̀' ce a m kur gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ àgho nà àmbò vi nòŋ njo, a ke' niŋ njo ka'.
eng: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying, yet he didn't enter in.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à ka' tose yi a ku niŋ ba njep rshè, a yɛ bcɛ̀' ce vi m nòŋ njo,
eng: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

lmp: a yɛ yì ce a m kur yi tu àgho nà. Yi m nòŋ àgee vì anà ka'. Yi m kashi nyor a noŋ jɛɛ.
eng: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ce e m vʉ̀ a ba' à ncûu rshè entombì nà à m niŋ njo foŋ a yɛ, a byemi.
eng: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

lmp: Wowèe a m be riŋ yap yu yuu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ Jisòs be fʉʉ efa rkwe nà ka'.
eng: For as yet they didn't know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

lmp: Wowèe a natì a kʉti à mlà'.
eng: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri à m tɛɛ àgee rshè a ce war. E ka' ce war wa'a, a be'ti nyor a fyɛ' njep rshè.
eng: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So, as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

lmp: E m yɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a baa. Wowèe a m mà' bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ, a cu mbe dì' ce a m lɛ̀ gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ nà. Mò' à cu mbe dì' ce yì tu yi m nòŋ, mò' a cu mbe dì' ce mi m mkùu mi m nòŋ.
eng: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head, and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

lmp: Wowèe a bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀, à ce war ba kɛ?" E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ce war njobè' a lòr yà Tata a du àgho, mɛ̀ ke' riŋ fàdì' ce a lɛ̀ ye ka'."
eng: They told her, Woman, why are you weeping? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don't know where they have laid him.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a karsi nyor a yɛ Jisòs àmbò e tɛɛ, a ke' riŋ enɛ a Jisòs ka'.
eng: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn't know that it was Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Njeŋwɛ̀, à ce war ba kɛ? À ce ròo ba nda?" Mɛ̀ɛri à m ce kwà'shi enɛ a ye ŋwɛ̀ ŋka' anà, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yà Tâ, ka' ba enɛ à lòr wɛ̀ a lor ye a du àgho, à suŋ mɛ̀ fàdì' ce wɛ̀ lòr ye a lɛ̂, tɛ m bo dù lòr."
eng: Jesus said to her, Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for? She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ɛri." E karsì nyor a laa nè ye à li Hibrù enɛ̂, "Ràbonì", ce mbùu efa gho yu enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì".
eng: Jesus said to her, Mary. She turned and said to him, Rabboni! which is to say, Teacher!

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Fa jòo mɛ̀ ka' njobè' mɛ̀ be du a yɛ Tàr ka'. Dù, du suŋ bfʉr wa enɛ m be dù fàdì' ce yà Ta ce e yu yè Tâ, a ba yà Nyʉ̀, a ba yè Nyʉ̀ foŋ nà yu."
eng: Jesus said to her, Don't hold me, for I haven't yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers, and tell them, 'I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ɛri ce à rla' Makdalà à dû, a suŋ ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ yɛ Tatâ." E m ker suŋ wowèe buu ce e m làa nè ye nà.
eng: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ entombì embe mʉ̀ ŋgàa anà à mbùuŋkùr, ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a kaarì àbee mbe ndàp, a li' kèŋ njobè' wowèe a m ce wɛp Jûs. Jisòs à ku nyɛɛ a wâp mʉ, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Cumʉnyaŋ ba nè wèe."
eng: When therefore it was evening, on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the midst, and said to them, Peace be to you.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a duŋshi wowèe mi mmbo ba yì mbèp nyor. Ŋgàa yɛ'ni yì buu a ka' yɛ Tatâ, a lu'shi sê.
eng: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

lmp: Jisòs à ker laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Cumʉnyaŋ ba nè wèe. Àmbò yà Ta à m tuu mɛ̀ nà, mɛ mɛ̀ ce tuu wèe foŋ."
eng: Jesus therefore said to them again, Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a yoŋse mbe wâp ndù a laa enɛ̂, "Koo nè Yʉ' Rara.
eng: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, Receive the Holy Spirit!

lmp: Wèe à ka' foosi ŋwɛ̀ efa yuu bebep ce ŋgàŋ à gèe, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be fòosi ye foŋ. Wèe à ka' tɛ fòosi ŋwɛ̀ efa yuu bebep ce ŋgàŋ à gèe ka' banɛ Nyʉ̀ be fòosi ye foŋ ka'."
eng: Whoever's sins you forgive, they are forgiven them. Whoever's sins you retain, they have been retained.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Jisòs à m vʉ̀ a duŋshi yì nyor nè yì bèe nà, Tomâs, mò' efa mʉ̀ bêe ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ce a m ce too enɛ rfar nà, à m ba àfo ka'.
eng: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn't with them when Jesus came.

lmp: E ka' vʉ̀, bɛr ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a suŋ ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à yɛ Tatâ." Tomas à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M ka' tɛ yɛ bdì' efa mi mmbo ce a mʉ ta nè mmbaa nà, jòo nè ntubo, kèr jòo yì mbèp nyor nè bo ka', àde' m byemì ka'."
eng: The other disciples therefore said to him, We have seen the Lord! But he said to them, Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi ka' càa waami, wowèe a ker kaari àbee mbe ndàp, Tomas à ba a wowèe. Wowèe a m li' kèŋ, Jisòs à ku lo a nyɛɛ a wâp mʉ, a laa enɛ̂, "Cumʉnyaŋ ba nè wèe."
eng: After eight days again his disciples were inside, and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the midst, and said, Peace be to you.

lmp: E ka' làa wa' wɛɛ, a laa nè Tomas enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè yò ntubo, yu'shi mbena, nàa yo bo joo yà mbèp nyor àgho. Fa kèr tarni ka', byemi."
eng: Then he said to Thomas, Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don't be unbelieving, but believing.

lmp: Tomas à beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Yà Tata ba yà Nyʉ̀."
eng: Thomas answered him, My Lord and my God!

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ byemi njobè' wɛ̀ yɛ mɛ̀. Bghònì vi yu nè bèe ce a yɛ ka', a ku byemi."
eng: Jesus said to him, Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen, and have believed.

lmp: Jisòs à m dùŋshi ku' mncòo mo' à bsii ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ca ka'.
eng: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

lmp: A saŋ buu ca tɛ wèe bo byemi enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis, ce Muu Nyʉ̀. Wèe à ka' byemi wa'a, wèe bo koni ryòŋ a yê rlii.
eng: but these are written, that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì wɛɛ, Jisòs à ker duŋshi yì nyor nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu àwâa tʉ̀ Tìbɛrìyàs. E m dùŋshi yì nyor ba à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ̂.
eng: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità ba Tomas ce a m ce too enɛ rfar nà, ba Nàtanìyɛ̀l ce à rla' Kɛnà ce à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, ba boo Sɛbɛ̀dî, ba bèe mo' a baa efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, a m ba àbee.
eng: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "M be dù koo nca." Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sèe be dù." Wowèe a du a niŋ mbe keŋ à rkoo nca, a ke' koo yuu nètʉ' anà ka'.
eng: Simon Peter said to them, I'm going fishing. They told him, We are also coming with you. They immediately went out, and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' ce raa, Jisòs à tɛɛ àwâa rò. Ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu a ke' riŋ enɛ a Jisòs ka'.
eng: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach, yet the disciples didn't know that it was Jesus.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Boo, wèe à koo nca ka' a?" Wowèe a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Ài'."
eng: Jesus therefore said to them, Children, have you anything to eat? They answered him, No.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mà' nè rraa à ŋgʉ̀' bo mà', wèe be koo yuu." Wowèe a ma' rraa, a moo à rsʉ̀ŋ rraa enjep rò làr, njobè' nca yi m ba njep rraa anà gòr sê.
eng: He said to them, Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some. They cast it therefore, and now they weren't able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ce Jisòs à m kòŋ se nà à laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "A Tatâ." Pità à ka' yu' enɛ a Tatâ, a ma' cɛ̀' à nyòr njobè' e m co'ni bcɛ̀' efa nyòr. E ka' mà' wɛɛ, a nyɛɛ embe keŋ a coo njep rò a du a yɛ Jisòs.
eng: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, It's the Lord! So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around him for he was naked, and threw himself into the sea.

lmp: Bɛr ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a m vʉ̀ yap ba mbe keŋ. A ka' ce vʉ̀ wa'a, a ce sʉ̀ŋ rraa ce nca yi m ba njo gòr se nà, a ce vʉ̀ àgho. Kɛ' embe dì' wowèe a m ba anà du nje wâa rò yi m ba njìsàp ka'. Kɛ' embo nà du nje wâa rò yi m ba àmbò mkoo mntâ.
eng: But the other disciples came in the little boat for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away, dragging the net full of fish.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' nje w a rò, fʉʉ embe keŋ, a yɛ mor, a yɛ brɛ̂d, a yɛ nca njep mor anà.
eng: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, and fish laid on it, and bread.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Lòr nè nca mo' ce wèe à ku koo sè'ni nà, vʉ àgho."
eng: Jesus said to them, Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.

lmp: Saimʉn Pità à kʉtì mbe keŋ a sʉŋ rraa a fʉr mbe ŋkʉ̀. Nca gòrgòr yi m ba njo sê. Yi m ba rjèe nè ncòp-taar-à-mntâ. Ka' nca yi m ba njo gòr wa'a, rraa li m ceeŋger ka'.
eng: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of great fish, one hundred fifty-three; and even though there were so many, the net wasn't torn.

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè ye yuu." Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ wowèe à tʉr ntee à rbipshi nè Jisòs enɛ a ye nda lɛ ka'. Wowèe a m rìŋ enɛ a Tatâ.
eng: Jesus said to them, Come and eat breakfast. None of the disciples dared inquire of him, Who are you? knowing that it was the Lord.

lmp: Jisòs à du a lor brɛ̂d a vʉ a gapshi nè wowèe, a ker lor nca a gapshi nè wowèe foŋ.
eng: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

lmp: A ŋkàrà' taar sè'ni àmbò Jisòs à m dùŋshi yì nyor nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni yì buu, kɛ̂' à nfè' ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples, after he had risen from the dead.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ye byee mìsi wɛɛ, Jisòs à laa nè Saimʉn Pità enɛ̂, "Saimʉ̀n, muu Jôn, wɛ̀ kòŋ mɛ̀ a caa bèe ca a?" Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no Tatâ, à rìŋ wɛnɛ m kòŋ wɛ̀." E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nyaŋ ya njèe."
eng: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you. He said to him, Feed my lambs.

lmp: E m ker laa nè Pità enɛ̂, "Saimʉ̀n, muu Jôn, à kòŋ mɛ̀ a?" E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no Tatâ, à rìŋ wɛnɛ m kòŋ wɛ̀." E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nyaŋ ya njèe."
eng: He said to him again a second time, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me? He said to him, Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you. He said to him, Tend my sheep.

lmp: E ka' làa nè Pità bà' bkâŋ btaar enɛ̂, "Saimʉ̀n, muu Jôn, à kòŋ mɛ̀ a?" Ntee yi bep ye njobè' e m bipshi nè ye ŋkàrà' taar enɛ̂, "À kòŋ mɛ̀ a?" E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, à rìŋ buu wɛɛwɛ, à rìŋ wɛnɛ m kòŋ wɛ̀." Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nyaŋ ya njèe.
eng: He said to him the third time, Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me? Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, Do you have affection for me? He said to him, Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you. Jesus said to him, Feed my sheep.

lmp: M ce suŋ wɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ à m ba à nfè' ce wɛ̀ m bii nsùnsù ŋwɛ̀, wɛ̀ m ce kur yò ŋkànda ce dù fàdì' ce wɛ̀ gwɛɛ. Be ba à nfè' ce à yu nleeŋwɛ̀ tɛ à naa mmbo, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ jɛɛ kur wɛ̀, lòr wɛ̀ dù àgho fàdì' ce à kòŋ à rdù ka'."
eng: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself, and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you, and carry you where you don't want to go.

lmp: E m làa wa'a, à rdùŋshi njɛ̀ɛ rkwe ce Pità be kè kwe, kù'si Nyʉ̀ àgho. Cena yi ka' mì wɛɛ, e laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, Follow me.

lmp: Pità à ka' karsi nyor a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs mò' ce Jisòs à m kòŋ se nà àmbò e ce vʉ̀ a wâp mbùu. A ye ce e m kɛ̀r nyor àgee Jisòs à nfè' wowèe a m ce ye byee, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fyèni wɛ̀ a nda?" nà.
eng: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus sincerely loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus' breast at the supper and asked, Lord, who is going to betray You?

lmp: Pità à ka' yɛ ye, a laa nè Jisòs enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yi yu yi kɛ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca?"
eng: Peter seeing him, said to Jesus, Lord, what about this man?

lmp: Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M ka' koŋ enɛ e ku cu ntèe caar tɛ m ke kʉti, yo enjo ba kɛ? Vʉ̀ yo ba fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: Jesus said to him, If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' làa wa'a, bfʉr a kɛ' a ce suŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni yì buu ce Jisòs à m kòŋ ye gòr nà be kè lɛ kwe ka'. Jisòs à m banì laa ba enɛ e be kè kwe ka' ka'. E m banì laa ba enɛ̂, "M ka' koŋ enɛ e ku cu ntèe caar tɛ m ke kʉti, yo enjo ba kɛ? Vʉ̀ yo ba fa mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: This saying therefore went out among the brothers, that this disciple wouldn't die. Yet Jesus didn't say to him that he wouldn't die, but, If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ca a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce suŋ wèe buu ca. À m saŋ ye a saŋ buu ca. Wèr rìŋ wernɛ yuu ce e làa yi yu mini.
eng: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

lmp: Buu mò' ce Jisòs à m gèe vi yu gòr sê. A m ba saŋ buu ca wɛɛwɛ, m kwà' mɛnɛ ŋgòŋ ca yi m ba tʉr dì' à rlɛ̀ mŋwà' ce a saŋ buu anà mbo ka'.
eng: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn't have room for the books that would be written.

lmp: Màsà Tìyofilòs, mbe ya ŋwà' entombì ce mɛ̀ m saŋ nè wɛ̀ nà, mɛ̀ m saŋ buu wɛɛwɛ ce Jisòs à m gèe ker ba vì ce e m yɛ'ni, kɛ̂' à nfè' ce e m kɛ̀' li rfà',
eng: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

lmp: du ba' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m lòr ye a du àgho mbe bùu. Tɛ e ka' kè dù mbe bùu e m fa ncep nè ŋgâa ntuu ce e m ce nà à ŋger Yʉ' Rara.
eng: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' kwe, fʉʉ efa rkwe a cu à mnòŋ mkyèe a yɛɛti fa wâp mʉ nfè' àŋgoo, a duŋshi yì nyor nè wowèe à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce rtarnì li m ba njo ka', enɛ e yu ntèe. E m ce suŋ wowèe àmbò rsa' Nyʉ̀ ce e ce sa' àmbò ŋkʉʉ.
