eng: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days, and speaking about God's Kingdom.

lmp: Jisòs à ka' ba a wowèe à nfè' anà, a laa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a fa lô à rlà' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ka'. E m làa enɛ̂, "Cu nè ce ke' yuu ce Nyʉ̀ Tàr à m kà' nè wèe à ba yuu ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe foŋ nà.
eng: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, Don't depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

lmp: Jôn à m bàptir wèe nè mdip, geewa'a, ku bɛti mnòŋ mʉcàr tɛ a baptir wèe ba nè Yʉ' Rara."
eng: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a ka' ba a Jisòs wèe, a bipshi nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wà' à be kʉsi ŋger nè bèe Isrɛ̀l sè'ni na a?"
eng: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?

lmp: Jisòs à beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yu ye dì' à rrìŋ nfè' kɛ̀ mnòŋ ce Tàr à lɛ̀ à yi ŋger ka'.
eng: He said to them, It isn't for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe be tʉr ŋger à nfè' ce Yʉ' Rara yi sùu mbe wêe ndù, tɛ wèe bo suŋ bèe àmbò mɛ̀ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, ba à ŋgôŋ Judà wɛɛwɛ, ba Sàmarìyà, ker ba à mŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ."
eng: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.

lmp: E ka' làa wa' mìsi, Nyʉ̀ à lor ye a du àgho mbe bùu, wowèe a tɛɛ a ce fyɛ', mmbà' vi vʉ a cete ye, wowèe a ke' ker yɛ ye ka'.
eng: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

lmp: Wowèe a m ku bii kè' mbe bùu a ce fyɛ' àmbò e ce dù, a ka' lò a ku yɛ mmbaŋrù a baa àmbò a tɛɛ a wâp geŋ, a yar bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ.
eng: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

lmp: Mmbaŋrù a baa ca a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bêe à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, wèe à tɛɛ a ce kè' ba kɛ mbe bùu? Jisòs ce Nyʉ̀ à lòr ye a du àgho mbe bùu na, e be kè kʉti à njɛ̀ɛ njì wèe à yɛ ye e ce dù na."
eng: who also said, You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a m lò embe rtùu Olèf a du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. À rlò embe rtùu Olèf dù Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m e ku ba àmbò mar mò'sir.
eng: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day's journey away.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' a ko' mbe rum ndap yî mbekì, mbe dì' ce wowèe a m ce cu. Bèe ce a m ba mbo à m ba Pità ba Jôn ba Jɛ̂ms, ker ba Andrù ba Felêp, ker ba Tomas ba Bàtòlomì ba Matìyò ba Jɛms muu Alfìyòs ba Saimʉ̀n ce e m ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe Silòt ba Judàs muu Jɛ̂ms.
eng: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room, where they were staying; that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a m ba cûu mo'sir, a ce loo àbee. Bbyèŋge mo' ba Mɛ̀ɛri ma yì Jisòs, ker ba bfʉr Jisòs, a m ba a wowèe.
eng: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women, and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

lmp: À m ba à mnòŋ anà Pità à natì mbekì a tɛɛ à mʉ̀ yì bèe ce a m ba àmbò bèe rjèe nè bèe mmbaa, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: In these days, Peter stood up in the midst of the disciples and the number of names was about one hundred twenty, and said,

lmp: "Yà bèe, blâa Nyʉ̀ vi be kù ghɛɛte àmbò Yʉ' Rara yi m làa njì enjep Dɛvìd, kuu Judàs ce e m dùŋshi njì nè bèe ce a m koo Jisòs.
eng: Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

lmp: Pità à ka' làa mìsi, wowèe a ce bèe a mmbaa. A m ce Josɛ̀f ce li rlii mo' li m ba enɛ Bàsabàs, rmo' li ba enɛ Jostòs, a ker ce Màtiyàs foŋ.
eng: They put forward two, Joseph called Barsabbas, who was surnamed Justus, and Matthias.

lmp: Wowèe a m loo, a laa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ rìŋ mntee bèe wɛɛwɛ. Dùŋshi là wèr ŋwɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ ce efa mʉ̀ bèe a mmbaa ca,
eng: They prayed, and said, You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

lmp: enɛ e gee rfà' ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ce Judàs à m ce fà', a ka' ma'shi a du fàdì' ce e ba dù."
eng: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.

lmp: A m saŋ mlii bèe a mmbaa ca enɛ a bo co' ŋwɛ̀ ce e be lòr dì' Judàs. A ka' gèe wa'a, rlii ce li fʉʉ entòmbì à ba li Màtiyàs. Li ka' fʉʉ, a lor ye a fa mbe mʉ̀ ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ce a m ba bèe ncòp-mò'sir-à-rrʉ̀ʉ nà.
eng: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias, and he was numbered with the eleven apostles.

lmp: Nôŋ Ŋkâ' Pɛntikòs yi ka' ghɛɛ, wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ba àbee mbe dî' mò'sir.
eng: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

lmp: Ka' cu, a ku yu' àmbò yuu mo' yi ce vʉ̀ embe bùu, a ce còo àmbò fu' tatap wa'a. Yi m ce còo à bdì' wɛɛwɛ embe ndàp ce wowèe a m ba.
eng: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

lmp: Yuu mo' yi yɛɛtì àmbò mcùŋ mor wa'a, a da' a suu mbendù ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ruu nè Yʉ' Rara, a kɛ' a ce làa bli ce wowèe a m yɛ'ni ka', ce Yʉ' Rara yi m gèe wowèe a ce làa.
eng: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

lmp: Jus ce a m vʉ̀se à bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na a m ce cu à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à nfè' anà. À m ba bèe ce a fa yap ntee nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

lmp: Yuu anà yi ka' ce còo wa'a, ku' bèe a kaarì àbee. Wowèe a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê, njobè' ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a m ce làa, ŋwɛ̀ nsìp à ce yu' à yì lî.
eng: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together, and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

lmp: Ca yi m gha' wowèe sê, wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr, a laa enɛ̂, "To bèe ce a làa na yu bêe Galèlê!
eng: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, Behold, aren't all these who speak Galileans?

lmp: Yi yu à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce enɛ wowèe a ce làa ŋwɛ̀ nsìp à ce yu' à yì lî?
eng: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wêr mʉ yu bêe Pɛtìyà ba Mɛdìyà, bêe Ɛlàm ba Mɛ̀sòpòtɛmìyà, bêe Judà ba Kàpàdosìyà, bêe Pontùs ba Ɛsìyà.
eng: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

lmp: Bèe a vʉ̂ à ŋgôŋ Frijìyà ba Pàmfilìyà ker ba à ŋgôŋ Ijìp ba bdì' mô' à to' Lebìyà ce vi yu àgee Sàirên. Bèe mo' efa wêr mʉ ce a vʉ̂ à ŋgôŋ Rûm, yu Jûs, ba bèe mo' enje jɛɛ ce a byemi nè Nyʉ̀ Jûs.
eng: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wêr mʉ a vʉ̂ à ŋgôŋ Krêt, ba à ŋgôŋ Àrɛbìyà. Wowèe a ce suŋ njɛ̀ɛ buu bbɛ̀ɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe sèe à ce yu' à visèe bli wɛɛwɛ."
eng: Cretans and Arabians: we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!

lmp: Wowèe a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê, a ker jep, a ce bipshi fa wâp mʉ enɛ̂, "Cena yi yu ba enɛ kɛ?"
eng: They were all amazed, and were perplexed, saying one to another, What does this mean?

lmp: Bèe mo' a m vʉ̀shi wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe ca a no mrù' mi koo wowèe."
eng: Others, mocking, said, They are filled with new wine.

lmp: Pità à natì mbekì a ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ce ncòp mò'sir-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, a laa mbekì nè ku' bèe anà enɛ̂, "Yà bêe Judà ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce cu à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. Yu'shi nè bòŋboŋ tɛ m suŋ wèe yuu ce yi yu.
eng: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice, and spoke out to them, You men of Judea, and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

lmp: Wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ bèe ca a no mrù' mi koo wowèe. Yi yu wa' ka'. Sè'ni ku bii nyʉ̀ bʉ̀'ʉ à ŋgàptʉ'.
eng: For these aren't drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

lmp: Cena a yuu ce Jowɛl ce ŋwɛ̀ ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ bèe. E m suŋ enɛ̂,
eng: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

lmp: "Nyʉ̀ ce làa enɛ̂, "Be ba à mnòŋ elʉ̀simbùu tɛ m fa ya yʉ' nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, tɛ boo wee ce mmbaŋrù ba bbyèŋge, a cep ya ntuu nè bèe. Tɛ boo wee boo mnsùnsù a yɛ buu ce vi be lô koni, tɛ bleebèe a yɛ mlo.
eng: It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

lmp: Nòŋ anà yi be ba tɛ m fa ya yʉ' nè ya ŋgâa mfà' wɛɛwɛ, mmbaŋrù ba bbyèŋge, tɛ wowèe a cep ya ntuu nè bèe.
eng: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

lmp: M be kè gèe buu bghagha' mbe bùu, dùŋshi mncòo njep ŋgòŋ na. Blɛɛ vi be kè ba, tɛ mor yi ba, tɛ ku' njemor yi dʉ'.
eng: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath; blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e ce saŋ na be kè liiti, tɛ ŋwɛɛ yi baŋ àmbò blɛɛ. Tɛ nòŋ yî Tata ce yi be kè ba gòr kèr ba jɛɛ se nà yi ka' ghɛɛ.
eng: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ke kɛ' rlii Tata enɛ e ja' ye, a ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kè lùŋ." "
eng: It will be, that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.'

lmp: "Yà bèe Isrɛ̀l, yu' nè yuu ce m be làa na. Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t à m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m dùŋshi enɛ e m ce ye. E m dùŋshi wa'a nè buu bghagha' ce Jisòs à m gèe, ba mncòo ce e m dùŋshi a wêe mʉ à ŋger Nyʉ̀. Wee wèe rìŋ buu ca bòŋboŋ.
eng: Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him in the midst of you, even as you yourselves know,

lmp: E m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, a riŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè ye. Nyʉ̀ à m ye lè' enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe ndʉ̀' Dɛvìd be kè ye kʉʉ Dɛvìd.
eng: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

lmp: Dɛvìd à m yɛ yuu ce yi be kè ba, a suŋ àmbò nfʉʉ efa rkwe Krâis enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à m mà'shi enɛ e cu mbà yir ka', a ma'shi enɛ yì nyor bʉte ka'."
eng: he foreseeing this spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that neither was his soul left in Hades, nor did his flesh see decay.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr Jisòs ca efa rkwe, wèr à yɛ ye nè mer mmir foŋ.
eng: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à nàa ye a cuusi à li rkoo mà', e koo Yʉ' Rara ce yì ta à m kà' nà. Banɛ yuu ce wèe ce yɛ a ker ce yu' sè'ni na, yu ba yʉ' anà ce e ce fa nè wèr.
eng: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this, which you now see and hear.

lmp: Dɛvìd à m be du mbe bùu ka', geewa'a yu ba ye ce e m làa enɛ̂, "Tata à m làa nè yà tata enɛ̂, "Cu à la rkoo mà' caar tɛ nfè' ghɛɛ
eng: For David didn't ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, 'The Lord said to my Lord, Sit by my right hand,

lmp: tɛ m ke gèe tɛ à tɛr mkùu mbendù bèe ce a bàa wɛ̀." "
eng: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.'

lmp: Banɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ a rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Jisòs ce wowèe a m taa mbe kìntaa nà yu ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe e ba Tatâ, a ker ba Krâis anà."
eng: Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.

lmp: Bèe anà a ka' yu', yi joo yap ntee sê, wowèe a laa nè Pità ker ba bɛr ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs enɛ̂, "Bfʉr wêr, yuu ce àde' wèr gêe, yu ba kɛ?"
eng: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, Brothers, what shall we do?

lmp: Pità à beesì enɛ̂, "Kupse nè, ma' yè buu bbebep tɛ a bo bàptir wèe wɛɛwɛ à rlii Jisos Krâis, tɛ Nyʉ̀ foosi wèe yè buu bbebep, tɛ wèe koni Yʉ' Rara ce yu rfa ese Nyʉ̀.
eng: Peter said to them, Repent, and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Mkà'ni ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà', mi yu nè wèe ba boo wee, ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a yu ànjìsàp ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce yìsèe Tata Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' enɛ a ba yì bèe."
eng: For the promise is to you, and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.

lmp: Pità à m ker laa buu mò' magòr nè wowèe tɛ wowèe a bo yɛ rara enjo, a ker loo wowèe enɛ̂, "Tee nè wee btu efa ŋgɛ' ce e ce vʉ̀ nè ŋgâa bsàrbuu ce e sè'ni."
eng: With many other words he testified, and exhorted them, saying, Save yourselves from this crooked generation!

lmp: A m bàptir bèe ce a m byemi yuu ce Pità à m làa anà. Bèe ce a m kyèse nyor à mʉ̀ ŋgâa rbyemì nyʉ̀ anà a m ba àmbò bèe ncʉ̀kì taar wa'a.
eng: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

lmp: Wowèe a m lòr yàp nfè' a yu' ryɛ'nì ce ŋgâa ntuu Jisos Krâis a m ce yɛ'ni, a ce vʉ̀ àbee cɛ'cɛ', a ce ye wap byee ker ba byee Nyʉ̀ àbee, a ker ce gèe mloo.
eng: They continued steadfastly in the apostles' teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ce wɛp sê, njobè' ku' buu bbɛ̀ɛ ba mncòo ce ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a m ce dùŋshi à ŋger Nyʉ̀.
eng: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

lmp: Ŋgâa rbyemì wɛɛwɛ a m ku ba àbee, a tʉr yàp buu àbee.
eng: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce lò fyeni yàp buu, ce lòr mbàa efa gho ce gàpshi fa wâp mʉ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ à m buu yuu.
eng: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce tarte mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, a ce bɛ'shi brɛ̂d fa wâp mndàp, a ce yeŋger àbee nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀, a ke' ce yu' nyor ka'.
eng: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

lmp: Wowèe a m ce nɛ̀si Nyʉ̀, bèe a ce yu' rbòŋ nè wowèe. Tata à m ce kyèse bèe ce a m lùŋ efa ŋgɛ' na a mʉ̀ bèe ca à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: praising God, and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ mo', Pità ba Jôn a du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ à nyʉ̀ taar nèmootì. À m ba nfè' ce a m ce dù mbo ce gèe rloo.
eng: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m kepŋger, kɛ' embe nfè' ce a m bi ye. Ŋwɛ̀ anà à m cu a cûu ŋka' ce a m bèe Ndap Nyʉ̀ àgho. A m ce too cûu ŋka' anà enɛ Rbòŋ. A m ce byɛ̀' ye à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ ce cuusi njep cûu ŋka' anà tɛ e bo ce loo mbàa ese bèe ce a m ce vʉ̀ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: A certain man who was lame from his mother's womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

lmp: E ka' yɛ àmbò wowèe a ce vʉ̀ à rniŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ e loo mbàa ese wowèe.
eng: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

lmp: Pità ba Jôn a ke' ye mbe mmìr. Pità à laa enɛ̂, "Kè' wèr!"
eng: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, Look at us.

lmp: E ka' kè' wowèe a ce kwà'shi enɛ wowèe a be fa ye yuu.
eng: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "M tʉr mbàa ka', geewa'a, m be fa wɛ̀ yuu ce m tʉr. À rlii Jisos Krâis ce à rlà' Nasarɛ̀t, nàti mbekì, jɛ̂r."
eng: But Peter said, Silver and gold have I none, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!

lmp: E ka' làa wa', a ghashi ye à rkoo mà', a naa mbekì. E ka' nàti tɛɛ mbekì, mi mkùu mi tap, vi byùŋ nyor enje mlir mkùu vi tap.
eng: He took him by the right hand, and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

lmp: E nyɛɛ mbekì a tɛɛ, a kɛ' a ce jɛ̀r, a du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a wowèe, a ka' bà' mbo e ce jɛ̀r mbo, a ce nyɛshi mbekì, a ce kù'si Nyʉ̀.
eng: Leaping up, he stood, and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a yɛ àmbò e ce jɛ̀r, a ce kù'si Nyʉ̀.
eng: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ, a riŋ enɛ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce cu njep cûu ŋka' ce a m ce too enɛ Rbòŋ, ce loo buu ese bèe nà. Wowèe a bɛɛŋgèr, a tʉr yuu làa ka', njo' yuu ce yi m koni anà.
eng: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

lmp: Àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca à m ku bii ghashi rkoo Pità ba Jôn nà, bèe wɛɛwɛ a bɛɛŋgèr sê, a caŋ a koni wowèe mbe njì baaki ŋkʉʉ Solomʉ̀n.
eng: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon's, greatly wondering.

lmp: Pità à ka' yɛ wowèe, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yà bèe Isrɛ̀l, wèe ce bɛ̀ɛŋger njo' yuu ce yi koni na, a ce kè' wèr ntuŋ-ŋ-ŋ njokɛ? Wà' wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ wèr à gèe ŋwɛ̀ ca à jɛr ba à yer ŋger kɛ̀ njobè' wèr rìŋ à rcà'ni Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ a?
eng: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ Abràham ce e yu Nyʉ̀ Aisìk a ba Nyʉ̀ Jakòp a ker ba Nyʉ̀ visèe btarkʉ wɛɛwɛ, à kù'si Jisòs ce e yu yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà'. Wèe à m fa ye nè bèe ce a m ce sa' wèe, a mɛŋni ye à bsii Pailɛ̀t, ka' Pailɛ̀t à m ce kòŋ à rmà'shi ye wa'a.
eng: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up, and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

lmp: Ka' e m ba ŋwɛ̂ nrara a ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì wa'a, wèe à m mɛŋni ye, a laa nè Pailɛ̀t enɛ e fʉr ba ŋwɛ̂ nyʉshi bèe embe shaŋ, fa nè wèe.
eng: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One, and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

lmp: Wèe à m yʉ ye yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e m mʉ̀' nduunjî ryòŋ. Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr ye efa rkwe, wèr à yɛ ye nè mer mmir.
eng: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

lmp: A gèe ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe à yɛ a riŋ na à tap bòŋboŋ ba à rbyemì ce à rlii Jisòs. À ka' ba njo' rbyemì ce à rlii Jisòs, ŋwɛ̀ ca à tap bòŋboŋ a wêe bsii.
eng: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

lmp: "Àmbò yi yu wa' sè'ni na, bfʉr wâ, mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ yuu ce wèe ker ba bèe ce a m ce sa' wèe à m gèe nè Jisòs nà, wèe wowèe à m ce gèe wa'a, a riŋ yuu ce wèe à m ce gèe ka'.
eng: Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

lmp: tuusi Krâis ce a lɛ̀ nè wèe. Jisòs ca yu Krâis anà.
eng: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

lmp: E be kù cu mbe bùu caar bà' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ kʉti bfi àmbò e m làa njì enjep yi ŋgâa ntuu elûuŋgòŋ ce à m ba bêe brara nà.
eng: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

lmp: Musìs à m làa yi enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ be kè fʉr ŋwɛ̀ ntuu efa wêe mʉ àmbò e m fʉr mɛ̀ nà. Wèe be kè yu' buu wɛɛwɛ ce e be kè làa nè wèe, gèe vi.
eng: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, 'The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ kè yu' yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ ntuu Nyʉ̀ anà be kè làa, gèe yi ka', banɛ a be kè fʉr ŋgàŋ efa mʉ̀ bèe, yʉ."
eng: It will be, that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.'

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, kɛ' embe nfè' yì Sâmwɛ̀l du ba' mbe nfè' yì ŋgâa ntuu wɛɛwɛ ce a m ba mbenjì Sâmwɛ̀l a m làa àmbò mnòŋ ca.
eng: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, they also told of these days.

lmp: Wèe yu boo ŋgâa ntuu Nyʉ̀, a ce ye sɛ' efa yuu ce wowèe à m suŋ bèe enɛ yi be kè ba nà. Lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye a wêe bta nà, wèe ce ye sɛ' efa gho sè'ni. Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Abràham enɛ̂, "M be ghòni mnjɛ̀ɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ njì enjep yò ŋgʉ̀ bèe."
eng: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, 'In your seed will all the families of the earth be blessed.'

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à fʉr yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà' efa wêe mʉ, a tuu ye nè wèe entombì, tɛ e bo ghòni wèe, gèe tɛ wèe kupse, mà' wee bsàrbuu."
eng: God, having raised up his servant, Jesus, sent him to you first, to bless you, in turning away everyone of you from your wickedness.

lmp: Pità ba Jôn a ka' kù bii ce làa nè bèe, ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè bèe ce a m ce kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀, ker ba bèe Sadùsî, a vʉsè.
eng: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

lmp: Ntee yi bep wowèe sê, njobè' Pità ba Jôn à m ce yɛ'ni bèe enɛ Jisòs à m fʉʉ efa rkwe, yi ce dùŋshi enɛ bèe ce a kweŋger a be fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

lmp: A m koo Pità ba Jôn a li' mbe ndàp, a lɛ wowèe mbo caar tʉ̀' à raa, njobè' nyʉ̀ à m coo.
eng: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

lmp: Geewa'a, bèe magòr ce a m yu' yuu ce wowèe a m làa a m byemi. Bèe ce a m byemi a m bà' sè'ni àmbò ncʉ̀kì ta wa'a.
eng: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, bèe ce a m ce sa' to' ba bleebèe, ker ba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir, a vʉsè àbee à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: It happened in the morning, that their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

lmp: Anàs ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, ba Kaifàs, ba Jôn ba Àlɛ̀ksandà, ker ba bèe embe ndʉ̀' ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a m ba àfo foŋ.
eng: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

lmp: A m fʉr wowèe embe ndàp, a tɛr mbe wâp tar, a kɛ' a ce bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à gèe ca ba à ŋger nda? Wèe à gèe ba à rlii nda?"
eng: When they had stood them in the middle of them, they inquired, By what power, or in what name, have you done this?

lmp: Pità à ruu nè Yʉ' Rara à nfè' anà, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa sa' to' ker ba bleebèe!
eng: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, You rulers of the people, and elders of Israel,

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce bipshi buu nè wèr kuu yuu bòŋboŋ ce wèr à gèe nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e kepŋger na, enɛ e gèe ekɛ a ka' ce jɛ̀r lɛ,
eng: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

lmp: banɛ wèe ker ba bêe à to' Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ, à ba rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca à jɛ̀r bòŋboŋ ba à rlii Jisos Krâis ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t. Jisòs ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe à m taa mbe kìntaa, Nyʉ̀ à fʉr ye efa rkwe nà.
eng: be it known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, in him does this man stand here before you whole.

lmp: E yu àmbò lùr ce wêe ŋgâa mboo mndap à m mà', à ka' ba sè'ni, e kʉtì ba à lûr à rbuu ndap.
eng: He is 'the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.'

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker ba ce àde' e gee bèe a luŋ ka', njobè' Nyʉ̀ à ker fa ŋwɛ̀ mò' njep ŋgòŋ na ce àde' sèe luŋ à li rlii ka'."
eng: There is salvation in none other, for neither is there any other name under heaven, that is given among men, by which we must be saved!

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ntee ce Pità ba Jôn a m tʉr, a bɛɛŋger sê, njobè' wowèe a m ku ba bêe àtɛ̀r, a riŋ ŋwà' ka'. Wowèe a m rìŋ à nfè' anà enɛ Pità ba Jôn a m ba a Jisòs wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a ker tʉr yuu làa ka' njobè' wowèe à m yɛ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kepŋger anà tɛɛ àgee Pità ba Jôn.
eng: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

lmp: A m làa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a fʉʉ embe kansùr. Wowèe a ka' fʉʉ, ŋgâa kansùr a kɛ' a ce sèesi yuu ce a be gèe nè wowèe.
eng: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

lmp: Wowèe a m làa enɛ̂, "Sèe be gèe seekɛ nè bèe ca? Bèe wɛɛwɛ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a rìŋ enɛ wowèe a gèe yuu bɛ̀ɛ sê. Àde' sèe kanì ka'.
eng: saying, What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can't deny it.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, sèe laa nè wowèe enɛ a fa kèr làa yuu mo' nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' à rlii Jisòs ka', fà dì' ryɛ'nì ca li bo kèr dù ntombì ka'."
eng: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let's threaten them, that from now on they don't speak to anyone in this name.

lmp: A m kɛ' wowèe a laa nè wowèe enɛ a fa ker làa yuu mo', kèr yɛ'ni yuu mo' à rlii Jisòs ka'.
eng: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

lmp: Pità ba Jôn a beesì nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Kwà'shi ka nè bòŋboŋ enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ enɛ wèr yu'ni ba nè wèe kɛ̀ nè Nyʉ̀ lɛ?
eng: But Peter and John answered them, Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

lmp: Àde' wèr buu yer yu efa rlàa yuu ce wèr à yɛ a ker yu' ka'."
eng: for we can't help telling the things which we saw and heard.

lmp: Ŋgâa Kansùr a m ker wɛpsi wowèe, a ma'shi wowèe. Wowèe a m tʉr njì à rgèe yuu mo' nè Pità wèe ka' njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ce kù'si Nyʉ̀ à yuu ce yi m koni anà.
eng: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce a m gèe yuu bɛ̀ɛ nè ye, e jɛr anà, à m càa bfè' mŋkyèe.
eng: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

lmp: A ka' mà'shi wowèe, wowèe a du a yɛ yàp bèe a suŋ wowèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce bèe ce a m ba btu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba bleebèe a m làa nè wowèe.
eng: Being let go, they came to their own company, and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

lmp: Yàp bèe a ka' yu', a loo àbee enɛ̂, "Târ ŋgòr ce e m gèe rbuu ba nshe, ba mdip, ker ba buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu à bdì' ca!
eng: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord, and said, O Lord, you are God, who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

lmp: Wɛ̀ m gèe Dɛvìd ce e m ba yò ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à laa à ŋger Yʉ' Rara enɛ̂, "Ntee yi m ce yaŋ bèe enje jɛɛ njokɛ? Bèe a m ce ròo mkùu bèe mo' à cicì njokɛ?
eng: who by the mouth of your servant, David, said, 'Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

lmp: Bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ a m ba'shi nyor, a ŋgâa sa' to' wèe a vʉsè àbee à rmà' bìr a Tata Nyʉ̀, ker ba yì Krâis."
eng: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take council together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.'

lmp: Yi yu nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Hɛròd ba Pontiyos Pailɛ̀t a m vʉ̀se àbee à rla' ca a bèe enje jɛɛ wèe, ker ba bèe Isrɛ̀l, a ce ròo mkùu Jisòs, ce e yu yò ŋwɛ̀ rfâ' nrara ce wɛ̀ m yo'.
eng: For truly, in this city against your holy servant, Jesus, whom you anointed, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together

lmp: Wowèe a ka' loo, mbe dì' ce wowèe a m ba nà yi ci'tì, wowèe a ruu nè Yʉ' Rara, a ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

lmp: Ŋgâa rbyemì ca wɛɛwɛ a m ku tʉr ntêe mo'sir ba rkwà'shî rmo'sir. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ke' ce làa enɛ buu ce e tʉr ku ba vi cà'cà' ka'. Wowèe a m ku tʉr yàp buu àbee.
eng: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ca a m ku ce suŋ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò nfʉʉ efa rkwe Tata Jisòs. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wowèe wɛɛwɛ a tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ a wâp mʉ.
eng: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wâp mʉ à ke' ker buu yuu mo' ka'. Bèe ce a m tʉr mŋkʉ̀, kɛ̀ mndap ɛ̀, a m ce fyèni, ce vʉ̀ nè mbàa efa gho,
eng: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

lmp: ce lɛ̀ njeptii ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs, wowèe a ce lòr mbàa anà ce gàpshi nè bèe ce a m tʉr yuu ka'.
eng: and laid them at the apostles' feet, and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba fa wâp mʉ ce a m ce too enɛ Josɛ̀f. Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a m ce too ye enɛ Bànabàs. Mbùu efa rlii ca yu enɛ, ŋwɛ̀ nfa ŋger. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Lɛvì, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ce a m bi ba à to' Saipròs.
eng: Joses, who by the apostles was surnamed Barnabas which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement, a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

lmp: E m fyèni yì ŋkʉ̀ mò', a lor mbàa efa gho a lɛ njeptii ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs.
eng: having a field, sold it, and brought the money and laid it at the apostles' feet.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba yi ce a m ce too li rlii enɛ Ànàniyàs. E m tʉr ŋgwa, rlii ŋgwa yì li ba enɛ Sàferèyà. A ŋgwa a m fyèni yap nsuu mo'.
eng: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira, his wife, sold a possession,

lmp: Wowèe a ka' fyèni, nduu yì a gapnì mbàa efa gho, a lor bɛr a du àgho a lɛ njeptii ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs. Ŋgwa yì à m rìŋ enjo foŋ.
eng: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, and brought a certain part, and laid it at the apostles' feet.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Pità à laa enɛ̂, "Ànàniyàs, Satàn à ruusi yo ntee, a gee wɛ̀ nya' mnde' nè Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, a gapni mbàa nsuu ce wɛ̀ mʉ fyeni njokɛ?
eng: But Peter said, Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit, and to keep back part of the price of the land?

lmp: Nsuu ca à m ku ba yo nsuu tɛ à ka' kè fyèni, wɛ̀ ka' fyèni mbàa efa gho à ba yo mbàa. Wɛ̀ kwà'shi à rgèe njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca njokɛ? Wɛ̀ nya' mnde' ba nè bèe ka', wɛ̀ nya' mnde' ba nè Nyʉ̀"
eng: While you kept it, didn't it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn't it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven't lied to men, but to God.

lmp: Ànàniyàs à ka' yu', a gwe à nshè a kwe. Bèe ce a m yu' yuu ce yi m koni anà, a m wɛp sê.
eng: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

lmp: Boo mnsùnsù a m vʉ̀, a kur yi gʉ̀ʉ nè bcɛ̀', a byɛ' a du àgho, a tuŋ.
eng: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

lmp: Awà vi ka' càa àmbô btaar, ŋgwa yì a vʉ̂, a ke' riŋ yuu ce yi ba koni ka'.
eng: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Suŋ ka mɛ̀ lɛ̂, wà' ca yu mbàa nsuu ce wèe à mʉ fyeni nà a?" E beesì enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no, a yi."
eng: Peter answered her, Tell me whether you sold the land for so much. She said, Yes, for so much.

lmp: Pità à làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèe nduu wò à kwà'shi a byemi enɛ wèe be mòoshi Yʉ' Tata Nyʉ̀ njokɛ? Yɛ̂! Mkùu bèe ce a tuŋ nduu wò mi yu kù ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀'. Wowèe a be byɛ̀' wɛ̀ fʉʉ àgho foŋ."
eng: But Peter asked her, How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.

lmp: Ye ye à gwe njeptii Pità, a kwe. Boo mnsùnsù a ka' vʉ̀, a yɛ àmbò e kwe, wowèe a byɛ', a du àgho, a tuŋ àgee nduu yì.
eng: She fell down immediately at his feet, and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

lmp: Cor nsìp ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m yu' buu ce vi m koni na a m wɛp sê.
eng: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a m gèe ku' buu bbɛ̀ɛ ba buu bghagha' à mʉ̀ bèe. Ŋgâa rbyemì wɛɛwɛ a m ce vʉ̀ àbee mbe njì baaki ŋkʉʉ Solomʉ̀n.
eng: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon's porch.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ker vʉ yi yu a kyese nyor a wâp mʉ ka', ka' bèe wɛɛwɛ a m lòr wowèe à bêe bbòŋboŋ se wa'a.
eng: None of the rest dared to join them, however the people honored them.

lmp: Ku' mmbaŋrù ba bbyèŋge a m ce byemi nè Tatâ.
eng: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

lmp: Ca yi m gèe bèe a byɛ' ŋgâa byaŋ foŋ a vʉ àgho a lɛ mbe bkuu ba mbe mwàa àwâa nduunjì enɛ Pità ka' ce càa tɛ li rlèŋshi li bo càa mbendù bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ.
eng: They even carried out the sick into the streets, and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at the least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

lmp: Bèe à m kaari à mʉ mla' ce mi m ba àgee rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a vʉ nè yàp bèe ce a m ce yaŋse, ker ba bèe ce byʉ' bbebep vi m ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ', Pità wèe a gee wowèe wɛɛwɛ a lûŋ.
eng: Multitudes also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people, and those who were tormented by unclean spirits: and they were all healed.

lmp: Yuu ce ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs à m ce gèe nà yi m cì' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a ci' yì bèe ce a m ba bèe Sadùsî, wowèe a ko'ndoŋ nè ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs sê.
eng: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him which is the sect of the Sadducees, and they were filled with jealousy,

lmp: A m koo wowèe a li' mbe shaŋ.
eng: and laid hands on the apostles, and put them in public custody.

lmp: À ka' ba nètʉ', ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à vʉ̂, a mʉ' bkèŋ shaŋ, a fʉr wowèe embo, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out, and said,

lmp: "Dù nè mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, suŋ bèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi kùu ryôŋ rfi ca."
eng: Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' wa'a, tʉ̀' à ka' ce raa, wowèe a du mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a yɛ'ni bèe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ba yì bèe a m kɛ' bleebèe embe kansùr wɛɛwɛ, a tuu bèe enɛ a du fʉr wowèe embe shaŋ vʉ àgho.
eng: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak, and taught. But the high priest came, and those who were with him, and called the council together, and all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dû bà', a yɛ wowèe mbe shaŋ ka', a kʉti a du a suŋ bèe ce a m tuu wowèe nà. A m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂,
eng: But the officers who came didn't find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

lmp: "Wèr à dù a yɛ àmbò a li' shaŋ bòŋboŋ sê, ŋgâa ncir a tɛɛ njepmbè a ce kè'ni ŋgâa shaŋ. Wèr à ka' mʉ̀' shaŋ, a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mbo ka'."
eng: We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀, ker ba bêe bgòrgòr efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a ka' yu', bfee vi jep wowèe, wowèe a kɛ' a ce tarni yuu ce àde' yi lo ba.
eng: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à vʉ a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂! Bèe ce wèe à mʉ li' mbe shaŋ nà, a yu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a ce yɛ'ni bèe mbo."
eng: One came and told them, Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa kè'ni Ndap Nyʉ̀ nà, ker ba yì bèe, a m dù a vʉ nè wowèe. A m koo wowèe à ŋger ka', njobè' ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a m ce wɛp enɛ a ka' koo wowèe à ŋger, seemò' bèe a tʉʉshì wowèe nè blùr.
eng: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

lmp: A ka' vʉ̀ nè wowèe, a tɛr wowèe mbe mʉ̀ kansùr. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à bipshì buu nè wowèe.
eng: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Wèr à m làa enɛ wèe fa yɛ'ni yuu mo' à rlii ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'. Yɛ là nè yuu ce wèe à gèe. Wèe à gèe le ryɛ'nì li du à mʉ bdì' wɛɛwɛ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a koŋ sè'ni à rgèe tɛ yi yɛɛti enɛ bèe ce a m yʉ ŋwɛ̀ ca à m yʉ wèr."
eng: saying, Didn't we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man's blood on us.

lmp: Pità ba ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a beesì enɛ̂, "Wèr be kù yu'ni ba nè Nyʉ̀ càa ce enɛ wèr yu'ni ba nè ŋwɛ̀.
eng: But Peter and the apostles answered, We must obey God rather than men.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ visèe btarkʉ à m fʉr Jisòs ce wèe à m kɛ̀ti mbe ce e kwe nà efa rkwe.
eng: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m nàa ye a cusi a yê bo mà' àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mʉ̀' nduunjì nè bèe, ba ŋwɛ̀ rjà', tɛ e bo fa bèe njì à rkupsè, mà' yàp buu bbebep tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo fòosi wowèe efa yàp buu bbebep.
eng: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

lmp: A wèr ce wèr ce suŋ bèe buu ca, Yʉ' Rara ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè ye, yi ce suŋ wowèe foŋ."
eng: We are His witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu', ntee yi bep wowèe sê, wowèe a kɛ' a ce kwà'shi à ryʉ ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs.
eng: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and determined to kill them.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Farìsi mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Gàmalìyàl, à m nàti mbekì. À m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce yɛ'ni bèe mncir Nyʉ̀, à ba ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ce yu'ni nè ye. E m làa enɛ a fʉr bèe ca njepmbè tɛ a cu njo nfè' mʉcàr.
eng: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

lmp: A ka' fʉr, e làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yà bèe Isrɛ̀l, lòr nè nfè' à yuu ce wèe ce kòŋ à rgèe nè bèe ca.
eng: He said to them, You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' mò' Tôdàs à nyɛɛ a lor yì nyor à ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr, mmbaŋrù ce a m ba àmbò mjèe kyèe a du a yê mbùu. A m yʉ ye, mmbaŋrù ce a m ce dù a yê mbùu a da'sè, yuu ce wowèe a m ce kòŋ à rgèe nà yi bʉ à cicì.
eng: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves: who was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed, and came to nothing.

lmp: Ca yi ka' càa wɛɛ, Judàs ce e m ba ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Galèle à nyɛɛ mbe nfè' ce a m ce bè' bèe, a sʉŋ bèe mo' à mbèp yì. Ye ye à m kwe, bèe ce a m ce dù a yê mbùu, a da'sè.
eng: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò yi yu sè'ni na, m ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe fa gèe yuu mo' nè bèe ca ka'. Lɛ̀ nè wowèe nyaŋ njobè' yuu ce wowèe a ce kwà'shi à rgèe na, yi ka' lo ba ese ŋwɛ̀ banɛ yi be gèeti ka'.
eng: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men, and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

lmp: Yi ka' lo ba ese Nyʉ̀, àde' wèe jepsì wowèe ka'. Wèe ka' jepsi wowèe, seemò' yi lo ba enɛ wèe ce mà' bìr wèe Nyʉ̀ wèe."
eng: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!

lmp: Wowèe a m yu' ncep ce e m fa, a ka' kɛ' ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs, a lip wowèe, a laa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a fa kèr làa yuu mo' à rlii Jisòs ka'. A ka' làa wa'a, a ma'shi wowèe enɛ wowèe a dû.
eng: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

lmp: Wowèe a fʉʉ embe kansùr a ce lu'shi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à yɛ wowèe a ghɛɛtè à bèe ce àde' bèe a coosì njo' rlii Jisòs.
eng: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus' name.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce yɛ'ni a ce fè'shi mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ ba à mla' à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis anà.
eng: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

lmp: À m ba à mnòŋ ca ce ŋgoo ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs à m ce kù', bèe ce a m ce làa li Grêk a m làaŋger a kuu bèe ce a m ce làa li Hibrù njobè' a m ce gàpshi buu nè bèe à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, a ce fa byepkʉʉ wap ka'.
eng: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

lmp: Bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ a kɛ' ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ wèr borni efa rfè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ ce gàpshi ba buu nè bèe ka'.
eng: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

lmp: Bfʉr wêr, banɛ wèe fʉr mmbaŋrù sàambâ, efa wêe mʉ ce yap ŋgèe yi yu yɛɛnì, wowèe a ruusì nè Yʉ' Rara, a ker riŋ buu, tɛ wèr bo fa rfà' ca mbe wâp mmbò,
eng: Therefore select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

lmp: lòr yèr nfè' ce gèe rloo, kèr ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀."
eng: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.

lmp: Yuu ce a m làa, yi m bòŋ bèe wɛɛwɛ, wowèe a ce Stɛfàn ce e m byemi sê, a ker ruusi nè Yʉ' Rara, ba Felêp, ba Pukorùs, ba Nikanò, ba Timʉ̀n, ba Pɛmɛnàs, ba Nikòlàs ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Antìyòk, ce e m lò a byemi nè Nyʉ̀ bèe Jûs.
eng: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch;

lmp: Wowèe a m lòr bèe ca a tɛr njeptii ŋgâa ntuu, wowèe a loo, a lɛ map mmbo mbe wâp ndù.
eng: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

lmp: Blâa Nyʉ̀ vi m dù kùntombì, ŋgoo bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à ku' sê. Ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce a m yu' blâa rbyemì ca a byemi, a m ba gòr.
eng: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples multiplied in Jerusalem exceedingly. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

lmp: Stɛfàn à m tʉr rbôŋ Nyʉ̀ ba ŋger Nyʉ̀ sê, a gee buu bghagha' ba buu bbɛ̀ɛ à mʉ̀ bèe.
eng: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bèe mo' ce a m ba bèe embe ndap rloo ce a m ce too enɛ ndap rloo bèe ce a bii fà' bkwàa ka', ce à m ba bêe à rla' Sàiren ba à rla' Àlɛ̀ksandà ker ba bêe à ŋgôŋ Sìlesìyà ba Ɛshà a m ce sɛr mnsɛr a Stɛfàn wèe.
eng: But some of those who were of the synagogue called The Libertines, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

lmp: Yap ŋger mnsɛr à Stɛfàn wèe yi m sɛ̀ njobè' Stɛfàn à m ce làa ba nè bfee ba ŋger Yʉ' Rara ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa ye.
eng: They weren't able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

lmp: Wowèe a du embenjì a cepshi bèe mo' enɛ wowèe a nya' mnde' mbe tu Stɛfàn. Wowèe a kɛ' a laa enɛ̂, "Wèr à yu' àmbò e ce nya' mnde' a ce bepsi rlii Musìs ba Nyʉ̀."
eng: Then they secretly induced men to say, We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.

lmp: Ca yi m gèe mntee bèe ba mntee bleebèe ba mntee ŋgâa yɛ'ni bèe mncir, vi yɛɛŋgèr, wowèe a vʉ mbendù Stɛfàn, a koo ye a du àgho mbe kansùr.
eng: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, and brought him in to the council,

lmp: A ka' dù àgho, a vʉ nè bèe enɛ a vʉ tɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ, laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca à be buu efa rlàa yuu bebep àmbò dî' rara ca ba mncir Musìs ka'.
eng: and set up false witnesses who said, This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

lmp: Wèr a yu' àmbò e ce làa enɛ Jisòs ce à rla' Nasarɛ̀t be sà'si dì' ca kèr kupse ndèe to' ce Musìs à m fa nè sèe."
eng: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ embe kansùr a ka' fyɛ' bsii Stɛfàn, a yɛ vi ba àmbò bsii ncìndap Nyʉ̀ wa'a.
eng: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì à bipshì nè Stɛfàn enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa' a?"
eng: The high priest said, Are these things so?

lmp: Stɛfàn à beesì enɛ̂, "Bfʉr wa ba wa btâ, yu' nè yuu ce m be làa. Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fòo à m yɛɛti nè Abràham ce e m ba yèr ta à nfè' ce e m ba à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sòpòtɛmìyà ka' nàtî àfo dù cu à rla' Hɛràn nà,
eng: He said, Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham, when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

lmp: a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Lò efa wɛ̂ ŋgòŋ, fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ yò bèe, du à ŋgòŋ ce m be dùŋshi wɛ̀."
eng: and said to him, 'Get out of your land, and from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.'

lmp: E nàtî à ŋgôŋ bèe Kaldìyà, a du a cu à rla' Hɛràn. Yì ta à ka' kwe, Nyʉ̀ à fʉr ye a vʉ àgho fàdì' ce wèe ce cu na.
eng: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans, and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land, where you are now living.

lmp: E m fa ye ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa ŋgòŋ ca kɛ̀ mʉ bɛbɛ' efa gho ka'. Geewa'a, e m ye lè' enɛ e be lò fa ŋgòŋ anà nè ye, ker ba boo vi, ka' à m ba mbe nfè' anà e tʉr muu ka' wa'a.
eng: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his seed after him, when he still had no child.

lmp: Yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè ye yi m ba enɛ yì ŋgʉ̀ be lò bkìlò, cu à ŋgôŋ bèe mo' tɛ bèe anà a gee wowèe a kʉti bkwàa, jar nè wowèe à bfè' mjèe kyèe.
eng: God spoke in this way: that his seed would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ker laa foŋ enɛ̂, "M be sa', fa ŋgɛ' nè to' ce wowèe a ce fà' bkwàa nè wowèe nà. Mɛ̂ gèe wa' wɛɛ, tɛ wowèe a fʉʉ àfo, vʉ̀ loo nè mɛ̀ àfa na."
eng: I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,' said God, 'and after that will they come out, and serve me in this place.'

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ye lè' ce ncòo efa gho à m ba bʉ̀ ce Abràham à m gèe nà. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Abràham à bi Aisìk, mnòŋ vi ka' ba waami, e gee ye bʉ̀. Aisìk à bi Jakòp, Jakòp à bi btu mntɛ̀' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

lmp: Btu mntɛ̀' ca a m ko'ndoŋ nè Josɛ̀f, a fyeni ye à to' Ijìp. Geewa'a Nyʉ̀ à m ba a ye,
eng: The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him,

lmp: caar ŋkʉʉ mò' ce e m rìŋ Josɛ̀f ka', à ko' kʉʉ à to' Ijìp.
eng: until there arose a different king, who didn't know Joseph.

lmp: E m bo' yìsèe bèe, a jar nè visèe btâ, a gee wowèe a fʉr boo wap àwaŋ, tɛ a bo kweŋger.
eng: The same took advantage of our race, and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to throw out their babies, so that they wouldn't stay alive.

lmp: A m bi Musìs à nfè' ca, e ba mbòŋmboŋ se à bsii Nyʉ̀. E m kù' mbe ndàp yì ta à mŋwɛɛ btar.
eng: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome. He was nourished three months in his father's house.

lmp: A ka' fʉr ye àwaŋ, muu Fɛrò ce à m ba muunje, à lor ye a du àgho, a ke' àgho àmbò muu yì.
eng: When he was thrown out, Pharaoh's daughter took him up, and reared him as her own son.

lmp: A m yɛ'ni Musìs bfee bêe à ŋgôŋ Ijìp wɛɛwɛ, e ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr à vi blàa ker ba yi ŋgèe.
eng: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

lmp: "Musìs à ka' bà' bfè' mŋkyèe, a kwa'shi à rcà'ni bfʉr vi ce a m ba boo Isrɛ̀l.
eng: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

lmp: E ka' dù yɛ àmbò a ce fa ŋgɛ' nè mò' efa wowèe, e beenjì nfʉr yì, a lip ŋwɛ̂ Ijìp, e kwê.
eng: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him, and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

lmp: Musìs à m ce kwà'shi enɛ yì bèe a be rìŋ enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à tuu enɛ e fʉr wowèe efa ŋgɛ'. Geewa'a, wowèe a riŋ yap yu ka'.
eng: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn't understand.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, e vʉ a yɛ àmbò bèe mo' efa wowèe a ce rè bkòr. E ghetèr enɛ e teni bkòr anà, a laa enɛ̂, "Bfʉr wâ, wèe yu bfʉr; mbùu njokɛ wèe ce rè bkòr?"
eng: The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, 'Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?'

lmp: E ka' yɛ, a bɛɛŋger sê. E ka' ce ko'shi àtʉtʉ à rfyɛ', a yu' àmbò Tata à làa enɛ̂,
eng: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, a voice of the Lord came to him,

lmp: "A mɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ wee btâ. A mɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ Abràham ba Aisìk ba Jakòp." Musìs à m kàŋ sê, a wɛp à rfyɛ'.
eng: I am the God of your fathers, the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.' Moses trembled, and dared not look.

lmp: Tata à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Co'ni blaba' njobè' mbe dì' à tɛɛ anà yu dî' rara.
eng: The Lord said to him, 'Take your sandals off of your feet, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò a ce jar nè yà bèe à to' Ijìp, a yu' àmbò wowèe a ce war, a suu tɛ m bo fʉr wowèe efa ŋgɛ'. Banɛ à be tami nyor tɛ m tuu wɛ̀ à to' Ijìp."
eng: I have surely seen the affliction of my people that is in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.'

lmp: "Musìs ca ce wowèe a m mɛŋni a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe enɛ à ba mbe wêr ndù, sa' wèr à gèe nda" nà, Nyʉ̀ à m tuu ye enɛ e ba ŋwɛ̀ rsa', ker ba ŋwɛ̀ nfʉr bèe efa ŋgɛ'. E m càasi ntuu nè ye mbe mmbo yì ncìndap ce e m nyɛɛ nje mʉ̀ mcùŋ mor mbe mʉ ce mo' nà.
eng: This Moses, whom they refused, saying, 'Who made you a ruler and a judge?'--God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

lmp: Wer bta a m vʉ̀ àgho àfa à nfè' ce Joshùwà à m ba yap tu, wowèe a vʉ a so yap ŋgòŋ, Nyʉ̀ à juu bèe enje jɛɛ ce a m ba àfo a wâp bsii nà. Yi m cu nè wowèe caar a ba' mbe nfè' yì Dɛvìd.
eng: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations, whom God drove out before the face of our fathers, to the days of David,

lmp: E m tʉr bsii waŋ a Nyʉ̀, a loo enɛ Nyʉ̀ fa ye njì tɛ e ba'ri ndap nè Nyʉ̀ Jakòp.
eng: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e m bà'ri ndap nè ye à m ba Solomʉ̀n.
eng: But Solomon built him a house.

lmp: "Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ embe bùu e ke cu ba mbe ndap ce a bà'ri nè mmbo ka'. Yi yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à m làa. E m làa enɛ̂, Tata ce làa enɛ̂,
eng: However, the Most High doesn't dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

lmp: "Rbuu yu ya kàbàrà', nshe à ba ya nta' ntɛr mkùu. Tata ce làa enɛ̂, Njɛ̀ɛ ndap ce àde' wèe ba'rì nè mɛ̀ yu ba njɛ̀ɛ ndap kɛ? Njɛ̀ɛ dì' ce àde' m lʉshì àfo, yo njɛ̀ɛ dì' kɛ?
eng: heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?' says the Lord; 'or what is the place of my rest?

lmp: Àmbò buu ca wɛɛwɛ à gèe mɛ̀ nè ma mmbo a?"
eng: Didn't my hand make all these things?'

lmp: "Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa ntèetu, a ba mbɛ̀'nsʉ̀r à mntee ker ba à btù', wêe ke kû rè bkòr wèe Yʉ' Rara wèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yuu ce wee bta a m gèe ku ba yuu ce wèe ce gèe.
eng: You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu', ntee yi bep wowèe sê, wowèe a kʉr msòŋ.
eng: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi m ruusi Stɛfàn, e ke' mbe bùu a yɛ fôo Nyʉ̀, a yɛ Jisòs àmbò e tɛɛ à rkoo mâ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven, and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ nè, mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò rbuu li mʉ̀'ti, mɛ̀ yɛ Muu Ŋwɛ̀ àmbò e tɛɛ à rkoo mâ' Nyʉ̀."
eng: and said, Behold, I see the heavens opened, and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' ca, a ghaa mbekì, a cete wap btù', a caŋ a gʉmi mbe yê ndù.
eng: But they cried out with a loud voice, and stopped their ears, and rushed at him with one accord.

lmp: Wowèe a m fʉr ye efa mʉ̀ rla' a tʉʉshi nè blùr. Bèe ce a m tɛɛ njìnsa' mbe kansùr nà a m lɛ̀ wap bcɛ̀' njeptii mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Sôl.
eng: They threw him out of the city, and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce tʉʉshi Stɛfàn nè blùr, e loo a laa enɛ̂, "Tata Jisòs, koo la ryòŋ."
eng: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!

lmp: E m gʉ'shi nè mkʉʉshi, a waa mbekì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, fa lɛ̀ yuu bebep ca mbe wâp ndù ka'." E ka' làa wa'a, a kwe.
eng: He kneeled down, and cried with a loud voice, Lord, don't hold this sin against them! When he had said this, he fell asleep.

lmp: Sol à m byemi enɛ a yʉ Stɛfàn. À m ba à nòŋ anà a kɛ' a ce fa ŋgɛ' nè cor ce à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m sê. Yi ka' ba wa'a, ŋgâa rbyemì a da'sè à bdì' wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà ba à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà. Bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ ce a m ku cu à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à m ku ba ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs.
eng: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

lmp: Bèe mo' ce a m fa yap ntee nè Nyʉ̀ a m tuŋ Stɛfàn, a war li rkwe sê.
eng: Devout men buried Stephen, and lamented greatly over him.

lmp: Sol à m fa ŋgɛ' nè cor sê. E m ce dù à mndap jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce koshi mmbaŋrù ba bbyèŋge ce fa mbe shaŋ.
eng: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house, and dragged both men and women off to prison.

lmp: Bèe ce a m da'se yap nà, a m ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à bdì' wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a m dù.
eng: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

lmp: Felep à m dù à mʉ bu' rla' mo' à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà, a suŋ àmbò Krâis anà nè bêe àfo.
eng: Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed to them the Christ.

lmp: Bkʉr bèe ca a ka' yu' yuu ce Felep à m làa, kèr yɛ mncòo ce e m dùŋshi, a ker lor nfè' a yu'shi bòŋboŋ sê.
eng: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip, when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

lmp: Byʉ' bbebep ce vi m niŋ njep bèe magòr, vi m ce waani, ce fʉʉse enjep bèe anà. Bèe magòr ce yàp ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' à m kwe, ker ba bèe ce a m ba mntɛ̀ŋ a m lùŋ.
eng: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

lmp: Bêe à rla' anà a m lu'shi sê.
eng: There was great joy in that city.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba, a too ye enɛ Saimʉ̀n À m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m be ce gèe fii à rla' Sàmarìyà, bêe à to' anà a ce bɛ̀ɛŋger sê. E m ce gèe fii anà a ce nàa nyor enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ŋger.
eng: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city, and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m yu'shi yuu ce e m ce làa bòŋboŋ, kɛ' embe bêe bkɛ'kɛ' du ba' mbe bêe bgòrgòr, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋger Nyʉ̀ ce a ce too enɛ Ŋger Ce Gòr nà."
eng: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, This man is that great power of God.

lmp: Wowèe a m yu' yuu ce e m ce làa bòŋboŋ njobè' yi fii ce e m gèe à bfè' àŋgoo, bèe a bɛɛŋgèr nà.
eng: They listened to him, because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

lmp: Geewa'a, wowèe a ka' byemi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce Felep à m fè'shi àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ker ba àmbò rlii Jisos Krâis, a baptìr wowèe, mmbaŋrù ba bbyèŋge.
eng: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning the Kingdom of God and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n ye ye à m byemi, a ka' bàptir ye, e ku ce kar a Felêp. E ka' yɛ mncòo ba buu bghagha' ce Felep à m gèe, e bɛɛŋgèr sê.
eng: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs e Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a ka' yu' enɛ bêe à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ a byemi, a tuu Pità ba Jôn enɛ a du yɛ wowèe.
eng: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù bà', a loo nè bèe anà tɛ wowèe a bo koni Yʉ' Rara,
eng: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

lmp: njobè' Yʉ' Rara yi m be suu mbe wâp ndù ka'. A m ku baptir wowèe ba à rlii Tata Jisòs.
eng: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a lɛ map mmbo mbe wâp ndù, wowèe a konì Yʉ' Rara.
eng: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n à ka' yɛ enɛ ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a lɛ̀ mmbo mbendù bèe, wowèe a konì Yʉ' Rara, e vʉ nè mbàa enɛ e bo fa nè wowèe,
eng: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles' hands, he offered them money,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Fa nè mɛ̀ njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ca foŋ, mɛ mɛ̂ lɛ̀ mmbo mbendù ŋwɛ̀, ŋgàŋ bo koni Yʉ' Rara."
eng: saying, Give me also this power, that whoever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèe yo mbàa anà du bʉ à cicì njobè' à ce kwà'shi enɛ àde' à yuu rfa Nyʉ̀ nè mbàa!
eng: But Peter said to him, May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

lmp: Rfà' ca yu lo rfà' ka'. À tʉr bo njo ka' njobè' yo ntee yi yu rara à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn't right before God.

lmp: Kupse, ma'shi wo bsàrbuu, loo nè Tata enɛ kɛ̀ e be fòosi wɛ̀ yuu ce à ce kwà'shi njep wɛ̂ ntee nà ɛ̀.
eng: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ à yu ŋwɛ̀ ntee sii, yo ŋgêe bebep yi kur wɛ̀."
eng: For I see that you are in the gall of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n à laa enɛ̂, "Loo nè nè Tata Nyʉ̀ nè mɛ̀ enɛ yuu mo' efa yuu wèe à làa na yi fa koni mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: Simon answered, Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' suŋ bèe àmbò Jisòs, kèr fè'shi blàa Tatâ, a nati a kʉti Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m. Wowèe a ka' ce kʉti a fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca à ku' mla' magòr à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà.
eng: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

lmp: Ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à laa nè Felep enɛ̂, "Nàti du mbà mbùuŋgòŋ, njep nduunjì ce yi lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a du à rla' Gaasà." Yu nduunjì ce yi yu à rìŋ.
eng: But an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.

lmp: E natì a ce dù, a ka' ce dù, a yɛ ŋwɛ̂ à to' Ìtopìyà. À m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce a m sòŋ, ce e m ce fà' njeptii Mayâa Kandɛ̀s ce e m ce sa' to' Ìtopìyà. Buu Mayâa wɛɛwɛ à m ba mba yê mmbò. E m dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m à rgèe rloo nè Nyʉ̀,
eng: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

lmp: a ka' ce kʉti, a cu mbe yì mutù ce à m ce sʉ̀ŋ ba mnyàabàrà', a ce bè' ŋwâ' Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

lmp: Yʉ' yi laa nè Felep enɛ̂, "Dù tee mutù ca."
eng: The Spirit said to Philip, Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.

lmp: Felep à ka' caŋ dû bà', a yu' àmbò e ce bè' embe ŋwà' Àsayà ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀. E bipshì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ bè' wa'a, a riŋ yuu ce yi ce làa a?"
eng: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, Do you understand what you are reading?

lmp: E laa enɛ̂, "Àde' m riŋ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' tɛ nàshi nè mɛ̀ ka'?" E m làa nè Felep enɛ e ko' cu a ye mbe mutù anà.
eng: He said, How can I, unless someone explains it to me? He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

lmp: Dì' embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ ce e m ce bè' à m ba dì' ce a saŋ enɛ̂, "Àmbò njèe ce a ke dù àgho à rsɛɛ, kɛ̀ muu njèe ce a ke koo mnyôr efa gho e ce war ka' nà, e m mʉ̀' yi cùu ka'.
eng: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn't open his mouth.

lmp: Bèe a m lòr ye à yuu cicì, a sa' vi mnsa' nè mnàŋ-ŋwɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce àde' e suŋ àmbò yi ràrà ka', njobè' a tee li ryòŋ enjep ŋgòŋ."
eng: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̂ nsòŋ ca à laa nè Felep enɛ̂, "Suŋ là mɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ ce ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ anà ce làa du kuu ye yu nda? E ce làa ba àmbò yì nyor kɛ̀ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mò' lɛ?"
eng: The eunuch answered Philip, Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?

lmp: Felep à kɛ' embe dì' ce ŋwɛ̀ anà à ba ce bè' nà, a fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ kuu Jisòs nè ye.
eng: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him Jesus.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce dù, a yɛ rdip mo', ŋwɛ̂ nsòŋ ca a laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, a rdip na. Yuu ce àde' yi jepsì wɛ̀ efa rbàptir mɛ̀ yu kɛ?"
eng: As they went on the way, they came to some water, and the eunuch said, Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?

lmp: E ka' bèesi wa'a, a lâa, mutù cà à tɛɛ. E ka' tɛɛ, Felep ba ŋwɛ̂ nsòŋ anà a suu njep rò, Felep à baptìr ye.
eng: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' fʉʉ enjep rò, Yʉ' Tata yi lor Felep a du àgho, ŋwɛ̂ nsòŋ ca à ker yɛ ye ka', a nati a ce dù, a ce lu'shi.
eng: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn't see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

lmp: Felep à ka' lò a ku yɛ enɛ e yu à rla' Àsotòs, a ka' ce càa, a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ à mla' wɛɛwɛ caar a du a ba' Sisàriyà.
eng: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities, until he came to Caesarea.

lmp: Sol à m ku bii ce wɛpsi bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu Tata Jisòs enɛ e be yʉshi wowèe. E m dù a yɛ tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì,
eng: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest,

lmp: a laa enɛ e fa ye ŋwà' tɛ e bo dù fa nè btu embe mndap mlôo à rla' Dàmaskòs, e ka' dù yɛ bèe ce a ce jɛ̀r njep nduunjì Krâis, kɛ̀ yu mmbaŋrù ɛ, kɛ̀ yu bbyèŋge ɛ̀, e bo kur wowèe vʉ̀ àgho à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m tɛ a bo sa' wowèe.
eng: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

lmp: E ka' koni ŋwà' ce dù àgho dû bà' àtʉtʉ, rraa li ku lo a bap embe bùu a suu mbe yê ndù.
eng: As he traveled, it happened that he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

lmp: E gwe à nshè a yu' àmbò njèndoŋ ce làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Sôl, Sôl, à ce jar nè mɛ̀ njokɛ?"
eng: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?

lmp: E beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, a wɛ̀ nda?" E laa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Jisòs ce à ce jar nè mɛ̀ nà.
eng: He said, Who are you, Lord? The Lord said, I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

lmp: Nàti mbekì du à mʉ̀ rla', tɛ a bo suŋ wɛ̀ yuu ce à be gèe."
eng: But rise up, and enter into the city, and you will be told what you must do.

lmp: Bèe ce a wowèe a m ce dù, a m tɛɛ, a tʉr yuu làa ka'. Wowèe a m yu' àmbò njèndoŋ ce làa, a ke' ce yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

lmp: Sol à natì enjep nshè, a ka' mʉ̀'shi mmir, a ker ce yɛ buu ka'. A m koo ye à rkoo a du àgho à rla' Dàmaskòs.
eng: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand, and brought him into Damascus.

lmp: E m cu à mnôŋ btaar, a yɛ yuu ka', a ye yuu ka', a no yuu ka'.
eng: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs à m ba à rla' Dàmaskòs, li rlii li ba enɛ Ànàniyàs. Tata Jisòs à m làa nè ye à rloo enɛ̂, "Ànàniyàs." E beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, a mɛ̀ na."
eng: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, Ananias! He said, Behold, it's me, Lord.

lmp: Tata Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàti du njep nduunjì ce a too enɛ Kùyɛɛ nà, du mbe ndàp mbe Judàs, laa enɛ wɛ̂ kòŋ à ryɛ ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Tasòs ce li rlii li yu enɛ Sol nà. E ce gèe rloo sè'ni na.
eng: The Lord said to him, Arise, and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

lmp: E ce gèe rloo wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à gee e yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce li rlii li yu enɛ Ànàniyàs àmbò e vʉ̀ a niŋ mbe ndàp a lɛ mmbo mbe yê ndù tɛ e bo yɛ buu."
eng: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in, and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.

lmp: Ànàniyàs à beesì enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mɛ̀ yu' bèe a làa buu magòr se àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ca. Bèe a làa àmbò ku' buu bbebep ce e gèe nè yò bêe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: But Ananias answered, Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

lmp: E yu àfa sè'ni na wa'a, bèe ce a yu btu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a banì fa ye ŋger wɛɛ enɛ e vʉ koo bèe ce a ce loo nè wɛ̀, kur du àgho, fa mbe shaŋ."
eng: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.

lmp: Tata Jisòs à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù yo yu. E yu yà ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ ce tɛ e bo suŋ àmbò la rlii nè bèe enje jɛɛ, ba bkʉʉ, ker ba boo Isrɛ̀l.
eng: But the Lord said to him, Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

lmp: Ku ba mɛ̀ ce m be dùŋshi ye ku' ŋgɛ' ce e be yɛ njo' la rlii."
eng: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name's sake.

lmp: E ka' làa wa' mìsi, Ànàniyàs à natì a du a niŋ mbe ndàp, a lɛ mi mmbo mbendù Sôl, a laa enɛ̂, "Nfʉrâ Sôl, Tata Jisòs ce e m yɛɛti à nduunjì ce wɛ̀ m vʉ̀ njo, à tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m vʉ gee tɛ à ker yɛ buu, ruusi nè Yʉ' Rara."
eng: Ananias departed, and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me, that you may receive your sight, and be filled with the Holy Spirit.

lmp: E ka' làa wa' mìsi, yuu mo' ce yi m ba àmbò bbap nyor wa'a vi gweŋgèr ye enjep mmìr njà' mò'sir, e ker kɛ' a ce yɛ buu. E m nàti mbekì, a baptìr ye.
eng: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

lmp: E ka' ye byee mìsi, yi ŋger yi kʉtì njo. E m cu à rla' Dàmaskòs a bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs nà à mʉ mnòŋ mo'.
eng: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

lmp: E m càasi nfè' ka'. E m niŋ à mndap mloo a ce fè'shi àmbò Jisòs, a ce làa enɛ̂, "E yu muu Nyʉ̀."
eng: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m yu', a m bɛ̀ɛŋger sê, a laa enɛ̂, "Mbò ŋwɛ̀ ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce ghèter à ryʉshi bèe ce a m ce loo nè Jisòs à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m nà a? Mbò e vʉ̀ àfa tɛ e bo kèr koshi ŋgâa rloo ca kur dù àgho dù fa nè bèe ce a yu btu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a?"
eng: All who heard him were amazed, and said, Isn't this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò Sôl, e m ker misi a tap, a ce nàshi enɛ Jisòs à m ba Krâis anà. Cena yi gee bfee vi jep Jus ce a m ce cu à rla' Dàmaskòs.
eng: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

lmp: Mnòŋ vi ka' càa àŋgoo, Jus a cutè, a fa mntaŋ a kɛ' a ce ròo mi mkùu.
eng: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

lmp: Bèe mo' a m suŋ Sol enɛ bèe a ce ròo mi mkùu. Wowèe a m ce kè'ni bcûu ŋka' nèmootì ba nètʉ', tɛ a bo koo Sol yʉ.
eng: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, yì bèe ce a m ce dù a yê mbùu a lor ye nètʉ', a lɛ njep ma ŋkàa mò', a torsi njî à wendù ŋka', a suusi njep nshè.
eng: but his disciples took him by night, and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

lmp: E ka' dû bà' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a koŋ à rba a bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs nà àbee. Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a m wɛp ye, njobè' wowèe a m byemi enɛ e yu mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs ka'.
eng: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

lmp: Geewa'a, Bànabàs à m lòr ye a du àgho mbe mʉ̀ ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs. E m suŋ nè wowèe enɛ Sol à yɛ Tata Jisòs à nduunjì, Tata à laa nè ye. E m ker suŋ wowèe enɛ Sol à m fè'shi à rlii Jisòs, nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀ à rla' Dàmaskòs
eng: But Barnabas took him, and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord in the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

lmp: Sol à m ku ba àbee a wowèe, a ce jɛ̀r a wowèe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

lmp: E m fè'shi à rlii Jisòs nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀. E m de' a Jus ce a m ce làa li Grêk, a sɛr mnsɛr a wowèe. Wowèe a m ce ròo à ryʉ ye.
eng: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

lmp: Bfʉr ca a ka' rìŋ wa'a, a lor ye a du àgho à rla' Sisàriyà, a ma'shi ye, e natì a du à rla' Tasòs.
eng: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea, and sent him off to Tarsus.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a ŋgâa cor ce e m ba à ŋgôŋ Judà wɛɛwɛ, ker ba à ŋgôŋ Galèle ba à ŋgôŋ Sàmarìyà a m cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀, a tap foŋ. Wowèe a ka' ce wɛp Tata Nyʉ̀, Yʉ' Rara yi ce fa wowèe ŋger foŋ, cor à ku' à bèe.
eng: So the assemblies throughout all Judea and Galilee and Samaria had peace, and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Pità à ka' jɛ̀r à mʉ bdì' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a nati a du à rla' Lidà foŋ, tɛ e bo yɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a m ba àfo.
eng: It happened, as Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

lmp: E ka' bà', a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mo' ce li rlii li m ba enɛ Àniyàs. Yì ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' à m kwe, e noŋ njep kèŋ yaŋ à bfè' waami.
eng: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.

lmp: Pità à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Àniyàs, Jisos Krâis ce gèe tɛ à bo lùŋ; nàti mbekì, kupshi wo bkuu." E m nàti mbekì njà' mò'sir.
eng: Peter said to him, Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed! Immediately he arose.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce cu à rla' Lidà ba mbo' Sharòn wɛɛwɛ, a m yɛ ye, a beeŋger a byemi nè Tata Jisòs.
eng: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs à m ba à rla' Jopà. Li rlii li m ba enɛ Tàbità; mbùu efa rlii anà à ba enɛ Ŋgap. E m ce gèe buu bbòŋboŋ sê, a ba mmbo mtoo.
eng: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated, means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

lmp: E m lò a yaŋ, a kwe. A ka' sù'si ye, a lɛ mbe rum ndàp yì embekì.
eng: It happened in those days that she fell sick, and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

lmp: Rla' Jopà li ku ba àtʉtʉ rla' Lidà. Bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu Jisòs a ka' yu' enɛ Pità yu à rla' Lidà, wowèe a tuu bèe a mmbaa enɛ a du laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Kyer wɛ̀, vʉ̀ cɛrcɛr, vʉ yɛ wèr."
eng: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

lmp: Pità à natì a du a wowèe. E ka' dû bà', a lor ye a du àgho mbe rum ndap yì embekì nà. Byepkʉʉ wɛɛwɛ a m tɛɛ a yê geŋ, a ce war, a ce dùŋshi bcɛ̀' njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce Dokàs à m tar à nfè' ce e m bii ntèe.
eng: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the coats and garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

lmp: Pità à m fʉr wowèe wɛɛwɛ njepmbè a gʉ'shi a loo; a karsi nyor a ke' gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀, a laa enɛ̂, "Tàbità, nàti mbekì." E m mʉ̀' mi mmir a ka' yɛ Pità, a nati a cu mbekì.
eng: Peter put them all out, and kneeled down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, Tabitha, get up! She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

lmp: Pità à ghashì ye à rkoo, a naa mbekì, a kɛ' bèe Nyʉ̀ ker ba byepkʉʉ, a fa ye nè wowèe ntèe.
eng: He gave her his hand, and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

lmp: Bêe à rla' Jopà wɛɛwɛ a m yu', bèe magòr efa wâp mʉ a byemì nè Tata Jisòs.
eng: And it became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

lmp: E m cu à rla' Jopà à mnòŋ àŋgoo a Saimʉ̀n ŋwɛ̀ yaati mŋgûp nyàa.
eng: It happened, that he stayed many days in Joppa with one Simon, a tanner.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba à rla' Sisàriyà ce li rlii li m ba enɛ Kòniyùs. E m ba tu nè kʉr bsoogɛ̀ ce a m ba rjèe. A m ce too kʉr bsoogɛ̀ anà enɛ bsoogɛ̀ enje Italè.
eng: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

lmp: À m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce a yì ndap à m fa yàp nyor nè Nyʉ̀, a ker ce wɛp ye foŋ. E m ba mmbo mtoo nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, a ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

lmp: À ka' ba à nòŋ mo', àmbò à nyʉ̀ taar nèmootì, e yɛ yuu mo' àmbò rlo wa'a. E m yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ se àmbò e vʉ̀, a niŋ mbe ndàp, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Kòniyùs."
eng: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him, and saying to him, Cornelius!

lmp: Kòniyùs a ke' ye enɛ ntuŋ-ŋ-ŋ, a kâŋ, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tatâ, yu kɛ?" E laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à yu' lo rloo, a yɛ enɛ à yu mmbo mtoo, a ce kuushi wɛ̀.
eng: He, fastening his eyes on him, and being frightened, said, What is it, Lord? He said to him, Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

lmp: Banɛ à tuu bèe à rla' Jopà tɛ wowèe a du vʉ̀ nè Saimʉ̀n ce li rlii mo' li yu enɛ Pità nà.
eng: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is surnamed Peter.

lmp: E ce cu a Saimʉ̀n ŋwɛ̀ yaati mŋgûp nyàa, ce yì ndap yu àwâa rdip rgòr nà."
eng: He lodges with one Simon, a tanner, whose house is by the seaside.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m làa nè ye nà à ka' dù, e kɛ' boo mfà' embe yê ndàp a baa ker ba ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̀ ce e m fa yì nyor nè Nyʉ̀, ce e m ba mò' efa bèe ce a m ce fà' nè ye.
eng: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

lmp: E ka' suŋ wowèe buu wɛɛwɛ, a tuu wowèe à rla' Jopà.
eng: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, wowèe a ce dù, a ka' bà' àtʉtʉ, Pità à ko' mbe tu ndap àmbò à nyʉ̀ ncòp-baa wa'a, à rgèe rloo.
eng: Now on the next day as they were on their journey, and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

lmp: E ka' ce loo, njè à ka' kɛ̀' ce yaŋ ye, e koŋ à rye yuu. A ka' ce fɛ̀r byee nè ye, e yɛ njɛ̀ɛ rlo mo'.
eng: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

lmp: E m yɛ àmbò rbuu li mʉ̀'ti, yuu mo' yi ce sùu embo àmbò ma cɛ̂' bɛ̀bɛr wa'a, a ghashì à bcùu kyèe efa gho a suusi njep nshè.
eng: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

lmp: Mnyàa njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ vi m ba njep cɛ̀' anà, ker ba buu mò' àmbò mnyo, ba bbar, ba bsiŋ.
eng: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

lmp: Njèndoŋ à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Pità, nàti mbekì, shɛshi, ye."
eng: A voice came to him, Rise, Peter, kill and eat!

lmp: Pità à laa yi yu enɛ̂, "Tatâ, mɛ̀ ka'. Mɛ̀ m be ye ya yu yuu ce ncir yi kani ka'."
eng: But Peter said, Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.

lmp: Njèndoŋ ca à ker laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à ka' gee yuu yi ba rara, à fa lòr yuu anà àmbò yuu ce yi raa ka' ka'."
eng: A voice came to him again the second time, What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.

lmp: Ca yi m koni nfè' taar, a lor yuu anà njà' mò'sir, a kʉti àgho mbe bùu.
eng: This was done three times, and immediately the vessel was received up into heaven.

lmp: Pità à ka' ce seŋ enɛ rlo ce e yɛ nà li ce làa ba enɛ kɛ lɛ, bèe ce Kòniyùs à m tuu nà a banì vʉ a roo ndap yì Saimʉ̀n a yɛ, a tɛɛ njep cùu ŋka' ce a m sìr ndap anà àgho,
eng: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon's house, stood before the gate,

lmp: a bipshi enɛ, "Saimʉ̀n ce li rlii mo' li yu enɛ Pità nà ce cu mbe ndàp na a?"
eng: and called and asked whether Simon, who was surnamed Peter, was lodging there.

lmp: Pità à m ku bii ce seŋ àmbò rlo ce e m yɛ nà, Yʉ' yi laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, bèe a mntaar a ce ròo wɛ̀.
eng: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, Behold, three men seek you.

lmp: Nàti, suu njep nshè. Fa wɛp à rdù wèe wowèe ka', njobè' à tuu mɛ̀ a tuu wowèe."
eng: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.

lmp: Pità à suu a yɛ wowèe, a laa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe ce ròo nà. Wèe à vʉ̀ à rròo mɛ̀ enɛ kɛ?"
eng: Peter went down to the men, and said, Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Kòniyùs ce e yu tu nè bsoogɛ̀ rjèe, à tuu wèr. E yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, a ce wɛp Nyʉ̀, Jus wɛɛwɛ a ce làa buu bbòŋboŋ kuu ye. Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' ce nrara à laa nè ye enɛ e kɛ' wɛ̀ tɛ à vʉ mbe yê ndàp, tɛ e bo yu' yuu ce à be làa nè ye."
