eng: They said, Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.

lmp: E lâa, a wowèe a niŋ mbe ndàp a nôŋ. Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, e natì a du a wowèe, bfʉr mô' à rla' Jopà a du a yê mbùu.
eng: So he called them in and lodged them. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

lmp: Tʉ̀' mò' à ka' kèr raa, wowèe a ba' à rla' Sisàriyà. Kòniyùs à m cu a ce kè' wowèe, a kɛ'shi bèe ce a wowèe a m ràte, ba bkar vi vi mntee, wowèe a vʉ mbe yê ndàp.
eng: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

lmp: Pità à ka' niŋ, Kòniyùs à konì ye, a gwe njep yê tìi a ca'ni ye àmbò a ke cà'ni Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: When it happened that Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

lmp: Pità à naa ye mbekì, a ce làa nè ye enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì, mɛ mɛ̀ foŋ ku ba ŋwɛ̀ àmbò wɛ̀."
eng: But Peter raised him up, saying, Stand up! I myself am also a man.

lmp: E ka' ce de' a ye, a ye a niŋ mbe ndàp, e yɛ ku' bèe àmbò a cu mbo.
eng: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe rìŋ weenɛ ncir yi yɛ'ni enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ Jus kar kɛ̀ ca'ni ŋwɛ̀ enje jɛɛ ka'. Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à gèe mɛ̀ riŋ mɛnɛ àde' m ker lor ŋwɛ̀ mò' àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' wèr ye buu efa rkar ka'.
eng: He said to them, You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn't call any man unholy or unclean.

lmp: A mbùu ce wɛ̀ ka' tuu bèe enɛ a vʉ kɛ' mɛ̀, mɛ̀ laa yuu mo' ka', a ku nati a ce vʉ̀. M ce bipshi nè wɛ̀ enɛ wɛ̀ tuu bèe enɛ m vʉ gee kɛ lɛ."
eng: Therefore also I came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?

lmp: Kòniyùs à laa enɛ̂, "Mnòŋ vi càa sè'ni kyèe ce mɛ̀ mʉ ba mbe mɛ̂ ndàp, à nfê' sè'ni ce yu nyʉ̀ taar nèmootì na, a ce loo. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ku lo a tɛɛ kùntombì nè mɛ̀, a yar bcɛ̀' ce vi m ce raa sê,
eng: Cornelius said, Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour, and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing,

lmp: a laa enɛ̂, "Kòniyùs, Nyʉ̀ à yu' lo rloo a yɛ enɛ à yu mmbo mtoo, a ce kuushi wɛ̀.
eng: and said, 'Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

lmp: Banɛ à tuu bèe à rla' Jopà tɛ wowèe a du vʉ̀ nè Saimʉ̀n ce li rlii mo' li yu enɛ Pità nà. E ce cu mbe ndàp mbe Saimʉ̀n ŋwɛ̀ yaati mŋgûp nyàa, ndap anà à ba àwâa rdip rgòr."
eng: Send therefore to Joppa, and summon Simon, who is surnamed Peter. He lodges in the house of Simon a tanner, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ càasi nfè' ka', a tuu bèe enɛ a vʉ kɛ' wɛ̀. Wɛ̀ gèe yuu bòŋboŋ sê, a vʉ̂. Wèr yu mbena sè'ni à bsii Nyʉ̀, tɛ wèr bo yu' yuu ce Tata à làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à laa nè wèr."
eng: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.

lmp: Pità à laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke lòr ŋwɛ̀ mò' jɛɛ ka'.
eng: Peter opened his mouth and said, Truly I perceive that God doesn't show favoritism;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' ce wɛp Nyʉ̀, ce gèe yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì, kɛ̀ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̂ à to' efɛ ɛ̀, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be koo ye mmbo mmbaa.
eng: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ ntuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m cep nè bêe à to' Isrɛ̀l, a ce suŋ bèe Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò cumʉnyaŋ ce e ce lò ese ye njì enjep Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ--he is Lord of all--

lmp: Wèe rìŋ yuu ce yi m koni à ŋgôŋ Judà wɛɛwɛ. Yi m kɛ̂' à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, rfè'shì ce Jôn à m ce fè'shi tɛ e bo bàptir bèe nà li m banì caa wɛɛ.
eng: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

lmp: Yi m ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m sùusi Yʉ' Rara mbe tu Jisòs, a ce ye, a fa ye ŋger. E m dù à bdì' wɛɛwɛ a ce gèe buu bbòŋboŋ a ce gèe bèe wɛɛwɛ ce nyʉ̀rkà' à m tʉr ŋger mbe wâp ndù a ce lùŋ, njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m ba a ye.
eng: even Jesus of Nazareth, how God anointed him with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

lmp: Wèr à m yɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce e m gèe à bbu' mla' à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m nè mer mmir. Wowèe a m yʉ ye, a m kɛ̀ti ye ba mbe ce, e kwê.
eng: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews, and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

lmp: Geewa'a, mnòŋ vi ka' bâ' btaar, Nyʉ̀ à fʉr ye efa rkwe, a gee e yɛɛtì àwaŋ.
eng: God raised him up the third day, and gave him to be revealed,

lmp: E m yɛɛti nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ka'. E m yɛɛti ba nè wèr ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce enɛ wèr suŋ bèe àmbò ye, wèr à ba bèe ce wèr à m yeŋger a ker noŋger àbee wèr wowèe à nfè' ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

lmp: E m fa rsa' nè wèr enɛ wèr fe'shi nè bèe, suŋ bèe enɛ yu ye ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce enɛ e ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kè sa' bèe ce a cu btèe ker ba bèe ce a m kweŋger.
eng: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

lmp: Ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ a m làa àmbò ye, a suŋ bèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be fòosi ŋgàŋ efa yì buu bbebep a yê rlii."
eng: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.

lmp: Pità à ka' kù bii ce làa, Yʉ' Rara yi suu mbendù bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m yu' blàa ca.
eng: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

lmp: Ŋgâa rbyemì efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m gèe bʉ̀ ce a m vʉ̀ a Pità wèe nà, a m bɛ̀ɛŋger se njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m sùusi yi Yʉ' mbendù bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ.
eng: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

lmp: Wowèe a m yu' àmbò wowèe a ce làa bli ce wowèe a m yɛ'ni ka', a ce ku'si Nyʉ̀. Pità à lâa enɛ̂,
eng: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

lmp: "Bèe ca a koni Yʉ' Rara àmbò see sèe à m koni nà. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' kanì enɛ a fa bàptir wowèe ka' a?"
eng: Can any man forbid the water, that these who have received the Holy Spirit as well as we should not be baptized?

lmp: E m làa enɛ a baptir wowèe à rlii Jisos Krâis. A ka' bàptir wowèe, wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ e cu a wowèe à mʉ mnôŋ mo'.
eng: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ker ba bfʉr ce a m ba à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a m yu' enɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ a byemi.
eng: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

lmp: Pità à ka' dù Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, bèe ce a m ce làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ gee bʉ̀ ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì nà, a lapnì Pità,
eng: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

lmp: a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ niŋ à mndap bèe ce a gèe bʉ̀ ka', a yeŋger wèe wowèe njokɛ?"
eng: saying, You went in to uncircumcised men, and ate with them!

lmp: Pità à lor nfè' a nashi yuu ce e m gèe anà nè wowèe bòŋboŋ sê, a laa enɛ̂,
eng: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

lmp: "Mɛ̀ m ba à rla' Jopà a ce gèe rloo a yɛ njɛ̀ɛ rlo mo'. Mɛ̀ m yɛ àmbò yuu mo' yi ce sùu embe bùu àmbò ma cɛ̂' bɛ̀bɛr wa'a, a ghashì à bcùu kyèe efa gho a suusi njep nshè. Yi m sùu a mɛ̂ geŋ.
eng: I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' ca, a ker tʉr yuu làa ka', a ku'si Nyʉ̀, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Banɛ Nyʉ̀ à mà'shi foŋ enɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a kupse, ma' yàp buu bbebep tɛ a bo koni ryòŋ."
eng: When they heard these things, they held their peace, and glorified God, saying, Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!

lmp: Bèe ce a m da'se njobè' a m yʉ Stɛfàn, ŋgɛ' à konì cor nà, a m dù à bdì' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Bèe mo' a m dù à ŋgôŋ Fònishà, bèe mo' a du à to' Saipròs, bèe mo' a du à rla' Antìyòk. Wowèe a m dù à bdì' ca wa'a, a ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ ba nè Jus cà'cà'.
eng: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

lmp: Geewa'a, bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ ce a m ba bêe à to' Saipròs ba rla' Sàiren a m bà' à rla' Antìyòk a fe'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ. Wowèe a m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Tata Jisòs nè bèe anà.
eng: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

lmp: Ŋger Nyʉ̀ yi m ba a wowèe, bèe magòr a byemì nè Tatâ, a kupse, a ma' yàp buu bbebep.
eng: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

lmp: Nsuŋ à m niŋ mbà btù' ŋgâa cor ce a m ba à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, wowèe a tuu Bànabàs enɛ e du à rla' Antìyòk.
eng: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

lmp: E ka' dù bà' yɛ rbòŋ Nyʉ̀ a wâp mʉ, a lu'shi, a tapse wowèe, a laa nè wowèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wowèe a ku ce yu'ni nè Tata nè ntêe mo'sir.
eng: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

lmp: E m tapse bèe anà wa'a njobè' e m ba ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ, a ruusi nè Yʉ' Rara, a byemi sê. Ku' bèe magòr a m byemi nè Tatâ.
eng: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Bànabàs à natì a du à rla' Tasòs à rròo Sôl.
eng: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

lmp: A ka' yɛ ye, a lor ye a vʉ àgho à rla' Antìyòk. Wowèe a m cu a ŋgâa cor wèe à fè' bìi, a yɛ'ni bèe magòr sê. A m kɛ̀' a too ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs enɛ ŋgâa rbyemì ba à rla' Antìyòk.
eng: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. It happened, that for a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

lmp: À m ba à mnòŋ anà, ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a du à rla' Antìyòk.
eng: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

lmp: Mò' efa wowèe ce a m ce too li rlii enɛ Àgabòs à m nàti mbekì, a laa à ŋger Yʉ' rara enɛ njè be koo à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ. Ca yi m koni à nfè' ce Klâdìyòs à m ce sa' bèe nà.
eng: One of them named Agabus stood up, and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a m kà'ni enɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be fa àmbò yi ŋger yi yu, tɛ a tuusi rfa anà nè bfʉr à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, jà' wowèe àgho.
eng: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

lmp: Wowèe a m gèe wa'a, a tuusi rfa anà nè Bànabàs ba Sôl, enɛ wowèe a du fa nè btu embe côr.
eng: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà ŋkʉʉ Hɛròd à koo ŋgâa cor mo' a ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ'.
eng: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

lmp: E m yʉ Jɛms ce e m ba nfʉr Jôn nè kàafà'.
eng: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

lmp: E ka' yɛ enɛ e gèe wa' nyor à boŋ Jûs, e koo Pità foŋ. Ca yi m koni à nfè' ce a m ce ye Ŋkâ' brɛ̂d ce a lɛ̀ yes njo ka'.
eng: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

lmp: E ka' koo ye, a fa ye mbe shaŋ. E m fa ye mbà mmbo bsoogɛ̀ ce a m ba bkʉr kyèe, bsoogɛ̀ a ba mbe kʉr e mo'sir bèe ŋkyèe, a ce kè'ni ye. E m ce kwà'shi enɛ a be ye Ŋkâ' càasi-mndap tɛ e ka' fʉr ye, sa' à mʉ̀ bèe.
eng: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison, and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

lmp: E m ku lɛ Pità mbe shaŋ; yi ka' ba wa'a, ŋgâa cor a ce loo nè ye nè mini- ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

lmp: À m ba nètʉ' ce tʉ̀' be raa tɛ Hɛròd fʉr ye embe shaŋ sa' nà, Pità à noŋ mbetar bsoogɛ̀ a baa, a cʉʉ ye nè bkwâŋ bbaa à mkoo. Bsoogɛ̀ ce a m ce kè'ni shaŋ a m tɛɛ à cûu ŋka' shaŋ.
eng: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

lmp: Ka' cu ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à nyɛ̂ɛ, rraa li raa mbe mʉ̀ shaŋ; e lipshì Pità nè bo à gee nyor, a yɛɛ ye efa mmirlò a laa enɛ̂, "Nàti mbekì cɛrcɛr." Bkwàŋ cà vi m gwèŋger efa yê mkoo.
eng: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side, and woke him up, saying, Stand up quickly! His chains fell off from his hands.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Kupshi wo bcɛ̀', yar wo blaba'." Pità à gee wa'a. E ker laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Yar wo mŋgàbʉlà, vʉ a mɛ̂ mbùu."
eng: The angel said to him, Get dressed and put on your sandals. He did so. He said to him, Put on your cloak, and follow me.

lmp: Pità à fʉʉ a du a yê mbùu a ke' riŋ enɛ yuu ce ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à m gèe anà yi m ba mini ka'. E m kwà'shi enɛ e ku yɛ yɛ.
eng: And he went out and followed him. He didn't know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' càa bsoogɛ̀ ce a m tɛɛ entòmbì ker ba bèe embenjì mo, a ba' à cùu ŋka' bkwàŋ ce a càa mbo niŋ ba à mʉ̀ la', yi mʉ'tì nè yi bo, wowèe a fʉ̂ʉ, a ka' ce jɛ̀r njep nduunjì mo', ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à ma'shì ye kâŋ mo'sir, a dû.
eng: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out, and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

lmp: Bfee Pità vi ka' kʉti mbo, e laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ rìŋ sè'ni nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Tata à tuusi yì ncìndap e fʉr mɛ̀ embà mmbo Hɛròd, a ker fʉr mɛ̀ efa ŋgɛ' ce Jus a m ce kè' enɛ e ba koni mɛ̀."
eng: When Peter had come to himself, he said, Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.

lmp: Pità à ka' rìŋ wa'a, a nati a du mbe ndàp mbe Mɛ̀ɛri, ma yì Jôn. A m ce too rlii Jôn mo' enɛ Mâk. Bèe magòr a m kaari mbo a ce gèe rloo.
eng: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John whose surname was Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

lmp: E ka' kùushi kèŋ enjep mbè, muunje ce e m ce fà' mbe ndàp anà ce a m ce too ye enɛ Rudà, a yu' a vʉ à ryu'shi enɛ ce kùu nda lɛ.
eng: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a maid named Rhoda came to answer.

lmp: E ka' yu' njèndoŋ Pità, rìŋ, a lu'shi sê, a mʉ' kèŋ ka', a caŋ a kʉti ba mbe ndàp, a laa enɛ̂, "Pità tɛɛ njep ncûu ŋka'."
eng: When she recognized Peter's voice, she didn't open the gate for joy, but ran in, and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

lmp: Wowèe a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Tu yi kar wɛ̀ embo." Muu anà à laa tatap se enɛ yi yu mini wa'a. Wowèe a laa enɛ̂, "Yu ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e ke kè'ni Pità."
eng: They said to her, You are crazy! But she insisted that it was so. They said, It is his angel.

lmp: Pità à ku ce kùushi kèŋ; wowèe a ka' mʉ̀', a yɛ ye, a bɛɛŋger sê.
eng: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him, and were amazed.

lmp: E ka' nàa bo mbekì enɛ wowèe a cu mʉnyaŋ, a suŋ wowèe àmbò Tata à fʉr ye embe shaŋ. E ka' mìsi, a laa enɛ̂, "Suŋ nè buu ca nè Jɛ̂ms, ba bfʉr mo' ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì." E laa wa'a, a fʉʉ, a du à dî' mo'.
eng: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, Tell these things to James, and to the brothers. Then he departed, and went to another place.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, bjep vi ba à mʉ̀ bsoogɛ̀ se njobè' wowèe a m rìŋ yuu ce yi m koni Pità ka'.
eng: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

lmp: Hɛròd à ka' ròo ye yɛ ka', a bipshi nè bsoogɛ̀ ce a m ce kè'ni ye nà. E ka' bipshi riŋ dì' e yu ka', a laa enɛ a yʉshi wowèe. E ka' làa wa'a, a natî à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà a du à rla' Sisàriyà, a cu àfo.
eng: When Herod had sought for him, and didn't find him, he examined the guards, and commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

lmp: Ntee yi m yaŋ Hɛròd nè bêe à rla' Tayà ba Sidòn wowèe a natì àbee a du à ryɛ ye. Wowèe a ka' dù bà', a loo Blâstòs ce e m ba ncìndap embe nto', a du a yɛ ŋkʉʉ a laa nè ye enɛ a wowèe a nashi buu, cu nè cumʉnyaŋ- ŋwɛ̀. A m làa wa'a njobè' yap to' yi m ce koni byee ba ese to' yî ŋkʉʉ anà.
eng: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him, and, having made Blastus, the king's personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king's country for food.

lmp: Nòŋ ce wowèe a m lɛ̀ yi ka' ghɛɛ, Hɛròd à yar bcɛ̂' kʉʉ a cu mbe kàbàrà', a laa nè wowèe.
eng: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

lmp: Wowèe a m fuŋ enɛ̂, "Cena yu ba njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀, a yì ŋwɛ̀ ka'."
eng: The people shouted, The voice of a god, and not of a man!

lmp: A ka' làa wa'a, ncìndap Tata Nyʉ̀ à tʉʉ ye nè yaŋ kâŋ mò'sir njobè' e m kù'si Nyʉ̀ ka'; mghòghò mi ye ye, e kwê.
eng: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn't give God the glory, and he was eaten by worms and died.

lmp: Blâa Nyʉ̀ vi m dù kùntombì, bèe magòr à yu' a byemi.
eng: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

lmp: Bànabàs ba Sol a ka' mìsi yuu ce wowèe a m dù à rgèe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, a kʉti. A ka' ce kʉti, a lor Jòn Mâk.
eng: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem, when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John whose surname was Mark.

lmp: Ŋgâa ryɛ'nì ba ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m ba mbe cor à rla' Antìyòk, à m ba Bànabàs ba Simìyòn ce a m ce too enɛ Ŋwɛ̂ Nsii, ker ba Lushôs à rla' Sàirên, ba Manɛ̀n ce e m kù' a Hɛròd ce e m be sa' njeptii ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr, ba Sôl.
eng: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce loo nè Tatâ, ce jì mdip ce gèe rloo, Yʉ' Rara yi laa enɛ̂, "Fʉr nè Bànabàs ba Sol efa wêe mʉ, tɛ a bo gèe rfà' ce mɛ̀ fʉr wowèe enɛ a gêe."
eng: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' jì mdip, ce gèe rloo wɛɛ, a lɛ map mmbo mbe wâp ndù, a ma'shi wowèe, wowèe a dû.
eng: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi ka' tuu wowèe, wowèe a natì a du à rla' Sɛ̀lushà, a lô àfo a niŋ mbe keŋ a du à to' Saipròs.
eng: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù bà' à rla' Sàlamìs, a fe'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à mndap rloo Jûs. Jôn à m ba a wowèe, tɛ e bo ce jà' wowèe.
eng: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed the word of God in the Jewish synagogues. They had also John as their attendant.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' jɛ̀r à to' ca wɛɛwɛ, bà' à rla' Pafòs, a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ fii mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Bâajisòs. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ Jus ce e m ce bo' bèe enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew, whose name was Bar Jesus,

lmp: E m ce fà' nè govanò ce a m ce too enɛ Sàjòs Polòs. À m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tʉr bfee sê. E m tuu bèe enɛ a du kɛ' Bànabàs ba Sôl, njobè' e m kòŋ à ryu' blâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fii anà ce a m ce too à li Grêk enɛ Ɛlemàs, à jepsì wowèe, a koŋ enɛ govanò byemi blàa ce wowèe a m fè'shi àmbò Jisòs nà ka'.
eng: But Elymas the sorcerer for so is his name by interpretation withstood them, seeking to turn aside the proconsul from the faith.

lmp: Sol ce a m ce too enɛ Pol foŋ nà, à ka' ruu nè Yʉ' Rara, a ke' ye a laa enɛ̂,
eng: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him,

lmp: "Wɛ̀ ce à yu muu nyʉ̀rkà', a baa buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu yɛɛnì, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ye kìŋgà, a ba ŋwɛ̀ mbo'ni a misî, â kòŋ à rborni efa rjepsi mini Tata ce e yu kùyɛɛ na ka' njokɛ?
eng: and said, Full of all deceit and all cunning, you son of the devil, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

lmp: Yɛ̂, Tata be fa wɛ̀ ŋgɛ'. À be fèp, kèr yɛ rlir nyʉ̀ ka' à mʉ nfè' mò'." E ka' làa wa'a, mbà' à tar ye à mmìr njà' mò'sir, mmir mi sii ye, e kɛ' a ce ròo ŋwɛ̀ ce e be ghashi ye à rkoo dù àgho.
eng: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season! Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

lmp: Govanò à ka' yɛ yuu ce yi koni, a byemi yuu ce Sol à m làa. E m bɛ̀ɛ ryɛ'nì ce a m yɛ'ni du kuu Tata na sê.
eng: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

lmp: Pol ba bèe ce a wowèe a m ce jɛ̀r, a m nàtî à rla' Pafòs a niŋ mbe keŋ a du à rla' Pɛgà à ŋgôŋ Pàmfilìyà. A ka' bà', Jôn à ma'shì wowèe a kʉti à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos, and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' nàtî à rla' Pɛgà a du a ba' à rla' Antìyòk à ŋgôŋ Pìsidìyà. À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Jûs, wowèe a niŋ mbe ndàp rloo a cu à nshè.
eng: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and sat down.

lmp: Bèe embe ndàp rloo a ka' bè' embe ŋwâ' mncir kèr bè' embe ŋwâ' ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, bèe ce a m ba btu embe ndàp rloo a tuu ŋwɛ̀ enɛ e laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bfʉr wêr, wèe à ka' tʉr ncep mò' à rfa nè bèe, wèe fa."
eng: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.

lmp: Pol à natì mbekì, a naa bo mbekì a laa enɛ̂, "Yà bèe Isrɛ̀l ker ba wèe ce wèe ce wɛp Nyʉ̀, yu' nè yuu ce m be làa.
eng: Paul stood up, and beckoning with his hand said, Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l ca à m ce visèe btâ, a gee ŋgʉ̀ yìsèe bèe à ku' à nfè' ce wowèe a m ba bkìlò à to' Ijìp. Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr wowêe à to' anà à yi ŋger,
eng: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

lmp: a ku ba a wowèe à rìŋ à bfè' mŋkyèe a ce kur ntee nè wowèe àfo.
eng: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

lmp: E ka' yʉshi bêe à bto' sàamba ce vi m ba à ŋgôŋ Kɛnàn, a fa ŋgòŋ anà à bti' nè yì bèe,
eng: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance, for about four hundred fifty years.

lmp: àmbò à bfè' mjèe kyèe ba nto'. À ka' ba embenjì ca, e fa wowèe ŋgâa nsa' mnsa', wowèe a sa' caar a ba' mbe nfè' yì Sâmwɛ̀l ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀.
eng: After these things he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' yì Sâmwɛ̀l, wowèe a laa enɛ Nyʉ̀ fa wowèe ŋkʉʉ, Nyʉ̀ à fa wowèe Sol ce e m ba muu Kîsh, ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ntɛ̀' yì Bɛnjamɛ̀n. E m sa' kʉʉ à bfè' mŋkyèe.
eng: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' sùusi ye embe kʉʉ, a ce Dɛvìd à yàp ŋkʉʉ. E m làa yuu a kuu ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ yɛ Dɛvìd muu Jɛsì e ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce e be gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce m kòŋ."
eng: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, 'I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.'

lmp: Yu ba embe ndʉ̀' ŋwɛ̀ ca ce Nyʉ̀ à fʉr ŋwɛ̀ ce e be gèe bèe a lûŋ, a fa nè bèe Isrɛ̀l àmbò e m kà' wowèe. Ŋwɛ̀ rlùŋ ca yu Jisòs.
eng: From this man's seed, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

lmp: Tɛ e ka' kè vʉ̀, Jôn à m fè'shi nè bèe Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ enɛ wowèe a kupse, ma'shi yàp buu bbebep tɛ a baptir wowèe.
eng: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

lmp: Jôn à ka' ce mìsi li rfà', a laa enɛ̂, "Wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ a mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ anà a? A mɛ̀ ye ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce vʉ̀ embe mɛ̂ njì, à ba ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à rbà'shi vi blaba' ka'."
eng: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, 'What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.'

lmp: "Bfʉr wâ, bèe embe ndʉ̀' Abràham ker ba wèe ce wèe ce wɛp Nyʉ̀, a tuusi nsuŋ rlùŋ ca ba nè sèe.
eng: Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

lmp: Bêe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ker ba bèe ce a ce sa' wowèe a rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Jisòs yu ka'. A m bè' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m saŋ à mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, wowèe a yu' a riŋ vi ka'. Àmbò yi yu wa' nà, yuu ce a m bè' anà yi m ku ghɛɛte mbe nfè' ce a m sa' vi mnsa' a teni enɛ a yʉ ye nà.
eng: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn't know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

lmp: Ka' wowèe a m tʉr yuu mo' ce àde' a m ba noŋ mbenjì mo, yʉ ye ka' wa'a, wowèe a m làa nè Pailɛ̀t enɛ a yʉ ye.
eng: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ a be kè gèe nè ye nà, a suusi ye embe ce, a lɛ njep rshè.
eng: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree, and laid him in a tomb.

lmp: Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr ye efa rkwe,
eng: But God raised him from the dead,

lmp: e yɛɛtì nè bèe ce a wowèe a m jɛ̂r à ŋgôŋ Galèlê, a du a ba' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m nà, à mnòŋ àŋgoo. Wowèe a ce suŋ yìsèe bèe sè'ni àmbò ye.
eng: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

lmp: Wèr à vʉ̀ àfa à rsuŋ wèe Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à fʉr Jisòs efa rkwe. Banɛ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be gèe nè visèe bta nà,
eng: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

lmp: e gèe yuu anà ba nè sèe ce sèe yu boo wap. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe bkʉ̀kʉ̂ bbaa embe Ŋwâ' Byɛɛ. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "À yu muu wà, kɛ̂' ntìni, m yu yo tâ."
eng: that God has fulfilled the same to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, 'You are my Son. Today I have become your father.'

lmp: Ca yu yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m laa àmbò rfʉʉ ce yi m ba enɛ e be kè fʉʉ efa kwe kèr dù mbà yir bʉ̀te ka' nà. E m làa enɛ̂, "M be fa wɛ̀ buu brara ce mɛ̀ m kà' nè Dɛvìd, rtarnì li ba njo ka' nà."
eng: Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: 'I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.'

lmp: Pol ba Bànabàs a ka' ce fʉʉ embe ndàp rloo, bèe anà a bu' mmbo nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a ker vʉ à mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ekô ker suŋ wowèe buu anà.
eng: So when the Jews went out of the synagogue, the Gentiles begged that these words might be preached to them the next Sabbath.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' fʉʉse ce dùse, Jus magòr se ker ba bèe mo' enje jɛɛ ce a m byemi nè Nyʉ̀ Jûs, a du àmbùu Pol ba Bànabàs. Pol ba Bànabàs a de' a wowèe, a fa wowèe ŋger enɛ wowèe a ku ce yu' ba ese Nyʉ̀ tɛ e be tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè wowèe.
eng: Now when the synagogue broke up, many of the Jews and of the devout proselytes followed Paul and Barnabas; who, speaking to them, urged them to continue in the grace of God.

lmp: À ka' ba à mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀ ekô, to' bìi yi ku ròo fʉʉ wɛɛwɛ à ryu' blâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: The next Sabbath almost the whole city was gathered together to hear the word of God.

lmp: Jus a ka' yɛ ku' bèe ca, a ko'ndoŋ, a sɛr yuu ce Pol à m làa, a cɛp ye.
eng: But when the Jews saw the multitudes, they were filled with jealousy, and contradicted the things which were spoken by Paul, and blasphemed.

lmp: Pol ba Bànabàs a ker laa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Yi m ba yɛɛnì enɛ wèr fe'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wèe entombì. Àmbò wèe à kani a lor enɛ wèe à ghɛɛte à rkoni ryòŋ ce nfesè ka' na, banɛ wèr be mà'shi wèe, fè'shi ba nè bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: Paul and Barnabas spoke out boldly, and said, It was necessary that God's word should be spoken to you first. Since indeed you thrust it from you, and judge yourselves unworthy of eternal life, behold, we turn to the Gentiles.

lmp: Ca yu ba yuu ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à làa nè wèr enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ gèe wɛ̀, wɛ̀ ba rraa nè bèe enje jɛɛ, tɛ à bo ba nduunjî rlùŋ nè ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ." "
eng: For so has the Lord commanded us, saying, 'I have set you as a light for the Gentiles, that you should bring salvation to the uttermost parts of the earth.'

lmp: Bèe enje jɛɛ a ka' yu' ca, a lu'shi sê, a ku'si Tata à vi blàa. Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce enɛ a bo koni ryòŋ ce nfesè a m byemi.
eng: As the Gentiles heard this, they were glad, and glorified the word of God. As many as were appointed to eternal life believed.

lmp: Blâa Tata vi m dù à ŋgòŋ anà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The Lord's word was spread abroad throughout all the region.

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Jus a m barsi bbyèŋge ŋgâa mlii ce a m ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ker ba mmbaŋrù ce a m ba bêe bgòrgôr à rla' anà, wowèe a fa ŋgɛ' nè Pol ba Bànabàs, a juu wowèe efa yap ŋgòŋ.
eng: But the Jews stirred up the devout and prominent women and the chief men of the city, and stirred up a persecution against Paul and Barnabas, and threw them out of their borders.

lmp: Pol wèe a ka' ce dù, a kashi nfʉ̀nfʉ efa map mkùu nè wowèe, a du à rla' Ìkonìyòm.
eng: But they shook off the dust of their feet against them, and came to Iconium.

lmp: Bèe ce a m byemi nè Jisòs à rla' Antìyòk a m ku lu'shi sê, a ruu nè Yʉ' Rara.
eng: The disciples were filled with joy with the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' à rla' Ìkonìyòm, a niŋ mbe ndap rloo Jus àmbò a m niŋ à rla' Antìyòk nà, a fe'shi bòŋboŋ sê. Jus magòr sê, ker ba bèe enje jɛɛ a byemì.
eng: It happened in Iconium that they entered together into the synagogue of the Jews, and so spoke that a great multitude both of Jews and of Greeks believed.

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Jus ce a m byemi ka', a m barsi bèe enje jɛɛ, a karsi wap btu, a gee wowèe a baa bfʉr.
eng: But the disbelieving Jews stirred up and embittered the souls of the Gentiles against the brothers.

lmp: Pol wèe a m lòr nfè' a cu àfo a ce fè'shi àmbò Tatâ, nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀. Tata à m fa wowèe ŋger, wowèe a duŋshì mncòo, a gee buu bbɛ̀ɛ à rdùŋshi enɛ yuu ce wowèe a m ce fè'shi àmbò rbôŋ Nyʉ̀ yi yu mini.
eng: Therefore they stayed there a long time, speaking boldly in the Lord, who testified to the word of his grace, granting signs and wonders to be done by their hands.

lmp: Bêe à rla' anà a m fʉʉ nto'nì baa, bèe mo' a du à ŋgʉ̀' yì Jûs, bèe mo' a du à ŋgʉ̀' yì ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs.
eng: But the multitude of the city was divided. Part sided with the Jews, and part with the apostles.

lmp: Bèe enje jɛɛ ba Jûs, ker ba bèe ce a m ba btu nè wowèe, a kwa'shì a byemi enɛ a be jar nè ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs, tʉʉshi wowèe nè blùr.
eng: When some of both the Gentiles and the Jews, with their rulers, made a violent attempt to mistreat and stone them,

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu', a caŋ a du a ŋgôŋ Lìkonìyà, a ka' bà', a du à rla' Listrà ba Dɛbè, ba mla' ce mi m ba àgee mla' ca,
eng: they became aware of it, and fled to the cities of Lycaonia, Lystra, Derbe, and the surrounding region.

lmp: a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àfo.
eng: There they preached the Good News.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba à rla' Listrà ce e m kepŋger. E m ku ba wa'a kɛ' embe nfè' ce a m bi ye. E m be jɛr ka'.
eng: At Lystra a certain man sat, impotent in his feet, a cripple from his mother's womb, who never had walked.

lmp: E m yu' àmbò Pol ce làa. Pol à ke' ye a yɛ enɛ e tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rbyemì ce àde' li gee ye e jɛ̂r.
eng: He was listening to Paul speaking, who, fastening eyes on him, and seeing that he had faith to be made whole,

lmp: E ka' yɛ wa'a, a laa mbekì enɛ̂, "Nàti, tɛɛ mbekì." Ŋwɛ̀ anà a nyɛɛ mbekì, a kɛ' a ce jɛ̀r.
eng: said with a loud voice, Stand upright on your feet! He leaped up and walked.

lmp: Kʉr bèe a ka' yɛ yuu ce Pol à m gèe na, a waa, a laa à li Lìkonìyà enɛ̂, "Mnyʉ̀ vi kʉti àmbò bèe wa'a, a vʉ fa sêe mʉ."
eng: When the multitude saw what Paul had done, they lifted up their voice, saying in the language of Lycaonia, The gods have come down to us in the likeness of men!

lmp: Wowèe a m too Bànabàs enɛ Siyùs, a too Pol enɛ Hɛmɛ̀, njobè' a ye ce e m ce làa yi buu gòr.
eng: They called Barnabas Jupiter, and Paul Mercury, because he was the chief speaker.

lmp: Ndap Siyùs à m ba àgee rla'. Ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì nè nyʉ̀ anà à vʉ nè nà' ba fʉ̀lawà njep cûu ŋka' njobè' ye ker ba yì bèe a m ce kòŋ à rtaŋshi taŋshì nè ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs.
eng: The priest of Jupiter, whose temple was in front of their city, brought oxen and garlands to the gates, and would have made a sacrifice along with the multitudes.

lmp: Bànabàs ba Pol a ka' yu' yuu ce bèe ca a m ce ròo à rgèe nè wowèe, a shashi wap bcɛ̀', a caŋ a niŋ mbe wâp mʉ, a laa mbekì enɛ̂,
eng: But when the apostles, Barnabas and Paul, heard of it, they tore their clothes, and sprang into the multitude, crying out,

lmp: "Yèr bèe, wèe ce gèe wa' njokɛ? Wèr yu bèe àmbò wèe. Wèr à vʉ̀ à rfè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wèe tɛ wèe bo mà'shi buu bcicì ca, byemi ba nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe, à ba Nyʉ̀ ce e m boo rbuu ba nshe ba mdip ker ba buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Men, why are you doing these things? We also are men of like passions with you, and bring you good news, that you should turn from these vain things to the living God, who made the sky and the earth and the sea, and all that is in them;

lmp: Ka' wowèe a m làa buu ca wa'a, wowèe a m lòr nfè' se à rgèe enɛ bèe ca a borni efa rtaŋshi taŋshì nè wowèe.
eng: Even saying these things, they hardly stopped the multitudes from making a sacrifice to them.

lmp: Jus mo' a lo a vʉ̂ à rla' Antìyòk ba Ìkonìyòm, a ka' bèesi mntee ese bèe, a wowèe bsìp a tʉʉshì Pol nè blùr, a ka' kwà'shi enɛ e kwe, a sʉŋ à nshè a fʉʉ àgho efa là'.
eng: But some Jews from Antioch and Iconium came there, and having persuaded the multitudes, they stoned Paul, and dragged him out of the city, supposing that he was dead.

lmp: Ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a ka' vʉ̀ mbe yê ndù, e natì mbekì a kʉti à mʉ̀ rla'. Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, a Bànabàs a natì a du à rla' Dɛbè.
eng: But as the disciples stood around him, he rose up, and entered into the city. On the next day he went out with Barnabas to Derbe.

lmp: Wowèe a m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ à rla' anà, a gee bèe magòr a byemì, a ba ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs. A ka' mìsi, a kʉti a caa rla' Listrà ba Ìkonìyòm, a ba' à rla' Antìyòk à ŋgôŋ Pìsidìyà.
eng: When they had preached the Good News to that city, and had made many disciples, they returned to Lystra, Iconium, and Antioch,

lmp: Wowèe a m fa ŋger nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisos à mla' anà, a ce làa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a tɛɛ tatap njep rbyemì. A m làa enɛ̂, "Sèe be kù yɛ ŋgɛ' wɛɛ ka' niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀."
eng: confirming the souls of the disciples, exhorting them to continue in the faith, and that through many afflictions we must enter into the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce btu embe cor nè bcor wɛɛwɛ à mla' anà, a ce loo ce jì mdip, ce fa wowèe mbà mmbo Tata ce wowèe a m byemi nè ye nà.
eng: When they had appointed elders for them in every assembly, and had prayed with fasting, they commended them to the Lord, on whom they had believed.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' càa ŋgôŋ Pìsidìyà, a ba' à ŋgôŋ Pàmfilìyà,
eng: They passed through Pisidia, and came to Pamphylia.

lmp: a fe'shi blàa Tata à rla' Pɛgà, a nati a du à rla' Àtalìyà.
eng: When they had spoken the word in Perga, they went down to Attalia.

lmp: Wowèe a natî àfo, a niŋ mbe keŋ a du à rla' Antìyòk, fàdì' ce a m fa wowèe mbà mmbo Nyʉ̀ tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo kè'ni wowèe, tɛ wowèe a gee rfà' ce wowèe a m gèe a misi nà.
eng: From there they sailed to Antioch, from where they had been committed to the grace of God for the work which they had fulfilled.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà', a kɛ' ŋgâa cor wɛɛwɛ, a suŋ wowèe buu ce wowèe a m gèe à ŋger Nyʉ̀. A m suŋ wowèe àmbò Nyʉ̀ à fa fɛŋ nè bèe enje jɛɛ à rbyemì.
eng: When they had arrived, and had gathered the assembly together, they reported all the things that God had done with them, and that he had opened a door of faith to the nations.

lmp: Wowèe a m cu àfo a ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisos wèe à nfè' njìsàp.
eng: They stayed there with the disciples for a long time.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m lô Jùdiyà a vʉ a ce yɛ'ni bfʉr enɛ̂, "A ka' tɛ gèe wèe bʉ̀ àmbò ncir Musìs yi làa ka', àde' wèe konì rlùŋ ka'."
eng: Some men came down from Judea and taught the brothers, Unless you are circumcised after the custom of Moses, you can't be saved.

lmp: Ca yi m gèe Pol ba Bànabàs a ba à yuu yi mo'sir a wowèe ka' koo mʉcàr, a sɛr nsɛr a wowèe. Yi ka' ba wa'a, ŋgâa cor a ce Pol ba Bànabàs, ba bèe mo', enɛ a du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, yɛ ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ba btu embe cor enɛ a wowèe a seesi yuu ce a be gèe.
eng: Therefore when Paul and Barnabas had no small discord and discussion with them, they appointed Paul and Barnabas, and some others of them, to go up to Jerusalem to the apostles and elders about this question.

lmp: Cor à ka' tuu wowèe wa'a, wowèe a du a caa à ŋgôŋ Fònishà ba Sàmarìyà, a suŋ bèe enɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a kupse, a byemi nè Nyʉ̀. Nsuŋ ca à m gèe bfʉr wɛɛwɛ a lu'shì sê.
eng: They, being sent on their way by the assembly, passed through both Phoenicia and Samaria, declaring the conversion of the Gentiles. They caused great joy to all the brothers.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bà' à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m, cor ba ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ker ba btu embe cor a konì wowèe. Pol wèe a suŋ wowèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ a gèe njì enjep wowèe.
eng: When they had come to Jerusalem, they were received by the assembly and the apostles and the elders, and they reported all things that God had done with them.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ Farìsi ce a m byemi, a m natì mbekì a laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu enɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a ku tʉr à rgèe bʉ̀, tɛ a ker suŋ wowèe enɛ wowèe a lɛ mncir Musìs."
eng: But some of the sect of the Pharisees who believed rose up, saying, It is necessary to circumcise them, and to command them to keep the law of Moses.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ba btu embe cor a m cute, tɛ a bo sèesi yuu ce a be gèe.
eng: The apostles and the elders were gathered together to see about this matter.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' lòr ku' nfè', sèesi yuu ce a be gèe, Pità à natì mbekì a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Bfʉr wâ, wèe rìŋ enɛ à m ba efa rkɛ̀', Nyʉ̀ à ce mɛ̀ tɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a bo yu' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ eku mɛ̂ cùu, byemi.
eng: When there had been much discussion, Peter rose up and said to them, Brothers, you know that a good while ago God made a choice among you, that by my mouth the nations should hear the word of the Good News, and believe.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e rìŋ yuu ce yi yu njep ntee ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à m dùŋshi enɛ e m koo wowèe à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e fa Yʉ' Rara nè wowèe àmbò e m fa nè sèe foŋ nà.
eng: God, who knows the heart, testified about them, giving them the Holy Spirit, just like he did to us.

lmp: E m ker yɛ wowèe a ba jɛɛ efa sèe ka'. E m gèe wap mntee vi ba brara foŋ njo' lap rbyemì.
eng: He made no distinction between us and them, cleansing their hearts by faith.

lmp: À ka' ba njokɛ sè'ni ce wèe ce kòŋ à rmòoshi Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèe ce lɛ̀ ntɛ̀r mbendù ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs, ce ka' wèr kɛ̀ wer bta ɛ̀, a m tʉr ŋger à rbyɛ̀' ka'.
eng: Now therefore why do you tempt God, that you should put a yoke on the neck of the disciples which neither our fathers nor we were able to bear?

lmp: Sèe à byemi enɛ yu ba njo' ntee bòŋboŋ Tata Jisòs ce sèe be kè lùŋ àmbò wowèe a be kè lùŋ njo' li foŋ nà."
eng: But we believe that we are saved through the grace of the Lord Jesus, just as they are.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m cu mʉnyaŋ a ce yu'shi yuu ce Bànabàs ba Pol a m ce suŋ kuu mncòo ba buu bbɛ̀ɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe à mʉ̀ bèe enje jɛɛ njì enjep wowèe.
eng: All the multitude kept silence, and they listened to Barnabas and Paul reporting what signs and wonders God had done among the nations through them.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' làa mìsi, Jɛms à beesì enɛ̂, "Bfʉr wâ, yu' nè yuu ce m be làa.
eng: After they were silent, James answered, Brothers, listen to me.

lmp: Saimʉ̀n à suŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ̀' a duŋshi ntee ce e m lɛ̀ njep bèe enje jɛɛ a fʉr bèe mo' efa wowèe à yì bèe.
eng: Simeon has reported how God first visited the nations, to take out of them a people for his name.

lmp: Yuu ce e làa na yi ghɛɛte à yuu ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m làa. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂,
eng: This agrees with the words of the prophets. As it is written,

lmp: Ca yi be càa wɛɛ, tɛ m kʉti, bà'ri ndap Dɛvìd ce e gwè. M be bà'ri ndap ce e sà'ŋger na, gèe tɛ e ba àmbò e m ba,
eng: After these things I will return. I will again build the tabernacle of David, which has fallen. I will again build its ruins. I will set it up,

lmp: tɛ bɛr bèe ce yu bèe enje jɛ̀ɛ ce mɛ̀ gèe wowèe a ba yà bèe a bo ròo Tatâ.
eng: That the rest of men may seek after the Lord; All the Gentiles who are called by my name, Says the Lord, who does all these things.

lmp: Ca ce làa ba Tata ce e m gèe bèe a riŋ ca elûuŋgòŋ sê.
eng: All his works are known to God from eternity.'

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ya mɛnɛ sèe fa gèe tɛ buu ba btatap nè bèe enje jɛɛ ce a ce kupse ce byemi nè Nyʉ̀ nà ka'.
eng: Therefore my judgment is that we don't trouble those from among the Gentiles who turn to God,

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ker ba btu embe cor ba cor wɛɛwɛ, a yɛ enɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ à rce bèe mò' efa wâp mʉ, tɛ a bo tuu wowèe a Pol wèe à rla' Antìyòk. Wowèe a m ce Judàs ce li rlii mo' li m ba enɛ Bàsabàs, ker ba Silàs. Wowèe a m ba boo mlii à mʉ bfʉr.
eng: Then it seemed good to the apostles and the elders, with the whole assembly, to choose men out of their company, and send them to Antioch with Paul and Barnabas: Judas called Barsabbas, and Silas, chief men among the brothers.

lmp: A m tuu wowèe nè ŋwà' ce a m saŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa ntuu Jisos ba btu embe cor ce a yu bfʉr wee a saŋ ŋwà' ca, a ca'ni bfʉr enje jɛɛ ce a ce cu à rla' Antìyòk, ba Sirìyà, ker ba Sìlesìyà.
eng: They wrote these things by their hand: The apostles, the elders, and the brothers, to the brothers who are of the Gentiles in Antioch, Syria, and Cilicia: greetings.

lmp: Wèr à yu' wernɛ bèe mo' a lô efa wêr mʉ a jepsi wèe nè buu ce wowèe a m làa, wèe à riŋ yuu ce wèe tɛɛ mbendù mo ka'. Wèr à m fa wowèe ŋger à rlàa buu anà ka'.
eng: Because we have heard that some who went out from us have troubled you with words, unsettling your souls, saying, 'You must be circumcised and keep the law,' to whom we gave no commandment;

lmp: Wèr à ka' yu', a yɛ enɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ nè wèr à rce bèe, tuu tɛ a vʉ yɛ wèe. Wowèe a be vʉ̀ a Bànabàs ba Pol ce yu bkar wer sê,
eng: it seemed good to us, having come to one accord, to choose out men and send them to you with our beloved Barnabas and Paul,

lmp: à ba bèe ce a tami nyor à rkwe àtu yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis.
eng: men who have risked their lives for the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Banɛ wèr ce tuu Judàs ba Silàs. Wowèe a be suŋ wèe buu ce wèr à saŋ na, nè yap cùu foŋ.
eng: We have sent therefore Judas and Silas, who themselves will also tell you the same things by word of mouth.

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi yɛ, wer wèr foŋ à yɛ enɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ wèr ker lɛ ntɛ̀r mo' mbe wêe ndù caa efa mʉ mncir ce wèr be suŋ wèe enɛ wèe lɛ na ka'.
eng: For it seemed good to the Holy Spirit, and to us, to lay no greater burden on you than these necessary things:

lmp: Wèe fa ye byee ce a fa nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Wèe fa no blɛɛ ka'. Wèe fa ye mnyàa ce a toosi mndoŋ efa gho vi kweŋgèr ka', ker borni bsàkì. Wèe à ka' borni buu ca, banɛ wèe à gèe bòŋboŋ. Sèe à bɛr."
eng: that you abstain from things sacrificed to idols, from blood, from things strangled, and from sexual immorality, from which if you keep yourselves, it will be well with you. Farewell.

lmp: A m mà'shi wowèe, wowèe a natì a du à rla' Antìyòk, a ka' bà', a baashi ŋgâa rbyemì wɛɛwɛ mbe dî' mo'sir, a fa ŋwà' anà nè wowèe.
eng: So, when they were sent off, they came to Antioch. Having gathered the multitude together, they delivered the letter.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' bè', a lu'shi à njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ce ŋwà' anà yi fa wowèe.
eng: When they had read it, they rejoiced over the encouragement.

lmp: Judàs ba Silàs ce a m ba ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ foŋ, a m làa buu gòr se à rfa wowèe ŋger tɛ wowèe a bo tap.
eng: Judas and Silas, also being prophets themselves, encouraged the brothers with many words, and strengthened them.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' cu àfo à mʉ nfè' mò', bfʉr a daasì wowèe enɛ wowèe a du bòŋboŋ, du yɛ bèe ce a m tuu wowèe.
eng: After they had spent some time there, they were sent back with greetings from the brothers to the apostles.

lmp: Pol ba Bànabàs a m cu à rla' Antìyòk a ce yɛ'ni a ker ce fè'shi blâa Tata a ku' bèe mo' wèe.
eng: But Paul and Barnabas stayed in Antioch, teaching and preaching the word of the Lord, with many others also.

lmp: Mʉ mnòŋ mo' vi ka' tuuse, Pol à laa nè Bànabàs enɛ̂, "Sò kʉti ca'ni bfʉr ce a yu à bbu' mla' ce sò à m fè'shi blâa Tata àfo nà, yɛ enɛ wowèe a ku cu yɛɛnì lɛ."
eng: After some days Paul said to Barnabas, Let's return now and visit our brothers in every city in which we proclaimed the word of the Lord, to see how they are doing.

lmp: Bànabàs à m ce kòŋ enɛ wowèe a du a Jòn Mak wèe.
eng: Barnabas planned to take John, who was called Mark, with them also.

lmp: Pol à kwa'shì enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ a wowèe a du ka' njobè' Jòn Mak à m mà'shi wowèe à ŋkʉ̀ rfà' à ŋgôŋ Pàmfilìyà a du yi yu.
eng: But Paul didn't think that it was a good idea to take with them someone who had withdrawn from them in Pamphylia, and didn't go with them to do the work.

lmp: Wowèe a m ba bcùu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ sê, a gapni. Bànabàs à lor Jòn Mâk, a ye a niŋ mbe keŋ a du à to' Saipròs.
eng: Then the contention grew so sharp that they separated from each other. Barnabas took Mark with him, and sailed away to Cyprus,

lmp: Pol à ce Silàs, a ye a dû. Bfʉr a m fa wowèe mbe mmbo Nyʉ̀, tɛ Tata Nyʉ̀ bo kè'ni wowèe.
eng: but Paul chose Silas, and went out, being commended by the brothers to the grace of God.

lmp: E m dù a caa à ŋgôŋ Sirìyà ba Sìlesìyà, a ka' ce càa a ce fa ŋger nè bcôr.
eng: He went through Syria and Cilicia, strengthening the assemblies.

lmp: Pol à du a ba' à rla' Dɛbè, a du à rla' Listrà. Ŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni buu Jisos mò' à m ba àfo, a too ye enɛ Timotì. Yì ma à m ba ŋwɛ̀ Jus ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì, yì ta à ba yi ŋwɛ̀ Grês.
eng: He came to Derbe and Lystra: and behold, a certain disciple was there, named Timothy, the son of a Jewess who believed; but his father was a Greek.

lmp: Bfʉr ce a m ba à rla' Listrà ba Ìkonìyòm a m làa buu bbòŋboŋ àmbò ye sê.
eng: The brothers who were at Lystra and Iconium gave a good testimony about him.

lmp: Pol à m ce kòŋ enɛ a Timotì a dû, yi ka' ba wa'a, a gee ye bʉ̀ njobè' Jus wɛɛwɛ ce a m ba à bdì' anà a m rìŋ enɛ yì ta yu ŋwɛ̀ Grês.
eng: Paul wanted to have him go out with him, and he took and circumcised him because of the Jews who were in those parts; for they all knew that his father was a Greek.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce dù ce càa à mla' anà, a ce suŋ bêe àfo buu ce ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ba btu embe cor à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a m sèesi a laa enɛ wowèe a gêe. A m làa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a gee buu anà.
eng: As they went on their way through the cities, they delivered the decrees to them to keep which had been ordained by the apostles and elders who were at Jerusalem.

lmp: Ca yi m gèe bcor wɛɛwɛ vi misì a tap à rbyemì, a ce kù' à bèe à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: So the assemblies were strengthened in the faith, and increased in number daily.

lmp: Wowèe a m nàti a caa à ŋgôŋ Frijìyà ba Gàlɛshà, njobè' Yʉ' Rara yi m kani wowèe efa rfè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à ŋgôŋ Ɛshà.
eng: When they had gone through the region of Phrygia and Galatia, they were forbidden by the Holy Spirit to speak the word in Asia.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce bà' njep ndèe ŋgôŋ Misìyà, a ce tà' à rdù à ŋgôŋ Bìtinìyà, Yʉ' Jisòs yi ma'shì enɛ wowèe a du ka'.
eng: When they had come opposite Mysia, they tried to go into Bithynia, but the Spirit didn't allow them.

lmp: Wowèe a m càa njî à ŋgôŋ Misìyà a du a ba' à rla' Trowàs.
eng: Passing by Mysia, they came down to Troas.

lmp: À ka' ba nètʉ', Pol à yɛ yuu mo' àmbò rlo wa'a. E m yɛ àmbò ŋwɛ̂ à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà à tɛɛ, a ce bu' mmbo nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà, ja' wèr."
eng: A vision appeared to Paul in the night. There was a man of Macedonia standing, begging him, and saying, Come over into Macedonia and help us.

lmp: Pol à ka' yɛ wa'a, wèr à roo nduunjì à rdù à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà, njobè' wèr à m rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' wèr enɛ wèr fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wowèe.
eng: When he had seen the vision, immediately we sought to go out to Macedonia, concluding that the Lord had called us to preach the Good News to them.

lmp: Wèr à ka' lô à rla' Trowàs, a niŋ mbe keŋ, a dû, a tɛɛ à dì' mo' ka', caar a ba' à rla' Sòmatɛrɛ̀s. Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, wèr à ba' à rla' Nìyapolìs.
eng: Setting sail therefore from Troas, we made a straight course to Samothrace, and the day following to Neapolis;

lmp: Wèr à ka' lô àfo, a du a ba' à rla' Filèpâi. À m ba rla' ce bàrà' ce a m vʉ̂ Rum a m ce sa'. À m ba rla' rgôr à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà. Wèr à m cu àfo à mnòŋ àŋgoo.
eng: and from there to Philippi, which is a city of Macedonia, the foremost of the district, a Roman colony. We were staying some days in this city.

lmp: À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa, wèr à fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ la' a ce du àwâa rò, a ce kwà'shi enɛ wèr be yɛ dì' rloo àfo. Wèr à ka' bà', a cu à nshè, a laa nè bbyèŋge ce a m vʉ̀ à rgèe rloo àfo.
eng: On the Sabbath day we went forth outside of the city by a riverside, where we supposed there was a place of prayer, and we sat down, and spoke to the women who had come together.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bbyèŋge ca ce a m ce too enɛ Lidìyà a m yu' yuu ce wèr à m làa. À m ba ŋwɛ̂ à rla' Tàitirà, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce fyèni bcɛ̀' ce vi m lùu ntaa. À m ba njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce loo nè Nyʉ̀. Nyʉ̀ à m mʉ̀' yi ntee, e byemì blâa Nyʉ̀ ce Pol à m fè'shi.
eng: A certain woman named Lydia, a seller of purple, of the city of Thyatira, one who worshiped God, heard us; whose heart the Lord opened to listen to the things which were spoken by Paul.

lmp: A m bàptir ye ker ba bèe embe yê ndàp, a ka' mìsi, e be wèr enɛ wèr vʉ mbe yê ndàp. E m làa enɛ̂, "Wèe à ka' yɛ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ mɛ̀ byemi nè Tatâ, wèe vʉ cu mbe mɛ̂ ndàp." E m làa nè wèr caar, wèr wowèe a dû.
eng: When she and her household were baptized, she begged us, saying, If you have judged me to be faithful to the Lord, come into my house, and stay. So she persuaded us.

lmp: À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mò', wèr à ce dù à rgèe rloo. A tarte wèr muunje mò' ce e m ba ŋkwàa. Njɛ̀ɛ yʉ' mo' yi m ba njep ye, a ce gèe e ce suŋ bèe buu ce vi bii ka' ba. E m ce kap ku' mbàa nè bèe ce a m yuu ye sê, njobè' e m ce suŋ bèe buu anà.
eng: It happened, as we were going to prayer, that a certain girl having a spirit of divination met us, who brought her masters much gain by fortune telling.

lmp: E m dù àmbùu wèr Pol wèe, a ce fuŋ enɛ̂, "Bèe ca yu ŋgâa mfà' nè Nyʉ̂ ŋgòr. A ce suŋ wèe njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' wèe gee ka' lûŋ."
eng: Following Paul and us, she cried out, These men are servants of the Most High God, who proclaim to us a way of salvation!

lmp: E m fuŋ wa' à mnòŋ àŋgoo, ntee yi yaŋ Pôl, e karsì nyor a ke' ye, a laa nè yʉ' ce yi m ba njep ye anà enɛ̂, "M ce làa nè wɛ̀ à rlii Jisos Krâis enɛ à fʉʉ enjep ye." E ka' làa wa'a, yʉ' anà yi ku fʉʉ à nfè' anà.
eng: She was doing this for many days. But Paul, becoming greatly annoyed, turned and said to the spirit, I command you in the name of Jesus Christ to come out of her! It came out that very hour.

lmp: Bèe ce a m tʉr ŋkwàa ca a ka' yɛ enɛ njì mò' ker ba àgho nè wowèe à rkap mbàa ka', wowèe a koo Pol ba Silàs a sʉŋ a du àgho à ntaa, a fa wowèe nè ŋgâa sa' to'.
eng: But when her masters saw that the hope of their gain was gone, they seized Paul and Silas, and dragged them into the marketplace before the rulers.

lmp: A m vʉ̀ nè wowèe kùntombì nè ŋgâa nsa' mnsa' a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe ca yu Jûs. Wowèe a ce jepsi lisèe rla'.
eng: When they had brought them to the magistrates, they said, These men, being Jews, are agitating our city,

lmp: Wowèe a ce yɛ'ni ndèe to' mò' ce yisèe ncir yi byemi enɛ sèe gee ka'. Sèe yu yisèe bêe à to' Rûm."
eng: and set forth customs which it is not lawful for us to accept or to observe, being Romans.

lmp: Kʉr bèe ce a m ba àfo a m niŋ njep mʉ̀ mo, a baa Pol wèe foŋ. Ŋgâa nsa' mnsa' a m shàshi bcɛ̀' efa nyòr Pol ba Silàs, a laa enɛ a lip wowèe nè mbàŋ.
eng: The multitude rose up together against them, and the magistrates tore their clothes off of them, and commanded them to be beaten with rods.

lmp: A ka' lìp wowèe bòŋboŋ, a fa wowèe mbe shaŋ, a laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kè'ni shaŋ enɛ e ke'ni wowèe bòŋboŋ.
eng: When they had laid many stripes on them, they threw them into prison, charging the jailer to keep them safely,

lmp: A ka' làa nè ye wa'a, e lɛ wowèe mbà mʉ̀ ndap embe shaŋ, a taa wowèe à bù'.
eng: who, having received such a command, threw them into the inner prison, and secured their feet in the stocks.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò nè ntee tʉ' wa'a, Pol ba Silàs a ce gèe rloo a ce yɛɛ byɛɛ nè Nyʉ̀, ŋgâa shaŋ a cu a ce yu'shi.
eng: But about midnight Paul and Silas were praying and singing hymns to God, and the prisoners were listening to them.

lmp: Ka' cu ŋgòŋ yi ci'tì, a ci' kûu shaŋ foŋ. Bkèŋ shaŋ vi mʉ'ŋgèr njà' mò'sir, bkwàŋ vi gweŋgêr à mkoo ŋgâa shaŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Suddenly there was a great earthquake, so that the foundations of the prison were shaken; and immediately all the doors were opened, and everyone's bonds were loosened.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce kè'ni shaŋ à ka' lɛ' efa mmirlò yɛ enɛ bkèŋ shaŋ vi mʉ̀'ŋger, e co' kàafà' enɛ e bo yʉ yì nyor àgho njobè' e m ce kwà'shi enɛ ŋgâa shaŋ a fʉʉse embe shaŋ a caŋ a duse.
eng: The jailer, being roused out of sleep and seeing the prison doors open, drew his sword and was about to kill himself, supposing that the prisoners had escaped.

lmp: Pol à waa enɛ̂, "Fa bɛɛsi yò nyor ka'! Wèr ku ba tâa wɛɛwɛ!"
eng: But Paul cried with a loud voice, saying, Don't harm yourself, for we are all here!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rkè'ni shaŋ anà à laa enɛ a bɛrsi mor fa nè ye. A ka' bɛrsi fa nè ye, e caŋ a du mbe shaŋ, a gwè njeptii Pol ba Silàs, a ce kàŋ.
eng: He called for lights and sprang in, and, fell down trembling before Paul and Silas,

lmp: A ka' nàti mbekì, a fʉr wowèe njepmbè a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Masà wèe, yuu ce àde' m gee ka' luŋ yu kɛ?"
eng: and brought them out and said, Sirs, what must I do to be saved?

lmp: Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "Byemi nè Tata Jisòs tɛ à bo luŋ, wɛ̀ ker ba bèe embe wɛ̂ ndàp."
eng: They said, Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved, you and your household.

lmp: A m fè'shi blâa Tata nè ye ker ba nè bèe wɛɛwɛ embe yê ndàp.
eng: They spoke the word of the Lord to him, and to all who were in his house.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' ana nètʉ' anà, e lor wowèe a su'si wap mnfur. E ka' sù'si mìsi, a baptir ye ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ embe yê ndàp.
eng: He took them the same hour of the night, and washed their stripes, and was immediately baptized, he and all his household.

lmp: E m lòr Pol ba Silàs a du àgho mbe yê ndàp, a fa wowèe byee. A bèe embe yê ndàp wèe a m lu'shi se njobè' wowèe a m byemi nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: He brought them up into his house, and set food before them, and rejoiced greatly, with all his household, having believed in God.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' raa, ŋgâa teni mnsa' a tuu yap ŋgâa ntuu enɛ a du laa enɛ a fʉr bèe anà embe shaŋ.
eng: But when it was day, the magistrates sent the sergeants, saying, Let those men go.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rkè'ni shaŋ à laa nè Pol enɛ̂, "Ŋgâa teni mnsa' a tuu bèe enɛ a fʉr wèe Silàs embe shaŋ. Banɛ wèe fʉʉ là embo, du bòŋboŋ."
eng: The jailer reported these words to Paul, saying, The magistrates have sent to let you go; now therefore come out, and go in peace.

lmp: Pol à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à be sa' wer mnsa' ka', a lip wèr à mʉ̀ bèe, a ku lor wer ce wèr yu bêe à to' Rum a fa mbe shaŋ. Wowèe a ce roo sè'ni à rfʉr wèr embe shaŋ ba à bsʉ̀ti njokɛ? Àde' yi ba wa' ka'. Làa nè tɛ wowèe a vʉ fʉr wèr embo nè yap bo."
eng: But Paul said to them, They have beaten us publicly, without a trial, men who are Romans, and have cast us into prison! Do they now release us secretly? No, most certainly, but let them come themselves and bring us out!

lmp: Ŋgâa ntuu ca a du a suŋ nè ŋgâa teni mnsa'. Wowèe a ka' yu' enɛ Pol ba Silàs a yu bêe à to' Rum, a wɛp sê,
eng: The sergeants reported these words to the magistrates, and they were afraid when they heard that they were Romans,

lmp: a dû, a bu' mmbo nè wowèe, a fʉr wowèe embe shaŋ, a laa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a fʉʉ efa lap rla' dû.
eng: and they came and begged them. When they had brought them out, they asked them to depart from the city.

lmp: Pol ba Silàs a ka' fʉʉ embe shaŋ a du mbe ndàp mbe Lidìyà, a tarte a bfʉr wèe, a fa wowèe ŋger. A ka' misì, a dû.
eng: They went out of the prison, and entered into Lydia's house. When they had seen the brothers, they encouraged them, and departed.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù càa rla' Àmfipolìs ba rla' Àpòlonìyà, a ba' à rla' Tɛ̀sàlonikà. Ndap rloo Jus à m ba àfo.
eng: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.

lmp: Pol à niŋ mbe ndàp rloo anà àmbò e m gèe à mla' mo' nà. E m lòr mmbomntaa mi mtaar à rnàshi wowèe buu embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀,
eng: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,

lmp: a ce sàr buu Nyʉ̀ nè wowèe, a ce dùŋshi nè wowèe enɛ yi m ba enɛ Krâis anà à m tʉr à ryɛ ŋgɛ', kwe, fʉʉ efa rkwe. E m làa enɛ̂, "Jisòs ce m ce suŋ wèe àmbò ye na, yu Krâis anà."
eng: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wowèe a m byemi, a ba àbee a Pol ba Silàs. Bèe magòr efa mʉ̀ Grêk ce a m ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ker ba bbyèŋge ce a m ba ŋgâa mlii a m byemi foŋ a ba àbee a Pol wèe.
eng: Some of them were persuaded, and joined Paul and Silas, of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.

lmp: Jus a m ko'ndoŋ nè wowèe, a du a yɛ ŋgâa bsàrbuu mo' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa fa ŋgɛ', wowèe a baashì bèe, bèe anà a kɛ' ŋgɛ' à mʉ̀ la'. A ka' kɛ̀' ŋgɛ', a caŋ a du mbe ndàp mbe Jasìn à rkoo Pol ba Silàs, fʉr wowèe fa nè bèe.
eng: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace, and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.

lmp: A ka' yɛ wowèe ka', a koo Jasìn ba bfʉr mo', a sʉ̂ŋ, a du àgho a fa nè ŋgâa kansùr, a laa mbekì enɛ̂, "Bèe ca ce a bèesi ŋgòŋ tʉtʉ̀ŋ na, a vʉ̀ a ba' àfa foŋ.
eng: When they didn't find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,

lmp: Jasìn à koo wowèe a lɛ mbe yê ndàp. Wowèe a ce bʉ' mncir Sisà à njì ce a ce laa enɛ ŋkʉʉ mò' ker ba, a ce too enɛ Jisòs."
eng: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!

lmp: Ku' bèe ce a m ba àfo ker ba ŋgâa kansùr a ka' yu', ntee yi fʉʉ wowèe.
eng: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.

lmp: Wowèe a laa enɛ Jasìn ba bfʉr ca a tee yap tu. Jasìn wèe a ka' tee yap tu àmbò a m làa, a ma'shì wowèe a dusè.
eng: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.

lmp: Tʉ̀' à ka' sii, bfʉr a lor Pol ba Silàs a du àgho à rla' Bɛ̀riyà. Wowèe a ka' bà', a du mbe ndàp rloo Jûs.
eng: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.

lmp: Ndèe bèe ca à boŋ a caa ndèe bèe embe ndàp rloo ce à rla' Tɛ̀sàlonikà, njobè' wowèe a m kòŋ à ryu'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ sê, a ce bè' Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ tɛ a bo yɛ enɛ yuu ce Pol à m ce làa yi m ba mini lɛ.
eng: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of the mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.

lmp: Bèe magòr a m byemi. Bbyèŋge Grêk ce ŋgâa mlii ba Grêk ce a m ba mmbaŋrù, a m byemi foŋ.
eng: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.

lmp: Jus à rla' Tɛ̀sàlonikà a ka' yu' enɛ Pol ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à rla' Bɛ̀riyà foŋ, wowèe a vʉ foŋ a barsi bèe ce a m ba àfo enɛ a wowèe a kɛ' ŋgɛ'.
eng: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bfʉr a lor Pol njà' mò'sir a du àgho àwâa rdip rgòr, Silàs ba Timotì a cu yap à rla' Bɛ̀riyà.
eng: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.

lmp: Bèe ce a m dù a Pol wèe nà, a m dù caar a du a ma'shi ye à rla' Atɛ̀ns. A ka' ce kʉti, Pol à laa nè wowèe enɛ a du laa nè Timotì ba Silàs enɛ a vʉ cɛrcɛr vʉ yɛ ye.
eng: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.

lmp: Pol à ka' cu à rla' Atɛ̀ns ce kè' Timotì ba Silàs, a yɛ ku' blaŋ ce bêe àfo a m ce loo nè vi enɛ a mnyʉ̀. E ka' yɛ, nyor à bep ye.
eng: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, e nashì buu mò' mbe ndàp rloo nè Jus ba nè Grêk ce a m ce loo nè Nyʉ̀. E m gèe wa' foŋ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ à ntaa nè bèe ce a m vʉ̀ àfo.
eng: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m tʉr ba bfee Ɛ̀pɛ̀kuràn, ba bèe mo' ce a m tʉr ba bfee Stoyìk, a m sɛr mnsɛr a Pôl. Bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ a laa yap enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ bu' cùu ca ce ròo à rlàa ba kɛ?" Bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Yi ce yɛɛti enɛ e ce làa ba àmbò mnyʉ̀ mo' ce sèe rìŋ ka'." Wowèe a m làa wa'a njobè' Pol à m ce fè'shi àmbò Jisòs ba nfʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, What does this babbler want to say? Others said, He seems to be advocating foreign deities, because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.

lmp: Wowèe a lor Pol a du àgho mbe rcutè ce a m ce cute mbe rtûu Àropagòs, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr ce kòŋ à rrìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ryɛ'nî rfi ce à ce yɛ'ni na.
eng: They took hold of him, and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by you?

lmp: Buu mò' ce wèe ce làa vi yu bfi nè wèr, wèr à ce kòŋ à rrìŋ vi."
eng: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa wa'a njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ à rla' Atɛ̀ns ker ba bkìlò ce a m ce cu àfo a m lòr ku' yàp nfè' a ce gèe kìnfɛ̀r ba àmbò buu bfi, a ker ce yu' buu bfi.
eng: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.

lmp: Pol à natì mbekì mbe rcutè embe Àropagòs, a laa enɛ̂, "Bêe à rla' Atɛ̀ns! Mɛ̀ yɛ bòŋboŋ mɛnɛ wèe yu bèe ce wèe ce wɛp mnyʉ̀ sê.
eng: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus, and said, You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a njobè' mɛ̀ kar à mʉ̀ le rla' ca, a yɛ bdì' ce wèe ce gèe mloo. Mɛ̀ yɛ foŋ dî' rfa, a saŋ mbe dì' anà enɛ̂, "Nè Nyʉ̀ ce a rìŋ ka'." Banɛ Nyʉ̀ ce wèe ce loo nè ye, a riŋ ye ka' anà, a yì ce m be suŋ wèe àmbò ye.
eng: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription: 'TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.' What therefore you worship in ignorance, this I announce to you.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e m gèe ŋgòŋ a ker gee buu enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ yu Nyʉ̀ ce e ce sa' mbe bùu ba njep nshè. E ke cu mbe ndàp Nyʉ̀ ce bèe a bà'ri nè mmbo ka'.
eng: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn't dwell in temples made with hands,

lmp: Àde' bèe a fa' nè ye àmbò e buu lɛ buu wa' ka', njobè' ku ba ba ye ce e ke gèe bèe a cu btèe ce yòŋse, ker fa wowèe buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: neither is he served by men's hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things.

lmp: E m gèe mnjɛ̀ɛ wɛɛwɛ vi fʉʉ enjep ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, tɛ vi bo cu à bdì' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na. E m kwà'shi wɛɛ, a lɛ mnfè', a ker lɛ bdì' rcu nè wowèe.
eng: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons, and the boundaries of their dwellings,

lmp: E m gèe wa'a tɛ bèe a bo ròo ye, ce ghàashi enɛ kɛ̀ seemò' a be yɛ ye lɛ. Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ yu ànjìsàp ese ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa sèe ka'.
eng: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.

lmp: Sèe cu btèe a ce jɛ̀r, a ba àgho njo' ye. Yi ku ba àmbò yè bèe ce a ke saŋ mghàghar a làa. Wowèe a làa enɛ̂, "Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, sèe yu boo vi."
eng: For in him we live, and move, and have our being.' As some of your own poets have said, 'For we are also his offspring.'

lmp: Banɛ àmbò sèe yu boo Nyʉ̀ na, sèe fa kèr ce kwà'shi enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu àmbò blaŋ ce a lòr ba bco' kɛ̀ blùr ɛ̀, a gee àgho, à ba yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à gèe ba nè vi bfee ba mi mmbo nà ka'.
eng: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce bèe a m rìŋ yuu ce a m ce gèe ka' nà, Nyʉ̀ à ce fuse. À ka' ba sè'ni na, Nyʉ̀ à ce làa nè bêe à bdì' wɛɛwɛ enɛ wowèe a kupse, ma' yàp buu bbebep,
eng: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,

lmp: njobè' e lɛ̀ nòŋ ce a be sa' bèe wɛɛwɛ à njî yɛɛnì, a ker ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e be sa' bèe. Nyʉ̀ à gèe ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à riŋ enɛ e be gèe wa'a njobè' e fʉr ŋwɛ̀ anà efa rkwe."
eng: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' àmbò rfʉʉ ce bèe a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe, bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ a vʉshì ye, bèe mo' a laa yap enɛ̂, "Wèr be kèr yu' yuu ce à be làa kuu yuu ca nyʉ̀ mò'."
eng: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, We want to hear you again concerning this.

lmp: Pol à fʉʉ efa wâp mʉ, a dû.
eng: Thus Paul went out from among them.

lmp: Bèe mo' a ba a Pol àbee, a byemi. Bèe mo' efa bèe ca à m ba Dàyonishòs ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe rcutè Àropagòs anà, ker ba njeŋwɛ̀ ce a m ce too enɛ Damɛrès, ker ba bèe mo'.
eng: But certain men joined with him, and believed, among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.

lmp: E ka' mìsi wɛɛ, a lô à rla' Atɛ̀ns a du à rla' Korèn.
eng: After these things Paul departed from Athens, and came to Corinth.

lmp: E ka' bà', a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' embe ndʉ̀' Jûs, ce a m ce too enɛ Àkwilà. A m bi ye à rla' Pontùs. E m lô à rla' Italè a ŋgwa yì ce a m ce too enɛ Prèsilà njobè' ŋkʉʉ Klâdìyòs à m fa rsa' enɛ Jus a fʉʉ à rla' Rum duse. Pol à m dù à ryɛ wowèe,
eng: He found a certain Jew named Aquila, a man of Pontus by race, who had recently come from Italy, with his wife Priscilla, because Claudius had commanded all the Jews to depart from Rome. He came to them,

lmp: a ka' yɛ enɛ yàp ntaa à m ba bcɛ̀' ce wowèe a m ce tar ce gèe btàp àgho ce fyèni àmbò ye ye foŋ, e cu a wowèe a ce fà' a wowèe àbee.
eng: and because he practiced the same trade, he lived with them and worked, for by trade they were tent makers.

lmp: E m ce dù mbe ndàp rloo Jus à mmbomntaa wɛɛwɛ, a ce nàshi wowèe buu tɛ Jus ba Grêk ce a m ba mbo a bo byemi nè Jisòs.
eng: He reasoned in the synagogue every Sabbath, and persuaded Jews and Greeks.

lmp: Silàs ba Timotì a ka' vʉ̂ à rla' Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà, Pol à lo sè'ni a ku ce fè'shi ba blâa Nyʉ̀ cà'cà', a ce suŋ Jus enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis anà.
eng: But when Silas and Timothy came down from Macedonia, Paul was compelled by the Spirit, testifying to the Jews that Jesus was the Christ.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' kani yuu ce Pol à m suŋ wowèe, ce cɛp ye, e kashì vi bcɛ̀' a laa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ làa ya wɛɛ, kwà' wèe. Kɛ' e sè'ni na, m be ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ ba nè bèe enje jɛɛ."
eng: When they opposed him and blasphemed, he shook out his clothing and said to them, Your blood be on your own heads! I am clean. From now on, I will go to the Gentiles!

lmp: E m lò a du mbe ndàp Taitìyùs ce e m ba àgee ndap rloo. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce loo nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: He departed there, and went into the house of a certain man named Justus, one who worshiped God, whose house was next door to the synagogue.

lmp: Krîspòs ce e m ba tu embe ndàp rloo ba bèe wɛɛwɛ embe yê ndàp a m byemi nè Tata Nyʉ̀. Bèe magôr à rla' Korèn a m yu' yuu ce Pol à m làa nè wowèe, a byemi, a baptìr wowèe.
eng: Crispus, the ruler of the synagogue, believed in the Lord with all his house. Many of the Corinthians, when they heard, believed and were baptized.

lmp: À ka' ba nètʉ' mò', Tata à laa nè Pol à rlo enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka', kù ce fe'shi blâa Nyʉ̀, ke' borni à nfè' mò' ka',
eng: The Lord said to Paul in the night by a vision, Don't be afraid, but speak and don't be silent;

lmp: njobè' m ku ba wèe sò. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' be gèe yuu mo' bebep nè wɛ̀ ka', njobè' ku' yà bèe a yu à rla' ca sê."
eng: for I am with you, and no one will attack you to harm you, for I have many people in this city.

lmp: Pol à m cu a wowèe à fè' bìi ba nto' a ce yɛ'ni wowèe blâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: He lived there a year and six months, teaching the word of God among them.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce Gàliyò à m ba govanô à ŋgôŋ Àkayà, Jus a m tar cùu, a koo Pol a du àgho mbe kôr.
eng: But when Gallio was proconsul of Achaia, the Jews with one accord rose up against Paul and brought him before the judgment seat,

lmp: A ka' bà' mbo, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce kòŋ à rgèe tɛ bèe a loo nè Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce ncir yi byemi ka'."
eng: saying, This man persuades men to worship God contrary to the law.

lmp: Pol à ka' lò enɛ e ce làa, Gàliyò à laa enɛ̂, "Yu' ka nè lɛ Jûs! Wèe à ka' ba ce làa enɛ Pol à gèe yuu mo' bebep kɛ̀ e bʉ' ncir mo' tatap ɛ̀, mɛ̀ ba lòr nfè', yu' yuu ce wèe ce làa.
eng: But when Paul was about to open his mouth, Gallio said to the Jews, If indeed it were a matter of wrong or of wicked crime, you Jews, it would be reasonable that I should bear with you;

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' wèe ce sɛr mnsɛr ba àmbò blàa ba mlii ker ba ye ncìr, banɛ wèe à ba sa' wee mnsa' mìsi fa wêe mʉ. M be sa' njɛ̀ɛ mnsa' anà ka'."
eng: but if they are questions about words and names and your own law, look to it yourselves. For I don't want to be a judge of these matters.

lmp: E ka' làa wa'a, a juu wowèe embe kôr.
eng: He drove them from the judgment seat.

lmp: Wowèe a koo Sòstɛnì ce e m ba tu embe ndàp rloo a lip à bsii kôr. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Gàliyò à m lòr yuu ce wowèe a m gèe anà à yuu ka'.
eng: Then all the Greeks laid hold on Sosthenes, the ruler of the synagogue, and beat him before the judgment seat. Gallio didn't care about any of these things.

lmp: Pol à m cu a bfʉr wèe à rla' Korèn à mʉ nfè' mò', a ma'shi wowèe a niŋ mbe keŋ a Prèsilà ba Àkwilà a du à ŋgôŋ Sirìyà. Tɛ wowèe a ka' dù, e m ye lè' à rla' Sinkrìyà, a koo yi tu àmbò ndèe Jus à m ba.
eng: Paul, having stayed after this many more days, took his leave of the brothers, and sailed from there for Syria, together with Priscilla and Aquila. He shaved his head in Cenchreae, for he had a vow.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' dù bà' à rla' Ɛfɛsòs, Pol à ma'shì Prèsilà ba Àkwilà àfo. E m du mbe ndàp rloo a suŋ Jus buu àmbò Jisòs.
eng: He came to Ephesus, and he left them there; but he himself entered into the synagogue, and reasoned with the Jews.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa enɛ a wowèe a cu à mʉ nfè' mò'. E kanì.
eng: When they asked him to stay with them a longer time, he declined;

lmp: E ka' ce dù, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à ka' byemi, m kʉtì vʉ yɛ wèe." E ka' làa wa'a, a nàtî à rla' Ɛfɛsòs a niŋ mbe keŋ a dû.
eng: but taking his leave of them, and saying, I must by all means keep this coming feast in Jerusalem, but I will return again to you if God wills, he set sail from Ephesus.

lmp: E ka' bà' à rla' Sisàriyà, a du Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a ca'ni cor yî àfo, a nati a kʉti à rla' Antìyòk.
eng: When he had landed at Caesarea, he went up and greeted the assembly, and went down to Antioch.

lmp: E ka' cu àfo à mʉ nfè' mò', a nati a jɛr à ŋgôŋ Gàlɛshà ba Frijìyà, a ce fa ŋger nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ce a m ba à bdì' anà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Having spent some time there, he departed, and went through the region of Galatia, and Phrygia, in order, establishing all the disciples.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Jus mò' ce a m ce too enɛ Àpolòs à m vʉ̂ à rla' Ɛfɛsòs. A m bi ye à rla' Àlɛ̀ksandà. À m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m rìŋ à rlàa yuu, a riŋ Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ foŋ sê.
eng: Now a certain Jew named Apollos, an Alexandrian by race, an eloquent man, came to Ephesus. He was mighty in the Scriptures.

lmp: A m yɛ'ni ye buu kuu Tata Jisòs. E m làa nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀, a yɛ'ni bèe buu àmbò Jisòs yɛɛnì sê. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, e m ku riŋ yi ba baptìr yì Jôn cà'cà'.
eng: This man had been instructed in the way of the Lord; and being fervent in spirit, he spoke and taught accurately the things concerning Jesus, although he knew only the baptism of John.

lmp: E m niŋ mbe ndàp rloo a kɛ' a ce làa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ sê. Prèsilà ba Àkwilà a ka' yu', a lor ye a du àgho mbe wâp ndàp, a nashi mnduunjî Nyʉ̀ nè ye yɛɛnì sê.
eng: He began to speak boldly in the synagogue. But when Priscilla and Aquila heard him, they took him aside, and explained to him the way of God more accurately.

lmp: Àpolòs à ka' tà' à rdù à ŋgôŋ Àkayà, bfʉr ce à rla' Ɛfɛsòs a fa ye ŋger, a ker saŋ ŋwà' nè ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs ce a m ba àfo enɛ wowèe a koni ye. E ka' bà', a ja' bèe ce a m byemi njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr wowèe à ntee bòŋboŋ nà.
eng: When he had determined to pass over into Achaia, the brothers encouraged him, and wrote to the disciples to receive him. When he had come, he greatly helped those who had believed through grace;

lmp: E m jà' wowèe a sɛr mnsɛr a Jus wèe àwaŋ tatap sê, a ce fyɛ' mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀, a ce dùŋshi wowèe enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis anà. E ka' sɛr wa'a, a so wowèe.
eng: for he powerfully refuted the Jews, publicly showing by the Scriptures that Jesus was the Christ.

lmp: Àpolòs à ka' ba à rla' Korèn, Pol à jɛr nè mkùu a du a ba' à rla' Ɛfɛsòs. E ka' bà' a yɛ bèe mo' efa ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs.
eng: It happened that, while Apollos was at Corinth, Paul, having passed through the upper country, came to Ephesus, and found certain disciples.

lmp: E m bipshi nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe à m byemi wa'a, a koni Yʉ' Rara a?" Wowèe a beesì nè ye enɛ̂, "Wèr à m be yu' yuu mo' àmbò Yʉ' Rara ka'."
eng: He said to them, Did you receive the Holy Spirit when you believed? They said to him, No, we haven't even heard that there is a Holy Spirit.

lmp: E laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Banɛ a m bàptir wèe ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?" Wowèe a beesì enɛ̂, "A m bàptir wèr ba nè bàptir yì Jôn."
eng: He said, Into what then were you baptized? They said, Into John's baptism.

lmp: Pol à laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Jôn à m ce bàptir bèe njobè' wowèe a m kupse, a ma' yàp buu bbebep." E m ker ce suŋ bèe enɛ wowèe a byemi nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e be vʉ̀ embe yê njì. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce làa na à m ba Jisòs.
eng: Paul said, John indeed baptized with the baptism of repentance, saying to the people that they should believe in the one who would come after him, that is, in Jesus.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yu' wa'a, a byemi, a baptìr wowèe à rlii Tata Jisòs.
eng: When they heard this, they were baptized in the name of the Lord Jesus.

lmp: Pol à ka' lɛ̀ mi mmbo mbe wâp ndù, Yʉ' Rara yi suu mbe wâp ndù, wowèe a laa bli ce a m yɛ'ni ka', a cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ nè bèe.
eng: When Paul had laid his hands on them, the Holy Spirit came on them, and they spoke with other languages and prophesied.

lmp: Bèe anà a m ba àmbò bèe ncòp-baa à-rrʉ̀ʉ wa'a.
eng: They were about twelve men in all.

lmp: Pol à m niŋ mbe ndàp rloo, a laa nè bèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ à mŋwɛɛ btaar, a ce nàshi wowèe buu àmbò Jisòs tɛ wowèe a bo rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Nyʉ̀ ce sa' àmbò ŋkʉʉ.
eng: He entered into the synagogue, and spoke boldly for a period of three months, reasoning and persuading about the things concerning the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wowèe a tee btu, a kani à rbyemì, a ce làa bebep àmbò nduunjì Tata à bsii bèe. Pol à fʉʉ efa wâp mʉ a lor ŋgâa yɛ'ni buu Jisòs a du àgho mbe ndap ŋwà' Tìranòs, e ce yɛ'ni wowèe buu mbo à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But when some were hardened and disobedient, speaking evil of the Way before the multitude, he departed from them, and separated the disciples, reasoning daily in the school of Tyrannus.

lmp: E m yɛ'ni wa'a à bfê' bbaa. Yi ka' ba wa', bèe wɛɛwɛ à ŋgôŋ Ɛsìyà, Jûs, ba bèe enje jɛɛ a yu' blàa Tatâ.
eng: This continued for two years, so that all those who lived in Asia heard the word of the Lord Jesus, both Jews and Greeks.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu bghagha' ce vi m ba jɛɛ se njì enjep Pôl.
eng: God worked special miracles by the hands of Paul,

lmp: Bèe a m lòr bbishîr, ba bcɛ̀' mfà' ce vi m jòo Pôl, a dù jòo bèe ce a m ce yaŋse àgho, wowèe a luŋ efa wâp byaŋ, byʉ' bbebep vi fʉʉ enjep wowèe.
eng: so that even handkerchiefs or aprons were carried away from his body to the sick, and the evil spirits went out.

lmp: Jus mo' ce a m ce kar ce jùu byʉ' bbebep enjep bèe, a kɛ' a ce yòŋ rlii Tata Jisòs mbendù bèe ce byʉ' bbebep vi m ba njep wowèe. Wowèe a m ce làa enɛ̂, "À rlii Jisòs ce Pol e ke fè'shi nà, fʉʉ nè dû."
eng: But some of the itinerant Jews, exorcists, took on themselves to invoke over those who had the evil spirits the name of the Lord Jesus, saying, We adjure you by Jesus whom Paul preaches.

lmp: Bèe mo' bèe nsàambâ ce a m ce gèe wa'a, à m ba boo Sìkivà ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ Jus mò' ce e m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mò' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: There were seven sons of one Sceva, a Jewish chief priest, who did this.

lmp: Yʉ' bebep ca yi m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ rìŋ Jisòs, a riŋ àmbò Pol foŋ, a wèe ye wèkɛ?"
eng: The evil spirit answered, Jesus I know, and Paul I know, but who are you?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce yʉ' bebep ca yi m ba njep ye na à gwe mbe wâp ndù, a lip wowèe sê, a gha' wowèe. Wowèe a caŋ a fʉʉ embe ndàp mbùuriŋ nè mnfur à nyòr.
eng: The man in whom the evil spirit was leaped on them, and overpowered them, and prevailed against them, so that they fled out of that house naked and wounded.

lmp: Jus wɛɛwɛ ker ba bèe enje jɛɛ ce a m ce cu à rla' Ɛfɛsòs a m yu' ca, a wɛp sê, a naa rlii Tata Jisòs mbekì sê.
eng: This became known to all, both Jews and Greeks, who lived at Ephesus. Fear fell on them all, and the name of the Lord Jesus was magnified.

lmp: Bèe magòr efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m byemi, a m vʉ̀se àwaŋ, a ce suŋ yàp buu bbebep.
