eng: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about the Kingdom of God, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

lmp: Bèe mo' a m byemi yuu ce e m làa, bèe mo' a byemi yap yu ka'.
eng: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

lmp: Wowèe a m tʉr mŋgàpni fa wâp mʉ kuu yuu ce Pol à m làa, a ka' nàti ce dù, Pol à laa mbʉ̀ làa nè wowèe. E m làa enɛ̂, "Yʉ' Rara yi m làa yuu yɛɛnì nè wêe btarkʉ mbe nfè' ce e m tuu Àsayà ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, e vʉ a laa enɛ̂,
eng: When they didn't agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one word, The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah, the prophet, to our fathers,

lmp: "Dù yɛ bèe ca laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe be yu' kèr yu', yu' ka'. Wèe be kè' kèr kè', yɛ ka'.
eng: saying, 'Go to this people, and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' mntee bèe ca vi tap sê. Btù' vi lo' wowèe, wowèe a ker kaashi map mmir, buwa'làr wowèe a ba yɛ buu nè map mmir, yu' buu nè wap btù', bèeŋger, vʉ̀ à mbèp yà, tɛ m gee wowèe a lûŋ.""
eng: For this people's heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.'

lmp: Banɛ m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ enɛ nsuŋ Nyʉ̀ ce kuu rlùŋ à dù nè bèe enje jɛɛ. Wowèe a be yu'shi bòŋboŋ."
eng: Be it known therefore to you, that the salvation of God is sent to the nations. They will also listen.

lmp: Pol à ka' làa wa'a, Jus a natì a dû, a ce sɛr mnsɛr a wâp mʉ tatap sê.
eng: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

lmp: Pol à m cu mbe ndàp à bfê' bbaa a ce là' ndap anà. E m ce koni bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce vʉ̀ à ryɛ ye.
eng: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house, and received all who were coming to him,

lmp: E m ce fè'shi àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀, a ce yɛ'ni bèe buu kuu Tata Jisos Krâis. E m gèe wa'a nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ à ce jepsi ye ka'.
eng: preaching the Kingdom of God, and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis. Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisòs, a fʉr mɛ̀ enɛ m fe'shi yì Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè bèe.
eng: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

lmp: Nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ca yu nsuŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè bèe. E m làa, ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ ce yi yu rara.
eng: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

lmp: Nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ca kùu muu yì ce Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè sèe. À ka' ba àmbò li rbi, a m bi ye mbe ndʉ̀' Dɛvìd.
eng: concerning his Son, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò yi yʉ' ce yi yu rara, Tata Nyʉ̀ à fʉr Jisòs efa rkwe a yê ŋger, à rdùŋshi enɛ e yu muu yì.
eng: who was declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

lmp: Yu njo' Jisòs ce Nyʉ̀ à tʉr mɛ̀ à ntee bòŋboŋ, a fa mɛ̀ fɛŋ à rba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu, tɛ bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ a bo byemi nè ye, yu'ni nè ye, nàa ye mbekì.
eng: through whom we received grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name's sake;

lmp: Wee wèe yu à mʉ̀ bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à ce enɛ a ba bèe Jisos Krâis.
eng: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

lmp: M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè wèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèe yu à rla' Rûm, ce Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ wèe, a kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe ba yì bèe. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Ta ker ba Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Tɛ m ka' làa buu mò', m ce yòŋshi yà Nyʉ̀ à rlii Jisos Krâis njo' wèe wɛɛwɛ, njobè' bèe a ce suŋ àmbò le rbyemì à bdì' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce m ce fà' nè ye nè ya ntee wɛɛwɛ àmbò m ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò muu yì na, rìŋ enɛ m ce loo nè wèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ à ka' byemi, e fa mɛ̀ fɛŋ sè'ni tɛ m vʉ yɛ wèe.
eng: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

lmp: M ce kòŋ à ryɛ wèe sê, tɛ m bo koni bghònì ce à yʉ', tɛɛ tatap.
eng: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

lmp: Yi yu enɛ sèe ja' visèe mnyor. M be tʉr ŋger njo' le rbyemì tɛ wèe tʉr ŋger njo' la rbyemì.
eng: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other's faith, both yours and mine.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ enɛ yu nfè' magòr ce mɛ ke lò kwa'shi enɛ m vʉ yɛ wèe. caar ba' ntìni na, mɛ̂ kwà'shi wa'a, yuu mo' yi ku jepsi mɛ̀. M ce kòŋ à rgèe tɛ bèe a byemi nè Jisòs tɛ la rfà' li ba nè sɛ'-ŋwɛ̀ a wêe mʉ àmbò li yu nè bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ nà.
eng: Now I don't desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

lmp: Yu ya dì' enɛ m fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ; m be fè'shi nè bèe Grêk, ba nè bèe ce a yu bèe Grêk ka', ker ba nè bèe ce a rìŋ ŋwà' ba bèe ce a rìŋ ŋwà' ka'.
eng: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ lɛ̀ ntee à rfè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wèe ce wèe yu à rla' Rum foŋ.
eng: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

lmp: Rìtu yi ce koo mɛ̀ nè Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca ka'. Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca yu ŋger Nyʉ̀ ce yi gèe bèe ce a byemi a lûŋ. Ca yi yu entombì nè Jûs, a ka' ba foŋ nè bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, for it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

lmp: Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca ce dùŋshi sèe njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Nyʉ̀ e ke gèe bèe a ba byɛɛnì a yê bsii. Njɛ̀ɛ njì anà à kɛ̀' nè rbyemì, a misi nè rbyemì. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njobè' e byemi nè ye, ŋgàŋ be lùŋ."
eng: For in it is revealed God's righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, But the righteous shall live by faith.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce ko'si rshentee nè bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep nè ye, a ker ce gèe nè bee mò' foŋ nà. Yàp buu bbebep anà ce jepsi bèe efa rrìŋ yuu mini.
eng: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce ko'si li rshentee njobè' buu wɛɛwɛ ce àde' bèe a riŋ àmbò ye vi yu brara nè wowèe. Nyʉ̀ ye ye à dùŋshi wowèe buu anà.
eng: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

lmp: Kɛ̂' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ŋgòŋ, buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe vi ce dùŋshi bèe buu ce àde' wowèe a m ba riŋ kuu ye ka' nà. Vi ce dùŋshi bòŋboŋ sê, enɛ e tʉr ŋger ce àde' yi ke mi ka', a ker ce dùŋshi foŋ enɛ e yu Nyʉ̀. Banɛ njì mò' yu àgho ce àde' wowèe a fʉr yap tu ka'.
eng: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.

lmp: Ka' wowèe a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ wa'a, wowèe a ce kù'si ye ka', a ker ce yòŋshi ye ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, bfee vi jep wowèe, wowèe a riŋ yuu ka'.
eng: Because, knowing God, they didn't glorify him as God, neither gave thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce làa enɛ wowèe a tʉr bfee, a kʉti ba blʉr.
eng: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

lmp: Wowèe a m borni efa rloo nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fòo a ker ba Nyʉ̀ ce e ke kwe ka', a ce loo ba nè blaŋ ce a sòp vi feesè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke lò ku kwe, ba bsiŋ ba mnyàa ker ba buu ce vi tʉr mnyôr ka'.
eng: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.

lmp: A mbùu ce Nyʉ̀ à mà'shi enɛ wowèe a gee buu bbebep àmbò wowèe a ce kòŋ à rgèe. Wowèe a ce gèe buu ce vi yu nè rìtu-ŋwɛ̀ nè wap mnyor, a wâp mʉ.
eng: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves,

lmp: Wowèe a mà' mini Nyʉ̀, a lor ba mnde'. Wowèe a ce loo ba nè buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe, a ce fà' ba nè buu anà, a ke' ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ce e m gèe buu anà ka'. Yu ye ce bèe a ba ce yòŋshi à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à ma'shì enɛ wowèe a gee buu ce a ce kòŋ à rgèe, à ba buu ce vi yu nè rìtu-ŋwɛ̀. Bbyèŋge a kupse yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à ba gèe, a ce gèe ba yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à ba gèe ka'.
eng: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù wowo a bornì efa rnòŋ a bbyèŋge wèe, a ce lùu à rnòŋ ba a mmbaŋrù mo' wèe, a ce gèe buu ce vi yu nè rìtu-ŋwɛ̀ sê. Wowèe a kɛ' ŋgɛ' mbe wâp ndù, à ba ŋgɛ' ce e ghɛɛte à yàp buu bbebep anà.
eng: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' bèe ca a kani efa rrìŋ Nyʉ̀ àmbò yàp Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à ma'shì wowèe a ce kwà'shi ba mkwà'shî mmbembep tɛ wowèe a bo gèe buu ce vi yu yɛɛnì ka' na.
eng: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

lmp: Yap ntee yi ruu nè buu bbebep njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Wowèe a ce gèe bsàrbuu. Wowèe a lɛ mmir mbendù buu bèe mo', a ce kwà'shi bebep àmbò bèe mo'. Wowèe a ce ko'ndoŋ, a ce yʉshi bèe, a ce rè bkòr a bèe wèe, a ce bo' bèe, a tʉr mntee byayaŋ nè bèe, a ce cʉ̀ bèe, a ce sa' bèe.
eng: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

lmp: Wowèe a bàa Nyʉ̀, a ce nyʉ̀' bèe, a ce nàa tu, a ce yu' nyor, a ce kwà'shi mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce àde' wowèe a gee buu bbebep. Wowèe a ce yu'ni nè wap mma ba wap bta ka'.
eng: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

lmp: Wowèe a rìŋ yuu ka'. Wowèe a kà' yuu, gee yuu anà ka', a ce kòŋ bèe ka', a ce koosimnse nè bèe ka'.
eng: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

lmp: Wowèe a rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ ce làa enɛ bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca a ghɛɛte à rkweŋgèr. Ka' wowèe a rìŋ wa'a, wowèe a ku ce gèe yap yu buu ca. Yuu ce yi bep sê, yi yu enɛ wowèe a ce làa enɛ bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca a gèe yɛɛnì.
eng: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

lmp: Banɛ wɛ̂ ŋwɛ̀ ce à ce sa' bèe mo', mbò wɛ̀ rìŋ wɛnɛ àde' à fʉr yo tu efa mnsa' Nyʉ̀ ka' a? Wɛ̀ ka' làa enɛ wowèe a gèe buu bbebep, banɛ wɛ̀ ce sa' yò nyor foŋ njobè' wɛ̀ ku ce gèe ba njɛ̀ɛ buu ce wowèe a ce gèe.
eng: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke gèe yɛɛnì à nfè' ce e ce sa' bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca.
eng: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

lmp: Ŋkarà, wà' wɛ̀ ka' ce sa' bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca, ker ce gèe vi foŋ, wà' àde' Nyʉ̀ buu efa rsa' wɛ̀ a?
eng: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

lmp: Wà' à ce lòr ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ ce gèe nè bèe, a gee yuu mo' nè wowèe ka', a tʉr ntee mʉfɛ̀ɛ nà, à yuu cicì a? Mbò wɛ̀ rìŋ wɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ca nè wɛ̀ wa'a, a ce fa wɛ̀ fɛŋ tɛ à bo kupse yo ŋgêe bebep a?
eng: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

lmp: Wɛ̀ tèe tu, a kani efa rkupsè, banɛ à ce kè' sè'ni ba rshentee Nyʉ̀ ce li be kè yɛɛti àwaŋ à nòŋ ce e be kè sa' bèe wɛɛwɛ à njî yɛɛnì nà.
eng: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ be kè là' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à buu wɛɛwɛ ce ŋgàŋ à m gèe.
eng: who will pay back to everyone according to their works:

lmp: Bèe ce a lɛ̀ ntee à rgèe buu bbòŋboŋ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, a lɛ mmir mbendù bkù' ese Nyʉ̀ ba ryu'nì ba ryòŋ ce nfesè, Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ wowèe a cu nfesè.
eng: to those who by patience in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

lmp: Bèe mò' ce a yu bwer, a kani yuu mini, a ce gèe ba buu bbebep nà, a be yɛ ŋgɛ' rshentee ba bepntee Nyʉ̀.
eng: but to those who are self-seeking, and don't obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,

lmp: E be kè fa ŋgɛ' nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ce gèe buu bbebep tɛ wowèe a yu' ryaŋ sê. E be kè kɛ̀' nè Jûs, ka' du mbendù bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ.
eng: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who works evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a ce gèe buu bbòŋboŋ, wowèe a be kè koni bkù' ba ryu'nì ba cumʉnyaŋ ese Nyʉ̀. E be kè kɛ̀' nè Jûs, ka' fa nè bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ.
eng: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who works good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ e ke so'niŋgòŋ ka'.
eng: For there is no partiality with God.

lmp: Bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep, a riŋ mncir Nyʉ̀ ka', a be bʉ, ka' a be kè sa' wowèe nè mncir ka' wa'a. Bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep a riŋ mncir Nyʉ̀ nà, Nyʉ̀ be sa' wowèe nè mncir anà.
eng: For as many as have sinned without law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

lmp: Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe a ba byɛɛnì a yê bsii yu bèe ce a ce yu' mncir ba nè btù' cà'cà' ka', yu bèe ce a ce lɛ̀ mncir.
eng: For it isn't the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

lmp: Bèe ce a yu Jus ka', a riŋ mncir ka', a ka' ce gèe buu mo' ce mncir vi ce làa à mkwà'shì map, ka' wowèe a rìŋ mncir ka' wa'a, wowèe a ku riŋ yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì.
eng: for when Gentiles who don't have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

lmp: Yap ŋgèe yi ce dùŋshi enɛ mncir Nyʉ̀ anà vi yu njep wâp ntee ghup. Wap bfee vi ce gèe wowèe a riŋ wa'a foŋ njobè' wowèe a gèe yuu bòŋboŋ, ku rîŋ, a gèe yuu bebep, ku rîŋ.
eng: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them

lmp: A mbò yi be kè ba wa'a à nòŋ ce Nyʉ̀ be fa ŋger nè Jisos Krâis tɛ e sa' bèe a yê tù, teni wap mnsa' nà. E be sa' wowèe à buu wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a m ce gèe à bsʉ̀ti àmbò m ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ, a ce suŋ bèe nà.
eng: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ce à ce nàa nyor enɛ a wɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ Jûs, à ce làa enɛ à yu yɛɛnì njobè' à rìŋ mncir, a ce nàa nyor enɛ à rìŋ Nyʉ̀ jɛɛ,
eng: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,

lmp: wɛ̀ rìŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ, a riŋ yuu ce yi yu bòŋboŋ njobè' a yɛ'ni wɛ̀ mncir Nyʉ̀.
eng: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

lmp: Wɛ̀ lòr yo yu enɛ àde' à duŋshì mnfèp nduunjì. À ce làa wɛnɛ à yu rraa nè bèe ce a yu à tʉ̀'nji.
eng: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

lmp: À ce làa wɛnɛ àde' à yɛ'ni blʉr, ker yɛ'ni foŋ bèe ce a rìŋ buu ka', njobè' mncir vi fa wɛ̀ bfee, a gee wɛ̀ riŋ yuu mini.
eng: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

lmp: Wà' wɛ̀ ce wɛ̂ ke yɛ'ni bèe mo', wɛ̀ yɛ'ni yò nyor a? Wɛ̀ ce wɛ̂ ke yɛ'ni enɛ bèe a fa yɛ̀ɛ ka', wà' wɛ̂ ke yɛ̀ɛ a?
eng: You therefore who teach another, don't you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn't steal, do you steal?

lmp: Wɛ̀ ce à ce làa enɛ bèe a fa koo bbyèŋge bèe mo' ka', wà' wɛ̂ ke koo bbyèŋge bèe mo' a? Wɛ̀ ce à bàa mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na, wà' wɛ̂ ke yɛ̀ɛ buu embe ndap mnyʉ̀ anà a?
eng: You who say a man shouldn't commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

lmp: Wɛ̀ ce à ce nàa nyor enɛ à riŋ mncir Nyʉ̀ sê, wà' wɛ̂ ke gèe bèe a ce làa bebep àmbò Nyʉ̀ njobè' à ce bʉ' mncir anà a?
eng: You who glory in the law, through your disobedience of the law do you dishonor God?

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Bèe enje jɛɛ a ce bepsi rlii Nyʉ̀ njobè' yuu ce wèe ce gèe."
eng: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you, just as it is written.

lmp: À ce gèe bʉ̀ à rdùŋshi enɛ à yu ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀. Bʉ̀ ce à ce gèe anà be ba nè sɛ'-ŋwɛ̀, ce à ka' ce lɛ̀ mncir Nyʉ̀. Wɛ̀ ka' ce bʉ' mncir Nyʉ̀, banɛ yi yu sè'ni àmbò wɛ̀ gèe lɛ bʉ̀ ka' wa'a.
eng: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe bʉ̀ ka', ŋgàŋ à ka' ce lɛ̀ mncir Nyʉ̀, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be kù lòr ŋgàŋ àmbo ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe bʉ̀ wɛɛ wa'a.
eng: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won't his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ca be coosi wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ gèe bʉ̀, a riŋ mncir Nyʉ̀ ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀, a lɛ vi ka' nà.
eng: Won't the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

lmp: Yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ Jus ghup yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce a ce yɛ ba nè mmir ka'. Bʉ̀ ce yu bʉ̀ mini à bsii Nyʉ̀ yu ba yì ce à gèe ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ Jus ghup yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu wa'a ba enjep ntee, bʉ̂ mini yu ba yì enjep ntee. Bʉ̀ anà yu ba rfà' ce à gèe ba Yʉ' Rara, a ke' ba yuu ce mncir vi ce làa ka'. E ke vʉse ba bèe vʉse njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke vʉse njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca.
eng: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

lmp: Banɛ mbôŋtu ce Jus a tʉr a caa bèe mò' yu kɛ? Wà' bʉ̀ ce ŋwɛ̀ à gèe e tʉr sɛ' mò' nè ŋgàŋ a?
eng: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

lmp: Jus a tʉr sɛ' gòr sê. Yuu entombì yi yu enɛ Jus a bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa vi blàa mba wâp mmbò.
eng: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the oracles of God.

lmp: Ka' bèe mo' efa wowèe a m tɛɛ njep blâa Nyʉ̀ anà ka' wa'a, wà' yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m buu efa rtɛɛ njep yuu ce e m làa a?
eng: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

lmp: Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ mnde', Nyʉ̀ ku ba yi yu ŋwɛ̂ mini. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Tɛ bèe a yɛ enɛ wɛ̂ ke làa, ku gee àmbò wɛ̀ làa. Wɛ̂ ke sa' wo mnsa', ku so."
eng: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ buu bbebep ce sèe ce gèe, ce gèe bèe a ce yɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, sèe ka' laa seenɛ kɛ? Wà' àde' sèe laa enɛ Nyʉ̀ à ka' fa sèe ŋgɛ' njo' buu bbebep ce sèe à gèe banɛ e gèe yuu yɛɛnì ka' a? M ce làa ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀.
eng: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

lmp: Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Yi ka' ba ba wa'a, e ka' sa' ŋgòŋ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ m ce nya' mnde', bèe a yɛ ghup enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̂ mini, ce kù'si ye, Nyʉ̀ ker taa mɛ̀ enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgèe buu bbebep à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

lmp: Banɛ sèe gee buu bbebep tɛ rbòŋ li bo fʉʉ enjo a? Bèe mò' a ce bepsi la rlii, a ce làa enɛ mɛ̀ làa lɛ wa'a. Nyʉ̀ be fa njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca ŋgɛ' ce e be ghɛɛte à yuu ce wowèe a làa.
eng: Why not as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say, Let us do evil, that good may come? Those who say so are justly condemned.

lmp: Sèe be ka' làa seekɛ sè'ni à? Wà' sèe yu jɛɛ efa bèe mò' a? Yi yu wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Mɛ̀ làa wɛɛ enɛ buu bbebep tʉr ŋger mbendù bèe wɛɛwɛ, kɛ̀ yu Jus ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bèe enje jɛɛ ɛ̀.
eng: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka', ka' ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: As it is written, There is no one righteous; no, not one.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e rìŋ buu Nyʉ̀ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e ce kòŋ à rrìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à bèesi njì nè Nyʉ̀. Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a kʉti buu bcicì. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e ce gèe yuu bòŋboŋ ka', ka' ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: They have all turned aside. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not, so much as one.

lmp: Blàa ce vi ce fʉʉ eku wâp bcùu vi ce vʉ̀ nè rkwe nè bèe ce a yu' blàa anà. Wap blàa vi yu àmbò nli' nyo ce yi ke yʉ ŋwɛ̀ nà.
eng: Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit. The poison of vipers is under their lips;

lmp: Blâa bcece' vi fʉʉ eku wâp bcùu.
eng: whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.

lmp: Wowèe a ke càasi nfè' à ryʉ ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Their feet are swift to shed blood.

lmp: Wowèe a ce gèe yàp buu, a ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ ka'."
eng: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ yuu ce mncir Nyʉ̀ vi ce làa, vi ce làa ba nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa mncir anà nè wowèe. Yi yu wa'a tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo làa enɛ e yu yi jɛɛ ka', tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na a bo kè tɛɛ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀, taŋshi yàp nsa' nè ye.
eng: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e lɛ̀ mncir wɛɛwɛ tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo làa enɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì ka'. Yuu ce mncir vi gèe yi yu enɛ vi gèe bèe a riŋ buu bbebep.
eng: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni na, Nyʉ̀ à gèe bèe a riŋ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ ba yɛɛnì a yê bsii. Njì anà tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè mncir ka'. Ŋwà' mncir Nyʉ̀ ba ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m làa àmbò njì anà.
eng: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Nyʉ̀ ce gèe bèe a ba byɛɛnì yu ba à rbyemi nè Jisos Krâis. Njɛ̀ɛ njì ca yu nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ka' byemi, ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker ba jɛɛ ka',
eng: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

lmp: njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a gèe buu bbebep, a sɛ efa fòo ce yi lò ese Nyʉ̀.
eng: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à tʉr wowèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, a gee wowèe à ba byɛɛnì a yê bsii. E m gèe wa'a nè wowèe à cicì. Jisòs Krâis a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe enɛ yi ba wa'a, a tee sèe efa ŋgɛ'.
eng: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m fa ye tɛ e bo ba àmbò mbʉ taŋshì wa'a, tɛ li rkwe li bo gèe tɛ Nyʉ̀ foosi bèe ce a byemi nè ye. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wa'a, tɛ e bo dùŋshi nè bèe enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, njobè' à m ba entombì, e kur ntee a fuse efa buu bbebep ce bèe a m ce gèe.
eng: whom God set forth to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God's forbearance;

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni na e duŋshì bèe enɛ e ce gèe buu à njî yɛɛnì tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, a ker gee bèe ce a byemi nè Jisos Krâis a ba byɛɛnì foŋ.
eng: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

lmp: Banɛ àde' sèe ker naatu a? Njì mò' yu ka'. Njokɛ? Njobè' Nyʉ̀ à gèe sèe à ba bêe byɛɛnì à ke' ba ba njo' mncir ka', yu ba njo' rbyemì.
eng: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

lmp: Wèr à làa wernɛ ŋwɛ̀ yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ce ŋgàŋ ka' byemi; ca yi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè mncir ka'.
eng: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

lmp: Wà' Nyʉ̀ ku ba ba Nyʉ̀ Jus cà'cà' a? Àmbò e yu Nyʉ̀ bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ a? Ɛ̀no, e yu Nyʉ̀ bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ,
eng: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn't he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

lmp: njobè' Nyʉ̀ ku ba mò'sir cà'cà'. E be gèe Jus ce a ke gèe bʉ̀ nà àmbò bêe byɛɛnì, ce wowèe a ka' byemi nè Jisos Krâis. Yi ku ba wa' foŋ nè bèe ce a ke gèe bʉ̀ ka' nà. Nyʉ̀ be gèe wowèe tɛ a ba byɛɛnì ce wowèe à ka' byemi nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.

lmp: Wà' cena yi yu sè'ni enɛ sèe lor mncir à yuu cicì njo' rbyemì a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Yi yu ba enɛ sèe tapsi mncir.
eng: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

lmp: Àde' sèe laa seekɛ àmbò Abràham ce e yu tar nè sèe ce sèe yu Jûs?
eng: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ka' ba gee Abràham ba yɛɛnì njobè' buu ce e m gèe, Abràham à m ba tʉr yuu ce àtà e m ba naa nyor àgho. Geewa'a, e m tʉr yuu mo' à rnàanyor àgho à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka',
eng: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

lmp: njobè' Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Abràham à m byemi nè Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à lor ye à ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì njo' li rbyemì."
eng: For what does the Scripture say? Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' gee rfà', a la' ye, banɛ mbàa ce a là' ye àgho anà yu yì ce a fa ye fa ka', njobè' e fà' a ka' koni.
eng: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ fa' ka', byemi ba nè Nyʉ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke gèe bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep a ba byɛɛnì, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be lòr ŋwɛ̀ anà àmbò ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, njobè' e byemi nè ye.
eng: But to him who doesn't work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

lmp: Dɛvìd ye ye à m làa foŋ wa'a, enɛ Nyʉ̀ à ka' lor ŋwɛ̀ àmbò ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì ke' ba njobè' rfà' ce ŋgàŋ à gèe ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu sê.
eng: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à fòosi wowèe efa wap bsàrbuu a ma' yàp buu bbebep anà, a yu ŋgâa mbôŋtu.
eng: Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered. Romans Ruêm 4 8 Ñwáè ce Tata Nyúè be keèr ce beè' buu bbebep ce ñgaèñ aè m geèe ka', yu ñwáâ rboâñtu." Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.

lmp: Wà' bèe ce a yu ŋgâa mbôŋtu ca ku ba ba bèe ce a gèe bʉ̀ a? Bèe ce a gèe bʉ̀ ka' a be ba ŋgâa mbôŋtu foŋ. Kwà'shi ka nè àmbò Abràhâm. To sèe ce làa seenɛ Nyʉ̀ à m lòr Abràham à ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì njo' li rbyemì.
eng: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m lòr Abràham àmbò ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì nà, Abràham à m banì gèe bʉ̀ a? Yi yu wa' ka', à m ba à nfè' anà e be gee bʉ̀ ka'.
eng: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

lmp: A m gèe ye bʉ̀, e ba àmbò ncòo wa'a, ce e m ce dùŋshi enɛ e yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njo' li rbyemì, ka' a m be gee ye bʉ̀ à nfè' anà ka' wa'a. Yi ka' ba à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a, Abràham à ba sè'ni tàr bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a byemi, Nyʉ̀ à ce yɛ wowèe à bêe byɛɛnì, ka' wowèe a gèe bʉ̀ ka' wa'a.
eng: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

lmp: Yìsèe ta Abràham ca yu tàr nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a gèe bʉ̀, a ke' ku gèe ba bʉ̀ cà'cà' ka', a ce jɛ̀r njep mi mkùu, a byemi àmbò e m byemi tɛ a ka' kè gèe ye bʉ̀ nà.
eng: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kà' Abràham ker ba ŋgʉ̀ Abràham enɛ e be fa ŋgòŋ nè wowèe. Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè Abràham wa'a njobè' e m ce lɛ̀ mncir ka'. E m kà' wa'a njobè' Abràham à m byemi nè ye a ba yɛɛnì a yê bsii.
eng: For the promise to Abraham and to his seed that he should be heir of the world wasn't through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

lmp: Yi m ba ba enɛ bèe ce a ce lɛ̀ mncir a bèe ce a be koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà', yi ba ba enɛ rbyemì li tʉr sɛ' ka', tɛ mkà'ni anà mi ba foŋ à cicì.
eng: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

lmp: Geewa'a, mncir vi ce gèe yi, ntee yi ce bep Nyʉ̀ nè bèe bep. Mncir vi ka' tɛ ba ka', ŋwɛ̀ bʉ' mncir ka'.
eng: For the law works wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

lmp: Banɛ mkà'ni anà mi yu ba nè bèe ce a byemi. Yi yu wa'a tɛ yi bo ba rara enɛ e ce fa buu ce e m kà' anà nè sèe njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ, tɛ buu anà bo ba àgho nè ŋgʉ̀ Abràham wɛɛwɛ, kè' kù ba ba nè bèe ce a ce lɛ̀ mncir ka', vi bo ba àgho nè bèe ce a byemi nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò Abràham à m byemi nà foŋ. Abràham yu tàr nè sèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ gèe wɛ̀ ba tàr nè bto' magòr" nà. Banɛ à bsii Nyʉ̀, Abràham yu tàr nè sèe. Yu ye ce Abràham à m byemi nè ye nà. Yu ye Nyʉ̀ ce e ke gèe bèe ce a kweŋger, a kʉtì btèe. Yu ye ce e ke làa, yuu ce yi m be ba ka', yi ku ba.
eng: As it is written, I have made you a father of many nations. This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

lmp: Abràham à m ku lɛ mi mmir mbendù Nyʉ̀, a byemi yuu ce e m kà', ka' yi m ce yɛɛti enɛ yuu ce Abràham à m lɛ̀ mmir mbendù mo nà yi be geeti ka' wa'a. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Abràham à lo a ba tàr nè bto' magòr. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwà' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Yo ŋgʉ̀ be ba gòr àmbò mkàŋsì wa'a."
eng: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, So will your seed be.

lmp: Abràham à m ba à nfè' anà àmbò bfè' rjèe. E m rìŋ enɛ e yu gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀, a riŋ enɛ Sɛ̀ra yu kar. Ka' e m rìŋ wa'a, e m ku byemi a sɛ ka'.
eng: Without being weakened in faith, he didn't consider his own body, already having been worn out, he being about a hundred years old, and the deadness of Sarah's womb.

lmp: E m tarni ka', a ku byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ be gèe yuu ce e m làa. E m ku tɛɛ tatap njo' li rbyemì, a ce kù'si Nyʉ̀.
eng: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn't waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

lmp: E m rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr ŋger à rgèe yuu ce e m kà' anà.
eng: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

lmp: A mbùu ce Nyʉ̀ à m yɛ ye à ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì njo' li rbyemì.
eng: Therefore it also was reckoned to him for righteousness.

lmp: Blàa ce a saŋ enɛ̂, "A m yɛ ye à ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì" nà, a m ku saŋ ba njo' Abràham cà'cà' ka',
eng: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

lmp: a m saŋ njo' sèe foŋ. Tata Nyʉ̀ be yɛ sèe àmbò bêe byɛɛnì, ce sèe ka' byemi nè ye ce e m fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe.
eng: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,

lmp: A m yʉ ye njo' yìsèe buu bbebep, Nyʉ̀ à fʉr ye efa rkwe tɛ sèe bo ba byɛɛnì a yê bsii.
eng: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' sèe yu byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njo' lisèe rbyemì, sèe ce cu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀ sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe njo' yuu ce yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis à m gèe.
eng: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

lmp: Yu ye ce e gèe sèe à konì fɛŋ, a riŋ rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ ce sèe ce yɛ sè'ni na, a ce lu'shi njobè' sèe rìŋ seenɛ sèe be koni fòo ce yi lò ese Nyʉ̀.
eng: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

lmp: Mo' foŋ yi yu enɛ sèe ce lu'shi à ŋgɛ' ce sèe ce yɛ njobè' sèe rìŋ seenɛ ŋgɛ' e ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e kur ntee;
eng: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;

lmp: ŋkur ntee anà e gèe ŋgèe ŋwɛ̀ yi boŋ Nyʉ̀. Yisèe ŋgèe yi ka' boŋ Nyʉ̀, banɛ yi be gèe tɛ sèe lɛ mmir mbendù Nyʉ̀.
eng: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

lmp: Sèe à ka' lɛ mmir mbendù Nyʉ̀ wa'a, sèe lɛ à cicì ka' njobè' sèe rìŋ seenɛ Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ sèe magòr sê. Sèe rìŋ wa'a, ba à ŋger Yʉ' Rara ce e fa nè sèe nà.
eng: and hope doesn't disappoint us, because God's love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ à m ba à nfè' ce sèe à m rìŋ à rjà' visèe btu ka' nà, Krâis à vʉ à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m lɛ̀, a kwe a sêe btù ce sèe yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep.
eng: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ yi yu àtɛ̀r nè ŋwɛ̀ à rkwe àtu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'; ka' ŋgàŋ à ka' ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì ɛ̀. Seemò' àde' ŋwɛ̀ ku byemi enɛ e be kwe àtu ŋwɛ̀ ce yì ndèe bòŋ sê.
eng: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò Nyʉ̀, e dùŋshi sèe enɛ e kòŋ sèe sê, njobè' à m ba à nfè' ce sèe à m ku bii ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep nà, Krâis à kwe a sêe btù.
eng: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' rkwe Jisos Krâis, Nyʉ̀ à gee sèe à ba byɛɛnì, banɛ yi yu mini ghup enɛ Jisòs be jà' sèe efa rshentee Nyʉ̀ foŋ.
eng: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God's wrath through him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce sèe à m ku bii ŋgâa bbàa nè Nyʉ̀, muu yì à gee sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe à kʉtì àbee njo' li rkwe. Yi ka' ba enɛ sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe à kʉtì àbee, banɛ yi yu mini enɛ sèe be lùŋ njobè' e cu ntèe.
eng: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

lmp: A yi wa' wɛɛ ka'. Sè'ni na, sèe ce lu'shi njo' yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe nè sèe njo' rkwe yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis, à ba ye ce e m gèe sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe à kʉtì àbee.
eng: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ buu bbebep à m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na njo' ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, a vʉ nè rkwe. Yi ka' ba wa'a, rkwe li vʉ àndù bèe wɛɛwɛ njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a gèe buu bbebep.
eng: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.

lmp: Buu bbebep à m ku ba njep ŋgòŋ tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kè fa vi mncir. Mncir vi ka' tɛ ba àgho ka', àde' a be' buu bbebep ce ŋwɛ̀ à gèe ka'.
eng: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, rkwe li m ku ba à nfè' ce ncir yi m be ba ka', kɛ' ese à nfè' yì Adàm du ba' à nfè' yì Musìs, rkwe li m ku ba, ka' wowèe a m gèe njɛ̀ɛ yuu bebep ce Adàm à m gèe à nfè' ce e m tèe tu nè Nyʉ̀ nà ka' wa'a. Adàm yu àmbò rlèŋshi Jisos Krâis ce e bii ka' vʉ̀.
eng: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren't like Adam's disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, rfa ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa njo' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m bii ka' vʉ̀ anà li yu jɛɛ efa yuu bebep ce Adàm à m gèe. Bèe magòr a m kweŋger njo' yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir ce yu Adàm à m gèe. À ka' ba njobè' rbôŋntee ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir foŋ ce yu Jisos Krâis, bèe magòr se a konì rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ ce yu rfa ce e fa à cicì.
eng: But the free gift isn't like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

lmp: Sɛ' efa rfa Nyʉ̀ yu jɛɛ efa sɛ' efa yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe. Ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe yuu bebep, Nyʉ̀ à sa' bèe, wowèe a gwe mnsa'. Geewa'a, bèe magòr a ku ce gèe buu bbebep, Nyʉ̀ à ku fa bèe rfa à cicì, a gee wowèe a ba byɛɛnì a yê bsii.
eng: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe, yi m gèe rkwe li tʉr ŋger mbendù ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ, bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce kweŋger njobè' ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir anà, banɛ yi yu foŋ enɛ rbôŋntee ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, ce yu Jisos Krâis, li be gèe bèe magòr a koni rfa ce à cicì, ba bêe byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, koni ryòŋ, so buu bbebep.
eng: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

lmp: Banɛ àmbò yuu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe yi m gèe bèe wɛɛwɛ a gwe mnsa' Nyʉ̀ nà, yi yu foŋ enɛ yuu yɛɛnì ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe nà, yi gèe bèe wɛɛwɛ a konì fɛŋ à rso mnsa', koni ryòŋ.
eng: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

lmp: Àmbò bèe magòr a m ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep njobè' ntèetu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir nà, yi yu foŋ enɛ bèe magòr a be ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njobè' ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: For as through the one man's disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m fa mncir tɛ bèe a bo gèe buu bbebep gòr. Ka' yi yu wa'a, fà dì' ce bèe a m ce gèe buu bbebep gòr, rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ li m gha' buu bbebep anà àfo gòr sê.
eng: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;

lmp: Banɛ àmbò buu bbebep à tʉr ŋger mbendù bèe, a vʉ nè rkwe, yi yu foŋ enɛ rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ li tʉr ŋger à rgèe bèe tɛ a ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, koni ryòŋ ce nfesè njo' yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis.
eng: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

lmp: Sèe be ka' làa seekɛ sè'ni? Wà' yi yu enɛ sèe be kù ce gèe buu bbebep tɛ bèe a bo yɛ rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ gòr a?
eng: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

lmp: Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Sèe yu àmbò bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ce àde' buu bbebep ker gee yuu mo' nè sèe ka'. Àde' sèe ker ce gèe buu bbebep à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ weenɛ à m ba à nfè' ce a m bàptir sèe à rlii Jisòs nà, sèe Jisos Krâis wèe à kweŋgèr àbee a?
eng: Or don't you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

lmp: A tuŋ sèe Jisos Krâis wèe àbee à bàptir ce a m bàptir sèe nà, yi ba enɛ sèe wowèe à kweŋger àbee. A m gèe enɛ sèe wowèe kweŋger àbee tɛ sèe bo koni ryòŋ, gèe ba ŋgêe fi àmbò Jisos Krâis à m fʉʉ efa rkwe à ŋger Tàr Nyʉ̀, a koni ryòŋ foŋ nà.
eng: We were buried therefore with him through baptism to death, that just like Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

lmp: Sèe à ka' ba àbee sèe Jisos Krâis wèe à li rkwe, banɛ sèe be kè ba àbee sèe wowèe, fʉʉ efa rkwe àmbò e m fʉʉ nà.
eng: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ à m ba à nfè' ce a m taa Krâis mbe kìntaa nà, a m taa njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce sèe à m ba nà mbo foŋ tɛ a bo yʉ yìsèe ndêe mbembep, fà dì' sèe bo kèr ba bkwàa nè buu bbebep ka'.
eng: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' ŋwɛ̀ à ka' kwe wɛɛ, banɛ ŋgàŋ à lùŋ efa buu bbebep.
eng: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ àmbò sèe Krâis wèe à kwe àbee na, sèe à byemi enɛ sèe be cu sèe Krâis wèe foŋ,
eng: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;

lmp: njobè' sèe rìŋ seenɛ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr Krâis efa rkwe nà, àde' e ker kwe ka'. Rkwe li ker tʉr ŋger mbe yê ndù ka'.
eng: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!

lmp: E m kwe wa'a, a ker kwe ka', tɛ yuu bebep yi ker gèe yuu mo' nè ye ka'. Li rcu ce e ce cu sè'ni na, e ce cu a Nyʉ̀.
eng: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

lmp: Banɛ wee wèe foŋ à ba yɛ wee mnyor àmbò bèe ce a kweŋger, yuu bebep yi ker ce gèe yuu mo' nè wèe ka', wèe à ce cu sè'ni wèe Nyʉ̀ wèe njobè' wèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu àbee.
eng: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa mà'shi tɛ yuu bebep yi tʉr ŋger mbendù wee mnyor ce vi be kweŋger, tɛ wèe ce gèe buu bbebep ce wèe ce kòŋ na ka'.
eng: Therefore don't let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

lmp: Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa yè nyor kʉti ba yuu ce wèe be ce gèe buu bbebep àgho ka'. Fa nè yè nyor ba nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò bèe ce a kweŋger, a kʉti btèe. Mà'shi nè tɛ yè nyor wɛɛwɛ ba ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ be ce gèe mfâ' myɛɛnì àgho.
eng: Neither present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

lmp: Buu bbebep be kèr tʉr ŋger mbe wêe ndù ka' njobè' wèe ker bii njeptii mncir ka', wèe yu ba njeptii rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀.
eng: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

lmp: Sèe be gèe seekɛ sè'ni? Wà' sèe be ce gèe buu bbebep njobè' sèe ker bii njeptii mncir ka', a ba ba njeptii rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr.
eng: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ wèe à ka' fa wêe mnyor nè ŋwɛ̀ tɛ wèe bo ce yu'ni nè ŋgàŋ àmbò bkwàa wa'a, banɛ wèe yu bkwàa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce wèe ce yu'ni nè ye anà a? Wèe à ka' fa wêe mnyor à rgèe buu bbebep, wèe ba bkwàa nè buu bbebep, sɛ' efa gho à ba rkwe. Wèe à ka' fa wêe mnyor à rgèe ŋgèe ryu'nì, wèe ba bkwàa nè ŋgèe ryu'nì, sɛ' efa gho yu enɛ wèe be ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: Don't you know that to whom you present yourselves as servants to obedience, his servants you are whom you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

lmp: Sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ njobè' wèe ce wèe à m ba bkwàa nè buu bbebep, à m kupse, a yu'ni ba nè ryɛ'nì ce a m yɛ'ni wèe nà nè ye ntee wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto you were delivered.

lmp: Wèe à lùŋ efa buu bbebep, a ba bkwàa nè ŋgêe yɛɛnì.
eng: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

lmp: M ce làa àmbo ŋgêe bkwàa tɛ yuu ce m ce làa yi bo ba rara njobè' yi yu tatap nè wèe à rrìŋ buu ca nè bfee vî ŋwɛ̀. À m ba entombì wèe à fa wêe mnyor nè buu bbebep, a ce gèe ba bsàrbuu. Banɛ wèe fa wêe mnyor sè'ni na ba nè ŋgêe yɛɛnì, tɛ wèe bo ba bèe Nyʉ̀ ce wèe yu brara.
eng: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce wèe à m ba bkwàa nè buu bbebep nà, ŋgêe yɛɛnì yi m tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè wèe ka'.
eng: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.

lmp: Wèe à m ye ba njɛ̀ɛ sɛ' kɛ efa buu ce rìtu yi ce koo wèe àgho sè'ni na? Sɛ' efa buu anà yu ba rkwe.
eng: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni na ce wèe à lùŋ efa buu bbebep a ba bkwàa nè Nyʉ̀ na, sɛ' efa gho yu enɛ wèe yu bèe Nyʉ̀ ce wèe yu brara, lò koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.

lmp: Blà' efa buu bbebep yu rkwe, rfa ce Nyʉ̀ ce fa nè bèe à cicì à ba ryòŋ ce nfesè ce sèe à koni njobè' sèe yu àbee sèe Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè sèe.
eng: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce làa nè wèe ce wèe wɛɛwɛ rìŋ mncir. Wèe rìŋ enɛ mncir vi tʉr ŋger mbendù ŋwɛ̀ ba à nfè' ce ŋgàŋ bii ntèe.
eng: Or don't you know, brothers for I speak to men who know the law, that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

lmp: Sèe lor à rdùŋshì, njeŋwɛ̀ à ka' du bgùu, banɛ e be kù cu ba a nduu yì, ce nduu yì anà a ka' ku bii ntèe, àmbò ncir yi làa. Nduu yì à ka' kwe banɛ e lùŋ efa ncir anà.
eng: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

lmp: E ka' ker du bgùu a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' ce nduu yì ku bii ntèe, banɛ e koo nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò'. Nduu yi anà à ka' kwe banɛ e lùŋ efa ncir. E ka' du bgùu a mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò' à nfè' anà, banɛ e koo nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yi ku ba nè wèe wa' foŋ. À ka' ba àmbò ŋger ce mncir vi tʉr mbe wêe ndù, yi yu sè'ni enɛ wèe à kwe, njobè' wèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu à ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir. Yi yu sè'ni na enɛ wèe cu njeptii nduu mò' jɛɛ, ce e yu Krâis ce Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr efa rkwe tɛ sèe bo gèe buu bbòŋboŋ nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit to God.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce sèe à m ce gèe buu ce e ke kòŋ ba ŋwɛ̀ à rgèe nà, mncir vi m ce nàashi visèe mntee, sèe à ce gèe buu bbebep, buu bbebep anà à lʉsì ba nè rkwe.
eng: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring forth fruit to death.

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni na, sèe à luŋ efa mncir. Sèe à kweŋger, yuu ce yi m kur sèe nà, yi ker tʉr ŋger mbe sêe ndù ka'. Sèe ce fà' nè Nyʉ̀ sè'ni na, a ce lɛ̀ mncir vî brʉ̀ʉ ce a saŋ nà ka'. Sèe ce fà' nè Nyʉ̀ ba à njî nfi, ce Yʉ' yi ce dùŋshi sèe.
eng: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

lmp: Sèe be ka' làa seekɛ sè'ni à? Wà' sèe be làa seenɛ mncir yu yuu bebep a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Yuu ce yi m gèe m ka' riŋ yuu bebep, à m ba mncir. Ncir yi m ka' tɛ bà làa enɛ̂, "Fa gani ka'" ka', mɛ̀ m ba rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ e ke gani yuu, banɛ ŋgàŋ à gèe yuu bebep ka'.
eng: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn't have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn't have known coveting, unless the law had said, You shall not covet.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' ncir anà, yuu bebep yi konì fɛŋ a gee mɛ̀ ce gani buu njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Mncir vi ka' tɛ ba àgho ka', buu bbebep yɛɛtì ka'.
eng: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

lmp: Nfè' mò' à m ba ce mɛ̀ m rìŋ mncir ka', a ku ba ntèe. Mncir vi ka' vʉ̀, yuu bebep yi ba tèe,
eng: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

lmp: mɛ̀ kwe. Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ mncir ce a m fa tɛ bèe a bo koni ryòŋ nà, vi gèe mɛ̀ kwe kwe.
eng: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' mncir anà, yuu bebep yi konì fɛŋ a bo' mɛ̀, a yʉ mɛ̀.
eng: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

lmp: Banɛ buu ca ce dùŋshi enɛ mncir vi yu brara, buu wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à làa vi ba brara a ba byɛɛnì, a bôŋ.
eng: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

lmp: Wà' yi yu enɛ yuu ce yi m ba bòŋboŋ yi m vʉ̀ ba nè rkwe nè mɛ̀ a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Yu ba buu bbebep ce vi m lòr mncir ce vi m ba bbòŋboŋ, a vʉ ba nè rkwe nè mɛ̀. Cena yi m ba wa'a, tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ yuu bbebep. À ka' ba njobè' yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à làa, yuu bebep yi bep ghup nè mini- ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ mncir yu ba yuu ce à yʉ', mɛ̀ ba ya ba ŋwɛ̀ ce a fyèni àmbò ŋkwàa wa'a nè buu bbebep.
eng: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

lmp: M rìŋ mbùu ce m ce gèe buu ce m ce gèe na ka', m ce gèe ba buu ce ya ntee yi ce kòŋ à rgèe ka'. M ce gèe ba buu ce mɛ̀ bàa.
eng: For I don't know what I am doing. For I don't practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

lmp: M ka' ce gèe buu ce ya ntee yi kòŋ à rgèe ka', banɛ cena yi ce dùŋshi enɛ mɛ̀ byemi mɛnɛ mncir vi yu bbòŋboŋ.
eng: But if what I don't desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

lmp: Banɛ buu anà ce gèe ba mɛ̀ ka', ce gèe ba buu bbebep ce vi yu njep mɛ̂ ntee.
eng: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ yuu bòŋboŋ mo' yi yu njep mɛ̂ ntee ka', m ce làa ba buu ce m ce kòŋ àmbò ŋwɛ̀. Ntee à rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ yi yu njep rbʉ̀, mmbo à rgèe yuu anà mi ba ka'.
eng: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don't find it doing that which is good.

lmp: M ce gèe yuu bòŋboŋ ce m ce kòŋ à rgèe na ka', a ce gèe ba yuu bebep ce m ce kòŋ à rgèe ka' nà.
eng: For the good which I desire, I don't do; but the evil which I don't desire, that I practice.

lmp: Àmbò m ce gèe ba buu ce m ce kòŋ à rgèe ka' na, ce gèe ba mɛ̀ ka', ce gèe ba buu bbebep ce vi yu njep mɛ̂ ntee.
eng: But if what I don't desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

lmp: Banɛ mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ yi yu sè'ni àmbò ncir wa'a enɛ m ka' ce kòŋ à rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ, ku vʉ ba yî bebep njep mɛ̂ ntee.
eng: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

lmp: M ce yu' rbòŋ nè mncir Nyʉ̀ enjep mɛ̂ mbùu ntee.
eng: For I delight in God's law after the inward man,

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ ncir mo' jɛɛ yi yu njep mɛ̂ blɛɛ, a ce mà' bìr a ncir enjep mɛ̂ ntee, a gee mɛ̀ ba ŋkwàa nè ncir yuu bebep ce yi yu njep mɛ̂ blɛɛ nà.
eng: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

lmp: Mɛ̀ bʉ ghup. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be jà' mɛ̀ efa nyor ce e be gèe tɛ m kwe na yu nda?
eng: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

lmp: Sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ njo' yuu ce yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis à m gèe. Banɛ yi yu enɛ m yu ŋkwàa nè mncir Nyʉ̀ enjep mɛ̂ ntee, yà nyor à ba ŋkwàa nè ncir yuu bebep.
eng: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God's law, but with the flesh, the sin's law.

lmp: Banɛ bèe ce a Jisos Krâis wèe a yu àbee a be kèr gwè mnsa' ka',
eng: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don't walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

lmp: njobè' ŋger Yʉ' ce yi vʉ̀ nè ryòŋ njo' Jisos Krâis yi gèe mɛ̀ luŋ efa ŋger buu bbebep ba rkwe.
eng: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à gèe yuu ce mncir vi tʉr ŋger à rgèe ka', njobè' ŋwɛ̀ à mòo à rlɛ̀ mncir làr. E m tuu muu yì, e beeŋgèr à ŋwɛ̀ àmbò sèe ce sèe yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, tɛ e bo gèe tɛ buu bbebep mî. A mbò e m so buu bbebep enjep sêe mntee à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a.
eng: For what the law couldn't do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wa'a tɛ sèe ce sèe ce gèe ŋgèe ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ kòŋ ka', a ce gèe ba àmbò Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce kòŋ, bo gèe ba buu byɛɛnì ce vi ghɛɛte àmbò mncir vi ce làa.
eng: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

lmp: Bèe ce a ce gèe ba yuu ce yàp nyor kòŋ, a ku ce kwà'shi ba àmbò yàp nyor. Bèe ce a ce gèe ba buu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi kòŋ, a ku ce kwà'shi ba àmbò buu Nyʉ̀.
eng: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lɛ ntee ba à yuu ce yì nyor kòŋ, banɛ e be kwe. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lɛ ntee ba à yuu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi kòŋ, banɛ e be koni ryòŋ, cu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lɛ ntee ba à yuu ce yì nyor kòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ be ba ŋwɛ̀ bbàa nè Nyʉ̀ njobè' e ce yu'ni nè mncir Nyʉ̀ ka'. Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, e mòo à ryu'ni nè mncir anà làr.
eng: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God's law, neither indeed can it be.

lmp: Àde' bèe ce a ce gèe ba buu ce ŋwɛ̀ kòŋ, a gee yuu ce nyor boŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Those who are in the flesh can't please God.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ka' ba njep wêe mntee ghup, banɛ wèe be kèr lɛ̀ ntee ba à buu ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke kòŋ à rgèe ka', wee be lɛ̀ ntee ba à buu Yʉ' Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ tʉr Yʉ' Krâis ka', banɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà yu yì ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn't have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

lmp: Krâis ka' ba njep wèe, ka' wêe mnyor vi kweŋger njobè' buu bbebep wa'a, wèe yu btèe à yʉ' njobè' e gèe wèe à ba byɛɛnì.
eng: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

lmp: Yʉ' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe yi ka' ba njep wèe, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe be gèe foŋ tɛ wêe mnyor ce àtà vi kweŋgèr na, vi kʉti btèe. E be gèe wa'a à ŋger yi yʉ' ce yi yu njep wèe nà.
eng: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, banɛ yuu mo' yi yu ce sèe be kù gèe, à ke' ba enɛ sèe yu'ni nè nyor, cu ba àmbò e ce kòŋ ka'.
eng: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' cu ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ e ke kòŋ, banɛ à be kwe. Wɛ̀ ka' yʉ buu ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke kòŋ à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, banɛ à be cu.
eng: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce dùŋshi wowèe nduunjì, a yu boo Nyʉ̀.
eng: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

lmp: Yʉ' ce wèe à m koni nà yu ba yʉ' ce yi gèe wèe à ba bkwàa tɛ wèe bo ce wɛp buu ka', yu ba yʉ' ce yi gèe wèe à ba ba boo Nyʉ̀. Yʉ' anà yi gèe sèe à ce war nè Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Abà, Yà Tâ."
eng: For you didn't receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, Abba! Father!

lmp: Yʉ' anà ba visèe mntee a ce dùŋshi enɛ sèe yu boo Nyʉ̀.
eng: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

lmp: Sèe à ka' ba boo banɛ sèe yu bèe ce sèe be ye bti'. Sèe yu ŋgâa ye bti' Nyʉ̀. Sèe Jisos Krâis wèe be ye bti' anà àbee. Sèe ka' yɛ ŋgɛ' sèe Jisòs wèe banɛ sèe wowèe be kè sa' fòo.
eng: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ àde' sèe be'nì ŋgɛ' ce sèe ce yɛ sè'ni na à fòo ce sèe be kè sa' na ka'.
eng: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe vi cu a ce kè' nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ boo vi a yɛɛti.
eng: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu ca à lo a kʉti à buu bcicì. À m kòŋ buu ca à rkʉti à buu bcicì ka', à m kòŋ Nyʉ̀ enɛ buu anà ba wa'a, a ce kè' enɛ,
eng: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

lmp: buu wɛɛwɛ ce e m gèe be luŋ efa rbʉ̀tè, tɛ vi bo koni rbòŋ efa fòo ce boo Nyʉ̀ a be koni.
eng: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe vi ce warŋger, a ce yu' ryaŋ àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ce e ce luuti muu wa'a, vʉ ba' ntìni na.
eng: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

lmp: Ku ba ba buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ce vi ce warŋger ka'. See sèe ce Nyʉ̀ à fa sèe yi yʉ' ce yu rfa entombì nà, sèe ce warŋger enjep ntee foŋ, a ce kè' nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be koo sèe àmbò boo vi, gèe tɛ visèe mnyor vi lûŋ.
eng: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

lmp: Sèe ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe sèe à lûŋ, sèe ce kè' nfè' ce sèe be koni buu anà. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yɛ yuu ce e ba ce kè', e ker ce kè' yi ka'. Wà' àde' ŋwɛ̀ ker cu à rkè' yuu ce e yɛ wɛɛ a?
eng: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

lmp: Sèe à ka' ce kè' yuu ce sèe à be yɛ ka', banɛ sèe be kur ntee ce kè' yi.
eng: But if we hope for that which we don't see, we wait for it with patience.

lmp: Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ foŋ yi ce jà' sèe ce sèe yu nè bsɛ̀-ŋwɛ̀, njobè' sèe rìŋ à rloo àmbò sèe à ba loo ka'. Yʉ' anà yi ke bu' mmbo nè Nyʉ̀ a sêe btù nè rwarŋgèr-ŋwɛ̀, à njì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ laa ka'.
eng: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don't know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can't be uttered.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fyɛ' visèe mntee wɛɛwɛ rìŋ yuu ce Yʉ' yi ce kwà'shi, njobè' yʉ' yi ce bu' mmbo àtu bèe Nyʉ̀ à buu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ.
eng: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit's mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ Nyʉ̀ à gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi koni à kʉtì ba rbòŋ nè bèe ce a kòŋ ye, ce yu bèe ce e kɛ' àmbò e m kòŋ à rgèe efa rkɛ̀'.
eng: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

lmp: Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m rìŋ wɛɛ enɛ a be ba yì bèe nà, e m làa enɛ e be gèe tɛ wowèe a feese muu yì, tɛ muu yì anà bo ba muu nlee nè bfʉr magòr.
eng: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

lmp: Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ wowèe a be feese muu yì nà, e m kɛ' wowèe. Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' anà, e m gèe wowèe a ba byɛɛnì. Bèe ce e m gèe wowèe a ba byɛɛnì nà, e m kù'si wowèe foŋ.
eng: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

lmp: Àde' sèe ka' ker laa seekɛ àmbò sèe rìŋ buu ca na? Nyʉ̀ à ka' ba à mbèp yìsèe, ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e ker gee yuu mo' nè sèe ba nda?
eng: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kani efa rfa muu yì ka'. E m fa muu yì a sêe btù. E ka' fa muu yì, banɛ e be fa sèe buu wɛɛwɛ foŋ à cicì.
eng: He who didn't spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e laa enɛ bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à ce a yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep yu nda? Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe sèe à ba byɛɛnì.
eng: Who could bring a charge against God's chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be làa enɛ sèe à gwè nsa' yu nda? Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ka', njobè' Jisos Krâis ce e m kwe, a ker lo a fʉʉ efa rkwe foŋ, cu sè'ni na à rkoo mâ' Nyʉ̀, a ce loo a sèe btù.
eng: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e gapnì sèe efa rkòŋnì ce Krâis kòŋ sèe nà, yu nda? Yuu mo' yi yu ka', kɛ̀ sèe yu à ŋgɛ' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ buu à tap nè sèe se ɛ̀, kɛ̀ bèe a ce fa sèe ŋgɛ' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ njè ce yaŋ sèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ sèe à buu bcɛ̀' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu rkwe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ bèe a ce yʉ sèe ɛ̀, àde' sèe Jisòs wèe gapnì ka'.
eng: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "À ka' ba njobè' wèe, bèe a tà' yʉshi wèr à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, a ce lòr wèr àmbò njèe ce a ce dù àgho à rsɛɛ wa'a."
eng: Even as it is written, For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò buu ce vi koni wèr na, wèr à so vi wɛɛwɛ a misî, njo' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kòŋ wèr.
eng: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

lmp: M rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ yuu mo' yi yu ce àde' yi gapnì sèe efa rkòŋnì ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ sèe na ka'. Kɛ̀ yu rkwe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu rlùŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bcìndap Nyʉ̀, kɛ̀ yu mnyʉ̂mkà' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu buu ce vi yu àgho sè'ni na ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu buu ce vi bii ka' ba ɛ̀, kɛ̀ njɛ̀ɛ ŋger kɛ ɛ̀,
eng: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

lmp: kɛ̀ yu ba vì embe bùu ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu ba vì enjep mʉ̀ nshe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu ba yuu mo' efa buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ɛ̀, yuu mo' yi yu ce àde' yi gapnì sèe efa rkòŋnì ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ sèe njo' Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè sèe nà ka'.
eng: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

lmp: M ce làa ba yuu mini à rlii Krâis. M ce nya' mnde' ka'. Ya ntee ce Yʉ' Rara yi yu njo yi tɛɛ yà njìnsa' enɛ,
eng: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit,

lmp: m ce koosimnse sê, ntee yi ce yaŋ mɛ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ,
eng: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

lmp: nè yà bèe ce a yu bfʉr wa seesê, wèr wowèe à ba lɛɛ e mo'sir. M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ ndòo co' mɛ̀, tɛ wèr Jisos Krâis gapni, ce yi ka' ba enɛ ŋgàpni anà yi be jà' yà bèe.
eng: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers' sake, my relatives according to the flesh,

lmp: Wowèe a yu bèe Isrɛ̀l. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wowèe a bo ba boo vi, a fa yi fòo nè wowèe. E m ye lè' a wowèe, a fa wowèe mncir. E m suŋ wowèe àmbò àde' wowèe a gee rloo. E m gèe mi mkà'ni ba nè wowèe.
eng: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

lmp: Wowèe a yu bèe embe ndʉ̀' Abràham ba Aisìk ba Jakòp. A m bi Krâis à ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' anà, e ba Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ. Sèe yoŋshi ye à nfè' sìp. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

lmp: Wà' yi yɛɛti enɛ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè bèe Isrɛ̀l yi buu efa rgèetì a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Bèe wɛɛwɛ embe ndʉ̀' Isrɛ̀l a yu bèe Isrɛ̀l ka'.
eng: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu boo Abràham njobè' wowèe a yu bèe embe ndʉ̀' Abràham ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Abràham enɛ̂, "Boo ce a be lɛ̀ lo rlii be ba boo Aisìk."
eng: Neither, because they are Abraham's seed, are they all children. But, In Isaac will your seed be called.

lmp: Cena yi ce dùŋshi enɛ yu boo wɛɛwɛ ce Abràham à m bi ce a yu boo Nyʉ̀ ka'; yu ba boo ce a m bi njo' mŋkà'ni ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nè Abràham ce a ce bè' à boo Abràhâm.
eng: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as a seed.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe mŋkà'ni anà, a laa enɛ̂, "Nfè' be ghɛɛ tɛ m kʉti; tɛ Sɛ̀ra bi muu mbaŋrù."
eng: For this is a word of promise, At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.

lmp: Yi ku ba ba wa' cà'cà' ka'. Boo Rɛ̀bɛkà a m tʉr tàr mò'sir ce e yu yìsèe ta Aisìk.
eng: Not only so, but Rebecca also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, à m ba à nfè' ce boo anà a m ku bii njep rbʉ̀, a ke' be gèe yuu bbebep kɛ̀ yuu bòŋboŋ ka', Nyʉ̀ à laa nè Rɛ̀bɛkà enɛ̂, "Nlee be fà' nè Ŋkɛ'." Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wa' tɛ yi bo ba enɛ à ce ba ye a ce mò' efa boo ca àmbò e m kwà'shi, à ke' ba ba njobè' yuu mo' ce ŋwɛ̀ anà à m gèe ka', à m ba njobè' à m kɛ̀' ba Nyʉ̀.
eng: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls, it was said to her, The elder will serve the younger.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m kòŋ Jakòp a baa Ɛsò." nà.
eng: Even as it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.

lmp: Banɛ sèe be làa seekɛ? Wà' sèe be làa seenɛ Nyʉ̀ à m gèe yuu mini ka' a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr.
eng: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Musìs enɛ̂, "M be koosimnse nè ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ kòŋ. Be kwà'shi ba mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce m be gèe bòŋboŋ nè ye."
eng: For he said to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.

lmp: Banɛ yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke ce ŋwɛ̀ ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce kòŋ kɛ̀ njo' yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à gèe ka'. E ke ce ba njo' yì ŋkoosimnse cà'cà'.
eng: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè Fɛrò mbe yê ŋwà' enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ ko'si wɛ̀ mbe kʉʉ, tɛ m bo dùŋshi ya ŋger njì enjep wɛ̀, tɛ la rlii li bo yu'ti à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ."
eng: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.

lmp: Banɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke koosimnse nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ à rkoosimnse nè ye, ker teesi tu ese ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ à rtèesi tu ese ye.
eng: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

lmp: Seemò' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ be làa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à ka' ce tàa ŋwɛ̀ njokɛ, àmbò yi yu ba enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ kanì efa rgèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ ŋgàŋ gee ka' na?"
eng: You will say then to me, Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?

lmp: Wɛ̀ ce à ku ba ba ŋwɛ̀, à yu nda ka' bèesi cùu wèe Nyʉ̀? Àde' rkìŋ li laa nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e boo li enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ boo mɛ̀ wa'a njokɛ" a?
eng: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, Why did you make me like this?

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mboo mkìŋ lor mboo, gee yuu ce e kòŋ àgho. Àde' e lor mboo embe dî' mo'sir boo mkìŋ àgho mmbaa, rmo' li boŋ du misî, rmo' li ku ba ba à rkìŋ.
eng: Or hasn't the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m ce kòŋ à rdùŋshi li rshentee, gèe tɛ bèe a bo yɛ yi ŋger, a lo a kur ba ntee nè bèe ce a m gèe ntee yi bep ye, à ba bèe ce yi m ba enɛ e be yʉshi wowèe nà,
eng: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath made for destruction,

lmp: banɛ e m gèe wa'a tɛ e bo dùŋshi rbòŋ efa yi fòo nè bèe ce e m ce koosimnse nè wowèe, à ba bèe ce e m kupshi tɛ wowèe a bo koni fòo anà nà.
eng: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory,

lmp: A sèe bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' enɛ a ba yì bèe anà. E ku kɛ' bèe ba efa mʉ̀ Jus ka', e kɛ' bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ.
eng: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à làa mbe ŋwâ' Hòsiyà enɛ̂, "Bèe ce a m ba yà bèe ka', m be too wowèe enɛ yà bèe. M be too to' ce mɛ̀ m kòŋ ka' enɛ ya to' ce m kòŋ sê."
eng: As he says also in Hosea, I will call them 'my people,' which were not my people; and her 'beloved,' who was not beloved.

lmp: E ker laa foŋ enɛ̂, "Mbe dì' ce a m làa nè wowèe enɛ, "wèe yu yà bee ka'", ku ba mbe dì' anà ce a be too wowèe enɛ boo Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe."
eng: It will be that in the place where it was said to them, 'You are not my people,' There they will be called 'children of the living God.'

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe Isrɛ̀l, Àsayà à m làa yuu a kuu wowèe. E m làa enɛ̂, "Ka' bèe Isrɛ̀l a yu gòr àmbò nsaruŋ àwâa rò wa'a, ku ba bèe mʉcàr efa wâp mʉ ce a be lùŋ."
eng: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

lmp: Tata be càasi nfè' ka', e be sa' mnsa' ŋgòŋ, teni.
eng: for He will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the LORD will make a short work upon the earth.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò Àsayà à m làa foŋ enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ à m ka' tɛ bà mà'shi boo mò' nè sèe ka', sèe à m ba ba àmbò rla' Sodòm ba rla' Gòmorà." wa'a.
eng: As Isaiah has said before, Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.

lmp: Cena yi yu ba enɛ kɛ? Yi yu enɛ bèe enje jɛɛ ce a m ce ghèter à rba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka', a yu sè'ni byɛɛnì njobè' lap rbyemì.
eng: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn't follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

lmp: Bèe Isrɛ̀l ce a m ce ròo yap à rba byɛɛnì njo' mncir ce a m ce lɛ̀, a m mòo làr.
eng: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn't arrive at the law of righteousness.

lmp: Wowèe a m mòo làr njokɛ? À m ba njobè' wowèe a m ghèter à rba byɛɛnì njo' mfà', ke' ba ba njo' rbyemì ka'. Wowèe a m kote à lùr,
eng: Why? Because they didn't seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone;

lmp: ce Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa àgho nà. Yi làa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, m ce lɛ̀ lùr à rla' Sayòn, ce e be gèe tɛ bèe a kote. Lùr anà be gèe tɛ wowèe a gweŋger. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè ye, m ke coosi ŋgàŋ ka'."
eng: even as it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kòŋ nè ya ntee-ŋwɛ̀, a ker ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ enɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l a lûŋ.
eng: Brothers, my heart's desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wowèe a lɛ̀ ntee à rdù àmbùu Nyʉ̀, a ke' riŋ njî mini ka'.
eng: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

lmp: Wowèe a m rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Nyʉ̀ e ke gèe bèe a ba byɛɛnì ka', a ce ghèter à rròo ba nduunjì yap à rba byɛɛnì, a kani yap yu njì yì Nyʉ̀.
eng: For being ignorant of God's righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn't subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

lmp: Krâis à m vʉ̀, rfà' efa mncir li mî, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e byemi nè ye bo ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

lmp: Musìs à m saŋ àmbò àde' ŋwɛ̀ ba yɛɛnì njo' mncir, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' lɛ mncir wɛɛwɛ banɛ ŋgàŋ be cu njo' mncir anà."
eng: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, The one who does them will live by them.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò njì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ ba yɛɛnì njo' rbyemì, e laa enɛ̂, "Fa làa njep wɛ̂ ntee enɛ̂, "Àde' ko' nda mbe bùu lɛ?" ka' ce yi yu enɛ, Be sùu nda nè Krâis embe bùu lɛ?.
eng: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, Don't say in your heart, 'Who will ascend into heaven?' that is, to bring Christ down;

lmp: Fa làa njep wɛ̂ ntee enɛ̂, "Àde' ŋwɛ̀ du mbà yir lɛ?" ka'" ce yi yu enɛ be vʉ̀ nda nè Krâis embà yir? lɛ.
eng: or, 'Who will descend into the abyss?' that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.

lmp: Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ kɛ? Yi làa ba enɛ̂, "Blâa Nyʉ̀ vi yu àtʉtʉ nè wɛ̀; vi yu ku wɛ̂ cùu, a ba njep wɛ̂ ntee." Blàa anà yu blàa ce vi ce suŋ àmbò rbyemì ce wèr ce fè'shi.
eng: But what does it say? The word is near you, in your mouth, and in your heart; that is, the word of faith, which we preach:

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' làa eku wɛ̂ cùu enɛ Jisos yu Tatâ, byemi enjep wɛ̂ ntee enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr ye efa rkwe, banɛ à be lùŋ.
eng: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord, and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ e ke byemi ba enjep ntee ka' ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, e ke làa ba ekù cùu ka' lûŋ.
eng: For with the heart, one believes unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

lmp: Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' byemi nè ye, banɛ e be coosi ŋgàŋ ka'."
eng: For the Scripture says, Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.

lmp: Jus a ker ba jɛɛ efa bèe enje jɛɛ ka'. Krâis yu Tata nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ. E ke ghòni ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' war nè ye.
eng: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' war à rlii Tatâ, banɛ ŋgàŋ be lùŋ" nà.
eng: For, Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.

lmp: Banɛ àde' bèe a war nè ye à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce wowèe a ka' tɛ byemi nè ye ka'? Àde' wowèe a byemì nè ye à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce wowèe a ka' tɛ yu' àmbò ye ka'? Àde' wowèe a yu' àmbò ye à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ fè'shi nè wowèe ka'?
eng: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

lmp: Àde' bèe a du fe'shi à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce a ka' tɛ tuu wowèe ka'? Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Mkùu bèe ce a vʉ̀ a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ mi bòŋ àmbò kɛ wa'a!"
eng: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, bèe wɛɛwɛ a byemi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca ka'. Àsayà à m làa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e byemi yuu ce wèr à làa ka'."
eng: But they didn't all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, Lord, who has believed our report?

lmp: Banɛ yi yu enɛ bèe a ke yu' wɛɛ ka' byemi; bèe a fè'shi àmbò Krâis wɛɛ, bèe a ka' yu'.
eng: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

lmp: M ce bipshi mɛnɛ wowèe a m yu' nsuŋ ca ka' lɛ? Yi yu mini wa' ka'. Yi yu enɛ̂, "Bèe a yu' yàp njèndoŋ à bdì' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ. Wap blàa vi bà' à mmbuu ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ."
eng: But I say, didn't they hear? Yes, most certainly, Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.

lmp: M ker ce bipshi mɛnɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l a m rìŋ ka' lɛ? M be bèesi nè yuu ce Musìs à m saŋ elûuŋgòŋ. E m saŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa, enɛ̂, "M be gèe tɛ wèe ko'ndoŋ nè bèe ce a ghɛɛte à to' ka'. M be gèe tɛ ntee yi bep wèe nè to' ce yi rìŋ yuu ka'."
eng: But I ask, didn't Israel know? First Moses says, I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation, with a nation void of understanding I will make you angry.

lmp: Àsayà ye ye à m raasi sê, a saŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ̂, "Bèe ce a m ce ròo mɛ̀ ka', a yɛ mɛ̀. Mɛ̀ dùŋshi yà nyor nè bèe ce a m ce bipshi enɛ m yu fɛ lɛ ka'."
eng: Isaiah is very bold, and says, I was found by those who didn't seek me. I was revealed to those who didn't ask for me.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò bèe Isrɛ̀l, Àsayà à m saŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ mà' ma mmbo nè yà bèe, kɛ̂' à ŋgàptʉ' du ba' à mbùuŋkùr, wowèe a tee btu, a yu'ni nè mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: But as to Israel he says, All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.

lmp: M be kèr bipshi yuu mo'. Wà' Nyʉ̀ à mà' yì bèe a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. Mɛ mɛ̀ yu mò' efa bèe Isrɛ̀l. M yu ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Abràhâm, a ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ntɛ̀' Bɛnjamɛ̀n.
eng: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à mà' yì bèe ce e m ce efa rkɛ̀' ka'. Mbò wèe rìŋ yuu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ àmbò Àlajà nà a? À m ba mbe nfè' mò', e laa bebep àmbò bèe Isrɛ̀l nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: God didn't reject his people, which he foreknew. Or don't you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Tatâ, bèe ca a yʉshi yo ŋgâa ntuu, a kɛɛshi wo bdî' ntòo mfa, à ku bɛti mɛ̀. Wowèe a ce ròo à ryʉ mɛ̀."
eng: Lord, they have killed your prophets, they have broken down your altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à beesì nè ye enɛ kɛ? E m bèesi enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ bɛr yà bèe ncʉ̀kì sàambâ, ce wowèe a loo nè Baal ka'."
eng: But how does God answer him? I have reserved for myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to Baal.

lmp: Yi ku ba wa' foŋ sè'ni na. Mʉ bèe mò' a ku ba à mʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l ce Nyʉ̀ à ce njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ à ce wowèe njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ banɛ e ce wowèe ba njo' yuu mo' ce wowèe a gèe ka'. E m ka' ba ce wowèe ba njo' yuu mo' ce wowèe a m gèe, yi ntee bòŋboŋ anà à m ba ba ntee bòŋboŋ ghup ka'.
eng: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

lmp: Yuu m ce làa yi yu ba enɛ kɛ? Yi yu enɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ a m koni yuu ce a m ce ròo ese Nyʉ̀ ka'. Mʉ bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce nà a bèe ce a m koni yuu anà. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe bɛr bèe a cip btù'.
eng: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn't obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wowèe a mɛŋnì buu, a ce yɛ buu ka', a ker ce yu' buu ka', caar ba' ntìni na."
eng: According as it is written, God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.

lmp: Dɛvìd ye ye à m làa enɛ̂, "Gèe tɛ yuu ce wowèe a ce yu' rbòŋ àgho nà, yi kʉti ba taa ce yi be koo wowèe. Gèe tɛ wowèe a taŋte, kèr kote à yuu anà, yɛ ŋgɛ' njo' yap yuu ce a gèe anà.
eng: David says, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

lmp: Gèe tɛ wowèe a fâp, fà dì' wowèe a bo kèr yɛ buu ka'. Gʉʉ wap mnjì nfesè."
eng: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Bow down their back always.
