lmp: Wà' cena yi yu enɛ wowèe a m kote tɛ wowèe a bo gwè kèr nàti ka' a? Àde' yi ba wa' ka' koo mʉcàr. À ka' ba njobè' wowèe a m gèe yuu bebep, Nyʉ̀ à fa fɛŋ nè bèe enje jɛɛ tɛ wowèe a bo lùŋ, tɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l a ko'ndoŋ nè wowèe.
eng: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ yuu bebep ce wowèe a m gèe nà à m kʉti ba bghònì nè ŋgòŋ, rgwè ce wowèe a m gwè nà à kʉtì ba bghònì nè bèe enje jɛɛ, banɛ bghònì ce sèe be kè koni à nfè' ce Jus wɛɛwɛ a yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ foŋ nà, vi be kè ba magòr àmbò kɛ?
eng: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fullness?

lmp: M ce làa sè'ni na ba nè wèe ce wèe yu ye bèe enje jɛɛ. M yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu ba nè bèe enje jɛɛ. M ce lòr la rfà' ca à mcɛ̂r ka',
eng: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry;

lmp: tɛ m bo yɛ mɛnɛ àde' m gee yà bèe à ko'ndoŋ tɛ bèe mo' efa wowèe a bo lùŋ lɛ.
eng: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ka' ma' wowèe, bɛr bèe enjep ŋgòŋ a konì fɛŋ à rkʉti àbee a Nyʉ̀ wèe, banɛ yi be ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à ka' koo wowèe à yì bèe? Yi be ba àmbò bèe ce a kweŋger a kʉti lɛ btèe wa'a.
eng: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' top mkʉ̂ŋ brɛ̂d, too brɛ̂d yì entòmbì fa nè Nyʉ̀, banɛ brɛ̂d wɛɛwɛ ce e be tòo efa mkʉ̀ŋ anà yu yî Nyʉ̀. Mŋgâŋ ce ka' ba vi Nyʉ̀, banɛ mmba' ce yu vi foŋ.
eng: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ a m fàrshi mmba' mo' efa ce Olèf ce a m byè à mŋkʉ̀, a lor wèe ce wèe yu ye mmba' ce Olèf ce à rìŋ a bar nje ce Olèf ce à mŋkʉ̀, wèe à ce kù' nè mdip enje nyòr ce anà,
eng: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them, and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree;

lmp: banɛ wèe fa nàa tu enɛ wèe à càa mmba' ce ce a m fàrshi efa Olèf ce à mŋkʉ̀ nà ka'. Wèe à ka' ce nàa nyor, wèe kuushi enɛ yu ba wèe ce wèe ce gèe mŋgâŋ ce vi ce kù' ka', yu ba mŋgâŋ ce ce vi gèe wèe à ka' ce kù'.
eng: don't boast over the branches. But if you boast, it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

lmp: Seemò' à be ce nàa tu enɛ̂, "A m fàrshi mmba' mo' tɛ a bo bar mɛ̀ njo."
eng: You will say then, Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.

lmp: Yi yu mini wa'a. A m fàrshi wowèe njobè' wowèe a m byemi ka'. Wèe yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa ce anà njo' le rbyemì cà'cà'. Banɛ wèe fa nàa tu ka', wèe lor nfè'.
eng: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don't be conceited, but fear;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ka' tɛ koosimnse efa rfàrshi mmba' ce mo' efa ce Olèf yî à mŋkʉ̀ ka', banɛ e be koosimnse efa rfàrshi wèe foŋ ka'.
eng: for if God didn't spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

lmp: Yɛ ka nè àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe mo', a ker ce jar nè bèe mò'. E ce jar nè bèe ce a gwè, a ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè wèe, ce wèe à ka' ku ce jɛ̀r ba njep yi nduunjì. Yi ka' tɛ ba wa' ka' banɛ e be fàr wèe foŋ.
eng: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

lmp: Bèe anà foŋ a ka' kupse byemi, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be bar wowèe nje ce ca. E tʉr ŋger à rgèe wa'a.
eng: They also, if they don't continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

lmp: E m lòr wèe ce wèe yu mmba' ce Olèf efa rìŋ, a bar nje ce Olèf yî à mŋkʉ̀, ce yi ke ba wa'a ka', banɛ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, e tʉr ŋger à rlòr mmba' ce vî à mŋkʉ̀ ce a m fàrshi nà, bar nje ce anà.
eng: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ yuu ce bèe a m be riŋ ka', fà dì' wèe bo ce kwà'shi enɛ wèe tʉr bfee se ka'. Yi yu enɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l a be kù cip btù' nfesè ka'. A be kù cip btù' caar dù bà' à nfè' ce bèe wɛɛwɛ efa mʉ̀ bèe enje jɛɛ ce a ba byemi, a byemi nà.
eng: For I don't desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won't be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

lmp: Ca yi be kè koni, tɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ a lûŋ. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be fʉr bèe efa ŋgɛ' be vʉ̀ efa rla' Sayòn, fʉr ŋgêe bebep embe ndʉ̀' Jakòp.
eng: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

lmp: Be ba à nfè' ce mɛ̀ siŋsi yàp buu bbebep, tɛ yi ba enɛ mɛ̀ gèe yuu ce mɛ̀ m ye lè' mɛnɛ m be gèe nà."
eng: This is my covenant to them, when I will take away their sins.

lmp: Bèe Isrɛ̀l a yu ŋgâa bbàa nè Nyʉ̀ njobè' wowèe a kani Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ. Cena yu sɛ' nè wèe ce wèe yu bèe enje jɛɛ. Ka' yi yu wa'a, e m ce wowèe a ku bii kòŋ wowèe njobè' wap btâ.
eng: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sake.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' ce bèe, ker ghoni wowèe, àde' e ker kupse yi ntee ka'.
eng: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

lmp: À m ba entòmbì, wèe à tee btu nè Nyʉ̀, à ka' ba sè'ni, Nyʉ̀ à koosìmnse nè wèe njobè' ntèetu bèe Isrɛ̀l.
eng: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

lmp: Wowo foŋ a tèe btu nè Nyʉ̀ sè'ni na tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo koosimnse nè wèe, kèr koosimnse nè wowèe foŋ.
eng: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ à fa bèe wɛɛwɛ à shaŋ ntèetu, tɛ e bo koosimnse nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

lmp: Yɛ àmbò Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr nà! Yɛ àmbò e rìŋ buu, a tʉr bfee se nà! Àde' ŋwɛ̀ riŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kwà'shi ka'. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ riŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce gèe yì buu ka'.
eng: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ àmbò Tata e ke kwà'shi yu nda? Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e cep ye yu nda?"
eng: For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?

lmp: "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m be fa Nyʉ̀ yuu tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo là' yuu ce e m fa nè ye anà yu nda?"
eng: Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ à m lò ese Nyʉ̀, buu anà wɛɛwɛ à ba àgho njo' ye, buu wɛɛwɛ à ba yì buu. Tɛ bèe a ku'si ye nfè' sìp! Yi yu wa'a.
eng: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yi ka' ba wa'a, àmbò Nyʉ̀ à koosimnse nè sèe na, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe fa wêe mnyor nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò buu taŋshì ce vi yu btèe, a ba brara, Nyʉ̀ à ce yu' rbòŋ àgho. A njɛ̀ɛ njî yɛɛnì ce ŋwɛ̀ à ba loo nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

lmp: Fa bè'ni nè buu ce bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ce gèe ka'. Mà'shi nè tɛ Nyʉ̀ kupse me mkwà'shì tɛ wèe bo gèe ŋgêe fi. Wèe à ka' gee wa'a, wèe riŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ. Wèe be rìŋ yuu ce yi yu bòŋboŋ, à ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce yu' rbòŋ àgho, a ba yɛɛnì.
eng: Don't be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' ŋger ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè mɛ̀ njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ, m ce làa nè wèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ fa kwà'shi àmbò yi tu, càa embe dì' ce e ba kwà'shi ka'. Kwà'shi àmbò yo tu ba à njî yɛɛnì. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ku kwa'shi àmbò yi tu ba àndèe rbyemì ce Nyʉ̀ à fa ye.
eng: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

lmp: Nyor ku ba mò'sir, a tʉr mŋgʉ̀' nyor jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, ŋgʉ̀' nyor wɛɛwɛ à tʉr li rfà'.
eng: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don't have the same function,

lmp: Yi ku ba nè sèe wa' foŋ. Ka' sèe yu àŋgoo wa'a, sèe ku ba nyor mò'sir njobè' sèe Krâis wèe yu àbee. Yi ka' ba enɛ sèe yu nyor mò'sir, banɛ ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' yu nè yi tu ka'.
eng: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

lmp: Sèe wɛɛwɛ à koni bfee jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ese Nyʉ̀ njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ ce e tʉr nè sèe, a ce gèe mfà' àgho. Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ gèe rfà' nè bfee anà. Nyʉ̀ à ka' fa ŋwɛ̀ bfee ce àde' e cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà cep àmbò li rbyemì li yu.
eng: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' fa ŋwɛ̀ bfee ce àde' e fa' nè bèe, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà fa' nè bèe. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr bfee à ryɛ'nì, ŋgàŋ yɛ'nì bèe.
eng: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr bfee à rfè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀, tapsi bèe àgho, banɛ ŋgàŋ fe'shî. Nyʉ̀ à ka' gee ŋwɛ̀ riŋ à rfa bèe buu, banɛ ŋgàŋ fa mmbo mtoo. Ŋwɛ̀ ka' tʉr bfee à rba tu nè bèe, e sa' bèe nè yi ntee-ŋwɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr bfee à rjà' bèe, ŋgàŋ ja' nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with liberality; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

lmp: Kòŋ nè bèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, baa yuu bebep, koŋ ba yuu bòŋboŋ.
eng: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

lmp: Wèe koŋni àmbò bfʉr. Wèe naa bèe mò' mbekì caa àmbò wèe ce nàa wee btu.
eng: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate one to another; in honor preferring one another;

lmp: Fa koosi nè bbor ka', fà' nè tatap. Fà' nè nè Tata Nyʉ̀ nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

lmp: Lɛ̀ nè mmir mbendù buu ce Nyʉ̀ à kà' nè wèe, ce lu'shi. Tɛɛ nè tatap à nfè' ŋgɛ', ce loo nè Nyʉ̀, ke' ce sɛ ka'.
eng: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ à ka' buu yuu, wèe tʉr yuu anà, wèe fa ye. Koni nè bèe ce a niŋ wèe, gɛ' nè wowèe bòŋboŋ.
eng: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

lmp: Loo nè enɛ Nyʉ̀ ghoni bèe ce a ce fa wèe ŋgɛ'. Fa loo nè enɛ ndòo co' wowèe ka', loo nè ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ ghoni wowèe.
eng: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don't curse.

lmp: Lu'shi nè wèe bèe ce a ce lu'shi, koosimnse wèe bèe ce a ce koosimnse.
eng: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

lmp: Cu nè nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀ wèe bèe wɛɛwɛ. Fa nàa nè tu ka', koo nè bkar wèe bèe ce a lòr wap mnyor njep nshè. Fa kwà'shi nè enɛ wèe yu ŋgâa bfee ka'.
eng: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don't set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don't be wise in your own conceits.

lmp: Fa kʉsi nè yuu bebep nè yuu bebep ka'. Ghèter nè gee ba buu ce vi be ba yɛɛnì à bsii bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

lmp: Gèe nè yuu wɛɛwɛ ce àde' wèe gêe, tɛ wèe bo cu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀ wèe bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

lmp: Bkar wâ, ŋwɛ̀ fa kʉsi mcucu' ka', mà'shi yì anà ba nè rshentee Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kʉsi mcucu' yu mɛ̀. M be là' wowèe. Cena ce làa Tata Nyʉ̀."
eng: Don't seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God's wrath. For it is written, Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.

lmp: Wèe gee ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Njè à ka' ce yaŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa wɛ̀, à fa ye byee. Ntee yi ka' yuushi ye, à fa ye yuu tɛ e no. Wɛ̀ ka' gee wa'a, banɛ wɛ̀ cù' mcùŋ mor mbe yê tu."
eng: Therefore If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.

lmp: Fa mà'shi tɛ yuu bebep yi so wɛ̀ ka'; so yuu bebep nè yuu bòŋboŋ.
eng: Don't be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ yu'ni nè bèe ce a ce sa' to' njobè' Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe enɛ bèe mo' a sa' bèe mo'. Nyʉ̀ ka' tɛ fa ŋwɛ̀ ŋger à rsa' bèe ka', ŋgàŋ tʉr ŋger anà ka'.
eng: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tee tu nè bèe ce a ce sa' bèe, banɛ ŋgàŋ à tèe tu nè yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe. Bèe ce a ka' gee wa'a, banɛ wowèe a ce kɛ' ŋgɛ' mbe wâp btù.
eng: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ wɛp ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce sa' bèe ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e wɛp ye, yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe ŋgêe bebep. Wɛ̀ ka' ce kòŋ à rwɛp ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce sa' bèe ka', à gee ŋgêe bòŋboŋ tɛ e bo yòŋshi wɛ̀.
eng: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ca ce fà' ba nè Nyʉ̀ tɛ e bo jà' wɛ̀. Wɛ̀ ka' gee yuu bebep, à wɛp ye, njobè' ŋger ce a fa ye anà yi yu à cicì ka'. Nyʉ̀ à fa ye ŋger à rkʉsi mcucu' nè bèe ce a ce gèe buu bbebep.
eng: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn't bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

lmp: Banɛ yi yu yɛɛnì à ryu'ni nè ŋgâa rsa', ke' ku ba ba njobè' à ce wɛp ŋgɛ' ka'. Gèe wa'a fà dì' yo ntee yi bo ce sa' wɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience' sake.

lmp: A mbùu ce wêe ke là' mbâa bàrà' foŋ, njobè' bèe ce a ce kùu mbâa bàrà' a ce fà' ba nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God's service, attending continually on this very thing.

lmp: Fa nè yuu ce wèe à ba fa nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ. Kɛ̀ yu mbâa bàrà' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu mbàa ce a làa enɛ à la' àtu buu ce wɛ̀ tʉr ɛ̀, là' yuu ce wɛ̀ ba là'. Wɛp bèe ce wɛ̀ ba wɛp, yu'ni nè bèe ce wɛ̀ ba yu'ni nè wowèe.
eng: Give therefore to everyone what you owe: taxes to whom taxes are due; customs to whom customs; respect to whom respect; honor to whom honor.

lmp: Wèe ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa ba nè rkaa ka'. Rkaa ce àde' à tʉr wèe ŋwɛ̀ li yu enɛ à kòŋ ŋgàŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ bèe, banɛ e lɛ̀ mncir wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

lmp: Mncir Nyʉ̀ vi ce làa enɛ̂, "Fa koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', fa yʉ ka', fa yɛ̀ɛ ka', fa gani ka'." Mncir ca wɛɛwɛ ker ba mncir mo' vi tɛɛ ba mbendù ncir e mo'sir. Ncir anà yi yu enɛ̂, "Kòŋ nfʉrò àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ yò nyor."
eng: For the commandments, You shall not commit adultery, You shall not murder, You shall not steal, You shall not give false testimony, You shall not covet, and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ nfʉr yì, e ker gee yu bebep nè ye ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ ŋwɛ̀ banɛ e lɛ̀ mncir wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Love doesn't harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

lmp: Wèe ce koŋni wa'a njobè' wèe rìŋ enɛ nfè' ce wèe à ba lɛ' efa mmirlò à ghɛɛ. Nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ sèe luŋ yu sè'ni àtʉtʉ a caa àmbò e m ba à nfè' ce sèe à m kɛ̀' byemi nè Jisos Krâis nà.
eng: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

lmp: Mbèr à lò, tʉ̀' à kɛ' a ce raa. Banɛ sèe ma' ŋgêe nètʉ', lor buu bìr e nèmootì, yar.
eng: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let's therefore throw off the works of darkness, and let's put on the armor of light.

lmp: Sèe gee ŋgèe àmbò bèe ce a ce cu ba à rraa. Sèe fa ce dù mŋkâ' bghaa, kɛ̀ ce no buu tɛ vi ce koo sèe ka'. Sèe borni bsàkì ba mkɛ'ni. Sèe borni mlap ba ŋko'ndoŋ.
eng: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

lmp: Lòr nè ba ndèe Tata Jisos Krâis. Fa fa nè njì nè buu bebep ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke kòŋ à rgèe nà ka'.
eng: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce li rbyemì li ka' ba wɛ̀ni, wèe koo ŋgàŋ a wêe mʉ. Wèe ŋwɛ̀ anà wèe fa sɛr ba mnsɛr àmbò yuu ce e byemi enɛ e ba gèe ka'.
eng: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à byemi yi enɛ àtà e ye njɛ̀ɛ buu wɛɛwɛ, ŋwɛ̀ ce li rbyemì li yu wɛ̀ni à ku ce ye yi ba njàp ce a kap kap.
eng: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce ye njɛ̀ɛ buu wɛɛwɛ fa jàasi ŋwɛ̀ ce e kani efa rye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' nà ka', ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce ye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' ka' nà fa làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ye njɛ̀ɛ byee wɛɛwɛ à gèe yuu bebep ka', njobè' Nyʉ̀ à koo ŋwɛ̀ anà à yì ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Don't let him who eats despise him who doesn't eat. Don't let him who doesn't eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

lmp: À yu nda, ka' sa' ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ŋwɛ̀ mò'? Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e laa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à gèe bòŋboŋ kɛ̀ bebep ɛ̀, ku ba yì masà. E be gwè ka' njobè' Tata tʉr ŋger à rgèe ye tɛ e tɛɛ tatap.
eng: Who are you who judge another's servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

lmp: Bèe mò' a ce lòr enɛ nôŋ mo' yu nôŋ gòr a caa mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, bèe mo' a lor yap enɛ mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ vi ku ba yɛɛnì. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ba kwà'shi, rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ yuu ce e ce kwà'shi yi yu yɛɛnì.
eng: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce lòr enɛ nôŋ mo' yi yu jɛɛ ce gèe wa'a tɛ e bo yu'ni nè Tatâ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce ye buu wɛɛwɛ, ce gèe wa'a njobè' e ce kòŋ à ryu'ni nè Tata foŋ. E ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à byee anà. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kani efa rye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo', ce gèe wa'a njobè' e ce kòŋ à ryu'ni nè Tata foŋ. Ye ye ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀.
eng: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn't eat, to the Lord he doesn't eat, and gives God thanks.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa sêe mʉ ce cu nè yi tu ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa sêe mʉ ce kwe nè yi tu ka'.
eng: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

lmp: Sèe à ka' cu btèe, sèe ku ce yu' ba ese Tatâ. Sèe à ka' kwe, banɛ sèe ku ba ba mba yê mmbò. Banɛ kɛ̀ sèe à cu btèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ sèe à kwe ɛ̀, sèe ku ba ba mbà mmbo Tatâ.
eng: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord's.

lmp: A mbùu ce Krâis à m kwe a fʉʉ efa rkwe. E m gèe wa'a tɛ e bo ba Tata nè bèe ce a kweŋger ba bèe ce a cu btèe.
eng: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

lmp: Àmbò yi yu wa' na, wɛ̀ ka' ce sa' nfʉrò njokɛ? À ce jàasi nfʉrò njokɛ? Sèe wɛɛwɛ be kè tɛɛ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀ tɛ e sa' sèe.
eng: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Tata à làa enɛ̂, "Àmbò m yu ntèe na ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be kè gʉ'shi njep mɛ̂ tìi. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be kè làa nè yi cùu enɛ m yu Nyʉ̀."
eng: For it is written, 'As I live,' says the Lord, 'to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.'

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be kè tɛɛ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀, suŋ yuu ce e m gèe.
eng: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

lmp: Banɛ sèe fa kèr sa' visèe mnyor ka'. Yuu ce wèe à ba gèe yi yu enɛ wèe kani enɛ wèe be kè gèe yuu mo' ce àde' yi gee nfʉr yè mò' kote kɛ̀ gwe ka'.
eng: Therefore let's not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother's way, or an occasion for falling.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò wèr Tata Jisòs yu àbee na, mɛ̀ riŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' vi yu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ buu efa rye ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' byemi enɛ njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' vi bòŋ à rye ka', banɛ byee anà vi yu bòŋboŋ nè ye ka'.
eng: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

lmp: Ntee yi ka' ce yaŋ nfʉrò njobè' à ce ye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo', banɛ à ker ce kòŋ ye ka'. Fa mà'shi tɛ byee vi kʉti ba yuu ce yi be gèe tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Krâis à m kwe a yê tù gwe ka'.
eng: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don't destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

lmp: Fa gèe tɛ yuu ce yi yu bòŋboŋ nè wɛ̀, yi kʉti ba yuu ce bèe a be làa bebep àgho ka'.
eng: Then don't let your good be slandered,

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu gòr nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ yu yàp ŋkʉʉ yu ba buu bye ba buu mno ka'. Yuu ce yi yu gòr yu ba ŋgêe yɛɛnì ba cumʉnyaŋ, ker ba rlu'shì ce li lò ese Yʉ' Rara.
eng: for the Kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce fà' nè Krâis à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be yu' rbòŋ nè ŋgàŋ, tɛ bèe a vʉse ye.
eng: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

lmp: Banɛ sèe gheter ce gee ba buu ce vi be gèe tɛ sèe cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀, kèr gèe tɛ sèe ce kù' àbee.
eng: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

lmp: Fa bepsi rfâ' Nyʉ̀ njo' byee ka'. Nyʉ̀ à kani sèe efa rye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, wɛ̀ ka' ye yuu ce yi be gèe tɛ nfʉrò gwê, banɛ wɛ̀ gèe yuu bebep.
eng: Don't overthrow God's work for food's sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

lmp: Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ à borni efa rye nyàa, ker borni efa rno mrù', borni efa gèe njɛ̀ɛ yuu ce àde' yi gee nfʉrò kotè.
eng: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à kani wɛ̀ efa rgèe buu ca ka', à ma'shì tɛ ku rìŋ ba wɛ̀ wèe Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' riŋ enɛ yuu ce e ce gèe yi yu yɛɛnì, yi ntee yi ce fa ye ŋgɛ' à yuu anà ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu.
eng: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn't judge himself in that which he approves.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce tarni à rye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo', kʉti ye byee anà, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be tàa ye njobè' e ce ye byee anà wa'a, a byemi enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì nè ye à rye ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce gèe yuu ce e byemi enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì ka', banɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à gèe yuu bebep.
eng: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn't of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

lmp: Sèe ku'si Nyʉ̀! E tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap, àmbò Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce làa nà. Nsuŋ ca a nsuŋ ce m ce suŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis, a ba nsuŋ àmbò buu ce vi m ba à bsʉ̀ti kɛ' elûuŋgòŋ,
eng: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

lmp: a yɛɛti àwaŋ sè'ni na. Buu ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m saŋ vi gèe buu ca à yɛɛti àwaŋ nè bèe enje jɛɛ. Nyʉ̀ ce e ce cu nfesè à m làa enɛ buu ca yɛɛti nè bèe enje jɛɛ wa'a, tɛ bto' wɛɛwɛ vi bo byemi, yu'ni nè ye.
eng: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

lmp: Ku ba ye Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr bfee. Sèe ku'si ye à nfè' sìp njo' yuu ce Jisos Krâis à m gèe! Yi yu wa'a.
eng: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen.

lmp: Sèe ce lisèe rbyemì li tap, sèe à ba kur ntee nè bèe ce lap rbyemì li yu wɛ̀ni. Sèe fa gèe ba buu ce nyor boŋ ba sèe ka'.
eng: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ efa sêe mʉ gee ba yuu ce nyor boŋ nfʉr yì tɛ nfʉr yì bo tap foŋ.
eng: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

lmp: Krâis ye ye à m gèe ba yuu ce nyor boŋ ba ye ka'. Yi ku ba ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Mcɛp ce bèe a m cɛp wɛ̀ àgho nà, mi dù ba mbe mɛ̂ tù."
eng: For even Christ didn't please himself. But, as it is written, The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.

lmp: Buu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, a m saŋ tɛ vi bo cep sèe, gèe tɛ sèe kur ntee, tɛɛ tatap ce kè' ba buu ce Nyʉ̀ à kà' nè sèe.
eng: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through patience and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

lmp: Tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e ke gèe sèe kur ntee, tʉr ŋger, ja' wèe tɛ wèe be'ni ndèe Jisos Krâis, cu wèe bfʉr wee wèe nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀,
eng: Now the God of patience and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

lmp: tɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ bo kù'si Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Tàr nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis nè ntee e mo'sir ba cûu mò'sir.
eng: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Banɛ wèe koo bfʉr mo' nje nyòr a wêe mʉ àmbò Krâis à m koo sèe foŋ na, tɛ bèe a bo ce kù'si Nyʉ̀.
eng: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

lmp: M ce làa nè wèe enɛ Krâis à m vʉ̀ à ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jus tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo gèe buu ce e m kà' nè visèe bta nà, dùŋshi enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ mini.
eng: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

lmp: E m vʉ̀ wa' foŋ tɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a bo yɛ, ku'si Nyʉ̀ njo' yì ŋkoosimnse. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Banɛ m be suŋ àmbò wɛ̀ à mʉ̀ bèe enje jɛɛ, yòp byɛɛ ce ku'si lo rlii àgho."
eng: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.

lmp: A ker saŋ foŋ enɛ̂, "Bèe enje jɛɛ, lu'shi nè wèe bèe Nyʉ̀ wèe."
eng: Again he says, Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.

lmp: A ker saŋ mbe dì' mo' enɛ̂, "Bèe enje jɛɛ wɛɛwɛ, yòŋshi nè Tata. Tɛ bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ a ku'si ye."
eng: Again, Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.

lmp: Àsayà ye ye à m làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Jɛɛsì be vʉ̀. E be vʉ̀ tɛ e bo sa' bèe enje jɛɛ àmbò yàp ŋkʉʉ. Bèe enje jɛɛ wɛɛwɛ a be lɛ̀ mmir mbe yê ndù."
eng: Again, Isaiah says, There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.

lmp: Tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e gèe wèe à lɛ mi mmir mbendù buu ce vi bii ka' koni gee tɛ wèe ce lu'shi sê, cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀ njobè' wèe à byemi nè ye. E gèe wa'a, tɛ wèe bo kù ce lɛ̀ mmir mbendù buu anà à ŋger Yʉ' Rara.
eng: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèe yu bêe bbòŋboŋ sê, a riŋ buu sê, a riŋ à rcep wèe btu.
eng: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, mɛ̀ saŋ ŋwà' ca a laa buu mò' mbo nè wèe tatap sê, tɛ wèe bo kuushi buu anà. Mɛ̀ gèe wa'a nè ŋger ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè mɛ̀ njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ,
eng: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

lmp: enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' Jisos Krâis nè bèe enje jɛɛ. M ce gèe rfà' ca wa'a, a ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì wa'a. M ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀ tɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a bo ba àmbò yuu m ce taŋshi taŋshì àgho ce yi yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njobè' Yʉ' Rara yi gèe yi ba rara.
eng: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Banɛ àde' m naatu à rfà' ce mɛ̀ gèe nè Nyʉ̀ njobè' wèr Jisos Krâis yu àbee.
eng: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

lmp: Àde' m ker naatu à yuu jɛɛ caa efa rfà' ce mɛ̀ gèe à ŋger Krâis à mʉ̀ bèe enje jɛɛ ka'. Wowèe a ce yu'ni nè Krâis njo' buu ce mɛ̀ làa ker ba buu ce mɛ̀ gèe.
eng: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

lmp: Wowèe a m yu'ni foŋ njobè' mɛ̀ m dùŋshi mncòo ba buu bbɛ̀ɛ, ker ba njo' ŋger Yʉ' Rara. Kɛ̂' ese à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m du ba' à rla' Ìlirikòm, mɛ̀ fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Krâis, a bɛr yuu mo' ka'.
eng: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God's Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

lmp: Mɛ̂ ke ghèter à nfè' wɛɛwɛ à rfè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ anà à bdì' ce bèe a m be yu' rlii Krâis ka'. Mɛ̂ ke gèe wa'a, fà dì' m bo bà'ri mbendù kùundap ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' à boo ka'.
eng: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another's foundation.

lmp: M ku ce gèe ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Bèe ce a m be suŋ wowèe yuu mo' àmbò ye ka' a be yɛ. Bèe ce a m be yu' yuu mo' àmbò ye ka' a be rìŋ."
eng: But, as it is written, They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven't heard will understand.

lmp: A yuu ce yi jepsi mɛ̀ nfè' àŋgoo se à rvʉ̀ cà'ni wèe.
eng: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

lmp: Dì' mo' yi ker ba àgho nè mɛ̀ sè'ni à rfà' àfa ka'. Yu bfè' àŋgoo se àmbò mɛ̀ m ce koŋ à rvʉ̀ cà'ni wèe.
eng: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

lmp: Banɛ m ka' ce dù à to' Spɛ̂n, tɛ m lɛ' cà'ni wee wèe tɛ sèe ku cu nfè' mʉcàr, tɛ m bo yu' rbòŋ à rba a wêe mʉ, tɛ wèe ka' jà' mɛ̀ tɛ m dû.
eng: whenever I journey to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

lmp: M ce dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m sè'ni na, tɛ m bo fa mbàa nè bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a yu àfo.
eng: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

lmp: M ce dù njobè' ŋgâa rbyemì ce a yu à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà ba ŋgôŋ Àkayà a m kwà'shi enɛ wowèe a be kùu mbàa tɛ a bo jà' ŋgâa fùp ce a yu à mʉ bèe Nyʉ̀ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

lmp: Wowèe a m yɛ enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì à rgèe wa'a. Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ yu yap bdì' à rjà' Jûs. Bèe enje jɛɛ a koni bghònì efa yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nè Jûs, banɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ wowèe a ja' Jus foŋ nè buu ce Nyʉ̀ à ghòni wowèe àgho.
eng: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

lmp: M ka' du ba' fa mbàa ce a kùu anà nè wowèe, misi rfà' anà, tɛ m lɛ' cà'ni wèe ka' càa dù à to' Spɛ̂n.
eng: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ m be vʉ̀ cà'ni wèe tɛ sèe koni bghònì ese Krâis gòr sê.
eng: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe à rlii Tata Jisos Krâis, a ce bu' mmbo nè wèe njobè' rkòŋnì ce sèe à koni ese yi yʉ', enɛ wèe koni mɛ̀ à rloo ce m ce loo nè yà nyor, tɛ sèe loo àbee.
eng: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

lmp: Loo nè enɛ Nyʉ̀ fʉr mɛ̀ embà mmbo bèe à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà ce a byemi nè Jisos Krâis ka' nà. Loo nè foŋ enɛ bèe Nyʉ̂ à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a yu' rbòŋ nè mbàa ce m ce dù fa nè wowèe,
eng: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

lmp: tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' byemi, m bo vʉ̀ yɛ wèe nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀, tɛ m bo lʉ̀shi, tɛ sèe yu' rbòŋ.
eng: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa bèe cumʉnyaŋ, ba wèe wowèe wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

lmp: M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ Febè ce e yu njar yìsèe, ce e yu dikòn embe cor à rla' Keŋkɛ̀rà.
eng: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

lmp: E ka' vʉ̂, wèe koni ye àmbò bèe Tata Nyʉ̀ a ba koni ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì. Fa nè ye yuu ce e ka' buu, njobè' e jà' bèe magòr sê, a ja' mɛ̀ foŋ.
eng: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Prîskà ba Àkwilà ce wèr wowèe à m fà' àbee nè Jisos Krâis nà nè mɛ̀.
eng: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

lmp: Wowèe a m tami nyor à rkwe njo' mɛ̀. À ku yoŋshi ba mɛ̀ wowèe cà'cà' ka', bcor wɛɛwɛ ce ŋgâa rbyemì embo yu bèe enje jɛɛ, a yòŋshi wowèe foŋ.
eng: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

lmp: Cà'ni nè ŋgâa rbyemì ce a ke niŋ cor mbe wâp ndàp. Cà'ni nè Ɛ̀pɛ̀nitòs ce e yu ŋkarà ce wa mntee nà. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ entombì à rbyemi nè Krâis à ŋgôŋ Ɛshà.
eng: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Mɛ̀ɛri ce e m fà' nè wèe tatap se nà.
eng: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Àndrònikòs ba Jùnayàs ce wèr wowèe yu Jûs, wowèe foŋ a yɛ ŋgɛ' mbe shaŋ àmbò mɛ̀. Wowèe a yu boo mlii à mʉ̀ ŋgâa ntuu Jisos Krâis. Wowèe a m ba ŋgâa rbyemì entombì nè mɛ̀.
eng: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Àmplatòs ce e yu ŋkarà ce wa mntee, ce wèr ye yu àbee wèr Tata wèe nà.
eng: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Òbanùs ce e ce fà' nè Jisos Krâis àmbò wèr ce fà' foŋ nà, ba Sìtakìs ce e yu ŋkarà se nà.
eng: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Àpɛlɛ̀s ce e ku tɛɛ tatap, a duŋshi nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ Krâis. Cà'ni nè bèe wɛɛwɛ embe ndàp Àrìstobulùs.
eng: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Hɛ̀rodìyòn ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ Jus àmbò mɛ̀ foŋ nà. Cà'ni nè bèe embe ndàp Nàkisòs ce yu bèe Tatâ.
eng: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Tìrfɛnà ba Tìrfosà ce yu bbyèŋge ce a ce fà' nè Tata nà. Cà'ni nè Pɛsìs ce e yu ŋkarà a ba foŋ njeŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e fà' nè Tata tatap se nà.
eng: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Rufòs ce e yu muu rlii efa mʉ̀ bèe Tata nà, ker ba yì ma ce e m gɛ' nè mɛ̀ àmbò muu yì wa'a nà.
eng: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Àsinkiritòs ba Fìlɛgòn ba Hɛmìs ba Pàtòropàs ba Hɛmàs, ker ba bfʉr ce a yu a wowèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

lmp: Cà'ni nè Fìlologìs ba Jùliyà, ba Nɛrìyòs a njar yì, ba Òlipàs ba bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce a yu a wowèe.
eng: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

lmp: Cà'ni nè bfʉr wee, baa wowèe nje nyòr à rlii Jisòs. Bcor wɛɛwɛ vi cà'ni wèe.
eng: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe lor nfè' nè bèe ce a ce vʉ̀ nè ŋgàpni a ker ce dà'si bèe foŋ nà. Wowèe a ce gèe jɛɛ efa yuu ce a yɛ'ni wèe. Sìr nè njì nè wowèe.
eng: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

lmp: Gèe nè wa'a njobè' njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca a ce fà' ba nè Krâis ce e yu Tata nè sèe ka', wowèe a ce gèe ba yuu ce yi bòŋ wowèe. Wowèe a ce bu' cùu nè blàa ce vi bòŋ a ce foo sê, a ce bo' bèe ce a mɛŋni buu.
eng: For those who are such don't serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò wèe, bèe wɛɛwɛ a rìŋ enɛ wèe yu bèe ce wèe ce yu'ni nè Tatâ. M ce lu'shi nè wèe sê. Ka' yi yu wa'a, m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ yuu bòŋboŋ, mɛŋni yuu bebep.
eng: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

lmp: Nfè' bɛti gòr ka', tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa bèe cumʉnyaŋ so Satàn, mà' njep wêe tìi tɛ wèe tɛr mkùu mbe yê ndù. M ce loo mɛnɛ tɛ yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

lmp: Timotì ce wèr ye ce fà' àbee, à cà'ni wèe. Lushòs ba Jasìn, ba Sòsipatà ce wèr wowèe yu Jus nà, a cà'ni wèe foŋ.
eng: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

lmp: Mɛ̂ Tɛshòs ce mɛ̀ saŋ ŋwà' ca ce cà'ni wèe foŋ à rlii yìsèe Tatâ.
eng: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

lmp: Gayòs, ce m ce cu mbe yê ndàp, ŋgâa rbyemì a ce niŋ cor mbo foŋ nà à cà'ni wèe. Ɛ̀rastòs ce e ce lɛ̀ mbàa to' nà ba Kwatòs a cà'ni wèe.
eng: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ tɛ yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe wɛɛwɛ à ntee bòŋboŋ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pôl, ce Nyʉ̀ à ce mɛ̀ enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. Wèr Sòstɛnì ce e yu nfʉr yìsèe ce cà'ni wèe.
eng: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

lmp: Wèr ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè ŋgâa cor ce a yu à rla' Korèn ce a Jisòs wèe a yu à ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir. Nyʉ̀ à ce wèe efa mʉ̀ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na tɛ wèe ba yì bèe. Wèe yu àbee wèe bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a yu à bdì' wɛɛwɛ a ce loo nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis. E yu Tata nè wowèe àmbò e yu nè sèe nà.
eng: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth; those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called to be saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, ker ba Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè wèr foŋ, tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Mɛ ke yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ a wêe btu à nfè' wɛɛwɛ njobè' e ghòni wèe embenjì Jisos Krâis.
eng: I always thank my God concerning you, for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus;

lmp: E ghòni wèe à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a gee wèe à tʉr bfee bbòŋboŋ, a ker fa wèe ŋger à rfè'shi vi blàa.
eng: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge;

lmp: Nsuŋ àmbò Jisos krâis à taa mŋgàŋ a wêe mʉ.
eng: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you:

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèe à buu mo' efa buu wɛɛwɛ ce Yʉ' Tata Nyʉ̀ yi ke fa nè bèe ka', àmbò wèe cu sè'ni ce kè' nfè' ce wèe be kè yɛ Jisos Krâis na.
eng: so that you come behind in no gift; waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ;

lmp: Tata Nyʉ̀ be fa wèe ŋger tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap bà' àlʉ̀simbùu fà dì' wèe bo kè gwè mnsa' à nòŋ ce Jisos Krâis à vʉ̀ ka'.
eng: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ yu mini. Yu ye ce e kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe bo ba àbee wèe muu yì ce Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè sèe.
eng: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ, our Lord.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, mɛ̀ loo wèe à rlii yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis, enɛ wèe ba cûu mo'sir. Wèe fa tʉr ŋgàpni a wêe mʉ ka'. Wèe ba àbee à yuu wèe ce kwà'shi ker ba à yuu wèe ce gèe.
eng: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, mɛ̀ làa wa'a njobè' bèe mo' embe ndàp Klôo a suŋ mɛ̀ enɛ wèe yu cûu mo'sir ka'.
eng: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe's household, that there are contentions among you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' mɛnɛ bèe mo' efa wêe mʉ a ce làa enɛ̂, "M yu ya wèr Pôl", mò' enɛ̂, "M yu ya wèr Àpolòs", mò' enɛ̂, "M yu ya wèr Sɛfàs", mò' enɛ̂, "M yu ya wèr Jisos Krâis."
eng: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, I follow Paul, I follow Apollos, I follow Cephas, and, I follow Christ.

lmp: Wà' wèe à gàp Jisòs a? Wà' ŋwɛ̀ ce a m taa mbe kìntaa njo' wèe à m ba Pol a? Wà' a m bàptir wèe à rlii Pol a?
eng: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

lmp: Mɛ̀ yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ njobè' mɛ̀ m bàptir ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ caa efa Krîspòs ba Gayòs ka',
eng: I thank God that I baptized none of you, except Crispus and Gaius,

lmp: fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo làa enɛ mɛ̀ m bàptir ye a mɛ̂ rlii ka'.
eng: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

lmp: Mɛ̀ kuushi enɛ mɛ̀ m bàptir bèe embe ndàp Stɛfɛnàs foŋ. Mɛ̀ kwà'shi mɛnɛ mɛ̀ m ker baptir ŋwɛ̀ mò' caa efa bèe ca ka'.
eng: I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don't know whether I baptized any other.

lmp: Jisos Krâis à m tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m du baptir bèe ka', e m tuu mɛ̀ ba enɛ m du fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ. Mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi nsuŋ ca ba nè bfee wa ka'. Mɛ̀ m gèe wa'a tɛ ŋger efa rkwe ce Jisos Krâis à m kwe mbe kìntaa yi bo buu efa ryɛɛtì ka'.
eng: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News--not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn't be made void.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ nsuŋ kuu rkwe Jisos Krâis embe kìntaa yu blʉr nè bèe ce a ce bʉ njep mʉ̀ buu bbebep. À ka' ba yi àmbò sèe ce sèe ce lùŋ, nsuŋ ca yu ŋger Nyʉ̀.
eng: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are saved it is the power of God.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "M be gèe tɛ bfee ŋgâa bfee vi bʉ à cicì. M be gèe tɛ bèe ce a feese, a jep."
eng: For it is written, I will destroy the wisdom of the wise, I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.

lmp: Banɛ ŋgâa bfee enjep ŋgòŋ na a yu ba fɛ sè'ni? Ŋgâa ŋwà' enjep ŋgòŋ na a yu ba fɛ? Ŋgâa mnsɛr enjep ŋgòŋ na a yu ba fɛ? Mbò Nyʉ̀ à gèe bfee enjep ŋgòŋ à kʉtì ba blʉr a?
eng: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the lawyer of this world? Hasn't God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

lmp: Bfee vi Nyʉ̀ vi yu jɛɛ. E m gèe enɛ bèe a riŋ ye ba nè bfee wap ka'. E m kòŋ enɛ e gee bèe ce a byemi nè ye a luŋ njì enjep rfè'shì ce bèe a lòr à yuu cicì nà.
eng: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn't know God, it was God's good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

lmp: Jus a ròo à ryɛ ncòo ka' byemi yuu ce bèe a làa, Grêk a ce ròo yap ba bfee.
eng: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

lmp: Wèr ce fè'shi ba àmbò Jisos Krâis ce a m taa mbe kìntaa. Rfè'shì ca li ce jepsi Jus efa rbyemi nè ye, à ba blʉr nè bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: but we preach Christ crucified; a stumbling block to Jews, and foolishness to Greeks,

lmp: À ka' ba yi nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à kɛ', kɛ̀ yu Jus ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu Grêk ɛ̀, wowèe a rìŋ enɛ ŋger Nyʉ̀ yi yɛɛti, bfee Nyʉ̀ vi yɛɛtì foŋ embenjì Jisòs Krâis.
eng: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God.

lmp: Yuu ce bèe a ce kwà'shi enɛ yi yu blʉr à ŋgʉ̀' yì Nyʉ̀ nà, bfee vi yu njo a caa bfee ce bèe a tʉr, yuu ce a kwà'shi enɛ a bgò'sì à ŋgʉ̀' yì Nyʉ̀ nà, ŋger yi yu njo a caa ŋger ce bèe a tʉr.
eng: Because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, fyɛ' ka nè njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèe à m ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe ba yì bèe. Wèe ka' fyɛ' a wêe mʉ wèe yɛ enɛ bèe ce ŋgòŋ ca yi m lòr enɛ a tʉr bfee a yu gòr ka'. Bèe ce ŋgòŋ ca yi m kwà'shi foŋ enɛ a yu bêe bgòrgòr a ker tʉr mnta' bgòrgòr a yu gòr ka'.
eng: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ce ba bèe ce bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ce kwà'shi enɛ a yu blʉr tɛ rìtu yi bo koo bèe ce a ce kwà'shi enɛ a yu ŋgâa bfee. E m ce bèe ce bèe enjep ŋgòŋ a kwà'shi enɛ a yu bgò'sì tɛ rìtu yi bo koo bèe ce a tʉr ŋger.
eng: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world, that he might put to shame the things that are strong;

lmp: E m ce buu ce bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a jàasi a lor à yuu cicì, tɛ e bo sùusi mkwà'shì ce bèe a tʉr à buu wɛɛwɛ ce a kwà'shi enɛ vi yu btatap se nà njep nshè.
eng: and God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that are not, that he might bring to nothing the things that are:

lmp: Yi yu wa'a, fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo nàa nyor à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: that no flesh should boast before God.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe wèe Jisos Krâis wèe à ka' ba àbee. E m gèe enɛ Jisos Krâis fa sèe bfee bbòŋboŋ. E ce yɛ sèe àmbò bèe ce a cu rcu yɛɛnì, a ba brara ba njì enjep Jisos Krâis. Ku ba njì enjep Jisòs ce e tee sèe efa ŋgɛ' buu bbebep.
eng: But of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption:

lmp: A mbùu ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce kòŋ enɛ e naa nyor, banɛ e naa ba à yuu ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à gèe nè ye.
eng: that, according as it is written, He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, à m ba mbe nfè' ce mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ yɛ wèe tɛ m bo fè'shi buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wèr à riŋ kuu Jisos Krâis nà, mɛ̀ vʉ a ke' ce laa ba blàa ce bèe bo vʉse ka' kɛ̀ fè'shi ba nè bfee ŋwɛ̀ tɛ wèe ka' byemi ka'.
eng: When I came to you, brothers, I didn't come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m làa enjep mɛ̂ ntee enɛ m be kù fè'shi ba àmbò Jisos Krâis cà'cà', suŋ wèe àmbò a m taa ye mbe kìntaa.
eng: For I determined not to know anything among you, except Jesus Christ, and him crucified.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ba a wêe mʉ, a go'sî, a ce wɛp buu, ntee yi ce kàŋ mɛ̀.
eng: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi blàa ca nè wèe, a ke' ce fè'shi ba nè bfee enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi ba nè ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ce yi m gèe wèe à ka' riŋ weenɛ blàa ca vi yu mini.
eng: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

lmp: Mɛ̀ m gèe wa'a njobè' mɛ̀ m kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe byemi ba njo' ŋger Nyʉ̀, ke' ba ba njo' bfee ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: that your faith wouldn't stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

lmp: Ka' mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi ba nè bfee ŋwɛ̀ ka' wa'a, wèr ce fè'shi blàa bfee nè bèe ce a bi njep mʉ̀ lap rbyemì. Blàa ca vi lò enjep ŋgòŋ na kɛ̀ ese bèe ce a ce sa' ŋgòŋ ca ka'. Yap ŋger yi be mì.
eng: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown; yet a wisdom not of this world, nor of the rulers of this world, who are coming to nothing.

lmp: Bfee Nyʉ̀ ce wèr ce làa na yu ba vi bfee ce vi m ba à bsʉ̀ti, bèe a m rìŋ ka'. Tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kè gèe ŋgòŋ ca, e m kwà'shi wɛɛ, a lɛ enɛ e be gèe buu ca tɛ sèe bo tʉr ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa yi fòo.
eng: But we speak God's wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

lmp: Bèe ce a ke sa' ŋgòŋ ca a m rìŋ wa' ka'. Wowèe a m ba riŋ a m ba taa Tata ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fòo mbe kìntaa ka'.
eng: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn't have crucified the Lord of glory.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Buu ce ŋwɛ̀ à m be yɛ kɛ̀ yu' ka', ker ba buu ce ŋwɛ̀ à m be kwa'shi ka', Nyʉ̀ à kupshi vi, a lɛ nè bèe ce a kòŋ ye."
eng: But as it is written, Things which an eye didn't see, and an ear didn't hear, which didn't enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à gèe sèe à riŋ buu ca njì enjep yi Yʉ'. Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi rìŋ buu wɛɛwɛ, a riŋ ka' buu Nyʉ̀ ce vi yu à bsʉ̀ti.
eng: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' e ke rìŋ yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce kwà'shi ka'. E ke kû rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ yuu ce yi yu njep yê ntee. Yi ku ba foŋ enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' riŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kwà'shi ka'. Ku ba ba Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ce yi rìŋ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kwà'shi.
eng: For who among men knows the things of a man, except the spirit of the man, which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God, except God's Spirit.

lmp: Yʉ' ce sèe à koni yu yʉ' enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Yʉ' ce sèe à koni yu yʉ' ce yi lò ese Nyʉ̀. Yʉ' ca yi ke gèe sèe riŋ buu ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè sèe.
eng: But we received, not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, àmbò wèr ce suŋ bèe buu ca, wèr ce suŋ ba buu ce bèe a yɛ'ni wèr nè wap bfee ka'. Wèr ce suŋ ba buu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi gèe wèr à rîŋ. Wèr ce yɛ'ni buu ce à yʉ' nè bèe ce a tʉr Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ njep wâp mntee.
eng: Which things also we speak, not in words which man's wisdom teaches, but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi yu njep yê ntee ka' e ke byemi buu ce vi lò ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ka' njobè' buu ca yu nè ye àmbò blʉr wa'a, àde' e riŋ buu ca ka' njobè' ku ba ba ŋwɛ̀ ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi yu njep yî ntee ce àde' e riŋ vi.
eng: Now the natural man doesn't receive the things of God's Spirit, for they are foolishness to him, and he can't know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi yu njep yê ntee, e ke fyɛ' buu wɛɛwɛ, riŋ mbùu efa gho, ka' bèe a fyɛ' ye, riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ka' wa'a.
eng: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is judged by no one.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' rìŋ ntee Nyʉ̀ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce àde' e cep Tata Nyʉ̀ ka'." À ka' ba àmbò sèe, sèe tʉr ntee Jisos Krâis.
eng: For who has known the mind of the Lord, that he should instruct him? But we have Christ's mind.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, à m ba mbe nfè' ce mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ yɛ wèe nà, àde' mɛ̀ m ba laa nè wèe àmbò bèe ce a tʉr Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ njep wâp mntee ka'. Mɛ̀ m làa nè wèe ba àmbò mɛ̂ ke làa nè bèe ce a ce yu' rbòŋ à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na. Mɛ̀ m làa wa'a njobè' wèe à m bii boo bkɛ' à buu Jisos Krâis, wèe à m ba àmbò boo ce a bii nyoŋ mmbee wa'a.
eng: Brothers, I couldn't speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m nyoŋsi wèe nyoŋsi, a ke' fa wèe ba yuu ye ka' njobè' wèe à m be ghɛɛte à rye yuu ka'. Ka' sè'ni na, wèe à be ghɛɛte ka'.
eng: I fed you with milk, not with meat; for you weren't yet ready. Indeed, not even now are you ready,

lmp: Wèe ku bii yu' rbòŋ à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na. Ŋko'ndoŋ yu a wêe mʉ, ŋgàpni yi ba a wêe mʉ, banɛ mbò wèe ku bii yu' rbòŋ à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na a? Mbò ye ŋgèe yi ku ba àmbò yi bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a?
eng: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren't you fleshly, and don't you walk in the ways of men?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' laa yi enɛ̂. "M yu ya wèr Pôl," mò' ker laa yi enɛ̂, "M yu ya wèr Àpolòs." Wà' banɛ wèe yu jɛɛ efa bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a?
eng: For when one says, I follow Paul, and another, I follow Apollos, aren't you fleshly?

lmp: Àpolòs yu nda, Pol à ba nda? Wèr ku ba ba ŋgâa mfà' nè Tata Nyʉ̀. Nyʉ̀ à m tuu wèr enɛ wèr gee tɛ wèe byemi nè Jisos krâis. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à m ku gee ba li rfà' ce Tata à m fa nè ye enɛ e gêe.
eng: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed; and each as the Lord gave to him?

lmp: Mɛ̀ m byè ŋgʉ̀ buu, Àpolòs à ŋwaŋshì mdip àgho. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe ŋgʉ̀ buu ca à fʉʉ a ku', à m ba ba Nyʉ̀.
eng: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rbyè yu yuu mo' ka', ŋwɛ̀ rŋwaŋshi nè mdip à ba yuu mo' foŋ ka'. Ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ku ba ba Nyʉ̀ ce e gèe buu ce a byè vi ce kù'.
eng: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ rbyè ba ŋwɛ̀ rŋwaŋshi nè mdip a ku ba yɛɛnì. Nyʉ̀ be là' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à rfà' ce ŋgàŋ à gèe.
eng: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

lmp: Wèr yu ŋgâa mfà', a ce fà' àbee nè Nyʉ̀. Wèe yu ŋkʉ̀ Nyʉ̀, a ba ndap ce Nyʉ̀ à bà'ri.
eng: For we are God's fellow workers. You are God's farming, God's building.

lmp: À ka' ba njo' bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à fa mɛ̀, mɛ̀ boo kùundap àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à rboo yuu sê. Bèe mo' a ce boo ndap mbe kùundap anà. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ce boo, lor nfè'.
eng: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker boo kùundap mo' jɛɛ caa efa yì ce a boo war ce yu Jisos Krâis na ka'.
eng: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò buu ce bèe a be bà'ri ndap anà àgho, bèe mo' a be bà'ri nè bco' ce a too enɛ gûl, ba bco' ce a too enɛ silvà, ba blùr ce vi lùu ntaa sê. Bèe mo' a be bà'ri yap nè mntaaŋguu ba bvʉp msaŋ, ba bbuu.
eng: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or stubble;

lmp: Mfà' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ mi be kè yɛɛti àwaŋ njobè' be kè ba à nòŋ mnsa' tɛ a mooshi mfà' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ. Mor yi be kè ce kɛti à nòŋ anà, gèe tɛ a riŋ njɛ̀ɛ mfà' ce ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à m ce gèe.
eng: each man's work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man's work is.

lmp: Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à bà'ri ndap anà àgho yi ka' tɛ she ka' banɛ ŋgàŋ be koo blà'.
eng: If any man's work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

lmp: Yuu anà yi ka' she, banɛ ŋgàŋ be bʉ à cicì, koni yuu ka'. Geewa'a, ŋgàŋ be lùŋ, kù lùŋ ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e caŋ mor, a coo njep mncùŋ mor a tose.
eng: If any man's work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ weenɛ wèe yu Ndap Nyʉ̀, Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce cu njep wèe a?
eng: Don't you know that you are a temple of God, and that God's Spirit lives in you?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' bepsi Ndap Nyʉ̀ banɛ Nyʉ̀ be bepsi ŋgàŋ. Yi yu wa'a njobè' Ndap Nyʉ̀ yu nrara, Ndap Nyʉ̀ anà à ba wèe.
eng: If anyone destroys the temple of God, God will destroy him; for God's temple is holy, which you are.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa bo' yi tu ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ ka' ce kwà'shi enɛ e tʉr njɛ̀ɛ bfee ce ŋgòŋ ca yi rìŋ enɛ a bfee, ŋgàŋ à ba kʉti lʉr tɛ e bo tʉr bfee nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he may become wise.

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' bfee enjep ŋgòŋ na yu ba blʉr à bsii Nyʉ̀. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ e ke lòr bfee ŋgâa bfee, koo ŋgâa bfee anà àgho."
eng: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, He has taken the wise in their craftiness.

lmp: A ker saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ rìŋ enɛ mkwà'shì bèe ce a tʉr bfee mi yu à cicì."
eng: And again, The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.

lmp: Àmbò yi yu na banɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa kèr kùu ŋgùŋ njo' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Buu wɛɛwɛ yu yè buu.
eng: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

lmp: Pol ba Àpolòs ba Pità a yu yè bèe, ŋgòŋ ca yu ye, ryòŋ yu le, rkwe à ba le, buu ce vi yu sè'ni na, ba buu ce vi be kè ba, vi wɛɛwɛ a yè buu.
eng: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

lmp: Yi yu enɛ wèe yu bèe Krâis, Krâis à ba ŋwɛ̀ yì Nyʉ̀.
eng: and you are Christ's, and Christ is God's.

lmp: Yi bòŋ enɛ wèe à ba yɛ wèr àmbò ŋgâa mfà' nè Jisos Krâis. Wèe à ba rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m lòr buu ce vi yu à bsʉ̀ti a fa mba wêr mmbò enɛ wèr yɛ'ni bèe.
eng: So let a man think of us as Christ's servants, and stewards of God's mysteries.

lmp: Yuu gòr ce masà e ke kòŋ ese ŋwɛ̀ rfà' yi yu enɛ e ba mini nè ye.
eng: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards, that they be found faithful.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, a ka' ce sa' mɛ̀, kɛ̀ ce sa' wèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ce sa' ba kor ɛ̀, m lor ya yu yì anà à yuu ka'. Ka' mɛ̀ foŋ, mɛ̂ ke sa' ya tu ka'.
eng: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by man's judgment. Yes, I don't judge my own self.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ke' rìŋ ya yu yuu bebep mo' ce mɛ̀ gèe ka'. Yi ke' ba enɛ àde' m sa' mnsa' embe mɛ̂ tù, teni enɛ mɛ̀ so ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e sa' wa mnsa' teni, a Tatâ.
eng: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ wèe fa ce sa' bèe tɛ nfè' mnsa' ka' ghɛɛ ka'. Be ba à nòŋ ce Tata Jisòs à kʉti, tɛ e gee buu ce bèe a gèe à tʉ̀'nji vi yɛɛti àwaŋ. E be kè gèe tɛ mkwà'shì bèe mi yɛɛti àwaŋ foŋ. Yu à nòŋ anà ce Nyʉ̀ be kè yòŋshi ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ àmbò a ba yòŋshi.
eng: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness, and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, mɛ̀ làa buu ca nè wèe, a lor Àpolòs ba ya tu nyor àmbò rdùŋshì wa'a, tɛ wèe bo yɛ'ni ese wèr à rcu, àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ bo nàa tu nè ŋwɛ̀ mò', lòr mò' à yuu cicì ka'.
eng: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe wɛ̀ à ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr à gèe nda? Yuu ce à tʉr ce wɛ̀ koni ba ese Nyʉ̀ ka', yu kɛ? Nyʉ̀ à ka' fa wɛ̀ buu ca, wɛ̀ ka' ce nàa tu àmbò wɛ̀ tʉr lɛ buu ca ba à yo ŋger wa'a njokɛ?
eng: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn't receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

lmp: Wà' wèe tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ a? Wà' wèe yu ŋgâa mbàa a? Wèr yu yer yu bkʉʉ ka', wèe à lor wee btu àmbò bkʉʉ. M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe à ba ba bkʉʉ ghup tɛ sèe bo sa' bsìp?
eng: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you.

lmp: M ce kwà'shi enɛ dì' ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè wèr ce wèr yu ŋgâa ntuu, yu dì' elʉ̀simbùu. Wèr yu àmbò bèe ce mnsa' mi koo wowèe, yi ka' tɛɛ sè'ni enɛ a be yʉ wowèe, a lor wowèe a tɛr àwaŋ tɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ba bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a bo kaari ce fyɛ'.
eng: For, I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

lmp: Wèr yu blʉr njo' Jisos Krâis. À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, wèe à tʉr bfee njep Jisos Krâis. Wèr tʉr ŋger ka', wèe à tʉr ye ŋger. Wèe yu bèe ce bèe a ce yu'ni nè wèe, wèr à ba yer bèe ce bèe a ce jàasi.
eng: We are fools for Christ's sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

lmp: Njè ku bii yaŋ wèr vʉ ba' sè'ni na, ntee-mdip yi ku bii lùu wèr, wèr à ce yar ba bkàkâ cɛ̀'. E ba à nfè' mò', a lip wèr. Wèr tʉr rla' ka'.
eng: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

lmp: Wèr ce fà' nè mer mmbo, ka' ce yeŋger. Bèe a ce cɛp wèr, wèr ce làa yer nè wowèe enɛ Nyʉ̀ ghoni wowèe. Bèe a ce fa wèr ŋgɛ' wèr ce kur ntee, ce làa yuu ka.
eng: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

lmp: Bèe a ce làa buu bbebep nè wèr, wèr ce kʉsi ba blâa bbòŋboŋ nè wowèe. Bèe a ce lòr wèr àmbò yuu cicì ce ŋgòŋ yi ker ce kòŋ à ryɛ ka'. A ku bii lòr wèr àmbò bkùp buu wa'a, vʉ ba' ntìni.
eng: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

lmp: M ce saŋ buu ca nè wèe tɛ rìtu yi bo koo wèe ka'. M ce fa wèe ba ncep njobè' wèe yu boo wa ce mɛ̀ kòŋ magòr.
eng: I don't write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

lmp: Ka' bèe ce a ce fa wèe ncep à rcu àmbò bèe Jisos Krâis a yu gòr wa'a, yè ta ku ba mò'sir. Yu ba mɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m ba àmbò tàr nè wèe njobè' mɛ̀ m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wèe tɛ wèe ka' kè ba bèe Jisòs Krâis.
eng: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, yet not many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a mɛ̀ loo nè wèe enɛ wèe ku gee ba yuu ce m ce gèe.
eng: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ tuu Timotì enɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe tɛ e bo kèr suŋ wèe àmbò ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ce m ce gèe njobè' m ce dù àmbùu Jisos Krâis. Timotì yu muu wà ce mɛ̀ kòŋ, njobè' wèr ye yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir njep Tata Jisos Krâis. E ke fà' nè yi ntee-ŋwɛ̀. Buu ce e be suŋ wèe yu buu ce m ce yɛ'ni à bcor ce vi yu à bdì' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wêe mʉ a ce kwà'shi enɛ m be kʉti vʉ̀ yɛ wèe ka', a ce nàa tu.
eng: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

lmp: Nfè' mʉcàr tɛ m vʉ yɛ wèe, ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à ka' kôŋ, tɛ m bo rìŋ mɛnɛ ŋger Nyʉ̀ yi yu njep ŋgâa nàatu ca kɛ̀ wowèe a ku ce bu' ba cùu lɛ.
eng: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

lmp: Kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yu ba cûu bu' ka', yu ba ŋger.
eng: For the Kingdom of God is not in word, but in power.

lmp: Wèe ce kòŋ ba yì efɛ? Wèe ce kòŋ enɛ m vʉ ba nè ŋgwàa kɛ̀ nè rkòŋnì ba ntee bobor?
eng: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' mɛnɛ bèe mo' efa wêe mʉ a ce sàki. Njɛ̀ɛ sàkì ca yu njɛ̀ɛ yì ce àde' e ba ka', ka' à mʉ̀ bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Mɛ̀ yu' mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ ce koo ŋgwa yì tâ.
eng: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father's wife.

lmp: Àde' wèe ce nàa tu à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ ka' ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca. Wèe à ba ce war war. Wèe fʉr ŋwɛ̀ ca efa wêe mʉ.
eng: You are puffed up, and didn't rather mourn, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

lmp: Ka' m yu ànjìsàp efa wèe wa'a, sèe ku ba àbee à yʉ'. À rlii Tata Jisos krâis, mɛ̀ sa' war yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ ca ce gèe, a teni mnsa' anà àmbò m yu lɛ a wêe mʉ wa'a. Gèe nè ba yuu ce m be suŋ wèe na. Kaari nè àbee mbe dî' mo'sir. Ya yʉ' yi be kù ba a wêe mʉ.
eng: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing. In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, you being gathered together, and my spirit, with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

lmp: Wee kaari wɛɛ, lor ŋwɛ̀ anà fa mbà mmbo Satàn à ŋger Tata Jisòs, tɛ e bo yɛ ŋgɛ', tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo jà' li ryòŋ à nòŋ ce Tata Jisos krâis be kʉti njep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

lmp: Yè nàatu anà bòŋ ka'. Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ àde' yuu bebep e mò'sir yi bepsì cor nsìp a?
eng: Your boasting is not good. Don't you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

lmp: Banɛ wèe fʉr yuu bebep ca efa wêe mʉ tɛ wèe bo ba brara. Yi yu mini enɛ wèe yu war brara njobè' a m taŋshi taŋshì nè Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe njèe taŋshì.
eng: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a banɛ sèe cu rcu ce mini. Njɛ̀ɛ buu bbebep àmbò bcena vi fa ba a sêe mʉ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ fa tʉr mkwà'shî mbebep nè nfʉr yì ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ fa gèe bsàrbuu ka'.
eng: Therefore let us keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m saŋ mbe ŋwà' ce mɛ̀ m saŋ nè wèe nà enɛ wèe fa kè kar wèe bèe ce a ce sàki ka'.
eng: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

lmp: Mɛ̀ m làa cena a ke' ce làa ba àmbò bèe ce a mɛŋni Jisòs ka'. Bèe ce a ke sàki, ce ko'ndoŋ, ce yɛ̀ɛ, ker ce loo nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na, a ku ba sèe wowèe njep ŋgòŋ na. Tɛ à ka' buu efa rkar wèe njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca wèe, banɛ à be fʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na dù fà mo'.
eng: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortioners, or with idolaters; for then you would have to leave the world.

lmp: Ncep ce mɛ̀ m fa wèe e m ba ba enɛ wèe fa kar wèe ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa enɛ e yu nfʉr, a ker ce sàki ka'. Kɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ŋko'ndoŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ nyɛ̀ɛ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce loo nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce cɛp bèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu no ŋkoo ɛ̀, wèe wowèe fa kè kar ka'. Fa kè ye byee wèe njɛ̀ɛ bèe anà wèe ka'.
eng: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortioner. Don't even eat with such a person.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a mɛŋni Jisòs, m tʉr ŋger mo' à rsa' wowèe ka'. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke sa' njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca. Yu ba yisèe dì' à rsa' ŋgâa côr, yɛ enɛ wowèe a gèe bòŋboŋ kɛ̀ bebep lɛ. Yà bèe, banɛ wèe gee àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Fʉr nè ŋwɛ̂ mbembep efa wêe mʉ." Mɛ̀ tʉr yuu à rlàa àmbò mnsa' ce wêe dù àgho mbe kôr.
eng: For what have I to do with also judging those who are outside? Don't you judge those who are within? But those who are outside, God judges. Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.

lmp: Wà' yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka' tʉr mnsa' a ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì mò', e lor ye du àgho mbe kor enɛ bèe ce a yu byɛɛnì ka' a sa' a? Mbò wèe à ba sa' wee mnsa' a wêe mʉ àmbò bèe Nyʉ̀ a?
eng: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

lmp: Mbò wèe à rìŋ enɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ a be kè sa' ŋgòŋ ca a? Ka' ba enɛ ŋgòŋ ca be kè sa' wèe, wà' banɛ wèe à ghɛɛte à rsa' mʉ mnsa' ce vi yu a wêe mʉ ka' a?
eng: Don't you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ sèe be kè sa' bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a? Yi ka' ba wa'a, yi ka' ba ekɛ àmbò buu ce vi kùu lisèe rcu enjep ŋgòŋ.
eng: Don't you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

lmp: Banɛ mʉ mnsa' vi ba a wêe mʉ, wèe du àgho mbe kôr, fa nè bèe ce cor e ke lòr à yuu ka', enɛ a sa' nè wèe njokɛ?
eng: If then, you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa cena tɛ rìtu yi bo koo wèe. Wà' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce e tʉr bfee yu a wêe mʉ ce mfʉr mò' ka' tʉr mnsa' a nfʉr mò', e sa' mnsa' anà nè wowèe ka' a?
eng: I say this to move you to shame. Isn't there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

lmp: Mbùu njokɛ ce nfʉr mò' e lò lor mò' du àgho mbe kor du tɛɛ kùntombì nè bèe ce a byemi nè Jisos Krâis ka'?
eng: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì mò' ka' ce lòr mò' ce dù àgho mbe kôr, banɛ wèe à gwè. Yi yu àndèe enɛ wèe à ba borni ye yu, lèse fàa ce bèe a gèe nè wèe tɛ a fip wèe, nè ce wèe lor wowèe dù àgho mbe kôr.
eng: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you, that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

lmp: Wèe à gèe wa' ka'. Yuu wèe à gèe ye, yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce gèe fàa nè mò', mò' à ce fìp mò', ka' wèe wɛɛwɛ yu bfʉr wa'a.
eng: No, but you yourselves do wrong, and defraud, and that against your brothers.

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ weenɛ àde' bèe ce a yu byɛɛnì ka' a niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka' a? Wèe fa bo' wee btu ka'. Rìŋ nè enɛ bèe ce a ce sàki ba bèe ce a ce loo nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na, ba bèe ce a ce koo bbyèŋge bèe mo', kɛ̀ mmbaŋrù mo' ɛ̀, ba mmbaŋrù ce a ce koo mmbaŋrù mo',
eng: Or don't you know that the unrighteous will not inherit the Kingdom of God? Don't be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

lmp: ka' byɛ̀ɛ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋgâa ŋko'ndoŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ no ŋkoo wèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋgâa mcɛpni ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋgâa fàpshi buu à ŋger ɛ̀, àde' a niŋ mbo ka'.
eng: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortioners, will inherit the Kingdom of God.

lmp: À m ba entombì, bèe mo' efa wèe a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca. À ka' ba sè'ni na, Tata Nyʉ̀ à su'sì wèe, a ker gee wèe à ba jɛɛ, a ba byɛɛnì à ŋger Jisòs Krâis ker ba à ŋger Yʉ' yìsèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: Such were some of you, but you were washed. But you were sanctified. But you were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ yuu mo' yi yu ce àde' m buu efa rgèe ka'. Geewa'a, yu buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi ce jà' ka'. Ka' yuu mo' yi yu ce àde' m buu efa rgèe ka' wa'a, àtà m ke' byemi mɛnɛ yuu mo' yi tʉr ŋger mbe mɛ̂ ndù tɛ m lo ba ŋkwàa nè yuu anà ka'.
eng: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are expedient. All things are lawful for me, but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

lmp: Àde' à laa wɛnɛ̂, "Byee vi yu njo' rbʉ̀, rbʉ̀ li ba njo' byee." Ka' yi yu mini wa'a, Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ rbʉ̀ ba byee a lo mì. À ka' ba yi àmbò nyor, Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nyor tɛ bèe a bo lòr ce sàki àgho ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nyor tɛ ŋwɛ̀ bo gèe rfà' àgho nè Tata Jisos Krâis. Tata Jisos Krâis à ce kè'ni nyor anà.
eng: Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods, but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord; and the Lord for the body.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ be lòr yi ŋger fʉr sèe àgho efa rkwe àmbò e m fʉr Tata Jisos Krâis efa rkwe nà.
eng: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ wêe mnyor yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor Jisos krâis a? Banɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ lor yì nyor ce yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor Jisos Krâis, gee tɛ e ba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor kwàrà a? Ka'! Àtà yi ba wa' ka'.
eng: Don't you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ, and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' lor yì nyor gee e ba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor kwàrà banɛ a ye a yu sè'ni ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir a? A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ba njeŋwɛ̀ ca a be ba nyor mò'sir."
eng: Or don't you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, The two, says he, will become one flesh.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gee yì nyor ba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor Tata Jisos Krâis banɛ Jisos Krâis a ŋwɛ̀ anà a yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à yʉ'.
eng: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

lmp: Caŋ nè bsàkì. Yuu bebep mo' ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke gèe e ke tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè yì nyor ka'. À ka' ba yi àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce sàki, e ce bepsi ba yì nyor.
eng: Flee sexual immorality! Every sin that a man does is outside the body, but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ wêe mnyor yu ndap Yʉ' Rara a? Yʉ' Rara anà yi vʉ̀ ese Nyʉ̀ a ce cu njep wèe. Mnyor ce wèe tʉr yu wêe mnyor ka'.
eng: Or don't you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit which is in you, which you have from God? You are not your own,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m yuu wèe à ntaa nlùuluu. Banɛ wèe lor wêe mnyor gee rfà' àgho ba nè ye cà'cà' tɛ e bo sa' fòo àgho.
eng: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God's.

lmp: M be bèesi buu ce wèe à m saŋ a bipshi nè mɛ̀ nà. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ lòr ŋgwa ka' yi ku ba yɛɛnì.
eng: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, yi bòŋ enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ tʉr ŋgwa yì, tɛ njeŋwɛ̀ tʉr nduu yì, fà dì' wowèe a lo gwè rmòoshì, ce sàki ka'.
eng: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

lmp: Nduu fa shè ŋgwa embe bkuu ka'. Ŋgwa ye ye fa shè nduu yì ka'.
eng: Let the husband render to his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife to her husband.

lmp: Àde' ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ cu nè yi tu ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger mbe yê ndù yu nduu yì. Àde' nduu ŋwɛ̀ cu nè yi tu ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger mbe yê ndù yu ŋgwa yì.
eng: The wife doesn't have authority over her own body, but the husband. Likewise also the husband doesn't have authority over his own body, but the wife.

lmp: Nduu ŋwɛ̀ fa kani bkuu ŋgwa, kɛ̀ ŋgwa kani bkuu nduu ka'. A ye a ka' tɛ tarshi bkuu ka' banɛ a ye a ba byemi àbee enɛ a be gèe wa' ka', tɛ a bo lòr nfè' anà gèe ba rloo. Wee lò ker tarshi bkuu fà dì' Satàn mooshi wèe tɛ wèe gwe rmòoshì njobè' wèe à mòo à rcu wa' làr ka'.
eng: Don't deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn't tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

lmp: M ku ce fa ca ba àmbò ntaŋ, ke' ba enɛ a ncir ka'.
eng: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

lmp: À ba ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, bèe wɛɛwɛ à ba kù cu ŋkʉ̀ àmbò mɛ̀. Ka' m ce làa wa'a, mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ à fa bèe ŋger jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. E fa ŋwɛ̀ mo' ŋger enɛ e fa' nè ye à njì mò', a ker fa mò' ŋger enɛ e fa' nè ye à njì mò'.
eng: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

lmp: Mɛ̂ làa ca sè'ni ba nè bkʉ̀ ker ba byepkʉʉ. Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ wowèe a ku cu nè yap tu àmbò mɛ mɛ̀ cu na.
eng: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a ka' moo à rcu wa' làr, mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ lor ŋgwa yì, njeŋwɛ̀ yɛ nduu yì a ye a cu. Yi yu àndèe ce mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ka' lor ŋgwa, njeŋwɛ̀ ye ye du bgùu nè ce a ku cu wa'a tɛ ntee njeŋwɛ̀ yi ce lò mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ sê, tɛ ntee mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ yi ce lò njeŋwɛ̀ sê.
eng: But if they don't have self-control, let them marry. For it's better to marry than to burn.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa nè bèe ce a dù bgùu wɛɛ yi yu enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ fa fʉʉ ese nduu yì ka'. Mɛ̀ làa cena nè wèe ba nè ya tu ka'. Blàa ca yu blàa ce vi vʉ̀ ba ese Tatâ.
eng: But to the married I command--not I, but the Lord--that the wife not leave her husband

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ka' fʉʉ bgùu, e fa kèr yɛ nduu mò' ka'. Ka' ba enɛ e yɛ nduu mò', e kʉtì ba a nduu yì cà. Yi yu foŋ enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ fa jùu ŋgwa yì ka'.
eng: but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband, and that the husband not leave his wife.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò mmbaŋrù ce a tʉr bbyèŋge ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì ka', ker ba bbyèŋge ce a tʉr bduu ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì ka', m be fa wowèe ncep. Ncep ca à kwà'shi ba mɛ̀, ke' ba enɛ à fa Tata Nyʉ̀ ka'. Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka' tʉr ŋgwa ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka', ŋgwa yì anà ku koŋ enɛ a ye a cu, e fa jùu ye ka'.
eng: But to the rest I--not the Lord--say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ka' tʉr nduu ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka', nduu anà koŋ enɛ a ye a ku cu, e fa fʉʉ bgùu ka'.
eng: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à gèe enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka' koni bghònì ese ye njo' ŋgwa yì ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì. E ker gee foŋ enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka' koni bghònì ese ye njo' nduu yì ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì. Yi ka' tɛ bà ba wa' ka', boo wap à ba ba boo bbebep, geewa'a, wowèe a yu brara.
eng: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

lmp: Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka', ka' koŋ enɛ a ŋgwa a gapni, àde' a ye a ku gapni. Njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka', ka' koŋ enɛ a nduu yì a gapni, àde' a ye a ku gapni. A ye a ka' gapni banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì, kɛ̀ yu mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu njeŋwɛ̀ ɛ̀, e bʉ' ncir Nyʉ̀ ka'. Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' sèe enɛ sèe bo cu rcu ce li yu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

lmp: Wɛ̂ ŋgwa, wɛ̀ rìŋ nè kɛ àmbò àde' Nyʉ̀ lo ja' nduu wò njo' wɛ̀? Wɛ̂ nduu, wɛ̀ rìŋ nè kɛ àmbò àde' Nyʉ̀ lo ja' ŋgwa wò njo' wɛ̀?
eng: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

lmp: Yɛ nè enɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ku gee ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à fa ye ŋger enɛ e gêe. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ku ba àmbò e m ba tɛ Tata Nyʉ̀ ka' kɛ' ye. A yuu ce m ce yɛ'ni à bcor wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ba ce a m gèe ye bʉ̀ tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kɛ' ye, ŋgàŋ fa kèr ròo nduunjì mo' enɛ a gee ye e kʉti mbɛ̀'-nsʉ̀r ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à m ka' ba ba mbɛ̀'-nsʉ̀r tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kɛ' ye, e fa gèe bʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

lmp: Kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe bʉ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe bʉ̀ ka' ɛ̀, yì anà yi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe ka'. Yuu ce yi yu gòr yi yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ lɛ mncir Nyʉ̀.
eng: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but the keeping of the commandments of God.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ku ba àmbò e m ba tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kɛ' ye.
eng: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

lmp: Wɛ̀ m ka' ba ba ŋkwàa à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wɛ̀, à fa bu' ka', ka' ba ne enɛ wɛ̀ koni fɛŋ à rfʉʉ efa bkwàa, à fʉʉ yo yu.
eng: Were you called being a bondservant? Don't let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa wa'a, njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ka' ba ba ŋkwàa à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' ye, e fʉʉ sè'ni efa buu bbebep njobè' a Tata a yu àbee. Yi yu foŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋkwàa à nfè' Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' ye ka', yu sè'ni ba ŋkwàa Jisos Krâis.
eng: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord's free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ's bondservant.

lmp: Wèe yu bkwàa Jisos Krâis njobè' e m yuu wèe à ntaa nlùuluu. Wèe fa ba bkwàa ba nè bèe ka'.
eng: You were bought with a price. Don't become bondservants of men.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ku ba a Nyʉ̀, ce cu àmbò e m ce cu à nfè' Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' ye.
eng: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò bèe ce a be du bgùu kɛ̀ bèe ce a be lor bbyèŋge ka', ka' Nyʉ̀ à fa mɛ̀ blàa mo' enɛ m laa nè wowèe ka' wa'a, m be suŋ wowèe yuu ya ce mɛ̂ kwà'shi. M ce làa wa'a àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce àtà wèe yu' yuu ce m ce làa, njobè' Tata Jisos Krâis ce e m koosimnse nè mɛ̀.
eng: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' ŋgɛ' ce e yu sè'ni na, m ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ku cu àmbò e yu.
eng: I think that it is good therefore, because of the distress that is on us, that it is good for a man to be as he is.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' tʉr ŋgwa, e fa tà' nduunjì à rjùu ye ka, ŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ tʉr ŋgwa ka', e fa tà' nduunjì à rlòr ŋgwa ka'.
eng: Are you bound to a wife? Don't seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don't seek a wife.
