lmp: Ka' mɛ̀ làa wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ka' lor ne ŋgwa, banɛ e gèe yuu bebep ka'. Muu ŋgòŋgò ka' du bgùu banɛ e gèe yuu bebep ka'. Wèe à rìŋ enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ke cu à nduu a ŋgwa a ke yɛ ŋgɛ' njep ŋgòŋ na sê. Mɛ̀ yɛ ya mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ba cu ŋkʉ̀ fà dì' e bo yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ca ka'.
eng: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yuu m ce làa yi yu enɛ nfè' Nyʉ̀ à fa sèe yu nlʉ̀'shi. Banɛ kɛ' e sè'ni na, bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a tʉr bbyèŋge, a cu àmbò a yu lɛ bkʉ̀ wa'a.
eng: But I say this, brothers: the time is short, that from now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

lmp: Tɛ bèe ce e koosimnse a cu àmbò a ce koosi lɛ mnse ka' wa'a. Tɛ bèe ce a ce lu'shi a cu àmbò bèe ce a ce lɛ lu'shi ka' wa'a. Tɛ bèe ce a yu ŋgâa ntaa a cu àmbò bèe ce a tʉr lɛ buu ntaa ka' wa'a.
eng: and those who weep, as though they didn't weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn't rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn't possess;

lmp: Tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr rfà' à rgèe njep ŋgòŋ na, kɛ̀ yu ba njɛ̀ɛ rfà' kɛ, cu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr lɛ mkwà'shì à buu anà ka' wa'a, njobè' ŋgòŋ ca yi ce mì.
eng: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

lmp: Mɛ̀ kòŋ mɛnɛ buu mò' ba ce vi be fa wèe ŋgɛ' ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e cu ŋkʉ̀ e ke kwà'shi àmbò buu ce Tata Jisòs à kòŋ enɛ e gee tɛ nyor boŋ ye.
eng: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr ŋgwa, e ke kwà'shi àmbò buu enjep ŋgòŋ ce ròo enɛ e gee nyor boŋ ŋgwa yì.
eng: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

lmp: Yi ba wa'a, banɛ yi ntee yi gàp nyor à buu bbaa. Boo mŋgòŋgò ba bbyèŋge ce a tʉr bduu ka', a ke kwà'shi àmbò buu Tatâ. Wowèe a lò lor wâp mntee ba wâp mnyor wɛɛwɛ fa nè Nyʉ̀. Bbyèŋge ce a tʉr bduu a lò kwa'shi ba àmbò buu enjep ŋgòŋ na njobè' wowèe a kòŋ enɛ a gee tɛ nyor boŋ bduu wap.
eng: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world--how she may please her husband.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa buu ca tɛ m bo jà' wèe jà'. Mɛ̀ kòŋ mɛnɛ m lɛ wèe ba ntɛ̀r mbendù nyor ka'. Yuu mɛ̀ kòŋ yi yu ba enɛ wèe gee buu ce vi yu bbòŋboŋ a ba byɛɛnì tɛ yuu mo' yi bo ba ce àtà yi jepsì wèe efa rfà' nè Tata ka'.
eng: This I say for your own profit; not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e fa kwàŋ nè muunje, mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ anà ka' yɛ enɛ e be lòr muunje ca ka' njobè' e kòŋ à rcu ŋkʉ̀ tɛ e bo fà' nè Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ, yi bep ka'. E ka' moo à rcu làr njo' ntee njeŋwɛ̀ yi ce lò ye, e ka' koŋ e lor ŋgwa yì. E ka' gee wa'a, banɛ e gèe yuu bebep ka'.
eng: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn't sin. Let them marry.

lmp: Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ka' kwa'shi nè yi tu enɛ e be lòr muunje anà ka', ce mbò à làa ŋwɛ̀ mò' nè ye ka', e ka' cu ŋkʉ̀, riŋ enɛ e be kèr kwà'shi yuu mo' àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ka', banɛ e gèe bòŋboŋ.
eng: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no necessity, but has power over his own heart, to keep his own virgin, does well.

lmp: Banɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e lòr ŋgwa, e gèe yɛɛnì. Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e lòr ŋgwa ka', e gèe yuu bòŋboŋ a caa mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e lòr ŋgwa.
eng: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn't give her in marriage does better.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ ka' du bgùu banɛ e be kù cu a nduu yì kè càa kwe. Ka' ba ne enɛ nduu yì à kwe, banɛ e tʉr ŋger à ryɛ nduu mò', ce yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e tɛɛ njep mʉ̀ buu Tatâ.
eng: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whoever she desires, only in the Lord.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ya mɛnɛ e ka' cu nè yi tu, e yu' rbòŋ sê. Mɛ̀ byemi mɛnɛ yuu mɛ̀ làa na, yi vʉ̀ ba ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God's Spirit.

lmp: M be làa yuu àmbò byee ce bèe a ce gèe taŋshì àgho nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na nà. Sèe rìŋ seenɛ sèe wɛɛwɛ tʉr bfee. Bfee anà vi lò gee ŋwɛ̀, e naa tu. Yu ba rkòŋnì ce li ke kupshi bèe.
eng: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kwà'shi enɛ e rìŋ buu sê, ŋgàŋ à be riŋ buu àmbò e ba rìŋ ka'.
eng: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn't yet know as he ought to know.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ Nyʉ̀ banɛ Nyʉ̀ rìŋ ye.
eng: But if anyone loves God, the same is known by him.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò nye byee ce bèe a ce gèe taŋshì àgho nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na nà, sèe à rìŋ enɛ njɛ̀ɛ mnyʉ̀ anà yu buu bcicì njobè' vi tʉr myòŋ ka'. Sèe rìŋ yisèe enɛ Nyʉ̀ ku ba mò'sir cà'cà'.
eng: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

lmp: Ka' buu mò' yu gòr mbe bùu ba njep nshè na ce bèe a ce too enɛ mnyʉ̀ wa'a, ker ce lòr buu anà àmbò vi yu lɛ btàr nè wowèe wa'a,
eng: For though there are things that are called gods, whether in the heavens or on earth; as there are many gods and many lords;

lmp: sèe à rìŋ yisèe enɛ Nyʉ̀ ku ba mò'sir cà'cà', E yu Tàr nè sèe. Yu ye ce e m gèe buu wɛɛwɛ, a ker gee sèe foŋ enɛ sèe bo ba yì bèe. Sèe ku tʉr Tata mò'sir ce yu Jisos Krâis. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ba njì enjep ye. Yu ye ce e fa sèe ryòŋ.
eng: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

lmp: Yu ba ŋgâa rbyemì wɛɛwɛ ce a rìŋ enɛ mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na yu ba buu bcicì ka'. Geewa'a, bèe mo' a yu ce a m ce loo nè mnyʉ̀ ca, e lò ba à nfè' ce wowèe a ce ye byee ce a fa nè mnyʉ̀ ca, a ku riŋ yap enɛ byee anà yu ba byee mnyʉ̀. Wowèe a ce ye, yap ntee yi ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ', wowèe a ce kwà'shi enɛ wowèe a gèe yuu bebep.
eng: However, that knowledge isn't in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

lmp: Sèe à rìŋ seenɛ àtà byee vi gee sèe sèe ba jɛɛ à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'. Sèe ka' tɛ ye ka', yì anà yi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe ka'. Sèe ka' ye, yì anà yi gee sèe sèe ba jɛɛ ka'.
eng: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don't eat, are we the worse; nor, if we eat, are we the better.

lmp: Ka' sèe rìŋ wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ lor nfè' fà dì' njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè ye enɛ e ye buu nà, yi lo gèe tɛ bfʉr mo' ce map mkwà'shì mi ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ' nà, a lo gwè ka'.
eng: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce yi ntee yi ka' ku bii fa ye ŋgɛ', ka' yɛ àmbò wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ tʉr bfee ce ye byee mbe ndàp njɛ̀ɛ mnyʉ̀ ca, mbò cena yi be fa ye ŋger à rye byee anà a?
eng: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol's temple, won't his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

lmp: E ka' ye, banɛ wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ tʉr bfee nà, wɛ̀ bepsi nfʉrò ce Jisos Krâis à m kwe nè ye.
eng: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' gee yuu bebep nè bfʉr wo, tɛ yap ntee yi ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ' wa'a, banɛ wɛ̀ gèe yuu bebep nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

lmp: M ka' yɛ mɛnɛ m be ye njɛ̀ɛ byee anà tɛ nfʉrà gee yuu bebep, gwè, banɛ m be kèr ye vi ka'.
eng: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forevermore, that I don't cause my brother to stumble.

lmp: M tʉr ŋger à rgèe yuu ce mɛ̀ ka' koŋ à rgèe. M yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. Mɛ̀ m yɛ Jisos Krâis ce e yu Tata nè sèe nè ma mmir. Wèe yu ya bo rfà' efa rfà' ce mɛ̀ fà' nè Tatâ.
eng: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven't I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren't you my work in the Lord?

lmp: Bèe mo' a ka' tɛ rìŋ enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis ka', mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe rìŋ wa'a njobè' wèe yu ncòo ce e gèe bèe a riŋ enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Tatâ.
eng: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

lmp: Blàa ce m be làa sè'ni na a blàa ce m ce làa nè bèe ce a ce tarni enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Tatâ.
eng: My defense to those who examine me is this.

lmp: Mbò wèr tʉr ŋger à rkoo byee ker ba buu mno ese bèe njo' rfà' ce wèr ce gèe nè wowèe a?
eng: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

lmp: Mbò wèr tʉr ŋger à rlòr wer bbyèŋge ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì, tɛ wèr wowèe ce kar àmbò Pità ba ŋgâa ntuu mo' foŋ, ker ba bfʉr Tata Jisòs a ce gèe nà a?
eng: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

lmp: Wà' bèe ce àde' a fa', tar buu enjep mmbò ka' ce yeŋger, ku ba wèr Bànabàs a?
eng: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

lmp: Wà' àde' ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̀ ce tàr buu enjep mmbò ka' ce yeŋger a? Wà' àde' ŋwɛ̀ nfà' byee lo buu efa rye byee ce e fà' a? Mbò bèe ce a ke cìŋ nà' a ke kaa mmbee nà' ce a ce cìŋ, no a?
eng: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn't eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn't drink from the flock's milk?

lmp: M ce làa buu ca, à ke' ku làa ba mɛ̀ ka', ncir Nyʉ̀ yi làa wa' foŋ.
eng: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn't the law also say the same thing?

lmp: A saŋ mbe ŋwà' mncir ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè Musìs enɛ̂, "Fa kur cùu nà' ce e ce bu' msaŋ ka'." Nyʉ̀ à m ce làa buu ca a ke' ce làa ba àmbò nà' ka'.
eng: For it is written in the law of Moses, You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain. Is it for the oxen that God cares,

lmp: E m ce làa ba àmbò sèe. Ŋwɛ̀ nfà' mnsuu à ba rìŋ enɛ e be tʉr ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa byee ce e fà', ŋwɛ̀ rkep riŋ foŋ enɛ e be tʉr ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa byee anà.
eng: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.

lmp: Wèr à ka' fa' a wêe mʉ, bye buu ce à yʉ' njep wêe mntee, yi ke' ba yɛɛnì enɛ wèr à ba koni buu ce vi be gèe tɛ wèr cu rcu ryɛɛnì ese wèe a?
eng: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

lmp: Bèe mo' a ka' tʉr ŋger à rlàa enɛ wèe ja' wowèe, rìŋ nè enɛ bèe ce wèe à ba jà' entombì yu wèr. Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèr à be laa enɛ wèe ja' wèr ka', wèr à kòŋ à ryɛ ŋgɛ' fà dì' wèr bo jepsi bèe efa ryu' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Jisòs ka'.
eng: If others partake of this right over you, don't we yet more? Nevertheless we did not use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

lmp: Kuushi nè enɛ bèe ce a ke fà' mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ a ke ye efa buu ce bèe a fa rfa àgho mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, bèe ce a ke fà' mbe dî' ntòo rfa a ke ye ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa buu ce a taŋshi taŋshì àgho.
eng: Don't you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

lmp: Tata à m làa foŋ enɛ bèe a fa ŋgâa rfè'shì buu ce àde' vi gee wowèe a cu rcu rbòŋboŋ.
eng: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

lmp: Ka' mɛ̀ tʉr ŋger à rlàa enɛ wèe ja' mɛ̀ wa'a, mɛ̀ be laa wa' ka'. M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè wèe sè'ni wa'a, a ke' ce saŋ tɛ wèe bo jà' mɛ̀ ka'. Ka' ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' gee tɛ nàatu ce m ce nàa njobè' m ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ a ke' ce koo buu ese wèe ka' nà, lo ba yuu cicì, m boŋlàr kwe kwe.
eng: But I have used none of these things, and I don't write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

lmp: Àde' m naa tu njobè' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce m ce fè'shi nè wèe ka' njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè mɛ̀ enɛ m fe'shî. Ndòo be co' mɛ̀ ce m ka' tɛ fè'shi ka'.
eng: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about; for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me, if I don't preach the Good News.

lmp: À m ba kwa'shi ba mɛ̀ enɛ m be fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè bèe, mɛ̀ m ba koo blà' ese wowèe. Yi ke' ba wa'a ka'. M ku ce gèe ba rfà' ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa mba mɛ̂ mmbò.
eng: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ sɛ' ce àde' m konì efa rfà' ca yu ba kɛ? Yà sɛ' ku ba ba enɛ m fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè bèe à cicì. A mbùu ce m ce làa mɛnɛ bèe a fa là' mɛ̀ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ rfè'shì ka'.
eng: What then is my reward? That, when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

lmp: M yu ŋkwàa nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Ka' m yu ŋkwàa nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' wa'a, mɛ̀ gèe yà nyor àmbò ŋkwàa nè bèe wɛɛwɛ tɛ m bo so bèe magòr nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

lmp: Mɛ̂ cu wèr Jus wèe, gee ŋgèe àmbò wowèe wa'a, tɛ m bo so wowèe nè Jisos Krâis. Ka' mncir Musìs vi kur mɛ̀ ka' wa'a, mɛ̂ cu wèr bèe ce mncir ca vi kur wowèe, gee ŋgèe àmbò mncir ca vi kur lɛ mɛ̀ foŋ wa'a. M ce gèe wa'a, tɛ m bo so bèe anà nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

lmp: Mɛ̂ cu wèr bèe ce mncir vi kur wowèe ka', gee ŋgèe àmbò wowèe wa'a, tɛ m bo so wowèe nè Jisos Krâis. M ce gèe wa'a, ke' ba enɛ mɛ̀ lòr mncir ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa àtɛ̀r ka'. M ce yu'ni nè mncir Jisos Krâis sê.
eng: to those who are without law, as without law not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ, that I might win those who are without law.

lmp: Mɛ̂ cu wèr bèe ce map mkwà'shì mi ku bii fa wowèe ŋgɛ', m ku ba àmbò wowèe wa'a tɛ m bo so wowèe nè Jisos Krâis. Mɛ̂ lò ku gee yà nyor àmbò bèe a yu, tɛ m bo ghèter à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, gèe tɛ wowèe a lûŋ.
eng: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

lmp: M ce gèe buu ca wa'a, tɛ bèe a bo yu' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ tɛ mɛ mɛ̀ koni bghònì ce nsuŋ anà e ke gèe bèe a konì.
eng: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

lmp: Mbò wèe rìŋ enɛ e ke ba nfè' mcaŋnì, ŋgàa mcaŋnì a caŋ wa'a, lo koo blà' bsìp ka' a? Banɛ wèe caŋ bòŋboŋ tɛ wèe bo koo blà'.
eng: Don't you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, that you may win.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ke kòŋ à rcaŋ, e ke yɛ'ni à rcaŋ bòŋboŋ sê. E lò gee wa'a tɛ e bo koo blà' ce vi ke cu nfesè ka'. Blà' visèe à ba blà' ce vi be cu nfesè.
eng: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' ce caŋ ya, a ke' ce caŋ ba à nji ka', a ku ce kè' ba kùntombì tɛ m bo caŋ mìsi. M ce mà' dʉ̀' a ke' ce mà' ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce mà' à bjiji ka'.
eng: I therefore run like that, as not uncertainly. I fight like that, as not beating the air,

lmp: M ce fa ŋgɛ' nè yà nyor, a gee e kʉtì à ŋkwàa fà dì' m ce fè'shi nè bèe mò', lò gwè, bɛ blà' ka'.
eng: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be rejected.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe à ba kuushi buu ce vi m koni visèe bta à nfè' ce wowèe a m ce dà' à rìŋ nà bòŋboŋ. Mmbà' vi m ce kè'ni wowèe. Wowèe a m tuu ma rdip mo' ce a m ce too enɛ rdip rbeer nè mkùu.
eng: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

lmp: Àmbò wowèe a m ce dù àmbùu mmbà', a ker tuu rdip rbeer ca, cena yi m ba nè wowèe àmbò njɛ̀ɛ bàptir mò' ce e m gèe wowèe a ba bèe Musìs.
eng: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a m ye byee ce Nyʉ̀ à m mà'ri embe bùu,
eng: and all ate the same spiritual food;

lmp: a no mdip ce mi m fʉʉ ba enje ryɛɛ. Ryɛɛ anà à m ba Jisos Krâis ce e m ce jɛ̀r a wowèe.
eng: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

lmp: Ka' wowèe a m yɛ buu ca nè map mmir wa'a, bèe magòr efa wowèe a m gèe buu ce ntee yi boŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a kweŋgèr, bgʉ̀ʉ vi saŋsì nyor à rìŋ.
eng: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

lmp: Buu ca à ba gèe tɛ see sèe foŋ riŋ enɛ sèe à ba kòŋ buu bbebep àmbò visèe bta a m kòŋ nà ka'.
eng: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things, as they also lusted.

lmp: Wèe fa gèe rloo nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na àmbò bèe mò' efa wowèe a m gèe nà ka'. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Bèe a m cu à nshè a ye byee, a no buu, a nati mbekì a bii bii nè blaŋ."
eng: Neither be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.

lmp: Sèe fa ce sàki àmbò bèe mo' efa wowèe a m sàki nà ka'. Wowèe a m sàki wa'a, bèe ncʉ̀kì-ncòp-taar-à-mmbaa a kweŋgèr à nôŋ mo'sir.
eng: Neither let us commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

lmp: Sèe fa mòoshi Tata àmbò bèe mo' efa wowèe a m mòoshi nà ka'. Mnyo vi m tashi wowèe, wowèe a kweŋgèr.
eng: Neither let us test the Lord, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

lmp: Sèe fa ce rʉ̀'ŋger àmbò bèe mo' efa wowèe a m rʉ̀'ŋger nà ka'. Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e ke yʉshi bèe nà à m yʉshi wowèe.
eng: Neither grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

lmp: Buu ce vi m koni bèe elûuŋgòŋ, yu buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m bɛɛ wowèe àgho. A m saŋ buu ca tɛ sèe ce sèe ce cu ba à nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi ce mì na, bo rìŋ, lòr nfè' fà dì' buu anà koni sèe foŋ ka'.
eng: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce kwà'shi enɛ e tɛɛ tatap, lor nfè' fà dì' e gwe ka'.
eng: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn't fall.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ rmòoshì ce li ka' vʉ nè wèe ku ba njɛ̀ɛ rmòoshì ce li vʉ̀ nè bèe mo' foŋ. Nyʉ̀ ce e yu mini be mà'shi tɛ li vʉ càa ye ŋger ka'. Rmòoshì li ka' vʉ nè wèe banɛ e be fa wèe ŋger tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap, so rmòoshì anà.
eng: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

lmp: Bkar wâ, banɛ m ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe fa tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'.
eng: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

lmp: M ce làa nè wèe ce wèe rìŋ buu. Wèe kwa'shi ka enɛ yuu ce m ce làa nè wèe yi yu mini lɛ.
eng: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

lmp: E ke ba à nfè' sèe ce ye byee Nyʉ̀, see loo, yoŋshi ye à ndoŋ mrù' ce see ke no. Sêe ce no enjep ndoŋ anà yi ce dùŋshi enɛ sèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu àbee njo' vi blɛɛ. Sêe ce bɛ'shi byee, yi ce dùŋshi foŋ enɛ sèe wowèe yu àbee njo' yì nyor. Mbò yi yu wa' a?
eng: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn't it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn't it a sharing of the body of Christ?

lmp: Ka' sèe ce sèe ce ye efa byee anà, sèe yu àŋgoo wa'a, ntu' brɛ̂d ku ba mò'sir. Cena yi dùŋshi enɛ sèe wɛɛwɛ yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

lmp: Kwà'shi nè àmbò ndèe bèe Isrɛ̀l. E ke ba à nfè' bèe mo' efa wowèe a ce ye byee ce a taŋshi taŋshì àgho nè Nyʉ̀, a Nyʉ̀ wèe a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don't those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa yi yu ba enɛ kɛ? Wà' nyʉ̀ mò' enjep ŋgòŋ na, kɛ̀ byee ce a ke taŋshi taŋshì àgho nè njɛ̀ɛ nyʉ̀ ca ɛ̀, e ke ba yuu gòr a?
eng: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

lmp: Yi yu wa' ka'. Bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' a ke taŋshi yap taŋshì ba nè mnyʉ̂mkà'. Wowèe a ke taŋshi taŋshì ca ba nè Nyʉ̀ ka'. M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe mnyʉ̂mkà' wèe ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir ka'.
eng: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don't desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ no enjep ndoŋ Tata Jisos Krâis, ker no enjep ndoŋ mnyʉ̂mkà' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ye byee ce yu ba byee Tata Jisos Krâis, ker ye byee ce yu ba byee mnyʉ̂mkà' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: You can't both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can't both partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.

lmp: Sèe lor nfè' fà dì' sèe gee yuu mo' ce ntee yi bep Tata Nyʉ̀ nè sèe ka'. Wà' sèe tʉr ŋger a caa ye a?
eng: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

lmp: Wèe tʉr ŋger à rgèe buu wɛɛwɛ. Ka' wèe tʉr ŋger ca wa'a, yu buu wɛɛwɛ ce àde' vi ja' bèe ka'. Yi yu mini enɛ wèe tʉr ŋger à rgèe buu wɛɛwɛ. Ka' yi yu mini enɛ wèe tʉr ŋger à rgèe buu ca wa'a, yu buu wɛɛwɛ ce àde' vi gee bèe a tɛɛ tatap njep buu ce yu vi Tata Jisos Krâis ka'.
eng: All things are lawful for me, but not all things are profitable. All things are lawful for me, but not all things build up.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ gee yuu ce àde' yi ja' ŋwɛ̀ mò'. Ŋwɛ̀ fa gèe ba yuu ce yi ku bòŋ ba ye cà'cà' ka'.
eng: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor's good.

lmp: Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ye ntee yi ce fa wèe ŋgɛ' à rye nyàa ce wèe a yuu efa ntaa ka'. Wèe fa kwà'shi enɛ wèe ka' gee wa'a ba yuu bebep ka'.
eng: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

lmp: M ce làa wa'a njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋgòŋ ca wɛɛwɛ yu yi Nyʉ̀, ker ba buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu njo."
eng: for the earth is the Lord's, and its fullness.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka', à ka' be wɛ̀ enɛ à vʉ tɛ wèe ye ye byee, wɛ̀ ka' dû, à ye njɛ̀ɛ byee wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' fa wɛ̀. Fa mà'shi tɛ yo ntee yi lo kɛ̀' ce fa wɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ka'.
eng: But if one of those who don't believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' suŋ wɛ̀ enɛ byee ce à ce ye anà yu byee ce a taŋshi taŋshì àgho, à fa ye ka'. Fa ye ka' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ anà ka' yɛ àmbò à ce ye, e kwa'shì yi enɛ wɛ̀ gèe ba yuu bebep.
eng: But if anyone says to you, This was offered to idols, don't eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For the earth is the Lord's, and all its fullness.

lmp: Fa ye ka' njo' mkwà'shì mi ŋwɛ̀ anà, ke' ba njo' mo ka'. Seemò' ŋwɛ̀ mò' be làa enɛ̂, "Àde' m bornì efa rgèe yuu mo' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce kwà'shi enɛ yuu anà yi yu bebep njokɛ?
eng: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other's conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

lmp: M ka' ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à byee ce m ce ye, bèe mo' a laa bebep àmbò mɛ̀ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for that for which I give thanks?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' laa wa'a, m beesì mɛnɛ̂, "Yuu wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̀ ka' ce gèe, kɛ̀ à ce ye ye ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à ce no no ɛ̀, gèe ba à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce bèe mo' a ka' yɛ, tɛ wowèe a bo kù'si Nyʉ̀."
eng: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

lmp: Lòr nfè' fà dì' à gee yuu mo' ce yi gee tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' gwê, kɛ̀ yu Jus ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bèe enje jɛɛ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu ŋgâa cor ɛ̀, fa kè mòo ka'.
eng: Give no occasions for stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

lmp: Mɛ mɛ̀ ce ghèter à rgèe tɛ nyor boŋ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à buu wɛɛwɛ ce m ce gèe. Mɛ ke kwà'shi ba à yuu ce àtà yi ja' ba mɛ̀ cà'cà' ka'. Mɛ ke kwà'shi ba àmbò yuu ce àtà yi ja' bèe wɛɛwɛ, tɛ wowèe a bo lùŋ efa buu bbebep.
eng: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

lmp: Kù ce gee nè ba yuu ce m ce gèe àmbò mɛ mɛ̀ ce gèe ba buu ce Jisos Krâis à m ce gèe.
eng: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yòŋshi wèe njobè' wèe ce kuushi buu ce mɛ̀ m yɛ'ni wèe, a ker ce gèe buu anà yɛɛnì sê.
eng: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

lmp: Mɛ̂ kòŋ tɛ wèe riŋ bòŋboŋ enɛ Jisos Krâis yu tu nè mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀, mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ à ba tu nè njeŋwɛ̀, Nyʉ̀ à ba tu nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is the man, and the head of Christ is God.

lmp: Ka' ba à nfè' ce mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce gèe rloo, ker ba à nfè' ce e ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, e ka' sop rtaa mbe tù banɛ e coosi Jisos Krâis ce e yu tu nè ye.
eng: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ye ye ka' ce gèe rloo, kɛ̀ ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ɛ̀, ke' seŋ rtaa mbe tù ka' banɛ e coosi mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ce e yu tu nè ye. Njeŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ seŋ rtaa mbe tù ka' banɛ e yu àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ce a kwàa ye tu wa'a.
eng: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head unveiled dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ka' kani à rseŋ rtaa mbe tù banɛ e ba bòŋlàr koo tu anà koo. À ka' ba enɛ yu rìtu nè njeŋwɛ̀ à rkwàa tu kɛ̀ koo tu ɛ̀, banɛ njeŋwɛ̀ seŋ rtaa mbe tù.
eng: For if a woman is not covered, let her also be shorn. But if it is shameful for a woman to be shorn or shaved, let her be covered.

lmp: Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ sop rtaa mbe tù ka', njobè' e yu rfeese Nyʉ̀, a ba fôo Nyʉ̀, njeŋwɛ̀ à ba fôo mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀.
eng: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m lòr nfàŋ njeŋwɛ̀ a boo mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ àgho ka'. E m lòr nfàŋ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ a boo njeŋwɛ̀ àgho.
eng: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m boo mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ a fa nè njeŋwɛ̀ ka', e m boo ba njeŋwɛ̀ a fa nè mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀.
eng: for neither was man created for the woman, but woman for the man.

lmp: A mbùu ce njeŋwɛ̀ à ba seŋ rtaa mbe tù fà dì' ntee yi bo yaŋ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: For this cause the woman ought to have authority on her head, because of the angels.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò sèe ce sèe ce cu sèe Tata Jisos Krâis wèe, njeŋwɛ̀ yu nè yi tu ka', mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ à ba nè yi tu ka'.
eng: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m lòr nfàŋ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ a boo njeŋwɛ̀ àgho, njeŋwɛ̀ ye ye à ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke bi mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀. Buu ca wɛɛwɛ à m gèe ba Nyʉ̀.
eng: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

lmp: Kwà'shi ka nè enɛ wà' yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ gee rloo nè Nyʉ̀ ce e seŋ rtaa mbe tù ka' lɛ.
eng: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a ku riŋ enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ka' ko'si tu, banɛ e coosi yi tu.
eng: Doesn't even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

lmp: À ka' ba yi nè njeŋwɛ̀, tu ko'si à ba yuu bòŋboŋ njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m fa ye nyʉ̀'tu sàsap tɛ e bo tɛ'shi yi tu àgho.
eng: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' ba ce e ce sɛr yi enɛ buu ca yu wa' ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ à ba rìŋ enɛ wèr ce gèe ba buu ca, bcor wɛɛwɛ vi ce gèe wa' foŋ.
eng: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God's assemblies.

lmp: Yuu ce m be fa wèe ncep àgho na yu ba yuu ce m be yòŋshi wèe àgho yòŋshi ka'. E ke ba à nfè' wèe à vʉ̀ àbee à rgèe rloo nè Nyʉ̀, wèe ce gèe ba ŋgêe bebep caa ŋgêe bòŋboŋ.
eng: But in giving you this command, I don't praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.

lmp: Yuu entombì ce mɛ̀ yu' yi yu enɛ e ke ba à nfè' ce wèe à vʉ̀ àbee à rgèe rloo nè Nyʉ̀, ŋgàpni yi ba a wêe mʉ. Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ seemò' yi yu mini wa'a.
eng: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

lmp: Yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ ŋgàpni yi ba a wêe mʉ, njobè' e ke ba ne à nfè' ce ŋgàpni yi niŋ wa'a, wèe ka' yɛ bèe ce a yuu bêe mini.
eng: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ wee ke vʉ̀ àbee, vʉ ba à rye byee Tata Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord's supper that you eat.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa wa'a njobè' e ke ba à nfè' ce a ce ye byee, ŋwɛ̀ ku ce ye vi byee, ke' ce kwà'shi àmbò bèe mo' ka'. Yi lò ba wa'a, njè ce yaŋ bèe mò', bèe mò' a no mrù' mi koo wowèe.
eng: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ yuu ce yi koni wèe na yu ba njɛ̀ɛ kɛ? Mbò wèe tʉr mndap ce wee ke fʉʉ embo wèe à banì yeŋger, a ker noŋger a? Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ wèe lor cor Nyʉ̀ à yuu cicì ker gee tɛ rìtu yi koo bèe ce a buu byee ba buu mno ka'. Yuu ce m be làa nè wèe yu kɛ? Wà' m be yòŋshi wèe a? Ka', àde' m yoŋshì wèe ka'.
eng: What, don't you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God's assembly, and put them to shame who don't have? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don't praise you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m yɛ'ni wèe buu ce Tata à m gèe mɛ̀ rîŋ. Buu anà yu enɛ, à m ba nètʉ' ce a be fyèni Tata Jisòs nà, e lor brɛ̂d,
eng: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

lmp: a yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, a bɛ'shi, a laa enɛ̂, "Ca yu yà nyor ce mɛ̀ fa a wêe btù. Ce gee nè àmbò sèe ce gèe na tɛ wèe bo ce kuushi mɛ̀."
eng: When he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ye wɛɛ, e lor ndoŋ a laa enɛ̂, "Ndoŋ ca tɛɛ àtu lê' fi ce Nyʉ̀ à ye a bèe nè wa blɛɛ. Kuushi nè mɛ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ka' ce no enjep ndoŋ ca."
eng: In the same way he also took the cup, after supper, saying, This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.

lmp: Banɛ ka' ba à nfè' efɛ ce wèe ce ye byee ca, ce no enjep ndoŋ ca, wèe ce suŋ bèe àmbò rkwe Tata Jisòs, caar tɛ e ke vʉ̀.
eng: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord's death until he comes.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ ye brɛ̂d ca, ker ce no enjep ndoŋ ca à njî yɛɛnì ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ à lòr nyor ba blɛɛ Tata à yuu cicì.
eng: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord's cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

lmp: Tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' ye brɛ̂d ca, kèr no enjep ndoŋ ca, ŋgàŋ fyɛ' yì nyor bòŋboŋ ka' gee wa'a.
eng: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ye brɛ̂d, ker no enjep ndoŋ ca, ke' ce kuushi enɛ buu ca tɛɛ àtu nyor ba blɛɛ Tata Jisòs ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ à lòr ndòo mbe yê tù.
eng: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself, if he doesn't discern the Lord's body.

lmp: A mbùu ce bèe magòr a wêe mʉ a sɛ̀, bèe mo' a ce yaŋ, bèe mo' a kweŋgèr.
eng: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

lmp: Sèe ka' fyɛ' visèe mnyor ka' ye brɛ̂d ca, ker no enjep ndoŋ ca, Nyʉ̀ sa' sèe àmbò bèe ce a gèe yuu bebep ka'.
eng: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn't be judged.

lmp: Tata Nyʉ̀ e ke sa' sèe wa'a ce nàshi sèe nàshi fà dì' sèe bo kè gwè mnsa', yɛ ŋgɛ' à nfè' ce e be sa' ŋgòŋ nà ka'.
eng: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yi ka' ba wa'a, ka' ba à nfè' wèe à vʉ̀ àbee à rye byee Nyʉ̀, bèe mo' a fa kù kɛ̀' ce ye entombì nè bèe mò' ka'.
eng: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

lmp: Njè ka' ce yaŋ ŋwɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ ye byee mbe yê ndàp ka' vʉ̂, fà dì' wèe vʉ àbee lò gèe ŋgêe bebep tɛ Nyʉ̀ sa' wèe ka'. M be fa wèe ncep à buu mo' foŋ, à nfè' ce m ka' vʉ ca'ni wèe.
eng: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ buu mò' kuu bfee ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ke fa nè bèe.
eng: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don't want you to be ignorant.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' wèe à m ku bii à tʉ̀'nji, Satàn à m ce bo' wèe à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a gee wèe à ce cà'ni mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ce vi ke làa ka'.
eng: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

lmp: Banɛ m ce kòŋ enɛ wèe riŋ enɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ka' ba njep ŋwɛ̀, àde' ŋgàŋ laa enɛ̂, "Ndòo co' Jisòs" ka'. Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ka' tɛ ba njep ŋwɛ̀ ka', àde' ŋgàŋ laa enɛ̂, "Jisòs yu Tatâ" ka'.
eng: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God's Spirit says, Jesus is accursed. No one can say, Jesus is Lord, but by the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ke fa bèe bfee jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ à rgèe buu. Ka' yi yu wa'a, Yʉ' anà yi ku ba yi mo'sir.
eng: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

lmp: Mfà' ce bèe a ke gèe mi ku ba jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ foŋ. Ka' yi yu wa'a, Tata Jisòs ce a ce fà' nè ye ku ba mò'sir.
eng: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

lmp: Mfà' mi yu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce bèe a ke gèe, à ku ba Nyʉ̀ mò'sir ce e fa bèe wɛɛwɛ bfee à rgèe mfà' anà.
eng: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.

lmp: Bfee Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ke yɛɛti njep bèe à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ tɛ ŋwɛ̀ bo lòr bfee anà jà' bèe Nyʉ̀ àgho.
eng: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

lmp: Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ke fa bèe mo' bfee à rfa bèe ncep mbòŋmboŋ, ker fa bèe mo' bfee à rfè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' bèe a riŋ Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ. Yʉ' ca yi ku ba yi mo'sir.
eng: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;

lmp: Yi ke fa bèe mo' bfee à rlɛ̀ ntee à buu Nyʉ̀, ker fa bèe mo' bfee à rgèe ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se. Ku ba Yʉ' yi mo'sir ce yi gèe buu ca wɛɛwɛ.
eng: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;

lmp: Yi ke fa bèe mo' bfee à rgèe buu bghagha', ker fa bèe mo' bfee à rcep ntuu Nyʉ̀. Yi ke fa bèe mo' bfee à rrìŋ buu ce vi lò ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, ker riŋ vì ce vi lò ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yi ke fa bèe mo' bfee à rlàa bli ce a m be yɛ'ni ka', ker fa bèe mo' bfee à rsuŋ bèe buu ce a làa à bli anà.
eng: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.

lmp: Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ anà yi ke fa bèe ŋger à rgèe buu ca wɛɛwɛ. Yi ke fa ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ yuu ce yi ce kòŋ à rfa.
eng: But the one and the same Spirit works all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò nyor e ke ba mò'sir, mŋgʉ̀' nyor vi ku ba jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ nà. Mŋgʉ̀' nyor ca vi ke tarshi nyor àbee, gee nyor mò'sir. Jisos Krâis ku ba wa' foŋ.
eng: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

lmp: Ka' bèe mo' efa sèe a yu Jûs, bèe mo' a ba bèe enje jɛɛ, bèe mo' a ba bkwàa, bèe mo' a ba bkwàa ka' wa'a, sèe wɛɛwɛ à m kʉti ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à nfè' ce a m bàptir sèe nè Yʉ' Nyʉ̀. Ku ba Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ca ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè sèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ yi niŋ njep visêe mntee.
eng: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

lmp: Nyor e ke tʉr ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò'sir ka', e ke tʉr mŋgʉ̀' nyor jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: For the body is not one member, but many.

lmp: Kùu yi ka' laa enɛ̂, "M yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor ka, njobè' m yu bo ka'," wà' banɛ kùu yi buu efa rba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor a?
eng: If the foot would say, Because I'm not the hand, I'm not part of the body, it is not therefore not part of the body.

lmp: Tù' yi ka' laa enɛ̂, "M yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor ka', njobè' m yu rlir ka'," wà' àde' blàa anà vi gee tù' yi buu efa rba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor a?
eng: If the ear would say, Because I'm not the eye, I'm not part of the body, it's not therefore not part of the body.

lmp: Nyor à m ba ku ba rlir, ŋwɛ̀ à m ba ce yu' buu ba nè kɛ? Nyor à m ba ku ba tù', ŋwɛ̀ à m ba ce yu' rʉ̀ʉ yuu ba nè kɛ?
eng: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

lmp: Gee ne wa'a, yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m gèe mŋgʉ̀' nyor jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ vi ce fà' buu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ àmbò e m kòŋ.
eng: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

lmp: Nyor wɛɛwɛ à m ba ku ba ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò'sir, yì anà à ba ba nyor ka'.
eng: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

lmp: Yi yu enɛ mŋgʉ̀' nyor vi yu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ wa'a, nyor à ku ba mò'sir.
eng: But now they are many members, but one body.

lmp: Banɛ àde' rlir li laa nè bo enɛ̂, "M tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè wɛ̀ ka'" ka'. Àde' tu foŋ yi laa nè mkùu enɛ̂, "M tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè wèe ka'" ka'.
eng: The eye can't tell the hand, I have no need for you, or again the head to the feet, I have no need for you.

lmp: Mŋgʉ̀' nyor mo' ce sèe ce yɛ yisèe enɛ vi tʉr mfà' ka' nà, vi ka' buu, sèe yu' rbòŋ ka'.
eng: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

lmp: Mŋgʉ̀' nyor ce sèe ce kwà'shi enɛ vi ku ba à cicì nà, a vì ce see ke gɛ' àgho sê. Mŋgʉ̀' nyor ce see ke kòŋ enɛ vi yɛɛti àwaŋ ka', a vì ce see ke tɛ'shi bòŋboŋ.
eng: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;

lmp: See ce tɛ'shi wa'a, ma'shi mŋgʉ̀' nyor bbòŋboŋ vi yɛɛtì àwaŋ. Yi yu wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m gèe visèe mnyor à njɛ̂ɛ enɛ mŋgʉ̀' nyor ce vi ke yɛɛti à vî bcicì nà, vi ba vì ce a be gɛ' àgho sê.
eng: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

lmp: Àmbò yi yu wa'a, banɛ mŋgʉ̀' nyor wɛɛwɛ vi ku ce fa' àbee njobè' mŋgʉ̀' nyor wɛɛwɛ ku tʉr yuu à rgèe nè ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò'.
eng: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

lmp: Ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ', banɛ mŋgʉ̀' nyor wɛɛwɛ vi be yɛ ŋgɛ'. Ŋgʉ̀' nyor mò' ka' ce yu' rbòŋ banɛ mŋgʉ̀' nyor wɛɛwɛ vi be yu' rbòŋ.
eng: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

lmp: Wèe yu nyor Jisos Krâis, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ba ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor anà.
eng: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à fa bèe embe cor bfee jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ enɛ a gee rfà' àgho. Rfà' entombì ce e fa nè bèe mo' li yu enɛ wowèe a ba ŋgâa ntuu Jisos Krâis, lì embenjì li ba enɛ bèe mo' a ba ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀. Lì embenjì mo li ba enɛ bèe mo' a yɛ'ni vi blàa nè bèe, rmo' li ba enɛ bèe mo' a gee buu bbɛ̀ɛ, rmo' li ba enɛ bèe mo' a gee tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se, rmo' li ba enɛ bèe mo' a ja' bèe, rmo' li ba enɛ bèe mo' a sa' bèe, rmo' li ba enɛ bèe mo' a laa bli ce wowèe a m be yɛ'ni ka'.
eng: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

lmp: Wà' bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs a? Wà' bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a? Wà' bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu ŋgâa ryɛ'nì a? Wà' bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu ŋgâa rgèe buu bghagha' a?
eng: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

lmp: Wà' Nyʉ̀ à fa bèe wɛɛwɛ bfee à rgèe tɛ ŋgâa byaŋ a ke'se a? Wà' bèe wɛɛwɛ a ke làa bli ce a be yɛ'ni ka' a? Wà' bèe wɛɛwɛ a rìŋ à rsuŋ bèe buu ce bèe mo' a làa à bli ce a m be yɛ'ni ka' a?
eng: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

lmp: Wèe lɛ ntee à rkoni bfee ce vi be gèe tɛ wèe ja' cor gòr, caa bfee mo'. Banɛ m be suŋ wèe yuu ce yi càa buu ca wɛɛwɛ sè'ni.
eng: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' riŋ à rlàa bli enjep ŋgòŋ na, ker laa bli ce bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a ke làa, ke' koŋ bèe ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ ku ba àmbò mbee ce e ke làa ŋooŋ-ŋooŋ nà.
eng: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don't have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' tʉr ŋger à rcep ntuu Nyʉ̀, ker tʉr ŋger à rrìŋ buu Nyʉ̀ ce vi yu à bsʉ̀ti, ker riŋ buu wɛɛwɛ, ker byemi nè Nyʉ̀ btatap sê, ce àde' e lâa, rtùu li co'tì embe dì' li tɛɛ, du tɛɛ à dî' jɛɛ, e ka' tɛ kòŋ bèe ka', banɛ e ku ba ŋwɛ̀ cicì.
eng: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don't have love, I am nothing.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' lor yì buu wɛɛwɛ gapshi nè bèe, ker ma'shi enɛ bèe a koo ye too nè mor, e ka' tɛ kòŋ bèe ka', sɛ' mò' ba njo ka'.
eng: If I dole out all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don't have love, it profits me nothing.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ bèe e ke kur ntee, ker ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ anà e ke ba ŋwɛ̀ ŋko'ndoŋ ka'. E ke yu' nyor kɛ̀ naa tu ka'.
eng: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn't envy. Love doesn't brag, is not proud,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà e ke gèe ŋgêe bebep nè bèe ka', e ke weti ka', e ke cɛpŋger ka', e ke lɛ̀ yuu bebep njep ntee ka'.
eng: doesn't behave itself inappropriately, doesn't seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà e ke yu' rbòŋ à yuu bbebep ka', e ke yu' rbòŋ ba à yuu ce yi yu mini.
eng: doesn't rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

lmp: Àde' yuu mo' yi caa rkòŋnì ka'. Rkòŋnì li ke yɛ fàa ŋwɛ̀ ka', li ke kwà'shi bòŋboŋ àmbò bèe mo', ker tɛɛ tatap à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

lmp: Bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè bèe mo' à rcep yi ntuu vi be kè càa, tɛ bfee ce e fa nè bèe mo' à rlàa bli ce a m be yɛ'ni ka', vi mî, tɛ bfee ce e fa nè bèe mo' à rrìŋ buu, vi ker ba ka'. À ka' ba yi àmbò rkòŋnì, àde' li ke mi ka'.
eng: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ buu à bbɛbɛ', a ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à bbɛbɛ'.
eng: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;

lmp: Be ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe sèe à riŋ buu wɛɛwɛ tɛ buu ca mî.
eng: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mɛ̀ m ba munte, mɛ̀ m ce làa buu àmbò munte, a ce kwà'shi buu àmbò munte, a riŋ buu àmbò munte, mɛ̀ ka' ba nleeŋwɛ̀, a borni buu bbonte.
eng: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

lmp: Sèe ce yɛ buu sè'ni na là'rì là'rì. Be kè ba à nfè' mò' tɛ sèe yɛ vi bòŋboŋ. Sèe rìŋ buu à bbɛbɛ' sè'ni na, be ba à nfè' anà, tɛ sèe riŋ buu wɛɛwɛ àmbò Nyʉ̀ ye ye à rìŋ sèe nà.
eng: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

lmp: Buu vi yû btaar ce vi be cu. Mo' yu rbyemì, mo' à ba rkè' ce sèe ce kè' enɛ Nyʉ̀ gee yuu ce e m kà', mo' à ba rkòŋnì. Yuu gòr efa mʉ̀ buu ca yu rkòŋnì.
eng: But now faith, hope, and love remain--these three. The greatest of these is love.

lmp: Wèe lɛ rkòŋnì kùntombì nè buu wɛɛwɛ, lɛ ntee foŋ a bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè bèe, laŋlaŋ bfee ce e fa nè bèe à rcep yi ntuu.
eng: Follow after love, and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce làa njɛ̀ɛ li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', banɛ e ce làa ba nè bèe ka', e ce làa ba nè Nyʉ̀ njobè' àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu' yuu e ce làa ka'. E ce làa buu ce à bsʉ̀ti à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God; for no one understands; but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ e ke cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, yi ja' bèe, fa bèe ŋger, ker gee mntee bèe vi fʉtè.
eng: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ e ke làa li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', ja' ba yi tu. Ŋwɛ̀ e ke cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, ja' ŋgâa cor wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

lmp: Mɛ̂ kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ laa njɛ̀ɛ bli ce wèe à m be yɛ'ni ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, yi yu àndèe enɛ wèe cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, nè ce enɛ wèe ku ce laa ba li ce wèe à m be yɛ'ni ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ à càa ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka'. Ka' ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce beesi buu ce ŋwɛ̀ anà à làa à li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka' na, vi ka' ja' côr.
eng: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but rather that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ka' vʉ à rcà'ni wèe, laa nè wèe ba à li ce mɛ̀ m be yɛ'ni ka', wà' àde' yì anà yi ja' wèe a? Ka' ba enɛ mɛ̀ vʉ̀ a suŋ wèe yuu mo' fi, kɛ̀ a gee buu Nyʉ̀ vi ba rara nè wèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ a cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ nè wèe, kɛ̀ a yɛ'ni wèe ɛ̀, yì anà yi be jà' wèe.
eng: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

lmp: Kwà'shi ka nè àmbò ndoŋ ce a ke fyɛp, ker ba rluŋ ce a ke bu', ce mi tʉr myòŋ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ka' fyɛp ndoŋ à nji, kɛ̀ bu' rluŋ à nji ɛ̀, àde' ŋwɛ̀ riŋ yuu ce e fyɛp, kɛ̀ yuu ce e bu' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn't give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' fyɛp rsòŋ bìr à nji, wà' àde' bèe a ba'shì nyor du bìr a?
eng: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

lmp: Yi yu nè wèe wa' foŋ. Wèe à ka' ce làa nè bèe ba à li ce a rìŋ ka', àde' wowèe a yu' yuu ce wèe ce làa à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ wèe ce bʉsi yè mbɛp à cicì.
eng: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

lmp: Bli vi yu njep ŋgòŋ na jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, li mò' à ke' ba ce ŋwɛ̀ buu efa ryu' ka'.
eng: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

lmp: M ka' tɛ yu' li ce ŋwɛ̀ ce làa ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ nfuu nè mɛ̀, mɛ mɛ̀ à ba ŋwɛ̀ nfuu nè ye.
eng: If then I don't know the meaning of the sound, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

lmp: A mbò à rlàa bli ce wèe à be yɛ'ni ka', yi ku ba wa'a. Banɛ wèe à ka' ce kòŋ enɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi fa wèe bfee à rfà' nè Nyʉ̀, wèe koŋ gòr ba njɛ̀ɛ bfee ce àde' vi gee tɛ cor du kùntombì.
eng: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce làa buu nè bèe à njɛ̀ɛ li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', ŋgàŋ loo enɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi fa ye bfee à rbèesi buu anà à li ce àde' bèe a yu'.
eng: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ li anà banɛ ŋgàŋ ku ce loo ba enjep ntee, a ke' riŋ yuu ce e ce loo ka'.
eng: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

lmp: Yuu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ gee yi yu enɛ kɛ? Yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ loo nè Nyʉ̀ à li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', ker loo à li ce e rìŋ, ŋwɛ̀ yop nè Nyʉ̀ à li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', ker yop nè ye à li ce e rìŋ.
eng: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce loo ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ buu Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ ka' gee ekɛ ka' byemi à yuu ce e làa, laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa'a", ce àmbò e ce yu' yuu ce ŋgàŋ à làa ka'.
eng: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the Amen at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn't know what you say?

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' ce loo à njɛ̀ɛ li anà, ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ àmbò kɛ, àde' yì anà yi ja' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

lmp: M ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ njobè' m ce làa bli ce mɛ̀ m be yɛ'ni ka', a caa wèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, m ka' ba niŋ côr, m koŋ mɛnɛ m laa mbʉ̀ làa ta à li ce bèe a rìŋ, tɛ m bo yɛ'ni bèe, nè ce enɛ m laa mmbʉ̀ làa ncʉ̀kì à li ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ yu' ka'.
eng: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe fa ce kwà'shi buu àmbò wèe yu lɛ bbonte wa' ka'. Wèe ba àmbò bbonte ba à njì ce wèe be ce kwà'shi buu bbebep ka'. Kwà'shi nè buu ba àmbò bleebèe.
eng: Brothers, don't be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ̂, "M be tuusi bèe ce a ce làa li mò' jɛɛ, tɛ a du suŋ wa blàa nè yà bèe. Ka' m be gèe wa'a, yà bèe ca a be yu' yuu ce mɛ̀ làa nè wowèe ka'." "
eng: In the law it is written, By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. Not even thus will they hear me, says the Lord.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ à rlàa li mò' ce ŋwɛ̀ à m be yɛ'ni ka', yu ba ncòo nè bèe ce a byemi nè ye ka', ke' ba ba enɛ yu ncòo ba nè bèe ce a byemi wɛɛ ka'. À rcep ntuu Nyʉ̀ yu ncòo ba nè bèe ce a byemi nè ye, ke' ba enɛ yu ncòo ba nè bèe ce a byemi nè ye ka' ka'.
eng: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

lmp: Wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ àde' yi ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ce bèe a ka' niŋ côr, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ku ce làa ba à li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka'? Bèe mo' ce a be riŋ buu Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ ka', ker ba bèe ce a be byemi ka', a ka' niŋ, àmbò a be kwà'shi yap enɛ wèe ce baa baa a?
eng: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won't they say that you are crazy?

lmp: Bèe a ka' niŋ côr, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca a ka' niŋ, yuu ce wowèe a yu' yi be gèe tɛ wowèe a yɛ yàp buu bbebep, kèr gèe tɛ yap ntee ye sa' wowèe,
eng: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

lmp: kèr gèe tɛ buu ce wowèe a m ce sʉ̀ti njep ntee nà vi yɛɛti àwaŋ, tɛ wowèe a gʉ'shi, yòŋshi Nyʉ̀, làa nè yap cùu enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ yu a wêe mʉ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀."
eng: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yuu ce m ce làa àlʉ̀simbùu du kuu buu ce mɛ̀ suŋ na yi yu ba enɛ wèe ka' niŋ côr, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ tami nyor à rgèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à fa ye bfee à rgèe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à ryòp yɛɛ, e yôp, ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à ryɛ'ni bèe blâa Nyʉ̀, e yɛ'nì, ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à rsuŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe vi ba brara nè ye, e sûŋ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à rlàa nè bèe à njɛ̀ɛ li ce e m be yɛ'ni ka', e lâa, ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à rbèesi blàa ce ŋwɛ̀ ca à làa à li anà, e beesî. Sèe gee buu ca wɛɛwɛ ba à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' buu anà ja' ŋgâa côr.
eng: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

lmp: Wèe ka' niŋ côr, bèe ce a rìŋ à rlàa li ce wowèe a m be yɛ'ni ka', a ka' ba a wêe mʉ àŋgoo sê, wowèe a fa làa bsìp ka'. Bèe a mmbaa kɛ̀ bèe a mntaar ɛ̀, efa wowèe a ka' lâa, yi ba yɛɛnì. Mò' e làa mìsi wɛɛ, mò' ka' lâa, ker ba enɛ a ka' ce làa, ŋwɛ̀ mò' beesi blàa anà à li ce àde' bèe a yu'.
eng: If any man speaks in another language, let it be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ ba ce àde' e beesì ka, banɛ bèe anà a fa làa mbe cor ka'. Wowèe a ku ce laa nè Nyʉ̀ ba enjep ntee.
eng: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.

lmp: bèe a mmbaa kɛ̀ bèe a mntaar ɛ̀, a ka' suŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe a rîŋ, banɛ bɛr bèe a fyɛ' ka enɛ buu wowèe a làa anà vi yu mini lɛ.
eng: Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ka' ker gee ŋwɛ̀ mò' ye ye riŋ yuu mo' ce àde' e suŋ bèe, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ba ce làa nà fa ye njì foŋ tɛ e lâa.
eng: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

lmp: Wèe ka' ce gèe wa'a banɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be tʉr fɛŋ à rlàa à nfè' yì ka'. Wèe ka' ce gèe wa'a banɛ bèe a be rìŋ buu gòr sê, kèr tʉr ntee à buu Nyʉ̀.
eng: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted.

lmp: Bèe ce a ke suŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe à rîŋ, a ke tʉr ŋger à rfà' nè bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à fa wowèe anà bòŋboŋ.
eng: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ e ke fa wowèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ca njobè' e kòŋ bjep ka'. E kòŋ bèe ce a tʉr cumʉnyaŋ. Àmbò yi yu à bcor wɛɛwɛ, banɛ wee bbyèŋge a ka' niŋ côr, a fa làa yuu ka', njobè' ncir Nyʉ̀ yi byemi enɛ wowèe a ka' niŋ côr, a lor yàp nyor njep nshè àmbò ncir Nyʉ̀ yi làa.
eng: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace. As in all the assemblies of the saints, let your wives keep silent in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to speak; but let them be in subjection, as the law also says.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce kòŋ à rrìŋ yuu mo', wowèe a bipshì nè bduu wap à mlà'. Yu yuu ncoosi tu nè bbyèŋge à rlàa yuu mbe mʉ̀ côr.
eng: If they desire to learn anything, let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a woman to chatter in the assembly.

lmp: Wèe ka' kani, banɛ wèe à ba rìŋ enɛ blâa Nyʉ̀ vi ku kɛ' ba nè wèe kɛ̀ mi nè wèe ka'.
eng: What? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kwà'shi enɛ e tʉr bfee à rsuŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe e rîŋ, a ker ce kwà'shi enɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi fa ye bfee à rgèe buu mo' foŋ, à ba rìŋ enɛ buu ce mɛ̀ suŋ nè wèe na yu buu ce à làa Tata Jisòs enɛ sèe gêe.
eng: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' kani yuu ce mɛ̀ làa na wèe kanì vi blàa foŋ.
eng: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yi ka' ba wa'a, m ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe à ba lɛ̀ ntee gòr ba à rsuŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe wèe à rîŋ. Yi ka' ba ne wa'a, wèe fa kani enɛ bèe mo' efa wêe mʉ ce a rìŋ à rlàa à li ce a m be yɛ'ni ka' nà a fa làa ka'.
eng: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don't forbid speaking with other languages.

lmp: Wèe gee buu wɛɛwɛ à njî yɛɛnì.
eng: Let all things be done decently and in order.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, tɛ m kuushi wèe àmbò Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce mɛ̀ m fè'shi nè wèe nà. Nsuŋ ca yu nsuŋ ce wèe à m yu' a byemi, a tɛɛ njo.
eng: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

lmp: Wèe ka' ku tɛɛ njo tatap, wèe luŋ njo' nsuŋ ca. Yi ka' tɛ ba wa' ka' banɛ wèe à m byemi ba à cicì.
eng: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you--unless you believed in vain.

lmp: Yuu tatap ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe à m ba yuu ce a m suŋ mɛ̀ foŋ. Nsuŋ anà yu enɛ Jisos Krâis à m kwe njo' yìsèe buu bbebep àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ yi be ba nà.
eng: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

lmp: E m kwe, a tuŋ ye, mnòŋ vi ka' bâ' btaar, e fʉʉ efa rkwe àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

lmp: E ka' fʉʉ efa rkwe a duŋshi yì nyor nè Sɛfàs, a ker lo a duŋshi yì nyor nè yì bèe ce ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

lmp: À ka' kèr ba à nfè' mò', e duŋshì yì nyor nè bèe ce a m ce dù a yê mbùu. Bèe anà a m càa bèe mjèe tâ. Bèe magòr efa wowèe a cu btèe, ka' bèe mo' a kweŋger wa'.
eng: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

lmp: À ka' kèr ba à nfè' mò' e duŋshì yì nyor nè Jɛ̂ms, a ker lo a duŋshi yì nyor nè yi ŋgâa ntuu.
eng: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

lmp: À ka' ba àlʉ̀simbùu e duŋshì yì nyor nè mɛ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ à m ba kwa'shi ka'.
eng: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

lmp: M yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' efa mʉ̀ bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a yu ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisòs. Mɛ̀ ghɛɛte à njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' bèe a ba lòr mɛ̀ enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisòs ka' njobè' mɛ̀ m fa ŋgɛ' nè ŋgâa côr.
eng: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀, e gee mɛ̀ ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce m yu sè'ni na. Yuu ce e m gèe nè mɛ̀ anà yi m bʉ à cicì ka' njobè' mɛ̀ m fà' a caa bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ba ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisòs. Yi ke' ba ba enɛ mɛ̀ m fà' nè ya ŋger ka'. À m ba njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr mɛ̀ à ntee bòŋboŋ, a ka' fa mɛ̀ ŋger anà.
eng: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was bestowed on me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, kɛ̀ à fè'shi ba mɛ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à fè'shi ba bèe mo' ce a yu ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisòs foŋ ɛ̀, wèr wɛɛwɛ ku ce fè'shi ba yuu yi mo'sir kuu Jisos Krâis, à ba yuu ce wèe à byemi foŋ.
eng: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

lmp: Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce wèr ce fè'shi nè bèe yu enɛ Jisòs à m fʉʉ efa rkwe. Wèr à ka' ce fè'shi wa'a, bèe mo' efa wèe a ce làa yap enɛ bèe a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe ka' njokɛ?
eng: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ bèe a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', banɛ Jisòs Krâis à m fʉʉ efa rkwe foŋ ka'.
eng: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

lmp: Yi ba ba enɛ Jisos Krâis à m fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', yi ba ba enɛ blàa ce wèr ce fè'shi nè wèe na vi yu à cicì, le rbyemì li ba foŋ à cicì.
eng: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, and your faith also is in vain.

lmp: Yi ba ba foŋ enɛ wèr à nya' mnde' a kuu Nyʉ̀, njobè' wèr à suŋ bèe enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe.
eng: Yes, we are found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn't raise up, if it is so that the dead are not raised.

lmp: Bèe ce a kweŋger a ka' tɛ kè fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', banɛ Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe foŋ ka'.
eng: For if the dead aren't raised, neither has Christ been raised.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ba fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe ka' yi ba ba enɛ le rbyemì li yu à cicì, yè buu bbebep à ku bii mbe wêe btù.
eng: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

lmp: Yi ba ba wa'a, yi ba ba enɛ bèe ce a m byemi nè Jisos Krâis foŋ, a kweŋger nà a bʉ à cicì.
eng: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

lmp: Sèe à ka' ce lɛ̀ mmir mbendù Jisos Krâis enɛ e be kù jà' sèe ba njep ŋgòŋ na cà'cà', banɛ sèe yu bèe ce a ba koosimnse nè sèe càa bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ.
eng: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ Jisos Krâis à m fʉʉ efa rkwe. Efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a m kweŋger, a ye ce e m kɛ̀' a fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.

lmp: Rkwe li m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na njo' yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe. Bèe a be kè fʉʉ efa rkwe foŋ njo' yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à m gèe.
eng: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce kweŋger njobè' a yu ràrà Adàm, a ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ be kè fʉr bèe ce a yu a Jisòs wèe àbee efa rkwe.
eng: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be kù fʉʉ efa rkwe à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à lɛ. Jisos Krâis a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe entombì. Be kè ba à nfè' ce Jisos Krâis à kʉti nà, tɛ yì bèe a fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ's, at his coming.

lmp: Yì anà yi mì wɛɛ, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi mî, tɛ Jisos Krâis so mnyʉ̂mkà' ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce sa', lòr yi kʉʉ fa nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yì Tâ.
eng: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

lmp: Tɛ Jisos Krâis ka' kè fa yi kʉʉ nè yì Tâ, e be kù sa' dù bà' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be so bèe ce a bàa ye, lɛ̀ wowèe wɛɛwɛ njep yê tìi.
eng: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ bbàa ce elʉ̀simbùu ce Nyʉ̀ be kè so, yu rkwe.
eng: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à lɛ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ njep yê tìi." Ka' buu wɛɛwɛ be kè ba njeptii Jisos Krâis wa'a, yi yu rara enɛ Nyʉ̀ be kè ba njeptii Jisos Krâis foŋ ka' njobè' yu ba ye ce e gèe buu ca wɛɛwɛ à ba njeptii Jisòs.
eng: For, He put all things in subjection under his feet. But when he says, All things are put in subjection, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

lmp: Buu ca wɛɛwɛ e ba njep yê tìi tɛ ye Jisos Krâis ce e yu Muu Nyʉ̀ lɛ yì nyor njeptii Nyʉ̀, tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e lɛ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ njeptii Jisos Krâis bo tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

lmp: Yi ba ba mini enɛ bèe ce a kweŋger a be fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', a ka' ce bàptir bèe àtu bèe ce a m kweŋger njokɛ?
eng: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren't raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

lmp: Yi ka' tɛ bà ba enɛ bèe ce a kweŋger a be fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', wèr à ba kù ce yɛ ŋgɛ' nfè' sìp njokɛ?
eng: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ku ba ŋwɛ̀ rkwe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Mɛ̀ làa wa'a njo' nàatu ce m ce nàa nè wèe njobè' sèe yu àbee sèe Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ.
eng: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ba à rla' Ɛfɛsòs, bêe àfo a fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' sê. Bèe a m lò beeŋger a vʉ mbe mɛ̂ ndù, a ce gèe ŋgèe àmbò mnyàa wa'a. Yi m ba ba enɛ bèe a be fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', yà sɛ' à ba ba kɛ? Yi ba ba wa'a, yi ba ba bòŋboŋ enɛ m laa nè wèe enɛ̂, "Sèe yeŋger ce noŋger njobè' ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ sèe kweŋger."
eng: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.

lmp: Fa mà'shi nè tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka'. Wèe ka' ce kar wèe bèe ce a ce gèe ŋgêe bebep, wèe ku lo gee ŋgêe bebep foŋ.
eng: Don't be deceived! Evil companionships corrupt good morals.

lmp: Borni mkwà'shì blʉr, borni efa rgèe buu bbebep. Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ bèe mo' efa wèe a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' koo mʉcàr. M ce làa wa' tɛ rìtu yi bo koo wèe.
eng: Wake up righteously, and don't sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bipshì enɛ̂, "Àde' bèe ce a kweŋger a fʉʉ efa rkwe à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Wowèe a be fʉʉ efa rkwe ba nè njɛ̀ɛ nyor ce e yu à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?"
eng: But someone will say, How are the dead raised? and, With what kind of body do they come?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' bipshi wa'a, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu lʉr. Mbò wɛ̀ rìŋ enɛ a ke byè ŋgʉ̀ yuu njep nshè e bʉtè wɛɛ ka' fʉʉ a?
eng: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

lmp: E ba à nfè' ce yuu ce wɛ̀ byè anà yi fʉʉ, a ku', yi ba jɛɛ efa ŋgʉ̀ yuu ce wɛ̀ byè, kɛ̀ yu ŋgʉ̀ kwaa ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋgʉ̀ kɛ ɛ̀.
eng: That which you sow, you don't sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ e lò gee yuu anà yi tʉr njɛ̀ɛ nyor ce e kòŋ enɛ yi ba tʉr. E lò gee buu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ vi tʉr nyor jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

lmp: Buu ce vi tʉr myòŋ vi tʉr nyor njɛ̀ɛ mò'sir ka'. Nyor ŋwɛ̀ yu jɛɛ efa yì nyàa, nyor siŋ à ba jɛɛ efa yì nca.
eng: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

lmp: Nyor buu embe bùu yu jɛɛ efa nyor buu enjep ŋgòŋ. Rbòŋ buu embe bùu li yu jɛɛ efa rbòŋ buu enjep ŋgòŋ.
eng: There are also celestial bodies, and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ, tʉr rbòŋ li, ŋwɛɛ yi tʉr rbòŋ li, mkàŋsì mi tʉr rbòŋ lap, lap rbòŋ anà li ba jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

lmp: Yi ku ba foŋ enɛ nyor ce bèe a be kè fʉʉ àgho efa rkwe be kè ba jɛɛ. A ke tuŋ ŋwɛ̀, nyor bʉtè. E fʉʉ efa rkwe, yì nyor anà ker bʉte ka'.
eng: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption.

lmp: A ke tuŋ ŋwɛ̀, nyor ce kè' mbòŋmboŋ ka', tʉr ŋger ka'. E fʉʉ efa rkwe, yì nyor ba mbòŋmboŋ, tʉr ŋger.
eng: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

lmp: E ke ba à nfè' ce a ce tuŋ ŋwɛ̀, e tʉr ba njɛ̀ɛ nyor ce sèe tʉr na. E ba à nfè' ce e fʉʉ efa rkwe e tʉr ba nyor ce à yʉ'. Nyor mò' ka' ba ce e yu nyor ce sèe tʉr na, banɛ nyor mò' ku ba ce e yu nyor ce à yʉ'.
eng: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ entombì ce a m too enɛ Adàm nà à m bèeŋger à yuu tèe." Adàm embenjì ce yu Adàm elʉ̀simbùu yu yi ba yʉ' ce yi ke fa bèe ryòŋ.
eng: So also it is written, The first man, Adam, became a living soul. The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

lmp: Nyor ce à yʉ' a yì ce e ke ba entòmbì ka', yì ce e ke ba entombì e ke ba nyor ce sèe tʉr na tɛ nyor ce à yʉ' ka' ba.
eng: However that which is spiritual isn't first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m boo ŋwɛ̀ entombì ba nè nshe, ŋwɛ̀ embenjì à vʉ yi ba embe bùu.
eng: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

lmp: Bèe enjep ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ a ku ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ entombì ce a m boo nè nshe, bèe embe bùu a ku ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m sùu embe bùu.
eng: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

lmp: Sèe ce sèe yu sè'ni àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m boo nè nshe, sèe be kè ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m sùu embe bùu à nòŋ mo'.
eng: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let's also bear the image of the heavenly.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce suŋ wèe enɛ àde' njɛ̀ɛ nyor ce sèe tʉr na niŋ mbe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Àde' yuu ce yi ke kwe yi ye bti' yuu ce yi ke cu nfesè ka'.
eng: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can't inherit the Kingdom of God; neither does corruption inherit incorruption.

lmp: Yɛ̂, m be suŋ wèe yuu ce wèe à m be riŋ ka'. Sèe wɛɛwɛ be kè kweŋger ka'. Sèe wɛɛwɛ be kè kupse kupse.
eng: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

lmp: Sèe be kè kupse nfè' mò'sir. Tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' kè bʉ̀r rlir sèe à kupse nè wɛɛ. Be ba à nfè' elʉ̀simbùu tɛ rsòŋ li lâa, tɛ buu ca koni. Li be kè làa, tɛ bèe ce a m kweŋger a fʉʉ efa rkwe nè njɛ̀ɛ nyor ce àtà e ke kwe ka', tɛ sèe ce a cu btèe, kupse.
eng: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

lmp: Visèe mnyor ce vi ke kwe bʉte na, vi be kè kù kʉti ba a njɛ̀ɛ mnyor ce vi ke kwe ka', bʉte ka'.
eng: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

lmp: Be kè ba à nfè' ce visèe mnyor vi kʉti à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a, tɛ yuu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "A so rkwe" nà, yi ghɛɛte njo.
eng: But when this corruptible will have put on incorruption, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: Death is swallowed up in victory.

lmp: "À wɛ̂ rkwê, yo ŋger yi yû? À wɛ̂ rkwê, yò nsìi yû?"
eng: Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?

lmp: Nsìi rkwe yu buu bbebep, ŋger buu bbebep à ba mncir.
eng: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

lmp: Sèe yoŋshi Tata Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa sèe ŋger à rso buu bbebep, ker ba rkwe, njì enjep Jisos Krâis.
eng: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Bfʉr wa ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, yi ka' ba wa'a, tɛɛ nè tatap, ke' ce ci'ti ka', ce fa' nè Tata Jisos Krâis nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, njobè' wèe rìŋ enɛ rfà' ce wèe ce gèe nè Tata Jisos Krâis li be kè bʉ à cicì ka'.
eng: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord's work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò mbàa ce wèe ce kùu tɛ wèe bo jà' bèe Nyʉ̀ ce à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m àgho nà, wèe ku kuu ba à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce mɛ̀ m làa nè bcor à ŋgôŋ Gàlɛshà enɛ a kuu nà.
eng: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

lmp: E ba à nòŋ entòmbì enjep ŋgàa ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ lor ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa mbàa ce Nyʉ̀ à ghòni ye àgho, lɛ̂, fà dì' m ka' vʉ tɛ bèe a bo kèr lòr nfè' mò' à rkùu mbàa ka'.
eng: On the first day of the week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.

lmp: Gèe nè wa'a, mɛ vʉ̀ bo saŋ ŋwà', lòr mbàa ce wèe à kùu nà kyèse àgee ŋwà' anà tuusi nè bèe ce wèe à ce tɛ wowèe a du àgho à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m.
eng: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

lmp: Yi ka' ba yɛɛnì enɛ mɛ mɛ̀ dû, wèr wowèe du bsìp.
eng: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

lmp: M ce kwà'shi à rdù njî à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà ka' vʉ̀ cà'ni wèe.
eng: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

lmp: M ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ m ka vʉ̂, sèe cu à mʉ nfè' mò', seemò' àde' sèe ku cu nfè' kìntòo mî. E mì wɛɛ, wèe ja' mɛ̀ m du fàdì' m kòŋ à rdù.
eng: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

lmp: M kòŋ mɛnɛ m ka' ba vʉ ba' yɛ wèe m ku càa ce dù ka'. M ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ m ka' vʉ̂, sèe cu nfè' njìsàp, ce Tata Nyʉ̀ ka' fa ŋger.
eng: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

lmp: M be cu à rla' Ɛfɛsòs na bà' à nòŋ Ŋkâ' Pɛntikòs.
eng: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

lmp: M tʉr fɛŋ à rgèe rfâ' rbòŋboŋ àfa, ka' bèe magòr a yu ce a kòŋ à rjepsi la rfà' wa'a.
eng: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

lmp: Timotì ka' vʉ̂, wèe konì ye bòŋboŋ sê, tɛ e bo wɛp yuu mo' ka', njobè' ye ye ce fà' foŋ ba nè Tata àmbò mɛ̀.
eng: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa lòr ye àtɛ̀r ka'. Jà' nè ye tɛ e jɛr bòŋboŋ dù fàdì' e ce dù tɛ e bo kʉti vʉ̀ yɛ mɛ̀ àfa. Wèr bfʉr ce àfa wèe ce kè' ye.
eng: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò nfʉr wêr Àpolòs, mɛ̀ loo ye se enɛ e vʉ a bfʉr mo' wèe vʉ ca'ni wèe, e yɛ yi enɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ e vʉ sè'ni ka'. E ka' lo koni nfè', e ka' vʉ̂.
eng: Now concerning Apollos, the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

lmp: Tami nyor, tɛɛ tatap à lo rbyemì. Fa wɛp yuu ka', ba nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

lmp: Gèe nè buu wɛɛwɛ nè rkòŋnì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Let all that you do be done in love.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe rìŋ enɛ Stɛfɛnàs ba bèe embe yê ndàp a m ba bèe entombì efa mʉ̀ bêe à ŋgôŋ Àkayà ce a m bèeŋger à ŋgâa rbyemì. Wowèe a m fa wâp mnyor à rjà' bèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: Now I beg you, brothers you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints,

lmp: M ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe yu'ni nè njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce a yu àmbò wowèe. Ker yu'ni nè bèe ce a wowèe a ce fà' àbee.
eng: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

lmp: M ce lu'shi njobè' Stɛfɛnàs, Fòtunatòs ba Àkaikòs a vʉ̀ a yɛ mɛ̀ àfa. M ce lu'shi njobè' mɛ̀ yɛ wowèe, yi ba àmbò mɛ̀ yɛ lɛ ba wèe wɛɛwɛ wa'a.
eng: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

lmp: Wowèe a m fa mɛ̀ ŋger àmbò a m ce fa wèe nà. Njɛ̀ɛ bêe wa'a yu bèe ce a ba yu'ni nè wowèe.
eng: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

lmp: Bcor à ŋgôŋ Ɛshà wɛɛwɛ vi cà'ni wèe. Àkwilà ba Prîskà ker ba bèe ce a ke niŋ cor mbe wâp ndàp a cà'ni wèe se à rlii Tatâ.
eng: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

lmp: Bfʉr ce àfa wɛɛwɛ a cà'ni wèe. Cà'ni nè bfʉr mo' ba mo', baa wowèe nje nyòr nè rkòŋnì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

lmp: Rcà'nì ca à saŋ mɛ̂ Pol nè ya bo.
eng: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ kòŋ Tata Jisòs ka', ndòo co' ye. Yèr Tatâ, vʉ̀.
eng: If any man doesn't love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Come, Lord!

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisòs tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ kòŋ wèe wɛɛwɛ njobè' sèe wɛɛwɛ yu àbee sèe Jisos Krâis wèe. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pôl, ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisòs. Wèr Timotì ce e yu nfʉr yìsèe ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè cor Nyʉ̀ ce e yu à rla' Korèn, ker ba nè bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce a yu à ŋgôŋ Àkayà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, ker ba Tata Jisos Krâis, tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Tàr nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis. E yu Tàr ce e ke koosimnse nè bèe, ker ce fa bèe ŋger à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort;

lmp: E ke fa sèe ŋger à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce sèe ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ'. E ke gèe wa'a enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' foŋ à ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ', sèe bo fa ŋgàŋ ŋger nè ŋger ce sèe à koni ese ye.
eng: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

lmp: Ndèe ce sèe à ka' yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ce Jisos Krâis à m yɛ, ka' ŋgɛ' anà à ka' ba gòr se ɛ̀, banɛ a ndèe ce sèe be koni ŋger njo' ye.
eng: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

lmp: Wèr ka' ce yɛ mlù, wèe riŋ enɛ wèr ce yɛ tɛ mi bo fa wèe ŋger, kèr gèe tɛ wèe lûŋ. Nyʉ̀ à ka' fa wèr ŋger, banɛ wee wèe foŋ be koni ŋger anà tɛ wèe bo kur ntee, tɛɛ tatap njep ŋgɛ' ce wèe ce yɛ àmbò wèr ce yɛ na.
eng: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

lmp: Wèr tʉr ntee njep wèe sê, a riŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ àmbò wèe ce yɛ ŋgɛ' àmbò wer wèr ce yɛ na, wèe be koni ŋger ce wèr à koni foŋ nà ese Nyʉ̀.
eng: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so also are you of the comfort.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce kòŋ enɛ wèe riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ce wèr à m yɛ à ŋgôŋ Ɛshà. Ŋgɛ' anà à m tap sê, a ba àmbò ntɛ̀r ce yi m rìr a caa yer ŋger wa'a, wer à lo a ce kwà'shi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ be cu ntèe ka'.
eng: For we don't desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

lmp: Wèr à m ce kwà'shi enɛ wèr à kweŋger wɛɛ. Geewa'a, ŋgɛ' ca à m koni wèr tɛ wèr bo kù lɛ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ mbe mmbo Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fʉr bèe efa rkwe, ke' ba mbe wêr mmbò ka'.
eng: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

lmp: E fʉr wèr efa ŋgɛ' ce e m ba yʉ wèr. E be kèr fʉr wèr. Wèr à lɛ̀ mmir ba mbe yê ndù enɛ ku ba ye ce e be kù ce fʉr wèr efa njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' anà.
eng: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver; on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us;

lmp: Wee wèe foŋ à ba jà' à rloo nè wèr. Wèe à ka' loo, banɛ bèe magòr a be yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ njo' yuu bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à yu' misèe mloo, a gèe nè wèr.
eng: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift bestowed on us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

lmp: Yuu mo' yi yu ce wèr ce nàa tu àgho, a ke' ce tarni ka'. Yuu anà yi yu enɛ wèr à cu njep ŋgòŋ na, laŋlaŋ à nfè' wèr à m ba a wêe mʉ nè ntee rara ba mini ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀. Wèr à cu wa'a ba nè bfee enjep ŋgòŋ na ka', wèr à cu ba njo' ntee bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ tʉr nè wèr.
eng: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience, that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

lmp: Mŋwà' ce wèr à saŋ nè wèe nà, buu embo wɛɛwɛ vi yu brara, a ba kùyɛɛ. Wèe à be riŋ wèr sè'ni na bòŋboŋ ka'. Banɛ m ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ wèe be lò rìŋ wèr bòŋboŋ tɛ wèe bo lò nàa tu nè wèr àmbò wèr be lò nàa nè wèe foŋ à nòŋ ce Tata Jisòs be vʉ̀.
eng: For we write no other things to you, than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end; as also you acknowledged us in part, that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe be lò rìŋ wèr bòŋboŋ. Yi ka' ba wa'a, mɛ̀ kwà'shi mɛnɛ m be cà'ni wèe entòmbì tɛ wèe bo lu'shi ŋkàrà' baa.
eng: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit;

lmp: Mɛ̀ m kwà'shi mɛnɛ m be ce dù à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà tɛ m caa cà'ni wèe mɛ ce kʉti, ker ca'ni wèe, tɛ wèe bo mà'shi mɛ̀ tɛ m du à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà.
eng: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

lmp: Seemò' àmbò mɛ̀ m kʉti a vʉ ka' nà, wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ m yu njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke kupse ntee àfo àfo. Wà' m ka' ce kwà'shi yuu ce m be gèe, m kwa'shì àmbò bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na ce a ke byemi yuu, ker lo kani nà a?
eng: When I therefore was thus determined, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I purpose, do I purpose according to the flesh, that with me there should be the Yes, yes and the No, no?

lmp: Yi yu wa' ka'. Àmbò sèe rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ mini, banɛ àde' wèr byemì à rgèe yuu ker lo kani efa rgèe yi ka'.
eng: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not Yes and no.

lmp: Jisos Krâis ce e yu Muu Nyʉ̀, yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke byemi ker kani ka'. Yu ye ce wèr Timotì ba Silàs à m ce fè'shi àmbò ye à nfè' ce wèr à m ba a wêe mʉ nà. E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke làa enɛ ɛ̀no, ku tɛɛ ba njo,
