eng: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us, by me, Silvanus, and Timothy, was not Yes and no, but in him is Yes.

lmp: njobè' e ce dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à byemi enɛ e be gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce e kà'. Banɛ sèe ce làa enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa'a" ba njo' ye. Sêe làa wa'a, ce ku'si ba Nyʉ̀.
eng: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the Yes. Therefore also through him is the Amen, to the glory of God through us.

lmp: Yu ye Nyʉ̀ ce e gèe sèe à tɛɛ tatap njep Krâis. Yu ye ce e ce sèe à yì bèe,
eng: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ, and anointed us, is God;

lmp: a ker fa sèe ncòo ce e ce dùŋshi enɛ sèe yu yì bèe. E fa yi Yʉ' njep sêe mntee, yi ba àmbò yuu ce e tɛr nè sèe enɛ sèe be koni buu wɛɛwɛ ce e kà' enɛ e be kè fa nè sèe.
eng: who also sealed us, and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ à rla' Korèn ka' fà dì' m bo lò gèe tɛ nyor bep wèe ka'. M ce kɛ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ e tɛɛ yà njìnsa' enɛ yuu ce m ce làa na yi yu mini.
eng: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that I didn't come to Corinth to spare you.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ wèr be vʉ̀ lòr ba ŋger ka' suŋ wèe yuu ce wèe byemi ka', njobè' wèe à tɛɛ tatap njep le rbyemì. Ler rfà' li yu ba enɛ wèr ja' wèe tɛ wèe bo yu' rbòŋ.
eng: Not that we have lordship over your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ m kwà'shi mɛnɛ àde' m ker vʉ ca'ni wèe ka', fà dì' m lo gèe tɛ nyor bep wèe ka'.
eng: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

lmp: M ka' gee nyor bep wèe, ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e ka' gee nyor boŋ mɛ̀ ba nda, caa efa wèe ce mɛ̀ gèe nyor à bep wèe nà?
eng: For if I make you sorry, then who will make me glad but he who is made sorry by me?

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ m saŋ ŋwà' anà nè wèe, fà dì' m ka' vʉ ca'ni wèe tɛ yi lo ba enɛ bèe ce m ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ wowèe a ba gèe nyor boŋ mɛ̀, a lo ba ba bèe ce a be gèe tɛ m lo yu' ba ryaŋ ka'. M rìŋ mɛnɛ m ka' ce yu' rbòŋ banɛ wèe ce yu' rbòŋ foŋ.
eng: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that, when I came, I wouldn't have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all, that my joy would be shared by all of you.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m saŋ ŋwà' anà nè wèe, a ce koosimnse, ntee yi ce fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ', mŋgoommir mi ce sùu mɛ̀ ekù tù. Mɛ̀ m ce saŋ yi tɛ m bo gèe tɛ nyor bep wèe bep ka'. Mɛ̀ m saŋ yi tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ m kòŋ wèe sê.
eng: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made sorry, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' gee yuu ce ntee yi bep bèe, banɛ ŋgàŋ à gèe ba nè mɛ̀ ka'. E gèe yuu anà gòr ba nè wèe wɛɛwɛ. Banɛ m ker laa tatap àmbò yuu anà ka'.
eng: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow, not to me, but in part that I not press too heavily to you all.

lmp: Ŋgɛ' ce bèe magòr efa wêe mʉ a fa nè ŋgàŋ à ghɛɛ.
eng: Sufficient to such a one is this punishment which was inflicted by the many;

lmp: Banɛ yuu ce wèe à ba gèe nè ŋwɛ̀ anà sè'ni yi yu enɛ wèe à ba fòosi ye, fa ye ŋger fà dì' bsɛ̀ vi lo koo ye ka'.
eng: so that on the contrary you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

lmp: M ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe gee tɛ ŋgàŋ riŋ enɛ wèe ku bii kòŋ ye.
eng: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m saŋ ŋwà' anà tɛ m bo mòoshi wèe, yɛ mɛnɛ wà' wèe ce yu'ni nè mɛ̀ à buu bsìp lɛ.
eng: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

lmp: Wèe à ka' foosi ŋwɛ̀, banɛ mɛ̀ fòosi ye foŋ. Yi ka' ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe yuu ce m foosi ye, m foosì ye à bsii Krâis njo' wèe,
eng: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

lmp: fà dì' Satàn lo tʉr ŋger mbe sêe ndù ka'. Sèe rìŋ enɛ Satàn yu kwɛ̀ɛ.
eng: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan; for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m dù à rfè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis à rla' Trowàs, a ka' ba àfo, a yɛ mɛnɛ Tata Nyʉ̀ à mʉ̀' nduunjì nè mɛ̀ àfo à rfà' nè ye.
eng: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, ntee yi bu' mɛ̀ se njobè' mɛ̀ m yɛ nfʉr yà ce Taitòs ka'. Mɛ̀ ka' yɛ ye ka', a daasi wowèe a du à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà.
eng: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn't find Titus, my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

lmp: Banɛ sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ njobè' sèe à ka' ce dù ba fɛ, e ku tɛɛ kùntombì nè sèe. E tɛɛ wa'a, sèe ce jɛ̀r àmbò bèe ce a ce jɛ̀r mbe ŋgoo bèe Jisòs, Jisòs à tɛɛ entombì a ce vʉni. Nyʉ̀ à lòr sèe a gee nsuŋ àmbò Jisòs à du à bdì' wɛɛwɛ àmbò nrɛ̀ɛ ce a too e rʉʉ bòŋboŋ sê, a du à bdì' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Now thanks be to God, who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

lmp: Nrɛ̀ɛ ce Jisòs ce tòo nè Nyʉ̀ anà yuu sèe. Nrɛ̀ɛ anà yi ce rʉ̀ʉ à mʉ̀ bèe wɛɛwɛ, kɛ̀ yu bèe ce a be lùŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bèe ce a be bʉ ɛ̀.
eng: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God, in those who are saved, and in those who perish;

lmp: Rʉ̀ʉ efa gho yi yu nè bèe ce a ce bʉ àmbò rʉ̀ʉ ce àde' yi yʉ ŋwɛ̀, a ba nè bèe ce a be lùŋ àmbò yuu ce àde' yi gee ŋwɛ̀ e cu ntèe. Àmbò yi yu wa' na, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ghɛɛte à rgèe njɛ̀ɛ rfà' ca yu nda?
eng: to the one a stench from death to death; to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèr, wèr yu àmbò bèe mo' ce a lòr blâa Nyʉ̀ à ba yuu ntaa nà ka'. À tuu ba Nyʉ̀ a tuu wèr, wèr à ce fè'shi vi blàa a yê bsii nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, à rlii Krâis.
eng: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

lmp: Wà' wèr ce làa buu ca wa'a tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ wèr yu ba bêe mini a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Wà' yi yu enɛ wer à ba fa ba ŋwà' nè wèe tɛ wee wèe saŋ ŋwà' nè wèr tɛ bèe a riŋ àmbò wèr ce fà' a wêe mʉ, àmbò bèe mo' a ke gèe nà a? Yi yu wa' ka'.
eng: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

lmp: Wèe yu njep wêr mntee àmbò ŋwà' ce a saŋ, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ce bè', a riŋ yuu ce a saŋ mbo wa'a,
eng: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men;

lmp: a ce yɛ bòŋboŋ enɛ wèe yu ŋwà' ce à saŋ ba Jisos Krâis, a ka' tuu wèr àgho. Ŋwà' ca yu ŋwà' ce a saŋ ba nè mdip ŋwà' ka'. A saŋ ba nè Yʉ' Nyʉ̂ ntèe. A saŋ ba mbe lûr mbɛ̀mbɛr ka', a saŋ ba njep mntee bèe.
eng: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

lmp: Wèr ce làa buu ca àmbò bèe ce a Jisos Krâis wèe a yu àbee, a riŋ wernɛ ku ba Nyʉ̀ ce e be jà' wèr tɛ wèr ka' gèe buu ca.
eng: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God;

lmp: Wèr tʉr ŋger à rgèe yuu mo' nè yer tu ka'. Yer ŋger yi lò ba ese Nyʉ̀.
eng: not that we are sufficient of ourselves, to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God;

lmp: E gèe sèe à ghɛɛtè à ŋgâa mfà' ce a ce fè'shi àmbò lê' fi. Lê' fi ca yi ce làa enɛ sèe yu' sè'ni ba ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, ke' yu' ba ese mncir ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ka'. Ncir yi vʉ̀ nè rkwe, Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce fa rlùŋ.
eng: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant; not of the letter, but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m lɛ̀ mncir a duŋshi yi fòo. E m saŋ mncir mbe lûr mbɛ̀mbɛr a fa nè Musìs. E ka' ce vʉ̀ nè mncir ca, rraa Nyʉ̀ li raa a yê bsii sê, ce àde' bèe Isrɛ̀l a m ba fyɛ' nè mmir ka'. Ka' rraa anà li m lò a ker ce raa àmbò li m ce raa nà ka' wa'a. Àmbò yi yu sè'ni enɛ rsa' rrʉ̀ʉ ce li m ce vʉ̀ ba nè rkwe li m ce dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀ na,
eng: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face; which was passing away:

lmp: banɛ rsa' rfi ce li vʉ̀ yi ba nè Yʉ' Rara, li càa lî rrʉ̀ʉ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e ce dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀.
eng: won't service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ rsa' rrʉ̀ʉ ce li m ce gèe bèe a gwe mnsa' Nyʉ̀ nà li m ce dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀, banɛ rsa' rfi ce li ce gèe bèe a ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ li càa lî rrʉ̀ʉ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e ce dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀.
eng: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

lmp: Àde' sèe laa sè'ni enɛ rraa ce li m ba njep rsa' rrʉ̀ʉ na li ker ce yɛɛti à yuu ka' njobè' sèe ce jɛ̀r sè'ni ba njep rsa' rfi ce li ce raa a caa ŋger.
eng: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ àmbò rsa' rrʉ̀ʉ anà li m cu njìsàp ka', a ku ce dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀ nà, banɛ rsa' rfi ce li be cu yi nfesè na, li be dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀ càa lî rrʉ̀ʉ anà.
eng: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' wèr rìŋ buu ca, wèr ce suŋ bèe buu Nyʉ̀ rara sê, a ke' ce sʉ̀ti yuu mo' ka'.
eng: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

lmp: Wèr yu àmbò Musìs ka'. Musìs à m ce lò cete vi bsii nè cɛ̀' fà dì' bèe Isrɛ̀l a bo yɛ àmbò rraa efa yê bsii anà li ce liiti ka'.
eng: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face, that the children of Israel wouldn't look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

lmp: Yap ntee yi yinì. Kɛ' ese à nfè' anà vʉ ba' sè'ni na, yuu mo' yi ce cete wap bfee. E ke ba à nfè' ce a ce bè' ŋwà' mncir embe ŋwâ' rʉ̀ʉ nè wowèe, wowèe a ke' ce yu' yuu ce a ce bè' ka'. Bfee ŋwɛ̀ vi ke mʉ̀'ti ba à nfè' ce ŋwɛ̀ anà ba Krâis a yu àbee.
eng: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

lmp: Yi yu mini wa'a enɛ kɛ' ese à nfè' anà vʉ ba' sè'ni na, wowèe a ke bè' mncir Musìs, yuu mo' yi ce cete wap bfee, wowèe a ke' riŋ yuu ce a ce bè' ka'.
eng: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' beesi yi ntee byemi nè Tata Jisòs banɛ Nyʉ̀ be cà'si yuu ce yi cete ye bfee anà.
eng: But whenever one turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

lmp: Tata ce sèe ce làa na yu Yʉ'. Fà dì' wɛɛwɛ ce Yʉ' Tata yi ka' ba, banɛ bèe anà a lùŋ.
eng: Now the Lord is the Spirit and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' yuu mo' yi ker ce cete sèe mmir ka', banɛ rraa Nyʉ̀ ca li ce raa sèe à nyòr, sèe à ce raa, a kɛ' a ce kupse, kù ce kupse caar, lò ba foŋ àmbò Tata Jisòs, ba ŋgâa fòo àmbò Krâis yu nà. Cena yu ba rfà' Tata ce e yu Yʉ'.
eng: But we all, with unveiled face beholding as in a mirror the glory of the Lord, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè wèr, a fa wèr rfà' enɛ wèr gee buu ca nè bèe. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèr à ce gèe li, a ke' ce koosi bsɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Therefore seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don't faint.

lmp: Wèr à mà' buu bbebep ce bèe a ke gèe à bsʉ̀ti njo' rìtu. Wèr ce bo' bèe ka', a ce kupse blâa Nyʉ̀ ka'. Wèr ce fè'shi buu mini àwaŋ, à bsii Nyʉ̀. Wèr ce gèe wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ce kwà'shi bòŋboŋ àmbò wèr.
eng: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness, nor handling the word of God deceitfully; but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man's conscience in the sight of God.

lmp: Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca ka' ba nè bèe mo' àmbò yuu ce a cete, banɛ e yu wa'a ba nè bèe ce a ce bʉ.
eng: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who perish;

lmp: Wowèe a byemi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca ka' njobè' Satàn ce e yu nyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na à gèe wowèe a fêp. Àde' wowèe a yɛ rraa ce li ce raa mbe wâp ndù ka'. Rraa ca yu rraa ce li vʉ̀ njo' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò fòo ce Krâis tʉr ce e ku ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ ye ye yu nà.
eng: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

lmp: Wèr ce fè'shi ba àmbò wêr mnyor ka'. Wèr ce fè'shi nè bèe enɛ Jisos Krâis yu Tatâ. Wèr yu ŋgâa mfà' nè wèe ba njo' Jisòs.
eng: For we don't preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus' sake;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e m làa enɛ̂, "Mà'shi tɛ rraa li raa à tʉ̀'nji," yu ye ce e gèe li rraa li ce raa njep sêe mntee, tɛ sèe bo koni rraa, yɛ fòo Nyʉ̀ àmbò yi ce raa à bsii Krâis.
eng: seeing it is God who said, Light will shine out of darkness, who has shone in our hearts, to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

lmp: Sèe ce sèe tʉr yuu bòŋboŋ ca, sèe yu àmbò mkìŋ nshe. Sèe yu wa'a tɛ yi bo dùŋshi enɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ce yi càa ŋger na, yu yisèe ŋger ka'. Ŋger anà yu ba ŋger Nyʉ̀.
eng: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God, and not from ourselves.

lmp: Ŋgɛ' ce koni wèr à mnjì wɛɛwɛ, wèr à ke' bornì rfà' ca ka'. E ba à nfè' mò' bfee vi jep wèr, ntee yi ke' kwe wèr efa rfà' ca ka'.
eng: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

lmp: Bèe a ce fa wèr ŋgɛ', wèr à ke' ba mer mŋgi' ka'. Bèe a ce lìp wèr, wèr à ce gwèŋger à nshè, a ke' ce kweŋger ka'.
eng: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

lmp: Wèr à byɛ̀' rkwe Jisòs nje wêr mnyòr à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, tɛ li ryòŋ li bo yɛɛti nje wêr mnyòr foŋ.
eng: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

lmp: Àmbò wèr ce cu njep ŋgòŋ na, rkwe li ce rʉ̀ʉ wer à nfyènyʉ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ njo' Krâis, tɛ li ryòŋ li bo yɛɛti nje wêr mnyòr ce vi be lò kweŋger nà.
eng: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus' sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

lmp: Banɛ wèr à byemi yer ba rkwe, tɛ wèe bo koni ryòŋ.
eng: So then death works in us, but life in you.

lmp: Wèr à lɛ̀ ntee njep Nyʉ̀ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m làa mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ m byemi a ka' lâa." Banɛ wer wèr foŋ à byemi a ka' lâa.
eng: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, I believed, and therefore I spoke. We also believe, and therefore also we speak;

lmp: Wèr rìŋ wernɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e m fʉr Tata Jisòs efa rkwe be fʉr wèr ce wèr yu bèe Jisòs efa rkwe, lòr wèr, kèr lòr wèe foŋ dù àgho, tɛr à bsii Krâis.
eng: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also with Jesus, and will present us with you.

lmp: Wèr ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ca tɛ wèe bo koni sɛ' efa gho, tɛ bèe magòr a koni rbòŋ Nyʉ̀, ce kù'si ye gòr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, bèe magòr a nɛsì ye.
eng: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

lmp: A mbùu ntee yi ce kwe wèr ka'. Ka' wer mnyor vi kɛ̀' a ce sɛ̀ wa'a, ryôŋ rfi ce li yu njep wèr nà, li ce top à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Therefore we don't faint, but though our outward man is decaying, yet our inward man is renewed day by day.

lmp: Ŋgɛ' ce wèr ce yɛ, ce e be cu njìsàp ka' nà, yu àmbò yuu ce yi fɛp wa'a, a ce gèe tɛ sèe bo ghɛɛte à rkoni fòo ce yi be cu nfesè. Fòo anà yi càa ŋgɛ' anà gòr sê.
eng: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory;

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèr à ke' ce lɛ̀ mer mmir ba mbendù buu ce bèe a ce yɛ nè mmir ka'. Wèr à lɛ̀ mer mmir ba mbendù buu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ yɛ ka', njobè' buu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ yɛ, vi be cu nfesè ka'. Vì ce vi be cu nfesè yu vì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ yɛ ka' nà.
eng: while we don't look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

lmp: Wèr rìŋ wernɛ yèr nyor ce wèr ce cu àgho njep ŋgòŋ na yu àmbò tàp ce wèr ce cu mbo wa'a. A ka' sa'si tàp anà, sèe ku riŋ seenɛ ndap yu mbe bùu ce à bà'ri ba ŋwɛ̀ ka'. Ndap anà à bà'ri Nyʉ̀, à ba ndap ce e be cu nfesè.
eng: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

lmp: Wèr ce shooŋger sè'ni njobè' wèr ce kòŋ se à ryar ndap ce e yu mbe bùu nà àmbò cɛ̀' ce ŋwɛ̀ à yar à nyòr wa'a.
eng: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven;

lmp: Wèr à ka' ke yar, wèr bo ba mbùuriŋ ka'.
eng: if so be that being clothed we will not be found naked.

lmp: Àmbò wèr ce cu nè nyor ca njep ŋgòŋ na, wèr ce shooŋger àmbò wèr à byɛ̀' lɛ ntɛ̀r yi ce rìr se wa'a. Yi yu ba enɛ wèr ce kòŋ à rco' cɛ̂' rʉ̀ʉ ca ka', wèr ce kòŋ ba à ryar cɛ̂' fi, tɛ cɛ̂' rʉ̀ʉ yi kupse dʉ̀dʉ̀.
eng: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened; not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe sèe à tamì nyor à rkupsè ca, a ker fa yʉ' nè sèe, àmbò btɛr, yi ce dùŋshi enɛ sèe be koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à kà' sèe.
eng: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

lmp: Banɛ wèr ce koosi bsɛ̀ à nfè' mò' ka'. Wèr rìŋ enɛ àmbò wèr ce cu nè nyor ca njep ŋgòŋ na, wèr yu njìsàp ese Tatâ.
eng: Therefore, we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

lmp: Àmbò wèr ce cu nè nyor ca njep ŋgòŋ na, wèr ce cu ba njobè' wèr à lɛ̀ ntee nè ye, ke' ba njobè' wèr à yɛ ye ka'.
eng: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

lmp: Wèr ce koosi bsɛ̀ ka', a koŋ yer à rmà'shi nyor ca dù cu à là' wèr Tata wèe.
eng: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body, and to be at home with the Lord.

lmp: Àmbò yi yu na, yuu ce wèr tʉr nje tù yi yu enɛ wèr fa' tɛ nyor boŋ ye, kɛ̀ wèr cu nè nyor ca njep ŋgòŋ na ɛ̀, kɛ̀ wèr à fʉʉ enjo ɛ̀.
eng: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

lmp: Sèe wɛɛwɛ be kè tɛɛ kùntombì nè Krâis, tɛ e bo sa' sèe, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ koo yuu ce yi ghɛɛte à yuu ce e m gèe à nfè' ce e m ce cu nè nyor ca njep ŋgòŋ na, kɛ̀ yuu anà yi m bòŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yi m bep ɛ̀.
eng: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ; that each one may receive the things in the body, according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

lmp: Àmbò wèr à rìŋ àmbò mnsa' Tatâ, a ce wɛp ye, wèr ce ghèter à rgèe tɛ bèe a kupse. Nyʉ̀ rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèr yu, mɛ̀ ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ wee wèe foŋ à rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèr yu.
eng: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God; and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

lmp: Wèr ce làa wa'a, a ke' ce ghèter ba à rgèe tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ wèr yu bêe mini ka'. Wèr ce tà' ba enɛ wèe koni yuu ce àde' wèe yu' rbòŋ àgho nè wèr, tɛ wèe bo tʉr yuu à rlàa nè bèe ce a ce yu' rbòŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ njo' nta' ce ŋgàŋ tʉr, ke' ba ba njo' njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ka'.
eng: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance, and not in heart.

lmp: Wèr à ka' ce yɛɛti àmbò bèe ce btu vi ce kar embo wa'a, banɛ wèr yu wa'a njo' Nyʉ̀. Wèr à ka' ba bèe ce yap tu yi yu mbo, banɛ wèr yu wa'a njo' wèe.
eng: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

lmp: Yu ba rkòŋnì Krâis ce li gèe ntee yi ce lùu wèr à rgèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca, njobè' wèr rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir ka' kwe à btu bèe wɛɛwɛ, banɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ à kweŋger.
eng: For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.

lmp: E m kwe à btu bèe wɛɛwɛ, tɛ bèe ce a cu btèe a bo cu nè yap tu ka', cu ba àtu ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwe a wâp tù, a fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

lmp: Banɛ wèr ker ce yɛ bèe ba à mmìr, àmbò bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ke gèe nà ka'. Wèr à m ce yɛ Krâis wa'a à nfè' mò', à ka' ba sè'ni na, wèr à ker ce yɛ ye wa' ka'.
eng: Therefore we know no one after the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ after the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba àbee a Krâis, banɛ e kʉti ŋwɛ̂ nfi; buu brʉ̀ʉ à mì, à ba ba buu bfi sè'ni.
eng: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

lmp: Cena yu ba rfà' Nyʉ̀. E m gèe sèe wowèe à kʉtì àbee njo' Krâis, a fa wèr rfà' enɛ wèr suŋ bèe enɛ àde' a Nyʉ̀ wèe a kʉtì àbee.
eng: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m càa embenjì Krâis a gee a bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na wèe a kʉtì àbee, a ke' ce bè' yàp buu bbebep ka'. E fa nsuŋ ca mba wêr mmbò enɛ wèr suŋ nè bèe.
eng: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

lmp: Wèr tɛɛ àtu Krâis, a ce làa buu ca àmbò ce làa lɛ ba Nyʉ̀ seese nè wèe wa'a. Wèr ce bu' mmbo nè wèe àtu Krâis enɛ wèe kʉti àbee wèe Nyʉ̀ wèe.
eng: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

lmp: Krâis à m gèe yuu bebep ka', geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m gèe e ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe lɛ yuu bebep wa'a, tɛ sèe bo ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ àmbò Nyʉ̀ yu, njo' ye.
eng: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf; so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

lmp: Àmbò wèr ce fà' àbee wèr Nyʉ̀ wèe na, wèr ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe fa mà'shi tɛ rbòŋ Nyʉ̀ ce wèe à koni na li bʉ à cicì ka'.
eng: Working together, we entreat also that you not receive the grace of God in vain,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à làa mbe yê Ŋwà' enɛ̂, "Nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ba à rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ nè wɛ̀ à m ghɛɛ, mɛ̀ fa wa btù' nè wɛ̀. Nòŋ ce mɛ̀ m ba à rjà' wɛ̀ tɛ à bo lùŋ, yi m ghɛɛ, mɛ̀ ja' wɛ̀." Rìŋ nè enɛ nfè' ce àde' Nyʉ̀ gee yuu bòŋboŋ nè sèe, yu ba sè'ni na. Nfè' ce àde' Nyʉ̀ gee bèe a lûŋ, yu sè'ni na.
eng: for he says, At an acceptable time I listened to you, in a day of salvation I helped you. Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

lmp: Wèr ce jepsi ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo làa yuu mo' bebep àmbò ler rfà' ka'.
eng: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

lmp: À ka' ba koni kɛ koni wèr, wèr ce dùŋshi enɛ wèr yu ŋgâa mfà' nè Nyʉ̀. Wèr ce dùŋshi wa'a à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèr à kur ntee sê, a tɛɛ tatap à nfè' ce wèr ce yɛ ŋgɛ', ba à nfè' ce fùp à koo wèr, ker ba à nfè' ce buu à ka' tap nè wèr.
eng: but in everything commending ourselves, as servants of God, in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

lmp: Bèe a lìp wèr, a fa wèr à shaŋ. E ba à nfè' mò' bèe a gaŋ wèr. E ba à nfè' mò' wèr fa' jorni, e ba à nfè' mò' wèr tʉr nfè' à rbuumì ka', e ba à nfè' mò' wèr tʉr yuu ye ka'.
eng: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings;

lmp: Wèr à dùŋshi enɛ wèr yu ŋgâa mfà' nè Nyʉ̀ à yer ŋgêe rara, ba à buu Nyʉ̀ ce wèr à rìŋ, ba à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèr ce kur ntee, ker ba foŋ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèr ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe. Wèr à ruusi ba nè Yʉ' Rara, a koŋ bèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: in pureness, in knowledge, in patience, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

lmp: Wèr ce suŋ nsuŋ mini à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, a ce gèe buu ba à ŋger Nyʉ̀. Yer ŋgêe yɛɛnì yi yu àmbò buu bìr ce wèr bo mà' bìr àgho nè Nyʉ̀, kèr tɛ'shi yèr nyor àgho.
eng: in the word of truth, in the power of God; by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

lmp: E ba à nfè' mò' bèe a naa wèr, e ba à nfè' mò' a coosì wèr. E ba à nfè' mò' bèe a laa buu bbebep àmbò wèr, e ba à nfè' mò' a laa buu bbòŋboŋ. Bèe a lò lor wèr àmbò ŋgâa mnde' wa'a, wèr ku ce làa yer yu ba yuu mini.
eng: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report; as deceivers, and yet true;

lmp: E ba à nfè' mò' bèe a lor wèr à buu bcicì, geewa'a, bèe a rìŋ wèr à bdì' wɛɛwɛ. E ba à nfè' mò' a yɛ wèr àmbò bgʉ̂ʉ bèe wa'a, geewa'a wèr ku ba btèe. Bèe a fa wèr ŋgɛ', a ke' yʉ ne wèr ka'.
eng: as unknown, and yet well known; as dying, and behold, we live; as punished, and not killed;

lmp: Wèr yu àmbò bèe ce a ce koosimnse wa'a, geewa'a wèr ce lu'shi à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Wèr yu àmbò ŋgâa fùp wa'a, geewa'a wèr ce gèe bèe magòr a ce koni bkù'. Wèr yu àmbò bèe ce a tʉr buu ka' wa'a, geewa'a wèr a tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: as sorrowful, yet always rejoicing; as poor, yet making many rich; as having nothing, and yet possessing all things.

lmp: Bêe à rla' Korèn, wèr à sʉ̀ti yuu mo' ese wèe ka'. Wèr à mʉ̀' yer ntee a lɛ too nè wèe.
eng: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

lmp: Wèr à cete yer ntee ese wèe ka', yu ba wèe ce wèe à cete ye ntee ese wèr.
eng: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

lmp: Kʉʉsi nè rbòŋ ce wèr à m ce gèe nè wèe nà, mʉ' wee mntee lɛ btoo foŋ. M ce làa nè wèe àmbò boo wa.
eng: Now in return, I speak as to my children, you also be open wide.

lmp: Wèe fa ba àbee wèe bèe ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì ka' ka'. Àde' yuu yɛɛnì ba yuu bebep a koo ŋkar à njɛ̀ɛ kɛ? Yuu ce rraa li tʉr à rgèe a tʉ̀'nji yu kɛ?
eng: Don't be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship have righteousness and iniquity? Or what fellowship has light with darkness?

lmp: Àde' Krâis ba Bɛ̀layàl a ba cûu mo'sir à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Àde' ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì tɛɛ kùu a ŋwɛ̀ ce e byemi ka' à njɛ̀ɛ kɛ?
eng: What agreement has Christ with Belial? Or what portion has a believer with an unbeliever?

lmp: Àde' Ndap Nyʉ̀ ba yì mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na a ba à yuu mo'sir à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ? Sèe yu ndap nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe. Yi ku ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ à làa. E làa enɛ̂, "M be cu a wâp mʉ, jɛ̀r a wâp mʉ, ba yàp Nyʉ̀ tɛ wowèe a ba yà bèe.
eng: What agreement has a temple of God with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, I will dwell in them, and walk in them; and I will be their God, and they will be my people.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fʉʉ efa wâp mʉ, tɛɛ jɛɛ. Wèe fa jòo yuu ce yi yu rara ka' ka', tɛ m bo koni wèe.
eng: Therefore, 'Come out from among them, and be separate,' says the Lord. 'Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

lmp: M be ba tàr nè wèe tɛ wèe ba boo wa, boo mmbaŋrù ba boo bbyèŋge. Cena à làa Tata ce e tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ."
eng: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,' says the Lord Almighty.

lmp: Bkar wâ, àmbò Nyʉ̀ à gèe mkà'ni ca nè sèe, sèe raasi visèe btu efa buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi ce bepsi visèe mnyor ba visèe byʉ'. Sèe ce wɛp Nyʉ̀, fa visèe btu wɛɛwɛ nè ye, ce gee ŋgêe rara à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

lmp: Mʉ̀' nè wee mntee nè wèr. Wèr à gèe fàa nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', wèr à dà'si ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', wèr à ye sɛ' efa ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a, a ke' ce lapni wèe lapni ka'. Wèr tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ àmbò wèr à m suŋ wèe nà. Kɛ̀ yu rkwe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu rlùŋ ɛ, sèe ku ba àbee.
eng: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before, that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

lmp: M tʉr ntee njep wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, a ce nàa tu nè wèe. Wèe ce gèe ya ntee yi ce fʉte. Ka' wèr yu njep ŋgɛ' wa'a, m be kù ce lu'shi lu'shi njo' wèe.
eng: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

lmp: Wèr à m bà' à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà a lʉshi ka', mlù mi ku bii nè wèr. Ŋgɛ' à konì wèr à mnjì wɛɛwɛ, bèe a ce kɛ̀' wèr msì'si, wèr a ce wɛp.
eng: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

lmp: Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m fa wèr ŋger àmbò e ke fa nè bèe ce a sɛ̀. E m fa wèr ŋger ca à nfè' ce Taitòs à m vʉ̀.
eng: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus;

lmp: Yi yu enɛ wèr à m ku tʉr ŋger ba njobè' Taitòs à m vʉ̀ ka, wèr m tʉr yi foŋ njobè' Taitòs à m suŋ wèr enɛ wèe à m fa ye ŋger. E m suŋ wèr enɛ wèe ce kòŋ à ryɛ mɛ̀ sê, a ker suŋ mɛ̀ enɛ wèe ce koosimnse à yuu ce wèe à m gèe. E m suŋ wèr àmbò wèe tʉr ntee à rgèe buu ce mɛ̀ làa. Mɛ̀ ka' yu' buu ce e suŋ anà, a lu'shi nè wèe gòr sê.
eng: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you, while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me; so that I rejoiced still more.

lmp: Wèe à m ka' ba koosimnse njo' ŋwà' ce mɛ̀ m saŋ nà, yi bep mɛ̀ ka'. Nyor à m bep mɛ̀ à nfè' entòmbì ce mɛ̀ m yɛ enɛ ŋwà' anà yi m gèe wèe à koosimnse à mʉ nfè' mò'.
eng: For though I made you sorry with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you sorry, though just for a while.

lmp: Geewa'a, m ce lu'shi sè'ni, a ke' ce lu'shi njobè' mɛ̀ m gèe wèe à koosìmnse ka', m ce lu'shi njobè' wèe à m koosimnse wa'a, a kupse, a ma' yè buu bbebep. Ŋkoosimnse ce wèe à m tʉr, yu njɛ̀ɛ ŋkoosimnse ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ. Wèr à m bepsi wèe bepsi ka' koo mʉcàr.
eng: I now rejoice, not that you were made sorry, but that you were made sorry to repentance. For you were made sorry in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koosimnse à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ, banɛ ŋkoosimnse ca be gèe tɛ ŋgàŋ kupse, ma' yì buu bbebep, lùŋ. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ seŋ buu enɛ e gèe yuu bebep à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e ce koosimnse wa' ka'. Ŋkoosimnse yì bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na e ke vʉ̀ ba nè rkwe.
eng: For godly sorrow works repentance to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world works death.

lmp: Yɛ nè yuu ce njɛ̀ɛ ŋkoosimnse ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ na à gèe nè wèe. E gèe wèe à lor buu tatap sê, a ka yè njo. E gèe nyor à bep wèe, wèe a ce bɛ̀ɛŋger, a ce kòŋ enɛ sèe ba cûu mo'sir, ntee yi ce lùu wèe à rgèe buu bbòŋboŋ. E gèe wèe à tamì nyor à rsa' ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu bebep. Wèe à dùŋshi enɛ wèe tʉr bo njep yuu bebep anà ka' koo mʉcàr.
eng: For behold, this same thing, that you were made sorry in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vengeance! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè wèe wa'a, a ke' ce saŋ ba enɛ m ce sa' ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe yuu bebep, kɛ̀ bèenjì ŋwɛ̀ ce a m gèe yuu bebep nè ye ka'. Mɛ̀ m saŋ tɛ wèe bo yɛ rara à bsii Nyʉ̀ enɛ wèe à fa wêe mnyor nè wèr nè mini- ŋwɛ̀.
eng: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèe à gee ntee yi fʉtè wèr. Kyese àgee ntee ce yi m fʉte wèr na, wèr à m yu' rbòŋ se à ryɛ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Taitòs à m ce lu'shi, njobè' wèe à m gèe yi ntee yi ke' ce bu' ka'.
eng: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m nàa tu nè Taitòs njo' wèe, wèe a ke' coosi mɛ̀ ka'. Àmbò yuu wɛɛwɛ ce wèr à m suŋ wèe yi m ba mini nà, buu ce wèr ce nàa tu àgho nè Taitòs njo' wèe nà, à yɛɛtì mini foŋ.
eng: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

lmp: Taitòs ce kuushi àmbò wèe wɛɛwɛ à m tami nyor à ryu'nì, ker ba njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèe à m koni ye nè rwɛp-ŋwɛ̀, cena yi gee e ker koŋ wèe a caa àmbò e m kòŋ.
eng: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

lmp: M ce lu'shi njobè' àde' m lɛ ntee njep wèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce kòŋ enɛ wèe riŋ yuu bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe bcor ce vi yu à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà vi gêe.
eng: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia;

lmp: Ŋgɛ' ce wowèe a m yɛ, à m mòoshi wowèe sê. Geewa'a wowèe a m ce lu'shi sê, a ba mmbo mtoo sê, ka' fùp à m koo wowèe se wa'a.
eng: how that in much proof of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their liberality.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wowèe a m ku fa ba àmbò àde' wowèe a m ba fa ka', wowèe a m fa a caa embo. À m làa ba ŋwɛ̀ nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a fa wa' ka', à m ku kwa'shi ba wowèe a fa wa'a.
eng: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

lmp: Wowèe a m loo wèr, a loo nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ wèr gee yuu bòŋboŋ nè wowèe, fa wowèe njì foŋ tɛ a ja' bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a yu à ŋgɛ'.
eng: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

lmp: Yuu mo' ce wèr à m ce kwà'shi enɛ àde' yi ba ka', yi yu enɛ wowèe a m fa wap mnyor nè Tatâ, a ker fa nè wèr foŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ e kòŋ.
eng: This was not as we had hoped, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

lmp: Wèr à ka' yɛ wa'a, a loo Taitòs ce e m kɛ̀' rfà' rjà' ca enɛ e du nè rfà' ca kùntombì, ja' wèe tɛ wèe misi rfâ' rbòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe na.
eng: So we urged Titus, that as he made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

lmp: Wèe ce gèe buu wɛɛwɛ bòŋboŋ. Wèe tʉr rbyemì tatap. Wèe rìŋ à rsuŋ buu Nyʉ̀, wèe tʉr bfee à buu mini, wèe à kòŋ à rjà' bèe, wèe à kòŋ wèr. Banɛ wèr ce kòŋ wernɛ wèe gee rfâ' rbòŋboŋ ca bòŋboŋ foŋ.
eng: But as you abound in everything, in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us, see that you also abound in this grace.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a a ce fa ba rsa' ka'. M ce kòŋ ba à rfè' le rkòŋnì à rkòŋnì lî bèe mo', tɛ m bo yɛ mɛnɛ le rkòŋnì anà li yu mini lɛ.
eng: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

lmp: Kuushi nè njɛ̀ɛ ntee bòŋboŋ ce Tata Jisòs à m tʉr. E m ba ŋwɛ̀ bkù', a lo a kʉti ŋwɛ̀ fùp njo' wèe, tɛ yì fùp ca bo gèe tɛ wèe tʉr bkù'.
eng: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that, though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

lmp: Cena yu ba yà ncep ce m ce fa nè wèe àmbò buu ca. Yi bòŋ enɛ wèe misi yuu ce wèe à m kɛ̀' ha' ŋgàani nà sè'ni na. Wèe à m ba bèe entombì, a ke' ku ba ba bèe entombì à rfa cà'cà' ka', wèe à m ba bèe entombì ce a m kɛ̀' a tami nyor à rfa.
eng: I give a judgment in this: for this is expedient for you, who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

lmp: Banɛ wèe gee rfà' ca misî. Wèe gee li nè ntee bòŋboŋ àmbò wèe à m kɛ̀' nè ntee bòŋboŋ foŋ nà. Gèe nè li nè yuu ce wèe à tʉr.
eng: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr ntee à rfa, Nyʉ̀ be koo ba yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ anà tʉr, ke' ba ba yuu ce e buu ka'.
eng: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don't have.

lmp: M ce làa ba enɛ wèe fa gòr sê, lo bɛ buu, tɛ bèe mo' a bo yu' rbòŋ àgho ka'. M ce làa ba enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a tʉr yuu ce yi ghɛɛ wowèe, tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a bo ba yɛɛnì, tɛ mò' buu yuu ka'.
eng: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

lmp: Wèe ja' bèe ce a buu yuu, nè ku' buu ce wèe tʉr sè'ni na, wee wèe à ka' buu yuu, wowèe a tʉr, tɛ a bo jà' wèe àgho foŋ. Yi ba sè'ni enɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à tʉr yuu ce e buu.
eng: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack; that there may be equality.

lmp: Yi yu àmbò a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwɛ̀' gòr à m tʉr gòr se ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwɛ̀' mʉcàr à m tʉr mʉcàr se ka'."
eng: As it is written, He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.

lmp: M ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ enɛ e gèe Taitòs à koŋ à rjà' wèe àmbò wer wèr foŋ à kòŋ à rjà' nà.
eng: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

lmp: Taitòs à m ku byemi ba yuu ce wèr à m làa nè ye ka', e kòŋ à rjà' wèe sê, a kwa'shi sè'ni nè yi tu enɛ e be vʉ̀ yɛ wèe.
eng: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

lmp: Wèr ce tuu nfʉr mò' enɛ e du a Taitòs. Nfʉr ca tʉr rlii rbòŋboŋ à bcor wɛɛwɛ njo' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce e ce fè'shi.
eng: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known through all the assemblies.

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce bcor wɛɛwɛ a ce, a tuu enɛ wèr wowèe jɛr koo rfa ca. Cena yu rfà' ce li be gèe tɛ bèe a ku'si Tata Nyʉ̀, kèr rìŋ foŋ enɛ wèr ce kòŋ à rjà' bfʉr wer.
eng: Not only so, but who was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

lmp: Wèr ce lòr nfè' nè ku' rfa ca, fà dì' bèe mo' a lo ce de'ŋger kùu rfa anà ka'.
eng: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

lmp: Wèr ce ghèter à rgèe ba yuu ce yi yu bòŋboŋ à bsii Tatâ, ker ba à bsii bèe foŋ.
eng: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

lmp: Banɛ wèr ce tuu nfʉr wèr mò' foŋ enɛ e du a wowèe. Nfʉr ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce wèr à fyɛ' ye nfè' àŋgoo sê, a yɛ enɛ e tʉr ntee à rgèe rfà' Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. E tʉr ntee à rjà' wèe sè'ni na sê, njobè' e tʉr ntee njep wèe gòr sê.
eng: We have sent with them our brother, whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò Taitòs, e yu ŋwɛ̀ ce wèr ye ce fà' àbee tɛ wèr bo jà' wèe. À ka' ba àmbò bfʉr mo' ce a wowèe a ce dù nà, wowèe a tɛɛ àtu bcor wɛɛwɛ. Wowèe a be gèe tɛ bèe a nɛsi Krâis.
eng: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

lmp: Dùŋshi nè nè bèe ca enɛ wèe à kòŋ wowèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. Wèe ka' gee wa'a, banɛ bcor wɛɛwɛ a be yu', rìŋ enɛ nàatu ce wèr à m nàa nè wèe nà, à m ba nàatu mini.
eng: Therefore show the proof of your love to them in front of the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

lmp: Mbùu mò' ker ba àgho nè mɛ à rsaŋ nè wèe kuu rfa ce wèe à ba fa tɛ a bo jà' bèe Nyʉ̀ àgho nà ka'.
eng: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe à tami nyor a ce lu'shi à rjà' wowèe. A mbùu ce m ce nàa tu nè wèe à bsii bèe Nyʉ̂ à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà mɛnɛ wèe ce bêe à ŋgôŋ Àkayà à m tami nyor à rfa kɛ' ha' ŋgàani. Ye ntee ce wèe à tʉr à rfa yuu yi gèe bèe magòr efa wâp mʉ a koŋ à rfa foŋ.
eng: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to them of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for a year past. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

lmp: M ku ce kòŋ à rtuu bfʉr ca nè wèe tɛ nàatu ce wèr ce nàa nè wèe nà bo bʉ à cicì ka'. M ce tuu wowèe tɛ wèe bo tami nyor àmbò mɛ̀ m làa nà,
eng: But I have sent the brothers that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

lmp: njobè' m ka' vʉ wèr bèe mo' e à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà, wowèe a vʉ yɛ enɛ wèe à tami nyor ka', rìtu yi koo wèr. Rìtu yi ka' koo wèr, yi ba ekɛ àmbò wèe ce wèr à lɛ̀ ntee njep wèe.
eng: so that I won't by any means, if there come with me any of Macedonia and find you unprepared, we to say nothing of you should be disappointed in this confident boasting.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ m kwà'shi mɛnɛ m loo bfʉr ca tɛ wowèe a du entombì yɛ wèe, tɛ a bo baashi rfa ce wèe à m kà'ni à rfa na mbe dî' mo'sir tɛ m ka' vʉ̀. Wèe à ka' gee wa'a, yi duŋshì enɛ wèe à fa njobè' wèe à kòŋ à rfa ke' ba njobè' a tàa wèe tàa ka'.
eng: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you, and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

lmp: Kuushi nè enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' bye mʉcàr banɛ ŋgàŋ be kep mʉcàr, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e byè gòr kep gòr.
eng: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ fa àmbò e kwà'shi enjep yê ntee à rfa. E fa, e fa ce de'ŋger kɛ̀ fa njobè' a tàa ye tàa ka' njobè' Nyʉ̀ kòŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fa nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart; not grudgingly, or under compulsion; for God loves a cheerful giver.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ tʉr ŋger à rghòni wèe gòr sê, tɛ wèe ke' buu yuu mo' à nfè' mò' ka', tɛ wèe bo lòr buu anà gèe mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ àgho.
eng: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

lmp: Yi yu àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "E lɛ̀ mi mmbo mtoo nè ŋgâa fùp, yi ŋgêe bòŋboŋ yi ce kupse à nfè' mò' ka'."
eng: As it is written, He has scattered abroad, he has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa ŋgʉ̀ buu nè ŋwɛ̀ rbyè, ker fa yuu ye, be fa wèe ku' ŋgʉ̀ buu, gèe tɛ ye ŋgêe bòŋboŋ yi fa sɛ' gòr.
eng: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness;

lmp: E be gèe tɛ wèe tʉr buu gòr à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, ba mmbo mtoo a nfè' wɛɛwɛ tɛ bèe magòr a bo yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ njo' le rfa ce wowèe a ce koo ese wèr.
eng: you being enriched in everything to all liberality, which works through us thanksgiving to God.

lmp: Rfà' ce wèe ce gèe na li ce jà' bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a buu yuu, a ker ce gèe bèe magòr a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀.
eng: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through many givings of thanks to God;

lmp: Wèe à ka' gee njɛ̀ɛ rfà' ca, banɛ wèe ce dùŋshi bèe njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèe yu. Bèe a be yɛ, kù'si Nyʉ̀ njobè' wèe ku ce gèe ba buu ce wèe à làa àmbò Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ kuu Jisos Krâis.
eng: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ, and for the liberality of your contribution to them and to all;

lmp: A be yòŋshi ye foŋ njobè' wèe yu mmbo mtoo nè wowèe, ker ba nè bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

lmp: Sêe yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à ku' li rfa ce àde' sèe tʉr cùu à rsuŋ ka' nà.
eng: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

lmp: Mɛ̂ Pôl, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe. Bèe a ce làa enɛ mɛ ke ba a wêe mʉ ce wɛp, e ba à nfè' m yu àfo ka', m saŋ ŋwà' tatap nè wèe. M ce loo nè wèe à rlii Jisòs ce e tʉr rbonì, a ba mʉnyaŋ enɛ,
eng: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ; I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

lmp: wèe fa gèe tɛ m lo làa nè njèndoŋ ntatap nè wèe à nfè' ce mɛ̀ vʉ̀ ka'. Àde' m laa tatap ba nè bèe ce a ce làa enɛ wèr ce gèe rfà' tɛ wèr bo ye sɛ' enjo, àmbò bèe enjep ŋgòŋ a ke gèe nà.
eng: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ wèr ce cu njep ŋgòŋ na. Wèr ce cu njo wa'a, a ke' ce mà' bìr ba àmbò bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ke mà' nà ka'.
eng: For though we walk in the flesh, we don't wage war according to the flesh;

lmp: Buu bìr ce wèr ce mà' bìr àgho yu ba buu bìr enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'. Wèr ce mà' ba nè buu bìr vî Nyʉ̀ ce vi tʉr ŋger, a ce sà'si bdì' ce yer ŋgâa bbàa a cu.
eng: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

lmp: Wèr ce lòr buu bìr ca ce siŋsi bfee bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na àgho, ker ba njɛ̀ɛ buu ce bèe a ce kwà'shi, ce vi gèe wowèe a mɛŋnì bfee Nyʉ̀. Wèr ce lòr vi ce so mkwà'shì bèe àgho tɛ wowèe a bo yu'ni nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God, and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ;

lmp: Wèe a ka' duŋshi enɛ wèe à yu'ni nè Jisos Krâis nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀, wèr fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe ce a tèe btu.
eng: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience, when your obedience will be made full.

lmp: Wèe ce fyɛ' buu ba efa mmìr. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' ce lòr yi tu enɛ ku ba ye ŋwɛ̀ yì Jisos Krâis, ŋwɛ̀ anà a ba kwà'shi nfè' baa, rìŋ enɛ wer wèr foŋ yu bèe vi Jisos Krâis.
eng: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ's, let him consider this again with himself, that, even as he is Christ's, so also we are Christ's.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce kwà'shi enɛ m ce yu' nyor magòr nè ŋger ce Tata Jisos Krâis à fa wèr nà, banɛ àde' m koosì rìtu ka'. E fa mɛ̀ ŋger anà tɛ m bo tapsi wèe àgho, ke' ba ba enɛ wèr sɛɛsi wèe àgho ka'.
eng: For though I should boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up, and not for casting you down I will not be disappointed,

lmp: Wèe fa kwà'shi enɛ m ku ce wɛpsi wèe ba nè mŋwà' ce m ce saŋ na cà'cà' ka'.
eng: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa wa'a njobè' bèe a ce làa enɛ mŋwà' ce m ce saŋ nè wèe vi tap, a ce' sê, mɛ̂ ba fa wêe mʉ, yɛɛti àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e gò'si, la rfè'shì li tʉr ŋger ka'.
eng: For, His letters, they say, are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.

lmp: Bèe anà a ba rìŋ enɛ buu ce wèr ce saŋ nè wèe à mŋwà' njo' wèr yu àfo ka' nà vi yu jɛɛ efa vì ce wèr be gèe à nfè' ce wèr à vʉ̀ a yɛ wèe nà ka'.
eng: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

lmp: Àde' wèr ke laa nyʉ̀ mò' enɛ wèr yu àmbò bèe ce a ce kwà'shi enɛ a yu bêe bgòrgòr nà ka'. Àde' wèr fe'nì yer ŋger à yap ka'. Wowèe a ce fè'ni yap ŋger fa wâp mʉ wa'a, banɛ wowèe a yu blʉr.
eng: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

lmp: Wèr be nàa tu caa embe dì' ce wèr à ba nàa ka'. Wèr be nàa tu ba à rfà' ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè wèr. Rfà' ce wèr ce gèe fa wêe mʉ yu mbèp mò' efa rfà' anà.
eng: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

lmp: Wèr à m nàti a jɛr sê, a vʉ a yɛ wèe a fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis nè wèe. Àmbò wee yu mbèp mo' efa ler rfà' na, wèr à ka' ce nàa tu nè wèe banɛ wèr ce nàa tu a caa embe dì' ce wèr à ba nàa ka'. Wèr à m ka' tɛ bà fà' fa wêe mʉ ka', wèr à m ba nàa tu càa embo.
eng: For we don't stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn't reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

lmp: Wèr à nàa tu a caa embe dì' wèr à ba nàa ka' njobè' wèr à nàa tu nè rfà' ce bèe mo' a gèe ka'. Wèr ce kwà'shi ba enɛ le rbyemì li be kù ce kù' tɛ ler rfà' ce wèr ce gèe fa wêe mʉ li ku' foŋ sê.
eng: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men's labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèr ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca à bdì' mo' foŋ, ke' ce nàa tu à rfà' ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' à gèe fa yê ŋkʉ̀ ka'.
eng: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

lmp: Yi ba enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce nàa tu, e naa ba à yuu ce Tata à gèe."
eng: But he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.

lmp: Yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa enɛ e yu yɛɛnì ce àde' e ba yɛɛnì ghup à bsii Tata ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu yɛɛnì à bsii Tata yu ŋwɛ̀ ce Tata rìŋ enɛ e yu yɛɛnì.
eng: For it isn't he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

lmp: M be loo à rlàa mʉ làa blʉr. Banɛ wèe ku fa mʉ nfè' mò' yu'shi blàa anà.
eng: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

lmp: M ce ko'ndoŋ nè wèe nè njɛ̀ɛ ŋko'ndoŋ ce Nyʉ̀ tʉr. Wèe yu àmbò muunje ce e be riŋ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ka', mɛ̀ kanì mɛnɛ m be gùusi ye nè mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ mò'sir cà'cà'. Mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ca yu Jisos Krâis.
eng: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I married you to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

lmp: Àmbò yi yu wa' na, m ce wɛp mɛnɛ Satàn be jepsi btu ese wèe àmbò e m lòr vi bkwɛ̀ɛ a bo' Ef àgho nà, tɛ wèe ker lɛ̀ ntee njep Jisos Krâis, fa wee mnyor nè ye ka'.
eng: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a njobè' mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' vʉ fe'shi àmbò Jisòs mò' caa efa yì ce wèr à m fè'shi nà, wèe ku byemi. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' laa àmbò yʉ' mo' ce yu yʉ' jɛɛ, wèe ku byemi. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ mò' ce e yu jɛɛ efa yì ce wèr à m fè'shi àmbò Jisos Krâis nà, wèe ku byemi, koo buu ca wɛɛwɛ mmbo mmbaa.
eng: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus, whom we did not preach, or if you receive a different spirit, which you did not receive, or a different good news, which you did not accept, you put up with that well enough.

lmp: Wèe ce lòr bèe ce a lòr wap btu enɛ a yu ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs nà à bèe ce a yuu jɛɛ. Wèe à ka' fe'ni mɛ̀ wèr wowèe m kwa'shì mɛnɛ àde' m ba mbà njì ka'.
eng: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

lmp: M ka' tɛ rìŋ à rlàa yuu ka', m mɛŋnì yuu Nyʉ̀ ka'. Wèr à gèe ca yi ba rara nè wèe à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wèe, mɛ̀ m bipshi blà' efa gho ka'. Mɛ̀ m sùusi yà nyor njep nshè tɛ m bo nàa wèe mbekì. Wà' mɛ̀ m gèe wa'a, à ba ba yuu bebep a?
eng: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God's Good News free of charge?

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ce fà' nè wèe, bcor mo' efà jɛɛ vi ce là' mɛ̀. Banɛ mɛ̀ m ce yɛ̀ɛ ese bcor anà tɛ m bo jà' wèe.
eng: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ à m ba à nfè' sèe à m ce cu nà, mɛ̀ m ka' ba buu yuu, m ke' ba ntɛ̀r nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Bèe ce a m vʉ̀ embe cor à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà a m fa mɛ̀ buu ce mɛ̀ m tʉr ka'. Mɛ̀ m làa mɛnɛ wèe la' mɛ̀ ka', m be kè làa mɛnɛ wèe la' mɛ̀ ka', fà dì' m bo ba ntɛ̀r nè wèe ka'.
eng: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn't a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

lmp: M ce làa mini àmbò ŋwɛ̀ Jisos Krâis enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ce à ŋgôŋ Àkayà jepsì mɛ̀ fà dì' m yu' nyor à yuu ce mɛ̀ gèe na ka'.
eng: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

lmp: Wà' m ce gèe wa'a njobè' m kòŋ wèe ka' a? Nyʉ̀ rìŋ enɛ m kòŋ wèe.
eng: Why? Because I don't love you? God knows.

lmp: M be kù ce gèe yuu ce m ce gèe sè'ni na, fà dì' bèe ce a ce kòŋ à ryu' nyor enɛ lap rfà' li ku ba àmbò ler nà a bo tʉr njì mò' à ryu' ka'.
eng: But what I do, that I will do, that I may cut off occasion from them that desire an occasion, that in which they boast, they may be found even as we.

lmp: Wowèe a yu ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs ce mini ka'. Wowèe a yu ŋgâa ŋkùprì ce a ce yɛɛti foŋ àmbò ŋgâa ntuu Jisos Krâis.
eng: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ's apostles.

lmp: Ca yu yuu bɛ̀ɛ ka', njobè' Satàn ye ye e ke lò yɛɛti àmbò ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rraa.
eng: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

lmp: Yi ŋgâa mfà' a ka' yɛɛti foŋ ba àmbò bèe ce a ke fà' à ryɛ enɛ bèe a gèe ŋgêe yɛɛnì nà, ker ba yuu bɛ̀ɛ ka'. Yàp ŋgɛ' be lò kù ba àmbò map mfà' mi m ba.
eng: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

lmp: M ker ce làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' fa kwà'shi enɛ m yu lʉr ka'. Wèe ka' ce kwà'shi enɛ m yu lʉr, wèe ku ma'shi tɛ m laa nlâa nyu' nyor àmbò àde' lʉr lâa.
eng: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa na, à làa Tata enɛ m laa ka'. M ka' ce yu' nyor, m ce làa ba àmbò lʉr.
eng: That which I speak, I don't speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

lmp: Àmbò bèe magòr a ce yu' nyor nè buu enjep ŋgòŋ na, banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ be yu' nyor foŋ.
eng: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

lmp: Wèe à làa enɛ wèe yu ŋgâa bfee sê, a ku ce byemi yuu ce blʉr a ce gèe nà nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

lmp: Wèe à mà'shi enɛ bèe a gee wèe à wap bkwàa, sop sɛ' efa wèe, nyʉ̀' wèe, ko' wèe nè mkùu mbe tù, lip wèe nè mmbo nje mmìr.
eng: For you bear with a man, if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, if he strikes you on the face.

lmp: Rìtu yi ce koo mɛ̀ enɛ wèr à m ba yer bgò'sì, a gee buu ca nè wèe ka'. Koosi nè mnse nè wèr à buu ce wèr à m gèe ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr yuu ce àde' e lip ŋgùŋ àgho, banɛ mɛ mɛ̀ tʉr yuu anà foŋ. M be lìp ŋgùŋ àgho. M ku bii ce làa àmbò lʉr.
eng: I speak by way of disparagement, as though we had been weak. Yet however any is bold I speak in foolishness, I am bold also.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ba bèe Hibrùs, banɛ m yu mò' foŋ. Wowèe a ka' ba' bèe Isrɛ̀l, banɛ m yu mò' foŋ. Wowèe a ka' ba bèe embe ndʉ̀' Abràhâm, banɛ m yu mò' foŋ.
eng: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the seed of Abraham? So am I.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ba ŋgâa mfà' nè Jisos Krâis, banɛ mɛ̀ gha' wowèe. M ce làa sè'ni àmbò ŋgàabaa wa'a. Mɛ̀ fà' a caa wowèe, a du shaŋ a caa wowèe, bèe a lìp mɛ̀ a caa wowèe, rkwe li rʉ̀ʉ mɛ̀ a nfyènyʉ nfè' àŋgoo.
eng: Are they servants of Christ? I speak as one beside himself I am more so; in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, in deaths often.

lmp: Jus a m lìp mɛ̀ nè ŋgwàa ce wowèe a ke lìp bèe àgho ŋkàrà' ncòp- bʉ̀'ʉ-à-mntaar nà, nfè' tâ.
eng: Five times from the Jews I received forty stripes minus one.

lmp: Bèe enje jɛɛ a m lìp mɛ̀ nè mmbàŋ nfè' taar, bèe a tʉʉshì mɛ̀ nè blùr nfè' mò'sir. Wèr à ka' ce jɛ̀r njep mdip mŋgòrŋgòr mbe bkeŋ bgòrgòr, bkeŋ anà vi bep nè wèr, a coo njep rò nfè' taar. Mɛ̀ m cu njep rdip rgòr kɛ̂' àŋgàptʉ' du ba' àŋgàptʉ' mò'.
eng: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m jɛ̀r sê. Mdip mi sɛni lòr mɛ̀, byɛ̀ɛ a fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ', yà bèe efa mɛ̂ to' a fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ', bèe enje jɛɛ a fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ'. Mɛ̀ m yɛ ŋgɛ' à mʉ̀ la', a yɛ ŋgɛ' à rìŋ, a yɛ ŋgɛ' njep rdip rgòr, a ker yɛ ŋgɛ' mbe mmbo bèe ce a bo' bèe enɛ a yu ŋgâa rbyemì nà.
eng: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

lmp: Mɛ̀ fà' a tee rlì', a sɛ̂, mmirlo mi gaa mɛ̀ mnòŋ àŋgoo. Njè à yaŋ mɛ̀, ntee yi yuushì, mɛ̀ konì yuu ye ka' nfè' àŋgoo. Mbɛp à m fʉte mɛ̀, mɛ̀ tʉr yuu yar foŋ ka'.
eng: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

lmp: Kyese àgee buu ca wɛɛwɛ, ya ntɛ̀r yu mkwà'shì ce m ce kwà'shi àmbò bcor wɛɛwɛ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily, anxiety for all the assemblies.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba gò'sì à buu Nyʉ̀, mɛ̂ kwà'shi àmbò ye, ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e gò'sì wa'a foŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' gee yuu bebep, mlù mi koo mɛ̀ sê.
eng: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don't burn with indignation?

lmp: Ka' ba enɛ m yu' nyor banɛ m be yu' nyor ba à buu ce vi dùŋshi wa bgò'sì.
eng: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Tàr nè Tata Jisos Krâis, à ba ye ce bèe a be ce yòŋshi à nfè' sìp, rìŋ enɛ m ce nya' mnde' ka'.
eng: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forevermore, knows that I don't lie.

lmp: À m ba à rla' Dàmaskòs ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ce e m ce fà' njeptii Àrɛtà à laa bsoogɛ̀ a sir rla' Dàmaskòs tɛ a bo koo mɛ̀.
eng: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the city of the Damascenes desiring to arrest me.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, bèe mo' a fa mɛ̀ njep ŋkàa, a torsi njî à wendù a suusi njepmbè, mɛ̀ caŋ a dû.
eng: Through a window I was let down in a basket by the wall, and escaped his hands.

lmp: M be kù ce yu' nyor, ka' sɛ' mò' yu njo ka' wa'a. M be ce yu' nyor sè'ni ce suŋ bèe ba buu ce Tata Jisos Krâis à m suŋ mɛ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ mlo mo' ker ba vì ce e mʉ̀' ma mmir mɛ̀ yɛ̂.
eng: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast. For I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ Jisos Krâis mò' ce a m lòr ye a du àgho mbe làlà rbuu. Kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ anà à m dù ba nè yì nyor ɛ̀, kɛ̀ e m dù ba nè yì nyor ka' ɛ̀, m rìŋ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ ku ba Nyʉ̀ cà'cà'. Yu sè'ni bfè' ncòp-kyèe-à-rrʉ̀ʉ àmbò ca yi m koni.
eng: I know a man in Christ, fourteen years ago whether in the body, I don't know, or whether out of the body, I don't know; God knows, such a one caught up into the third heaven.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ a m lòr mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ anà a du àgho à ŋgôŋ Paràdâis. Kɛ̀ e m dù nè yì nyor ɛ̀, kɛ e m dù àgho ka' ɛ̀, m rìŋ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ ku ba Nyʉ̀ cà'cà'.
eng: I know such a man whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don't know; God knows,

lmp: E ka' bà' mbo a yu' buu ce àde' e suŋ ka'. Nyʉ̀ à mà'shi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ suŋ buu anà nè bèe ka'.
eng: how he was caught up into Paradise, and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

lmp: M be yu' nyor nè njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca, ke' ba ba nè yà nyor ka'. Yuu ce àde' m yu' nyor àgho nè yà nyor ku ba wa bgò'sì cà'cà'.
eng: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

lmp: M ka' ba ce kwà'shi à ryu' nyor, m ba lʉr ka', njobè' m be kù ce làa ba yuu ce yi yu mini. Ka' yi yu wa'a, m be yu' nyor ka' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo kwà'shi àmbò mɛ̀ càa buu ce m ce gèe, ker ba vì ce m ce làa na ka'.
eng: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me, or hears from me.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ce kòŋ enɛ m naatu nè ku' buu bbɛ̀ɛ ce e m mʉ̀' ma mmir mɛ̀ yɛ nà ka'. E m fa mɛ̀ yuu mo' nje nyòr, yi ba àmbò msini wa'a, à ba yuu ce à m tuusi Satàn. Yuu anà yi m ce yaŋ mɛ̀ tɛ m bo ce nàa tu ka'.
eng: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, there was given to me a thorn in the flesh, a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m loo nè Tata nfè' taar mɛnɛ e fʉr mɛ̀ yuu anà enje nyòr.
eng: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' loo wa'a, Tata à beesì enɛ̂, "Ya ŋger ce mɛ̀ fa nè wɛ̀ yi ghɛɛte yi ba à rjà' wɛ̀ tɛ à cu nè yuu anà nje nyòr. Ya ŋger yi ce yɛɛti bòŋboŋ ba njep ŋwɛ̀ ce e gò'si." Banɛ m be yu' nyor nè wa bgò'sì nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀ tɛ ŋger Jisos Krâis yi bo ba mbe mɛ̂ ndù.
eng: He has said to me, My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness. Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ byemi buu ca. Kɛ̀ bgò'sì ɛ̀, kɛ̀ mcɛp ɛ̀, kɛ̀ bjep ce vi vʉ̀ nè mɛ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu buu ce vi tap nè mɛ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu ŋgɛ' ɛ̀, mɛ̀ byemi buu ca wɛɛwɛ njo' Jisos Krâis, a ce bu' ka'. Mɛ̀ byemi wa'a njobè' e ke ba à nfè' ce m gò'si, m ka' tʉr ŋger.
eng: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, in distresses, for Christ's sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

lmp: M ce làa nè wèe àmbò lʉr wa'a, à gee ba wèe mɛ̀ ka' ce làa wa'a. Yi yu enɛ wèe à ba ce yu' nyor nè mɛ̀ njobè' a ka' ba ce fè'ni mɛ̀ wèr bèe ce a lòr wap btu àmbò ŋgâa ntuu Jisos Krâis ce a yu yap jɛɛ nà, m ba ba mbe wâp njì ka', ka' m yu yuu cicì wa'a.
eng: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for in nothing was I inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m gèe buu bghagha' ce vi ke dùŋshi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu Jisòs nà a wêe mʉ, a ke' borni à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all patience, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

lmp: Yuu ce mɛ̀ m gèe nè bcor mo' a ke' gee nè wèe ka', yu kɛ? Yuu ce mɛ̀ m gèe nè wèe ka' ku ba ba enɛ mɛ̀ m ba ntɛ̀r nè wèe ka'. Mɛ̀ gèe fàa. Fòosi nè mɛ̀.
eng: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong.

lmp: Mɛ̀ tami nyor à rvʉ̀ cà'ni wèe. M ka' vʉ ca'ni wèe banɛ mɛ̀ cà'ni wèe sè'ni nfè' taar. M be vʉ̀ tɛ m ba ntɛ̀r nè wèe ka' njobè' yuu ce m ce ròo yu ba yè buu ka', m ce ròo ba wèe. Yi yu enɛ boo a fyɛ' à wap mma ba wap bta ka'. Yi yu ba enɛ mma ba btàr a fyɛ' à boo wap.
eng: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

lmp: Banɛ m be bepsi yà buu wɛɛwɛ njo' wèe, fa yà nyor foŋ nè wèe nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀. M ka' koŋ wèe gòr àmbò m kòŋ nà, wèe koŋ ye mɛ̀ mʉcàr a?
eng: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

lmp: Wèe ce làa weenɛ̂, "Yi yu mini enɛ e ke vʉ̀ ba ntɛ̀r nè wèr ka'. Yi ku ba ba enɛ e yu kwɛ̀ɛ. Wèr rìŋ enɛ e ye sɛ' efa wèr à mʉ mnjì mo'."
eng: But be it so, I did not myself burden you. But, being crafty, I caught you with deception.

lmp: Ca yu ba njɛ̀ɛ kɛ? Wà' bèe ce mɛ̀ m tuu mɛnɛ a vʉ yɛ wèe nà, a m vʉ̀ wa'a enɛ m bo bo' wèe koshi buu ese wèe a?
eng: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of them whom I have sent to you?

lmp: Mɛ̀ m bu' mmbo nè Taitòs enɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe, a laa nè nfʉr mò' enɛ e du a ye. Wà' Taitòs à m bo' wèe a koshi buu ese wèe a? Wèr Taitòs ku ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, a ce gèe yèr buu nè ntee e mo'sir.
eng: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn't we walk in the same spirit? Didn't we walk in the same steps?

lmp: Seemò' wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ wèr ce làa enɛ wèr yu ŋgâa ntuu Jisos Krâis wa'a, a ce tɛ'shi ba yer tu. Yi yu wa' ka'. Wèr ce làa buu ca ba à bsii Nyʉ̀ àmbò bèe Jisos Krâis. Bkar wâ, buu ce wèr ce gèe na, wèr ce gèe vi wɛɛwɛ tɛ wèe bo tɛɛ tatap njep Jisos Krâis.
eng: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

lmp: M ce wɛp mɛnɛ m be vʉ̀ yɛ wèe, tɛ wèe ba jɛɛ efa yuu ce m ce kwà'shi, tɛ mɛ mɛ̀ ba jɛɛ efa yuu ce wèe ce kwà'shi. M ce wɛp mɛnɛ m be vʉ̀ bà' tɛ mlap ba ŋko'ndoŋ ba mshentee ba ŋgàpni ba mbepsi bèe, ba mnsa'ni, ba nàanyor ker ba bjep vi ba fa wêe mʉ.
eng: For I am afraid that by any means, when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don't desire; that by any means there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, riots;

lmp: M ce wɛp mɛnɛ m be vʉ̀, tɛ Nyʉ̀ gee tɛ rìtu yi koo mɛ̀ fa wêe bsii, tɛ nyor bep mɛ̀, tɛ m war njo' bèe ce cu rcu rrara ka', a kupse ka' nà. M be war njobè' wowèe a ce sàki, a kʉti à bbɛp.
eng: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness and sexual immorality and lustfulness which they committed.

lmp: M ka' vʉ ca'ni wèe banɛ a nfè' taar sè'ni àmbò mɛ̀ cà'ni wèe. Kuushi nè enɛ̂, "A ka' vʉ nè mnsa' enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe yuu bebep, banɛ a be sa' mnsa' anà ce bèe a mmbaa kɛ̀ bèe a mntaar ɛ̀, a ka' tɛɛ njìnsa' enɛ ŋgàŋ à gèe fàa anà ghup."
eng: This is the third time I am coming to you. At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m bɛɛ wèe mbe nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ker vʉ a ca'ni wèe nà, a ker ce bɛɛ wèe sè'ni na tɛ nfè' ce m be kèr vʉ̀ cà'ni wèe ka' ghɛɛ. M ce làa nè bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep nà ker ba bɛr bèe enɛ m be vʉ̀ tɛ m koosimnse nè wowèe ka'.
eng: I have said beforehand, and I do say beforehand, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now, and to all the rest, that, if I come again, I will not spare;

lmp: Banɛ wèe be rìŋ enɛ ya nlàa yi lò ese Jisos Krâis. Jisòs Krâis ye ye ghashi wèe nè mmbo ce mi yu mwɛ̀ni ka', e ce fà' a wêe mʉ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me; who toward you is not weak, but is powerful in you.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ e m gò'si à nfè' ce a m taa ye mbe kìntaa. Geewa'a, e cu ntèe sè'ni à ŋger Nyʉ̀. Àmbò wèr yu bgò'sì foŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis à m ba nà, banɛ wèr be cu btèe foŋ wèr Jisos Krâis wèe à ŋger Nyʉ̀, a ce fà' nè wèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

lmp: Fyɛ' nè wee mnyor yɛ ka enɛ wèe ce cu ba rcu ŋgâa rbyemì a ba cu lɛ? Mòoshi nè wêe mnyor. Mbò wèe à rìŋ weenɛ Jisos Krâis yu njep wèe, ce wèe ka' tɛ gwè rmòoshì ka' a?
eng: Test your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don't you know as to your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?--unless indeed you are disqualified.

lmp: M ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ wèe be lò yɛ enɛ wèr à gwè rmòoshì ka'.
eng: But I hope that you will know that we aren't disqualified.

lmp: Yuu ce wèr ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ yi yu enɛ wèe fa gèe yuu bebep ka'. Wèr ce loo wa'a, a ke' ce loo tɛ bèe a bo yɛ enɛ wèr à so ka'. Wèr ce loo ba enɛ wèe gee yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì, ka' yi ce yɛɛti àmbò wèr à lɛ gwè wa'a.
eng: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we are as reprobate.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ àde' wèr gee yuu mo' ce àbà yi jepsì yuu mini ka'. Wèr be kù gèe ba yuu ce yi be gèe tɛ mini du ba entòmbì.
eng: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

lmp: Wèr à ka' ba bgò'sì, wèe ba btatap, nyor boŋ wèr sê. Wèr ku ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ba enɛ wèe kupse, ba yɛɛnì.
eng: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. And this we also pray for, even your perfecting.

lmp: Banɛ a mbùu ce m ce saŋ buu ca nè wèe ka' lò vʉ̀ cà'ni wèe. M ce saŋ wa'a fà dì' m bo lòr ŋger ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à fa mɛ̀, ghashi wèe ba nè mmbo mtatap à nfè' ce m ka' vʉ ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m fa mɛ̀ ŋger anà tɛ m bo tapsi wèe àgho, ke' ba ba enɛ m sɛɛsi wèe àgho ka'.
eng: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up, and not for tearing down.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce mìsi ya ŋwà' ca a ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe cu bòŋboŋ. Ghèter nè kupse, ba yɛɛnì. Yu' nè yuu ce m ce làa. Tʉr nè ntee e mo'sir, cu nè nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀. Wèe à ka' gee wa'a, Nyʉ̀ ce rkòŋnì li ke lò ese ye, cumʉnyaŋ lo ese ye foŋ nà ba wèe wowèe.
eng: Finally, brothers, rejoice. Be perfected, be comforted, be of the same mind, live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

lmp: Cà'ni nè bfʉr wee, baa wowèe nje nyòr à rlii Jisòs.
eng: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

lmp: Bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ a cà'ni wèe.
eng: All the saints greet you.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, tɛ Nyʉ̀ koŋ wèe, tɛ Yʉ' Rara yi gee wèe ba àbee.
eng: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit, be with you all. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. À m ce ŋwɛ̀ a ce mɛ̀ enɛ m gee rfà' ca ka'. Mɛ̀ m koo ŋger ese ŋwɛ̀ mò' à rgèe rfà' ca foŋ ka'. À m ce ba Jisos Krâis ba Tàr Nyʉ̀ ce e m fʉr Jisòs efa rkwe.
eng: Paul, an apostle not from men, neither through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead,

lmp: Wèr bfʉr wɛɛwɛ ce a yu àfa à cà'ni bcor ce vi yu à ŋgôŋ Gàlɛshà.
eng: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

lmp: Tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, ba Tata Jisos Krâis, tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ ker fa wee cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you and peace from God the Father, and our Lord Jesus Christ,

lmp: Jisos Krâis à m fa yì nyor a sêe tù, tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo fòosi sèe efa yìsèe buu bbebep, tee sèe efa ŋgêe bbebep enjep ŋgòŋ na. E m gèe ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Ta à m kòŋ enɛ yi ba.
eng: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father--

lmp: Tɛ bèe a ku'si Nyʉ̀ à nfè' bsìp. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' yuu ce wèe ce gèe, a bɛɛŋger sê. Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe ba yì bèe njo' yuu bòŋboŋ ce Jisos Krâis à m gèe nè wèe. Ka' Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wa'a, wèe à beesì njì nè ye cɛrcɛr sê, a ce dù ba àmbùu nsuŋ mò' ce wèe ce kwà'shi enɛ a nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different good news;

lmp: Nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ mò' ce e yu mini ker ba àgho caa efa yì mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe nà ka'. Bèe mo' a ce jepsi wèe, a ce kòŋ enɛ a ba kupse nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ce e yu àmbò Jisos Krâis.
eng: and there isn't another good news. Only there are some who trouble you, and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' ker fe'shi nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ mò' ce e yu jɛɛ efa yì ce wèr à m fè'shi nè wèe nà, ndòo co' ye. Ka' à ba fe'shi ba wèr ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ embe bùu ɛ̀, ndòo co' ŋgàŋ.
eng: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any good news other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe ba yuu ce wèr à m suŋ wèe nà. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ka' ker fe'shi nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ mò' ce e yu jɛɛ efa yì ce wèr à m fè'shi nè wèe, wèe à yu' a byemi nà, ndòo co' ye.
eng: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any good news other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

lmp: Wà' m ce làa buu ca tɛ bèe a bo kòŋ mɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu' rbòŋ nè yuu ce m ce làa a? Yi yu wa' ka'. M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ yu' ba Nyʉ̀ yu' rbòŋ nè mɛ̀. Mɛ̀ m ba ce kòŋ mɛnɛ yu' ba bèe yu' rbòŋ nè mɛ̀, mɛ̀ m ba ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis ka'.
eng: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn't be a servant of Christ.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kòŋ enɛ wèe riŋ bòŋboŋ enɛ nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ce mɛ̀ m fè'shi nè wèe nà à m ba nsuŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m yu' nsuŋ ca ba ekù cùu ŋwɛ̀ ka'. À m yɛ'ni ŋwɛ̀ a yɛ'ni mɛ̀ nsuŋ ca ka'. Yu ba Jisos Krâis ce e m gèe mɛ̀ riŋ buu ca.
eng: For neither did I receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ àmbò ya ŋgèe yi m ba à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ce gèe ba ndèe Jus nà. À m ba à nfè' anà mɛ̀ ce fa ŋgɛ' nè ŋgâa cor sê. Mɛ̀ m ce kòŋ mɛnɛ cor ba àgho ka'.
eng: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews' religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God, and ravaged it.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m càa bèe magòr sê, efa mʉ̀ yà wà', à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce mɛ̀ m ce gèe ndèe Jûs. Mɛ̀ m tʉr ntee lùulu njep ndèe wa btarkʉ sê.
eng: I advanced in the Jews' religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀, a ce mɛ̀ tɛ yà ma ka' kè bi mɛ̀.
eng: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother's womb, and called me through his grace,

lmp: Nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ, e gee mɛ̀ riŋ muu yì tɛ m bo suŋ bèe enje jɛɛ àmbò muu yì anà. À m ba à nfè' anà mɛ̀ ke' cu mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' suŋ mɛ̀ yuu ce m gee ka'.
eng: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn't immediately confer with flesh and blood,

lmp: Mɛ̀ m dù à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m tɛ m bo yɛ bèe ce a m ba ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisòs entombì nè mɛ̀ nà ka'. Mɛ̀ m nàti cɛrcɛr sê, a du à ŋgôŋ Àrɛbìyà, a ka' lô àfo a ku kʉti ba à rla' Dàmaskòs.
eng: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

lmp: Bfè' vi ka' câa btaar, mɛ̀ du à rlà' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m tɛ m bo lɛɛte wèr Pità. Mɛ̀ m cu wèr ye à mnòŋ ncòp-ta-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ker yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ntuu mò' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa ntuu entombì nà ka'. Mɛ̀ m ku yɛ ba Jɛms ce e yu nfʉr Tata Jisòs.
eng: But of the other apostles I saw no one, except James, the Lord's brother.

lmp: Buu ce m ce saŋ na vi yu mini. Nyʉ̀ rìŋ enɛ m ce nya' ba mnde' ka'.
eng: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I'm not lying.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' lô à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m a du à bdì' mo' à ŋgôŋ Sirìyà ba à ŋgôŋ Sìlesìyà.
eng: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà bcor Jisos Krâis ce vi m ba à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, a be riŋ mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

lmp: Wowèe a m ku yu' ba buu ce bèe a m ce làa àmbò mɛ̀. Bèe a m ce làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce fa ŋgɛ' nè sèe nà ce fè'shi sè'ni ba àmbò rbyemî nè Jisos Krâis, ce e m ce kòŋ enɛ li ba ka' nà."
eng: but they only heard: He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce ku'si rlii Nyʉ̀ njo' mɛ̀.
eng: And they glorified God in me.

lmp: Bfè' vi ka' càa ncòp-kyèe-à-rrʉ̀ʉ, mɛ̀ ker du à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m wèr Bànabàs. Mɛ̀ m lòr Taitòs, wèr wowèe à dû.
eng: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m dù njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m làa nè mɛ̀ enɛ m dû. Mɛ̀ ka' dù bà', a suŋ wowèe yuu ce mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi nè bèe enje jɛɛ. Mɛ̀ m ku suŋ ba bèe ce a m ba btu embe cor cà'cà'. Mɛ̀ m suŋ wowèe fà dì' rfà' ce mɛ̀ m gèe ker ba lì ce m ce gèe sè'ni, mi bo bʉ à cicì ka'.
eng: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

lmp: Wowèe a byemì yuu ce mɛ̀ m suŋ wowèe anà. Ka' Taitòs ce wèr wowèe à m vʉ̀ nà à m ba ŋwɛ̂ à to' Grês wa'a, a m tàa ye enɛ e gèe bʉ̀ ka'.
eng: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

lmp: A m sèesi yuu a kuu bʉ̀ ba njo' bèe mo' ce a m ce bo'shi enɛ a yu ŋgâa rbyemì. Bèe anà a m la' kùu a vʉ a wêr mʉ tɛ a bo yɛ ka njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèr ce gèe buu wàrwàr njobè' wèr Jisòs wèe yu àbee nà. Wowèe a m kòŋ enɛ mncir Jus vi kur wèr.
eng: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage;

lmp: Wèr à m fa njì nè wowèe koo mʉcàr ka', fà dì' a kupse nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ca, jepsi wèe ka'.
eng: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò bèe ce a m ce à btu embe cor nà, wowèe a m ker kyese yuu mo' mbendù blàa ce mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi ka'. Ka' bèe ca a m ba btu wa'a, mɛ̀ m lòr yap nta' anà à yuu gòr ka', njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: But from those who were reputed to be important whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn't show partiality to man--they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

lmp: Wowèe a m yɛ yap enɛ blàa ce mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi anà à m fa Nyʉ̀ a fa nè mɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. A m yɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m tuu mɛ̀ enɛ m du fe'shi blàa ca nè bèe enje jɛɛ, àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m fa blàa ca foŋ nè Pità enɛ e du fe'shi yi ba nè Jus nà.
eng: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcision, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcision

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fa Pità ŋger enɛ e gee rfà' ca nè Jus à m ku ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fa mɛ̀ ŋger foŋ enɛ m gee rfà' ca nè bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: for he who appointed Peter to the apostleship of the circumcision appointed me also to the Gentiles;

lmp: Jɛms ba Pità ba Jôn ce a m ba àmbò btu btatap embe côr, a ka' yɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à fa mɛ̀ njɛ̀ɛ rfà' ca ghup, wèr wowèe ba Bànabàs à fanì mmbo à rdùŋshi enɛ wèr ce fà' àbee. Wèr wowèe à m byemi àbee enɛ wèr Bànabàs du fe'shi yer ba nè bèe enje jɛɛ, tɛ wowèe a fe'shi yap ba nè Jûs.
eng: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, they who were reputed to be pillars, gave to me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

lmp: Wowèe a m ku fa wèr ncep ba à yuu mo'sir cà'cà'. Wowèe a m làa enɛ wèr fa lèse efa rjà' ŋgâa fùp ka'. Wowèe a m ku laa ba yuu ce mɛ̀ m ce kòŋ à rgèe sê.
eng: They only asked us to remember the poor--which very thing I was also zealous to do.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce Pità à m vʉ̀ à rla' Antìyòk, mɛ̀ lapnì ye à mʉ̀ bèe njobè' e m gèe fàa.
eng: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

lmp: Pità à m kɛ̀' a ce ye byee a bèe enje jɛɛ wèe. Jɛms à ka' tuu Jus mo' enɛ a vʉ yɛ Pità, Pità à bornì efa rye byee a bèe enje jɛɛ cà, a fʉr yì nyor efa mʉ̀ wowèe. E m gèe wa'a njobè' e m ce wɛp Jus mo' ce a m ce làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ gèe bʉ̀ ka', ŋgàŋ ba ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì ka'.
eng: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

lmp: Jus ce a m ce cu à rla' Antìyòk a ba ŋgâa rbyemì foŋ nà, a m koni ŋgêe cicì ce Pità à m ce gèe nà. Bànabàs ye ye à m lò a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ yap ŋgèe anà.
eng: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy; so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' yɛ mɛnɛ wowèe a ce gèe ba yuu jɛɛ efa yuu ce nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ce làa, mɛ̀ laa nè Pità à bsii bèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ̂, "À yu ŋwɛ̀ Jûs, a ce cu àmbò bèe enje jɛɛ a ce cu nà. Wɛ̀ ka' ce tàa bèe enje jɛɛ enɛ a gèe ba ndèe Jus njokɛ?"
eng: But when I saw that they didn't walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèr ce wèr yu Jus seese nà, wèr yu àmbò bèe enje jɛɛ ce a ke lɛ̀ yap yu mncir Nyʉ̀ ka' nà ka'.
eng: We, being Jews by nature, and not Gentile sinners,

lmp: Bêe à ŋgôŋ Gàlɛshà, wèe yu blʉr a? Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rò' wèe à rò' nda? Mbò wèr à m suŋ wèe mbùu efa rkwe Jisos Krâis embe kìntaa rara se a?
eng: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly set forth among you as crucified?

lmp: Kù suŋ nè mɛ̀ ba yuu mo'sir. Yʉ' Rara yi m niŋ njep wêe mntee njo' mncir ce wèe à m ce lɛ̀, kɛ̀ njo' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce wèe à m yu' a byemi?
eng: I just want to learn this from you. Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

lmp: Wèe à m kɛ̀' nè Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, a ce tà' mìsi ba à ye ŋger njokɛ? Wèe yu blʉr wa' njokɛ?
