eng: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

lmp: Wà' ku' buu ce Yʉ' anà yi gèe wèe à riŋ na vi ku bʉ à cicì a? M ce kwà'shi wa' ka'.
eng: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

lmp: Wèe à yɛ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe yi Yʉ', a ker ce gèe buu bbɛ̀ɛ a wêe mʉ njì enjep Yʉ' anà. Nyʉ̀ ce gèe buu ca njobè' wèe ce lɛ̀ mncir, kɛ̀ njobè' wèe à yu' nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ, a byemi?
eng: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you, and works miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

lmp: Kwà'shi ka nè àmbò Abràhâm. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Abràham à m byemi yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa, li rbyemì anà li gee e ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀."
eng: Even as Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.

lmp: Banɛ wèe riŋ enɛ bèe ce a byemi nè Nyʉ̀ a bèe ce a yu boo Abràhâm.
eng: Know therefore that those who are of faith, the same are children of Abraham.

lmp: A m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ be kè gèe tɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a ba byɛɛnì a yê bsii njobè' wowèe a byemi nè ye. A m saŋ elûuŋgòŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m fè'shi nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ nè Abràhâm. E m làa nè ye enɛ̂, "M be ghòni bto' enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ njo' wɛ̀."
eng: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, In you all the nations will be blessed.

lmp: Banɛ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m ghòni Abràham njobè' e m byemi nè ye nà, e be ghòni bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a byemi nè ye foŋ.
eng: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò bèe ce a fòosi ba nè mncir nà, ndòo yu mbe wâp tù, njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ yu'ni nè mncir wɛɛwɛ ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' mncir ka', banɛ ndòo à co' ye."
eng: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, Cursed is everyone who doesn't continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ àde' mncir vi gee ŋwɛ̀ e ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka', njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njobè' e byemi nè ye, ŋgàŋ be lùŋ."
eng: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, The righteous will live by faith.

lmp: Mncir vi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè rbyemì ka'. Mncir vi làa yi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ yu'ni nè vi yu'ni. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lɛ mncir wɛɛwɛ, ŋgàŋ ka' koni ryòŋ."
eng: The law is not of faith, but, The man who does them will live by them.

lmp: Ndòo à co' sèe wɛɛwɛ njobè' sèe à lɛ̀ mncir wɛɛwɛ ka'. Jisos Krâis à tee sèe efa ndòo ca. E m lòr yisèe dì', a kwe mbe ce, a lo a ba ŋwɛ̀ ndòo à bsii Nyʉ̀. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce a ka' kɛti mbe ce banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ ndòo à bsii Nyʉ̀."
eng: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,

lmp: Jisos Krâis à m yɛ ŋgɛ' ca tɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a bo koni efa bghònì ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè Abràhâm, tɛ sèe ce sèe à byemi nè Jisòs bo koni Yʉ' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè yì bèe nà njo' ye.
eng: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus; that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m be fè'ni yuu ce m ce làa à yuu ce bèe a ke gèe. Bèe a mmbaa a ka' ye lè', àde' mò' bʉ' lè' anà ka'. Àde' mò' ker kyese yuu mo' mbendù lè' anà ka', njobè' a kur wɛɛ.
eng: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man's covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void, or adds to it.

lmp: Lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye elûuŋgòŋ nà yi ku ba wa' foŋ. E m ye lè' anà, a gee mkà'ni anà ba nè Abràham ba yì ŋgʉ̀. Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Nè yò ŋgʉ̀", ce yi yu enɛ e m ce làa ba àmbò bèe àŋgoo ka', e m ce làa ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, ŋwɛ̀ anà à ba Jisos Krâis.
eng: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed. He doesn't say, To seeds, as of many, but as of one, To your seed, which is Christ.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m ye lè' a Abràham wa'a, bfè' mjèe- kyèe-ba-bfè'-mntaar vi ka' càa, e ka' fa mncir nè Jûs. Mncir anà vi tʉr ŋger à rbʉ' lè' tɛ yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' yi kʉti à yuu cicì ka'.
eng: Now I say this. A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koni bghònì ese Nyʉ̀ njo' mncir ce e ce lɛ̀, yi ba ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ ce fa sèe bghònì anà njo' lè' ce e m ye ka'. Geewa'a, sèe rìŋ seenɛ Nyʉ̀ à m ghòni Abràham njobè' e m kà' enɛ e be ghòni ye.
eng: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

lmp: Àmbò yi yu wa' na banɛ Nyʉ̀ à m fa sèe mncir njokɛ? E m fa sèe mncir tɛ sèe bo rìŋ yuu ce yi yu bebep. Mncir anà vi m ba, dù bà' à nfè' ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋgʉ̀ Abràham ca à vʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ anà a ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye lè' a Abràham enɛ e be ghòni ye. Nyʉ̀ à lor mncir anà, a fa nè bcìndap Nyʉ̀, bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wo wo a fa mncir anà nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m tɛɛ mbetar Nyʉ̀ ba ŋwɛ̀.
eng: What then is the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the seed should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛɛ mbetar bèe, banɛ ŋgàŋ tɛɛ à btu bèe àŋgoo. À ka' ba àmbò Nyʉ̀, e ku ba mò'sir.
eng: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

lmp: Wà' mncir vi jepsi lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye nà a? Yi yu wa' ka'. Mncir vi m ka' ba tʉr ŋger à rfa ŋwɛ̀ ryòŋ ce nfesè, à ba kù ba vi ce vi m ba gèe tɛ bèe a ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

lmp: Geewa'a, àde' mncir vi fa ŋwɛ̀ ryòŋ ce nfesè ka'. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ buu bbebep vi tʉr ŋger mbendù ŋgòŋ ca wɛɛwɛ. Banɛ yu ba bèe ce a byemi nè Jisos Krâis nà, ce a be tʉr buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè bèe ce a byemi nè ye.
eng: But the Scriptures imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce Jisos Krâis à m be vʉ ka' nà, mncir vi kur sèe àmbò ŋgâa shaŋ wa'a caar a du a ba' à nfè' ce e m vʉ̀, sèe à byemì nè ye nà.
eng: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

lmp: Mncir vi m ce nàshi sèe tɛ Jisos Krâis ka' vʉ̀, tɛ sèe ce sèe à byemi nè ye nà bo ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni ce sèe à byemi nè Jisòs na yuu mo' yi ker ce nàshi sèe àmbò yi m ce nàshi nà ka'.
eng: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

lmp: Wèe wɛɛwɛ yu boo Nyʉ̀ njobè' wèe à byemi nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce a bàptir ye, a Jisos Krâis a ba àbee, ŋwɛ̀ anà à lòr ba ŋgèe Jisos Krâis.
eng: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

lmp: Banɛ kɛ̀ à yu Jus ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à yu ŋwɛ̀ enje jɛɛ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à yu ŋkwàa ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à yu muu ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à yu mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ à yu njeŋwɛ̀ ɛ̀, jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ yu àgho ka' njobè' wèe wɛɛwɛ yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir njep Jisos Krâis.
eng: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ Jisos Krâis, banɛ à yu mò' efa ŋgʉ̀ Abràham ce e be koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè ŋgʉ̀ Abràham nà.
eng: If you are Christ's, then you are Abraham's seed and heirs according to promise.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa yi yu ba enɛ muu ce e be ye bti' yì tâ, ka' bii munte, e ku ba àmbò ŋkwàa, ka' bti' anà yu vi wa'a.
eng: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all;

lmp: E ke ba à nfè' anà, bèe a ba ce a be ce kè'ni muu anà, kèr ce fyɛ' buu ce yu vi nà nè ye caar tɛ bfè' ce yì ta à m lɛ̀ nà vi ghɛɛ.
eng: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

lmp: Yi ku ba nè sèe wa' foŋ. À m ba mbe nfè' ce sèe à m be riŋ buu Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ ka' nà, sèe à ce fà' bkwàa nè byʉ' enjep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

lmp: Nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ, Nyʉ̀ à tuu muu yì njep ŋgòŋ na. À m bi njeŋwɛ̀ a bi muu anà. A m bi ye à ŋwɛ̀ Judà, e ce lɛ̀ mncir Jûs.
eng: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wa'a tɛ e bo tee bèe ce mncir vi m kur wowèe nà, tɛ sèe bo ba boo Nyʉ̀.
eng: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption of children.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' wèe yu boo Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à tuusì Yʉ' muu yì enɛ yi vʉ niŋ njep visèe mntee. Yʉ' ca yi gèe sèe ce kɛ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Bâa, Tàr."
eng: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, Abba, Father!

lmp: Banɛ wèe ker bii bkwàa ka'. Wèe yu sè'ni ba boo. À ka' ba njobè' wèe yu boo Nyʉ̀, banɛ wèe be koni buu wɛɛwɛ ce e kupshi a lɛ nè boo vi nà.
eng: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce wèe à m rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' nà, wèe à m ba bkwàa nè buu ce yu mnyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni àmbò wèe à rìŋ Nyʉ̀ na, kɛ̀ sè'ni ce Nyʉ̀ à rìŋ wèe na, wèe à ker ce kòŋ à rkʉti àmbùu byʉ' enjep ŋgòŋ na njokɛ? Njɛ̀ɛ byʉ' anà vi yu à cicì, a tʉr ŋger ka'. Wèe ker ce kòŋ à rkʉti ba bkwàa nè byʉ' anà njokɛ?
eng: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

lmp: Wèe ce lòr mnòŋ mo', ba mŋwɛɛ mo', ba nfè' mò', ba bfè' mo' enɛ vi yu jɛɛ njokɛ?
eng: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

lmp: Ye ŋgèe anà yi ce wɛpsi mɛ̀ sê. Yi ce yɛɛti àmbò la rfà' ce mɛ̀ m gèe a wêe mʉ nà li bʉ à cicì wa'a.
eng: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe lor ba ya ŋgèe àmbò mɛ mɛ̀ à lòr ŋgèe ye nà. Wèe à m be gee yuu bebep nè mɛ̀ ka' koo mʉcàr.
eng: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

lmp: Wèe rìŋ enɛ à m ba à nfè' entombì ce mɛ̀ m fè'shi nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ nè wèe nà, mɛ̀ m ce cu a wêe mʉ njobè' mɛ̀ m ce yaŋ.
eng: but you know that because of weakness of the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

lmp: Ka' ya yaŋ à m ba yì ce wèe à m ba caŋ efa mɛ̂ geŋ wa'a, wèe à m lòr mɛ̀ à yuu cicì ka'. Wèe à m gɛ' nè mɛ̀ àmbò wèe ce gɛ' lɛ ba nè ncìndap Nyʉ̀ wa'a. Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, wèe à m gɛ' nè mɛ̀ àmbò wèe ce gɛ' lɛ ba nè Jisos Krâis wa'a.
eng: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn't despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' mɛ̀ m vʉ̀ yɛ wèe nà, wèe à lu'shì sê. Yuu ce yi koni sè'ni à koni kɛ? Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ à m ba mbe nfè' anà, wèe à koŋ mɛ̀ sê. A m ba laa mbe nfè' anà enɛ ŋwɛ̀ co'ni mmir enje tù fa nè mɛ̀, ŋgàŋ à m ba kù gèe wa'a.
eng: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

lmp: Wà' mɛ̀ kʉti ŋwɛ̀ bbàa nè wèe njobè' m ce suŋ wèe yuu mini a?
eng: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

lmp: Bèe ca a ce kòŋ enɛ a so wèe, koo wèe à mbèp yàp. A ce kòŋ à rso wèe ba à yuu bòŋboŋ ka'. Wowèe a ce kòŋ enɛ sèe gàpni tɛ wèe bo kòŋ ba wowèe.
eng: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

lmp: Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ so ŋwɛ̀ à mbèp yì ba àtu yuu bòŋboŋ. Cena yu yuu yɛɛnì à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, kɛ̀ yu à nfè' m yu a wêe mʉ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ m yu a wêe mʉ ka' ɛ̀.
eng: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

lmp: Boo wa ce mɛ̀ kòŋ nè ya ntee wɛɛwɛ, m ker ce yɛ ŋgɛ' a wêe btù àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ce e ce luuti wa'a. M be kù ce yɛ ŋgɛ' wa'a caar tɛ wèe lor ba ŋgèe Jisos Krâis.
eng: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you--

lmp: Mɛ̀ ba ba a wêe mʉ, mɛ̀ ba rìŋ yuu ce m be làa. Njɛ̀ɛ yuu ce wèe à gèe na, yi gèe bfee vi bʉ mɛ̀.
eng: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.

lmp: Wèe ce wêe kòŋ enɛ wèe ba njeptii mncir, wà' wèe ce yu' yuu ce mncir vi ce làa a?
eng: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don't you listen to the law?

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ Abràham à m tʉr boo mmbaŋrù a baa. E m bi mò' a ŋkwàa, a bi mò' a njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋkwàa ka'.
eng: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the handmaid, and one by the free woman.

lmp: Ŋkwàa ca yi m bi muu yì ca àmbò a ke bi boo wɛɛwɛ nà. Njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba ŋkwàa ka' nà à m bi muu yì ba njo' mkà'ni ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nè Abràhâm.
eng: However, the son by the handmaid was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

lmp: Àde' sèe lor cena ba àmbò ŋgàa wa'a. Bbyèŋge a baa ce a too enɛ Hagà ba Sɛ̀ra na a tɛɛ àtu blê' bbaa. Hagà tɛɛ àtu lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye a Musìs mbe rtùu Sinài à nfè' ce e m fa mncir nè Musìs nà. Boo wɛɛwɛ ce a yu njeptii lè' ca a ku ba bkwàa.
eng: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

lmp: Hagà tɛɛ àtu lè' ce a m ye mbe rtùu Sinài ce li yu ba à ŋgôŋ Àrɛbìyà, a ker tɛɛ foŋ àtu rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m lî sè'ni na, njobè' bêe à rla' Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m wɛɛwɛ a yu bkwàa nè mncir.
eng: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe embe Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ce embe bùu, wowèe a yu bkwàa ka'. Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ca yu yìsèe mâ.
eng: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

lmp: Yuu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ àmbò buu ca yi yu mini. A m saŋ enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ njeŋwɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ be bi muu ka', lu'shi. Wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ be riŋ àmbò a ke luuti muu ka', waa mbekì ce lu'shi, njobè' boo njeŋwɛ̀ ce nduu à mà' ye, a be lò càa boo njeŋwɛ̀ ce e cu a nduu"
eng: For it is written, Rejoice, you barren who don't bear. Break forth and shout, you that don't travail. For more are the children of the desolate than of her who has a husband.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, à ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, wèe yu boo Nyʉ̀ njo' mkà'ni ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe, àmbò a m bi Aisìk à muu Abràham njo' mkà'ni ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nà.
eng: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, muu ce a m ku bi àmbò bèe wɛɛwɛ a ke bi boo nà, à lo a ce fa ŋgɛ' nè muu ce a m bi ba à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ nà. Yi ku ba sè'ni wa' foŋ.
eng: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ àmbò ŋgɛ' ca enɛ kɛ? A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Jùu njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋkwàa nà a muu yì bsìp. Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ muu ŋkwàa anà ye bti' a muu njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋkwàa ka' nà ka'."
eng: However what does the Scripture say? Throw out the handmaid and her son, for the son of the handmaid will not inherit with the son of the free woman.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, banɛ sèe yu boo njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋkwàa nà ka', sèe yu ba boo njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋkwàa ka' nà.
eng: So then, brothers, we are not children of a handmaid, but of the free woman.

lmp: Jisos Krâis à m fʉr sèe efa bkwàa fà dì' sèe bo ker fà' bkwàa nè yuu mo' ka'. Banɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap. Wèe fa kèr byemi à rfà' bkwàa nè yuu mo' ka'.
eng: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don't be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

lmp: Yu' nè bòŋboŋ. Mɛ̂ Pôl, m ce suŋ wèe enɛ wèe ka' byemi enɛ a gee wèe bʉ̀ tɛ wèe ka' ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, banɛ yuu ce Jisos Krâis à m gèe nè wèe nà yi bʉ à cicì.
eng: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

lmp: M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ bòŋboŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' byemi enɛ a gee ye bʉ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ tʉr à rlɛ̀ mncir Jus wɛɛwɛ foŋ.
eng: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision, that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe ce kòŋ enɛ wèe ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njobè' wèe ce lɛ̀ mncir, wèe Jisos Krâis wèe à gàpni. Wèe à bɛ yuu bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à ba gèe nè wèe.
eng: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò sèe, Yʉ' Rara yi gèe sèe à ce kè' ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ be lòr sèe àmbò bêe byɛɛnì a yê bsii njobè' sèe à byemi nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: For we, through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

lmp: Sèe Jisos Krâis wèe ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe bʉ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe bʉ̀ ka' ɛ̀, yi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè lisèe rbyemì ka'. Yuu tatap yi yu enɛ sèe byemi nè Jisos Krâis, duŋshi lisèe rbyemì anà à lisèe rkòŋnì.
eng: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision amounts to anything, nor uncircumcision, but faith working through love.

lmp: À m ba efa rkɛ̀' wèe à ce gèe bòŋboŋ sê. À gèe ba nda, wèe à ka' borni efa rgèe yuu mini?
eng: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e dòoshi wèe, wèe à ka' ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca à dòoshi Nyʉ̀ ce e m kɛ' wèe enɛ tɛ wèe ba yì bèe ka'.
eng: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

lmp: Kuushi nè enɛ kò' e mo'sir yi ke bepsi ncwa'.
eng: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' sèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, mɛ̀ byemi mɛnɛ wèe be yu' buu ce mɛ̀ làa na. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce jepsi wèe nà, kɛ̀ yu nda ɛ̀, Tata Nyʉ̀ be fa ye ŋgɛ'.
eng: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, à ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, yi yu rara enɛ m ker bii fè'shi enɛ bèe ce a byemi nè Jisos Krâis a gee bʉ̀ ka'. Mɛ̀ ka' ba ce fè'shi wa'a, bèe a ba kèr ce fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ka'. Yi ka' ba ba mini wa'a, yuu ce m ce fè'shi enɛ Jisos Krâis à m kwe mbe kìntaa na yi ba gèe tɛ bèe a bepsi ntee nè mɛ̀ ka'.
eng: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò bèe ce a ce jepsi wèe nà, mà'shi nè tɛ wowèe a soŋ wap mnyor.
eng: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' wèe fà dì' wèe bo kèr ce fà' bkwàa nè mncir ka'. Àmbò wèe ker bii ce fà' bkwàa nè mncir ka' nà, wèe fa làa weenɛ àde' wèe ku gee yuu ce wèe kòŋ ka'. Yuu ce wèe à ba gèe yi yu enɛ wèe koŋ bfʉr mo', ce fa' nè wowèe.
eng: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don't use your freedom for gain to the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

lmp: Wèe gee wa'a njobè' làa ce enɛ̂, "Kòŋ nfʉrò àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ yò nyor" nà, yi kur mncir wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: You shall love your neighbor as yourself.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce luuni àmbò mnyàa, banɛ wèe lor nfè' fà dì' wèe yʉshi wee btu ka'.
eng: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don't consume one another.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa yi yu enɛ wèe ma'shi tɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ke'ni wèe fà dì' wèe bo gèe ba yuu ce yè nyor ce kòŋ ka'.
eng: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won't fulfill the lust of the flesh.

lmp: Yuu ce nyor kòŋ, a yuu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi kòŋ ka'. Yuu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi kòŋ, a yuu ce nyor ce kòŋ ka'. Bûu bbaa ca vi yu à yuu mo'sir ka'. A mbùu ce àde' à gee yuu ce wɛ̂ kòŋ à rgèe ka'.
eng: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

lmp: Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ka' ce kè'ni wɛ̀, banɛ mncir vi ker tʉr ŋger mbe wɛ̂ ndù ka'.
eng: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

lmp: Buu ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke gèe yu buu ce bèe a mɛŋni ka'. Buu ca yu mkɛ'ni ba bsàkì, mkwà'shì àmbò mkɛ'ni ba bsàkì, bsàkì ce e dù ba à yaŋ,
eng: Now the works of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

lmp: rloo nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na, tʉ', bbànì ba mlap, ŋko'ndoŋ, ntee yayaŋ, bwer, ŋgàpni ba rcu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ,
eng: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

lmp: ghɛ̀', no buu vi koo, ŋaŋ ker ba buu mò' ce vi ku ba àmbò bca. M ce làa nè wèe tatap àmbò mɛ̀ m làa nè wèe nà, enɛ àde' bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca a konì ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: envyings, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit the Kingdom of God.

lmp: Buu ce vi lò ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yu buu ca: rkòŋnì, rlu'shì, cumʉnyaŋ, ŋkur ntee, ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe, à rba mini,
eng: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

lmp: à rba nè rbonì-ŋwɛ̀, à rmà'shi yò nyor àwàa ka'. Ncir mo' yi yu ce yi kani bèe efa rgèe buu ca ka'.
eng: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

lmp: Bèe ce a yu bèe Jisos Krâis a mà' buu ce nyor ce kòŋ. Cena yi yu àmbò a taa lɛ vi mbe kìntaa wa'a.
eng: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

lmp: Àmbò sèe ce cu à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ na, banɛ sèe ce gee buu à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: If we live by the Spirit, let's also walk by the Spirit.

lmp: Sèe fa nàa tu ka', sèe fa gèe tɛ ntee yi bep ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', sèe fa ko'ndoŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: Let's not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe à ka' yɛ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ à gèe yuu bebep, wèe ce wèe ce gèe buu à ŋger Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ nà, wèe ja' ye tɛ e bo kʉti njep nduunjî yɛɛnì. Wee ce jà' ŋwɛ̀ anà, wèe fa ce nàa tu ka'. Wèe fyɛ' wêe mnyor bòŋboŋ fà dì' wèe lo gwè rmòoshì foŋ ka'.
eng: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness; looking to yourself so that you also aren't tempted.

lmp: Wèe koni bfʉr wee à ŋgɛ' ce wowèe a ce yɛ. Wèe ka' gee wa'a, banɛ wèe à lɛ̀ ncir Jisos Krâis.
eng: Bear one another's burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lor yi tu enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀, ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ ce bo' yi tu.
eng: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

lmp: Tɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ fyɛ' yì ndèe; yì ndèe ka' ba yɛɛnì, banɛ ŋgàŋ be yu' nyor njobè' buu bbòŋboŋ ce e gèe, ke' ba njobè' e yɛ enɛ e gèe buu anà a caa ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: But let each man test his own work, and then he will take pride in himself and not in his neighbor.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be kù byɛ̀' yi ntɛ̀r.
eng: For each man will bear his own burden.

lmp: Tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce yɛ'ni wowèe buu Nyʉ̀ a fa buu mò' efa buu bbòŋboŋ ce a tʉr nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce yɛ'ni wowèe.
eng: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

lmp: Fa bo' yo tu, lòr Nyʉ̀ à lʉr ka'. Yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ à byè ku ba yuu ce e be kep.
eng: Don't be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce gèe ba buu ce yì nyor kòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni rbep ba rkwe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe ba buu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi kòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

lmp: Banɛ sèe fa koosi bsɛ̀, borni efa rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ ka', njobè' sèe ka' tɛ borni ka', nfè' ka' ghɛɛ, sèe ye sɛ' efa lisèe rfà' anà.
eng: Let us not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season, if we don't give up.

lmp: Banɛ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce sèe à ka' koni fɛŋ, sèe gee yuu bòŋboŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, laŋlaŋ ŋgâa rbyemì.
eng: So then, as we have opportunity, let's do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

lmp: Yɛ nè mbʉ̂ ŋwà' gòrgòr ce m ce saŋ nè ya bo na.
eng: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

lmp: Bèe ce a ce kòŋ à ryɛɛti bòŋboŋ à bsii bèe nà, a bèe ce a ce tàa wèe enɛ wèe gee bʉ̀. Wowèe a ce gèe wa'a fà dì' bèe a bo fa wowèe ŋgɛ' njobè' wowèe a ce fè'shi àmbò rkwe ce Jisos Krâis à m kwe mbe kìntaa ka'.
eng: As many as desire to look good in the flesh, they compel you to be circumcised; only that they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

lmp: Ka' bèe ce a gèe bʉ̀ wɛɛ nà, a ce lɛ̀ mncir wɛɛwɛ ka'. Wowèe a ku koŋ enɛ wèe gee bʉ̀ tɛ a bo nàa tu enɛ wèe à yu'ni nè wowèe.
eng: For even they who receive circumcision don't keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, that they may boast in your flesh.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, àde' m naatu à yuu mo' caa efa rkwe ce Tata Jisos Krâis à m kwe mbe kìntaa nà ka'. À ka' ba njobè' li rkwe anà, buu enjep ŋgòŋ na à kʉti buu bcicì nè mɛ̀. Buu anà yu nè mɛ̀ àmbò bgʉ̂ʉ buu wa'a, mɛ mɛ̀ à ba àmbò gʉ̂ʉ yuu wa'a, nè buu anà.
eng: But far be it from me to boast, except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

lmp: Kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe bʉ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à gèe bʉ̀ ka' ɛ̀, yi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè lisèe rbyemì ka'. Yuu gòr yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ gee tɛ sèe ba bêe bfi.
eng: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

lmp: Tɛ Nyʉ̀ fa cumʉnyaŋ, ker koosimnse nè bèe ce a ce cu àmbò bêe bfi, a ba bèe Isrɛ̀l mini ce a yu bèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God's Israel.

lmp: Kɛ̂' sè'ni na, ŋwɛ̀ fa kèr fa mɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ka', njobè' ncòo ce e yu a mɛ̂ nyòr ce dùŋshi enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̀ Jisos Krâis.
eng: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisòs tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce Nyʉ̀ à ce mɛ̀ enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a yu à to' Ɛfɛsòs. Bèe Nyʉ̀ ca yu bèe ce a dù àmbùu Jisos Krâis nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, ba Tata Jisos Krâis, tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, gee tɛ wèe cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Sèe yoŋshi Tata Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Tàr nè Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ. Yu ye ce e ghòni sèe nè buu embe bùu. E ghòni sèe nè buu ca njobè' sèe yu bèe Jisos Krâis.
eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ;

lmp: Tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kè gèe ŋgòŋ, e m ce sèe enɛ sèe ba àbee sèe Jisos Krâis wèe tɛ sèe bo ba yì bèe, ba brara, ba yɛɛnì a yê bsii. À ka' ba njobè' Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ sèe,
eng: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without blemish before him in love;

lmp: e m kwà'shi war, a gee enɛ sèe ba boo vi njo' rfà' ce Jisos Krâis be vʉ̀ gèe nè sèe. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ca njobè' à m ba yuu ce yi m bòŋ ye, e koŋ à rgèe.
eng: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

lmp: E m gèe enɛ sèe ba boo vi tɛ sèe bo kù'si ye njobè' e m gèe yuu bòŋboŋ nè sèe. E m gèe yuu anà nè sèe à cicì. Sèe à koni yi njo' muu yì ce e kòŋ se nà.
eng: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely bestowed favor on us in the Beloved,

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' Jisòs à m fa vi blɛɛ à rtee sèe efa ŋgɛ', Nyʉ̀ à foosì sèe efa yìsèe buu bbebep. E m tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè sèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀,
eng: in whom we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace,

lmp: a ka' gee yuu anà nè sèe à njì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ laa ka'. E m tʉr bfee, a riŋ buu wɛɛwɛ, a ka' gee wa'a.
eng: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

lmp: E m gèe yuu ce e m ce yu' rbòŋ àgho, a gee sèe à riŋ buu ce àde' sèe à m ba riŋ ka', ce yu buu ce e m kwà'shi enɛ e be lòr Jisos Krâis gèe àgho.
eng: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

lmp: E m kwà'shi enɛ e be gèe buu ca ce nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ, vʉ̀ nè buu embe bùu ba buu enjep nshè wɛɛwɛ tarshi àbee, lɛ̀ njeptii Jisos Krâis.
eng: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens, and the things on the earth, in him;

lmp: Yu ba njo' Jisos Krâis ca ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce wèr enɛ wèr ba yì bèe. E ke gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ba àmbò e lɛ̀ enɛ e be gèe.
eng: in whom also we were assigned an inheritance, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who works all things after the counsel of his will;

lmp: E m ce wèr wa'a tɛ wèr ce wèr à m ba bèe entòmbì à rlɛ̀ mmir mbendù Jisos Krâis bo gèe tɛ bèe a yɛ yi fòo, ce kù'si ye.
eng: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ:

lmp: Wee wèe foŋ yu àbee wèe Jisos Krâis wèe. Wèe à m yu' nsuŋ kuu yuu mini, ce e yu enɛ àde' wèe lûŋ, a byemi nè Jisòs. Wèe à ka' byemi wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe ncòo ce e ce dùŋshi enɛ wèe yu yì bèe. Ncòo anà yu Yʉ' Rara ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè yì bèe.
eng: in whom you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation--in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the Holy Spirit of promise,

lmp: Yʉ' Rara ca yi yu àmbò yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à tɛr lɛ nè sèe wa'a, caar tɛ Nyʉ̀ tee sèe efa ŋgɛ', tɛ sèe koni buu wɛɛwɛ ce e be fa nè yì bèe, tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a yɛ yi fòo, kù'si ye.
eng: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God's own possession, to the praise of his glory.

lmp: À ka' ba njo' buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe nè wèe na, m ce loo nè wèe kɛ̂' à nfè' ce bèe a m suŋ mɛ̀ enɛ wèe à byemi nè Tata Jisòs, a ker koŋ bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you, and the love which you have toward all the saints,

lmp: M ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ njo' wèe, a ker ce loo nè wèe à nfè' ce m ka' ce loo.
eng: don't cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

lmp: M ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Nyʉ̀ nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis a ker ba Tàr ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fòo, enɛ e fa wèe yi yʉ', tɛ wèe tʉr bfee, rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ yu nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him;

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ mʉ' wee bfee tɛ wèe bo yɛ li rraa, rìŋ buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe à lɛ̀ mmir mbendù mo njobè' e m kɛ' wèe, ker riŋ enɛ bti' ce Nyʉ̀ à lɛ̀ nè yì bèe vi bòŋ a caa ŋger.
eng: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

lmp: M ce loo enɛ e mʉ' wee bfee tɛ wèe bo rìŋ yi ŋger ce yi càa ŋger bsìp. Yu ŋger ca ce e lòr a ce gèe rfà' àgho njep visêe mntee, ce sèe yu bèe ce sèe à byemi nè ye. Ŋger ce yi càa ŋger anà ku ba ŋger
eng: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

lmp: ce e m lòr a gee Jisos Krâis à fʉʉ efa rkwe, e lor ye a cuusi a yê rkoo mà' mbe bùu.
eng: which he worked in Christ, when he raised him from the dead, and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

lmp: A mbe dì' ce Jisos Krâis yu, a ce sa' buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi tʉr ŋger mbe bùu; e yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr a caa byʉ' wɛɛwɛ, ba bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, a ker tʉr ŋger a caa bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a tʉr mlii njep ŋgòŋ na sè'ni. E tʉr ŋger sè'ni na, kèr lò tʉr à nfè' ce e bii ka' ba.
eng: far above all rule, and authority, and power, and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m lòr buu wɛɛwɛ a lɛ njeptii Jisòs, a ker gee enɛ e ba tu nè côr, ce sa' buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

lmp: Cor yu nyor Jisos Krâis, ce e gèe Jisòs à misì a ghɛɛte, Jisòs ye ye à gee buu ce vi yu à bdì' wɛɛwɛ vi misì a ghɛɛte.
eng: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' wèe à ba àmbò bèe ce a kweŋger wa'a, njobè' wèe à m gèe fàa ba buu bbebep.
eng: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà wèe à ce gèe ŋgèe ce bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a ce gèe, a ker ce yu'ni ba nè ŋkʉʉ embe dì' ce byʉ' bbebep vi ce cu, à ba dì' ce yi yu ba mbekì. Ŋkʉʉ ca yu yʉ' ce yi ce fà' njep mntee bèe ce a tèe btu nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience;

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' see sèe à ba àmbò bèe ca, a ce gèe buu ce yìsèe nyor à m ce kòŋ à rgèe ker ba vì ce sèe à m ce kwà'shi à rgèe. À ka' ba njobè' sèe à m ku tʉr ba njɛ̀ɛ ntee ce bèe ca a m tʉr, yi ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ be ko'si rshentee nè sèe wowèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: among whom we also all once lived in the lust of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, ŋkoosimnse Nyʉ̀ à m càa ŋger, e ker koŋ sèe magòr.
eng: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce sèe à m ce gèe buu bbebep, a ba àmbò bèe ce a kweŋger nà, Nyʉ̀ à gee sèe à kʉtì btèe sèe Jisos Krâis wèe. Yu njobè' ntee bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr nè sèe, ce sèe à lùŋ efa rkwe.
eng: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ by grace you have been saved,

lmp: À ka' ba njo' Jisos Krâis, Nyʉ̀ à naa sèe mbekì àbee sèe wowèe, a gee sèe wowèe à cu mbe bùu.
eng: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

lmp: E m gèe buu ca tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a bo yɛ buu bòŋboŋ ce e m gèe nè sèe ce sèe yu àbee sèe Jisòs wèe, rìŋ yi ntee bòŋboŋ ce yi càa ŋger.
eng: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

lmp: Yu njo' ntee bòŋboŋ ca ce wèe à m lùŋ efa rkwe à nfè' ce wèe à m byemi nè Jisòs. Cena yi m lò ba ese wèe ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè wèe à cicì.
eng: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

lmp: Sèe à koni rbòŋ ca njo' yuu mo' ce sèe à gèe ka', fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo nàa nyor enɛ e gèe yuu mo' a ka' koni ka'.
eng: not of works, that no one would boast.

lmp: Sèe yu bo rfâ' Nyʉ̀. E gèe sèe Jisos Krâis wèe à ba àbee tɛ sèe bo gèe mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m lɛ̀ enɛ sèe gêe.
eng: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu bèe enje jɛɛ nà, kuushi nè njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèe à m ba. Jus ce a ce too wap btu enɛ ŋgâa ŋgèe bʉ̀ nà, a ce too wèe enɛ mmbɛ̀'nsʉ̀r. Bʉ̀ ca ku ba bʉ̀ ce bèe a gèe nè mmbo.
eng: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called uncircumcision by that which is called circumcision, in the flesh, made by hands;

lmp: Kuushi nè enɛ wèe à m tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè Krâis ka'. Wèe à m ba ŋgʉ̀ bèe Isrɛ̀l ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce nà ka'. Wèe à m tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye a yi bèe njo' mkà'ni ce e m gèe a wowèe nà ka'. Wèe à m ce cu le rcu enjep ŋgòŋ na, a tʉr yuu mo' ce àde' wèe lɛ mmir mbendù mo ka', a riŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

lmp: Wèe à m ba ànjìsàp ese Nyʉ̀, à ka' ba sè'ni ce wèe yu àbee wèe Jisos Krâis wèe na, wee wèe à vʉ àtʉtʉ njobè' e m kwe a wêe btù.
eng: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

lmp: Yu ye ce e gèe sèe à ce cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀. E m gèe bèe ce a yu Jûs, ker ba bèe ce a yu Jus ka' a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir. E m lòr yì nyor a ca'si buu ce vi m gàpni sèe, a gee sèe à banì nà, àgho.
eng: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of partition,

lmp: E m siŋsi mncir Musìs ce vi m ce suŋ bèe buu ce bèe a ba ce gèe. E m gèe wa'a tɛ e bo lòr bèe embe mnjɛ̂ɛ bbaa ca, ba a wowèe àbee, tɛ a ba njɛ̀ɛ mò'sir, cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: having abolished in the flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace;

lmp: E m kwe mbe kìntaa, a gee sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe à kʉtì àbee. E m gèe mmbàni anà yi mî,
eng: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility thereby.

lmp: e vʉ̂, a fe'shi nsuŋ cumʉnyaŋ nè wèe ce wèe à m ba ànjìsàp ker ba nè bèe ce a m ba àtʉtʉ.
eng: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

lmp: Yu njo' Jisòs ce sèe wɛɛwɛ à tʉr yʉ' e mo'sir, a koni fɛŋ à rtɛɛ à bsii Tàr.
eng: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

lmp: Banɛ wèe ce wèe yu Jus ka' na, wèe ker bii bkìlò kɛ̀ bèe ce a ce càa càa ka', wèe yu boo ŋgâa nshe wèe bèe Nyʉ̀ wèe, a ba bèe embe ndàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints, and of the household of God,

lmp: Wèe yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa ndàp Nyʉ̀ ce a boo. Bèe ce a m ba ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisos Krâis, ba ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, a ba kùundap anà. Jisos Krâis yu lùr rbuu ndap anà,
eng: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

lmp: à ba ye ce e gèe ndap anà à tɛɛ yɛɛnì, a ku', a ba ndap nrara.
eng: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

lmp: Àmbò wèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir sè'ni na, e gèe wèe bèe ca wèe à ba àbee àmbò ndap ce a bà'ri wa'a, tɛ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi bo cu mbo.
eng: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' Nyʉ̀ à gèe wa'a, mɛ̂ Pôl, m ce loo nè wèe. M yu ŋwɛ̀ shaŋ njobè' m yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis, a ce fà' nè wèe ce wèe yu bèe enje jɛɛ.
eng: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

lmp: M ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ wèe à m yu' wɛɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ enɛ m suŋ wèe àmbò ntee bòŋboŋ ce e tʉr nè wèe.
eng: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m dùŋshi mɛ̀ buu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ à m ba riŋ ka', mɛ̀ riŋ vi. Mɛ̀ saŋ a suŋ wèe mʉ mmo' efa gho.
eng: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

lmp: Wee à ka' be' buu ce mɛ̀ saŋ nè wèe na, wèe yɛ enɛ yuu ce àde' bèe a riŋ kuu Krâis ka' nà, m rìŋ yi bòŋboŋ sê.
eng: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ;

lmp: À m ba entòmbì, Nyʉ̀ à gee bèe a riŋ yuu anà ka'. À ka' ba sè'ni na e tuu yi yʉ' yi gee yì bèe ce e m ce à ŋgâa ntuu, ker ba bèe ce a ce suŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe a riŋ nà, a riŋ yuu anà.
eng: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit;

lmp: Yuu anà yi yu enɛ bèe enje jɛɛ a be koni bghònì ce Jus a koni nà foŋ. Wowèe foŋ a yu ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa nyor Jisos Krâis. Wowèe a be koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè yì bèe ce a yu àbee a Jisos Krâis wèe. Yuu ce yi gèe bèe à ka' riŋ buu ca yu Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis.
eng: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs, and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ enɛ m fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ anà. À ka' ba njobè' e m tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀, e m lòr yi ŋger a fa' njep mɛ̂ ntee, a fa mɛ̀ rfà' ca enɛ m gêe.
eng: of which I was made a servant, according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

lmp: Ka' m yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' efa mʉ̀ bèe Nyʉ̀ wa'a, e fa mɛ̀ rfà' ca enɛ m fe'shi nè bèe enje jɛɛ wɛɛwɛ, suŋ wowèe buu bbòŋboŋ ce vi lò ese Krâis, ce yu buu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ riŋ ka'.
eng: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

lmp: E m ce mɛ̀ enɛ m gee tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a riŋ buu ca, ce yu buu ce vi m ba tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' kè ba. Nyʉ̀ ce e m gèe buu wɛɛwɛ à m kupshi buu ca a lɛ̂, bèe a riŋ vi ka',
eng: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ;

lmp: enɛ nfè' e sè'ni na ka' ghɛɛ àmbò e ghɛɛ na tɛ e bo lòr cor gèe tɛ bèe embe bùu ce a yu btu, ba bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce bgòrgòr a riŋ bfee ce Nyʉ̀ tʉr à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

lmp: A mbò Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu ce e m kupshi a lɛ efa rkɛ̀' wa'a, buu anà à geetì à nfè' ce e m tuu Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ.
eng: according to the eternal purpose which he purposed in Christ Jesus our Lord;

lmp: Yu njo' ye ce sèe ce sèe wowèe yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à koni fɛŋ à rvʉ̀ àgee Nyʉ̀, tɛɛ a yê bsii nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ njobè' sèe à byemi nè ye.
eng: in whom we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, mɛ̀ ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe fa sɛ̀ njo' ŋgɛ' ce m ce yɛ fa wêe btù na ka'. Wèe be koni sɛ' efa ŋgɛ' anà.
eng: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce gʉ̀'shi njeptii Tàr
eng: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

lmp: ce bèe embe bùu ba bèe enjep nshè wɛɛwɛ a yu àgho njo' ye.
eng: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

lmp: M ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr bkù' sê, enɛ e fa wèe yi yʉ' tɛ yi bo gèe tɛ wee mntee vi ba btatap,
eng: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inward man;

lmp: tɛ Jisos Krâis cu njep wêe mntee àmbò wèe à byemi nè ye na. M ce loo mɛnɛ wèe taa mŋgàŋ, tɛɛ tatap à rkòŋnì,
eng: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith; to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

lmp: tɛ wèe ker ba bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ bo rìŋ ku' njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ce li bɛ̀r à bke', a sap kùyɛɛ, a sap a ko' mbekì, a coomi a caa ŋger.
eng: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the breadth and length and height and depth,

lmp: Ka' njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì anà li càa ŋger ŋwɛ̀ à rrìŋ wa'a, m ce loo mɛnɛ wèe riŋ li, tɛ buu bbòŋboŋ ce vi ruu njep ntee Nyʉ̀ nà vi bo ruu njep wêe mntee foŋ.
eng: and to know Christ's love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

lmp: Wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀ ce wɛ̀ lòr yo ŋger a ce fà' àgho njep wêr mntee gòr sê, Wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀ ce wɛ̀ tʉr ŋger à rgèe caa embe dì' wèr à bipshi kɛ̀ embe dì' wèr ce kwà'shi ɛ̀,
eng: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

lmp: tɛ bèe a ku'si wɛ̀ njo' cor ker ba njo' Jisos Krâis à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ shaŋ njo' Tata Jisòs, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe gee ŋgèe ce yi ghɛɛte à ŋgèe bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' enɛ a ba yì bèe.
eng: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

lmp: Lòr nè wee mnyor njep nshè, ba mʉnyaŋ, kur ntee. Koo nè fàa ce bfʉr a gèe, nje nyor, njo' wèe kòŋni.
eng: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love;

lmp: Ghèter nè cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀ tɛ wèe bo cu àbee àmbò bèe ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi gèe a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

lmp: Nyor Jisos Krâis yu mò'sir. Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ba e mo'sir. Yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' sèe, sèe à lɛ mmir mbendù mo yi ku ba e mo'sir foŋ.
eng: There is one body, and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling;

lmp: Tata yu mò'sir, rbyemì li ba rmo'sir, bàptir à ba mò'sir,
eng: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Tàr nè bèe wɛɛwɛ à ba mò'sir foŋ. Yu ye ce e tʉr ŋger mbendù bèe wɛɛwɛ, à ba ye ce e lòr bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce gèe mi mfà' àgho, a ker ba foŋ njep bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: one God and Father of all, who is over all, and through all, and in us all.

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à koni ŋger à ndèe ce Jisòs Krâis à fa.
eng: But to each one of us was the grace given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

lmp: A mbùu ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "E m ko' mbekì a gee bèe ce e m so a du a yê mbùu, a fa mfa nè bèe foŋ."
eng: Therefore he says, When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to men.

lmp: Àmbò a saŋ enɛ̂, "E m ko' mbekì" na, banɛ yi yu ba enɛ kɛ? Yi yu ba enɛ e m kɛ̀' entombì a suu embe dì' ce e m ba, a ba'si njep nshè.
eng: Now this, He ascended, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m sùu anà ku ba ye ce e m ko' mbekì a caa rbuu tɛ e bo ba à bdì' wɛɛwɛ, tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ghɛɛte àmbò vi ba ba.
eng: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

lmp: Ku ba ye ce e m fa mfa nè bèe. E m fa rfa nè bèe mo' enɛ wowèe a ba ŋgâa ntuu, a fa nè bèe mo' enɛ wowèe a suŋ bèe buu ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe a rîŋ, a fa nè bèe mo' enɛ wowèe a kar mbekì fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ, a fa nè bèe mo' enɛ wowèe a ke'ni ŋgâa rbyemì, ker yɛ'ni wowèe.
eng: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

lmp: E m fa mfa ca tɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ a bo rìŋ à rgèe li rfà', tɛ ŋgâa rbyemì ce a yu nyor Jisos Krâis nà a bo tap,
eng: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ;

lmp: caar dù bà' à nfè' ce sèe be ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir à lisèe rbyemì ker ba à buu ce sèe à rìŋ àmbò Muu Nyʉ̀. Sèe ka' cu wa'a, yi gee sèe ghɛɛ, misi ba yɛɛnì àmbò Krâis yu nà.
eng: until we all attain to the unity of the faith, and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ;

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ sèe be kèr ba àmbò bghàrbèe ka'. Bèe a ka' ce bo' sèe nè ryɛ'nì mnde', sèe bo dà' ka'. Wowèe a ka' lor ba bfee kwɛ̀ɛ ce tà' tù'si sèe àgho, sèe bo cì'ti àmbò yuu ce yi ke cì'ti à nfè' fu' yi ce càa nà ka'.
eng: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

lmp: Banɛ sèe à ba ce kòŋ bèe, ce làa ba yuu ce yi yu mini, ce gèe yi, tɛ sèe bo kù' ba àmbò Jisos Krâis ce e yu tu nà, à mnjì wɛɛwɛ.
eng: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him, who is the head, Christ;

lmp: Tu yi ka' tʉr nyor àmbò byùŋ nyor vi ke cʉ'te nyor, gee nyor ba mò'sir nà, mŋgʉ̀' nyor wɛɛwɛ vi ce fà' àmbò vi ba ce fà', banɛ nyor wɛɛwɛ be ku', tap. A mbò nyor Jisos Krâis yu wa'a, ce ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ka' koŋ bèe mò'.
eng: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

lmp: Banɛ m ce làa nè wèe tatap sê, à rlii Tata Jisòs enɛ wèe fa cu njɛ̀ɛ rcu ce bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' a ce cu nà ka'. Map mkwà'shì yu mkwà'shî cicì.
eng: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

lmp: Wowèe a ce cu à tʉ̀'nji, a tʉr ka' mʉ bɛbɛ' efa ryòŋ ce li lò ese Nyʉ̀ ka', njobè' wowèe a tèe btu, a riŋ yuu ka'.
eng: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God, because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts;

lmp: Wowèe a ker tʉr rìtu ka'. Wowèe a niŋ njep mʉ̀ bsàrbuu, a koŋ à rgèe vi à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: who having become callous gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, cena yu yuu ce a yɛ'ni wèe a kuu Jisos Krâis ka'.
eng: But you did not learn Christ that way;

lmp: M ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ wèe à yu' yì nsuŋ, a yɛ'nì wèe buu ce vi yu mini, à ba buu ce vi kùu ye.
eng: if indeed you heard him, and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

lmp: Banɛ wèe co' ŋgûp nrʉ̀ʉ ce e m gèe wèe à ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ce wèe à m gèe nà. Buu bbebep ce vi bo' wèe, wèe à ce kòŋ à rgèe vi nà vi bepsi wèe.
eng: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man, that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit;

lmp: Mà'shi nè tɛ Nyʉ̀ kupse wee mntee tɛ wèe bo tʉr mkwà'shî mfi.
eng: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

lmp: Yar nè ŋgûp nfi ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe e feesè ye. Ŋgûp nfi ca yu ŋgêe mini ce yi yu yɛɛnì a ker ba rara.
eng: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa ce nya' mnde' ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ laa ba yuu mini nè nfʉr yì njobè' sèe wɛɛwɛ yu mŋgʉ̀' nyor efa nyor Jisos Krâis.
eng: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.

lmp: Ntee yi ka' bep wɛ̀, à fa mà'shi yi gee tɛ à gee yuu bebep ka'. Fa cu nè ntee bebep ca caar nyʉ̀ coo ka'.
eng: Be angry, and don't sin. Don't let the sun go down on your wrath,

lmp: Fa fa fɛŋ nè Satàn ka'.
eng: neither give place to the devil.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba nyɛ̀ɛ borni byɛ̀ɛ, ce fa' nè mi mmbo à njî yɛɛnì, tɛ e bo koni yuu ce àde' e ja' ŋgâa fùp àgho.
eng: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, working with his hands the thing that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

lmp: Fa làa blâa bebep ka'. Làa ba yuu bòŋboŋ ce àde' yi ja' ŋwɛ̀, tɛ wo blàa anà vi bo vʉ̀ nè rbòŋ nè bèe ce a yu' vi.
eng: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but such as is good for building up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

lmp: Fa gèe tɛ ntee yi yaŋ Yʉ' Rara ce yu Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ nà ka'. Nyʉ̀ à fa yi nè wèe àmbò ncòo, yi ce dùŋshi enɛ be ba à nòŋ mo' tɛ Nyʉ̀ tee wèe efa ŋgɛ'.
eng: Don't grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

lmp: Mà' nè ncɛpntee, ba rshentee, ba ntee bebep, ba mlap, ba mnsa'ni. Ŋwɛ̀ fa kèr yu' ryaŋ nè nfʉr yì ka'.
eng: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander, be put away from you, with all malice.

lmp: Gèe nè ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe mò', koosimnse nè wowèe, foosi wowèe foŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m fòosi wèe njo' Jisos Krâis nà.
eng: And be kind to one another, tenderhearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu boo ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ sê, bè'ni nè gee ŋgèe ce Nyʉ̀ ce gèe.
eng: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

lmp: Cu nè nè rkòŋnì-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò Jisos Krâis ye ye à m kòŋ sèe, a fa li ryòŋ a sêe btù nà. Li ryòŋ ce e m fa na, li m ba àmbò rfa ce a fa, Nyʉ̀ à yu' rbòŋ àgho sê.
eng: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved you, and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ buu àmbò bsàkì ba mkɛ'ni, ba ŋgêe ŋgwe, ba mbàŋ mmir à buu yi fa kèr yu'ti a wêe mʉ ka', njobè' wèe yu bèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness, or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

lmp: Blâa bbebep, bde' bcicì ba ŋkɛ̀rbuu mbembep fa kè fʉʉ eku wêe cùu ka'. Buu ca yu yɛɛnì ka'. Wèe à ba ce yòŋshi ba Nyʉ̀.
eng: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate; but rather giving of thanks.

lmp: Rìŋ nè nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce sàki, ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce kɛ'ni, ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr yuu, yi ghɛɛ ye ka', ce e lòr buu ca àmbò yì Nyʉ̀ wa'a, àde' e konì buu bbòŋboŋ ce bèe ce a tʉr dì' mbe dî' kʉʉ Jisos Krâis ba Nyʉ̀ a koni nà ka'.
eng: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man, who is an idolater, has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

lmp: Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe nè blâa bcicì tɛ wèe gee njɛ̀ɛ buu ca ka'. Yu njo' buu anà ce enɛ Nyʉ̀ be ko'si rshentee, fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè ye ka'.
eng: Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa tɛɛ kùu wèe njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca wèe ka'.
eng: Therefore don't be partakers with them.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' wèe à ce cu à tʉ̀'nji, à ka' ba sè'ni na, wèe à ce cu ba à rraa njobè' wèe yu bèe Tata Jisòs. Gèe nè ŋgèe àmbò bèe ce a ce cu à rraa.
eng: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

lmp: Rraa ca li gèe bèe a gee buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu bbòŋboŋ, a ba yɛɛnì, a ker ba mini.
eng: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

lmp: Ghèter nè riŋ buu ce vi bòŋ Tata Jisòs.
eng: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

lmp: Fa tʉr nè yuu mo' à rgèe nè buu bcicì ce bèe a ce gèe à tʉ̀'nji na ka'. Gèe nè tɛ buu anà yɛɛti àwaŋ.
eng: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

lmp: Yi yu nè rìtu-ŋwɛ̀ à rlàa àmbò buu ce wowèe a ce gèe à bsʉ̀ti.
eng: For the things which are done by them in secret, it is a shame even to speak of.

lmp: A ka' nyɛɛ nè yuu à rraa, banɛ yuu anà yi yɛɛti àwaŋ.
eng: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

lmp: Yuu yi ka' yɛɛti àwaŋ yi kʉtì ba ba yuu ce à rraa. A mbùu ce a làa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ce à ce buumi, lɛ' efa mmirlò, fʉʉ efa rkwe, tɛ rraa Krâis li saŋ mbe wɛ̂ ndù."
eng: Therefore he says, Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.

lmp: Banɛ wèe lor nfè' nè ye ŋgèe. Wèe fa gèe ŋgèe àmbò bèe ce a mɛŋni buu ka', gèe nè ba àmbò bèe ce a rìŋ buu.
eng: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise;

lmp: Wèe à ka' koni fɛŋ à rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ wèe gee yi, njobè' buu bbebep à kù' à ŋgòŋ sè'ni na.
eng: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa ba blʉr ka'. Rìŋ nè ba buu ce Tata Jisòs ce kòŋ enɛ wèe gêe.
eng: Therefore don't be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

lmp: Wèe fa ce no mrù' tɛ mi ce koo wèe ka'. Mi ka' ce koo wèe banɛ mi be ce bepsi wèe bepsi. Fa nè wee mnyor ba nè Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ tɛ yi bo ruu njep wêe mntee.
eng: Don't be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

lmp: Yòp byɛɛ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, laa buu nè bèe nè byɛɛ ca. Yòp byɛɛ, ku'si Tata Jisòs nè yo ntee wɛɛwɛ.
eng: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing, and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

lmp: Yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, à rlii yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis. Yòŋshi ye à buu wɛɛwɛ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, to God, even the Father;

lmp: Yu'ni nè nè wee btu, njobè' wèe yu bèe ce wèe ce gʉ'shi nè Krâis.
eng: subjecting yourselves one to another in the fear of Christ.

lmp: Bbyèŋgê, yu'ni nè nè bduu wee àmbò wèe ce yu'ni nè Tata Jisòs nà.
eng: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

lmp: Nduu yu tu nè ŋgwa àmbò Krâis ye ye yu tu nè cor nà. Yu ye ce e gèe cor à lûŋ, cor ca à ba yì nyor.
eng: For the husband is the head of the wife, and Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

lmp: Banɛ àmbò cor ce yu'ni nè Krâis nà, yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ bbyèŋge a yu'ni nè bduu wap à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù, kòŋ nè wee bbyèŋge àmbò Krâis ye ye à m kòŋ côr, a fa yi tu àtu mo nà,
eng: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly, and gave himself up for it;

lmp: tɛ cor anà bo ba jɛɛ. E m lòr mdip ce yu blâa Nyʉ̀ a gee cor à ba nrara àgho,
eng: that he might sanctify it, having cleansed it by the washing of water with the word,

lmp: tɛ e lor fa nè yì nyor àmbò ŋgwagûu mbòŋmboŋ ce e yu nyɛɛnì, a ba nrara, a tʉr fàa koo mʉcàr ka'.
eng: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing; but that it should be holy and without blemish.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù foŋ a ba kòŋ wap bbyèŋge àmbò a kòŋ wap mnyor nà. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ ŋgwa yì, banɛ e kòŋ yì nyor.
eng: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à m be baa yì nyor ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ e lò nyaŋ yi tu, ker fyɛ' à yì nyor àmbò Krâis e ke gèe nè cor nà.
eng: For no man ever hated his own flesh; but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly;

lmp: E ke gèe wa'a njobè' cor yu yì nyor. Sèe ce sèe yu ŋgâa côr, sèe yu mŋgʉ̀' mo' efa yì nyor.
eng: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ be mà'shi yì ta ba yì mâ, cu a ŋgwa yì, tɛ a ye a ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir" nà.
eng: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will be joined to his wife. The two will become one flesh.

lmp: Yi yu àtɛ̀r à ryu' blàa ca ka'. Mɛ̀ yɛ ya mɛnɛ vi kùu Krâis ba yì côr.
eng: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and of the assembly.

lmp: Vi kùu nduu a nje foŋ. Banɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ koŋ ŋgwa yì àmbò e kòŋ yì nyor, tɛ njeŋwɛ̀ yu'ni nè nduu yì.
eng: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

lmp: Boo, yu'ni nè nè wêe bta ba wêe mmâ. Yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ bèe ce a yu àbee a Tata Jisòs wèe a gee wa'a.
eng: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

lmp: Ncir entòmbì ce mkà'ni mi yu àgee mo yi yu enɛ̂, "Yu'ni nè yo ta ba yo mâ." Mkà'ni anà mi yu enɛ̂,
eng: Honor your father and mother, which is the first commandment with a promise:

lmp: "Tɛ buu bo ba yɛɛnì nè wɛ̀, tɛ à cu à ŋgòŋ ca njìsàp."
eng: that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.

lmp: Btar boo, wèe fa gèe tɛ ntee yi ce yaŋ boo wee ka'. Wèe yɛ'ni wowèe, cep wowèe à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce Tata Jisòs kòŋ.
eng: You fathers, don't provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu bkwàa, yu'ni nè nè wee mmasà enjep ŋgòŋ na; wɛp wowèe. Yu'ni nè nè wowèe nè ntee e mo'sir àmbò wèe ce yu'ni nè Krâis nà.
eng: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ;

lmp: Wèe fa kù ce fà' ba à nfè' ce wowèe a ce yɛ wèe tɛ wowèe a bo yu' rbòŋ nè wèe ka'. Wèe à ba kuushi ba enɛ wèe yu ŋgâa mfà' nè Krâis, lòr ye ntee wɛɛwɛ gèe ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ.
eng: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers; but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart;

lmp: Gèe nè le rfà' nè ntee bòŋboŋ. Wèe fa gèe àmbò wèe ku ce fà' ba nè ŋwɛ̀ wa' ka', wèe gee li ba nè Tata Jisos Krâis.
eng: with good will doing service, as to the Lord, and not to men;

lmp: Rìŋ nè enɛ Tata be là' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à yuu bòŋboŋ ce e gèe, kɛ̀ ŋgàŋ yu ŋkwàa ɛ̀, kɛ̀ e yu ŋkwàa ka' ɛ̀.
eng: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu mmasà, gèe nè ŋgêe bòŋboŋ foŋ nè bkwàa. Wèe fa ce wɛpsi wowèe ka'. Wèe à ba kuushi enɛ wèe bkwàa ca wèe wɛɛwɛ tʉr Masà mò'sir ce e ce cu mbe bùu. E ke so'niŋgòŋ ka'.
eng: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa elʉ̀simbùu yi yu enɛ àmbò wèe Tata Jisòs wèe yu àbee na, tɛɛ nè tatap, koni ŋger ese ye ce e tʉr ŋger gòr.
eng: Finally, be strong in the Lord, and in the strength of his might.

lmp: Yar nè buu bìr wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe tɛ wèe bo tami nyor à rmà' bìr àgho, fà dì' Satàn bo' wèe nè bfee kwɛ̀ɛ ka'.
eng: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

lmp: Sèe ce mà' bìr ca ba sèe bèe wèe ka'. Sèe ce mà' ba sèe byʉ' bbebep wɛɛwɛ ce vi tʉr ŋger mbekì. Byʉ' bbebep ca yu byʉ' ce vi ce sa', a tʉr ŋger, a tap njep ŋgòŋ ce yi yu à tʉ̀'nji na.
eng: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world's rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

lmp: Banɛ wèe lor buu bìr ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè wèe nà, tami nyor àgho, tɛ Satàn e vʉ̀ nà, wèe bo mà' bìr bòŋboŋ, gwè ka'. Bìr ca ka' mî, tɛ wèe bo kù tɛɛ tatap.
eng: Therefore, put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and, having done all, to stand.

lmp: Tɛɛ tatap, tami nyor àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mini tɛ mini ca ba àmbò ŋkànda ce ŋwɛ̀ mà' bìr à kur njep mbùu. Mà'shi tɛ yo ŋgèe yi ba yɛɛnì. Njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca yi tɛ'shi wèe àmbò yuu ce ŋwɛ̀ mà' bìr à yar a tɛ'shi yì ŋgùŋ àgho wa'a.
eng: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

lmp: Lòr Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce e ce suŋ àmbò cumʉnyaŋ ce Nyʉ̀ ce fa nè bèe, tɛ e ba àmbò blaba' ce ŋwɛ̀ mà' bìr à yar, fà dì' à bo gwè ka'.
eng: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace;

lmp: Mo' foŋ yi yu enɛ à lɛ̀ ntee nè Tata Jisòs, tɛ ntee ce wɛ̀ lɛ̀ anà yi ba àmbò byɛɛ bìr, tɛ mjɛɛ Satàn ce mor yi yu à cùu mo mi bo koo njo.
eng: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

lmp: Lòr nè rlùŋ tɛ li ba àmbò rtaa ŋwɛ̀ mà' bìr wa'a. Lòr nè kàafà' ce à fa ba Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ a fa nè wèe. Kàafà' ca yu blâa Nyʉ̀.
eng: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

lmp: Loo nè nè Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Wèe à ka' ce loo wa'a, wèe ma'shi tɛ Yʉ' Rara yi gee tɛ wèe riŋ à rloo. Cu nè njo, ke' sɛ ka'. Loo nè nè bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ,
eng: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints:

lmp: ker loo nè mɛ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ fa mɛ̀ blàa ce vi yu yɛɛnì à nfè' ce m ka' ce suŋ bèe buu ce àde' bèe à m ba riŋ ka' kuu nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ. Loo nè enɛ m ka' ce suŋ bèe buu ca, m suŋ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: on my behalf, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

lmp: Nsuŋ ca yu nsuŋ ce Jisos Krâis à m ce mɛ̀ enɛ m tɛɛ a yê tù, suŋ bèe, ka' m yu mbe shaŋ sè'ni wa'a. Loo nè enɛ m suŋ bèe buu ca nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, suŋ vi àmbò mɛ̀ ba suŋ.
eng: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

lmp: M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ foŋ yuu ce yi koni mɛ̀ tɛ wèe bo rìŋ àmbò m yu. Tikikòs be suŋ wèe buu ca. E yu nfʉr yìsèe, sèe à koŋ ye sê. E yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce e ce fà' nè Tata Jisòs nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things;

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce tuu ye enɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe tɛ e bo suŋ wèe àmbò wèr yu tɛ ye ntee yi bo fʉte tɛ wèe yu' rbòŋ.
eng: whom I have sent to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state, and that he may comfort your hearts.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, ba Tata Jisos Krâis, fa cumʉnyaŋ nè bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, gee tɛ wowèe a koŋni, lɛ̀ ntee nè Jisòs.
eng: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a kòŋ Tata Jisos Krâis nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, a ku cu ba njep rkòŋnì anà.
eng: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol wèr Timotì ce wèr yu ŋgâa mfà' nè Jisos Krâis. Wèr ce saŋ nè wèe ce wèe yu bèe Nyʉ̀ à rla' Filèpâi, ce wèe à tarshi wèe Jisos Krâis wèe, a ker ce saŋ nè wee btu embe côr, ker ba bdikìn.
eng: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ; To all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

lmp: Wèr ce loo wernɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Ta ker ba Tata Jisos Krâis, tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you, and peace from God, our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Mɛ̂ ke yòŋshi yà Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce m ce kwà'shi àmbò wèe.
eng: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

lmp: Mɛ̂ ke loo nè wèe, ce loo nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all making my requests with joy,

lmp: Mɛ̂ loo wa'a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ njobè' m ce kuushi àmbò wèe à koni mɛ̀ à rfà' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ, kɛ' embe nfè' ce wèe à m byemi nè Nyʉ̀ vʉ ghɛɛ sè'ni na.
eng: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

lmp: M rìŋ bòŋboŋ mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e m kɛ̀' a gee li rfà' ce rbòŋboŋ ca njep wêe mntee be kù dù kùntombì nè rfà' anà, caar dù bà' à nfè' ce li be kè mì à nòŋ ce Jisòs be vʉ̀ nà.
eng: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

lmp: Yi bòŋ enɛ m tʉr njɛ̀ɛ mkwà'shì ca kuu wèe, njobè' m tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ. Wèe à m koni mɛ̀ à rfâ' rbòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa mɛ̀. Wèe à m koni mɛ̀ à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m tɛɛ a ce fè'shi, a ker ce sàr Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè bèe, ker ba sè'ni ce m yu mbe shaŋ na.
eng: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because, both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ rìŋ enɛ ya ntee yi ce lùu à ryɛ wèe. Njɛ̀ɛ njì ce m kòŋ wèe, ku ba àmbò Jisòs ye ye kòŋ wèe nà.
eng: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

lmp: M ce loo nè wèe enɛ le rkòŋnì li ku' du kùntombì, gee tɛ wèe yi buu Nyʉ̀, kèr rìŋ jɛɛ jɛɛ efa yuu bòŋboŋ ba yuu bebep,
eng: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment;

lmp: tɛ wèe bo co' yuu ce yi bòŋ a caa mo', e kè ba à nòŋ ce Krâis be kèr vʉ̀ nà wee mntee vi bo ba brara tɛ yuu yi ke' ba ce e taa wèe àgho ka'.
eng: so that you may approve the things that are excellent; that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ;

lmp: Jisos Krâis be gèe tɛ wèe tʉr ba ndêe mbòŋmboŋ ce bèe a yɛ bo kù'si Nyʉ̀, kèr nɛ̀si ye.
eng: being filled with the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kòŋ tɛ wèe riŋ enɛ ŋgɛ' ce e koni mɛ̀ na à gèe Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ à misì a du kùntombì.
eng: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News;

lmp: Ŋgâa ncìŋ nto', ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce àfa a riŋ sè'ni enɛ m yu mbe shaŋ njobè' m yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ;

lmp: Bèe magòr efa mʉ̀ bfʉr visèe a ka' yɛ mɛ̀ mbe shaŋ wa'a, Tata à gêe, wowèe a misì a tʉr ntee, a ce fè'shi Blâa Nyʉ̀ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ a ke' ce wɛp yuu ka'.
eng: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

lmp: Wè mo' efa wowèe a fè'shi buu kuu Jisos Krâis njobè' a ce ko'-ndoŋ nè mɛ̀, a ce ròo à rcàa mɛ̀, wè mo' a ce fè'shi yap ba à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

lmp: Bèe ca a ce fè'shi njobè' wowèe a kòŋ mɛ̀. Wowèe a rìŋ enɛ m yu mbe shaŋ tɛ m bo tome Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

lmp: Bèe mo' ca a fè'shi buu kuu Jisos Krâis njobè' wowèe a ce kòŋ à rba bêe bgòrgòr. Yuu ce wowèe a ce fè'shi yu ba yuu ce wowèe a tʉr njep ntee ka'. Wowèe a ku ce ròo enɛ mlù mi ku ce koo mɛ̀ àmbò m yu mbe shaŋ na.
eng: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

lmp: Yi gèe mnsa' ka'. Kɛ̀ wowèe à ce fè'shi ba à ntee bebep ɛ̀, kɛ̀ a ce gèe ba à ntee bòŋboŋ ɛ̀, bèe a ce yu' àmbò Jisos Krâis. A yuu ce yi gèe m ku ce lu'shi.
eng: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

lmp: Nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, m be kù ce lu'shi wa'a dù kùntombì, njobè' m rìŋ mɛnɛ le rloo ba rjà' ce li lò ese Yʉ' Jisòs Krâis li be gèe tɛ m lûŋ.
eng: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation, through your supplication and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

lmp: Yuu mo'sir ce m ce ròo, a ce kè' mɛnɛ yi koni nè mɛ̀ yi yu enɛ m fa kè gèe yuu ce yi be koosi mɛ̀ rìtu ka'. Yi yu enɛ m tʉr ba ntee tatap sè'ni àmbò mɛ̀ m ku tʉr nà à nfè' sìp tɛ m bo kù fa rlii rgòr nè Jisos Krâis nè yà nyor. Kɛ̀ m be cu ntèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ m be kwe ɛ̀, m ku ce ròo ba à rfa rlii rgòr nè ye.
eng: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life, or by death.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò mɛ̀, m ka' cu mbe tunshe na m ku ce lɛ̀ mmir ba mbendù Jisos Krâis. Mɛ̀ ka' kwe, ba sɛ' nè mɛ̀.
eng: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' cu mbe tunshe na m gee rfà' ce li be jà' bèe. Yi ka' ba wa' mɛ̀ ke' riŋ yì ce m co' ka'.
eng: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don't know what I will choose.

lmp: M tɛɛ mbetar. M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ mɛ̀ ba mà'shi tunshe dù cu wèr Jisos Krâis. Yì anà yi bòŋ a caa rcu embe tunshe na.
eng: But I am in a dilemma between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

lmp: Geewa'a, yi bòŋ magòr enɛ m cu mbe tunshe njo' wèe.
eng: Yet, to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ yi bòŋ wa'a. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ m be cu wèe sèe, tɛ m bo jà' wèe tɛ wèe du kùntombì nè le rbyemì, kèr ce lu'shi,
eng: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all, for your progress and joy in the faith,

lmp: mɛ̂ kèr vʉ̀ yɛ wèe, tɛ wèe bo yòŋshi Jisos Krâis njo' mɛ̀.
eng: that your rejoicing may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

lmp: Yuu mo'sir yi yu enɛ yè ndèe ba le rcu li ku ba yɛɛnì àmbò Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ Jisòs ce ròo enɛ li ba, ka' mɛ̀ ka' vʉ yɛ wèe, kɛ̀ mɛ̀ vʉ̀ ka' ɛ̀, m bo kù yu' mɛnɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap, a tʉr rkwà'shî rmo'sir, a ker ce rè nè ntee mo'sir tɛ Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce wèe à byemi àgho bo dù kùntombì.
eng: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that, whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

lmp: Wèe ka' tɛ ce wɛp ye ŋgâa bbàa ka', ca yi be ba ncôo nrara nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a be kwe, bʉ, kèr dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ wèe lûŋ.
eng: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe njì enɛ wèe fa kù byemi nè Jisos Krâis byemi ka', e fa enɛ wèe yɛ ŋgɛ' a yê tù foŋ.
eng: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

lmp: E gèe enɛ wee wèe niŋ njep mʉ̀ bkòr ce wèe à m yɛ mɛ̀ ce rè, a ker ce yu' sè'ni enɛ m ku bii rè na.
eng: having the same conflict which you saw in me, and now hear is in me.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ enɛ wèe à tarshi wèe Krâis wèe. Mbò rtarshì anà li gèe wèe à tʉr ŋger a? Mbò ntee yi fʉte wèe njobè' Krâis kòŋ wèe a? Mbò wèe yu àbee wèe Yʉ' Rara wèe a? Mbò wèe tʉr mntee bbòŋboŋ a ce koosimnse àgho a?
eng: If there is therefore any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

lmp: Banɛ wèe kwa'shi yuu yi mo'sir, koŋni a wêe mʉ, tʉr cûu mo'sir; wee gèe wa' nà, m bo mìsi lu'shi.
eng: make my joy full, by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

lmp: Wèe fa gèe yuu njo' ŋwɛ̀ ce ròo à rcàa ŋwɛ̀ ka', kɛ̀ njo' ŋwɛ̀ ce kòŋ à rnàa nyor ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ lor yi tu njep nshè, yɛ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à càa ye.
eng: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fa kù ce kwà'shi ba àmbò yi tu ka', ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ kwa'shi àmbò bèe mo' foŋ.
eng: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

lmp: Yè ndèe à ba ba àmbo yì Jisos Krâis.
eng: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

lmp: E m ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ yu nà, a ka' ba wa'a, a ke' ce ghèter enɛ e be kù cu àmbò Nyʉ̀ yu nà ka'.
eng: who, existing in the form of God, didn't consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

lmp: E m mà'shi nta' gòr ca, a lor yi tu njep nshè a ba àmbò ŋkwàa wa'a. A m bi ye à ŋwɛ̀.
eng: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

lmp: E ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ wa'a, a ker lor yi tu njep nshè a yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ a byemi à rkwe; a ka' kwe a kwe ba rkwe ce embe kìntaa.
eng: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to death, yes, the death of the cross.

lmp: A mbùu ce Nyʉ̀ à nàa ye mbekì, a fa ye rlii ce li càa mlii wɛɛwɛ,
eng: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name;

lmp: enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a yu mbe bùu, a ker ba mbe tunshe, ker ba bèe ce a yu mbà yir a yu' rlii Jisòs bo gʉ'shi,
eng: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

lmp: suŋ enɛ Jisos Krâis yu Tàr, tɛ bkù'sì vi ba nè Nyʉ̀ Tàr.
eng: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

lmp: Bkar wâ, banɛ yi bòŋ enɛ wèe yu'ni nè mɛ̀ sè'ni ce m yu njìsàp na, yu'ni nè caa àmbò wèe à m ce yu'ni nè mɛ̀ à nfè' ce sèe à m ba nà. Wèe ku ce fa', ce kaŋ nè rwɛp-ŋwɛ̀ tɛ wèe bo mìsi koni rlùŋ.
eng: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

lmp: Yu Nyʉ̀ ce e ce fà' njep wêe mntee, a ce gèe enɛ wèe koŋ à rgèe yuu ce e ce ròo, à ker ba ye ce e ce fa wèe ŋger à rgèe yuu anà.
eng: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work, for his good pleasure.

lmp: Wèe ka' ce gèe ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ, wèe fa ce rʉ̀ʉrʉ ka',
eng: Do all things without murmurings and disputes,

lmp: fà dì' yuu yi bo ba ce a taa wèe àtu mo ka', tɛ wee mntee vi ba brara. Gèe nè wa'a tɛ wèe bo ba boo Nyʉ̀ ce a tʉr fàa ka', a ce cu à mʉ̀ ŋgâa bsàrbuu, a ce raa à wâp mʉ àmbò mkàŋsì wa'a.
eng: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without blemish in the midst of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

lmp: Wèe ce gee tɛ wowèe a yu' nsuŋ ce e yu àmbò ryòŋ ce nfesè. Wèe gee wa'a tɛ m bo koni yuu ce m naatu àgho, à nòŋ ce Krâis à vʉ̀, fà dì' yi bo kè ba enɛ mɛ̀ m yʉ nyor à cicì ka'.
eng: holding up the word of life; that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ, that I didn't run in vain nor labor in vain.

lmp: Yuu ce wèe à m gèe njo' le rbyemî nè Jisos Krâis yi yu àmbò taŋshì ce wèe à gèe nè Nyʉ̀. Mɛ̀ ka' ba kwe, wa blɛɛ vi misì taŋshì anà, m ku ce lu'shi lu'shi.
eng: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I rejoice, and rejoice with you all.

lmp: Wee wèe ce lu'shi, tɛ sèe lu'shi bsìp.
eng: In the same way, you also rejoice, and rejoice with me.

lmp: Tata Jisòs à ka' byemi, banɛ m be tuu Timotì nfè' mʉcàr, tɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe, e kʉti suŋ mɛ̀ nsuŋ àmbò wèe tɛ mɛ mɛ̀ bo lu'shi.
eng: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker ba ce e tʉr wèe njep ntee àmbò mɛ̀, caa efa Timotì ka'.
eng: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a ku ce kwà'shi ba àmbò wap btu, a ke' ce kwà'shi àmbò yuu ce Jisòs ce ròo ka'.
eng: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò Timotì, wèe ku riŋ yì ndèe. Wèe rìŋ enɛ e fà' wèr ye àmbò muu e ke fà' a yì ta nà, à rgèe enɛ Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ du kùntombì.
eng: But you know the proof of him, that, as a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce ke' mɛnɛ a ka' teni mnsa' m riŋ àmbò buu yu, m ka' tuu ye tɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe.
eng: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

lmp: M rìŋ mɛnɛ nfè' mʉcàr tɛ Tata ma'shi tɛ mɛ mɛ̀ vʉ yɛ wèe.
eng: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ m tuu nfʉr yìsèe ce Ɛ̀pafròditòs tɛ e kʉti vʉ̀ yɛ wèe. E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce wèr ye ce fà' àbee, a ce mà' bìr Nyʉ̀ àbee. E yu foŋ ŋwɛ̀ ntuu ce wèe à m tuu enɛ e vʉ ja' mɛ̀.
eng: But I counted it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need;

lmp: Cùu yi ce lùu ye à ryɛ wèe, mlù mi ce koo ye njobè' e rìŋ enɛ wèe à yu' yi yaŋ.
eng: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled, because you had heard that he was sick.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ e m yaŋ, a ku tɛɛ yî ŋkwe, Nyʉ̀ à ke' byemì ka'. Nyʉ̀ à ka' kani wa'a, a koosi ba mnse nè ye, a koosi nè mɛ̀ foŋ, njobè' e m ba kwe kwe, yà ŋgɛ' à ba bɛ̀r.
eng: For indeed he was sick, nearly to death, but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce kòŋ enɛ m tuu ye tɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe, tɛ wèe bo lu'shi à ryɛ ye tɛ ntee yi bo fʉte mɛ̀ foŋ.
eng: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that, when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

lmp: Koni nè ye bòŋboŋ nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò nfʉr wèe ce wèe wowèe yu àbee wèe Tata Jisòs wèe. Yi bòŋ enɛ wèe gʉ'shi nè njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ àmbò ye anà.
eng: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such in honor,

lmp: À m bɛr mʉcàr e m ba kwe njo' rfà' ce e m ce gèe nè Jisos Krâis. E m tami nyor à rkwe tɛ e bo jà' mɛ̀ a wêe btù.
eng: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

lmp: Banɛ à rmìsì, bfʉr wâ, wèe lu'shi njobè' wèe yu wèe Tata wèe. Yi gèe mnsa' nè mɛ̀ à ker saŋ buu ca nè wèe ka'. Buu anà be jà' wèe tɛ wèe ke' bo lɛ'ti ka'.
eng: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord. To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

lmp: Lòr nè nfè' wèe bèe ce a yu àmbò ŋgwe. Lòr nè nfè' wèe bêe bbebep ca wèe. Wèe lor nfè' wèe wowèe ce a ce yɛ'ni enɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ tʉr à rgèe bʉ̀ ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: Beware of the dogs, beware of the evil workers, beware of the false circumcision.

lmp: Yu ba sèe ce sèe à gèe bʉ̀ ce mini, njobè' sèe ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò Yʉ' Rara yi ce ròo, a ce lu'shi à rcu ce sèe Jisòs wèe ce cu, a ke' ce lɛ̀ yisèe ntee à buu ce à nyòr ka'.
eng: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

lmp: Mɛ̀ ba ce kòŋ à rlɛ̀ ntee à buu ce à nyòr, mɛ̀ ba lɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' ce kwà' enɛ e tʉr yuu ce àde' yi gee enɛ e lɛ ntee à njɛ̀ɛ buu anà, m tʉr buu anà a caa ye.
eng: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

lmp: A m bi mɛ̀ à ŋwɛ̀ Isrɛ̀l mbe ntɛ̀' Bɛnjamɛ̀n, yà ta ba yà ma a ba bèe Hibrùs ce mini, mɛ̀ ka' bà' ŋgàa mò'sir, a gee mɛ̀ bʉ̀. À ka' ba àmbò mncir ce a lɛ̀, mɛ̀ m ba ŋwɛ̀ Farìsî.
eng: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò buu Nyʉ̀ ce Jus a byemi àgho, mɛ̀ m fà' nè ya ntee wɛɛwɛ à rfa ŋgɛ' nè ŋgâa côr. Banɛ àmbò mncir Jus anà vi yu, mɛ̀ m bʉ' mo' ka'.
