eng: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

lmp: Kɛ̀ yu ba njɛ̀ɛ sɛ' kɛ ce mɛ̀ m tʉr enjep mʉ̀ buu anà ɛ̀, mɛ̀ yɛ sè'ni mɛnɛ buu anà wɛɛwɛ vi m ce bʉsi mɛ̀ bʉsi, a ma'shi vi wɛɛwɛ tɛ m bo dù ba àmbùu Jisos Krâis.
eng: However, what things were gain to me, these have I counted loss for Christ.

lmp: À ke' ku ba cena cà' ka', mɛ̀ lòr buu wɛɛwɛ à buu ce vi ce bʉsi mɛ̀ bʉsi, a ma' vi wɛɛwɛ tɛ m bo yi yà Tata Jisos Krâis, njobè' yì anà a yuu ce yi yu gòr a caa buu wɛɛwɛ. Mɛ̀ bʉsi buu wɛɛwɛ njo' ye. Mɛ̀ lòr vi sè'ni à buu bcicì tɛ m bo ba àbee wèr Krâis,
eng: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

lmp: ba yì ŋwɛ̀, ba yɛɛnì njobè' mɛ̀ byemi nè ye, ke' ba njobè' mɛ̀ lɛ̀ mncir ka'. Yu Nyʉ̀ ce e ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ ba yɛɛnì njo' e byemi.
eng: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith;

lmp: Yuu mo'sir ce m ce ròo yi yu enɛ m riŋ Krâis, ker yɛ yi ŋger ce e m tʉr à nfè' ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe. M ce ròo foŋ mɛnɛ m yɛ ŋgɛ' àmbò e m yɛ, byemi rkwe àmbò e m byemi,
eng: that I may know him, and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death;

lmp: tɛ yi ka' ba àtɛ̀r Nyʉ̀ bo fʉr mɛ̀ efa rkwe, fa mɛ̀ ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

lmp: Yi yu ba enɛ mɛ̀ koni yuu ce mɛ̀ ce ròo à rkonì nà ka', a ke' ba enɛ mɛ̀ buu fàa dʉ̀dʉ̀ ka'. M ku bii ghèter ce dù kùntombì mɛnɛ m bo koni yuu anà, ce yu yuu ce Jisos Krâis à koo mɛ̀ mba yê bò àtu mo.
eng: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, if it is so that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce kwà' mɛnɛ mɛ̀ be koni yuu anà ka', yuu mo'sir yi yu enɛ mɛ̀ mà'shi buu ce vi m càa, a ce dù ba àmbùu yuu ce yi bii kùntombì.
eng: Brothers, I don't regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do. Forgetting the things which are behind, and stretching forward to the things which are before,

lmp: M ce fà' ce dù kùntombì mɛnɛ m bo dù koni blà' embe bùu ce Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' mɛ̀ enɛ e bo fa mɛ̀ njo' yuu ce Jisos Krâis à m gèe.
eng: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Yi bòŋ enɛ sèe ce sèe yu bleebèe à buu Nyʉ̀ sèe tʉr njɛ̀ɛ mkwà'shì ca. Yuu mo' yi ka' ba àgho ce wèe ce kwà'shi jɛɛ banɛ Nyʉ̀ be nàshi yuu anà nè wèe.
eng: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

lmp: Yi ba enɛ sèe ku ce jɛr sè'ni ba njep mkùu ce sèe ce jɛ̀shi njo na.
eng: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let us walk by the same rule. Let us be of the same mind.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe wɛɛwɛ ce be'ni ba yuu ce m ce gèe. Wèr à dùŋshi ndêe mbòŋmboŋ. Wèe be'ni yuu ce bèe ce a bè'ni yèr ndèe anà, a ce gèe.
eng: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

lmp: Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe nfè' àŋgoo, a ker ce suŋ wèe sè'ni nè mŋgoommir-ŋwɛ̀ mɛnɛ bèe magòr a yu a wêe mʉ ce yàp ndèe ce dùŋshi enɛ wowèe a bàa rkwe ce Jisos Krâis à m kwe mbe kìntaa nà.
eng: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

lmp: Wowèe a be kwe, bʉ njobè' wowèe a kòŋ buu ce à nyòr a caa Nyʉ̀. A lòr yuu ce rìtu yi ba koo wowèe àtu mo a beesi à yuu nàatu, a lɛ yap ntee wɛɛwɛ ba njep buu embe tunshe.
eng: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò sèe, lisèe rla' li yu ba mbe bùu mbe dì' ce sèe ce kè' seenɛ yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis be vʉ̀ embo, gèe tɛ sèe lûŋ.
eng: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ;

lmp: E be vʉ̀ bèesi bjàprì nyor visèe ca tɛ vi ba àmbò ku' yì nyor mbòŋmboŋ ce e m tʉr à nfè' ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe nà. Ŋger ce e be gèe yuu ca àgho ku ba ŋger ce àde' e lôr, beesi buu wɛɛwɛ ce à ŋgòŋ na tɛ vi ba njep yê tìi.
eng: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

lmp: Banɛ wèe ku tɛɛ tatap wèe Tata wèe, bfʉr wâ. M kòŋ wèe magòr sê, bkar wâ. Ya ntee yi ce lùu mɛ̀ à ryɛ wèe. Yu wèe ce wèe ce gèe m ce lu'shi, a ce nàa tu nè wèe.
eng: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, so stand firm in the Lord, my beloved.

lmp: M ce loo nè Ɛ̀vodìyà ba Sìntikɛ̀ mɛnɛ wowèe a ba tarte, ba cûu mo'sir njobè' wowèe a tarshi a Tata wèe.
eng: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

lmp: Kyer wɛ̀ Sisigùs ce à yu mini à rfà' ce sò ce fà' àbee, jà' bbyèŋge ca, njobè' wèr wowèe à m ce rè àbee tɛ m bo fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè bèe. Klɛ̂mɛ̀n ye ye à m ce rè wèr ye, ker ba bèe mo' ce a m ce fà' wèr wowèe nà; mlii bèe anà mi yu mbe ŋwà' Ryòŋ.
eng: Yes, I beg you also, true yokefellow, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News, with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

lmp: Wèe ce lu'shi nfè' sìp njobè' wèe yu wèe Tata wèe; m ker ce làa mɛnɛ wèe lu'shi.
eng: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, Rejoice!

lmp: Wèe gee buu wɛɛwɛ à nduunjì ce ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ bo yɛ enɛ wèe yu nè rbornì-ŋwɛ̀. Kuushi nè enɛ nfè' mʉcàr tɛ Tata vʉ̂.
eng: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

lmp: Wèe fa bu' ka'. Yuu yi ka' buu wèe, wèe loo yi ese Nyʉ̀ ker yoŋshi ye àtu mo.
eng: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

lmp: Wèe à ka' gee wa'a, Nyʉ̀ fa wèe rfʉtè ce li càa bfee ŋwɛ̀, ba rfʉtè ce li be ba njep wêe mntee ba njep wêe mkwà'shì njobè' wèe yu àbee wèe Jisos Krâis wèe.
eng: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Banɛ à rmìsì, bfʉr wâ, wèe ce kwa'shi àmbò buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu bbòŋboŋ, a ghɛɛte à buu ce àde' bèe a nɛsì. Buu anà yu buu ce vi yu mini, buu ce vi yu nè fòo-ŋwɛ̀, ce vi yu kùyɛɛ a ba brara, buu ce àde' bèe a kôŋ, buu ce vi ce kè' bbòŋboŋ.
eng: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report; if there is any virtue, and if there is any praise, think about these things.

lmp: Gèe nè buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe à yɛ'ni ese mɛ̀, a koo ese mɛ̀, a yu' ese mɛ̀, a ker yɛ ese mɛ̀ tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ cumʉnyaŋ bo ba wèe wowèe.
eng: The things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me: do these things, and the God of peace will be with you.

lmp: M ce lu'shi magòr àmbò ŋwɛ̀ Tatâ, njobè' mɛ̀ yɛ enɛ wèe à ker kuushi a ja' mɛ̀ àmbò wèe à m ce jà' entòmbì nà. Wèe à m ku ce ne kuushi mɛ̀, a ka' buu ba njì à rjà' mɛ̀.
eng: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly, that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

lmp: Ke' ba enɛ m ce làa njobè' yuu mo' yi buu mɛ̀ ka'; mɛ̀ lɛɛte à rcu, mʉ yì ce mɛ̀ tʉr yi ghɛɛtè mɛ̀.
eng: Not that I speak in respect to lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ yuu ce m gee à nfè' ce buu vi gha' mɛ̀, a riŋ yuu ce m gee à nfè' ce mɛ̀ tʉr buu gòr. Mɛ̀ lɛɛte à buu anà wɛɛwɛ, a tami nyor, ka' à se'kɛ, kɛ̀ mɛ̀ ye ɛ̀, kɛ̀ mɛ̀ ye ka' ɛ̀; kɛ̀ mɛ̀ tʉr ɛ̀, kɛ̀ mɛ̀ tʉr ka' ɛ̀!
eng: I know how to be humbled, and I know also how to abound. In everything and in all things I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

lmp: Àde' m gee buu wɛɛwɛ, ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke fa mɛ̀ ŋger à ka' tɛɛ mbe mɛ̂ njì.
eng: I can do all things through Christ, who strengthens me.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' laa àmbò mɛ̀ làa na, m ku riŋ mɛnɛ wèe à gèe yɛɛnì sê, à rjà' mɛ̀ sè'ni ce m yu à ŋgɛ' na.
eng: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

lmp: Wèe ce bêe à rla' Filèpâi, wèe ku riŋ yɛɛnì enɛ à m ba à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m nàtî à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà a kɛ' a ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nà, cor mò' à m ker ba ce wèr wowèe à m ce tarte mmbo ker caa efa wèe ka'.
eng: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

lmp: Kɛ̂' à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ba à rla' Tɛ̀sàlonikà wèe à m tuusi buu a ja' mɛ̀ àgho bkàŋ àŋgoo.
eng: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

lmp: Yu ba buu ce wèe à m tuusi ce m ce lòr à yuu gòr ka'. Yuu ce m ce lòr à yuu gòr yu ba ku' sɛ' ce wèe be tʉr njo' buu anà.
eng: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

lmp: M ker buu yuu sè'ni ka', m tʉr buu vi ce gha' mɛ̀ gha'. M tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ sè'ni njobè' mɛ̀ koo buu ce wèe a m tuusi nè mɛ̀ mbe bo Ɛ̀pafròditòs. Buu anà yu àmbò njɛ̀ɛ yuu mo' ce yi ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ, a ba àmbò taŋshì ce Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ, a byemi.
eng: But I have all things, and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ku' buu bbòŋboŋ be fa wèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe buu. E be càasi buu anà mbe bo Jisos Krâis.
eng: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Bkù'sì vi ba nè Nyʉ̀ ce yìsèe ta sè'ni ba à nfè' sìp. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

lmp: Cà'ni nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e yu àbee a Jisos Krâis. Bfʉr ce a yu wèr wowèe àfa a cà'ni wèe.
eng: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

lmp: Bèe Nyʉ̀ ce àfa wɛɛwɛ a cà'ni wèe, laŋlaŋ bèe ce a ce fà' mbe ndàp Sisà.
eng: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar's household.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce Nyʉ̀ à ce mɛ̀ enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca wèr Timotì ce e yu nfʉr yìsèe.
eng: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

lmp: Wèr ce saŋ nè wèe ce wèe yu bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à ce, a ce cu à rla' Kòlosì, wèe Jisòs wèe à ba àbee, wèe à ce dù a yê mbùu nè ntee mo'sir. Wèr ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yèr ta enɛ e tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: E ke ba à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce wèr ce loo nè wèe, wèr ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Tàr nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis,
eng: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

lmp: njobè' wèr à yu' enɛ wèe à lɛ̀ ntee nè Jisos Krâis, a ker koŋ bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

lmp: Wèr à rìŋ enɛ wèe à tʉr njɛ̀ɛ ntee ca njobè' wèe ce kè' ba buu ce Nyʉ̀ à kupshi a lɛ nè wèe mbe bùu. À m ba njobè' nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ ce e yu mini ce a m fè'shi, wèe à ka' riŋ àmbò buu ca.
eng: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,

lmp: Nsuŋ anà à bà' à bdì' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na. E gèe bèe a ce kupse yap ŋgêe bebep a ce gèe ba ŋgêe bòŋboŋ. Bèe magòr se a ce byemi nsuŋ ca. Nsuŋ ca à gèe wèe à ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ foŋ kɛ̂' à nòŋ ce wèe à m kɛ̀' yu', a riŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè bêe bbebep.
eng: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;

lmp: Wèe à m yu' nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ anà ese Ɛ̀pafràs ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis àmbò wèr. Wèr kòŋ ye sê. E yu wèe wowèe wa'a, a tɛɛ ba a wêr tù, a ce fà' nè Jisos Krâis nè ntêe mo'sir.
eng: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,

lmp: E suŋ wèr àmbò njɛ̀ɛ njì ce wèe kòŋ bèe nè rkòŋnì ce li lò ese Yʉ' Nyʉ̀.
eng: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

lmp: A mbùu ce kɛ̂' à nòŋ ce wèr à m yu' buu ca, wèr à be borni efa rloo nè wèe à nfè' mò' ka'. Wèr ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ enɛ e gee tɛ wèe koni bfee ce vi lò ese yi Yʉ', rìŋ buu ce yu vi wɛɛwɛ, tɛ wèe bo rìŋ buu ce e kòŋ bòŋboŋ.
eng: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don't cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,

lmp: Wèe à ka' riŋ wa'a, banɛ wèe be tʉr ndèe ce bèe Tata Jisòs a ba tʉr, gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, kèr rìŋ buu ce yu vi Nyʉ̀ gòr.
eng: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;

lmp: Wèr ce loo foŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ lor yi ŋger ce yi càa buu wɛɛwɛ gee tɛ wèe tʉr ntee tatap, ka' à ka' ba ba kɛ, tɛ wèe bo kur ntee, tɛɛ tatap kèr ce lu'shi,
eng: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;

lmp: ce yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ Tàr ce e yu yìsèe ta à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yu ye ce e gèe wèe à ghɛɛtè à rkoni ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa buu ce e kupshi a lɛ nè yì bèe mbe dî' kʉʉ ce yu dî' rraa.
eng: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;

lmp: E fʉr sèe efa tʉ̀'njì, a lor sèe a lɛ ba à dì' ce muu yì ce e kòŋ se nà ce sa' àmbò ŋkʉʉ.
eng: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;

lmp: Muu yì anà a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe Nyʉ̀ à foosì yìsèe buu bbebep, a tee sèe efa ŋgɛ'.
eng: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m be yɛ Nyʉ̀ nè mmir ka'. Muu yì ce bèe a yɛ nè mmir, a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe sèe à riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ yu. E yu entòmbì nè buu wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe.
eng: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu wɛɛwɛ njì enjep ye, kɛ̀ yu buu embe bùu ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu vì enjep ŋgòŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu buu ce àde' bèe a yɛ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu buu ce àde' bèe a yɛ ka' ɛ̀, buu ca wɛɛwɛ yu àgho njo' Jisos Krâis. Ka' byʉ' njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce vi tʉr ŋger ɛ̀, Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu ca wɛɛwɛ nè muu yì, njì enjep muu yì anà.
eng: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce yuu mo' yi m be ba ka', muu anà à ku ba. Buu wɛɛwɛ yu àmbò vi ba ba njo' ye.
eng: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

lmp: E yu tu nè côr. Cor anà à ba yì nyor. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kɛ̀' cor à m kɛ̀' ye njobè' e m ba ŋwɛ̀ entombì à rfʉʉ efa rkwe nè nyor ce àde' e ker kwe ka'. Buu ca yu wa'a tɛ e bo ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e tɛɛ kùntombì nè buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe enɛ buu ca ba wa'a njobè' e m kòŋ enɛ muu yì ba yɛɛnì àmbò ye ye yu nà à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;

lmp: E m kòŋ enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce e m gèe kɛ̀ yu vì embe bùu ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu vì enjep ŋgòŋ ɛ̀, a kʉti àbee njì enjep muu yì. À ka' ba njo' rkwe ce muu yì anà à m kwe mbe kìntaa, Nyʉ̀ à gee buu enjep ŋgòŋ ba vì embe bùu, vi kʉtì bkar a ye, a cu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' wèe à ba ànjìsàp ese Nyʉ̀, a ba ŋgâa bbàa nè ye, njobè' wèe à m ce kwà'shi buu bbebep, a ce gèe buu bbebep.
eng: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' e sè'ni Nyʉ̀ à gee wèe wowèe à kʉtì bkar njo' rkwe ce muu yì ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ à m kwe a sêe tù nà. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wa'a, tɛ e bo tɛr wèe a yê bsii àmbò yì bèe ce a yu brara, a tʉr fàa ka'.
eng: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without blemish and blameless before him,

lmp: Wèe be tɛɛ à bsii Nyʉ̀ wa'a, ce wèe ka' ku lɛ ntee nè Jisos krâis à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, tɛɛ tatap kè' ce cì'ti ka', kù ce kè' ba buu ce bèe ce a m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca nè wèe a m suŋ wèe enɛ wèe be koni nà. Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca yu ba nsuŋ ce a fè'shi nè bèe wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na. Rfà' ce mɛ mɛ̂ Pol ce gèe foŋ li yu enɛ m suŋ Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca nè bèe.
eng: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

lmp: Àmbò m ce yɛ ŋgɛ' a wêe btù sè'ni na, m ce lu'shi. M ce yɛ ŋgɛ' àmbò Jisos Krâis à m yɛ àtu cor ce e yu yì nyor nà. M ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ca wa'a, ryaŋ ce m ce yu' li ce mìsi ŋgɛ' ce Jisòs à m yɛ, e bɛtì nà.
eng: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body's sake, which is the assembly;

lmp: La rfà' li yu enɛ m fa' nè côr. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa rfà' ca mba mɛ̂ mmbò tɛ m bo jà' wèe. Yu ya dì' enɛ m gee tɛ bèe a riŋ Nsuŋ Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ.
eng: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,

lmp: A m sʉ̀ti nsuŋ anà ese bèe wɛɛwɛ. À ka' ba à nfè' e sè'ni, Nyʉ̀ à gee yì bèe a rîŋ.
eng: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kòŋ enɛ e gee tɛ yì bèe a yɛ enɛ rbòŋ efa nsuŋ ce e càa buu wɛɛwɛ na li yu nè bèe enje jɛɛ foŋ. Nsuŋ ce e gèe sèe à riŋ na yu enɛ Jisos Krâis yu njep wêe mntee, yi ka' ba wa'a, wèe à riŋ enɛ wèe be koni ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa fòo Nyʉ̀.
eng: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;

lmp: Wèr ce suŋ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ àmbò Jisòs ca. Wèr ce bɛɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ, a ker ce lòr bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à fa wèr a ce yɛ'ni bèe àmbò Jisos Krâis tɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e yu àbee a Jisòs bo ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ e ba ba.
eng: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce ghèter, a ce fà' nè ŋger wɛɛwɛ ce Jisos Krâis à fa mɛ̀ tɛ m bo mìsi li rfà' àgho.
eng: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

lmp: M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe riŋ àmbò m ce ghèter nè wèe, ker ba bêe à rla' Làodisìyà ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèr wowèe à m be tarte ka'.
eng: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you, and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

lmp: Mɛ̀ kòŋ enɛ wee mntee vi ba btatap tɛ wèe koŋ bfʉr wee, ba àbee wèe wowèe. M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ yuu ce yi m ba à bsʉ̀ti, Nyʉ̀ à gee sèe à riŋ nà, yi ba rara nè wèe tɛ wèe bo rìŋ yi bòŋboŋ. Yuu ce yi m ba à bsʉ̀ti anà yu nsuŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis.
eng: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe sèe à tʉr bfee bbòŋboŋ ku ba Jisòs cà'cà'. Njɛ̀ɛ bfee ca vi tʉr sɛ' sê.
eng: in whom are all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge hidden.

lmp: M ce suŋ wèe buu ca fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo bo' wee nè cùu ka'.
eng: Now this I say that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

lmp: Ka' m yu ànjìsàp wa'a, sèe ku ba àbee enjep ntee. M ce lu'shi njobè' mɛ̀ yu' mɛnɛ wèe yu àbee, a ku tɛɛ tatap à rbyemì ce wèe à m byemi nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet am I with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

lmp: Wèe à byemi Jisos Krâis àmbò ye Tatâ, banɛ wèe ce gee ba ŋgèe ce bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Jisos Krâis a ba ce gèe.
eng: As therefore you received Christ Jesus, the Lord, walk in him,

lmp: Taa nè mŋgàŋ njep ye, ku' njep ye, tɛɛ tatap à rbyemì ce a m yɛ'ni wèe nà, ker ce yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: rooted and built up in him, and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

lmp: Lòr nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe nè bfee enjep ŋgòŋ na, koo wèe à bkwàa ka'. Ndèe to' ker ba mncir ce byʉ' bebep vi lɛ̀, a buu ce vi vʉ̀ nè njɛ̀ɛ bfee ca. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e fa bèe njɛ̀ɛ bfee ca à fa Jisos Krâis ka'.
eng: Be careful that you don't let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elements of the world, and not after Christ.

lmp: Rìŋ nè enɛ Jisos Krâis ce e yu ŋwɛ̀, yu yɛɛnì a Nyʉ̀ à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For in him all the fullness of the Godhead dwells bodily,

lmp: Rìŋ nè enɛ wèe Jisos Krâis wèe ka' ba àbee, wèe tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ njobè' e yu tu nè byʉ' wɛɛwɛ ce vi tʉr ŋger.
eng: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power;

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce wèe Jisos Krâis wèe à m ba àbee nà, Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe njɛ̀ɛ ncòo mò' ce e ce dùŋshi enɛ wèe yu yì bèe. Ncòo anà yu ba bʉ̀ ce a gèe nè mmbo àmbò Jus a ce gèe nà ka', yu ba njɛ̀ɛ ncòo yì Jisos Krâis. Njɛ̀ɛ ncòo ca yu ba ncòo enjep ntee, ce e yu enɛ wèe bii gèe buu bbebep àmbò wèe à m ce gèe nà ka'.
eng: in whom you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ;

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce a m bàptir wèe, yi duŋshì enɛ a tuŋ wèe Jisos Krâis wèe àbee. À m ba à nfè' anà foŋ Nyʉ̀ à fʉr wèe Jisos Krâis wèe efa rkwe. E m gèe wa'a njobè' wèe à m byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e m fʉr Jisos Krâis efa rkwe, tʉr ŋger à rfʉr wèe efa rkwe foŋ.
eng: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' entombì wèe à ba àmbò bgʉ̂ʉ bèe wa'a, njobè' wèe à m ce gèe buu bbebep, a ke' tʉr ncòo ce yu ba ncòo bèe Nyʉ̀ ka'. Sèe Jisos Krâis wèe à ka' ba àbee, Nyʉ̀ à foosì sèe efa yìsèe buu bbebep wɛɛwɛ, a gee sèe à kʉtì btèe sèe Jisos Krâis wèe.
eng: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

lmp: Sèe à m bʉ' mncir Nyʉ̀, sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe à tʉr mnsa', Nyʉ̀ à ca'sì buu bbebep ca embe sêe tù. E m cà'si wa'a, yi ba sè'ni enɛ e lɛ̀ mbe tu Jisòs à nfè' ce a m taa ye mbe kìntaa nà.
eng: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us; and he has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross;

lmp: Jisos Krâis à m kwe mbe kìntaa wa'a, a so byʉ' bbebep wɛɛwɛ ce vi tʉr ŋger, a duŋshi nè bèe rara se enɛ e tʉr ŋger a caa byʉ' ca.
eng: having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

lmp: Àmbò buu ca yu wa'a, fa mà'shi nè tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' gee mncir nè wèe àmbò buu ce àde' wèe ye, ker ba buu ce àde' wèe no ka'. Fa mà'shi nè foŋ tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' gee mncir nè wèe àmbò njɛ̀ɛ njì ce àde' wèe gee mŋkà' ka', kɛ̀ yu ŋkà' enjep fè' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu Ŋkâ' ŋwɛɛ fi ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu Ŋkâ' mmbomntaa ɛ̀.
eng: Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

lmp: Buu ca vi m ba àmbò rlèŋshi ce li m ce dùŋshi bèe yuu ce yi be kè ba. Yuu ce buu ca vi m ce dùŋshi anà à ba Jisos Krâis.
eng: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ's.

lmp: Fa yu'shi yuu ce bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ wèe lor wee mnyor njep nshè, a ker ce làa enɛ wèe gʉ'shi nè bcìndap Nyʉ̀ nà ka'. Wowèe a ce làa wa'a, a ce bepsi wèe bepsi. Njɛ̀ɛ bèe anà a ce làa enɛ Nyʉ̀ à gèe wowèe a yɛ rlo. Wowèe a làa wa'a, a ce nàa ba tu à cicì, bfee wap à ba bfee enjep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: Let no one rob you of your prize by a voluntary humility and worshipping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

lmp: Cena yi ce dùŋshi enɛ wowèe ker ba Jisos Krâis ce e yu yisèe tu, a yu àbee ka'. Ku ba ba bèe ce a yu àbee a Jisos Krâis wèe, ce a yu àbee à nyor mò'sir, a koni byee, a ce kù' àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ.
eng: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God's growth.

lmp: Àmbò wèe rìŋ wɛɛ enɛ wèe Jisos Krâis wèe à kwe àbee, banɛ byʉ' bbebep enjep ŋgòŋ na vi ker tʉr ŋger mbe wêe ndù ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèe à ce lɛ̀ mncir ce bèe a làa enɛ wèe lɛ njokɛ?
eng: If you died with Christ from the elements of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

lmp: Wowèe a ce làa nè wèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa gèe cena ka', wèe fa ye cena ka', wèe fa jòo cena ka'."
eng: Don't handle, nor taste, nor touch

lmp: Mncir ca à lɛ̀ ba bèe, a lɛ ba à buu ce vi be cu nfesè ka'.
eng: all of which perish with use, according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ mncir ca vi lò gee bèe a yu'nì àgho, lor wap mnyor njep nshè ker fa ŋgɛ' nè yàp nyor. E ba à nfè' ce bèe a kɛ̀' ce lɛ̀ mncir anà yi yɛɛtì àmbò vi gèe bèe a tʉr lɛ bfee wa'a, vi banì tʉr ŋger à rjà' ŋwɛ̀ tɛ e borni yuu ce yì nyor ce kòŋ enɛ e gee ka'.
eng: Which things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, and humility, and severity to the body; but aren't of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à gee wèe à fʉʉ efa rkwe wèe Jisòs Krâis wèe, banɛ wèe lɛ ntee ba à buu embe bùu, mbe dì' Jisos Krâis yu, a cu à rkoo mà' Nyʉ̀.
eng: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

lmp: Kù ce kwa'shi nè ba àmbò buu embe bùu, ke' ba àmbò buu enjep ŋgòŋ ka'.
eng: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

lmp: Wèe kwa'shi wa'a njobè' wèe à m kwe, le ryòŋ li ba njep Jisos Krâis ce e yu a Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à kupshì ryòŋ anà a lɛ nè wèe.
eng: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

lmp: Le ryòŋ yu Jisos Krâis. Be kè ba à nfè' ce e nyɛɛ, tɛ wèe wowèe ba àbee, tɛ wèe tʉr ŋgʉ̀' mò' efa fòo ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè ye.
eng: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

lmp: Banɛ wèe borni njɛ̀ɛ buu ce wèe à m ce gèe à nfè' wèe à m ce cu ba rcu enjep ŋgòŋ na nà. Lòr nè buu anà àmbò buu ce vi kwe wa'a. Mà'shi nè bsàkì ba mkɛ'ni, borni ŋgêe bebep wɛɛwɛ, ba mkwà'shî mmbembep. Fa bàŋ mmir à buu ka', njobè' à ka' ce bàŋ mmir à buu banɛ wɛ̀ lòr buu anà àmbò yu Nyʉ̀ wa'a.
eng: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry;

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ buu bbebep ca vi gèe Nyʉ̀ ce ko'si rshentee nè bèe.
eng: for which things' sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' entombì wèe à ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca, njɛ̀ɛ mkwà'shì à rgèe buu ca mi tʉr ŋger mbe wêe ndù.
eng: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them;

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni ce wèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu àbee na, banɛ wèe borni ŋgêe bebep. Fa ba ŋwɛ̀ rshentee kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ncɛpntee ka'. Fa kwà'shi bebep àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Fa ba ŋwɛ̀ mnsa'ni ka'. Fa mà'shi tɛ blâa bbebep vi fʉʉ eku wɛ̂ cùu ka'.
eng: but now you also put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

lmp: Fa nya' nè mnde' nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', njobè' wèe à mà' ye ŋgêe rʉ̀ʉ ce wèe à m ce gèe nà,
eng: Don't lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

lmp: a lor sè'ni ba ŋgêe fi. Nyʉ̀ ce e m boo wèe à bêe bfi ca ce kupshi ye ŋgèe ca tɛ yi bo ba àmbò ŋgèe yi, tɛ wèe bo rìŋ ye bòŋboŋ.
eng: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

lmp: À ka ba njobè' wèe à tʉr ba ŋgêe fi sè'ni na, jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ker ba fa wêe mʉ ka'. Jus a yu jɛɛ efa bèe enje jɛɛ ka'. Bèe ce a gèe bʉ̀ a yu jɛɛ efa bèe ce a yu mbɛ̀'nsʉ̀r ka'. Ŋwɛ̂ à rìŋ yu jɛɛ ka'. Nfuu bkà' a yu jɛɛ ka. Jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ yu àgho mbetar bkwàa ba boo ka'. Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ku ba byɛɛnì njobè' a ce yɛ sè'ni ba Jisos Krâis, à ba ye ce e tʉr bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: where there can't be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, freeman; but Christ is all, and in all.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ce wèe enɛ wèe ba yì bèe. E kòŋ wèe sê. Banɛ wèe gee ba ŋgèe ce yi dùŋshi enɛ wèe yu yì bèe. Ce koosi nè mnse nè bèe mo', gee ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè wowèe. Lòr nè wee mnyor njep nshè, ba nè rbonì- ŋwɛ̀, ker kur ntee.
eng: Put on therefore, as God's chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

lmp: Fa bepsi nè ntee cɛrcɛr ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' gee yuu bebep nè wèe, wèe foosì ye. Tata Jisòs à fòosi wèe efa yè buu bbebep, banɛ wèe foosi bèe mo' foŋ.
eng: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu lulu sê, yi yu enɛ wèe koŋ bèe, njobè' rkòŋnì a yuu ce yi kur buu ca wɛɛwɛ àbee, tɛ wèe bo ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ wèe ba.
eng: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

lmp: Yɛ nè enɛ cumʉnyaŋ ce e lò ese Jisos Krâis ba njep wêe mntee à buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce gèe, njobè' Nyʉ̀ à kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe ba àbee àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀. Ce yoŋshi nè Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body; and be thankful.

lmp: Yɛ nè enɛ blâa Jisòs vi cu njep wêe mntee à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Lòr bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à fa wèe, yɛ'ni ker cep àgho. Ku'si Nyʉ̀ nè byɛɛ njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Wee yòp wa'a, wèe ce yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ enjep ntee.
eng: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce gèe, kɛ̀ wèe ce làa ɛ̀, gèe nè buu anà wɛɛwɛ ba à rlii Tata Jisòs, ker ce yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ Tàr a yê rlii.
eng: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father, through him.

lmp: Bbyèŋgê, yu'ni nè nè bduu wee àmbò bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Tata Jisòs a ba gèe.
eng: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

lmp: Mmbaŋrù, kòŋ nè wee bbyèŋge. Fa nyʉ̀' nè wowèe ka'.
eng: Husbands, love your wives, and don't be bitter against them.

lmp: Bôo, yu'ni nè nè wêe bta ba wêe mma à buu wɛɛwɛ, njobè' wèe ka' ce gèe wa'a, Tata yu' rbòŋ.
eng: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

lmp: Btar boo, wèe fa gèe ŋgèe à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce ntee yi lo yaŋ boo wee tɛ bsɛ̀ vi lo koo wowèe ka'.
eng: Fathers, don't provoke your children, so that they won't be discouraged.

lmp: Bkwàa, yu'ni nè nè wee mmasà enjep ŋgòŋ na. Wèe fa kù ce fà' ba à nfè' ce wowèe a ce yɛ wèe tɛ wowèe a bo yu' rbòŋ nè wèe ka'. Fà' nè nè wowèe nè ntêe mo'sir njobè' wèe ce wɛp Tata Nyʉ̀.
eng: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

lmp: Wèe ka' ce gèe ba njɛ̀ɛ kɛ, wèe gee nè ye ntee wɛɛwɛ njobè' wèe ce gèe yuu anà ba nè ŋwɛ̀ ka, wèe ce gèe ba nè Tata Jisòs.
eng: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord, and not for men,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu yè masà yu Tata Jisos Krâis. E be kè là' wèe. E be kè fa wèe buu ce e kupshi a lɛ nè yì bèe.
eng: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ be là' bèe ce a ce gèe buu bbebep à buu bbebep anà. E ke so'niŋgòŋ ka'.
eng: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

lmp: Mmasà, gèe nè ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè wee bkwàa. Kuushi nè enɛ wee wèe tʉr masà ce e yu mbe bùu.
eng: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

lmp: Wèe ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Wee loo, wèe ce kwa'shi ba à yuu ce wèe ce loo anà, ce yoŋshi ye à buu wɛɛwɛ ce e gèe nè wèe.
eng: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching therein with thanksgiving;

lmp: Loo nè nè wèr tɛ wèr bo koni njì à rsuŋ nsuŋ ce e m ba à bsʉ̀ti àmbò Jisos Krâis nà, nè bèe. M yu mbe shaŋ sè'ni na njobè' mɛ̀ m ce suŋ nsuŋ anà nè bèe.
eng: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds;

lmp: Loo nè enɛ Nyʉ̀ ja' mɛ̀ tɛ m gee tɛ bèe a riŋ nsuŋ anà bòŋboŋ àmbò mɛ̀ ba gèe.
eng: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

lmp: Wèe ka' cu wèe bèe ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì ka', wèe cu nè bfee-ŋwɛ. Wèe fa mà'shi tɛ nfè' ce wèe yu wèe wowèe anà bʉ à cicì ka'.
eng: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

lmp: Yɛ nè enɛ wee blàa vi yu bbòŋboŋ, a ker ce lèe àmbò mgwaŋ wa'a. Ŋwɛ̀ ka' bipshi yuu nè wèe, wèe ghetèr beesi ye à njî mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

lmp: Tikikòs be suŋ wèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi koni mɛ̀. E yu nfʉr ce wèr kòŋ ye sê. E ce gèe rfà' Tata Nyʉ̀ nè yi ntee wɛɛwɛ. Wèr ye ce fà' nè Tata Jisòs àbee.
eng: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

lmp: Mɛ̂ tuu ye enɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe tɛ e bo suŋ wèe àmbò wèr yu, kèr fa wèe ŋger foŋ.
eng: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

lmp: Yùnismòs ce e yu muu wèe à vʉ̀ a ye. E yu nfʉr ce wèr kòŋ sê. E ce dù àmbùu Jisòs nè yi ntee wɛɛwɛ. Wowèe a be suŋ wèe buu ce vi koni wèr àfa wɛɛwɛ.
eng: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

lmp: Àristakòs ce wèr ye yu mbe shaŋ, à cà'ni wèe. Mak ce e yu nfʉr Bànabàs à cà'ni wèe foŋ. Mɛ̀ fa wèe ncep àmbò Mak wɛɛ. Mɛ̀ suŋ wèe enɛ e ka' vʉ̂, wèe konì ye bòŋboŋ.
eng: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas concerning whom you received commandments, if he comes to you, receive him,

lmp: Jisòs ce a too li rlii mo' enɛ Jostòs à cà'ni wèe foŋ. Ku ba bèe a mntaar ca ce a yu Jus à mʉ̀ bèe ce wèr wowèe ce fà'. Wèr wowèe ce fà' wa'a tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ àmbò kʉʉ Nyʉ̀. Wowèe a fa mɛ̀ ŋger magòr sê.
eng: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for the Kingdom of God who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

lmp: Ɛ̀pafràs ce e yu muu wèe, a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis, à cà'ni wèe. E ce loo nè wèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ gee tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap, ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ wèe à ba ba, rìŋ buu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ wèe à ba gèe, gèe buu anà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ nè ma mmir enɛ e ce fà' tatap sê, tɛ e bo jà' wèe, jà' bêe à rla' Làodisìyà ker ba bêe à rla' Hìrapolìs.
eng: For I testify about him, that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

lmp: Luk ce wèr kòŋ sê, ce e ke fa bèe mcɛ̀p nà, ker ba Dimàs, a cà'ni wèe.
eng: Luke, the beloved physician, and Demas greet you.

lmp: Cà'ni nè bfʉr ce à rla' Làodisìyà nè mɛ̀, ker ca'ni Nimfà ba bèe ce a ke niŋ cor mbe yê ndàp nà foŋ.
eng: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, and Nymphas, and the assembly that is in his house.

lmp: Wee bè' ŋwà' ca, wèe tuusì nè cor ce à rla' Làodisìyà tɛ wowèe a bo bè' foŋ. Wee wèe be' ŋwà' ce mɛ̀ tuusi nè cor ce à rla' Làodisìyà nà foŋ.
eng: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans; and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

lmp: Làa nè nè Àkibòs enɛ e ce gee rfà' ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè ye enɛ e gee nà.
eng: Tell Archippus, Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.

lmp: À saŋ mɛ̂ Pôl, a saŋ rcà'ni ca nè ya bo. Kuushi nè yà ŋgɛ' ce m ce yɛ mbe shaŋ. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The salutation of me, Paul, with my own hand: remember my bonds. Grace be with you. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pôl, ba Silàs ba Timotì nè ŋgâa cor ce a yu à rla' Tɛ̀sàlonikà. Bèe ca yu bèe Nyʉ̀ Tàr, a ker ba bèe Jisos Krâis foŋ. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Wer ke loo à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce kuushi wèe ker ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ njo' wèe.
eng: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

lmp: Wer ke loo nè Tata Nyʉ̀ wa'a ce kuushi njɛ̀ɛ rbyemì ce wèe à tʉr nè Jisos Krâis, a ce fà' àgho. Wer ke loo wa'a ce kuushi mfà' ce wèe ce gèe njo' le rbyemì, ba le rkòŋnì ce wèe tʉr nè Jisos Krâis, a ker ce kuushi àmbò wèe à tɛɛ tatap a ce kè' nfè' ce e be vʉ̀.
eng: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and patience of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

lmp: Bfʉr wêr, wèr rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ wèe, a ce wèe.
eng: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

lmp: Wèr rìŋ wa'a njobè' wèr à m ku fe'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca nè wèe ba nè cùu cà' ka'. Wèr à m fè'shi nè wèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀ à ŋger Yʉ' Rara, a riŋ enɛ yuu ce wèr ce làa yi yu mini. Wèe rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ rcu ce wèr à m ce cu a wêe mʉ. Wèr à m ce cu wa'a njo' wèe.
eng: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit, and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

lmp: Wèe à m koni yuu ce wèr à m ce gèe, a koni yuu ce Tata Jisòs à m ce gèe. Ka' a m fa wèe ŋgɛ' gòr wa'a, wèe à m ku yu' blàa ca a byemi, Yʉ' Rara yi gee wèe à ce lu'shi.
eng: You became imitators of us, and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

lmp: Wèe à ka' byemi wa'a, a ba rdùŋshì nè ŋgâa rbyemì ce à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà ba à ŋgôŋ Àkayà.
eng: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

lmp: Blàa àmbò Tata ce vi lò ese wèe vi ku ba' ba à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà ba à ŋgôŋ Àkayà ka', bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ a yu' àmbò le rbyemì ce wèe tʉr nè Nyʉ̀. Yi ka' ba wa'a, yuu mo' ce àde' wèr ker suŋ bèe àmbò wèe yi yu ka'.
eng: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out; so that we need not to say anything.

lmp: Bèe a ce suŋ àmbò wèe à m koni wèr à nfè' ce wèr à m vʉ̀ ca'ni wèe nà. A ce suŋ foŋ àmbò wèe à m mà'shi mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na a ce fà' ba nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe, à ba Nyʉ̂ mini,
eng: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you; and how you turned to God from idols, to serve a living and true God,

lmp: a ker ce kè' nfè' ce muu yì be sùu embe bùu. Muu yì anà yu Jisòs ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe, à ba ye ce e be fʉr sèe efa ku' ŋgɛ' ce e be vʉ̀ à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à sa' ŋgòŋ ca.
eng: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead--Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wee wèe à rìŋ enɛ rcà'nì ce wèr à m vʉ̀ ca'ni wèe nà li m ba à cicì ka'.
eng: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn't in vain,

lmp: Wèe rìŋ wɛɛ àmbò wèr a m yɛ ŋgɛ', bèe a jar nè wèr à rla' Filèpâi. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, wèr à m kur ntee à ŋger yèr Nyʉ̀ a suŋ wèe Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce e lò ba ese ye, ka' bèe à m ker ku jepsi wèr se wa'a.
eng: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

lmp: Wèr à ka' vʉ̀ yɛ wèe, a ce fè'shi ànji kɛ̀ nè ntee sii ka', a ce bo' ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m yɛ enɛ wèr à ghɛɛte, a ka' fa Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca mba wêr mmbò. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèr à ce fè'shi blàa ca tɛ nyor bo bòŋ ŋwɛ̀ ka'; wer ce fè'shi tɛ nyor bo bòŋ ba Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fyɛ' wer mntee.
eng: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak; not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ bòŋboŋ enɛ wèr à m vʉ̀ tɛ wèr bo bu' cùu koni yuu ese wèe ka'. Wèr à m vʉ̀ tɛ wèr bo bo' bèe, koni bkù' ka'. Nyʉ̀ rìŋ wa' foŋ.
eng: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness God is witness,

lmp: Wèr à m ce ròo enɛ bèe a ku'si wèr ka', ka' wèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ bèe mo' ɛ̀, wèr à m ce ròo wa' ka'.
eng: nor seeking glory from men neither from you nor from others, when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

lmp: À m ku ba yer dì' enɛ wèr à m ba làa enɛ wèe nɛsi wèr njobè' wèr yu ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. Wèr à ka' ba a wêe mʉ, a ba ba àmbò ma muu ce e ke gɛ' nè boo vi nà.
eng: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

lmp: Wèr à m ka' bà kòŋ wèe wa'a, a ke' koŋ enɛ wèr ku suŋ wèe ba Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀ ka', wèr à m kòŋ à rfa wer mnyor nè wèe foŋ, njobè' wèr à m kòŋ wèe sê.
eng: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you, not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe ku bii ce kuushi njɛ̀ɛ mfà' ce wèr à m ce gèe à nfè' sèe à m ba wèr à ce suŋ Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wèe nà. Wèr à m ce fà' nètʉ' ba nèmootì fà dì' wèr bo ba ntɛ̀r nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ àmbò Nyʉ̀ ye ye rìŋ foŋ nà enɛ yer ŋgèe ce wèr à m ce gèe nè wèe ce wèe à byemi, yi m ba yɛɛnì. Wèr à m gèe yuu bebep ka'.
eng: You are witnesses with God, how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

lmp: Wèe ku bii ce kuushi enɛ wèr à m gɛ' nè wèe àmbò tar muu e ke gɛ' nè boo vi nà.
eng: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

lmp: Wèr à m làa ba buu ce vi fa wèe ŋger kèr gèe tɛ wee mntee vi ce fʉte. Wèr à m cep wèe enɛ wèe gee ba ŋgèe ce Nyʉ̂ kòŋ. Ku ba ye ce e kɛ' wèe tɛ wèe bo ye rbòŋ ba fòo efa yi kʉʉ.
eng: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

lmp: Mbùu mò' ce wer ke yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ yu njobè' wèr à m fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wèe, wèe à yu' a byemi. Wèe à m byemi enɛ blàa ca à m ba blâa ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', à m ba ba blâa Nyʉ̀. Yi yu mini wa'a. Wèe à ka' ce byemi blàa ca wa'a, vi ce kupsè me myòŋ.
eng: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing, that, when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but, as it is in truth, the word of God, which also works in you who believe.

lmp: Yuu ce yi m koni wèe, ku ba yuu ce yi m koni ŋgâa cor ce a yu à ŋgôŋ Jùdiyà, ce a yu bèe Jisos Krâis. Yè bèe a m fa wèe ŋgɛ' àmbò Jus a m fa wowèe ŋgɛ' foŋ nà.
eng: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews;

lmp: Jus ca yu bèe ce a m yʉ Tata Jisòs, a ker yʉshi ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀. Wowèe a m fa wèr ŋgɛ', a juu wèr, a ce gèe ŋgèe ce yi bòŋ Nyʉ̀ ka', a ker baa bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and didn't please God, and are contrary to all men;

lmp: Wowèe a m ce jepsi wèr efa rfè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè bèe enje jɛɛ. A m ce gèe wa'a a ce jepsi bèe enje jɛɛ anà efa ryu' nsuŋ ce e be gèe tɛ wowèe a lûŋ. Àmbò wowèe a ce gèe wa' nà, yàp buu bbebep à ku ce kù'. À ka' ba àlʉ̀simbùu Nyʉ̀ à ma' ŋgɛ' mbe wâp ndù.
eng: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved; to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, kɛ̂' à nfè' wèr à m vʉ̀ ca'ni wèe, sèe à lo a gàpni nà, nfè' à be du se ka. Sèe à m gàpni ba enjep ntee ka, sèe à m ku gapni ba efa nyòr. Wèr à canì efa ryɛ wèe, a ce kòŋ se enɛ wèr à ba vʉ̀ tɛ sèe ker yɛni.
eng: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season, in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

lmp: Wèr à m ghèter se enɛ wèr à ba koni fɛŋ vʉ̀ cà'ni wèe. Mɛ̂ Pôl, mɛ̀ ghetèr nfè' àŋgoo sê, Satàn à ka' jepsi wèr efa rvʉ̀.
eng: because we wanted to come to you--indeed, I, Paul, once and again--but Satan hindered us.

lmp: Yuu ce àde' wèr kwa'shì àgho, lu'shi àgho, ker naatu àgho kùntombì nè yìsèe Tata Jisòs à nfè' ce e be vʉ̀ nà, yu ba kɛ caa efa wèe?
eng: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn't it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

lmp: Wèe yu bèe ce wèr be nàa tu, kèr lu'shi àgho à nfè' anà.
eng: For you are our glory and our joy.

lmp: Wèr à ka' càni à ryɛ wèe gòr wa'a, a moo à rcu làr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wèr à kwa'shì enɛ wèr be tuu Timotì tɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe tɛ wèr ku di' bòŋlàr cu à rla' Atɛ̀n. Timotì yu nfʉr wèr ce wèr wowèe e ke fà' nè Nyʉ̀. Ye ye e ke fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis nè bèe. Wèr à tuu ye enɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe tɛ e bo fa wèe ŋger, gèe tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap njep le rbyemì,
eng: Therefore, when we couldn't stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

lmp: fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ lo jep njo' ŋgɛ' ce bèe a ce fa wèe na ka'. Wèe à rìŋ foŋ enɛ ŋgɛ' ca yu ŋgɛ' ce e be kù ba nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a byemi nè Jisòs.
eng: that no one be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

lmp: Wèr à m suŋ wèe wɛɛ à nfè' ce sèe à m ba nà enɛ ŋgɛ' be koni. Wèe à riŋ foŋ enɛ ŋgɛ' anà à koni wèe wɛɛ.
eng: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

lmp: A mbùu ce mɛ̀ tuu Timotì enɛ e vʉ yɛ wèe. Mɛ̀ tuu ye enɛ e vʉ yɛ enɛ wèe ku tɛɛ tatap njep le rbyemì lɛ. Mɛ̀ gèe wa'a njobè' mɛ̀ kwà'shi àmbò buu ce vi koni wèe na, vi caa ya ŋger, mɛ̀ riŋ àmbò m ku cu wa' ka'. Mɛ̀ m ce wɛp mɛnɛ seemò' Satàn à mòoshi wèe gòr sê, tɛ yi lo ba sè'ni enɛ rfà' ce wèr à m gèe li bʉ à cicì.
eng: For this cause I also, when I couldn't stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

lmp: Timotì à kʉti a vʉ a yɛ wèr a suŋ wèr nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ. E suŋ wèr enɛ le rbyemì li ku bii tatap, wèe à ku koŋ Nyʉ̀ àmbò wèe à m kòŋ nà. E suŋ foŋ enɛ wèe tʉr wèr à ntee bòŋboŋ, a ce kòŋ à ryɛ wèr àmbò wèr ce kòŋ à ryɛ wèe foŋ nà.
eng: But when Timothy came just now to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you;

lmp: Bfʉr wêr, àmbò yi yu wa' sè'ni na, wèr ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ce wèr ce yɛ na, ce yu' ryaŋ ce wèr ce yu' na, wèr ce yu' rbòŋ nè wèe, ntee yi fʉte wèr njobè' wèe ku tɛɛ tatap njep le rbyemì.
eng: for this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

lmp: Àmbò wèr à rìŋ sè'ni enɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap njep Tata na, wèr be cu sè'ni yɛɛnì.
eng: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à gèe wèr à ce yu' rbòŋ à njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèe yu sê. Wèr à rìŋ àmbò àde' wèr yoŋshì ye ka'.
eng: For what thanksgiving can we render again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God;

lmp: Wèr ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ nètʉ' ba nèmootì enɛ e fa wèr fɛŋ tɛ wèr vʉ̂, tɛ sèe yɛni, tɛ wèr yɛ'ni wèe buu mò' ce wèe à be riŋ ka' nà, tɛ le rbyemì li bo ruusi.
eng: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face, and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

lmp: Wèr ce loo enɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Ta ker ba Tata Jisòs, gee tɛ wèr koni fɛŋ vʉ̀ yɛ wèe.
eng: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you;

lmp: Tɛ Tata Jisòs gee tɛ rkòŋnì ce wèe tʉr a wêe mʉ nà, li du kùntombì, ker gee tɛ wèe koŋ bèe wɛɛwɛ àmbò wèr à kòŋ wèe foŋ nà.
eng: and the Lord make you to increase and abound in love one toward another, and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

lmp: Wèe à ka' gee wa'a, Nyʉ̀ gee wee mntee vi tap. E kè ba à nfè' ce Tata Jisòs à vʉ̀ a yì bèe wèe nà, tɛ wèe bo ba brara, kè' tʉr fàa à bsii Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Ta ka'.
eng: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father, at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ker tʉr yuu mo' à rkyèse mbendù buu ce wèr à suŋ wèe wɛɛ na. Wèr ce bu' mmbo nè wèe à rlii Tata Jisòs enɛ wèe ce gee ba ŋgèe ce Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ, àmbò wèe ce gèe nà, ke' borni à nfè' mò' ka'. Njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca a yì ce wèr à m yɛ'ni wèe.
eng: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ ncep ce wèr à m fa nè wèe à rlii Tata Jisòs nà.
eng: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

lmp: Yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ ese wèe yi yu enɛ wèe cu ba njɛ̀ɛ rcu ce li ce dùŋshi enɛ wèe à fa wee mntee nè Nyʉ̀. Wèe fa ba ŋgâa mkɛ'ni ka'.
eng: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ efa wêe mʉ cep yi tu tɛ e bo gèe ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ enɛ e gee nè yì nyor, à ba yuu ce bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce yu' rbòŋ àgho.
eng: that each one of you know how to possess himself of his own vessel in sanctification and honor,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fa kù lòr njeŋwɛ̀ ba njo' rbòŋ ce a ye a be yu' mbe bkuu, àmbò bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' a ke gèe nà ka'.
eng: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don't know God;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fa gèe yuu bebep nè nfʉr yì à njɛ̀ɛ yuu ca ka'. Wèr à m cìisi nè wèe wɛɛ enɛ Tata Jisòs be kè kʉsi mcucu' nè bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu ca.
eng: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' sèe tɛ sèe bo ce gèe ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋgêe bebep ca ka'. E m kɛ' sèe tɛ sèe bo cu ba rcu rrara.
eng: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' kani ncep ca, banɛ ŋgàŋ à kani ba ŋwɛ̀ ka', e kani ba Nyʉ̀ ce e fa wèe yi Yʉ' ce yi yu rara.
eng: Therefore he who rejects this doesn't reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò rkòŋnì ce e nè nfʉr mò' ce e byemi nè Jisòs, mbùu mò' ker ba nè wèr à rsaŋ nè wèe àmbò li ka' njobè' Nyʉ̀ à yɛ'ni wèe njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ca wɛɛ.
eng: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

lmp: Wèe à dùŋshi njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ca nè bfʉr wee wɛɛwɛ ce a yu à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà. Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce tapsi wèe enɛ wèe gee tɛ njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ca li du ba kùntombì.
eng: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

lmp: Ghèter nè cu ba rcu ce li yu yɛɛnì. Ŋwɛ̀ fa ce fʉ̀ʉshi cùu à buu bèe mò' ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce fa' yuu ce yi be jà' ye. Wèr à m suŋ wèe wɛɛ enɛ wèe gee wa'a.
eng: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you;

lmp: Wèe ka' gee wa'a bèe ce a yu ŋgâa rbyemì ka' nà, a vʉsè wèe, wee wèe ker ke' enɛ ŋwɛ̂ jɛɛ be fà' tɛ wèe ka' ye ka'.
eng: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

lmp: Bfʉr wêr, wèr ce kòŋ enɛ wèe riŋ yuu ce yi be lò koni bèe ce a kweŋger wɛɛ nà, fà dì' wèe bo ce koosimnse àmbò bèe ce a ke kè' rcu ce nfesè ka' nà ka'.
eng: But we don't want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don't grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

lmp: Àmbò sèe à byemi enɛ Jisòs à m kwe a fʉʉ efa rkwe, sèe à byemi foŋ enɛ e ba à nfè' ce e vʉ̀, tɛ Nyʉ̀ fʉr bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m byemi nè Jisòs nà efa rkwe, àmbò e fʉr Jisòs efa rkwe nà.
eng: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

lmp: Wèr ce suŋ wèe ba yuu ce Tata à làa. Yi yu enɛ be ba à nfè' ce Tata à vʉ̀, sèe ce sèe bii btèe sèe ke' du yɛ ye entombì nè bèe ce a kweŋger ka'.
eng: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left to the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

lmp: Tata be kè sùu embe bùu, tɛ bèe a yu' ma njèndoŋ àmbò e waa, tɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̂ ŋgòr waa foŋ, tɛ rsòŋ Nyʉ̀ li lâa. Be kè ba à nfè' anà tɛ bèe ce a m byemi nè Jisos Krâis a ka' kweŋger, a fʉʉ efa rkwe wɛɛ,
eng: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel, and with God's trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

lmp: tɛ sèe ce sèe cu btèe a ba' à nfè' anà, ka' tarshi nyor sèe wowèe mbe mʉ̀ mmbà', dù koni Tata mbekì tɛ sèe wowèe cu nfesè.
eng: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds, to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

lmp: Banɛ wèe lor blàa ca, gee tɛ mntee bèe efa wêe mʉ vi fʉte.
eng: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, mbùu mò' ker ba àgho nè wèr à rsaŋ nè wèe àmbò nfè' kɛ̀ nòŋ ce Jisòs be vʉ̀ ka'.
eng: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

lmp: Wèe à rìŋ bòŋboŋ enɛ nòŋ ce Tata Jisòs be vʉ̀ yi be kè ba àmbò nyɛ̀ɛ ce e ke bʉ̀ʉ ŋwɛ̀ nètʉ' nà.
eng: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

lmp: Be ba à nfè' ce bèe a ce làa enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ yu yɛɛnì, cumʉnyaŋ à ba se nà, tɛ ŋgɛ' mò' lo vʉ̀ nè wowèe. Ŋgɛ' ca be kè lɛ'si wowèe àmbò à nfè' ce njeŋwɛ̀ e ke kɛ̀' ce luuti muu nà, tɛ wowèe a tʉr njì mò' ce àde' a caŋ ka'.
eng: For when they are saying, Peace and safety, then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman; and they will in no way escape.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, bfʉr wâ, wèe yu bèe ce wèe ce cu à tʉ̀'nji tɛ nòŋ anà yi bo bʉ̀ʉ wèe àmbò nyɛ̀ɛ e ke bʉ̀ʉ ŋwɛ̀ nà ka'.
eng: But you, brothers, aren't in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

lmp: Wèe yu bèe ce wèe ce cu ba à rraa, a ker ba àmbò bèe ce a ce jɛ̀r ba nèmootì. Sèe yu bèe ce sèe ce cu ba à tʉ̀'nji ka'. Sèe tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè tʉ̀'nji ka'.
eng: You are all children of light, and children of the day. We don't belong to the night, nor to darkness,

lmp: Banɛ sèe fa ce buumi àmbò bèe mo' a ce gèe nà ka'. Sèe ce ke'se, tami nyor.
eng: so then let's not sleep, as the rest do, but let's watch and be sober.

lmp: Bèe ce a ke buumi a ke buumi ba nètʉ', buu mno vi ke gha' koo ŋgâa no buu ba nètʉ'.
eng: For those who sleep, sleep in the night, and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

lmp: Àmbò sèe yu yi sèe bèe ce sèe ce cu ba à rraa, banɛ sèe tami nyor. Sèe tɛ'shi visèe mnyor àmbò bsoogɛ̀ a ke tɛ'shi wap mnyor à ŋkʉ̀ bìr nà. Sèe lɛ visèe mntee njep Nyʉ̀, ker koŋ ye foŋ tɛ cena yi bo ba àmbò kaŋ ce sèe à tɛ'shi visèe mŋgùŋ àgho. Yi yu foŋ enɛ àmbò sèe cu a ce kè' nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be jà' sèe, cena yi yu nè sèe àmbò rtaa bco' ce sèe à sòp mbe tù tɛ li bo tɛ'shi tu wa'a.
eng: But let us, since we belong to the day, be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and, for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ce sèe tɛ e bo mà' ŋgɛ' mbe sêe ndù ka'. E m ce sèe enɛ sèe bo koni rlùŋ njì enjep Tata Jisos Krâis,
eng: For God didn't appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

lmp: ce e m kwe nè sèe. E m kwe nè sèe tɛ sèe wowèe bo cu àbee à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. E ka' vʉ̂, kɛ̀ sèe cu btèe ɛ̀, kɛ̀ sèe à kweŋger ɛ̀, tɛ sèe wowèe bo cu àbee.
eng: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

lmp: Àmbò wèe à rìŋ buu ca wɛɛ na, wèe ku ce gee bòŋboŋ àmbò wèe ce gèe nà. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ efa wêe mʉ fa ŋger nè nfʉr mò', ja' nfʉr mò' tɛ e tɛɛ tatap.
eng: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce loo nè wèe enɛ wèe yu'ni nè bèe ce a ce fà' a wêe mʉ, à ba bèe ce Tata Nyʉ̀ à ce enɛ wowèe a ke'ni ker ce yɛ'ni wèe nà.
eng: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord, and admonish you,

lmp: Yu'ni nè nè wowèe bòŋboŋ sê, koŋ wowèe nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀ njo' rfà' ce wowèe a ce gèe. Cu nè rcu ce li yu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: and to respect and honor them in love for their work's sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe fa ncep nè bèe ce a yu bbor, fa ŋger nè bèe ce wap mntee vi ce bu', ja' bèe ce a sɛ̀, tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: We exhort you, brothers, admonish the disorderly, encourage the fainthearted, support the weak, be patient toward all.

lmp: Yɛ nè enɛ ŋwɛ̀ fa kʉsi yuu bebep nè yuu bebep ka'. Ghèter nè à rgèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ. Gèe nè buu bbòŋboŋ ca nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e yu a wêe mʉ ker ba bèe enjepmbè foŋ.
eng: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good, for one another, and for all.

lmp: Lu'shi nè à nfè' wɛɛwɛ,
eng: Rejoice always.

lmp: loo nè nè Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ,
eng: Pray without ceasing.

lmp: yoŋshi nè Nyʉ̀ à buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi ka' koni wèe. Buu ca a buu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Jisos Krâis a gêe.
eng: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

lmp: Fa kani nè Yʉ' Rara efa rfà' njep wèe ka',
eng: Don't quench the Spirit.

lmp: wèe fa jàasi ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce suŋ buu ce Yʉ' Rara yi gèe e riŋ ka'.
eng: Don't despise prophesies.

lmp: Taase nè buu wɛɛwɛ ce bèe a ce làa nè wèe, koo vî bbòŋboŋ,
eng: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

lmp: ba ànjìsàp efa buu bbebep wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Abstain from every form of evil.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa sèe cumʉnyaŋ, gee tɛ wèe cu rcu rrara, tʉr fàa koo mʉcàr ka', ker gee tɛ fàa ba à yuu ce wèe ce gèe kɛ̀ à yuu ce wèe ce kwà'shi ka', kù ba bbòŋboŋ à buu wɛɛwɛ du ba' à nfè' ce Tata Jisos Krâis be vʉ̀.
eng: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce e kɛ' wèe, yu ŋwɛ̂ mini. E be gèe tɛ yi ba wa'a.
eng: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, loo nè nè wèr.
eng: Brothers, pray for us.

lmp: Cà'ni nè bfʉr wer wɛɛwɛ nè wèr. Baa wowèe nje nyòr à bèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

lmp: M ce làa nè wèe à rlii Tata Jisòs enɛ wèe be' ŋwà' ca nè bfʉr wɛɛwɛ.
eng: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisòs tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca a saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ba Silàs ba Timotì nè ŋgâa cor ce a yu à rla' Tɛ̀sàlonikà, ce yu bèe yìsèe Ta Nyʉ̀, a ker ba bèe Tata Jisos Krâis.
eng: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ:

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tàr Nyʉ̀ ba Tata Jisos Krâis a tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yu yer dì' à ryòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ njo' wèe. Yi bòŋ enɛ wèr gee wa'a njobè' ler rbyemì li ce tap, a caa àmbò li m ba, ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ à ce kòŋ nfʉr yì a caa àmbò e m kòŋ.
eng: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you towards one another abounds;

lmp: A mbùu ce wer ke làa nè bcor mo', ce nàa tu nè wèe njobè' bèe a ke nyʉ̀' wèe, ker fa wèe ŋgɛ', wèe ku tɛɛ tatap, byemi ba nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your patience and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

lmp: Ca yi ce dùŋshi enɛ buu ce Nyʉ̀ e ke gèe vi yu yɛɛnì, njobè' yi be gèe tɛ wèe ghɛɛte à bèe ce a be ye rbòŋ embe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀. A mbùu ce wèe ce yɛ ŋgɛ' sè'ni.
eng: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of the Kingdom of God, for which you also suffer.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ mini. E be kʉsi mcucu' nè bèe ca njobè' a ce fa wèe ŋgɛ',
eng: Since it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

lmp: jà' wèe efa ŋgɛ' ce wèe ce yɛ anà, kèr jà' wèr foŋ efa ŋgɛ'. E be gèe cena à nfè' ce Tata Jisòs ce vʉ̀ embe bùu nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, a bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wèe.
eng: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us, when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

lmp: E be vʉ̀ njè mʉ̀ mcùŋ mor, fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe ce a mɛŋni Nyʉ̀ a kani efa rgèe yuu ce Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Tata Jisòs ce làa enɛ a gêe.
eng: giving vengeance to those who don't know God, and to those who don't obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

lmp: Wowèe a be bʉ nfesè, gàpni a Tata Nyʉ̀ wèe, bɛ fòo efa yi ŋger.
eng: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

lmp: E be kè vʉ̀ à nòŋ anà tɛ yì bèe ce a byemi nè ye a ku'si ye kèr vʉse ye. Wèe be kè ba à mʉ̀ bèe ca njobè' wèe à byemi blâa Nyʉ̀ ce wèr à m fè'shi nè wèe.
eng: when he comes to be glorified in his saints, and to be admired among all those who have believed because our testimony to you was believed in that day.

lmp: A mbùu ce wer ke loo nè wèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ gee tɛ wèe cu njɛ̀ɛ rcu ce e kòŋ enɛ yì bèe a cu. Tɛ yìsèe Nyʉ̀ gee à yi ŋger tɛ buu bbòŋboŋ ce wèe ce kwà'shi à rgèe vi geetî, ker gee tɛ mfà' ce wèe ce gèe njo' le rbyemì mi geetî.
eng: To this end we also pray always for you, that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith, with power;

lmp: Yi ba wa'a, a ku'sì Jisos Krâis njo' wèe, ku'si wee wèe foŋ njo' ye. Bkù' ca vi be ba wa'a njobè' ntee bòŋboŋ ce yìsèe Nyʉ̀ ba Tata Jisos Krâis a tʉr nè sèe.
eng: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Bfʉr wêr, à ka' ba àmbò rvʉ̀ Tata Jisos Krâis, ker ba nfè' ce sèe Jisòs wèe be tarte, wèr ce làa nè wèe enɛ,
eng: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, and our gathering together to him, we ask you

lmp: ntee yi fa yàŋse bu' wèe, kɛ̀ wèe fa yàŋse tù'te njobè' bèe mò' a ce làa enɛ nòŋ Tata anà yi yu àtʉtʉ ka'. Seemò' kɛ̀ à làa ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce suŋ bèe buu ce Yʉ' Rara yi gèe e riŋ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fè'shi ba blâa Nyʉ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ bèe mo' a ce làa enɛ wèr à saŋ ŋwà' ɛ̀,
eng: not to be quickly shaken in your mind, nor yet be troubled, either by spirit, or by word, or by letter as from us, saying that the day of Christ had come.

lmp: wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ ka'. Tɛ nòŋ ca yi ka' ba, ntèetu ce àlʉ̀simbùu be ba, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa Krâis vʉ̂. Ca yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e bʉ yi wɛɛ.
eng: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the departure comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction,

lmp: E be nàa tu enɛ e càa buu wɛɛwɛ ce bèe a ce gʉ'shi àgho enɛ a Nyʉ̀. E gèe wa'a, du niŋ mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, cu mbo, lor yi tu enɛ a ye Nyʉ̀.
eng: he who opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped; so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

lmp: Mbò wèe bii kuushi enɛ à m ba mbe nfè' ce sèe à m ba nà, mɛ̀ suŋ wèe buu ca a?
eng: Don't you remember that, when I was still with you, I told you these things?

lmp: Wèe à rìŋ yuu ce yi gèe enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà fa vʉ̀ sè'ni ka', tɛ e bo lò vʉ̀ ba à nfè' yì.
eng: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

lmp: Bsàrbuu vi yu àgho wɛɛ, a ka' ba ba à bsʉ̀ti. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe bsàrbuu anà vi ke' ce yɛɛti àwaŋ ka' yu àgho. Be ba à nfè' ce a fʉr ŋwɛ̀ anà,
eng: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ bsàrbuu ca yɛɛti àwaŋ. E yɛɛti àwaŋ tɛ Tata Jisos Krâis lo vʉ̀ nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀, fyɛp ye nè mbɛp, tɛ e kwe, mìsi bʉ à nòŋ anà.
eng: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth, and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ bsàrbuu anà be vʉ̀ nè ŋger ce yi lò ese Satàn, gèe ku' mncòo ba buu bbɛ̀ɛ ce bo' bèe àgho enɛ a ku'si ye.
eng: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

lmp: E be gèe ku' buu gòr se tɛ e bo bo' bèe ce a ce bʉ àgho. Wowèe a ce bʉ njobè' a m kani à rkòŋ mini ce e m ba gèe tɛ wowèe a lûŋ.
eng: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn't receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' wowèe a m kòŋ mini ca ka', Nyʉ̀ ce gèe wowèe a ce jep, a ce koŋ ba mnde'.
eng: Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce gèe wa'a, tɛ mnsa' mi bo koo bèe ce a byemi yuu mini ka', a ce yu' yap rbòŋ ba nè bsàrbuu.
eng: that they all might be judged who didn't believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, bfʉr wêr, Tata Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ wèe. Yu yer dì' à ryòŋshi Nyʉ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce wèe yu njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m ce wèe efa rkɛ̀' tɛ wèe bo koni ryòŋ. Wèe à m koni ryòŋ ca njì enjep yʉ' Nyʉ̀. Yi m gèe wèe à ba brara, ker byemi blâa mini ce wèe à m byemi àgho.
eng: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wèe, wèe à konì ryòŋ ca à nfè' ce wèr à m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè wèe nà. E m kɛ' wèe tɛ wèe bo sa' fòo ce yu fòo Tata Jisòs.
eng: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a bfʉr wêr, tɛɛ nè tatap, ku lɛ ba ryɛ'nì ce wèr à m yɛ'ni wèe a ker saŋ nè wèe nà nje tù.
eng: So then, brothers, stand firm, and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word, or by letter.

lmp: Tata Jisos Krâis ba Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ. Nyʉ̀ à m kòŋ sèe a fa sèe ŋger nfesè, a ker ka'ni sèe buu ce sèe à rìŋ enɛ vi be ba. E m gèe buu ca njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ ce e m tʉr nè sèe. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ca fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ, gee tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap, ce gèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ kèr ce làa ba buu bbòŋboŋ.
eng: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace, comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce làa nè wèe àlʉ̀simbùu enɛ wèe loo nè wèr. Loo nè enɛ blàa àmbò Tata vi du à ŋgòŋ cɛrcɛr tɛ bèe a byemi ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò wèe à m byemi a ce yu'ni nà.
eng: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you;

lmp: Loo nè foŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ fʉr wèr embà mmbo ŋgâa bsàrbuu. Wèr ce làa wa' njobè' bèe wɛɛwɛ a ce byemi blàa ca ka'.
eng: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, Tata Jisòs yu ŋwɛ̀ mini. E be fa wèe ŋger, kè'ni wèe ese Satàn ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ bsàrbuu.
eng: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you, and guard you from the evil one.

lmp: À ka' ba njo' yì mini ca wèr à byemi enɛ wèe ce gèe buu ce wèr à suŋ wèe, kù ce gèe ba vi à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

lmp: Tata Nyʉ̀ beesi wee mntee tɛ wèe riŋ njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ce e tʉr nè wèe, kèr rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋkur ntee ce Jisos Krâis tʉr.
eng: May the Lord direct your hearts into the love of God, and into the patience of Christ.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèr ce cìisi nè wèe à rlii Tata Jisos Krâis enɛ nfʉr mò' ka' ba a wêe mʉ ce e ce kòŋ à rfà' ka', a ce cu àmbò wèr à m yɛ'ni wèe enɛ wèe cu nà ka', wèe wowèe fa kar ka'.
eng: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion, and not after the tradition which they received from us.

lmp: Wee wèe rìŋ enɛ wèe à ba gèe ba ŋgèe ce wèr à m ce gèe. Wèr à m ba a wêe mʉ a ce koosi bbor ka'.
eng: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn't behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

lmp: Wèr à m ye yuu mo' a buu efa rlà' ka'. Wèr à m ce fà' ce lì'mi nètʉ' ba nèmootì fà dì' wèr bo ba ntɛ̀r nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'.
eng: neither did we eat bread from anyone's hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you;

lmp: Wèr à m ce gèe wa'a yi ke' ba enɛ wèr à m buu ŋger à rlàa enɛ wèe ja' wèr ka'. Wèr à m gèe wa'a tɛ wèe bo yɛ'ni, ce fà' àmbò wèr à m ce fà'.
eng: not because we don't have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

lmp: Wèr à m làa nè wèe à nfè' ce sèe à m ba nà wɛɛ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ fà' ka', e fa ye ka'.
eng: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: If anyone will not work, neither let him eat.

lmp: Wèr ce làa wa'a, njobè' wèr à yu' enɛ bèe mò' efa wèe a yu bbor. Wowèe a kòŋ à rfà' ka' a ce kar a ce jepsi ba ntà'tè bèe mò'.
eng: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don't work at all, but are busybodies.

lmp: Wèr ce cìisi a ker ce bu' mmbo nè bèe anà à rlii Tata Jisòs Krâis enɛ wowèe a cu à nshè ce fa' tɛ a bo tʉr yuu ye.
eng: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that with quietness they work, and eat their own bread.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe fa sɛ̀ à rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ ka'.
eng: But you, brothers, don't be weary in doing well.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' kani à rgèe yuu ce wèr à saŋ nè wèe na, wèe fyɛ' ŋgàŋ bòŋboŋ. Wèe fa tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe wèe ŋwɛ̀ anà wèe ka' tɛ e bo ghàani.
eng: If any man doesn't obey our word in this letter, note that man, that you have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe fa lòr ne ye à ŋwɛ̀ bbàa ka'. Cep nè ye ba àmbò nfʉr wèe.
eng: Don't count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

lmp: Tata ce e ke fa sèe cumʉnyaŋ, fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ ca à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, ka' à ba koni kɛ koni wèe ɛ̀. Tata ba a ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ efa wêe mʉ.
eng: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

lmp: Rcà'nì ca à saŋ mɛ̂ Pol nè ya bo. Mɛ̀ ku saŋ àmbò mɛ ke saŋ mbe wa mŋwà' wɛɛwɛ nà, tɛ wèe bo rìŋ enɛ à saŋ mɛ̀.
eng: The greeting of me, Paul, with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter: this is how I write.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. M yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu ba à ŋger Nyʉ̀ ce e gèe sèe à luŋ ker ba à ŋger Jisos Krâis ce e gèe sèe à lɛ mmir mbendù buu ce vi be kè ba.
eng: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the commandment of God our Savior, and Christ Jesus our hope;

lmp: M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè Timotì ce e yu muu wà ce mini njobè' e byemi nè Jisos Krâis. M ce loo mɛnɛ Tàr ba Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tata tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, koosimnse nè wèe, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

lmp: Àmbò mɛ̀ m làa nè wɛ̀ à nfè' ce mɛ̀ m ce dù à ŋgôŋ Mɛ̀sɛ̀donìyà nà, m ker ce làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ à ku cu à rla' Ɛfɛsòs, tɛ à bo làa nè bèe mo' ce a ce yɛ'ni ryɛ'nì mnde' nà enɛ wowèe a borni njɛ̀ɛ ryɛ'nì anà.
eng: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

lmp: Làa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a fa lòr yàp nfè' ce suŋ ba mghàghar kɛ̀ ce nàshi ba bfʉr ce bà' àfo ka' ka'. Buu ca vi gèe bèe a ce sɛr ba mnsɛr a ke' ce jà' bèe à rrìŋ buu ce vi yu a kuu mfà' Nyʉ̀ ka'. Bèe a ke rìŋ buu ca ba njobè' wowèe a byemi yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à làa.
eng: neither to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes, rather than God's stewardship, which is in faith--

lmp: Mbùu ce wɛ̀ ba làa buu ca nè wowèe yu enɛ wowèe a bo kòŋ bèe. Rkòŋnì ca li ba ba à nfè' ce ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr ntee rara, yi ntee yi ke' ce fa ye ŋgɛ' ka' njobè' e gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ, a byemi nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: but the goal of this command is love, out of a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith;

lmp: Bèe mo' a mà' buu ca a da' nduunjì a du ba àmbùu bde' bcicì.
eng: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned aside to vain talking;

lmp: Wowèe a kòŋ à rba ŋgâa ryɛ'ni mncir Nyʉ̀, a ke' riŋ buu ce wowèe a ce làa nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ vi yu mini nà ka'.
eng: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say, nor about what they strongly affirm.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ mncir Nyʉ̀ vi yu bbòŋboŋ ce ŋwɛ̀ à ka' gee rfà' ce a ba gèe àgho.
eng: But we know that the law is good, if a man uses it lawfully,

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ à fa mncir ca ba njo' bêe bbòŋboŋ ka'. E fa vi njo' bèe ce a tèe btu, a ce bʉ' mncir, ker ba bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka', a ba ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep. E fa vi foŋ njo' bèe ce yap ŋgèe yi yu rara ka', wowèe a ce jàasi buu Nyʉ̀. E fa vi njo' bèe ce a ce yʉshi wap bta ba wap mmâ, ker ba bèe mo' foŋ ce a yu ŋgâa nyʉshi bèe.
eng: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

lmp: E fa vi njo' bee ce a ce sàki, ba mmbaŋrù ce a ce nòŋ a mmbaŋrù mo', ba bèe ce a ce yɛ̀ɛ bèe ce fyèni à bkwàa, ba ŋgâa nya' mnde', ker ba ŋgâa ntɛɛ njìnsa' mnàŋ, ker ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe wɛɛwɛ ce bèe a ce gèe yi ba jɛɛ efa ryɛ'nì mini.
eng: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine;

lmp: Ryɛ'nì mini ca yu ryɛ'nì ce li ghɛɛte a ke' ba jɛɛ efa Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à fa mba mɛ̂ mmbò ka'. Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca ce gèe bèe a ce rìŋ fòo Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ bghòo.
eng: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

lmp: M ce yòŋshi Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ, à ba ye ce e fa mɛ̀ ŋger enɛ m gee rfà' ca. M ce yòŋshi ye njobè' e m yɛ enɛ m yu ŋwɛ̂ mini, a ka' ce mɛ̀ enɛ m fa' nè ye.
eng: And I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service;

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m ce bepsi rlii Jisos Krâis, a ce fa yì bèe ŋgɛ', a ce gèe bsàrbuu nè bèe. Ka' mɛ̀ m ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̂ wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à koosìmnse nè mɛ̀ njobè' mɛ̀ m ce gèe buu ca wa'a, a be byemi nè Jisos Krâis ka', a riŋ enɛ a buu bbebep ka'.
eng: although I was before a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

lmp: Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tata à m gèe yuu bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀ sê. E m gèe mɛ̀ byemì nè ye, a ker koŋ bèe foŋ. Jisos Krâis e ke fa rbyemì ca ba rkòŋnì nè bèe ce a wowèe a yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir.
eng: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Nlàa ca yu nlàa mini, rtarnì li ke' ba njo ka', à ba nlàa ce bèe a ba byemi nè yap ntee-ŋwɛ. Nlàa anà yi yu enɛ Jisos Krâis à m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na à rgèe tɛ ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep a lûŋ. Ŋkʉʉ efa mʉ̀ bêe bbebep ca yu mɛ̀.
eng: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

lmp: Mbùu ce Nyʉ̀ à m koosimnse nè mɛ̀ à m ba tɛ Jisos Krâis bo dùŋshi bèe enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e kur ntee sê. E m gèe wa'a tɛ bèe a bo yɛ àmbò e kur ntee nè mɛ̀ ce m yu ŋkʉʉ efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, tɛ m bo ba rdùŋshì nè bèe ce a be byemi nè ye, koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience, for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

lmp: Ha wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀! Ŋkʉʉ ce à ce cu nfesè, ce àde' à kwe ka', ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ yɛ wɛ̀ nè mmir ka', ce nyʉ̀ mò' ker ba caa efa wɛ̀ ka', tɛ bèe a yu'ni nè wɛ̀, tɛ à sa' fòo nfesè. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Muu wà ce Timotì, m ce làa buu ca nè wɛ̀. Buu ce m ce làa nè wɛ̀ na yu buu ce vi ghɛɛte à buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe à nfè' mò', bèe a riŋ a laa àmbò wɛ̀ nà. Wɛ̂ ce gèe buu anà, vi bo fa wɛ̀ ŋger à rmà' bìr ce mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: This instruction I commit to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which led the way to you, that by them you may wage the good warfare;

lmp: Kù tɛɛ tatap njep lo rbyemì, lɛ yo ntee rara. Bèe mo' a kani yuu ce yap ntee yi ce suŋ wowèe, a sa'si lap rbyemì.
eng: holding faith and a good conscience; which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith;

lmp: Bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ bèe ca yu Hìminàs ba Àlɛ̀ksandà. Mɛ̀ fa wowèe mbà mmbo Satàn tɛ wowèe a bo yɛ ŋgɛ', rìŋ buu, borni efa rbepsi rlii Nyʉ̀.
eng: of whom is Hymenaeus and Alexander; whom I delivered to Satan, that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

lmp: Yuu entombì ce m ce làa nè wɛ̀ yi yu enɛ wèe loo nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, yoŋshi Nyʉ̀, loo buu ce wèe à buu ese ye. Loo enɛ e ja' bèe mo' foŋ.
eng: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks, be made for all men:

lmp: Loo nè nè bkʉʉ ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce sa' bèe tɛ sèe bo cu nè cumʉnyaŋ- ŋwɛ̀, tɛ ŋgɛ' ba ka', cu ba rcu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ, ba bêe byɛɛnì à bsii bèe à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: for kings and all who are in high places; that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

lmp: À rloo wa'a yu yuu bòŋboŋ, à ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà' e ke yu' rbòŋ àgho.
eng: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior;

lmp: E ke kòŋ à rjà' bèe tɛ wowèe a bo rìŋ yuu ce yi yu mini.
eng: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ yu mò'sir, ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu mbetar Nyʉ̀ ba bèe, a ce gèe tɛ bèe a ba àbee a Nyʉ̀ àmbò sèe yu, à ba mò'sir foŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ca yu Jisos Krâis ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ àmbò sèe.
eng: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

lmp: Jisos Krâis ca à m fa yì nyor à rtee bèe wɛɛwɛ efa yàp ŋgɛ'. Yuu ce e m gèe na yi ce dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m ce kòŋ à rgèe tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a lûŋ. Cena yi ku koni ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m lɛ̀.
eng: who gave himself as a ransom for all; the testimony in its own times;

lmp: A mbùu ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ rfè'shì ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu foŋ. Yuu ce m ce làa na yu yuu mini, m ce nya' ba mnde' ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ wa'a tɛ m bo yɛ'ni bèe enje jɛɛ yuu mini, tɛ wowèe a riŋ foŋ àmbò àde' ŋwɛ̀ byemì nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying, a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

lmp: M ce kòŋ enɛ mmbaŋrù ce a yu à bdì' wɛɛwɛ a loo. Wowèe a ce loo, a naa mmbo mrara mbekì, ke' tʉr ntee yayaŋ nè bèe mò', kɛ̀ ba ŋgâa mntaŋshì ka'.
eng: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

lmp: M ce kòŋ foŋ enɛ bbyèŋge a yar buu à njî yɛɛnì tɛ vi ba yɛɛnì, kè' ba ba buu rŋgòo ka', kè' ba' ba tu rŋgòo ka', kɛ̀ yar ba bsa' kɛ̀ btee kɛ̀ bcàŋ rŋgòo, kɛ̀ bcɛ̀' ce vi lùu ntaa ka'.
