eng: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety; not just with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing;

lmp: Wowèe a susi nyor ba nè mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ, ce yu mfà' ce mi ghɛɛte nè bbyèŋge ce a ce làa enɛ wowèe a rìŋ Nyʉ̀.
eng: but which becomes women professing godliness with good works.

lmp: Ka' ba à nfè' ce a ce yɛ'ni bèe, njeŋwɛ̀ cu mʉnyaŋ, cu nè ryu'nì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Let a woman learn in quietness with all subjection.

lmp: Mɛ̀ byemi enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ yɛ'ni kɛ̀ tʉr ŋger mbendù mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ ka'. Njeŋwɛ̀ tʉr à rcu mʉnyaŋ.
eng: But I don't permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

lmp: Cena yi yu wa'a njobè' a m boo Adàm entombì nè Êf.
eng: For Adam was first formed, then Eve.

lmp: Yi ba foŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce a m bo' à m ba Adàm ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a m bo', e bʉ' ncir, à m ba njeŋwɛ̀.
eng: Adam wasn't deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

lmp: Geewa'a, njeŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛɛ tatap njep li rbyemì ba rkòŋnì, gee ŋgêe rara, cu yɛɛnì, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be jà' ye embenjì boo ce e ce bi.
eng: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and sanctification with sobriety.

lmp: Nlàa ce m be làa na yu nlàa mini. Nlàa anà yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ à ka' koŋ à rba tu-nta', banɛ ŋgàŋ à kòŋ ba rfâ' rbòŋboŋ.
eng: This is a faithful saying: if a man seeks the office of an overseer, he desires a good work.

lmp: Tu embe cor yi tʉr à rba ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' a taa ye àtu yuu mo' ka'. E be kù tʉr ŋgwa mò'sir, tʉr ntee bobor, tʉr bfee. E fa ba ŋwɛ̂ àwàa ka'. E be ba ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e sa' bèe yɛɛnì, riŋ à ryɛ'ni bèe yɛɛnì foŋ.
eng: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

lmp: E tʉr à rba no-ŋkoo ka', ce gèe buu ba à ŋger ka'. E be ce gèe buu nè rbonì- ŋwɛ̀. E tʉr à rba ŋwɛ̀ mntaŋshì ka'. E fa roŋ mbàa ka'.
eng: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

lmp: Ŋgàŋ tʉr à rba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce kè' à yì ndap bòŋboŋ, ker ce yɛ'ni boo vi tɛ wowèe a ce yu'ni nè ye, ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ rìŋ à rkè'ni à yì ndap bòŋboŋ ka', àde' e gee ekɛ ka' ke'ni à cor Nyʉ̀?
eng: but if a man doesn't know how to rule his own house, how will he take care of the assembly of God?

lmp: E tʉr à rba ba ŋwɛ̀ rbyemî nfi ka', buwa'làr e lo naatu, gwe mnsa' àmbò Satàn à m gwè nà.
eng: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

lmp: E tʉr à rba ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe ce a yu ŋgâa cor ka' a be ce làa yɛɛnì àmbò ye foŋ fà dì' bèe a lo tàa ye, tɛ e kwe à taa Satàn ka'.
eng: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

lmp: Bdikìn foŋ a tʉr à rba bèe ce a ke lòr buu àtɛ̀r ka', kèr ba foŋ bèe ce a nya' mnde' ka'. Wowèe a tʉr à rba bèe ce a ce no mrù' gòr ka', kɛ̀ bèe ce a roŋ mbàa ka'.
eng: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money;

lmp: Wowèe a tʉr à ce tɛɛ njep buu ce vi kùu rbyemì ce yu buu ce vi càa bfee ŋwɛ̀ nà nè ntee rara.
eng: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

lmp: Tɛ wowèe a ka' kè fà' rfà' bdikìn, banɛ a be fyɛ' wowèe bòŋboŋ sê. A ka' fyɛ' wowèe wa'a, yɛ enɛ wowèe a ghɛɛte, wowèe a fa'.
eng: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

lmp: Bbyèŋge foŋ a tʉr à rba ba bèe ce a ce lòr buu àtɛ̀r ka', ba ŋgâa mnsa'ni foŋ ka'. A tʉr à rba bèe ce a tʉr ntee bobor, ba foŋ bèe ce a yu mini à buu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, faithful in all things.

lmp: Bdikìn a tʉr à rba bèe ce a tʉr bbyèŋge àŋgoo ka', ba bèe ce a ce kè' à boo wap ba wap mndap bòŋboŋ.
eng: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

lmp: Bèe ce a ka' fa' rfà' bdikìn ca bòŋboŋ, banɛ a be nàa wowèe mbekì, wowèe a ce làa àmbò rbyemì ce e nè Jisos Krâis, laa nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing, and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Àmbò m ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè wɛ̀ sè'ni na, m ce kwà'shi enɛ ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ m vʉ yɛ wɛ̀.
eng: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly;

lmp: Geewa'a, m ka' caasi nfè', tɛ ŋwà' ca yi bo gèe tɛ bèe a riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ce a ba gèe à mʉ̀ bèe Nyʉ̀. Bèe Nyʉ̀ ca yu cor Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe. Cor ca yu àmbò rkì ce li ghashi buu ce vi yu mini.
eng: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in the house of God, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

lmp: Àde' bèe a kanì enɛ buu ce vi kùu Nyʉ̀, ce e mʉ̀' misèe mmir sèe à yɛ nà vi buu efa rba bghagha' ka'. E m vʉ̀ àmbò ŋwɛ̀, bèe a yɛ ye. Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi m dùŋshi enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì. Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a m yɛ ye. Bèe a m fè'shi àmbò ye à bto' wɛɛwɛ. Ŋgòŋ ca yi m byemi nè ye. Nyʉ̀ à m lòr ye a du àgho mbe bùu, e cu mbo nè fòo-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi ce làa rara enɛ be kè ba à nfè' mò' tɛ bèe mo' a ma' yuu ce a m byemi, ce yu'ni ba nè byʉ' ce vi ke bo' bèe, kèr ce yu' ba buu ce mnyʉ̂mkà' vi ce yɛ'ni.
eng: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

lmp: Yi be kè ba wa'a njobè' ŋgâa nya' mnde' ce a yu ŋgâa mbo'ni a be kè yɛ'ni njɛ̀ɛ ryɛ'nì ca. Wowèe a be kè rìŋ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ efa yuu bòŋboŋ ba yuu bebep ka' njobè' wap mntee vi yini.
eng: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron;

lmp: Wowèe a be kè yɛ'ni enɛ mbaŋrùŋwɛ̀ fa lòr ŋgwa ka', kèr yɛ'ni enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ du bgùu foŋ ka'. Wowèe a be kè yɛ'ni bèe enɛ wowèe a fa ye njɛ̀ɛ byee mo' ka'. Geewa'a, Nyʉ̀ à m gèe byee tɛ bèe ce a byemi a riŋ yuu mini a bo ye ce yòŋshi ye.
eng: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gee vi yu yɛɛnì, mo' efa gho à ke' ba yì ce ŋwɛ̀ kani ka'. Yi yu enɛ bèe à ka' koni buu ca, a yoŋshì Nyʉ̀.
eng: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected, if it is received with thanksgiving.

lmp: Blâa Nyʉ̀ ba rloo vi gèe buu ca vi ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

lmp: Wɛ̀ ka' suŋ buu ca nè bfʉr enjep Jisos Krâis banɛ à yu ŋwɛ̀ rfâ' mbòŋmboŋ nè Jisòs, a ce dùŋshi enɛ à ce nyaŋ yò nyor nè blàa ce vi kùu rbyemì, ker ba ryɛ'nî rbòŋboŋ ce wɛ̀ ku tɛɛ njo nà.
eng: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith, and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

lmp: Fa tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè mghàghar cicì ka'. Mi tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe nè Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yɛ'ni yò nyor à rcu ba rcu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ.
eng: But refuse profane and old wives' fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yɛ'ni yì nyor à rgèe mcɛ̂r, mʉ sɛ' ku ba njo. Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yɛ'ni yì nyor à rkwà'shi ba àmbò buu Nyʉ̀, sɛ' ba njo à buu wɛɛwɛ njobè' njɛ̀ɛ mkwà'shì ca mi kà'ni sèe rcu rbòŋboŋ sè'ni na, ker ba rcu rbòŋboŋ à nfè' ce e bii ka' ba.
eng: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now, and of that which is to come.

lmp: Nlàa ca yu nlâa mini, rtarnì li ke' ba njo ka', à ba nlàa ce bèe a ba byemi nè yap ntee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

lmp: A mbùu ce wèr ce fà', a ce faate msòŋ. Wèr ce gèe wa'a njobè' wèr à lɛ̀ mer mmir ba mbendù Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe. E yu Nyʉ̀ ce e be gèe tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a bo lùŋ, laŋlaŋ bèe ce a byemi nè ye.
eng: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

lmp: Làa buu ca ker yɛ'ni vi.
eng: Command and teach these things.

lmp: Fa mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' lor wɛ̀ àtɛ̀r njobè' à yu ghàrŋwɛ̀ ka'. Ba rdùŋshì nè bèe ce a byemi, à wo blàa, ba a yo ŋgèe, ba à lo rkòŋnì, ba a lo rbyemì, ker ba à lo rcu rrara.
eng: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

lmp: Tɛ m ka' vʉ̀, lòr yò nfè' ce be' blâa Nyʉ̀ nè bèe, cep wowèe, ker ce yɛ'ni wowèe.
eng: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

lmp: Fa mà' bfee rfà' ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè wɛ̀ ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m fa wɛ̀ bfee ca njo' buu ce e m gèe à nfè' mò', bèe mo' a yu' ese ye a laa àmbò wɛ̀, btu embe cor foŋ a la' mmbo mbe wɛ̂ ndù nà.
eng: Don't neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy, with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

lmp: Lɛ̀ ntee à buu ca, ce gee vi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ bo yɛ àmbò à ce kù' à buu Nyʉ̀.
eng: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

lmp: Kè'ni yo tu, lor nfè' à yuu ce à ce yɛ'ni. Ce gee ba buu ca à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, njobè' wɛ̀ ka' ce gèe vi, banɛ à be tee yo tu efa ŋgɛ', kèr tee btu bèe ce a ce yu' buu ce à ce làa.
eng: Pay attention to yourself, and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

lmp: Fa lapni nleeŋwɛ̀ ka', cep ye àmbò àde' à cep yò tâ. Gèe yuu ce àde' à gee nè bfʉr wo nè boo mnsùnsù.
eng: Don't rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

lmp: Gèe yuu ce àde' à gee nè yo mâ, nè bbyèŋge ce a yu bleebèe, gee yuu ce àde' à gee nè bjar wo nè bbyèŋge ce a yu bleebèe ka' nà. Cu wèe wowèe à njî yɛɛnì.
eng: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

lmp: Jà' byepkʉʉ ce a yu byepkʉʉ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

lmp: Ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr boo kɛ̀ mmbishì ɛ̀, banɛ boo ca kɛ̀ mmbishì ca ɛ̀, a ba ba bèe entombì à rjà' ye. Wowèe a ka' ja' ye banɛ wowèe a ce gèe yuu ce wowèe a yɛ'ni a kuu Nyʉ̀, tɛ yi ba enɛ njèe à rʉ̀ʉ a ce nyoŋ muu. Cena yu yuu ce Nyʉ̀ e ke yu' rbòŋ àgho.
eng: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety towards their own family, and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

lmp: Ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, a ke' tʉr ŋwɛ̀ ce e ja' ye ka', yu ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ce e lɛ̀ mi mmir mbendù Nyʉ̀ a ce loo nè ye à nfè' wɛɛwɛ enɛ e ja' ye.
eng: Now she who is a widow indeed, and desolate, has her hope set on God, and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

lmp: Ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce ye yi ba rbòŋ enjep ŋgòŋ na, banɛ ka' e yu ntèe wa'a, e kwe.
eng: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

lmp: Làa buu ca nè bèe tɛ wowèe a bo cu rcu ryɛɛnì, fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo làa yuu bebep kùu wowèe ka'.
eng: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ jà' yì bèe ka', laŋlaŋ bèe embe yê ndàp, banɛ ŋgàŋ à kani buu ce e byemì, a bep a caa ŋwɛ̀ ce e byemi ka'.
eng: But if anyone doesn't provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith, and is worse than an unbeliever.

lmp: Ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛ càa bfè' mntuunfu kèr ba foŋ ba njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ku tʉr nduu mò'sir ka', wèe fa saŋ li rlii à mʉ̀ mlii byepkʉʉ ka'.
eng: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

lmp: E be ba njeŋwɛ̀ ce bèe a rìŋ ye à mi mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ. E be ba njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce kè' à boo vi bòŋboŋ, a ce koni bèe mbe yê ndàp bòŋboŋ, a ce su'si mkùu bèe Nyʉ̀, a ce jà' ŋgâa ŋgɛ', a ce fa nyor à rgèe mfà' wɛɛwɛ ce mi yu mmbòŋmboŋ.
eng: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints' feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

lmp: Wèe fa saŋ mlii byepkʉʉ ce a yu bleebèe ka' nà ka', njobè' wowèe a ka' lo ce kwà'shi gòr ba àmbò rbòŋ nyor caa rfà' e nè Jisos Krâis, wowèe a lo koŋ ba à rdù bgùu.
eng: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry;

lmp: Wowèe a dù bgùu banɛ wowèe a bʉ' mkà'ni ce wowèe a m gèe nà, a kɛ' ŋgɛ' mbe wâp ndù.
eng: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

lmp: Wowèe a lo kòŋ ba à rcu à cicì, ce kar à mndap bèe mo' foŋ. Yi ka' ba wa'a, wowèe a lo kɛ̀' mnsa'ni, kèr ce jepsi ntà'tè bèe mo', ce làa buu ce wowèe a ba làa ka'.
eng: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

lmp: M ce cep byepkʉʉ ce a yu bleebèe ka' nà enɛ wowèe a du bgùu, bi boo, fyɛ' wap mndap bòŋboŋ fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ bbàa koni fɛŋ à rlàa yuu bebep kùu wowèe ka'.
eng: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wowèe a dà' njì wɛɛ, a du ba àmbùu Satàn.
eng: For already some have turned aside after Satan.

lmp: Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì à ka' tʉr byepkʉʉ mbe yê ndàp, e fyɛ' à byepkʉʉ anà. E fa lɛ̀ ntɛ̀r ca mbendù cor ka', tɛ cor bo fyɛ' à byepkʉʉ ce a yu byepkʉʉ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don't let the assembly be burdened; that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

lmp: Btu embe cor ce a ka' ce gèe lap rfà' bòŋboŋ banɛ wowèe a ghɛɛte à bèe ce cor à ba yu'ni nè wowèe jɛɛ, kèr fyɛ' à wowèe bòŋboŋ. M ce làa laŋlaŋ ŋgâa rfè'shì ce a ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀, a ker ce yɛ'ni vi bòŋboŋ se nà.
eng: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

lmp: Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Fa kur cùu nà' ce e ce bu' msaŋ ka'." Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi ker laa foŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ rfà' à ghɛɛte à rkoo vi blà'."
eng: For the Scripture says, You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain. And, The laborer is worthy of his wages.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' laa enɛ tu embe cor yi gèe fàa, wèe fa byemi ka'. Geewa'a, bèe a mmbaa kɛ̀ bèe a mtaar ɛ̀, a ka' vʉ suŋ enɛ e gèe fàa ghup wèe ka' byemi.
eng: Don't receive an accusation against an elder, except at the word of two or three witnesses.

lmp: Bèe ce a ka' gee buu bbebep, banɛ a be lapni wowèe àwaŋ tɛ bɛr a bo wɛp.
eng: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

lmp: M ce làa cena nè wɛ̀ à bsii Nyʉ̀, ba à bsii Jisos Krâis, ker ba foŋ à bsii bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à ce. M ce làa tatap sê, enɛ à gee buu ce m ce làa nè wɛ̀ na, ke' ce so'niŋgòŋ ka'. Gee nè bèe wɛɛwɛ yɛɛnì.
eng: I command you in the sight of God, and Christ Jesus, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

lmp: Fa kàka à rla' mmbo mbendù ŋwɛ̀ ka'. Fa tʉr bo njep yuu bebep ce bèe mo' a gèe ka'. Gèe ŋgêe rara.
eng: Lay hands hastily on no one, neither be a participant in other men's sins. Keep yourself pure.

lmp: Fa kù no ba mdip cà'cà' ka', no mʉ mrù' mʉcàr tɛ mi bo jà' wɛ̀ a rbʉ̀ ce li ce fa wɛ̀ ŋgɛ', à ce yaŋ cɛ'cɛ' se nà.
eng: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach's sake and your frequent infirmities.

lmp: Buu bbebep bèe mò' vi ke yàŋse yɛɛti, bèe à riŋ enɛ wowèe a be gwè mnsa'. Buu bbebep vi bèe mò' vi lò lor nfè' sê, ka' yɛɛti.
eng: Some men's sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

lmp: Yi ku ba wa' foŋ nè buu bbòŋboŋ ce bèe a ce gèe. Buu bbòŋboŋ ce bèe mo' a ce gèe vi lò yaŋse yɛɛti. Buu bbòŋboŋ ce bèe mo' a ce gèe vi lò lor nfè' ka' yɛɛti. Geewa'a àde' vi lo buu efa ryɛɛtì ka'.
eng: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can't be hidden.

lmp: Bèe ce a yu bkwàa, a ce yɛ ŋgɛ', a ba lòr wap mmasà àmbò bèe ce wowèe a ba yu'ni nè wowèe bòŋboŋ sê, fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ lo làa yuu bebep kùu Nyʉ̀ ker ba buu ce wèr ce yɛ'ni bèe na ka'.
eng: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

lmp: Bkwàa ce wap mmasà a yu ŋgâa rbyemì nà a fa lòr wap mmasà àtɛ̀r njobè' wowèe a yu bfʉr enjep Jisos Krâis ka'. Wowèe a ba fà' nè wap mmasà anà bòŋboŋ sê, njobè' bèe ce a ce ye sɛ' efa lap rfà' yu bèe ce a ku ba ŋgâa rbyemì àmbò wowèe, à ba bèe ce wowèe a kòŋ. Yɛ'ni bèe buu ca, cep wowèe tɛ a bo gèe vi.
eng: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them, because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yɛ'ni yuu mo' jɛɛ, ke' byemi blàa ce Jisòs à m làa ker ba ryɛ'nì ce li gèe bèe a ce rìŋ Tata Nyʉ̀ ka',
eng: If anyone teaches a different doctrine, and doesn't consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

lmp: banɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà ce nàa tu, a riŋ yuu ka'. E ce seŋ buu, a ce sɛr mnsɛr à mʉ blàa jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Cena yi gèe bèe a ce ko'ndoŋ, a ce lapni, a ce cɛpni, bèe a ce kwà'shi bebep kuu bèe mo'.
eng: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

lmp: Cena foŋ yi gèe bèe ce map mkwà'shì mi jep a ker riŋ yuu mini ka', a ce sɛr mnsɛr. Wowèe a ce kwà'shi ba enɛ buu Nyʉ̀ yu buu ce a be koni sɛ' enjo.
eng: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

lmp: Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce cu rcu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ, yuu ce e tʉr yi ghɛɛtè ye, banɛ ŋgàŋ à koni sɛ' sê.
eng: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

lmp: Sèe à m ce vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na, a tʉr yuu mo' ka'. Sèe be kè ce dù tɛ sèe lor yuu mo' enjo ka'.
eng: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can't carry anything out.

lmp: Sèe à ka' tʉr bcɛ̀' ba byee, sèe ma'shì tɛ vi ghɛɛte sèe.
eng: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

lmp: Bèe ce a kòŋ à rkù' à buu a lo gwe rmòoshì, kwe à taa. Taa ce wowèe a lò kwe àgho na, yu ba buu ce wowèe a kòŋ nè blʉr-ŋwɛ̀, ŋgɛ' à ba njo. Buu ce wowèe a kòŋ nè blʉr-ŋwɛ̀ na yu buu ce vi ke sùusi bèe njep nshè, bepsi wowèe dʉ̀dʉ̀.
eng: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation and a snare and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

lmp: Broŋ mbàa yu mŋgàŋ efa buu bbebep wɛɛwɛ. Bèe mo' a kòŋ à rtʉr mbàa sê, a ka' ce kòŋ wa'a, a da' njì rbyemì, a ce seŋ ba buu, wap ntee vi ce fa wowèe ŋgɛ'.
eng: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wɛ̀ ce à yu ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀, caŋ efa gee buu ca. Lɛ̀ ntee ce gee ba ŋgêe yɛɛnì, cu ba rcu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ, lɛ ntee nè Nyʉ̀, koŋ bèe, tɛɛ tatap, ba mʉfɛ̀ɛ à yo ŋgèe.
eng: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, patience, and gentleness.

lmp: Caŋ mcaŋnî mbòŋmboŋ ce à rbyemì, so ryòŋ ce nfesè ce Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wɛ̀ enɛ à bo koni. Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wɛ̀ enɛ à bo koni njɛ̀ɛ ryòŋ ca, wɛ̀ konì li nyʉ̀ ce wɛ̀ m làa à mʉ̀ bèe enɛ wɛ̀ byemi, Nyʉ̀ à yu' rbòŋ nà.
eng: Fight the good fight of faith. Lay hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

lmp: M ce làa nè wɛ̀ à bsii Nyʉ̀ ce e ke gèe buu wɛɛwɛ ba btèe, ba à bsii Jisos Krâis ce e m làa bòŋboŋ à bsii Pontos Pailɛ̀t.
eng: I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

lmp: M ce làa enɛ à gee buu ce mɛ̀ làa na, ke' co' mo' embo ka'. Gèe vi yɛɛnì caar du ba' à nfè' ce Tata Jisos Krâis be vʉ̀.
eng: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless, until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ be gèe tɛ Jisos Krâis vʉ à nfè' ce e m lɛ̀. Nyʉ̀ ca yu Nyʉ̀ ce bèe a ba ce nɛ̀si, yu ye ce e ce sa' cà'cà'. E yu ŋkʉʉ nè bkʉʉ wɛɛwɛ, a ba Tàr nè btàr wɛɛwɛ.
eng: which in its own times he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings, and Lord of lords;

lmp: Ku ba ye ce àde' e kwe ka', a ce cu ba à rraa ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ ba' àtʉtʉ efa gho ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ à m be yɛ ye ka', àde' ŋwɛ̀ yɛ ye ka'. Tɛ bèe a yu'ni nè ye, tɛ yi ŋger yi cu nfesè. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light; whom no man has seen, nor can see: to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

lmp: Làa nè bèe ce a kù' à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na enɛ wowèe a fa nàa tu kɛ̀ lɛ̀ mmir mbendù bkù' ka', njobè' ŋwɛ̀ mò' rìŋ àyàŋsè ka'. Làa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a lɛ map mmir ba mbendù Nyʉ̀ ce e yu mmbo mntoo a ce fa sèe buu wɛɛwɛ tɛ sèe bo yu' rbòŋ àgho.
eng: Charge those who are rich in this present world that they not be haughty, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

lmp: Làa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a gee buu bbòŋboŋ, ku' à mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ, ba mmbo mntoo, koŋ foŋ à rgàp yàp buu a bèe mo' wèe.
eng: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to communicate;

lmp: Wowèe a ka' gee wa'a tɛ yi bo ba enɛ wowèe a kupshi buu ce vi be jà' wowèe à nfè' ce e bii ka' vʉ̀ nà, a lɛ bòŋboŋ, tɛ wowèe a bo so ryòŋ ce yu ryôŋ mini.
eng: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

lmp: Timotì, ke'ni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à fa mba wɛ̂ mmbò na bòŋboŋ. Fa fa yo cùu njep mʉ̀ bde' bcicì ba mnsɛr ce bèe a ce kwà'shi enɛ yu bfee nà ka'.
eng: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of the knowledge which is falsely so called;

lmp: Bèe mo' à làa enɛ a tʉr njɛ̀ɛ bfee ca, a ka' ce làa wa', a da' njì rbyemì. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: which some professing have erred concerning the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce àmbò e m kòŋ, enɛ m ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis, tɛ m bo suŋ bèe enɛ Nyʉ̀ à kà' enɛ e be fa bèe ryòŋ ce nfesè njì enjep Jisos Krâis.
eng: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

lmp: M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè Timotì ce e yu muu wà ce mɛ̀ kòŋ nè ya ntee-ŋwɛ̀. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ Tàr, ker ba Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ, tʉr wɛ̀ à ntee bòŋboŋ, koosimnse nè wɛ̀, fa wɛ̀ cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

lmp: M ce loo nè wɛ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, a ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce m ce fà' nè ye nè ntee rara àmbò wa bta a m ce fà' nà.
eng: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

lmp: Mɛ̂ kuushi mŋgoommir ce wɛ̀ m sùusi nà, a ce kòŋ à ryɛ wɛ̀ tɛ m bo lu'shi.
eng: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

lmp: M ce kuushi lo rbyemì ce wɛ̀ byemi nè Jisòs nè yo ntee wɛɛwɛ. Yò makʉ Lowɛ̀s, ba yò ma Yunìs, a m tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rbyemì ca. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ à tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rbyemì ca sè'ni.
eng: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you; which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice, and, I am persuaded, in you also.

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce kuushi wɛ̀ enɛ à yɛɛsi bfee rfà' ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè wɛ̀ à nòŋ ce mɛ̀ m la' mmbo mbe wɛ̂ tù nà.
eng: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à fa sèe ba yʉ' ce yi gèe sèe ce wɛp buu ka', e fa sèe ba yʉ' ce yi gèe sèe tʉr ŋger ba ntee rkòŋnì ker ba ntee ce àtà yi gee sèe tʉr ŋger mbendù yìsèe nyor.
eng: For God didn't give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

lmp: Banɛ à fa koosi rìtu à rsuŋ bèe àmbò yìsèe Tata Jisòs, kɛ̀ koosi rìtu njo' mɛ̀ ce m yu mbe shaŋ njo' ye ka'. Yɛ ŋgɛ' njo' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ à ŋger Nyʉ̀.
eng: Therefore don't be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

lmp: E gèe sèe à lûŋ, a kɛ' sèe enɛ sèe cu rcu rrara, à ke' ba njo' rfà' mo' ce sèe à gèe nè ye ka'. E m kɛ' sèe ba àmbò e m lɛ̀ enɛ yi ba, ker ba njobè' Jisos Krâis. E m kwà'shi buu ca tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' kè ba.
eng: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

lmp: À ka' ba sè'ni na ce Jisos Krâis ce e gèe sèe à lûŋ, à vʉ̀ na, buu ca à yɛɛtì àwaŋ. Jisos Krâis ca à m so rkwe a vʉ nè ryòŋ ce àtà li ke mi ka'. Sèe yi buu ca njo' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce a ce fè'shi.
eng: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ njo' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca, enɛ m fe'shî, ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisòs, ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ryɛ'nì.
eng: For this, I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

lmp: M ce yɛ ŋgɛ' njo' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ca, a ka' ce yɛ wa'a, a ce koosi rìtu ka' njobè' m rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ byemi nè ye, a riŋ mɛnɛ e be kupshi mfà' ce e fa mba mɛ̂ mmbò nà lɛ̀ dù bà' nòŋ ce Jisòs be vʉ̀.
eng: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

lmp: Kù tɛɛ ba njep blâa mini àmbò Jisos Krâis ce wɛ̀ m yu' ese mɛ̀ nà. Gèe tɛ lo rbyemì ba rkòŋ ce wɛ̀ kòŋ bèe njo' Jisos Krâis nà li yɛɛti.
eng: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à fa nsuŋ ca ce yu nsuŋ mbòŋmboŋ sê, mba wɛ̂ mmbò. Lòr nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' kupse nsuŋ anà ka'. Lor nfè' ba à ŋger Yʉ' Rara ce yi yu njep wɛ̂ ntee.
eng: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

lmp: Wɛ̀ rìŋ wɛnɛ bêe à ŋgòŋ Ɛshà wɛɛwɛ a mà'shi mɛ̀, mɛ̀ ba mamŋgi'. Bèe mo' efa wowèe à m ba Fugɛlòs ba Ɛ̀mogɛnìs.
eng: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Nyʉ̀ koosimnse nè ndap Ònisiforòs wɛɛwɛ, njobè' a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m mà'shi mɛ̀ ka', a ke' koosi rìtu njobè' mɛ̀ m ba mbe shaŋ ka'. E m bà' à to' Rum, a lor nfè' a roo mɛ̀ a yɛ. E m yɛ mɛ̀ wa'a a fa mɛ ŋger sê.
eng: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain, but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Nyʉ̀ gèe tɛ Tata Jisos Krâis koosimnse nè ye à nòŋ ce e ka' vʉ̂. Wɛ̀ rìŋ enɛ e m jà' mɛ̀ à to' Ɛfɛsòs à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: the Lord grant to him to find the Lord's mercy in that day; and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

lmp: Wɛ̂ Timotì ce à yu muu wà, Nyʉ̀ à tʉr wɛ̀ à ntee bòŋboŋ. Wɛ̀ konì sɛ' efa gho njo' Jisos Krâis. Banɛ à tɛɛ tatap.
eng: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̀ m yu' àmbò m ce yɛ'ni bèe nà, lòr vi fa mbà mmbo bèe ce wɛ̀ rìŋ enɛ a yu mini, a riŋ foŋ enɛ wowèe a ghɛɛte à ryɛ'ni bèe mo'.
eng: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same to faithful men, who will be able to teach others also.

lmp: Lòr yo dì' yɛ ŋgɛ' àmbò ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ nè Jisos Krâis.
eng: You therefore must endure hardship, as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ soogɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ cu àmbò bêe à là' a ke cu nà ka', njobè' yi yu enɛ e gee ba yuu ce yi bòŋ yì ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr.
eng: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

lmp: Kwà'shi ka àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mcaŋnì, e ka' tɛ lɛ̀ mncir ce a lɛ̀ nè ŋgâa mcaŋnì ka', e so ka'.
eng: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn't crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nfà' mnsuu ce e fà' tatap à ba ba ŋwɛ̀ entombì à rye efa buu ce e fà' à mŋkʉ̀.
eng: The farmers who labor must be the first to get a share of the crops.

lmp: Kwà'shi àmbò buu ce mɛ̀ suŋ wɛ̀ na, tɛ Tata ku gee tɛ à riŋ vi.
eng: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

lmp: Kuushi enɛ Jisos Krâis ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ embe ndʉ̀' Dɛvìd à m fʉʉ efa rkwe. Ca yu Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce m ce fè'shi nè bèe.
eng: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the seed of David, according to my Good News,

lmp: M ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ca mbe shaŋ àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e bʉ' lɛ ncir wa'a njo' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ anà. Ka' a kur mɛ̀ nè bkwàŋ wa'a, àde' a kur blâa Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God's word isn't chained.

lmp: M ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ca tɛ bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à ce a bo byemi nè Jisos Krâis, koni ryôŋ rfi, koni bkù' ce vi be kè mì ka'.
eng: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones' sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

lmp: Blàa ca vi yu mini. "Sèe ka' kwe sèe Jisòs wèe, sèe ke cu sèe wowèe.
eng: This saying is faithful: For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

lmp: Sèe ka' tɛɛ tatap du ba' àlʉ̀simbùu, sèe Jisòs wèe ke sa' àbee. Sèe ka' kani ye, ye ye ke kani sèe.
eng: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

lmp: Sèe ka' tɛ ba mini nè ye ka', àde' e kupse efa rba njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu na ka'. E be kù ba yi yu mini à nfè' wɛɛwɛ."
eng: If we are faithless, he remains faithful. He can't deny himself.

lmp: Kuushi bèe buu ca, ker cep wowèe à rlii Tata Nyʉ̀ enɛ a fa ce sɛr mnsɛr à mʉ blàa jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ka'. Njɛ̀ɛ mnsɛr anà vi tʉr sɛ' ka', vi ke bepsi bèe ce a ce yu'.
eng: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord, that they don't argue about words, to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

lmp: Ghèter gee ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè Nyʉ̀ tɛ e bo yu' rbòŋ nè wɛ̀. Ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' ce àde' rìtu yi koo ye ka', ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be ce yɛ'ni bèe blâa mini yɛɛnì.
eng: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn't need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

lmp: Fa fa yo cùu njep mʉ̀ mnsɛr ka'. Àde' mnsɛr anà vi gee ŋwɛ̀ riŋ Nyʉ̀ ka', vi lò gee bèe ce a ce sɛr vi a misì mɛŋni Nyʉ̀ mɛŋni.
eng: But shun empty chatter, for they will proceed further in ungodliness,

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ mnsɛr ca vi lò ba àmbò nfur ce e ke lò beeŋger à kòtɛ nà. Bèe mo' efa mʉ̀ ŋgâa mnsɛr ca yu Hàmɛneyòs ba Fìlɛtòs.
eng: and their word will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus;

lmp: Wowèe a dà' njì, a ce yɛ'ni bèe enɛ bèe à m fʉʉ efa rkwe war. Wowèe a yɛ'ni wa'a a ce gèe bèe mo' a ce tarni yuu ce wowèe a m byemi.
eng: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

lmp: Ka' bèe anà a ce tarni wa'a, blâa Tata Nyʉ̀ vi yu mini, àtà vi kupsè ka'. Vi yu àmbò kùundap wa'a, a saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ rìŋ bèe ce a yu yì bèe." A ker saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce làa enɛ e ce dù àmbùu Tata Jisòs banɛ ŋgàŋ fa kèr gèe buu bbebep ka'."
eng: However God's firm foundation stands, having this seal, The Lord knows those who are his, and, Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.

lmp: E ke ba mbe ndàp ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr, bghee bbòŋboŋ ba mkîŋ mmbòŋmboŋ ce a gèe nè bco', ker ba mkìŋ ce a ku boo ba nè mboo mi ku ba mbo. A lò lor bghee ba mkîŋ mmbòŋmboŋ lɛ byee njo nè bkèe, lor mkìŋ ce a ku boo ba nè mboo nà lɛ byee njo nè ŋgâa ndap.
eng: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor, and some for dishonor.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' borni efa rgèe buu bbebep, e ba àmbò bghee bbòŋboŋ ba mkîŋ mmbòŋmboŋ cà. E yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara ce àde' Nyʉ̀ lor gee rfà' àgho, njobè' e tami nyor à rgèe mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ e gee nà à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master's use, prepared for every good work.

lmp: Fa kè gèe ŋgèe rnsùu ka'. Gèe ba ŋgêe yɛɛnì, foosi nè Tata Nyʉ̀, tʉr ntee rkòŋnì ba ntee cumʉnyaŋ. Wɛ gèe wa'a, yi ba enɛ à ce gèe àmbò bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce kɛ' rlii Jisòs nè ntee rara a ce gèe nà.
eng: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

lmp: Fa fa yo cùu njep mnsɛr ka'. Nsɛr yu yuu blʉr ce vi ke vʉ̀ ba nè mlap.
eng: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Tatâ, ŋgàŋ fa ba ŋwɛ̀ mnsɛr ka'. E ba ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ à ryɛ'nì, ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e kur ntee.
eng: The Lord's servant must not quarrel, but be gentle towards all, able to teach, patient,

lmp: Bèe mo' a ka' kani yuu ce e ce suŋ wowèe, e lor nfè' nashi nè wowèe njobè' àde' Nyʉ̀ gee wowèe a kupsè yap ntee lo byemi yuu ce yi yu mini,
eng: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him: perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

lmp: tɛ wap bfee vi bo kʉti wowèe mbo, tɛ wowèe a fʉʉ enjep taa Satàn ce yi m koo wowèe, a gee wowèe a ce yu'ni ba nè ye nà.
eng: and they may recover themselves out of the devil's snare, having been taken captive by him to his will.

lmp: Rìŋ enɛ be kè ba à nfè' elʉ̀simbùu tɛ ŋgɛ' ba sê.
eng: But know this, that in the last days, grievous times will come.

lmp: Bèe a be kè kòŋ wap mnyor, kòŋ mbàa sê, ce yu' nyor, kèr ce suŋni nyor, ce cɛpni. Boo foŋ a be kè tèe btu nè wap mma ba wap btâ. Bèe a be kè ce yòŋshi bèe à buu bbòŋboŋ ce a gèe nè wowèe ka', ce gèe mntùp buu.
eng: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

lmp: Bèe a be kè ce kòŋni ka', tʉr ntee rfòosì ka', ce tee mnde' mbe tu bèe mò', gèe yuu ce yàp nyor ce kòŋ enɛ a gêe, ce gèe ŋgèe mnyàa, kòŋ buu bbòŋboŋ ka'.
eng: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, no lovers of good,

lmp: Bèe a be kè ce ye mcʉ̀ mbe btu bèe mò', ce gèe buu àwàa, ce nàa nyor, kòŋ à rye ŋgòŋ, kè' kòŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God;

lmp: Wowèe a be kè rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ba à mŋgùpcùu kè' rìŋ ye enjep ntee ka', Fa tɛɛ kùu wèe njɛ̀ɛ bèe anà ka'.
eng: holding a form of godliness, but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wâp mʉ a lo la' kùu du à mndap bèe mo', bo' bbyèŋge ce a yu blʉr a ce wɛp buu njo' yàp buu bbebep ce wowèe a jep njep mʉ̀ mo.
eng: For some of these are people who creep into houses, and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ bbyèŋge anà a kòŋ à ryɛ'ni buu sê, a ce ghèter sê, a ke' riŋ yuu mini ka'.
eng: always learning, and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ mmbaŋrù ce a bo' bbyèŋge na a bàa yuu ce yi yu mini àmbò Jɛnìs ba Jɛmbrɛ̀s a m gèe nè Musìs nà. Wap mntee vi yu bsii, lap rbyemì li ba mini ka'.
eng: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so do these also oppose the truth; men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith, are rejected.

lmp: Bèe a be lò tee yàp mbùu tɛ wowèe a yɛɛti àwaŋ àmbò Jɛnìs ba Jɛmbrɛ̀s a m yɛɛti nà.
eng: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

lmp: Wɛ̂ Timotì, wɛ̀ rìŋ la ryɛ'nì ba njɛ̀ɛ njì ce m ce cu la rcu, a riŋ yuu ce m ce kòŋ à rgèe njep ŋgòŋ na, a yɛ la rbyemì, a yɛ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce m ce kur ntee, a yɛ la rkòŋnì, a yɛ foŋ àmbò mɛ̀ tɛɛ tatap nè Jisòs,
eng: But you did follow my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

lmp: a yɛ ŋgɛ' ce bèe a m ce fa nè mɛ̀, a yɛ mlù ce mɛ̀ m ce yɛ. Wɛ̀ m yɛ yuu ce yi m koni mɛ̀ à rla' Antìyòk ba à rla' Ìkonìyòm ker ba à rla' Listrà. Bèe a m fa mɛ ŋgɛ' sê, mɛ̀ ku tɛɛ tatap, Tata Jisos à ja' mɛ efa ŋgɛ' anà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: persecutions, and sufferings: those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. Out of them all the Lord delivered me.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ bèe a be fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Jisòs, a ce kòŋ à rcu lap rcu àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ.
eng: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

lmp: Ŋgèe bèe ce a yu yap ba bêe bbebep, a ce bo'shi enɛ a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ se nà, yi be bep càa ŋger. Wowèe a be kè ce bo' bèe, ce bo' wap btu foŋ.
eng: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

lmp: Kù tɛɛ yo ba njep buu ce a m yɛ'ni wɛ̀, wɛ̀ rîŋ, a byemi enɛ vi yu mini nà, kuushi bèe ce a m yɛ'ni wɛ̀ buu anà.
eng: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

lmp: Wɛ̀ rìŋ enɛ kɛ̂' à nfè' ce wɛ̀ m ba ghàrŋwɛ̀ vʉ ghɛɛ sè'ni na, wɛ̀ rìŋ blàa embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ sê. Àde' blàa anà vi gee à tʉr bfee, byemi nè Jisos Krâis, lûŋ.
eng: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith, which is in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Blàa wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀, vi lò ese Nyʉ̀, a tʉr sɛ' sê. Vi yu à ryɛ'ni bèe, a ba à rlapni bèe ce a ce yɛ'nì ryɛ'nì mnde', a ba à rnàshi bèe, a ker ba à rcep bèe tɛ a bo cu rcu ryɛɛnì,
eng: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fà' nè Nyʉ̀ bo tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ, ghɛɛte à rgèe mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ.
eng: that the man of God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

lmp: M ce làa nè wɛ̀ tatap à bsii Nyʉ̀, ker ba à bsii Jisos Krâis ce e be kè sa' bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a cu btèe ker ba bèe ce a kweŋger. À ka' ba njobè' e be vʉ̀ tɛ e bo sa' wowèe àmbò ŋkʉʉ, m ce làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ,
eng: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

lmp: à fe'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, kɛ̀ yu à nfê' mbembep ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu a nfê' mbòŋmboŋ ɛ̀, gèe tɛ wowèe a riŋ yàp buu bbebep, lapni wowèe, fa wowèe ŋger, yɛ'ni wowèe nè ntee mʉfɛ̀ɛ.
eng: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort, with all patience and teaching.

lmp: Yɛ'ni wowèe njobè' nfè' mò' be ba ce bèe a be kèr kòŋ à ryu' ryɛ'nì ce li yu mini ka', kòŋ ba à rgèe buu ce wowèe à gwɛɛ. Yi ba wa'a tɛ wowèe a kɛ' ku' ŋgâa ryɛ'nì mo' enɛ a vʉ yɛ'ni wowèe ba buu ce wowèe a kòŋ.
eng: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but, having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts;

lmp: Wowèe a be kè kòŋ à ryu' yuu ce yi yu mini ka', kòŋ ba à ryu' mghàghar ce bèe a ce suŋ àmbò buu enjep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn aside to fables.

lmp: Timotì, tɛɛ yo yɛɛnì à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, tɛɛ tatap à nfè' ŋgɛ', gee rfà' ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ à ba gèe, gèe rfà' wɛɛwɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè wɛ̀.
eng: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò mɛ̀, nfè' ce ghɛɛ ce m be fa la ryòŋ nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò taŋshì wa'a. Nfè' ce m be mà'shi à ghɛɛ.
eng: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ghèter a caŋ mcaŋnì ce mmbòŋmboŋ a misî, a tɛɛ ba njep mini a ba' àlʉ̀simbùu.
eng: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ sè'ni mɛnɛ blà' ce a kupshi a lɛ nè mɛ̀ njo' ya ŋgêe yɛɛnì vi yu àgho. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kè fa mɛ̀ blà' anà be kè fa Tata Jisòs ce e ke sa' vi mnsa' yɛɛnì. E be kè fa mɛ̀ blà' ca à nòŋ ce e vʉ̀. E be kè fa ba nè mɛ̀ cà' ka. E be kè fa nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce nyàŋnyaŋ à ryɛ nòŋ ce e be vʉ̀ anà.
eng: From now on, there is stored up for me the crown of righteousness, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

lmp: Ghèter vʉ ghàaghèr vʉ yɛ mɛ̀,
eng: Be diligent to come to me soon,

lmp: njobè' Dimàs à kòŋ yi yu ba buu enjep ŋgòŋ, a ma'shi mɛ̀ a du à to' Tɛ̀sàlonikà. Krîsɛ̀n à du yi ba à ŋgôŋ Gàlɛshà, Taitòs à du yi ba à ŋgôŋ Dàlmashà.
eng: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia, and Titus to Dalmatia.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu wèr ye ku ba Lûk. Lòr Mak tɛ wèe ye vʉ tɛ e bo jà' mɛ̀ à rfà' ce m ce gèe.
eng: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark, and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

lmp: Mɛ̀ tuu Tikikòs à rla' Ɛfɛsòs.
eng: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

lmp: Wɛ vʉ̀ à tʉr kur ce mɛ̀ m lɛ̀ nè Kapòs à rla' Trowàs, ker ba wa mŋwà', laŋlaŋ wa mŋwâ' bbòŋboŋ cà.
eng: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come, and the books, especially the parchments.

lmp: Àlɛ̀ksandà ŋwɛ̀ ntòo nlàa à m gèe buu bbebep nè mɛ̀ sê. Tata Nyʉ̀ be là' ye à buu ce e gèe nè mɛ̀ anà.
eng: Alexander, the coppersmith, did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his works,

lmp: Lòr nfè' nè ye njobè' e m jepsi blâa Nyʉ̀ ce wèr à m ce fè'shi nà sê.
eng: of whom you also must beware; for he greatly opposed our words.

lmp: A m dù nè mɛ̀ mbe kor à nfè' entòmbì, bèe wɛɛwɛ a caŋ a ma' mɛ̀, ŋwɛ̀ ce e tɛɛ yà njìnsa' à ke' ba ka'. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ fa bàa wowèe njobè' wowèe a m gèe nè mɛ̀ wa' ka'.
eng: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

lmp: Ka' yi m ba wa'a, Tata Jisòs à ku ba wèr ye a fa mɛ̀ ŋger, tɛ m bo fè'shi buu Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ nè bèe enje jɛɛ tɛ wowèe a yu'. Nyʉ̀ à m fʉr mɛ̀ ekù cùu bʉrʉ̀'.
eng: But the Lord stood by me, and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear; and I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

lmp: Tata Jisòs be jà' mɛ̀ efa ŋgɛ' wɛɛwɛ, lòr mɛ̀ dù àgho mbe bùu mbe dì' ce e ce sa' yi kʉʉ. Sèe ku'si ye à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work, and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom; to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Cà'ni Prîskà ba Àkwilà ker ba bèe embe ndàp Ònisiforòs.
eng: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

lmp: Ìrastòs à m cu à rla' Korèn, mɛ̀ ma'shì Trôfimòs à rla' Milɛtɛ̀ns njobè' e m ce yaŋ.
eng: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

lmp: Ghèter vʉ tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' fʉte. Yùbulòs ba Pudàn ba Lainòs ba Klâudìyà ker ba bfʉr wɛɛwɛ, a cà'ni wɛ̀.
eng: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Nyʉ̀ ke'ni lo ryòŋ, tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Nyʉ̀ a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. Nyʉ̀ à m ce mɛ̀ tɛ m bo jà' bèe ce e ce, tɛ wowèe a bo byemi nè ye, rìŋ yuu mini ce àde' yi gee ŋwɛ̀ cu rcu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ.
eng: Paul, a servant of God, and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's chosen ones, and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ cu njɛ̀ɛ rcu ca njobè' e ce kè' ryòŋ ce nfesè. Tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' kè ba, Nyʉ̀ ce e ke nya' mnde' ka' à m kà' enɛ e be fa bèe njɛ̀ɛ ryòŋ ca.
eng: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can't lie, promised before time began;

lmp: Nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ, Nyʉ̀ à gee yi nlàa yi yɛɛtì àwaŋ, bèe a riŋ buu ca. Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà' à fa blàa ca mba mɛ̂ mmbò enɛ m fe'shi nè bèe.
eng: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior;

lmp: M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè Taitòs ce e yu muu wà ce mini njobè' e byemi nè Jisos Krâis àmbò sèe à byemi nà. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Ta ker ba Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà', tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m mà'shi enɛ à cu à to' Krêt tɛ à bo nàshi buu embe cor ce vi yu yɛɛnì ka' nà, kèr ce btu embe cor à bcor ce vi yu à bu' mla' wɛɛwɛ. Kuushi enɛ mɛ̀ m làa nè wɛ̀ enɛ,
eng: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking, and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you;

lmp: à ka' ce ce tu embe côr, à ce ba ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe a rìŋ enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ, a tʉr ŋgwa mò'sir cà'cà', boo vi foŋ a ba ŋgâa rbyemì, yap ŋgèe à ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ce àde' bèe a yɛ laa enɛ wowèe a ce gèe buu bbebep kɛ̀ enɛ a tèe btu ka'.
eng: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fyɛ' bèe Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce mfà' Nyʉ̀ mi yu mba yê mmbò. Banɛ yi ŋgèe yi ba bòŋboŋ. E fa nàa tu kɛ̀ tʉr ntee cɛcɛp ka'. E fa lɛ ntee à buu mno ka'. E fa ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe buu ba à mntee ka'. E fa ba ŋwɛ̀ roŋ mbàa ka'.
eng: For the overseer must be blameless, as God's steward; not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

lmp: E ba ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu mmbo mtoo, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ ba yuu bòŋboŋ. E ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kwà'shi buu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀, ba ŋwɛ̀ nyɛɛnì, ba ŋwɛ̀ nrara à bsii Nyʉ̀, ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e mà'shi yì nyor àwàa ka'.
eng: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled;

lmp: E ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be tɛɛ njep ryɛ'nì mini ce a yɛ'ni ye, tɛ ye ye foŋ bo rìŋ à ryɛ'ni bèe mo' bòŋboŋ, kèr gee tɛ yi yɛɛti rara enɛ bèe ce a ce kani ryɛ'nì ca nà a ce jep jep.
eng: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

lmp: M ce làa wa'a njobè' bèe ce a tèe btu a yu gòr sê, laŋlaŋ bêe à mʉ̀ ŋgâa ŋgèe bʉ̀. Njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca a yu ŋgâa làa buu bcicì, a ce bo' bèe nè wap blàa anà.
eng: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

lmp: Gèe tɛ wowèe a baate yap cùu njobè' wowèe a ce yɛ'ni ba yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì ka'. A ku ce ròo ba nduunjì à rkoni mbàa à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e yu nè rìtu- ŋwɛ̀. Wowèe a jepsi rbyemì embe mndap bèe mo' nè wap blàa anà.
eng: whose mouths must be stopped; men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain's sake.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bêe à to' Krêt anà, ce e m ce yɛ buu ce vi be kè ba, à m làa enɛ̂, "Bêe à to' Krêt a yu ŋgâa mnde'. Wowèe a yu àmbò mnyàa efa rìŋ wa'a, a ba mŋkuŋri ce a yu bbor."
eng: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.

lmp: Yuu ce e m làa anà yi yu mini. Banɛ à lapni wowèe tatap sê, tɛ wowèe a bo byemi ba yuu ce yi yu mini.
eng: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

lmp: Fa mà'shi tɛ wowèe a ker du àmbùu mghàghar Jûs, kɛ̀ kèr yu'ni nè rsa' ce bèe ce a kani yuu mini a fa nà ka'.
eng: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr ntee rara, banɛ buu wɛɛwɛ be ba brara a yê bsii. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tʉr ntee sii, ke' byemi ka' banɛ buu wɛɛwɛ vi be ba brara nè ye ka' njobè' mi mkwà'shì mi yu msii, e ke' ker rìŋ jɛɛ jɛɛ efa yuu bòŋboŋ ba yuu bebep ka'.
eng: To the pure, all things are pure; but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca a lòr enɛ a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ sê, buu ce wowèe a ce gèe vi ce dùŋshi enɛ wowèe a mɛŋni Nyʉ̀. Wowèe a yu bêe bcicì, a tee btu. Àde' wowèe a gèe yuu bòŋboŋ ka'.
eng: They profess that they know God, but by their works they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wɛ̀, yɛ'ni bèe ba ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ce ryɛ'nî rbòŋboŋ li làa enɛ bèe a gêe.
eng: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

lmp: Làa nè mmbaŋrù ce a yu bleebèe enɛ wowèe a tʉr ba ntee bobor, ke' lor buu àtɛ̀r ka; kwa'shi buu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀; byemi nè Jisos Krâis nè mini- ŋwɛ̀, koŋ bèe, tɛɛ tatap.
eng: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in patience:

lmp: Làa nè bbyèŋge ce a yu bleebèe foŋ enɛ wowèe a gee ŋgèe ce yi yu nè ryu'nì-ŋwɛ̀. Wowèe a fa tee mnde' mbe tu bèe mo', kɛ̀ ba bkwàa nè mrù' ka'. Wowèe a yɛ'ni bèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ,
eng: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

lmp: tɛ ryɛ'nì ca li bo gèe tɛ bbyèŋge ce a bii bghàrbèe nà a bo kòŋ bduu wap ba boo wap,
eng: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

lmp: gèe buu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀, ba brara enjep ntee, fyɛ' wap mndap bòŋboŋ, gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe mo', yu'ni nè bduu wap. Wowèe a gee wa'a fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo koni njì à rlàa yuu bebep àmbò blâa Nyʉ̀ njo' yap ŋgèe ka'.
eng: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God's word may not be blasphemed.

lmp: Cep boo mnsùnsù foŋ enɛ wowèe a fa mà'shi wap mnyor àwàa ka'.
eng: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded;

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò wɛ̀, yuu wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̀ ka' ce gèe, à gee ba yuu bòŋboŋ tɛ bèe mo' a bo yɛ bè'ni. Yɛ'ni bèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, fa gèe ŋkɛ̀rbuu nè lo ryɛ'nì ka'.
eng: in all things showing yourself an example of good works; in your teaching showing integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

lmp: Làa ba blâa bbòŋboŋ ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' jaasì ka', tɛ rìtu yi bo koo bèe ce a kani lisèe rfà'. Rìtu yi be koo wowèe njobè' wowèe a yɛ yuu bebep ce àde' a suŋ àmbò sèe ka'.
eng: and soundness of speech that can't be condemned; that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

lmp: Làa nè bkwàa enɛ wowèe a yu'ni nè wâp mmasà, gee buu wɛɛwɛ ce wap mmasà a kòŋ enɛ wowèe a gêe. Wowèe a fa sɛr mnsɛr ka'.
eng: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing in all things; not contradicting;

lmp: Wowèe a fa cwàr mmbo ka'. Wowèe a fa' nè wap mmasà nè ntee mo'sir à nfè' wɛɛwɛ tɛ yap ŋgèe yi bo gèe tɛ bèe a vʉse buu ce sèe ce yɛ'ni àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà'.
eng: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

lmp: Kuushi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m gèe yi ŋgêe bòŋboŋ yi yɛɛtì àwaŋ tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a bo lùŋ.
eng: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

lmp: Yi ŋgêe ca yi ce yɛ'ni sèe enɛ sèe borni ŋgèe ce bèe ce a mɛŋni Nyʉ̀ a ke gèe, ker borni efa rlɛ̀ ntee à buu enjep ŋgòŋ na. Yi ce yɛ'ni sèe foŋ enɛ sèe cu rcu ce li yu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀, ba mini tɛ yisèe ŋgèe enjep ŋgòŋ na yi bo ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world;

lmp: Sêe ce cu wa'a, ce kè' nfè' ce Jisos Krâis be vʉ̀ nè vi bghònì, tɛ yi fòo yi yɛɛti àwaŋ. E yu yìsèe Nyʉ̂ ŋgòr, a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ rjà'.
eng: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ;

lmp: E m kwe a sêe btù tɛ e bo fʉr sèe efa buu bbebep, kèr gèe tɛ sèe ba brara enjep ntee, ba yì bèe ce a ce lu'shi à rgèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ.
eng: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

lmp: Suŋ bèe buu ca. Cep, ker lapni bèe nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀. Fa mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' lor wɛ̀ àtɛ̀r ka'.
eng: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise you.

lmp: Kuushi bèe enɛ wowèe a yu'ni nè bèe ce a ce sa' wowèe ba bèe ce a yu btu mnta' nè wowèe. Wowèe a yu'ni nè bèe ca ker tami nyor à rgèe njɛ̀ɛ rfà' ce li ka' ba yɛɛnì.
eng: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

lmp: Wowèe a fa làa yuu bebep àmbò ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka, borni mlap, gee buu nè rbonì-ŋwɛ̀, ba mʉfɛ̀ɛ à yap ŋgèe nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

lmp: À m ba entombì wer wèr foŋ à ba blʉr, a tee btu. Wèr à m dà' nduunjì. Wèr à m ba bkwàa nè buu wɛɛwɛ ce yèr nyor à m kòŋ. Mer mkwà'shì mi m ba mmbembep, wèr à ce ko'ndoŋ nè bèe, bèe a mmbaa wèr, wèr à baa wowèe foŋ.
eng: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

lmp: À ka' ba mbe nfè' mò', Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà' à duŋshì sèe yi ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ba li rkòŋnì,
eng: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

lmp: a ja' sèe. E m jà' sèe njo' buu bbòŋboŋ mo' ce sèe à m gèe ka'. À m ba njo' yì ŋkoosimnse. E m sù'si visèe mntee vi ba brara, a fa sèe ryôŋ rfi, yi yʉ' yi gee sèe à ba bêe bfi.
eng: not by works of righteousness, which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

lmp: À ka' ba njo' yuu ce Jisòs Krâis ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà' à m gèe, e fa sèe yi yʉ' sê,
eng: whom he poured out on us richly, through Jesus Christ our Savior;

lmp: tɛ sèe bo ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njo' yi ŋgêe bòŋboŋ, lò koni ryòŋ ce nfesè ce sèe ce kè' nà.
eng: that, being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

lmp: Nlàa ca yu nlâa mini. M ce kòŋ enɛ à laa buu ca tatap sê, tɛ bèe ce a byemi nè Nyʉ̀ a bo lòr nfè' ce gèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ. Buu ca vi yu byɛɛnì, sɛ' à ba njo nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you affirm confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

lmp: Fa sɛr mnsɛr blʉr ka'. Fa càasi nfè' à rbè' bràrà bèe ce a m kweŋger ka', fa ba ŋwɛ̀ mlap ka', fa ce sɛr mnsɛr àmbò mncir ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè Musìs nà ka'. Njɛ̀ɛ buu ca yu buu bcicì, sɛ' à ba njo ka'.
eng: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' sɛr yuu ce à ce yɛ'ni, à cep ye. E ka' tɛ yu' ka' à ker cep ye. Wɛ̀ ka' cep ye nfè' baa e ke' yu' ka', à fa tʉr yuu mo' à rgèe wèe ye ka'.
eng: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning;

lmp: Rìŋ enɛ mkwà'shì njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ca mi jep, e ce gèe buu bbebep, a lor ndòo mbe yê tù.
eng: knowing that such a one is perverted, and sins, being self-condemned.

lmp: M be tuu Àtimà kɛ Tàikokòs ɛ̀, tɛ e vʉ yɛ wɛ̀. E ka' vʉ ba', à vʉ cɛrcɛr sê, vʉ yɛ mɛ̀ à rla' Nìkapolìs njobè' mɛ̀ kwà'shi enɛ m be cu à rla' ca tɛ lùu yi she.
eng: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

lmp: Ghèter ja' Sɛnàs ce e riŋ mncir se nà, ker ja' Àpolòs à rjɛ̀r ce wowèe a ce tami nyor à rjɛ̀r nà, yɛ enɛ wowèe a tʉr buu ce vi be jà' wowèe à rjɛ̀r anà.
eng: Send Zenas, the lawyer, and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

lmp: Gèe tɛ yìsèe bèe a lor yàp nfè' ce gèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ tɛ wowèe a bo koni buu ce vi be jà' wowèe kèr jà' bèe mo' foŋ. Wowèe a fa lòr yàp nfè' bʉsi ba à cicì ka'.
eng: Let our people also learn to maintain good works for necessary uses, that they may not be unfruitful.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèr wowèe yu àfa a cà'ni wɛ̀. Cà'ni bèe wɛɛwɛ ce sèe wowèe à byemi nè Jisos Krâis, wowèe a kòŋ wèr nà. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr wèe wɛɛwɛ à ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pôl, ce m yu mbe shaŋ àtu Jisos Krâis. M ce saŋ yi wèr Timotì ce e yu nfʉr yìsèe. Wèr ce saŋ nè wɛ̀ ce Fìlemʉ̀n ce wèr kòŋ sê, sèe à ce fà' à yuu mo'sir, ba bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce a ke tarshi mbe wɛ̂ ndàp.
eng: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

lmp: Wèr ce saŋ yi foŋ nè wɛ̀, Àfiyà ce à yu njar yèr, ker ba wɛ̀ ce Àcipòs ce sèe à rè bsìp a rfè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ.
eng: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus, our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Ta Nyʉ̀, ba Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Mɛ ke kuushi wɛ̀ à nfè' m ce loo, ker ce yòŋshi Nyʉ̀ a wɛ̂ tù,
eng: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

lmp: njobè' m ce yu' àmbò à kòŋ bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, a ker byemi nè Tata Jisos Krâis.
eng: hearing of your love, and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus, and toward all the saints;

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ lisèe rtarshî àbee àmbò ŋgâa rbyemì li gee tɛ à rìŋ bòŋboŋ àmbò bghònì ce sèe à koni àmbò bèe Jisos Krâis.
eng: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective, in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

lmp: Nfʉrà, njɛ̀ɛ rkòŋnì ce à tʉr nè bèe Nyʉ̀ li gèe mɛ̀ ce lu'shi, a ker tapsi mɛ̀. Wɛ̀ kòŋ wowèe wa'a, a gee wap mntee vi fʉtè.
eng: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

lmp: Àmbò m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu Jisos Krâis, àde' m laa nè wɛ̀ a mɛ̂ ŋger mɛnɛ à gee yuu ce à tʉr à rgèe.
eng: Therefore, though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

lmp: A ka' ba njobè' rkòŋnì ce à tʉr na, m be loo wɛ̀ loo. Kuushi wɛnɛ ce loo mɛ̀ e loo wɛ̀, mɛ̀ ce Pol ce m yu nleeŋwɛ̀ sè'ni, a ba mbe shaŋ àtu Jisos Krâis.
eng: yet for love's sake I rather beg, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ à koo muu wà Ònɛsimòs ce mɛ̀ bèeti yi ta sè'ni ce m yu mbe shaŋ na.
eng: I beg you for my child, whom I have become the father of in my chains, Onesimus,

lmp: À m ba à nfè' entombì e ba yuu cicì nè wɛ̀; sè'ni e yu lulu nè wɛ̀ ker ba nè mɛ̀ foŋ.
eng: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

lmp: M ce kʉsi ye ce e yu wa mntee nè wɛ̀.
eng: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

lmp: Sè'ni ce mɛ̀ niŋ shaŋ njobè' Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ na, mɛ̀ ba kòŋ à rlɛ̀ ye àfa tɛ e lor yo dì', ce jà' mɛ̀.
eng: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ke' gèe wa' ka', njobè' m ce kòŋ à rgèe yuu ce à buu efa rrìŋ enjo ka'. M ce kòŋ ba mɛnɛ à ka' ce gee yuu bòŋboŋ nè mɛ̀ à gee ba àmbò wɛ̀ gwɛɛ.
eng: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

lmp: Seemò' yi yu enɛ ye ce Ònɛsimòs à m caŋ ese wɛ̀ dù cu nfè' mʉcàr, e kʉti bo cu wèe ye nfesè.
eng: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while, that you would have him forever,

lmp: E be kʉti kèr cu wèe ye sè'ni ba àmbò ŋkwàa ka', e gha' ŋkwàa sè'ni. E be cu wèe ye sè'ni ba àmbò nfʉr ce wèe ye kòŋni. E yu yuu gòr nè mɛ̀ sê. E ka' ba nè mɛ̀ wa'a, yi ka' ba yi kɛ àmbò wɛ̀ ce e yu yò ŋwɛ̀ rfà' a ker ba nfʉrò ce wèe ye yu bèe Tatâ?
eng: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother, especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

lmp: Banɛ yi ka' ba mini enɛ sò yu à ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, à konì ye àmbò wɛ̀ ba koni mɛ̀.
eng: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

lmp: À ka' ba enɛ e m fàa yuu mo' nè wɛ̀, kɛ̀ e m ye wɛ̀ ba rkaa ɛ̀, à suŋ mɛ̀ tɛ m la'.
eng: But if he has wronged you at all, or owes you anything, put that to my account.

lmp: Ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pol nè ya bo, m be là'. Banɛ m ker làa yuu àmbò rkaa ce wɛ̀ tʉr mɛ̀ ka', rkaa ce yu ba yo tu nyor.
eng: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides.

lmp: Nfʉrà, m ce loo wɛ̀ à rlii Tata mɛnɛ à ja' mɛ̀, gee yuu bòŋboŋ ca nè mɛ̀. Gèe wa' njobè' Jisos Krâis, tɛ ya ntee yi bo kèr tap.
eng: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

lmp: A mbùu ce m ce saŋ na, mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ à be gèe yuu ce mɛ̀ làa na, kèr gèe caa embo nà.
eng: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

lmp: M ce làa foŋ enɛ à kupshi dì' rnòŋ nè mɛ̀, njobè' m ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ le rloo li be gèe tɛ Nyʉ̀ ker tuusi mɛ̀ nè wèe.
eng: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

lmp: Ɛ̀pafràs ce wèr ye à niŋ shaŋ bsìp àtu Jisos Krâis, à cà'ni wɛ̀.
eng: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

lmp: Mak ba Àristakòs, Demàs, ker ba Lukas ce wèr wowèe ce fà', a cà'ni wɛ̀ foŋ.
eng: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisos Krâis tʉr wèe a ntee bòŋboŋ.
eng: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

lmp: À m ba elûuŋgòŋ, Nyʉ̀ à laa nè visèe bta nfè' àŋgoo à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. E m làa njì enjep bèe ce a m ce cep yi ntuu nè bèe.
eng: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' e sè'ni ce yu ba mnòŋ elʉ̀simbùu, Nyʉ̀ à laa nè sèe njì enjep muu yì. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ŋgòŋ ca wɛɛwɛ ba njì enjep muu yì anà. Nyʉ̀ à m ce ye tɛ e bo fa buu wɛɛwɛ mba yê mmbò.
eng: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

lmp: Fòo Nyʉ̀ yi ce yɛɛti ba njì enjep muu yì, sèe à riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ yu ba njì enjep ye, njobè' e ku ba àmbò Nyʉ̀ yu. Muu yì ca ce lòr vi blàa ce vi tʉr ŋger sê, a ce gèe ŋgòŋ ca yi ku bii àgho. E m lòr yì nyor a gee taŋshì àgho tɛ e bo gèe tɛ Nyʉ̀ foosi sèe efa yìsèe buu bbebep. E ka' gèe wa'a, a ko' mbe bùu, a cu à bo mà' Nyʉ̀ ce yi kʉʉ yi tɛɛ kùntombì.
eng: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, when he had by himself made purification for our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m fa muu yì nta' ce yi càa mnta' bcìndap Nyʉ̀. Cena yi ku ba foŋ àmbò rlii ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè ye li caa mlii bcìndap Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: having become so much better than the angels, as he has inherited a more excellent name than they have.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m be laa yuu ce e m làa àmbò muu yì nè yì ncìndap mò' ka'. E m làa àmbò muu yì enɛ̂, "À yu muu wà, kɛ' e ntìni m yu yò tâ." E m ker laa àmbò muu yì enɛ̂, "M be ba yì tâ, tɛ e ba muu wà." Nyʉ̀ à m be laa àmbò yì ncìndap mò' wa' ka'.
eng: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, You are my Son. Today have I become your father? and again, I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ba enɛ e be fa muu yì ce à m ba muu rŋgòo njep ŋgòŋ, a laa enɛ̂, "Tɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ a gʉ'shi nè ye."
eng: Again, when he brings in the firstborn into the world he says, Let all the angels of God worship him.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò bcìndap, e a laa enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à m gèe vi bcìndap a ba àmbò fu', yi ŋgâa mfà' anà a ba àmbò mcùŋ mor."
eng: Of the angels he says, Who makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò muu, Nyʉ̀ à laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀, yo kʉʉ yi be cu nfesè. À be sa' yo to' nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: But of the Son he says, Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

lmp: Wɛ̀ kòŋ ŋgêe bòŋboŋ, a baa ŋgêe bebep. A mbùu ce Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yò Nyʉ̀ à ce wɛ̀ enɛ à ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ce lu'shi caa bfʉr wo."
eng: You have loved righteousness, and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

lmp: E ker laa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ Tatâ, à m ba efa rkɛ̀', wɛ̀ gee ŋgòŋ ba buu embe bùu wɛɛwɛ nè mo mmbo.
eng: And, You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

lmp: Buu ca vi be kè bʉ tɛ à ku cu nfesè. Vi be kʉti brʉ̀ʉ àmbò bcɛ̀' wa'a.
eng: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

lmp: À be kashi buu ca àmbò a ke kashi cɛ̀' nà. Vi be kupse àmbò cɛ̀' yi ke kwe ncòo, kupse nà. À ka' ba yi àmbò wɛ̀, à be kupse ka', àde' à ke kwe ka'."
eng: As a mantle, you will roll them up, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years will not fail.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' yu ce Nyʉ̀ à m be laa yuu ce e m làa nè muu yì nè ye ka'. E m làa nè muu yì enɛ̂, "Cu a mɛ̂ bo mà' caar tɛ m gee tɛ à tɛr mkùu mbendù bèe ce a bàa wɛ̀."
eng: But which of the angels has he told at any time, Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?

lmp: Banɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ku ba ba byʉ' ce vi ke gèe rfà' nè Nyʉ̀. E ke tuu vi enɛ vi du ja' bèe ce e be gèe tɛ wowèe a lûŋ.
eng: Aren't they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

lmp: Àmbò sèe rìŋ buu ca wa'a, banɛ sèe à ba lòr blàa ce sèe à yu' àmbò ye na tatap sê, fà dì' sèe lo fʉʉ enjo ka'.
eng: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

lmp: Sèe à rìŋ seenɛ blàa ce bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a m suŋ nè visèe bta vi m tʉr ŋger sê. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ka' tee tu, yu'ni nè blàa anà ka', e m ku yɛ ŋgɛ' ce e m ba yɛ.
eng: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just recompense;

lmp: Àmbò yi yu wa'a, sèe à ka' lor blàa ce vi yu àmbò rlùŋ ce li vʉ̀ ese Nyʉ̀ na àtɛ̀r, sèe gee seekɛ ka' fʉʉ efa ŋgɛ'. Tata Jisòs à m kɛ̀' a suŋ bèe blàa ca, bèe ce a m yu' blàa ca ese ye a gèe sèe à riŋ enɛ blàa anà vi yu mini.
eng: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation--which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe buu bbɛ̀ɛ, a duŋshi yi ŋger à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a ker lor ŋger ce yi ke vʉ̀ ese yi Yʉ' Rara, a gapshi nè bèe àmbò e m kòŋ, tɛ bèe a bo rìŋ foŋ enɛ blàa ca vi yu mini.
eng: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe enɛ ŋgòŋ mo' ce wèr à suŋ wèe enɛ yi be vʉ̀ nà, be sa' ba bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: For he didn't subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

lmp: E m gèe ba àmbò a saŋ mbe dì' mo' embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀. A saŋ mbo enɛ̂, "Tatâ, muu ŋwɛ̀ yu kɛ tɛ à ka' kwà'shi àmbò ye? E yu kɛ tɛ à ka' jà' ye.
eng: But one has somewhere testified, saying, What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

lmp: Wɛ̀ m gèe yi nta' yi sɛtè embe nta' bcìndap Nyʉ̀ à mʉ nfè' mò', mʉ nfè' anà à ka' càa, wɛ̀ fa ye nta' kʉʉ ba ryu'nì,
eng: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

lmp: a gee e tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ foŋ." Àmbò e tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ wa'a, banɛ yuu mo' yi yu ce e be buu efa rtʉr ŋger mbendù mo ka'. À ka' ba à nfè' e sè'ni na, sèe à ke' be yɛ ne àmbò ŋwɛ̀ tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ ka'.
eng: You have put all things in subjection under his feet. For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don't see all things subjected to him, yet.

lmp: Ka' àmbò wèr à yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ka' na, wèr à yɛ Jisòs. À m ba à mʉ nfè' mò' Nyʉ̀ à gee nta' Jisòs yi sɛtè embe nta' bcìndap Nyʉ̀. À ka' ba njobè' ŋgɛ' ce Jisòs à m yɛ, a kwe, Nyʉ̀ à lo a fa ye nta' kʉʉ, a gee enɛ bèe a yu'ni nè ye. À ka' ba njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ, yi ba enɛ Jisòs à kwe àtu bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ à gèe Nyʉ̀, à ba yì buu. À ka' ba njobè' e m ròo enɛ bèe magòr a koni fɛŋ à rba boo vi, sa' fòo, yi m ba yɛɛnì enɛ e gee tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e be mʉ̀' njì nà yɛ ŋgɛ', ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e gee wowèe a lûŋ.
eng: For it became him, for whom are all things, and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

lmp: Yi yu enɛ Jisòs ce e ke gèe bèe a ba brara à bsii Nyʉ̀, ker ba bèe ce e ke gèe wowèe a ba brara anà, a ku tʉr tàr mò'sir. A mbùu ce rìtu yi ce koo Jisòs à rtoo wowèe enɛ bfʉr vi ka'.
eng: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' e laa enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀, m be suŋ bfʉr wa àmbò njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce à yu; m be tɛɛ à mʉ̀ yò bèe, yòp yɛɛ, nɛ̀si wɛ̀."
eng: saying, I will declare your name to my brothers. In the midst of the congregation I will sing your praise.

lmp: E kèr làa àmbò ŋwɛ̀ e ke làa, laa enɛ̂, "M be lɛ̀ buu wɛɛwɛ mbe mmbo Nyʉ̀." E m ker laa foŋ enɛ̂, "Yɛ là mɛ̀ wèr boo ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè mɛ̀."
eng: Again, I will put my trust in him. Again, Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.

lmp: Boo vi anà ku ba bèe ce a tʉr lɛɛ foŋ. Jisòs ye ye à m vʉ̀ a ku ba ŋwɛ̀ àmbò wowèe tɛ e bo kwe, bepsi ŋger Satàn, njobè' Satàn a ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger à rvʉ̀ nè rkwe mbendù bèe.
eng: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

lmp: E m gèe wa'a, a ja' bèe ce a m ba bkwàa njobè' a m ce wɛp rkwe.
eng: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

lmp: Yi yu rara enɛ e m vʉ̀ ba à rjà' bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ka', e m vʉ̀ ba à rjà' ŋgʉ̀ Abràhâm.
eng: For most certainly, he doesn't give help to angels, but he gives help to the seed of Abraham.

lmp: Yi m ba yɛɛnì enɛ e beeŋger ba àmbò bfʉr vi à mnduunjì wɛɛwɛ, tɛ e bo ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce e be fà' nè Nyʉ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, koosimnse nè bèe, tɛ e bo maa yàp buu bbebep.
eng: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

lmp: E ghɛɛte à rjà' bèe ce rmòoshì li vʉ̀ nè wowèe njobè' rmòoshì li m vʉ̀ nè ye ye, e riŋ ŋgɛ' efa rmòoshì foŋ.
eng: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe bo ba yì bèe. Banɛ wèe kwa'shi àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce Jisòs yu. A ye ce e tɛɛ àtu Nyʉ̀, a ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì efa buu Nyʉ̀ ce sèe à byemi àgho.
eng: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;

lmp: E m gèe rfà' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce ye enɛ e gee nà nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. E m ku gee rfà' anà nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò Musìs ye ye à m gèe nè bèe Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

lmp: Jisòs yu ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe a ba kù'si ye càa Musìs, àmbò bèe a ke kù'si ŋwɛ̀ ce e bà'ri ndap caa ndap ce e bà'ri nà.
eng: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who built the house has more honor than the house.

lmp: Ndap mò' yu ce à buu efa rbà'ri ŋwɛ̀ ka'. Ka' yi yu wa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e m gèe buu wɛɛwɛ yu Nyʉ̀.
eng: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

lmp: Musìs à m gèe rfà' nè bèe Nyʉ̀ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. E m gèe rfà' ca wa'a a ku ba ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Nyʉ̀. Li rfà' anà li m tɛɛ ba àtu yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m bii ka' gèe tɛ bèe a rîŋ.
eng: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

lmp: Jisos Krâis yu yi ba muu ce e tʉr ŋger mbendù bèe Nyʉ̀ àmbò muu ŋwɛ̀ ndap e ke tʉr ŋger mbendù buu yì ta nà. E ce gèe rfà' anà nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. See sèe yu bèe Nyʉ̀, ce sèe à ka' ku tɛɛ tatap, lɛ mmir mbendù buu ce Nyʉ̀ a kà' nè sèe, ce yu' rbòŋ à rsuŋ bèe buu anà.
eng: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

lmp: Banɛ wèe à ba yu' yuu ce Yʉ' Rara yi làa. Yi làa enɛ̂, "Wèe à ka' yu' njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀ ntìni,
eng: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, Today if you will hear his voice,

lmp: wèe fa tèe btu àmbò wêe bta a m tèe nè Nyʉ̀, a kani efa rgèe yuu ce e m làa nà ka'. À m ba à nfè' ce wowèe a m ce jɛ̀r à rìŋ nà, wowèe a m tèe btu nè mɛ̀. Wowèe a m tèe wa'a a mooshi mɛ̀.
eng: don't harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

lmp: Wowèe a m mòoshi mɛ̀ à rìŋ anà wa'a, a yɛ buu ce mɛ̀ m gèe nè wowèe à bfè' mŋkyèe.
eng: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.

lmp: A mbùu ce ntee yi m bep mɛ̀ nè bèe anà, mɛ̀ laa mɛnɛ wowèe a kani efa ryu'ni nè mɛ̀, a ker riŋ ya nduunjì ka'.
eng: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, 'They always err in their heart, but they didn't know my ways;'

lmp: Ntee yi m bep mɛ̀ nè wowèe, mɛ̀ ye lè' mɛnɛ àde' wowèe a ke ba' a ya dî' rlʉ̀shì tɛ a bo lʉ̀shi ka'."
eng: as I swore in my wrath, 'They will not enter into my rest.'

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, lòr nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ tʉr ntee bebep, kani efa rfòosi nè Nyʉ̀, mà'shi Nyʉ̀ ka'. Kuushi nè enɛ Nyʉ̀ ca yu Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe.
eng: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

lmp: Yuu ce wèe à ba gèe yi yu enɛ wèe à ba cep wee btu fà dì' ntee bebep anà yi bo' ŋwɛ̀ mò' tɛ e tee tu nè Nyʉ̀ ka'. Kù ce gee nè wa'a à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ àmbò nfè' ku bii àgho ntìni na.
eng: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called today; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

lmp: Sèe Jisos Krâis wèe yu ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir, ce sèe ka' ku tɛɛ tatap ba à yuu ce sèe à byemi nà du ba' àlʉ̀simbùu.
eng: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Wèe ka' yu' njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀ ntìni, wèe fa tèe tu àmbò wêe bta a m tèe nè Nyʉ̀, a kani efa rgèe yuu ce e m làa nà ka'."
eng: while it is said, Today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.

lmp: Bèe ce a m yu' njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀ a tee btu nè Nyʉ̀ à m ba wèe kɛ? À m ba bèe ce Musìs à m fʉr efa bkwàa à to' Ijìp elûuŋgòŋ nà.
eng: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn't all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?

lmp: Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m bepsi ntee nè wowèe à bfè' mŋkyèe nà à m ba wèe kɛ? À m ba bèe ce a m gèe buu bbebep a kweŋger à rìŋ nà.
eng: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn't it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye lè' enɛ àde' wowèe a vʉ ba' fa yê dî' rlʉ̀shì ka' nà, e m ye lè' anà àtu wèe kɛ? À m ba bèe ce a m tèe tu nè Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: To whom did he swear that they wouldn't enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

lmp: Banɛ sèe à yɛ sè'ni enɛ wowèe a m dù ba' à dì' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ wowèe a be dù bà' nà ka', njobè' wowèe a m byemi nè ye ka'.
eng: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ku bii kà' enɛ àde' sèe vʉ mbe yî dî' rlʉ̀shì foŋ. Banɛ sèe lor nfè' fà dì' mò' efa sèe lo buu efa rbà' à dî' rlʉ̀shì anà ka'.
eng: Let us fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

lmp: Wèr à yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce a fè'shi nè wèr àmbò wowèe foŋ a m yu' nà. Wèr à yɛ wernɛ blâa Nyʉ̀ ce a m yu' anà vi m tʉr sɛ' nè wowèe ka' njobè' wowèe a m yu' wa'a, a byemi ka'.
eng: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn't profit them, because it wasn't mixed with faith by those who heard.

lmp: Bèe ce a be bà' mbe dì' ce Nyʉ̀ e ke lʉ̀shi anà, lʉ̀shi mbo foŋ, yu ba sèe ce sèe à yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ a byemi. À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a m yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ a byemi ka' nà, Nyʉ̀ à saŋ mbe yê ŋwà' enɛ̂, "Ntee yi m bep mɛ̀ nè wowèe, mɛ̀ ka' mɛnɛ àde' wowèe a vʉ ba' mbe ya dî' rlʉ̀shì tɛ a bo lʉ̀shi ka'." Yi yu enɛ dî' rlʉ̀shì yi m buu ka', njobè' e m ce làa wa'a, e m banì gee ŋgòŋ wɛɛ a lʉshi yi yu.
eng: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest; although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

lmp: A saŋ mbe dì' mo' embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ àmbò nòŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m mìsi li rfà', enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ à m gèe li rfà' à mnòŋ ntuunfu a misî, tʉ̀' à ka' raa ce enɛ a mnòŋ sàambâ, e lʉshì."
eng: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, God rested on the seventh day from all his works;

lmp: Ka' dî' rlʉ̀shì anà yi m ba àgho wɛɛ wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à ku ker laa enɛ̂, "Àde' wowèe a ba' mbe ya dî' rlʉ̀shì tɛ a bo lʉ̀shi ka'."
eng: and in this place again, They will not enter into my rest.

lmp: Ka' yi yu rara enɛ bèe mo' a be bà' à dî' rlʉ̀shì anà wa'a, yi ku ba rara foŋ enɛ bèe ce a m yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ a byemi ka' nà, a m bà' à dî' rlʉ̀shì anà ka'.
eng: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter therein, and they to whom the good news was before preached failed to enter in because of disobedience,

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à lɛ nfè' mò' ce bèe a be lʉ̀shi ce yu nfè' e sè'ni na. Bfè' vi ka' càa àŋgoo sê, Nyʉ̀ à laa njì enjep Dɛvìd. E m ku laa ba blàa ce wèr à saŋ nè wèe wɛɛ nà. E m làa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ka' yu' njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀ ntìni na, à fa tèe tu ka'."
eng: he again defines a certain day, today, saying through David so long a time afterward just as has been said, Today if you will hear his voice, don't harden your hearts.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ wɛɛ enɛ Joshùwà à m lòr visèe btarkʉ a du àgho à to' Kɛnàn. To' Kɛnàn anà à m ba ba dî' rlʉ̀shì anà, Nyʉ̀ à m ba ker laa àmbò nfè' rlʉ̀shì ce e bii ka' ba ka'.
eng: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

lmp: Yi yu rara enɛ nfè' rlʉ̀shì ce bèe Nyʉ̀ a be lʉ̀shi nà bii ka' ba. Nfè' anà be kè ba àmbò nòŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe li rfà' a ka' mìsi wɛɛ a lʉshi nà.
eng: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' bà' mbe dî' rlʉ̀shì ca lʉshi mbo, banɛ ŋgàŋ be kèr fà' ka', àmbò Nyʉ̀ ye ye à m mìsi li rfà' a lʉshî, a ker fa' ka' nà.
eng: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

lmp: Banɛ sèe gheter ba' mbe dî' rlʉ̀shì anà. Ŋwɛ̀ fa ba ce e be buu efa rbà' à dì' anà njobè' e tèe tu àmbò visèe bta a m tèe nà ka'.
eng: Let us therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

lmp: Blâa Nyʉ̀ vi yu btèe, a tʉr ŋger, vi cɛp a caa sa' mbyɛ̀rɛŋ. Vi lò niŋ njep ntee ŋwɛ̀ ker niŋ njep mi mkwà'shì caa àmbò sà' mbyɛ̀rɛŋ e ke niŋ nje yuu nà. Blâa Nyʉ̀ ca vi ke gèe buu ce ŋwɛ̀ ce kwà'shi njep yê ntee vi yɛɛtì àwaŋ.
eng: For the word of God is living, and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, and piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

lmp: Yuu mo' yi yu efa buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ce àde' Nyʉ̀ buu efa ryɛ ka'. Buu wɛɛwɛ vi yu àwaŋ à bsii Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ ce sèe be kè tɛɛ kùntombì nè ye à nòŋ mo', suŋ buu wɛɛwɛ ce sèe à m gèe.
eng: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

lmp: Sèe tɛɛ tatap ba à buu mini ce sèe à yu' a byemi nà njobè' sèe tʉr tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce e yu ŋgòr, ce e cu mbe bùu a tɛɛ a sêe btù. Ŋwɛ̀ taŋshî ŋgòr ca yu Jisòs ce e yu muu Nyʉ̀.
eng: Having then a great high priest, who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let us hold tightly to our confession.
