lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ buu ce vi yu btatap nè sèe, a ce koosimnse nè sèe njobè' ye ye ku ba àmbò sèe. Rmòoshì li m vʉ̀ nè ye foŋ à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ àmbò li ke vʉ̀ nè sèe, geewa'a e ke' gwe ka'.
eng: For we don't have a high priest who can't be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

lmp: Banɛ vʉ̀ àgee kàbàrà' Nyʉ̀, ke' ce tarni ka', yɛ ntee bòŋboŋ ce e tʉr nè sèe, njobè' a mbe dì' ce Nyʉ̀ be koosimnse nè sèe, jà' sèe à nfè' ce yi yu enɛ e ba jà' sèe.
eng: Let us therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy, and may find grace for help in time of need.

lmp: Sèe riŋ enɛ a ke ce tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì efa mʉ̀ bèe tɛ e bo tɛɛ àtu bèe kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀, koo buu ce bèe a fa nè Nyʉ̀, kèr taŋshi btaŋshì àtu yàp buu bbebep.
eng: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' e tʉr njɛ̀ɛ ntee ce àde' yi gee ye e gee yuu bebep, e riŋ foŋ yuu yɛɛnì ce àde' e gee nè bèe ce a ku ba ànji, a ce dà'.
eng: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' e tʉr njɛ̀ɛ ntee ca, banɛ e tʉr à rtaŋshi taŋshì àtu yì buu bebep àmbò e ke taŋshi àtu buu bbebep bèe mo' nà.
eng: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì e ke ce yi tu tɛ bèe a bo ce yu'ni nè ye ka'. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke ce ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì àmbò e m ce Ɛròn nà.
eng: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

lmp: Jisos Krâis ye ye à m ce yi tu à ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshî ŋgòr ka'. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce ye. E m ce ye wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "À yu muu wà, mɛ̀ ba yò ta kɛ' e ntìni na."
eng: So also Christ didn't glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, You are my Son. Today I have become your father.

lmp: E ker laa mbe dì' mo' foŋ enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ enɛ à ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì à nfè' wɛɛwɛ àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m ba nà."
eng: As he says also in another place, You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.

lmp: Jisòs à m loo nè Nyʉ̀ à nfè' ce e m ba njep ŋgòŋ na. E m loo wa'a a ce warŋger a ce sùusi mŋgoommir. E m loo nè Nyʉ̀ njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m tʉr ŋger à rjà' ye efa rkwe. Nyʉ̀ à m yu' li rloo njobè' e m ce loo nè ryu'nì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

lmp: Ka' e m ba muu Nyʉ̀ wa'a, e m rìŋ àmbò àde' e yu'nì nè Nyʉ̀ ba njo' ŋgɛ' ce e m lò a yɛ.
eng: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ye e ba yɛɛnì sê, a ba sè'ni na ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce fa ryòŋ ce nfesè nè bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè ye.
eng: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

lmp: E m ghɛɛte à rgèe wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m kù'si ye à tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m ba nà.
eng: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

lmp: Wèr tʉr buu magòr se à rlàa àmbò ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì ca, geewa'a wèr à rìŋ àmbò àde' wèr nashì vi nè wèe ka' njobè' wèr ka' nashi wèe yu' ka'.
eng: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

lmp: Wèe à yɛ'ni a riŋ buu sê, nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ ce wèe à ba yɛ'ni bèe mo' foŋ, wèr à yɛ wernɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ba kèr yɛ'ni wèe buu Nyʉ̀ ce wèe à m rìŋ efa rkɛ̀' nà. Wèe ku bii nyoŋ ba mmbee, ce wèe à ba ghɛɛte à rye ba buu.
eng: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the oracles of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce nyoŋ ba mmbee, banɛ ŋgàŋ ku bii munte, a be lɛɛte à ryɛ'nì ce li yu àmbò àde' ŋwɛ̀ ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e ye yuu yu ba nleeŋwɛ̀. A ŋwɛ̀ ce e yɛ'ni, a lɛɛte a riŋ yuu bòŋboŋ ba yuu bebep.
eng: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

lmp: Banɛ sèe yɛ'ni riŋ buu btatap ce vi yu àmbò Jisos Krâis tɛ sèe bo ba bleebèe à buu Nyʉ̀. Sèe fa kù cu ba à ryɛ'nì ce a m kɛ̀' a yɛ'ni sèe nà ka'. Sèe à yɛ'ni a riŋ wɛɛ enɛ bèe a ba kupse, borni efa rgèe buu ce àde' vi vʉ nè rkwe, byemi ba nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let us press on to perfection--not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

lmp: Sèe à yɛ'ni àmbò bàptîr, ker ba àmbò a ke la' bèe mmbo mbe tù, a ker yɛ'ni àmbò Nyʉ̀ be kè fʉr bèe efa rkwe, a yɛ'ni àmbò mnsa' ce a be kè sa', teni nfesè.
eng: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

lmp: Banɛ Nyʉ̀ à ka' byemi, sèe yɛ'nì buu mo' bfi.
eng: This will we do, if God permits.

lmp: Bèe a ka' riŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ yu, lo beesi njì nè ye, njì mò' ker ba àgho ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ gêe, wowèe a beesì yap ntee à nfè' mò' ka'. Wowèe a m yɛ rraa ce li m lò ese Nyʉ̀, a riŋ bghònì ce Nyʉ̀ à fa wowèe, a koni Yʉ' Rara njep wâp mntee.
eng: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

lmp: A yu'shi blâa Nyʉ̀, a riŋ enɛ vi ke lèe sê, a ker riŋ foŋ njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ce yi be ba à ŋgôŋ fi ce yi bii ka' ba nà.
eng: and tasted the good word of God, and the powers of the age to come,

lmp: Bèe a ka' riŋ buu Nyʉ̀ ca wa'a, beesi njì nè ye, banɛ njì mò' ker ba àgho ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ gêe, wowèe a beesì yap ntee à nfè' mò' ka', njobè' wowèe a ka' beesi njì wa'a, banɛ wowèe a ker taa Jisos Krâis mbe kìntaa, a ker coosi ye à mʉ̀ bèe, a bɛ sɛ' efa li rkwe.
eng: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

lmp: Mbèŋ à ka' gwê, nshe nyoŋ mbèŋ anà, byee ce bèe a byè vi ku' ja' bèe anà banɛ Nyʉ̀ be ghòni nshe anà.
eng: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it, and brings forth a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

lmp: Yuu ce yi ka' fʉʉ ku' mbe dì' anà à ka' ku ba ba ŋgʉʉ ba msini, banɛ nshe anà yu à cicì. Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ nfè' à ghɛɛ ce Nyʉ̀ be bepsi nshe anà tɛ a too nè mor.
eng: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

lmp: Bkar wâ, wèr ce bɛɛ wèe wa'a a ku riŋ wernɛ wèe ce jɛ̀r ba njep nduunjî yɛɛnì, a ce lùŋ.
eng: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ e ke gèe buu à njî yɛɛnì. E be mà' wèe ka'. E be lèse rfà' ce wèe à gèe, kɛ̀ lèse njɛ̀ɛ rjà' ce wèe à m jà' yì bèe a ku bii jà' nà ka'. Wèe à m jà' wowèe njobè' wèe kòŋ Nyʉ̀.
eng: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

lmp: Wèr ce kòŋ wernɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ ku ce gee rfà' ca nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀ caar du ba' àlʉ̀simbùu, tɛ wèe bo koni buu ce wèe cu ce kè' nà.
eng: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

lmp: Wèr ce kòŋ enɛ wèe koosi bbor ka'. Wèr ce kòŋ enɛ wèe ba ba àmbò bèe ce a ce byemi yuu ce yi yu mini, a ke' ce bu' ka'. Wèe à ba ba wa'a njobè' njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca yu bèe ce a be koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à kà' nè yì bèe.
eng: that you won't be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and patience inherited the promises.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe mkà'ni nè Abràham nà, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ker ba ce e càa ye ce Nyʉ̀ ka'. À ka' ba wa'a, e kaa ba à li rlii enɛ e be gèe yuu ce e làa.
eng: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by none greater, he swore by himself,

lmp: E m làa enɛ̂, "Rbuu ba nshe a ka' ba ce tarte, m buu efa rghòni wɛ̀ kèr gèe tɛ yò ŋgʉ̀ yaa ka'."
eng: saying, Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.

lmp: Abràham à ka' kur ntee, ce bu' ka', a koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè ye nà.
eng: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

lmp: Sèe à rìŋ seenɛ bèe a ke kàa à rlii ŋwɛ̀ ce e càa wowèe. Bèe a ke kàa wa'a, yi ce gèe mntaŋshì vi ce mì efa mʉ̀ bèe.
eng: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ye ye à kòŋ enɛ bèe ce a be lò koni yuu ce e m kà' nè wowèe nà, a riŋ ghup enɛ e be kupse yuu ce e m làa ka'. A mbùu ce e m kàa à li rlii.
eng: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath;

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, buu bbaa vi yu ce àde' vi kupsè ka' njobè' àde' Nyʉ̀ laa wa'a nya' ba mnde' ka'. Buu bbaa anà a buu ce vi ce fa sèe ŋger tɛ sèe ce sèe à caŋ a sʉni njeptii Nyʉ̀ sèe bo rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ sèe be koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à kà' nè sèe.
eng: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

lmp: Àmbò sèe à rìŋ seenɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke kupse mi mkà'ni ka' nà, àde' visèe mntee vi ker bu' ka'. Banɛ sèe à tii ndàŋ a niŋ mbe dî' rara embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil;

lmp: Jisòs à dù a niŋ mbe dî' rara anà entombì nè sèe a tɛɛ mbo a sêe btù, a ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nfesè àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m ba nà.
eng: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

lmp: Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k ca à m ba ŋkʉʉ à to' Salɛ̀m, a ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀ embe bùu. À m ba à nfè' mò' Abràham à ka' dù mà' bìr a bkʉʉ mo', a so wowèe. A ka' ce kʉti, Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à du a koni ye a ghoni ye.
eng: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

lmp: Abràham ye ye à lor buu ce e m koo à ŋkʉ̀ bìr a gap bdì' rʉ̂ʉ, a lor dî' mo'sir a fa nè Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k. Mbùu efa rlii Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k ca yu enɛ̂, "Ŋkʉʉ ce e ke gèe ŋgêe yɛɛnì." Mbùu efa rlii yi to' yu enɛ̂, "Cumʉnyaŋ" Banɛ li rlii li yu foŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋkʉʉ cumʉnyaŋ"
eng: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all being first, by interpretation, king of righteousness, and then also king of Salem, which is king of peace;

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e rìŋ yì ma kɛ̀ yì ta ka'. A làa yuu mo' àmbò yi ràrà ka'. Sèe rìŋ nfè' a m bi ye kɛ̀ nfè' ce e m kwe ka'. E yu àmbò muu Nyʉ̀, e yu ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì nfesè.
eng: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God, remains a priest continually.

lmp: Yɛ nè àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr. Abràham ce e m ba tàr bêe à to' Isrɛ̀l à m lòr buu ce e m koo à ŋkʉ̀ bìr a gàp bdì' rʉ̂ʉ, a lor dî' mo'sir a fa nè Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k.
eng: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham, the patriarch, gave a tenth out of the best spoils.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce a yu ràrâ Lɛvì nà, ncir yi byemi enɛ wowèe a koo dî' mo'sir efa bdì' rʉʉ efa buu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ ce bêe à to' Isrɛ̀l a tʉr. Yuu ce sèe rìŋ yi yuu enɛ wowèe a ce koo buu ca ba ese bfʉr wap, ka' wowèe wɛɛwɛ a yu ŋgʉ̀ Abràham wa'a.
eng: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest's office have a commandment to take tithes of the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

lmp: Ka' Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m ba ràrâ Lɛvì ka' wa'a, e m koni buu ese Abràham ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' buu nè ye, a ghoni ye.
eng: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ sɛnì enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke ghòni ŋwɛ̀, yu ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr a caa ŋwɛ̀ ce e ghòni nà ka'.
eng: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

lmp: Ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce a yu ràrâ Lɛvì ce bèe a ke fa wowèe dî' mo'sir efa buu ce wowèe a tʉr nà, a ke lò kweŋger. À ka' ba yi àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k, Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ e ku cu ntèe.
eng: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' Abràham à m gàp buu bdì' rʉ̂ʉ, lor dî' mo'sir a fa nè Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k nà, yi m ba àmbò Lɛvì ce boo vi a ke koo dî' mo'sir efa buu rʉʉ nà à m lɛ fa foŋ wa'a.
eng: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

lmp: Àde' sèe laa wa'a njobè' Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m dù à rkoni Abràham ce e m ba tarkʉ Lɛvì, a be bi Lɛvì ka'.
eng: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ràrâ Lɛvì a ba ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nà, e m fa mncir nè bêe à to' Isrɛ̀l tɛ a bo rìŋ à rloo nè ye. Rfà' ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ca li m ka' ba ghɛɛte à rgèe tɛ bèe a ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, mbùu mò' à m ba kèr ba enɛ sèe tʉr ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì mò' ce e yu ba àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k ce e yu jɛɛ efa Ɛròn nà ka'.
eng: Now if there was perfection through the Levitical priesthood for under it the people have received the law, what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

lmp: Yi yu rara enɛ ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì mò' ka vʉ̂, ce gèe taŋshì yi à njɛ̂ɛ jɛɛ, banɛ mncir vi be kupse foŋ.
eng: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò Tata Jisòs ce sèe ce làa àmbò ye na, e m ba yi ba ràrâ jɛɛ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ràrà anà à m be fa' à ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì ka'.
eng: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ e m ba yi ba ràrâ Judà. Musìs à m làa yuu mo' a kuu ràrà ca à nfè' ce e m ce làa àmbò ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ka'.
eng: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

lmp: Yuu ce yi gèe yuu sèe ce làa àmbò ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì na yi ba rara sê, yi yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì mò' à vʉ̀ a ba yi ba àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k.
eng: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì, a ke' ba ba àmbò ncir kuu ràrà ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì yi ce làa ka'. E yu ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì njobè' e tʉr ryòŋ ce nfesè. Ku ba ŋger efa ryòŋ anà ce e gèe e ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì.
eng: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life:

lmp: Sèe à rìŋ wa'a njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Mɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ enɛ à ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì à nfè' wɛɛwɛ àmbò Mɛ̀lkisidɛ̀k à m ba nà."
eng: for it is testified, You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.

lmp: Banɛ a m mà' mncir ce vi m ba entombì njobè' vi m tʉr ŋger à rjà' bèe ka'.
eng: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

lmp: Vi m tʉr ŋger à rgèe ŋwɛ̀ tɛ e ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yuu ce sèe ce làa àgho sè'ni yi yu àndèe njobè' a yuu ce àde' yi vʉ nè sèe àgee Nyʉ̀.
eng: for the law made nothing perfect, and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ à m ba à nfè' Nyʉ̀ à m làa enɛ e be gèe Jisòs à ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì nfesè nà, a kâa. À ka' ba à nfè' e m gèe ràrâ Lɛvì à ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nà, e kaa ka'.
eng: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ka' gèe Jisòs à ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì, a kâa, a laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Mɛ̂ Tàr, mɛ̀ kàa enɛ à be ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì nfesè. Àde' ya nlàa ca yi kupsè ka'"
eng: for they indeed have been made priests without an oath, but he with an oath by him that says of him, The Lord swore and will not change his mind, 'You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.'

lmp: Cena yi yu enɛ Jisòs yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à ye sèe wowèe nà yi tap a caa lê' rʉ̀ʉ.
eng: By so much, Jesus has become the collateral of a better covenant.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce à m ba ràrâ Lɛvì nà a m ba àŋgoo njobè' à m ba bèe ce a be lò kweŋger, tɛ lap rfà' li mì.
eng: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

lmp: Jisòs yu yi ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e cu ntèe nfesè, àde' e ke buu efa rba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

lmp: A mbùu ce e tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ bèe ce a vʉ̀ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀ à li rlii a luŋ dʉ̀dʉ̀ njobè' e cu ntèe nfesè a ce loo a sêe btù.
eng: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

lmp: Banɛ Jisòs a tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce e ghɛɛte nè sèe. E ghɛɛte njobè' e yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara a ce kwà'shi kɛ̀ a ce gèe fàa ka', a ba yi jɛɛ efa bèe ce a ke gèe buu bbebep, Nyʉ̀ à naa ye mbekì.
eng: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

lmp: Btu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ca a m ce taŋshi à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ. Wowèe a m ce kɛ̀' be taŋshi àtu yàp buu bbebep wɛɛ, ka' taŋshi àtu buu bbebep bèe. Jisòs à m taŋshi taŋshì yi ba à njɛ̂ɛ wa' ka'. E m taŋshi yi nfè' mò'sir yi ku mi wa'a. E m taŋshi taŋshì anà ba à nfè' ce e m fa yì nyor, a kwe a sêe btù nà.
eng: who doesn't need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

lmp: Ncir Musìs yi byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e gee fàa ba à tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. À ka' ba yi àmbò lè' ce Nyʉ̀ a m ye, ce yi lor dì' mncir nà, e m ce ba muu yì à ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì. E m gèe ye e ba yɛɛnì nfesè.
eng: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath which came after the law appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

lmp: Yuu tatap ce wèr ce làa yi yu enɛ sèe tʉr tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce e ghɛɛte nè sèe. E cu mbe bùu à bo mà' kàbàrà' Nyʉ̀ ce e ke sa' li rsa' nè ŋger-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this. We have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke fà' mbe dî' rara ce yi yu mbe dì' ce a ke loo nè Nyʉ̀. Dî' rara ca à m gèe ŋwɛ̀ ka', à m gèe ba Nyʉ̀. Yu dì' rloo ce yi yu yɛɛnì.
eng: a servant of the sanctuary, and of the true tabernacle, which the Lord pitched, not man.

lmp: Rfà' ce tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì e ke gèe li yu enɛ e koo buu ce bèe a fa, ker ba buu taŋshì, gee taŋshì àgho. Banɛ yi m ba bòŋboŋ enɛ tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce e tɛɛ a sêe btù mbe bùu nà tʉr yuu mo' ce ye ye be fa nè Nyʉ̀ foŋ.
eng: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

lmp: E m ba ba njep ŋgòŋ na e m ba ba ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì ka' njobè' ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a yu njep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛ, a ce taŋshi taŋshì àmbò ncir Musìs yi làa.
eng: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law;

lmp: Rfà' ce ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ca a ce gèe li tɛɛ ba àtu yuu ce yi yu mbe bùu. Sèe rìŋ wa'a njobè' à m ba à nfè' ce Musìs à m ce tami nyor à rbà'ri tàp nè bcɛ̀' nà, Nyʉ̀ à laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Lòr nfè' ba'ri tàp ca tɛ yi ku ba àmbò mɛ̀ m suŋ wɛ̀ mbe rtùu Sinài enɛ à ba'ri nà."
eng: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò rfà' ce Jisòs ce gèe, li càa rfà' ce ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì mo' ca a ce gèe. Yi yu foŋ enɛ lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye sèe wowèe, taŋshì efa gho à ba Jisòs nà, yi bòŋ a caa yì ce yi m ba entombì. Yi yu wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à kà' sèe buu ce vi bòŋ a caa vì ce vi m ba njo' lè' anà.
eng: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by so much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

lmp: Lè' entòmbì anà yi m ba ghɛɛte à rgèe tɛ bèe a ba byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à m ba kèr ye lè' mo' ka'.
eng: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m yɛ enɛ yi m ghɛɛte ka'. Sèe rìŋ wa'a njobè' e m làa enɛ̂, "Nfè' mò' be kè ba ce m be ye lê' fi wèr bèe Isrɛ̀l ba bèe Judà. Nlàa ca à làa mɛ̂ Tata Nyʉ̀.
eng: For finding fault with them, he said, Behold, the days come, says the Lord, that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

lmp: Lè' anà yi be ba jɛɛ efa yì ce mɛ̀ m ye wèr wap bta à nòŋ ce mɛ̀ m jà' wowèe, a fʉr wowêe à to' Ijìp nà. Wowèe a m bʉ' lè' ce mɛ̀ m ye wèr wowèe, mɛ̀ beesì njì nè wowèe. Nlàa ca à làa mɛ̂ Tata Nyʉ̀.
eng: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers, in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn't continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them, says the Lord.

lmp: Mɛ̂ Tàr, mɛ̀ làa mɛnɛ̂, Lè' ce m be ye wèr bèe Isrɛ̀l à mnòŋ ce vi bii ka' ba nà yi yu enɛ m be gèe tɛ wowèe a kupse yap ntee, ce yu' rbòŋ à rlɛ̀ wa mncir. M be ba yàp Nyʉ̀ tɛ wowèe a ba yà bèe.
eng: For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel. After those days, says the Lord; I will put my laws into their mind, I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

lmp: Mbùu mò' be kèr ba àgho nè ŋwɛ̀ à ryɛ'ni bfʉr vi, làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Rìŋ nè Tàr" ka', njobè' wowèe wɛɛwɛ a be kè rìŋ mɛ̀, kɛ' embe bêe bkɛ'kɛ' du ba' mbe bêe bgòrgòr.
eng: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen, and every man his brother, saying, 'Know the Lord,' for all will know me, from the least of them to the greatest of them.

lmp: Yi be ba wa'a njobè' m be kè koosimnse nè wowèe, fòosi wowèe efa yàp buu bbebep, kèr kuushi vi à nfè' mò' ka."
eng: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ce làa àmbò lê' fi wa'a banɛ e m gèe lè' entòmbì yi kʉtì yuu rʉ̀ʉ. Yuu yi ka' kʉti rʉ̀ʉ, beeŋger à yuu cicì, banɛ yuu anà yi be bʉ.
eng: In that he says, A new covenant, he has made the first old. But that which is becoming old and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ye lè' a yì bèe à nfè' entombì, a gee mncir ce vi m ba àmbò àde' wowèe a loo nè ye. Dì' mo' yi m ba ce a m ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ mbo.
eng: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service, and an earthly sanctuary.

lmp: A m bèe dì' anà nè bcɛ̀', a ba'ri tàp nè bcɛ̀' foŋ mbe mʉ̀ mo. A m bà'ri tàp anà wa'a, yi ba brum bbaa. A m too yì entombì enɛ̂, "Dî' rara." Buu ce a m lɛ̀ mbe rum anà à m ba lâm, ba tɛbùr ba brɛ̂d yî Nyʉ̀.
eng: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lampstand, the table, and the show bread; which is called the Holy Place.

lmp: A m teni rum yì enje mʉ ba nè cɛ̀'. A m too rum yì anà enɛ, Dî' rara ce yi càa ŋger.
eng: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

lmp: Dî' ntòo nrɛ̀ɛ yi m ba mbo, a yo' nè gûl. Ŋkùp lè' Nyʉ̀ à m ba mbe rum anà foŋ. A m yo' ŋkùp anà nè gul foŋ. A m lɛ̀ ntʉŋ ce a m gèe nè gûl, a lɛ manà njo, a lɛ njep ŋkùp anà. Mbàŋ Ɛròn ce e m lò a saa mmbar, à m ba njep ŋkùp anà. Blùr ce Nyʉ̀ à m saŋ lè' mbo nà vi m ba njo foŋ.
eng: having a golden altar of incense, and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron's rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

lmp: A m kupshi buu mo' bbaa àmbò bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wa'a, ce vi m ce dùŋshi fòo Nyʉ̀, a tooshi mbendù ŋkùp anà à rdùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu mbe dì' anà. Vi m tɛɛ à bgeŋ ŋkùp, a bʉr bbàp vi tartè a tɛ'shi ŋkùp ce Nyʉ̀ e ke fòosi buu bbebep bèe mbo. Àde' wèr suŋ wèe buu ca wɛɛwɛ sè'ni ka'.
eng: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can't speak now in detail.

lmp: A m kupshi buu embe brum bbaa ca wa'a, ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a ce dù mbe rum yî entombì a ce gèe rfà' mbo nè Nyʉ̀ à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ,
eng: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

lmp: ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce niŋ mbe rum yì embenjì à ku ba tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì. E ke niŋ mbo nfè' mò'sir njep fè'. E niŋ wa'a, tʉr blɛɛ mbʉ tɛ e bo ŋwaŋshi àtu yì buu bbebep ker ba buu bbebep ce bèe a m gèe a riŋ ka' nà.
eng: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself, and for the errors of the people.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' ce gèe buu ca wa'a, Yʉ' Rara yi gee yi ba rara enɛ àmbò dî' rara ca yi ku bii àgho na, njì yi yu nè bèe wɛɛwɛ à rniŋ mbe dî' rara ce yi càa ŋger nà ka'.
eng: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn't yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing;

lmp: Buu ca vi tɛɛ ba àtu buu ce vi yu sè'ni na. Yi dùŋshi sèe enɛ mfa ba btaŋshì ce a m ce gèe nè Nyʉ̀ nà vi tʉr ŋger à rgèe ŋwɛ̀ tɛ e riŋ enɛ e yu nrara à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: which is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshipper perfect;

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' buu anà vi kùu ba buu ce sèe ce yɛ nè mmir àmbò byee ba buu mno, ker ba ndèe ce e yu ba àmbò àde' bèe a su'sì buu ba nyor. Buu ca ku ba buu enjep ŋgòŋ na ce vi be dù bà' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be gèe buu wɛɛwɛ tɛ vi kʉti bfi nà.
eng: being only with meats and drinks and various washings fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

lmp: Jisos Krâis à vʉ̀ wɛɛ à tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a vʉ nè bghònì a fa nè sèe. E ce gèe li rfà' ba mbe dì' ce yi bòŋ a caa dî' rara ca njobè' dì' anà yi yu yɛɛnì sê. Dì' anà à m gèe ŋwɛ̀ ka', banɛ yu yuu enjep ŋgòŋ na ka'.
eng: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

lmp: À m ba à nfè' Jisos Krâis à m niŋ mbe dì' anà, e m dù a ba' mbe dî' rara ce yi càa ŋger nà nfè' mò'sir, yi ku mi wa'a. E m dù mbo ba nè blɛɛ mbʉ kɛ̀ blɛɛ muu nà' ka'. E m dù ba nè vi blɛɛ. E m lòr vi blɛɛ anà a tee sèe efa ŋgɛ' ce sèe à m ce yɛ njo' buu bbebep ce sèe à m ce gèe nà nfesè.
eng: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

lmp: A m ce lòr blɛɛ mbʉ ba blɛɛ muu nà', ba bʉ efa muu nà' ce a tòo, ŋwaŋshi bèe ce wowèe a m ba brara à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka' àgho tɛ wowèe a bo ba brara.
eng: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh:

lmp: Blɛɛ njɛ̀ɛ mnyàa ca vi ka' ba tʉr ŋger à rgèe mnyor bèe tɛ vi ba brara, yi ka' ba yi kɛ àmbò blɛɛ Jisos Krâis ce vi tʉr ŋger à rgèe visèe mntee tɛ vi ba brara? E m lòr yì nyor ce e m ba nrara a gee taŋshì àgho nè Nyʉ̀ a sêe btù. E m gèe cena ba à ŋger Yʉ' Rara ce yi ku ba àgho à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Vi blɛɛ vi tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ sèe ba brara fà dì' sèe bo gèe mfâ' mcicì ce àde' mi lo vʉ̀ nè rkwe ka'. E m gèe wa'a tɛ sèe bo fà' ba nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe.
eng: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without blemish to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' li rkwe ce e m kwe nà, e ba sè'ni ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e tɛɛ mbetar Nyʉ̀ ba ŋwɛ̀, a gee lê' fi, tɛ bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à ce a bo koni buu bbòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à kà' nè wowèe nà, tʉr buu anà nfesè. Li rkwe anà li gèe bèe ce a m ce gèe buu bbebep à nfè' ce lè' entombì yi m kur wowèe nà, a ce lùŋ.
eng: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ e ke là' rkwe, banɛ bèe a be yɛ enɛ ŋgàŋ à kwe wɛɛ tɛ a ka' gèe buu ce ŋwɛ̀ anà à m làa.
eng: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ anà ka' ku bii ntèe, nlà' rkwe anà yi tʉr ŋger ka'. Yi ku tʉr ŋger ba à nfè' ce ŋwɛ̀ anà à kwe.
eng: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

lmp: A mbùu ce a m kur lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye a bèe à nfè' entombì nà ba nè blɛɛ.
eng: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' Musìs à m suŋ bèe mncir ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ, a lor mnyôr njèe ce vi m ce bàŋ, a cʉʉ à fù ce a too enɛ Hisòp, a fʉʉ njep blɛɛ muu nà' ce a m fìŋshi nè mdip, a ŋwaŋshi mbendù ŋwà' mncir a ker ŋwaŋshi bèe wɛɛwɛ àgho.
eng: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

lmp: E ka' ŋwaŋshi wɛɛ a laa enɛ̂, "Cena yu ba blɛɛ ce vi kur lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à ye wèe wowèe, a laa enɛ wèe gee yuu ce lè' yi làa nà."
eng: saying, This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.

lmp: E m ker ŋwaŋshi blɛɛ anà à dî' rara cà, a ker ŋwaŋshi à buu mfà' wɛɛwɛ ce vi m ba mbo.
eng: Moreover he sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

lmp: Yi yu mini enɛ ncir yi làa enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ vi yu brara à bsii Nyʉ̀, ce a ka' ŋwaŋshi nè blɛɛ. Banɛ blɛɛ vi ka' tɛ ba ka', a foosì buu bbebep bèe ka'.
eng: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

lmp: Yi m ba yɛɛnì enɛ a lor ba blɛɛ gee buu ce vi tɛɛ ba àtu buu ce vi yu mbe bùu nà gee tɛ vi ba brara à bsii Nyʉ̀. À ka' ba àmbò buu embe bùu anà, yi yu yɛɛnì enɛ a gee njɛ̀ɛ taŋshì mo' ce yi càa btaŋshì ce a m ce gèe nè mnyàa nà, àtu buu anà.
eng: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these; but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

lmp: Krâis à m niŋ ba mbe dî' rara ce à m kupshi ba bèe ka'. Dì' ce à m kupshi ba bèe anà yi tɛɛ ba àtu dì' ce Nyʉ̀ yu. E m niŋ mbe bùu mbe dì' ce Nyʉ̀ yu, tɛ e bo tɛɛ a sêe btù à bsii Nyʉ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For Christ hasn't entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì yi m ce niŋ mbe dî' rara, du mbe dî' rara ce yi m càa ŋger nà nfè' mò'sir à bfè' wɛɛwɛ. E m ce dù mbo wa'a, du ba nè blɛɛ ce vi m fʉʉ enje nyòr nje ye ka'. Jisos Krâis à m dù yi ba mbe dî' rara embe bùu, a lor yì nyor a gee taŋshi àgho nfè' mò'sir cà'cà'.
eng: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

lmp: E m ba du mbe dî' rara nfè' àŋgoo, e m ba yɛ ŋgɛ' foŋ nfè' àŋgoo kɛ' embe nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ŋgòŋ. E m gèe wa' ka'. E vʉ̀ ba nfè' mò'sir à nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi ce mì na, a lor yì nyor a taŋshi taŋshì àgho tɛ e bo siŋsi buu bbebep ce bèe a gèe, nfesè.
eng: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ be kù kwe ba nfè' mò'sir. E lò embenjìmo tɛ Nyʉ̀ sa' ye.
eng: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

lmp: Jisos Krâis ye ye à m kwe nfè' mò'sir àtu bèe magòr tɛ e bo siŋsi yàp buu bbebep. E be kè kʉti njep ŋgòŋ na, kʉti tɛ e bo siŋsi buu bbebep bèe ka'. E be kè kʉti tɛ e bo gèe tɛ bèe ce a ce kè' ye a lûŋ.
eng: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, without sin, to those who are eagerly waiting for him for salvation.

lmp: Mncir ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè Jus vi m tɛɛ ba àtu buu bbòŋboŋ ce vi bii ka' ba. Àde' vi duŋshì sèe buu bbòŋboŋ anà seese ka'. Yi ka' ba wa'a, btaŋshì ce ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì a ke taŋshi njep fè' njep fè' vi tʉr ŋger à rgèe bèe ce a ce vʉ̀ àgho nà tɛ a ba yɛɛnì ka'.
eng: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

lmp: Btaŋshì anà vi m ka' ba tʉr njɛ̀ɛ ŋger ca, bèe a m ba kèr ce taŋshi btaŋshì ka' njobè' wowèe a m ba bà raa mìsi, kèr rìŋ enɛ wowèe a yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep ka'.
eng: Or else wouldn't they have ceased to be offered, because the worshippers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

lmp: Yi yu ba enɛ btaŋshì ce a ce taŋshi njep fè' njep fè' anà, vi gèe bèe a kuushi yàp buu bbebep,
eng: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

lmp: njobè' àde' blɛɛ nà' ba blɛɛ mbʉ vi siŋsì buu bbebep anà ka'.
eng: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

lmp: A mbùu ce Jisos Krâis à m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na a laa nè Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ m kòŋ btaŋshì ba mfa ka'. Wɛ̀ m fa mɛ̀ ba nyor tɛ m bo gèe yuu ce wɛ̀ kòŋ àgho.
eng: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, Sacrifice and offering you didn't desire, but you prepared a body for me;

lmp: Wɛ ke yu' rbòŋ nè buu ce bèe a ke fa nè wɛ̀, too nè mor vi she ji' nà ka'. Wɛ ke yu' rbòŋ nè btaŋshì ce bèe a ke gèe tɛ vi bo siŋsi yàp buu bbebep nà ka'
eng: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a mɛ̀ laa mɛnɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀, a mɛ̀ na. Mɛ̀ tami nyor à rgèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̀ kòŋ enɛ m gêe, àmbò a saŋ mbe yo ŋwà' mncir." "
eng: Then I said, 'Behold, I have come in the scroll of the book it is written of me to do your will, O God.'

lmp: E m ce làa mbo wa'a, a ce làa ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke yu' rbòŋ nè btaŋshì ca ka', ka' ncir yi ce làa enɛ bèe a taŋshi wa'a.
eng: Previously saying, Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn't desire, neither had pleasure in them those which are offered according to the law,

lmp: E m ker laa foŋ enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ na, mɛ̀ tami nyor à rgèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̂ kòŋ enɛ m gêe." E m làa wa'a banɛ e siŋsi btaŋshî rʉ̀ʉ ca a kʉʉsi ba yî fi.
eng: then he has said, Behold, I have come to do your will. He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' Jisos Krâis à m vʉ̀ à rgèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ, sèe yu sè'ni brara à bsii Nyʉ̀. E m lòr yì nyor a taŋshi taŋshì àgho nfè' mo'sir, yi ku mi wa'a.
eng: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshì e ke tɛɛ mbekì ce taŋshi njɛ̀ɛ btaŋshì ce e m be taŋshi nfè' àŋgoo wɛɛ, à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ. Àde' njɛ̀ɛ btaŋshì ca vi siŋsì buu bbebep ce bèe a gèe ka'.
eng: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and often offering the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò Jisos Krâis, e m ku taŋshi taŋshì yi nfè' mò'sir, Taŋshì anà yi tʉr ŋger à rsiŋsi buu bbebep ce bèe a gèe, nfesè. E ka' taŋshi taŋshì ca wɛɛ, a du a cu à bo ma' Nyʉ̀.
eng: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God;

lmp: E cu wa'a a ce kè' ba nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be lɛ̀ yi ŋgâa bbàa njep yê tìi tɛ e tɛr mi mkùu mbe wâp ndù.
eng: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

lmp: E m ku taŋshi ba taŋshì e mo'sir, a gee enɛ bèe ce e gèe wowèe a ba brara nà a ba byɛɛnì nfesè.
eng: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

lmp: Yʉ' Rara yi dùŋshi sèe enɛ taŋshì ce e m gèe nfè' mò'sir nà yi m ghɛɛte. Yi kɛ̀' a laa enɛ̂,
eng: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

lmp: "Nyʉ̀ à làa enɛ̂, "Nfè' be ghɛɛ tɛ m ye lè' wèr wowèe. M be gèe tɛ wowèe a kupse yap ntee, ce yu' rbòŋ à rlɛ̀ wa mncir." "
eng: This is the covenant that I will make with them: 'After those days,' says the Lord, 'I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;' then he says,

lmp: Yi ker laa enɛ̂, "M be kèr kuushi buu bbebep ba bsàrbuu ce wowèe a gèe ka'."
eng: I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' foosi bèe efa yàp buu bbebep, mbùu mò' ker ba àgho nè wowèe à rtaŋshi taŋshì tɛ yi bo siŋsi yàp buu bbebep ka'.
eng: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, à ka' ba njobè' blɛɛ Jisòs, sèe tʉr ŋger sè'ni à rniŋ mbe dî' rara ce yi caa ŋger nà, kè' wɛp yuu mo' ka'.
eng: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

lmp: Jisòs à mʉ̀' nduunjî fi tɛ sèe bo niŋ mbe dì' anà, koni ryòŋ. E mʉ̀' nduunjì anà nè yì nyor. Cena yi yu àmbò e tii lɛ ndàŋ ce a m teni rum enje mʉ nà àgho wa'a.
eng: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh;

lmp: Àmbò sèe tʉr yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ taŋshi taŋshî ŋgòr ce e yu mbendù bèe Nyʉ̀ na,
eng: and having a great priest over the house of God,

lmp: banɛ sèe lɛ ntee njep ye, ke' ce tarni yuu mo' ka', niŋ mbe dì' anà nè ntee e mo'sir. Àde' sèe gee wa'a njobè' a ŋwaŋshi visèe mntee nè blɛɛ Jisòs vi ba brara, sèe à ker ce kwà'shi enɛ sèe yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep ka', a ba ba bèe ce a sù'si wap mnyor nè mdip mrara.
eng: let's draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience, and having our body washed with pure water,

lmp: Banɛ sèe tɛɛ tatap, lɛ mmir ba mbendù buu ce sèe à byemi wɛɛ enɛ vi be koni nà. Sèe fa tarni ka' njobè' àde' Nyʉ̀ buu efa rgèe yuu ce e m kà' ka'.
eng: let us hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

lmp: Sèe kwa'shi àmbò àde' sèe yɛɛsì mntee bfʉr mo' tɛ sèe bo kòŋ bèe kèr gèe buu bbòŋboŋ.
eng: Let us consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

lmp: Sèe fa borni efa rtarshi àbee ce gèe rloo nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò bèe mo' a ce gèe nà ka'. Sèe fa bfʉr mo' ba ŋger tɛ a bo tɛɛ tatap, ŋgɛ̀'ni mo' àmbò sèe à rìŋ war enɛ nòŋ ce Tata Jisòs be vʉ̀ yi yu àtʉtʉ nà.
eng: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another; and so much the more, as you see the Day approaching.

lmp: Sèe à rìŋ buu ce vi yu mini war. Sèe à ka' ker kani buu anà gee ba buu bbebep banɛ taŋshi mo' yi ker ba ce àde' yi siŋsì buu bbebep ce sèe à gèe nà ka'.
eng: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ku ce gèe ba buu bbebep wa'a, banɛ ŋgàŋ à ba kɛ̀' ce wɛp njobè' e be gwè mnsa' Nyʉ̀. Ma njɛ̀ɛ mor mo' yi yu ce yi be kè yɛ̀r bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a tèe tù nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò mncir ce Musìs à m vʉ̀ àgho nà, ŋwɛ̀ à m ka' bʉ' mncir anà, bèe a mntaar kɛ̀ bèe a mmbaa ɛ̀, a m ka' tɛɛ njìnsa' enɛ a yɛ ŋgàŋ à gee yuu ce ncir yi kani, banɛ a be koosimnse efa ryʉ ŋwɛ̀ anà ka'.
eng: A man who disregards Moses' law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, banɛ yi be ba à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e nyʉ̀' muu Nyʉ̀, a lòr blɛɛ ce a m ye lè' àgho à ba blɛɛ ce vi gèe ye e ba nrara nà à yuu cicì, a ker cɛp Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ce yi ke vʉ̀ nè bghònì nà?
eng: How much worse punishment, do you think, will he be judged worthy of, who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

lmp: Sèe rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m làa enɛ̂, "Ku ba mɛ̀ ce m be kʉʉsi mcucu', m be là' wowèe." E m ker làa foŋ enɛ̂, "Tata Nyʉ̀ be sa' yì bèe."
eng: For we know him who said, Vengeance belongs to me, says the Lord, I will repay. Again, The Lord will judge his people.

lmp: Yu yuu bwɛp sê, ce ŋwɛ̀ à ka' tɛɛ enɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe teni mi mnsa'.
eng: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

lmp: Kuushi nè yuu ce yi m ba à nfè' ce wèe à m kɛ̀' a yɛ rraa Nyʉ̀ nà. Ka' wèe à m yɛ ŋgɛ' à nfè' anà se wa'a, wèe à m ku kur ntee a tɛɛ tatap.
eng: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings;

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' bèe a ce cɛp wèe àwaŋ a ker ce fa wèe ŋgɛ'. À m ba à nfè' mò' wèe à ba à mʉ̀ bèe mò' ce a m ce yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ca foŋ.
eng: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions; and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

lmp: Nse yi m koo wèe nè ŋgâa shaŋ, wèe à ja' wowèe. Bèe a m fàpshi yè buu, wèe à ma'shì, a ku ce lu'shi lu'shi njobè' wèe à m rìŋ enɛ wèe tʉr buu mò' ce vi bòŋ a caa vì anà, à ba buu ce vi be cu nfesè.
eng: For you both had compassion on me in my chains, and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa kɛ̀' ce tarni ka' njobè' bèe ce a ka' tɛɛ tatap ba' à lʉ̀simbùu, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be là' wowèe bòŋboŋ sê.
eng: Therefore don't throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

lmp: Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ wèe kur ntee tɛ wèe bo gèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ, koni yuu ce e kà' enɛ e be fa wèe nà.
eng: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e be vʉ̀ nà, vʉ̂. E be càasi nfè' ka'.
eng: In a very little while, he who comes will come, and will not wait.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò sèe, sèe yu àmbò njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce a be kʉti njìnjì lò bʉ ka'. Sèe be byemi ba nè Nyʉ̀, lùŋ.
eng: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

lmp: Rbyemì yu ba enɛ kɛ? Rbyemì yu enɛ sèe à rìŋ rara enɛ yuu ce sèe ce kè', sèe be koni. Rbyemì yu ba enɛ sèe à rìŋ enɛ yuu yi yu àgho nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, a ka' be yɛ yuu anà nè mmir ka'.
eng: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m yu' rbòŋ nè bèe elûuŋgòŋ njobè' wowèe a m byemi wa'a.
eng: For by this, the elders obtained testimony.

lmp: Rbyemì li gèe sèe à riŋ rara enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m ku laa làa, ŋgòŋ yi ba àgho. Banɛ yuu ce sèe ce yɛ nè mmir yi m lò ba efa yuu ce àde' sèe yɛ nè mmir ka'.
eng: By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe Ɛbɛ̀l à gee taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀, yi ba bòŋboŋ à bsii Nyʉ̀ a caa yi Kɛ̂n. Yi taŋshì yi m bòŋ wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à lor ye àmbò ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì njobè' e m byemi nè ye. Sèe à rìŋ wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m koo buu ce e m fa nè ye. Ka' e m kwe elûuŋgòŋ wa'a, li rbyemì li ku bii làa.
eng: By faith, Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

lmp: À ka bà njobè' rbyemì, rkwe li m joo Ɛnòk ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m lòr ye a du àgho mbe bùu ntèe. Bèe a m ker yɛ ye ka' njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m lòr ye a du àgho. Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kè lòr Ɛnòk, yi ŋgèe yi m ba bòŋboŋ à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: By faith, Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn't see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ byemi ka', àde' Nyʉ̀ yu' rbòŋ nè ye ka', njobè' ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce kòŋ à rvʉ̀ àtʉtʉ nè Nyʉ̀ banɛ ŋgàŋ be byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu àgho a ce là' bèe ce a ce ròo ye nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe Nowa à yu' yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ ye enɛ yi be kè koni. Ka' e m be yɛ buu anà nè mmir ka' wa'a, e m ku yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀, a gee ma njɛ̀ɛ keŋ mò', a bèe embe yê ndàp wɛɛwɛ a lo a niŋ mbo a luŋ efa mdip ce mi m cete ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ nà. E m gèe wa'a yi duŋshì enɛ ŋgèe bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na yi m ba bebep. Nyʉ̀ à m lòr yi ye àmbò ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, àmbò e ke lòr ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' byemi nè ye.
eng: By faith, Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world, and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe Abràham à yu'nì nè Nyʉ̀. Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' ye a laa nè ye enɛ e nati du fàdì' ce e be fa nè ye. E lo efa yê to' a ce dù, a ke' riŋ fàdì' ce e ce dù ka'.
eng: By faith, Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' e m byemi, e du a cu àmbò kìlò wa'a fàdì' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè ye nà. E m cu ba à btàp ce a m bà'ri ba nè bcɛ̀' a muu yî Aisìk ker ba muu muu yî Jakòp ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè wowèe wɛɛwɛ enɛ e be fa wowèe ŋgòŋ anà.
eng: By faith, he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents, with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

lmp: Abràham à m cu à btàp anà a ce kè' nfè' ce e be kè ce cu ba mbe ndàp à rla' ce à m kupshi ba Nyʉ̀ a ba'rî.
eng: For he looked for the city which has the foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe Sɛ̀ra ce e m ba ma nleeŋwɛ̀ a caase efa rbi muu, à lo a yeeti. Cena yi m ba wa'a njobè' e m byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̂ mini, e be gèe yuu ce e kà'.
eng: By faith, even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, Abràham à ba ma nleeŋwɛ̀, ka' yi m ba wa'a, yì ŋgʉ̀ à m lò yaa, a ba àmbò mkàŋsì embe bùu, a ker ba foŋ àmbò nsaruŋ yî àwâa rò ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ be' ka' nà.
eng: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

lmp: Bèe elûuŋgòŋ ca a m ku byemi nè Nyʉ̀ caar a kweŋger, a koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè wowèe nà ka'. Wowèe a m ku yɛ buu anà à njìsàp sê, a lu'shi, a laa enɛ wowèe a yu bkìlò njep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

lmp: Bèe ce a ce làa wa'a a gèe yi ba rara enɛ a roo ba rla' mo' ce be ba rlap.
eng: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

lmp: Wowèe a m ker ce kwà'shi àmbò lap rla' ce a m lô àfo nà ka'. Wowèe a m ka' ba ce kwà'shi àmbò lap rla' anà, a m ba tʉr njì à rkʉti àfo.
eng: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce kòŋ à rdù ba à rla' ce li bòŋ a caa fàdì' ce wowèe a m ce cu. Rla' anà yu lì embe bùu. Banɛ wowèe a ka' too Nyʉ̀ enɛ yàp Nyʉ̀, rìtu yi ke' koo Nyʉ̀ nè wowèe ka'. Sèe rìŋ wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ à kupshi rla' a lɛ nè wowèe.
eng: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m taase Abràhâm, a laa enɛ e lor Aisìk ce à m ku ba muu yì ce e m tʉr cà'cà' taŋshi taŋshì àgho nè ye nà, à m ku ba ba rbyemì ce li m gèe, Abràham à ka' yu'ni. E m tami nyor à rtaŋshi taŋshì nè Aisìk, ka' Nyʉ̀ à m kà' nè ye enɛ yì ŋgʉ̀ be yaa se wa'a.
eng: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his one and only son;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ war Abràham enɛ Aisìk a ŋwɛ̀ ce e be kɛ̀' gèe tɛ yì ŋgʉ̀ yaa.
eng: even he to whom it was said, In Isaac will your seed be called;

lmp: Abràham à m byemi enɛ Aisìk à ka' kwe, Nyʉ̀ ku tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ e kʉti ntèe. Àde' sèe laa seenɛ Aisìk à m ba àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kwe wɛɛ, Nyʉ̀ à fʉr ye efa rkwe, yì ta à konì lɛ ye wa'a.
eng: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe Aisìk à ghonì Jakòp ba Ɛsò, a suŋ wowèe àmbò bghònì ce wowèe a be lò koni.
eng: By faith, Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Jakòp à m ce kwe, rbyemì li m gèe e ghonì boo mmbaŋrù a baa ce Josɛ̀f à m tʉr. À m ba mbe nfè' anà e too nyor à mbàŋ a gʉ'shi nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: By faith, Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

lmp: À m ba à nfè' ce Josɛ̀f be kwe, rbyemì li m gèe ye e laa enɛ bèe Isrɛ̀l a be kè lô à to' Ijìp, a ker laa enɛ wowèe a ka' ke ce lò, a lor yi gʉ̀ʉ du àgho.
eng: By faith, Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel; and gave instructions concerning his bones.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe tàr ba ma yì Musìs a ka' bi Musìs, a ke' yʉ ye ka', a sʉti mbe ndàp à mŋwɛɛ btaar. Wowèe a m yɛ enɛ muu wàp anà bòŋ sê, a ke' wɛp yap yu à rbʉ' ncir ŋkʉʉ ka'.
eng: By faith, Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child, and they were not afraid of the king's commandment.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe Musìs à ka' kù' ghɛɛ ŋwɛ̀, a kani enɛ a fa kèr too ye enɛ muu embe nto' ŋkʉʉ à to' Ijìp ka'.
eng: By faith, Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter,

lmp: E m làa enɛ yi bòŋ enɛ a bèe Nyʉ̀ wèe a yɛ ŋgɛ' àbee caa ce enɛ e gee buu bbebep ce yu' rbòŋ àgho à mʉ nfè' mʉcàr.
eng: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God's people, than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time;

lmp: E m byemi yi yu enɛ bèe a ka' cɛp ye njo' Krâis ce Nyʉ̀ be lò tuu njep ŋgòŋ na, cena yi boŋ ye caa ce enɛ e tʉr bkû' à to' Ijìp wɛɛwɛ. Yi m ba wa'a njobè' e m ce kè' ba blà' ce vi bii ka' ba.
eng: accounting the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe e lô à to' Ijìp a du yi yu a ke' wɛp njobè' ntee yi m bep ŋkʉʉ ka'. E m kur ntee a du àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce yɛ lɛ Nyʉ̀ ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ yɛ nè mmir ka' nà wa'a.
eng: By faith, he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe e kɛ' Ŋkâ' càasi mndap. E m làa nè bèe Isrɛ̀l enɛ a ŋwaŋshi blɛɛ à ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' tɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m ce yʉshi boo mmbaŋrù ce a m ba boo rŋgòo nà, e càa bo yɛ, yʉshi boo rŋgòo ce bèe Isrɛ̀l a m tʉr ka'.
eng: By faith, he kept the Passover, and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe bèe Isrɛ̀l a tuu ma rdip ce a too enɛ rdip rbeer. A m tuu rli àmbò a m ce jɛ̀r lɛ ba mbe ŋkʉ̀ wa'a. Bêe à to' Ijìp a ka' jùu a wâp mbùu ghèter foŋ enɛ a bo tuu, rdip anà li kuŋrì wowèe a du àgho mbà rò.
eng: By faith, they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe bèe Isrɛ̀l a jɛr a kaari to' Jɛ̀rikù à nòŋ à nòŋ, mnòŋ vi ka' ba sàambâ, ŋka' à to' anà yi kɛɛtì.
eng: By faith, the walls of Jericho fell down, after they had been encircled for seven days.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe sàkì ce a m ce too enɛ Rahàp à sʉtì bèe Isrɛ̀l ce a m vʉ̀ à rker ŋgòŋ nà mbe yê ndàp. À ka' ba à nfè' ce bèe ce a m tèe btu nè Nyʉ̀ à m kweŋger nà, e kwe ka'.
eng: By faith, Rahab the prostitute, didn't perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

lmp: Àde' m suŋ wèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce rbyemì li m gèe bèe mo' foŋ a gee ka'. M ka' lo enɛ m ce suŋ, m suŋ du ba' fɛ? Nfè' yu àgho ce m suŋ wèe àmbò Gidìyòn, ba Baràk, ba Sâmsìn, ba Jɛptà, ba Dɛvìd, ba Sâmwɛ̀l ker ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets;

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe bèe mo' efa wowèe a ma' bìr a bto' mo', a so bto' anà. Wowèe a m sa' bèe à njî yɛɛnì, a koni buu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè wowèe. Nyʉ̀ à m cete bcùu bbʉrʉ̀' njo' lap rbyemì.
eng: who, through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

lmp: Bèe mo' efa wowèe a m tɛɛ mbe mʉ̀ mcùŋ mor, mor yi too wowèe ka'. Wèe mo' a m lùŋ efa bìr. Ka' wowèe a m ba bgò'sì wa'a, a m ku lo a gee buu btatap. Bèe mo' a m tʉr ŋger à rmà' bìr. Bèe mo' a m jùu ŋgâa mà' bîr à bto' mo'.
eng: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

lmp: Rbyemì li m gèe bbyèŋge mo' a yɛ yàp bèe mò' ce a m kweŋger a lo a kʉti btèe. Bèe mo' a m yɛ mlù à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce enɛ a m fa ŋgɛ' nè wowèe, a lip bèe mo' nè mmbàŋ, bvʉp vi kepŋgèr, wowèe a kweŋgèr. Wowèe a m byemi enɛ a be bèesi njì nè Nyʉ̀ tɛ a bo lùŋ ka'. Wowèe a m gèe wa'a njobè' wowèe a m rìŋ enɛ wowèe a be lò fʉʉ efa rkwe, cu rcu ce li yu jɛɛ.
eng: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

lmp: A m jàasi bèe mò', a lip wèe mo', a kur wèe mo' mkoo a fa mbe shaŋ.
eng: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

lmp: A m tʉʉshi bèe mo' efa wowèe nè blùr a kweŋgèr, a gwate bèe mo' efa wowèe a teni bkʉ̀kʉ̂ bbaa. A m yʉshi bèe mo' efa wowèe nè bkàafà'. Bèe ce a m ce yɛ ŋgɛ' na a m ba ŋgâa fùp. Wowèe a m ce yar ba mŋgʉp mbʉ. Bèe a m fa wowèe ŋgɛ' a jar nè wowèe sê.
eng: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated

lmp: Wowèe a m ce jɛ̀r à brìŋ ba à mtùu, a ce cu ba à mmbʉ̀' ba à mntòŋ. Ŋgòŋ ca yi m ba yɛɛnì nè wowèe à rcu njo ka'.
eng: of whom the world was not worthy, wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

lmp: Bèe ca a m kweŋger a lɛ rlii mbenjì njobè' wowèe a m byemi nè Nyʉ̀. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, wowèe a m koni yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be lò fa nè bèe ka'.
eng: These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn't receive the promise,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kwà'shi enɛ e be gèe yuu ce yi yu bòŋboŋ nè sèe ce sèe yu bêe sè'ni na, tɛ e bo gèe tɛ sèe bèe ca wèe ba àbee, ba yɛɛnì a yê bsii.
eng: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò sèe, bèe magòr ca, ce a m byemi nè Nyʉ̀ na, a sìr sèe a kaari a tarte a ce fyɛ' yuu ce sèe be gèe. Banɛ sèe ma' buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi ce jepsi sèe, ker ba buu bbebep ce vi yu sèe njep blɛɛ nà, kur ntee caŋ mcaŋnì ce Nyʉ̀ e kòŋ enɛ sèe caŋ nà.
eng: Therefore let us also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

lmp: Sèe ku lɛ misèe mmir ba mbendù Jisòs ce e m mʉ̀' njì enɛ sèe lɛ ntee njep ye, à ku ba ye ce e be kè lòr sèe dù àgho mbe bùu àlʉ̀simbùu. E m byemi a kwe rkwe rìtu mbe kìntaa. E m lòr rìtu anà à yuu ka', tɛ e bo tʉr njɛ̀ɛ rlu'shì ce Nyʉ̀ à m kupshi a lɛ nè ye. À ka' ba njobè' e m gèe wa'a, e cu sè'ni à bo mà' kàbàrà' yî Nyʉ̀.
eng: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

lmp: Kwà'shi ba àmbò Jisòs ce e m byemi, a yɛ ŋgɛ' mbà mmbo bêe bbebep ce a m bàa ye, fà dì' wèe lo koosi bsɛ̀ tɛ ntee yi lo kwe wèe ka'.
eng: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don't grow weary, fainting in your souls.

lmp: Bìr ce wèe ce mà' wèe buu bbebep nà à be ba' mbe dì' ce wèe ma' wa'a kweŋger ka'.
eng: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin;

lmp: Wèe fa lèse blâa Nyʉ̀ ce vi ke fa wèe ŋger njobè' wèe yu boo vi nà ka'. A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Muu wà, Nyʉ̀ à ka' fa wɛ̀ ŋgɛ' njo' yuu bebep ce wɛ̀ gèe, à fa lòr àtɛ̀r ka'. E ka' cep wɛ̀, à fa koosi bsɛ̀ ka'.
eng: and you have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, My son, don't take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

lmp: Rìŋ nè enɛ Nyʉ̀ e ke fa njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ca ba nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ. E ke lìp ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e lòr enɛ a muu yì."
eng: For whom the Lord loves, he chastens, and scourges every son whom he receives.

lmp: Banɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ce wèe ce yɛ na yu ba njì ce Nyʉ̀ ce yɛ'ni wèe. Cena yi dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à lòr wèe àmbò boo vi. Wà' muu mò' à m be ba ce e ka' gee yuu bebep, tàr ke' lip ka' a?
eng: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn't discipline?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à ka' tɛ fa wèe ŋgɛ' njo' yuu bebep ce wèe à gèe àmbò e ke gèe nè boo vi wɛɛwɛ nà ka', banɛ wèe yu boo bsuu.
eng: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then are you illegitimate, and not children.

lmp: Yi yu foŋ enɛ visèe bta a m ce fa ŋgɛ' nè sèe njo' fàa ce sèe à gèe, sèe yu'nì nè wowèe. Banɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ sèe yu'ni nè yisèe ta ce e yu mbe bùu bòŋboŋ sê, tɛ sèe bo koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits, and live?

lmp: Visèe bta enjep ŋgòŋ na a m fa sèe ŋgɛ' à yuu bebep ce sèe à gèe à mʉ nfè' àmbò a m yɛ enɛ yi yu yɛɛnì. À ka ba yi àmbò Nyʉ̀, e ke fa sèe ŋgɛ' njo' yuu bebep ce sèe à gèe tɛ ŋgɛ' anà bo jà' sèe tɛ sèe ba rara àmbò ye ye yu nà.
eng: For they indeed, for a few days, punished us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

lmp: E ke ba mbe nfè' ce sèe ce yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ca, sèe ce koosimnse, ke' ce lu'shi ka'. E ba embenjì, bèe ce a yɛ'ni yuu efa njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ca, a cu lap rcu nè rfʉtè- ŋwɛ̀, gee ŋgêe yɛɛnì.
eng: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been exercised thereby.

lmp: Banɛ wèe tapsi mkoo ce mi sɛ̀ nà, ke' ma'shi tɛ mkoo mi ce kàŋ wèe ka'
eng: Therefore, lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

lmp: Kûu jɛr nè ba njep nduunjì ce yi yu kùyɛɛ, tɛ kùu ce wèe ce nyɛ̀ɛ ntɛ̀ŋ àgho nà yi bo tap tap, ke' yaŋ gòr ka'.
eng: and make straight paths for your feet, so that which is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

lmp: Ghèter yɛ enɛ wɛ̀ cu à mʉ̀ bèe nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀. Ghèter cu rcu rrara njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ka' tɛ cu njɛ̀ɛ rcu ca ka', e ke yɛ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

lmp: Lòr nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ lo buu efa rkoni bghònì Nyʉ̀ ka'. Lòr nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ lo ba àmbò ŋgʉ̀ cece' ce ŋwɛ̀ e ke si'si mbà mmbò, e jòo byee nè mmbo vi ku ce' foŋ nà ka'. Njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce a yu àmbò ŋgʉ̀ cece' a ke vʉ̀ yap ba nè ŋgɛ', bepsi ŋgêe bèe magòr.
eng: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and many be defiled by it;

lmp: Lòr nè nfè' fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ lo gèe bsàrbuu kɛ̀ lòr buu Nyʉ̀ àtɛ̀r lò ba àmbo Ɛsò ce e m fyèni blee àtu baa nà ka'.
eng: lest there be any sexually immoral person, or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ enɛ Ɛsò à m ker lo a koŋ enɛ yì ta à ba ghòni ye, yi ta à kanì yi yu. Njì mò' à m ker ba nè Ɛsò à rkupse yuu ce e m gèe na ka', ka' e m ce war enɛ yì ta ghoni ye, mŋgoommir mi ce sùu wa'a.
eng: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

lmp: Rìŋ nè mbe dì' ce wèe tɛɛ. Wèe tɛɛ ba mbe dì' ce bèe Isrɛ̀l a m be tɛɛ nà ka'. Wowèe a m tɛɛ àgee rtùu ce a m ce too enɛ Sinài. À m ba rtùu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ à m ba jôo. À m ba à nfè' anà mcùŋ mor mi ko' mbekì, tʉ̀' à sii bìp, fu' yi ce càa tatap sê.
eng: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

lmp: Wowèe a m yu' àmbò rsòŋ li làa, a ker yu' àmbò njèndoŋ ŋwɛ̀ à làa. Buu ce njèndoŋ ŋwɛ̀ anà à m làa vi m wɛpsi wowèe, wowèe a bu' mmbo enɛ njèndoŋ anà fa kèr làa ka'.
eng: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

lmp: Wowèe a m làa wa'a, njobè' yuu ce njèndoŋ anà à m làa, yi m càa yap ŋger. Njèndoŋ anà à m làa enɛ̂, "Yuu mo' yi ka' joo rtùu ca, kɛ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu nyàa ɛ̀, banɛ a be tʉʉshi nè blùr tɛ e kwe."
eng: for they could not stand that which was commanded, If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned;

lmp: Buu ce wowèe a m yɛ àfo vi m wɛpsi wowèe sê. Musìs ye ye à m làa enɛ̂, "M ce wɛp a ce kàŋ."
eng: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, I am terrified and trembling.

lmp: Wèe tɛɛ ye ba àgee rtùu ce a too enɛ Sayòn. Wèe à bà' à rla' Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe. A too rla' anà enɛ̂, "Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m yî mbekì". Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ be' ka', a yu mbo a ce lu'shi.
eng: But you have come to Mount Zion, and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

lmp: Wèe yu à mʉ̀ boo blee vî Nyʉ̀, ce Nyʉ̀ à m saŋ map mlii mbe ŋwà' embe bùu nà. Wèe tɛɛ ba à bsii Nyʉ̀ ce e ke sa' bèe wɛɛwɛ. Me myòŋ mi yu à mʉ̀ myòŋ bêe mini ce a gèe wowèe a ba yɛɛnì nà.
eng: to the general assembly and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

lmp: Wèe à dù àmbùu Jisòs ce e m lòr yì nyor a fa nè Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à ye lè' àgho a ŋwɛ̀ nà wɛɛ. Wèe à lɛ̀ mmir ba mbendù blɛɛ Jisòs ce a m ŋwaŋshi, yuu ce blɛɛ anà vi tɛɛ àtu mo yi càa yuu ce blɛɛ Ɛbɛ̀l vi m tɛɛ àtu mo.
eng: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

lmp: Banɛ wèe lor nfè' fà dì' wèe lo kani efa ryu' blàa ce ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa nè wèe nà à m ce fè'shi nà ka'. Bèe elûuŋgòŋ ce a m kani efa ryu' blàa ce ŋwɛ̀ ce a m ba njep ŋgòŋ na à m ce fè'shi, a m lùŋ efa ŋgɛ' ka'. Àmbò wowèe a m lùŋ efa ŋgɛ' ka', banɛ àde' sèe ce sèe à yu' blâa ŋwɛ̀ ce e sùu embe bùu, sèe luŋ efa ŋgɛ' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ, ce sèe à ka' kani efa ryu' blàa anà.
eng: See that you don't refuse him who speaks. For if they didn't escape when they refused him who warned on the Earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà, njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀ à gee ŋgòŋ yi ci'tì, à ka' ba sè'ni, Nyʉ̀ à ye lè' enɛ e be cì' ŋgòŋ ca sè'ni nfè' mò'sir cà'cà', kèr cì' rbuu foŋ.
eng: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.

lmp: Blàa ce enɛ̂, "Nfè' mò'sir cà'cà'", vi ce dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ be cà'si buu ce àde' vi ci'tì, ce yu buu ce e m gèe nà, tɛ buu ce àde' vi ci'tì ka' vi cu nfesè.
eng: This phrase, Yet once more, signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

lmp: Banɛ sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e fa sèe dî' kʉʉ ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ ci' ka'. Sèe yu'ni nè ye, gʉ'shi nè ye nè rbonì-ŋwɛ̀ à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce ye ye kòŋ. Sèe wɛp ye foŋ.
eng: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can't be shaken, let us have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

lmp: Yìsèe Nyʉ̀ yu àmbò mor ce yi be tòo buu wɛɛwɛ nà wa'a.
eng: for our God is a consuming fire.

lmp: M ce kòŋ à rsuŋ wèe enɛ wèe yu bfʉr, banɛ wèe koŋni.
eng: Let brotherly love continue.

lmp: Wèe fa lèse efa rkoni bkèe ce a vʉ̀ à rcà'ni wèe ka', kè' nè wowèe bòŋboŋ. Bèe mo' a m koni bkèe a ke' à wowèe bòŋboŋ sê, a ke' riŋ enɛ bkèe anà à m ba bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Don't forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

lmp: Kuushi bèe ce a yu mbe shaŋ, koosimnse nè wowèe àmbò wɛ wɛ̀ yu lɛ mbe shaŋ wa' foŋ. Kwà'shi àmbò bèe ce a ce yɛ ŋgɛ', njobè' à ku tʉr nyor foŋ àmbò wowèe.
eng: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

lmp: Yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a lɛ mncir ce vi yu nje mʉ̀ bgùu. Tɛ mmbaŋrù a ba mini nè wap bbyèŋge tɛ bbyèŋge a ba mini nè wap mmbaŋrù. Nyʉ̀ be kè sa' bèe ce a ce koo bduu bèe mo', kèr sa' bèe ce a ce koo bbyèŋge bèe mo'.
eng: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

lmp: Lòr nè nfè' efa rkòŋ mbàa. Mà'shi tɛ buu ce wɛ̀ tʉr nà vi ghɛɛte wɛ̀, njobè' Nyʉ̀ à làa enɛ àde' e ma'shì wɛ̀ à nfè' mò' ka'. E be jà' wɛ̀ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.

lmp: Banɛ àde' sèe laa nè ntee-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce jà' mɛ̀, àde' ŋwɛ̀ gee yuu mo' nè mɛ̀ ka'."
eng: So that with good courage we say, The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?

lmp: Kuushi nè bèe ce a m ba btu nè wee, a fe'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nè wèe nà. Kwà'shi nè àmbò rcu bèe anà li m ba, byemi nè Nyʉ̀ foŋ àmbò wowèe a m byemi nà.
eng: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

lmp: Jisos Krâis ku ba ntìni àmbò e mʉ ba nèŋkùr, kù ba wa' foŋ àyàŋsè. Àde' e kupsè à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

lmp: Fa mà'shi tɛ buu mo' ce bèe mo' a ce yɛ'ni, vi ba yi jɛɛ nà, vi lo bo' wèe ka'. Yuu ce yi gèe visèe mntee vi ka' tap, à gèe ba bghònì ce vi vʉ̀ ese Nyʉ̀. Mncir ce vi yu a kuu ba byee nà vi yu à cicì. Àde' mncir anà vi ja' bèe ce a ce lɛ̀ vi ka'.
eng: Don't be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

lmp: Sèe tʉr dì' ce a gèe taŋshì mbo nè sèe. Ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce a ke fà' ba mbe Tabɛ̀nakùr nà, a tʉr ŋger à rye yuu embe dì' taŋshì yisèe na ka'.
eng: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

lmp: Tu nè ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì efa mʉ̀ Jus e ke taŋshi taŋshì àtu buu bbebep bèe. E ke taŋshi taŋshì ca, lor ba blɛɛ cà'cà' niŋ àgho mbe dî' rara ce yi càa ŋger nà, lor nyàa ce a ba sɛɛ nà fʉʉ àgho efa mʉ̀ rla', too nè mor.
eng: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

lmp: Jisòs ye ye à m fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ rla' a ka' kwe tɛ e bo siŋsi buu bebep ce bèe a m gèe nè vi blɛɛ.
eng: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

lmp: Banɛ sèe fʉʉ efa mʉ̀ rla' du yɛ ye tɛ a coosi sèe wowèe àbee,
eng: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

lmp: njobè' sèe tʉr rla' mo' njep ŋgòŋ na ce li be cu nfesè ka', sèe ce kè' ba rla' ce li bii ka' ba.
eng: For we don't have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

lmp: Banɛ sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ à rlii Jisòs. Lisèe ryòŋshì anà li be ba àmbò taŋshì ce sèe à gèe nè Nyʉ̀ wa'a. Sèe yoŋshi ye nè visèe mnjèndoŋ à njî yɛɛnì.
eng: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

lmp: Fa lèse efa rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ kèr gàp yò buu ce wɛ̀ tʉr nè bèe ka', njobè' njɛ̀ɛ ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ca yi yu àmbò njɛ̀ɛ taŋshì ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ se wa'a.
eng: But don't forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

lmp: Yu'ni nè nè bèe ce a yu kùntombì nè wèe, gee yuu ce a ce làa nè wèe. Wowèe a ce kè'ni me myòŋ, a ker ba foŋ bèe ce a be kè tɛɛ à bsii Nyʉ̀, suŋ àmbò a m gèe rfà' ca à nfè' ce wowèe a m ba njep ŋgòŋ na. Sèe yu'ni nè wowèe tɛ wowèe a bo ce gèe lap rfà' nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀, buwa'làr wowèe a lo ce koosimnse, tɛ yuu anà yi ja' wèe ka'.
eng: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

lmp: Loo nè nè wèr. Wèr rìŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ yer ntee yi yu rara.
eng: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

lmp: M ce bu' mmbo nè wèe sê, enɛ wèe loo nè wèr, tɛ m bo yàŋse koni fɛŋ kèr vʉ̀ yɛ wèe.
eng: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à gèe Jisos Krâis à fʉʉ efa rkwe. Blɛɛ Jisòs a yuu ce yi m gèe lè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m ye a ŋwɛ̀ yi tʉr ŋger nfesè. À ka' ba njobè' rkwe Jisòs, Jisòs yu ŋkʉʉ gày ce e ce kè'ni yì bèe.
eng: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

lmp: Banɛ, tɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa bèe cumʉnyaŋ njep ntee, fa wèe buu bbòŋboŋ tɛ wèe bo gèe buu ce e ce kòŋ enɛ wèe à ba gèe. Tɛ e fa' njep visèe mntee, gee tɛ sèe ba njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce e kòŋ enɛ sèe à ba ba, à ŋger Jisos Krâis. Tɛ bèe a ku'si Jisos Krâis nfesè. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe enɛ wèe koo ncep ca mmbo mmbaa. Ŋwà' ce mɛ̀ saŋ nè wèe na yi sàp ka'.
eng: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

lmp: M ce kòŋ enɛ wèe riŋ enɛ Timotì à fʉʉ embe shaŋ sè'ni. E ka' vʉ yɛ mɛ̀, tɛ m lor ye, wèr ye vʉ yɛ wèe.
eng: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

lmp: Cà'ni nè btu embe côr, ker ca'ni bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ nè mɛ̀. Bèe Nyʉ̀ ce à to' Italè a cà'ni wèe foŋ.
eng: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ ghoni wèe wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: Grace be with you all. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Jɛ̂ms, ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Nyʉ̀ ker ba nè Tata Jisos Krâis. M ce saŋ nè wèe ce bèe Isrɛ̀l ce à mntɛ̀' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ce a da'se mbe tunshe sìp. M ce ca'ni wèe.
eng: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, rmòoshì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ li ka' vʉ nè wèe njo' le rbyemì banɛ wèe kù ce lu'shi,
eng: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

lmp: njobè' wèe yi enɛ wèe ka' so rmòoshì ca banɛ li be gèe tɛ wèe tʉr ŋger à rtɛɛ tatap.
eng: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

lmp: Wèe gheter enɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap du kùntombì, tɛ wèe bo ba yɛɛnì à buu wɛɛwɛ, kè' buu yuu mo' ka'.
eng: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' efa wêe mʉ à ka' buu bfee, e loo ese Nyʉ̀. Nyʉ̀ be fa ye, njobè' e yu mmbo mtoo, ce fa nè ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ, ke' cɛpshi nyor ka'.
eng: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach; and it will be given to him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' loo yuu ese Nyʉ̀, ŋgàŋ byemi nè yi ntee-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ Nyʉ̀ be fa ye yuu anà. E loo, e fa tarni ka' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ à ka' loo ce tarni, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu àmbò rdip gòr ce fu' yi càa ce cì' wa'a.
eng: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr mkwà'shì mmbaa wa'a ce koko koko. E fa kwà'shi enɛ e be koni yuu mo' ese Tata ka'.
eng: For let that man not think that he will receive anything from the Lord. He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

lmp: Nfʉr ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fùp à ba ce lu'shi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à nàa ye mbekì,
eng: But let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

lmp: tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mbàa ye ye ce lu'shi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à sùusi ye njep nshè, njobè' e be kù lò ba àmbò fʉ̀lawà ce e tɛɛ ntìni ce foo, tʉ' e ce raa e banì yuushi nà.
eng: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ e saŋ à mjɛɛ, mi yuushi, fʉ̀lawà efa gho yi karnger, gwe à nshe, li rbòŋ li bʉ à cicì. A mbò yi yu nè ŋwɛ̀ mbàa wa'a; yi ntà'tè e ce dù kùntombì, e kwe, bɛr buu anà.
eng: For the sun arises with the scorching wind, and withers the grass, and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So also will the rich man fade away in his pursuits.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛɛ tatap à nfè' ce rmòoshì li vʉ̀ nè ye, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ rbôŋtu. Rmòoshì li ka' vʉ nè ye, e so, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be fa ye ryòŋ ce yu blà' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kà' enɛ e be fa nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a kòŋ ye.
eng: Blessed is the man who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life, which the Lord promised to those who love him.

lmp: Rmòoshì li ka' vʉ nè ŋwɛ̀, ŋgàŋ fa làa enɛ li lò ese Nyʉ̀ ka'. Àde' yuu bebep yi mooshì Nyʉ̀ ka', Nyʉ̀ ye ye e ke mòoshi ŋwɛ̀ ka' foŋ.
eng: Let no man say when he is tempted, I am tempted by God, for God can't be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

lmp: Yu ba broŋ ce ŋwɛ̀ roŋ à buu ce vi ke gèe ŋgàŋ ka' tʉr rmòoshì à rgèe yuu bebep.
eng: But each one is tempted, when he is drawn away by his own lust, and enticed.

lmp: Broŋ ca vi dòoshi ŋwɛ̀ e gee yuu bebep; yuu bebep ca yi ku', vʉ nè rkwe.
eng: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin; and the sin, when it is full grown, brings forth death.

lmp: Bfʉr wa ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, fa byemi nè tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka'.
eng: Don't be deceived, my beloved brothers.

lmp: Famɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e yu bòŋboŋ, a ba yɛɛnì, e ke vʉ̀ embe bùu ese Nyʉ̀ ce e m boo mraa wɛɛwɛ ce mi ke raa embe bùu. Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke kupse yì ndèe, ma'shi yì bèe à tʉ̀'njì ka'.
eng: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation, nor turning shadow.

lmp: E m co' sèe à li rkòŋ, a laa yì nlàayɛ, a gee sèe à ba boo vi, tɛ sèe bo ba entombì nè buu wɛɛwɛ ce e m boo nà.
eng: Of his own will he brought us forth by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

lmp: Bfʉr wa ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, m ce cep wèe mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ba cɛrcɛr à ryu' buu, lor nfè' ka' laa yuu, ker lor nfè' ka' cɛpshi nyor.
eng: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ncɛpshi nyor gee yuu ce yi yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: for the anger of man doesn't produce the righteousness of God.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, mɛ̀ ce làa nè wèe sè'ni enɛ wèe ma' ndêe mbembep ba bsàrbuu. Nyʉ̀ ce byè vi blàa njep wêe mntee, banɛ wèe mʉ' wee mntee, yu' vi nè rbonì-ŋwɛ̀. Àde' vi gee wèe lûŋ.
eng: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

lmp: Wêe yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ anà, wèe ce gee yuu ce yi suŋ wèe enɛ wèe gêe. Wèe à ka' ku ce yu' blâa Nyʉ̀ yu', ke' ce gèe yuu ce vi làa ka' banɛ wèe ce bo' wee btu.
eng: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce yu' blâa Nyʉ̀, ke' ce gèe buu ce vi làa ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e fyɛ' yì nyor nje cɛrlîr.
eng: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

lmp: E lɛ'si nyor, nfè' mʉcàr lese àmbò li rfeese li ba ba.
eng: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce yu' ncir Nyʉ̀ ce yi bòŋ du misî, à ba ncir ce yi fa ŋwɛ̀ fɛŋ à rgèe buu bbòŋboŋ, a ker lɛ ncir anà bòŋboŋ à nfè' sìp, Nyʉ̀ be ghòni yuu wɛɛwɛ ce e ce gèe, njobè' ŋwɛ̀ anà ku ce yu' yu' ka', e ce yu' ce gèe.
eng: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom, and continues, not being a hearer who forgets, but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce làa enɛ e byemi nè Nyʉ̀, ke' ghashi li rlee ka', banɛ e bo' yi tu. Li rbyemì anà li yu à cicì.
eng: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn't bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man's religion is worthless.

lmp: Rbyemì ce li yu rrara a ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ, li yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ja' boo ŋkʉ ba byepkʉʉ ce a ce yɛ ŋgɛ'. Li yu foŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ fa mà'shi tɛ ŋgòŋ yi bo' ye ka'.
eng: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe ce wèe à byemi nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ fòo, wèe fa so'niŋgòŋ ka'.
eng: My brothers, don't hold the faith of our Lord Jesus Christ of glory with partiality.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ fùp ba ŋwɛ̀ mbàa a ka' niŋ mbe dì' ce wèe ce gèe rloo nè Nyʉ̀, ŋwɛ̀ mbàa yar tee ce e lùu ntaa, ma' bcɛ̂' bbòŋboŋ à nyòr, ŋwɛ̀ fùp cà yar bcɛ̀' ce vi yu bjàpri,
eng: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in;

lmp: wèe à ka' fa rgʉ'shì nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e sùsi nyor nà, laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ cu mbe nta' bòŋboŋ ca," laa nè ŋwɛ̀ fùp ca yi ba enɛ̂, "Tɛɛ yo mbonà, buwa'làr à sɛrnì à nshè mbe mɛ̂ geŋ mkùu na,"
eng: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing, and say, Sit here in a good place; and you tell the poor man, Stand there, or Sit by my footstool;

lmp: banɛ wèe à dùŋshi jɛɛ jɛɛ a wêe mʉ, a lɛ wêe mnyor à ŋgâa nsa' mnsa' bèe nè mntee bbebep.
eng: haven't you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

lmp: Yu' nè, bfʉr wa ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê, mbò Nyʉ̀ à m ce ŋgâa fùp enjep ŋgòŋ na enɛ wowèe a byemi nè Jisos Krâis, koni sɛ' gòr, ye bti' embe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ce e m kà' nè bèe ce a kòŋ ye a?
eng: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn't God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe à ku cu à rjàasì ŋgâa fùp. Mbò bèe ce a ke fa wèe ŋgɛ', ker ce lòr wèe ce dù àgho mbe ndap mnsa' yu ŋgâa mbàa a?
eng: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don't the rich oppress you, and personally drag you before the courts?

lmp: Mbò yu wowèe ce a ce bepsi rlii rbòŋboŋ ce Jisòs à m fa nè wèe na a?
eng: Don't they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

lmp: Banɛ yuu ce yi ghɛɛte nè wèe à rgèe yi yu enɛ wèe lɛ ncir ce embe dî' kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Kòŋ nfʉrò àmbò wɛ̀ kòŋ yò nyor" nà.
eng: However, if you fulfill the royal law, according to the Scripture, You shall love your neighbor as yourself, you do well.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce so'niŋgòŋ, banɛ wèe ce gèe ba yuu bebep, wèe à bʉ' ncir Nyʉ̀.
eng: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' lɛ mncir Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, ku bʉ' ba mo'sir, banɛ e bʉ' mncir wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

lmp: Wèe yi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m làa enɛ̂, "Fa koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'," ku ba ye ce e m làa foŋ enɛ̂, "Fa yʉ ŋwɛ̀ ka'." Wɛ̀ ka' tɛ koo ŋgwa ŋwɛ̀ mò' kɛ̀ nduu ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka', yʉ ŋwɛ̀, yi ku ba enɛ wɛ̀ bʉ' mncir wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For he who said, Do not commit adultery, also said, Do not commit murder. Now if you do not commit adultery, but murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

lmp: Banɛ wèe ce laa buu, ker ce gee ŋgèe ba àmbò bèe ce Nyʉ̀ be kè sa' wèe nè ncir ce yi mà'shi ŋwɛ̀ àwàa à rgèe buu ce e kòŋ.
eng: So speak, and so do, as men who are to be judged by a law of freedom.
