lmp: Nyʉ̀ be kè sa' bèe tɛ e kani efa rkoosimnse nè bèe ce a m buu efa rkoosimnse nè bèe mo'. Banɛ bèe ce a m ce koosimnse nè bèe mo' a be wɛp mnsa' anà ka'.
eng: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, ŋwɛ̀ à ka' laa enɛ e byemi nè Nyʉ̀, ke' ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ka', banɛ sɛ' efa gho yu kɛ? Àde' rbyemì anà li gee ye e luŋ a?
eng: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

lmp: Nfʉr mò' kɛ̀ njàr mò' ka' buu bcɛ̀' ce e yar, ker buu byee ce e ye,
eng: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

lmp: mò' efa wèe ka' yɛ ye, laa nè ye enɛ̂, "Dù nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀ du ma' bcɛ̀' ce yò nyor bo lùu, yeŋger bòŋboŋ," e làa wa'a ke' fa ye buu ce e buu na ka', e ja' ye a njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: and one of you tells them, Go in peace, be warmed and filled; and yet you didn't give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

lmp: A mbò rbyemì li ku ba wa'a. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' byemi, ke' ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ka' banɛ rbyemì anà li yu gʉ̂ʉ yuu.
eng: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' laa yi enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ tʉr rbyemì, mɛ̀ tʉr ndêe mbòŋmboŋ." M be bèesi nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e làa wa' mɛnɛ̂, "Dùŋshi ka mɛ̀ lo rbyemì ce li buu ndêe mbòŋmboŋ, tɛ m duŋshi wɛ̀ yà ndêe mbòŋmboŋ tɛ à yɛ wɛnɛ mɛ̀ tʉr rbyemì."
eng: Yes, a man will say, You have faith, and I have works. Show me your faith without works, and I by my works will show you my faith.

lmp: To wɛ̀ byemi enɛ Nyʉ̀ ku ba mò'sir. Wɛ̀ gèe yɛɛnì. Kuushi wɛnɛ byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà' vi ku byemi wa' foŋ, a ce wɛp a ce kàŋ.
eng: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe, and shudder.

lmp: Lʉr câ, wɛ̂ ròo enɛ m duŋshi wɛ̀ enɛ rbyemì ce li buu ŋgêe bòŋboŋ li yu à cicì a?
eng: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

lmp: Kuushi enɛ Nyʉ̀ à m lòr yìsèe ta Abràham à ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì a yê bsii njobè' e m lòr muu yî Aisìk tɛ e bo taŋshi taŋshì àgho nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Wasn't Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

lmp: Àde' wèe yɛ sè'ni enɛ rbyemì Abràham ba yì ndêe mbòŋmboŋ a m ku ce jɛ̀r àbee. Yuu ce Abràham à m gèe yi m gèe li rbyemì li ghɛɛtè.
eng: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;

lmp: Cena yi m gèe yuu ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Abràham à m ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njo' li rbyemì," nà yi ghɛɛtè njo. A mbùu ce a m ce too Abràham enɛ̂, "Ŋkar Nyʉ̀."
eng: and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness; and he was called the friend of God.

lmp: Wèe à yɛ sè'ni enɛ ŋwɛ̀ yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njo' yì ndêe mbòŋmboŋ, ke' ku ba njo' li rbyemì cà' ka'.
eng: You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.

lmp: Yi m ku ba wa'a foŋ nè njeŋwɛ̀ sàkì ce a m ce too enɛ Rahàp. E m ba yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njobè' e m sʉ̀ti ŋgâa ŋker ce bèe Isrɛ̀l a m tuu, a duŋshi wowèe nduunjì mo', wowèe a caŋ a kʉti.
eng: In the same way, wasn't Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?

lmp: Rbyemì ce li buu ndêe mbòŋmboŋ li ku ba àmbò gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ wa'a.
eng: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yi bòŋ enɛ bèe magòr efa wêe mʉ a ba ŋgâa ryɛ'nì ka', njobè' Nyʉ̀ be kè sa' sèe ce sèe yu ŋgâa ryɛ'nì tatap càa bèe mo'.
eng: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ e ke gèe buu bbebep magòr. Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba ce e ke làa yuu bebep ka', banɛ ŋgàŋ yu yɛɛnì à buu wɛɛwɛ, a ce lòr nfè' à buu wɛɛwɛ ce e ce gèe.
eng: For in many things we all stumble. If anyone doesn't stumble in word, the same is a perfect man, able to bridle the whole body also.

lmp: Sèe à ka' fa kwàŋ kù cûu nyàabàrà' tɛ e bo yu'ni nè sèe, àde' sèe gee e du à dì' sèe à gwɛɛ.
eng: Indeed, we put bits into the horses' mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

lmp: Kèr kwa'shi nè àmbò ma keŋ enjep rdip rgòr. Fu' tatap yi ka' ce dòo ce dù àgho à jɛɛ, ŋwɛ̀ rdòo ku beesi ba mʉ co' mo' embe keŋ anà, e du à njì ce ŋwɛ̀ rdòo ce kòŋ.
eng: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

lmp: A mbò rlee ŋwɛ̀ li yu wa'a foŋ. Li yu mʉcàr wa'a a tʉr ŋger sê. Kù kwa'shi ka nè foŋ àmbò mʉ rcùŋ mor li ke tòo ma kòp lɛ̂.
eng: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

lmp: Rlee ŋwɛ̀ li yu àmbò mor, a ba àmbò ŋgòŋ ce yi ruu nè buu bbebep, a ce bepsi ŋwɛ̀ dʉ̀dʉ̀. Àde' li ku too ŋwɛ̀, ŋgàŋ yɛ mlù caa kwe. Mor Satàn a yuu ce e ke cʉ̀' mor ca.
eng: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

lmp: Bèe a yɛ'ni mnyàa ce à rìŋ ba vì enjep rò, ba bsiŋ, vi ce gèe àmbò bèe a kòŋ;
eng: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and thing in the sea, is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind.

lmp: geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ à ke' ba ce àde' e yɛ'nì li rlee tɛ li ku ce làa ba buu bbòŋboŋ ka'. Rlee yu njɛ̀ɛ yuu bebep mo' ce yi ke kòŋ à rcu mʉnyaŋ ka'. Li ke làa yuu yi ba àmbò nli' ce àde' e yʉ ŋwɛ̀ wa'a.
eng: But nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

lmp: See ke lòr rlee yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tata àgho, ker lor ro' bfʉr visèe ce Nyʉ̀ à m boo a feesè ye àgho.
eng: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men, who are made in the image of God.

lmp: Ryòŋshì ba mcɛp mi ke kù ce fʉʉ ekù cûu mo'sir. Bfʉr wâ, yi bòŋ wa' ka'.
eng: Out of the same mouth comes forth blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

lmp: Wà' àde' mdip mmbòŋmboŋ mi fʉʉ embe dî' mo'sir a mdip mmbembep a?
eng: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, àde' mmbì mi yʉ mbe ce fer a? Àde' fer yi yʉ mbe rtɛɛ a? Yi yu foŋ enɛ àde' à tu' mdip mmbòŋmboŋ enjep dì' ce mdip mgwaŋ mi ce fʉʉ ka'.
eng: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba a wêe mʉ ce e tʉr bfee, a yi buu, banɛ li rcu rbòŋboŋ li be kù ce dùŋshi enɛ e tʉr bfee. E ka' ce cu wa'a, e ba mʉfɛ̀ɛ à yi ŋgèe àmbò ŋwɛ̀ bfee à ba ba.
eng: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ba ne ŋwɛ̀ ŋko'ndoŋ sê, ker ce taŋ buu à bwer, banɛ e fa ce naa- tu, ce jepsi mini nè mnde' enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ bfee ka'.
eng: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don't boast and don't lie against the truth.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ bfee ca vi vʉ̀ ese Nyʉ̀ ka'; yu ba bfee enjep ŋgòŋ, à ba bfee ŋwɛ̀ ce vi vʉ̀ ba ese Satàn.
eng: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

lmp: Fàdì' ce ŋko'ndoŋ ba bwer vi yu, banɛ bèe a be kù ba bcùu jɛɛ jɛɛ, kèr ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ buu bbebep wɛɛwɛ.
eng: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

lmp: Bfee ce vi vʉ̀ ba ese Nyʉ̀ vi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀, e ce gèe ŋgêe rara. Vi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀, e cu nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀, ba nè rbonì-ŋwɛ̀, ker tʉr ntee à ryu' yuu ce bèe mo' a ce làa. Vi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀, e tʉr ŋkoosimnse ker ce gèe buu bbòŋboŋ. Vi ke gèe ŋwɛ̀ e ce so'niŋgòŋ ka', ke' ce bo' bèe ka'.
eng: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

lmp: Ŋgâa ŋgèe cumʉnyaŋ a ka' bye cumʉnyaŋ à mʉ̀ bèe, e ku', banɛ a be kep ba ŋgêe bòŋboŋ.
eng: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

lmp: Mlap ba bkòr ce vi yu a wêe mʉ na vi lò efɛ? Mbò vi yu ba njobè' wèe ce taŋ buu njep wêe mntee a?
eng: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don't they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

lmp: Wèe ce yʉshi bèe njobè' wèe ce ròo à rtʉr buu ce wèe tʉr ka', wèe ce lapni, ker ce rè bkòr njobè' wèe ku ce gani buu gani ke' ce koni ka'. Wèe tʉr buu ce wèe ce kòŋ à rtʉr ka' njobè' wèe ce loo vi ese Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: You lust, and don't have. You kill, covet, and can't obtain. You fight and make war. You don't have, because you don't ask.

lmp: Wèe à ka' loo buu ese Nyʉ̀ ke' tʉr vi ka', banɛ wêe loo nè mkwà'shî mmbembep. Wèe ce loo à rkoni buu ce wèe ce taŋ à rtʉr njep wêe mntee.
eng: You ask, and don't receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it for your pleasures.

lmp: Wèe ce bsàkì, mbò wèe yi weenɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koo ŋkar a ŋgòŋ, banɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà yu ŋwɛ̀ bbàa nè Nyʉ̀ a? Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' kòŋ à rkoo ŋkar a ŋgòŋ banɛ e gèe yi tu à ŋwɛ̀ bbàa nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: You adulterers and adulteresses, don't you know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

lmp: Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ yi làa enɛ̂, "Yʉ' ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè sèe yi kòŋ magòr enɛ sèe ku yu'ni ba nè Nyʉ̀." Wà' yi làa ba à cicì a?
eng: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously?

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, Nyʉ̀ à tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè sèe sê, a fa sèe ŋger. Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ bàa ŋgâa nàatu, a ce fa ŋger nè bèe ce a sùusi yàp nyor njep nshè."
eng: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

lmp: Banɛ wèe fa wee btu mbe mmbo Nyʉ̀. Wèe kani Satàn tɛ e caŋ wèe.
eng: Be subject therefore to God. But resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

lmp: Vʉ̀ nè àgee Nyʉ̀ tɛ ye ye bo vʉ̀ a wêe geŋ, wèe ce ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, fʉr nè me mmbo enjep mʉ̀ buu bbebep, ŋgâa rtarnì, fa nè wee mntee nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners; and purify your hearts, you double-minded.

lmp: Kuushi nè yè buu bbebep ce wèe à gèe, koosimnse, war nè Nyʉ̀; fa kèr lu'shi nè ce vʉ̀shi ka', ce war nè war ce koosi ba mnse.
eng: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning, and your joy to gloom.

lmp: Sùusi nè wee mnyor njep nshè à bsii Tatâ, tɛ e naa wèe mbekì.
eng: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe fa ce làa bebep kuu bèe mo' ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce làa bebep kuu nfʉr yì, ker ce sa' ye, banɛ e ce làa bebep kuu ncir, a ker ce sa' ba yi. Wèe à ka' ce sa' ncir banɛ wèe à borni à rlɛ̀ ncir, a kɛ' a ce sa' yi sa'.
eng: Don't speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law, but a judge.

lmp: Ku ba Nyʉ̀ ce e fa ncir, a ker tʉr ŋger à rsa' bèe, ku ba ye ce e tʉr ŋger à rjà' bèe, a ker tʉr ŋger à rbepsi bèe. A wɛ̀ nda, ka' ce sa' bfʉr wo?
eng: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

lmp: Yu' nè sè'ni, wèe ce wèe cu ce kà' buu ce wèe be gèe, ce làa enɛ̂, "Wèr be lò ntìni, buwa'làr wèr lo àyàŋsè dù cu à to' mo' àmbò fè', tɛ wèr bo gèe ntaa, koni mbàa."
eng: Come now, you who say, Today or tomorrow let's go into this city, and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ yuu ce yi be ba àyàŋsè ka'. Le ryòŋ li yu àmbò mmbà' ce vi yɛɛti, nfè' mʉcàr vi bʉ nà.
eng: Whereas you don't know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor, that appears for a little time, and then vanishes away.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce kà' à rgèe yuu, wèe à ba làa ba enɛ̂, "Tata ka' byemi banɛ sèe be gèe ca ba ca."
eng: For you ought to say, If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a wèe à ku bii nè nàa-tu-ŋwɛ̀, a ce kwà' enɛ àde' wèe gee buu wɛɛwɛ a wêe ŋger. Njɛ̀ɛ nàa-tu anà bòŋ ka'.
eng: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

lmp: Yi ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' riŋ yuu bòŋboŋ ce àde' e gêe, ke' gee yuu anà ka' banɛ ŋgàŋ à gèe yuu bebep.
eng: To him therefore who knows to do good, and doesn't do it, to him it is sin.

lmp: Wèe ce wèe yu ŋgâa mbàa, yu' nè yuu ce m be làa nè wèe. War nè, ker koosimnse njo' ŋgɛ' ce e be vʉ̀ nè wèe.
eng: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

lmp: Yè buu à bʉ̀te, nsɛ' yi ye wèe bcɛ̀' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

lmp: Nlo à ye ye mbàa; nlo ca be kè fa wèe à ŋgɛ', ye wèe ba àmbò mor ce yi tòo ŋwɛ̀ wa'a. Wèe à baashi ye mbàa a lɛ à nfè' ce ŋgòŋ yi ce mì.
eng: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you, and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

lmp: Bèe a fà' nè wèe, wèe à kanì à rlà' wowèe. Yu' nè àmbò wowèe a ce war ce gʉ̀ʉ wèe, wowèe a war tètè, Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger mbendù buu wɛɛwɛ à yu'.
eng: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out, and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

lmp: Wèe à ye rbòŋ enjep ŋgòŋ, a cu nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀. À m ba nyʉ̀ ce a m ce yʉshi bèe, wèe à ku cu à rye byee, a ce kù'ŋger.
eng: You have lived delicately on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

lmp: Wèe à fa bèe ce a gèe fàa ka' à ŋgɛ', a yʉshi wowèe, wowèe a ke' gee yuu mo' ka'.
eng: You have condemned, you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn't resist you.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, àmbò yi yu wa' nà, m ce làa nè wèe enɛ wèe kur ntee du ba' à nfè' ce yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis be kè vʉ̀. Kwà'shi ka nè àmbò ŋgâa nfà' mnsuu a ke kur ntee ce kè' mbèŋ kwâa, ker kè' nfè' ce kwaa be bi tɛ a ka' kep nà.
eng: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

lmp: Banɛ wee wèe kur ntee wa' foŋ. Tami nè nyor, tɛɛ tatap ce ke', njobè' nfè' mʉcàr tɛ yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis vʉ̂.
eng: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, wèe fa ce rʉ̀'ŋger ka', fà dì' a bo sa' wèe ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be teni visèe mnsa' yu àtʉtʉ.
eng: Don't grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won't be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

lmp: Kuushi nè ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m cep à rlii Tatâ, bfʉr wâ. Yɛ'ni nè ese wowèe à rtʉr ntee tatap à nfè' ŋgɛ' àmbò wowèe a m tʉr nà.
eng: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of patience, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

lmp: Sèe ce làa seenɛ wowèe a yu ŋgâa Mbôŋtu njobè' wowèe a m tɛɛ tatap à nfè' ŋgɛ'. Wèe à m yu' àmbò Jup ce e m kur ntee à nfè' ce rmòoshì li m vʉ̀ nè ye, a ka' lò embenjì mo, Nyʉ̀ à fa ye ku' buu. Banɛ wèe riŋ enɛ Tàr Nyʉ̀ bòŋ ŋgèe, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ŋkoosimnse sê.
eng: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the patience of Job, and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, yuu mo' tatap ce m ker ce ròo suŋ wèe yi yu enɛ wee ce suŋ buu wèe fa kàa ka'. Wèe fa kàa ka' à rlii Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ à rlii nshe ka', kɛ̀ à rlii yuu mo' ka'. Kù làa nè enɛ̂, "Ɛ̀no" ce wèe à ka' byemi, laa enɛ̂, "Kaka'" ce wèe à ka' kani, tɛ yi mi wa'a, fà dì' Nyʉ̀ bo kè sa' wèe ka'.
eng: But above all things, my brothers, don't swear, neither by heaven, nor by the earth, nor by any other oath; but let your yes be yes, and your no, no; so that you don't fall into hypocrisy.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e ce yɛ ŋgɛ' a? Ŋgàŋ loo nè Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e ce lu'shi a? Ŋgàŋ yop yɛɛ, nɛsi Nyʉ̀.
eng: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e ce yaŋ a? Ŋgàŋ kɛ' btu embe côr, tɛ a vʉ loo nè ye kèr yo' ye nè mgʉr à rlii Tata Jisos Krâis.
eng: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord,

lmp: Wowèe a ka' loo nè rbyemì-ŋwɛ̀, Tata ja' ŋwɛ̀ yaŋ anà. Ka' ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà à m gèe buu bbebep, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be fòosi ye.
eng: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

lmp: Yi ba sè'ni enɛ wèe to'shi yè buu bbebep, ŋwɛ̀ to'shi vi nè ŋwɛ̀; loo nè nè wee btu, ŋwɛ̀ loo nè ŋwɛ̀, tɛ Yʉ' yi bo jà' wèe tɛ wèe ke'si efa wee byaŋ. Ŋwɛ̂ mbòŋmboŋ ka' loo yuu ese Nyʉ̀ nè yi ntee-ŋwɛ̀, Nyʉ̀ yu' li rloo cɛrcɛr sê.
eng: Confess your offenses to one another, and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

lmp: Àlajà ce e m ku ba ŋwɛ̀ àmbò sèe à m loo tatap enɛ mbèŋ fa gwè ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m yu' li rloo, mbèŋ à ke' gwe ka' à bfê' btaar ba mŋwɛɛ ntuunfu.
eng: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn't rain on the earth for three years and six months.

lmp: Embenjì mo Àlajà à ker loo, mbèŋ à gwê, byee vi kɛ' a ce kù'.
eng: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth brought forth its fruit.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, kuushi nè yuu ce m be làa nè wèe na. Mò' efa wèe à ka' ma'shi nduunjì Nyʉ̀, nfʉr mò' ja', kʉsi ye njep nduunjì Nyʉ̀, banɛ nfʉr anà à tee yʉ' ŋwɛ̂ mbembep cà efa rkwe, a ker bʉsi ku' buu bbebep magòr.
eng: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth, and someone turns him back, let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death, and will cover a multitude of sins.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Pità ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ ntuu Jisos Krâis. M ce saŋ nè bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a da'se a ba bkìlò à ŋgôŋ Pontùs, ba Gàlɛshà, ba Kàpàdosìyà, ba Ɛshà ker ba Bìtinìyà.
eng: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ Tàr à m rìŋ wèe wɛɛ, a ka' ce wèe, yi yʉ' yi gee wèe à ba brara, tɛ wèe bo yu'ni nè Jisos Krâis, tɛ Nyʉ̀ ŋwaŋshi wèe nè blɛɛ Jisòs. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè wèe sê, ker gee tɛ wèe cu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀ bòŋboŋ sê.
eng: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

lmp: Sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e yu Nyʉ̀ a ba Tàr nè yìsèe Tata Jisos Krâis. À ka' ba njobè' e m koosimnse nè sèe sê, e m gèe sèe à ba bêe bfi njobè' Jisos Krâis à m fʉʉ efa rkwe. Ca yi gèe sèe à ce kè' bti' ce àde' vi bʉtè, kɛ̀ bep, kɛ̀ kwe ncòo ka', a ke' ce tarni ka'. A lɛ̀ vi mbe bùu nè wèe,
eng: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy became our father again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn't fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

lmp: ce wèe yu bèe ce wèe à byemi, Nyʉ̀ à ce kè'ni à yi ŋger, tɛ wèe bo koni rlùŋ ce li be yɛɛti àwaŋ à nfè' elʉ̀simbùu.
eng: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

lmp: Ca yi gèe wèe à ce lu'shi sê, ka' wèe be yu' ryaŋ sè'ni na njo' rmòoshì ce li be vʉ̀ nè wèe à mʉ nfè' mò', à mnduunjì jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ wa'a.
eng: Wherein you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been put to grief in various trials,

lmp: Rmòoshì ca li be vʉ̀ nè wèe tɛ le rbyemì li bo ba yɛɛnì. Ka' gul ce e ke cu nfesè ka' nà, bèe a ke lòr too njep mor tɛ e bo ba yɛɛnì. A mbò le rbyemì ce li lùu ntaa a caa gul nà li ku ba wa'a. A be mòoshi li tɛ li bo ba yɛɛnì, tɛ a bo yòŋshi wèe, kù'si wèe, yu'ni nè wèe nyʉ̀ ce Jisos Krâis be yɛɛti àwaŋ.
eng: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ--

lmp: Wèe à m be yɛ Jisos Krâis ka', a ku koŋ ye. Wèe ce yɛ ye sè'ni na ka', a ku byemi nè ye, a ce lu'shi njɛ̀ɛ rlu'shì ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ suŋ ka',
eng: whom not having known you love; in whom, though now you don't see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy unspeakable and full of glory--

lmp: njobè' le rbyemì li be lʉ̀si nè rlùŋ ce wèe ce kè' à rkonì nà.
eng: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

lmp: Ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m lòr nfè' a fyɛ' njep mʉ̀ rlùŋ ca bòŋboŋ sê. Wowèe a m suŋ bèe àmbò rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ ce yi m ba enɛ wèe be koni.
eng: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently, who prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

lmp: Yʉ' Krâis ce yi m ba njep wowèe yi m suŋ wowèe àmbò ŋgɛ' ce Krâis be yɛ, tɛ bèe a ka' kù'si ye. Wowèe a m ghèter à rrìŋ nfè' ce buu ca be koni, ker ba njɛ̀ɛ njì ce vi be ba.
eng: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ, which was in them, pointed to, when he predicted the sufferings of Christ, and the glories that would follow them.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m gèe wowèe a riŋ enɛ buu ce wowèe a m ce suŋ bèe à m ba buu ce vi be koni à nfè' yàp ka'. E m gèe wowèe a riŋ enɛ vi be koni ba à nfê' yì. À ka' ba sè'ni na, bèe ce a m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis nè wèe à ŋger Yʉ' Rara, ce a m tuu embe bùu, a suŋ wèe buu anà. Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ foŋ a ce kòŋ à rfyɛ' nje mʉ̀ buu ca.
eng: To them it was revealed, that not to themselves, but to you, they ministered these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

lmp: Banɛ wèe tami nyor, ke'ni wee btu, ce ke' ba rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ ce wèe be koni à nfè' ce Jisos Krâis à vʉ̀.
eng: Therefore, prepare your minds for action, be sober and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ--

lmp: Àmbò wèe yu boo ce wèe ce yu'ni na, wèe fa kèr ràasi nyor à buu bbebep ce wèe à m ce kòŋ à rgèe à nfè' ce wèe à m mɛŋni buu nà ka'.
eng: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

lmp: Àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e kɛ' wèe yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara na, banɛ wèe ba rara à buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce gèe,
eng: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior;

lmp: njobè' a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Ba nè brara njobè' m yu nrara."
eng: because it is written, You shall be holy; for I am holy.

lmp: Wèe ce loo, ce too Nyʉ̀ enɛ yè Tâ. E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke so'ni ŋgòŋ ka', ce sa' bèe ba à buu ce wowèe a gèe, banɛ àmbò wèe ce cu njep ŋgòŋ na àmbò bkìlò na, wèe ce wɛp ye.
eng: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man's work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear:

lmp: Wèe rìŋ weenɛ à m ba à nfè' ce a m yuu wèe efa ndèe to' ce wêe bta a m lɛ̀ nè wèe, sɛ' à ba njo ka' nà, a m yuu wèe ba nè buu ce nlo e ke koo àgho àmbò mbàa na ka'.
eng: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things, with silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

lmp: A m yuu wèe ba nè blɛɛ Krâis ce vi lùu ntaa sê, a ba àmbò blɛɛ fûu njèe taŋshì ce yi yu yɛɛnì, jɛ' yi ba àgho ka'.
eng: but with precious blood, as of a faultless and pure lamb, the blood of Christ;

lmp: Tɛ Nyʉ̀ ka' kè gèe ŋgòŋ, e m rìŋ war yuu ce e be gèe nè Krâis. À ka' ba à nfè' elʉ̀simbùu e gêe, e yɛɛtì àwaŋ njo' wèe.
eng: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed at the end of times for your sake,

lmp: Yu njo' ye ce enɛ wèe à byemi nè Nyʉ̀ ce e m fʉr ye efa rkwe, a ku'si ye. Yi ka' ba wa'a wèe à ce byemi ba nè Nyʉ̀, a lɛ mmir ba mbe yê ndù.
eng: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead, and gave him glory; so that your faith and hope might be in God.

lmp: Àmbò wèe yu brara njobè' wèe à yu'ni a gee buu mini, a koŋ bfʉr wee nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ na, m ce làa mɛnɛ wèe koŋni nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently:

lmp: Yi yu enɛ a ker bi wèe, wèe à ke' ba boo bèe ce a ke lò ku kweŋger nà ka'. Wèe yu ba boo ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e ke kwe ka'. Yu Nlàa Nyʉ̀ ce yi yu tèe, a tʉr ŋger nfesè, ce yi gèe wèe à ka' ba boo vi.
eng: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a m saŋ enɛ̂, "Bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu àmbò mjɛɛ, lap rbòŋ li ku ba àmbò fʉ̀lawà ce e ke kù' à rìŋ nà. Mjɛɛ mi ke yopri, fʉ̀lawà karŋgèr.
eng: For, All flesh is like grass, and all of man's glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

lmp: Nlâa Tata Nyʉ̀ yi cu yi à nfè' sìp." Nlàa anà yu Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce a fè'shi nè wèe nà.
eng: but the Lord's word endures forever. This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

lmp: Banɛ wèe ma' bsàrbuu. Wèe fa kèr ce bo' bèe, kɛ̀ ce bo' wêe btu, kɛ̀ ce ko'ndoŋ, kɛ̀ ce sa'ni ka'.
eng: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

lmp: Wèe yu sè'ni àmbò boo bbeer ce a bi wa'a. Banɛ wèe à ba kòŋ à rnyoŋ mmbee ce à yʉ' ce mi yu mrara, tɛ wèe bo kù', lùŋ.
eng: as newborn babies, long for the pure milk of the Word, that you may grow thereby,

lmp: Wèe à yɛ war enɛ Tata à gèe yuu bòŋboŋ nè wèe.
eng: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious:

lmp: Wèe ko'shi àgee Tata ce e yu lùr ce ntèe. Bèe a m mà' lùr ana, à ba lùr ce Nyʉ̀ à m ce, e luu ntaa nè ye sê.
eng: coming to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

lmp: Wee wèe foŋ yu àmbò blûr btèe wa'a. Banɛ wèe ko'shi a yê geŋ tɛ e bo lòr wèe bà'ri Ndap Nyʉ̀ yî à yʉ' àgho, tɛ wèe bo fà' mbo àmbò ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì ce a yu brara, a ce taŋshi btaŋshì ce à yʉ', ce vi yu byɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀ njo' yuu ce Jisos Krâis à m gèe.
eng: You also, as living stones, are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

lmp: A saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ enɛ̂, "Yu' nè, m ce lɛ̀ lùr rbuu ndap à rla' Sayòn. À co' mɛ̀ lùr anà, e boŋ nè mɛ̀ sê. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi nè ye, àde' rìtu yi ke koo ŋgàŋ ka'."
eng: Because it is contained in Scripture, Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen, and precious: He who believes in him will not be disappointed.

lmp: Banɛ e bòŋ nè wèe ce wèe à byemi. À ka' ba yi nè bèe ce a byemi ka', "Lùr ce ŋgâa mboo mndap a m mà', à kʉti ba lùr rbuu ndap."
eng: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, The stone which the builders rejected, has become the chief cornerstone,

lmp: A ker ba foŋ, "Lùr ce bèe a ce kote àgho, a ce gwèŋger." Wowèe a ce kote àgho njobè' wowèe a byemi Nlâa Nyʉ̀ ka'. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe enɛ yi ba wa'a.
eng: and, a stone of stumbling, and a rock of offense. For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, wèe yu ndʉ̀' bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à ce, a ba ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì, a ce fà' nè ŋkʉʉ, a ba to' rara, a ba bèe vi Nyʉ̀, tɛ wèe bo suŋ àmbò buu bbòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ à gèe. Yu ye ce e kɛ' wèe a fʉr wèe efa tʉ̀'nji, wèe à ba sè'ni ba à li rraa ce li bòŋ sê.
eng: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God's own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light:

lmp: À m ba à nfè' mò' wèe à m ba bèe Nyʉ̀ ka', à ka' ba sè'ni na, wèe à ba bèe Nyʉ̀. À m ba à nfè' mò', Nyʉ̀ à m koosimnse nè wèe ka', à ka' ba sè'ni na, e koosimnse nè wèe.
eng: who in time past were no people, but now are God's people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

lmp: Bkar wâ, m ce bu' mmbo nè wèe ce wèe yu bkìlò a ker ba bèe ce a ce càa njep ŋgòŋ na càa, enɛ wèe borni buu ce wee blɛɛ vi lùute à rgèe, à ba buu ce vi ke jepsi wee mntee ce wèe à lɛ̀ nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims, to abstain from fleshly lusts, which war against the soul;

lmp: Cu nè rcu rbòŋboŋ à mʉ̀ bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' tɛ wowèe a ka' ba ce làa enɛ wèe yu ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep ɛ̀, tɛ a bo yɛ buu bbòŋboŋ ce wèe ce gèe, kù'si Nyʉ̀ à nòŋ ce e be vʉ̀ à rsa' ŋgòŋ.
eng: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may by your good works, which they see, glorify God in the day of visitation.

lmp: Àmbò wèe yu bèe Tatâ, banɛ wèe yu'ni nè nè ŋgâa rsa' wɛɛwɛ ce bèe a lɛ̀ enɛ a sa' wèe. Kɛ̀ yu ŋkʉʉ ɛ̀, wèe yu'ni nè ye àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce ŋger bto' wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba yê mmbò.
eng: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord's sake: whether to the king, as supreme;

lmp: Kɛ̀ yu bgovanò ɛ̀, wèe yu'ni nè wowèe àmbò bèe ce ŋkʉʉ à tuusi tɛ a bo fa ŋgɛ' nè ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, yòŋshi bèe ce a gèe buu bbòŋboŋ.
eng: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ wèe gee bòŋboŋ wa'a tɛ blʉr ce a mɛŋni buu nà a bo yɛ, baate yap cùu.
eng: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men:

lmp: Fa cu nè àmbò bkwàa nè ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka'. Wêe cu wa'a, wèe fa lòr njɛ̀ɛ rcu anà tɛ' à mmìr, ce gèe buu bbebep ka'. Cu nè ba àmbò bèe ce a yu bkwàa nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: as free, and not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

lmp: Yu'ni nè nè bèe wɛɛwɛ, koŋ bfʉr ce wèe wowèe yu ŋgâa rbyemì, wɛp Nyʉ̀, yu'ni nè ŋkʉʉ.
eng: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

lmp: Ŋgâa mfà', yu'ni nè nè wee mmasà bòŋboŋ, gʉ'shi nè wowèe. Wèe fa kù gèe wa' ba nè bèe ce a ce gèe buu bbòŋboŋ nè wèe, a ce lòr wèe à bèe ka', gèe nè wa' foŋ nè bèe ce yap ŋgèe yi yu tatap.
eng: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all fear; not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

lmp: Yu yuu bòŋboŋ sê, ce à ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ' àtu yuu ce wɛ̀ gèe ka', a kur ntee, a ce yɛ ŋgɛ' anà wa'a, njobè' à ce kòŋ à rgèe yuu ce yi bòŋ Nyʉ̀.
eng: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

lmp: Àde' a yoŋshì wɛ̀ à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ, ce à ka' gee yuu bebep, a lip wɛ̀, à kur ntee. Wɛ̀ ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ' njobè' yuu bòŋboŋ ce wɛ̀ gèe, ku kur ntee, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be yu' rbòŋ nè wɛ̀.
eng: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if, when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ', wèe kur ntee, njobè' Krâis ye ye à m yɛ ŋgɛ' a wêe btù. E m gèe wa'a, à ba ncòo enɛ wèe à ba gèe wa'a foŋ.
eng: For to this you were called, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

lmp: E m be gèe yuu mo' bebep ka'. Mnde' mi m be fʉʉ eku yê cùu ka'.
eng: who did not sin, neither was deceit found in his mouth.

lmp: A m cɛp ye, e ke' kʉsì ka'. A m fa ye ŋgɛ', e ke' gee yuu mo' ka'. E m ku lɛ buu anà ba mbe mmbo Nyʉ̀ ce e ke sa' mnsa' yɛɛnì.
eng: Who, when he was cursed, didn't curse back. When he suffered, didn't threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously;

lmp: E m kwe yìsèe boo-bìr à nfè' ce a m taa ye mbe kìntaa nà, tɛ sèe bo kèr ce gèe buu bbebep ka', cu ce gèe ba buu byɛɛnì. À ka' ba njobè' a m bɛɛsi ye, sèe à lûŋ.
eng: who his own self bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness; by whose stripes you were healed.

lmp: Wèe à m ba àmbo njèe ce yi dà', à ka' ba sè'ni wèe à kʉtì a ce dù ba àmbùu ŋwɛ̀ ncìŋ njèe ce e ce kè'ni wèe.
eng: For you were going astray like sheep; but now have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

lmp: Bbyèŋge foŋ a ba yu'ni nè bduu wap, bduu wap mo' a ka' ba ce a byemi blâa Nyʉ̀ ka' tɛ yap ŋgèe yi bo gèe wowèe tɛ a byemi ce wowèe a làa yuu mo' nè wowèe ka',
eng: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands; so that, even if any don't obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word;

lmp: njobè' a yɛ àmbò wowèe a ce cu rcu rrara a ce yu'ni.
eng: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

lmp: Le rbòŋ li fa lò ba efa btu ce wèe ce ba', ba bsa', ba bcɛ̀' ce wèe ce sùsi nyor àgho tɛ bèe a bo yɛ nà ka'.
eng: Let your beauty be not just the outward adorning of braiding the hair, and of wearing jewels of gold, or of putting on fine clothing;

lmp: Le rbòŋ li ba ba enjep ntee, ba nè rbornì-ŋwɛ̀, ba nè rfʉtè enjep ntee. Njɛ̀ɛ rbòŋ ca li ke kwe ncòo ka', a boŋ à bsii Nyʉ̀ sê.
eng: but in the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is in the sight of God very precious.

lmp: A njɛ̀ɛ njì ce bbyèŋge brara elûuŋgòŋ ce a m lɛ̀ map mmir mbendù Nyʉ̀, a m ce dùŋshi lap rbòŋ. Wowèe a m ce yu'ni nè bduu wap.
eng: For this is how the holy women before, who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands:

lmp: Sɛ̀ra ye ye à m ce yu'ni nè Abràhâm, a ce yòŋ ye enɛ yì masà. Wèe yu boo vi ce wèe à ka' ce gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ, ke' ce wɛp yuu mo' ka'.
eng: as Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are, if you do well, and are not put in fear by any terror.

lmp: Bduu foŋ a ba cu a wap bbyèŋge wèe nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀. Wowèe a ba rìŋ enɛ bbyèŋge a yu yap bwɛ̀ni, yu'ni nè wowèe. Wowèe a ba gèe wa'a njobè' wowèe bsìp a be koni ryòŋ ce nfesè ce li lò ese Nyʉ̀ njo' yi ntee bòŋboŋ. Wowèe a ba gèe wa'a fà dì' yuu mo' yi bo jepsi lap rloo ka'.
eng: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman, as to the weaker vessel, as being also joint heirs of the grace of life; that your prayers may not be hindered.

lmp: Yuu ce m ce làa nè wèe àlʉ̀simbùu sè'ni yi yu enɛ wèe ba cûu mo'sir, ce koosimnse nè bèe, koŋni àmbò bfʉr boo ma wa'a, gee ŋgêe bòŋboŋ nè bèe, ker lor yè nyor njep nshè.
eng: Finally, be all like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

lmp: Fa kʉsi nè yuu bebep nè yuu bebep ka. Fà kʉsi mcɛp nè mcɛp ka'. Loo nè ba enɛ Nyʉ̀ ghoni bèe ce a gèe buu ca nè wèe, njobè' Nyʉ̀ à m kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe bo gèe wa'a, tɛ e bo ghòni wèe.
eng: not rendering evil for evil, or insult for insult; but instead blessing; knowing that to this were you called, that you may inherit a blessing.

lmp: Yi ku ba àmbò a saŋ enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce kòŋ à rcu ce yu' rbòŋ, ce lu'shi, ŋgàŋ fa làa yuu bebep kɛ̀ nya' mnde' ka'.
eng: For, He who would love life, and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil, and his lips from speaking deceit.

lmp: Ŋgàŋ be borni buu bbebep, gèe ba buu bbòŋboŋ. E be kòŋ cumʉnyaŋ, ròo mnduunjì à rkoni cumʉnyaŋ anà. Ŋgàŋ à ba gèe wa'a,
eng: Let him turn away from evil, and do good. Let him seek peace, and pursue it.

lmp: njobè' Tata Nyʉ̀ ce kè'ni bèe ce a ce gèe buu byɛɛnì, a ce yu' lap rloo, a ce fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe ce a ce gèe buu bbebep."
eng: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.

lmp: Ntee yi ka' ce lùu wèe à rgèe yuu bòŋboŋ, ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e gee yuu bebep nè wèe ba nda?
eng: Now who is he who will harm you, if you become imitators of that which is good?

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, wèe à ka' ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ba njo' yuu bòŋboŋ ce wèe à gèe banɛ wèe yu ŋgâa mbôŋtu. Wèe fa wɛp wowèe, mà'shi tɛ mlù mi ce koo wèe njo' wowèe ka'.
eng: But even if you should suffer for righteousness' sake, you are blessed. Don't fear what they fear, neither be troubled.

lmp: Yi yu ba enɛ wèe yu'ni ba nè Krâis àmbò Tatâ, nè ye ntee-ŋwɛ̀. Tami nè nyor à nfè' wɛɛwɛ à rbèesi ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' bipshi enɛ wèe suŋ mbùu efa yuu ce wèe cu ce kè'.
eng: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts; and always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear:

lmp: Gèe nè wa'a nè cumʉnyaŋ-ŋwɛ̀ ba ryu'nì, lɛ ye ntee rara, tɛ bèe a ka' ce cɛp wèe, tɛ rìtu yi bo koo wowèe njo' wap blâa bbebep ce a ce làa njo' ye ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ce wèe ce gèe njo' wèe yu bèe Jisos Krâis.
eng: having a good conscience; that, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

lmp: Yi yu àndèe enɛ à yɛ ŋgɛ' njo' yuu bòŋboŋ ce à ce gèe ce Nyʉ̀ ka' koŋ enɛ yi ba wa'a, nè ce enɛ à yɛ ŋgɛ' njo' yuu bebep.
eng: For it is better, if it is God's will, that you suffer for doing well than for doing evil.

lmp: Krâis ye ye à m kwe àtu yìsèe buu bbebep, a ku kwe ŋkàrà' mò'sir cà'cà'. Ye ce e m ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, à m kwe àtu bèe ce a m ba byɛɛnì ka', tɛ e bo lòr sèe fa nè Nyʉ̀. À m ba à nfè' ce e m ba à ŋwɛ̀, a yʉ ye. Nyʉ̀ à ka' fʉr ye efa rkwe, e ba à yʉ'.
eng: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God; being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the spirit;

lmp: E m dù à yʉ', a du a fe'shi Nlàa Nyʉ̀ nè byʉ' ce vi m ba mbe shaŋ,
eng: in which he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

lmp: à ba byʉ' ce vi m tèe tu elûuŋgòŋ à nfè' ce Nowa à m ce bà'ri keŋ, Nyʉ̀ à kur ntee nè vi nà. Bèe ce a m niŋ mbe keŋ anà a m ba mʉcàr sê. À m ku ba bèe nwaami cà'cà' ce a m lùŋ embenjì mdip anà.
eng: who before were disobedient, when God waited patiently in the days of Noah, while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

lmp: Mdip anà mi yu àmbò bàptir ce e ce gèe wèe ce lùŋ sè'ni na. Bàptir anà yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce sù'si mghaa efa nyòr ka', yu ba enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce gèe mkà'ni nè Nyʉ̀ nè ntee rara. E ce gèe wèe ce lùŋ embenjì rfʉʉ ce Jisos Krâis à m fʉʉ efa rkwe.
eng: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you--not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God, through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

lmp: E m dù mbe bùu, a cu à rkoo mà' Nyʉ̀, bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ba byʉ' wɛɛwɛ ce vi tʉr ŋger a ba njep yê tìi.
eng: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

lmp: Banɛ àmbò Krâis à m yɛ ŋgɛ' à nfè' ce e m ba à ŋwɛ̀, a yu' ryaŋ se nà, wee wèe foŋ à ba tʉr ba njɛ̀ɛ ntee ce e m tʉr, njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yɛ ŋgɛ' wa'a, banɛ ŋgàŋ à gàpni a yuu bebep.
eng: Forasmuch then as Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin;

lmp: E gàpni a yuu bebep, banɛ e be kèr cu li rcu enjep ŋgòŋ na, ce gèe ba buu bbebep ce vi blɛɛ vi ce lùute à rgèe ka'. E be cu ce gèe ba yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ.
eng: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

lmp: Nfè' ce wèe à m ce gèe buu ce bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka' a ce gèe nà, à ghɛɛ wa'a. Wowèe a ce gèe mnyɛ̂r, a ce gèe yuu ce wap blɛɛ vi ce lùute à rgèe. Wowèe a ce no buu vi ce koo wowèe, a ce gèe mŋkà' bghaa, a ce gèe mŋkà' no buu, a ce loo nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ce Nyʉ̀ à kani enɛ bèe a fa loo nè vi ka'.
eng: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

lmp: Wowèe a ka' yɛ enɛ wèe ker ce gèe ku' njɛ̀ɛ buu bbebep ce wèe wowèe à m ce gèe nà ka', a bɛɛŋger, a ce cɛp wèe.
eng: They think it is strange that you don't run with them into the same excess of riot, blaspheming:

lmp: Wowèe a be kè làa yuu kùu yuu ce wowèe a ce gèe na nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e tami nyor à rsa' bèe ce a cu btèe ker ba bèe ce a kweŋger.
eng: who will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

lmp: A mbùu ce a m fè'shi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ nè bèe ce a m kweŋger, tɛ wowèe a bo cu à yʉ' àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce cu nà. Wowèe a be cu wa'a, ka' a m sa' wowèe à nfè' ce wowèe a m ba njep ŋgòŋ na, wowèe a kwe àmbò bèe wɛɛwɛ a ke kwe nà wa'a.
eng: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

lmp: Nfè' mʉcàr tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ mî. Banɛ wèe cu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀ tɛ wèe bo rìŋ à rloo bòŋboŋ.
eng: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu tatap sê, yi yu enɛ wèe koŋni nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ njobè' rkòŋnì li ke tɛ'shi buu bbebep gòr.
eng: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

lmp: Koni nè bèe ce a ce niŋ wèe, gɛ' nè wowèe bòŋboŋ. Wee gèe wa' wèe fa ce de'ŋger ka'.
eng: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

lmp: Wèe wɛɛwɛ à koni bfee ese Nyʉ̀. Banɛ wèe lor bfee anà ja' wee mnyor àgho. Wee gèe wa'a banɛ wèe à lòr yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè wèe à ntee bòŋboŋ, a fa' àgho yɛɛnì.
eng: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce fè'shi, e fe'shì ba blâa Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ce fà' nè bèe, e lor ŋger ce Nyʉ̀ à fa nè ye fa' àgho, tɛ bèe a bo kù'si Nyʉ̀ à buu wɛɛwɛ ce wèe ce gèe njo' wèe yu bèe Jisos Krâis. Bkù' wɛɛwɛ vi ba nè ye à nfè' sìp, ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi ba nè ye à nfè' sìp foŋ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Bkar wâ, wèe fa ce bɛ̀ɛŋger njo' rmòoshì ce li ce tòoshi wèe àmbò mor na, àmbò yu lɛ yuu ce yi bʉ̀ʉ wèe wa' ka'.
eng: Beloved, don't be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you, to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

lmp: Wèe à ba ce lu'shi lu'shi enɛ wèe ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ce Krâis à m yɛ, tɛ wèe bo kè lu'shi ce yu' rbòŋ à nfè' ce e be vʉ̀ dùŋshi yi fòo.
eng: But because you are partakers of Christ's sufferings, rejoice; that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

lmp: Bèe a ka' ce cɛp wèe njo' Jisos Krâis, banɛ wèe yu ŋgâa mbôŋtu, njobè' yʉ' ce yi ke vʉ̀ nè fòo, ce yu yʉ' Nyʉ̀ nà, yi yu mbe wêe ndù.
eng: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

lmp: Mò' efa wèe fa yɛ ŋgɛ' njobè' e yu ŋwɛ̀ nyʉshi bèe, kɛ̀ nyɛ̀ɛ, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ŋgèe buu bbebep, kɛ̀ njobè' e ce jepsi ntà'tè bèe mo' ka'.
eng: For let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men's matters.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' yɛ ŋgɛ' ba njobè' e yu ŋwɛ̀ rbyemì, rìtu yi fa koo ŋgàŋ ka', ŋgàŋ yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ enɛ e yu mbàmba Krâis.
eng: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

lmp: Nfè' ce a be sa' mnsa' à ghɛɛ. Bèe ce a be sa' entombì yu bèe Nyʉ̀. A ka' kɛ' mnsa' anà ba nè sèe, yi lo ba ekɛ nè bèe ce a byemi Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ ce e lò ese Nyʉ̀ nà ka'?
eng: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don't obey the Good News of God?

lmp: A saŋ enɛ̂, "Yi ka' ba tatap nè bèe ce a yu yɛɛnì à rlùŋ efa mnsa', bèe ce a ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ ka', a ce gèe buu bbebep a lo ba yap ba fɛ?"
eng: If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?

lmp: Banɛ bèe ce a ce yɛ ŋgɛ' àmbò Nyʉ̀ à kòŋ, a ba fa wâp mnyor nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m boo wowèe, ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ mini, kù ce gèe buu bbòŋboŋ.
eng: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

lmp: M tʉr yuu à rlàa nè btu embe côr. M ce làa àmbò tu foŋ. M yu ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m yɛ yuu ce a m gèe nè Krâis à nfè' ce e m yɛ ŋgɛ', a ba mò' efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a be koni rbòŋ ce Jisòs be kè vʉ̀ àgho nà.
eng: I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed.

lmp: Cìŋ nè kʉr njêe Nyʉ̀ ce yi yu mba wêe mmbò nà, ciŋ yi nè rlu'shì-ŋwɛ̀ àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce kòŋ enɛ wèe ciŋ nà, ke' ba ba àmbò a tàa lɛ wèe tàa wa' ka'. Wèe fa fà' njobè' wèe à roŋ mbàa ka', fà' nè ba njobè' wèe ce lu'shi à rfà'.
eng: Shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily, not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

lmp: Wèe fa sa' bèe ce Nyʉ̀ à fa mba wêe mmbò àmbò wèe yu lɛ wâp mmasà wa' ka'. Wèe duŋshi ba ndêe mbòŋmboŋ, ce wowèe a yɛ, bo koni.
eng: neither as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

lmp: Be ba nyʉ̀ ce tu ŋgâa ncìŋ njèe à vʉ̀ tɛ wèe koni rtaa fòo ce àde' li ke kwe ncòo ka'.
eng: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn't fade away.

lmp: M ce làa nè boo mnsùnsù foŋ mɛnɛ wowèe a yu'ni nè bleebèe. Banɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ lor wêe btu àmbò bkwàa, ce fa' a wêe mʉ. Nyʉ̀ e ke fa ŋgɛ' nè ŋgâa nàatu, duŋshi yi ntee bòŋboŋ nè bèe ce a ce nàa tu ka'.
eng: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility, to subject yourselves to one another; for God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.

lmp: Banɛ wèe suusi yè nyor njeptii Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger, nfè' à ka' ghɛɛ, tɛ e bo nàa wèe mbekì.
eng: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;

lmp: Fa nè yè buu wɛɛwɛ ce mlù mi ce koo wèe àgho mbe yê mmbò, njobè' e tʉr ntee nè wèe.
eng: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

lmp: Cu nè nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀, ce ke'nî, njobè' Satàn ce e yu yè ŋwɛ̀ bbàa ce kashi àmbò bʉrʉ̀' ce e ce waa wa'a, a ce ròo ŋwɛ̀ ce e bo koo, ye.
eng: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

lmp: Wèe fa fa yè njì ka', tɛɛ nè njep yuu ce wèe à byemi, riŋ weenɛ bfʉr wee ce a yu à bdì' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na, a ce yɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgɛ' ce wèe ce yɛ na.
eng: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

lmp: Wèe à ka' yɛ ŋgɛ' à mʉ nfè' mò' wɛɛ, tɛ Nyʉ̀ gee tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ kʉti ba yɛɛnì, kèr gèe tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap ce cì'ti ka'. Yu ye Nyʉ̀ ce bghònì wɛɛwɛ vi lò ese ye, yu ye ce e m kɛ' wèe enɛ wèe bo koni bkù' ce nfesè njo' yuu ce Krâis à m gèe nà.
eng: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

lmp: Tɛ yi ŋger yi cu nfesè. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e jà' mɛ̀ a saŋ mʉ ŋwà' ca nè wèe a Sìlìvanòs. E yu nfʉr ce m rìŋ mɛnɛ e yu ŋwɛ̂ mini. Mɛ̀ saŋ tɛ m bo fa wèe ŋger, kèr suŋ wèe mɛnɛ rbôŋntee Nyʉ̀ li yu àmbò mɛ̀ m suŋ wèe nà nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. Tɛɛ nè njo tatap.
eng: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

lmp: Ŋgâa rbyemì embe cor ce à rla' Babilòn, ce Nyʉ̀ à ce foŋ àmbò e ce wèe nà, a cà'ni wèe. Muu wâ Mak à cà'ni wèe foŋ.
eng: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you; and so does Mark, my son.

lmp: Wèe ca'ni wee mnyor, baani mnyor à rdùŋshi enɛ wèe kòŋni. Tɛ wèe wɛɛwɛ ce wèe yu bèe Krâis, koni cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to you all who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e saŋ ŋwà' ca à saŋ mɛ̂ Saimʉn Pità. M yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ntuu nè Jisos Krâis. M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè bèe ce a byemi nè Jisos Krâis àmbò wer wèr foŋ à byemi nà. Rbyemì ca li bòŋ a caa buu wɛɛwɛ. Jisos Krâis à fa sèe njì enɛ sèe byemi nè ye njobè' e ke gèe buu à njî yɛɛnì. E yu Nyʉ̀ a ker ba yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà'.
eng: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ àmbò wèe be ce yɛ'ni, rìŋ Nyʉ̀ bòŋboŋ, tɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè wèe, ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à fa sèe buu wɛɛwɛ ce sèe à ba tʉr, tɛ sèe bo cu rcu ryɛɛnì. E m gèe yi ba àtɛ̀r wa'a njo' yi ŋger ce yi yu jɛɛ. Njì ce sèe à rìŋ à rcu wa'a yi yu enɛ sèe riŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kɛ' sèe enɛ sèe ba bbòŋboŋ àmbò e yu nà.
eng: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue;

lmp: E gèe wa'a a fa sèe buu bbòŋboŋ ce e m kà' enɛ e be fa sèe nà, tɛ wèe bo tʉr ŋger à rcaŋ efa gee buu bbebep enjep ŋgòŋ na, ce bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a kòŋ se nà. Yi ka' ba wa'a tɛ wèe bo gèe ba ŋgèe ce yi yu àmbò yî Nyʉ̀.
eng: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

lmp: Banɛ àmbò wèe à fòosi nè Jisòs na, ghèter nè kyese buu mò' ca mbendù le rbyemì. Gèe nè ŋgêe bòŋboŋ ker riŋ buu foŋ.
eng: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

lmp: Wèe fa kù rìŋ ba buu cà'cà' ka', wèe kani wee mnyor efa rgèe yuu bebep. Wêe ce kani wee mnyor efa rgèe yuu bebep, wèe tɛɛ tatap à buu bbòŋboŋ anà. Wêe ce tɛɛ tatap à buu ca, wèe gee ba ŋgèe ce yi yu àmbò yî Nyʉ̀.
eng: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control patience; and in patience godliness;

lmp: Àmbò wèe ce gèe ŋgèe ce yi yu àmbò yî Nyʉ̀, wèe gee yuu ce àde' wèe gee nè nfʉr embe wêe ndap nè nfʉr mò' foŋ. Wêe ce gèe wa'a wèe tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: and in godliness brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

lmp: Wèe à ka' ce gèe ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca, ce kù' njo banɛ buu ce wèe à rìŋ àmbò Jisos Krâis nà vi be bʉ à cicì ka'. Wèe be ye sɛ' efa gho.
eng: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to be not idle nor unfruitful to the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ca ka' banɛ ŋgàŋ yu àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e fèp wa'a, a ce yɛ buu ce vi yu à njìsàp ka', a lese yi yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ à sù'si ye efa fàa ce e m gèe.
eng: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

lmp: Bfʉr wà, àmbò yi yu wa'a, banɛ wèe gheter gee ba buu ce vi be dùŋshi ghup enɛ Nyʉ̀ à ce wèe. Wèe à ka' ce gèe wa'a wèe ke gwe rmòoshì à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, tɛ Nyʉ̀ bo lu'shi à rfa wèe fɛŋ tɛ wèe bo niŋ mbe nto' Tata Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe ŋwɛ̀ rjà', tɛ sèe wowèe bo cu mbo nfesè.
eng: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

lmp: Banɛ m be kù ce kuushi wèe buu ca à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe à rìŋ war buu mini a tɛɛ njo tatap.
eng: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them, and are established in the present truth.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ m kuushi wèe buu ca à nfè' wɛɛwɛ àmbò m ku bii ntèe na, tɛ m bo dòoshi wèe àgho.
eng: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you;

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ m buu àgho. Tata Jisos Krâis à m suŋ mɛ̀ wa'a.
eng: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

lmp: M be ghèter tatap sê, ka' m ka' kwe, tɛ wèe bo ku ce kuushi buu ca à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

lmp: Buu ce wèr à m suŋ wèe àmbò rvʉ̀ Jisos Krâis ce e m vʉ̀ nè ŋger Nyʉ̀ nà à m ba ba mghàghar ce bèe a saŋ nè wap bfee nà ka'. Wèr à m yɛ yi ŋger nè mer mmir.
eng: For we did not follow cunningly devised fables, when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

lmp: À m ba mbe nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ Tàr à m fa ŋger ba fòo nè Jisos Krâis nà, njèndoŋ Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr fòo ce vi càa ŋger à m làa enɛ̂, "Muu ca a muu wà ce mɛ̀ kòŋ sê. M ce yu' rbòŋ nè ye."
eng: For he received from God the Father honor and glory, when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.

lmp: Wèr Jisòs wèe à m ba mbe rtùu ce Nyʉ̀ à m làa mbo anà, a yu' njèndoŋ ce e m làa embe bùu nà.
eng: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

lmp: Banɛ wèr à riŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ enɛ blàa ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m fè'shi nà vi yu mini njobè' buu ce wèr à yɛ nè mer mmir. Wèe à ba yu' blàa ca bòŋboŋ, njobè' vi yu àmbò lam ce e raa nètʉ', ku raa du bà' à nfè' ce tʉ̀' be raa nà. Be ba à nfè' ce mbèr à lò nà, tɛ wèe yɛ rraa njep wêe mntee.
eng: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns, and the morning star arises in your hearts:

lmp: Yuu ce yi yu tatap yi yu enɛ wèe riŋ enɛ yu ba ŋwɛ̀ mò'sir ce e be sàr blâa ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

lmp: Yi yu wa'a njobè' buu ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a m làa anà vi m lò ese ŋwɛ̀ ka'. Yʉ' Rara yi m niŋ njep ntee bèe Nyʉ̀ a gee wowèe a fe'shì blàa ce Nyʉ̀ à m suŋ wowèe.
eng: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man: but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

lmp: À m ba elûuŋgòŋ, bèe ce a m ce làa enɛ a ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀, a ba ba ŋgâa mnde' nà, a m ku ba à mʉ̀ bèe Nyʉ̀. Ŋgâa ryɛ'nì ce a yu ŋgâa mnde' a be lò ba a wêe mʉ foŋ àmbò ŋgâa mnde' a m ba à mʉ̀ bèe Nyʉ̀ elûuŋgòŋ nà. Wowèe a be vʉ̀ nè ryɛ'nî rbebep, bo' bèe, bepsi wowèe àgho. Wowèe a be kani yàp masà Krâis ce e m tee wowèe efa bkwàa nà. Yuu ce wowèe a be gèe na yi be gèe tɛ wowèe a bʉ à cicì cɛrcɛr.
eng: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

lmp: Bèe magòr a be bè'ni ndêe mbembep ca, gèe tɛ bèe a laa bebep àmbò nduunjì ce mini.
eng: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

lmp: Ŋgâa mnde' anà a ku ce kòŋ enɛ wowèe a koni sɛ' efa buu wɛɛwɛ. Wowèe a be bo' wèe nè mnde' tɛ a bo ye sɛ' efa mnde' anà. Yu nfè' njìsàp àmbò Nyʉ̀ ce e be sa' mnsa' bèe teni à tami nyor à rfa wowèe ŋgɛ' njo' yàp ndêe mbembep anà. Ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ e misi wowèe nfesè.
eng: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn't linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

lmp: Yɛ nè yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe nè vi bcìndap mo' ce a m gèe buu bbebep nà. Nyʉ̀ à m buu efa rfa wowèe ŋgɛ' ka'. E m mà' wowèe njep mor. Wowèe a nòŋ njep ma bè'tè ce yi coomi nè bshaŋ à mkoo. Njo yi ce sii mbîŋ mbîŋ. Wowèe a be cu njo dù bà' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ be sa' ŋgòŋ.
eng: For if God didn't spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness, to be reserved for judgment;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m buu foŋ efa rfa ŋgɛ' nè bèe elûuŋgòŋ ce a m ce gèe buu bbebep nà ka'. E m gèe mdip mi ruu a cete ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ, a yʉshi bèe ce a m tèe tu nè ye anà. E m ku ja' ba Nowa cà'cà' ce e m ce fè'shi nè bèe enɛ a ce gee ba buu bbòŋboŋ, ker ba bèe mo' bèe nsàambâ.
eng: and didn't spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly;

lmp: À ka' ba àmbò mla' Sodòm ba Gòmorà, mnsa' Nyʉ̀ mi m koo wowèe. Nyʉ̀ à m tòo mla' anà nè mor mi shê, a kʉti à bʉ. E m gèe cena wa'a, a ce dùŋshi enɛ a yuu ce yi be kè koni bèe ce a m tèe tu nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live ungodly;

lmp: À m ba à nfè' anà e ja' Lot ce e m ba ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì. Ntee yi m ce yaŋ ye njo' ndêe mbembep ce bèe ce à mla' ca a m ce gèe.
eng: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

lmp: E m cu à mʉ̀ bêe bbebep ca, a ce yɛ buu bbebep ce wowèe a m ce gèe à mnòŋ wɛɛwɛ, a ker ce yu' buu bbebep ce wowèe a m ce làa. Ntee yi m yaŋ ye se njobè' e m ce gèe ŋgêe yɛɛnì.
eng: for that righteous man dwelling among them, was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds:

lmp: Buu ca vi ce dùŋshi enɛ Nyʉ̀ rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e be jà' yì bèe efa ŋgɛ', a ker riŋ njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e be fa ŋgɛ' nè bêe bbebep caar dù bà' à nfè' ce e be sa' ŋgòŋ.
eng: the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment;

lmp: Bèe ce Nyʉ̀ be fa ŋgɛ' ce e càa ŋger nè wowèe, yu bèe ce a ku ce gèe ba buu bbebep ce yàp nyor ce kòŋ, a ker ce kani efa ryu'nì nà. Ŋgâa ryɛ'nì ce a yu ŋgâa mnde' nà a ke wɛp yuu ka'. Wowèe a tèe btu, a ke' ce wɛp à rcɛp byʉ' ce vi tʉr ŋger a caa wowèe nà ka'.
eng: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement, and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries;

lmp: Ka' bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a càa ŋgâa ryɛ'nì ce a yu ŋgâa mnde' nà a ke làa bebep àmbò wowèe à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don't bring a railing judgment against them before the Lord.

lmp: Bèe ca a ce làa bebep àmbò buu ce wowèe a rìŋ ka'. Wowèe a ce gèe ŋgèe blʉr a ba àmbò mnyâa à rìŋ ce bèe a ke koo, yʉ nà. Wowèe a be bepsi bèe mo' wa'a, bep foŋ njep mʉ̀ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe anà, lò kwe bʉ à cicì.
eng: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

lmp: Nyʉ̀ be là' wowèe ba nè ŋgɛ' njobè' wowèe a fa ŋgɛ' nè bèe mo' foŋ. Wowèe a yu' rbòŋ à rgèe buu bbebep ce bèe a ke gèe nètʉ' nà ba nèmootì. Yap ŋgèe yi coosi wèe. Wèe wowèe e cu àbee ye byee, wowèe a kʉti mbenjì, ce yu' rbòŋ njep mʉ̀ buu bbebep.
eng: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and blemishes, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

lmp: Wowèe a ku ce kwà'shi ba àmbò bbyèŋge à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, a ke' sɛ̀ efa rgèe buu bbebep ka'. Wowèe a ka' yɛ bèe ce a tɛɛ tatap ka', banɛ a be bo' wowèe tɛ wowèe a bo gèe buu bbebep foŋ. Wowèe a weti a lɛɛte nje mʉ̀ ŋgèe bwer. Wowèe a gwè mnsa' Nyʉ̀ war.
eng: having eyes full of adultery, and who can't cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed; children of cursing;

lmp: Wowèe a mà'shi njî yɛɛnì a du ba à njî mbembep. Wowèe a lòr ba njì yì Balàm ce e m ba muu Beyò. Balàm ca à m kòŋ à rgèe yuu bebep tɛ e bo koni mbàa.
eng: forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m lapni ye njo' yuu bebep ce e m kòŋ à rgèe anà. À m ba à nfè' anà, jàaki' ce e ke làa ka', à laa àmbò ŋwɛ̀ wa'a, a gee ŋwɛ̀ ntuu Nyʉ̀ ca à ke' gee yuu ce yi m ba nè blʉr-ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A mute donkey spoke with a man's voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

lmp: Njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce a mà'shi nduunjî yɛɛnì na a yu àmbò mntòŋ mdip ce vi yuushi wa'a, a ker ba àmbò mmbà' ce fu' yi ke càa, lor nà. Nyʉ̀ à kupshi dì' mo' nè wowèe; fà dì' anà à ku ba ba tʉ̀'nji.
eng: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm; for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

lmp: Wowèe a bu' cùu à cicì, a ce bòose bèe ce a ce ghèter à rfʉʉ efa mʉ̀ bèe ce a ce gèe yuu mini ka', a ce làa enɛ wowèe a gee ba yuu ce yàp nyor kòŋ.
eng: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

lmp: Wowèe a ce suŋ bèe enɛ yuu mo' yi be ker kur wowèe ka'. Ka' wowèe a ce suŋ bèe wa'a, wowèe a ku bii fà' bkwàa nè buu bbebep, njobè' yuu ce yi ka' tʉr ŋger mbendù ŋwɛ̀, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋkwàa nè yuu anà.
eng: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

lmp: Bèe a ka' riŋ Jisos Krâis ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ, a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe sèe à lûŋ, ma'shi buu bbebep enjep ŋgòŋ ce vi ke bepsi ŋwɛ̀ nà, ker lo kʉti àmbùu mo, banɛ wowèe a yu mbe dî' bebep à nfè' anà a caa àmbò a m ba entombì.
eng: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

lmp: Yi m ba ba à ndèe nè wowèe ce wowèe a m ka' ba riŋ nduunjî yɛɛnì ka', nè yì ce enɛ wowèe a riŋ nduunjì anà wɛɛ, kèr lò borni efa rlɛ̀ mncir ce Jisòs à m fa nè wowèe.
eng: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than, after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

lmp: Yuu ce yi koni bèe ca yi ce dùŋshi enɛ mŋgàa ce a ke mà' enɛ̂, "Ŋgwe à vʉ', a ker kʉti àmbùu mo." Ker ma' mò' enɛ̂, "A sù'si ŋkûnyàm, e ka' raa wɛɛ a ker biŋri à ncà'" nà vi yu mini.
eng: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, The dog turns to his own vomit again, and the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.

lmp: Bkar wâ, cena yu ŋwà' embenjì ce mɛ̀ saŋ nè wèe. Mɛ̀ saŋ mŋwâ' bbaa ca a ce kuushi wèe buu ca tɛ wèe bo lɛ' efa mmirlò ce kwà'shi buu Nyʉ̀ à njî yɛɛnì.
eng: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you;

lmp: M ce kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe kuushi buu ce ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ce a m ba bêe brara a m ce làa, ker ba yuu ce Tata Jisòs ce e gèe sèe à luŋ à m làa enɛ wèe gêe. E m tuu yi ŋgâa ntuu a vʉ a suŋ wèe buu anà.
eng: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets, and the commandments of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior:

lmp: Yuu entombì ce wèe à ba rìŋ bòŋboŋ yi yu enɛ be kè ba à mnòŋ elʉ̀simbùu tɛ bèe mo' a fʉʉ à mʉ̀ bèe, ce gèe ba yuu ce a kòŋ. Bèe ca a be kè vʉ̀shi blàa ce wèe ce fè'shi àmbò Jisòs,
eng: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts,

lmp: ce làa enɛ̂, "To e m kà' enɛ e be dù kʉti? E yû? Wer bta a m kweŋger war, buu wɛɛwɛ à ku cu àmbò vi m ba kɛ̂' à nfè' ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ŋgòŋ."
eng: and saying, Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.

lmp: Bèe ca a ce làa wa'a, a ce gèe àmbò a mɛŋni enɛ à m ba elûuŋgòŋ Nyʉ̀ à laa enɛ rbuu li ba, tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ba, buu ca à ku ba ghup ka' wa'a. E m gàpse nshe a mdip, a gee nshe nè mdip.
eng: For this they willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water, by the word of God;

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m bepsi ŋgòŋ elûuŋgòŋ ba nè mdip à nfè' ce mi m ruu a cete ŋgòŋ dʉ̀dʉ̀ nà.
eng: by which means the world that then was, being overflowed with water, perished.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m ker laa làa, yi ba enɛ rbuu ba nshe ce sèe ce yɛ na a be kù cu dù bà' à nòŋ ce mor yi be tòo tɛ vi she dʉ̀dʉ̀. Buu ca be kù cu dù bà' à nòŋ ce Nyʉ̀ be sa' bèe wɛɛwɛ, gèe tɛ bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè ye ka' a kwe bʉ à cicì.
eng: But the heavens that now are, and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

lmp: Bkar wâ, wèe fa lèse enɛ nôŋ mo'sir yi yu à bsii Nyʉ̀ àmbò bfè' ncʉ̀kì, bfè' ncʉ̀kì vi ba àmbò nôŋ mo'sir ka'.
eng: But don't forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

lmp: Bèe mo' a ce kwà'shi enɛ Tata e ke càasi nfè' efa rgèe buu sê, a ce gèe yuu ce e m kà' ka'. Yi yu ba enɛ Tata à kur ntee nè wèe njobè' e ce kòŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' kwe bʉ à cicì ka'. E ce kòŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ kupse, borni yi ŋgêe bebep.
eng: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but is patient with us, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

lmp: Ka' yi yu wa'a, Tata be vʉ̀ tɛ e bʉʉ bèe bʉ̀ʉ àmbò nyɛ̀ɛ wa'a. Be kè ba à nfè' anà tɛ rbuu li côo, ce barŋger àmbò mor wa'a, bʉ. Buu embe bùu wɛɛwɛ vi be kè she, tɛ ŋgòŋ foŋ ba buu wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ vi bʉ.
eng: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night; in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat, and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

lmp: Àmbò wèe à rìŋ enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ vi be kè bʉ na, banɛ njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe ce wèe à ba ce gèe yu njɛ̀ɛ yî kɛ? Wèe à ba fa wêe mnyor nè Nyʉ̀, gèe ba ŋgèe ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ.
eng: Therefore since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

lmp: Ce ke' nè nòŋ ce Nyʉ̀ be vʉ̀, ker gheter foŋ gee tɛ nòŋ ca yi yaŋse ba. Be ba à nòŋ anà tɛ rbuu ba nshe a bʉ, tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ she dʉ̀dʉ̀.
eng: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à kà' sèe enɛ rbuu rfi ba nshe nfi be kè ba, tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ vi ku ba byɛɛnì à ŋgòŋ anà. A yuu ce sèe cu sè'ni a ce ke'.
eng: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

lmp: Bkar wâ, banɛ àmbò wèe cu a ce ke' buu anà, wèe gheter gèe ŋgêe bòŋboŋ, e vʉ̀, wèe bo tʉr fàa mò' a yê bsii ka', cu nè rfʉtè-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without blemish and blameless in his sight.

lmp: Rìŋ nè enɛ mbùu ce Tata à kur ntee a ku cu caar a ghɛɛ sè'ni yu njobè' e kòŋ enɛ bèe a lûŋ. Pol ce e yu nfʉr yìsèe ce sèe kòŋ se nà à m lòr bfee ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa ye a saŋ buu ca àgho mbe ŋwà' ce e m saŋ nè wèe nà.
eng: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you;

lmp: E làa buu ca mbe vi mŋwà' wɛɛwɛ ce e saŋ. Buu mò' yu mbe vi mŋwà' ce vi tap sê. Bèe ce a mɛŋni buu a tɛɛ tatap ka', a lò beesi buu ca à njɛ̀ɛ yàp àmbò a bèesi blàa mò' embe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ nà. Yuu ce wowèe a ce gèe anà yi be mà' ŋgɛ' mbe wâp btù.
eng: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

lmp: Bkar wâ, à ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, wèe à rìŋ buu ca war. Banɛ wèe lor nfè' fà dì' bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka' a lo bo' wèe tɛ wèe lo kʉti ŋgâa ŋgèe buu bbebep, gwè embe dî' bòŋboŋ ce wèe yu na ka'.
eng: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

lmp: Kù ce du nè ye yu ba àmbùu Tata Jisos Krâis ce e gèe sèe à lûŋ, tɛ e bo tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè wèe, tɛ e bo ghoni wèe gòr, tɛ wèe riŋ yì buu bòŋboŋ. Tɛ bèe a ku'si ye sè'ni na ker ba à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

lmp: Yuu ce yi m ba efa rkɛ̀' ce wèr à yu', a yɛ nè mer mmir, a ke'shî, a ker joo nè mer mmbo yu nlàa ce e ce fa ryòŋ.
eng: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

lmp: A m dùŋshi ryòŋ ca, wèr à yɛ̂, a ce suŋ wèe àmbò ryòŋ ca ce yu ryòŋ ce nfesè ce li m ba a Tàr a duŋshì li nè wèr.
eng: and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us;

lmp: Yuu ce wèr à yɛ a ker yu', wèr ce suŋ wèe foŋ tɛ sèe bo ba àbee. Yu ba sèe Tàr ba Muu yî Jisos Krâis wèe, ce sèe yu àbee.
eng: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father, and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

lmp: Wèr ce saŋ buu ca tɛ sèe bo ruu nè rlu'shì.
eng: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

lmp: Nsuŋ ce wèr à yu' ese ye, a ce suŋ wèe, yu enɛ Nyʉ̀ yu rraa, tʉ̀'nji yu njep ye ka',
eng: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

lmp: Sèe ka' laa enɛ sèe wowèe yu àbee, kʉti ce jɛ̀r à tʉ̀'nji banɛ sèe ce nya' mnde', a ke' ce cu rcu ce li yu mini ka'.
eng: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie, and don't tell the truth.

lmp: Geewa'a, sèe ka' ce jɛ̀r à rraa, àmbò e yu à rraa, sèe wɛɛwɛ ba àbee, blɛɛ Jisòs ce Muu yì vi su'sì sèe efa yìsèe buu bbebep.
eng: But if we walk in the light, as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ, his Son, cleanses us from all sin.

lmp: Sèe ka' laa enɛ sèe tʉr yuu bebep ka', banɛ sèe ce bo' visèe btu, a ker buu mini.
eng: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

lmp: Sèe ka' suŋ yìsèe buu bbebep, banɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e ke lɛ̀ yi nlàa, a ker ba kùyɛɛ, be fòosi sèe yìsèe buu bbebep, sù'si sèe efa buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu yɛɛnì ka'.
eng: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

lmp: Sèe ka' laa enɛ sèe à gèe yuu bebep ka', banɛ sèe ce lòr Nyʉ̀ à ŋwɛ̀ mnde', a buu yi nlàa.
eng: If we say that we haven't sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

lmp: Boo wâ, m ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè wèe fà dì' wèe bo gèe buu bbebep ka'. Geewa'a yi ka' koni enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à gèe yuu bebep, wèe yi enɛ sèe tʉr ŋwɛ̀ njà' bèe àgee Tàr. Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu Jisos Krâis ce yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì.
eng: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce a m gèe taŋshì àgho enɛ a bo fòosi sèe yìsèe buu bbebep. A m ku gee wa'a a sêe tu cà' ka', à m ba foŋ àtu buu bbebep bèe wɛɛwɛ.
eng: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

lmp: Yuu ce yi ce dùŋshi enɛ sèe rìŋ Nyʉ̀ yi yu enɛ sèe ce gèe yuu ce e làa.
eng: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa enɛ̂, "M rìŋ ye", ke' ce gèe yuu ce e làa ka' yu ŋwɛ̀ nya' mnde', a buu mini.
eng: One who says, I know him, and doesn't keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn't in him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce lɛ̀ nlàa Nyʉ̀ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ Nyʉ̀ a misî. Cena a njì ce àde' sèe ba sèe Nyʉ̀ wèe.
eng: But whoever keeps his word, God's love has most certainly been perfected in him. This is how we know that we are in him:

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e làa enɛ e ce cu àbee a Nyʉ̀, ŋgàŋ tʉr à rcu àmbò Jisòs à m ce cu.
eng: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

lmp: Bkar wâ, yuu ce m ce saŋ nè wèe enɛ wèe gee na, yu yuu fi ka', yu yuu rʉ̀ʉ ce a m làa nè wèe efa rkɛ̀'. Yuu rʉ̀ʉ ca yu nlàa ce wèe à m yu' wɛɛ.
eng: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

lmp: Geewa'a, m ce saŋ nlâa fi nè wèe ce yi ce dùŋshi nyor njep Krâis, ker ba njep wèe foŋ. Yi yu wa'a njobè' tʉ̀'nji ce fa njì, rraa ce mini li kɛ' a ce raa.
eng: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you; because the darkness is passing away, and the true light already shines.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce làa enɛ e cu à rraa, baa nfʉr yì, banɛ ŋgàŋ ku cu à tʉ̀'nji.
eng: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother, is in the darkness even until now.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ nfʉr yì, ŋgàŋ cu à rraa, yuu mo' yi yu njep ye ce àtà yi gee ŋgàŋ gee yuu bebep ka'.
eng: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa nfʉr yì yu à tʉ̀'nji, a ce jɛ̀r à tʉ̀'nji, a ke' yi fàdì' e ce dù ka', njobè' tʉ̀'nji à bèesi ye à nfèp.
eng: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn't know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

lmp: M ce saŋ nè wèe boo wâ, njobè' a fòosi wèe ye buu bbebep wɛɛ à rlii Jisos Krâis.
eng: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name's sake.

lmp: M ce saŋ nè wêe btàr njobè' wèe rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba efa rkɛ̀'. M ce saŋ nè wêe mnsùnsù njobè' ce wèe à so Satàn.
eng: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

lmp: M ce saŋ nè wèe boo wâ, njobè' wèe rìŋ Tàr. M ce saŋ nè wêe btàr njobè' wèe rìŋ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ba efa rkɛ̀'. M ce saŋ nè wêe mnsùnsù njobè' wèe yu btatap, nlàa Nyʉ̀ yi niŋ wèe njep blɛɛ, wèe à so Satàn.
eng: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

lmp: Wèe fa kòŋ ŋgòŋ ka'. Wèe fa kòŋ buu enjep ŋgòŋ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ka' koŋ ŋgòŋ àtà ŋgàŋ koŋ Tàr ka',
eng: Don't love the world, neither the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father's love isn't in him.

lmp: njobè' buu enjep ŋgòŋ vi lò ese Tàr ka', vi lò ese ŋgòŋ. Buu enjep ŋgòŋ ca yu buu bbebep ce nyor ce ròo, ba mbàŋ mmir à rtʉr buu wɛɛwɛ ce à ce yɛ, ker ba nàanyor à buu ce à tʉr.
eng: For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn't the Father's, but is the world's.

lmp: Ŋgòŋ yi be mì, tɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce bèe a ce yɛ mbo, a ce ròo à rtʉr, vi mi foŋ. Geewa'a, ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe yuu ce Nyʉ̀ ce ròo, banɛ ŋgàŋ be cu nfesè.
eng: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God's will remains forever.

lmp: Boo wâ, nfè' ca yu lʉ̀simbùu nfè'. Wèe à m yu' enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa Krâis ce vʉ̀. Bèe ce a bàa Krâis a vʉ̀ sè'ni à ku' ŋgoo, banɛ sèe yi sè'ni enɛ nfè' anà à ghɛɛ.
eng: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

lmp: Wowèe a fʉʉ efa sêe mʉ njobè' wowèe a m ba à ŋgʉ̀' yìsèe ka'. Wowèe a m ba ba à ŋgʉ̀' yìsèe, a m ba cu sèe wowèe. Wowèe a fʉʉ efa sêe mʉ tɛ yi bo ba rara enɛ wowèe wɛɛwɛ a m ba à ŋgʉ̀' yìsèe ka'.
eng: They went out from us, but they didn't belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, Krâis à fa wèe Yʉ' Rara, wèe wɛɛwɛ à yi buu ce mini.
eng: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

lmp: M ce saŋ nè wèe ba à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ wèe mɛŋni mini ka'. M ce saŋ njobè' wèe yi mini wɛɛ, a ker yi enɛ àtà mnde' mi lo ese mini ka'.
eng: I have not written to you because you don't know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nya' mnde' a nda? Yu ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e kani enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis anà ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ anà yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa Krâis. E ce kani Tàr ba muu.
eng: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ kanì muu, ba a Tàr ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi muu banɛ ŋgàŋ yu à Tàr foŋ.
eng: Whoever denies the Son, the same doesn't have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

lmp: Yɛ nè enɛ buu ce wèe à m yɛ'ni efa rkɛ̀' vi cu njep wêe mntee. Buu ce wèe à m yɛ'ni na vi ka' cu njep wêe mntee banɛ wèe be ba àbee wèe muu ba Tàr.
eng: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

lmp: Yuu ce Krâis à kà' sèe, yu ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

lmp: M ce saŋ cena nè wèe du kuu bèe ce a ce ròo à rbo' wèe.
eng: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

lmp: Ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, Krâis à fa wèe Yʉ' Rara, yi ba nè wèe. Mbùu mò' yu ce ŋwɛ̀ mò' ker yɛ'ni wèe ka'. Yʉ' ce e m fa wèe nà yi be yɛ'ni wèe buu wɛɛwɛ. Yʉ' ce e m fa yu yʉ' mini, à ke' ba yʉ' mnde' ka'. Wèe ce cu àbee wèe Krâis wèe àmbò yi m yɛ'ni wèe.
eng: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don't need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

lmp: Boo wâ, ce cu nè àbee wèe Krâis wèe, tɛ e ba à nfè' ce e vʉ̀ nà, sèe bo lu'shi à ryɛ ye, kè' ce koosi rìtu ce sʉ̀ni à nfè' ce e vʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness, and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

lmp: Wèe ka' riŋ enɛ Krâis yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì, banɛ wèe tʉr à rrìŋ foŋ enɛ ŋwɛ̀ nsìp ce e ce gèe buu byɛɛnì yu muu Nyʉ̀.
eng: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness is born of him.

lmp: Yɛ nè àmbò Tàr à kòŋ sèe sê, a ce too sèe à boo vi nà. Nè mini- ŋwɛ̀, sèe yu boo vi. Mbùu ce ŋgòŋ yi mɛŋni sèe yu njobè' yi m mɛŋni ye.
eng: Behold, how great a love the Father has bestowed on us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn't know us, because it didn't know him.

lmp: Bkar wâ, sèe yu boo Nyʉ̀ sè'ni. Yuu ce sèe be kè ba yi be yɛɛti nè sèe ka'. Geewa'a sèe yi enɛ be kè ba à nfè' ce e vʉ̀ tɛ sèe feese ye njobè' sèe be kè yɛ ye àmbò e yu.
eng: Beloved, now we are children of God, and it is not yet revealed what we will be. But we know that, when he is revealed, we will be like him; for we will see him just as he is.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nsìp ce e cu ce kè' ye, ce lɛ yi ntee rara àmbò Krâis ye ye yu nrara nà.
eng: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ nsìp ce e ce gèe yuu bebep à bʉ' ncir. Yuu bebep yu à rbʉ' ncir.
eng: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

lmp: Wèe rìŋ enɛ Krâis à m vʉ̀ à rcà'si buu bbebep. Yuu bebep yi yu njep yê ntee ka'.
eng: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and in him is no sin.

lmp: Àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce cu àbee a ye ker ce gèe yuu bebep ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe yuu bebep banɛ ŋgàŋ à be yɛ ye ka', a riŋ ye ka'.
eng: Whoever remains in him doesn't sin. Whoever sins hasn't seen him, neither knows him.

lmp: Boo wâ, wèe fa mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' bo' wèe ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe yuu yɛɛnì, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̂ nyɛɛnì àmbò Krâis yu ŋwɛ̀ nyɛɛnì.
eng: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe yuu bebep banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ Satàn njobè' Satàn à m gèe yuu bebep efa rkɛ̀'. Mbùu ce Muu Nyʉ̀ à m vʉ̀ à m ba enɛ e bo bʉsi mfà' Satàn.
eng: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed, that he might destroy the works of the devil.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu muu Nyʉ̀ e ke gèe yuu bebep ka' njobè' Nyʉ̀ yu njep ye. Àtà e gee yuu bebep ka' njobè' e yu muu Nyʉ̀.
eng: Whoever is born of God doesn't commit sin, because his seed remains in him; and he can't sin, because he is born of God.

lmp: Yuu ce yi gèe sèe riŋ enɛ bèe a yu boo Nyʉ̀ kɛ̀ a yu boo Satàn ɛ̀, yu enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe yɛɛnì ka' banɛ ŋgàŋ yu muu Nyʉ̀ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ kòŋ nfʉr yì ka' banɛ ŋgàŋ yu muu Nyʉ̀ foŋ ka'.
