eng: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn't do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn't love his brother.

lmp: Cena a nsuŋ ce wèe à m yu' efa rkɛ̀' enɛ sèe koŋni.
eng: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another;

lmp: Wèe fa ba àmbò Kɛn ce e m ba ŋwɛ̀ Satàn a yʉ nfʉr yì nà ka'. E m yʉ nfʉr yì ba njokɛ? À m ba njobè' buu ce e m gèe à m ba buu bbebep, vî nfʉr yì vi ba yɛɛnì.
eng: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one, and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his works were evil, and his brother's righteous.

lmp: Bfʉr wâ, ŋgòŋ yi ka' baa wèe, wèe fa ba nè rgha'nì-ŋwɛ̀ ka'.
eng: Don't be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

lmp: Sèe riŋ enɛ sèe à fʉʉ efa ŋgʉ̀' rkwe a ba à ŋgʉ̀' ryòŋ njobè' sèe kòŋ bfʉr visèe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa bfʉr yì, ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e kwe.
eng: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn't love his brother remains in death.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' baa nfʉr yì, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ nyʉ bèe. Wèe yi weenɛ ŋwɛ̀ nyʉ bèe à koni ryòŋ ce nfesè ka'.
eng: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

lmp: Yuu ce yi gèe sèe, sèe à riŋ àmbò rkòŋnì li yu, yu enɛ Krâis à m fa yi tu, a kwe njo' sèe. See sèe tʉr à rfa visèe btu njobè' bfʉr visèe.
eng: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' tʉr buu enjep ŋgòŋ na, yɛ enɛ nfʉr yì buu yuu, tee mmbo, àtà rkòŋnì Nyʉ̀ li ba njep ye à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: But whoever has the world's goods, and sees his brother in need, and closes his heart of compassion against him, how does the love of God remain in him?

lmp: Boo wâ, sèe fa kù kòŋ bèe ba ekù cùu ka'. Sèe duŋshi rkòŋnì nè mini-ŋwɛ̀ à yuu ce sèe ce gèe.
eng: My little children, let's not love in word only, neither with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

lmp: Sèe à ka' gee wa'a, banɛ yi be gèe tɛ sèe yi enɛ sèe yu ŋgâa mini, kèr tapsi visèe mntee à bsii Nyʉ̀
eng: And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,

lmp: à nfè' ce visèe mntee vi ce sa' sèe. Yi yu wa'a njobè' Nyʉ̀ càa visèe mntee, a yi buu bsìp.
eng: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

lmp: Bkar wâ, visèe mntee vi ka' tɛ sa' sèe ka', sèe wɛp à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Beloved, if our hearts don't condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, sèe ka' loo ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ, e be fa sèe njobè' sèe ce gèe buu ce e ce làa, ker ce gèe buu ce yi bòŋ ye.
eng: and whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

lmp: Yi nlàa yi yu enɛ sèe byemi nè Muu yì ce Jisos Krâis, ker koŋni àmbò e m làa nè sèe.
eng: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

lmp: Bèe ce a ce gèe yuu ce e làa, a ce cu njep ye, ye ye ce cu njep wowèe. Yuu ce yi gèe sèe à yi enɛ e cu sèe wowèe yu Yʉ' ce e fa nè sèe.
eng: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

lmp: Bkar wâ, wèe fa byemi byʉ' bsìp ka'. Wèe taase byʉ' à ryɛ enɛ vi lò ese Nyʉ̀ lɛ, njobè' bèe magòr ce a bo'shi enɛ a yu ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, a yu à ŋgòŋ.
eng: Beloved, don't believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

lmp: Yuu ce àde' yi gee wèe riŋ Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi yu enɛ, yʉ' wɛɛwɛ ce yi byemi enɛ Jisos Krâis à m bèeŋger à ŋwɛ̀, a vʉ njep ŋgòŋ, yi lò ese Nyʉ̀.
eng: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

lmp: Yʉ' wɛɛwɛ ce yi ka' tɛ byemi wa' ka', banɛ yi lò ese Nyʉ̀ ka'. Yʉ' cena yu yʉ' ŋwɛ̀ ce e bàa Krâis ce wèe à m yu' enɛ yi ce vʉ̀. Yi yu war njep ŋgòŋ sè'ni.
eng: and every spirit who doesn't confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God, and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

lmp: Boo wâ, wèe yu bèe Nyʉ̀, a so njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu njep wèe à càa ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu njep ŋgòŋ.
eng: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them; because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

lmp: Wowèe a yu bèe enjep ŋgòŋ, banɛ a ce làa yap ba buu enjep ŋgòŋ, ŋgòŋ yi ce yu' buu ce wowèe a ce làa.
eng: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

lmp: Wèr yu yer bèe Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ce yu' yuu ce wèr ce làa. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀ ka', ce yu' yuu ce wèr ce làa ka'. Cena a yuu ce yi ce gèe sèe ka' ce rìŋ yʉ' ce mini, ba yʉ' mnde'.
eng: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn't listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

lmp: Bkar wâ, sèe koŋni njobè' rkòŋnì li lò ese Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e kòŋ bèe, yu muu Nyʉ̀, a ker riŋ Nyʉ̀.
eng: Beloved, let us love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves is born of God, and knows God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e kòŋ bèe ka', rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka', njobè' Nyʉ̀ yu rkòŋnì.
eng: He who doesn't love doesn't know God, for God is love.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m dùŋshi li rkòŋnì nè sèe à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ e m tuu muu yì ce e m ku ba mò'sir njep ŋgòŋ enɛ sèe bo cu njo' ye.
eng: By this God's love was revealed in us, that God has sent his one and only Son into the world that we might live through him.

lmp: Rkòŋnì anà li yu ba enɛ sèe à m kòŋ Nyʉ̀ ka', yu ba enɛ e m kòŋ sèe, a tuu muu yì enɛ e ba yuu gèe taŋshì àtu yìsèe buu bbebep.
eng: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

lmp: Bkar wâ, àmbò Nyʉ̀ à m koŋ sèe se nà, see sèe tʉr à rkòŋnì foŋ.
eng: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m be yɛ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Sèe ka' koŋni, Nyʉ̀ cu njep sèe, sèe koŋnì sê, du misî.
eng: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ seenɛ sèe cu njep ye, e cu njep sèe, njobè' yi yʉ' ce e fa nè sèe.
eng: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

lmp: Wèr à yɛ, a ce suŋ bèe enɛ Tàr à m tuu Muu yì enɛ e ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be gèe tɛ ŋgòŋ yi lûŋ.
eng: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' byemi enɛ Jisòs yu Muu Nyʉ̀, banɛ Nyʉ̀ cu njep ye, ye ye à cu njep Nyʉ̀.
eng: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

lmp: Yi ka' ba wa'a, sèe à rîŋ, a byemi rkòŋnì ce Nyʉ̀ à tʉr nè sèe. Nyʉ̀ yu rkòŋnì. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' cu njep rkòŋnì, banɛ e cu njep Nyʉ̀, Nyʉ̀ à cu njep ye.
eng: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

lmp: Sèe à kòŋni a du a misi wa'a, tɛ sèe bo kè wɛp yuu mo' à nòŋ mnsa' ka', njobè' sèe cu njep ŋgòŋ na, a ba àmbò ye.
eng: In this love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so are we in this world.

lmp: Rwɛp li yu njep rkòŋnì ka'. Yi yu enɛ rkòŋnì ce li mìsi li ke jùu rwɛp, njobè' rwɛp li ke ba ba à nfè' ce sèe à rìŋ enɛ a be fa sèe ŋgɛ' njobè' sèe à gèe yuu bebep. Banɛ rkòŋnì lî ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce wɛp buu li yu à bɛbɛ'.
eng: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

lmp: Sèe à kòŋni njobè' e m kòŋ sèe entombì.
eng: We love him, because he first loved us.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' laa enɛ̂, "M kòŋ Nyʉ̀," baa nfʉr yì, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ mnde' njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ka' baa nfʉr yì ce e ce yɛ, àde' e koŋ Nyʉ̀ ce e ce yɛ ka' à njɛ̂ɛ kɛ?
eng: If a man says, I love God, and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn't love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à làa ca nè sèe, e làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' koŋ Nyʉ̀, banɛ e be kù kòŋ nfʉr yì foŋ."
eng: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e byemi enɛ Jisòs yu Krâis, ŋgàŋ yu muu Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e kòŋ tar muu, kòŋ muu anà foŋ.
eng: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ is born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

lmp: Sèe ka' koŋ Nyʉ̀ ker ce gèe buu ce e ce làa, sèe yi enɛ sèe kòŋ boo vi.
eng: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

lmp: Rkòŋnî nè Nyʉ̀ li yu enɛ sèe gee buu ce e ce làa. Buu ce e ce làa vi gha' sèe à rgèe ka',
eng: For this is the love of God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

lmp: njobè' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e yu muu Nyʉ̀ e ke so ŋgòŋ. Yuu ce yi so ŋgòŋ yu lisèe rbyemì.
eng: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e so ŋgòŋ yu nda? Ku ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e byemi enɛ Jisòs yu Muu Nyʉ̀.
eng: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

lmp: Jisos Krâis à m vʉ̀ njep ŋgòŋ, a caa njep mdip ba blɛɛ. E m càa ba njep mdip cà'cà' ka', e m càa ba njep mdip ba blɛɛ. Yʉ' yi m suŋ àmbò ye foŋ njobè' Yʉ' yu mini.
eng: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

lmp: Banɛ buu ce vi ce suŋ àmbò ye vi yu vi btaar.
eng: For there are three who testify:

lmp: Buu vi btaar anà yu Yʉ' ba mdip, ker ba blɛɛ. Buu ca vi ce làa yuu yi mo'sir.
eng: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

lmp: Sèe à ka' byemi yuu ce bèe a làa, banɛ yì ce à làa Nyʉ̀ yi càa yì anà, njobè' cena a yì ce à làa Nyʉ̀ kuu muu yì.
eng: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God's testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e byemi nè Muu Nyʉ̀, ŋgàŋ rìŋ wa'a njep yê ntee. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e byemi ka' ce lòr Nyʉ̀ à ŋwɛ̀ mnde', njobè' ce e byemi yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à làa kuu Muu yì ka'.
eng: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn't believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

lmp: Yuu ce Nyʉ̀ à làa yi yu enɛ e fa sèe ryòŋ ce nfesè. Ryòŋ ca li ce lò ese muu yì.
eng: The testimony is this, that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr Muu Nyʉ̀ à koni ryòŋ, ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr Muu Nyʉ̀ ka', à koni ryòŋ ka'.
eng: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn't have God's Son doesn't have the life.

lmp: Mɛ̀ saŋ buu ca nè wèe ce wèe à byemi nè Muu Nyʉ̀ tɛ wèe bo yi enɛ wèe à koni ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

lmp: Yuu ce yi gèe wèr à tʉr rtarnì à rbipshi yuu nè ye ka' yi yu enɛ wèr ka' loo ka' kɛ ce e kòŋ ese ye, e be yu' wèr.
eng: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that, if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

lmp: Sèe ka' yi enɛ ka' njɛ̀ɛ kɛ ce sèe ce loo, e ce yu' sèe, banɛ sèe riŋ enɛ sèe à koni yuu ce sèe à loo ese ye wɛɛ.
eng: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' yɛ nfʉr yì e ce gèe yuu bebep ce àde' e gee e kwe ka', ŋgàŋ loo tɛ Nyʉ̀ fa ye ryòŋ. M ce làa ba àmbò bèe ce a gèe buu bbebep ce àde' vi gee wowèe a kweŋgèr ka'. Yuu bebep ce e gèe ŋwɛ̀ kwe yu àgho, geewa'a m ce làa mɛnɛ e loo à yuu bebep anà ka'.
eng: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is a sin leading to death. I don't say that he should make a request concerning this.

lmp: Buu wɛɛwɛ ce bèe a gèe ce vi yu yɛɛnì ka', yu buu bbebep. Geewa'a, yuu bebep mo' yi yu àgho ce àde' yi gee ŋwɛ̀ kwe ka'.
eng: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is a sin not leading to death.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ àde' ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu muu Nyʉ̀ ku ce gèe yuu bebep ka', njobè' Muu Nyʉ̀ ce kè'ni ye. Àtà Satàn joo ŋgàŋ ka'.
eng: We know that whoever is born of God doesn't sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn't touch him.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ enɛ sèe yu boo Nyʉ̀, a riŋ enɛ ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ yi yu mbà mmbo Satàn.
eng: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

lmp: Sèe rìŋ foŋ enɛ Muu Nyʉ̀ à vʉ̀, a fa sèe bfee tɛ sèe bo rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ce mini. Sèe yu njep Nyʉ̀ ce mini anà àmbò sèe yu njep Muu yî Jisos Krâis. Yu ye ce e yu Nyʉ̀ ce mini, a ker ba ryòŋ ce nfesè.
eng: We know that the Son of God has come, and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true, and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God, and eternal life.

lmp: Boo wâ, lòr nè nfè' wèe mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ wèe.
eng: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca à saŋ mɛ̂ nleeŋwɛ̀ nè njeŋwɛ̀ ce a ce, ker ba boo vi ce m kòŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. Ku ba ba mɛ̀ cà'cà' ce m kòŋ wèe ka'. Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a rìŋ yuu mini a kòŋ wèe foŋ,
eng: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth; and not I only, but also all those who know the truth;

lmp: njobè' yuu mini yi yu njep sèe, yi be kù ba njo nfesè.
eng: for the truth's sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

lmp: Àmbò sèe tɛɛ njep mini ba rkòŋnì Nyʉ̀, m ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ Tàr, ba Jisos Krâis ce e yu Muu Tàr ghoni sèe, koosimnse nè sèe, ker fa sèe cumʉnyaŋ.
eng: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father, and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

lmp: M ce lu'shi magòr à ryɛ mɛnɛ boo wee mo' a ce tɛɛ njep yuu mini àmbò Tàr à m làa nè sèe.
eng: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

lmp: Maamâ, m ce loo wèe sè'ni enɛ sèe koŋni. M ce saŋ wa'a a ce làa ba yuu fi nè wɛ̀ ka', yu ba yi ce sèe a m yu' efa rkɛ̀'.
eng: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

lmp: Rkòŋnì li yu enɛ sèe ce gee buu ce Nyʉ̀ ce làa. Àmbò wèe à m yu' efa rkɛ̀', yuu ce e làa yi yu enɛ wèe cu nè rkòŋnì-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

lmp: Ku' ŋgâa mbo' bèe a yu njep ŋgòŋ, a ce kani enɛ Jisòs à m bèeŋger à ŋwɛ̀, a vʉ njep ŋgòŋ ka'. Njɛ̀ɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà yu ŋwɛ̀ mbo' bèe, a ba ŋwɛ̀ bàa Krâis.
eng: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don't confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

lmp: Lòr nè nfè' fà dì' wèe bɛ yuu ce wèe ce fà' àtu mo ka' tɛ wèe bo koni wee blà' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Watch yourselves, that we don't lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ma'shi yuu ce Krâis à m yɛ'ni, ce gèe jɛɛ, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu àbee a Nyʉ̀ ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ka' ku cu ba njep yuu ce Krâis à m yɛ'ni, banɛ ŋgàŋ yu àbee a Tàr a ker ba àbee a Muu.
eng: Whoever transgresses and doesn't remain in the teaching of Christ, doesn't have God. He who remains in the teaching, the same has both the Father and the Son.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' ka' vʉ à ryɛ wèe, ke' ce yɛ'ni ba njɛ̀ɛ ryɛ'nì ca ka', wèe fa byemi tɛ e niŋ mbe wêe ndàp ka', fa fa nè ye bo foŋ ka'.
eng: If anyone comes to you, and doesn't bring this teaching, don't receive him into your house, and don't welcome him,

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' fa ye bo, banɛ a ŋgàŋ a gèe bsàrbuu anà bsìp.
eng: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil works.

lmp: M tʉr buu gòr ce m ba saŋ nè wèe. M be kèr saŋ saŋ ka', m ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ m be vʉ̀ yɛ wèe, làa nè ya cùu tɛ sèe bo lu'shi dù mìsi.
eng: Having many things to write to you, I don't want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you, and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

lmp: Boo nfʉrò ce a ce nà, a cà'ni wɛ̀.
eng: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca à saŋ mɛ̂ nleeŋwɛ̀ nè ŋkarâ Gayòs ce mɛ̀ kòŋ nè mini-ŋwɛ̀.
eng: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

lmp: Ŋkarà, m ce loo mɛnɛ à cu yɛɛnì, tɛ yò buu wɛɛwɛ ba yɛɛnì àmbò yo ntee yi yu yɛɛnì foŋ nà.
eng: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m lu'shi sê, à nfè' ce bfʉr mo' a m vʉ̀ a ce suŋ mɛ̀ àmbò à ce cu rcu ce li yu nè mini-ŋwɛ̀. Yi ku ba mini wa'a.
eng: For I rejoiced greatly, when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

lmp: Àde' yuu mo' yi gee m ker lu'shi caa àmbò m ce lu'shi à ryu' enɛ boo wa a ku cu njep mini na ka'.
eng: I have no greater joy than this, to hear about my children walking in truth.

lmp: Ŋkarà, buu ce à ce gèe nè bfʉr na, à ce gèe nè mini-ŋwɛ̀, laŋlaŋ nè bkèe.
eng: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

lmp: Wowèe a suŋ ŋgâa cor àmbò lo rkòŋnì. Be ba yuu bòŋboŋ ce wɛ̀ ka' daasi wowèe à njɛ̀ɛ njì ce e yu yɛɛnì à bsii Nyʉ̀.
eng: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

lmp: Yu njo' rlii Krâis ce enɛ wowèe a m fʉʉ à mbè a ke' ce koo yuu mo' ese bèe ce a mɛŋni Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

lmp: Banɛ sèe à ba ce jà' njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca tɛ sèe wowèe bo fà' àbee à rsuŋ nsuŋ ce mini.
eng: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m saŋ yuu mo' nè côr, geewa'a Dàyotrɛfɛ̀s ce e kòŋ à rba tu embe cor à byemì ka'.
eng: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn't accept what we say.

lmp: Banɛ m ka' vʉ̂, m fʉʉ nè ye àwaŋ, suŋ ku' buu bbebep ce e làa a kuu wèr. E ce sa' wèr nè bsàrbuu-ŋwɛ̀. E gèe ca wa'a, yi ghɛɛ ye ka', e kani à rkoni bfʉr, a kani bèe ce a ce kòŋ à rgèe wa'a foŋ, a fʉr wowèe embe côr.
eng: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, neither does he himself receive the brothers, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

lmp: Ŋkarà, fa bè'ni yuu bebep ka', bè'ni ba yuu bòŋboŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gèe yuu bòŋboŋ banɛ ŋgàŋ yu ŋwɛ̀ Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ce gee yuu bebep, banɛ ŋgàŋ à m yɛ Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Beloved, don't imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn't seen God.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce làa bòŋboŋ kuu Dɛ̀mitròs. Ka' yì ndêe mini foŋ ce dùŋshi wa'a. Wer wèr foŋ ce làa bòŋboŋ kuu ye. Wɛ̀ rìŋ wɛnɛ yuu ce wèr ce làa yi yu mini.
eng: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

lmp: M tʉr buu magòr ce m ba bà saŋ nè wɛ̀, m be kèr saŋ saŋ ka'.
eng: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

lmp: M ce kwà'shi à rvʉ̀ yɛ wɛ̀, làa nè ya cùu. Cumʉnyaŋ ba nè wɛ̀. Bkar a ce cà'ni wɛ̀. Cà'ni bkar à mlii.
eng: but I hope to see you soon, and we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca ce saŋ mɛ̂ Jud ce m yu ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Jisos Krâis, a ba nfʉr Jɛ̂ms. M ce saŋ ŋwà' ca nè bèe ce Nyʉ̀ Tàr à ce, a kôŋ, Jisòs à ce kè'ni bèe anà.
eng: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ koosimnse nè wèe, fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ sê, ker koŋ wèe sê.
eng: Mercy to you and peace and love be multiplied.

lmp: Bkar wâ, mɛ̀ m ce kòŋ magòr se à rsaŋ nè wèe kuu lisèe rlùŋ. Geewa'a, mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ yi bòŋ enɛ m saŋ ŋwà' nè wèe sè'ni tɛ m bo fa wèe ŋger tɛ wèe tɛɛ tatap njep rbyemì ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa nè yì bèe. Àde' nsuŋ du kuu rbyemì ca kee kupse ka'.
eng: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

lmp: Mɛ̀ làa wa'a njobè' bèe mo' ce a ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka', a sʉ̀ni a niŋ a wêe mʉ, a ce ghèter à rkupse nsuŋ ce e yu àmbò ntee bòŋboŋ ce Nyʉ̀ tʉr nè bèe nà, tɛ wèe bo byemi enɛ à rgèe bsàrbuu yi yu yɛɛnì. Wowèe a gèe wa'a, a ce kani Jisos Krâis ce ku ba ba ye cà'cà' ce e yu yìsèe masà, a ker ba Tata nè sèe. A m saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ elûuŋgòŋ enɛ Nyʉ̀ be fa ŋgɛ' nè njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca.
eng: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

lmp: M ce kòŋ à rkuushi wèe buu mò' ce wèe à m rìŋ wɛɛ. Nyʉ̀ à m jà' bèe Isrɛ̀l a fʉr wowêe à to' Ijìp. Ka' yi m ba wa'a, e m ku lo a yʉshi bèe efa wâp mʉ ce a m byemi nè ye ka'.
eng: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn't believe.

lmp: Kuushi nè foŋ enɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a m kani efa rcu mbe dì' ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa wowèe, a ma'shi yap dì' anà nà, Nyʉ̀ à ma' wowèe njep dì' ce ku ba ba tʉ̀'nji tɛ wowèe a ku nòŋ njo nè bshaŋ kù mkoo caar dù bà' à nôŋ gòr ce Nyʉ̀ be sa' ŋgòŋ nà.
eng: Angels who didn't keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

lmp: To' Sodòm ba to' Gòmorà foŋ, ker ba mla' ce mi m ba àgee bto' ca a m ce gèe bsàrbuu, a ce gèe mnyɛ̂r sê. Wowèe a ce yɛ ŋgɛ' njep mor ce àde' yi liitì à nfè' mò' ka'. Cena yi ce dùŋshi sèe yuu ce yi be koni nè bèe ce a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ ŋgèe anà foŋ.
eng: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah, and the cities around them, having, in the same way as these, given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are set forth as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

lmp: Bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka', a ba a wêe mʉ nà, a ce gèe njɛ̀ɛ bsàrbuu ca foŋ. Wowèe a ce yɛ mlo, mlo anà mi ce gèe wowèe a ce bepsi wap mnyor, a kani efa ryu'nì, a ce làa bebep kuu byʉ' ce a ba ce yu'ni nè vi se nà.
eng: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

lmp: Ka' Maikɛ̀l ce e yu tu nè bcìndap nà, e m làa bebep nè Satàn à nfè' ce a ye a m ce sɛr mnsɛr àmbò gʉ̂ʉ Musìs nà ka'. E m làa ba enɛ̂, "Tɛ Nyʉ̀ lapni wɛ̀."
eng: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, May the Lord rebuke you!

lmp: À ka ba yi àmbò bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka' na, wowèe a làa bebep kuu yuu wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a rìŋ ka' nà. Wowèe a yu àmbò mnyàa efa rìŋ ce vi ke gèe buu nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀ ka' nà. Buu ce wowèe a ce gèe na, a buu ce vi ce bepsi wowèe, wowèe a ce bʉ à cicì.
eng: But these speak evil of whatever things they don't know. What they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason, they are destroyed in these things.

lmp: Ndòo be co' wowèe. Wowèe a ce jɛ̀r ba njep mkùu Kɛ̂n. Wowèe a ce gèe buu bbebep tɛ a bo koni mbàa àmbò Balàm à m gèe nà. Wowèe a ce kweŋger njobè' wowèe a tèe btu àmbò Korà à m tèe tu a lo a kwe nà.
eng: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah's rebellion.

lmp: Wèe bèe ca wèe e ke ye byee àbee àmbò bèe Nyʉ̀, yap ŋgèe yi ce coosi wèe. E ke ba à nfè' anà, wowèe a ku ce tɛ' ba wap btu, rìtu yi ce koo wowèe ka'. Wowèe a yu àmbò mmbà' ce vi ke ko', fu' yi càa lor du àgho, mbèŋ ke' gwe ka' nà. Wowèe a yu àmbò bce ce nfè' e ke ghɛɛ ce vi ba yʉ, vi yʉ ka', a co'nì, vi kwe dʉ̀dʉ̀ nà.
eng: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn leaves without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

lmp: Wowèe a yu àmbò ma rdip rgòr ce li ke baŋti, mdip mi ce ko' mbekì ce gwè nà. Yàp buu bbebep yu àmbò mghaa ce rdip li fʉr mbe waa ŋkʉ̀ wa'a. Wowèe a yu àmbò mkàŋsì ce mi ke tɛɛ mbe dî' mo'sir ka' nà. Nyʉ̀ à kupshi dì' mo' nè wowèe; fà dì' anà ku ba ba tʉ̀'nji, à ba dì' ce wowèe a be cu nfesè.
eng: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

lmp: Ɛnòk ce yì ŋgʉ̀ bèe à m ba mbenjì mŋgʉ̀ bêe ntuunfu kɛ' embe ŋgʉ̀ yì Adàm, à m làa yuu a kuu njɛ̀ɛ bèe ca. E m làa enɛ̂, "Tata be vʉ̀ a vi bcìndap à mncʉ̀kì à mncʉ̀kì,
eng: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

lmp: tɛ e bo teni mnsa' bèe wɛɛwɛ. Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka', a ce gèe buu bbebep, a ce làa buu à njî mbembep a kuu Nyʉ̀, a be gwè mnsa' Nyʉ̀."
eng: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.

lmp: Bèe ca a ce rʉ̀'ŋger à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yuu mo' yi ghɛɛte wowèe ka'. Wowèe a gèe yuu ce yàp nyor kòŋ. Wowèe a ce làa nlàa nàa-nyor, a ce bu' cùu tɛ a bo bo' bèe, koni yuu mo' enjo.
eng: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts and their mouth speaks proud things, showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

lmp: Bkar wâ, à ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, kuushi nè buu ce ŋgâa ntuu Tata Jisos Krâis a m suŋ wèe enɛ vi be lò koni nà.
eng: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

lmp: Wowèe a m làa nè wèe enɛ be ba à mnòŋ elʉ̀simbùu tɛ bèe a ba ce a be vʉ̀shi wèe. Bèe anà a be yu'ni nè Nyʉ̀ ka', ce gèe ba yuu ce a kòŋ à rgèe.
eng: They said to you that In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.

lmp: Bèe ca a bèe ce a vʉ̀ nè ŋgàpni à mʉ̀ bèe, a tʉr ba mntee bèe enjep ŋgòŋ. Yʉ' Rara yi yu njep wâp mntee ka'.
eng: These are they who cause divisions, and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

lmp: Bkar wâ, à ka' ba yi àmbò wèe, wèe gheter ja' wêe mnyor tɛ wèe bo tɛɛ à buu Nyʉ̀ ce wèe à byemi, ce vi bòŋ à misî. Ce loo nè à ŋger Yʉ' Rara à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

lmp: Tɛɛ nè ba njep rkòŋnì Nyʉ̀ àmbò wèe ce kè' nfè' ce Tata be koosimnse nè wèe, lòr wèe tɛ wèe wowèe cu nfesè.
eng: Keep yourselves in the love of God, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

lmp: Koosi nè mnse nè bèe ce a ce tarni, nashi wowèe.
eng: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

lmp: Bèe mo' a yu ce wèe à ba fʉr enjep mor, tɛ wowèe a lûŋ. Bèe mo' a yu ce wèe à ba koosi mnse nè wowèe, kèr ce wɛp; kɛ̀ yu wap bcɛ̀' ce vi ce sii njobè' yap ŋgêe bebep ce a ce gèe anà ɛ̀, wèe fa jòo nè bo ka'.
eng: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

lmp: Sèe ku'si Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger à rkè'ni sèe fà dì' sèe gwe ka'. E be lòr wèe tɛ wèe tɛɛ kùntombì nè ye mbe nfè' ce e dùŋshi yi ŋger a ce sa' bèe nà, tɛ wèe tɛɛ wa'a, tʉr fàa ka', ce lu'shi.
eng: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

lmp: Sèe ku'si Nyʉ̀ ce e ku ba mò'sir cà'cà', mò' à ker ba ka'. Yu ye ce e gèe sèe à luŋ njì enjep Tata Jisos Krâis. Tɛ bèe a yu'ni nè ye, ker ku'si ye. Tɛ e ba ŋkʉʉ ce e be sa' sèe, kɛ' efa rkɛ̀' vʉ ba' sè'ni na, ker ba à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

lmp: Cena yu buu ce Jisos Krâis à m gèe bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Nyʉ̀ a rîŋ. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe Jisos Krâis a riŋ buu ca tɛ e bo gèe tɛ bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Nyʉ̀ a riŋ buu ce vi be koni nfè' mʉcàr. Yi ka' ba wa'a, Jisos Krâis à tuu yì ncìndap enɛ e du yɛ Jôn ce e yu yì ŋwɛ̀ rfà', gee tɛ e yɛ buu ca.
eng: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

lmp: Jôn à ka' yɛ, a suŋ bèe. E m saŋ ba blàa ce vi m lò ese Nyʉ̀, Jisòs à suŋ ye.
eng: who testified to God's word, and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' be' blàa ca banɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ Mbôŋtu. Bèe ce a ka' yu' blàa ca, gee àmbò vi làa banɛ wowèe a yu ŋgâa Mbôŋtu njobè' nfè' ce buu ca vi be koni ku bɛti mʉcàr.
eng: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is at hand.

lmp: Ŋwà' ca à saŋ mɛ̂ Jôn nè bcor sàambâ, ce vi yu à ŋgôŋ Ɛsìyà. M ce loo mɛnɛ Nyʉ̀ tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè wèe ker fa wèe cumʉnyaŋ. Ku ba ye ce e yu sè'ni na, à ker ba Nyʉ̀ ce e m ba, à ku ker ba ye ce e be kè vʉ̀. Buu ca à lò foŋ ese Byʉ' sàambâ, ce vi tɛɛ kùntombì nè yi kàbàrà'.
eng: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace, from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

lmp: Vi lò foŋ ese Jisos Krâis ce e ke suŋ buu ce vi yu mini, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m fʉʉ efa rkwe entombì, a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce sa' bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ. M ce yòŋshi ye ce e m kòŋ sèe, a kwe a sêe btù a fʉr sèe efa buu bbebep nè vi blɛɛ.
eng: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood;

lmp: E gèe sèe à ba bèe ce e ce sa' sèe àmbò ŋkʉʉ, a ker gee sèe à ba ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yì Tâ. Tɛ fòo yi ba nè Jisòs, tɛ ŋger yi ba nè ye foŋ à nfè' sìp. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father; to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

lmp: Yɛ̂, e ce vʉ̀ mbe mʉ̀ mmbà'. Bèe wɛɛwɛ a be yɛ ye. Bèe ce a m sòp ye nè rkòŋ a be yɛ ye foŋ. Bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na a be war enɛ a m ba riŋ a m ba byemi nè ye. Ɛ̀no, yi yu wa'a.
eng: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

lmp: Ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mbà mmbo Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tâ. E yu sè'ni na. E m ba, à ku ba ye ce e be kè vʉ̀. E m làa enɛ̂, "A mɛ̀ Alfà a ker ba Òmɛgà."
eng: I am the Alpha and the Omega, says the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.

lmp: A mɛ̀ Jôn ce m yu nfʉr wèe, sèe à ba àbee àtu Jisos Krâis. Sèe yu àbee à ŋgɛ' ce sèe ce yɛ. Jisos Krâis yu yìsèe ŋkʉʉ. Sèe ce yɛ ŋgɛ' ca wa'a, a ke' ce sɛ̀ ka'. À m ba à nfè' mò', a koo mɛ̀ a du àgho à dì' mo' ce a m ce too enɛ Patmòs ce rdip rgòr li m sìr a kaari a tarte. A m koo mɛ̀ a du àgho àfo njobè' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce mɛ̀ m ce fè'shi kuu Jisos Krâis.
eng: I John, your brother and partner with you in oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God's Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

lmp: À ka' ba nyʉ̀ mmbomntaa Nyʉ̀, mɛ̀ ba mbà mmbo Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, a yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à làa embe mɛ̂ njì àmbò rsòŋ wa'a, enɛ̂,
eng: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

lmp: "Lòr ŋwà', saŋ buu ce wɛ̀ yɛ mbo, tuusi nè bcor ce à rla' Ɛfɛsòs, ba Sìmainà, ba Pɛgamòm, ba Tàitirà, ba Sadìs, ba Fìlàdɛlfìyà ker ba à rla' Làodisìyà."
eng: saying, What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' yu' njèndoŋ ca a karsi nyor tɛ m bo yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce làa. Mɛ̀ ka' karsi nyor a yɛ mʉ njɛ̀ɛ btɛbùr ce a ke tooshi blam mbo vi sàambâ. A m gèe mʉ btɛbùr ca nè bco' ce a too enɛ gûl.
eng: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lampstands.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' fyɛ' a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' à tɛɛ mbetar btɛbùr ca a ba àmbò muu ŋwɛ̀ wa'a. E m mà' sàaro à nyòr, a cʉʉ kʉ̀ cɛ̀' ce a gèe nè gûl, nje ŋgùŋ.
eng: And among the lampstands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

lmp: Yi nyʉ̀'tu yi m ce fʉp àmbò mmbà', mi mmir mi ba àmbò mcùŋ mor wa'a.
eng: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

lmp: Mi mkùu mi m ce là'ŋger àmbò bco' ce ŋgâa ntòo nlàa a kupshi wa'a. Yì njèndoŋ à m ba àmbò njèndoŋ rdip ce li ke gwè à rkoŋ wa'a.
eng: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

lmp: E m tʉr mkàŋsì sàamba mbà bo mà', sà' mbyɛ̀rɛŋ à fʉʉ eku yê cùu. Vi bsii vi m ce raa àmbò nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ nèmootì nà.
eng: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' yɛ ye, a gwe a noŋ njep yê tìi àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce e kwe wa'a. E lɛ yi bo mà' mbe mɛ̂ ndù a laa enɛ̂, "Fa wɛp ka', m yu ŋwɛ̀ entòmbì a ba ŋwɛ̀ elʉ̀simbùu.
eng: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, Don't be afraid. I am the first and the last,

lmp: M yu ŋwɛ̂ ntèe. Mɛ̀ m kwe a kʉti ntèe, cu nfesè. Rkwe ker ba ŋgòŋ byir a yu mba mɛ̂ mmbò.
eng: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forevermore. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

lmp: Saŋ buu ce wɛ̀ yɛ na mbe ŋwà'. Saŋ buu ce vi be koni sè'ni ker ba buu ce vi bii ka' koni.
eng: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter;

lmp: Wɛ̀ yɛ mkàŋsì ce m tʉr mbà bo mà' a ker yɛ mʉ btɛbùr sàamba ce a ke tooshi blam mbo nà. M be suŋ wɛ̀ mbùu efa buu ca. Mkàŋsì sàamba ca mi tɛɛ àtu bcìndap sàamba ce a ce kè'ni bcor sàambâ, mʉ btɛbùr sàamba ca à ba bcor sàambâ."
eng: the mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lampstands. The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lampstands are seven assemblies.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m yɛ nà à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Saŋ ŋwà' nè ncìndap embe cor à rla' Ɛfɛsòs enɛ̂, "Cena yu ba blàa ce vi lò ese ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr mkàŋsì sàamba mbà bo mà' a ce jɛ̀r mbe mʉ̀ mʉ btɛbùr blam ce a gèe nè gûl.
eng: To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lampstands says these things:

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ ye ŋgèe. Mɛ̀ rìŋ àmbò wèe à kur ntee a fa' a ke' ce sɛ̀ ka'. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe ce mà'shi bêe bbebep a wêe mʉ ka'. Wèe à fyɛ' bèe ce a ce làa enɛ wowèe a yu ŋgâa ntuu Jisòs nà, a yɛ enɛ wowèe a ce bo'shi bo'shi.
eng: I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can't tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ ŋgɛ' ce wèe ce yɛ. Mɛ̀ rìŋ fùp ce e koo wèe. Yi yu mini ghup enɛ wèe yu ŋgâa fùp ka'. Nyʉ̀ à ghòni wèe magòr sê. Mɛ̀ rìŋ buu bbebep ce bèe ce a ce lòr wap btu enɛ a wowèe Jus nà a ce làa àmbò wèe. Wowèe a yu Jus ka', a yu ba bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Satàn.
eng: I know your works, oppression, and your poverty but you are rich, and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ dì' ce wèe ce cu, à dì' ce Satàn cu mbe kàbàrà'. Wèe à kani mɛ̀ efa rba yè ŋkʉʉ ka'. A m yʉ Antipàs ce e m byemi nè mɛ̀ njobè' e m suŋ bèe enɛ e ce dù a mɛ̂ mbùu. Ka' a m yʉ ye ba fàdì' wèe ce cu, à ba dì' ce Satàn ye ye ce cu wa'a, wèe à ku tʉr ntee njep mɛ̀.
eng: I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan's throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn't deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ ye ŋgèe. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ wèe kòŋ mɛ̀, a riŋ mɛnɛ wèe ku tɛɛ njep le rbyemì, a riŋ rfà' ce wèe ce gèe, a riŋ mɛnɛ wèe ce kur ntee sê. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ ŋgèe ce wèe ce gèe sè'ni na yi bòŋ a caa yì ce wèe à m ce gèe entòmbì.
eng: I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

lmp: Wèe fa buumi ka'. Lɛ' nè, tapsi ryòŋ cor ce li bɛti nà, fà dì' li ba'si kwe ka'. Mɛ̀ yɛ mɛnɛ ye ŋgèe yi ghɛɛte à bsii Nyʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Wake up, and keep the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

lmp: Banɛ wèe kuushi buu ce a yɛ'ni wèe, wèe à byemì nà. Gèe nè buu anà, ker kupse ye ntee, buwa'làr m lo bʉʉ wèe bʉ̀ʉ àmbò nyɛ̀ɛ wa'a. Wèe be rìŋ nfè' ce m be vʉ̀ ka'.
eng: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it, and repent. If therefore you won't watch, I will come as a thief, and you won't know what hour I will come upon you.

lmp: Mʉ bèe mo' a ku bii à rla' Sadìs, ce a siisi wap bcɛ̀' ka'. Bèe ca a be mà' bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ tɛ wèr wowèe ce jɛ̀r njobè' a bèe ce a ghɛɛte à rgèe wa'a.
eng: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that did not defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛɛ tatap, caa rmòoshì banɛ m be fa ŋgàŋ bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ à nyor, kè' siŋsi li rlii embe ŋwà' ryòŋ ka'. M be tɛɛ kùntombì nè yà Ta ba vi bcìndap, làa àwaŋ mɛnɛ ŋwɛ̀ anà yu yà.
eng: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù' ŋgàŋ yu' yuu ce Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi ce làa nè bcor wɛɛwɛ." "
eng: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce mɛ̀ m yɛ nà à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Saŋ ŋwà' nè ncìndap embe cor à rla' Fìlàdɛlfìyà enɛ̂, "Cena yu blàa ce vi lò ese ŋwɛ̂ nrara, a ker ba ŋwɛ̀ mini. E tʉr bki Dɛvìd mba yê mmbò. E ka' mʉ' kèŋ, ŋwɛ̀ cetè ka', e ka' cete, ŋwɛ̀ mʉ' ka'.
eng: To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

lmp: Mɛ̀ rìŋ ye ŋgèe. Mɛ̀ rìŋ mɛnɛ ka' wèe tʉr ŋger gòr ka' wa'a, wèe à yu' wa blàa. Wèe à m be mɛŋni mɛ̀ à nfè' mò' ka'. Yɛ̂, mɛ̀ mʉ̀' kèŋ nè wèe, ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ba ce àde' e ker cete ka'.
eng: I know your works behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut, that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn't deny my name.

lmp: M rìŋ ye ŋgèe. Wèe ce fʉte ka', a ke' ce lùu ka'. Mɛ̂ kòŋ mɛnɛ wèe à ka' tɛ ce lùu ka', wèe ce fʉte.
eng: I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

lmp: Yì anà yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ ka' nàa mmir fyɛ' mbekì, a yɛ àmbò ncʉ̀ʉndʉ̀' embe bùu yi mʉ̀'ti. Mɛ̀ ker yu' njèndoŋ ce e m làa nè mɛ̀ a ba àmbò rsòŋ li ke làa nà. Ŋwɛ̀ anà à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ mbena tɛ m duŋshi wɛ̀ buu ce vi bii ka' koni."
eng: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven, and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.

lmp: À ka' ba à nfè' anà mɛ̀ ba ba mbà mmbo Yʉ' Nyʉ̀. A ka' kè', a yɛ kàbàrà', ŋwɛ̀ à cu mbo.
eng: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

lmp: Bsii ŋwɛ̀ anà vi m ce là'ŋger àmbò kwakwa' wa'a, a ce bàŋ àmbò nlòp wa'a. Ghùghumbèŋ yi m kaari kàbàrà' anà a tarte, ncòo efa gho à ba àmbò ncòo kàkar wa'a.
eng: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

lmp: Bkàbàrà' mo' ce vi m ba ncòp-kyèe-à-mmbaa vi m kaari kàbàrà' ca a tarte. Bêe bgòrgòr ce a m ba ncòp-kyèe-à-mmbaa a m cute mbe bkàbàrà' anà a yar bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ. Wowèe a m sòp mtaa kʉʉ ce a m gèe nè gûl.
eng: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò mbèŋ ce bàpŋger a ce rʉ̀ʉŋger, a ce waŋger embe kàbàrà'. Mɛ̀ yɛ bturkaŋ sàamba àmbò vi tɛɛte kùntombì nè kàbàrà' a ce raa. Bturkaŋ anà vi tɛɛ àtu byʉ' Nyʉ̀ ce vi yu sàambâ.
eng: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' kè' a yɛ ma rdip mo' li ce raa, ce tose àmbò glâs wa'a. Li m ba kùntombì nè kàbàrà'. Buu btèe vi m tɛɛ bdì' kyèe a kaari kàbàrà' anà a tarte. Buu btèe anà vi m tʉr mmir àŋgoo sê. Mmir mo' mi m ba kùntombì, mmo' mi ba mbenjì.
eng: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the midst of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

lmp: Efa mʉ̀ buu btèe ca, yì entombì yi m feese bʉrʉ̀'. Yì embenjì yi feesè nduu nà'. Yì embenjì yì ce e m feese nduu nà' nà à tʉr bsii vi feesè bsii ŋwɛ̀. Yì elʉ̀simbùu à ba àmbò wàawa mŋkùr ce e ce fɛŋ wa'a.
eng: The first creature was like a lion, and the second creature like a calf, and the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

lmp: Buu btèe ce vi m ba kyèe anà vi m tʉr bbàp ntuunfu ntuunfu, mmir mi ba àgho àŋgoo sê. Mmo' mi m ba mbendù bbàp, mmo' mi ba nje mʉ̀ bbàp. Vi m ce yòp yɛɛ a ce buumi à nfè' mò' ka', kɛ̀ nètʉ' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ nèmootì ɛ̀. Vi m ce yòp enɛ̂, "Nyʉ̀ yu nrara, Nyʉ̀ yu nrara, Nyʉ̀ yu nrara, ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mbà mmbo Tata Nyʉ̀. E m ba, a ba àgho sè'ni na, à ku ba ye ce e be vʉ̀."
eng: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!

lmp: Buu btèe anà vi yop yɛɛ a ce kù'si a ker ce yòŋshi ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe kàbàrà', à ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e ku ba ntèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ nà.
eng: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

lmp: A ka' ce yòp wa'a, bêe bgòrgòr ce ncòp-kyèe-à-mmbaa cà a ce gʉ'shi njeptii ŋwɛ̀ ce e cu mbe kàbàrà' a ba ntèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ nà a ce kù'si ye. Wowèe a co'nì map mtaa kʉʉ embe tù, a lɛ njeptii ŋwɛ̀ anà, a yop yɛɛ enɛ̂,
eng: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne, and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

lmp: "Wɛ̂ yèr Tata Nyʉ̀, wɛ̀ ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe a ba kù'si wɛ̀, nɛ̀si wɛ̀, a ker ghɛɛte à rtʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ, njobè' a wɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ m gèe buu wɛɛwɛ, a kwa'shi enɛ buu anà ba àgho."
eng: Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed, and were created!

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ fù ŋwà' mbà bo mà' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe kàbàrà' nà. A m saŋ ŋwà' mbo mbèp bsìp, a kar àmbò a ke kar rwàa nà, a siŋ bcùu efa gho nè nlàadoŋ bdì' sàambâ.
eng: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m tʉr ŋger magòr sê. E m waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ghɛɛte à rnàa nlàadoŋ ce a sìŋ bcùu fù ŋwà' àgho nà, bʉ̀r ŋwà' anà yu nda?"
eng: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à ke' ba mbe bùu, kɛ̀ njep ŋgòŋ na, kɛ̀ mbà yir ce e m ghɛɛte à rbʉ̀r ŋwà' anà, fyɛ' mbo ka'.
eng: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book, or to look in it.

lmp: Mɛ̀ war sê, njobè' ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ghɛɛte à rbʉ̀r ŋwà' ca fyɛ' mbo ka'.
eng: And I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book, or to look in it.

lmp: Awɛ ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr mò' efa mʉ̀ bêe bgòrgòr ca à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Fa war ka'. Yɛ̂, ŋwɛ̀ ce a too enɛ bʉrʉ̀' ce yu yî à ŋgôŋ Judà, a ba muu rlii embe ndʉ̀' Dɛvìd nà, à so. E be nàa nlàadoŋ ce a sìŋ bcùu ŋwà' àgho bdì' sàamba nà, bʉ̀r ŋwà' anà."
eng: One of the elders said to me, Don't weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome; he who opens the book and its seven seals.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ muu njèe àgee kàbàrà' ca. Buu btèe cà ba bêe bgòrgòr cà a sir njèe anà a kaari a tarte. Njèe anà à m ce yɛɛti àmbò yì ce a sɛɛ wa'a. E m tʉr mndoŋ sàambâ, a tʉr mmir sàambâ. Mndoŋ ba mmir ca mi tɛɛ àtu byʉ' Nyʉ̀ ce vi yu sàambâ, a tuusì vi à bdì' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na nà.
eng: I saw in the midst of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns, and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

lmp: Njèe anà à du a koo ŋwà' ca embà bo mà' ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe kàbàrà' nà.
eng: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

lmp: E ka' koo, buu btèe cà ba bêe bgòrgòr cà a gwe njeptii njèe anà. Wowèe a m tʉr rluŋ rmo'sir rmo'sir, a ker tʉr ghee ce a gèe nè gul yi mo'sir mo'sir, mgʉr mo' ce mi m ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ sê, mi ba njo, a tɛɛ àtu rloo bèe Nyʉ̀.
eng: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

lmp: Wowèe a yop yɛɛ fi enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ghɛɛte à rlòr fù ŋwà', nàa nlàadoŋ ce a sìŋ bcùu efa gho àgho nà, njobè' a m sɛɛ wɛ̀, wɛ̀ lor wo blɛɛ a yuu bèe àgho nè Nyʉ̀. Wɛ̀ yuu wowèe à mntɛ̀' wɛɛwɛ, ce vi yu à bto' wɛɛwɛ a ce làa bli jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: They sang a new song, saying, You are worthy to take the book, and to open its seals: for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood, out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

lmp: Wɛ̀ gèe wowèe a ba bèe ce à ce sa' wowèe à yàp ŋkʉʉ, a ker gee wowèe a ba ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì tɛ a bo fà' nè Nyʉ̀. Wowèe a be sa' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na."
eng: and made us kings and priests to our God, and we will reign on earth.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ker fyɛ' a yu' njèndoŋ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a m ba à mncʉ̀kì à mncʉ̀kì. Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ca a sir kàbàrà' ba buu btèe cà, ba bêe bgòrgòr cà a fa mbetar,
eng: I saw, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders; and the number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands;

lmp: a yop se enɛ̂, "Muu Njèe ce a m sɛɛ nà à ghɛɛte à rkoni ŋger ba ku' buu ba bfee. E ghɛɛte à ŋwɛ̀ ce a ba kù'si ye, yòŋshi ye."
eng: saying with a loud voice, Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò buu wɛɛwɛ embe bùu ce Nyʉ̀ à m gèe ba vì enjep ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ, ba vì embà yir wɛɛwɛ ba vì enjep rò wɛɛwɛ vi ce yòp enɛ̂, "Sèe yoŋshi Nyʉ̀ ce e cu mbe kàbàrà', ker ba muu njèe. Sèe yu'ni nè wowèe, ku'si wowèe, riŋ enɛ wowèe a tʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ. Sèe gee wa'a nfesè."
eng: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, To him who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!

lmp: Buu btèe ce kyèe cà vi laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa'a." Vi ka' làa wa'a, bêe bgòrgòr cà a gʉ'shì nè wowèe.
eng: The four living creatures said, Amen! The elders fell down and worshiped.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' kè' a yɛ àmbò muu njèe à nàa nlàadoŋ yì entòmbì efa mʉ̀ vî sàambâ. E ka' nàa, mɛ̀ yu' àmbò mò' efa buu btèe ce vi m ba kyèe nà à làa, njèndoŋ à rʉʉŋgèr àmbò mbèŋ wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀!"
eng: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, Come and see!

lmp: Mɛ̀ fyɛ' a yɛ nyàabàrâ' mbʉʉ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe ndù mo à tʉr ŋgʉʉ mbà bò. A m fa ye rtaa ce a ke fa nè bèe ce a mà' bìr a so nà. E caŋ mbe nyàabàrà' anà a ce mà' bìr tɛ e bo kèr so.
eng: And behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came forth conquering, and to conquer.

lmp: Muu jèe ca à ka' kèr nàa nlàadoŋ yì embenjì, mɛ̀ yu' àmbò yuu tèe mo' yi làa enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀!"
eng: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, Come!

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò nyàabàrâ' mbeer à vʉ̀. A m fa ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe nyàabàrà' anà ŋger enɛ e gee tɛ cumʉnyaŋ mi enjep ŋgòŋ na tɛ bèe a bo ce yʉshi wap mnyor. A m fa ye ma kàafà'.
eng: Another came forth, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

lmp: Muu Njèe ca à ka' kèr nàa nlàadoŋ mo', mɛ̀ yu' àmbò yuu tèe mo' yi làa enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀!" Mɛ̀ ker fyɛ' a yɛ nyàabàrâ' nsii. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbo à m tʉr ndoŋ ce a ke fè' buu njo mbà bo.
eng: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, Come and see! And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' yuu mo' yi fʉʉ e mbetar buu btèe anà àmbò njèndoŋ wa'a, a laa enɛ̂, "Bèe a be lòr mbàa ce a fà' à nòŋ, yuu ndoŋ sàa àgho mò'sir, buwa'làr a yuu mndoŋ msaŋ vi btaar. Fa bepsi mgʉr ba mrù' ka'."
eng: I heard a voice in the midst of the four living creatures saying, A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don't damage the oil and the wine!

lmp: Muu Njèe ca à ka' nàa nlàadoŋ mò', mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ yuu tèe mo' à làa enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀!"
eng: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, Come and see!

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' kè' a yɛ nyàabàrà', ncòo efa gho à ba jìpri. A m ce too rlii ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbo enɛ Rkwe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce a m ce too enɛ Mbà Yir à ce vʉ̀ mbe yê njì. A m fa wowèe ŋger mbendù ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa bdì' kyèe efa bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na, enɛ a yʉshi wowèe nè kàafà', gee tɛ wowèe a kwe njè, kwe byaŋ, vʉ̀ nè mnyàa efa rìŋ a wâp mʉ.
eng: And behold, a pale horse, and he who sat on it, his name was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

lmp: Muu Njèe ca à ker naa nlàadoŋ mo', mɛ̀ yɛ myòŋ bèe ce a m yʉshi njo' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce wowèe a m ce fè'shi. Myòŋ anà mi m ba njeptii dì' ce a ke taŋshi taŋshì nè nyàa, sɛɛ mbo.
eng: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

lmp: Wowèe a waa, enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ Tata Nyʉ̀ ce à tʉr ŋger, a ba ŋwɛ̂ mini, a ba nrara, wèr be cu mbena dù bà' à nfè' efɛ tɛ à ka' sa' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ, fa wowèe ŋgɛ' njobè' wowèe a m yʉshi wèr?"
eng: They cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?

lmp: A lor bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ a fa wowèe e mo'sir mo'sir, a laa nè wowèe enɛ wowèe a tɛɛ nfè' mʉcàr njobè' bèe mo' efa bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a be mìsi yʉshi àmbò a m yʉshi wowèe nà a ku bɛti.
eng: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ker yɛ àmbò Muu Njèe à nàa nlàadoŋ mo'. E ka' nàa, ŋgòŋ yi ci'tì sê, nyʉ̀ à sii àmbò cɛ̂' sii wa'a, ŋwɛɛ yi baŋ àmbò blɛɛ wa'a.
eng: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

lmp: Mkàŋsì mi gweŋgèr à nshè àmbò piya ce fu' tatap yi ke càa ceni embe ce mber nà wa'a.
eng: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

lmp: Rbuu li karŋgèr àmbò ŋwɛ̀ ce kar lɛ rwàa wa'a, a bʉ, mtùu wɛɛwɛ ba njɛ̀ɛ ŋgòŋ ce rdip li ke sìr kaari tarte nà, yi ci'tì a nati embe dì' yi m ba.
eng: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island were moved out of their places.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m caŋse a du a sʉnî. Bkʉʉ ba bêe bgòrgòr, ba bèe ce a m ba btu nè bsoogɛ̀, ba ŋgâa mbàa, ba bèe ce a m tʉr ŋger à rgèe buu, ba bkwàa ba boo a m caŋse a du a sʉni à mmbʉ̀', bèe mo' a sʉnì njeptii myɛɛ.
eng: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

lmp: Wowèe a war a kɛ' mtùu ba myɛɛ a laa enɛ̂, "Gwè nè mbe wêr ndù, cete wèr, fà dì' ŋwɛ̀ ce e cu mbe kàbàrà' yɛ wèr, tɛ Muu Njèe bepsi ntee, fa wèr ŋgɛ' àtu yèr buu bbebep ka'.
eng: They told the mountains and the rocks, Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

lmp: Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce wowèe a be dùŋshi lap rshentee. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e be tʉr ŋger à rjà' yi tu a nda?"
eng: for the great day of his wrath has come; and who is able to stand?

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ vi kyèe àmbò a tɛɛte à mmbuu ŋgòŋ kyèe. A m tɛɛ wa'a, a cete fu' ce yi ke vʉ̂ à mmbuu ŋgòŋ anà, fà dì' yi bo kèr ce càa ka'. Fu' yi m ker caa mbendù nshe kɛ̀ mbendù mdip enjep rò ka', a ker ce cì' bce foŋ ka'.
eng: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' àmbò e nyɛɛ ekù mbùuntii, a tʉr rkɛ̀ɛ Nyʉ̀ ce e yu ntèe. À m ba rkɛ̀ɛ ce a ke fa ncòo bèe Nyʉ̀ àgho. E m fuŋ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a m ba bèe ŋkyèe, ce Nyʉ̀ à m fa wowèe ŋger enɛ a bepsi bûu à nshè ba buu enjep rò nà.
eng: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

lmp: E m làa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Wèe fa bepsi nshe kɛ̀ mdip, kɛ̀ bce ka', caar tɛ wèr fa mncòo à mnsàpsi bèe ce a ce fà' nè yèr Nyʉ̀."
eng: saying, Don't harm the earth, neither the sea, nor the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' mɛnɛ bèe ce a m fa wowèe ncòo nje nsàpsi nà a m ba ncʉ̀kì- rjèe-nè-ncʉ̀kì-ncòp-kyèe-à-mŋkyèe. Bèe ca a m ba bèe efa mntɛ̀' bèe Isrɛ̀l wɛɛwɛ.
eng: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

lmp: Bèe embe ntɛ̀' mò'sir ce a m fa wowèe ncòo anà a m ba ncʉ̀kì-ncòp- baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ. Mntɛ̀' anà vi m ba à njɛ̀ɛ enɛ̂: ntɛ̀' Judà, ntɛ̀' Rubɛ̀n, ntɛ̀' Gâd,
eng: of the tribe of Judah were sealed twelve thousand, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' kèr fyɛ' a yɛ ku' bèe ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ be' ka'. Bèe anà à m ba bèe efa bto' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, ba mntɛ̀' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, ce a m ce làa bli jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛ. Wowèe a m tɛɛ kùntombì nè kàbàrà' ba Muu Njèe, a yar bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ, a tʉr bbàp mtɛɛ à mmbò.
eng: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude, which no man could number, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

lmp: Wowèe wɛɛwɛ a ce yòp mbekì a ce làa enɛ̂, "Rlùŋ li lò ese Nyʉ̀ ce e cu mbe kàbàrà', ker ba ese Muu Njèe."
eng: They cried with a loud voice, saying, Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!

lmp: Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ wowo a m sìr kàbàrà', ba bêe bgòrgòr, ba buu btèe ce vi m ba kyèe nà, a kaari a tarte. A ka' sìr, a gʉ'shi nè Nyʉ̀,
eng: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

lmp: a ce làa enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa'a. Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce bèe a ba yòŋshi, kù'si. E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e tʉr bfee wɛɛwɛ. Bèe a ba yòŋshi ye à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, yu'ni nè ye, kèr rìŋ enɛ e tʉr ŋger wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a."
eng: saying, Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.

lmp: Mò' efa bêe bgòrgòr ca à bipshì nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ rìŋ njɛ̀ɛ bèe ce a yar bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ na a? Wowèe a vʉ̀ efɛ?"
eng: One of the elders answered, saying to me, These who are arrayed in white robes, who are they, and from where did they come?

lmp: Mɛ̀ beesì a laa nè ye mɛnɛ̂, "Masà, ŋwɛ̀ ce e rìŋ yu ba wɛ̀." E laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Bèe ca yu bèe ce a fʉʉ efa ku' ŋgɛ' ce e càa ŋger. Wowèe a sù'si wap bcɛ̀' nè blɛɛ Muu Njèe, vi ce fʉp.
eng: I told him, My lord, you know. He said to me, These are those who came out of the great tribulation. They washed their robes, and made them white in the Lamb's blood.

lmp: A mbùu ce wowèe a tʉr ŋger à rtɛɛ kùntombì nè kàbàrà' Nyʉ̀, ce fà' nè ye mbe yê ndàp nètʉ' ba nèmootì. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e cu mbe kàbàrà' be ba a wowèe, sʉ̀ti wowèe fà dì' yuu mo' yi bo jòo wowèe ka'.
eng: Therefore they are before the throne of God, they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

lmp: Njè be kèr yaŋ wowèe ka'. Ntee mdip yi be kèr lùu wowèe ka'. Nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ na be tòo wowèe ka'.
eng: They will never be hungry, neither thirsty any more; neither will the sun beat on them, nor any heat;

lmp: Muu Njèe ce e yu àgee kàbàrà' be cìŋ wowèe àmbò gày wa'a. E be lòr wowèe dù àgho fà rdip ce li ke fʉʉ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce fa ryòŋ ce nfesè. Nyʉ̀ be siŋsi mŋgoommir ese wowèe wɛɛwɛ."
eng: for the Lamb who is in the midst of the throne shepherds them, and leads them to springs of waters of life. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, Muu Njèe à naa nlàadoŋ yì elʉ̀simbùu efa vî sàamba cà. E ka' nàa, ŋgòŋ embe bùu yi noŋ enɛ nyòŋ-ŋ-ŋ, yuu yi ce kàra' ka' à mʉ nfè' mò'.
eng: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ sàamba ce a ke tɛɛ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀. A m fa wowèe msòŋ sàambâ.
eng: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mô' jɛɛ à vʉ a tɛɛ mbe dì' ce a ke fa rfa nè Nyʉ̀, a tʉr rkîŋ ntòo nrɛ̀ɛ ce a m gèe nè gûl. A lor ku' nrɛ̀ɛ a fa ye, ye ye à lor nrɛ̀ɛ anà a fiŋshi à mʉ̀ mloo ce bèe Nyʉ̀ a ce loo, a fa nè Nyʉ̀ mbe dì' rfa ce a gèe nè gûl, yi ba kùntombì nè kàbàrà'.
eng: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

lmp: E too nrɛ̀ɛ anà, nje efa gho yi natì a mloo àbee embà bo ncìndap Nyʉ̀, a ko' kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel's hand.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à koo mor embe dì' ce a ke fa rfa, a lɛ njep rkìŋ anà a ma' njep ŋgòŋ. E ka' mà', mbèŋ à rʉʉŋgèr, a bapŋger, a waŋger, nshe à ci'tì.
eng: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, and threw it on the earth. There followed thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, bcìndap Nyʉ̀ sàamba ce a m tʉr msòŋ sàamba nà a tamì nyor à rfyɛp msòŋ anà.
eng: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì entombì a fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, a lor mghòo ba mor ba blɛɛ, a tarshi a ma' njep nshè. Ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa nshè à shê. Ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa bce à she foŋ, mjɛɛ mi she wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burnt up, and one third of the trees were burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì embenjì à fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, a lor yuu mo' ce yi m ce she a feese ma rtùu, a ma' njep rdip rgòr.
eng: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

lmp: A ka' mà', ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa rdip anà à beeŋgèr à blɛɛ. Ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa buu btèe enjep rò vi kweŋgèr wɛɛwɛ. Ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa bkeŋ enjep rò vi bep wɛɛwɛ.
eng: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ embenjì mo à fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, ma rkàŋsì ce li m ce kɛti àmbò rsùsùŋ wa'a, li gwe embe bùu. Li m gwè mbendù ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa mdip ker ba fàdì' mdip mi ke fʉʉ.
eng: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of the waters.

lmp: Rlii rkàŋsì anà li m ba enɛ̂, "Ŋgʉ̀ cece'." Rkàŋsì anà li m gèe ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa mdip mi ce'. Bèe magòr a m no mdip anà a kweŋger njobè' mi m ce ce'.
eng: The name of the star is called Wormwood. One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ embenjì mo à fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, yuu mo' yi kuu nyʉ̀, ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa gho à sii, a ke' ker saŋ ka', a kuu ŋwɛɛ, ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa gho à sii, a ke' ker saŋ ka', a kuu mkàŋsì, ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa gho à sii, a ke' ker raa ka'. Ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar e nèmootì ba ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar e nètʉ' a ke' ker raa ka'.
eng: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars; so that one third of them would be darkened, and the day wouldn't shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' fyɛ' a yɛ wàawa mŋkùr àmbò e ce fɛŋ mbe bùu. E ka' ce fɛŋ wa'a, a waa enɛ̂, "Ŋgɛ', ŋgɛ', ŋgɛ'." Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a bɛti a taar nà a be lò fyɛp msòŋ map tɛ yi ba bebep nè bèe ce a ce cu njep ŋgòŋ.
eng: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, Woe! Woe! Woe for those who dwell on the earth, because of the other voices of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ embenjì mo à fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, mɛ̀ yɛ rkàŋsì àmbò li sùu embe bùu a gwe à nshè. A fa bki ce rkàŋsì anà li bo mʉ̀' cùu rwee àgho. Rwee anà li m coomi sê, lʉ̀simbùu à ba àgho ka'.
eng: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

lmp: Rkàŋsì anà li ka' mʉ̀' rwee anà, njemor yi fʉʉ enjo àmbò nje efa mor fòo wa'a. Njemor anà yi ka' fʉʉ wa'a, a cete rbuu wɛɛwɛ, rlir nyʉ̀ li ke' ker yɛɛti ka'.
eng: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

lmp: Mŋguu vi fʉʉ embe mʉ̀ njemor anà a suu njep ŋgòŋ. A m fa mŋguu anà ŋger enɛ vi tashi bèe àmbò nyobsaa enjep ŋgòŋ na wa'a.
eng: Then out of the smoke came forth locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

lmp: A m làa nè mŋguu ca enɛ vi fa jòo yuu ce yi fʉʉ enjep nshè a ce kù' ka'. A m mà'shi enɛ vi fa ŋgɛ' ba nè bèe ce a m buu ncòo Nyʉ̀ nje nsàpsi.
eng: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don't have God's seal on their foreheads.

lmp: A m mà'shi enɛ mŋguu vi yʉ bèe ca ka'. A m làa enɛ vi fa bèe ca ba ŋgɛ' à mŋwɛɛ tâ. Ŋgɛ' anà à m ba àmbò njɛ̀ɛ ryaŋ ce ŋwɛ̀ ce nyobsaa à ta e ke yu' nà.
eng: They were given power not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion, when it strikes a person.

lmp: Be ba à mŋwɛɛ ta anà tɛ wowèe a roo rkwe, yɛ ka'. Wowèe a be kòŋ à rkwe tɛ rkwe li tɛɛ wowèe.
eng: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

lmp: Mŋguu anà vi m ba àmbò mnyàabàrà' ce a ba'shi tɛ a bo dù bìr àgho wa'a. Mtaa ce mŋguu anà vi m sòp mi feesè mtaa kʉʉ ce a gèe nè gûl. Wap bsii vi m feese bsii ŋwɛ̀.
eng: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people's faces.

lmp: Yap nyʉ̀'tu yi m feese nyʉ̀'tu njeŋwɛ̀; map msòŋ mi feesè msòŋ bʉrʉ̀'.
eng: They had hair like women's hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

lmp: A m cete yàp ŋgùŋ nè bco' ce ŋgâa mà' bìr a ke cete ŋgùŋ àgho, wap bbàp vi ce còo àmbò njɛ̀ɛ mutù mntaaŋguu ce ŋgâa mà' bìr a ke dù bìr cu mbo, mnyàabàrà' vi ce sʉ̀ŋ nà.
eng: They had breastplates, like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of chariots, or of many horses rushing to war.

lmp: Vi m tʉr mŋkùŋ àmbò mŋkùŋ nyobsaa wa'a. Vi m tashi bèe nè mŋkùŋ anà, a fa wowèe ŋgɛ' àgho à mŋwɛɛ tâ.
eng: They have tails like those of scorpions, and stings. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

lmp: Ŋkʉʉ ce e ce sa' wowèe yu ncìndap mbembep ce e ce sa' njep rwee ce lʉ̀simbùu yu àgho ka' nà. A too li rlii à li Hibrù enɛ Àbadòn, too à li Grêk enɛ Àpolìyòn; mbùu efa gho à ba enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ rbepsì."
eng: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is Abaddon, but in Greek, he has the name Apollyon.

lmp: Cena a ŋgɛ' entombì efa mŋgɛ' ce vi be koni. Mŋgɛ' ce vi bii ka' koni vi bɛti vi bbaa.
eng: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ embenjì mo à fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, mɛ̀ yu' njèndoŋ àmbò e vʉ̂ à mmbur kyèe embe dì' rfa ce a m gèe nè gûl, yi tɛɛ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

lmp: Njèndoŋ anà à laa nè ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m tʉr rsòŋ nà enɛ̂, "Bà'shi nè bcìndap bbebep ce a m kur a lɛ àwâa rò ce a too enɛ Yufrɛtìs nà efa bkʉ̀."
eng: saying to the sixth angel who had one trumpet, Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!

lmp: Njèndoŋ anà à ka' làa wa'a, a ba'shì wowèe efa bkʉ̀ tɛ wowèe a bo yʉ ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa bèe enjep ŋgòŋ. A m kur bcìndap bbebep ce a m ba kyèe na a lɛ wa'a, wowèe a ce kè' ba nfê' à nòŋ anà, embe ŋwɛɛ anà, embe fè' anà tɛ a bo gèe lap rfà' à nfè' anà.
eng: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m yɛ yap ŋgâa mà' bìr ce a ke mà' bìr yàp cu ba mbe mnyàabàrà'. A m suŋ mɛ̀ enɛ wowèe a yu malàr mjêe mmbaa.
eng: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ mnyàabàrà' anà a yɛ àmbò bèe ce a m ce caŋ mbo a m ba. Wowèe a m yar bco' bbɛ̀bɛr nje ŋgùŋ. Bco' anà vi m ce bàŋ àmbò mor wa'a, a ce sii àmbò ncòororò, a ce bàŋ àmbò cwa wa'a. Btù' mnyàabàrà' anà vi m ba àmbò btù' bʉrʉ̀' wa'a. Mor ba njemor ba rʉ̀ʉ mkàŋ yi m ce fʉʉ ekù cùu mnyàabàrà' anà.
eng: Thus I saw the horses in the vision, and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the heads of lions. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

lmp: Ŋgɛ' mor, ba ŋgɛ' njemor, ba ŋgɛ' rʉ̀ʉ mkàŋ ce yi m fʉʉ ekù cùu mnyàabàrà' ca nà à m yʉ ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa bèe enjep ŋgòŋ.
eng: By these three plagues were one third of mankind killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

lmp: Ŋger mnyàabàrà' anà yi m ba ku wâp cùu, a ker ba à wap mŋkùŋ. Wap mŋkùŋ vi m ba àmbò mnyo, a tʉr btù'. Vi tashì bèe ba nè mŋkùŋ anà.
eng: For the power of the horses is in their mouths, and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads, and with them they harm.

lmp: Bɛr bèe ce ŋgɛ' ca a m yʉshi wowèe ka' nà a m kupse yap ntee a borni efa rgèe buu bbebep ka'. Wowèe a m ku ce gʉ'shi nè byʉ' mnyʉ̂mkà', ker ba mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na ce a m kupshi ba nè mmbo. A m kupshi mnyʉ̀ anà ba nè bco' àmbò gul ba selvà, ba brôn. A ker kupshi mmo' ba nè blùr, ba mntaaŋguu. Àde' mnyʉ̀ anà vi yɛ buu, kɛ̀ yu' buu, kɛ̀ jɛr ka'.
eng: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn't repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn't worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood; which can neither see, nor hear, nor walk.

lmp: Wowèe a m kani efa kupse yap ntee, borni yàp buu bbebep. Wowèe a m ku ce yʉshi bèe, a ce gèe tʉ', a ce sàki, a ce yɛ̀ɛ.
eng: They didn't repent of their murders, nor of their sorceries, nor of their sexual immorality, nor of their thefts.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ ker yɛ ma ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' àmbò e ce sùu embe bùu. Mmbà' vi m cete ye àmbò cɛ̀' ce ŋwɛ̀ à mà' à nyor wa'a, ghùghumbèŋ yi ba mbe yê tù. Vi bsii vi m ce raa àmbò nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ na, mi mkùu mi ba àmbò mntiti mor wa'a.
eng: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

lmp: E m tʉr mʉ ŋwà' mo' ce a bʉ̀r wɛɛ mba yê bò. E m tɛr yi kûu mà' mbendù rdip rgòr, a tɛr yi kûu ŋkòp mbendù nshe, a waa,
eng: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

lmp: njèndoŋ a rʉʉŋgèr àmbò yì bʉrʉ̀' wa'a. E ka' waa, bsa'mbèŋ ce vi m ba sàamba vi beesì nè rwaŋgèr.
eng: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

lmp: Bsa'mbèŋ anà vi ka' waŋger, mɛ̀ ce kwà'shi mɛnɛ m be saŋ yuu ce bsa'mbèŋ anà vi làa. Mɛ̀ ka' ce kwà'shi wa'a, a yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à suu embe bùu enɛ̂, "Fa gèe tɛ ŋwɛ̀ mò' riŋ yuu ce bsa'mbèŋ anà vi làa ka'. Fa saŋ blàa anà mbe ŋwà' ka'."
eng: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don't write them.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m tɛr yi kùu mbendù rdip rgòr, a tɛr mo' mbendù nshe nà à naa yi bo mà' mbe bùu.
eng: The angel who I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky,

lmp: E m nàa wa'a, a ye lè' à rlii Nyʉ̀ ce e ce cu à nfè' wɛɛwɛ, à ba ye ce e m gèe rbuu ba buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu mbo, a gee ŋgòŋ ba buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu njo, a ker gee mdip ba buu wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu njo. E m ye lè' enɛ̂, "A be kèr càasi nfè' ka'.
eng: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

lmp: Be ba à nfè' ce ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì elʉ̀simbùu yì embenjì bcìndap ntuunfu à fyɛp rsòŋ li nà, tɛ rfà' Nyʉ̀ li mî, tɛ buu Nyʉ̀ ce vi m ba à bsʉ̀ti nà vi yɛɛti àwaŋ, tɛ yi bo kù ba àmbò e m suŋ yi ŋgâa ncep ntuu."
eng: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants, the prophets.

lmp: Njèndoŋ ce mɛ̀ m yu' e ce sùu embe bùu nà à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Dù koo ŋwà' ce a bʉ̀r yi ba mbà bo ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e tɛr kùu mbendù rdip rgòr, a tɛr mo' mbendù nshe nà."
eng: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.

lmp: Mɛ̀ du a laa nè ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà enɛ e fa mɛ̀ ŋwà' anà. E laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Kò ye, à be ye tɛ yi lee kù cùu àmbò blù wa'a, bep njep rbʉ̀."
eng: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, Take it, and eat it up. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.

lmp: Mɛ̀ koo ŋwà' anà emba yê bò, a ye. Mɛ̀ ka' ye, yi lee kù cùu àmbò blù, a bep njep rbʉ̀.
eng: I took the little book out of the angel's hand, and ate it up. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

lmp: A m làa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "À be kèr cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ kuu bêe à bto' jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, ce a ce làa bli jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, ker ba bkʉʉ à bto' anà."
eng: They told me, You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, a fa mɛ̀ rɛ̀rɛŋ ce a ke fè' buu àgho, a laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Nàti dû, du fe' Ndap Nyʉ̀, ker fe' dì' ce a ke fa rfa mbo mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ foŋ. Bè' bèe ce a ce loo nè Nyʉ̀ mbe ndàp anà.
eng: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, Rise, and measure God's temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

lmp: Fa fè' mambe efa Ndap Nyʉ̀ anà ka' njobè' a mà'shi mambe anà ba nè bèe ce a rìŋ Nyʉ̀ ka'. Wowèe a be nyʉ̀'si rla' Nyʉ̀ à mŋwɛɛ ncòp-baa-à- mŋkyèe.
eng: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don't measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

lmp: M be tuusi bèe a mmbaa tɛ a du suŋ wa blàa nè bèe. Wowèe a be yar bcɛ̂' njì rkwe. M be fa wowèe ŋger tɛ a cep ya ntuu à mnòŋ ncʉ̀kì nè mnòŋ mjèe-mmbaa ba mnòŋ mntuunfu."
eng: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.

lmp: Bèe à mmbaa ca a yu bce Olêf bbaa ce a m saŋ àmbò vi nà, a ker ba mʉ btɛbùr blam bbaa ce vi tɛɛ kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ nà.
eng: These are the two olive trees and the two lampstands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ à ka' ce ròo à rgèe yuu bebep nè wowèe, banɛ mor yi be fʉʉ eku wâp cùu, tòo ŋgàŋ. Banɛ ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ ce e ka' ce ròo à rgèe yuu bebep nè wowèe, banɛ ŋgàŋ be kù kwe.
eng: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

lmp: Be ba à nfè' ce wowèe a ce cep ntuu Nyʉ̀ anà tɛ wowèe a tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ mbèŋ ker gwè à nfè' anà ka'. Wowèe a be tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ mdip enjep ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ mi beeŋger à blɛɛ. Wowèe a be tʉr ŋger à rgèe tɛ mŋgɛ' njɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ vi koni bèe enjep ŋgòŋ à nfè' wɛɛwɛ ce wowèe a ka' kôŋ.
eng: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

lmp: Wowèe a be suŋ bèe blâa Nyʉ̀ mìsi, tɛ nyâa ntatap ce e m fʉʉ enjep rwee ce lʉ̀simbùu yu àgho ka' nà, ma' bìr a wowèe. E mà' bìr a wowèe wa'a, so wowèe, yʉshi wowèe.
eng: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

lmp: Bgʉ̂ʉ bèe anà vi be nòŋ à nduunjì à mʉ̀ rla' Nyʉ̀ anà, à ba rla' ce li yu rgòr, à ba rla' ce a m taa yàp ŋkʉʉ àfo mbe kìntaa nà. A m fa mlii mo' nè rla' anà à rdùŋshi njɛ̀ɛ njì ce li m ba. Rmo' li m ba enɛ Sodòm, rmo' li ba enɛ Ijìp.
eng: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

lmp: Bèe a be vʉ̀se à mntɛ̂' à bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ. Be ba bèe ce wap bli vi yu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. Wowèe a be vʉ̀ wa'a, fyɛ' bgʉ̂ʉ bèe anà à mnôŋ btaar ba bɛ', byemi enɛ ŋwɛ̀ tuŋ bgʉ̂ʉ bèe anà ka'.
eng: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

lmp: Bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a be lu'shi njobè' bèe anà a kweŋger. Wowèe a be gèe ŋkà', ce lu'shi, ce fa bèe buu njobè' bèe a mmbaa ce a m gèe bèe enjep ŋgòŋ a yɛ ŋgɛ' nà a kweŋger.
eng: Those who dwell on the earth rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

lmp: Mnôŋ btaar ba bɛ' vi ka' càa, Nyʉ̀ à yoŋsè mbendù bèe a mmbaa anà, a fa wowèe ryòŋ, wowèe a natì a tɛɛ mbekì. Bèe ce a m yɛ wowèe a wɛp sê.
eng: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

lmp: Bèe a mmbaa ca a yu' àmbò njèndoŋ ntatap à sùu embe bùu, a laa nè wowèe enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè mbena." Wowèe a ka' ce dù mbe bùu, mmbà' vi sir wowèe a kaari a tarte. Bèe ce a m bàa wowèe nà a m yɛ àmbò wowèe a ce dù.
eng: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, Come up here! They went up into heaven in the cloud, and their enemies saw them.

lmp: À ka ba à nfè' anà, nshe à ci'tì sê. Ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' rʉ̂ʉ, efa mndap efa ma rla' anà à gweŋgèr à nshè. Nshe anà à ka' cì'ti wa'a, a yʉshi bèe ncʉ̀kì sàambâ. Bèe ce a m bɛti nà a wɛp sê. A ka' wɛp wa'a, a ku'si Nyʉ̀ embe bùu.
eng: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified, and gave glory to the God of heaven.

lmp: Cena a ŋgɛ' embenjì yì entombì. Yì embenjì mo be koni nfè' mʉcàr.
eng: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì elʉ̀simbùu à fyɛp rsòŋ li. E ka' fyɛp, mɛ̀ yu' mnjèndoŋ àmbò vi sùu embe bùu. Mnjèndoŋ ca vi m làa mbekì enɛ̂, "Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce yìsèe Nyʉ̀ ba Krâis ce e m tuusi njep ŋgòŋ na, a be sa' ŋgòŋ ca. Nyʉ̀ be sa' ŋgòŋ ca nfesè."
eng: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord, and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr ce a m ba ncòp-kyèe-à-mmbaa, a cute mbe bkàbàrà' kùntombì nè Nyʉ̀ nà, a gʉ'shì nè Nyʉ̀.
eng: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God's throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

lmp: Wowèe a m làa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀ ce ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba wɛ̂ mmbò, wɛ̀ m ba, a ba sè'ni na. Wèr ce yòŋshi wɛ̀ njobè' wɛ̀ lòr ku' yo ŋger anà a kɛ' a ce sa' ŋgòŋ àgho.
eng: saying: We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was; because you have taken your great power, and reigned.

lmp: Ntee yi m ce yaŋ bto' mo' nè wɛ̀, nfè' à ghɛɛ ce ntee yi be yaŋ wɛ̀ foŋ. Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce à be sa' mnsa' bèe ce a kweŋger. Nfè' à ghɛɛ ce à be là' ŋgâa mfà' ce a m ce fè'shi wo blàa, ker ba bèe ce a ce yu'ni nè wɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bêe bgòrgòr ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bêe bkɛ'kɛ' ɛ̀. Nfè' anà yu nfè' ce à be bepsi bèe ce a m ce bepsi ŋgòŋ ca."
eng: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints, and those who fear your name, to the small and the great; and to destroy those who destroy the earth.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr ca a ka' mìsi, mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò Ndap Nyʉ̀ embe bùu à mʉ̀'ti. E ka' mʉ̀'ti, mɛ̀ yɛ ŋkùp lê' Nyʉ̀ ce e m ba mbo. Mbèŋ à bapŋgèr, a rʉʉŋger, a waŋger, nshe à ci'tì, ku' mghòo mi gwê.
eng: God's temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord's covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

lmp: Mɛ̀ lo a yɛ ma yuu mo' àmbò yi yɛɛti mbe bùu. À m ba yuu bɛ̀ɛ. Njeŋwɛ̀ mò' à m yɛɛti mbo. E m mà' nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ na à nyòr, a tɛɛ mbendù ŋwɛɛ, a yar rtaa kʉʉ ce a m gèe nè mkàŋsì ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ.
eng: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

lmp: E m ba nè rbʉ̀. A ka' kɛ̀' ce luuti, a ce war, njobè' e m ce yu' ryaŋ.
eng: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ker yɛ yuu mo' àmbò yi yɛɛti mbe bùu. Mɛ̀ yɛ njɛ̀ɛ nyàa mò' e feesè nyàarò. Nyàa anà à m ce bàŋ. E m tʉr btu sàambâ, a tʉr mdoŋ rʉ̂ʉ. E m sòp mtaa kʉʉ mbe btu sàamba anà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

lmp: E lor yi ŋkùŋ a sʉŋ ŋgʉ̀' mò'sir efa ŋgʉ̀' taar efa mkàŋsì embe bùu, a ma' njep nshè. Nyàa anà à vʉ a tɛɛ kùntombì nè njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce luuti muu nà enɛ njeŋwɛ̀ anà e bi muu tɛ e bo ye.
eng: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.
