lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ca à bi muu mbaŋrù ce e be lòr mbàŋ kʉʉ ce a gèe nè bco', sa' bto' wɛɛwɛ àgho. E ka' bi muu anà, a koo muu anà ese ye a caŋ a du àgho mbe dì' Nyʉ̀ yu, yi kàbàrà' yi ba mbo foŋ nà.
eng: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God, and to his throne.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ anà à natì foŋ a caŋ a du à ntee rìŋ fàdì' ce Nyʉ̀ à m kupshi nè ye, à ba dì' ce e be cu tɛ a ke'ni ye à mnòŋ ncʉ̀kì nè mnòŋ mjèe-mmbaa ba mnòŋ mntuunfu.
eng: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

lmp: A lo a kɛ' a ce mà' bìr mbe bùu. Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a ce too enɛ Maikɛ̀l ba bcìndap ce a m ba njep yê tìi a m mà' bìr a nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà. Nyàa anà ba vi bcìndap a m mà' bìr a Maikɛ̀l wèe tatap sê.
eng: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

lmp: A ka' mà' bìr anà, Maikɛ̀l ba vi bcìndap a so. A ker ma'shi enɛ nyàa ca ba vi bcìndap vi cu mbe bùu ka'.
eng: They didn't prevail, neither was a place found for him any more in heaven.

lmp: A m lòr ma nyàa anà a ma' njep ŋgòŋ na. Ma nyàa anà foŋ yu nyo elûuŋgòŋ ce a too li rlii enɛ ŋwɛ̀ mnàŋ, too rmo' enɛ Satàn. E yu ŋwɛ̀ ce e ke bo' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na. A m mà' ye a vi bcìndap wèe njep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' ma njèndoŋ àmbò e sùu embe bùu a laa enɛ̂, "Yèr Nyʉ̀ à gèe wèr à lûŋ. Ŋger Nyʉ̀ ba kʉʉ Nyʉ̀ yi yɛɛti àwaŋ. Bèe a yɛ ŋger Krâis ce Nyʉ̀ à m tuusi njep ŋgòŋ nà. A fʉr ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce tee mnde' mbe btu bfʉr visèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ nà embe bùu, a ma' njep nshè.
eng: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, Now is come the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

lmp: Bfʉr visèe ca a so ye njo' blɛɛ Muu Njèe ker ba njobè' blâa Nyʉ̀ ce wowèe a m ce suŋ bèe. Wowèe a m tami nyor enɛ à ka' ba rkwe banɛ wowèe a be kwe njo' Jisos Krâis.
eng: They overcame him because of the Lamb's blood, and because of the word of their testimony. They didn't love their life, even to death.

lmp: Tɛ rlu'shì li ba mbe bùu, ker ba nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce cu mbo. Yi yu bebep nè bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na ba mdip wɛɛwɛ, njobè' a mà' Satàn embe bùu, e suu a ce cu a wowèe. Ntee yi ce yaŋ ye, njobè' e rìŋ enɛ yì nfè' ku bɛti ba mʉcàr sê."
eng: Therefore rejoice, heavens, and you who dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has gone down to you, having great wrath, knowing that he has but a short time.

lmp: Nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà à ka' yɛ enɛ a mà' ye embe bùu, e gwe njep ŋgòŋ, e kɛ' a ce jùu àmbùu njeŋwɛ̀ ce e m bi muu mbaŋrù nà.
eng: When the dragon saw that he was thrown down to the earth, he persecuted the woman who gave birth to the male child.

lmp: A m fa njeŋwɛ̀ anà bbàp vi bbaa. Bbàp anà vi m feese bbàp wàawa mŋkùr. A m fa ye bbàp ca tɛ e bo fɛŋ àgho caŋ du à dì' ce a m kupshi nè ye à ntee rìŋ nà, fà dì' nyo ca bo koo ye ka'. E fɛŋ bà' àfo, tɛ a bo kè'ni ye à bfê' btaar ba nto'.
eng: Two wings of the great eagle were given to the woman, that she might fly into the wilderness to her place, so that she might be nourished for a time, and times, and half a time, from the face of the serpent.

lmp: Nyo anà à fʉr mdip ekù cùu, mi ba àmbò rdip wa'a. E m fʉr mdip anà tɛ mi bo lòr njeŋwɛ̀ anà dù àgho.
eng: The serpent spewed water out of his mouth after the woman like a river, that he might cause her to be carried away by the stream.

lmp: E ka' fʉr wa'a, nshe à ja' njeŋwɛ̀ ca, a sa'ti, a nyoŋ rdip ce nyàa ca à m fʉr ekù cùu nà wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed up the river which the dragon spewed out of his mouth.

lmp: Ntee yi yaŋ nyàa ca nè njeŋwɛ̀ ca. E du a ma' bìr a bɛr boo njeŋwɛ̀ ca. Boo njeŋwɛ̀ anà yu bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce lɛ̀ mncir Nyʉ̀, a ce suŋ enɛ Jisòs yu yàp Tatâ. Nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà à du a tɛɛ àwâa rdip rgòr.
eng: The dragon grew angry with the woman, and went away to make war with the rest of her seed, who keep God's commandments and hold Jesus' testimony.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ nyâa mbembep mò' àmbò e ce fʉʉ enjep rò. Nyàa anà à m tʉr btu sàambâ, a tʉr mdoŋ rʉ̂ʉ. E m tʉr mtaa kʉʉ mbe mdoŋ anà wɛɛwɛ. A m saŋ mlii mbe btu anà a ce cɛp ba Nyʉ̀ àgho.
eng: Then I stood on the sand of the sea. I saw a beast coming up out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads. On his horns were ten crowns, and on his heads, blasphemous names.

lmp: Nyàa ce mɛ̀ m yɛ anà à m feese mbaa. Mkùu efa gho mi feesè mkùu njɛ̀ɛ nyàa mò' ce a ke too enɛ bɛ̂ɛ, cùu efa gho yi ba àmbò yî bʉrʉ̀' wa'a. Nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà à fa nyàa ca ŋger ba kʉʉ.
eng: The beast which I saw was like a leopard, and his feet were like those of a bear, and his mouth like the mouth of a lion. The dragon gave him his power, his throne, and great authority.

lmp: Tu mo' efa nyàa anà yi m tʉr ma nfur mò' à ba ce e m ba yʉ ye; nfur anà à m ba nè ke'se yi yu. Ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ yi m bɛ̀ɛ nyàa anà a kɛ' a ce yu'ni ba nè nyàa anà.
eng: One of his heads looked like it had been wounded fatally. His fatal wound was healed, and the whole earth marveled at the beast.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ce gʉ'shi nè nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà njobè' e m fa ŋger nè nyàa mò' ca. Wowèe a m ce gʉ'shi nè nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò nà foŋ, a ce làa enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mò' yu ce e tʉr ŋger a caa nyàa ca ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ yu ce àde' a nyàa ca a re bkòr ka'."
eng: They worshiped the dragon, because he gave his authority to the beast, and they worshiped the beast, saying, Who is like the beast? Who is able to make war with him?

lmp: A m fa nyàa ca ŋger enɛ e naatu, cɛp Nyʉ̀. A m fa ye ŋger enɛ e gee yuu ce e kòŋ àgho à mŋwɛɛ ncòp-baa-à-mkyèe.
eng: A mouth speaking great things and blasphemy was given to him. Authority to make war for forty-two months was given to him.

lmp: E m kɛ̀' a ce cɛp Nyʉ̀, a laa buu bbebep a kuu rlii Nyʉ̀ ker ba fàdì' Nyʉ̀ ce cu, ba bèe embe bùu wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He opened his mouth for blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his dwelling, those who dwell in heaven.

lmp: A m fa ŋger enɛ nyàa ca ma' bìr a bèe Nyʉ̀, so wowèe. A m ker fa ŋger enɛ e sa' bèe ce a ce làa bli jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a ce cu à mntɛ̀' ce vi yu à bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na.
eng: It was given to him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them. Authority over every tribe, people, language, and nation was given to him.

lmp: Bèe ce a ce cu njep ŋgòŋ a be gʉ'shi nè nyàa ca. Bèe ce a be gʉ'shi ka' be ba bèe ce a m saŋ map mlii mbe ŋwà' Muu Njèe ce a m yʉ. A m saŋ mlii ca tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' kè ba àgho.
eng: All who dwell on the earth will worship him, everyone whose name has not been written from the foundation of the world in the book of life of the Lamb who has been killed.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr btù', ŋgàŋ yu'.
eng: If anyone has an ear, let him hear.

lmp: Yi ka' ba enɛ a be koo ŋwɛ̀ fa à shaŋ banɛ àde' ŋgàŋ buu efa rdù shaŋ ka'. Yi ka' ba enɛ a be yʉ ŋwɛ̀ nè sà' banɛ a be kù yʉ ye ba àgho. Àmbò yi yu à njɛ̂ɛ wa'a, banɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ a ba tɛɛ tatap, lɛ̀ ntee ba nè Tàr Nyʉ̀.
eng: If anyone is to go into captivity, he will go into captivity. If anyone is to be killed with the sword, he must be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ nyàa mò' àmbò e fʉʉ enjep nshè. Nyàa anà à m tʉr mdoŋ mbe tù àmbo mdoŋ ya' ce yi ku bii kɛ'. Mdoŋ anà mi m ba mi mmbaa. Yì njèndoŋ à m feese njèndoŋ nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà.
eng: I saw another beast coming up out of the earth. He had two horns like a lamb, and he spoke like a dragon.

lmp: E m lòr ŋger nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò a tʉr nfur ce e m kè'se wɛɛ nà a gee buu àgho à rlii nyàa anà. E m gèe bèe enjep ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ a gʉ'shì nè nyàa anà.
eng: He exercises all the authority of the first beast in his presence. He makes the earth and those who dwell in it to worship the first beast, whose fatal wound was healed.

lmp: E m gèe buu bbɛ̀ɛ, a gee mor yi suu embe bùu foŋ, bèe wɛɛwɛ a yɛ.
eng: He performs great signs, even making fire come down out of the sky to the earth in the sight of people.

lmp: A ka' gèe ku' buu bbɛ̀ɛ ce Nyʉ̀ à m mà'shi enɛ e gee à rlii nyàa ca nà, a bo' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ àgho. E m làa enɛ a wowèe a gee blaŋ tɛ a bo gʉ'shi nè nyàa ce a m gwàr nè kàafà' e ke' kwe ka' nà.
eng: He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast; saying to those who dwell on the earth, that they should make an image to the beast who had the sword wound and lived.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à m mà'shi enɛ nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep nshè na, yoŋse mbendù blaŋ ca, fa ryòŋ àgho tɛ vi bo làa. E m mà'shi enɛ blaŋ ca vi yʉshi bèe ce a be gʉ'shi nè vi ka'.
eng: It was given to him to give breath to it, to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should both speak, and cause as many as wouldn't worship the image of the beast to be killed.

lmp: Nyàa anà à m fa ŋger enɛ a fa bèe wɛɛwɛ ncòo. Kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ à m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋgòr ɛ̀, kɛ̀ e m ba ŋwɛ̂ ŋkɛ' ɛ̀, kɛ̀ e m ba ŋkwàa kɛ̀ muu ɛ̀, a m fa ye ncòo. A m ka' tɛ fa ŋwɛ̀ ncòo ca à rkoo mà' ka', a fa nje nsàpsi.
eng: He causes all, the small and the great, the rich and the poor, and the free and the slave, to be given marks on their right hands, or on their foreheads;

lmp: A m làa enɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tɛ tʉr ncòo ca ka' banɛ ŋgàŋ be fyèni yuu kɛ̀ yuu yuu ka'. Ncòo anà yu nombà efa rlii nyàa anà.
eng: and that no one would be able to buy or to sell, unless he has that mark, the name of the beast or the number of his name.

lmp: Bèe a ba kwà'shi àmbò yuu ca bòŋboŋ sê, nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' tʉr bfee banɛ ŋgàŋ riŋ yuu ce nombà ca tɛɛ àtu mo. Nombà ca tɛɛ àtu ŋwɛ̀. Nombà anà yu mjèe ntuunfu nè ncòp-ntuunfu-à-mntuunfu.
eng: Here is wisdom. He who has understanding, let him calculate the number of the beast, for it is the number of a man. His number is six hundred sixty-six.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' kèr fyɛ' a yɛ Muu Njèe àmbò e tɛɛ mbe rtùu Sayòn. E m tɛɛ mbo a bèe ncʉ̀kì rjèe nè ncʉ̀kì ncòp-kyèe-à-mŋkyèe. A m saŋ li rlii ba rlii yì ta nje mnsàpsi bèe ca wɛɛwɛ.
eng: I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing on Mount Zion, and with him a number, one hundred forty-four thousand, having his name, and the name of his Father, written on their foreheads.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à sùu embe bùu a coo àmbò rdip ce li ce gwè à rkoŋ wa'a, a rʉʉŋger àmbò mbèŋ e ke waŋger ce rʉ̀ʉŋger nà. Njèndoŋ anà à m làa àmbò mluŋ ce bèe a ce bu' wa'a.
eng: I heard a sound from heaven, like the sound of many waters, and like the sound of a great thunder. The sound which I heard was like that of harpists playing on their harps.

lmp: Bèe anà a m tɛɛ kùntombì nè kàbàrà' ba buu btèe ce vi m ba kyèe nà, ker ba bêe bgòrgòr ce a m ba ncòp-kyèe-à-mmbaa nà a ce yòp yɛɛ fi. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba yɛ'ni yɛɛ anà caa efa bèe ce a m ba ncʉ̀kì rjèe nè ncʉ̀kì ncòp-kyèe-à-mŋkyèe nà ka'. Bèe anà a ba bèe ce muu njèe à m yuu nè vi blɛɛ a fʉr wowèe efa mʉ̀ bèe enjep ŋgòŋ nà.
eng: They sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. No one could learn the song except the one hundred forty-four thousand, those who had been redeemed out of the earth.

lmp: Bèe anà yu bèe ce a lɛ̀ wap mnyor brara, a ke' bepsi wap mnyor a bbyèŋge wèe ka'. Wowèe a yu bèe ce a ce dù àmbùu Muu Njèe à bdì' wɛɛwɛ ce muu njèe ka' ce dù. Bèe ca yu bèe ce a yuu wowèe nè blɛɛ, a fʉr wowèe efa mʉ̀ bèe, wowèe a ba bèe Nyʉ̀, a ker a ba bèe Muu Njèe foŋ.
eng: These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he goes. These were redeemed by Jesus from among men, the first fruits to God and to the Lamb.

lmp: Wowèe a m be nya' mnde' ka'. Yuu bebep mo' yi yu ce àde' ŋwɛ̀ laa enɛ wowèe a gèe ka'.
eng: In their mouth was found no lie, for they are blameless.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' àmbò e ce fɛŋ mbe bùu. E m ce vʉ̀ nè Nsuŋ Mbòŋmboŋ, à ba nsuŋ ce e be mì à nfè' mò' ka'. E m ce vʉ̀ tɛ e bo suŋ nsuŋ anà nè bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce cu njep ŋgòŋ na, a ba à mntɛ̀' wɛɛwɛ ce vi yu à bto' wɛɛwɛ, a ce làa bli jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: I saw an angel flying in mid heaven, having an eternal Good News to proclaim to those who dwell on the earth, and to every nation, tribe, language, and people.

lmp: E m làa nè njèndoŋ ntatap enɛ̂, "Wɛp nè Nyʉ̀, ku'si ye, njobè' nfè' à ghɛɛ ce e be sa' bèe wɛɛwɛ. Banɛ wèe gʉ'shi nè ye. E m gèe rbuu ba nshe, ba mdip ce mi ce fʉʉ enjep nshè ba mdip mŋgòrŋgòr."
eng: He said with a loud voice, Fear the Lord, and give him glory; for the hour of his judgment has come. Worship him who made the heaven, the earth, the sea, and the springs of waters!

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à ker vʉ̂, a laa enɛ̂, "Li gwè. Ma rla' rgòr ce a too enɛ Babilòn nà li gwè. À m ba rla' ce li m gèe bto' wɛɛwɛ vi no mi mrù' ce yu sàkì, a ce sàki foŋ àmbò wowèe."
eng: Another, a second angel, followed, saying, Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality.

lmp: Ncìndap yì embenjì bcìndap Nyʉ̀ vi bbaa ca à laa nè njèndoŋ ntatap enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' gʉ'shi nè nyàa ker ba blaŋ ca, byemi enɛ a fa ye ncòo nje nsàpsi kɛ̀ mbe rkoo ɛ̀,
eng: Another angel, a third, followed them, saying with a great voice, If anyone worships the beast and his image, and receives a mark on his forehead, or on his hand,

lmp: banɛ rshentee Nyʉ̀ li be gwè mbe tu ŋwɛ̀ anà. Rshentee Nyʉ̀ anà li be ba àmbò mrû' mtatap ce a fiŋshi ka'. E be no mi wɛɛwɛ. E be yɛ mlù njep mor ce yi ce she àmbò a lɛ̀ lɛ mkàŋ njo wa'a. E be yɛ ŋgɛ' ca à bsii bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ba Muu Njèe.
eng: he also will drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is prepared unmixed in the cup of his anger. He will be tormented with fire and sulfur in the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb.

lmp: Njemor ce yi be fa wowèe ŋgɛ' yi be mì à nfè' mò' ka'. Bèe ce a ce gʉ'shi nè nyàa anà ba vi blaŋ, a ker tʉr ncòo rlii nyàa anà, a be yɛ mlù nètʉ' ba nèmootì."
eng: The smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever. They have no rest day and night, those who worship the beast and his image, and whoever receives the mark of his name.

lmp: Banɛ yi yu bòŋboŋ enɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ ce a ce lɛ̀ vi mncir, a lɛ ntee nè Jisòs nà, a tɛɛ tatap.
eng: Here is the patience of the saints, those who keep the commandments of God, and the faith of Jesus.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à sùu embe bùu a laa enɛ̂, "Saŋ blàa ca: "Kɛ' e sè'ni, mbôŋtu mi yu nè bèe ce a lɛ̀ ntee nè Tata Jisòs wɛɛ a ka' kwe." " Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ yi beesì enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa'a, lap rfà' li mì. Wowèe a be lʉ̀shi ce lu'shi, njobè' sɛ' efa map mfà' be dù a wâp mbùu."
eng: I heard the voice from heaven saying, Write, 'Blessed are the dead who die in the Lord from now on.' Yes, says the Spirit, that they may rest from their labors; for their works follow with them.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' fyɛ' a yɛ ku' mmbâ' bbʉʉ. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à cu mbendù mmbà' anà a ba àmbò muu ŋwɛ̀ wa'a. E m sòp rtaa kʉʉ ce a gèe nè gûl, a tʉr sâ' ncɛncɛp mbà bò.
eng: I looked, and behold, a white cloud; and on the cloud one sitting like a son of man, having on his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à fʉʉ embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀, a laa nè njèndoŋ ntatap nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbendù mmbà' nà enɛ̂, "Nfè' ce a be kep buu efa mŋkʉ̀ à ghɛɛ. Buu ce a byè njep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ vi bi. Lòr sà' du kep àgho."
eng: Another angel came out from the temple, crying with a loud voice to him who sat on the cloud, Send forth your sickle, and reap; for the hour to reap has come; for the harvest of the earth is ripe!

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbendù mmbà' nà à lor yì sà' a kep buu enjep ŋgòŋ àgho wɛɛwɛ.
eng: He who sat on the cloud thrust his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ker yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' àmbò e fʉʉ embe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ embe bùu, a tʉr sâ' ncɛncɛp mbà bò foŋ.
eng: Another angel came out from the temple which is in heaven. He also had a sharp sickle.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ker yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò'. À m ba ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e ke tòo mor mbe dì' ce a ke fa rfa nè Nyʉ̀. E vʉ embe dì' rfa anà a waa, a laa nè ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' ca enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, grɛ̂p à bàŋ. Lòr yò sà' anà du ceni efa mŋkwaa enjep ŋgòŋ na."
eng: Another angel came out from the altar, he who has power over fire, and he called with a great voice to him who had the sharp sickle, saying, Send forth your sharp sickle, and gather the clusters of the vine of the earth, for the earth's grapes are fully ripe!

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à cenì grɛ̂p enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ nè sà', a ma' njep bè'tè tɛ a bo nyɛ̀ŋ tɛ mdip mi fʉʉ enjo. Rnyɛ̀ŋ efa gho anà li tɛɛ àtu rshentee Nyʉ̀.
eng: The angel thrust his sickle into the earth, and gathered the vintage of the earth, and threw it into the great winepress of the wrath of God.

lmp: Bè'tè anà yi yu ba à mʉ̀ rla' ka'. A ka' nyɛ̀ŋ grɛ̂p anà blɛɛ vi fʉʉ enjo. Bsàp efa gho vi m ba bkìlomɛtà mjèe mtaar, rcoomì efa gho li ba àmbò rkoo rmo'sir.
eng: The winepress was trodden outside of the city, and blood came out from the winepress, even to the bridles of the horses, as far as one thousand six hundred stadia.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ ker yɛ yuu bɛ̀ɛ mo' mbe bùu. À m ba yuu làa ka'. Mɛ̀ m yɛ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ sàambâ. Wowèe a m vʉ̀ nè mŋgɛ' sàambâ. Mŋgɛ' sàamba ca à m ba mŋgɛ' ce elʉ̀simbùu. Nyʉ̀ be mìsi li rshentee ba nè mŋgɛ' ca.
eng: I saw another great and marvelous sign in the sky: seven angels having the seven last plagues, for in them God's wrath is finished.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ yuu mo' yi feesè rdip rgòr ce a gèe nè glâs ce a fìŋshi mor à mʉ̀ mo. Mɛ̀ yɛ bèe ce a m so nyàa ba blaŋ nyàa cà, ba nombà rlii nyàa anà àmbò a tɛɛte àwâa rdip rgòr a tʉr mluŋ Nyʉ̀ mbà mmbò.
eng: I saw something like a sea of glass mixed with fire, and those who overcame the beast, his image, and the number of his name, standing on the sea of glass, having harps of God.

lmp: Wowèe a m ce yòp yɛɛ ce Musìs ce e m ce fà' nè Nyʉ̀ à m yòp, à ba yɛɛ Muu Njèe foŋ nà. Wowèe a m yòp enɛ̂, "Wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀ ce à yu yèr tâ, ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba wɛ̂ mmbò. Mo mfà' mi càa ŋger, à ba foŋ mfâ' mmbɛ̀ɛ. À yu ŋkʉʉ nè bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na, buu ce wɛ̂ gèe vi ku ba yɛɛnì, a ba mini à nfè' wɛɛwɛ.
eng: They sang the song of Moses, the servant of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and marvelous are your works, Lord God, the Almighty! Righteous and true are your ways, you King of the nations.

lmp: Yèr tâ, ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e wɛp wɛ̀ ka', yu nda? Ŋwɛ̀ ce àde' e buu efa rkù'si lo rlii yu nda? Ŋwɛ̀ ce e yu nrara ku ba wɛ̀ cà'cà'. Bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ a be vʉ̀ gʉ'shi nè wɛ̀, njobè' a yɛ enɛ buu wɛɛwɛ ce à ce gèe vi yu yɛɛnì."
eng: Who wouldn't fear you, Lord, and glorify your name? For you only are holy. For all the nations will come and worship before you. For your righteous acts have been revealed.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ mbe bùu. A ka' fyɛ' mbo, dî' rara ce yi càa ŋger ce yi yu mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ embe bùu nà yi ba too.
eng: After these things I looked, and the temple of the tabernacle of the testimony in heaven was opened.

lmp: Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ sàamba ce a m vʉ̀ nè mŋgɛ' sàamba nà a fʉʉ embe dì' Nyʉ̀ anà. Wowèe a m yar bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ ce vi m ce fʉp sê. Wowèe a m cʉʉ kʉ̀ cɛ̀' ce a gèe nè gul nje ŋgùŋ.
eng: The seven angels who had the seven plagues came out, clothed with pure, bright linen, and wearing golden sashes around their breasts.

lmp: Mò' efa buu btèe ce vi m ba kyèe nà à fa bcìndap Nyʉ̀ sàamba ca bghee ce a gèe nè gul vi sàambâ. Rshentee Nyʉ̀ ce e ku ba ntèe à nfè' wɛɛwɛ li m ba njep bghee anà jiŋ.
eng: One of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls full of the wrath of God, who lives forever and ever.

lmp: Njemor yi tar mbe dì' Nyʉ̀ anà. Njemor anà yi m vʉ̀ ese ŋger ker ba fòo Nyʉ̀. Ŋwɛ̀ mò' à m ba ce àde' e m ba du mbe dì' Nyʉ̀ anà ka'. Àde' ŋwɛ̀ à m ba ku du mbo ba à nfè' ce mŋgɛ' sàamba ce bcìndap Nyʉ̀ a vʉ̀ àgho nà vi mì.
eng: The temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God, and from his power. No one was able to enter into the temple, until the seven plagues of the seven angels would be finished.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à làa tatap embe dì' Nyʉ̀. E m làa nè bcìndap Nyʉ̀ sàamba cà enɛ̂, "Cù' nè rshentee Nyʉ̀ ce wèe tʉr à bghee nà njep ŋgòŋ."
eng: I heard a loud voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, Go and pour out the seven bowls of the wrath of God on the earth!

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì entòmbì à cu' ŋgɛ' ce e m ba njep ghee yi nà njep ŋgòŋ. E ka' cù', bkòtɛ ce vi ke yaŋ se nà vi koo bèe ce a m fa wowèe ncòo nyàa cà, wowèe a ker ce gʉ'shi nè blaŋ nyàa anà nà.
eng: The first went, and poured out his bowl into the earth, and it became a harmful and evil sore on the people who had the mark of the beast, and who worshiped his image.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì embenjì mo à cu' ŋgɛ' ce e m ba njep ghee yi njep rdip rgòr. E ka' cù', rdip rgòr li ghuptì a ba àmbò blɛɛ gʉ̂ʉ ŋwɛ̀ wa'a. Buu btèe ce vi m ba njo vi kweŋgèr wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The second angel poured out his bowl into the sea, and it became blood as of a dead man. Every living thing in the sea died.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à cu' ŋgɛ' ce e m ba njep ghee yi njep rò ba mdip ce mi ce fʉʉ enjep nshè. Mdip anà mi beeŋgèr à blɛɛ.
eng: The third poured out his bowl into the rivers and springs of water, and they became blood.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m tʉr ŋger mbendù mdip nà à làa enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ ce à yu ŋwɛ̂ nrara, wɛ̀ m ba, a ba sè'ni na. Wɛ̀ teni mnsa' ca yɛɛnì.
eng: I heard the angel of the waters saying, You are righteous, who are and who were, you Holy One, because you have judged these things.

lmp: Bèe ce a m yʉshi yò bèe a ker yʉshi yo ŋgâa ncep ntuu, blɛɛ vi lɛŋ nà, a bèe ce wɛ̀ fa blɛɛ nè wowèe enɛ a no. Yu bèe ce a ba no blɛɛ anà ghup."
eng: For they poured out the blood of the saints and the prophets, and you have given them blood to drink. They deserve this.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à làa embe dì' rfa enɛ̂, "Yi yu mini. Wɛ̂ Nyʉ̀ ce à yu yèr tâ, ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba wɛ̂ mmbò. Wɛ̀ teni mnsa' à njî yɛɛnì."
eng: I heard the altar saying, Yes, Lord God, the Almighty, true and righteous are your judgments.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à cu' ŋgɛ' ce e m ba njep ghee yi mbendù nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ na. E ka' cù', Târ Nyʉ̀ à ma'shì, ŋgɛ' anà à she àmbò mor wa'a, a too bèe.
eng: The fourth poured out his bowl on the sun, and it was given to him to scorch men with fire.

lmp: E ka' tòo wowèe, wowèe a cɛp Nyʉ̀ ce e tʉr ŋger mbendù mŋgɛ' ca wɛɛwɛ. Wowèe a m kani efa rkupse yap ntee, kù'si Nyʉ̀.
eng: People were scorched with great heat, and people blasphemed the name of God who has the power over these plagues. They didn't repent and give him glory.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à cu' ŋgɛ' ce e m ba njep ghee yi mbendù kàbàrà' nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò nà. E ka' cù', tʉ̀' à sii à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ ce nyàa anà à m ce sa'. Bèe a m luushi mlee njo' mlù ce wowèe a m ce yɛ.
eng: The fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast, and his kingdom was darkened. They gnawed their tongues because of the pain,

lmp: Wowèe a m cɛp Nyʉ̀ embe bùu njo' ŋgɛ' ce wowèe a m ce yɛ, ker ba njobè' bkòtɛ ce vi m koo wowèe nà. Wowèe a m yɛ ŋgɛ' ca wa'a, a ke' kupse yap ntee borni buu bbebep ce wowèe a m ce gèe ka'.
eng: and they blasphemed the God of heaven because of their pains and their sores. They didn't repent of their works.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à cu' ŋgɛ' ce e m ba njep ghee yi njep ma rdip ce a too enɛ Yufrɛtìs. E ka' cù', rdip anà li yuushì tɛ bkʉʉ ekù mbùuntii a bo càa njì enjo.
eng: The sixth poured out his bowl on the great river, the Euphrates. Its water was dried up, that the way might be prepared for the kings that come from the sunrise.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ byʉ' bbebep vî btaar, vi feesè bja'. Vi m fʉʉ ekù cùu nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà, ba nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò nà, ker ba ekù cùu ŋwɛ̀ ce e mʉ ce nya' mnde' enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ nà.
eng: I saw coming out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, something like frogs;

lmp: Byʉ' anà yu mnyʉ̂mkà', a tʉr ŋger à rgèe buu bbɛ̀ɛ. Byʉ' anà vi m dù a yɛ bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ, a baashi wowèe àbee tɛ a bo mà' bìr a Nyʉ̀ wèe à nòŋ ce Nyʉ̀ ce ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba yê mmbò be dùŋshi yi ŋger.
eng: for they are spirits of demons, performing signs; which go forth to the kings of the whole inhabited earth, to gather them together for the war of that great day of God, the Almighty.

lmp: Yɛ̂, "M be vʉ̀ àmbò nyɛ̀ɛ wa'a. Rbôŋtu li yu nè ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce buumi ka', a ce kè'ni vi bcɛ̀', fà dì' a lor vi, tɛ e lo kar mbùuriŋ tɛ rìtu yi koo ye à mʉ̀ bèe ka'."
eng: Behold, I come like a thief. Blessed is he who watches, and keeps his clothes, so that he doesn't walk naked, and they see his shame.

lmp: Byʉ' ca vi vʉ̀ nè bkʉʉ ca àbee à dì' ce a too à li Jus enɛ Àmàgɛdòn.
eng: He gathered them together into the place which is called in Hebrew, Megiddo.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ yì elʉ̀simbùu à ŋwaŋ ŋgɛ' enjep ghee yi mbekì. E ka' ŋwaŋ, njèndoŋ à laa embe kàbàrà' ce yi m ba mbe Ndàp Nyʉ̀ nà enɛ̂, "Yi mì."
eng: The seventh poured out his bowl into the air. A loud voice came forth out of the temple of heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done!

lmp: Njèndoŋ anà à ka' làa wa'a, mbèŋ à bapŋgèr, a rʉʉŋger, a waŋger, nshe à ci'tì. Kɛ' embe nfè' ce bèe a m kɛ̀' ba njep ŋgòŋ na, ŋgòŋ yi m be ci'ti wa' ka'.
eng: There were lightnings, sounds, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since there were men on the earth, so great an earthquake, so mighty.

lmp: Ma rla' rgòr cà li tenì nyor bdî' btaar, mla' ce mi m ba à bto' wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na mi gweŋgèr. Nyʉ̀ à m kuushi ma rla' rgòr ce a m ce too enɛ Babilòn nà, li rshentee ba yì ŋgɛ' à vʉ mbendù rla' ca. Nyʉ̀ à m gèe rla' ca li no li rshentee ce li m ba njep yê ndoŋ àmbò ndoŋ mrû' mtatap wa'a.
eng: The great city was divided into three parts, and the cities of the nations fell. Babylon the great was remembered in the sight of God, to give to her the cup of the wine of the fierceness of his wrath.

lmp: Bto' ce mdip mi sìr a kaari a tarte ker ba mtùu a m kɛ̀ɛŋger, a bʉ.
eng: Every island fled away, and the mountains were not found.

lmp: Mghòo mi suu embe bùu a gweŋger àndù bèe. Rghôo rmo'sir li m ce rìr àmbò bàa msaŋ wa'a. Ŋgɛ' anà à m bɛɛmi sê. Bèe a m cɛp Nyʉ̀ njobè' ku' ŋgɛ' ce wowèe a m ce yɛ.
eng: Great hailstones, about the weight of a talent, came down out of the sky on people. People blasphemed God because of the plague of the hail, for this plague is exceedingly severe.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bcìndap sàamba ce a m tʉr bghee sàamba nà. E m vʉ̀ a laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ tɛ m duŋshi wɛ̀ ŋgɛ' ce kwàrà ce e càa ŋger na be yɛ. Kwàrà ca tɛɛ àtu rla' ce a bà'ri mbetar mdip.
eng: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls came and spoke with me, saying, Come here. I will show you the judgment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters,

lmp: Bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ a m nòŋ a kwàrà anà wèe, bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ a no mrù' sàkì, a ce sàki foŋ àmbò kwàrà ca."
eng: with whom the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality, and those who dwell in the earth were made drunken with the wine of her sexual immorality.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ba mbà mmbo Yʉ' Nyʉ̀, ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à lor mɛ̀ a du àgho à ntee rìŋ. Mɛ̀ ka' bà' àfo a yɛ njeŋwɛ̀ àmbò e cu mbendù nyâa mbembep, nyàa anà à ba mbeer. A m saŋ mlii à nyor nyàa anà wɛɛwɛ, à ba ba mlii ce a m ce cɛp ba Nyʉ̀ àgho. Nyàa anà à m tʉr btu sàambâ, a tʉr mdoŋ rʉ̂ʉ.
eng: He carried me away in the Spirit into a wilderness. I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet-colored animal, full of blasphemous names, having seven heads and ten horns.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ca à m yar bcɛ̂' bbeer, à ba bcɛ̀' ce vi m bòŋ sê. E m sùsi yì nyor nè buu jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ. À m ba buu àmbò bkwàŋ, ba mncìi ba byɛ̀ɛri. A m gèe buu anà nè gul ker ba blùr ce vi m ce là'ŋger sê. E m tʉr ndoŋ ce a gèe nè gul mba yê bò, ndoŋ anà à ruu nè bsàrbuu efa yì sàkì.
eng: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls, having in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of the sexual immorality of the earth.

lmp: A m saŋ rlii nje nsàpsi njeŋwɛ̀ ca. Rlii anà li m tɛɛ ba àtu ŋgàa ce a m mà'. Rlii anà li m ba enɛ̂, "Babilòn ce ŋgòr, ma ŋwɛ̀ bsàkì, ba ma ŋwɛ̀ bsàrbuu enjep ŋgòŋ na."
eng: And on her forehead a name was written, MYSTERY, BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF THE PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m yɛ mɛnɛ njeŋwɛ̀ anà à m no blɛɛ bèe ce a m yʉshi njobè' wowèe a m ce làa àwaŋ enɛ wowèe a ce dù àmbùu Jisòs nà. E m no, blɛɛ anà vi koo ye àmbò mrù' mi ke koo ŋwɛ̀ nà. Mɛ̀ ka' yɛ wa'a, a bɛɛŋger sê.
eng: I saw the woman drunken with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the martyrs of Jesus. When I saw her, I wondered with great amazement.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Wɛ̀ bɛ̀ɛŋger njokɛ? M be to' wɛ̀ yuu ce njeŋwɛ̀ ca ker ba nyàa ce e tʉr btu sàamba a tʉr mdoŋ rʉʉ nà, a tɛɛ àtu mo.
eng: The angel said to me, Why do you wonder? I will tell you the mystery of the woman, and of the beast that carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

lmp: Nyàa anà à m ba ntèe a ker bii ntèe sè'ni ka'. E be fʉʉ enjèp rwee ce lʉ̀simbùu yu àgho ka' nà, tɛ a lo yʉ ye tɛ e kwe dʉ̀dʉ̀. Bèe ce a ce cu njep ŋgòŋ na a be yɛ nyàa ca, bɛ̀ɛŋger sê. Bèe ca yu bèe ce a m saŋ map mlii mbe ŋwà' ryòŋ ka', tɛ ŋgòŋ yi ka' kè ba àgho. Wowèe a be bɛ̀ɛŋger njobè' nyàa ca à m ba ntèe a ker bii ntèe sè'ni ka, kèr lò kʉti ntèe.
eng: The beast that you saw was, and is not; and is about to come up out of the abyss and to go into destruction. Those who dwell on the earth and whose names have not been written in the book of life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see that the beast was, and is not, and shall be present.

lmp: "Bèe a ba kwà'shi àmbò buu ca bòŋboŋ se nè bfee-ŋwɛ̀. Btu sàamba ca yu mtùu sàamba ce njeŋwɛ̀ ca cu mbendù mo. Btu anà vi tɛɛ àtu bkʉʉ sàambâ.
eng: Here is the mind that has wisdom. The seven heads are seven mountains, on which the woman sits.

lmp: Bkʉʉ ta efa mʉ̀ bkʉʉ sàamba ca a bii mbe kʉʉ ka'. Ŋkʉʉ mò' ku bii sa', mò' à ku bii vʉ̀. E be vʉ̀ kù sa' ba nfè' mʉcàr sê.
eng: They are seven kings. Five have fallen, the one is, the other has not yet come. When he comes, he must continue a little while.

lmp: Nyàa ce e m ba ntèe, a bii ntèe sè'ni ka' nà yu ŋkʉʉ embenjì bkʉʉ sàambâ. E yu ŋkʉʉ embenjì bkʉʉ sàamba wa'a, a ku ba à mʉ̀ bkʉʉ sàamba ca. Ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ e nati du fàdì' ce a be yʉ ye tɛ e kwe dʉ̀dʉ̀.
eng: The beast that was, and is not, is himself also an eighth, and is of the seven; and he goes to destruction.

lmp: "Mdoŋ rʉʉ ce wɛ̀ yɛ nà, yu bkʉʉ rʉʉ ce a bii ka' ko' mbe kʉʉ. A be ghar wowèe wɛɛ, tɛ wowèe a sa' a nyàa anà wèe àbee nfè' mʉcàr sê.
eng: The ten horns that you saw are ten kings who have received no kingdom as yet, but they receive authority as kings, with the beast, for one hour.

lmp: Bkʉʉ rrʉʉ ca a be kù tʉr ba rkwà'shî rmo'sir. Wowèe a be fa wap mnyor nè nyàa anà, ce fà' ba nè ye.
eng: These have one mind, and they give their power and authority to the beast.

lmp: Wowèe a be mà' bìr a muu njèe Nyʉ̀, tɛ Muu Njèe Nyʉ̀ so wowèe. E be so wowèe njobè' e yu ŋkʉʉ ce e càa bkʉʉ wɛɛwɛ, a ker ba Tàr ce e càa btàr wɛɛwɛ. Muu Njèe a yì bèe wèe a be so àbee. Bèe ca yu bèe ce e kɛ', a ce, à ba bèe ce a ce dù a yê mbùu nè ntee e mo'sir."
eng: These will war against the Lamb, and the Lamb will overcome them, for he is Lord of lords, and King of kings. They also will overcome who are with him, called and chosen and faithful.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Mdip ce wɛ̀ yɛ ma kwàrà cà à cu mbetar mo nà, mi tɛɛ àtu ku' bêe à mntɛ̀' wɛɛwɛ à bto' wɛɛwɛ ce a ce làa bli jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ.
eng: He said to me, The waters which you saw, where the prostitute sits, are peoples, multitudes, nations, and languages.

lmp: Nfè' mò' be ba ce mdoŋ rʉʉ ce wɛ̀ yɛ, ba nyàa cà a be bàa kwàrà ca, fàp buu ese ye wɛɛwɛ tɛ e kar mbùuriŋ. A be sɛɛ nyàa efa yê nyòr ye, kèr lòr mor tòo ye àgho."
eng: The ten horns which you saw, and the beast, these will hate the prostitute, and will make her desolate, and will make her naked, and will eat her flesh, and will burn her utterly with fire.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ a ŋwɛ̀ ce e gèe bkʉʉ ca a tʉr ntee e mo'sir, a vʉ àbee, a fa yap ŋger nè nyàa ca enɛ e sa' caar tɛ yuu ce e m làa enɛ yi be kè ba, yi geetî.
eng: For God has put in their hearts to do what he has in mind, and to be of one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast, until the words of God should be accomplished.

lmp: Njeŋwɛ̀ ce wɛ̀ m yɛ nà, yu rla' rgòr ce li ce sa' bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ.
eng: The woman whom you saw is the great city, which reigns over the kings of the earth.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' àmbò e ce sùu embe bùu. E m tʉr ŋger gòr sê. Yì nyor à m ce raa, rraa efa yê nyor anà li raa à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ.
eng: After these things, I saw another angel coming down out of the sky, having great authority. The earth was illuminated with his glory.

lmp: E m waa nè njèndoŋ ntatap enɛ̂, "Ma rla' Babilòn li gwè. Li gwè dʉ̀dʉ̀. Rla' anà à kʉti dì' ce mnyʉ̂mkà' vi ce cu. Byʉ' bebep wɛɛwɛ vi tarshi àfo. Njɛ̀ɛ bsiŋ ce bèe a kòŋ ka' vi tarshi nyor àfo.
eng: He cried with a mighty voice, saying, Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons, a prison of every unclean spirit, and a prison of every unclean and hateful bird!

lmp: A fa rla' ca ŋgɛ' njobè' li m fa mrù' sàkì nè bto' enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ, bto' ca vi no a ce sàki foŋ àmbò rli. Bkʉʉ wɛɛwɛ enjep ŋgòŋ na a m ce kɛ' rla' ca enɛ a wowèe a sakî. Li m gèe ŋgâa ntaa enjep ŋgòŋ na a tʉr mbàa njobè' li m ce yuu ku' buu ese wowèe tɛ e bo ye rbòŋ àgho."
eng: For all the nations have drunk of the wine of the wrath of her sexual immorality, the kings of the earth committed sexual immorality with her, and the merchants of the earth grew rich from the abundance of her luxury.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ mò' à sùu embe bùu a laa enɛ̂, "Fʉʉ nè efa mʉ̀ rla' anà yà bèe. Fʉʉ nè fà dì' wèe rla' ca wèe lo cʉ' mmbo tɛ wee wèe foŋ lo gèe buu bbebep ka'. Fʉʉ nè fà dì' wee wèe foŋ lo yɛ ŋgɛ' ce a be fa nè rla' anà ka'.
eng: I heard another voice from heaven, saying, Come out of her, my people, that you have no participation in her sins, and that you don't receive of her plagues,

lmp: Ku' buu bbebep anà à kù' a ba àmbò rtùu ce li sàp a ba' mbe bùu wa'a. Nyʉ̀ à kuushì buu bbebep anà.
eng: for her sins have reached to the sky, and God has remembered her iniquities.

lmp: Tɛ buu bbebep ce rla' ca li m gèe nà kʉti mbe tu mo. Tɛ ŋgɛ' ce a be fa nè rla' ca, caa yì ce li m ce fa nè bèe nà ŋkàrà' baa. Lòr nè ndoŋ ce rla' ca li m ce fa bèe mrù' njo enɛ a no nà fa li mrù' njo tɛ li no. Fa nè li ba mrù' ce mi tap a caa mrù' mi cà ŋkàrà' baa.
eng: Return to her just as she returned, and repay her double as she did, and according to her works. In the cup which she mixed, mix to her double.

lmp: Fa nè li ŋgɛ', gee tɛ li koosimnse. Gèe nè tɛ ŋgɛ' ba ŋkoosimnse rla' anà ku ba gòr foŋ àmbò ku' fòo ba ku' buu ce li m tʉr nà. Fa nè li ŋgɛ' njobè' li ce nàa tu enɛ li yu ŋkʉʉ. Li ce làa enɛ li yu ŋgwaŋkʉŋwɛ̀ ka', àde' li war à nfè' mò' ka'.
eng: However much she glorified herself, and grew wanton, so much give her of torment and mourning. For she says in her heart, 'I sit a queen, and am no widow, and will in no way see mourning.'

lmp: À ka' ba njobè' li ce làa wa'a, banɛ ku' ŋgɛ' ce li be lò yɛ nà, be gwè mbendù mo. Be ba à nòŋ ŋgɛ' anà tɛ li yaŋ, koosimnse, tɛ njè koo li, mor yi ker tòo li foŋ. À ka' ba njobè' yìsèe Ta Nyʉ̀ tʉr ŋger, banɛ ku ba ye ce e be sa' mnsa' rla' ca teni."
eng: Therefore in one day her plagues will come: death, mourning, and famine; and she will be utterly burned with fire; for the Lord God who has judged her is strong.

lmp: Bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na ce a m ce kɛ' rla' ca enɛ a wowèe a sakî, ce ye ŋgòŋ nà, a be yɛ nje efa mor ce yi be tòo rla' ca, taa mmbo mbe tù, war.
eng: The kings of the earth, who committed sexual immorality and lived wantonly with her, will weep and wail over her, when they look at the smoke of her burning,

lmp: Wowèe a be yɛ àmbò rla' ca li ce yɛ ŋgɛ', wɛp, tɛɛ ànjìsàp làa enɛ̂, "Ndòo! Ndòo! Ma rla' rgòr ce a too enɛ Babilòn ce li tʉr ŋger foŋ se nà, li ce yɛ ŋgɛ'. A ku lor ba nfè' mʉcàr, a teni wo mnsa'."
eng: standing far away for the fear of her torment, saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! For your judgment has come in one hour.'

lmp: Ŋgâa ntaa enjep ŋgòŋ na a be yɛ àmbò rla' ca li ce she tɛ a taa mmbo mbe tù war, njobè' ŋwɛ̀ ce e yuu yàp buu ntaa be kèr ba ka'.
eng: The merchants of the earth weep and mourn over her, for no one buys their merchandise any more;

lmp: Ŋgâa ntaa ca a m ce gèe ntaa nè buu ce a m gèe nè gul ba selvà ba blùr ce vi m ce là'ŋger. Ntaa bcɛ̀' ce vi m tʉr ncòo jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ a luu ntaa se nà à ker ba àgho ka'. Ntaa buu embe ndàp ce a m gèe nè mntaaŋguu ce vi m ce rʉ̀ʉ bbòŋboŋ sê, ba vì ce a m gèe nè msòŋ jù', ba vì ce a m sòp, ba buu ce a m gèe nè bco' bbòŋboŋ ba blùr, à ba àgho ka'.
eng: merchandise of gold, silver, precious stones, pearls, fine linen, purple, silk, scarlet, all expensive wood, every vessel of ivory, every vessel made of most precious wood, and of brass, and iron, and marble;

lmp: Ntaa mgʉr ce mi m ce rʉ̀ʉ bòŋboŋ à ba àgho ka'. Ntaa mrù' ba ntaa mgʉr à ba àgho ka'. Ntaa kwaa à ba àgho ka'. Ntaa nyàa àmbò nà' ba njèe ba mnyàabàrà' à ba àgho ka'. Ntaa mutù mntaaŋguu à ba àgho ka'. Ntaa bkwàa ba bèe ce a m koo à rkòŋ à ker ba àgho ka'.
eng: and cinnamon, incense, perfume, frankincense, wine, olive oil, fine flour, wheat, sheep, horses, chariots, and people's bodies and souls.

lmp: Ŋgâa ntaa cà a be làa enɛ̂, "Buu wɛɛwɛ ce wɛ̀ m kòŋ nà vi mì. Yo fòo ba ku' buu ce wɛ̀ m tʉr nà vi mì. Àde' à ker tʉr buu anà ka'."
eng: The fruits which your soul lusted after have been lost to you, and all things that were dainty and sumptuous have perished from you, and you will find them no more at all.

lmp: Bèe ce a m ce gèe ntaa a tʉr ku' buu se nà, a be yɛ àmbò rla' ca li ce yɛ ŋgɛ', wɛp, tɛɛ ànjìsàp, taa mmbo mbe tù, war, làa enɛ̂,
eng: The merchants of these things, who were made rich by her, will stand far away for the fear of her torment, weeping and mourning;

lmp: "Ndòo! Ndòo à co' rla' rgòr ca. À m ba entòmbì rla' ca li m ba àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ce e yar bcɛ̂' bbòŋboŋ ce vi m ce fʉp, mo' vi ce bàŋ. E m sùsi yì nyor nè buu ce a m gèe nè gul ba blùr ce vi ce là'ŋger.
eng: saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, she who was dressed in fine linen, purple, and scarlet, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls!

lmp: Ku' buu ce rla' ca li m tʉr wɛɛwɛ vi ku mi ba njà' mò'sir." Bèe ce a yu btu mfà' nè bèe ce a ke fà' mbe bkeŋ bgòrgòr, ba bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ke yeŋger ba enjep rò, a m tɛɛ foŋ ànjìsàp,
eng: For in an hour such great riches are made desolate.' Every shipmaster, and everyone who sails anywhere, and mariners, and as many as gain their living by sea, stood far away,

lmp: a ka' yɛ njemor efa rla' ce li m ce she, a waa, a laa enɛ̂, "Hɛbɛ̂, rla' mo' li m be ba àmbò rla' ca ka'."
eng: and cried out as they looked at the smoke of her burning, saying, 'What is like the great city?'

lmp: Wowèe a m gwè à nshè a biŋri, a waa a laa enɛ̂, "Ndòo! Ndòo à co' rla' ca. À m ba entòmbì, bèe ce a m tʉr bkeŋ bgòrgòr a ku' njo' rla' ca. Ku' buu ce rla' ca li m tʉr wɛɛwɛ vi ku mi ba njà' mò'sir."
eng: They cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and mourning, saying, 'Woe, woe, the great city, in which all who had their ships in the sea were made rich by reason of her great wealth!' For in one hour is she made desolate.

lmp: Tɛ bèe embe bùu wɛɛwɛ a lu'shi njobè' rla' Babilòn li gwè. Tɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ, ba ŋgâa ntuu nè Jisòs, ker ba ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ a lu'shi njobè' Nyʉ̀ à bepsi rla' ca njo' ŋgɛ' ce li m ce fa nè wowèe.
eng: Rejoice over her, O heaven, you saints, apostles, and prophets; for God has judged your judgment on her.

lmp: Ma ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' à lor lùr ce e m kù' àmbò ŋgò' baa wa'a, a ma' njep rò a laa enɛ̂, "A be koo ma rla' ce a too enɛ Babilòn na à ŋger, gèe tɛ li gwe wa'a, tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ker yɛ rli ka'.
eng: A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, Thus with violence will Babylon, the great city, be thrown down, and will be found no more at all.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ be kèr yu' àmbò bèe a ce bu' mluŋ, ce fyɛp mdoŋ ba msòŋ, kɛ̀ ce yòp byɛɛ àfo ka'. Bèe ce a ke fɛ̀r buu enje mmbò a be kèr ba àfo ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ be kèr yu' àmbò a ce gò' baa àfo ka'.
eng: The voice of harpists, minstrels, flute players, and trumpeters will be heard no more at all in you. No craftsman, of whatever craft, will be found any more at all in you. The sound of a mill will be heard no more at all in you.

lmp: Blam vi be kèr raa àfo ka. Mŋkà' bgùu vi be kèr ba àfo ka'. À m ba entòmbì ŋgâa ntaa ce à rla' Babilòn a ba bêe bgòrgòr njep ŋgòŋ na, ma rla' anà li ce bo' bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ à tʉ'.
eng: The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no more at all in you; for your merchants were the princes of the earth; for with your sorcery all the nations were deceived.

lmp: Blɛɛ ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ ba blɛɛ bèe Nyʉ̀ mò' wɛɛwɛ, ker ba blɛɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a yʉshi njep ŋgòŋ na, vi yu mbe tu rla' anà."
eng: In her was found the blood of prophets and of saints, and of all who have been slain on the earth.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, yuu mo' yi coo mɛ̀ mbà tù' embe bùu àmbò mnjèndoŋ ma kʉr bèe wa'a. A m ce yòp yɛɛ enɛ̂, "Àlèluyà! Rlùŋ ba fòo ba ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi ba mba yê mmbò.
eng: After these things I heard something like a loud voice of a great multitude in heaven, saying, Hallelujah! Salvation, power, and glory belong to our God:

lmp: E yu ŋwɛ̂ mini. E ke sa' mnsa', teni à njî yɛɛnì. E fa ŋgɛ' nè ma kwàrà ce e m bepsi ŋgòŋ nè sàkì nà. E kʉsi mcucu' nè kwàrà ca njobè' e m yʉshi yì bèe ce a m ce fà' nè ye."
eng: for true and righteous are his judgments. For he has judged the great prostitute, who corrupted the earth with her sexual immorality, and he has avenged the blood of his servants at her hand.

lmp: Wowèe a ker yop enɛ̂, "Àlèluyà! Rla' ca li ce she, tɛ njemor yi ko' mbekì, mì à nfè' mò' ka'."
eng: A second said, Hallelujah! Her smoke goes up forever and ever.

lmp: Bêe bgòrgòr ce a m ba ncòp-kyèe-à-mmbaa nà ker ba buu btèe ce vi m ba kyèe nà, a gʉ'shì nè Nyʉ̀ ce e m cu mbe kàbàrà', a laa enɛ̂, "Yi yu wa'a! Àlèluyà."
eng: The twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and worshiped God who sits on the throne, saying, Amen! Hallelujah!

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ à làa embe kàbàrà' enɛ̂, "Bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a yu ŋgâa mfà' nè Nyʉ̀, a ce wɛp Nyʉ̀ foŋ nà, a yoŋshi yìsèe Nyʉ̀. Kɛ̀ yu bêe bgòrgòr ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bêe bkɛ'kɛ' ɛ̀, yòŋshi nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: A voice came forth from the throne, saying, Give praise to our God, all you his servants, you who fear him, the small and the great!

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' yuu mo' yi coo mɛ̀ mbà tù' àmbò njèndoŋ ma kʉr bèe wa'a. Njèndoŋ anà à m ba àmbò njèndoŋ rdip ce li ce gwè à rkoŋ wa'a, a ker waŋger àmbò mbèŋ wa'a. Njèndoŋ anà à m waa enɛ̂, "Àlèluyà. Nyʉ̀ ce e yu yìsèe Tatâ, ce e tʉr buu wɛɛwɛ mba yê mmbò, yu ŋkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na sè'ni.
eng: I heard something like the voice of a great multitude, and like the voice of many waters, and like the voice of mighty thunders, saying, Hallelujah! For the Lord our God, the Almighty, reigns!

lmp: Sèe yu' rbòŋ, lu'shi, ku'si Nyʉ̀, njobè' nfè' à ghɛɛ ce Muu Njèe be tarshi bgùu. Ŋgwa yì à tami nyor à bgùu anà foŋ.
eng: Let us rejoice and be exceedingly glad, and let us give the glory to him. For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and his wife has made herself ready.

lmp: Nyʉ̀ à fa ŋgwagùu anà bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ ce vi ce raa a ce là'ŋger sê, enɛ e yar." Bcɛ̀' ca vi tɛɛ àtu mfâ' mmbòŋmboŋ ce bèe Nyʉ̀ a gèe.
eng: It was given to her that she would array herself in bright, pure, fine linen: for the fine linen is the righteous acts of the saints.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m làa nè mɛ̀ nà à ker laa enɛ̂, "Saŋ blàa ca: "Mbôŋtu mi yu nè bèe ce a be wowèe à ŋkâ' bgùu yi Muu Njèe."" E ker laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Blàa ca à làa ba Nyʉ̀ seesê."
eng: He said to me, Write, 'Blessed are those who are invited to the marriage supper of the Lamb.' He said to me, These are true words of God.

lmp: Mɛ̀ ka' yu' wa'a, a gwe njeptii ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà enɛ m bo gʉ'shi nè ye. E laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Fa gèe wa' ka'. M ku ba ŋwɛ̀ ce m ce gèe rfà' Nyʉ̀ àmbò wɛ̂ gèe foŋ nà. M ku ba ŋwɛ̀ rfà' nè Nyʉ̀ àmbò wèe bfʉr wo wèe yu nà. M ku ba àmbò bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a tɛɛ tatap, a ce làa enɛ Jisòs yu yàp Tatâ. Gʉ'shi nè ba nè Nyʉ̀ cà'cà'. Nsuŋ Jisòs yu ntee efa ntuu Nyʉ̀."
eng: I fell down before his feet to worship him. He said to me, Look! Don't do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers who hold the testimony of Jesus. Worship God, for the testimony of Jesus is the Spirit of Prophecy.

lmp: Cena yi ka' mì, mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò rbuu li mʉ̀'ti. Li ka' mʉ̀'ti, mɛ̀ yɛ nyàabàrâ' mbʉʉ. Rlii ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe nyàabàrà' anà li m ba enɛ̂, "Ŋwɛ̀ mini ce àde' bèe a foosì." E ke sa' mnsa' yɛɛnì, ku ma' ba bìr ce e ba mà'.
eng: I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and he who sat on it is called Faithful and True. In righteousness he judges and makes war.

lmp: Mi mmir mi yu àmbò mcùŋ mor wa'a. E sòp mtaa kʉʉ mbe yê tù àŋgoo. A saŋ rlii mo' a yê nyòr, à ku riŋ ba ye a riŋ rlii anà.
eng: His eyes are a flame of fire, and on his head are many crowns. He has names written and a name written which no one knows but he himself.

lmp: E mà' sàaro ce a fʉ̀ʉ njep blɛɛ. A too li rlii enɛ̂, "Nlàa Nyʉ̀."
eng: He is clothed in a garment sprinkled with blood. His name is called The Word of God.

lmp: Ŋgâa mà' bìr embe bùu wɛɛwɛ a m ce dù a yê mbùu. Wowèe a m yar bcɛ̂' bbʉʉ ce mʉ ncòo mò' à m ba àgho ka', a cute mbe mnyàabàrâ' bbʉʉ.
eng: The armies which are in heaven followed him on white horses, clothed in white, pure, fine linen.

lmp: Sà' mbyɛ̀rɛŋ à m fʉʉ eku yê cùu. À m ba sà' ce e be so bto' ce a bàa ye àgho. E be lòr yì mbàŋ kʉʉ ce a gèe nè bco', sa' wowèe àgho. E be nyɛ̀ŋ grɛ̂p ce a m ceni nà njep bè'tè ce a ke nyɛ̀ŋ. Rnyɛ̀ŋ efa gho li tɛɛ àtu ku' rshentee Nyʉ̀ ce ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba yê mmbò.
eng: Out of his mouth proceeds a sharp, double-edged sword, that with it he should strike the nations. He will rule them with an iron rod. He treads the winepress of the fierceness of the wrath of God, the Almighty.

lmp: A m saŋ rlii a yê cɛ̀' ce e m mà' à nyòr ker ba a yi kɛ'shi. Rlii ce a m saŋ anà li m ba enɛ̂, "Ŋkʉʉ ce e càa bkʉʉ wɛɛwɛ. Tata ce e càa btata wɛɛwɛ."
eng: He has on his garment and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' àmbò e tɛɛ à nyʉ̀. E m waa a kɛ'shi bsiŋ ce vi ke ye bgʉ̂ʉ buu, a laa nè vi enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ nè àbee ye ku' ŋkà' ce Nyʉ̀ à kɛ'.
eng: I saw an angel standing in the sun. He cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in the sky, Come! Be gathered together to the great supper of God,

lmp: Vʉ̀ nè ye bgʉ̂ʉ bkʉʉ, ba bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ce a m ba btu nè bsoogɛ̀, ker ba bgʉ̂ʉ bêe bgòrgòr. Vʉ̀ nè ye bgʉ̂ʉ mnyàabàrà' ba bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ce a m ce caŋ mbo. Vʉ̀ nè ye bgʉ̂ʉ bèe wɛɛwɛ, kɛ̀ yu bkwàa ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu boo ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bêe bgòrgòr ɛ̀, kɛ̀ yu bêe bkɛ'kɛ' ɛ̀, ye nè bgʉ̀ʉ efa gho."
eng: that you may eat the flesh of kings, the flesh of captains, the flesh of mighty men, and the flesh of horses and of those who sit on them, and the flesh of all men, both free and slave, and small and great.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò nà à vʉ̀ àbee a bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na ker ba bsoogɛ̀ ce a yu njeptii bkʉʉ ca. Wowèe a m vʉ̀ àbee tɛ a bo mà' bìr a ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe nyàabàrâ' mbʉʉ nà ba bsoogɛ̀ ce a m ba njep yê tìi.
eng: I saw the beast, and the kings of the earth, and their armies, gathered together to make war against him who sat on the horse, and against his army.

lmp: A m koo nyàa ca ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce nya' mnde' enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, à ker ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce gèe buu bbɛ̀ɛ à bsii nyàa ca nà. E m gèe buu bbɛ̀ɛ anà a bo' bèe ce a m fa wowèe ncòo nyàa ca, wowèe a ker ce gʉ'shi nè blaŋ nyàa ca nà. A m koo nyàa ca ba ŋwɛ̀ mnde' ca a ma' wowèe btèe njep ma mor ce mkàŋ mi ce she njo.
eng: The beast was taken, and with him the false prophet who worked the signs in his sight, with which he deceived those who had received the mark of the beast and those who worshiped his image. These two were thrown alive into the lake of fire that burns with sulfur.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe nyàabàrâ' mbʉʉ nà à lor sà' ce e m ba ku yê cùu nà a yʉshi bɛr bèe ce a m ce dù àmbùu nyàa anà àgho, bsiŋ vi vʉ a ye bgʉ̂ʉ bèe ca, a sɛ̂.
eng: The rest were killed with the sword of him who sat on the horse, the sword which came forth out of his mouth. All the birds were filled with their flesh.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ àmbò ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' ce sùu embe bùu, a tʉr ki ce a ke mʉ' rwee ce lʉ̀simbùu yu àgho ka' nà àgho. E m tʉr ma shaŋ ŋgòr mbà bò.
eng: I saw an angel coming down out of heaven, having the key of the abyss and a great chain in his hand.

lmp: E m koo nyàa ce e m feese nyàarò nà a kyɛɛ nè shaŋ anà, e cu àgho à bfè' ncʉ̀kì. Nyàa ca yu nyo ce e m ba elûuŋgòŋ, à ba nyàa ce a ce too rlii efa gho enɛ nyʉ̀rkà', a ker ce too rmo' enɛ Satàn nà.
eng: He seized the dragon, the old serpent, which is the devil and Satan, who deceives the whole inhabited earth, and bound him for a thousand years,

lmp: E m koo ye a ma' njep rwee ce lʉ̀simbùu yu àgho ka'. A ka' mà' njo a li' cùu efa gho, a siŋ nè ncòo Nyʉ̀. E m gèe wa'a tɛ e bo cu njo à bfè' ncʉ̀kì, kèr tʉr njì à rbo' bèe enjep ŋgòŋ ka'. Bfè' ncʉ̀kì ca vi mì, tɛ a ku fʉr ye enjo à mʉ nfè' mò'.
eng: and cast him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the thousand years were finished. After this, he must be freed for a short time.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ bkàbàrà', a yɛ bèe ce a m cu mbe bkàbàrà' anà. A m fa bèe anà ŋger enɛ a sa' bèe. Mɛ̀ yɛ myòŋ bèe ce a m ceeshi wowèe btu njobè' wowèe a m ce suŋ bèe enɛ wowèe a byemi nè Jisòs, a ker ce fè'shi blâa Nyʉ̀ nà. Bèe ca a bèe ce a m gʉ'shi nè nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò nà ka', a ker gʉ'shi nè blaŋ nyàa anà ka'. Wowèe a m kani foŋ enɛ a fa fa wowèe ncòo nyàa anà nje nsàpsi kɛ̀ à bò ka'. Bèe ca a m kweŋger, a fʉʉ efa rkwe, a Jisos Krâis wèe a sa' àbee à bfè' ncʉ̀kì.
eng: I saw thrones, and they sat on them, and judgment was given to them. I saw the souls of those who had been beheaded for the testimony of Jesus, and for the word of God, and such as didn't worship the beast nor his image, and didn't receive the mark on their forehead and on their hand. They lived, and reigned with Christ for a thousand years.

lmp: Cena yu nfʉʉ efa rkwe ce entòmbì. Bɛr bèe ce a m kweŋger nà a m ker fʉʉ efa rkwe ka', caar tɛ bfè' ncʉ̀kì ca vi mî.
eng: The rest of the dead didn't live until the thousand years were finished. This is the first resurrection.

lmp: Bèe ce a ka' ke fʉʉ efa rkwe entombì banɛ wowèe a yu ŋgâa mbôŋtu a ba bêe brara. Rkwe embenjì li be jòo wowèe ka'. Wowèe a be ba ŋgâa taŋshi taŋshì nè Nyʉ̀ ba Krâis, sa' a Krâis wèe à bfè' ncʉ̀kì.
eng: Blessed and holy is he who has part in the first resurrection. Over these, the second death has no power, but they will be priests of God and of Christ, and will reign with him one thousand years.

lmp: Bfè' ncʉ̀kì ca vi be mì tɛ a fʉr Satàn efa shaŋ,
eng: And after the thousand years, Satan will be released from his prison,

lmp: tɛ e du à bto' ce vi yu à mmbuu ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ, bo' bto' anà. A too bto' anà enɛ Gok ba Magòk. E be vʉ̀ nè bto' ca àbee tɛ vi bo mà' bìr. Ŋgâa mà' bìr anà a be ba gòr àmbò nsaruŋ wa'a.
eng: and he will come out to deceive the nations which are in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war; the number of whom is as the sand of the sea.

lmp: Wowèe a be dù à ŋgòŋ wɛɛwɛ, sìr dì' ce bèe Nyʉ̀ a yu, ce yu rla' ce Nyʉ̀ kòŋ se nà, kaari tarte. Wowèe a be sìr wa'a, tɛ mor yi suu embe bùu tòo wowèe.
eng: They went up over the breadth of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints, and the beloved city. Fire came down out of heaven from God, and devoured them.

lmp: A be koo Nyʉ̀rkà' ce e m bo' bèe anà nà, mà' njep ma mor ce mkàŋ mi m ce she njo. A dì' ce nyàa ce e m fʉʉ enjep rò nà ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e m ce nya' mnde' enɛ e yu ŋwɛ̀ ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀ nà a yu. Wowèe a be cu njo, yɛ mlù nètʉ' ba nèmootì, kù yɛ wa'a nfesè.
eng: The devil who deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire and sulfur, where the beast and the false prophet are also. They will be tormented day and night forever and ever.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ ma kàbàrâ' bʉʉ, a yɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbo. Ŋwɛ̀ ca à ka' nyɛɛ, nshe ba rbuu a da' a bʉ, a ker yɛɛti ka'.
eng: I saw a great white throne, and him who sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away. There was found no place for them.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ bêe bgòrgòr ba bêe bkɛ'kɛ' ce a m kweŋger àmbò a tɛɛ kùntombì nè kàbàrà' anà. A m mʉ̀' mŋwà'. A m ker mʉ' ŋwà' mo', ŋwà' anà à ba ŋwâ' ryòŋ. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe kàbàrà' nà à m fyɛ' mbe mŋwà' ce a m saŋ mfà' bèe ce a m kweŋger anà mbo, a teni mnsa' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ àmbò mi mfà' mi m ba.
eng: I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened, which is the book of life. The dead were judged out of the things which were written in the books, according to their works.

lmp: Bèe wɛɛwɛ a m ba àfo. Bèe ce a m kweŋger njep rdip rgòr a m fʉʉ enjo. Bèe ce a m kweŋger, a ba mbà yir a vʉ embâ, a sa' wowèe, a teni mnsa' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ àmbò mi mfà' mi m ba.
eng: The sea gave up the dead who were in it. Death and Hades gave up the dead who were in them. They were judged, each one according to his works.

lmp: A ka' teni mnsa' wɛɛ, a lor rkwe ba ŋgòŋ embà yir a ma' njep ma mor cà. Ma mor anà yu rkwe embenjì.
eng: Death and Hades were thrown into the lake of fire. This is the second death, the lake of fire.

lmp: A m koo bèe ce a m saŋ map mlii mbe ŋwâ' ryòŋ ka', a ma' njep ma mor anà.
eng: If anyone was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ rbuu rfi ba nshe nfi. Rbuu ce li m ba entombì ba nshe ce e m ba entombì à m bʉ, rdip rgòr li bʉ foŋ.
eng: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yɛ rla' rrara ce a m ce too enɛ Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ce nfi àmbò li ce sùu embe bùu. À m sùusi Nyʉ̀ a suusi li. Li m bòŋ àmbò njeŋwɛ̀ ce e sùsi nyor tɛ e bo dù mbe ndàp nduu yì wa'a.
eng: I saw the holy city, New Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God, prepared like a bride adorned for her husband.

lmp: Mɛ̀ yu' àmbò njèndoŋ ntatap à làa embe kàbàrà' enɛ̂, "Rla' Nyʉ̀ li yu sè'ni ba à mʉ bèe. E be cu a wowèe tɛ wowèe a ba yì bèe. Nyʉ̀ seese be ba a wowèe, ba yàp Nyʉ̀.
eng: I heard a loud voice out of heaven saying, Behold, God's dwelling is with people, and he will dwell with them, and they will be his people, and God himself will be with them as their God.

lmp: E be siŋsi map mŋgoommir wɛɛwɛ. Rkwe li be kèr ba àgho ka', ŋkoosimnse ba àgho ka', rwar li ba àgho ka', ryaŋ li ba àgho ka', njobè' buu brʉ̀ʉ à mì dʉ̀dʉ̀."
eng: He will wipe away from them every tear from their eyes. Death will be no more; neither will there be mourning, nor crying, nor pain, any more. The first things have passed away.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m cu mbe kàbàrà' nà à laa enɛ̂, "Yɛ̂, m be gèe ba buu bfi sè'ni." E m ker laa enɛ̂, "Saŋ blàa ca njobè' yu blàa ce àde' vi caa à cicì ka', vi yu mini."
eng: He who sits on the throne said, Behold, I am making all things new. He said, Write, for these words of God are faithful and true.

lmp: E m ker laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "La rfà' li mì. M yu Alfà, a ba Òmɛgà. A mɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ ce e m kɛ̀' buu wɛɛwɛ, a ba ŋwɛ̀ ce e be mìsi buu anà. Ŋ wɛ̀ ce ntee mdip yi ka' ce lùu ye, banɛ m be sɛp mdip enjep rdip ryòŋ fa ye tɛ e no à cicì.
eng: He said to me, It is done! I am the Alpha and the Omega, the Beginning and the End. I will give freely to him who is thirsty from the spring of the water of life.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' so, banɛ ŋgàŋ be koni buu ca wɛɛwɛ. M be ba yì Nyʉ̀, tɛ e ba muu wà.
eng: He who overcomes, I will give him these things. I will be his God, and he will be my son.

lmp: À ka' ba yi àmbò bèe ce a yu ŋgâa bwɛp, ba bèe ce a yu mini ka', ba ŋgâa bsàrbuu, ba ŋgâa nyʉshi bèe, a be fa wowèe ŋgɛ'. Bèe ce a ce sàki, ba ŋgâa tʉ', ba bèe ce a ce gʉ'shi nè mnyʉ̀ enjep ŋgòŋ na, ba ŋgâa mnde', a be fa wowèe ŋgɛ' foŋ. A be koo wowèe wɛɛwɛ mà' njep ma mor ce mkàŋ mi ce she njo. Ŋgɛ' ca yu rkwe embenjì."
eng: But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars, their part is in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur, which is the second death.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ mò' efa mʉ̀ bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ce a m tʉr bghee sàambâ, mŋgɛ' vi ba njo nà à vʉ a laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀ tɛ m duŋshi wɛ̀ ŋgwagùu ce e yu ŋgwa Muu Njèe."
eng: One of the seven angels who had the seven bowls, who were loaded with the seven last plagues came, and he spoke with me, saying, Come here. I will show you the wife, the Lamb's bride.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m ba mbà mmbo Yʉ' Rara, ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à lor mɛ̀ a du àgho mbe tu ma rtùu ce li m sàp sê. Wèr ye à ka' bà' mbo, e duŋshì mɛ̀ Jɛ̀rusalɛ̀m ce yu rla' rrara ce li m lò ese Nyʉ̀, àmbò li ce sùu embe bùu.
eng: He carried me away in the Spirit to a great and high mountain, and showed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of heaven from God,

lmp: Rraa Nyʉ̀ li m ce saŋ à rla' anà, rla' anà li ce là'ŋger àmbò lùr ce a too enɛ jaspà, a ce raaŋger àmbò kwakwa' wa'a.
eng: having the glory of God. Her light was like a most precious stone, as if it was a jasper stone, clear as crystal;

lmp: A m boo ŋka' ce yi m sàp sê, a sir rla' anà àgho a tarte. Bcùu efa ŋka' anà vi m ba ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ. Bcìndap Nyʉ̀ ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ a m ce kè'ni bcùu ŋka' anà. A m saŋ mlii mntɛ̂' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̂ʉ à to' Isrɛ̀l à bcùu efa gho wɛɛwɛ.
eng: having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels; and names written on them, which are the names of the twelve tribes of the children of Israel.

lmp: Mŋgʉ̀' ŋka' kyèe anà wɛɛwɛ vi m tʉr bcùu vi btaar btaar. Bcùu vi btaar vi m ba à ŋgʉ̀' ekù mbùuntii, bcùu vi btaar vi ba à yì embà mbùuntii. Bɛr mŋgʉ̀' ŋka' bbaa vi m tʉr bcùu vi btaar btaar foŋ.
eng: On the east were three gates; and on the north three gates; and on the south three gates; and on the west three gates.

lmp: A m boo ŋka' anà mbendù blùr ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ. A m saŋ mlii bèe ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ ce a m ba ŋgâa ntuu nè Muu Njeè mbe blùr anà.
eng: The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m ce làa nè mɛ̀ nà à m tʉr mʉ co' sàsap ce a m gèe nè gûl. À m ba co' ce a m ce fè' buu àgho. E m tʉr co' anà tɛ e bo fè' rla' ca, fè' ŋka' ce a boo a sir rla' ca àgho, kèr fè' bcùu ŋka' anà.
eng: He who spoke with me had for a measure, a golden reed, to measure the city, its gates, and its walls.

lmp: Bsàp ba bbɛ̀r efa rla' anà vi m ku ba yɛɛnì. Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ à ka' fè' rla' anà, bsàp efa gho vi ba bkìlomɛtà ncʉ̀kì-baa nè mnjêe-mmbaa ba ncòp- baa-à-mmbaa. 2,222 Bbɛ̀r efa gho vi ku ba wa'a. Bsàp embekì vi ku ba foŋ wa'a.
eng: The city lies foursquare, and its length is as great as its breadth. He measured the city with the reed, Twelve thousand twelve stadia. Its length, breadth, and height are equal.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ca à m ku fe' àmbò bèe a m ce fè'. E m fè' bsàp embekì efa ŋka' anà vi ba mmɛtà ncòp-ta-à-msàambâ.
eng: Its wall is one hundred forty-four cubits, by the measure of a man, that is, of an angel.

lmp: A m boo ŋka' anà nè blùr ce vi m ce raaŋger àmbò kwakwa', a boo rla' mbe mʉ̀ mo nè gul ce e m ce raaŋger àmbò glâs.
eng: The construction of its wall was jasper. The city was pure gold, like pure glass.

lmp: A m lòr blùr ce vi m ba jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ, a tʉr mlii jɛɛ jɛ̀ɛ jɛɛ a boo kùu ŋka' anà àgho. Blùr anà vi m ba ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ. Mlii efa gho mi m ba enɛ̂: jaspà, ba safɛ̀r, ba agɛ̀r, ba emɛràl,
eng: The foundations of the city's wall were adorned with all kinds of precious stones. The first foundation was jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

lmp: ba onìk, ba kàniliyàn, ba kwôt, ba bɛ̀rîl, ba topàs, ba krisoprɛ̀s, ba jasìn, ker ba amɛtìs.
eng: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, jacinth; and the twelfth, amethyst.

lmp: A m gèe bcùu ŋka' ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ anà nè njɛ̀ɛ blùr mo' ce a m ce too enɛ, "Pɛ̂l." Blùr anà vi m ba ncòp-baa-à-rrʉ̀ʉ a ghɛɛte à bcùu efa gho wɛɛwɛ. A m gèe mnduunjî à rla' ca nè gul ce e m ce raaŋger àmbò glâs.
eng: The twelve gates were twelve pearls. Each one of the gates was made of one pearl. The street of the city was pure gold, like transparent glass.

lmp: Mɛ̀ m yɛ Ndap Nyʉ̀ à rla' anà ka' njobè' yìsèe Ta Nyʉ̀ ce ŋger wɛɛwɛ yi yu mba yê mmbò, ba muu njèe a m ba à rla' anà.
eng: I saw no temple in it, for the Lord God, the Almighty, and the Lamb, are its temple.

lmp: Mbùu mò' à m ker ba enɛ nyʉ̀ ce e ke saŋ na ba ŋwɛɛ a saŋ à rla' anà ka', njobè' rraa Nyʉ̀ li m ce saŋ àfo, muu njèe à ba lam efa rla' anà.
eng: The city has no need for the sun, neither of the moon, to shine, for the very glory of God illuminated it, and its lamp is the Lamb.

lmp: Bèe enjep ŋgòŋ na a be yɛ dì' ce a ce dù, njo' rraa anà. Bkʉʉ enjep ŋgòŋ na a be lòr bkù' ce a tʉr wɛɛwɛ dù àgho à rla' anà.
eng: The nations will walk in its light. The kings of the earth bring the glory and honor of the nations into it.

lmp: Bcùu ŋka' ce a sìr rla' anà àgho vi be kù tɛɛ btoo à nfè' wɛɛwɛ. A be cete ka' njobè' àde' tʉ̀' sii à rla' anà ka'.
eng: Its gates will in no way be shut by day for there will be no night there,

lmp: A be vʉ̀ nè ku' bkù' enjep ŋgòŋ na wɛɛwɛ lɛ̀ à rla' anà.
eng: and they shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into it so that they may enter.

lmp: Àde' yuu bebep yi ba' à rla' anà ka'. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' ba ŋwɛ̀ bsàrbuu, kɛ̀ ŋwɛ̀ mnde' ɛ̀, àde' e niŋ à rla' anà ka'. Bèe ce a be niŋ à rla' anà ku ba ba bèe ce a m saŋ map mlii mbe ŋwâ' ryòŋ muu njèe.
eng: There will in no way enter into it anything profane, or one who causes an abomination or a lie, but only those who are written in the Lamb's book of life.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à m dùŋshi mɛ̀ rdip ce li ke fa ryòŋ, li ce là'ŋger àmbò glâs. Rdip anà li m ce fʉʉ enje kàbàrà' ce tʉr Nyʉ̀ ba muu njèe.
eng: He showed me a river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

lmp: Li m ce càa mbe ntòŋ nduunjì efa rla' anà. Bce ce mbàŋ efa gho yi ke fa ryòŋ vi m tɛɛ àwâa rdip anà, mo' à bo ŋkòp, mo' à bo mà'. Mbàŋ yi m ce yʉ mbo à mŋwɛɛ ncòp-baa enjep fè'. Bfù efa gho à m ba mcɛ̀p. A m ce jà' bêe à bto' wɛɛwɛ ce a m ce yaŋ àgho.
eng: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

lmp: Àde' yuu ce yi yu bebep à bsii Nyʉ̀ yi ker ba ka'. Yuu ce yi be ba à rla' anà be ba kàbàrà' ce tʉr Nyʉ̀ ba muu njèe. Yì bèe ce a ce dù a yê mbùu a be gʉ'shi nè ye à rla' anà.
eng: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.

lmp: Wowèe a be yɛ bsii Nyʉ̀, tɛ a saŋ rlii Nyʉ̀ nje wâp mnsàpsi.
eng: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

lmp: Àde' tʉ̀' ker sii ka'. Mbùu mò' be ba enɛ blam vi ba àfo tɛ vi bo ce raa, kɛ̀ enɛ nyʉ̀ saŋ àfo ka', njobè' Tàr Nyʉ̀ be ba rraa nè wowèe. Wowèe a be sa' àmbò bkʉʉ nfesè.
eng: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ca à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Àde' blàa ca vi caa à cici ka', vi yu mini. Tàr Nyʉ̀ ce e ke fa yi yʉ' nè yi ŋgâa ncep ntuu, a ŋwɛ̀ ce e tuu yì ncìndap enɛ e vʉ yɛ bèe ce a ce fà' nè ye, duŋshi wowèe buu ce ku bɛti nfè' mʉcàr tɛ vi koni."
eng: He said to me, These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.

lmp: "Yɛ̂, m ce vʉ̀ sè'ni sè'ni. Mbôŋtu mi yu nè bèe ce a ce gèe buu ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ca."
eng: Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e m yu' buu ca, a ker yɛ vi nè mmir a mɛ̂ Jôn. Mɛ̀ ka' yu' buu ca, yɛ vi, a gwe njeptii ncìndap Nyʉ̀ ce e m dùŋshi mɛ̀ buu ca tɛ m bo gʉ'shi nè ye.
eng: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

lmp: Ncìndap Nyʉ̀ anà à laa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Fa gèe wa' ka'. M ku ba ŋwɛ̀ ce m ce gèe rfà' Nyʉ̀ àmbò wɛ̂ gèe foŋ nà. M ku ba àmbò wɛ̀ ba bfʉr wo ce a yu ŋgâa ncep ntuu Nyʉ̀, a ker ba àmbò bèe wɛɛwɛ ce a ce gèe buu ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ca. Gʉ'shi ba nè Nyʉ̀."
eng: He said to me, See you don't do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.

lmp: E m làa nè mɛ̀ enɛ̂, "Fa sʉ̀ti blàa ce a saŋ mbe Ŋwâ' Nyʉ̀ na ese bèe ka'. Gèe tɛ bèe wɛɛwɛ a yu', njobè' nfè' ce buu ca be koni yu àtʉtʉ.
eng: He said to me, Don't seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

lmp: Mà'shi tɛ ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe buu bbebep ku ce gèe yì buu bbebep anà. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe bsàrbuu ku ce gèe vi bsàrbuu. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ce gèe ŋgêe yɛɛnì ku ce gèe yɛɛnì. Ŋwɛ̂ nrara ku cu à ŋwɛ̂ nrara."
eng: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.

lmp: Yɛ̂, m ce vʉ̀ sè'ni sè'ni. M be vʉ̀ nè blà' tɛ m bo là' ŋwɛ̀ wɛɛwɛ àmbò li rfà' li yu.
eng: Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

lmp: Yʉ' Nyʉ̀ ba ŋgwagùu ce muu njèe à lòr a làa enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀." Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yu' blàa ca banɛ ŋgàŋ laa foŋ enɛ̂, "Vʉ̀." Ŋwɛ̀ ce ntee mdip yi ka' ce lùu ye, e koŋ enɛ e ba no mdip enjep rdip ce li ke fa ryòŋ, banɛ ŋgàŋ vʉ no mdip anà à cicì.
eng: The Spirit and the bride say, Come! He who hears, let him say, Come! He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

lmp: M ce bɛɛ wèe. Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' yu' blàa ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ca, ce yu blàa ce vi lò ese Nyʉ̀, kyese yuu mo' mbendù mo, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be lòr ku' ŋgɛ' ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ca, kyèse mbendù ŋgɛ' ce ŋgàŋ be yɛ.
eng: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to them, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e ka' co' yuu mo' efa gho, banɛ Nyʉ̀ be mà'shi tɛ e ye mbàŋ ce ce yi ke fa ryòŋ, ce a suŋ mbe ŋwà' ca nà ka'. E be mà'shi tɛ ŋgàŋ niŋ à rla' Nyʉ̀ ce a saŋ mbe ŋwà' ca foŋ nà ka'.
eng: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, may God take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

lmp: Ŋwɛ̀ ce e suŋ buu ca à làa enɛ̂, "Yi yu mini, m ce vʉ̀ sè'ni sè'ni." Yi yu wa'a. Vʉ̀, Tata Jisòs.
eng: He who testifies these things says, Yes, I come quickly. Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

lmp: M ce loo mɛnɛ Tata Jisòs tʉr ntee bòŋboŋ nè bèe Nyʉ̀ wɛɛwɛ. Yi yu wa'a.
eng: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
